title: Territory Manager
description:
**Company Description**  

Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because **Good Health Can’t Wait**.


We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.


For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).


‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose\-driven, future\-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1\.5 Bn\+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency


Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ \& nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

 **Job Description** **Job Summary**  

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic individual for the position of “Territory Manger” for driving the sales strategy and achieving business goals within your designated region, for executing the product management team's strategies, gathering customer feedback, and providing crucial insights for the development of new products. Your key focus will be on establishing and nurturing relationships with key opinion leaders, monitoring competitor information, and understanding prescription trends within the pharmaceutical industry. Additionally, you will be responsible for organizing and managing Continuing Medical Education (CME) events and other initiatives to bolster the company's brand image.  

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**  

* You will be responsible for the promotion of the new product. You will be executing the Product Management Team’s marketing strategy, analysing market trends, consulting with doctors on new product potential, and relaying feedback to the Product Management Team. Additionally, responsibilities include identifying key opinion leaders, monitoring product availability, and implementing brand strategies to facilitate a successful product launch.
* You will be responsible for monitoring primary and secondary sales through regular visits to stockists and pharmacies, ensuring the accomplishment of doctor and product\-specific sales objectives. Active participation in monthly review meetings to assess coverage, adherence to SOPs, and expense management, all aimed at achieving area\-level, product\-level, and overall sales targets.
* You will be responsible for focusing on customer relationship management, the role entails establishing strong connections and addressing queries promptly using Infoginip. It also involves customer classification based on potential, determining meeting frequency accordingly, and tracking return on investment per customer to foster a loyal customer base for the company.
* You will responsible to meet Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Key business leader (KEL) frequently and pursue them to conduct CME with the company; Collect interest areas of key customers and hospitals and conduct CMEs on those topics.
* You will responsible to prepare product matrix depending upon doctor's potential \& preference and decide which product will fit doctor's need. Update data on chemist, doctors and Retail Chemist Prescription Audit (RCPA) through palm top to Unnati portal in order to ensure all stakeholders' access to latest information.
 **Qualifications** **Educational qualification\-** Graduate with science background.  

  

**Minimum work experience\-** 6 months of experience in pharmaceutical sales.  

  

**Skills \& attributes**  

**Technical Skills**  

* Basic understanding of pharmaceutical products and marketing
* Experience in implementing and analysing sales and marketing strategies.
* Basic knowledge of Computers.


  

**Behavioural Skills**  

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good at building and leveraging relationship.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong Decision making skills.
 **Additional Information** **About the Department**  

**Global Generics India**  

Global Generics India business journey began in 1986\. In the last three decades, we have grown as a trusted name in the healthcare industry and rank as one of the top 10 Pharma Companies in the Indian Pharma Market (IPM) as per IQVIA MAT (November 2022\). Our commitment to Lead Ahead has helped us move ranks from 16th position to 10th position (IPM) in the last four years. We are a fast\-growing organisation with double\-digit growth and significant market share in domestic markets. Currently, we rank among the top 5 in oncology, anti\-allergy and gastrointestinal diseases and the top 10 in a few other therapy areas. Our focus is on leveraging our digital capabilities, collaborations, innovations and inorganic opportunities to become the top 5 companies in the Indian Pharma Market.  

  

**Benefits Offered**  

At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.  

The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining \& relocation support, family support (Maternity \& Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.  

  

**Our Work Culture**  

Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.  

For more details, please visit our career website at **https://careers.drreddys.com/\#!/**

description:
**Job Description**
 As an Analyst within the Global Technology Controllers in Corporate Sector Controllers, you will be responsible for providing controllership support to the technology function, including accounting for technology in accordance with US GAAP and JPMC standards.
   

  

 Global Technology Controller provide controllership support to technology function in to Hardware, Software, Professional services and other direct expense lines. Team is also responsible for capitalization of tangible or intangible assets.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Determine expense versus capitalization treatment, ensure timely disposal recognition, and post close entries with appropriate support and approvals.
* Partner with Technology, P\&A, Business Management, and Procurement to align on project scope, in\-service dates, and cutover timing, and maintain SOX\-compliant controls and audit\-ready evidence.
* Perform ongoing review of work\-in\-process ledger balances, including aging analysis, root\-cause identification, and timely clearing to fixed assets or expense when criteria are met.
* Reconcile WIP balances to upstream project and procurement systems and validate against purchase orders, capitalization requests, and approvals.
* Capitalize qualifying assets by evaluating projects against thresholds and criteria and determining start/stop capitalization dates, place\-in\-service dates, useful lives, and residual values.
* Validate operational impacts and future benefit assumptions with Technology and business stakeholders and record entries accurately and timely in the general ledger.
* Ensure balance sheet positions are appropriately supported to maintain a strong fortress balance sheet.
* Document analytics through estimates, walk\-forwards, controller financial reviews, and flash reports.
* Analyze, communicate, and resolve material variances between the general ledger and upstream systems, as defined by the line of business.


**Required Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities**
* 3 years of related experience
* General Ledger experience
* Experience with financial reporting and month end close responsibilities
* Comfortable liaising with business and risk managers
* Able to build and maintain partnerships within the various product aligned businesses and across other corporate financial, treasury, and accounting groups
* Able to understand business drivers and requirements and influence middle and front office partners to deliver solutions to business issues and problems
* Strong analytical skills: Ability to quickly understand workings of a complex processing system and general ledger systems across the infrastructure and their interrelationships and dependencies
* Excellent desktop/spreadsheet/database skills
* Excellent organizational and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Able to multi\-task in a constantly changing environment
* Able to critically challenge with the goal of identifying control issues

**About The Role**
 As a
 **Director \- Marketing \& Communications** 
 , you will make an impact by shaping and amplifying the market narrative for Cognizant’s Intuitive Operations and Automation (IOA) practice across marketing, executive communications, and people communications. You will be a valued member of the IOA team and work collaboratively with IOA business leaders, global corporate marketing and communications teams, sales, solutioning, delivery, client\-facing teams, analysts, agencies, and regional stakeholders.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Define and own the end\-to\-end IOA messaging and positioning strategy, including differentiated AI, automation, and agentic AI narratives for clients, analysts, employees, and internal stakeholders.
* Drive an always\-on, multi\-channel marketing presence across the IOA website, social media, practice decks, campaigns, events, digital platforms, and sales enablement assets.
* Build a robust case study and proof\-point library by partnering with delivery teams, client partners, and service line specialists to translate client impact into compelling market\-facing stories.
* Partner with sales and solutioning teams on strategic pursuits by developing bespoke narratives, tailored presentations, credentials decks, competitive battlecards, capability briefs, and RFP content.
* Lead IOA’s annual marketing strategy, roadmap, performance rhythm, analyst recognition communications, regional marketing support, executive communications, and people communications.
* Consistently demonstrate the Cognizant Way to Lead, which means operating with Personal Leadership (building trust, collaboration, and inclusion), Organizational Leadership (driving vision and purpose, demonstrating a strategic and enterprise mindset, and creating and communicating a bold direction that inspires purpose), and Business Leadership (exemplifying client focus, managing ambiguity with accountability and results, and operating with financial acumen).


**What You Need To Have To Be Considered**
* 15\+ years of progressive experience in marketing and/or communications, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Deep understanding of technology, particularly AI, automation, and digital transformation in the BPS, IT services, or professional services industry.
* Proven track record of building and leading integrated marketing and communications functions within a global services or technology organization.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with strong storytelling capability for C\-suite audiences, employees, clients, analysts, and internal stakeholders.
* Strong executive presence and stakeholder influence, with the ability to counsel senior leaders and operate effectively in a complex, matrixed global environment.
* Experience leading and developing high\-performing, cross\-functional teams while managing multiple priorities with strong project management discipline.
* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent advanced degree is strongly preferred.
* Embodiment of the Cognizant Way to Lead: Leading Self, Leading Others, \& Leading the Business.
* The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The Right Thing, \& Own It.


**These will help you succeed**
* Experience in the BPS industry, especially within AI\-powered operations, business process automation, or digital transformation services.
* Experience working with analyst firms such as Everest, HFS, Gartner, or IDC to support market visibility and recognition initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to build scalable editorial workflows, case study engines, reusable sales enablement assets, and thought leadership programs.
* Experience adapting global marketing strategies for regional markets while maintaining brand consistency and local relevance.
* Ability to work with creative, digital, design, and agency partners to produce high\-quality visuals, multimedia, video, interactive content, and digital experiences.


**Work model**
 We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. description:
Join Skillz and Level Up Your Career!
   

  

 Are you ready to take your career to the next level? Join Skillz, the first publicly\-traded mobile esports platform that hosts billions of casual mobile gaming tournaments for millions of players worldwide. Skillz is revolutionizing the gaming industry, providing the ultimate platform for competitive mobile games. By fostering social competition within games, Skillz empowers developers to create multi\-million dollar franchises while connecting players through fair, enjoyable, and meaningful competition.
   

  

 At Skillz, we firmly believe that everyone is born with unique skills and deserves to experience an epic win. We understand the thrill of achievement and the satisfaction of overcoming challenges. That's why we passionately champion game developers and players alike, empowering them to unleash their full potential through the power of competition.
   

  

 Life @ Skillz
   

  

* Culture of Impact: Join a united team of builders, creators, innovators, and entrepreneurs driven by the desire to win. At Skillz, we create value and make a difference in the world.
* Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy peace of mind with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision expenses for both you and your entire family.
* Wellness Support: Enhance your well\-being with our array of wellness initiatives, including meditation and mental health resources, physical fitness coaching and classes, family planning assistance, health and parenting guidance, virtual therapy sessions, and more.
* Perks: We believe in enhancing your work experience. Enjoy daily breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks, Friday Happy Hours, insurance, and many more. We also offer competitive paid time off (PTO) \& company holidays to help you recharge and pursue your passions.


 Why Skillz?
   

  

* Pioneers of Skill\-Based Competition: Skillz is not just any company in the gaming industry; we are the pioneers of skill\-based competition, partnered with industry titans like UFC, NFL, T\-Mobile, Buzztime, while also hosting renowned events like the Game Developer Conference (GDC). Join us in transforming the way people play games and building the home of competition for all.
* Impact Beyond Gaming: Skillz harnesses the power of its platform to support nonprofit organizations such as Susan G. Komen, American Cancer Society, the NAACP, and more. By participating in Skillz tournaments, you can make a difference and contribute to causes you care about.
* Recognized Success: Skillz has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, CNBC's Disruptor 50, San Francisco Business Times' Best Places to Work, Forbes' Next Billion\-Dollar Startups, and the \#1 fastest\-growing company in America on the Inc. 5000 list, and many more.
* Talent Magnet: Join a team of talented professionals who are passionate about what they do. Our team includes experts from Meta, Apple, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Tesla, Twitter (X), Roblox, Zynga, Samsung, Lyft, EA, Riot, Nexon, Gameskraft, PlayStation, Unity, Scopely, Tinder, Intel, Deloitte, EY, Twitch, DraftKings, and more.


 The Future of Gaming Awaits!
   

  

 The gaming industry is larger than movies, music, and books combined, with over 3 billion active gamers playing monthly and over 25 million active developers worldwide. Mobile gaming, in particular, is the fastest\-growing segment, projected to reach $300 billion by 2025\. At Skillz, you have the opportunity to be at the forefront of this exciting industry and shape its future.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Own the Blackout Bingo LiveOps calendar end to end — events, tournaments, promotions and the limited\-time\-offer slate — as the single accountable operator for the game.
* Be accountable for the three ratified KPIs on the surface: incremental NGR per campaign (holdout\-audited), event margin (collection vs prizes), and the count of events running at negative margin.
* Lead the Blackout Bingo LiveOps line — the Senior Associate today and the Associate bench as it lands — setting standards, developing the team and hiring into it.
* Design and configure campaigns directly: segments, entry\-fee tiers, prize curves, schedules, eligibility and guardrails, in the admin portal and in CleverTap.
* Tune the slate to Blackout Bingo's own economy — entry\-fee distribution, session profile, tail composition and marquee rhythm — rather than inheriting a shared calendar.
* Hold offer discipline on the surface: 30% standard bonus cap, same\-day bonus decay, wallet\-balance gating and net\-winner exclusions; prevent LTO stacking across Daily, Weekend and Filler offers.
* Reserve holdouts at send time and run experiments end to end — hypothesis, segment, control, read — retiring what does not earn its incentive cost.
* Deliver the tail live\-event tier, zonal identity events and month\-long merch events on Blackout Bingo as the economy rebalance rolls out.
* Own the Blackout Bingo line in the weekly LiveOps Review and the per\-venue scorecard commentary: what moved, why, and what happens next.
* Partner with Product on capability and roadmap, Analytics on measurement and independent scoring, Lifecycle CRM on messaging, and Launch GTM on feature adoption.
* Contribute to the Game LiveOps operating model alongside Indrani G as the function scales.


**Key Competencies**
* Owns a number, not a calendar — reasons in event margin and incremental NGR, and can tell the difference between a campaign that worked and one that ran during a good week.
* Economy sense — understands that an offer is a cost, and reasons about prize curves, collection versus prizes and net deposits rather than participation counts.
* Hands\-on operating detail — comfortable in campaign tooling and configuration, and precise about eligibility rules and guardrails. A build\-and\-run role, not a briefing role.
* People leadership — has managed or closely mentored operators, sets standards rather than approving individual campaigns, and can hire and develop a small bench.
* Experiment discipline — reserves the holdout before the send, defines the read before launch, and accepts a null result.
* Willing to kill a popular event — can retire a well\-liked but negative\-margin event and explain why to players, Product and their own team.
* Peer\-level presence — can hold a position against Product and Analytics without a reporting line, and be the accountable voice for the surface in a room of senior stakeholders.
* Clear written communication — weekly commentary that says what moved, why, and what happens next.


**Experience**
* 6–10 years in LiveOps, game operations, product marketing, promotions or growth operations for a consumer mobile product, including full ownership of an events and offers calendar for a live title at scale.
* People leadership — has managed at least one or two operators directly, or has a clear and evidenced step\-up into a management line (setting standards, reviewing work, developing others).
* Real\-money gaming, online gambling, fantasy sports, fintech or a mid\-core F2P title with a deep in\-game economy strongly preferred. Bingo, casual or social\-casino category experience is a plus but not required.
* Evidence of running a title's economy, not just its calendar: prize curves, entry\-fee tiering, bonus rules, and a documented decision to change or retire something on margin grounds.
* Ran a measured experimentation practice — control groups or holdouts with a defined read — and can show a result that changed what was shipped, including a null result.
* Hands\-on with campaign and segmentation tooling (CleverTap, Braze, MoEngage, WebEngage or an internal admin portal) and comfortable pulling their own data in SQL or a BI tool.
* Comfortable with a fast weekly cycle, with a function being built around them, and with having their results independently scored by an analytics function.

 Whether you're on a consumer product (like Gmail, Search, Maps, Chrome, Android) or a business product (Google Ads, AdSense, Google Marketing Platform, Analytics), you take part in a complete marketing experience as you lead every facet of the product's journey. From determining positioning, naming, competitive analysis, feature prioritization and external communications, you help shape the product and help it grow a consumer base. Operating across all major Product Areas including Gemini, Search, YouTube, Google Pay, Pixel, Android, and Play the CoE creates defensible market moats and drives user habituation across some of the core User Segments: Youth, Premium, Merchants, and Bharat, among others.

You will shape the overarching strategy for asset exchanges, negotiate multi\-year mega\-alliances with C\-suite executives across India’s leading conglomerates, and establish institutional governance across Google Marketing. **Role Overview:** 




 We're looking for a Digital Marketing Executive with 2–3 years of hands\-on experience to plan and execute our marketing efforts across content and social channels. You'll work closely with the marketing team to bring campaigns to life, keep our brand voice consistent, and help grow our online presence. This is an office\-based role for someone who enjoys owning execution end\-to\-end and wants to build a strong digital marketing foundation.

 Gumlet is a PeakXV (formerly Sequoia SEA)\-backed, fast\-growing global SaaS company from India, building a modern media delivery infrastructure for images and videos. Founded in 2019, Gumlet helps businesses automatically process, optimize, and deliver high\-performance media across web and mobile apps \- without complex developer workflows. Trusted by 10,000\+ customers, including BookmyShow, Tata 1mg, TV9 Network, Spinny, Snapdeal, Ethos Watches, PocketFM, and other high\-scale digital brands, Gumlet powers the delivery of 4\+ billion media files every day. **About the Role**

**The ideal candidate should be comfortable creating technical and non\-technical content, designing social media creatives, producing/editing videos, and supporting campaigns across Meta and Google Ads.**

* Create engaging static creatives, carousels, infographics, short\-form videos, and technical content.

**Required Skills** 



* 1–2 years of experience in Social Media Marketing / Digital Marketing / Content Marketing.

* Experience with Canva, Coreldraw and/or Adobe Creative Suite.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of video editing.
* Good copywriting and content\-writing skills.

* Strong communication and coordination skills.

* Experience in B2B, technology, cybersecurity, or IT industry.
* Knowledge of SEO and Google Analytics.
* Experience with YouTube Studio and video optimization.

**What We Are Looking For** 




**Someone who is creative, curious, proactive and hands\-on person who can take an idea, understand the subject, turn it into an engaging creative/video, publish it and track its performance.**

description:
**About Us:**




  





 We are India's leading political consulting organisation, dedicated to providing high\-quality professional support for political campaigns. We strongly believe that the nation will best benefit from an enlightened political leadership in the form of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and are proud to have previously contributed in a similar capacity in the momentous election campaigns of 2014, 2019 and 2024, as well as various state elections.
 



  





 Our work includes envisioning and executing innovative electioneering campaigns, facilitating the capacity building of grassroots cadre, and shaping governance. We add professional aspects to the strengths of the scores of grassroots workers supporting the Prime Minister and ensure optimal electoral results, not as an end in itself, but to add to the Prime Minister's vision for a developed India. Our work leverages on\-ground activities, data analytics, research, and new\-age media as force multipliers for the Prime Minister's messages and actions.
 



  





 We comprise a diverse group of dedicated individuals\-including former management consultants, lawyers, engineers, political theorists, public policy professionals, and experts from other varied sectors, all hailing from premier institutes and corporates\-with the unified objective of meaningfully contributing to the nation's polity.
 



  





**Join us in building high\-impact digital campaigns that engage millions of citizens through regional creator networks, data\-driven outreach, and compelling public narratives.** 




  





**About the Role** 




 We’re looking for a dynamic Influencer Marketing Associate with 2–4 years of experience to build, manage, and scale creator partnerships that drive public engagement, narrative amplification, and campaign outreach. If you have a passion for creator ecosystems, regional content networks, digital mobilisation, and data\-driven campaign execution, we want you on our team!
 



  





**Eligibility** 



* MBA in Marketing, Communications, Media, Public Relations, Political Communication, or a related field from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 business school.
* 2–4 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, political communication, digital campaigns, or social media management.
* Strong understanding of the Indian creator ecosystem across Instagram, YouTube, X, Facebook, and emerging regional platforms.
* Experience in managing regional influencers, community pages, youth creators, or public affairs campaigns.
* Exposure to election campaigns, advocacy initiatives, social impact organisations, or fast\-paced startup environments is a plus.



  





**Skills:\-** 




  





**Influencer Strategy \& Network Building** 




 Ability to identify, evaluate, onboard, and manage creators across multiple geographies, languages, and audience segments
 



**Campaign Execution \& Relationship Management** 




 Experience in negotiating collaborations, briefing influencers, coordinating approvals, managing publishing schedules, and ensuring timely campaign delivery
 



**Narrative Monitoring \& Social Listening** 




 Strong understanding of online conversations, sentiment tracking, trend identification, and rapid\-response coordination across digital platforms.
 



**Performance Analytics \& Optimisation** 




 Ability to analyse reach, engagement, impressions, CPV, CPM, CTR, and audience response metrics to improve campaign effectiveness.
 



**Cross\-Team Collaboration** 




 Work closely with content, research, design, communications, and field teams to ensure consistent messaging and coordinated campaign execution.
 



**Presentation \& Report\-Making** 




 Strong skills in preparing campaign reports, influencer performance evaluations, trend analyses, and stakeholder presentations.
 



  





**Job Description** 



* Influencer Discovery \& Management: Build and maintain a robust database of creators, meme pages, regional influencers, youth communities, and digital opinion leaders segmented by geography, language, category, and audience profile.
* Campaign Planning \& Execution: Plan and execute influencer\-led outreach campaigns, coordinating creator onboarding, negotiations, content approvals, publishing timelines, and post\-campaign follow\-ups.
* Narrative Amplification: Support the dissemination of campaign messages through relevant creator networks, ensuring alignment with communication objectives and audience targeting strategies.
* Social Listening \& Trend Tracking: Monitor emerging conversations, viral trends, sentiment shifts, and competitor activity to identify opportunities for proactive engagement and rapid\-response communication.
* Performance Monitoring \& Reporting: Track campaign performance using platform analytics, Meta Insights, X analytics, YouTube analytics, and reporting dashboards. Prepare actionable post\-campaign analyses with recommendations for optimisation.
* Content Coordination: Collaborate with creative and communications teams to develop influencer briefs, messaging frameworks, and content guidelines while ensuring consistency across platforms.
* Project Management: Manage multiple influencer campaigns simultaneously, ensuring timely execution, budget adherence, stakeholder coordination, and achievement of outreach targets.
* Flexibility: Be able to adapt to meet our dynamic campaign and communication needs that may change or evolve over time.



  





 Note\- This is a contractual job till June,2027\.

 ABOUT THE ROLE
 



  





 Cao Jewellery is a handcrafted statement jewellery brand on a mission to change the way the world experiences jewellery. We believe that beautifully crafted, meaningful pieces shouldn't be reserved for the few, they should be within reach of every person who desires them. We're looking for a highly driven, data\-oriented Performance Marketing Executive to scale our digital growth across paid channels. You'll own customer acquisition, funnel optimization, and ROAS scaling across Meta, Google, and other platforms — turning ad spend into a predictable revenue engine. 
 



  





 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 Plan, execute, and optimize paid campaigns across Meta Ads (Facebook \& Instagram), Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube), other platforms.
 



 Own the end\-to\-end performance marketing funnel — Awareness → Consideration → Conversion— and the metrics at every stage.
 



 Drive customer acquisition and revenue growth while holding the line on target ROAS and CPA.
 



 Analyze campaign performance daily, spot trends early, and scale winning audiences, creatives, and placements.
 



 Run structured A/B tests on creatives, audiences, landing pages, and ad copy — and turn learnings into the next round.
 



 Partner closely with creative, content, and brand teams to brief and ship high\-converting ad assets, including UGC and influencer\-led creatives.
 



 Track and report key metrics — CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS, LTV — in clean, decision\-ready dashboards.
 



 Optimize landing pages and conversion funnels in collaboration with the website/Shopify team for better CVR.
 



 Plan and allocate monthly budgets across platforms, channels, and campaigns to maximize blended ROAS.
 



 Stay ahead of platform updates, algorithm shifts, and competitor strategies — and translate them into our roadmap.
 



  





 REQUIRED SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS
 



  




1. 3\+ years of hands\-on performance marketing experience, preferably in jewellery, fashion, or D2C e\-commerce.

7. Experience managing high ad spends with consistent, predictable performance.
8. Excellent communication skills and the ability to manage stakeholders across creative, brand, and leadership teams.



  





 YOU'LL STAND OUT IF YOU HAVE
 



  




1. Experience running performance marketing for a Shopify or similar D2C e\-commerce stack.

3. Familiarity with GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, and Microsoft Clarity.
4. A bias for action, ownership mentality, and hunger to grow a brand from the inside.



  





 WHY JOIN US
 



  




1. Chance to work with a growing premium fashion brand.
2. Opportunity to scale Ad spends and Brand Visibility.

**Creative Strategist**

We are looking for a Digital Marketing Executive to take complete ownership of our digital marketing activities and lead-generation campaigns.

Our social media platforms, basic optimization, advertising setup and lead funnel have already been established with the support of a digital marketing agency. The selected candidate will take over the existing setup and be responsible for SEO, Google Ads, paid campaigns, lead generation, campaign optimization and digital performance tracking.

SEO

Develop and execute off-page SEO and quality backlink strategies. Improve organic traffic, keyword rankings and lead generation. Coordinate with content writers/web developers wherever required. 3. Lead Generation & Funnel Management

Plan content calendars based on business objectives. Monitor engagement and identify opportunities for organic growth. Support paid social media campaigns when required. 5. Analytics & Reporting 
 Set up and manage Google Analytics and Google Search Console. Monitor website traffic, user behaviour and conversions. Track campaign performance using appropriate analytics and reporting tools. Analyse campaign data and make decisions based on performance. Continuously test and improve campaigns. Work closely with the sales/admission team to improve conversions. title: Head Digital Marketing
description:
Role & responsibilities The Head of Digital Marketing owns the growth and profitability of Ahujasons digital business. That means the e-commerce store, the corporate gifting demand engine, and the brand presence that feeds both. The person is accountable for revenue and return on ad spend, and equally for building a team and a system that keeps producing results without depending on any one individual. This is not a hands-off strategy role. The person will still get into ad accounts, still read the numbers themselves, and still write creative briefs. The difference from the current setup is leadership: the ability to direct a content team toward creative that actually converts, to develop people, and to run the function with discipline through a highly seasonal business cycle. Annual media budget under management 
 Approximately Rs. 65 lakh to Rs. 90 lakh. Current run rate is Rs. 15,000 to Rs. 20,000 per day on e-commerce and Rs. 3,000 to Rs. 5,000 per day on corporate gifting, with seasonal swings. Budget is not the constraint; return on it is. Revenue lines owned 
 E-commerce (own Shopify store, no marketplaces) and corporate gifting lead generation. Combined digital-led revenue to be confirmed by Finance before the role is offered. Channels 
 Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO, email marketing, WhatsApp marketing, LinkedIn and Lusha outbound, organic social. Direct reports 
 Social Media Manager. Content team of photographer, video editor and graphic designer. Functional coordination with the web developer and the e-commerce operations team. Indirect scope 
 Shopify storefront experience, product listing quality, order status visibility, inbound enquiry handling. Reports to 
 Director, Digital Divisions. 
 Preferred candidate profile Essential 8 to 12 years in digital marketing, with at least 3 years leading a team of five or more. Direct, hands-on ownership of Meta Ads and Google Ads accounts at a monthly spend of Rs. 5 lakh or above. Agency oversight alone is not sufficient; we need someone who has been accountable for the number, not for the client relationship. Proven experience running a Shopify or comparable D2C store as a revenue line, including conversion rate work, not only traffic acquisition. Demonstrated ability to brief and direct creative teams. The candidate should be able to explain, with examples, how they turned a creative idea into a measurable performance result. B2B or corporate lead generation experience, ideally including LinkedIn and outbound tooling. Practical AI fluency: routine use of AI tools for creative production, copy, campaign analysis, reporting and automation, with specific examples of workflows they have built and what those workflows saved or earned. Comfort with a seasonal, inventory-led business where demand concentrates into a few months. Preferred Background in fashion, apparel, accessories, gifting, jewellery or a comparable visual-led category. Exposure to a family-run or promoter-led business, where influence matters more than formal authority. Experience with email and WhatsApp retention marketing, not just acquisition. SEO depth, including technical SEO on Shopify. Remuneration shall not be a limiting factor for the right candidate

Key Skills: Digital Strategy,Corporate Strategy,Ai Techniques,E-commerce,Digital Transformation,Team Leadership,Social Media Strategies,Brand Strategy

description:
**Description**
 Payroll Technology at Amazon is all about enabling our business to perform at scale as efficiently as possible with no defects. As Amazon's workforce grows, both in size and geography, Amazon's payroll operations become increasingly complex, and our customers are asked to do more with less. Process can only get them so far, and that's where we come in with technology solutions to integrate and automate systems, detect defects before payment, and provide insights. As an SDE on our team, you will be responsible for leading the architecture, design, development and launch of some of the core product features. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy by helping define these product features, drive the system architecture, and spearhead the best practices to delivery high quality products.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is clearly passionate about new opportunities and has a demonstrated track record of success in delivering new features and products. A commitment to team work, hustle, and strong communication skills (to both business and technical partners) are absolute requirements. You will tackle large complex projects, massive data volume \+ complex business rules in a highly distributed and service\-oriented architecture. You will create reliable, scalable, secure products for our customers in a hyper\-growth environment where priorities shift quickly.
   

  

 This position requires that you are a significant and autonomous contributor. Your work is of consistently high quality. You solve complex problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. Your focus is on designing, developing and effectively applying automated solutions that test major portions of software (e.g. significant component, set of features, mid\-size application, service, etc.). You prevent and find defects early. You apply software testing techniques, such as equivalence class partitioning, boundary value testing, etc. You build complete test and/or measurement solutions (e.g. performance, load, scalability, usability, etc.). You use data from testing, deployment, and production to measure quality and provide actionable improvement to the product. You write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to make trade\-offs. Your solutions are pragmatic. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time, or at least minimize incidental complexity. You consider the legacy of the code you produce, limiting the use of short\-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over\-engineering. You reuse where possible, while being judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g. designing to avoid impacting the system under test.)
   

  

**A Day In The Life**
 You are expected to do HLD/LLD of features, code them to Amazon standards, and do code and design reviews. You will attend regular stand\-up meetings and provide your updates. You will keep an eye out for opportunities to improve the product or user experience and suggest those enhancements. You will participate in requirement grooming meetings to ensure the use cases we deliver are complete and functional. You will take your turn at on\-call and own production operational maintenance. You will respond to customer issues and monitor services for healthy execution.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Own design, development, unit test and integration test of features and modules.
* Operational maintenance in production environment.
* Code reviews, design reviews, HLD/LLD preparation.
* Participate in requirements grooming sessions.
* Suggest new ways to improve the customer experience or product.
* Responsible for CI/CD pipelines and suggest ways to improve the code delivery process.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3\+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

description:
**Description**
 INSLP (Security \& Loss Prevention) is hiring an SLP Specialist to support growth of the “SLP MDR Concessions Abuse Program” and help preventing losses via identification of abusive entity. The program is aimed at identifying and eliminating Concessions Abuse while preserving customer trust.
   

  

 The primary objective of the SLP Specialist is to provide security services, investigation and asset protection in designated area of responsibility, assist in mitigating product loss, and maintain customer satisfaction in accordance with INSLP guidelines and policies. The role is cross\-functional and requires deep collaboration and influencing ability with stakeholders from business and corporate functions. SLP Specialist's day\-to\-day activities involve planning, organizing, coordinating, implementing and executing process and procedures laid down by the organization and the SLP function.
   

  

 As a part of the SLP MDR Concessions Abuse program, the SLP Specialist is required to deep dive into the Concessions request raised by customer, and conduct end\-to\-end investigation across customer, DA/network and seller to identify the abusive entity. SLP has outlined frameworks for investigation, and the SLP Specialist is bound to adhere to the investigation guidelines. Along with primarily supporting on Concessions investigations, the SLP Specialist will be required to provide on\-ground intel useful in uncovering abuse MOs. In order to ensure network integrity, the SLP Specialist will be required to conduct risk assessment and process audit for the respective sites and work in accordance with the security policies and guidelines.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Security Operation
   

  

* Implementation and follow\-up of Loss Prevention Plan in MDR Concessions


 Audits and Compliance
   

  

* Conducting SLP audits and implementing SOPs
* Surprise check and reports at LM (Last Mile) stations
* Keeping the plans and SOPs updated
* Periodical check of documentation
* Adhering to SLAs defined for the SLP MDR Concessions Abuse Program


 Process Improvement and Loss Prevention
   

  

* Process review, gap analysis and implementation of necessary improvements
* Weekly, monthly and quarterly assessments
* Loss prevention reporting
* Working on feedbacks received from internal and external stakeholders
* Follow up and completion of CAPA
* Recommending loss prevention initiatives based on on\-ground intel


 Loss Prevention Analysis and Investigation
   

  

* Work closely with the SLP and CS teams to analyze the loss trends in MDR Concessions
* Weekly loss trend analysis, identifying defects / abusive entities and working towards loss reduction
* Conduct investigations by working closely with CS and support functions in SLP and Ops
* Meeting the weekly investigation targets and submitting investigation reports
* Sharing RCAs and PTG initiatives on shrink and unmet goals


**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of security and loss prevention experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent

description:
**Description**
 Inventory Trust team (SPIV) works to ensure that bad actors cannot profit from using our services to abuse Customers, Selling Partners or our Store. Our mission is to safeguard our store from bad inventory and bad actors concealing their identities. To accomplish this mission, we withhold funds from bad actors, deny our fulfillment network to bad actors as a means to scale their abuse and ensure that counterfeit/illegal inventory is destroyed, prevent Seller credit abuse, identify and disrupt bad actor “spare accounts”, and generate insights to help SPS understand where bad actors are prioritizing their efforts.

title: Head Digital Marketing
description:
We are looking for an experienced, data-driven, and commercially focused Head of Digital Marketing to lead digital growth, customer acquisition, performance marketing, brand visibility, and revenue-focused marketing initiatives. Reporting To: CMO / CEO / Business Head 
 The role will own the end-to-end digital marketing charter, with direct accountability for customer acquisition, CAC, CPL, CPA, ROAS, conversion, customer quality, activation, retention, and revenue growth. 
 The ideal candidate will combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution and have a strong understanding of performance-led growth in FinTech, NBFC, Banking, Digital Lending , Payments, Insurance, or BFSI. The candidate should be comfortable working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Technology, Risk, Analytics, and Compliance teams to build scalable and compliant digital acquisition engines. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 1. Digital Marketing & Growth Strategy Develop and own the overall digital marketing and growth strategy aligned with business, revenue, and customer acquisition objectives. Build an integrated digital roadmap across paid, organic, social, CRM, content, partnerships, and app/web channels. Identify new growth opportunities, customer segments, channels, and digital products to accelerate acquisition and revenue. Translate business objectives into measurable marketing plans, budgets, targets, and KPIs. 2. Performance Marketing & Customer Acquisition Lead performance marketing across Google, Meta, programmatic, affiliate, app marketing, and other relevant digital channels. Own customer acquisition metrics including CAC, CPL, CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, lead quality, activation, and disbursement/revenue. Develop scalable acquisition strategies across the complete customer funnel, from awareness and lead generation to application, approval, activation, and conversion. Continuously optimize channel mix, campaigns, audiences, creatives, bidding, landing pages, and budgets based on business performance. Drive efficient allocation of marketing budgets to maximize incremental revenue and customer value. 3. Growth, Funnel Optimization & CRO Own the digital customer journey and identify opportunities to improve funnel performance. Partner with Product and Technology teams to improve website/app conversion, application journeys, onboarding, and customer activation. Establish a structured A/B testing and experimentation framework across campaigns, creatives, landing pages, messaging, and customer journeys. Drive continuous improvement in conversion rates, activation, retention, and LTV/CAC. 4. SEO, Content & Organic Growth Develop and execute SEO and organic acquisition strategies to drive sustainable, high-quality traffic. Lead content strategy across website, landing pages, blogs, product content, and customer education. Improve organic visibility, rankings, traffic, and organic conversion. Build scalable content and SEO programs aligned with customer intent and business priorities. 5. Social Media & Brand Management Lead digital brand strategy and social media presence across relevant platforms. Build brand visibility, engagement, credibility, and customer trust. Ensure consistency of brand positioning and communication across paid and organic channels. Partner with creative and content teams to develop high-performing, insight-led campaigns. 6. CRM, Lifecycle Marketing & Retention Build and optimize CRM and lifecycle marketing programs across email, SMS, WhatsApp, push notifications, and other relevant channels. Develop customer journeys for lead nurturing, onboarding, activation, cross-sell, upsell, retention, and reactivation. Leverage customer data and segmentation to improve engagement, conversion, and lifetime value. Drive marketing automation and personalized communication at scale. 7. Analytics, Attribution & Marketing Intelligence Establish robust measurement frameworks across all digital channels and customer journeys. Own GA4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, attribution, dashboards, and marketing analytics. Develop clear visibility into channel-level and campaign-level performance, customer quality, CAC, revenue, and ROI. Use data and customer insights to identify growth opportunities and make informed budget and channel decisions. Build a culture of experimentation, measurement, and accountability across the marketing function. 8. FinTech / BFSI Compliance & Risk Ensure all digital marketing, customer communication, campaigns, creatives, landing pages, and acquisition practices comply with applicable BFSI/FinTech regulations, internal policies, and brand guidelines. Work closely with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and relevant stakeholders to ensure compliant customer acquisition and communication. Balance growth objectives with customer protection, transparency, responsible marketing, and business risk requirements. 9. Team, Agency & Stakeholder Management Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing digital marketing and growth team. Manage external agencies, media partners, technology partners, affiliates, and other marketing vendors. Establish clear goals, ownership, performance standards, and review mechanisms for the team and partners. Collaborate closely with Product, Sales, Technology, Data/Analytics, Risk, Compliance, Finance, and Operations teams. Present marketing performance, insights, challenges, and growth plans to senior leadership. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): 
 Digital customer acquisition growth CAC / CPA / CPL reduction ROAS and Marketing ROI improvement Lead quality and lead-to-customer conversion Application, approval, activation, and disbursement growth Revenue generated through digital channels Website and app traffic and conversion Organic traffic, rankings, and SEO contribution Customer activation and retention LTV/CAC improvement Funnel conversion and drop-off reduction Marketing budget utilization and efficiency Digital brand awareness and engagement 
 Required Skills & Expertise: 
 Performance Marketing & Digital Growth Google Ads & Meta Ads SEO / SEM & Organic Growth Social Media & Digital Brand Management CRM & Marketing Automation GA4 & Google Tag Manager Attribution & Conversion Tracking A/B Testing, CRO & Growth Experimentation Affiliate & Partnership Marketing App & Web Marketing Customer Lifecycle & Retention Marketing Marketing Analytics & Data Interpretation Budget Planning, Allocation & Optimization Team, Agency & Vendor Management Strong commercial, analytical, leadership, and communication skills 
 Educational Qualification: 
 Bachelors degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Management, or a related field. MBA / PGDM in Marketing or a related discipline preferred. Relevant Digital Marketing / Analytics certifications preferred. 
 Experience: 
 8-12 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Performance Marketing, Growth Marketing, or Customer Acquisition. Minimum 35 years of experience in a leadership / people-management role. Proven experience in scaling digital customer acquisition and managing significant marketing budgets. Strong track record of delivering measurable improvements in CAC, CPA, CPL, ROAS, conversion, customer quality, and revenue. Experience in FinTech, NBFC, Banking, Digital Lending, Payments, Insurance, or BFSI is highly preferred. Experience working in a fast-paced, data-driven, technology-led business environment is preferred. 
 Ideal Candidate Profile: 
 The ideal candidate is a strategic yet hands-on digital growth leader who can connect marketing investments directly to business outcomes. Strategic Thinking | Data Driven | Growth Mindset | Commercial Acumen | Customer Centricity | Leadership | Execution Focus | Innovation 
 The candidate should be able to build the strategy, challenge assumptions, interpret data, execute campaigns, optimize performance, and lead teams while maintaining a strong focus on customer quality, profitability, compliance, and sustainable growth.

description:
About Ecoil
 
 Ecoil is a sustainability\-focused company working in the
 **Used Cooking Oil (UCO) collection and recycling ecosystem** 
 .
 



 We work with restaurants, hotels, cloud kitchens, caterers, food businesses and commercial establishments to promote responsible used cooking oil disposal and support its journey into the green\-energy ecosystem.
 



 As we continue to grow, we're looking for a creative and versatile
 **Content Writer, Creator \& Visual Content** 
 professional who can help us build our digital presence and communicate our brand story through engaging content.
 



  




 🎯 About the Role
 
 We are looking for a
 **creative all\-rounder** 
 who can write, ideate, design, shoot and edit content for digital and social media platforms.
 



 This role goes beyond traditional content writing. You will work across
 **content creation, social media, graphic designing, video editing, scripting, storytelling and creative ideation** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should be able to take an idea from:
 



**Think → Write → Design → Shoot → Edit → Publish** 




 You will work closely with the marketing team to create content that is engaging, informative, visually appealing and aligned with the Ecoil brand.
 



  




 Key ResponsibilitiesContent Writing \& Creation
 * Develop creative content ideas for Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube and other platforms.
* Write social media posts, captions, blogs, articles, Reel scripts and campaign content.
* Create engaging concepts and scripts for Reels, Shorts and other short\-form videos.
* Research trends, topics and content opportunities.
* Develop strong hooks, storytelling concepts and audience\-focused content.
* Assist in planning and maintaining the content calendar.



  




 🎨 Graphic Designing
 * Design social media posts, carousels, stories, banners, posters, presentations and marketing creatives.
* Convert content ideas into visually engaging designs.
* Maintain consistency with Ecoil's brand guidelines.
* Apply strong understanding of typography, layouts, composition and visual hierarchy.
* Create creatives for campaigns, events and digital marketing activities.



  




 🎥 Video Editing \& Content Production
 * Edit Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and other social media videos.
* Add subtitles, transitions, music, sound effects, graphics and motion elements.
* Create engaging short\-form videos based on trends and platform formats.
* Assist with video shoots, shot planning and creative direction.
* Repurpose long\-form content into short\-form content.



 The responsibilities above are based on the uploaded Ecoil job description, which specifically covers content creation, graphic design, video editing, scripting and social media responsibilities.
 



  




 🧠 What We're Looking For
 * **1–3 years of relevant experience** 
 in content creation, social media, graphic design and/or video editing.
* Strong writing and communication skills.
* Creative thinking and the ability to generate fresh content ideas.
* Good understanding of Instagram, YouTube and social media trends.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of graphic design and video editing.
* Strong storytelling skills and attention to detail.
* Good understanding of visual aesthetics, typography and composition.
* Ability to write in English and/or Hinglish.
* Proactive, curious and willing to experiment with new formats.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating work across multiple content formats.



 These requirements are aligned with the full\-time candidate criteria in the original JD.
 



  




 🛠️ Tools
 
 Experience with tools such as:
 



**Canva \| Photoshop \| Illustrator \| Premiere Pro \| After Effects \| CapCut \| DaVinci Resolve** 




 or similar design and video\-editing tools will be an advantage.
 



 You don't need to be an expert in every tool. We value
 **creative thinking, execution, storytelling and the willingness to learn** 
 .
 



  




 Who We're Looking For
 
 We're looking for someone who doesn't just wait for ideas but actively creates them.
 



 Someone who can:
 



**Think → Write → Design → Shoot → Edit → Publish** 




 You should be comfortable experimenting with different formats, following trends, understanding audiences and turning everyday business topics into engaging stories.
 



 The ideal candidate profile in the JD specifically highlights this ability to take an idea from concept to the final creative/video.
 



  




 Why Join Ecoil?
 
 This is an opportunity to work with a
 **purpose\-driven sustainability brand** 
 and create content around topics such as sustainability, responsible waste management, used cooking oil, restaurants, food businesses and green energy.
 



 You'll have the opportunity to work across multiple formats including:
 



**Reels \| Carousels \| LinkedIn Content \| Videos \| Blogs \| Campaigns \| Graphics \| Brand Content** 




 If you're creative, curious, proactive and passionate about content, storytelling and digital media, we'd love to hear from you.
 



  




 📩 Apply Now
 
 Share your
 **Resume \+ Portfolio \+ Relevant Work Samples** 
 with your application.

 Gurugram
 



**Experience:** 
 1–3 Years
 



**Position:** 
 Full\-Time

 Preffered Immediate Joiner
 



**Apply Now on \-** 
 \+91 90019 58957 or priyasha@knparises.com

 Looking for Your First Job—or an Opportunity to Build Something Meaningful?
 
 Invigilate® is a technology\-driven assessment and examination solutions provider affiliated with NCVET, Government of India. We help educational institutions, government organizations, training partners, and enterprises conduct secure, scalable, and technology\-enabled assessments.
 



 At Invigilate®, we do more than sell products—we contribute to shaping the future of examinations, certifications, workforce development, and digital assessments across India.
 



 We are looking for a curious, proactive, and growth\-oriented professional with an interest in market research, networking, sales, and business development.
 



 As a Sales \& Marketing Executive, you will work closely with the leadership team to identify new prospects and business opportunities, engage with industry stakeholders, strengthen our brand presence, and support the company’s growth initiatives.
 



 If you enjoy turning ideas into action, building professional relationships, and creating opportunities instead of waiting for them, this role could be the right fit for you.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * Conduct market research and identify potential business opportunities
* Generate qualified leads and execute outreach campaigns
* Connect with educational institutions, government organizations, corporates, and training partners
* Build brand visibility through content, communication, and storytelling
* Support the preparation of business proposals, presentations, and marketing materials
* Coordinate client meetings, product demonstrations, and follow\-up activities
* Maintain the CRM and regularly track leads and business opportunities
* Support digital marketing, LinkedIn outreach, and brand\-building initiatives

 * Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to write engaging content and communicate ideas effectively

* Familiarity with LinkedIn and other social media platforms
* Confidence in networking and professional interactions

* Willingness to learn, take initiative, and accept responsibility


 Why Join Invigilate®?
 * Work directly with the founders and leadership team
* Build a professional portfolio with measurable business impact
* Gain exposure to universities, government organizations, corporates, and India’s skilling ecosystem
* Develop practical expertise in business development, branding, partnerships, marketing, and consultative sales
* Work with innovative assessment and examination technologies
* Take ownership and contribute meaningfully from Day One

**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1739734
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**EY GDS – Commercial Architect – Associate Director**

  



As an Associate Director in the Strategic Pricing \& Insights team under Commercial Excellence, you will provide strategic financial and commercial leadership for EY’s most complex and high\-value opportunities. This role combines pursuit leadership with commercial transformation responsibilities, requiring you to architect innovative pricing strategies, influence senior stakeholders, and lead a high\-performing team to optimize winnability and profitability. You will also contribute to EY’s broader commercial transformation agenda by driving adoption of best practices, tools, and thought leadership initiatives.



You will act as a trusted liaison for onshore engagement leaders and business leaders, building trust\-based relationships to ensure seamless collaboration and alignment on pursuit priorities.

  


**Your key responsibilities**


**Strategic Pursuit Leadership**


* Own the end\-to\-end pricing and commercial strategy from qualification to closure for large, complex deals. Develop business cases, design commercial constructs, optimize deal price positioning, and ensure alignment with EY’s profitability and risk frameworks.
* Lead and govern development of client\-facing proposals and commercial narratives, ensuring strategic alignment and executive\-level positioning; actively support high\-stakes negotiations and articulate EY’s differentiated value proposition.
* Integrate solution intelligence and competitive insights to refine price positioning using price\-to\-win analysis, market benchmarks, and behavioral economics principles (e.g., prospect theory, loss aversion, anchoring and adjustment, choice architecture).
* Proactively identify, communicate, and manage competitive and commercial risks by collaborating with the Deal Leader/Manager, Lead Negotiator, Solution Architect, Legal, Risk Management, QRM, and Independence.
* Function as a trusted bridge between pursuit leaders and delivery teams—establishing trust\-based influence and ensuring consistent deal shaping, monetization approaches, and commercial terms and conditions.


**Commercial Transformation \& Governance**


* Drive activation and adoption of best practice pricing methods, tools, dashboards, and analytics platforms \- spanning MS Excel models, SaaS/web tools, and EY digital assets \- bringing together external observations, solution design, modeled pursuit economics, and historical peer performance to accelerate value based pricing; flex engagement approach to meet pursuit or project team needs.
* Establish KPIs and accountability metrics for the team, ensure compliance with internal policies, risk management requirements, and pursuit hygiene standards.
* Contribute to thought leadership through development of pricing frameworks, training programs, and knowledge capital \- e.g., immersive sites, newsletters, white papers, articles, presentations, and learning assets.


**Team Leadership \& Development**


* Lead assigned team; mentor and coach team members to enhance technical and commercial capabilities. Function as a regional or sector pod lead when needed, driving consistent pricing strategies across multiple pursuits and geographies.
* Cultivate a culture of growth and design transformative career journeys for team members by delivering structured feedback and orchestrating capability\-building programs. Support the firm’s performance management process with open, constructive developmental feedback and capability building plans.
* Mentor teams in authoring client facing materials \- value estimation and articulation, pricing proposal narratives, commercial assumptions, MS Excel based price/solution templates, and applicable sections of the Statement of Work (SOW)
* Serve as a technical subject matter resource (SMR), providing constructive peer review and risk mitigation across financial modeling, analysis, and documentation for select pursuits.
* Ensure compliance with pursuit hygiene and operational requirements, including time recording, capacity tracking, and deal intake documentation.

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


* Proven expertise in value\-based pricing, commercial strategy, and competitive intelligence for professional services.
* Strong leadership and coaching skills—able to influence without authority, manage conflicts, and inspire high\-performing teams.
* Ability to direct advanced financial modeling and analytics, ensuring insights drive strategic decisions; Adept at synthesizing large volumes of internal and external data (primary, secondary, third‑party) into actionable intelligence for diverse stakeholders.
* Demonstrated empathy and collaborative agility across diverse social styles; influences without authority to achieve target outcomes.
* Executive presence with effective communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Innovative mindset with a track record of transformative impact on commercial outcomes.

  


**Leadership attributes**


* Demonstrate a growth mindset and the following leadership behaviors:
* “Gold Standard Champion \- execute with discipline and rigor, improving consistency and leading practices to win.”
* “Innovation Driver \- differentiate EY through innovative strategies, experiences, and deliverables at scale.”
* “Trusted Strategic Advisor \- guide stakeholders toward outcomes that deliver compelling, sustainable results.”
* “Inspirational Change Agent \- invest in developing world class talent, methods, tools, and capabilities.”

  


**Others**


* Contribute to internal initiatives (e.g., townhalls, CSR projects, mandatory learnings) and advance knowledge capital through newsletters, white papers, and articles.

  


**Qualifications for the role:**


* Graduate in finance, accounting, economics, engineering, or related fields; MBA or financial certifications (CFA, CMA, CPA) preferred.
* Minimum 12 years of relevant experience in pricing, commercial strategy, or financial planning within professional services or SaaS/cloud environments.
* Project management certifications (e.g., PMP, Agile, Scrum) preferred.
* Advanced MS Excel and commercial modeling skills.
* Familiarity with solution architecture and advanced analytics platforms is an advantage.
* Fluency in English (oral and written); flexibility to work across global time zones and occasional travel.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**About the Company:** 




 Crepdog Crew is India’s biggest marketplace for streetwear and sneakers. We don't just stock brands. We build culture around them. The brands on our platform are here because they belong here, and we intend to keep it that way. We are dedicated to redefining streetwear culture in India and providing an exceptional shopping experience. Join Crepdog Crew on its journey and become part of the Crew today.

You're the person who genuinely understands marketing, genuinely understands culture, and happens to be very, very good at getting people to say yes. As Partner \- Growth Marketing Manager, you'll own the relationship between CDC and the brands on our platform, helping them see where they're growing, where they're leaving money on the table, and why investing in CDC's marketing ecosystem is the smartest thing they can do about it. 
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




 ● Own the growth of every brand in your portfolio. Their numbers are your numbers.

 ● 3–4 years in account management, brand solutions, or marketing sales, ideally at a marketplace, media company, or consumer platform.
 



 ● You understand how brand teams think about marketing budgets, what metrics they care about, what language they speak, and what it takes to get a yes.

 ● You're organised enough to manage ten brand conversations at once without a single thing slipping.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable speaking with customers and closing sales.

You should be able to understand what the customer actually needs, explain the right scooter confidently and guide them towards making a purchase decision.

You should also be comfortable following up.

Many customers will not buy on their first visit.

Your ability to stay in touch, answer their questions and bring them back to the showroom will be an important part of the role.

What We’re Looking For

You should be:

* Confident and well\-spoken

* Comfortable following up on phone and WhatsApp
* Organised with leads and customer records
* Responsible and able to manage the showroom independently
* Presentable and professional
* Target\-oriented
* Comfortable working with daily and monthly sales goals
* Able to handle customer objections calmly
* Good at building trust with customers

You’ll Be a Strong Fit If

You enjoy talking to customers.

You can explain products without sounding scripted.

You know when to push for a sale and when to give the customer space.

You follow up consistently instead of waiting for customers to call back.

You take ownership of the showroom instead of waiting for someone to tell you what to do.

And when showroom sales are slow, your first thought is:

The objective is not simply to keep the showroom running.

The objective is to **make the showroom perform.**

The difference from the current setup is leadership: the ability to direct a content team toward creative that actually converts, to develop people, and to run the function with discipline through a highly seasonal business cycle. Annual media budget under management 
 Approximately Rs. 65 lakh to Rs. 90 lakh. Current run rate is Rs. 15,000 to Rs. 20,000 per day on e-commerce and Rs. 3,000 to Rs. 5,000 per day on corporate gifting, with seasonal swings. Budget is not the constraint; return on it is. Revenue lines owned

 Shopify storefront experience, product listing quality, order status visibility, inbound enquiry handling. Reports to

Comfort with a seasonal, inventory-led business where demand concentrates into a few months. Preferred Background in fashion, apparel, accessories, gifting, jewellery or a comparable visual-led category.  Location: Kolkata \- Onsite
 



 Experience \- 1 year to 3 Years
 



 Salary: 15,000 to 25,000
 



 Immediate joiners preferred
 



  





 Job Responsibilities
 


* Conduct comprehensive keyword research and competitor analysis to identify growth opportunities and improve search visibility.
* Implement On\-Page and Technical SEO strategies, including website structure, metadata, internal linking, indexing, crawlability, and page optimization.
* Develop and execute Off\-Page SEO and link\-building strategies to strengthen domain authority and improve organic rankings.
* Implement GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) strategies to improve brand visibility and discoverability across AI\-powered search platforms.
* Optimize website content for both traditional search engines and AI\-generated search results, ensuring relevance, authority, and search intent alignment.
* Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, conversions, and AI visibility to evaluate SEO/GEO performance.
* Manage and analyze data from Google Search Console and Google Analytics to identify trends, opportunities, and performance gaps.
* Conduct regular SEO and GEO audits to identify technical, content, and visibility issues and recommend actionable improvements.
* Prepare SEO/GEO performance reports with key metrics, insights, and recommendations for continuous improvement.
* Stay updated with Google algorithm updates, AI search developments, SEO trends, and emerging GEO practices.



  





 Educational Qualification
 


* Graduation in any discipline
* Digital Marketing certification preferred
* Must have basic English communication skills (at least in writings)

title: Social Media & Digital Marketing Executive
description:
JBAC Innovations is a product company in Gandhinagar. You will handle marketing for two products:
 


* **QEase** 
 — software for hospitals and clinics to manage patient queues and appointments
* **Buzzire** 
 — a face\-verified dating app, live on Google Play in Pune, Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar and other cities



 These are two very different audiences. Hospital owners on one side, young app users on the other. You need to be comfortable switching between both.
 



**What you will do:** 



* Run Buzzire's existing social accounts — Instagram, X, Facebook, YouTube — and grow them
* Build QEase's presence from zero — LinkedIn and content for hospital owners
* Create posts, reels and short videos for both
* Run paid ads: Google and LinkedIn for QEase, and app install campaigns for Buzzire
* Track results — installs, signups and demo requests. Not just likes and reach.
* Report monthly on what worked and what did not



**What we need:** 



* **2–4 years in social media or digital marketing**
* You have personally run an ad account. Please share screenshots or examples with real spend.
* You can write in English, Gujarati and Hindi
* Basic design and video editing (Canva, CapCut are fine)
* Portfolio required — accounts you handled, ads you ran, content you made



**Good to have:** 
 consumer app marketing, app install campaigns, healthcare or B2B experience, SEO
 



**To apply:** 
 Send CV and portfolio to info@jbacinnovations.com, subject "Social Media Executive"
