title: Marketing Technologist, Web
description:
**About The Team**
 We are looking for an experienced Marketing Web Technologist to help build highly coordinated and efficient web integrations and infrastructure that powers Zillow's marketing organization. We serve as the technical liaison between marketing, product, engineering, and marketing vendor teams to bring all partners together toward a common goal. As part of the WebTech team, you will be responsible for building highly coordinated and efficient web integrations, infrastructure, and web platforms while playing a key role in the operations of the WebTech space; building new web components, managing configurations, integrations, and workflows to help with marketing needs. Participate in the onboarding and building of new platforms from implementation, integration, execution, data and security compliance review, and training user teams.
   

  

 This role leans heavily into hands\-on\-keyboard work, but also requires technical program management to work collaboratively across teams to deliver automation capabilities that empower our customers. The ideal candidate shines in a fast\-paced and ambiguous environment, and has a balance of technical web skills and program management. If you like solving complex problems and are passionate about enabling marketing teams and delivering the vision of Zillow 2\.0, we want to hear from you!
   

  

**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission\-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** 
 Our work spans cross\-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high\-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
   

  

**About The Role**
* Drive the marketing web technology roadmap by participating in onboarding of new web platforms including requirements definition, implementation, integration, execution, testing and validation, data and security compliance review, and training of end user teams.
* Be involved in shaping MarTech web system design and help guide technical architecture discussions and decisions to establish a flexible, scalable, and secure tech stack.
* Understand web business requirements and identify data needs to enable marketing to deliver a personalized customer experience.
* Collaborate with teams across marketing, product, and engineering to develop detailed technical web project plans and align on roadmaps.
* Coordinate with other dev dependencies to align cross\-tech team sprint schedules \& release plans.
* You will assess risks, anticipate bottlenecks, provide critical issue management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, while balancing the business needs versus technical constraints.
* Beyond being successful, you’ll thrive if you relish crafting clarity from ambiguity (at a company level) and you take pride in driving complex cross\-team web programs while aligning to company and engineering strategy.
* Define and prioritize strategic web projects and shepherd them from concept to launch.
* Own and drive large and sophisticated web programs, while creating transparency through project plans that are focused on value realization, while collaborating with engineers to align teams and manage dependencies.
* Maintain and report on program status and seek to optimize timely delivery.
* Update leadership and the business on progress, issues, risk, and course correction plans.
* Drive AI adoption across Marketing Technology by identifying high\-impact use cases, implementing AI\-powered workflows, and using automation to improve team efficiency and free up time for higher\-value strategic work.


 This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
   

  

 In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation subject to applicable laws and relevant Zillow policies. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

* Have the ability to work with other engineering team’s code and systems to deliver new features that have impact across the company.
* You love driving cross\-functional, technical and sophisticated web programs to achieve business outcomes.
* An ability to take large, complex features, and break them down in deliverables that focus on value\-realization for the end user/customer.
* Improve management decision\-making by delivering data\-driven recommendations that are aligned with organizational strategy and quarterly goals.
* You are passionate about championing great work and advocate effectively on behalf of what’s best for the customer/user.
* Outstanding oral and written communication skills, as well as the ability to think clearly, analyze quantitatively, problem\-solve, scope technical requirements, and prioritize tasks.
* Highly effective communicator that enables you to earn trust at all levels and engage effectively with senior leaders.
* Ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Gravitate toward the detail but can keep the big picture in focus.
* Highly analytical approach, using data to drive step\-change results.
* Exhibit a collaborative working style with a strong focus on execution and results.
* Have the modesty to question assumptions, seek broad input, and validate iteratively.
* Dedicated to operational excellence, clear communication, and take ownership of your work.
* You actively look for ways to use AI tools in your day\-to\-day work, experiment with new workflows, and are excited to dig in, learn, and iterate to make yourself and the team more efficient.


****Qualifications:****
* Bachelor's Degree in related field or relevant experience.
* 5\+ years of proven experience working in Marketing Technologies/Front End Engineering/Full\-Stack Engineering/Web Development in a technical setting, or similar role.
* Experience developing end\-to\-end applications including frontend UI (e.g., React/Next.js), backend services (e.g., Node/JavaScript), API integrations (e.g., REST/GraphQL), and working with modern data storage technologies (e.g., SQL/NoSQL databases).
* Experience deploying and operating applications in cloud environments (AWS), working with containers (Docker), CI/CD pipelines, and, ideally, infrastructure\-as\-code tools.
* Have experience developing/customizing WordPress themes and plugins and integrating WordPress as a headless CMS using modern frontend frameworks.
* Ability to think critically, be self\-motivated, and deal with ambiguity.
* Professional application of agile methodologies, specifically Scrum.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills and experience interacting with both business and engineering individuals at all levels including the executive level.
* JIRA, Confluence, and g suite experience preferred.


 Get to know us
   

  

 At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers.
   

  

 As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., Zillow helps millions of customers navigate buying, selling, financing, and renting with greater ease and confidence. Our teams in India play a critical role in building and scaling the technology, products, and operations that power this experience.
   

  

 Whether you’re working in tech, operations, or shared services, you’ll collaborate with global partners to solve meaningful problems and help more people make home a reality.
   

  

 Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S.. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
   

  

 No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.
   

  

*Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, maternity status, HIV status, or veteran status. Reasonable accommodations will be provided to candidates with disabilities, in accordance with applicable policies.*

title: GTM Engineer - Growth Marketing, AI Solutions
description:

What we do not yet have is the machine that finds those companies and warms them up before anyone gets on a call. That is this job. You will be the first person we hire to build demand from zero. You will design the pipeline system, build it with AI, run it yourself, and be judged on what comes out of it, working directly with the founder.

title: Social Media & Omnichannel Marketing Executive
description:
**Location:** Hyderabad, India (In\-Office)


**Target Markets:** India \& Australia


**Experience Level: 1\+ years**


**Reports To:** Marketing Manager / Founders


**About Us:**


At **Zithara.ai**, we are pioneering the next generation of **Customer Intelligence**. Our platform serves as the "North Star" for consumer brands, empowering them to unify disparate customer data, automate personalized omnichannel engagement, and deploy advanced AI Agents for sales, support, and marketing. Zithara.ai simplifies retention and accelerates revenue growth for high\-transaction, data\-rich industries across India and Australia.


**The Role:**


We are seeking a creative, data\-driven, and multi\-faceted **Social Media \& Omnichannel Marketing Executive** to join our growth marketing team in Hyderabad.


In this role, you won't just manage a single social page—you will own our brand’s digital footprint across organic social, paid advertising, and direct engagement channels like Email and WhatsApp. You will design, execute, and optimize cross\-channel campaigns aimed at capturing the attention of B2B retail business owners and C\-level executives in both India and Australia.


**Key Responsibilities:**


**1\. Social Media Marketing (Organic \& Paid Ads):**


* **Organic Strategy:** Plan, create, and schedule engaging content across LinkedIn, X (Twitter), YouTube, and Instagram that establishes Zithara.ai as a thought leader in Martech and AI.
* **Paid Campaigns:** Set up, monitor, and optimize paid ad campaigns on **LinkedIn Campaign Manager** and **Meta Ads Manager** to generate high\-quality demo requests and inbound leads.
* **A/B Testing:** Continuously test ad creatives, hooks, and audience segments (specifically targeting the Retail/E\-commerce landscape in IN and AU) to maximize ROAS and lower Cost Per Lead (CPL).

**2\. Omnichannel Execution (Email \& WhatsApp Marketing):**


* **Email Campaigns:** Build, segment, and execute targeted email marketing campaigns for inbound nurture tracks, cold outbound sequences, and monthly product newsletters.
* **WhatsApp Marketing:** Design and deploy conversational WhatsApp marketing workflows for event promotions (like trade shows), webinars, and direct lead re\-engagement.
* **Analytics Tracking:** Monitor key messaging metrics including open rates, click\-through rates (CTR), spam scores, and conversion rates to iterate on copy and targeting.

**3\. Content Creation \& Event Support:**


* **Copywriting:** Write compelling, persuasive copy for ad creatives, email subject lines, WhatsApp broadcasts, and long\-form social posts.
* **Collateral Coordination:** Collaborate with graphic designers or utilize tools like Canva to produce crisp, thumb\-stopping visual assets and video shorts.
* **Event Amplification:** Create buzz around major industry events and exhibitions (e.g., pre\-booking campaigns for retail trade shows) to drive foot traffic and booth appointments.

**Qualifications \& Requirements:**


* **Experience:** 2–4 years of proven marketing experience, ideally within a **B2B SaaS or Martech company**.
* **Paid Ads Mastery:** Hands\-on experience managing and scaling budgets on LinkedIn Ads and Meta Ads.
* **Tool Proficiency:** Experience using modern marketing tools (e.g., HubSpot, Mailchimp, Intercom, or native WhatsApp API setups). High proficiency with Canva or basic video editing apps is a major plus.
* **Exceptional Communication:** Stellar written and verbal English communication skills. You must be able to write sharp, professional copy that resonates with business leaders.
* **Data\-Driven Mindset:** You don't just post content; you actively track impressions, clicks, conversions, and revenue metrics to justify marketing spend.
* **Location \& Shift Awareness:** Based in Hyderabad. Willingness to occasionally align campaign scheduling and optimization tracking to match Australian business hours.

**What to Expect (Why Join Us):**


**"Drink Your Own Champagne"** \> You will be marketing a world\-class platform using the exact channels our platform automates. Your success stories will directly form the case studies we show our clients.


* **High\-Growth Environment:** Be part of an agile startup team where your ideas are implemented fast, and your impact is visible daily.
* **Advanced Tech Stack:** Work directly alongside AI engineers and SaaS growth experts, picking up cutting\-edge knowledge in AI agents and Customer Data Platforms (CDPs).
* **Competitive Compensation:** Attractive base salary with performance incentives tied directly to pipeline contribution and lead generation.

title: AI SEO Engineer
description:
**About E2M**E2M Solutions works as a trusted white\-label partner for digital agencies. We support agencies with consistent and reliable delivery through services such as website design, web development, eCommerce, SEO, AI SEO, PPC, AI automation, and content writing.  

Founded on strong business ethics, we are an equal opportunity organisation powered by 300\+ experienced professionals, partnering with 400\+ digital agencies across the US, UK, Canada, Europe, and Australia. At E2M, we value ownership, consistency, and people who are committed to doing meaningful work and growing together. If you’re someone who dreams big and has the gumption to make them come true, E2M has a place for you **About the Role**
We are looking for a Fresher AI SEO Engineer who is curious about how people search using ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews, and other AI\-powered search platforms.  

Your main responsibility will be to help improve the visibility of our clients' websites, brands, products, and services in LLM and AI\-generated search results for targeted prompts and queries. This role sits at the intersection of SEO, AI, content, data, and experimentation. You do not need years of experience. We are looking for someone who is highly curious, analytical, comfortable experimenting with AI tools, and willing to continuously learn how AI search is evolving. **Responsibilities*** Optimize client websites and content to improve their visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews, Copilot, and other LLM\-powered search platforms.
* Conduct prompt research to understand what potential customers are asking AI platforms related to a client's products, services, industry, competitors, and buying decisions.
* Build and maintain a list of target prompts for each client and track how frequently the client's brand appears in AI\-generated answers.
* Research how different LLMs retrieve, understand, rank, cite, and recommend information.
* Understand how vector embeddings work to map out content retrieval.
* Understand the fundamentals of how LLMs, search engines, RAG systems, embeddings, knowledge graphs, citations, entities, and web content work together.
* Analyze why certain competitors or websites are being recommended by LLMs and identify opportunities for clients to improve their presence.
* Optimize website pages, content structure, internal linking, entities, FAQs, schema, topical coverage, and other signals that can improve visibility in AI search.
* Work with content teams to create and improve content that directly answers the questions users are asking AI platforms.
* Identify opportunities to get client brands mentioned, referenced, cited, and recommended across trusted websites and online sources.
* Understand the US market, especially how small and mid\-sized businesses operate, market themselves, generate leads, and make purchasing decisions.
* Study customer intent across different stages such as:
* Research
* Comparison
* Recommendation
* Problem solving
* Vendor selection
* Buying decisions
* Monitor how targeted prompts perform across different LLM platforms.
* Run experiments to understand what changes improve AI visibility and document the findings.
* Track traffic coming from AI platforms and identify opportunities to increase website traffic, leads, and conversions from LLM\-driven discovery.
* Measure the impact of AI SEO activities using metrics such as:
* Brand mentions in LLM results
* Citation frequency
* Share of AI search visibility
* Target prompt coverage
* Referral traffic from AI platforms
* Leads and conversions generated through AI discovery
* Stay continuously updated on changes happening across AI search, LLMs, SEO, GEO, AEO, and search technologies.

 **Qualifications**
We are open to candidates from different educational backgrounds. Candidates from the following areas may be a good fit:* Computer Science / IT
* Engineering
* Digital Marketing
* Marketing
* Business
* Data / Analytics


More than your degree, we care about your curiosity, problem\-solving ability, understanding of AI, and willingness to experiment and learn. **Required Skills*** Strong curiosity about AI, LLMs, SEO, and search technology.
* Basic understanding of SEO concepts such as keywords, search intent, content optimization, backlinks, technical SEO, and website structure.
* Good understanding of tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, or similar AI platforms.
* Ability to conduct detailed prompt and search intent research.
* Analytical mindset and willingness to test ideas instead of relying only on traditional SEO practices.
* Ability to understand patterns in LLM responses and competitor visibility.
* Good written and spoken English.
* Basic understanding of the US business market and small and mid\-sized businesses.
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, data, analytics, and research tools.
* Ability to learn new AI tools and technologies quickly.

Your goal will be to help position our clients so that AI platforms increasingly discover, understand, cite, mention, and recommend their businesses for relevant prompts, ultimately increasing qualified traffic, leads, and conversions. **Succes Metrics**
Success in this role means helping our clients become more visible when their potential customers ask AI platforms questions such as:* "What are the best companies for \[service]?"
* "Who can help me with \[problem]?"

title: Digital Marketing Intern
description:
Creative Design \& Content Intern – Qwikxy

**Company:** Qwikxy  
**Role:** Creative Design \& Content Intern  
**Location:** Sarjapur Sompura Gate \- 562125  
**Duration:** \[3–6 months]  
**Stipend:** 8000\-15000  
**Joining:** Immediate

About Qwikxy

Qwikxy is an online platform for building, renovation and home\-improvement products. We help customers conveniently discover and purchase products across categories such as bathrooms, kitchens, plumbing, hardware, tiles and home interiors—with genuine products, detailed information and free home delivery.

About the Role

We are looking for a creative, energetic intern who can turn product information and marketing ideas into engaging visual content.

You will work closely with the Qwikxy team to create social\-media posts, reels, advertisements and campaign creatives. This role is ideal for someone who understands current content trends, enjoys experimenting with new ideas and can make everyday home\-improvement products look interesting and relatable.

Key Responsibilities

* Design Instagram posts, stories, carousels, banners and promotional creatives.
* Create and edit short\-form videos and reels for Instagram and other digital platforms.
* Develop product advertisements highlighting features, offers and customer benefits.
* Convert content ideas and scripts into visually engaging videos.
* Assist with festival campaigns, product launches and brand\-awareness campaigns.
* Write or refine hooks, captions, on\-screen text and calls to action.
* Use AI creative tools to generate visuals, animations and video concepts.
* Maintain consistency in Qwikxy’s colours, logo placement, typography and overall brand identity.
* Resize and adapt creatives for different platforms and formats.
* Research social\-media trends, competitor content and viral content formats.
* Manage multiple creative assignments and deliver them within agreed timelines.

Skills We Are Looking For

* Good visual\-design sense and attention to detail.
* Basic proficiency in tools such as Canva and Adobe Photoshop or Illustrator.
* Video\-editing experience using CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects or similar software.
* Familiarity with AI creative tools for image or video generation is an advantage.
* Understanding of Instagram reels, social\-media trends and digital advertisements.
* Ability to write simple, engaging and relatable content.
* Comfortable communicating in English; knowledge of Hindi or Hinglish content is a plus.
* Ability to accept feedback and revise creatives quickly.
* Strong time\-management skills and willingness to learn.

Who Can Apply?

* Students or recent graduates in graphic design, visual communication, advertising, marketing, media or a related field.
* Self\-taught designers and content creators with a strong portfolio are also encouraged to apply.
* Candidates who can commit for at least \[3 months].
* Candidates with access to a laptop and the required design or editing software.
* Applicants who can share samples of previous designs, reels or personal creative projects.

What You Will Gain

* Hands\-on experience creating content for a growing e\-commerce brand.
* Practical exposure to social\-media marketing and digital advertising.
* Experience working on real products, offers and marketing campaigns.
* Opportunities to experiment with AI\-assisted creative production.
* Portfolio\-worthy work across multiple home\-improvement categories.
* Internship certificate and performance\-based recommendation.
* Possibility of a longer\-term or full\-time opportunity based on performance.

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**About the job \- Manager of Product Marketing – ExpertusOne** 

**Location:** Chennai, India (On\-site)

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Department:** Product Marketing

**About ExpertusOne** 

ExpertusOne is an enterprise Learning Management System (LMS) that helps organizations deliver, manage, and measure workforce learning at scale. Our platform serves global enterprises across compliance training, employee development, extended enterprise learning, certifications, classroom training, content management, eCommerce, analytics, AI\-powered learning experiences, and more. As we continue to expand our market presence, we are seeking a strategic and execution\-focused Manager of Product Marketing to define our product positioning, sharpen our messaging, support revenue growth, and serve as the bridge between Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing.

**Role Overview**

The Manager of Product Marketing will own the positioning, messaging, go\-to\-market strategy, competitive intelligence, analyst relations support, sales enablement, and product storytelling for the ExpertusOne platform.

This role requires a unique combination of strategic thinking, market insight, customer empathy, product understanding, and commercial acumen. The successful candidate will work closely with Product Management, Business Solutions Group (BSG), Sales, Pre\-Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Executive Leadership to ensure that ExpertusOne's value proposition is clearly communicated and differentiated in the market.

The ideal candidate understands enterprise SaaS, B2B technology marketing, and preferably the Learning \& Development (L\&D), Talent Development, HR Technology, or Learning Management System market.

**Key Responsibilities** 

**Product Positioning \& Messaging** 

* Define and continuously refine ExpertusOne's positioning, messaging, and value propositions.
* Create differentiated messaging for:

→ Enterprise LMS

→ Compliance Training

→ Certifications

→ Skills Development

→ AI\-Powered Learning

→ Content Authoring

→ Learning Analytics

→ Extended Enterprise Learning

→ Commerce \& Training Monetization

* Develop messaging tailored to:

→ CLOs

→ HR Leaders

→ L\&D Leaders

→ Operations Leaders

→ Compliance Teams

→ Training Administrators

→ Executive Buyers

* Build messaging frameworks and narrative strategies for new product releases and strategic initiatives.

**Go\-To\-Market Strategy** 

* Lead go\-to\-market planning for product launches, feature releases, platform enhancements, and strategic initiatives.
* Develop launch plans that align Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams.
* Create launch readiness programs and internal communication plans.
* Establish launch success metrics and measure business impact.

**Product \& Market Intelligence** 

* Conduct market research and identify emerging trends within:

→ Learning Management Systems

→ Learning Experience Platforms

→ Skills\-Based Learning

→ AI in Learning

→ Workforce Development

→ Compliance Training

→ HR Technology

* Maintain detailed competitive intelligence on major LMS and learning technology vendors.
* Develop battle cards, competitor comparisons, win/loss insights, and market analysis reports.
* Provide strategic recommendations to Product Management based on market feedback.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration \-** Partner closely with:

**Product Management** 

* Translate product capabilities into customer\-facing value.
* Influence product roadmap decisions using market insights.
* Support product launch planning and release communications.

**Sales** 

* Develop sales enablement assets and value\-based selling materials.
* Equip sales teams with competitive differentiation and messaging.
* Support strategic opportunities and executive presentations.

**Pre\-Sales / Solutions Consulting**

* Build demonstration narratives and use\-case\-driven storytelling.
* Create industry\-specific solution positioning.
* Assist in high\-value opportunities and RFP responses.

**Business Solutions Group (BSG)** 

* Align solution messaging with customer business outcomes.
* Support enterprise proposals and strategic account pursuits.
* Develop solution\-specific positioning frameworks.

**Customer Success** 

* Capture customer success stories and business outcomes.
* Create case studies, references, and customer advocacy programs.
* Support customer expansion and adoption initiatives.

**Corporate Marketing** 

* Align demand generation activities with product positioning.
* Support campaigns, webinars, events, analyst programs, and thought leadership initiatives.

**Sales Enablement**

* Own the creation and maintenance of:

→ Sales decks

→ Product presentations

→ Solution briefs

→ One\-pagers

→ Battle cards

→ Competitive matrices

→ ROI messaging

→ Value proposition frameworks

* Train sales and pre\-sales teams on product positioning and market differentiation.
* Develop industry\-specific and persona\-specific sales assets.

**Analyst \& Thought Leadership Support** 

* Support relationships with industry analysts and market influencers.
* Contribute to analyst briefings and evaluation submissions.
* Develop thought leadership content around:

→ Learning Technology

→ AI in Learning

→ Skills Transformation

→ Workforce Development

→ Compliance Training

* Represent ExpertusOne at industry events, webinars, conferences, and customer forums.

**Customer \& Voice\-of\-Market Programs** 

* Build programs to gather customer insights and market feedback.
* Conduct customer interviews and persona research.
* Lead win/loss analysis initiatives.
* Translate customer insights into actionable recommendations.

**Success Metrics \-** Success in this role will be measured through:

* Product adoption growth
* Pipeline influence and contribution
* Launch effectiveness
* Sales enablement effectiveness
* Win\-rate improvements
* Competitive win performance
* Analyst and market visibility
* Customer engagement and advocacy growth
* Messaging consistency across customer touchpoints

**Required Qualifications** 

**Education** 

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* MBA preferred.

**Experience** 

* 09–13 years of B2B SaaS marketing experience.
* Experience marketing enterprise software platforms.
* Demonstrated ownership of product positioning, messaging, and GTM strategy.
* Experience partnering closely with Product Management and Sales organizations.
* Experience supporting enterprise sales cycles and complex buying committees.

**Preferred Industry Experience** 

Strong preference for experience in one or more of:

* Learning Management Systems (LMS)
* Learning Experience Platforms (LXP)
* Talent Management
* HR Technology
* Workforce Development Platforms
* Enterprise SaaS Platforms
* Employee Experience Platforms

**Required Skills \& Competencies** 

**Strategic Skills** 

* Product positioning and messaging
* Go\-to\-market strategy
* Market segmentation
* Competitive intelligence
* Pricing and packaging support
* Analyst relations support

**Commercial Skills** 

* Enterprise B2B sales enablement
* Value\-based selling
* Solution marketing
* Executive communication
* Customer storytelling

**Analytical Skills** 

* Market research
* Win/loss analysis
* Customer insights
* Performance measurement
* Data\-driven decision making

**Communication Skills**

* Exceptional written and verbal communication
* Executive presentation skills
* Thought leadership content creation
* Workshop facilitation

**Leadership Skills**

* Cross\-functional leadership
* Stakeholder management
* Project management
* Team mentoring and development

**Preferred Candidate Profile** 

The ideal candidate:

* Has marketed enterprise SaaS products to HR, L\&D, Compliance, or Operations leaders.

* Understands how enterprise software is evaluated, purchased, and expanded.
* Is comfortable engaging with executives, prospects, customers, analysts, and internal stakeholders.
* Can influence without authority and drive alignment across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.
* Brings both strategic thinking and hands\-on execution capability.
* Thrives in a fast\-growing product organization where market differentiation and customer value are critical.

**Why Join ExpertusOne?** 

* Help shape the future of enterprise learning and workforce development.
* Lead product marketing for a mature enterprise SaaS platform with global customers.
* Work directly with Product, Sales, and Executive Leadership on company strategy.
* Drive AI\-powered learning innovation and next\-generation learning experiences.
* Build and scale the product marketing function during a high\-growth phase.

**Location Requirement:** This role is based in **Chennai** and requires **full\-time, on\-site presence.** Occasional travel may be required for customer meetings, industry events, and company initiatives.

If this opportunity aligns with your experience, **apply through this post** or share your profile at swethav@peopleone.co.

description:
**Company Description**  

Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**


At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise\-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And, over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.

**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

 **Job Description**  

Freshworks is hiring a Lead Product Marketer to drive go\-to\-market strategies, positioning, and adoption across the Freshdesk portfolio. As customer service software rapidly evolves alongside advances in AI and modern CX capabilities, proactive automation, and shifting buyer expectations, staying ahead of market alternatives is critical.


We’re looking for a seasoned SaaS product marketer who can bridge product capabilities with business value, enjoys translating complex AI technology into clear messaging, and thrives working cross\-functionally in a fast\-moving SaaS environment.

**What you'll do**

* Develop crisp product positioning and value\-driven messaging that differentiates Freshworks solutions in the customer service market.
* Frame technical capabilities into clear, compelling narratives tailored to buyer personas, CX leaders, and executives.
* Lead cross\-functional product launches in close collaboration with Product Management, Sales, Marketing, and Enablement teams.
* Lead competitive intelligence across the CX landscape, tracking competitor feature launches, pricing, and GTM moves.
* Develop, scale, and maintain actionable competitive enablement assets, including battlecards, competitive matrices, demos, FAQs, displacement pitch decks, and win/loss analysis. Serve as an SME on direct sales calls, executive briefing centers, and competitive deal desks.
* Create high\-impact sales tools, pitch decks, FAQs, demos, and collateral to equip GTM teams with targeted strategies for handling competitor objections, feature gaps, and displacement throughout the buyer journey.
* Partner with Product Management to feed real\-time competitive gap insights back into the product roadmap.
* Partner with Demand Generation, Lifecycle Marketing teams, and other PMMs to inject product and competitive positioning into field campaigns, web, content, webinars, and any customer\-facing collateral and campaigns.
* Integrate modern AI tools into daily marketing workflows to automate content creation, market research, competitive intelligence, and win/loss data analysis, thereby accelerating output and asset development.
* Stay current on emerging AI technologies and competitive offerings to help shape Freshworks' AI narrative.

 **Qualifications*** Any graduate degree (MBA preferred) with 7 to 9 years of prior experience in a similar position.
* Excellent English written, verbal, and presentation skills, with an eye for quality and attention to detail.
* An ability to understand AI, tech, and the customer service domain, including buyer behavior and ideal customer profiles, and translate tech content into marketing material
* Proven track record of planning and executing end\-to\-end marketing strategies, product launches, customer research, and messaging frameworks.
* Strong messaging and positioning skills, with the ability to simplify technical concepts for both business and technical audiences, complemented by a customer\-first mindset supported by strong market research and storytelling abilities.
* Strong expertise in integrating AI into product marketing processes, with hands\-on experience using modern AI tools to enhance marketing tasks, content creation, and research workflows.
* Strength in collaborating with cross\-functional teams, across geographies, including executive management, product management, operations, sales, and marketing

 **Additional Information**  

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

title: Commercial Marketing Manager
description:
Commercial Marketing Manager – India


Culture \& Values: Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart


Location: Mumbai / Bangalore, India (Hybrid)


Reports To: Director of Field Marketing, India


The Opportunity


As the Nutanix Commercial Field Marketing Manager, you will be the primary marketing engine driving scalable demand generation, pipeline acceleration, and market penetration across Nutanix’s India commercial segment.


Reporting directly to the Director of Field Marketing, India, you will sit at the intersection of commercial sales, demand generation, partner marketing, and sales engagement. In this high\-impact role, you will take ownership of designing and executing full\-funnel marketing programs that reach commercial audiences at scale and convert engagement into measurable business outcomes.


You will work closely with Commercial Sales leaders, Account Executives, Inside Sales, channel partners, the APJ marketing team, and the Global Demand Center to build repeatable programs that position Nutanix as the platform of choice for hybrid multicloud, cloud\-native applications, and Enterprise AI.


About the Team


You will be part of the vibrant India Field Marketing organisation, working in lockstep with local commercial sales leadership, the channel ecosystem, the APJ team, and Global Demand Center.


We operate in a fast\-paced, data\-informed environment where bold ideas, experimentation, and collaborative execution are central to how we build impactful marketing programs. The team combines strategic planning with hands\-on execution to create demand, accelerate pipeline, and strengthen Nutanix’s position in the Indian market.


Your Role (What You’ll Do)

* Build \& Execute the Commercial Demand Engine: Develop and lead integrated marketing plans for India’s commercial segment across digital campaigns, email, webinars, third\-party demand generation, seminars, workshops, and partner programs.
* Pipeline Generation \& Velocity: Own the commercial marketing target and partner closely with Commercial Sales leaders, Account Executives, and Inside Sales to build quarterly pipeline generation and acceleration plans.
* Scale Digital \& Lifecycle Programs: Create repeatable programs that acquire, engage, nurture, and re\-engage prospects and customers, with a focus on whitespace, net\-new logo acquisition, and measurable funnel progression.
* Drive Ecosystem Co\-Marketing: Work with resellers, distributors, system integrators, service providers, and technology partners to develop joint go\-to\-market programs that extend reach and generate partner\-sourced pipeline.
* Curate High\-Impact Commercial Experiences: Plan and deliver regional events, partner\-led activities, customer and prospect workshops, user groups, webinars, and other experiences that create meaningful sales engagement—not just attendance.
* Localize \& Contextualize Narratives: Translate global campaigns into relevant India\-focused messaging that addresses commercial customer priorities, including cloud modernization, infrastructure simplification, hybrid multicloud, cloud\-native applications, competitive displacement, and Enterprise AI adoption.
* Analytics \& Optimization: Monitor campaign performance, funnel progression, pipeline contribution, and program ROI using Salesforce, marketing automation, and analytics platforms. Test and optimize programs to improve quality, conversion, and efficiency.
* Advocate Customer Success: Identify and cultivate referenceable customers, testimonials, speakers, and local success stories that strengthen Nutanix’s value proposition across India.
* Manage Execution Excellence: Own program planning, budgets, agencies, vendors, timelines, follow\-up processes, and stakeholder communications across multiple concurrent initiatives.

What You Will Bring

* 6–9 years of B2B technology marketing experience, with specific experience in field marketing, demand generation, integrated campaigns, or commercial marketing.
* A proven track record of developing and executing high\-impact marketing programs that deliver measurable leads, meetings, opportunities, and pipeline.
* Strong understanding of commercial or mid\-market audiences and the ability to build programs that work across direct, digital, and partner\-led routes to market.
* Practical knowledge of the B2B sales funnel, lead management, campaign attribution, nurture, and sales follow\-up processes.
* Experience planning and executing digital programs, webinars, third\-party demand generation, seminars, workshops, regional events, and partner activities.
* Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships with Sales leaders, Account Executives, Inside Sales, channel teams, partners, APJ stakeholders, and global marketing teams.
* Hands\-on experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms such as Salesforce and Marketo; familiarity with campaign reporting and analytics is essential.
* Strong project management, budget management, prioritization, agency, and vendor\-management skills.
* Familiarity with enterprise software, SaaS, cloud, data center, infrastructure, or cybersecurity technologies, with the curiosity to learn complex technical solutions quickly.
* A data\-driven, results\-oriented mindset with the ability to analyze performance, communicate insights, and make clear recommendations.
* A creative thinker, team player, detail\-oriented, self\-motivated, and effective communicator who can thrive in a fast\-paced, changing environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field. An MBA is a plus.

Work Arrangement


Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration.


In India offices (Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster team alignment, collaboration, and access to in\-office resources.


The scope of responsibilities for this role is territory\-based across India, meaning that travel will be required for sales alignment, partner engagement, customer programs, and regional events.


Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.


Nutanix is a global leader in cloud software and a pioneer in hyperconverged infrastructure solutions, making computing invisible anywhere.


Companies around the world use Nutanix software to leverage a single platform to manage any app, at any location, at any scale for their private, hybrid, and multicloud environments.

title: Performance Marketing Freelancer
description:
**Company Description:** 




 1\-2\-Taste is transforming the B2B food ingredients industry through a digital, AI\-managed marketplace that optimizes how ingredients are sourced, sold, and innovated. Business customers can easily find and order a broad range of food ingredients from trusted suppliers. The platform is built on transparency in pricing, reliable delivery, and efficient supply chain management. This combination of technology and service quality makes 1\-2\-Taste a distinctive player in the global food ingredients market and an engaging environment for performance\-driven marketing professionals.
 



  





  





**Role Description** 




 Drive qualified lead generation and conversion growth through performance marketing campaigns, while ensuring accurate, reliable and actionable tracking and analytics across all digital channels.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should be equally strong in Performance Marketing and Marketing Analytics, with hands\-on expertise in Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4\), conversion tracking, event tracking, debugging and data validation.
 



  





**Key Result Areas (KRAs)**



* Increasing qualified leads
* Campaign ROI \- Efficient advertising spend
* Conversion Optimisation \- Improving conversion rates
* Tracking \& Measurement \- Accurate and reliable marketing data
* Analytics \& Reporting \- Clear performance visibility and actionable insights
* Data Quality\- Ensuring consistency between website activity, GTM and GA4



  





**1\. Performance Marketing** 



* Manage and optimise Google Ads, Meta Ads and LinkedIn Ads campaigns.
* Plan and execute campaigns based on lead generation and business objectives.
* Optimise targeting, audiences, budgets, bidding and campaign structures.
* Monitor CPL, conversion rates, ROAS and overall campaign performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve lead quality and reduce acquisition costs.
* Conduct A/B testing of campaigns, audiences, landing pages and creatives.



  





**2\. Google Tag Manager (GTM) – Advanced Expertise** 



* Take complete ownership of Google Tag Manager containers and tracking implementation.
* Create, configure and manage Tags, Triggers and Variables based on business and marketing requirements.
* Implement tracking for key website interactions such as:
* Form submissions
* CTA/button clicks
* Product/category page visits
* Sample requests
* Contact/lead forms
* Downloads
* Outbound clicks
* Scroll depth and engagement events
* Other important user journeys and conversion actions
* Maintain a clear and structured GTM container with proper naming conventions and documentation.
* Manage GTM versions, workspaces and publishing processes.
* Identify and troubleshoot duplicate, missing or incorrectly configured tags.
* Ensure that tracking implementations do not negatively impact website performance.



  





**3\. Google Analytics 4 (GA4\) – Advanced Expertise** 



* Take ownership of GA4 configuration, events, parameters, conversions and reporting.
* Configure and manage GA4 events and relevant event parameters.
* Define and maintain a clear measurement framework for the website and marketing campaigns.
* Configure relevant conversions/key events in GA4\.
* Ensure important user actions and business outcomes are properly captured.
* Analyze user journeys, acquisition sources, engagement and conversion behaviour.
* Create and maintain relevant GA4 explorations, reports and audiences.
* Ensure campaign data such as source, medium, campaign and other relevant parameters are captured correctly.



  





**4\. Tracking Validation, Testing \& Debugging** 




*This is a critical responsibility of the role.*



* Test every major tracking implementation before and after deployment.
* Use GTM Preview/Debug mode, GA4 DebugView and browser developer tools to validate tracking.
* Verify that the correct event is triggered when a user performs the intended action.
* Verify that the correct parameters and values are being passed with each event.
* Cross\-check that the data fired through Google Tag Manager is correctly received and recorded in GA4\.
* Identify discrepancies between:
* Website → GTM → GA4 → Advertising Platforms
* Test whether conversions are being recorded correctly and only once.
* Identify and resolve duplicate events, missing events, incorrect parameters and incorrectly firing tags.
* Perform regression testing whenever changes are made to the website, GTM or GA4 configuration.
* Regularly audit the tracking setup to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
* Maintain a tracking QA checklist and document any issues, fixes and changes made.



  





 5\. Conversion \& Campaign Tracking
 


* Implement and validate conversion tracking for Google Ads, Meta and LinkedIn.
* Ensure UTM parameters and campaign tracking are correctly implemented.
* Verify that campaign source/medium/campaign information is correctly attributed in GA4\.
* Ensure leads generated through different channels can be accurately identified and attributed.
* Troubleshoot discrepancies between advertising\-platform conversions and GA4 conversions.
* Continuously improve the accuracy of attribution and conversion measurement.



 6\. Analytics \& Reporting
 


* Maintain marketing dashboards and performance reports.
* Track key metrics including MQLs, leads, CPL, conversion rate, ROAS and campaign performance.
* Provide insights rather than simply reporting numbers.
* Identify trends, anomalies and tracking issues proactively.
* Highlight actionable recommendations for improving campaign and website performance.
* Ensure reporting data is based on properly validated tracking.



  





**Technical Skills Required**




*Must\-Have*



* Strong hands\-on experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM).
* Strong hands\-on experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4\).
* Advanced understanding of GTM containers, Tags, Triggers and Variables.
* Strong understanding of GA4 Events and Event Parameters.
* Experience implementing and testing conversion tracking.
* Experience debugging GTM and GA4 tracking issues.
* Ability to validate data flow from website → GTM → GA4 → advertising platforms.
* Strong understanding of UTM parameters and campaign attribution.
* Experience with Google Ads conversion tracking.
* Experience with Meta Pixel and LinkedIn Insight Tag.
* Ability to independently identify and fix tracking discrepancies.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.



*Good to Have*



* Understanding of Google Search Console.
* Basic understanding of JavaScript/dataLayer.
* Experience with CRM and marketing automation integrations.
* Experience with server\-side tracking/conversion APIs.
* Experience working with B2B lead\-generation websites.



  





**Ideal Candidate**




 We are looking for someone who is not just a campaign manager, but a hands\-on performance marketer who understands how data is generated, captured, validated and used to make marketing decisions.
 



  





 The candidate should be comfortable asking:
 



  





 “Did the user action actually fire?” → “Did GTM capture it correctly?” → “Did GA4 receive it correctly?” → “Was the correct parameter passed?” → “Was the conversion recorded correctly?” → “Can we trust the number in the report?”
 



  





 The candidate should be capable of independently setting up, testing, debugging and validating the complete tracking ecosystem without relying solely on developers or external analytics teams.
 


* KPI Owned
* KPI Target / Expectation
* MQL Generation Increasing
* Cost per Lead Optimized
* ROAS High
* Conversion Rate Improving
* Tracking Accuracy High
* Conversion Data Integrity 100% validated
* Reporting Accurate and actionable
* Reporting / Supervision



  





 Reports to: Head of Digital Marketing

description:
WE'RE HIRING \| SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER

**ALLOY DESIGN STUDIO \| Mumbai**

ALLOY is looking for a **Social Media Manager** with around **2 years of experience** to take ownership of our social media and digital presence.

We are looking for someone who understands that **marketing a design practice is different from marketing a product**. The role requires someone who can turn spaces, people, processes, and ideas into compelling stories — while maintaining a strong and consistent visual identity.

THE ROLE

This is a highly **hands\-on, creative, and execution\-driven** role. You will work closely with the design team, Founders, and external collaborators to conceptualise, create, shoot, edit, and publish content across ALLOY's platforms.

The ideal candidate has a **strong aesthetic and design sense**, understands storytelling, learns quickly, and is comfortable taking an idea from *"we should do this"* to actually making it happen.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Develop and manage ALLOY's **monthly content and social media calendar**.
* Come up with fresh content ideas, campaigns, formats, and ways to communicate our projects and brand.
* Develop content around **projects, design processes, materials, people, studio culture, site execution, and the thinking behind our work**.
* Edit project images and social media content while maintaining ALLOY's visual language and aesthetic.
* Conceptualise, plan, and coordinate **photoshoots and video shoots**, including locations, shot lists, props, talent, photographers, videographers, and production requirements.
* Participate actively in shoots and be comfortable directing or assisting with content production on the ground.
* Write and develop **scripts, captions, reels, interview formats, and other content**.
* Assist in conceptualising and producing **podcasts, founder interviews, conversations, and other long\-form content**.
* Regularly visit project sites to identify content opportunities and document the design and execution process.
* Coordinate with designers, photographers, videographers, editors, PR agencies, and other external collaborators.
* Identify relevant **design awards, publications, features, and industry opportunities**, and manage submissions from start to finish.
* Keep up with social media trends and identify which ones can be meaningfully adapted to ALLOY without compromising the brand.
* Monitor performance and use insights to continuously improve content and engagement.
* Maintain consistency across ALLOY's **visual identity, tone of voice, and overall brand positioning**.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

* **2\+ years of experience** in social media, content, digital marketing, or brand marketing.
* Experience marketing **service\-based businesses** is strongly preferred — particularly architecture, interior design, hospitality, real estate, luxury, lifestyle, or other creative industries.
* A **strong aesthetic eye** and genuine understanding of design, composition, imagery, typography, and visual storytelling.
* Strong content ideation and storytelling skills.
* Comfortable with **image editing and basic content production tools**.
* Strong writing and communication skills.
* Someone who is highly **hands\-on** and comfortable being involved in everything from planning a shoot to being on\-site during one.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, people, vendors, and deadlines.
* A fast learner who can understand a brand's language and evolve with it.
* Proactive, resourceful, and willing to take ownership rather than wait for instructions.
* Someone who notices details, has opinions, and can bring fresh thinking to the table.

THE PERSON WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for someone who simply **posts on Instagram**.

We're looking for someone who can **think like a marketer, see like a designer, and execute like a producer**.

Someone who can walk into a finished space and immediately see five stories worth telling. Someone who can organise a shoot, write the script, coordinate the team, get on site, edit the content, and make sure it goes out well.

If you are curious, creatively driven, hands\-on, and excited by the intersection of **design, culture, storytelling, and marketing**, we'd like to hear from you.

**Role:** Full\-time  
**Industry:** Interior Design \& Architecture

title: Brand Marketing Manager
description:
**Designation**\- Brand Marketing Manager
  

  

**Experience** \- 5 Years
  

  

**Position Description** – Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it's equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you.
  

In the capacity of a Brand Marketing Manager, you will ensure the efficient execution of business plans to meet future brand expectations and targets. You will also take part in the development of short\-term tactical Brand Management marketing plans. You will ensure brand integrity by guiding efforts across multiple channels and functions and support the development and execution of offline, digital, and paid social advertising programs for the business.
  

The role entails the management of media campaigns from the beginning to the end and is also responsible for the execution across all media channels inclusive of TV, Radio, Digital, Print, and Paid Social. The Brand Marketing Manager reports directly to the Director\- Womennovator.
  

  

**The Impact You'll Make in this Role** \-
  

  

**Strategy :** You will play part in the development of the brand marketing strategies in order to establish strategic direction and program positioning. In this capacity, the Brand Marketing Manager, you will develop marketing partnerships with media partners, and other external partners in an attempt to broaden the reach of the business’s brand messaging.
  

You will also play part in the development and execution of paid social programs on advertising platforms inclusive of Facebook, YouTube, Pinterest, and Twitter etc. along with supporting the brand’s paid media programs. At this capacity, you will contribute to the development and execution of all online/offline events, promotions for the business/brand.
  

  

**Management:** You will play a managerial role in the production process for all offline marketing materials, for example, project timelines, and so forth. You will be tasked with the maintenance of the lower department’s operational production budget, ensuring that there is a continuous effective and economical allocation of resources. You will also supervises multiple external agencies in developing creative advertising, high\-impact promotions, and media planning,event sponsorship.
  

You will additionally manage media timelines and executes plans across all media channels, that is, TV, Social, Radio, and Print etc. you will effectively supervisethe junior marketing staff/team, managing workflow, providing direction, and overseeing constant skill development. You will strike a balance in ensuring all branding and key information strategies are in line with overall business strategy without compromising the brand’s integrity.
  

  

**Collaboration:** You will work closely with Director, in reviewing and approving all branded elements for advertising and launch materials inclusive of printed collateral, product packaging, online assets, launch toolkits, product logos, and videos etc..
  

In this collaboration, he/she also provides feedback and insight on the performance of program campaigns and relays them for further strategic development and solution formulation. You will serves as a collaborative partner and liaison between all internal product departments in ensuring integrated campaigns and cohesive strategies. Youwill also be tasked with collaborating with external partners in ensuring that all media plans are aligned with the business’s values and goals, are executed on\-time and on\-budget.
  

  

**Analytics:** You will also play an analytical role where you will conduct research and analyses, translating campaign performance into communication documents and reports, which are distributed to management and key stakeholders. Some of these documents are marketing briefs, competitive analyses, campaign recap decks, and so forth.
  

At this capacity, You will track spending on all media campaigns for the purpose of ensuring that brand marketing efforts always stay within the allocated budget. Here, you will actualize cost reports per project at the completion of each brand marketing campaign. You will prepare account management, expenditure, progress, and other related reports. Additionally, you will review targeted spends and make real\-time adjustments to optimize brand marketing campaign performance.
  

  

**Knowledge and Opportunity:** You will also conduct regular and consistent research and keep the business and the brand marketing department informed on best practices and the latest trends in brand marketing that ensure that the business does not lag behind of its competition and also in order to provide growth opportunity for the brand by capitalizing on the acquisition potential that alternative branding strategies/approaches may hold.
  

At this capacity, you will ensure that the product/service maintains a consistent tone that is relevant to the business’s brand and the audience, solidifying the brand identity by ensuring consistent, on\-time and accurate development, deliveryfor each brand marketing campaign.
  

  

**Other Duties:** You will also performs other tasks as designated by the Director.
  

  

**To set you up for success in this role from day one, Womennovator is looking for candidates who must have the following qualifications:**  

  

  

* MBA or Master's Degree in Marketing (Completed and verified prior to start) from an accredited university


* Five (5\) combined years’ experience in brand management or integrated marketing


* Three (3\) years people leadership experience


* Strong communications (written, verbal, presentation and interpersonal) skills, including tact, diplomacy, and ability to influence and navigate across a diverse and complex organization.


* Highly proficient in Ms Word, PowerPoint, and Ms Excel


  

**Age:** Preferably below 35 years as on the closing date for receipt of application

 : Adani Airports Holding Limited is reshaping the aviation landscape, transforming airports into dynamic hubs of connectivity, innovation, and service excellence. Our vision is to create world\-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.

 Executive \- Marketing is responsible for execution of marketing strategies. This role is also responsible for organising events, identify sponsorships and enhance the airport's public image,
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute annual and quarterly BTL marketing calendars aligned with airport business objectives.
* Plan and manage on\-ground activations, experiential campaigns, roadshows, exhibitions, kiosks, and brand promotions.
* Coordinate seasonal and festive campaigns across terminals and commercial areas.
* Drive passenger engagement initiatives to enhance the travel experience.


**Retail \& Non\-Aero Revenue Support**
* Conceptualize promotional campaigns to increase footfall and sales at retail, F\&B, and service outlets.
* Collaborate with concessionaires to design joint marketing programs and customer engagement activities.
* Measure campaign effectiveness through sales uplift, footfall growth, and customer participation metrics.


**Event Management**
* Execute airport events, cultural programs, brand showcases, product launches, and entertainment activities.
* Manage event agencies, vendors, artists, and promotional partners.
* Ensure smooth implementation while complying with airport operational and security requirements.


**Stakeholder Coordination**
* Coordinate with internal departments including Operations, Security, Terminal Management, Commercial, and Corporate Communications.
* Liaise with brands, concessionaires, advertising agencies, and event partners.
* Obtain necessary approvals and ensure compliance with airport regulations.


**Digital \& Customer Engagement Support**
* Support digital marketing initiatives through integration with on\-ground campaigns.
* Assist in passenger engagement programs through social media, contests, and loyalty initiatives.
* Collect customer feedback and insights for future campaign planning.


**Vendor \& Budget Management**
* Identify and manage marketing agencies, event partners, and production vendors.
* Negotiate contracts and ensure optimum utilization of marketing budgets.
* Track campaign expenses and ensure adherence to approved budgets.


**Reporting \& Analytics**
* Monitor campaign ROI and prepare performance reports.
* Analyze passenger behavior, footfall trends, and promotional outcomes.
* Present campaign results and recommendations to management.


**Qualifications**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
* MBA/PGDM in Marketing, Mass Communication, Event Management, or related field.
* 5\-8 years of experience in BTL marketing, event management, retail marketing, mall marketing, hospitality, aviation, or experiential marketing.
* Experience in managing large\-scale consumer engagement activities preferred.


**Key Skills**
* BTL Marketing
* Event Management
* Brand Activation
* Retail Marketing
* Vendor Management
* Stakeholder Management
* Budget Management
* Communication \& Negotiation
* Campaign Planning \& Execution
* Data Analysis \& Reporting


**KPIs**
* Number of activations/events executed.
* Passenger engagement levels.
* Commercial area footfall growth.
* Retail/F\&B sales uplift from campaigns.
* Campaign ROI.
* Concessionaire participation and satisfaction.
* Budget adherence and execution efficiency.

title: Specialist - Brand, Marketing & Communication- Graphic Design
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 Specialist —Designer
   

  

 If you’re a marketer, creative, communicator, storyteller, or strategist, our unique blend of talented pros needs one more ingredient: you. Deloitte’s full\-service Brand, Marketing \& Communications organization is seeking collaborative creatives, skilful strategists, and marketing masterminds to lead our businesses in exciting new directions. At Deloitte, we combine world\-class creativity and business knowledge, insightful strategic thinking, and Deloitte’s powerful brand equity to create undeniable impact. If you find opportunity where others don’t, thrive in a supportive and diverse team environment, keep your finger on the pulse of cultural trends and the latest technology, and apply new ideas to challenge the status quo, then we want your talents in our mix. Together we’ll discover new ways to transform out\-of\-the\-box concepts into work that feels like marketing magic.
   

  

 In this role, you’ll contribute to the growth and development of the organization in a variety of ways. Everyday you’ll have the opportunity to use your skills to bring big ideas to life. We celebrate inquisitive team players who can regularly anticipate, adjust, and act in a rapidly changing market and marketing landscape—and find new opportunities within it.
   

  

**The work you’ll do**
* Design high\-quality external visual assets across print, digital, web, video, and internal communications formats within established brand guidelines.
* Create design work across all phases of development, from creative consultation and concepting through execution, revision, and final production.
* Translate stakeholder input and strategic direction into clear, visually compelling design solutions.
* Build storyboards, rough layouts, and design concepts that communicate ideas effectively and support business objectives.
* Collaborate with design managers, writers, and stakeholders to solve creative challenges and refine output.
* Ensure design work is accurate, on\-brand, visually cohesive, and production\-ready.
* Contribute to the team’s vision by sharing ideas, visual references, and practical design recommendations.


**The team**
 Deloitte’s Creative team within the Growth and Purpose office brings together the strength of Deloitte’s brand and the expertise of inspired marketing and creative professionals to deliver meaningful business impact. By combining strategic insight with world\-class creative thinking, the team develops compelling, data\-informed work that supports key business priorities. When stakeholders need next\-level solutions that support their business priorities, Brand, Marketing \& Communications is the partner that can transform big ideas into big impact .
   

  

**Location** 
 :
 **Hyderabad**
**Work timing** 
 :
 **2:00 PM–11:00 PM (IST)**
**Required**
**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, or a related field.
* 3–6 years of relevant experience in Graphic Design and Visual Design.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating work across print, digital, and illustration\-based deliverables.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, especially Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
* Strong illustration capability, including digital illustration; freehand illustration skills are a plus.
* Ability to translate strategic direction into high\-quality design within an established brand system.
* Strong understanding of layout, typography, iconography, composition, and visual storytelling.
* A wholistic understanding of AI and trends in design.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and work effectively within a process\-driven environment


**Preferred**
* Experience working in an advertising agency or large, matrixed, global organization.
* Familiarity with executive communications, integrated campaigns, or internal communications.
* Experience working with Wacom and presentation tools

 Think Hat Media

 Kolkata

 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 Freshers and junior creators are welcome
 



**Salary:** 
 ₹7,000–₹10,000 per month, depending on skills and portfolio
 


 About the Role
 
 We’re looking for a creative, detail\-oriented person who can turn ideas into
 **social media images and short\-form reels using AI tools, Canva and video\-editing tools.** 




 You’ll work on visual content for multiple client brands, following supplied briefs, copy and brand guidelines. This is a hands\-on creative role—ideal for someone who enjoys experimenting with AI while making sure the finished content looks polished and is ready to publish.
 



**This role focuses on creating images and reels. It does not include SEO, ad management, social media posting or client servicing.** 



 Key Responsibilities
 * **Create social media images:** 
 Design static posts, carousels, promotional creatives, festival greetings and story visuals using Canva and AI tools.
* **Produce short\-form reels:** 
 Turn client photographs, supplied footage and AI\-generated visuals into engaging reels with clear storytelling, text overlays, subtitles, transitions and suitable music.
* **Generate and refine AI content:** 
 Write and improve prompts, evaluate results, and correct visual errors rather than relying on the first generated output.
* **Follow each brand’s identity:** 
 Use the correct colours, fonts, logos and messaging. Preserve supplied logos and actual property or product photographs without unwanted alterations.
* **Prepare final deliverables:** 
 Check spelling, readability, cropping, image quality and video pacing; export in the required formats and organise editable files.
* **Handle feedback and deadlines:** 
 Make revisions accurately and manage assigned work across different client brands.


 What We’re Looking For
 * Working knowledge of
 **Canva, Gemini and other AI image or video\-creation tools** 
 , plus basic reel\-editing skills.
* A good eye for layout, typography, colour, composition and visual consistency.
* The ability to follow a brief, pay attention to details and improve work based on feedback.
* A portfolio showing both image designs and short\-form videos.
 **Personal projects and practice work are welcome.**



 You do not need to be an expert in every tool. We’re more interested in your creative judgment, willingness to learn and ability to turn an idea into a finished visual.
 


 What We Provide
 
 Clear creative briefs, brand assets, feedback and access to the required paid tools. You’ll gain hands\-on experience creating content for real client projects in a growing agency.
 


 How to Apply
 
 Send your
 **CV or a brief introduction, 3–5 image samples and 1–2 reel samples** 
 to
 **career@thinkhat.in** 
 .
 



**Email subject:** 
 Application – AI Content Creator – \[Your Name]
 



 Please mention the tools you use, your contribution to the samples and your availability to join. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a small paid practical assignment.
 



**Your portfolio matters more than certificates—we’d love to see what you can create.**
