title: SEO Team Lead
description:
**About DGTL360**

DGTL360 is a next\-generation, full\-service digital agency specialising in design, development, performance marketing, and analytics. Founded with the mission of driving measurable digital transformation, we partner with educational institutions, B\-Schools, and growth\-oriented brands to help them innovate, scale, and achieve their goals through data\-driven strategies and bespoke digital solutions.

Our team is a mix of experienced strategists and new\-age specialists who deliver beyond conventional methods — spanning campaign design, web development, UI/UX, SEO, PPC, and MarTech. With a strong client roster including premier educational institutions and a track record of long\-standing client relationships, DGTL360 is growing rapidly and looking for exceptional talent to grow with us.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a senior SEO professional ready to step into a leadership role. As SEO Team Lead at DGTL360, you will be the strategic and operational backbone of our organic search practice — owning SEO outcomes across a portfolio of client accounts while leading, mentoring, and growing a team of SEO specialists.

This is not a purely executional role. You will be expected to set the SEO vision for each client, connect organic strategy to broader business goals, drive alignment across content, development, and performance teams, and represent SEO as a growth lever in client conversations. The right candidate combines deep technical SEO knowledge with strong people leadership and client management skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. SEO Strategy \& Planning**

* Own the SEO strategy across an assigned portfolio of client accounts — from audit and discovery through to roadmap creation and quarterly planning.
* Develop customised organic search strategies for each client, aligned to their business goals, audience, and competitive landscape.
* Identify and prioritise opportunities across technical SEO, on\-page optimisation, content, and link acquisition to maximise organic visibility and traffic.
* Stay ahead of Google algorithm updates, search trends, and emerging SEO developments (AI search, SGE, zero\-click, etc.) and translate them into actionable recommendations.
* Build and present strategic SEO roadmaps to clients and internal stakeholders with clear timelines, KPIs, and expected outcomes.

**2\. Technical SEO Ownership**

* Lead comprehensive technical SEO audits covering site architecture, crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, page speed, structured data, hreflang, and mobile usability.
* Work closely with the web development team to ensure SEO best practices are embedded in all website builds, migrations, and updates.
* Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues — including crawl budget waste, duplicate content, canonicalisation errors, redirect chains, and log file anomalies.
* Oversee implementation of schema markup, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, and other technical configurations across client sites.
* Lead website migration projects with thorough pre\- and post\-migration SEO planning to protect and grow organic performance.

**3\. On\-Page SEO \& Content Strategy**

* Drive on\-page SEO excellence across client websites — including keyword mapping, meta optimisation, header structure, internal linking, and content gap analysis.
* Develop content strategies grounded in keyword research, search intent analysis, and competitive benchmarking.
* Collaborate with the content team to brief, review, and quality\-check SEO\-optimised content that serves both users and search engines.
* Build topical authority frameworks for clients by identifying pillar\-cluster opportunities and guiding content production accordingly.
* Conduct regular content audits to identify pages for improvement, consolidation, or removal based on performance data.

**4\. Off\-Page SEO \& Authority Building**

* Design and oversee ethical, white\-hat link acquisition strategies tailored to each client's niche and authority goals.
* Identify high\-quality link opportunities through digital PR, content partnerships, guest contributions, and industry directories.
* Monitor and manage backlink profiles using tools such as SEMrush — proactively disavowing toxic links where required.
* Build relationships with relevant publishers and content partners to support long\-term domain authority growth.

**5\. Analytics, Reporting \& Insights**

* Own SEO performance reporting across all client accounts — setting up dashboards in GA4, Google Search Console, and reporting tools (Looker Studio, etc.).
* Define and track meaningful SEO KPIs: organic sessions, keyword rankings, share of voice, click\-through rates, conversions from organic, and revenue attribution.
* Translate data into clear, client\-friendly insights and forward\-looking recommendations — connecting SEO performance to business outcomes.
* Conduct regular performance reviews with clients, presenting progress against goals and adjusting strategy based on data.
* Maintain a proactive approach to anomaly detection — flagging traffic drops, ranking volatility, or indexation issues early and responding swiftly.

**6\. Team Leadership \& Development**

* Lead, manage, and mentor a team of Senior SEO Specialists and Junior SEOs — setting clear goals, providing regular feedback, and supporting career growth.
* Conduct regular 1:1s, team reviews, and knowledge\-sharing sessions to build a high\-performance SEO culture.
* Delegate work effectively across the team based on skills, capacity, and client complexity.
* Establish team processes, SOPs, and quality benchmarks to ensure consistent, high\-quality output across all accounts.
* Champion continuous learning within the team — fostering a culture of curiosity, testing, and staying current with industry developments.

**7\. Client Management \& Stakeholder Communication**

* Serve as the primary SEO point of contact for assigned clients — building trusted, consultative relationships built on transparency and results.
* Lead client onboarding, strategy presentations, monthly review meetings, and QBRs.
* Coordinate seamlessly between the SEO team, content team, web development, PPC, and business development to deliver integrated, holistic digital strategies.
* Identify opportunities to grow client accounts through expanded scope, new services, or additional SEO investment.
* Ensure timely, accurate delivery of all client deliverables — audits, reports, recommendations, and content briefs.

**Skills \& QualificationsMandatory Requirements**

* Minimum 4 years of experience in SEO, with at least 2 years in a team lead or senior management role.
* Proven track record of managing and growing organic search performance across multiple client accounts simultaneously.
* Hands\-on experience with leading SEO tools: Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, and Looker Studio.
* Deep understanding of Google's ranking systems, core algorithm updates, and E\-E\-A\-T principles.

**Technical SEO**

* Expert\-level understanding of technical SEO: crawling, indexation, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, page speed optimisation, structured data, and log file analysis.
* Hands\-on experience managing website migrations with zero or minimal organic traffic loss.
* Proficiency in HTML, CSS basics, and working knowledge of JavaScript's impact on SEO.
* Familiarity with server\-side rendering, headless CMS architectures, and modern web development frameworks from an SEO perspective.

**Content \& On\-Page SEO**

* Strong command of keyword research methodologies, search intent mapping, and topical authority building.
* Experience briefing and collaborating with content writers to produce SEO\-optimised, high\-quality content.
* Ability to conduct comprehensive content audits and develop data\-backed content strategies.

**Leadership \& Communication**

* Proven ability to lead, motivate, and develop an SEO team with varying levels of experience.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to explain complex SEO concepts clearly to clients and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple accounts and deadlines without compromising quality.
* Client\-facing confidence with the ability to handle challenging conversations, manage expectations, and build long\-term partnerships.
* A postgraduate degree in Marketing, IT, Communications, or a related field is preferred.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

title: Marketing & Content Intern
description:
Rev AI Pvt. Ltd. is building RevampKey, an AI\-powered software development platform.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who wants to learn how serious technology marketing is built.
 



  





 This is not a copy\-paste social media role.
 



  





 Our audience includes founders, senior technology executives, engineering leaders, and other decision\-makers. To communicate with them, we need more than a regular posting schedule.
 



  





 Every piece of content should begin with a question:
 



  





 What is worth saying?
 



 Who needs to hear it?
 



 What problem does it help them understand?
 



 What evidence or experience makes it credible?
 



 Why would someone remember it or share it?
 



  





 You will be expected to research before writing, find original angles, understand the audience, and turn complex product and technology ideas into clear, useful communication.
 



  





 You will work on:
 



  





 • Researching technology, software development, AI, startup, and executive audiences
 



 • Developing original content ideas for LinkedIn and other relevant channels
 



 • Writing thoughtful founder\-led posts, product stories, and campaign content
 



 • Managing social media profiles and marketing channels
 



 • Creating presentations, marketing decks, campaign briefs, and research summaries
 



 • Editing basic videos for product communication and social media
 



 • Studying content performance and learning why certain ideas work
 



 • Working directly with the founder and product team
 



  





 We are not looking for someone who only wants to fill a content calendar.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who is curious, thoughtful, comfortable with research, open to feedback, and willing to put real effort into improving their work.
 



  





 MBA or postgraduate students specializing in Marketing are preferred. Freshers and BTech graduates with a genuine interest in marketing, content, technology, or communication are also welcome.
 



  





 You should have:
 



  





 • Strong written and spoken English
 



 • Basic knowledge of presentations, social media, and video editing
 



 • An interest in technology and business
 



 • The ability to think independently and ask better questions
 



 • A willingness to learn, take ownership, and work in an early\-stage startup environment
 



  





 By the end of this internship, you should have more than a certificate or another line on your CV. You should have stronger skills in research, writing, communication, content strategy, presentation, and execution.
 



  





 To apply, send your CV along with:
 



  





 1\. One example of work you have created, if available
 



 2\. One original content idea for founders or technology executives
 



 3\. A short note explaining why you want to learn technology marketing
 



  





 Good marketing does not begin with, “What should we post today?”
 



  





 It begins with, “What is worth saying, who needs to hear it, and why should they care?”
 



  





 If that is the kind of work you want to learn, we would be happy to hear from you.

**About the Role** 




  





 Ripple Links is looking for a driven and commercially strong Business Development Manager to lead new business acquisition and grow strategic brand partnerships across our Influencer Marketing and Content business.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of the influencer ecosystem, digital marketing, social media and branded content, along with a proven track record of building relationships with senior marketing stakeholders and closing high\-value business opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities**

 Negotiate high\-value opportunities while balancing client expectations and business profitability.
 



 Take ownership of opportunities from the first conversation through final closure and onboarding.
 



  





 🔹 Account Growth \& Partnerships
 



  





 Grow revenue from existing accounts through repeat campaigns, larger engagements and new business opportunities.
 



 Identify opportunities to expand relationships across categories, brands and marketing requirements.
 



 Conduct regular business conversations with clients to understand upcoming marketing priorities and opportunities.
 



 Build partnerships that contribute to long\-term revenue growth for Ripple Links.
 



  





 🔹 Market Intelligence \& Sales Strategy
 



  





 Track competitor activity, market trends, influencer pricing and evolving brand requirements.
 



 Identify new categories, brands and markets that can contribute to business growth.
 



 Share market insights with leadership and recommend new business opportunities.
 



 Maintain accurate sales pipeline, opportunity tracking and revenue forecasts.
 



  





 🔹 Team Collaboration \& Leadership
 



  





 Work closely with Strategy, Creator Partnerships, Creative, Campaign Management and Finance teams to ensure smooth conversion of business opportunities.
 



 Mentor and guide junior members of the Business Development team.
 



 Support the team with prospecting, pitching, negotiation and client relationship management.
 



 Represent Ripple Links at brand meetings, industry events, networking forums and pitch presentations.
 



 What We’re Looking For
 



 5\+ years of experience in Sales, Business Development, Brand Partnerships, Strategic Partnerships or Client Acquisition.
 



 Minimum 1\+ year of experience in Influencer Marketing / Creator Economy / Digital Marketing.
 



 Proven track record of acquiring new clients and consistently achieving revenue targets.
 



 Experience handling or closing ₹2–5 Cr\+ in annual business.
 



 Strong understanding of influencer marketing, social media platforms, content formats, creator ecosystems and digital marketing.
 



 Experience managing pan\-India brand portfolios and multiple senior client relationships.
 



 Strong network among Marketing Heads, Brand Managers, CMOs and digital/media agency leaders is a strong advantage.
 



 Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship\-building skills.
 



 Strong commercial understanding with experience in proposals, pricing and negotiations.
 



 Ability to work independently, build a pipeline from scratch and take complete ownership of business outcomes.

 Good to Have
 



 Strong relationships with marketing heads and digital/media agency leaders.
 



 Existing network across brands, agencies and digital\-first companies.
 



 Client references or recommendations from previous partnerships.
 



 Good understanding of influencer rates, engagement benchmarks and creator performance.
 



 Strong knowledge of emerging creators, content trends and social platforms.
 



  





**💡 About Ripple Links** 




  





 Ripple Links is an award\-winning influencer marketing agency focused on influencer\-first strategies and campaigns.
 



  





 We believe that the right mix of creativity, technology and passionate people drives the most impactful collaborations.
 



  





 We work with leading brands and creators across fashion, food, lifestyle, comedy, entertainment and multiple consumer categories, building influencer\-led campaigns that create meaningful brand impact.
 



  





 If you are someone who enjoys building relationships, cracking new business, closing high\-value deals and shaping the future of influencer marketing, this is an opportunity to take ownership and grow with us.
 



  





**🚀 Why Join Ripple Links?**

 High ownership and autonomy in your role.

 Opportunity to grow with a fast\-moving influencer marketing company.
 



 Be part of a team shaping the next phase of creator\-led marketing.

 If you're passionate about Influencer Marketing, Brand Partnerships and Business Development and have a proven record of closing high\-value business opportunities, we'd love to hear from you!

 📧 praveen@ripplelinks.com

**1\. Job Purpose**

We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented **Area Sales Manager – Modern Trade** to drive sales growth, distribution expansion, revenue generation, and brand visibility across modern trade channels.

The candidate will be responsible for developing strong relationships with modern trade customers, achieving sales targets, managing key accounts, implementing trade promotions, and expanding the company's presence across organized retail and modern trade outlets.

**2\. Key Responsibilities**

**Modern Trade Sales**

* Develop and execute sales strategies for Modern Trade channels to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual targets.
* Manage sales operations across supermarkets, hypermarkets, organized retail chains, and other modern trade outlets.

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with Modern Trade customers and key accounts.

* Plan and execute in\-store promotions, displays, activations, schemes, and promotional campaigns.

* Monitor competitor activities, pricing, promotions, product launches, and market trends.

* Ensure discipline, reporting, and achievement of assigned targets.

**Educational Qualification:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field.

**Experience:**

* **5–10 years of relevant experience in Sales \& Marketing.**
* Mandatory experience in **Modern Trade / FMCG / Food \& Beverages / Consumer Products** or a closely related industry.
* Candidates with strong experience handling supermarkets, hypermarkets, organized retail chains, and key accounts will be preferred.

**6\. Required Skills**

* Strong Modern Trade sales and business development skills.
* Excellent negotiation and relationship\-management abilities.
* Good understanding of FMCG/food product distribution.
* Strong knowledge of modern trade operations and retail execution.
* Target\-oriented and result\-driven approach.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to manage distributors, retailers, and sales teams.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel, sales reports, MIS, and sales analysis.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.

**7\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Achievement of monthly and annual sales targets.
* Primary and secondary sales growth.
* Modern Trade outlet expansion.
* New account/customer acquisition.
* Product distribution and availability.
* SKU\-wise sales growth.
* Market share and territory growth.
* Trade promotion effectiveness.
* Collection and outstanding management.
* Distributor and team performance.
* Reduction in expiry, damages, and sales returns.

**8\. Preferred Candidate Background**

Candidates from the following sectors will be preferred:

* Packaged Foods
* Consumer Goods
* Retail / Organized Retail

**Salary: Best in the Industry**

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**Marketing Manager** 




 Own Growth. Drive Visibility. Turn Traffic into Business.
 



  





**Salary Offered:** 
 8 LPA \- 10 LPA
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 For most customers, the journey with Zolo starts online. Whether someone is searching for co\-living, student housing, hotels, or short stays, search remains one of the most powerful acquisition channels available to the business. As Zolo continues to scale, we need a growth\-focused marketer who can ensure that customers discover us before they discover our competitors. This role exists to build and scale a predictable acquisition engine through SEO and Google Ads.
 



 A strong hire will help us:
 


* Increase qualified website traffic
* Improve search visibility across key categories
* Generate high\-quality leads at efficient costs
* Improve conversion from traffic to bookings
* Build sustainable growth beyond paid dependency



 If this role is strong, customer acquisition becomes scalable and measurable.
 



 If this role is weak, traffic stagnates, acquisition costs increase, and growth becomes inconsistent.
 



  





**Your mandate is clear** 



* Own SEO performance across Zolo businesses
* Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns end\-to\-end
* Drive growth in organic traffic and lead generation
* Improve conversion rates across landing pages and campaigns
* Maximize marketing ROI through continuous optimization
* Build a data\-driven growth engine through experimentation and analysis



 This is not a campaign execution role.
 



 It is end\-to\-end ownership of search visibility, paid acquisition performance, and growth outcomes.
 



  





**About Zolo** 




 Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.
 



 People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.
 



 Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.
 



 Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.
 



 Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.
 



 Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life. Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation.
 



  





**What you will be responsible for** 




**1\.Own SEO Growth** 



* Drive on\-page, off\-page, and technical SEO initiatives
* Improve keyword rankings across priority business categories
* Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis
* Identify opportunities to grow organic visibility and traffic
* Work closely with content, product, and technology teams to improve search performance



**2\.Own Google Ads Performance** 



* Manage Google Search, Display, and Performance Max campaigns
* Optimize campaigns for traffic, leads, and conversions
* Improve campaign efficiency and return on ad spend
* Monitor budgets, bidding strategies, and keyword performance
* Ensure continuous improvement in acquisition metrics



**3\.Drive Traffic\-to\-Conversion Performance** 



* Improve landing page performance and conversion rates
* Partner with design and product teams to optimize user journeys
* Run A/B tests and growth experiments
* Identify and remove conversion bottlenecks



**4\.Use Data to Drive Decisions** 



* Track traffic, lead generation, conversion, and acquisition metrics
* Monitor CPL, ROAS, CTR, conversion rates, and keyword performance
* Build performance dashboards and business insights
* Take decisions based on data rather than assumptions



**5\.Own Growth Experiments** 



* Identify new acquisition opportunities
* Test channels, landing pages, messaging, and audience strategies
* Scale successful experiments and eliminate low\-performing activities
* Continuously improve marketing efficiency



**6\. Stakeholder \& Agency Management** 



* Coordinate with internal teams and external partners
* Work with agencies, freelancers, and vendors where required
* Ensure alignment between marketing activities and business goals



**What success looks like after 6–12 months** 



* Significant improvement in organic traffic and keyword rankings
* Improved Google Ads efficiency and ROI
* Higher volume of qualified leads and bookings
* Reduced customer acquisition costs
* Strong reporting visibility across growth channels
* Consistent contribution to business growth through digital channels



 The role delivers predictable traffic, measurable growth, and efficient customer acquisition.
 



  





**Who this role is for** 




 You will likely thrive here if:
 


* You enjoy solving growth problems through data and experimentation
* You are comfortable owning outcomes, not just activities
* You think in traffic, leads, conversions, and revenue
* You enjoy identifying opportunities others miss
* You are analytical, curious, and execution\-focused
* You like continuously testing, learning, and improving performance



  





**Experience we value** 



* 2–5 years of experience in SEO, Performance Marketing, or Growth Marketing
* Strong hands\-on experience with Google Ads
* Good understanding of technical SEO and search fundamentals
* Experience with Google Analytics, Search Console, Tag Manager, and reporting tools
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability
* Experience in startups, consumer internet, e\-commerce, travel, hospitality, or high\-growth businesses preferred



 A marketing degree is not mandatory.
 



 Strong execution capability, curiosity, and ownership matter more.
 



  





**The impact you will have** 



* You directly influence customer acquisition and business growth
* You help customers discover Zolo through search
* You improve marketing efficiency and ROI
* You build scalable growth channels that contribute to long\-term revenue growth



  





**Why join now** 




 Zolo is entering its next phase of growth across multiple business lines.
 



 Search and performance marketing will play a critical role in:
 


* Customer acquisition
* Revenue growth
* Brand visibility
* Long\-term scalability



 This role offers a direct path toward Growth Marketing, Performance Marketing Leadership, and broader Business Growth roles.

title: Head of Marketing
description:
**Head of Marketing** 




**Location** 
 : Bengaluru,India
 



 Reports to the Chief Product Officer
 



  





**About Deep Cognition** 




 Deep Cognition builds AI automation for freight forwarding and customs brokerage. Freight forwarding runs on people and paperwork. We build the AI that handles the repetitive work so teams can focus on customers.We have two products. Agentic TMS is a transportation management system run by AI agents. The agents handle quoting, booking, customs filing, and invoicing across the shipment lifecycle. PaperEntry AI is intelligent document processing. It reads commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, and customs entries with 99 percent or better accuracy. Together they let a forwarder or broker move 5 to 10 times more volume with the same team.Our customers include C.H. Robinson, Maersk, JAS Worldwide, Dachser, and Rohlig Logistics. We process over $1 billion in goods each year.
 



 We are an early stage company with a small, fast team. Our headquarters is in Dallas, Texas. Our engineering and marketing teams are in Bengaluru. Our customers are in the US, Canada, Europe, and Asia.
 



  





**The role :** 




 We are hiring a Head of Marketing to own our pipeline. You will report to the Chief Product Officer, who currently leads marketing. Your job is simple to state. Grow the number of qualified leads. Turn those leads into sales meetings. Make our brand the one forwarders and brokers think of when they think about AI for logistics. This is a hands on leadership role. You will set the strategy. You will also run campaigns yourself. You will manage a small in house team and a bench of external contractors and agencies.
 



  





**What we are looking for :** 



* 8 or more years in B2B marketing. At least 3 years leading a team or a function.
* Experience at an early stage startup. You have built marketing from a small base with a small budget.
* A track record of growing pipeline. You can show the numbers.
* Experience managing external contractors and agencies. You know how to brief, measure, and replace vendors.
* Strong writing. You can produce a clear email, landing page, or one pager without an agency.
* Comfort with data. You know your cost per lead, conversion rates, and pipeline sources.
* Based in Bengaluru or willing to relocate. Hybrid work from our Bengaluru office.

**What you will do :** 



* Own the lead pipeline target. Report on it weekly.

* Build and manage the marketing tech stack.
* Manage external contractors for content, design, video, paid media and appointment setting. Set clear briefs. Hold them to results.
* Write and edit content that speaks to freight forwarders and customs brokers. Cover both Agentic TMS and PaperEntry AI.
* Plan our conference and trade show calendar. Run our presence at events.
* Work with Sales on lead handoff, follow up, and conversion.
* Work with Product on positioning, launches, and customer stories.
* Own our website and our presence on review and analyst sites.
* Hire and coach a small marketing team as we grow.



  





**It would be great if you have :** 



* Logistics, freight, customs, or supply chain industry experience. This is our ideal profile.
* Experience marketing to US and European buyers from India.
* Experience marketing AI agents, TMS, or document automation products.
* Experience with outbound prospecting and sales engagement tools.

 , you will be the commercial catalyst for our region. Sitting within the APAC Demand Generation team and reporting to the Senior Director of Demand Generation (APAC), you will be responsible for developing and implementing end\-to\-end marketing strategies that generate high\-quality leads and drive revenue for the Indian business.
   

  

 We are looking for a marketing leader who bridges the gap between strategy and execution. You will act as the vital linchpin between the India Sales Leadership team and our global/regional marketing functions, seamlessly adapting global frameworks into highly impactful, hyper\-localized programs that resonate with Indian IT leaders and decision\-makers.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 As the Marketing Manager for India, you will take ownership of the regional marketing roadmap, orchestrating campaigns that build our brand and directly fill the sales pipeline.
   

  

* Strategic Planning \& Alignment: Build and own the comprehensive regional marketing plan. Collaborate deeply with the APAC Demand Gen leader and the India Regional Vice President to align marketing initiatives with core business goals and sales priorities.
* Multi\-Channel Campaign Execution: Design and implement persona\- and industry\-specific campaigns. Orchestrate a diverse mix of tactics including physical and digital events, executive roundtables, Account\-Based Marketing (ABM), email nurtures, and community marketing.
* Localization \& Global Synergy: Work in tandem with global program teams to execute the "local flavor" of global campaigns. Localize messaging, digital properties (website, landing pages), and assets to optimize SEO/AEO for the Indian market.
* Partner \& Ecosystem Marketing: Collaborate closely with regional Partner Managers to increase local brand awareness, drive joint partner pipeline, and support partner enablement through tailored campaign toolkits.
* Budget \& ROI Management: Take full ownership of the regional field and partner marketing budget. Rigorously track program spending, assess campaign effectiveness, and continuously optimize for maximum Return on Investment (ROI).
* Data\-Driven Reporting: Provide regular, detailed reporting on pipeline health and marketing analytics (lead funnel, account engagement) to regional leadership, driving corrective actions to ensure demand generation targets are met.
* Customer Advocacy: Partner with the Corporate Communications team and local agencies to craft compelling local customer success stories that resonate in the Indian market.


**Qualifications**
 We are looking for a highly results\-focused, energetic professional who combines strong commercial acumen with a deep understanding of the B2B technology sales process in India.
   

  

* Professional Experience: 8\+ years of experience in Field Marketing, Demand Generation, or a related B2B marketing role, specifically within the IT/Software (SaaS/PaaS) industry in India.
* Market Expertise (GCC Focus): Proven experience marketing to Global Capability Centres (GCCs) or running GCC\-focused marketing programs is a massive advantage, given their critical and growing significance within India's enterprise ecosystem.
* Campaign Mastery: Demonstrated experience building and executing multi\-channel marketing programs to drive pipeline, with hands\-on expertise in ABM, event management, and digital content adaptation.
* Stakeholder Management: Exceptional collaboration and stakeholder management skills. The ability to confidently present to cross\-functional leaders, absorb feedback gracefully, and align local sales teams with global marketing directives.
* Analytical Rigor: Highly analytical mindset with prior experience managing end\-to\-end budgets and reporting on complex marketing KPIs to senior leadership.
* Drive \& Agility: A self\-starter with a growth mindset. Adept at working independently on multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment, acting with urgency, and demonstrating an energetic, resourceful attitude.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive Compensation: A highly competitive base salary paired with a performance\-driven bonus structure aligned with regional pipeline and revenue goals.
* Health \& Wellness: Comprehensive healthcare coverage for you and your dependents.
* Financial Security: Statutory retirement benefits including generous Employee Provident Fund (EPF) and Gratuity contributions in full compliance with Indian labor laws.
* Work\-Life Balance: Flexible working hours, a hybrid work environment, and generous paid time off (PTO) including observance of all major Indian public holidays.
* Continuous Growth: Dedicated budget and resources for continuous career development, certifications, and ongoing learning within the fast\-paced SaaS marketing space.
* Global Culture: The opportunity to be a pivotal leader in a high\-growth, global organization, collaborating within a diverse, inclusive workplace culture that champions innovation and autonomy.

description:
**About Hector Beverages Pvt. Ltd.**
 Established in 2010 in India, Hector Beverages rose to prominence with its signature brand, the Paper Boat, a ready\-to\-drink beverage that encapsulates the essence of traditional Indian flavors. The inception of Hector Beverages was driven by the founders' vision to bridge the market void for traditional Indian drinks and to present the world with a taste of India's rich cultural beverages.
   

  

 L ocation
   

  

 Headquartered in Whitefield, Bengaluru.
   

  

 Current Standings
   

  

 Over the past decade, Hector Beverages has expanded its product line to include fruit juices, coconut water, and iconic Indian beverages such as Aam panna and Jal\-jeera and foods \& dry fruits which includes products such as Chikki, Aam Papad, range of raw, roasted, and flavored dry fruits that includes mix of nuts, berries \& seeds. The brand is synonymous with distinctive flavors and premium ingredients. Furthermore, the firm's commitment to quality and innovation is evidenced by its extensive infrastructure of nine dedicated factories (and counting) for Paper Boat products, providing direct employment to approximately 900 individuals and indirect employment to another 2000\.
   

  

 Organizational Culture
   

  

 At its core, Hector Beverages thrives on a culture rooted in innovation, creativity, and collaboration. The company's flat organizational structure promotes open dialogue, empowering employees to lead their projects passionately. Hector Beverages is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. The organization is dedicated to fostering high\-performing teams. Moreover, the culture of celebrating both minor and major achievements, nurture a motivated and committed workforce, driving exponential growth.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Paper Boat is looking for an Influencer Marketing Intern to join our brand team for a 6\-month, full\-time internship based out of our Bangalore office. This is a hands\-on role for someone who wants real exposure to how a FMCG brand builds and runs creator\-led campaigns from the ground up. You'll work with the Creative Team on Paper Boat's influencer marketing engine — from creator selection to content review to campaign tracking — and get a front\-row seat to how a Gen Z\-first beverage brand builds culture\-relevant marketing.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Creator sourcing \& vetting: Help identify and shortlist nano, micro, and macro creators aligned with Paper Boat audience and brand personality.
* Agency coordination: Liaise with our roster of influencer marketing agency partners on brief distribution, creator go\-lives, and timely reporting.
* Content review: Review creator content drafts against brand briefs, tone\-of\-voice guidelines, and ASCI disclosure norms before go\-live approval.
* Campaign tracking: Maintain and update the Influencer campaign tracker — creator status, go\-live dates, content links, and performance data.
* Reporting \& analysis: Help compile weekly/monthly campaign performance summaries and flag high performing content for amplification.
* Ad\-hoc brand support: Assist with other Paper Boat marketing initiatives as they come up — this role will evolve with the brand's needs.


**What We're Looking For**
* Genuine interest in social media, creator culture, and how brands show up on Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.
* Sharp eye for funny, witty content — you can tell good creator content from generic content.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets/trackers; no prior tool experience required, we'll train you.
* Strong written communication — you'll be reviewing briefs and creator content daily.
* Organized and detail\-oriented — juggling multiple agencies and creators requires it.
* Bias for action and comfort with ambiguity — this is a startup\-paced brand team, not a big\-company internship.


**Internship Details Duration\- 6 months**
**Location\- Bangalore (Hector Beverages office)**
**Work Mode\- Full\-time,**
**Start Date\- Immediate**

 OrangeCarrot Media is a full\-funnel growth agency running SEO, paid media, lifecycle marketing, and analytics for a portfolio of US clients.
 



  





 This role owns SEO content strategy and execution across multiple client accounts at once, search intent and topical authority strategy, content calendars, on\-page optimization, and ranking/traffic results, each account with its own vertical, voice, and goals.
 



  





 This is not a single\-brand, in\-house marketing role. You'll be running several clients in parallel, each with different priorities and deadlines, and you're expected to already know how to do that without it becoming chaos.
 



  





**What You'll Own:** 



* Search intent and topical authority strategy per client account, tied to what people are actually asking, not just keyword volume.
* Editorial calendars and topical/content maps across multiple accounts simultaneously.
* On\-page optimization: titles, meta, headings, internal linking, content structure.

* Coordinating with writers (or writing directly, depending on account) to get content from brief to published.
* Tracking rankings, traffic, and keyword movement per client via GSC, Ahrefs/Semrush, and Google Analytics and reporting what's actually working.
* Cross\-functional coordination with the technical SEO and creative teams to keep each account's SEO and content in sync.



  





**What you'll bring** 
**:** 



* Agency experience specifically, proven track record managing SEO/content for multiple clients concurrently, not one brand in\-house.
* Demonstrated ranking/traffic results you can speak to concretely (keywords ranked, traffic growth, what you actually did to get there).
* Fluency with Semrush/Ahrefs, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and at least one CMS (WordPress, Webflow, or similar).
* Strong organizational discipline: you will be running several client calendars at once and nothing falls through the cracks.
* Comfort using AI\-assisted tools to speed up research and drafting, without letting that replace your own editorial judgment or SEO reasoning.



  





**How to Apply:** 




 Do not apply through LinkedIn Easy Apply. Email hello@orangecarrotmedia.com with the subject line "SEO Content Manager: \[Your Name]".
 



 Include:
 


1. A short write\-up of one ranking or traffic result you're proud of, redact the client name and exact numbers if needed. What was the goal, what did you actually do, and what changed.
2. Your honest read on this job post, what excites you, what concerns you.
3. Confirmation that you're able to work a night shift aligned with US business hours, this role works directly with US clients, so this is a hard requirement, not a preference.



 No cover letter template. A short, direct note is enough.

**Performance Marketing Executive** 




  





**Location: Mumbai (On\-site)** 




**Employment Type: Full\-time** 




**Experience: 2–4 Years** 




  





 About Stay Ukiyo
 



  





 Stay Ukiyo is a luxury vacation rental brand curating premium villas and holiday homes across India’s most sought\-after destinations. Our mission is to redefine hospitality by combining exceptional stays, personalized service, and technology to create memorable travel experiences. As we continue to expand, we’re looking for a performance\-driven marketer who understands the hospitality industry and is passionate about driving bookings and revenue through digital channels.
 



  





 Role Overview
 



  





 We are looking for a Performance Marketing Executive to lead our customer acquisition efforts across paid digital channels. You will be responsible for planning, executing, optimizing, and scaling campaigns that drive qualified leads and direct bookings while maximizing return on ad spend.
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone who understands consumer travel behavior, booking funnels, seasonality, and hospitality marketing. You will work directly with the founders and collaborate closely with the sales, reservations, design, and content teams to accelerate Stay Ukiyo’s growth.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 \* Plan, execute, and optimize paid campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, YouTube, Display, and other performance channels.
 



 \* Drive direct villa bookings while reducing dependency on OTAs.
 



 \* Manage monthly advertising budgets and maximize ROAS, occupancy, and booking revenue.
 



 \* Develop acquisition strategies for weekend getaways, holiday seasons, long weekends, corporate retreats, celebrations, and destination travel.
 



 \* Launch remarketing campaigns targeting website visitors, abandoned enquiries, and previous guests.
 



 \* Create audience segmentation strategies based on traveller personas, destinations, and booking behaviour.
 



 \* Continuously optimize campaigns through A/B testing of creatives, audiences, bidding strategies, and landing pages.
 



 \* Monitor campaign performance across the complete booking funnel, from click to confirmed reservation.
 



 \* Collaborate with the reservations and sales teams to improve lead quality and booking conversion rates.
 



 \* Coordinate with designers and content creators to develop high\-converting ad creatives and landing pages.
 



 \* Analyze competitor campaigns, travel trends, destination demand, and seasonal opportunities.
 



 \* Prepare weekly and monthly reports with actionable insights and growth recommendations.
 



 \* Track campaign performance using Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, Google Tag Manager, and reporting dashboards.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




  





 \* 2–4 years of experience in Performance Marketing, preferably in hospitality, travel, vacation rentals, hotels, resorts, OTAs, or tourism.
 



 \* Hands\-on experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics (GA4\), Google Tag Manager, and Meta Pixel.
 



 \* Strong understanding of booking funnels, customer acquisition, and conversion optimization.
 



 \* Experience managing campaigns focused on bookings, revenue, or lead generation.
 



 \* Knowledge of attribution models, conversion tracking, audience targeting, and remarketing.
 



 \* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and make data\-driven decisions.
 



 \* Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets for reporting and analysis.
 



 \* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
 



 \* Ability to work in a fast\-paced startup environment with ownership and accountability.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  





 \* Experience working with luxury hospitality brands, hotels, villas, resorts, or travel companies.
 



 \* Familiarity with OTA platforms such as Airbnb, Booking.com, Agoda, and MakeMyTrip.
 



 \* Understanding of seasonal demand, occupancy management, and hospitality revenue strategies.
 



 \* Experience with CRM, WhatsApp marketing, email automation, and customer retention campaigns.
 



 \* Knowledge of Looker Studio or similar reporting tools.
 



 \* Familiarity with AI tools for creative generation and campaign optimization.
 



  





**Success Metrics (KPIs)** 




  





 \* Direct Booking Growth
 



 \* Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
 



 \* Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
 



 \* Cost Per Booking
 



 \* Qualified Lead Volume
 



 \* Occupancy Growth
 



 \* Revenue Generated Through Paid Campaigns
 



 \* Booking Conversion Rate
 



 \* Website Conversion Rate
 



 \* Customer Lifetime Value (LTV)
 



  





**Why Join Stay Ukiyo?** 




  





 \* Work directly with the founders and play a key role in scaling one of India’s growing luxury vacation rental brands.
 



 \* Own high\-impact marketing campaigns with measurable business outcomes.
 



 \* Opportunity to experiment, innovate, and build performance marketing from the ground up.
 



 \* Fast\-paced environment with significant learning and career growth.
 



 \* Competitive compensation and performance\-based incentives.

title: Content Marketing Manager, Prime Video
description:
**Description**
 Join the Prime Video Content Marketing team as a Content Marketing Manager supporting title campaigns across Australia and New Zealand — from global tentpoles to locally relevant content.  This is the first India\-based role dedicated to AUNZ content marketing. You'll sit with the India team locally while embedding into the AUNZ marketing squad day\-to\-day.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Support the planning and execution of title marketing campaigns for AUNZ, including global tentpoles and local originals
* Coordinate day\-to\-day with creative, media, social, and PR teams to keep campaigns on track — managing timelines, asset deliveries, feedback loops, and approvals
* Track and report on campaign performance, pulling together post\-campaign recaps and actionable insights to inform future strategy
* Manage operational workflows — briefing agencies, routing assets, maintaining campaign trackers, and ensuring stakeholder alignment
* Contribute to measurement frameworks, compiling data and surfacing trends that help the team optimise campaigns over time
* Support always\-on marketing activity alongside tentpole moments


**What Makes This Role Exciting**
* High\-visibility campaigns — you'll work to support Prime Video's biggest global launches and locally resonant content in AUNZ
* Cross\-functional hub — you'll build strong working relationships with creative, media, social, PR, and regional stakeholders
* Performance lens — you'll develop analytical skills that directly influence how the team allocates effort and investment
* First of its kind — you'll shape what this India\-based AUNZ marketing role looks like as it grows
* Global company, regional impact — you'll be part of a lean, fast\-moving team where your contributions are felt immediately


 This is an individual contributor role based in Mumbai, India. This role requires working AUNZ time\-zone hours.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Your day starts on AUNZ time, syncing with the Australia and New Zealand teams as their day kicks off:
   

  

 Morning (AUNZ hours): Check\-in on campaign trackers and flag any blockers ahead of the week's title launches. Jump on a stand\-up with the AUNZ creative agency to review asset deliveries . Follow up with the media team on paid placement timelines.
   

  

 Mid\-morning: Join the weekly campaign sync with the PR team to align on press outreach and talent moments tied to an upcoming global tentpole launch. Where necessary, update the campaign timeline and circulate next steps to stakeholders.
   

  

 Afternoon: Pull together performance data from last week's local title launch — compile viewership, social engagement, and media metrics into a recap. Surface key insights and draft recommendations for the next campaign cycle. Share the recap with your manager and the wider AUNZ marketing squad.
   

  

 Late afternoon: Connect with the social team on an upcoming title's content calendar, ensuring visibility across teams against the paid media plan. End the day reviewing media delivery trackers queued for the next tentpole to ensure all details required are on\-track.
   

  

**You'll Spend Your Time Across**
 Campaign coordination and operational delivery (creative, media, social, PR)
   

  

 Performance reporting and campaign measurement
   

  

 Stakeholder communication and cross\-functional alignment
   

  

 You'll regularly collaborate with: Creative producers, media partners, social teams, PR, and the Sr. Content Marketing Manager.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Prime Video Content Marketing team for AUNZ is responsible for bringing Prime Video's content slate to life for audiences across Australia and New Zealand. We develop and execute marketing campaigns that drive awareness, engagement, and viewership — spanning global tentpole originals, local titles, and licensed content.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of professional non\-internship marketing experience
* Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
* Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
* Experience building and optimizing multiple, simultaneous marketing campaigns
* Experience managing or working within cross\-functional marketing and creative teams
* Experience delivering paid media campaigns spanning TV, print ads and digital/social channels


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in multi\-territory campaign management
* Experience in digital marketing and content production timelines and process
* Experience in the entertainment industry
* Experience in a marketing role and proficient with analytic tools
* Experience working independently with minimal supervision
* Experience working within a global company, with multi\-country responsibilities

title: Marketing Executive
description:
About the Role
 
 We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented Marketing Executive with 3–5 years of experience to support YUJ Designs’ marketing initiatives across brand communication, social media, email marketing, website, performance marketing, SEO, PR, content, and marketing operations.
 



 The role is suited for someone who can work independently, coordinate with internal teams and external partners, and take ownership of execution from planning through completion.
 



  




 Experience
 * 3–5 years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, brand marketing, B2B marketing, or a similar role.
* Experience managing multiple marketing channels, including social media, email marketing, website, content, SEO, paid media, and PR.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams such as Design, Content, Technology, Sales, Leadership, and external agencies.
* Experience coordinating campaigns, maintaining trackers, managing timelines, and ensuring execution.
* Working knowledge of B2B marketing, lead generation, digital marketing funnels, and brand communication.
* Experience in technology, design, consulting, SaaS, digital services, or professional services will be an advantage.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to proactively identify gaps and execution issues.



  




 Skills We Seek
 * Strong understanding of brand communication, digital marketing, email marketing, and B2B marketing.
* Good understanding of LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, email marketing platforms, and other relevant channels.
* Strong written communication, proofreading, editing, and content\-quality skills.
* Working knowledge of website management, SEO, Google Analytics/GA4, Search Console, email marketing metrics, and basic digital performance metrics.
* Understanding of paid marketing platforms such as Google, Meta, and LinkedIn.
* Strong project coordination, stakeholder management, and organisational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, timelines, and dependencies.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret marketing performance data and identify actionable insights.
* Proactive approach with the ability to identify issues and opportunities independently.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams, leadership, and external agencies.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled marketing and productivity tools is an advantage.



  




 What You Will DoBrand \& Marketing Communication
 * Develop a strong understanding of YUJ Designs’ brand positioning, tone of voice, messaging, and guidelines.
* Ensure consistency across website content, social media, presentations, newsletters, external communications, and other marketing touchpoints.
* Execute marketing communication activities in coordination with the Marketing Lead and relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain and organise key marketing assets, templates, brand collaterals, and communication repositories.



  




 Social Media Management \& Engagement
 * Support monthly social media planning, content calendars, and publishing across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external agencies for content development, creatives, approvals, and publishing.
* Monitor channels and ensure timely responses to comments, messages, mentions, and relevant conversations.
* Track performance and identify content themes, formats, and topics that drive stronger engagement.
* Identify opportunities to drive relevant website traffic, enquiries, and leads through social channels.
* Monitor competitor and industry activity for relevant content and engagement opportunities.



  




 Email Marketing
 * Support email marketing campaigns, including planning, audience segmentation, content coordination, scheduling, and execution.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external partners on email copy, creatives, approvals, and deployment.
* Maintain email lists and ensure data is accurate, updated, and appropriately segmented.
* Monitor key metrics such as open rates, click\-through rates, engagement, and conversions.
* Analyse campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve content, targeting, and engagement.
* Maintain email campaign calendars, templates, and performance trackers.



  




 Website Management \& Health Monitoring
 * Work closely with the Marketing Lead to ensure the website remains accurate, current, consistent, and conversion\-ready.
* Conduct regular website audits to identify:
* Outdated or incorrect information
* Broken links, redirects, or forms
* Missing or incorrect CTAs
* Content, formatting, alignment, or spacing issues
* Incorrect terminology, capitalisation, or punctuation
* Missing or incorrectly placed images
* Mobile responsiveness issues
* Incorrectly linked case studies, blogs, and service pages
* Issues with enquiry journeys
* Document website issues and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve them.
* Follow up to ensure identified issues are closed and conduct regular website hygiene checks.



  




 Performance Marketing
 * Understand the fundamentals of performance marketing, paid media, and lead\-generation funnels.
* Support performance marketing initiatives across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.
* Coordinate with agencies and internal stakeholders on campaign setup, targeting, creatives, messaging, and landing pages.
* Monitor key metrics including reach, CTR, CPC, CPL, lead quality, and conversion.
* Analyse campaign performance to identify better\-performing audiences, creatives, geographies, and messaging.
* Maintain performance trackers and support campaign reporting and optimisation.



  




 SEO \& Organic Growth
 * Coordinate with SEO partners on keyword implementation and on\-page optimisation.
* Support SEO requirements for new website pages, blogs, case studies, and other content.
* Monitor SEO performance and flag significant traffic or ranking drops.
* Ensure published content includes relevant keywords, metadata, internal links, and appropriate page structure.
* Identify opportunities to improve organic traffic and content visibility.



  




 PR \& Brand Visibility
 * Identify relevant PR opportunities, publications, podcasts, industry platforms, events, and speaking opportunities.
* Coordinate with PR agencies and partners by providing briefs, company information, case studies, research, and leadership inputs.
* Track media coverage and maintain a PR visibility tracker.
* Identify opportunities for YUJ Designs and its leadership team to be featured in relevant business, technology, design, and industry publications.
* Support CEO and leadership thought\-leadership opportunities.
* Identify relevant awards and industry recognitions and coordinate nomination materials and deadlines.



  




 Content \& Proofreading
 * Proofread blogs, social media posts, website content, newsletters, emails, presentations, case studies, and marketing collateral.
* Check grammar, spelling, punctuation, formatting, factual accuracy, and brand language.
* Review content from a reader’s perspective and flag unclear, repetitive, overly generic, AI\-generated, or inconsistent content.
* Work with content and design teams to ensure final marketing assets meet quality standards before publishing.



  




 Marketing Campaign \& Project Coordination
 * Support the Marketing Lead in planning and executing integrated marketing campaigns.
* Maintain activity trackers, timelines, ownership matrices, and campaign calendars.
* Coordinate with Design, Content, Technology, SEO, PR, Sales, and external agencies.
* Follow up on action items and ensure timelines are met.
* Maintain records of campaign deliverables, approvals, and publishing schedules.
* Proactively flag delays, dependencies, risks, and gaps to ensure timely execution.



  




 Marketing Analytics \& Reporting
 * Maintain dashboards and trackers covering website traffic, social media, email marketing, lead generation, paid media, SEO, PR visibility, and content performance.
* Support the Marketing Lead with monthly marketing performance reviews.
* Track campaign and channel\-level performance against defined objectives.
* Use analytics and AI\-enabled tools to identify trends, audience behaviour, and performance patterns.
* Translate marketing data into actionable observations and recommendations.



  




 Marketing Operations \& Hygiene
 * Maintain marketing calendars, trackers, databases, and repositories.
* Ensure campaigns and communication assets are systematically archived and updated.
* Maintain databases of media contacts, awards, influencers, partners, industry platforms, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Keep marketing assets, campaign files, reports, and approvals organised and accessible.
* Ensure marketing activities, follow\-ups, deliverables, and dependencies are tracked through completion.



  




 What Success Looks Like
 * Marketing activities are executed consistently, accurately, and on time.
* Social media, email, and digital channels remain active, relevant, and aligned with the YUJ brand.
* Website content and user journeys remain accurate, functional, and conversion\-ready.
* Marketing campaigns are tracked against measurable performance metrics.
* PR and brand visibility opportunities are identified and followed through.
* Marketing content maintains high quality and brand consistency.
* Trackers, calendars, databases, and repositories remain organised and up to date.
* Issues and dependencies are identified proactively and closed without repeated follow\-ups.
* The Marketing Lead has a reliable resource who can independently manage day\-to\-day marketing execution and coordination.

title: B2B Marketing Manager / Assistant Manager
description:
**The Short Version**




  





**Who we’re looking for:** 
 Someone with 3–5 years of experience in B2B marketing, demand generation, or ABM who can identify high\-value accounts, build targeted campaigns, and translate marketing efforts into a real business pipeline. You should be comfortable owning both the strategy and execution, and have a strong understanding of CRM, prospecting, and B2B content.
 



  





**What the role is about:** 
 Building Kraftshala’s B2B marketing engine to engage companies that could hire our talent. You’ll own account targeting, ABM campaigns, LinkedIn / Email outreach, sales enablement content, CRM and marketing operations, and track how marketing converts target accounts into recruiter conversations and partnerships.
 



  





**Why you should apply:** 
 This is a builder role — you’ll have the opportunity to create the B2B marketing playbook rather than inherit one. If you enjoy figuring out which accounts to target, what will get their attention, and how to turn that attention into business, you’ll get significant ownership and impact here.
 



  





**About us:** 
 Kraftshala is India’s largest skilling institution in terms of marketing placements, with a 94% placement rate, and we are gunning to become the world’s largest career launchpad, across domains.
 



  





 We’re backed by a number of eminent investors including ex\-unicorn startup founders and CXOs of global giants like RedBus, NoBroker, Nestlé, and Performics.
 



  





**The Detailed Version**




  





**What you’ll do:** 




  





***Primary \- Account\-Based Marketing:***



* Build and manage a tiered target account list across big brands, large agencies, FMCG, and top SaaS companies, with clear logic for prioritising each segment.
* Design and run segment\-specific, account\-based campaigns across email and LinkedIn, targeting the people who influence hiring decisions.
* Move accounts from cold to hiring\-ready, and hand them over to the outreach team with the right context and insights.



  





***Secondary \- Sales Enablement:***



* Build the sales\-enablement content the outreach team needs for live conversations — case studies, testimonials, blogs, one\-pagers, and talent briefs.
* Maintain a lean, credible B2B presence across the channels where hiring decision\-makers spend their time.



  





**What you’ll own:** 




  




* Own the B2B marketing funnel from target\-account identification through account engagement and handoff to the outreach team.
* Build a repeatable ABM engine that can scale across priority segments and evolve based on what works.
* Ensure marketing efforts are closely connected to recruiter acquisition and business outcomes, rather than operating as a standalone brand function.
* Collaborate closely with sales/outreach and leadership to prioritise accounts, sharpen messaging, and improve the overall approach.
* Continuously measure, learn, and iterate based on account and campaign performance.



  





**Must Haves**




  




1. 3–5 years of experience in B2B marketing, demand generation, ABM, growth marketing, or similar roles.
 *(We’re not too fussed about the exact years of experience, as that’s just a proxy for your skill level, which is what we really care for.)*
2. Past roles could include B2B Marketing Manager/Associate, Demand Generation Manager, Growth Marketing Manager, ABM Manager, or similar roles in SaaS, EdTech, D2C, or other B2B businesses.
3. **Experience with:**


* Building and executing B2B/ABM campaigns across channels such as LinkedIn and email.
* Identifying and researching target accounts and decision\-makers, and tailoring campaigns based on account needs.
* Using CRM, marketing automation and prospecting tools to manage campaigns and account engagement.
* Creating B2B marketing and sales\-enablement content such as case studies, one\-pagers, talent briefs, and reports.
* Tracking campaign performance and account\-level engagement, with a clear focus on pipeline and business outcomes.



  





**Good to Haves**




  




* Experience working in a startup or lean team where you’ve had to build processes or campaigns from scratch.
* Experience marketing to enterprise/large accounts or working with multiple stakeholders in a B2B buying journey.
* Experience working closely with sales/business development teams to convert marketing activity into qualified opportunities.



  





**Recruitment Process**




  





 As a small team, it’s imperative that we get to know each other before taking the leap. We want to ensure you succeed in your role within our team. Each conversation with us will last about 30\-60 minutes, and will be a mix of online and offline meetings.
 



  




1. **Conversation 1:** 
 This will be a call with the HR Team to understand your profile briefly and share the details of the selection process.
2. **Technical Exercise:** 
 This is a specific assessment designed to evaluate your fit for this role
3. **Conversation 2:** 
 This will be a conversation with our Head of Operations wherein you can expect to have a discussion on the technical exercise along with specific competencies required for the role.
4. **Conversation 3:** 
 A conversation with our CEO to ensure that there is a fit with the Kraftshala Kode.
5. **Extending an offer:** 
 If all goes well, we will extend an offer that will mention the relevant details.



  





**Location:** 




 Gurugram
 



  





 Know more about Kraftshala’s philosophy, culture and investors here.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
**Eicore Technologies · Gurgaon · Full\-time, In\-Office, Experience 4\-6years** 




  





**Eicore is rebuilding the insurance core as the operating system for autonomous insurers.** 




 Founded by people who came from the insurance industry, and trusted by leading insurers across India, Asia\-Pacific and the Middle East, we combine deep domain experience with a platform that has quietly run critical operations for over two decades, processing millions of policies and managing significant premium volumes every year. Names you know, including SBI, run on what we build.
 



 This is a founding\-team marketing role, with the canvas of a startup and none of the risk. The customers, the revenue and the credibility are already in place. You get to help build the marketing function on top of it, at a company that is about to have its most ambitious chapter.
 



 We are looking for a brilliant generalist to help build it.
 



  





**The role** 




 This is a broad, hands\-on role for someone who has done a bit of everything in marketing and wants to do more of it, with real ownership. You will work closely with our fractional CMO and directly with the founders, and see the impact of your work quickly, because there are no layers between you and the people making decisions.
 



 It is a thinker, dreamer and doer role. You will help shape how a modern insurance company shows up in the world and then roll up your sleeves and make it happen yourself. As we grow, you will help build the team, the partners and the tools around you.
 



 You should be
 **AI\-native** 
 : someone who reaches for AI tools by instinct, uses them to work faster and better, and is excited to help build a marketing function that is AI\-first from the ground up.
 



  





**What you will work across** 



* **Digital marketing** 
 , campaigns, LinkedIn, email, web, and the numbers behind them
* **Content marketing** 
 , from thought leadership to product stories to social, written like a human, not a brand
* **Brand** 
 , keeping everything, we put out sharp, consistent and premium
* **PR and communications** 
 , press, announcements, and building our voice in the market
* **Field and event marketing** 
 , roundtables, conferences and the moments that put us in front of insurers
* **Marketing operations and AI** 
 , the tools, workflows and AI infrastructure that let a lean team punch far above its weight



 You will not be expected to be a world expert in all of these on day one. You will be expected to have
 *done* 
 most of them, to learn fast, and to be the kind of person who figures out the rest.
 



  





**You will thrive here if you** 



* **Write well and know it.** 
 Not "communicate clearly", well. Most of what you make here is words, and the difference between adequate and good is the difference between an analyst returning your call and not.
* **Are a genuine generalist who gets a kick out of shipping.** 
 Around 4 to 6 years across B2B marketing, in tech, SaaS, fintech or insurance, with enough range that you have run an event, written a launch, argued with a designer, and fixed a campaign that was not working. We care more about the shape of that than the number.
* **Think like an owner** 
 and move without waiting to be told.
* **Find insurance more interesting than boring.** 
 You will get curious about claims, underwriting, and why an insurer in Kuala Lumpur has different problems than one in Mumbai.
* **Have your own way of working with AI and can defend it.** 
 We will ask you to walk us through it. "I use ChatGPT a lot" is not an answer.



  





**Why this is worth your time** 



* This is a world class product, and you will be marketing it to the world. Taking cutting edge platform concepts and making them land with the people who buy them.
* You will sit in the thick of B2B enterprise SaaS, at the point where AI agents and humans start working side by side. Not a trend deck, an actual product doing it.
* You will help build a marketing function from early days, at a company that already has the customers and credibility most startups spend a decade chasing.
* You will work directly with the founders, and learn the business, not just the marketing.
* You will own real scope, not a corner of someone else's plan.
* You will do the most interesting work of your career so far, if you are the right person.



  





 If that sounds like you, we would like to meet you.

description:

 Trackier is a leading SaaS platform serving businesses across 20\+ countries worldwide. For over a decade, we have empowered brands, advertisers, agencies, and ad networks with innovative Performance Marketing and Mobile Marketing solutions that drive growth and maximize conversions.
   

  

 We empower marketers worldwide with advanced technology and a customer\-first approach. We help businesses build impactful campaigns, create exceptional user experiences, and ensure data privacy.  During this six\-month internship, you'll work closely with the SEO and content teams to research publishing opportunities, create external content, and support off\-page SEO and link\-building initiatives.

**Research \& Opportunity Discovery**
* Research third\-party websites, blogs, publications, communities, and other platforms for relevant publishing opportunities

* Research competitors to identify their mentions, backlinks, publishing opportunities, and external visibility

**Content Creation \& Guest Posting**
* Research and write original guest posts, articles, and supporting content for external publication
* Adapt writing style, topic, structure, and depth based on the target publication and audience
* Work with SEO and content teams to align content with link\-building and off\-page SEO objectives
* Maintain records and track external content opportunities and submissions


**SEO \& Optimization**
* Develop a practical understanding of backlinks, anchor text, search intent, domain authority, referring domains, and off\-page SEO
* Understand how on\-page content, external authority, and search intent contribute to organic visibility
* Learn to evaluate and prioritize publishing opportunities using relevant SEO indicators and tools


**Requirements**
* Currently pursuing or recently completed an undergraduate or postgraduate degree in Marketing, Communications, English, Journalism, Media, or a related field. Candidates from other backgrounds with strong research and writing skills are also encouraged to apply
* Strong written English and ability to structure information clearly
* Strong research skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to research\-heavy work
* Willingness to learn SEO beyond simply following keyword checklists
* Ability to work independently once objectives are defined and respond positively to feedback
* Prior formal education in SEO is not required


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior exposure to SEO, content marketing, link building, digital PR, or guest posting
* Experience writing blogs, articles, essays, newsletters, or other long\-form content
* Familiarity with keywords, search intent, backlinks, anchor text, domain authority, or referring domains

**Benefits**
 By the end of six months, you'll understand how content and SEO work together to improve organic visibility and authority.
   

  

* Learn to identify and evaluate valuable third\-party publishing opportunities
* Gain hands\-on experience in competitor, topic, and audience research
* Learn to write and adapt guest content for different publications and audiences
* Develop an understanding of backlinks, off\-page SEO, search intent, authority building, and organic growth
* Gain exposure to the relationship between on\-page content and off\-page authority
* Build published writing samples and experience working on real SEO campaigns
* Develop a stronger, structured research methodology and the ability to take an opportunity from discovery and topic selection through writing, submission, and tracking

 ₹45,000/month (₹10,000 cash \+ ₹35,000 towards housing) with shared accommodation provided.

 Every brief, every collab, every content call — you'll be in the room where it happens.

 This role grows into Head of Social / Brand / Partnerships as we scale. Our last 2 interns became founding members within 4 months — one is now Chief of Staff with equity.

 A close\-knit crew working from a villa in Gurgaon — startup crash\-pad meets family, where you ship hard, learn fast, and have real fun.

 ASAP

 themes, formats, calendar, target personas, and GTM plans across programs and university and industry partners

 lead and mentor a lean team to deliver results

**Manager, Content Platform Governance**
**Position Summary**
 The Program Manager, Content Platform Governance will execute the day\-to\-day operating model of the company’s sales enablement content ecosystem, with Highspot as the primary platform. This role ensures sellers can quickly find trusted, relevant, current content within their workflow and that content owners follow consistent standards for publishing, metadata, lifecycle management, and measurement.
   

  

 The role is responsible for applying established governance standards and operating processes to ensure sales content is accurate, current, discoverable, properly tagged, and managed consistently. The successful candidate will be highly organized, detail\-oriented, and comfortable coordinating across content owners, publishers, Sales, Marketing, Sales Enablement, and IT.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Operate and maintain the established Highspot governance model, including content structure, navigation, metadata, publishing standards, and lifecycle processes.
* Administer daily platform activities, including user access, publisher support, Spot and page updates, publishing coordination, and issue resolution.
* Review content submissions for required metadata, ownership, naming conventions, approvals, and alignment to publishing standards.
* Coordinate content lifecycle activities, including scheduled reviews, content updates, archival, retirement, and remediation of outdated or duplicate materials.
* Maintain accurate content records, governance trackers, publisher lists, and documentation of standards and operating procedures.
* Conduct routine platform\-health and content\-quality audits; identify gaps and coordinate remediation with publishers and content owners.
* Support content owners and publishers with training, guidance, and practical assistance in using Highspot and following governance requirements.
* Produce recurring reporting on content health, metadata completion, publishing activity, aging content, platform usage, and publisher compliance.
* Help translate reporting insights into clear action lists for content owners, business groups, and governance reviews.
* Coordinate platform change requests, integrations, and technical issues with IT, Digital Transformation, and platform support teams.
* Partner with content\-strategy and seller\-experience teams to ensure governed content is easy for sellers to find and use.
* Maintain operational continuity and document key decisions, risks, and outstanding actions.
* Interface with Highspot including vendor relationship and contract

* 4\+ years of experience in sales enablement, content operations, marketing operations, revenue operations, digital platforms, or a related field.
* Experience working with a content\-management, knowledge\-management, sales enablement, or digital experience platform.
* Experience managing operational processes involving content publishing, metadata, taxonomy, approvals, or content lifecycle management.
* Strong organizational and project\-coordination skills, with the ability to manage detailed work across multiple stakeholders and deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail and a consistent approach to quality control, documentation, and follow\-through.
* Comfortable using reports and data to identify issues, track progress, and communicate operational performance.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, cross\-functional environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting global sales, marketing, or enablement organizations.
