title: Senior Partnerships Manager - US
description:
Sprinto is an
 **Autonomous Trust Platform** 
 that centralizes trust requirements across
 **security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**
 Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.
   

  

 Backed by top\-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve
 **raised** 
**$31\.8M** 
 in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over
 **4,000 organizations across 75 countries** 
 , Sprinto helps organizations stay audit\-ready, manage real\-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With
 **300\+ native integrations** 
 and AI\-driven automation, Sprinto supports
 **200\+ global security standards natively** 
 , including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.
   

  

**Founded in 2020** 
 by second\-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
   

  

**Life as a Sprinter \-**
 Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
   

  

 We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
   

  

 Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.
   

  

 We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
   

  

 And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
   

  

**The mission \-**
 We're hiring a
 **Partnership Manager** 
 to build and scale Sprinto's partner ecosystem. This role is about creating long\-term revenue through strategic partnerships, not just managing existing relationships.
   

  

 You'll identify, recruit, and enable consulting firms, channel partners, resellers, system integrators, and managed service providers who can take Sprinto to new customers and markets. From building the partner pipeline to driving joint go\-to\-market initiatives and co\-selling opportunities, you'll own the partner journey end to end.
   

  

 We're looking for someone who understands that successful partnerships are built on mutual growth. Someone who can influence senior stakeholders, create repeatable partner programs, and turn relationships into predictable pipeline and revenue.
   

  

**Where you'll leave your mark?**
* Build and scale Sprinto's partner ecosystem by recruiting consulting firms, MSPs, MSSPs, system integrators, resellers, and channel partners
* Own the end\-to\-end partner lifecycle, from prospecting and qualification to onboarding, enablement, and long\-term success
* Design and execute joint go\-to\-market strategies, including co\-selling, co\-marketing, and partner\-led growth initiatives
* Develop partner enablement assets, business plans, sales collateral, and value proposition decks to help partners sell Sprinto effectively
* Partner closely with Sales teams on strategic opportunities and participate in customer conversations alongside partners
* Track partner health through pipeline generation, deal registrations, win rates, deal velocity, and overall revenue contribution
* Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to align on business goals, performance, and growth opportunities
* Own partner operations, including CRM and PRM hygiene, partner tiering, deal registration processes, and reporting
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams to launch partner programs and campaigns that accelerate growth


**The kind of builder we're looking for \-**
* 5–8 years of overall experience, including 3\+ years in SaaS partnerships, alliances, channel sales, or ecosystem roles
* Must have recent experience building and scaling partner programs across US
* Strong understanding of partner\-led GTM motions, channel sales, and indirect revenue models
* Proven ability to recruit, enable, and grow strategic partners that contribute measurable pipeline and revenue
* Strong commercial acumen with experience supporting or participating in enterprise sales cycles
* Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills across executive and operational stakeholders
* Experience working cross\-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams
* Highly organized, self\-driven, and comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment


 This Role Is Ideal For Someone Who
   

  

  

* Enjoys building partnerships from scratch instead of simply managing existing accounts
* Thinks beyond partner recruitment and focuses on long\-term partner success and revenue generation
* Can balance strategic relationship\-building with operational excellence
* Loves collaborating across teams to create scalable GTM programs
* Is energized by building new markets and expanding partner ecosystems
* Measures success by partner\-generated pipeline, revenue, and long\-term business impact


**How we care for our Sprinters?**
* Co\-working, on the house: If co\-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
* We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills
* We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
* Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
* Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you


**Inclusion \& Diversity \-**
 At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.
   

  

 We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Growth Champion
description:
**About Be Limitless** 


 Be Limitless is a feature\-rich job search marketplace — built as a hybrid of Naukri.com, Instagram, and LinkedIn. The platform brings together customers (employers and recruiters) and candidates (job seekers) in one place, with the discovery and engagement layer of a social platform and the intent\-driven matching of a job board.
 





 We are well\-funded and putting real capital behind scaling this platform aggressively.
 



**The Opportunity** 


 We've built the product. What we haven't cracked yet is the classic marketplace cold\-start problem: getting both sides — customers and candidates — active on the platform at the same time, and keeping them there.
 





 This role exists to solve exactly that. There is no existing playbook to execute — the person in this role will build one from scratch, through direct hustle, before it becomes a repeatable growth motion for a wider team to scale.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 

 •     Own early\-stage growth across both sides of the marketplace — customers and candidates — as a single, accountable owner of the cold\-start problem.
 



 •     Personally drive acquisition of the first 100 customers and the first 1 lakh candidates through direct outreach, partnerships, community\-building, and hands\-on growth tactics.
 



 •     Design and run unconventional, low\-cost go\-to\-market experiments; double down on what works and kill what doesn't.
 



 •     Build the early acquisition and retention playbook — the foundation a growth team will scale once traction is proven.
 



 •     Work closely with product and marketing to turn direct market feedback into fast platform improvements.
 



 •     Track and report on growth metrics, and iterate quickly based on data rather than assumption.
 



 •     Act as the face of Be Limitless in the market during this early phase — building direct relationships with founding customers and candidate communities.
 



  




**What We're Looking For** 

 •     Proven experience scaling a two\-sided marketplace or platform from zero to meaningful traction — ideally in job search, recruitment, social, or consumer tech.
 



 •     A genuinely entrepreneurial mindset: comfortable without a playbook, biased toward action over process.
 



 •     Strong sales and business development instincts, with a track record of personally closing early customers.
 



 •     A young, high\-energy, hands\-on operator — this is a builder role first, not a management role, in its early phase.
 



 •     Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid iteration in a startup\-like environment.
 



 •     Excellent communication skills — equally credible speaking to a corporate customer and a first\-time job seeker.
 



  




**Nice to Have** 

 •     Experience in recruitment, HR\-tech, job search, or talent marketplace businesses.
 



 •     A track record in growth hacking, community\-led growth, or content/influencer\-driven acquisition.
 



 •     An existing network among employers, recruiters, and/or job seekers in India.
 



  




**What You'll Get** 

 •     Genuine ownership of strategy and execution — not implementation of someone else's plan.
 



 •     The chance to build a category\-defining platform from the ground up, backed by serious capital.
 



 •     Competitive compensation with performance\-linked incentives tied to the growth you drive.
 



 •     Direct access to, and mentorship from, the founding leadership team.
 



  




**How to Apply** 


 Send your resume along with a short note on how you've solved a similar cold\-start problem before — what you did, and what the results were — to \[add application email / link].

title: Farm Manager
description:
**JD FOR FARM MANAGER**

**Location:** Vellaputhur, Tamil Nadu  
**Experience:** 20 to 25 Years  
**Qualification:** Degree in Agriculture (Mandatory)  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time With Accommodation Language: English, Hindi \& Tamil (Mandatory )

**Farm Operations Management**: Overseeing day\-to\-day operations of the farm, including crop cultivation, livestock care, and maintenance of farm facilities.

1\. **Staff Management**: Hiring, training, scheduling, and supervising farm workers or labourer’s to ensure efficient operation of the farm.

2\. **Crop Planning and Management**: Developing crop rotation plans, selecting appropriate crops for planting, and managing planting, harvesting, and post\-harvest activities.

3\. **Livestock Care**: Ensuring the health and well\-being of livestock, including feeding, watering, monitoring for illness, and coordinating with veterinarians as needed.

4\. **Equipment Maintenance**: Maintaining farm equipment and machinery to ensure they are in good working condition. This includes scheduling regular maintenance and repairs as needed.

5\. **Budgeting and Financial Management**: Developing and managing the farm budget, including monitoring expenses, tracking revenues, and making financial decisions to ensure the profitability of the farm.

6\. **Marketing and Sales**: Identifying market opportunities for farm products, developing marketing strategies, and managing sales channels such as farmers' markets, CSA (Community Supported Agriculture) programs, or direct sales to restaurants and retailers.

7\. **Environmental Stewardship**: Implementing sustainable farming practices to minimize environmental impact, conserve natural resources, and promote soil health and biodiversity.

8\. **Compliance and Regulation**: Ensuring compliance with local, state, and federal regulations related to farming, food safety, labour, and environmental protection.

9\. **Record Keeping**: Maintaining accurate records of farm activities, including crop yields, livestock inventory, financial transactions, and regulatory compliance documentation.

10\. **Facility Management**: Managing farm buildings, infrastructure, and utilities to ensure they are well\-maintained and operational.

11\. **Pest and Disease Management**: Implementing integrated pest management strategies to control pests and diseases while minimizing the use of chemical pesticides.

12\. **Community Relations**: Building positive relationships with neighbours, community organizations, and local authorities to foster goodwill and address any concerns related to the farm's operations.

13\. **Emergency Response**: Developing and implementing emergency response plans to address situations such as severe weather, livestock emergencies, or equipment failures.

14\. **Continued Learning and Professional Development**: Staying informed about advancements in farming techniques, technologies, and regulations through on\-going education and professional development opportunities.

title: Customer Relationship Manager
description:
Position Overview

The **Customer Relationship Manager (CRM)** will be responsible for managing and enhancing Glow's overall client relationship journey, from initial enquiry to consultation, treatment, and post\-service engagement.

The role will have a strong focus on **client escalation management, lead tracking and conversion, online doctor consultations, review management, and quality auditing of Case Manager interactions**.

The CRM will work closely with Case Managers, Doctors, Centre Managers, Front Desk, and Operations teams to ensure every client receives a consistent, professional, and premium experience aligned with Glow's luxury brand standards.

Reporting To

COO

Key Responsibilities1\. Client Escalation Management

* Take ownership of client escalations and ensure concerns are addressed promptly and professionally.
* Act as a senior point of contact for complex, sensitive, or high\-value client concerns.
* Understand the root cause of complaints and coordinate with relevant teams to identify appropriate resolutions.
* Ensure timely service recovery while protecting the client relationship and Glow's brand experience.
* Maintain an escalation tracker and monitor cases until complete closure.
* Identify recurring complaints and recommend corrective and preventive actions to management.
* Follow up with clients after resolution to ensure satisfaction and rebuild trust where required.

2\. Client Enquiry \& Lead Conversion Management

* Monitor client enquiries received through various channels, including calls, WhatsApp, website enquiries, social media, digital campaigns, and other lead\-generation platforms.
* Maintain accurate data on incoming enquiries and their source.
* Track the complete journey from **Enquiry → Contacted → Consultation Booked → Consultation Completed → Treatment Conversion**.
* Analyse enquiry\-to\-consultation and consultation\-to\-treatment conversion ratios.
* Identify high\-performing and underperforming lead sources.
* Work with Case Managers to improve follow\-up quality and conversion rates.
* Identify lost, pending, dormant, and unresponsive leads and develop strategies for re\-engagement.
* Prepare regular conversion reports and provide actionable insights to management.

3\. Online Doctor Consultation Management

* Coordinate and schedule online consultations between clients and Glow's Doctors.
* Ensure clients are contacted and scheduled within the required turnaround time.
* Coordinate with Doctors and Case Managers to ensure availability and smooth consultation scheduling.
* Monitor scheduled, completed, cancelled, and missed online consultations.
* Follow up with clients who have not completed their scheduled consultations.
* Track conversion of online consultations into in\-clinic appointments and treatments.

4\. Review \& Reputation Management

* Monitor client reviews and feedback across relevant platforms, including Google and other approved channels.
* Track positive and negative feedback and identify recurring themes.
* Coordinate appropriate responses to client reviews in line with Glow's communication standards.
* Escalate negative or sensitive reviews to the appropriate management team for resolution.
* Analyse review trends to identify opportunities for improving client experience.

5\. Product \& Service Feedback Management

* Actively collect and consolidate **client feedback on products, treatments, services, and overall experience**.
* Identify recurring feedback regarding product efficacy, quality, pricing, availability, packaging, usage experience, or client preferences.
* Capture feedback received through Case Managers, Front Desk, Doctors, Therapists, reviews, WhatsApp, calls, and direct client interactions.
* Differentiate between **product\-related concerns, service\-related concerns, and client expectations** to identify the underlying issue.
* Maintain a structured **Product \& Service Feedback Tracker** and analyse trends periodically.
* Share relevant product feedback and recurring client concerns with **Management, Procurement, Operations, Doctors, Therapists, and other relevant teams**.
* Highlight products or services receiving consistently positive or negative feedback.
* Identify potential opportunities for introducing new products, services, packages, or improvements based on client needs and preferences.
* Ensure product\-related complaints are escalated promptly to the appropriate team for investigation and resolution.
* Track corrective actions and communicate relevant updates to clients where required.
* Provide management with **actionable client insights**, rather than simply reporting feedback.

6\. Quality Auditing of Case Manager Calls

* Conduct regular quality audits of Case Manager calls to clients.
* Evaluate calls against defined quality parameters and communication standards.
* Assess greeting, understanding of client requirements, product/service knowledge, communication, appointment conversion, follow\-up, objection handling, upselling/cross\-selling, accuracy, professionalism, and closure.
* Maintain individual Case Manager quality scores.
* Identify recurring gaps and provide structured feedback and coaching.
* Track improvement following feedback and training interventions.
* Escalate serious deviations, misinformation, or inappropriate communication to management.

7\. Client Follow\-up \& Relationship Management

* Monitor follow\-ups for prospective, existing, inactive, and high\-value clients.
* Ensure clients receive timely communication regarding consultations, appointments, treatments, packages, and relevant offers.
* Identify opportunities to re\-engage dormant clients.
* Support Case Managers in developing stronger client relationships and improving retention.
* Ensure important client interactions are documented accurately in the relevant CRM/system.

8\. Cross\-Functional Coordination

* Work closely with Case Managers, Centre Managers, Doctors, Front Desk, Marketing, Procurement, Operations, and other relevant teams.
* Coordinate resolution of client issues that require involvement from multiple departments.
* Ensure client feedback and insights are communicated to relevant stakeholders.
* Support management in implementing client experience and product/service improvement initiatives.
* Identify operational or product gaps that negatively impact the client journey and recommend solutions.

Reporting \& Analytics

The CRM will be responsible for maintaining and analysing key client experience and conversion data, including:

* Total client enquiries
* Enquiries by source
* Enquiry\-to\-contact ratio
* Contact\-to\-consultation conversion
* Consultation\-to\-treatment conversion
* Overall lead\-to\-client conversion
* Online consultation bookings
* Online consultation completion rate
* No\-show and cancellation rates
* Follow\-up completion
* Dormant lead reactivation
* Client escalation volume
* Escalation resolution time
* Review ratings and sentiment
* Case Manager call quality scores

The role should convert this data into **actionable insights**, rather than simply maintaining reports.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)Client Experience

* Client Satisfaction Score
* Escalation Resolution Rate
* Escalation Closure Time
* Repeat Complaint Rate
* Review Rating \& Sentiment

Lead Conversion

* Enquiry\-to\-Contact Ratio
* Contact\-to\-Consultation Conversion
* Consultation\-to\-Treatment Conversion
* Overall Lead Conversion Rate
* Dormant Lead Reactivation Rate

Online Consultations

* Online Consultation Booking Rate
* Consultation Completion Rate
* Online Consultation\-to\-Treatment Conversion

Case Manager Quality

* Call Quality Audit Score
* Follow\-up Compliance
* Conversion Performance
* Improvement After Coaching

Qualifications \& Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Healthcare Management, Hospitality, or a related field.
* **3–6 years of experience** in Customer Relationship Management, Client Experience, Customer Success, Inside Sales, Healthcare, Hospitality, Beauty, Wellness, or a premium service environment.
* Experience in managing client escalations and analysing conversion data is strongly preferred.
* Experience in call quality auditing, CRM systems, and lead management will be an advantage.

Required Skills \& Competencies

* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Strong client relationship and escalation\-management skills.
* Strong analytical and data interpretation abilities.
* Good understanding of sales funnels and conversion metrics.
* Strong listening and call\-auditing skills.
* Ability to coach and provide constructive feedback.
* Excellent problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to handle sensitive and high\-value client interactions with discretion.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets and CRM proficiency.
* Highly organised with excellent follow\-up discipline.
* Professional, polished, and service\-oriented personality.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be **highly client\-centric, analytical, commercially aware, and confident in handling difficult conversations**.

They should be someone who can look at a client enquiry not merely as a data point, but understand the entire journey—from the first enquiry and Case Manager call to the online consultation, treatment conversion, review, and long\-term relationship.

The individual should have the maturity to handle escalations independently, the analytical ability to identify conversion gaps, and the communication skills to coach Case Managers towards better client interactions and business outcomes.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means **fewer unresolved escalations, stronger client satisfaction, higher enquiry\-to\-client conversion, better online consultation utilization, improved reviews, and consistently high\-quality Case Manager interactions**.

The CRM will play a critical role in ensuring that every client interaction reflects Glow's standards of **luxury, professionalism, responsiveness, and exceptional care**.

Pay: ₹9,693\.16 \- ₹31,701\.23 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Marketing Manager
description:
**Join Our Team as a Senior Manager\- Marketing \& GTM at Helo.ai by VivaConnect** 




  





 📍
 **Location:** 
 Mumbai, India (Work from Office)
 



 📅
 **Working Days:** 
 Monday to Friday (Saturday only when required)
 



 🏢
 **Work Mode:** 
 Work from Office
 



 📈
 **Experience:** 
 7–10 Years
 



  





**🌐 About Helo.ai**




 Helo.ai by VivaConnect is an AI\-first cloud communication platform (CPaaS), built on 25 years of enterprise communication expertise. We help businesses—from startups to large enterprises—personalise conversations for billions with AI across SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, Voicebots, Chatbots, and Email, all from a single platform.
 


* 25\+ years of enterprise communication expertise
* Trusted by leading brands including Aditya Birla Capital, Bajaj Finance, and Kotak Mahindra Bank
* Google and Meta Partner



**🌟 Why Build Your Career With Us**



* Own and shape Helo.ai’s brand positioning and go\-to\-market presence
* Drive integrated marketing across brand, content, demand generation, events, and partnerships
* Work closely with leadership, sales, product, design, PR, and growth teams
* Lead high\-impact campaigns in a fast\-growing AI and CPaaS environment
* Build a scalable marketing engine that influences brand visibility and business growth
* Play a strategic role in defining how Helo.ai is perceived in the market



  





**🌍 Discover More About Helo.ai**



* Website: https://helo.ai/
* LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sayheloai/
* Instagram: @sayheloai \| @lifeathelo.ai



  





  





**💼 The Role You'll Play**




  





 As our
 **Senior Manager \- Marketing \& GTM** 
 , you will lead Helo.ai’s marketing strategy across brand, content, campaigns, events, partnerships, and demand generation.
 



 You will be responsible for building a strong and differentiated market presence for Helo.ai while driving high\-quality engagement, pipeline impact, and category visibility. This role requires someone who can combine strategic thinking with hands\-on execution and work cross\-functionally to turn marketing into a strong growth lever for the business.
 



 In addition to the responsibilities listed below, you should be open to taking up related initiatives that strengthen Helo.ai’s market positioning, revenue influence, and brand impact.
 



  





  





**🧩 What You'll Be Driving**




**🔹 Brand Positioning \& Strategic Marketing**



* Own and strengthen Helo.ai’s brand positioning across key business segments
* Shape messaging and narrative for products, solutions, and company\-level communication
* Ensure consistency of brand voice across external and internal marketing touchpoints
* Drive brand visibility and differentiation in the AI, CPaaS, and enterprise communication space



**🔹
 
 Go\-to\-Market Strategy**



* Lead GTM planning and execution for products, solutions, campaigns, and key business initiatives
* Translate business priorities into clear and actionable marketing programs
* Build marketing strategies aligned to customer segments, ICPs, and business goals
* Partner with sales and leadership teams to support revenue\-focused campaigns and launches



**🔹
 
 Content \& Communication Leadership**



* Oversee high\-impact content across LinkedIn, social media, website, email, decks, case studies, and sales enablement material
* Guide the creation of thought leadership, brand campaigns, product messaging, and customer\-facing narratives
* Ensure quality, clarity, and consistency across all content assets
* Build a strong content engine that supports awareness, engagement, and conversion



**🔹
 
 Demand Generation \& Pipeline Support**



* Design and execute integrated campaigns that contribute to lead generation and pipeline growth
* Support inbound and outbound efforts through targeted content, lead magnets, and campaign programs
* Work closely with sales teams to improve lead quality, engagement, and conversion
* Measure campaign performance and optimize for reach, engagement, and business outcomes



  





**🔹
 
 Events, Field Marketing \& Partnerships**



* Lead the planning and execution of trade shows, industry events, webinars, and flagship brand activations
* Build strategic partnerships and co\-marketing opportunities that enhance brand reach and credibility
* Represent marketing in cross\-functional planning for industry presence and ecosystem engagement
* Ensure strong pre\-event, on\-ground, and post\-event marketing execution



**🔹 Team Leadership \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration**



* Build, mentor, and manage a high\-performing marketing team
* Collaborate with product, sales, design, SEO, PR, and leadership teams on strategic initiatives
* Manage agencies, freelancers, and external partners where required
* Bring structure, ownership, and performance discipline into the marketing function



**🔹 Performance, Analytics \& Optimization**



* Track KPIs across brand growth, campaign performance, engagement, and revenue contribution
* Use data and market insights to refine strategy and improve execution quality
* Monitor content, events, and GTM performance and identify areas for optimization
* Build marketing systems and processes that can scale with business growth



  





  





  





  





**🧠 Knowledge \& Expertise We Value**




**Functional Capability**



* 7–10 years of experience in B2B marketing, GTM, brand, demand generation, content, or partnerships
* Strong experience in SaaS, CPaaS, telecom, conversational AI, martech, or technology\-led businesses
* Proven ability to lead integrated marketing strategies across digital, content, events, and field marketing
* Experience in building brand positioning and executing GTM programs for growth\-stage businesses
* Strong understanding of enterprise buyer journeys and ICP\-led marketing
* Experience working closely with revenue, leadership, and product teams
* Exposure to fintech, BFSI, enterprise tech, or regulated\-industry marketing is an added advantage
* Experience in scaling teams, functions, or new marketing initiatives is preferred



**Professional Strengths**



* Strong strategic thinking with hands\-on execution ability
* Excellent storytelling, communication, and messaging skills
* Commercial mindset with a clear understanding of business impact
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities
* Ability to manage multiple high\-priority initiatives simultaneously
* High ownership, problem\-solving ability, and attention to detail
* Passion for brand\-building, growth, and continuous innovation



  





  





  





**🛠 Platforms \& Tools**



* Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail \& Drive)
* CRM and marketing automation platforms
* LinkedIn and other digital/social media platforms
* Analytics and campaign reporting tools
* AI tools for productivity, research, and content support
* Project and content planning tools



  





  





**🎓 Education \& Experience**



* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Mass Communication, Journalism, English, or a related field (Preferred)
* MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is a plus
* 7–10 years of relevant experience in Marketing, Brand, GTM, Demand Generation, Content, or Partnerships
* Strong track record of driving business\-aligned marketing programs in fast\-paced environments
* Experience in high\-growth startups, B2B SaaS, technology, or enterprise\-focused businesses preferred



  





  





**📊 Indicators of Success**



* Stronger brand visibility and market positioning for Helo.ai
* High\-quality marketing campaigns delivered across channels and business priorities
* Meaningful contribution to lead generation, pipeline growth, and revenue influence
* Successful execution of product launches, GTM programs, and brand initiatives
* Strong event marketing and partnership outcomes
* Scalable team structure, stronger execution quality, and improved marketing efficiency
* Consistent growth in engagement, content quality, and strategic brand impact



**📈
 
 Performance \& Growth**




 The role follows defined KPIs and KRAs to ensure clarity in responsibilities, support performance tracking, and recognize contributions toward brand growth, GTM excellence, audience engagement, and business impact.
 



  





  





**🌍 Equal Opportunity Employer**




 At Helo.ai, we celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive, collaborative environment for all.

title: Growth Manager, Prime Video India, Prime Video
description:

 Amazon Prime Video is shaping the future of digital video entertainment. Our mission is to offer customers the widest selection of digital video content including Amazon original content, favourite TV series and Movies, while making it trivially easy for them to enjoy they favourite content wherever and whenever they want. We have a goal to become the entertainment destination for customers in India while delighting our customers with a great service and broad content.
   

  

 We are looking for a versatile Growth Manager who is responsible for designing and executing the strategy to drive Prime Video growth in India. As a result of the broad scope and critical nature of the position, the role will interact with leadership at multiple levels in the company
   

  

 Key job responsibilities

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience managing external partners to develop marketing programs

title: BU Head India/SEA Neurovascular
description:
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.
   

  

 As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
   

  

**Job Function**
 MedTech Sales
   

  

**Job Sub Function**
 Clinical Sales – Hospital/Hospital Systems (Commission)
   

  

**Job Category**
 Professional
   

  

**All Job Posting Locations:**
 Mumbai, India
   

  

**Job Description**
 Lead the Neurovascular business for India \& SEA with full country P\&L accountability. Drive commercial strategy, operational execution, clinical engagement, and cross functional alignment to grow the portfolio while maintaining the highest standards of patient safety, quality, and compliance. Build and lead a high‑performing India \& SEA leadership team and partner with APAC and Global teams to localize and execute launch and lifecycle plans.
   

  

 Core accountabilities
   

  

* Own the India \& SEA P\&L for Neurovascular: annual planning, forecasting, margin management, and business reviews with APAC leadership.
* Define and deliver India \& SEA go‑to‑market strategy: market segmentation, pricing, channel mix (direct vs distributor), tender approach, and key account plans.
* Drive commercial execution: meet or exceed revenue, market share and profitability targets across priority segments (public/private hospitals, tertiary centers, Neuro Interventional programs).
* Lead country team: hire, coach, develop and retain high‑caliber managers (Area managers / CSR’s). Set clear performance targets and accountability.
* Clinical \& KOL engagement: partner with Medical and Clinical Affairs to design and deliver training, proctorships and evidence generation to accelerate adoption.
* New product introductions: own India \& SEA launch planning and execution, local clinical rollout, hospital onboarding, and post‑launch performance.
* Regulatory \& quality oversight: ensure all commercial and clinical activities comply with local regulatory, quality and ethical requirements; work with RA/QA on approvals and vigilance.
* Commercial operations: optimize demand planning, inventory management, pricing execution and distributor performance with Supply Chain and Operations.
* Stakeholder management: build trusted relationships with KOLs, hospital leadership, government/payer stakeholders and strategic distributors. Represent the company at conferences, advisory boards and institutional meetings.
* Market insight \& influence: provide timely market intelligence to APAC/Global functions to influence portfolio strategy, investments and R\&D priorities.


 Key performance indicators (KPIs)
   

  

* Revenue vs plan and YoY growth (by product / segment).
* Market share in targeted neurovascular segments.
* Gross margin / profitability vs target.
* New product adoption metrics (Market Share growth, penetration in target centers).
* Clinical engagement: number and quality of trainings/proctorships and investigator studies.
* Customer satisfaction / account retention for top accounts.
* Team performance and retention / leadership bench strength.
* Compliance audit outcomes and regulatory milestone achievement.


**Required Experience \& Qualifications**
* 12\+ years in medical devices / medtech or closely related healthcare industry with progressive commercial leadership experience.
* Minimum 7\+ years managing teams with direct people leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated P\&L ownership and track record of delivering revenue and margin results.
* Experience in high‑complexity specialty businesses; direct neurovascular experience essential. Experience in interventional cardiology, peripheral vascular, or related specialties acceptable
* Proven success engaging KOLs and driving clinical adoption within Indian hospitals and healthcare systems.
* Experience launching complex devices and managing lifecycle activities.
* Strong understanding of India regulatory, reimbursement and tender environments.


**Preferred / Differentiating**
* Prior experience running a country P\&L for a specialty device business.
* Relationships with Neuro Interventional KOLs and leading tertiary centers in India \& SEA region
* Experience with digital commercialization tools (CRM, analytics) and commercial transformation.
* MBA or advanced degree preferred; clinical background (nursing/clinical qualification) is a plus.


 Core competencies \& leadership behaviors
   

  

* Strategic commercial acumen with strong financial discipline.
* Demonstrated ability to build and scale cross‑functional teams.
* High stakeholder influence and negotiation skills.
* Customer and patient‑centric mindset; commitment to quality and compliance.
* Data‑driven decision making and commercial rigor.
* Strong communication and presence with clinicians, hospital leadership and internal senior stakeholders.
* Collaborative, resilient and adaptable in matrixed environments.


 Education
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, Business, or related field required.
* MBA or advanced degree preferred.


 Travel
   

  

* Up to 40–60% travel within India; occasional international travel to APAC as required.


**Required Skills**
**Preferred Skills:**
 Advertising, Business Development, Customer Training, Hospital Operations, Innovation, Market Savvy, Medicines and Device Development and Regulation, Negotiation, Pricing Strategies, Process Improvements, Relationship Building, Representing, Sales, Sales Training, Strategic Sales Planning, Sustainable Procurement, Technical Credibility, Vendor Selection

 .

title: Category Manager - Lifestyle (Indianwear)
description:
**Job Descrioption – Category Manager (Lifestyle – Indianwear)** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a commercially driven and fashion\-forward
 **Category Manager – Indian Wear** 
 to lead category growth, brand partnerships, and assortment strategy across ethnic apparel, contemporary Indian fashion, and designer\-led brands. The role will drive GMV, profitability, customer experience, and category expansion by curating compelling assortments, building strategic brand partnerships, and delivering differentiated customer experiences aligned with business objectives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Category Strategy \& Business Ownership** 




 • Define and execute category growth plans aligned with the overall Indian Wear business strategy and annual operating plan.
 



 • Own category performance across GMV, gross margins, conversion rates, and customer satisfaction metrics.
 



 • Drive sales growth and profitability through effective assortment planning, pricing strategies, and commercial negotiations.
 



**Brand \& Partner Management** 




 • Build and strengthen relationships with leading ethnic wear, contemporary Indian fashion, and designer brands.
 



 • Identify and onboard new brands to expand category selection, improve market coverage, and drive customer acquisition.
 



 • Develop joint business plans with brand partners to drive sustainable growth and improve business performance.
 



**Assortment, Pricing \& Inventory Management** 




 • Curate a differentiated assortment across ethnic apparel, occasion wear, fusion wear, festive collections, and related categories.
 



 • Drive assortment expansion by balancing seasonal trends, new launches, core bestsellers, and emerging fashion opportunities.
 



 • Partner with brands and internal teams to optimize pricing, inventory availability, and inventory health.
 



**Marketing \& Growth Enablement** 




 • Collaborate with Marketing and Site Merchandising teams to drive category visibility, customer engagement, and conversion.
 



 • Plan and execute seasonal campaigns, festive events, designer launches, and key category initiatives in partnership with brands.
 



 • Leverage customer insights and market trends to identify growth opportunities and improve category performance.
 



**Customer Experience \& Quality Governance** 




 • Drive a seamless shopping experience by continuously improving product discovery, content quality, assortment relevance, and brand representation.
 



 • Monitor customer feedback, NPS, return rates, and operational metrics to identify and address improvement opportunities.
 



 • Partner with Customer Experience and Operations teams to resolve escalations and enhance customer satisfaction.
 



**Cross\-Functional Leadership** 




 • Collaborate closely with Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, Cataloguing, and Operations teams to ensure seamless execution of category plans.
 



 • Present category performance, key insights, and growth opportunities to senior stakeholders.
 



 • Drive innovation, process improvements, and best practices to enhance category efficiency and business outcomes.
 



  





**Must\-Have Skills** 




 • Strong experience in category management, buying, merchandising, or brand management within Indian wear, fashion, ethnic wear, or lifestyle categories.
 



 • Proven track record of driving category growth, GMV, and margin improvement.
 



 • Strong commercial acumen with excellent negotiation and partner management skills.
 



 • Data\-driven decision\-making and strong analytical capabilities.
 



 • Customer\-centric mindset with a focus on delivering exceptional shopping experiences.
 



  





**Good\-to\-Have Skills** 




 • Experience working with ethnic wear, designer wear, occasion wear, or premium Indian fashion brands.
 



 • Exposure to e\-commerce, omnichannel retail, or marketplace business models.
 



 • Strong understanding of Indian fashion trends, festive consumption patterns, and customer behavior.
 



 • Experience managing large brand portfolios and strategic partnerships.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Fashion Management, Design, Marketing, or a related field.
 



 • MBA from a Tier 1/2 institute preferred.
 



 • 7\-10 years of experience in Category Management in ecommerce and/or retail roles within Indian Wear, Fashion, Lifestyle.
 



 • Demonstrated success in managing and scaling category performance through strong brand and business partnerships.
 



  





**Why Join Us** 




 • Opportunity to shape and scale one of India's fastest\-growing Indian Wear businesses.
 



 • High ownership role with direct impact on category growth, customer experience, and business performance.
 



 • Exposure to leading ethnic wear and designer fashion brands across India.
 



 • Collaborative and entrepreneurial environment with opportunities to drive innovation and business transformation.
 



 • Competitive compensation and strong career growth opportunities within Tata CLiQ.

title: Lead - Strategy & Operations
description:
**Who are we and what do we do?**
 BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud\-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high\-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000\+ real devices and browsers.
   

  

 With over 1,200 employees and a remote\-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto\-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.
   

  

 Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission\-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.
   

  

**Location: This is a remote position; however, the role requires the candidate to be based in Mumbai.**
**Role In Nutshell**

title: (Associate) Director, Expansion & Partnerships, AI Access Initiative (EAII)
description:
This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India.
   

  

**About EAII**
 EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence\-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi\-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long\-term wellbeing of children and families.
   

  

 For more information, read about our work here: About Evidence Action and EAII
   

  

**About The AI Access Initiative (2AI)**
 We're at an inflection point in artificial intelligence \- presenting both tremendous potential opportunity and risk for people in developing countries. AI capabilities are improving on a timescale measured in months, while development systems often move on timescales measured in decades. Much of the technology needed for positive impact exists today, but few organizations exist to bridge research, deployment, and scaled implementation: we must act now to ensure AI's benefits reach people in poverty in LMICs.
   

  

 Incubated at Evidence Action, we're scaling The AI Access Initiative, an organization focused on scaling AI\-enabled 'big bets' to benefit tens or hundreds of millions of people in poverty in low\- and middle\-income countries (LMICs). We operate at the intersection of global development actors, top AI labs, and leading researchers to drive meaningful access to AI's benefits for the 3\.5 billion people living in poverty globally. We create "public good," open\-sourced playbooks, toolkits, and insights that define how to design and launch tractable and impactful AI\-enabled programs. Given the scale of opportunity, we expect our portfolio to expand substantially, but to start, we're scaling two programs focused on AI in Agriculture and AI in Health.
   

  

 We are led by former Evidence Action CEO Kanika Bahl, a founding member of Anthropic's Long\-Term Benefit Trust, and advised by Nobel Laureate Michael Kremer; Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic; and Kent Walker, President, Global Affairs for Alphabet and Google. This work builds on Evidence Action's track record reaching 530M\+ people with cost\-effective, evidence\-based programs across 9 countries in Africa and Asia, with a focus on last\-mile delivery.
   

  

**The Role**
 2AI is building fast. We have a founding team, two live program portfolios, and a pipeline of opportunities that will drive significant expansion. The programs we are running have credible pathways to 100s of millions of people. While incubated at Evidence Action, we plan to spin out in Q4 '26\.
   

  

 Our Agriculture portfolio is scaling AI\-enabled weather forecasting services to reach tens of millions of smallholder farmers, in close partnership with state and national governments in India. The next phase is to expand this work: deciding which countries we move into next and building what it takes to operate there. We are seeking a rigorous, high\-ownership Associate Director or Director, Expansion \& Partnerships to own that expansion end to end, from market selection and government and telco partnerships through to standing up offices and teams in new markets.
   

  

 This role is based in India and sits on 2AI's global team, reporting into the VP, Agriculture. It includes people leadership, managing at least one senior manager across the program. You will work closely with our India country team and other in\-country team members to scope and expand programming.
   

  

**You Will:**
* Identify new markets for forecast delivery: In conjunction with the VP, Agriculture, develop the criteria for market selection and prioritize countries to expand into
* Stand up new markets: Once a new market is confirmed, support the set\-up of offices and the hiring of high\-quality staff with the requisite skills to implement large\-scale forecast delivery
* Oversee development of forecasts for new regions: Collaborate with academics to ensure forecasts are developed, tested, and ready to disseminate in new countries. This could include hiring and managing post\-doctoral students to support in model benchmarking or dataset support
* Lead telco partnerships: Identify target telcos and lead engagement, negotiation, and relationship management to set up sustainable telco\-based dissemination systems
* Hire and manage in\-country scoping support: Where staff on the ground are needed to determine whether there is an opportunity in a new market, hire and oversee them, for example short\-term consultants
* Build and maintain government relationships: Create new and nurture existing relationships with the government bodies needed to operate and disseminate forecasts in a new market, including agriculture departments and meteorological agencies
* Partner with stakeholders: Create new and nurture existing relationships with academic institutions, delivery partners, and other agriculture organizations.
* Develop best practices and thought leadership: Across all of the above, build best practices and replicable toolkits that can be applied elsewhere by others. Share key learnings with the sector through toolkits, blogs, and other public\-good resources


**Requirements**
 The ideal candidate is an exceptional builder with the ability to drive outcomes in a fast\-moving, high\-stakes environment. Given the startup nature of this work, we seek contributors with high throughput, strong work ethic, and willingness to lean in and work extended hours.
   

  

 You will likely have:
   

  

* 7\-10\+ years' experience as a builder in international development, consulting, or an agriculture adjacent organization
* Strong communication skills in English with experience working with international teams
* A proven track record of significantly scaling organizations and/or programs to deliver impact at scale, preferably in close partnership with national governments. Direct experience taking a program or organization into a new region is a plus
* Demonstrated success building and negotiating partnerships with governments and the private sector. Experience with telcos, mobile network operators, or platform partners is a strong plus
* Training or early career experience in a high\-rigor environment (e.g., top\-tier management consulting, high\-growth NGO program leadership, strategy/econ research) and the ability to rapidly get up to speed in new technical areas including AI/ML forecasting concepts
* A track record as a strong people manager and builder: able to set clear standards, empower others, and cultivate a high\-performance culture across distributed and field\-based teams
* Experience working with Asian and/or African governments to drive large\-scale change, with a strong preference for direct experience working with ministries of agriculture or national meteorological agencies
* High EQ and the ability to influence across diverse partners, from AI/forecasting researchers to frontline delivery staff to senior government officials
* Strong fluency with AI tools, and eager to experiment, learn, and adapt to emerging technologies
* Comfort with ambiguity and fast iteration; can define and test hypotheses, adapt quickly, and maintain focus on impact
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to synthesize complex technical ideas (e.g., AI/ML weather forecasting language) into crisp narratives for different audiences
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively internationally (:40\-50%) to prospective and current markets across low\-and\-middle income countries
* Passion for the mission of ensuring that the benefits of frontier AI reach the world's poorest populations, while mitigating its downside risks


**Position Location**
 This role is based in India, with flexibility on location within the country. The role sits on 2AI's global team rather than within a single country program, and requires significant international travel (:40\-50%) to prospective and current markets. Evidence Action is an Equal Opportunity Employer with a commitment to diversity. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply.
   

  

 Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time.
   

  

**Benefits**
 EAII provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees . Benefits include:
   

  

* Comprehensive health insurance with IPD and OPD provisions,
* Life and Accidental insurance,
* PF, ESIC and Gratuity as per statutory requirements,
* Generous leave,
* Mental and physical wellbeing benefits
* Learning \& Development benefits
* Avenues for engagement and recognition


 Compensation: Pay will be competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience and previous pay scale.
   

  

 This role will initially be housed at EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, with the explicit plan to transfer with the AI Access Initiative as a founding member of the team when that project is spun out as a new entity later this year. At that point, benefits and policies may change.

title: Vice President Influencer Marketing
description:
Role Overview
 



 We are looking for an experienced, strategic, and highly connected
 **Vice President Influencer Marketing** 
 to lead our influencer and creator marketing function. This person will own the influencer strategy end\-to\-end—from creator identification and partnerships to campaign execution, measurement, and long\-term relationship building.
 



 The ideal candidate combines strong strategic thinking with deep knowledge of the creator ecosystem, excellent negotiation skills, commercial acumen, and a proven ability to build high\-performing influencer programs at scale.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



**1\. Influencer Strategy \& Leadership** 



* Develop and own the overall influencer and creator marketing strategy aligned with brand and business objectives.
* Build annual and quarterly influencer marketing plans, budgets, and growth strategies.
* Identify emerging creator trends, platforms, formats, and opportunities.
* Define the right mix of macro, mid\-tier, micro, and nano influencers for different campaign objectives.
* Establish influencer marketing as a scalable and measurable growth channel.



**2\. Creator Partnerships** 



* Build and maintain strong relationships with influencers, creators, talent managers, agencies, and creator networks.
* Identify and onboard high\-impact creators aligned with the brand's values, audience, and positioning.
* Lead contract negotiations, commercial terms, exclusivity, usage rights, and long\-term partnerships.
* Develop ambassador and always\-on creator programs.



**3\. Campaign Management** 



* Lead influencer campaigns from briefing and creator selection through execution and reporting.
* Partner closely with creative, social, PR, brand, product, and performance marketing teams.
* Develop compelling creator briefs, campaign concepts, and content frameworks.
* Ensure creator content is authentic while meeting brand, legal, and compliance requirements.
* Manage campaign timelines, deliverables, approvals, and budgets.



**4\. Performance \& Analytics** 



* Establish KPIs and measurement frameworks for influencer campaigns.
* Track metrics including reach, engagement, views, EMV, conversions, CAC/ROI, revenue, and incremental impact.
* Use data and insights to optimize creator selection, content strategy, and investment allocation.
* Build regular executive\-level reporting and recommendations.



**5\. Budget \& Commercial Management** 



* Own and manage the influencer marketing budget.
* Negotiate rates and maximize return on creator investments.
* Evaluate agency, platform, and technology partnerships.
* Develop scalable processes for forecasting, budgeting, and campaign ROI.



**6\. Team Leadership** 



* Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing influencer marketing team.
* Set goals, KPIs, processes, and operating standards.
* Foster a culture of creativity, experimentation, accountability, and performance.
* Manage external agencies and strategic partners where required.



 Key Success Metrics
 


* Influencer\-attributed revenue and/or conversions
* Campaign ROI / ROAS
* Creator engagement and content performance
* Reach and quality of audience
* Cost per engagement / acquisition
* Growth of creator community and strategic partnerships
* Brand awareness and consideration impact
* Percentage of creator partnerships becoming repeat/long\-term collaborations



 Candidate Profile
 



**Experience** 



* 8–12\+ years of experience in influencer marketing, creator marketing, social media, digital marketing, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading large\-scale influencer/creator campaigns.
* Experience managing significant marketing budgets and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong network across relevant creator, talent, and agency ecosystems.
* Experience building influencer programs from strategy through execution and measurement.

* Own Store Manager hiring and coordinate end\-to\-end store team hiring for existing and new DTC stores in partnership with Human Resources, and influence partner staffing quality for Partner Monobrand stores.
* Lead, coach and develop Store Managers and field operations teams, building a performance\-oriented culture focused on accountability, execution excellence, succession planning and talent retention.
* Act as the regional operating link across Commercial, Product, Marketing, Planning, Supply Chain, Finance, VM, HR, Real Estate and partners, ensuring timely closure of priorities, escalations and corrective actions with clear, data\-led updates.

----------------------------------


* MBA preferred; Bachelor’s degree in Business, Retail Management, Operations, Supply Chain or a related discipline – or equivalent years of relevant and related experience.
* Minimum 8–12 years of experience in Retail Operations, Wholesale Operations, Franchise Management or Commercial Operations, with multi\-state exposure preferred.
* Background knowledge in retail hiring, new store openings and property/site evaluation.
* Strong understanding of retail operations, store P\&L, inventory productivity, replenishment processes and partner governance.
* Highly influential across cross\-functional stakeholders and external partners, including situations without direct authority.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multi\-location operations and Store Managers, identify business risks early and drive corrective action.
* Ability to attract, select and build strong Store Manager and frontline teams, with strong analytical, stakeholder management, communication and people leadership skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively across North \+ East India, with a field\-oriented, process\-driven and data\-led approach.
The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability, or any other protected classification.

Your participation in this flexible schedule plays a key role in building a connected and successful team. Statcon Powtech Private Limited is seeking enthusiastic and result\-oriented Telecalling Executives to support the company's expansion of its dealer and distributor network across India. title: Power & Utilities Sector Leader
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Position Summary (Enter the description) \- Power \& Utilities Sector Leader responsible for driving sector\-led growth through origination, deal shaping, and execution of large\-scale transformation programs, with a strong emphasis on strengthening sales enablement and pipeline quality.
   

  

 Acts as a senior industry advisor, translating energy transition and utilities disruption into actionable client opportunities while building a differentiated sector proposition and positioning the firm as a partner of choice for complex, high\-value engagements.
   

  

**Objective and purpose:**
* Lead the growth agenda for the Power \& Utilities sector in GDS, defining strategic priorities, target accounts, and differentiated plays to scale the practice and drive sustained revenue growth.
* Drive origination and closure of large, complex transformation opportunities, translating sector themes such as energy transition, grid modernization, and asset optimization into actionable, high\-value deals.
* Act as a trusted advisor to P\&U C\-suite leaders, shaping enterprise transformation agendas across generation, transmission, distribution, and customer operations with a clear link to business outcomes.
* Institutionalize strong sales enablement across the sector, embedding disciplined pipeline management, pursuit excellence, sector narratives, and commercial frameworks to improve win rates and consistency.
* Build and commercialize differentiated sector offerings, including repeatable frameworks, assets, and go\-to\-market propositions, while strengthening market positioning through thought leadership and industry engagement.


**Scope of the position:**
* Own the GDS Power \& Utilities sector agenda across priority accounts, aligning global client needs with GDS capabilities to identify and shape high\-value transformation opportunities across the utilities value chain.
* Lead end\-to\-end pursuit lifecycle, including opportunity qualification, solution shaping, commercial structuring, and deal closure, ensuring strong integration with onshore teams and global account leadership.
* Drive sales enablement at scale, embedding consistent pipeline discipline, qualification frameworks, reusable sector narratives, and pursuit playbooks to improve win rates and cost of sales efficiency across deals.
* Lead integrated go\-to\-market initiatives, working across Consulting, SaT, Tax, and Assurance to bring unified, market\-facing sector solutions and drive coordinated account penetration.
* Develop and industrialize sector\-specific assets and accelerators, including playbooks, benchmarks, and solution components that enable faster deal shaping, repeatable delivery, and differentiated positioning.
* Build and maintain senior client relationships, engaging C\-suite stakeholders to position the firm as a strategic partner across energy transition, regulatory change, infrastructure modernization, and customer transformation agendas.
* Build and scale GDS alliance and ecosystem capabilities for the P\&U sector, working closely with global teams to operationalize and support partnerships, enhancing solution depth and strengthening competitiveness in large deals
* Build and scale a high\-performing P\&U capability within GDS, enhancing domain depth, pursuit leadership, and delivery excellence to support sustained sector growth and competitive advantage.


**Essential Functions Of The Job (Enter The Description)**
* Sponsor and steer priority pursuits and engagements, providing senior direction on deal strategy, solution architecture, and executive messaging to maximize win probability and value realization.
* Shape differentiated client propositions, translating complex utilities challenges (e.g., grid resilience, decarbonization, regulatory compliance, asset performance) into clear, outcome\-driven transformation narratives for senior stakeholders.
* Govern quality and consistency of proposals and deliverables, ensuring alignment with client priorities, commercial expectations, and delivery feasibility across large, multi\-tower programs.
* Drive commercial rigor in deal\-making, including pricing strategy, margin management, and contract structuring for complex transformation programs.
* Enable cross\-functional solution integration, ensuring seamless alignment of capabilities across consulting, technology, risk, and core utility operations
* Influence executive\-level client decision\-making, leading high\-stakes conversations, facilitating alignment across stakeholders, and positioning transformation initiatives in the context of enterprise value creation.
* Oversee development and evolution of sector IP, ensuring that frameworks, benchmarks, and solution components remain relevant to evolving industry trends and are effectively applied in client contexts
* Ensure strong alignment between deal strategy and delivery approach, guiding teams on shaping scalable, GDS‑led delivery models that are commercially viable, feasible, and differentiated during pursuits.
* Coach and develop senior team members on pursuit leadership and client engagement, strengthening capability in solutioning, storytelling, and executive\-level communication.


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities (Enter The Description)**
* Evaluate and prioritize pursuit opportunities, applying judgment on deal size, strategic fit, client buying appetite, competitive positioning, and win probability to guide sector focus and resource allocation.
* Make strategic decisions on solution positioning and value definition, determining which transformation levers (e.g., energy transition, grid modernization, cost optimization) to emphasize based on client context and value potential.
* Direct commercial and pricing strategy for complex deals, balancing competitiveness, margin expectations, and delivery feasibility to secure priority opportunities.
* Determine optimal GDS involvement across pursuits, making decisions on when and how to position GDS capabilities within deal constructs, including the choice of delivery model, offshore leverage, and integration with onshore teams to maximize competitiveness and value realization.
* Assess and prioritize sector investments, including development of assets, offerings, and alliance capabilities, based on market demand, pipeline trends, and potential for differentiation.
* Analyze market trends and disruption themes in Power \& Utilities, including regulatory shifts, decarbonization priorities, infrastructure investment cycles, and evolving customer models, to inform sector strategy and pursuit direction.


**Education And Experience (Enter The Description)**
* 25\+ years of relevant experience in consulting (Big 4 / strategy) and/or senior industry roles within the Power \& Utilities sector, with exposure to large\-scale transformation or business\-led growth initiatives.
* Proven track record of working with global clients and stakeholders, with experience operating across geographies and leading complex, multi\-market engagements or pursuits.
* Demonstrated experience in both industry and consulting environments (preferred), bringing a balanced perspective on sector challenges, operating models, and client decision\-making dynamics.
* Strong academic background, with an MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred; undergraduate degree in engineering, business, or a related discipline is typically expected.
* Exposure to working within global delivery or distributed team models, with familiarity in leveraging offshore/onshore constructs and collaborating across matrixed organizations.


**Knowledge And Skill Requirements (Enter The Description)**
* Deep Power \& Utilities sector expertise, with strong understanding of industry drivers such as energy transition, regulatory frameworks, grid modernization, asset\-intensive operations, and evolving customer models.
* Familiarity with core Power \& Utilities technology landscape and ecosystems, including platforms such as SAP IS‑U, Oracle Utilities, AMI/MDM systems, grid management (ADMS/EMS), and data/cloud ecosystems, with an understanding of how these enable transformation across the utilities value chain.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to interpret deal economics, value drivers, and business cases, and translate these into compelling, outcome\-focused client narratives.
* Advanced problem\-solving and structured thinking capability, with the ability to synthesize complex, multi\-dimensional client challenges into clear strategic choices and actionable priorities.
* Executive\-level communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage credibly with C\-suite stakeholders, simplify complex topics, and drive alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.
* Ability to operate in a global, matrixed environment, collaborating effectively across geographies, service lines, and alliance ecosystems while navigating organizational complexity and competing priorities.


**Good to have (Differentiators)**
* Strong perspective on energy transition and emerging business models, including renewables integration, distributed energy resources (DER), hydrogen, and evolving market structures, with the ability to connect these shifts to long\-term utility transformation agendas.
* Exposure to grid and infrastructure modernization, including smart grids, digital substations, asset performance optimization, and resilience programs, reflecting the increasing digitization of network operations.
* Experience driving AI\- and data\-led transformation in asset\-intensive environments, including applications such as predictive maintenance, digital twins, advanced analytics, and real\-time decisioning across utility operations and customer ecosystems.
* Ability to translate global disruption trends into scalable market propositions, including navigating regulatory complexity, ESG mandates, and capital investment cycles, while identifying new growth and efficiency opportunities.
* Experience in building and leveraging ecosystem\-led solutions, including working with hyperscalers, platform providers, and industrial technology partners to shape integrated, future\-ready offerings in complex, multi\-stakeholder environments.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Manager - Manufacturing, Operations & Supply Chain
description:
**Role Objective**

To drive Brillare's supply planning and logistics operations, ensuring the right products are available at the right place and time to support the company's rapid growth across channels and geographies.

The role will have a strong focus on demand and supply planning, inventory management, warehousing, logistics, and delivery performance, while working closely with Production and Purchase teams to ensure seamless availability of finished goods.

The ideal candidate will be a hands\-on supply chain professional who can build robust planning processes, improve forecast accuracy, optimize inventory, and ensure high service levels without excessive working capital or stock\-outs.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Demand \& Supply Planning**

● Own the demand and supply planning process across SKUs, channels, and geographies.

● Translate sales forecasts, marketing campaigns, new product launches, and channel expansion plans into actionable production and procurement requirements.

● Build and strengthen the S\&OP process in collaboration with Sales, Marketing, Production, and Purchase teams.

● Improve forecast accuracy and ensure optimal inventory availability across the network.

● Minimize stock\-outs, excess inventory, obsolescence, and working capital lock\-up.

**2\. Logistics, Warehousing \& Delivery Excellence**

● Own the movement of finished goods from manufacturing locations to warehouses, distributors, retail partners, and customers.

● Drive strong logistics and delivery performance across GT, MT, e\-commerce, quick commerce, EBOs, and other relevant channels.

● Ensure high levels of **OTIF (On\-Time In\-Full)** and service\-level excellence.

● Monitor and improve order fulfilment, dispatch planning, delivery timelines, freight costs, and logistics partner performance.

● Identify bottlenecks across warehousing and distribution and implement scalable solutions.

**3\. Inventory \& Working Capital Management**

● Maintain optimal inventory levels across raw materials, packaging materials, and finished goods.

● Establish inventory norms and monitor ageing, slow\-moving, and obsolete inventory.

● Balance product availability with working capital efficiency.

● Build dashboards and MIS to provide visibility on stock availability, inventory health, forecast accuracy, and service levels.

**4\. Production Planning Coordination**

● Work closely with manufacturing teams to align production schedules with demand forecasts and inventory requirements.

● Understand production capacities, lead times, constraints, and batch economics to create realistic supply plans.

● Ensure adequate capacity planning for business growth, seasonal peaks, promotions, and new product launches.

● Proactively identify potential supply constraints and develop mitigation plans.

**5\. Purchase \& Procurement Coordination**

● Work closely with the Purchase team to ensure timely availability of raw materials and packaging materials.

● Understand procurement lead times, vendor dependencies, and material availability risks.

● Support supplier planning and ensure procurement schedules are aligned with production requirements.

● Help identify opportunities to improve material availability and reduce supply disruptions.

**6\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement**

● Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Production, Purchase, Finance, Quality, and R\&D teams.

● Support new product launches by ensuring material, production, inventory, and logistics readiness.

● Drive process improvements across planning, inventory, warehousing, and logistics.

● Build scalable systems and processes capable of supporting rapid business growth.

**Ideal Candidate ProfileExperience \& Background**

● 6–10 years in manufacturing, operations, or supply chain in:

○ FMCG

○ Personal Care

○ Beauty / Pharma / Consumer products

**● Strong experience in:**

○ Demand planning

○ Warehousing, logistics \& Delivery

● Exposure to new product launches is a strong plus

**Skills \& Attributes**

● Systems\-builder — can scale operations, not just run them

● Highly analytical, structured, and data\-driven

● Strong ownership mindset — treats factory, inventory \& cost as their own P\&L

● Comfortable in fast\-changing, high\-growth environments

● Calm, mature, and execution\-focused

**Educational \& Professional Credentials**

● IIT / NIT / Tier\-1 Engineering College preferred

● MBA / Operations specialisation is a plus

● Strong pedigree in MNC FMCG / high\-quality manufacturing setups

Pay: Up to ₹1,700,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund
