description:
Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

  

At Leica Biosystems, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

  

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

  

At Leica Biosystems, we’re not just shaping the future of cancer diagnostics — we’re transforming lives. Our mission of “Advancing Cancer Diagnostics, Improving Lives” is the driving force behind everything we do. As a global leader with the most comprehensive portfolio spanning from biopsy to diagnosis, we empower clinicians with innovative, reliable solutions so they can give patients timely, accurate answers when they need them most. When you join Leica Biosystems, you’re not just taking a job; you’re becoming part of a passionate team that knows every moment matters when it comes to cancer. You’ll help develop diagnostic solutions that turn anxiety into answers, and aid the acceleration of next\-generation, life\-changing therapies. Surrounded by a diverse and collaborative global community, you’ll be inspired each day to stretch, grow, and make an impact.

  

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

  

The **Clinical Sales** role is responsible for driving Leica Biosystems’ Core Histopathology, Immunohistochemistry (IHC), and Digital Pathology growth through a strong combination of clinical application expertise and direct sales execution. The role will support customers across the assigned territory through technical consultation, product demonstrations, proof\-of\-principle activities, customer training, troubleshooting, and scientific engagement, while also carrying sales targets and contributing directly to opportunity creation, funnel progression, revenue conversion, and market share expansion.

  

This position reports to the **Regional Manager, West** and is part of the Sales/Commercial organization located in **Ahmedabad, India** and will be fully remote to cover the Westregion.

 **In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**

* Prior experience in a customer\-facing application specialist, product specialist, clinical sales specialist, technical sales, or diagnostic sales role.

description:
Deputy General Manager Digital Marketing Performance Marketing | Digital Growth | AI-First Search | Content Location: Bengaluru

 Employment Type: Full-time 
 About Deeksha Vedantu Deeksha Vedantu brings together Deekshas established academic strength and Vedantu’s digital learning capabilities to create an integrated learning ecosystem for students. As the organization continues to scale, digital is becoming an increasingly important engine for brand discovery, student acquisition, engagement and admissions. Role Purpose We are looking for a high-ownership, performance-oriented digital marketing professional to join us as Deputy General Manager – Digital Marketing. Reporting to the Head of Growth, the role will independently own the day-to-day digital marketing agenda across performance marketing, search, AI-led discovery, SEO, content, analytics and conversion optimisation. The role is designed for a strong digital operator who can translate business objectives into measurable campaigns, manage agencies and partners, work hands-on with platforms and data, and continuously improve the efficiency and quality of digital acquisition. Key Responsibilities 1. Performance Marketing & Digital Acquisition Own and execute performance marketing strategy across Google Ads, Meta Ads, YouTube and other relevant digital channels. Manage Search, Performance Max, YouTube, Display, remarketing and lead-generation campaigns. Build full-funnel acquisition plans covering awareness, consideration, lead generation, counselling and admission. Optimise CPL, cost per qualified lead, CAC, lead-to-counselling conversion, counselling-to-admission conversion and ROAS/ROI. Develop campaign strategies by geography, class, course, examination, audience and intent. Continuously test new channels, formats, audiences, creatives and messaging. 2. AI-First Search, AEO & GEO Develop Deeksha Vedantu’s approach to the rapidly evolving AI Search and discovery ecosystem. Drive initiatives across Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) and AI-search visibility. Improve discoverability across Google’s AI-led search experiences and relevant AI discovery platforms. Build strategies around conversational search, long-tail intent, topical authority, entities and structured content. Understand the questions and decision journeys of students and parents across traditional search and AI platforms. Create a measurable framework to track visibility, authority and referral opportunities from AI-led discovery. 3. SEO & Organic Growth Own the organic search strategy across Deeksha Vedantu’s websites and digital properties. Drive technical SEO, on-page SEO, content SEO, local SEO, internal linking, structured data and authority-building initiatives. Develop search-intent and keyword strategies aligned to courses, examinations, locations and student/parent needs. Increase organic traffic, search visibility and organic lead generation through a structured growth roadmap. 4. Content Marketing Own the digital content strategy in collaboration with academic, creative and content teams. Build content engines around JEE, NEET, CBSE/State Boards, Classes 11–12, careers, college choices and academic guidance. Develop content for reach, engagement, search, trust and conversion. Build a content ecosystem that works across Search, YouTube, Social, AI Search, Website and lead-generation funnels. Use search, audience and performance data to continuously refine content themes, formats and distribution. 5. Landing Pages & Conversion Optimisation Own the conversion journey beyond traffic acquisition. Improve landing pages, lead forms, CTAs, WhatsApp journeys, website conversion and mobile experience. Identify funnel drop-offs and develop hypotheses to improve conversion. Drive A/B testing of messaging, creatives, landing pages, offers and user journeys. 6. Analytics, Attribution & Performance Intelligence Build a robust digital measurement framework using GA4, advertising platforms, CRM and business data. Establish reliable source-to-lead and source-to-admission attribution. Develop dashboards covering leads, qualified leads, CAC, conversion, admissions, revenue contribution and ROI. Move optimisation beyond CPL towards qualified leads, admissions and revenue outcomes. Use data to identify incremental growth opportunities and improve digital budget allocation. 7. AI, Automation & Marketing Technology Identify practical opportunities to use AI across campaign optimisation, audience research, content, SEO/AEO/GEO, reporting and personalisation. Build repeatable AI-assisted workflows that improve marketing speed, quality and efficiency. Evaluate emerging marketing technologies that can improve acquisition, lead quality and conversion. Champion an AI-first mindset within the digital marketing function. 8. Agency & Stakeholder Management Manage external agencies, partners, freelancers and specialist vendors where required. Set clear KPIs, SLAs, budgets, reporting standards and performance expectations. Work closely with the Head of Growth, business teams, academic teams, creative/content, admissions and technology/product teams. Ensure timely execution, transparent reporting and accountability across all digital initiatives. 9. Digital Budget Management Support annual and monthly digital marketing planning in alignment with the Head of Growth. Recommend channel-wise budget allocation based on performance, incremental opportunity and business priorities. Forecast acquisition outcomes and proactively identify risks, opportunities and corrective actions. Maintain strong control over digital marketing efficiency and return on investment. Key Performance Indicators Qualified leads and cost per qualified lead Customer acquisition cost (CAC) Digital-attributable admissions and revenue Digital contribution to admissions ROAS / marketing ROI Organic traffic, organic leads and search visibility AI Search / AEO / GEO visibility Website and landing-page conversion rate Lead-to-admission conversion Incremental growth delivered through digital channels Candidate Profile Must Have 7–12 years of experience in digital marketing, performance marketing or digital growth. Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads. Demonstrated experience managing meaningful digital advertising budgets. Strong understanding of performance marketing funnels and lead-generation businesses. Strong analytical capability and comfort working with campaign and funnel data. Working knowledge of GA4, attribution, CRM-based measurement and reporting. Strong understanding of SEO, content marketing and conversion optimisation. Experience managing agencies and/or digital marketing teams. Preferred Experience in EdTech, education, consumer internet, D2C or another high-consideration category. Experience with large-scale lead-generation campaigns. Experience with YouTube performance marketing. Working knowledge of AEO, GEO and AI Search. Experience using AI tools and automation in marketing workflows. Experience building content-led acquisition engines. Experience connecting marketing metrics to admissions, revenue or other business outcomes. The Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a builder and operator who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. They should be performance-led, analytical, commercially minded, curious about AI, comfortable with data and willing to challenge existing approaches through experimentation. What Success Looks Like Success in this role will mean building a disciplined, measurable and scalable digital marketing engine for Deeksha Vedantu — with stronger paid acquisition efficiency, clearer attribution, improved conversion, growing organic discovery and a credible presence across traditional and AI-led search environments.

Company Profile 
 Vissco Healthcare Pvt Ltd Established in 1963,is one of India's leading manufacturers of orthopaedic supports, rehabilitation products, mobility aids, and wellness solutions. With over six decades of expertise, Vissco is committed to improving mobility, enhancing recovery, and empowering people to lead active, independent lives through innovative and high-quality healthcare products. 
 Headquartered in Mumbai, Vissco has a strong presence across India and international markets, serving healthcare professionals, hospitals, retailers, and millions of customers worldwide. Driven by innovation, quality, and customer-centricity, Vissco continues to set benchmarks in the healthcare and medical devices industry. 
 Company Website: https://www.vissconext.com/ 

 Role Overview 
 The Marketing Manager will be responsible for developing and implementing effective marketing and brand strategies to drive business growth, strengthen brand awareness, and enhance market positioning. The role involves market research, campaign planning and execution, promotional activities, budget management, performance analysis, team leadership, and collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. 
 Key Responsibilities

 Develop, implement, and monitor marketing strategies and policies in line with the organization's business objectives, market opportunities, and budgetary requirements. Market Research and Competitive Analysis

 Plan, execute, and monitor integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social media, traditional, and other relevant channels to drive brand awareness and business growth. Promotional Activities 
 Plan and implement promotional activities and customer engagement initiatives to encourage repeat business, support new product launches, and strengthen customer relationships. Budget Management 
 Manage marketing budgets effectively by allocating resources, monitoring expenses, and evaluating return on investment (ROI) to optimize marketing spend and achieve business objectives. Team Management 
 Lead, mentor, and supervise the marketing team by providing guidance, support, and direction to ensure effective execution of marketing initiatives. Brand Management and Consistency 
 Develop and maintain comprehensive brand guidelines and ensure consistency across all marketing and communication materials. Oversee the creation, distribution, and management of brand assets. Brand Growth and Development 
 Drive the overall growth and development of the Vissco brand by developing and implementing strategic brand initiatives that strengthen brand identity, increase market awareness and visibility, enhance brand positioning, and support long-term business growth. Performance Analysis and Optimization 
 Monitor and analyze the performance of marketing campaigns and initiatives. Identify areas for improvement and optimize strategies based on insights and performance metrics. Cross-Functional and External Collaboration 
 Collaborate with internal teams, including Sales, Product, and Creative teams, to align marketing initiatives with overall business objectives and ensure consistent brand communication. Coordinate with external agencies, vendors, and partners to leverage expertise, execute campaigns effectively, and maximize marketing impact. Content and Social Media Communication

title: Senior Marketing Manager
description:
About FIAB Finance in a Box is an accounting and financial consulting firm based in California, providing outsourced CFO and controller services to companies around the world. FIAB operates as one managed operating partner for finance, HR, and regulatory readiness for growing businesses. FIAB recently expanded beyond finance into HR services through its partnership with GyroHR, and is preparing to launch FinOpz, an AI-enabled finance operations platform, as a new product line alongside its core services business. 
 The Role Were looking for a Senior Marketing Manager / Marketing Lead to build and run marketing for Finance in a Box, as a hands-on, individual-contributor role working closely with FIABs fractional CMO. Youll personally plan, write, run, and measure campaigns, own the marketing side of our CRM (HubSpot), lead nurture campaigns, build our LinkedIn and thought-leadership presence, and work side-by-side with BD/Sales to turn marketing activity into a measurable pipeline. Youll also take on product marketing support for FinOpz, our new AI-enabled finance operations platform, as one part of a broader, all-around marketing role rather than a dedicated product marketing seat. Youll meet weekly with the fractional CMO to set priorities and review work, and use freelancers or agencies as extra hands, not as a substitute for your own execution. 
 Responsibilities Campaigns demand generation Own multi-channel campaign execution (LinkedIn, email, content, webinars/events) that generates qualified leads for priority segments. Manage the marketing side of our CRM (HubSpot): email nurture campaigns, list segmentation, and reporting, in coordination with BD/Sales on lead handoff and pipeline feedback. Partner with BD/Sales on account-based approaches for target accounts and joint go-to-market plans. Track leads through the funnel and report results and ROI to leadership. Brand content Build and personally drive our LinkedIn presence and thought-leadership content: founder posts, articles, case studies, and market commentary that build credibility across finance and HR/people-ops circles. Translate FIABs finance, HR, and expanding service offerings into clear, differentiated positioning and messaging for different buyer personas. Own website updates, one-pagers, decks, and sales-enablement content, working with leadership and BD. Track competitor positioning and market developments in fintech/finops, and B2B services to keep messaging sharp and current. Product marketing (FinOpz) Take on product marketing support for FinOpz as it moves through beta and toward public launch, coordinating with the fractional CMO on strategy and priorities. Process vendor management Build repeatable marketing processes, calendars, SOPs, and playbooks, proactively identifying and fixing gaps rather than running campaigns ad hoc. Brief and manage external agencies, freelancers, or contract designers/copywriters, holding them accountable for quality and deadlines while retaining ownership of strategy and outcomes. Meet weekly with the fractional CMO to set priorities, review work, and course-correct. 
 What Youll Need 10-12+ years of B2B marketing experience, with a strong track record in demand generation, not just brand or communications. Genuinely fluent with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) as a core part of how you work, not an occasional add-on. Youll be a team of one and need to multiply your own output. Hands-on experience running the marketing side of a CRM/marketing automation platform (HubSpot strongly preferred): nurture tracks, list management, and reporting. Proven experience building LinkedIn presence and thought-leadership content for a B2B brand or leader. Experience working closely with BD/Sales on pipeline generation, lead handoff, and account-based approaches. Comfortable marketing technology, recruitment/HR, or financial and professional-services offerings to sophisticated B2B buyers. A bias for personal execution: comfortable writing copy, building campaigns, and getting into the details rather than only directing others. Data-driven mindset: able to set up and read funnel metrics and adjust tactics based on results. Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, or contractors to deliver on brief and on time. Strong written communication skills in English, with real editorial judgment on what AI-assisted drafts still need before theyre ready to ship. A self-starter who takes a loose direction and turns it into a concrete plan, and builds process and structure proactively. 
 Nice to Have Experience marketing a new product launch, ideally in B2B SaaS or fintech. Experience as the first or sole marketing hire in a growing services or technology business. Familiarity with account-based marketing motions alongside demand generation. Comfort with design/no-code tools (Canva, basic Figma, website CMS) to move quickly without always relying on a designer. Exposure to both US and India B2B buyer contexts. Experience working alongside a fractional or outside CMO/marketing advisor. Required Skills Branding CRM BD experience HubSpot Marketing

title: Marketing Intern
description:
National Health Governance Council (NHGC) is an independent healthcare governance and policy platform working at the intersection of health policy, public health, healthcare delivery, technology and institutional reform . 
 NHGC brings together policymakers, Parliamentarians, healthcare leaders, clinicians, public-health experts, academia, industry, technology organisations and other stakeholders to facilitate meaningful dialogue and develop actionable perspectives on Indias healthcare priorities. 
 NHGCs work includes policy dialogues, roundtables, conferences, research, white papers, knowledge forums and stakeholder engagements across areas such as NCDs, healthcare access, financing, patient safety, digital health, AI, pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, medtech and resilient health systems. 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for a Marketing Intern who is creative, organised and interested in healthcare, policy, communications and digital media. 
 The intern will work closely with the NHGC team on digital communication, social media, event marketing and stakeholder communication . 
 This is a hands-on role where you will get exposure to how a healthcare policy and governance platform is built, communicated and positioned among senior stakeholders. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Social Media & Digital Marketing 
 Manage and maintain NHGCs social media handles, particularly LinkedIn and other relevant platforms. 
 Develop and schedule posts around NHGC initiatives, policy discussions, events and healthcare developments. 
 Assist in creating social media calendars and monthly content plans. 
 Coordinate with designers and content teams for creatives, posts, carousels and short-form content. 
 Track social media performance and prepare basic analytics reports. 
 Research relevant healthcare, policy and industry conversations for content opportunities. 
 Events & Event Marketing 
 Support marketing and communication for conferences, roundtables, policy dialogues and webinars . 
 Prepare event-related social media content before, during and after events. 
 Assist with speaker announcements, event reminders and post-event communication. 
 Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely dissemination of event information. 
 Emailers & Communication 
 Draft and coordinate event emailers, invitations, reminders and follow-up communications . 
 Maintain email communication calendars for upcoming NHGC activities. 
 Assist in preparing stakeholder communication for policymakers, healthcare leaders, speakers and partners. 
 Support basic email campaign tracking and reporting. 
 Coordination 
 Coordinate with designers, content writers, event teams and external stakeholders. 
 Maintain content and communication trackers. 
 Ensure deadlines for social media posts, emailers and event communication are met. 
 
 
 
 Requirements Who We Are Looking For 
 Students or graduates from Marketing, Mass Communication, Journalism, Public Relations, Business, Healthcare Management or related fields . 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills. 
 Good understanding of social media platforms, particularly LinkedIn. 
 Comfortable with basic content writing and proofreading. 
 Good research and information-gathering skills. 
 Strong organisational and coordination abilities. 
 Ability to work on multiple tasks and meet deadlines. 
 Interest in healthcare, public policy, current affairs or social-impact initiatives will be an advantage. 
 Preferred Skills 
 Canva or similar design tools 
 Social media management 
 Email marketing 
 Basic analytics/reporting 
 Content writing 
 MS Office / Google Workspace 
 Basic understanding of LinkedIn marketing 
 
 
 Benefits What You Will Learn 
 How a healthcare governance and policy platform operates.

title: Hospitality Sales, Marketing & Operations Manager
description:
**Company:** 
 Soul Club
 



**Location:** 
 Hosur, Tamil Nadu
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Salary:** 
 ₹25,000/month fixed \+ up to ₹10,000/month performance incentives
 



**Experience:** 
 1–4 years preferred; exceptional freshers may be considered
 


 About Soul Club
 
 Soul Club is a growing boutique hospitality brand operating a portfolio of private luxury villas around Hosur/Bangalore.
 



 We are looking for a
 **young, energetic and commercially driven all\-rounder** 
 to take ownership of our sales, reservations, online listings, marketing and commercial administration.
 



 This is not a conventional hospitality desk job. We want someone who can
 **drive bookings, grow revenue, manage our digital presence and eventually take complete ownership of the commercial side of the business.** 



 The Role
 
 You will work directly with the Founder and become the primary person responsible for driving bookings and revenue across Soul Club's properties.
 



 Your core objective:
 


**Generate more inquiries → convert more bookings → increase occupancy and revenue → build Soul Club's direct customer base.** 
 1\. Sales \& Reservations — Primary Responsibility
 * Handle all incoming inquiries through Airbnb, WhatsApp, phone, Instagram and other channels.
* Respond quickly and professionally to prospective guests.
* Follow up with leads and convert inquiries into confirmed bookings.
* Handle pricing discussions and objections within approved guidelines.
* Maintain a database of leads, guests and previous customers.
* Drive repeat bookings, referrals and direct bookings.
* Upsell relevant experiences, food, BBQ, events and other services.
* Ensure no genuine lead is missed or left without follow\-up.



**Sales ability and communication skills are extremely important for this role.** 



 2\. OTA \& Listing Management
 
 Manage Soul Club's presence across platforms such as:
 


* Airbnb
* MakeMyTrip
* Agoda
* Booking.com
* Other relevant OTAs



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Maintaining property listings, descriptions, photos and amenities.
* Managing availability and calendars.
* Updating pricing and promotions.
* Monitoring reviews and ratings.
* Optimizing listings for better visibility and conversion.
* Monitoring competitors and market pricing.


 3\. Revenue \& Occupancy Growth
 
 You will be responsible for helping grow revenue across the portfolio.
 



 You will track:
 


* Occupancy
* Average booking value / ADR
* Revenue per property
* Weekend vs weekday demand
* Inquiry\-to\-booking conversion
* Direct vs OTA bookings
* Cancellations



 You will be expected to identify underperforming properties and develop ideas to improve them through pricing, packages, marketing, content, partnerships, influencers and other initiatives.
 


 4\. Digital Marketing \& Social Media
 
 You will support and drive Soul Club's marketing activities, including:
 


* Managing Instagram and other relevant social channels.
* Coordinating content creation, photography and videography.
* Identifying and managing influencer collaborations.
* Planning influencer campaigns and tracking results.
* Running basic Meta/Instagram advertising campaigns.
* Supporting Google Ads.
* Driving traffic towards direct booking channels.
* Building Soul Club's online presence and brand.



**Digital marketing experience is a strong advantage.** 



 5\. Direct Bookings \& Customer Database
 
 A major objective will be to increase bookings that come directly to Soul Club rather than through third\-party OTAs.
 



 You will:
 


* Generate bookings through WhatsApp, phone, Instagram and referrals.
* Maintain a clean customer database.
* Follow up with previous guests.
* Develop repeat\-customer and referral opportunities.
* Explore WhatsApp marketing and CRM initiatives.
* Build partnerships with local businesses, communities and event organizers.


 6\. Financial \& Commercial Administration
 
 You will not be responsible for tax filings or statutory accounting — these will be handled by our accountant/CA.
 



 However, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate commercial records:
 


* Record all bookings and payments.
* Track collections and outstanding amounts.
* Maintain booking/CRM data.
* Record expenses and maintain receipts/invoices.
* Track property\-level expenses where required.
* Coordinate with the accountant/CA.
* Prepare a simple monthly revenue and expense report.



 The Founder should be able to ask
 **"How did we perform this month?"** 
 and receive a clear, accurate answer.
 


 7\. General Business Development
 
 You may also support:
 


* Corporate/group bookings
* Events
* Partnerships
* New property launches
* Local business development
* Marketing campaigns
* Promotional offers
* Customer retention
* Process improvements


 Who We're Looking For
 
 We want someone who is:
 


* **Excellent at communication and sales**
* **Extremely comfortable speaking on the phone**
* **Highly proficient in written and spoken English**
* **Fluent in Hindi**
* **Kannada or Tamil is a strong advantage**
* **Young, energetic and ambitious**
* **Commercially minded and target\-driven**
* **Proactive and comfortable taking initiative**
* **Organized and good with numbers**
* **Tech\-savvy and quick to learn new software**
* **Comfortable working independently**
* **Comfortable in a fast\-moving entrepreneurial environment**


 Experience
 
 Hospitality experience is preferred but
 **not mandatory** 
 .
 



 Candidates from backgrounds such as:
 


* Hotel front office
* Reservations
* Hospitality sales
* Travel
* Airbnb/vacation rentals
* Hotel/OTA management
* Digital marketing
* Sales/business development



 will be considered.
 



 However, we are equally interested in smart, hungry candidates from other backgrounds who demonstrate exceptional communication, sales ability and initiative.
 


 Mandatory Requirements
 * Excellent English communication
* Excellent Hindi communication
* Valid driving licence
* Ability to confidently drive a four\-wheeler
* Comfortable working in/around Hosur
* Willingness to travel locally when required



 A personal vehicle is an advantage but not mandatory.
 


 Location \& Work Arrangement
 
 This is primarily a
 **Hosur\-based role** 
 .
 



 The job will involve a combination of:
 


* Guest communication
* Property visits
* Marketing activities
* Local meetings
* Administrative work
* Remote/desk\-based work



 Candidates should ideally have their own accommodation in or around Hosur. Accommodation at our properties is not a standard part of the role.
 


 Compensation
 
**₹25,000/month fixed salary** 



* **Up to ₹10,000/month performance incentive**



**Potential monthly earnings: ₹35,000\+** 




**Performance incentives will be linked to measurable outcomes such as:** 



* Revenue growth
* Direct bookings
* Sales performance
* Booking conversion
* OTA/listing management
* Reporting accuracy
* Commercial performance


 What Success Looks Like
 
 Within the first few months, you should be able to:
 


* Take complete ownership of booking inquiries.
* Ensure leads are followed up and converted.
* Reduce the Founder's involvement in daily reservations.
* Keep all OTA listings accurate and optimized.
* Increase occupancy and revenue.
* Generate more direct bookings.
* Build an influencer and marketing pipeline.
* Maintain accurate booking and financial records.
* Produce a reliable monthly business report.
* Identify problems and proactively propose solutions.



 Ultimately,
 **the Founder should be able to travel for a week without Soul Club's sales and commercial operations slowing down.** 



 Why Join Soul Club?
 
 This is an opportunity to work directly with the Founder of a growing hospitality business and gain hands\-on exposure to:
 



**Hospitality \+ Sales \+ Marketing \+ Digital Advertising \+ Revenue Management \+ Business Operations \+ Entrepreneurship** 




**If you're ambitious, commercially minded and want to eventually build or run a business yourself, this role will give you exposure to far more than a traditional hospitality position.** 




**We are looking for someone who wants to build, not just work.** 



 How to Apply
 
 Please send your CV along with short answers to:
 


1. Why do you think you would be good at selling luxury villa stays?
2. Tell us about a situation where you personally generated sales, customers or revenue.
3. What digital marketing platforms/tools have you worked with?
4. Are you comfortable working in Hosur and travelling locally?
5. Do you have a valid driving licence and can you confidently drive a four\-wheeler?



**Apply only if you are comfortable taking ownership and being measured on results.** 



 Soul Club

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
**About This Role**

**Digital Marketing Manager / Pod Manager – Client Growth \| Pod P\&L \| Escalation Leadership**

**Full\-Time \| Work From Office \| Banjara Hills, Hyderabad \| Reports to: Founder / CEO**

**Company Description**

Digital Mojo is a results\-driven digital marketing agency based in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. Since 2016, we have been helping brands scale through performance\-focused digital strategies, storytelling, lead generation, branding, and high\-impact marketing campaigns.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a highly ownership\-driven **Digital Marketing Manager / Pod Manager** with 4\-7 years of agency experience to lead a pod of clients end\-to\-end.

The Pod Manager is not a delivery coordinator. They are the business head of their pod. They own the P\&L of their accounts, drive client growth strategy, lead the pod team, and are the last point of escalation before it reaches the CEO. Every commercial decision, every retention risk, every growth opportunity within the pod runs through them.

If something goes wrong in the pod, the Pod Manager owns it. If something goes right, the Pod Manager drove it.

**What This Role Is Not**

Not a senior Account Manager with a fancier title

Not someone who only reviews reports and attends calls

Not someone who escalates client problems to the CEO without first attempting resolution

Not a task manager or execution coordinator

Not someone who waits for strategy to come from above

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Pod P\&L Ownership**

Own the revenue, profitability, and commercial health of all accounts within the pod

Track pod\-level billing, scope utilization, and team bandwidth against revenue

Identify accounts where the agency is over\-servicing and course\-correct scope or pricing

Protect agency margins by managing team allocation and delivery efficiency

Flag accounts at commercial risk to the Founder with a clear plan, not just a problem

Identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities and close them in coordination with the Founder

Own monthly pod revenue targets and report against them with clarity

**2\. Client Growth Strategy**

Go beyond delivery. Actively think about what is next for each client's business

Develop quarterly growth plans for key accounts covering new campaigns, channels, and opportunities

Proactively bring ideas to clients before they ask. Be the strategic voice in every client relationship

Identify gaps in a client's current marketing mix and recommend solutions backed by data

Lead strategic review meetings with clients, not just performance catch\-up calls

Connect client business goals to marketing strategy and keep both aligned as the business evolves

Be the person a client calls when they want a fresh perspective, not just a status update

**3\. Escalation Leadership**

Serve as the final internal escalation point before the CEO for all pod\-level issues

Handle client escalations, conflicts, and difficult conversations directly and with confidence

Resolve delivery failures, team gaps, and quality issues at the pod level without pushing them upward

Make judgment calls on scope disputes, pricing conversations, and client dissatisfaction independently

Know when to involve the Founder and walk in with context, options, and a recommendation

Protect the Founder's bandwidth by resolving 90% of pod issues at the pod level

**4\. Team Leadership and Pod Management**

Lead and manage Account Managers, Social Media Managers, Performance Marketers, and SEO Specialists within the pod

Set clear expectations, review output quality, and hold team members accountable

Run pod reviews, identify underperformance early, and address it directly

Build a culture of ownership, speed, and quality within the pod

Identify training or skill gaps in the team and flag them to the Founder

Ensure Account Managers are handling day\-to\-day client communication so the Pod Manager can focus on strategy and commercial outcomes

**5\. Delivery and Quality Oversight**

Own the quality of everything that leaves the pod, from reports to creatives to campaign performance

Ensure all client deliverables across social media, SEO, and performance marketing are on time and to standard

Review monthly performance reports before they reach the client

Maintain SLA adherence across the pod and flag risks before they impact delivery

Coordinate with centralized teams including design, SEO, website, and automation for seamless execution

**6\. Performance and Campaign Strategy**

Understand performance marketing fundamentals including CPL, ROAS, CTR, lead quality, and funnel structure

Review campaign performance across accounts and push for optimization when results are not meeting targets

Work with Performance Marketers on budget planning, channel strategy, and campaign direction

Ensure SEO, social, and paid strategies are aligned and working toward the same client business outcome

**7\. Commercial Responsibility and Client Retention**

Own client retention across all pod accounts

Conduct regular health checks on every account and know the status of each relationship at all times

Identify at\-risk clients early and create a recovery plan before it becomes a churn situation

Manage contract renewals, scope expansions, and pricing conversations

Track client satisfaction and act on early signals before they escalate

**Key KPIs**

Pod Revenue vs Target

Pod Gross Margin and Profitability

Client Retention Rate

Upsell and Cross\-sell Revenue Generated

Client Satisfaction Score

Escalations Reaching CEO (target: minimal)

On\-Time Delivery Percentage

Team Utilization and Bandwidth Efficiency

Strategic Growth Plans Delivered per Quarter

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

4\-7 years of experience in a digital marketing agency

Proven experience managing multiple client accounts and cross\-functional teams

Strong understanding of agency P\&L, billing, scope management, and margin control

Deep knowledge of performance marketing, social media, SEO, and content marketing

Experience handling client escalations and difficult commercial conversations independently

Strong strategic thinking with the ability to build and present growth plans for clients

Excellent English communication skills, written and verbal

Confident in senior client\-facing discussions and presentations

Experience with project management and reporting tools

Ability to lead, motivate, and hold a team accountable in a fast\-paced environment

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

**Agency experience is mandatory**

Has managed a revenue\-bearing portfolio of clients, not just a team of people

Has had commercial conversations with clients around scope, pricing, and renewals

Thinks in terms of client business growth, not just campaign delivery

Is a problem\-solver who finds solutions before escalating

Can lead a room whether it is a team standup or a senior client strategy session

**Reporting Structure**

**Reports To:** Founder / CEO

Manages: Account Managers, Social Media Managers, Performance Marketers, SEO Specialists

**Coordinates With:** Creative Team, SEO Team, Website Team, Automation Team

**Escalation Authority:** Final internal point before the CEO

**Career Growth**

Senior Pod Manager → Group Account Manager → Delivery Head → Business Head

**Job Type:** Full\-Time, Work From Office, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad

Benefits: Health Insurance \| Provident Fund \| Leave Encashment

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹900,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

title: SEO / GEO Executive
description:
**About** 

Langoor, a 'born in digital era' digital marketing agency, is challenging/changing the very way marketers make sense of the digital disruption and navigate their way to Impact — Business x Marketing x Brand Performance. Going beyond the elementary impact of digital in terms of search, social and storytelling, marketers need to look at their customer journeys in the digital domains and focus their action based on insights of digital behaviour and contextualise their marketing mix strategies and action. Driving Indian Brands into the Digital First Marketing Era with our expertise in Data x Technology x Strategic Thinking x Creative Edge, delivering agile Marketing Transformations \& Brand Performance.

**Details about the role**

We're looking for an SEO/GEO Manager who combines strong technical SEO expertise with a deep understanding of Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), search behaviour, content strategy, and digital performance. You'll be responsible for developing and executing SEO and GEO strategies that improve organic visibility, search rankings, website performance, and brand presence across traditional search engines as well as AI\-powered search and answer engines.

The ideal candidate has worked on real client projects, is comfortable managing multiple stakeholders, can translate data and search insights into actionable strategies, and understands how search is evolving with AI\-driven experiences such as AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and other generative search platforms.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop and execute comprehensive SEO and GEO strategies aligned with client business objectives, marketing goals, and customer journeys.
* Conduct technical SEO audits, identifying issues related to crawling, indexing, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, structured data, internal linking, and overall website health.
* Develop keyword, topic, entity, and search\-intent strategies across different stages of the customer journey.
* Conduct competitor, SERP, content, and market analysis to identify opportunities for improving organic visibility.
* Develop strategies to improve brand visibility and citations across AI\-powered search and generative answer engines.
* Analyse how brands, products, services, and entities are represented across Google Search, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and other emerging search experiences.
* Build and optimise content strategies around topic clusters, semantic relevance, entities, E\-E\-A\-T, and search intent.
* Work closely with content, creative, technology, and development teams to ensure SEO and GEO best practices are incorporated into websites and content.
* Provide recommendations for on\-page SEO, including title tags, meta descriptions, headings, content structure, internal linking, image optimisation, schema markup, and other relevant elements.
* Develop and implement structured data and schema strategies to improve search engine understanding and eligibility for enhanced search experiences.
* Monitor organic performance, rankings, traffic, visibility, conversions, and other relevant SEO KPIs.
* Track GEO/AI visibility metrics, including brand mentions, citations, entity associations, answer inclusion and share of visibility where measurable.
* Use tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and other SEO/AI search monitoring platforms for analysis and optimisation.
* Create regular performance reports and translate complex SEO data into clear business insights and actionable recommendations.
* Identify opportunities for technical, content, authority, and digital PR improvements to strengthen organic performance.
* Stay updated with Google algorithm updates, AI search developments, SERP changes, search behaviour, and emerging GEO best practices.
* Work directly with clients to present SEO/GEO strategies, performance iinsights, recommendations, and roadmaps.
* Collaborate with internal teams to prioritise SEO initiatives based on business impact, effort, opportunity and expected performance.
* Manage multiple SEO/GEO projects simultaneously while ensuring timely delivery and measurable outcomes.

**What You Bring**

* Strong understanding of SEO fundamentals, including technical SEO, on\-page SEO, content optimisation, off\-page SEO, crawling, indexing, site architecture, and search intent.
* Strong understanding of GEO and AI\-driven search, including how generative engines discover, interpret, retrieve, and present information.
* Ability to develop strategies around entities, semantic search, topic authority, structured content, and E\-E\-A\-T.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to convert data into actionable insights.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with the confidence to interact directly with clients.
* Strong understanding of website architecture, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and common technical SEO considerations.
* Ability to work closely with content writers, developers, designers, digital marketers, and other cross\-functional teams.
* Strong understanding of Google Search Console and Google Analytics.
* Hands\-on experience with SEO tools such as Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, or equivalent platforms.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritise tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced agency environment.
* Strong attention to detail and a performance\-oriented mindset.
* Ability to balance search visibility, user experience, brand objectives, and business outcomes.
* Curiosity about emerging technologies and the evolving relationship between search, AI, content, and consumer behaviour.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Digital Marketing, Communications, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 4–7 years of hands\-on experience in SEO, preferably with experience working on multiple client accounts or within a digital agency environment.
* Proven experience developing and executing SEO strategies for websites across different industries.
* Hands\-on experience with technical SEO audits, keyword research, content strategy, competitor analysis, and performance optimisation.
* Experience working with Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Semrush/Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and other SEO platforms.
* Working knowledge of GEO, AI search, LLMs, AI Overviews, and generative search experiences.
* Experience with structured data/schema markup and understanding of how search engines interpret website content.
* Experience working with developers and content teams to implement SEO recommendations.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills with the ability to communicate performance to clients and senior stakeholders.
* Agency experience and experience managing multiple client projects will be an advantage.
* Candidates should demonstrate real commercial/client project experience with measurable SEO outcomes. Academic projects or purely theoretical SEO knowledge without hands\-on experience will not be considered.

* Provident Fund

title: Associate Director, Solutions Marketing
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

**Role Summary**

This Solution Marketing Manager is a key member and leader o n the Solution Marketing team, own ing the develop ment of positioning, messaging and narrative that helps Kyndryl’s sales, marketing and GTM teams succeed . They own the artifacts and arguments that make Kyndryl’s capabilities credible and compelling to our target buyers .


We are hiring for people skilled and passionate about the craft of solution marketing (often called portfolio or product marketing): getting inside a technical domain quickly, synthesizing customer, market, competitive and business insight, finding the customer tension and business value at stake, and building the positioning and evidence that make Kyndryl’s value obvious and differentiated . For this specific role, e xperience in cloud technology and cloud services is an asset.


This is a n individual contributor role with significant leadership opportunity to influence portfolio strategy. It works with limited direction and anticipates where the market and the business are moving and updates positioning ahead of being asked, rather than waiting for a brief. It is accountable for cross\-functional projects and mobilizes people who do not report to it.


**Your Future at Kyndryl**  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Positioning, Value Proposition and Messaging**

* Develop and maintain a point of view on buyers, their needs, market dynamics and competiti on ; synthesize these inputs into implications for positioning, messaging and go\-to\-market priorities.
* Own the development of positioning, messaging and narrative for Cloud propositions so that sales, marketing and customer\-facing GTM teams have credible , evidence\-based assets to work from.
* Build messaging that works across the buying cohort: business outcomes and strategic relevance for executive buyers, and the technical specificity and proof required by architects and practitioners.
* Anticipate shifts in the market and proactively update artifacts before they go stale.
* Ensure the narratives connect to Kyndryl’s wider modernization portfolio message and Kyndryl ’s top level narrative, so it lands as part of a whole rather than a standalone pitch.
* Contribute to naming decisions for propositions and offerings.
**Buyer and Field Enablement**

* Own the content on Kyndryl.com — accurate, current, and consistent with the agreed positioning.
* Build the first\-call and executive customer materials that carry narratives into live conversations.
* Run feedback loops with sales, delivery and solutioning teams, and refine messaging based on what actually happens in real engagements.
* Translate positioning into prioritized buyer stories, use cases and GTM plays, partnering with campaign, content, sales and alliance teams to determine how and where it should show up.
**Stakeholder Partnership**

* Become a critical part of extended team s , partnering closely on shared projects with the business stakeholders . Know what is being built and what is coming.
* Partner with the hyperscaler \& broader alliance teams so messaging holds up in joint go\-to\-market and partner\-facing touchpoints.
* Influence and align stakeholders without formal authority — adapt the argument to the audience and find agreement rather than escalating.
**Success Measures**

* **Message Foundations** : artifacts stay current with the business and the market, and buyer relevance , with updates landing ahead of change rather than after it.
* **Credibility:** recognized by business stakeholders as a trusted marketing partner, measured by demand for the role’s input.
* **Cross\-functional delivery:** named accountability on cross\-functional initiatives, delivered without direct authority over the contributors.
* **Message adoption:** positioning shows up intact in campaigns, field conversations and partner touchpoints.
  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
**Required skills and experience**

* Substantial B2B solution, product or portfolio marketing experience in enterprise technology or services.
* Demonstrated ownership of core messaging artifacts — positioning, messaging frameworks, buyer journeys, proof points , etc. — from research through field adoption.
* Track record building positioning from customer and competitive insight .
* Experience translating technical capability into business outcomes for both executive and practitioner audiences.
* Evidence of leading cross\-functional work in a global, matrixed organization without formal authority.
* Demonstrated ability to learn a new technical domain quickly and become credible in it.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including with senior stakeholders.
* AI fluency, including the ability to use AI\-enabled tools to accelerate research, synthesis, content development and iteration while applying sound judgment to accuracy, differentiation, evidence and brand integrity.
* Strong business acumen, with the ability to connect technology capabilities, customer priorities and market dynamics to differentiated business value.
**Nice to Have**

* Experience in cloud technology and cloud services — hybrid and multicloud operating models, cloud economics, migration and modernization, or sovereign and regulated\-industry cloud requirements.
* Experience working with hyperscaler alliance teams on joint positioning.
* Experience working with industry analysts and contributing to analyst evaluations or briefings.
* Bachelor’s degree.

  

**Preferred skills and experience**

* Experience marketing technology or services to enterprise customers
* Familiarity with analyst engagement and market positioning activities
* Experience supporting go‑to‑market launches or solution introductions
Experience working with global or geographically distributed teams  
* 

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Marketing Operations Lead (India)
description:
**About us**


Almost every single thing that you eat, wear, or use (yes, even the screen you’re reading this on) is imported. Freight quite literally moves the world. And we’re helping it move even better.


Freightos (Nasdaq: CRGO) is the global booking and payment platform for the trillion\-dollar freight industry. Hundreds of airlines and ocean liners, thousands of freight companies, and over ten thousand importers and exporters use our platform to move goods around the world faster and more efficiently. This matters. Efficient freight ultimately makes things cost a little bit less when you buy them in the store.


As the leading global freight booking platform for a massive industry, we’ve been crushing it with double\-digit growth, year after year, supporting well over one million shipments every year.


**About the Role**


We're looking for a highly technical, data\-driven Marketing Operations Lead to own and scale our marketing operations function across the business.


This role sits at the center of Marketing, Sales and RevOps, ensuring our systems, processes and data work seamlessly together to power demand generation, customer lifecycle marketing, reporting and revenue growth.


You'll own our marketing technology ecosystem, optimize our lead management infrastructure, build scalable automations, maintain CRM health, and provide the reporting and insights that enable the marketing team to make better decisions.


This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys solving complex operational challenges, building efficient systems, and turning manual processes into automated workflows.


If you enjoy connecting platforms, cleaning messy data, building intelligent automations and enabling high\-performing marketing teams, we'd love to meet you.

  


Requirements:  

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the marketing operations ecosystem: Manage and continuously optimize our core martech stack, including HubSpot, Zoho CRM, Zapier and other marketing and analytics tools, ensuring systems are scalable, connected and fit for purpose.

* Manage integrations \& data flows: Build and maintain integrations between HubSpot, Zoho, website, product and third\-party platforms using tools such as Zapier, APIs (Domo and others) and webhooks, working closely with Product, Engineering and RevOps where needed.
* Improve processes \& scalability: Identify operational bottlenecks and opportunities for automation, standardization and AI\-enabled efficiencies, continuously improving how Marketing operates and scales.
* Partner cross\-functionally: Work closely with Marketing, Sales, RevOps, Product and Engineering to ensure strong alignment across systems, processes, data and the overall customer journey.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of marketing operations experience, preferably B2B (SaaS preferred).
* Extensive experience working with HubSpot:
* Marketing Hub
* Operations Hub
* Workflows
* Custom objects
* Reporting
* Integrations
* Automation.
* Strong experience managing CRM platforms (Zoho CRM experience is highly preferred).
* Extensive experience building integrations using Zapier or similar automation platforms.
* Experience with lifecycle marketing, lead management and CRM architecture.
* Ability to think about customer journeys beyond open rates and click through rates.
* Strong understanding of marketing attribution and funnel analytics.
* Advanced reporting and dashboard creation experience.
* Detail\-oriented with strong technical and analytical skills and knowledge of BI tools.
* Strong ability to juggle multiple projects, stay organized, and prioritize quickly.
* Team player with excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: SEO - Backlinking Intern - Thane West
description:

* Use AI to assist with outreach emails, content briefs, article ideas, and link\-building campaigns.

* Develop efficient AI\-assisted workflows for repetitive SEO tasks.

SEO Research \& Reporting

* Analyze SERPs and identify websites ranking for target keywords.
* Research websites that could potentially link to our clients.

* Comfortable working with spreadsheets such as **Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel**.

* Good written English.
* Ability to identify whether a website is genuinely relevant and valuable for a backlink.
* Comfortable using AI tools to complete research and marketing tasks.
* Willingness to learn new SEO and AI tools quickly.

**AI Skills – Important**

You should be comfortable with:

* ChatGPT and other AI/LLM platforms.
* Writing effective prompts.
* Breaking a large task into smaller AI\-assisted workflows.
* Providing structured instructions and data to AI models.
* Reviewing and correcting AI\-generated output.
* Using AI for research, analysis, categorization, content development, and repetitive tasks.
* Finding ways to improve productivity using AI.

**Candidates who demonstrate strong practical AI usage will be preferred.**

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who is:

* Detail\-oriented and organized.
* Comfortable spending significant time researching websites and online data.
* Good at following instructions and processes.
* Able to work independently once a task is assigned.
* Comfortable working with repetitive research tasks while maintaining accuracy.
* A problem solver who looks for better and faster ways to complete tasks.

**Educational Background**

Candidates pursuing or having completed a degree/diploma in:

* Marketing
* Mass Communication
* Business
* Computer/IT\-related fields
* Or any other relevant discipline

may apply.

**Freshers are welcome to apply.**

Prior SEO or digital marketing experience is an advantage but is not mandatory if the candidate has strong research skills and demonstrates good practical use of AI tools.

**Internship Structure**

**Duration:** 3 months  
**Work Location:** Thane West

During the internship, the candidate will work on **real\-world SEO and backlinking projects** rather than only theoretical assignments.

Performance will be evaluated throughout the internship.

Permanent Employment Opportunity

Job Description – SEO, AEO, GEO \& Social Media Executive

About the Role

We are looking for a **result\-oriented SEO, AEO, GEO \& Social Media Executive** to strengthen Derma Arts’ online presence across search engines, AI platforms, local search, and social media.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on knowledge of **SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Local SEO, content optimization, and social media management**. Experience in healthcare, dermatology, cosmetology, aesthetics, wellness, or clinic marketing will be preferred.

The role will focus on improving **organic visibility, search rankings, AI visibility, Google Business Profile performance, website traffic, engagement, and ultimately organic leads and appointment enquiries.**

Key ResponsibilitiesSEO – Search Engine Optimization

* Develop and execute **on\-page, off\-page, technical, and local SEO strategies** to improve organic rankings.
* Conduct keyword research for dermatology, skin, hair, aesthetic, weight\-loss, cosmetic, and wellness treatments.
* Optimize website pages, landing pages, blogs, meta titles, descriptions, headings, URLs, schema, and internal linking.
* Identify new keyword opportunities based on **search intent, commercial intent, location, and treatment\-specific queries**.
* Improve rankings for location\-based keywords such as **Dermatologist in Delhi, Skin Clinic in GK, Hair Treatment in Delhi**, etc.
* Conduct competitor analysis and identify content, keyword, backlink, and SERP opportunities.
* Build high\-quality backlinks through ethical and relevant off\-page SEO strategies.
* Identify and resolve technical SEO issues including broken links, indexing, redirects, page speed, sitemap, crawlability, and other website issues.
* Monitor and improve **Core Web Vitals and overall website SEO health**.

AEO – Answer Engine Optimization

* Optimize website content to increase the chances of Derma Arts being surfaced in **Google featured snippets, People Also Ask, AI\-generated answers, and conversational search results**.
* Identify common questions users ask around dermatology, skin, hair, aesthetics, and cosmetic treatments.
* Create and optimize **FAQ sections, question\-based content, concise answers, comparison content, and informational pages**.
* Structure content around search intent and natural\-language queries.
* Work with content writers to create **expert\-led, accurate, and answer\-focused content** that can perform across traditional and answer\-based search.

GEO – Generative Engine Optimization

* Develop strategies to improve Derma Arts’ visibility across **AI and generative search platforms**.
* Identify topics and queries where AI platforms may recommend dermatologists, clinics, treatments, or brands.
* Optimize website content and brand information for **AI discoverability, entity relevance, topical authority, and citation potential**.
* Strengthen the clinic’s digital presence across relevant authoritative platforms and directories.
* Track emerging trends in **AI search and generative search optimization** and adapt strategies accordingly.

Local SEO \& Google Business Profile

* Manage and optimize the clinic’s **Google Business Profile** for maximum local visibility.
* Improve rankings for **“near me” and location\-based searches**.
* Manage local citations and relevant business listings.
* Identify opportunities to improve local search presence across Delhi/NCR.
* Monitor Google Business Profile performance, reviews, searches, calls, website visits, and other relevant actions.
* Coordinate with the team to encourage and manage authentic customer reviews.

Social Media Posting \& Content Coordination

* Manage the **day\-to\-day posting and publishing** of content across Instagram, Facebook, and other relevant social platforms.
* Create and maintain a **monthly social media posting calendar** in coordination with the content and creative teams.
* Publish reels, carousels, static posts, stories, educational content, treatment\-related content, offers, and clinic updates as required.
* Ensure captions, hashtags, keywords, and social content are optimized for **social search and discoverability**.
* Repurpose SEO/AEO content and high\-performing website topics into social media content.
* Coordinate with designers, video editors, doctors, and content writers to ensure timely content delivery.
* Monitor basic social media performance and identify content topics that can improve **reach, engagement, profile visits, and enquiries**.
* Stay updated with changing Instagram and social search trends.

Analytics, Tracking \& Reporting

* Monitor website and SEO performance using **Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Google Business Profile, and SEO tools**.
* Track keyword rankings, organic traffic, impressions, clicks, conversions, leads, and appointment enquiries.
* Monitor AI/AEO/GEO visibility and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Track backlink growth and quality.
* Monitor social media reach, engagement, profile visits, and content performance.
* Prepare **weekly/monthly SEO \& digital visibility reports** with clear insights, results, and recommendations.
* Use data to identify what is working, what is not, and where further optimization is required.

Requirements

* **2–4 years of hands\-on experience** in SEO.
* Strong knowledge of **On\-Page, Off\-Page, Technical, Local SEO, AEO, and emerging GEO practices**.
* Experience with Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Google Business Profile, and SEO tools such as **Ahrefs, SEMrush, Ubersuggest, or similar**.
* Good understanding of keyword research, search intent, SERPs, competitor analysis, and content optimization.
* Basic knowledge of HTML, website structure, schema, and technical SEO.
* Understanding of **AI search and how users discover businesses through generative search platforms** will be an advantage.
* Basic understanding of social media platforms, especially **Instagram and Facebook**.
* Ability to independently manage social media posting schedules and coordinate content.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work with content writers, designers, developers, and marketing teams.
* Candidates with experience in **healthcare, dermatology, aesthetics, cosmetology, hospitals, wellness, or similar industries** will be preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)SEO

* Improvement in targeted keyword rankings.
* Growth in organic website traffic and search visibility.
* Growth in impressions, clicks, and CTR.
* Improvement in website engagement and organic conversions.

AEO \& GEO

* Growth in visibility across answer\-based and AI\-generated search results.
* Increase in featured snippets, People Also Ask, and relevant answer\-result visibility.
* Improvement in brand/entity visibility across generative search platforms.
* Growth in relevant third\-party mentions and authoritative digital references.

Local SEO

* Improvement in Google Business Profile visibility.
* Growth in local keyword rankings.
* Increase in Google Business Profile actions, calls, website visits, and direction requests.
* Improvement in quality and volume of authentic reviews.

Leads \& Revenue Contribution

* Growth in **organic leads and appointment enquiries**.
* Improvement in organic lead quality.
* Increase in organic website conversions.
* Contribution of SEO/AEO/GEO and social media to overall enquiry generation.

Social Media

* Consistency and timely execution of the content calendar.
* Growth in reach, engagement, profile visits, and relevant audience.
* Improvement in content performance and discoverability.
* Growth in enquiries generated through social media.

Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is **hands\-on, analytical, proactive, and focused on measurable growth** — not someone who only produces reports or delegates SEO activities.

The candidate should be comfortable working across **SEO \+ AEO \+ GEO \+ Local SEO \+ Social Search**, understand how search behaviour is changing, and be able to translate content and visibility strategies into **traffic, enquiries, and business growth**.

**About Taho Living :\-** 




 Taho Living is a design\-led luxury furniture and home décor brand creating distinctive pieces
 



 rooted in materiality, craftsmanship and contemporary living.
 



 As Taho Living enters its next phase of growth, we are looking to strengthen our in\-house digital
 



 function with someone who can take hands\-on ownership of the brand's performance marketing,
 



 SEO and day\-to\-day website management.
 



  





**About the Role :** 




 We are looking for a Digital Performance \& SEO Executive who understands that marketing a luxury
 



 brand requires a different approach from mass\-market digital advertising.
 



 The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience with Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO, analytics
 



 and website backend management, along with prior exposure to luxury brands or high\-value
 



 products and clientele.
 



 A key part of the role will be understanding how to identify, reach and convert the right audience
 



 for Taho Living \- including affluent and HNI/UHNI consumers, architects, interior designers and
 



 luxury homeowners \- rather than simply maximising traffic or generating low\-quality leads.
 



 This is a full\-time, in\-office and execution\-focused role dedicated to Taho Living.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities :** 




 • Performance Marketing: Plan, execute and continuously optimise paid campaigns across Meta and
 



 Google. Manage targeting, retargeting, budgets, campaign structures and testing with a clear focus
 



 on generating qualified enquiries and converting digital spend into orders.
 



 • SEO \& Organic Growth: Manage Taho Living's on\-page, off\-page and technical SEO; conduct
 



 keyword and competitor research; optimise website pages and product content; monitor rankings
 



 and identify opportunities to improve relevant organic visibility.
 



 • Luxury Audience Targeting: Understand how to market high\-value products to affluent and
 



 HNI/UHNI audiences. Develop and refine digital audiences around luxury consumers, architects,
 



 interior designers, homeowners and other relevant customer segments while maintaining Taho
 



 Living's luxury positioning.
 



 • Website Management \& Conversion: Manage the day\-to\-day backend of the Taho Living website,
 



 including product uploads, collections, content updates, banners, SEO metadata and landing pages.
 



 Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and conversion rate, while coordinating any
 



 technical development requirements with the external web developer.
 



 • Analytics \& Optimisation: Track the complete digital journey from traffic and enquiry generation
 



 through to conversion. Monitor campaign and website performance, identify what is and isn't
 



 working, conduct A/B tests where relevant, and make data\-backed recommendations to improve
 



 results.
 



 • Creative Coordination: Work closely with the brand and creative teams to identify what
 



 advertisements, formats, products and messaging are performing best and provide clear
 



 requirements for new campaign creatives and content.
 



 • Reporting: Maintain clear weekly and monthly reporting across advertising spend, leads,
 



 conversions, orders, revenue, ROAS, website performance, SEO performance and key learnings.
 



  





**Who We're Looking For :** 




 • 2\-4 years of hands\-on experience across performance marketing and digital marketing.
 



 • Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
 



 • Practical experience with SEO, keyword research, on\-page optimisation and technical SEO
 



 fundamentals.
 



 • Experience using Google Analytics and Google Search Console, along with tools such as Ahrefs or
 



 SEMrush.
 



 • Experience managing the backend of an e\-commerce or product\-led website.
 



 • Prior experience working with a luxury brand, luxury products or high\-value clientele would be
 



 strongly preferred.
 



 • An understanding of how marketing and targeting strategies differ when communicating with
 



 affluent and HNI/UHNI audiences.
 



 • Strong analytical ability and comfort working with campaign and conversion data.
 



 • Ability to independently execute campaigns rather than relying entirely on agencies.
 



 • Good communication skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with creative, brand and
 



 website\-development partners.
 



  





**Education :** 




 Graduate in Marketing, Business, Communications, IT or a related field.
 



 Relevant hands\-on experience and demonstrated digital performance will carry greater weight than
 



 academic qualifications.
 



  





**Primary Objective :** 




 The primary objective of this role is simple: Convert Taho Living's digital marketing efforts into
 



 actual business.
 



 Traffic, impressions, reach, clicks and rankings are important indicators \- but they are not the end
 



 goal.
 



 The ultimate measure of performance will be the individual's ability to use performance marketing,
 



 SEO and the Taho Living website to consistently contribute towards qualified enquiries, conversions
 



 and orders.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like :** 




 We are looking for someone who is hands\-on, analytical, commercially minded and
 



 performance\-oriented \- someone who can look beyond vanity metrics and understand whether
 



 Taho Living's digital activity is actually contributing to sales.
 



 The person should be equally comfortable inside Meta Ads Manager, analysing website and SEO
 



 performance, updating the website backend and working with the creative team to improve what customers ultimately see and respond to.
