title: Marketing Manager
description:
Job Purpose

The primary responsibility of this role is to **develop and maintain strong professional relationships with doctors, hospitals, clinics, and healthcare professionals to generate patient referrals for Carebees Healthcare**.

The candidate will be responsible for increasing Carebees' visibility among the medical community, generating qualified patient leads, converting referrals into Carebees services, and contributing directly to **patient acquisition, revenue growth, and business expansion**.

The role requires regular field visits, relationship management, lead generation, follow\-ups, and achievement of monthly sales targets.

2\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Doctor Referral \& Relationship Management

* Identify and develop relationships with:
* Orthopaedic surgeons
* Neurologists
* Neurosurgeons
* Physiotherapists
* General physicians
* Geriatricians
* PM\&R/Rehabilitation specialists
* Other relevant medical professionals
* Regularly visit doctors and clinics to introduce Carebees Healthcare services.
* Explain Carebees' home healthcare and physiotherapy services to doctors and their staff.
* Build long\-term professional relationships with doctors and referral partners.
* Maintain regular follow\-up with existing referring doctors.
* Ensure doctors are aware of Carebees' services, service areas, pricing, and patient\-care process.
* Identify opportunities for hospital and clinic referral partnerships.

B. Lead Generation

* Generate qualified patient leads through doctor and healthcare\-professional referrals.
* Collect complete patient information and referral details.
* Ensure every referral is immediately communicated to the Carebees operations/customer\-care team.
* Follow up on every lead until:
* **Referral → Contact → Assessment → Service Start → Conversion**
* Maintain accurate records of all leads and their status.
* Reactivate inactive or old referral sources.C. Sales \& Revenue Generation
* Achieve monthly and quarterly patient acquisition targets.
* Convert doctor referrals into paid Carebees services.
* Increase the number of active referring doctors every month.
* Focus on high\-value cases such as:
* Post\-operative physiotherapy
* TKR rehabilitation
* ACL rehabilitation
* Neurological rehabilitation
* Spine rehabilitation
* Geriatric physiotherapy
* Home physiotherapy
* Home nursing
* Long\-term rehabilitation
* Track revenue generated from each referral source.
* Identify high\-potential doctors and develop them into consistent referral partners.

D. Carebees Brand Visibility

* Increase Carebees' visibility within the local healthcare ecosystem.
* Introduce Carebees to new hospitals, clinics, doctors, nursing homes, senior\-living facilities and rehabilitation centres.
* Distribute Carebees brochures, visiting cards, service information and other approved marketing materials.
* Coordinate doctor awareness activities, professional meetings and healthcare camps when required.
* Communicate Carebees' key differentiators and service quality professionally.

E. Hospital \& Institutional Business Development

* Identify hospitals and clinics where Carebees can develop referral partnerships.
* Meet hospital administrators, consultants, discharge coordinators and relevant healthcare staff.
* Explore opportunities for:
* Post\-discharge home physiotherapy
* Home rehabilitation
* Elderly care
* Home nursing
* Follow\-up rehabilitation
* Corporate wellness/healthcare programs
* Support the management in developing new institutional partnerships.

F. Lead Follow\-up \& Coordination

* Coordinate closely with the Carebees customer\-care and operations teams.
* Ensure quick response to all doctor\-generated leads.
* Follow up with patients when required to support conversion.
* Monitor whether the referred patient has received the required service.
* Collect feedback from referral partners regarding patient experience.
* Escalate complaints or service issues immediately to management.

G. Reporting \& CRM

The employee must maintain daily and weekly sales activity records.

Daily reporting should include:

* Doctors visited
* New doctors contacted
* Existing doctors followed up
* Hospitals/clinics visited
* Leads generated
* Leads converted
* Pending leads
* Lost leads
* Revenue generated
* Follow\-up activities
* Next\-day action plan

All leads and referral activities must be updated in the **Carebees CRM/lead management system** or approved reporting format.

3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

This is a high\-impact role that requires:

You will work cross\-functionally, collaborating with teams across Product, Business, Finance, Analytics, Tech, Legal, Procurement and Marketing to drive impact.

Description


Role: Marketing Manager


This role is in the Marketing team at PhonePe, reporting into AD, Marketing, Payments.

Responsibilities

Coordinating with channel owners across traditional media, social media, digital performance, and internal app touchpoints—owning communication for categories in\-app and off \-app to define clear problem statements \& follow up on solutions \& impact.

Identifying, evaluating \& onboarding the right creative, content \& media partners to solve for problem statements. Planning campaign networks \& campaign designs across off\-app media as well as in\-app category surfaces, and working with agencies/partners to timely deliver the output.

Ability to plan \& drive experiments that lead to incremental impact for the categories.

Critical Requirement

description:
### **Job Description**


### **A. Trade Marketing \& Retail Excellence**


* Own the annual Trade Marketing strategy and calendar, aligned to business priorities, brand strategy, product launches, scheme calendars and regional market opportunities.
* Develop the retail visibility strategy across Retail, Experience Centres and other relevant channels, including POSM, in\-shop branding, display systems, outdoor branding and retail experience assets.
* Define differentiated retail interventions by outlet/customer segment and ensure the POSM mix reflects priority categories, new launches and premiumization objectives.
* Drive deployment and compliance of retail assets through the sales network; identify gaps through market visits, audits and data and close them with clear action plans.
* Develop scalable retail toolkits and standards that improve counter share, shelf/display presence, shopper navigation and brand consistency.
* Partner with Sales to identify high\-potential outlets and markets where focused trade interventions can unlock incremental throughput, visibility or premium mix.

### **B. Experience Centres \& Strategic Partner Activation**


* Build and manage an engagement calendar for Legrand’s Experience Centres (Studios/ ZIPs)
* Improve the overall customer and shopper experience through displays, demonstrations, experiences, launch programs and partner\-specific activations.
* Develop programs that support incremental sales, lead generation, conversion and premiumization
* Create post\-activation measurement frameworks linking activity to sales uplift, leads/funnel movement, conversion and partner performance.

### **C. Experiential Marketing, BTL \& Influencer Engagement**


* Own the BTL and experiential activation calendar across electricians, retailers, architects, dealers and other relevant influencers/decision\-makers.
* Develop concepts and execution frameworks for retailer meets, electrician engagement, product demonstrations, roadshows, consumer experiences, launches and other field activations.
* Lead end\-to\-end planning of experiential programs: objective, audience, concept, agency brief, production, logistics, on\-ground execution, measurement and post\-event learning.
* Ensure every experience is consistent with Legrand's premium brand standards while remaining relevant to the audience and commercial objective.
* Build repeatable activation properties and playbooks rather than relying only on one\-off events.

### **D. Events, Exhibitions \& Brand Experiences**


* Lead Legrand’s participation in major exhibitions, industry events, customer events
* Own event objectives and success metrics \- visibility, engagement, qualified leads, customer/partner participation, sales opportunity and brand impact \- rather than measuring events only on attendance.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders, agencies and vendors to ensure delivery within agreed timelines, budgets and quality standards.
* Develop post\-event reports with learnings, ROI/impact assessment and recommendations for future editions.

### **E. Agency, Vendor \& Budget Management**


* Build and manage a capable ecosystem of regional and national vendors/fabricators/activation agencies to improve speed, quality and scalability of execution.
* Drive vendor onboarding, rate benchmarking, negotiation, quality control, timelines, service levels and reconciliation.
* Continuously identify cost optimization opportunities without compromising brand experience or execution quality.
* Own allocated Trade/BTL/Experiential budgets, ensuring disciplined planning, approvals, utilization and ROI tracking.

### **F. Data, Measurement \& Trade Marketing Dashboard**


* Establish a Trade Marketing dashboard covering deployment, outlet activation, visibility compliance, activation impact, Modern Trade scorecards, competition intelligence and spend.
* Define simple, decision\-oriented KPIs that connect marketing activity with business outcomes such as throughput, incremental sales, counter/shelf share, leads, conversion and premium mix.
* Use DMS/sales data, retail audits, market intelligence and field feedback to identify opportunities and recommend corrective actions.
* Institutionalize pre\- and post\-activity measurement and build a culture of test–learn–scale.

### **G. Cross\-functional Leadership**


* Work closely with Sales, Brand, Product, Commercial, Procurement, Finance, Supply Chain and regional teams to convert business priorities into market execution.
* Act as the bridge between Brand strategy and last\-mile execution, ensuring that what is planned centrally is practical, scalable and measurable in\-market.


Influence without authority and build strong relationships with sales leaders, channel partners, agencies and Vendors.


### **Responsibilities**


* Should have independently managed multi\-city activations, retail visibility programs, exhibitions/events and external agencies/vendors.
* Strong commercial orientation with the ability to connect marketing interventions to sales, throughput, conversion and ROI.
* Comfort with data and dashboards; strong Excel and PowerPoint skills. Exposure to Power BI or similar reporting tools is an advantage.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders, vendors, timelines and budgets simultaneously.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and stakeholder\-management skills.
* High ownership, attention to detail and willingness to travel extensively across India.

### **Qualifications**


* 4\-5 years of relevant experience in Trade Marketing, Shopper Marketing, BTL, Experiential Marketing, Retail Marketing or Channel Marketing.
* Experience in Building Materials \& allied categories is preferred. Also open to Telecomm, Baggage, etc.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
We are looking for a **Performance Marketing Manager** with hands\-on experience in **fashion, clothing, apparel, D2C, or e\-commerce brands**. The ideal candidate should be capable of independently **researching, planning, executing, analysing, and optimizing paid marketing campaigns** with a strong focus on **ROAS, revenue, customer acquisition, and profitability**.

This is a **results\-driven role** where success will be measured by business growth and campaign performance—not simply by ad execution.

Key Responsibilities1\. Performance Marketing \& Paid Ads

* Plan, execute, and manage **Meta Ads (Facebook \& Instagram) and Google Ads**.
* Develop campaigns focused on **sales, conversions, revenue, and ROAS**.
* Monitor and optimize **ROAS, CAC, CPA, CTR, conversion rate, and revenue**.
* Manage and allocate advertising budgets efficiently.
* Identify winning campaigns, audiences, products, and creatives and scale them profitably.
* Continuously test new campaign structures, targeting strategies, offers, and ad formats.

2\. Fashion \& Competitor Research

* Research **fashion and apparel customer behaviour, buying patterns, and market trends**.
* Analyse competitors, including their:
* Advertising strategy
* Creatives and content
* Offers and discounts
* Product positioning
* Pricing
* Landing/product pages
* Identify opportunities for new audiences, products, offers, and campaigns.
* Develop strategies specifically for **D2C fashion and apparel brands**.

3\. Full\-Funnel Marketing Strategy

* Build and manage a complete customer journey:
* **Awareness → Traffic → Add to Cart → Checkout → Purchase → Retargeting**
* Develop retargeting campaigns for website visitors, product viewers, ATC users, and previous customers.
* Build and optimize **Lookalike and high\-intent audiences**.
* Create strategies to improve repeat purchases and customer lifetime value.
* Identify and reduce funnel drop\-offs.4\. Creative Strategy \& Testing
* Work closely with the **creative, graphics, and video teams** to develop high\-performing ad creatives.
* Provide clear creative briefs based on campaign data and customer insights.
* Test:
* Reels / Video Ads
* Static Ads
* Carousel Ads
* Hooks
* Ad Copy
* Offers
* Product angles
* UGC\-style content
* Analyse creative performance and identify winning concepts.
* Continuously develop new creative testing strategies to avoid ad fatigue.

5\. Shopify \& Conversion Optimization

* Analyse Shopify store performance and customer journey.
* Identify issues affecting conversion rate.
* Recommend improvements to:
* Product pages
* Product descriptions
* Pricing/offers
* Landing pages
* Cart
* Checkout experience
* Work with the web/development team to implement CRO improvements.

6\. Tracking \& Analytics

* Set up, monitor, and troubleshoot:
* Meta Pixel
* Meta Conversions API (CAPI)
* Google Analytics 4 (GA4\)
* Google Ads Conversion Tracking
* Shopify Analytics
* Ensure accurate tracking of purchases, revenue, ATC, checkout, and other key events.
* Monitor campaign attribution and identify tracking discrepancies.

7\. Reporting \& Performance Analysis

* Prepare **weekly and monthly performance reports**.
* Track and analyse:
* ROAS
* Net ROAS
* Revenue
* Ad Spend
* CAC
* CPA
* CTR
* CPC
* CPM
* ATC
* Checkout
* Conversion Rate
* Provide clear insights, reasons for performance changes, and **actionable recommendations**.
* Present campaign performance to management/founder.

Required Skills \& Experience

* **2–4 years of hands\-on Performance Marketing experience** preferred.
* Strong experience with **Meta Ads and Google Ads**.
* Prior experience with **fashion, clothing, apparel, D2C, or e\-commerce brands is highly preferred**.
* Strong understanding of **ROAS, CAC, conversion funnels, retargeting, and scaling**.
* Experience working with **Shopify** is preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to independently manage campaigns and budgets.
* Good understanding of creative testing and performance\-driven content.
* Must be **data\-driven and revenue\-focused**.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who can answer:

**“What did we spend, what did we generate, what worked, what didn't work, and what should we do next?”**

The candidate should be comfortable taking **ownership of campaign performance and revenue growth**, rather than simply launching advertisements.

Perks \& Benefits

* Work directly with the **founder and leadership team**.
* Opportunity to work on **premium fashion and D2C brands**.
* End\-to\-end ownership of performance marketing.
* Direct impact on business revenue and growth.
* Opportunity to work closely with **creative, graphics, video, web, and e\-commerce teams**.
* Opportunity to build and scale high\-performing products and collections.
* Growth\-oriented work environment with significant responsibility and learning opportunities.

Job Details

**Employment Type:** Full Time, Permanent

**Education:** Any Graduate

title: Director of Member Engagement Marketing
description:
### **A****BOUT TIDE**



At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.



Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.



Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.


**Tide facts:**


* Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members: 900,000 UK and 1,100,000 in India and growing rapidly
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* Over 2,800 Tideans globally
* Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India's Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
### **ABOUT THE ROLE**



As the Director – Member Engagement Marketing (India), you will lead the strategy and execution of lifecycle, CRM, and engagement marketing initiatives that directly drive revenue and product adoption for Tide's India Business. You will work at the intersection of product, data, growth, and customer success to ensure every member interaction is personalised, impactful, and revenue\-generating — while building and leading a high\-performing, on\-the\-ground India team. You'll bring a test\-and\-learn, data\-driven approach to member marketing, partnering closely with the SVP of Member Engagement Marketing, Product, and Data \& Analytics teams to build deep relationships with existing members that increase usage, cross\-sell, and grow lifetime value.


**Core responsibilities will include:**


**Strategic Ownership**


* Own the member engagement marketing strategy across the entire lifecycle — from onboarding and activation to retention and reactivation.
* Own the retention marketing strategy to grow revenue from the existing member base.
* Build cross\-sell and upsell campaigns that deepen product usage and maximise member lifetime value.
* Identify high\-potential member segments and create tailored journeys that boost engagement and reduce churn.
* Lead CRM marketing programmes across email, push, in\-app, SMS, and WhatsApp focused on driving behavioural outcomes and monetisation.
* Lead nurture journeys that drive reactivation, repeat usage, and deeper financial engagement.


**Analytics \& Data\-Led Decision\-Making**


* Partner closely with Data \& Analytics to deeply understand the India member base and define KPIs tied to conversion, churn reduction, and engagement.
* Bring a test\-and\-learn approach: run A/B and MVT testing across CRM channels to continually improve targeting, content, and offers.
* Build a segmentation and targeting strategy based on lifecycle stage, member value, product uptake, and behavioural signals.
* Own dashboarding and reporting of all member marketing metrics and attribution, sharing results broadly with stakeholders.
* Apply AI/ML tools to accelerate marketing execution — e.g. testing more variants, sharpening targeting, and speeding up insight\-to\-action — with a track record of measurable gains in team speed or campaign performance.


**Platform \& Tooling Leadership**


* Hands\-on experience setting up a team on a CRM platform. Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience is ideal; depth of hands on experience with CRM tooling, including ability to support key platform changes and team training.
* Ensure the India CRM tech stack is set up to support scalable, personalised, multi\-channel campaigns post\-migration.


**Team Building \& Leadership**


* Build and lead a high\-performing team of CRM/lifecycle marketers, campaign managers, and content strategists in India — this is a team you will be building out, so hiring, structuring, and developing the right talent will be critical to success in this role.
* Motivate, coach, and grow your team while embedding a test\-and\-learn, data\-driven culture.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Product, Growth, Sales, Risk, and Customer Success teams, building strong networks across the business to deliver as 'one team'.
* Contribute to quarterly planning around revenue growth via member marketing.


**India Market Leadership**


* Represent Member Engagement Marketing within the India Business leadership team, acting as the senior on\-the\-ground owner for engagement marketing strategy and execution.
* Adapt global MEM strategy and playbooks to the India context — including regional language personalisation, and WhatsApp/SMS as primary engagement channels alongside email and push.
* Ensure marketing communications comply with India's regulatory requirements (e.g. TRAI/DLT registration and consent management for SMS and outbound calls).
* Identify cross\-sell opportunities specific to India SME members (e.g. GST\-linked invoicing triggers, credit and collections products) and build journeys that reflect local product adoption patterns.
* Partner effectively with UK\-based Marketing, Product, and P\&E stakeholders across time zones, while owning delivery for the India market.

### **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**


* 12\+ years of experience in B2C or B2B2C marketing, preferably in fintech, lending, banking, or consumer tech, with meaningful experience in the Indian market.
* Proven expertise in lifecycle, retention, and CRM marketing with demonstrable commercial impact (e.g. improved conversion, reduced churn, incremental revenue).
* Track record of building and leading high\-performing marketing/CRM teams — ideally having built a team from the ground up or through a significant scale\-up phase.
* Direct experience leading or contributing to a marketing platform/CDP migration, including local rollout and change management; hands\-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud specifically will be a strong advantage given the migration this role will lead (comparable platforms: MoEngage, Adobe Campaign, or similar).
* Hands\-on campaign experience across the full engagement channel mix this role covers — email, push, in\-app messaging, SMS, and WhatsApp — rather than one or two channels in isolation.
* Deep understanding of cross\-sell/upsell mechanics, revenue contribution tracking, and member behaviour insights.
* Strong working knowledge of marketing automation tools and customer data platforms (CDPs); highly analytical, comfortable using data to make decisions and build ROI\-driven programmes.
* Experience with A/B/MVT testing and optimising offers/incentives to drive the best commercial return.
* Awareness of India\-specific regulatory considerations for marketing communications (TRAI/DLT, consent management).
* Exceptional leadership and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to operate confidently across India and UK stakeholders and time zones.
* A strong, clear communicator able to explain complex information simply and build trust across functions.

### **WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN**



Our location\-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:


* Competitive Compensation – Competitive salary and share options.
* Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
* Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
* Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
* Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top\-up options.
* Life \& Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
* Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
* Volunteering \& Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
* Learning \& Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
* Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
* Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it's time for a replacement.
* Snacks \& Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).

### **TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE**



At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently\-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members' diverse needs and lives.



We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone's voice is heard.

  


*At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone's voice is heard.*

  


**Disclaimer**

*It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:*
* *Tide does* ***not*** *charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.*
* *All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our* ***Careers Page*** *and applications should be submitted through this channel.*
* *Communication from Tide will only come from an official* ***@tide******.co*** *email address.*
* *Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.*


*If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at* *talent@tide.co*  

*Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.*

  


*Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our* *AI Policy**.*


*Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with* *Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

consumer goods sales channels.

commerce (Quick Commerce), and HoReCa / B2B bulk buyers.

tools.

 Plan and execute Trade Marketing initiatives, including point\-of\-sale displays (POSM), end\-cap branding, sampling

activations, and seasonal consumer schemes.

 Manage Consumer Promotion (CP) and Trade Promotion (TP) budgets, ensuring optimal ROI on trade schemes and

listing fees.

 Analyze competitor pricing, consumer trends, packaging innovations, and shelf share to maintain competitive edge.

4\. Demand Forecasting \& Supply Chain Alignment

 Collaborate with Supply Chain and Production teams to align monthly demand forecasting with factory supply

schedules.

 Track sales pipeline metrics, distributor stock levels, and regional market demand patterns to prevent stock\-outs.

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Food Technology, or related discipline (MBA in

Marketing/Sales strongly preferred).

* Experience: 4–8 years of proven experience in Sales, Business Development, and Trade Marketing within the FMCG

industry (Food, Beverages, Consumer Packaged Goods).

* Channel Expertise: Deep experience in managing Distributor Networks, General Trade (GT), Modern Trade (MT),

Quick Commerce, and B2B Institutional channels.

* Technical Competencies: Proficiency in Sales Force Automation (SFA) software, DMS (Distributor Management

Systems), CRM tools, and MS Excel data analytics.

* Key Skills: High commercial negotiation capability, team leadership, trade spend management, and strong field

title: Marketing Manager India
description:
**About Aerogen:** 




 Headquartered in the vibrant city of Galway, Ireland, with offices around the world, Aerogen is proud to be the world leader in acute care aerosol drug delivery. Recognised through multiple MedTech awards and twelve\-time winner of the Zenith award for Respiratory Care Excellence in North America, collectively our employees make a difference to patients’ lives every day, having already reached 20 million patients in over 80 countries.
 



  





 Our talented and skilled team collaborate to innovate, challenge and test not only in relation to our products but every facet of how we work. We lead the way, finding innovative solutions to even the most complex problems, all in the name of delivering better patient care.
 



  





 Our business is growing rapidly across the globe and as we grow, our core culture of “We Care” universally connects us. We believe that your ambition and integrity fuels ours and we are committed to supporting our employees to reach their full potential through tangible investment in their careers.
 



  





**What is the role?** 




 The Marketing Manager will be responsible for developing and driving Aerogen brand awareness strategy and generating leads that lead to broad adoption and utilization of Aerogen technology within region. This individual will report to the Commercial Director/Senior Marketing Manager. They will work in strong partnership with sales leadership, global marketing, Clinical Education Manager, medical affairs, global cross\-functional partners and third party vendors.
 



  





**What are the key responsibilities?** 



* Marketing Strategy: You will create, partnering with the regional leadership, an annual marketing plan that drives Aerogen towards standard of care with sustained double digit revenue growth, while maintaining margins and delivering increased market share.
* Corporate and Government strategy: Working with the RBMs and KAM in market to develop out specific messaging for both corporate and government sectors. Understanding key KPIs for each corporate group , developing out metrics and correct data to support key claims for top level discussions to drive mass adoption within the hospital chains.
* Customer Communications: Develop an ongoing customer communication program to encourage better utilisation of Aerogen. Plan will factor in different media outlets, including social media, advertising, email, etc. based on tools and cadence defined in our market awareness strategy. Manage downstream campaign roll out across region and track return on investment (ROI).
* Product / Solutions launch: You will partner with Commercial Leadership to develop execute best\-in\-class launches to drive maximum market penetration.
* Conference and Events Calendar: Develop and implement an events calendar with key audience / attendee information,key messaging and build out an ROI calculator. Social media plan to support the annual calendar.
* Distributor meeting and strategy: Work with commercial team to onboard distributors in accordance with Aerogen best practice. Educate on the use of Aerogen corporate branding, expectations, marketing materials and sales excellence. Organisation of bi\-annual distributor meeting and ensure regular communications on in market activities and marketing updates.
* National Customer Facing Events: Full responsibility on Coordinating participation in events, event displays, and all promotion and lead generation activities. Work with 3rd party vendor for innovative stand solutions within budget to make market impact. Responsible for key event measurables, reporting success and surveys on all engagements. Post market follow up and track ROI associated with each event.
* Budget: Own and track and manage all spend in line with budget, keep within process for approvals. Monthly reporting to line manager on budget and forecasting.
* Public Relations: Develop ideas for contributed articles and regular press releases about Aerogen. Make sure these activities are factored into broader market awareness strategy.
* KOL Strategy Support: Integrate KOL strategy with broader marketing team into our communications plan and showcase customer engagement activities and outputs. contracting organisation.
* Peer to Peer Education: Take ownership of Peer to Peer Education within market; symposiums, workshops, webinars working with Medical Affairs and commercial. Gain accreditation for key activities and look to do full launch of AeroED, Aerogen’s Education portal in market with clear measurable and ongoing management.
* Society engagement: Responsible for working with key societies, along with medical affairs to build education programs, support events and build rapport to influence guidelines.
* Corporate communications: Ensure Aerogen’s corporate brand guidelines are followed and adhered to within region at all times, train out distributers on the use of Aerogen logo and expectations on representing the Aerogen product and name.



  





**What education and experience are required?** 



* Minimum10\+ years Previous work experience in Medical Device Marketing. Spending at least 3\-4 years in commercial role is desirable.
* Experience owning budgets, building and executing strategic marketing and demonstrating ROI.
* Demonstrated leadership in leading and working on cross\-functional teams.
* Must be energetic, self\-motivated, detail\-oriented, creative, strategic and highly accountable.
* Must have excellent communication – engaging and adjusted to audience.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced, ever\-changing environment, prioritise assignments and multi\-task.
* Proven experience in creating a strategic work plan and executing programs to achieve specific goals.
* Experienced in working cross\-functionally with people with diverse backgrounds.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite, and CRM platform (ideally salesforce)
* Hands\-on experience with project management and budgeting.
* Able to stay organized, operate independently with high quality and high detail orientation.
* Ability to travel \~60% of the time.



  





**What key skills will make you great at the role?** 



* Bachelor’s Degree in Science and postgraduate qualification in Business or Marketing or equivalent job experience. Ideally with prior commercial experience.
* Experience in respiratory therapeutic area and the acute care hospital setting desirable.
* Experience in working with range of internal stakeholders locally and globally; including sales, marketing, operations, analytics and more.
* Highly self\-motivated with solution driven mindset.



  





**What is it like to work in Aerogen?** 




 Our purpose is to transform patient lives and innovation is embedded in our culture This also translates to how we look after our people. We want talented, passionate and engaged people to join Aerogen and build your career with us. We understand that your life evolves through different stages, and we are here to support our global team with a range of financial and non\-financial rewards and benefits. There’s something for everyone! Here is an idea of what we offer:
 


* Competitive bonus plan.
* Above market life insurance.
* Opportunities for development and professional growth.
* "Aerogen Connect" – our employee\-led program that helps our global teams unite and have fun.
* We donate 1% of profits and time to charities and organizations.



  





 Visit our careers website for more information about life at Aerogen.
 



 Aerogen is committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equality in the workplace. If you have difficulty using our application process, please contact us via email at careers@aerogen.com. Please provide your name and preferred contact method.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
About Arkahub

Arkahub (Interglacial Renewable Technologies Pvt. Ltd.) is building the infrastructure for residential solar in India. We make rooftop solar adoption simple and seamless for homeowners—from consultation and design to installation and after\-sales support.

With a strong presence in Bengaluru and Hyderabad, we are expanding rapidly into Nagpur and are looking for a highly driven Marketing Executive to lead our on\-ground customer acquisition initiatives.

About the Role

As a Marketing Executive, you will be responsible for creating and executing local, on\-ground marketing initiatives that generate qualified customer leads for our Sales team. You will build strong relationships with Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs), apartment communities, local influencers, and key ecosystem partners to establish Arkahub's presence across Nagpur.

This is a field\-intensive role that requires excellent communication, relationship\-building skills, and the ability to execute marketing campaigns independently.

Key Responsibilities

Community \& RWA Partnerships

* Identify and build relationships with Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs), apartment associations, gated communities, and housing societies.
* Schedule and conduct meetings with RWA committees to introduce Arkahub's residential solar solutions.
* Secure permissions for awareness sessions, society activations, kiosks, and customer engagement events.
* Develop long\-term partnerships with communities to create a recurring pipeline of customer leads.

Lead Generation \& Field Marketing

* Plan and execute Door\-to\-Door (D2D) outreach campaigns across targeted residential areas.
* Organize and manage Below\-the\-Line (BTL) marketing activities such as:
* Society activations
* Residential stalls and kiosks
* Community awareness drives
* Weekend events
* Local exhibitions and campaigns
* Educate homeowners about rooftop solar, financing options, and the benefits of switching to solar.
* Generate qualified customer leads and ensure they are accurately captured in the CRM.

DISCOM \& Local Ecosystem Coordination

* Build and maintain relationships with local DISCOM officials and other relevant stakeholders to support lead generation opportunities.
* Coordinate with local ecosystem partners wherever applicable to improve market visibility and customer acquisition.
* Identify local events, associations, and networking opportunities that can help expand Arkahub's presence.

Sales Coordination

* Work closely with the Presales team to qualify leads and schedule customer meetings.
* Coordinate with Sales Consultants to ensure timely customer visits and follow\-ups.
* Track lead status and help improve conversion through continuous coordination between field marketing and sales teams.

Campaign Execution \& Reporting

* Execute city\-level marketing campaigns as per business priorities.
* Share market insights, customer feedback, and competitor activities with the leadership team.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Commerce, or any related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in field marketing, BTL marketing, sales, community engagement, or business development.
* Experience working with residential communities, RWAs, channel partners, or local institutions is highly preferred.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Comfortable with extensive field travel across Pune.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced startup environment.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, and CRM tools is an advantage.
* Fluency in English, Hindi, and Marathi is preferred.

Why Join Arkahub?

* Be part of one of India's fastest\-growing startups.
* Work directly with experienced founders and business leaders.
* Build a city from the ground up and make a visible business impact.
* Opportunity to grow into Marketing, Growth, or Business Development leadership roles as the company expands.
* Competitive compensation and a high\-ownership work environment where your ideas and execution matter.

Pay: ₹400,000\.00 \- ₹600,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Job Description – Social Media \& Digital Marketing Executive

**Company:** Sri Asha Forgings Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana  
**Position:** Social Media \& Digital Marketing Executive  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 1–3 years preferred *(freshers with strong digital marketing skills may also be considered)*

About Sri Asha Forgings

Sri Asha Forgings Pvt. Ltd. is a Hyderabad\-based manufacturer specializing in **aluminium alloy forgings** for demanding industrial applications, including aerospace, defence, space and engineering sectors.

We are looking for a **creative, digitally savvy and results\-oriented Social Media \& Digital Marketing Executive**who can build our online presence and generate meaningful business enquiries through digital marketing.

Key Responsibilities1\. Social Media Management

* Manage the company's **Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook and YouTube** accounts.
* Develop and execute a monthly social media content calendar.
* Create and publish **posts, reels, videos, carousels, stories and technical content**.
* Develop content around:
* Aluminium alloy forgings
* Manufacturing processes
* Forging equipment
* Quality \& testing
* Products and applications
* Company capabilities
* Industry knowledge
* Projects and achievements
* Maintain a consistent **professional corporate brand identity** across all platforms.
* Monitor comments, messages and enquiries and coordinate internally for appropriate responses.
* Track social media performance and prepare monthly reports.

2\. Content Creation \& Design

* Create professional graphics and marketing creatives using **Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator or similar tools**.
* Edit short\-form videos/reels using **CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar software**.
* Photograph/video factory operations, machinery, products and company activities when required.
* Convert technical manufacturing information into **simple, engaging and visually appealing content**.
* Maintain a library of company photographs, videos, logos and marketing assets.

3\. Google Ads \& Paid Digital Marketing

The candidate will be responsible for managing and optimizing **Google Ads campaigns**, including:

* Google Search Ads
* Display campaigns where appropriate
* Remarketing campaigns
* Lead\-generation campaigns
* Keyword research
* Ad\-copy creation
* Audience targeting
* Campaign budget management
* Conversion tracking
* Monitoring **CPC, CTR, conversions, CPL and ROI**
* Regular optimization of campaigns to improve lead quality and reduce unnecessary spending.

4\. LinkedIn B2B Marketing

Since Sri Asha Forgings operates in a **B2B industrial/manufacturing environment**, LinkedIn will be an important part of the role.

Responsibilities include:

* Building the company's LinkedIn presence.
* Creating technical and industry\-focused posts.
* Promoting company capabilities and products.
* Identifying relevant industries and potential business segments.
* Supporting **B2B lead\-generation campaigns**.
* Researching potential customers, OEMs, engineering companies and procurement contacts.
* Coordinating with the management/sales team regarding potential leads.

5\. Website \& SEO

* Coordinate with the website team to keep company information updated.
* Suggest new website content and landing pages.
* Perform basic **SEO keyword research**.
* Improve website visibility for relevant searches such as aluminium forgings, aluminium alloy forgings, aerospace forgings, defence forgings, etc.
* Monitor Google Search performance and website traffic.
* Suggest improvements to generate more enquiries through the website.

6\. Lead Generation \& Marketing

The role is **not limited to posting on social media**.

The candidate will be expected to actively contribute to business development through digital marketing.

This includes:

* Generating enquiries through Google, LinkedIn and social media.
* Tracking incoming digital leads.
* Maintaining a lead database.
* Coordinating with the sales/business development team.
* Following up on marketing\-generated enquiries.
* Identifying new digital channels for customer acquisition.
* Researching competitors and industry trends.
* Suggesting new marketing campaigns and strategies.

7\. Email \& Digital Communication

* Assist in preparing professional **email marketing campaigns**.
* Create company newsletters and product/capability announcements.
* Maintain digital customer/prospect databases.
* Support promotional campaigns for new products, capabilities and company developments.

8\. Analytics \& Reporting

Prepare regular reports covering:

* Social media growth
* Engagement
* Reach and impressions
* Website traffic
* Google Ads performance
* Leads generated
* Cost per lead
* Conversion rate
* Campaign ROI
* Best\-performing content

The candidate should be able to **look at marketing data and make decisions**, rather than simply report numbers.

Skills RequiredEssential

* Good knowledge of **Digital Marketing**
* Social media management
* **Google Ads**
* Basic SEO
* Canva / graphic design
* Video and reel editing
* LinkedIn marketing
* Content writing
* Basic Google Analytics / Search Console knowledge
* Good English communication
* Strong creative thinking

Preferred

* Google Ads certification
* Meta Ads experience
* B2B marketing experience
* Industrial/manufacturing marketing experience
* WordPress or similar CMS experience
* Basic photography/videography
* CRM/lead management experience
* Experience with LinkedIn lead generation

What We Expect From the Candidate

We are looking for someone who can **own the company's digital marketing**, not someone who only schedules Instagram posts.

The ideal candidate should be able to think:

**Content → Reach → Engagement → Enquiry → Lead → Business**

They should actively identify opportunities to improve Sri Asha Forgings' digital presence and generate new B2B enquiries.

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Quality and consistency of content
* Growth of social media presence
* Website visibility
* Quality of leads generated
* Google Ads performance
* B2B enquiries generated
* Campaign ROI
* Creativity and initiative
* Ability to understand and communicate technical products

Education

**Bachelor's degree/Diploma in:**

* Digital Marketing
* Marketing
* Mass Communication
* Business Administration
* Advertising
* Media/Design

or a related field.

**Experience:** 1–3 years preferred, but talented freshers with practical digital marketing knowledge may be considered.

A Good Job\-Portal Summary

**Sri Asha Forgings Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a Social Media \& Digital Marketing Executive to manage our complete digital marketing activities, including social media, Google Ads, LinkedIn B2B marketing, SEO, website content, lead generation, email marketing and digital campaigns. The candidate will be responsible for creating professional content, managing paid advertising campaigns, generating business enquiries and tracking marketing performance. Candidates with experience in B2B, industrial or manufacturing marketing will be preferred.**

**Key areas:** Social Media \| Google Ads \| LinkedIn \| SEO \| Content Creation \| Canva \| Video Editing \| Lead Generation \| B2B Marketing \| Website \| Analytics \| Digital Campaigns

Pay: From ₹15,000\.00 per month

BlueOak Ventures works with startups, founders and growing businesses to help them build stronger business foundations, improve execution and access the right growth opportunities.

The role will involve planning and executing digital campaigns, managing social media, creating marketing content, running paid advertising campaigns and continuously improving lead quality and acquisition performance.

Analytics \& Reporting

* Track campaign performance and prepare regular marketing reports.
* Analyze customer acquisition costs, conversion rates and campaign ROI.

The Field Marketing Manager, India will execute field marketing across India’s defense and government ecosystem. This role will drive account\-based marketing programs, support strategic capture efforts, and contribute to measurable pipeline impact in close partnership with regional Sales, Business Development, and Capture teams.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role in a high\-growth environment. The ideal candidate is comfortable executing account strategies and field programs, thrives in complex government sales environments, and understands how to align marketing activities with long\-cycle defense procurement processes.
   

  

 The Field Marketing Manager, India will report to the Director of Field Marketing, Asia Pacific / Middle East.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Execute field marketing programs across India’s defense, Ministry of Defence, Armed Forces, DRDO, and strategic aerospace accounts, aligned with regional Go\-to\-Market priorities.
* Support the development and execution of account\-based marketing strategies for priority India\-based government and defense accounts, helping map buying centers and coordinate multi\-touch engagement across events, executive briefings, targeted campaigns, and customer programs.
* Develop a strong understanding of India’s defense procurement environment, acquisition cycles, and stakeholder landscape, using that knowledge to inform effective marketing programs.
* Execute major India\-based defense and aerospace events, prioritizing high\-value account engagement, customer meetings, and opportunity progression over brand presence alone.
* Plan and execute owned customer events, private briefings, roundtables, and targeted engagements in partnership with Sales and Capture teams.
* Partner closely with Sales and Business Development to align marketing programs with local account plans, pipeline targets, and strategic business priorities.
* Support ABM programs designed to generate new pipeline, deepen engagement within strategic accounts, and accelerate existing opportunities.
* Own Salesforce campaign execution, including creating and managing Campaign IDs, ensuring proper campaign structure, tracking member status, and maintaining data integrity in partnership with Sales.
* Partner with Sales to ensure accurate opportunity association, contact mapping, and required CRM field completion to support reliable pipeline reporting and attribution.
* Build and execute programs within Marketo, including campaign flows, audience segmentation, nurture programs, and performance reporting.
* Track and report field marketing performance against KPIs including account engagement, stakeholder engagement, campaign participation, opportunity influence, pipeline contribution, and deal acceleration.
* Manage event and program logistics, agencies, vendors, and other external partners to ensure high\-quality and efficient execution.
* Bring structure, accountability, and operational rigor to field marketing execution within a fast\-growing international aerospace and defense organization.


**Required Qualifications**
* 5 to 8\+ years of experience in field marketing, demand generation, integrated marketing, or related marketing roles, preferably with exposure to government, aerospace, or defense markets in India.
* Experience marketing into India\-based government, defense, aerospace, or public sector organizations. Experience with Ministry of Defence, Armed Forces, DRDO, or related organizations is highly valuable.
* Understanding of India’s defense procurement processes, long\-cycle acquisition environments, and complex multi\-stakeholder account structures.
* Proven experience executing account\-based marketing programs within complex enterprise, government, or strategic accounts.
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce CRM, including campaign creation, Campaign ID management, opportunity alignment, reporting, and maintaining strong CRM hygiene.
* Hands\-on experience with Marketo or a comparable marketing automation platform, including campaign execution, segmentation, nurture programs, and performance tracking.
* Experience executing trade shows, industry events, executive briefings, and owned customer programs, preferably within the India aerospace and defense market.
* Ability to engage professionally with senior military leaders, government stakeholders, defense industry executives, and technical audiences.
* Strong project management and execution skills, with the ability to manage multiple programs and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong cross\-functional partnership skills with Sales, Business Development, Capture, and Global Marketing teams.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment with evolving priorities and processes.
* Fluent in English, both written and verbal, with the ability to collaborate effectively with global teams. Proficiency in Hindi or other regional Indian languages is a plus.

title: Growth Marketing Manager
description:
**Role:** 
 Growth Marketing Manager
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**Experience Level:** 
 Senior Travel
   

  

**About ElderGo**
 Somewhere in Bangalore there's a 63\-year\-old who has quietly decided her travelling days are behind her. They aren't. Your job is to find her.
   

  

 ElderGo runs all\-inclusive group tours for Indian travellers aged 55 and above. Last year, 200 of them went with us across 8 countries — and seven in ten came back for another trip. The product works. The trips sell.
   

  

 The gap is reaching more of the right people.
   

  

**The Role**
 You'll own how ElderGo finds its travellers. That starts with paid — running our campaigns, building the creative, knowing why one ad works and another doesn't. You'll be sharper at this than we are, and you'll have room to run.
   

  

 But it doesn't end there. There are far more people out there who'd love these trips than we're currently reaching, and finding them is the real work of this role. We have a clear sense of where to look next. We're hiring someone who'll have a better one.
   

  

 Our sales team is about to grow from 4 people to 12\. This role is what makes that possible.
   

  

**Who You Might Be**
* You've run consumer campaigns yourself — hands on the account, over months, not a slide deck about them.
* You've marketed something people think about before buying, not something they add to a cart.
* You've started something where there was nothing, and you liked that part.
* You've carried a number that was yours to answer for.
* You're in Bengaluru, or happy to be.


 Coming from B2B or SaaS? The instincts tend not to transfer — this is a different craft.
   

  

**Why This One**
 Marketing here isn't a support function. It's the thing that decides how fast the company grows, and right now nobody owns it. You'd work directly with the founders, on a product people write thank\-you letters about, in a category almost nobody in India is serving properly. It's a lot of room for one person. That's the offer.

description:
**About Opptra** 




 Opptra unlocks Asian expansion for consumer brands through ecommerce and digital capabilities. We build category\-aligned franchising businesses powered by a shared global supply chain and centrally developed technology, balancing online and offline channels across India, GCC, and Southeast Asia.
 



  





**The Role** 




 Own profitable online growth for Opptra's portfolio — Home, Kitchen, Furniture, Electronics, PCA, Packed Foods, Sports, Baby, Toys, Pets, and Beauty — by planning, executing, and scaling marketplace demand engines across India, GCC, and SEA.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




 Marketplace Execution
 


* Take full ownership of paid campaigns on
 **Amazon India and Flipkart** 
 — from campaign structure and bid logic to placement strategy and spend pacing
* Make real spending decisions; this is a hands\-on role with significant monthly ad spend under your direct control
* Be accountable for topline growth on a large, multi\-category marketplace portfolio
* Work closely with Catalog and Category to ensure listing quality — content, ratings, pricing, and promotions — is pulling its weight in campaign performance
* Get ahead of major sale events by locking in stock availability, content sign\-offs, and launch timelines well before go\-live



 Growth \& Optimisation
 


* Hit the ground running with a clear plan — defined priorities, measurable targets, and an honest view of what needs fixing first
* Treat every campaign as a learning opportunity — design structured experiments, read the results properly, and build on what works
* Get more out of the tools and agencies you work with than most people do — use automation and external partners to punch above your headcount



 Reporting \& Stakeholder Management
 


* Keep leadership genuinely informed — not just with data, but with a clear read on what's working, what isn't, and what you're doing about it
* Be the connective tissue between marketing and the rest of the business — Category, Supply Chain, Finance — so nothing falls through the cracks
* Run structured weekly and monthly reviews that drive decisions, not just discussion



  





**What We're Looking For** 




**Must Have** 



* Directly managed performance marketing at meaningful scale on Indian marketplaces — this is not a first rodeo
* Hands\-on ownership of substantial monthly ad spend on Amazon India and Flipkart — not delegated to an agency
* Deep expertise in Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, DSP, and Flipkart Ads — not just familiarity
* Proficiency with ad management tools — Adbrew, Pacvue, Hector/Sku, or equivalent

* Experience building attribution or performance dashboards — not just consuming them
* A point of view on how AI will reshape marketplace advertising in the next 2–3 years



**Why Opptra** 




 You'll own real revenue — not a slice of a campaign managed by committee. Opptra's model gives you category\-level accountability across a growing multi\-brand portfolio, with the tooling, data, and cross\-functional support to back it up. If you're a marketplace operator who thinks in systems and wants to help build Asia's most ambitious brand distribution engine — this is the seat.

title: Content Marketing Specialist  (12-month contract)
description:
**About The Group/Team**
 CJKI is the group responsible for making Canva feel like a local product in four of its most dynamic markets \- China, Japan, Korea, and India. We sit within Canva's International Supergroup, whose mission is to empower those closest to our international customers to drive Truly Local growth across our top 40 markets.
   

  

 Our group operates with genuine autonomy, building in\-market functions across marketing, product, engineering, data, and user voice \- with the support of Canva's central teams behind us.
   

  

 India is one of our most active and ambitious subgroups, with growing teams in SEO, marketing, and product all working toward the same goal: making Canva indispensable for Indian creators, educators, and businesses, and growing our active user base in the country.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About the Role/Specialty**
 This is a opportunity to help build Canva's marketing presence for Indian users across touchpoints. You'll plan \& create content that shows up where Indian users actually are: on Canva's homepage, in the product itself, on their social feeds, and on YouTube where hundreds of millions of Indians search for how\-tos, tools, and inspiration every day.
   

  

 You'll work closely with the India Marketing team, with clear direction and room to develop your craft. This isn't a single\-channel role \- you'll stretch across planning content, writing scripts, writing product interface copy, producing content, coordinating with agencies to make production\-heavy content, and CMS management. You will get a real view of what full\-funnel content marketing looks like in one of the world's most exciting digital markets.
   

  

**What You’ll Do (responsibilities)**
* Plan content across touchpoints \- from a social ad to a YouTube tutorial to a product surface \- so every piece of content is shaped for the context in which it lands.
* Script \& produce a bank of short\-form video content for multiple touchpoints \- so the Marketing team always has fresh, tested content to work with.
* Brief and coordinate with external agencies or internal creative teams to make production\-heavy content, specially video content.
* Experiment with new content formats for Canva's product surfaces \- including the homepage, landing pages and other surfaces, such as highlights, videos, learning cards, etc.
* Manage end\-to\-end content execution \- content scheduling, CMS uploads, A/B tests across platforms and surfaces.
* Coordinate localisation across languages where needed \- a working understanding of Hindi is required, as most India localisation will be in this language.
* Measure the impact of the content, and calibrate future plans according to new insights and learnings.


**Qualifications**
**What we're looking for**
* You write clearly and versatilely across formats \- from punchy Shorts scripts to instructional video copy to product interface language.
* You're an avid Canva user who knows the product's workflows and use cases inside out \- you can speak credibly about what Canva can do, and that knowledge shows up naturally in the content you create.
* You think in channels and touchpoints \- you instinctively ask "where will someone see this, and what do they need from it at that moment?" before you write or brief a single word.
* You are comfortable facing the camera, and have a good screen presence to represent a brand like Canva in India.
* You have a sharp eye for social and design trends \- you're the kind of person who spots an emerging content format or visual style early, and can translate that into new ideas.
* You take genuine ownership of your output \- you flag blockers early, manage your own time across multiple content surfaces, and care about whether your work actually lands with users.
* You're comfortable working to a brief and taking feedback in your stride \- you see revision as part of the craft, not a setback.
* You have a good understanding of Hindi and are comfortable reviewing or briefing localised content to ensure it reads naturally for Indian users \- not just translated, but truly local.
* You're based in Bangalore and ready to contribute across a range of content types from day one.


**Additional Information**
**What you will learn and how you will develop at Canva**
* Multi\-surface content marketing \- you'll develop real experience writing \& producing social content, product content, and YouTube in a single role, giving you a rounded view of how content works across the funnel.
* Stakeholder and project management \- you'll learn how to brief external agencies, manage feedback loops, and keep multiple content workstreams moving at once, building production and stakeholder coordination skills that are invaluable in any marketing role.
* YouTube \& social content strategy \- you'll learn how to build a content funnel designed around search behaviour, create for discoverability, and grow an audience in one of the world's most competitive YouTube markets.
* A strong, full\-funnel content portfolio \- over 12 months, you'll have published work across social media, product interfaces, homepage, and other touchpoints.

title: Ecommerce Marketing Manager
description:
Job Title: E\-commerce Executive – Amazon Marketplace Operations
 
**Organization:** 
 SOAI India Private Limited
 



**Department:** 
 E\-commerce
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



**Experience Required:** 
 2 to 4 Years
 



**Work Schedule: 6 Days a Week** 




**Compensation: ₹4–8 LPA, depending on relevant experience and expertise** 



 Important – Please Read Before Applying
 
 This position has a
 **fixed compensation range of ₹4–8 LPA** 
 , depending on the candidate’s years of relevant experience, depth of hands\-on Amazon expertise, and overall fit for the role.
 



**The maximum budget for this position is ₹8 LPA. Candidates with current or expected compensation above ₹8 LPA / expectations of ₹10 LPA or higher are requested not to apply** 
 , as we will not be able to accommodate compensation beyond the stated range.
 



 This is also a
 **6\-day working role based in Bangalore** 
 . Please apply only if you are comfortable with both the compensation range and the 6\-day work schedule.
 


 About the Organization
 
 SOAI India Private Limited is a Bengaluru\-based gaming peripherals company and the official brand owner of AULA, LEOBOG, and PROGAMER in India. The organization designs, imports, and markets gaming keyboards, mice, headsets, and related accessories, with a growing presence across online marketplaces.
 


 Role Summary
 
 We are seeking a hands\-on
 **E\-commerce Executive with strong expertise in Amazon Marketplace Operations** 
 to manage and grow the AULA brand portfolio on Amazon India.
 



 The role requires strong working knowledge of
 **both Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central** 
 , with particular emphasis on catalogue management, marketplace operations, FBA and inventory planning, account health, returns and reimbursements, pricing, promotions, advertising, and business reporting.
 



 The ideal candidate should be comfortable independently managing day\-to\-day Amazon operations, resolving marketplace issues, maintaining catalogue health, monitoring performance, and coordinating across internal and Amazon teams.
 


 Key ResponsibilitiesAmazon Marketplace Management
 * Independently manage day\-to\-day operations across
 **Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central** 
 , including sales, orders, inventory, pricing, returns, payments, account health, and marketplace issues.
* Monitor marketplace performance and proactively resolve operational issues impacting sales, inventory, product availability, or account performance.
* Raise, manage, and follow up on Amazon support cases relating to inventory, FBA, purchase orders, payments, account health, and other operational matters.
* Coordinate with Amazon teams and internal functions to ensure smooth marketplace operations.


 Catalogue and Listing Management
 * Take complete ownership of the
 **Amazon product catalogue** 
 across Seller Central and Vendor Central.
* Create, update, and optimize listings including titles, bullet points, descriptions, keywords, backend attributes, specifications, images, videos, and A\+ Content.
* Manage new ASIN creation, parent\-child variations, product families, and new product launches.
* Work with Amazon flat files, bulk uploads, and catalogue tools for listing creation and updates.
* Resolve suppressed or inactive listings, variation issues, incorrect attributes, duplicate ASINs, image issues, and other catalogue errors.
* Conduct keyword research and optimize product detail pages for improved visibility and conversion.
* Ensure catalogue accuracy, consistency, completeness, and compliance with Amazon policies and Brand Registry requirements.


 Sales and Performance Monitoring
 * Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance at SKU and ASIN level.
* Analyse revenue, units sold, traffic, conversion, pricing, returns, inventory availability, and advertising contribution.
* Identify underperforming and high\-growth SKUs and recommend actions to improve sales and profitability.
* Monitor competition, pricing, ratings, reviews, rankings, and marketplace visibility.


 Vendor Central Operations
 * Manage Vendor Central activities including purchase orders, confirmations, shipment coordination, operational issues, and related reporting.
* Monitor purchase order status, fulfilment, shortages, cancellations, and discrepancies.
* Coordinate internally to ensure timely order processing and compliance with Amazon requirements.
* Track and resolve Vendor Central claims, shortages, deductions, and operational issues in coordination with relevant teams.


 Amazon Advertising
 * Manage and monitor Amazon Advertising campaigns across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display.
* Coordinate keyword targeting, budgets, bids, and campaign performance.
* Monitor key metrics including ACOS, ROAS, CPC, CTR, conversion rate, advertising sales, and spend.
* Identify campaign performance gaps and recommend optimization actions.
* Support advertising plans for new product launches, promotions, and major Amazon sale events.


 Inventory and FBA Management
 * Monitor FBA and warehouse inventory, sales velocity, stock cover, and projected demand.
* Identify stock\-out and excess inventory risks and coordinate timely replenishment.
* Plan and track FBA shipments and resolve receiving discrepancies.
* Monitor stranded, unfulfillable, reserved, and aged inventory.
* Coordinate inventory availability for launches, promotions, and major sale events.


 Pricing and Promotions
 * Monitor product pricing, Buy Box status, competitive pricing, and marketplace offers.
* Manage coupons, promotions, deals, and sale\-event participation.
* Ensure pricing and inventory are aligned with promotional and business plans.


 Returns and Reimbursements
 * Analyse customer returns, refunds, and product\-level return reasons.
* Coordinate corrective actions for products with high return rates.
* Track FBA inventory discrepancies, lost or damaged inventory, reimbursements, claims, and Vendor Central deductions.
* Raise and follow up on eligible cases until closure and coordinate reconciliation with the Accounts team.


 Account Health and Compliance
 * Monitor Amazon Account Health, policy notifications, listing compliance, and performance risks.
* Resolve policy violations, listing restrictions, suppressed listings, and other account\-related issues within required timelines.
* Monitor customer feedback, ratings, reviews, and Voice of the Customer where applicable.
* Ensure compliance with Amazon marketplace policies and operational requirements.


 Reporting
 * Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports covering sales, inventory, advertising, returns, reimbursements, Vendor Central operations, and account health.
* Maintain trackers for catalogue issues, support cases, FBA shipments, purchase orders, claims, and marketplace action items.
* Analyse marketplace data and highlight performance gaps, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions for management review.


 Required Skills and Experience
 * **2 to 4 years of hands\-on experience in Amazon Marketplace Operations** 
 , preferably in consumer electronics, gaming accessories, or related categories.
* **Strong hands\-on knowledge of both Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central is mandatory.**
* **Strong experience in Amazon catalogue and listing management is essential** 
 , including ASIN creation, variations, flat files, backend attributes, listing optimization, and catalogue troubleshooting.
* Good working knowledge of Amazon Advertising, including campaign management and key performance metrics such as ACOS, ROAS, CPC, CTR, and conversion rate.
* Sound understanding of FBA operations, inventory planning, purchase orders, pricing, promotions, returns, reimbursements, claims, and account health.
* Experience with Amazon Brand Registry will be an advantage.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, and business reporting.
* Strong analytical, communication, coordination, and problem\-solving abilities.
* High attention to detail and demonstrated ability to independently manage Amazon marketplace operations and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.

 Whether you're on a consumer product (like Gmail, Search, Maps, Chrome, Android) or a business product (Google Ads, AdSense, Google Marketing Platform, Analytics), you take part in a complete marketing experience as you lead every facet of the product's journey. From determining positioning, naming, competitive analysis, feature prioritization and external communications, you help shape the product and help it grow a consumer base. In this role, you'll be involved with product marketing strategy from beginning to end.

Operating across all major Product Areas including Gemini, Search, YouTube, Google Pay, Pixel, Android, and Play the CoE creates defensible market moats and drives user habituation across some of the core User Segments: Youth, Premium, Merchants, and Bharat, among others.
   

  

 As the Senior Strategic Alliance Lead, you will play a role in hunting and scoping, architecting high\-impact agreements and be the strategic steward of Google India’s partnership portfolio. You will shape the overarching strategy for asset exchanges, negotiate multi\-year mega\-alliances with C\-suite executives across India’s leading conglomerates, and establish institutional governance across Google Marketing. * Drive Executive Alignment: Partner with senior Google leaders across multiple areas (Marketing, Legal, PR, Partnerships) to secure strategic commitments and upskill the broader marketing organization.

 AEO and GEO

* Track our visibility across these platforms and report on how it changes

 YouTube and podcast channel
 



* Own YouTube SEO: titles, descriptions, tags, thumbnails, chapters, end screens, and playlists

* Track watch time, retention, click\-through rate, and subscriber growth, and act on what the data shows

 Paid campaigns
 



* Set up, launch, and optimise campaigns across Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and LinkedIn Campaign Manager
* Implement and maintain conversion tracking: Google Tag Manager, GA4 events, Meta Pixel, and the LinkedIn Insight Tag
* Build LinkedIn Lead Gen Forms and monitor lead quality with the sales team
* Manage daily budget pacing, audience testing, and creative rotation



  






 Content operations and reporting
 



* Schedule and publish organic content across LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube using scheduling tools
* Use AI tools actively to draft, adapt, and optimise content, and edit output to match our brand voice
* Brief our design and video team on creative and content requirements
* Deliver a structured weekly report covering technical work completed, search performance, campaign results, channel growth, and key observations



  





  






 QUALIFICATIONS
 



* 2 to 3 years of hands\-on digital marketing experience with a clear technical SEO component
* Demonstrated experience doing technical SEO on a coded or static website, not only through a CMS plugin
* Hands\-on experience implementing schema markup and validating it
* Working knowledge of Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and Google Tag Manager
* Practical experience with at least one SEO crawler or audit tool, such as Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, or Semrush
* Hands\-on campaign experience in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads. LinkedIn Campaign Manager experience is an advantage
* Working knowledge of AEO and GEO, how AI platforms select and cite sources, and how content can be structured to appear in them
* YouTube SEO and channel management experience is a strong advantage
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Mass Communication, Engineering, or a related discipline preferred



  






 SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS
 



* Able to read HTML and understand how a page is constructed. You do not need to be a developer, but you should be able to explain a technical fix to one and check whether it was done correctly
* Actively uses AI tools as part of daily content and research workflow, with judgement about where they help and where they do not

* Strong written English for B2B communication and content briefs
* Able to read campaign and analytics data and form a view from it, rather than only reporting numbers
* Organised enough to hold several brands and channels at once without dropping threads
* Self\-driven, able to maintain content schedules and reporting without follow\-up
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, growth\-stage environment
* WordPress and WooCommerce familiarity is an advantage
* Office presence is mandatory



  





  






 COMPENSATION
 





 CTC: ₹4 LPA – ₹5 LPA (based on experience and demonstrated technical skills).
 





 Includes PF and other mandatory deductions. We will issue the offer letter and annexure after the office visit and discussion with management at the head office in Gandimaisamma.
 




  





  






 LANGUAGES
 





 English, Hindi. Telugu is an advantage.
 




  





  






 WHY JOIN GROUP WELKIN?
 



* Work with a 50\-year\-old trusted brand actively building its digital presence from the ground up, with real ownership, not support work
* Genuine technical scope. You will be doing SEO properly on a coded site, not filling in fields in a plugin
* Rare breadth for this level: B2B search, AI search visibility, YouTube channel growth, and paid campaigns across three platforms
* Build a brand's digital presence from zero, which is an experience most people at this stage do not get
* Direct collaboration with leadership and a short path from decision to execution
* We work with AI tools seriously and expect you to get sharper at them here
* Product\-based business with high repeat order potential and a well\-defined B2B audience
