title: Off-Page SEO Specialist
description:
**About Keka** 




 Keka is India's \#1 People Operations Platform, trusted by 10,000\+ businesses to manage their HR, payroll, attendance, and performance processes. We are on a mission to make HR delightful — and we're looking for passionate people to help us scale that mission through world\-class marketing.
 



  





**Role snapshot** 




**Experience:** 
 3\-4 years in off\-page SEO, link building or outreach.
 



**Markets:** 
 India, United States, UAE / GCC
 



**Location:** 
 Hyderabad (On\-site)
 



  





**What you'll own** 




**Backlink campaign planning** 



* Build a quarterly link plan mapped to specific target pages and keyword clusters, rather than a fixed monthly link count. Plan anchor text and target\-page distribution deliberately, and maintain a natural link velocity.
* Run link\-gap analysis against defined competitors in each market using Ahrefs or Semrush, and prioritise prospects by how realistically they can be won. Segment them into tiers, each with its own approach: editorial and media, HR communities and associations, partner and integration pages, SaaS directories and roundups, guest contributions, and resource pages.
* Commission linkable assets with the content team, including survey data, calculators, statistics pages and templates, and then promote them. Maintain a single prospect database recording owner, status, last contact and outcome.
* Prospect and verify contacts, and write outreach that is short, specific and built around a single clear request.
* Manage replies through to completion, including negotiation and decisions on paid placements, and follow up until the link is live. Track reply rate, positive reply rate and link\-live rate by template, and discontinue approaches that do not perform.
* Establish Keka's presence in the sources AI systems draw from: “best HR software” and “best payroll software” roundups, comparison articles, and review platforms including G2, Capterra, GetApp, Software Advice, TrustRadius and SoftwareSuggest.
* Participate genuinely in the community surfaces that appear in AI answers, including relevant subreddits, Quora, LinkedIn and HR forums.
* Maintain consistent brand entity information wherever Keka is described, and correct outdated third\-party facts such as old pricing, discontinued features and comparisons with retired products.
* Run a fixed prompt set across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot and Google AI Mode, recording which brands are named and which sources are cited, and target those sources. Report on\-site gaps, such as schema, content structure and llms.txt, to the SEO lead.
* Improve LLM citation performance through backlinks, analysing which platforms, directories, review sites, communities and other sources need to be reached out to in order to increase Keka’s visibility and citations across AI systems.
* Manage directory listings and review site listings, ensuring Keka is consistently represented across relevant directories, software listing platforms and review sites, and identify new platforms where a listing or backlink can strengthen search and LLM visibility.
* Audit links gained, links lost and spam exposure each month, and disavow only where clearly warranted. Reclaim links pointing to 404 pages or redirect chains, and raise the underlying fix with the SEO lead.
* Maintain a live reporting dashboard covering referring domains gained, weighted by the linking domain's organic traffic, links per target page, ranking movement on target pages, and AI citation share of voice.



**What you need to have** 



* 3\-4 years of experience in off\-page SEO, link building or outreach, in\-house or agency\-side.
* Strong written English. The role involves a high volume of written outreach.
* Hands\-on experience with Ahrefs, Semrush or Moz, and familiarity with Google Search Console.
* Experience running cold email at volume, with an understanding of deliverability fundamentals.
* Examples of live links you have personally built, with an explanation of how each was secured.



**Nice to have** 



* Experience in B2B SaaS or HR technology.
* Outreach experience with US, UK or GCC audiences.
* Experience with an outreach platform such as Pitchbox, BuzzStream, Instantly or Smartlead.
* Experience tracking AI search visibility, using a tool such as Peec, Profound or Otterly, or a manually maintained prompt log.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Location: Bengaluru, Pune — on\-site
 



 This regional real\-estate developer has always sold through brokers and word of mouth in its home city. Its next project is in a second city where it has no existing broker network and no name recognition, which means digital is now the primary way it will reach buyers rather than a supporting channel. The company has partnered with Flexiple to hire a Digital Marketing Manager to own that shift.
 



**What you'd be building** 




 You will set up and run digital demand generation for a project launch from close to zero: paid search and social aimed at homebuyers researching a new city, a landing page and lead\-capture flow, and a retargeting sequence for people who visit a show apartment but do not book on the spot. Real estate lead cycles are long and this is not a lead\-farming role — you will be measured on qualified site visits and bookings, not raw form fills.
 



**How the launch team runs** 



* You report to the head of sales and marketing and work alongside the on\-ground sales team that handles site visits
* You manage the budget and agency relationship for paid media directly
* You track cost per qualified lead and cost per booking, and adjust spend weekly based on what sales is closing



**Who this role needs** 




 Two to seven years in digital or performance marketing, ideally with some real\-estate, high\-ticket, or long\-cycle\-purchase experience. You should be comfortable owning a paid budget directly, reading a CRM to understand what is actually converting to bookings rather than just leads, and working closely with an on\-ground sales team rather than at arm's length from them.
 


* Hands\-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads, including landing\-page and retargeting setup
* Comfort with a CRM and basic funnel reporting



**What you'd get out of it** 




 You would be the first owner of a real digital budget at this company, not inheriting someone else's dashboards, with direct visibility into what converts to actual bookings and a straight line to the head of sales and marketing.
 



**How this moves** 




 A short case exercise on the launch, one round with the head of sales and marketing, and a decision within two weeks.
 



 This application also puts you forward for other digital marketing roles we are currently hiring for.

 Paid media execution looks quite different today than it did even a couple of years ago, with automated bidding, AI\-driven campaign types, and generative tools now part of everyday work. So we're also looking for someone who's comfortable using AI tools for things like creative generation, copy testing, and reporting, while still applying good judgement on strategy and optimization.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Campaign Execution: Plan, set up, launch, and manage campaigns end to end across Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max) and Meta Ads (Facebook, Instagram, Advantage\+).
 



 • Platform Depth: Bring a solid, current understanding of how Google Ads and Meta Ads actually work: auction dynamics, automated bidding, audience signals, and algorithm behaviour, and use that to push performance beyond the basics.
 



 • AI\-First Execution: Use AI tools for ad copy and creative generation, creative testing, performance insights, and reporting to work faster and get more done.
 



 • Daily Optimization: Monitor and optimize bids, budgets, targeting, and creatives on a daily basis to keep improving performance.
 



 • Creative \& Landing Page Testing: Run structured A/B and multivariate tests on ad creatives and landing pages, using data and AI\-assisted analysis to find winning variants faster.
 



 • Reporting \& Insights: Build and maintain performance dashboards and reports, and use AI tools to help pull out trends and insights rather than just raw numbers.
 



 • Attribution \& Tracking: Set up and QA pixels, events, UTM tracking, GA4, and attribution so the data you're working with is clean and reliable.
 



 • Lead Quality: Track lead\-to\-sale conversion and flag lead quality issues early, based on what the funnel data is telling you.
 



 • Staying Current: Keep an eye on new platform features, automated campaign types, AI\-driven ad products, and other tools worth bringing into your day\-to\-day work.
 



 Skills \& Experience
 



 • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.
 



 • 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in performance marketing or paid media, with strong, demonstrable expertise in Google Ads and Meta Ads. This is a must.
 



 • Experience managing paid media budgets of ₹10 Cr\+ (cumulative or annualized) across campaigns.
 



 • Good understanding of bidding strategies, audience targeting, campaign structuring, and platform algorithms, and the reasoning behind what works, not just how to execute it.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with Performance Max, Advantage\+, and other automated or AI\-driven campaign types.
 



 • Comfortable using AI tools for creative generation, copywriting, data analysis, and workflow automation as part of everyday execution.
 



 • Proficiency in Google Analytics (GA4\), Google Tag Manager, and Excel.
 



 • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to turn data into clear, actionable decisions.
 



 • High ownership and attention to detail, with the ability to execute independently in a fast\-paced environment.
 



 • Genuinely curious about how paid media platforms and AI\-driven marketing tools keep evolving
 



  





  





 Interested, Drop in your CV to radhika.an@designcafe.com

 **150%\+ average QoQ growth**

 **1 → 100**

 You’ve actually built or grown something. You understand acquisition, positioning, funnels, content and conversion beyond theory.

 You’re comfortable with numbers, metrics and experimentation. You know how to turn data into decisions.

 You enjoy starting with a blank sheet of paper. You can go from strategy → hypothesis → execution without needing a large team around you.

 You have a strong instinct for great content, creative, messaging and storytelling. You know the difference between something that is merely “good enough” and something people genuinely remember.
 


* **High ownership**



 You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks. You see a problem and figure out how to solve it.
 


* **Comfort with ambiguity**



 There won’t always be an obvious answer. That’s the point.
 



  




 This role is for you if...
 * You want to
 **build** 
 , not just execute

 * You’re looking for a narrowly defined JD

* You’re uncomfortable with ambiguity
* You’d rather manage than build

 Our founders have spent

 , having previously built companies including Stupidsid and Yocket.
 



 We’re building Ruvimo with a
 **20\+ year view** 
 .
 



 That means we’re still early, but we’re not thinking small.
 



 If you want to join at a stage where

 How to apply

**Go crazy creative.**

title: Social Media Content Creator
description:

 If you spend half your day watching reels, the other half arguing about markets on Twitter/X, and somehow still know what’s trending before everyone else —
 **we should talk.** 




  





**We’re looking for an in\-house Content Creator \& Social Media Manager who is obsessed with finance, markets, trading, internet culture and great content.** 




  





***You’ll be responsible for making our brand impossible to ignore.***




  





**What you’ll do** 




 ·   Create high\-quality, highly shareable content across Instagram, X, LinkedIn, YouTube and other relevant platforms.
 



 ·   Conceptualise and create Reels, short\-form videos, memes, carousels, threads and other social\-first content.
 



 ·   Turn complex topics around finance, investing, trading, crypto and markets into content that people actually want to consume.
 



 ·   Stay obsessively on top of market trends, financial news, memes, internet culture and what’s going viral.
 



 ·   Manage our social media channels end\-to\-end — from ideation and creation to publishing, engagement and analytics.

 ·   Help build founder\-led content and personal brands.
 



 ·   Track what is working, understand why it is working, and continuously experiment with new formats.
 



 ·   Monitor performance metrics and use data to improve reach, engagement and audience growth.
 



 ·   Coordinate with designers, editors, agencies or other external partners where required — while owning the creative direction internally.
 



  





**Who you are** 




*You probably already know you’re chronically online.* 




  





 ·   You genuinely love finance, markets and trading. You don’t need to be an expert, but you should be curious enough to understand what’s happening in the market and have an opinion.
 



 ·   You know your way around Instagram, X, LinkedIn, YouTube and the creator ecosystem.
 



 ·   You can write a killer hook and have good humor.
 



 ·   You understand memes, trends, formats and cultural references without needing them explained to you.
 



 ·   You’re comfortable being on camera — or at least willing to become comfortable very quickly.
 



 ·   You can shoot and edit short\-form videos yourself.
 



 ·   You have a strong sense of timing, storytelling and what feels cringe vs. what actually works.
 



 ·   You’re curious, fast\-moving and constantly experimenting.
 



 ·   You don’t need someone telling you what to post every morning. You find the story yourself.
 



  





  





**Bonus points if…** 




 ·   You actively trade or invest.
 



 ·   You follow financial markets every day.
 



 ·   You have a personal finance/trading/creator account.
 



 ·   You’ve grown a social media account from scratch.
 



 ·   You have examples of Reels or short\-form content that have performed exceptionally well.
 



 ·   You can edit on CapCut / Premiere Pro / After Effects / similar tools.
 



 ·   You understand crypto and digital assets.
 



 ·   You know the difference between a 10,000\-view video and a 1\-million\-view video — and can explain why.
 



 ·   You can write both a serious LinkedIn post and an absolutely unhinged meme.
 



  





**What we care about** 




*We care less about your degree and more about your taste, curiosity and output.*




  





**Show us what you’ve made.** 
 If you can look at a boring financial topic and immediately think:
 



 “There’s a 30\-second Reel in this.” —you’re probably our person.
 



  





**How to apply** 




 1\.   3–5 pieces of content you’ve created
 



 2\.   One 60 second video on a Trading topic you find boring/complicated and how you would make it interesting.
 



  





**Please don’t send us a generic cover letter. Show us your work.**

title: Head of Marketing
description:
**Overview:** 
 Sellability is on an aggressive, market\-redefining growth trajectory, with development mandates spanning residential, commercial and mixed\-use projects. We're a merit\-driven, entrepreneurial team — the kind of place where ambitious, hard\-working people get real ownership early, not after they've proven themselves for years. At Sellability, you don't just build a job, you build a legacy: fast\-tracked career growth, structured mentorship, exposure to marquee developers, and a direct hand in redefining how real estate is sold and marketed in India.
 



  





 Our projects demand year\-round market activation and sustained brand salience. As we serve an AOP of INR 5000 Cr\+ and growing, Marketing carries a real mandate: project branding, launch and sustenance support, and constant innovation. This role will own consumer and media understanding, inventory\-linked activations, MARTECH adoption, campaign management, SOP creation, AOP strategy, ATL/BTL/Digital coordination, PR and brand communication, and a roadmap across our live markets. About the role: You will be responsible for every brand in our portfolio, across Pune, Mumbai, overseas, and NRI markets. You will plan activations around inventory, run loyalty initiatives timed to project delivery milestones, and build word\-of\-mouth that actually works. You will conceptualize and execute a full communication and activation plan and build the growth strategy that drives demand and new customer acquisition across every channel, from mass and brand campaigns to search, digital, PR, outbound and affiliate marketing. You will fire up every distribution and support vertical needed to move sales across our products and markets.
 



  





 What you will own:
 



  





 Brand Marketing
 



 • Be the custodian of the brand. What Sellability stands for rests on your shoulders, and that's a responsibility we take seriously.
 



 • Keep the brand alive and charismatic. Build campaigns that reinforce what we stand for and bring genuine creativity to how we talk to our customers.
 



 • Drive performance marketing: ideas and initiatives across offline and online campaigns that convert into new registrations, working closely with the performance marketing team. Agency \& Partner Management
 



 • Lead agency relationships with the confidence of someone who has run a top marketing team before. You know how to brief an agency and pull real creative output from them.
 



 • Manage digital influencers and turn them into creative, viral campaigns across social platforms. • Partner with content developers to build strong content across media platforms.
 



 • Handle offline media relationships, both content and advertising. Entrepreneurial Drive
 



 • Bring an entrepreneurial mindset to new initiatives and MARTECH. We've already launched community platforms and educational content platforms for our customers, and there's more to build.
 



 • Lead a team of designers, content writers and external freelancers to deliver stories that do justice to the brand.
 



 • Work cross\-functionally with business and functional teams, translating requirements into crisp, actionable briefs for your team and agencies.
 **Business Ownership** 




 • Build and run the SOPs for your department.
 



 • Own the annual marketing budget and its effective utilisation, including short and long\-term scheduling, media split and resourcing.
 



 • Conceptualise and execute campaigns end to end.
 



 • Plan, execute and monitor all ATL/BTL promotions, marketing database, digital, email, social and display advertising across the portfolio.
 



 • Build growth frameworks for long\-term planning and scalable solutions, while enabling rapid daily experimentation and micro\-optimisation.
 



 • Build team capability across our marketing tech stack, including experimentation, data and CRM platforms.
 



 • Design and run comprehensive test and measurement plans that improve the effectiveness of growth initiatives.
 



 • Build the planning function for growth, defining success metrics and tracking goals at a granular level.
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 • 12\-18 years of relevant experience in a dynamic, growing organisation, with strong proficiency across brand marketing, PR, content management, digital and performance marketing.
 



 • Tech savvy, with a strong grip on brand planning, consumer insights, market intelligence, business models and budget management across geographies.
 



 • A strategic mindset that sees the big picture and reads how environmental and organisational change affects the business. • Strong business acumen paired with high EQ.
 



 • Sound judgement, with integrity, compliance and confidentiality as non\-negotiables.
 



 • A self\-starter who can operate independently, set priorities and drive results with minimal supervision.
 



 • Excellent time management and the ability to multi\-task and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
 



 • Meticulous attention to detail while managing multiple stakeholders seamlessly.
 



 • Strong decision\-making with a genuine ownership mindset.
 



 • Someone who leads with process and data but adapts when the situation calls for it. You take initiative, collaborate freely, and care about growing the team and the culture around you as much as the numbers.
 



  





**Why Sellability** 




 • Growth without limits — Real leadership scope from day one: shape the brand strategy for a portfolio scaling toward INR 5000 Cr\+, with direct exposure to marquee developers and large\-scale launches.
 



 • Performance with rewards — A merit\-driven culture where your strategy, your calls and your outcomes are visible at the top, not buried in a hierarchy.
 



 • Collaborative culture — Work directly with founder\-level leadership, in a transparent, "one team" environment built for people who want to build, not just execute.
 



 • Purpose \& impact — Own the brand for one of the most ambitious portfolios in the market, with the mandate to redefine how real estate is sold and marketed in India.

title: Global Digital Marketing Manager - SEO/AEO/GEO
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 BCG.com is a highly trafficked web property, publishing hundreds of articles, reports, and perspectives annually. As AI\-powered search reshapes how decision\-makers discover and consume thought leadership, BCG is investing to ensure its content surfaces prominently—not just in traditional search, but across AI\-generated answers, featured snippets, and emerging generative engine results.
   

  

 We are seeking a Senior SEO/AEO/GEO resource who specializes in on\-site content discoverability, with a strong foundation in keyword research and strategic SEO planning. This role ensures that content is not only discoverable within the site, but also aligned to how users search, think, and navigate topics.
   

  

 You will act as a strategic partner to content, product, and marketing teams—translating keyword insights into content structures, internal linking systems, and scalable discoverability frameworks—and participate in hands\-on execution of search optimization on BCG.com.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Keyword Research \& Strategic SEO Leadership
   

  

* Lead comprehensive keyword research to identify user intent, topic clusters, and content opportunities
* Translate keyword insights into content strategies, site architecture, and taxonomy design
* Partner with stakeholders to prioritize content based on search demand, business value, and discoverability gaps
* Provide strategic guidance on:
+ Content creation and expansion opportunities
+ Topic clustering and pillar/cluster models
+ Search intent alignment across the content ecosystem


**Content Discoverability Strategy**
* Design and implement systems that ensure content is both searchable (externally) and findable (internally)
* Map keywords to content and ensure logical, scalable internal linking structures
* Identify and resolve gaps where content exists but is not aligned to high\-value search demand
* Align taxonomy, tagging, and categorization with keyword themes and user intent


**On\-Site SEO \& UX Optimization**
* Ensure content is structured to reflect target keywords and semantic relevance
* Optimize page templates for keyword clarity, content hierarchy), and scannability
* Improve navigation and related content modules using keyword relationships and topic modeling
* Implement structured data to reinforce content meaning


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* BA/BS in Digital Marketing, Marketing, Information Technology, or equivalent experience
* 5\-10 years of experience in search strategy and execution, preferably at a B2B organization
* Proven ability to translate keyword data into actionable business and content decisions
* Deep understanding of:
+ Search intent and SERP behavior
+ Topic clustering and semantic SEO
+ On\-page optimization and internal linking

* Experience with tools like:
+ Ahrefs, Semrush, or similar (advanced keyword research)
+ Google Search Console, GA4
+ Screaming Frog / Sitebulb

* Strong communication skills—able to advise and influence non\-SEO stakeholders


 Additional info
   

  

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**
 The ideal candidate for this role will have experience working in a fast\-paced global environment. They must be comfortable with ambiguity and default to action to drive toward critical objectives set to deliver on global strategy. A flexible mindset is important as the global marketing team continues to leverage new approaches to work and people management.
   

  

* Critical thinker and ability to problem solve and propose solutions
* Ability to navigate complex environment with many voices
* Serve as SME for leadership on importance of discoverability to marketing strategy
* Default to proactivity and responsibility for self and team\- you can work autonomously but seek help when necessary
* Excellent communication skills – both written and oral – to manage priorities, expectations, and communicate strategy and results directly to stakeholders. Must be comfortable presenting/explaining technical concepts to non\-technical teams
* Ability to measure the effectiveness of strategy and make strategic decisions based on data
* Ability to manage portfolio of projects and experience influencing cross\-functional teams


 At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
   

  

 For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
   

  

 We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Head of Marketing
description:
**About the Role:
 



  





 We are looking for an experienced Head of Marketing to lead our marketing function end\-to\-end — across offline and online channels — for a B2B organization operating in the infrastructure space. This is a strategic and hands\-on leadership role for someone who understands both traditional relationship\-driven B2B marketing (exhibitions, trade shows, industry events, print/collateral) as well as modern digital and lead\-generation practices.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will own the marketing strategy, build and lead a high\-performing team, manage external agency relationships, and work closely with sales to ensure a strong, qualified pipeline of leads.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 



  





 1\. Marketing Strategy \& Brand
 



 Develop and execute the overall marketing strategy aligned with business and sales goals, tailored to industry prospects and target accounts.
 



 Own brand positioning, messaging, and communication consistency across all channels — online and offline.
 



 Track industry trends, competitor activity, and market shifts to keep strategy relevant and ahead of the curve.
 



  





 2\. Lead Generation \& Sales Enablement
 



 Lead and mentor the in\-house lead generation team; set targets, review performance, and continuously optimize the funnel.
 



 Build and manage a healthy pipeline of qualified leads for the sales team through multiple channels (outbound, inbound, events, referrals, partnerships).
 



 Work closely with the sales leadership to align on lead quality, handoff process, feedback loops, and conversion tracking.
 



 Own and improve CRM/marketing funnel reporting to measure lead\-to\-conversion effectiveness.
 



  





 3\. Events \& Offline Marketing
 



 Plan and manage participation in industry exhibitions, trade shows, conferences, and networking events.
 



 Oversee stall/booth design, collateral, logistics, and on\-ground team coordination for events.
 



 Build relationships with industry bodies, associations, and event organizers to maximize visibility and lead capture.
 



 Manage offline marketing assets — brochures, catalogues, case studies, signage, and print media.
 



  





 4\. Digital \& Online Marketing
 



 Oversee website, SEO/SEM, email marketing, and online lead\-capture initiatives.
 



 Manage and guide social media presence and content strategy (in coordination with agency/in\-house team).
 



 Monitor digital campaign performance and ROI, and adjust strategy based on data.
 



  





 5\. Agency \& Vendor Management
 



 Identify, onboard, and manage external agencies and vendors — social media, PR, design, digital advertising, event management, etc.
 



 Set clear briefs, timelines, and KPIs for agencies; review deliverables regularly for quality and ROI.
 



 Negotiate contracts and manage marketing budgets across agencies and channels.
 



  





 6\. Team Leadership
 



 Build, mentor, and manage an in\-house marketing team including lead generation executives, content/design resources, and digital marketers.
 



 Set individual and team KPIs; conduct regular performance reviews.
 



 Foster a culture of accountability, creativity, and continuous improvement.
 



  





 7\. Budgeting \& Reporting
 



 Own the marketing budget across offline and online channels; ensure optimal allocation and spend efficiency.
 



 Report regularly to leadership on marketing performance, lead generation metrics, event ROI, and overall pipeline contribution.
 



  





  





 Requirements:
 



  





 Experience: 8–15 years in B2B marketing, with at least 3–5 years in a leadership role managing a team.
 



  





 Industry Background: Prior experience in \[industry — e.g., manufacturing, industrial equipment, chemicals, engineering, etc.] preferred.
 



  





 Proven Track Record in:
 



 Managing exhibitions/trade shows and offline marketing
 



 Leading a lead generation function and driving measurable pipeline growth
 



 Coordinating with external agencies (social media, digital, PR, design)
 



 Building marketing strategy for long sales\-cycle, relationship\-driven B2B industries
 



  





 Skills:
 



 Strong strategic thinking combined with hands\-on execution capability
 



 Excellent stakeholder management — internal teams, sales, leadership, and external agencies/vendors
 



 Data\-driven approach to measuring marketing and lead\-gen effectiveness
 



 Strong communication, negotiation, and vendor management skills
 



 Comfortable balancing traditional B2B marketing (events, print, relationships) with digital channels
 



  





 Education: MBA/PG in Marketing or related field preferred.
 



  





 What Success Looks Like in This Role:
 



 A steady, high\-quality pipeline of qualified leads flowing into the sales team.
 



 Strong brand visibility and positioning across offline (exhibitions, industry events) and online channels.
 



 Well\-managed, high\-ROI agency partnerships.
 



 A capable, motivated in\-house marketing and lead\-gen team.
 



 Marketing spend that is efficient, tracked, and tied to business outcomes.**

 We are looking for a growth\-oriented SaaS SEO professional who understands how organic traffic translates into pipeline, demos, and revenue.

* Drive organic growth through a combination of SEO, content, and conversion optimization initiatives.

* 3 years of experience in SEO, content marketing, growth marketing, or a related role.

* Ability to connect organic traffic efforts to measurable business outcomes such as leads, demos, signups, or revenue.

* Build scalable SEO and content growth frameworks.
* Help both Shipturtle and its customers achieve measurable organic growth outcomes.

title: Head of Branding & Communication
description:

title: Principal Systems Engr

Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.  



Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.


Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.

:
  
Job Summary
  
  

* Group Internal Audit and Investigations (GIAI) is looking for an accomplished and highly motivated audit professional with a robust background and strong expertise around the key risks and controls in the Human Resources (HR); Corporate Affairs Brand and Marketing (CABM) and Strategy portfolio which fall within the wider Functions and Group Chief Operating Officer (GCOO) portfolios..
* The role\-holder will be an integral part of the Functions and GCOO Audit teams. The team provides independent assessments of risk management and internal control environment of HR, CABM and Strategy globally.
* We pride ourselves in being auditors of the future, forward\-looking and agile with a keen focus on smarter auditing. When you join us, you will enter a role that challenges the status quo and moves mindsets and be a part of the future of banking


Key Responsibilities
  
  

Strategy
  
* Support Audit Directors and Senior Audit Managers where required, in the development of the GIA risk assessment and development of an appropriate audit plan for the HR, CABM and Strategy portfolio;
* Propose audits for coverage during the audit cycle based on their knowledge of the business;
* Audits assigned to the individual in the audit plan should address the key risks identified in the detailed risk assessment and in the audit planning process and meet relevant regulatory requirements and expectations that are required to be covered by GIAI.
* Ensure that audit team operates in line with the Audit Charter during engagements, remains independent from management and free from interference.
* Build the knowledge, awareness and confidence across the GIAI teams so that over time, support for HR, CABM and Strategy audits outside of the GCOO and Functions team can be tailored to need and that functional and product teams are confident in completing relevant audit tests.


Business
  
* Effectively manage the cost of assigned audits within the allocated budget for their areas within audit engagements


Processes
  
* To act as Team Lead/ Team Member on assigned audit work across the Group.
* Provide technical input and challenge on audit work being undertaken within the scope of assigned product area of responsibility. This will include working with the audit team to produce outputs of high quality which address the areas of greatest risk.
* When Team Leading to provide clear guidance, detailed review and supervision of the audit team’s work so that audit deliverables meet quality standards and timelines in line with the GIA methodology.
* When Team Leading to provide guidance on business/audit technical knowledge and management skills to team members to enable them to effectively deliver their assigned contributions for an audit.
* Support adherence to the GIA methodology in all areas of the audit engagement, as well as raising awareness and understanding of the methodology.
* Demonstrate sound knowledge of both business/technical areas and expert knowledge in the audit process, including the GIAI system, so that audit work is carried out to a high standard that meets all methodology and GIAI system requirements.
* Monitor the implementation/delivery of the agreed issues/audit plans for the audits assigned, understanding the key risks arising, provide advice on resolution of issues to auditees/action plan owners and escalate audit findings that remain unresolved.
* Demonstrates strong foundational analytics skills, with the ability to independently design, execute and interpret data driven audit tests. Proficient in using data analytics tools (e.g., SQL, Python, Excel advanced functions, Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent) to support audit planning, fieldwork and continuous monitoring activities.


Analytics Responsibilities
  
* Apply data and analytics techniques during the audit cycle for better efficiency and effectiveness
* Contribute to the design and implementation of effective continuous monitoring and automated testing strategies using analytics
* Work with key stakeholders to understand data flow, data points for key systems relevant to the audit portfolio


People \& Talent
  
* Share knowledge to increase specialism within the function.
* Influence change within the department by highlighting potential enhancements.
* Identify growth areas on an ongoing basis and identify how best to develop them.
* When Team Leading provide performance feedback, as appropriate at the end of an audit.
* Identify and successfully complete key internal training for self\-development.
* Facilitate the development of audit team members by providing on the job training and recommending formal training to support GIAI activities.


Risk Management
  
* Assist in the update of the assigned Continuous Risk Assessment on a regular basis to identify changes in risk profiles and document these in a timely manner, proposing changes to the assigned audit plan, as appropriate.
* Promote early identification and escalation of risks, issues, trends and developments to relevant stakeholders. Be prepared to raise issues/concerns outside the normal audit process.
* Adopt an anticipatory approach to risk assessment through stakeholder engagement and monitoring of the external environment to improve audit planning; and
* Review MI and reports regularly to keep up\-to\-date with key trends within the business and audit deliverables.


Governance
  
* Manage the relevant portfolio stakeholders and establish good working relationships to help the businesses improve the control environment and keep updated with changes in the business impacting their risk profile.
* Use networks and relationships to build engagement and achieve results.
* Escalate delays in the execution of audit work, both to auditee management and GIA Management.
* Be able to clearly explain issues identified along with the risks and root causes to GIA and business management, using language designed to be understood by non\-experts


Regulatory \& Business Conduct
  
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.


Key stakeholders
  
* Designated business stakeholders, typically related to assigned portfolio; and
* GIAI stakeholders – team leaders, team members, team managers, Audit Directors, Senior Audit Directors.


Other Responsibilities
  
* Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in GIA; and
* Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.


Skills and Experience
  
  

* GIA Methodology and Systems
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Risk Assessment
* Audit Planning
* Audit Report Writing
* Continuous Monitoring
* Ability to work within a global team
* Data analysis
* Data insights (generation and interpretation)
* Basic Tools (MS Excel, Power BI etc.)


Qualifications
  
  

* Experience in Audit, Governance, Risk or business environment.
* Professional Audit or Accounting Certification preferred
* Good Communicator, both written and verbal, with an ability to influence and gain respect of senior management, stakeholders, peers and their teams.
* Confident and courageous to raise / escalate issues in a pro active, professional and timely manner.
* Self\-directed and able to work with minimum supervisions
* Demonstrates understanding and commitment to the Group’s Core Values
* Familiarity with Banking Regulations,
* Working experience with analytics/visualisation tools such as PowerBI, Tableau, or similar tools, and is able interpret and generate data insights using data visualisation
* Certifications around analytics and AI/Gen AI will be an advantage


About Standard Chartered
  
  

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
  
  

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

description:
### **Role Overview**


We are looking for a strategic, high\-impact **Product Marketing Manager (PMM)** to own the end\-to\-end go\-to\-market strategy for IRIS CARBON’s SaaS compliance solutions. Positioned at the intersection of Product Management, Demand Generation, and Direct Sales, you will translate complex financial/ESG regulatory requirements into compelling value propositions, high\-converting enablement assets, and category\-defining campaigns.### **Key Responsibilities**

**Go\-to\-Market Strategy \& Launches**  

* Architect and execute global GTM frameworks for core XBRL/iXBRL reporting solutions and emerging ESG compliance modules.
* Define precise ICPs, buyer personas (CFOs, Controllers, ESG Directors, Legal Compliance), and value messaging frameworks tailored to global regulatory shifts.

**Sales Enablement \& Content Strategy**  

* Equip enterprise sales and demand generation teams with high\-impact pitch decks, competitor battlecards, ROI calculators, case studies, and demo scripts.
* Collaborate closely with Sales Development \+ Sales Team(s) to build customized content streams for high\-value strategic accounts.

* Monitor evolving global taxonomy shifts and regulatory mandates (SEC, ESEF, CSRD, FERC) to continuously refine IRIS CARBON’s market positioning.
* Conduct win/loss analyses and competitive benchmarking to identify growth opportunities and feature gaps.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**  

* Partner with Product Management to align feature roadmaps with buyer demands and deliver clear customer communication during release cycles.
* Work with Digital Marketing and Campaign Ops to design campaign messaging that drives pipeline growth and accelerates enterprise deal velocity.

### **What We Are Looking For**

* **Experience:** 4\+ years of B2B SaaS Product Marketing experience (enterprise FinTech, RegTech, Corporate Finance, or Governance/Risk/Compliance background preferred).
* **Domain Exposure:** Familiarity with corporate financial reporting, XBRL/iXBRL tagging workflows, or regulatory technology platforms is a strong advantage.
* **Core Competencies:** Exceptional positioning/messaging capability, data\-informed decision\-making, and a proven track record of enabling direct B2B enterprise sales teams.
* **Location:** Based in or willing to work out of our Hyderabad or Mumbai office(s), collaborating across North American and European business hours as needed.

### **About IRIS CARBON®**


IRIS CARBON® is a leading cloud\-based SaaS platform designed to streamline corporate reporting and regulatory disclosure management. We empower enterprises across North America, Europe, and Asia\-Pacific to fulfill complex compliance mandates—including SEC, ESEF, FERC, and global ESG/sustainability reporting—with precision, automation, and structured tagging technologies (iXBRL/XBRL).

title: D2C Head
description:
**Location:** 
 Mumbai (in\-office)
 



**Function:** 
 D2C Growth \& Performance Marketing
 



**Reports to:** 
 Founders
 



  





 Earthful is a plant\-based nutrition brand for women's health, backed by Fireside Ventures and V3 Ventures. This is a leadership role: you'll own the D2C (earthful.me) growth number end to end, and build the team behind it as the channel scales — not just run campaigns, but decide where the channel goes next.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 This role leads Earthful's D2C growth engine — full ownership of the website's revenue number, driven through performance marketing, conversion optimization, and a high\-velocity creative pipeline. You'll be directly accountable for hitting D2C growth targets set in the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), decide how budget is allocated across products, and build the team needed to scale that ownership over time. You'll work closely with the organic/content team, the creative team, and the website team — this starts as a hands\-on individual role, but is expected to grow into leading a small team as the channel scales.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




**D2C Revenue Growth \& Ownership** 




 • Own the D2C (earthful.me) revenue number end\-to\-end, driven primarily through performance marketing across Meta, Google, and other paid channels
 



 • Be directly accountable for hitting D2C growth targets set in the AOP
 



 • Coordinate with the organic/content team so paid and organic efforts reinforce each other rather than working at cross purposes
 



**Creative Pipeline for Performance** 




 • Direct the creative team's output for performance — a steady flow of new hooks, angles, and formats
 



 • Run structured creative testing across campaigns
 



 • Brief the next round of creative based on what the data shows is actually working
 



**Budget, ROAS \& Site Conversion** 




 • Decide how budget is allocated across products — what to scale up, what to scale down, and the ROAS target for each
 



 • Own website conversion end\-to\-end — landing page CVR, checkout drop\-off, and AOV — directing the website team's roadmap around what actually moves conversion
 



 • Own the full D2C P\&L view — revenue, ad spend, and contribution margin — not just a topline growth number
 



**Team Building \& Leadership** 




 • Build and lead a small performance marketing/growth team as the D2C channel scales — this starts as a hands\-on, individual role but is expected to grow into managing others
 



 • Set the growth roadmap and testing cadence for the function, not just execute your own campaigns
 



**Cross\-Functional (Suggested Additions)** 




 • Track CAC and LTV alongside channel\-level ROAS, so budget decisions aren't driven by vanity metrics that look good in a single channel but don't hold up at the business level
 



 • Coordinate with Supply Chain on demand forecasting tied to growth targets — aggressive scaling only works if inventory can back it up
 



 • Maintain a structured testing roadmap/calendar for creative and channel experiments, rather than running tests ad hoc
 



**Optional Scope Extensions (decide before posting)** 




 • Own or co\-own retention/CRM levers (email, WhatsApp, repeat purchase) — a natural extension if you want this role to cover full\-funnel D2C, not just acquisition and conversion
 



 • Weigh in on on\-site pricing and promotions strategy, since these directly affect conversion and AOV
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 • Ideally has been part of a D2C/e\-commerce brand's growth or marketing team during a scale\-up phase — joining when revenue was roughly ₹0–30 Cr and helping scale it to ₹100 Cr or more
 



 • MBA from a top\-tier B\-school strongly preferred, with 4–6\+ years of post\-MBA experience in performance marketing or growth; candidates without an MBA but with 6–8\+ years of hands\-on growth experience at a D2C/e\-commerce brand will also be considered
 



 • At least 2\+ years of experience owning a full P\&L or AOP\-style revenue number, not just executing campaigns for someone else's target
 



 • Direct, hands\-on experience running and optimizing paid campaigns on Meta and Google Ads — not just briefing or managing an agency
 



 • Prior experience building or leading a team, or clear readiness to do so as the role grows — this is a leadership\-track role, not a purely individual\-contributor one
 



 • Comfortable making budget allocation calls across multiple products, trading off scale versus ROAS
 



 • Understanding of website conversion levers (CVR, checkout drop\-off, AOV) and experience working with a website/CRO team
 



 • Strong analytical and Excel skills — comfortable building and interpreting performance dashboards.

description:
**POSITION:** Sales \& Marketing Executive
  

**REPORTS TO:** Project Manager – Annapurna


**LOCATION:**Thane / Pune / Raigad (one per district)
  

**LEVEL/GRADE:** Coordinator (ECC)


**About ACCESS:**
  

ACCESS Development Services is a national livelihoods promotion organization that incubates innovations and builds sustainable models of livelihood promotion for the poor — implementing programmes on the ground (Tier I); partnering civil society, government, the corporate sector and multilateral agencies (Tier II); and shaping national policy and the enabling environment (Tier III). Headquartered in New Delhi, ACCESS works across 14 project offices. More at www.accessdev.org


**Project Summary:**  

Annapurna – Catalysing Women Entrepreneurship in Food Processing is a 36\+3\-month initiative supported by Bajaj Holdings \& Investment Limited, administered by the Bajaj Finserv CSR team, running from 1 August 2026 to 31 October 2029\. It works with 12,000 women from 1,200 Self Help Groups across 15 blocks of Thane, Pune and Raigad districts of Maharashtra — 4,000 women, 400 SHGs and 5 Annapurna Resource Centres (ARCs) per district, each ARC serving about 80 SHGs through centralised (at\-ARC) and decentralised (home\-based) support. Maharashtra State Rural Livelihoods Mission (UMED) is proposed as a facilitation partner.


**Position Summary:**  

One Officer per district builds the demand side of Annapurna — moving product out of five ARCs into real, repeatable markets. The role covers channel development, buyer relationships, exhibitions and government e\-marketplaces, packaging and brand execution, and order\-to\-delivery discipline. ACCESS is looking for someone who has actually sold food products and can work patiently with first\-generation women entrepreneurs on quality, cost and timelines.


**Responsibilities:**

**1\. Market Development and Sales**


* Map buyers, channels and price points for the project’s value chains; build a live pipeline of institutional, retail, aggregator and channel\-partner buyers
* Secure and service access to SARAS, e\-SARAS, Umed Mart, GeM, Womaniya and state exhibition platforms through UMED facilitation
* Negotiate and document buyer terms — volume, price, quality specification, delivery, payment cycle and return liability
* Plan and execute district and state exhibitions, melas, buyer\-seller meets and B2B events
**2\. Product, Packaging and Brand**


* Work with the Production Coordinator to convert buyer requirements into product specification, grammage, shelf\-life and price
* Coordinate packaging, labelling and the product catalogue in line with FSSAI labelling and legal metrology requirements, and execute the project brand at point of sale — the brand is held by a community institution or producer entity, with ACCESS as custodian during the project term
**3\. Transaction Discipline and Reporting**


* Ensure every sale is transacted by the community institution or enterprise group. Sales revenue must not pass through ACCESS accounts at any stage.
* Maintain buyer agreements, order registers and market transaction records as project means of verification
* Support enterprise\-level costing so that women see gross margin, not just turnover, and report monthly on orders, dispatches, realisation and receivables
**Education \& Experience::**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA or PG in Marketing, Agribusiness or Rural Management preferred
* 3–5 years in sales, distribution or rural marketing, with 3\+ years handling food, FMCG, agri\-processed or SHG/handicraft products
* Hands\-on experience of retail or institutional listing, exhibition sales, and/or e\-commerce, ONDC or GeM onboarding; prior work with FPOs, SHG federations or producer collectives is a strong advantage
* Working familiarity with FSSAI labelling, legal metrology, GST and GTIN/barcoding for packaged food
**Skills and Competencies:**

* Fluency in Marathi essential, with working Hindi and English
* Real negotiation ability and a buyer network that can be called on from day one
* Numerate — comfortable with landed cost, margin, credit period and working capital
* Patience to build the seller’s capability rather than bypass her; two\-wheeler with valid license
**Travel Requirement:**

Market and field travel within and outside the assigned district; 15\+ field days a month.


**Compensation:**

The salary range for this position is commensurate with industry standards and will be determined based upon the experience set of the candidate and the HR policies of the organization.

One Coordinator per district holds technical responsibility for what is made in that district’s five ARCs and how safely it is made — process standardisation, food safety, quality assurance, shelf\-life, packaging and statutory licensing of each facility. This is the technical conscience of the project: the person who decides whether a batch goes to market.


**Responsibilities:**

**1\. Process, Product and Quality**


* Develop and document SOPs, process flows, recipes, yields and product costing for each assigned value chain
* Establish QA protocols, in\-process checks, batch records, traceability and the inventory register at every ARC
* Plan and interpret shelf\-life studies and accredited\-lab testing; set storage and distribution conditions
* Specify, commission and maintain processing equipment; run preventive maintenance and calibration
**2\. Food Safety and Licensing**


* Support each operating Cluster Level Federation, SHG or enterprise group to obtain and maintain FSSAI registration or licence in its own name for its own premises. No food business under this project will operate on a licence held by any other entity.
* Serve as, or train and certify, the Food Safety Supervisor at each facility; deliver FoSTaC\-aligned hygiene and food safety training
* Establish and rehearse product recall, complaint handling and non\-conforming product procedures, and ensure compliance with FSSAI labelling, legal metrology and packaging requirements
**3\. Capability Building and Coordination**


* Train Centre\-cum\-Cluster Coordinators and women entrepreneurs in production, quality and hygiene practice
* Work with the Sales \& Marketing Officer to meet buyer specifications on quality, grammage, packaging and delivery
* Maintain production, quality and equipment records for the project MIS
**Education \& Experience::**

* Tech / M.Tech / M.Sc. in Food Technology, Food Science, Food Processing, Food Engineering or Dairy Technology
* 3–5 years in a food processing unit, common facility centre or food QA/QC function, with hands\-on plant\-floor experience — not laboratory experience alone
* Has obtained an FSSAI registration or licence and faced a food safety audit or inspection
* FoSTaC\-certified Food Safety Supervisor, or willing to certify within three months of joining
* Experience in dry and low\-moisture categories — spices and masalas, snacks and farsan, papad, pickles, millet and bakery — preferred; SHG\-run unit experience is a strong advantage
**Skills and Competencies:**

* Working Marathi essential, with Hindi and English
* Can teach a process to a first\-generation entrepreneur who has no technical vocabulary
* Firmness on food safety, including the willingness to reject a batch and be unpopular for it
* Methodical on batch records, deviations and corrective action; two\-wheeler with valid license
**Travel Requirement:**

Rotational travel across the five ARCs of the assigned district; 15\+ field days a month.


**Compensation:**

The salary range for this position is commensurate with industry standards and will be determined based upon the experience set of the candidate and the HR policies of the organization.

 End\-to\-end enablement, processes and tools

 Strategic Initiatives/Other

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:
Startup \& ISV Manager
 



**Location \-** 
 Delhi NCR/Bengaluru
 



  





  





 India's AI economy is being built right now — and the startups and ISVs at the centre of it need infrastructure that scales with their ambition. At Yotta, we are looking for someone who can own the GTM motion for this segment end\-to\-end: from shaping how we position ourselves in the startup ecosystem, to closing the deals that put Yotta's GPU cloud at the heart of the next generation of AI\-native companies.
 



 This is a commercially driven role with strategic depth. You will define how Yotta shows up for founders and product teams, build the relationships that convert early conversations into long\-term platform commitments, and work across functions to ensure our messaging, campaigns, and outreach are consistently sharp and effective.
 



 What You Will Do
 


* Define and evolve Yotta's GTM approach for the startup and ISV segment — including positioning, messaging, target profiles, and channel strategy.
* Build and manage a portfolio of accounts across growth stages, structuring the right commercial engagements and ensuring long\-term platform retention.
* Drive pipeline through well\-timed campaigns, ecosystem partnerships, and direct outreach to Founders, CTOs, and product leadership.
* Work on and refine content narratives and sales assets — collateral, thought leadership, and technical proof points — that help the Yotta story land with technical and business buyers alike.
* Cultivate relationships with the VC and startup incubator/accelerator ecosystem — to get Yotta in front of portfolio companies early.
* Collaborate with Solutions, Product, and Marketing teams to ensure what we promise in the market reflects what we deliver.
* Identify ISV co\-sell opportunities and structure joint GTM motions with software platforms embedding Yotta into their customer stack.
* Track pipeline, forecast accurately, and continuously evaluate what is working — optimising based on data and market feedback, not instinct alone.



  





 What We're Looking For
 



 We want someone who can think strategically and stay close to execution — not one or the other. The Indian startup ecosystem rewards people who move fast, speak credibly, and follow through.
 


* 6–10 years in enterprise or startup sales, GTM, growth, or ecosystem roles within cloud, SaaS, or technology infrastructure.
* Strong grasp of B2B SaaS and cloud ecosystems — how buying decisions get made, how budgets move, and how infrastructure fits into a startup's build vs. buy calculus.
* Ability to craft messaging and positioning that resonates — with a technical CTO and a commercial CFO in the same conversation.
* Existing relationships in the Indian startup ecosystem, whether through prior roles, community involvement, or investor networks.
* Experience in early\-stage or high\-growth environments where you have built process, not just followed it.
* Data\-driven mindset — focused on outcomes, not just activity.
* Comfort operating across functions and driving alignment without relying on hierarchy to get things done.

Support and participate in marketing initiatives such as seminars, webinars, conferences, exhibitions and customer engagement programs.

Gather and communicate customer feedback, market intelligence, competitive insights and new business opportunities to relevant internal teams.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Strong interpersonal, presentation, negotiation and relationship management skills.

Analytical thinking with strong problem\-solving abilities.

Effective planning, organizational and time management skills.

Customer\-focused with a high level of professionalism and integrity.

description:

India Sales
**Experience:**
5\-10 Years
**Location:**
India
**About Tally**
The pioneers of software product industry in India, we are a technology and innovation led company simplifying the lives of small and medium businesses over the last three decades. With our cutting\-edge technology, we have had the privilege to reach over 2\.5 million business globally and cater to more than 7 million users in over 100 countries. We are passionate about the SMEs’ growth and aim to deliver the best for their business through our product innovation and excellence. Our teams develop some of the most ingenious solutions that suit the unique requirements of millions of businesses across the globe. With a market share of 75% in India, we have a strong foothold in the Middle East and are also serving customers in SAARC \& APAC, Africa, and North America. Our robust network of 28000\+ partners help us deliver unmatched customer experience in sales, support, and services globally.  

With a sole purpose of Making Everyone Who Touches Tally, Happier, we aim to be the technology fabric that drives the economic growth of the world, by 2030\.


**Culture \& Values**
Over the years, we have nurtured a value\-based culture that let individuals follow their lead and support them in their growth journey with us. We value honesty and integrity, prioritize a people\-first culture, pursue excellence, and drive impactful innovation with simplicity.  

Our vision at Tally is to ensure that all employees get access to equal opportunities, with decisions grounded on performance, merit, competence, and potential. We are dedicated to fairness and transparency in our policies. By fostering diversity and equality, we strive to eliminate all forms of discrimination. We are committed to an inclusive leadership where our leaders ensure that our people are empowered to be at their best, professionally, and personally. We take great pride in our work culture which has helped become a proud member of the elite Kincentric Best Employers Club!


**India Sales**
India Sales function within Tally focuses on driving high quality customer engagement at scale. We are enthusiastic and growth focused team who support in building great brand experiences for customers and partners. Our sales experts work closely with the Partner ecosystem to ensure consistent delivery of delightful customer experiences and collaborative associations across geography.



We are obsessed with the voice of our customers to fuel product innovation and profitable growth of our partners. You will get to coordinate with our partners by meeting new people and building a lasting relationship with the best tech sales team in the country.


### **We believe in**


* **Build:** A profitable partner ecosystem mentored to be enthusiastic, domain expert, customer centric.
* **Drive:** Consistent Tally way of sales embracing consultative selling approach for delivering uniform brand experience.
* **Empower:** Automate and enable small and medium enterprises with \#Magicoftally to fully participate in India growth story.
* **Equip:** Be the most effective source of Voice of Customer (VoC) for Product Innovation team and Marketing.


**What You Will Own**
As a Business Manager (BM) in the Business Development function, one is responsible for the P\&L ownership of the assigned Certified Partners (CP) in the respective territory.



Being a part of the Customer Centric organization, a BM should be able to help the assigned Certified Partners to create long\-term and short\-term Business Plans and identify key initiatives for the defined period which are going to impact and increase customer satisfaction, directly or indirectly. This includes what the partner aspires for and what should be the key focus areas of activities that will take the Certified Partner reach the aspiration within the set timeline.


**Where Your Expertise Meets Our Future**
* Experience in customer engagement and SME business.
* Expertise of managing a team and creating and working for the development of the team members as a well\-wisher.
* Knowledge of creating business plans and product expertise, evaluating, and analysing a company’s financial data to arrive at a conclusion or identify opportunities.
* Complete understanding of B2B purchasing behaviours and their market.
* Good understanding of the organization’s policies and processes related to customer and partner business groups.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Understanding of Software and the market in India.
**The Scope of Your Influence*** Identify and define issues and the relevant solution to designated partners and the internal team – scoping, analyzing, preparing, and presenting the overall solutions.
* Own execution and improvement of the planned initiatives through consistent interventions.
* Champion changes and effectively manage implementation of new ideas or programs aligned with company’s strategic goals.
* Identify areas of development for Partners and their team members and plan for the necessary upskilling. Help and support the CPs to have agreed common and aligned initiatives and focus areas with defined and established impacts and possible outcomes.
* Spend considerable quality time with the CP organization owner and the team members regularly for which there can be necessary travelling out of the headquarter town in the respective geography for 10 to 15 days in a month.
* Ensure complete understanding of partner’s way of operations – major source of business, methods of lead generation, conversion ratio, profile of customers, type of customers, internal capability, capacity, and all other factors that impacts the daily operation and efficiency for delivering best business results.
* Regular structured business reviews must be undertaken to examine the progress and do necessary corrections wherever required to achieve the set plans. Close working with the team members is very crucial to understand the individuals and their areas of competencies and upskilling requirements and plan for necessary trainings and input accordingly.
* A BM must have a complete understanding of the CP’s past business trend, key line of business and aligned objectives that is to be worked upon to achieve the goals.
* A BM also needs to have a clear understanding about the expansion opportunities for the CP in future and create a timebound plan with the partner with necessary activities and set milestones to check the progress.

title: Director, Commercial Strategy // Technology, Media & Telecommunications Insights
description:
Portage Point Partners is a Chicago\-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle\-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States.
   

  

 The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround \& Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution\-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transitions and transformations.
   

  

 Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm’s platform, established to build a high\-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.\-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long\-term growth in a high\-performance environment.
   

  

 The Commercial Strategy team is responsible for optimizing the firm’s go\-to\-market strategy, commercial operations and business development infrastructure. The team partners closely with firm leadership and practice leaders to drive revenue growth, enhance client engagement, improve pipeline visibility and strengthen decision\-making through technology, data and process optimization. By leveraging platforms such as Intapp DealCloud and related business systems, the Commercial Strategy team delivers scalable solutions that improve collaboration, increase operational efficiency and support the firm’s continued expansion.
   

  

 The Director, Commercial Strategy // Technology, Media \& Telecommunications (TMT) Insights is a credentialed industry Subject Matter Expert (SME) who owns the commercial agenda for the TMT vertical within the firm's Commercial Enablement (CE) function. Reporting to the Head of Commercial Enablement, this leader is the firm's sector SME and the source of market insight that equips MDs, Practice Line Leaders (PLLs) and Account Teams to drive origination in the sector.
   

  

 The role owns the vertical's commercial point of view (POV) – the market updates, sector analysis and origination\-focused thought leadership that position the firm with prospects and clients – working closely with PLLs, MDs, Account Teams and Marketing to translate that insight into firm\-facing content and external presence.
   

  

 Success is measured by the firm's positioning in the TMT sector, the quality and timeliness of the vertical's commercial intelligence, its presence in firm marketing and external content, and the degree to which market\-facing teams treat the vertical as the firm's authoritative source for sector insight.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the commercial agenda for the TMT vertical, serving as the firm’s sector SME
* Partner with senior team members across the firm to drive recurring deliverables, including sector POVs, quarterly outlooks, market maps, origination theses, account whitespace analysis, MD briefing packs and pitch / proposal support
* Equip MDs, PLLs and Account Teams with the sector context and briefings needed to pursue whitespace and cross\-sell opportunities ahead of priority meetings and pursuits
* Monitor industry trends, market signals and competitive dynamics specific to the TMT sector and translate them into actionable commercial direction
* Support business development efforts with sector\-specific positioning, insight and supporting analysis
* Provide expertise to maintain a credible external presence in the TMT sector by developing materials and content to be used for bylined content, conference participation and other public\-facing channels
* Partner with Marketing to align vertical content, campaigns and external presence with firm go\-to\-market strategy and thought leadership
* Coordinate with peer industry vertical leaders to maintain a consistent commercial POV format and cadence across the CE function
* Partner with the VP, Account and VP, Pipeline to ensure sector insight is reflected in account plans and pursuit strategy
* Share and manage best practices as well as lead internal trainings where required
* Support talent acquisition and firm development efforts
* Contribute to creating a high\-performing and inclusive culture


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree from a top undergraduate program required
* Willing to relocate to or be primarily present in Gurgaon
* 10 plus years in the TMT sector, in commercial strategy, business development, consulting, investment banking or an industry\-facing advisory role
* Recognized subject matter expertise in TMT, with a credible origination, investment banking or advisory track record in that sector
* Demonstrated track record of producing credible, market\-facing commercial content for an external audience
* Experience operating within professional services, consulting, investment banking or private equity environments
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and a process\- and ownership\-oriented mindset
* Strong project management and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience within the middle market private equity and advisory ecosystem, preferably serving U.S. clients
* Familiarity with Intapp DealCloud, HubSpot or equivalent commercial platforms preferred
* Experience producing thought leadership or market commentary published in industry\-recognized channels preferred
* Superior written and verbal communication, including executive\-ready presentation and reporting, with the ability to influence stakeholder and work effectively across technical and non\-technical teams
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast\-moving teams
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
* Track record of success in high\-pressure, client\-facing environments

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
