title: Ecommerce Lead
description:
**About the Role** 




 This is a P\&L\-owning mandate to build and scale the Beauty.coms \& other marketplaces. across our brand portfolio. The person will lead a cross\-functional team of KAMs and performance marketers and carry direct accountability for close to a third of the company's total e\-commerce business.
 



 This is not a caretaker role. We need someone who can sit inside genuine ambiguity, shifting algorithms, unclear ownership lines? and still drive a sharp, numbers\-backed plan forward. Equally, this is a high\-stakes relationship seat: the person will be the face of the business to some of the most demanding, tough negotiating counterparts in Indian e\-commerce, and needs to be able to hold their own without burning the relationship.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. P\&L Ownership \& Commercial Management** 




 \- Own the full P\&L for the beauty.coms portfolio \& other marketplaces across all brands.
 



 \- Drive topline growth without trading away contribution margin, pricing, trade terms, marketing spend efficiency, returns/RTO.
 



 \- Run quarterly and annual business planning: revenue targets, margin targets, and investment allocation across platforms and brands.
 



 \- Own the key commercial levers end\-to\-end: ASP, discounting, platform fees/commissions, marketing ROI, inventory health? and be answerable for movement in each.
 



  





**2\. Analytical Rigor \& Reporting** 




 \- Build a real\-time, no\-blind\-spots view of performance? platform\-wise, brand\-wise, SKU\-wise.
 



 \- Convert raw data (sales, ad spend, funnel metrics, competitive benchmarks) into decisions, not just decks.
 



 \- Diagnose performance dips from first principles \- never accept a platform's explanation at face value.
 



  





**3\. Problem Solving in Ambiguity** 




 \- Operate comfortably where the playbook doesn't exist yet ?? new platforms, shifting policies, unclear internal ownership.
 



 \- Identify and act on growth levers across platforms ?? new brand launches, category expansion, platform\-exclusive programs.
 



 \- Get ahead of algorithm/policy shifts and competitive moves rather than reacting to them.
 



 \- Cut through complexity fast ?? make a call with 80% information rather than waiting for the last 20%.
 



  





**4\. Relationship Management at the Highest Stakes** 




 \- Own senior relationships with category and business heads at Nykaa, Myntra, Tira, and other key platforms ?? this is the most demanding part of the role and needs someone who can genuinely excel at it, not just survive it.
 



 \- Negotiate trade terms, marketing budgets, and visibility placements firmly, without burning the relationship.
 



 \- Manage difficult, ego\-heavy counterparts ?? internal and external ?? with equal parts spine and tact.
 



 \- Know precisely when to hold a line and when to build the other side an exit that lets them save face.
 



  





**5\. Team Leadership** 




 \- Lead and develop a team of Key Account Managers and Performance Marketing professionals.
 



 \- Set clear goals, review cadences, and coaching plans; raise the bar on analytical and commercial thinking across the team.
 



 \- Build a culture of ownership: the team should operate like founders of their respective platforms.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 Criteria \| Requirement
 



 Designation: DGM / GM (preferred)
 



 Experience \| 8\+ years, with direct experience in Beauty x E\-commerce, either from the brand side (D2C/FMCG e\-commerce team) or the retailer/platform side.
 



  





 Education \| MBA \|
 



 Core strength 1 \| Demonstrated ability to handle ambiguity and complexity? must have operated without a fixed playbook, not just executed an existing one.
 



  





 Core strength 2 \| Must peak on complex relationship management? this role lives or dies on the person's ability to manage tough, high\-ego counterparts at the senior\-most level.
 



  





**Additional Requirements** 




 \- Demonstrated ownership of a multi\-crore P\&L, accountable for both growth and margin? not just topline.
 



 \- Strong analytical muscle, comfortable building models, dissecting data, and drawing conclusions independently.
 



 \- Experience managing and developing a team (KAMs and/or performance marketing).
 



 \- A track record of negotiating with large platforms/partners at a senior stakeholder level, not just day\-to\-day account operations.
 



  





**Success Metrics (First 12 Months)** 




 \- Revenue growth and margin improvement across the beauty.coms portfolio vs. plan.
 



 \- Improved platform relationship health measured via visibility, trade term quality, and escalation resolution speed.
 



 \- A high\-performing, well\-coached KAM and performance marketing team with clear ownership of platform\-level metrics.
 



 \- A reliable analytical/reporting cadence that leadership can act on without needing to chase data.

E\-commerce Manager – Marketplace Listing \& Ads Optimization

**Job Title:** E\-commerce Manager – Amazon, Flipkart \& Myntra  
**Experience:** 2–4 years  
**Location:** Coimbatore / On\-site  
**Salary:** ₹20,000–₹40,000 per month, based on experience

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **E\-commerce Manager** to manage and optimize marketplace operations across **Amazon, Flipkart and Myntra**. The primary focus will be on **product listing, catalog optimization, marketplace advertising, sales growth and performance analysis**.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Product Listing \& Catalog Optimization**

* Create and optimize product listings on Amazon, Flipkart and Myntra.
* Optimize product titles, descriptions, bullet points and search keywords.
* Manage product images, attributes, variations, pricing and inventory.
* Improve listing quality, visibility and conversion rates.
* Manage new product launches and catalog updates.

**2\. Marketplace Ads Optimization**

* Manage and optimize **Amazon Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display** campaigns.
* Manage **Flipkart Ads** and optimize campaigns for better visibility and sales.
* Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis and search\-term analysis.
* Optimize bids, budgets, keywords, **ACOS, TACOS and ROAS**.
* Identify high\-performing and negative keywords and reduce wasted ad spend.
* Scale profitable campaigns to improve sales and ROI.

**3\. Marketplace Management**

* Monitor product performance, sales, inventory, rankings and conversions.
* Support promotions and marketplace campaigns.
* Identify and resolve catalog, listing and serviceability issues.
* Coordinate with internal teams for product, pricing, inventory and marketing requirements.

**4\. Analytics \& Reporting**

* Prepare weekly and monthly marketplace performance reports.
* Track **sales, orders, conversion rate, ad spend, ACOS/TACOS, ROAS and product rankings**.
* Analyze performance and implement strategies to improve sales and profitability.

Requirements

* 2–4 years of experience in **E\-commerce / Marketplace Management**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Amazon, Flipkart and Myntra**.
* Strong knowledge of **product listing and catalog optimization**.
* Practical experience in **Amazon Ads / Flipkart Ads optimization**.
* Knowledge of SEO, keyword research and marketplace analytics.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and meet sales/performance targets.

Key Skills

**E\-commerce Management \| Amazon \| Flipkart \| Myntra \| Product Listing \| Catalog Management \| Amazon Ads \| Flipkart Ads \| Keyword Research \| SEO \| ACOS \| TACOS \| ROAS \| Marketplace Optimization**

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

title: Showroom Manager
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a well\-presented, confident, and customer\-focused **Showroom Manager** to manage the day\-to\-day operations of the showroom, ensure excellent customer service, achieve sales targets, and maintain a professional showroom environment.

The ideal candidate should have **good personal grooming, professional communication skills, a pleasant personality, and the ability to confidently interact with customers, dealers, architects, interior designers, and other visitors.**

Key Responsibilities

* Manage the overall day\-to\-day operations of the showroom.
* Welcome and assist customers professionally and understand their requirements.
* Explain products, features, specifications, applications, and pricing to customers.
* Generate leads and convert showroom enquiries into sales.
* Achieve monthly and annual showroom sales targets.
* Maintain strong relationships with customers, architects, interior designers, dealers, and other business contacts.
* Follow up with customers on enquiries, quotations, orders, and payments.
* Ensure proper display, cleanliness, arrangement, and visual presentation of products.
* Maintain updated records of showroom enquiries, sales, customer details, and follow\-ups.
* Coordinate with Sales, Marketing, Warehouse, Accounts, and other departments for smooth order execution.
* Handle customer complaints and ensure timely resolution.
* Monitor showroom stock, samples, catalogues, and promotional materials.
* Ensure showroom discipline and adherence to company policies.
* Guide and monitor showroom staff, if applicable.
* Prepare regular sales and enquiry reports for management.
* Support promotional activities, exhibitions, events, and showroom campaigns.

Grooming \& Professional Presentation

* Maintain excellent **personal grooming and professional appearance** at all times.
* Follow the company's dress code and grooming standards.
* Maintain a neat, clean, and presentable appearance while interacting with customers.
* Demonstrate professional body language, confidence, and a positive attitude.
* Represent the company and brand professionally in all customer interactions.

Required Skills

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good sales and negotiation skills.
* Strong customer\-handling ability.
* Leadership and team\-management skills.
* Good follow\-up and relationship\-management skills.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office/Excel and CRM software.
* Good presentation and product demonstration skills.
* Ability to achieve sales targets.
* Professional attitude and excellent grooming.

Qualification \& Experience

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification preferred.
* **2–5 years of experience in showroom management, retail sales, interior products, building materials, furniture, home décor, or a related industry.**
* Candidates with experience in **premium showrooms and customer\-facing sales roles** will be preferred.
* Experience in handling architects, interior designers, dealers, and high\-value customers will be an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is **smart, well\-groomed, confident, energetic, customer\-friendly, sales\-oriented, and capable of independently managing a showroom and achieving business targets.**

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹85,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

title: Senior 3D Visualizer
description:
We are seeking a talented and creative **3D Visualizer** to transform architectural designs, interior concepts, and product ideas into high\-quality, photo\-realistic visual renders and animations. In this role, you will work closely with design, architecture, and marketing teams to produce compelling visual assets for client presentations, marketing campaigns, and project approvals.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Produce high\-quality, photorealistic 3D renderings, walkthroughs, and animations based on architectural CAD drawings, sketches, and design briefs.
* Build 3D models of exterior architectures, interior spaces, furniture, lighting, and environmental assets.
* Apply accurate textures, materials, and lighting to scenes to achieve realistic visual representations.
* Perform post\-processing and touch\-ups on rendered images and videos using photo and video editing software.
* Collaborate with architects, interior designers, and project managers to understand spatial requirements and design intent.
* Maintain organized digital asset libraries, 3D models, textures, and project file archives.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Education \& Experience:** Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Architecture, Interior Design, Graphic Design, Animation, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* **Software Proficiency:** Strong expertise in industry\-standard tools such as 3ds Max, Blender, SketchUp, Rhino, V\-Ray, Corona Renderer, Unreal Engine, or Twinmotion.
* **Post\-Production:** Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, After Effects, Premiere Pro).
* **Technical Skills:** Strong understanding of spatial layouts, proportions, composition, color theory, texturing, and lighting setups.
* **Portfolio:** A strong portfolio demonstrating photorealistic rendering abilities in architectural or product visualization.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with real\-time rendering engines (Unreal Engine 5 or Unity).
* Familiarity with BIM/CAD software (AutoCAD, Revit).
* Knowledge of 3D animation and camera sequencing.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Branch Manager - Sales & Marketing
description:
***About Eaton Business School***





 Eaton Business School (EBS) is a
 
 UK\-registered organization serving working professionals from
 
 116\+ nationalities. We deliver postgraduate management programmes \- MBA, EMBA, DBA, and international partner qualifications \- to a global cohort of learners who study in the evenings while running businesses, leading teams, and building lives during the day. Our India operations serve as a key gateway for learners across the South Asian subcontinent, and our Coimbatore office anchors our presence in Tamil Nadu and the wider south of India.
 




  





***The Opportunity***





 We are looking for a Branch Manager to lead our Coimbatore office end\-to\-end \- its people, its numbers, and its student experience
 
**. This is a full P\&L role with real accountability. Y** 

 ou will own the branch's revenue targets, lead a small but capable team, build relationships with corporates and community partners in the region, and be the visible face of EBS to learners and stakeholders in Coimbatore.
 





 The role reports to the Business Head at our UAE headquarters, with regular strategic touchpoints with the CEO. You will be trusted to run the branch with autonomy, backed by a global HR, marketing, and academic infrastructure that already supports our other locations.
 




  





***What You Will Do***




**1\.Business leadership \& P\&L ownership** 





 •   
 

 Own the full P\&L of the Coimbatore branch \- revenue, cost, and margin.
 





 •   
 

 Set and deliver quarterly and annual enrolment and revenue targets in coordination with the Business Head.
 





 •   
 

 Plan and manage the branch operating budget, capex where required, and monthly variance reviews.
 





 •   
 

 Report monthly on branch performance to HQ with a clear read on pipeline, conversion, cost, and risks.
 




**2\. Admissions \& student growth** 





 •   
 

 Lead the local admissions function \- from lead generation through counselling to enrolment closure \- for the full EBS programme portfolio.
 





 •   
 

 Build a healthy, forecastable pipeline through direct channels (walk\-ins, referrals) and partner channels (corporate tie\-ups, community events).
 





 •   
 

 Ensure counselling conversations reflect EBS's honest, empowering tone \- no over\-promising, no pressure tactics.
 





 •   
 

 Own the local student experience post\-enrolment, from onboarding through to graduation, in partnership with the academic and student support teams.
 




**3\.Team leadership** 





 •   
 

 Lead, develop, and retain the Coimbatore team \- admissions counsellors, administrative staff, and business support.
 





 •   
 

 Hire for open positions in coordination with HR, in line with EBS's standing recruitment framework.
 





 •   
 

 Set individual KPIs, conduct regular one\-to\-ones, and run annual performance reviews using the organisation's standard KPI framework.
 





 •   
 

 Build a positive branch culture that reflects EBS values and supports team wellbeing.
 




**4\.Business development \& partnerships** 





 •   
 

 Build corporate partnerships in Coimbatore and the wider Tamil Nadu region for corporate learner enrolments and executive education engagements.
 





 •   
 

 Represent EBS at local industry events, employer forums, and academic partner meetings.
 





 •   
 

 Grow the alumni community in the region and use it as a channel for referrals and brand advocacy.
 





 •   
 

 Coordinate with the marketing team at HQ on local campaigns, positioning, and event execution.
 




**5\.Operations, compliance \& governance** 





 •   
 

 Manage the day\-to\-day operations of the Coimbatore office \- facility, IT, vendor relationships, and general administration.
 





 •   
 

 Ensure adherence to applicable Indian statutory requirements (Shops \& Establishment Act \- Tamil Nadu, Professional Tax, GST on locally\-billed services, and other state\-level rules where they apply).
 





 •   
 

 Uphold EBS's data protection standards under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act), including responsible handling of student and employee data.
 





 •   
 

 Follow EBS policies, escalate exceptions transparently, and represent the branch honestly in all internal reviews.
 




**6\.Stakeholder management** 





 •   
 

 Build strong working relationships with corporate partners, universities, employer bodies, and community stakeholders in the region.
 





 •   
 

 Serve as the primary local point of contact for students, parents, and alumni for escalations and significant queries.
 





 •   
 

 Maintain constructive engagement with local authorities and regulators as required.
 





  
 




***Qualifications***





 •   
 

 Bachelor's degree required; a Master's in Business Administration (MBA / PGDM) is strongly preferred.
 





 •   
 

 Additional certifications in sales leadership, marketing, or general management are advantageous.
 




  





***Experience***





 •   
 

 Minimum 8 to 10 years of total professional experience.
 





 •   
 

 At least 3 to 5 years leading a branch, business unit, or team with direct P\&L accountability.
 





 •   
 

 Track record of consistently delivering revenue and growth targets in an education, executive education, professional training, or comparable service industry.
 





 •   
 

 Experience in a Tier\-2 city operation is a strong advantage.
 





 •   
 

 Exposure to international or multi\-jurisdictional organisations is a plus but not essential.
 




  





***Skills \& competencies \- must\-have***





 •   
 

 Business acumen with a working understanding of a P\&L, unit economics, and cost management.
 





 •   
 

 Strong sales and business development orientation \- comfortable owning targets and closing enrolments.
 





 •   
 

 Team leadership experience with a warm but firm management style; genuinely enjoys developing people.
 





 •   
 

 Fluent English and Tamil; working knowledge of Hindi is advantageous.
 





 •   
 

 Comfortable with digital tools \- CRM systems, MS Teams and Office, analytics dashboards, and standard admissions technology.
 





 •   
 

 Ability to work collaboratively across time zones with a UAE\-based leadership team.
 





 •   
 

 Personal integrity, discretion with confidential information, and comfort operating with autonomy.
 




**Nice to have** 





 •   
 

 Familiarity with the executive education / part\-time postgraduate market in South India.
 





 •   
 

 Existing corporate network in Coimbatore, Chennai, Bangalore, or wider Tamil Nadu.
 





 •   
 

 Exposure to UK or UAE\-headquartered education providers, or to international qualifications frameworks (e.g. Scottish Qualifications Authority).
 





 •   
 

 Experience with corporate B2B sales in the training and education space.
 




  





***What We Offer***





 •   
 

 A senior, autonomy\-rich role at the heart of EBS's India growth strategy.
 





 •   
 

 Compensation aligned with role, experience, and the local market, with a performance\-linked variable component.
 





 •   
 

 Full statutory benefits per Indian labour law \- Provident Fund (EPF Act 1952\), Gratuity (Payment of Gratuity Act 1972\), Employees' State Insurance where applicable, and statutory leave \- plus discretionary benefits per EBS policy.
 





 •   
 

 Structured performance\-review framework, individual development plan, and support for continued professional growth.
 





 •   
 

 Global exposure through regular engagement with the UAE\-based leadership team and peer branch managers across other markets.
 





 •   
 

 A culture that takes the work seriously without taking itself too seriously.
 




  





***How to Apply***





 Please email your CV, along with a brief note on why this role is a fit for where you are in your career, to the Human Resources team at
 
**alfiya@ebsedu.org** 

 . Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisted candidates will progress through a screening conversation with HR, followed by discussions with the Business Head and the CEO. We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time.
 




**Eaton Business School is an equal opportunity employer.** 

 We do not discriminate on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex, descent, place of birth, or residence, in line with applicable Indian labour and constitutional protections. Applications from all qualified candidates are welcome.

Willingness to travel as per business requirements. Ability to achieve sales targets within deadlines.

title: Head Ecommerce
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for an experienced Head E-commerce to lead and accelerate the company's online FMCG business across marketplaces, quick-commerce platforms, D2C, and other digital channels. 

 Key Responsibilities 
 1. E-commerce Business Strategy 
 Develop and execute the company's overall e-commerce growth strategy. Own the online business P&L, revenue, margins, and profitability. Build annual, quarterly, and monthly sales plans. Identify opportunities across marketplaces, quick commerce, D2C, and emerging digital channels. 
 2. Marketplace & Quick-Commerce Management 
 Manage key accounts and business relationships with major e-commerce and quick-commerce platforms. Drive sales and visibility through platform-specific promotions, campaigns, banners, search placement, and product merchandising. Negotiate commercials, margins, visibility investments, promotional plans, and annual business agreements. 

 3. Revenue & Profitability 
 Own monthly, quarterly, and annual online sales targets. Drive GMV/NMV, net revenue, gross margin, and contribution margin. Develop pricing, discounting, promotion, and assortment strategies. Optimize trade spends and promotional investments. 

 4. Quick-Commerce Growth 
 Develop and execute strategies for quick-commerce channels. Improve product availability, assortment, visibility, and ranking across dark stores. Drive sales through tactical promotions and platform-led events. Analyze store-level and SKU-level performance. 

 5. D2C & Digital Growth 
 Lead the company's D2C/e-commerce website business. Improve traffic, conversion rate, AOV, repeat purchases, and customer retention. Develop customer acquisition and retention programs. Coordinate with digital marketing teams on Google, Meta, affiliate, influencer, and other acquisition channels. Optimize CAC, ROAS, and customer lifetime value. 
 6. Category & Product Management 
 Develop the right online assortment by platform and consumer segment. Identify hero SKUs and high-growth categories. Drive new product launches and online-exclusive packs/bundles. 
 7. Supply Chain & Availability 
 Work closely with demand planning, supply chain, warehouse, and sales teams. Ensure optimum inventory levels across online channels. Improve fill rates and reduce stock-outs, cancellations, expiry, and excess inventory. 

 8. Digital Marketing & Consumer Acquisition 
 Develop digital campaigns to build brand awareness and drive sales. Work with internal teams and agencies to optimize performance marketing. Monitor ROAS, CAC, conversion, traffic, and consumer acquisition. 

 9. Data & Business Analytics 
 Establish dashboards and reporting for online business performance. Analyze sales by channel, platform, category, SKU, geography, and customer segment. Track key business metrics and identify corrective actions. 
 10. Team & Stakeholder Management 
 Lead and develop the e-commerce team. Manage marketplace account managers, category teams, agencies, and external partners. Work cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, Demand Planning, IT, and Product teams. Establish clear KPIs and performance standards for the team.

description:
𝗧𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝗶𝘀 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗪𝗲𝗲𝗸𝗱𝗮𝘆'𝘀 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀
   

  

 𝗦𝗮𝗹𝗮𝗿𝘆 𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗴𝗲: 𝗥𝘀 𝟯𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬 \- 𝗥𝘀 𝟭𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬 (𝗶𝗲 𝗜𝗡𝗥 𝟯\-𝟭𝟬 𝗟𝗣𝗔)
   

  

 Experience: 3\+ yrs
   

  

 Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, Bengaluru
   

  

 Job Type: Full\-time
   

  

 We are looking for a data\-driven and results\-oriented
 **Performance Marketing Manager** 
 to lead digital acquisition, campaign optimisation, and revenue growth across e\-commerce channels. The role combines
 **performance marketing, data analytics, e\-commerce ROAS, creative strategy, and marketing technology** 
 to build scalable customer acquisition programs.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be comfortable working across paid media, analytics, creative, and e\-commerce operations, using data to make informed decisions and improve campaign efficiency. You will play a key role in driving profitable growth through structured experimentation, performance optimisation, and strong collaboration across marketing and creative teams.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop and execute performance marketing strategies focused on customer acquisition, revenue growth, and profitability
* Plan, launch, monitor, and optimise paid digital campaigns across relevant platforms
* Track and improve e\-commerce ROAS, CAC, conversion rates, revenue, AOV, and other key performance metrics
* Analyse campaign, customer, product, and website data to identify performance trends and growth opportunities
* Build dashboards, reports, and performance analyses to communicate campaign results and actionable insights
* Use GA4 to analyse customer journeys, traffic sources, conversions, engagement, and e\-commerce performance
* Implement and maintain accurate marketing and conversion tracking through Google Tag Manager
* Work with Shopify to analyse store performance, conversion funnels, product performance, and customer behaviour
* Identify tracking gaps and coordinate with technical teams to improve data accuracy and attribution
* Develop a strong creative strategy based on performance data, customer insights, audience behaviour, and campaign results
* Collaborate with designers, content teams, and creative partners to develop high\-performing ad concepts, formats, and messaging
* Conduct structured A/B testing across creatives, audiences, landing pages, offers, and campaign strategies
* Monitor campaign performance regularly and proactively identify underperforming areas
* Optimise budgets, targeting, bidding, creatives, and campaign structures to improve efficiency
* Translate analytics into clear recommendations for marketing and business stakeholders
* Collaborate with e\-commerce, creative, product, and technology teams to improve the overall customer acquisition funnel
* Stay updated on changes in digital advertising platforms, analytics tools, attribution practices, and e\-commerce trends
* Continuously experiment with new growth opportunities, channels, creative approaches, and optimisation techniques


 What Makes You a Great Fit
   

  

* 3\+ years of experience in performance marketing, digital marketing, e\-commerce growth, or a related role
* Strong hands\-on experience with Data Analytics and performance marketing
* Proven ability to manage and optimise e\-commerce ROAS and performance metrics
* Strong understanding of customer acquisition, conversion funnels, CAC, LTV, AOV, and revenue optimisation
* Hands\-on experience with Shopify and e\-commerce analytics
* Strong working knowledge of GA4 and Google Tag Manager, including conversion and event tracking
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign and customer data and convert insights into actions
* Experience developing performance\-focused Creative Strategy and collaborating with creative teams
* Practical experience with A/B testing, experimentation, campaign optimisation, and performance reporting
* Strong understanding of paid media platforms and digital acquisition strategies
* Excellent Excel/Google Sheets skills and comfort working with large datasets and performance reports
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills
* Highly detail\-oriented, commercially aware, and focused on measurable outcomes
* Proactive, curious, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced, performance\-driven environment

description:
**Company:** 
 Ogha Health
 



**Location:** 
 Gachibowli, Hyderabad
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Work Mode:** 
 On\-site
 



**Vacancies:** 
 2
 



**Experience:** 
 2–5 Years
 



**Qualification:** 
 M.Sc. Psychology / Counselling Psychology preferred
 



**Salary:** 
 ₹40,000–₹50,000 per month \+ Performance\-Based Incentives
 


 About Ogha Health
 
 Ogha Health is a multi\-specialty healthcare centre in Gachibowli, Hyderabad, providing integrated healthcare, diagnostic, therapeutic, fitness, and preventive health services.
 



 Our key service areas include:
 


* Diagnostics \& Health Check\-ups
* Physiotherapy \& Pain Management
* Snoring \& Sleep Care
* Dental Care
* Body Transformation
* Weight Management
* Sleep Therapeutics
* Fitness \& Wellness


 About the Role
 
 Ogha Health is looking for an
 **M.Sc. Counsellor – Diagnostics \& Internal Sales** 
 to manage diagnostic enquiries, counsel patients, coordinate appointments, support lead conversion, and contribute to diagnostic sales and revenue targets.
 



 The role requires strong communication, patient counselling, relationship management, follow\-up, and sales\-conversion skills.
 



 The selected candidate will work closely with doctors, the diagnostic team, marketing, front\-office staff, and management to support a smooth patient journey from enquiry and counselling through diagnostic booking and completion.
 


 Key Responsibilities1\. Patient Counselling
 * Counsel patients and their family members regarding available diagnostic services and health\-check packages.
* Understand patient requirements and provide information about relevant services based on available and approved clinical recommendations.
* Explain diagnostic tests, packages, procedures, pricing, preparation requirements, and appointment processes in a clear and patient\-friendly manner.
* Build professional relationships with patients through empathetic and respectful communication.
* Address patient queries and non\-clinical concerns appropriately.
* Maintain a positive and professional patient experience throughout the counselling process.


 2\. Diagnostics Sales \& Lead Conversion
 * Manage diagnostic leads received through calls, digital marketing, walk\-ins, referrals, and other channels.
* Respond to new enquiries in a timely manner.
* Understand and qualify diagnostic requirements.
* Support the conversion of relevant enquiries into diagnostic appointments and package bookings.
* Conduct timely follow\-ups with interested, pending, and inactive leads.
* Address non\-clinical concerns related to pricing, packages, appointment timings, and processes.
* Work toward monthly diagnostic sales and revenue targets.
* Follow ethical and patient\-focused communication practices throughout the conversion process.


 3\. Diagnostic Package Counselling
 * Develop comprehensive knowledge of Ogha Health’s diagnostic tests and health\-check packages.
* Clearly explain package features, inclusions, pricing, processes, and applicable preparation requirements.
* Educate patients about preventive health check\-ups and available diagnostic services.
* Identify relevant package opportunities based on patient requirements and approved clinical recommendations.
* Support diagnostic revenue growth through effective counselling, follow\-up, and appropriate service conversion.


 4\. Appointment \& Patient Coordination
 * Schedule and confirm diagnostic appointments.
* Coordinate with the diagnostic team to support smooth patient scheduling.
* Communicate relevant preparation instructions to patients as per approved protocols.
* Follow up with patients to help minimise cancellations and no\-shows.
* Coordinate internally to address patient\-related queries and support a seamless experience.


 5\. Follow\-Up \& Relationship Management
 * Conduct structured follow\-ups with patients who have not yet completed their booking.
* Maintain an organised follow\-up process for diagnostic leads.
* Follow up on missed, cancelled, and postponed appointments.
* Maintain professional relationships with existing patients.
* Communicate information about appropriate repeat health\-checks and diagnostic services when relevant.
* Identify suitable opportunities to connect patients with other relevant Ogha Health services.


 6\. Internal Coordination
 * Work closely with doctors, diagnostic technicians, therapists, front\-office staff, marketing, and management.
* Coordinate patient requirements with the appropriate internal departments.
* Ensure accurate and timely communication of relevant patient information within the organisation.
* Share feedback with the marketing team regarding lead quality, patient requirements, and conversion\-related challenges.


 7\. CRM \& Reporting
 * Maintain accurate records of leads, calls, follow\-ups, appointments, bookings, and sales.
* Regularly update CRM and lead\-management systems.
* Track lead\-to\-appointment and appointment\-to\-diagnostic booking conversion.
* Maintain daily activity reports.
* Prepare weekly and monthly sales performance reports.
* Track revenue generated from diagnostic services.
* Monitor pending leads and ensure timely follow\-up.


 Candidate ProfileQualification
 * M.Sc. Psychology / Counselling Psychology / Clinical Psychology preferred.
* Candidates with relevant postgraduate qualifications and strong healthcare sales or counselling experience may also be considered.


 Experience
 
**2–5 years of relevant experience** 
 in one or more of the following areas:
 


* Patient counselling
* Diagnostic centres
* Hospitals
* Healthcare sales
* Healthcare counselling
* Wellness centres
* Health\-check packages
* Medical/diagnostic sales
* Customer relationship management


 Required Skills
 * Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong counselling and active\-listening abilities.
* Empathetic and patient\-focused approach.
* Strong sales and conversion skills.
* Excellent follow\-up and relationship\-management skills.
* Ability to address objections and discuss service\-related concerns professionally.
* Target\-oriented approach with strong ownership of responsibilities.
* Good understanding of healthcare and diagnostic services.
* Ability to explain healthcare services in clear, simple, and patient\-friendly language.
* Strong organisational and coordination skills.
* Basic knowledge of CRM systems and reporting.
* Professional conduct and communication in a patient\-facing environment.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 
 Performance will be evaluated primarily on diagnostic conversion, revenue generation, follow\-up effectiveness, and quality of patient service.
 



 Key metrics include:
 


* Number of diagnostic leads contacted
* Lead response time
* Qualified leads
* Counselling sessions completed
* Diagnostic appointments generated
* Lead\-to\-booking conversion rate
* Appointment\-to\-booking conversion rate
* Diagnostic tests/packages sold
* Diagnostic revenue generated
* Average revenue per patient
* Follow\-up completion rate
* Repeat diagnostic bookings
* Monthly sales target achievement
* Patient satisfaction and service quality


 Compensation
 
**₹40,000–₹50,000 per month \+ Performance\-Based Incentives** 




 Performance\-based incentives may be linked to measurable outcomes, including:
 


* Diagnostic bookings
* Package conversions
* Revenue achievement
* Monthly targets
* Repeat business


 What We Are Looking For
 
 We are looking for a professional who can effectively combine
 **patient counselling, communication, relationship management, and sales skills** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate will be:
 


* Empathetic and patient\-focused
* Confident in communication
* Comfortable discussing healthcare and diagnostic services
* Strong in follow\-ups and relationship management
* Comfortable addressing non\-clinical objections and concerns
* Target\-oriented
* Capable of converting relevant enquiries into bookings
* Comfortable taking ownership of diagnostic sales and revenue objectives


 Why Join Ogha Health?
 * Work with a growing multi\-specialty healthcare organisation.
* Opportunity to develop expertise in healthcare counselling and diagnostics.
* Performance\-based earning potential.
* Professional and growth\-oriented work environment.
* Opportunity to contribute to patient experience and organisational growth.


 Apply Now
 
 If you are an M.Sc. Psychology, Counselling Psychology, or related postgraduate professional with strong communication, patient\-handling, counselling, and sales\-conversion abilities, and are interested in developing your career in healthcare diagnostics and internal sales, we would like to hear from you.
 



**Join Ogha Health and become part of our Diagnostics \& Patient Counselling team.**

title: Digital Performance Marketing & CRM Specialist
description:
**Location: Thane** 




**CTC: ₹3\.6–6 LPA** 




**Company: Union Living** 




  





**About the Role** 




 We’re looking for a hands\-on, data\-driven Digital Performance Marketing \& CRM Specialist to own our paid marketing engine and the systems that sit behind it.
 



  





 This role is not just about running ads.
 



  





 You will be responsible for Meta performance, marketing budgets, lead generation, analytics, reporting, CRM, WhatsApp automation, integrations and building systems that help us convert more leads into residents.
 



  





 If you enjoy looking at numbers, figuring out what is working, fixing what isn't, and building systems that make marketing more efficient this role is for you.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 



* Plan, execute and optimise Meta Ads campaigns across Facebook and Instagram with a strong focus on lead generation and conversions.
* Own monthly marketing budgets, campaign allocation and spend optimisation to maximise ROI.
* Track and analyse key performance metrics including CPL, CAC, lead quality, conversion rates, ROAS and occupancy impact.
* Build and maintain weekly and monthly performance reports and dashboards for management.
* Analyse the complete funnel from ad → lead → CRM → follow\-up → site visit → booking and identify areas for improvement.
* Work closely with the sales and operations teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
* Manage and optimise CRM systems and ensure accurate lead capture, routing, tagging, tracking and follow\-ups.
* Set up and manage WATI / WhatsApp automation for lead communication, follow\-ups, reminders and customer journeys.
* Work on CRM, WhatsApp, website and marketing platform integrations to ensure seamless movement of data across systems.
* Build automated workflows to reduce manual intervention and improve lead response and follow\-up.
* Set up tracking, pixels, events, UTM structures and other marketing measurement systems.
* Work with content and design teams to develop and test high\-converting creatives and messaging.
* Continuously run A/B tests across audiences, creatives, campaigns and landing pages.
* Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to improve campaign performance, reporting and marketing workflows.
* Build scalable marketing processes and systems as Union Living continues to expand.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 2–5 years of hands\-on experience in performance marketing, paid media, growth marketing or a similar role.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Meta Ads Manager — this is a must.
* Experience managing marketing budgets and taking ownership of campaign performance.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign and funnel data and make decisions based on it.
* Experience creating performance reports, dashboards and management\-level MIS.
* Strong understanding of lead\-generation funnels and conversion optimisation.
* Hands\-on experience with CRM platforms such as LeadSquared, HubSpot, Zoho or similar.
* Experience with WATI / WhatsApp Business API and automation is strongly preferred.
* Understanding of API/integrations and connecting CRM, WhatsApp, website and marketing systems.
* Good understanding of Google Analytics/GA4, pixels, tracking and UTM parameters.
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets and data.
* Strong coordination skills across marketing, sales, design and technology teams.
* Ability to independently identify a problem, figure out a solution and implement it.



  





**The Kind of Person We're Looking For** 




**You should be someone who doesn't just say:** 




**“The CPL has increased.”** 




  





**You should be asking:** 




 “Why has the CPL increased, where is the funnel dropping, what can we change, and how do we fix it?”
 


* We want someone who is analytical, curious, hands\-on and extremely execution\-oriented.
* Someone who can run a Meta campaign in the morning, analyse the numbers in the afternoon, fix a CRM workflow in the evening and come back the next day with a better system.



  





**Why This Role?** 



* You'll have direct ownership of a critical part of Union Living's growth engine.
* You'll work across Performance Marketing \+ CRM \+ WhatsApp \+ Analytics \+ Automation \+ Growth, with the opportunity to build systems from the ground up as we scale.



  





 If you like numbers, marketing, systems and making things work, we'd love to hear from you.

title: SEO Manager (Remote, Full - Time) [HR210]

* Drive YouTube content promotion as an essential part of the role.
  


  


  




**Requirements** 
  

  
* 5\+ years of experience in content marketing and SEO content strategy.
  
* 5\+ years of experience driving Google Search and organic ranking growth.
  
* 5\+ years of experience with Google Analytics/GA4 and Google Tag Manager (GTM).
  
* 5\+ years of experience in keyword research and competitor analysis.

description:
**Marketing Executive — Institutional Partnerships** 




 Skill Grimoire Private Limited · Remote, anywhere in India · Full\-time ·
 **Multiple positions** 




  





 About us
 



  





 Skill Grimoire is an AI\-integrated skill development company based in Bengaluru. We partner with schools and colleges to teach students practical, job\-relevant skills alongside their regular syllabus \- 100 skills across six levels, from Class 10 to postgraduate.
 



 We are early. The curriculum is built; the partnerships are not. That is the job.
 



  





 The role:
 



  




* You will open and close institutional partnerships. Practically, that means:



 Identifying schools and colleges in your region worth approaching
 


* Reaching decision\-makers \- principals, directors, management committees



 Presenting our programme, online or in person at their campus
 


* Handling objections, negotiating terms, and closing the partnership
* Staying with the institution through onboarding so the relationship holds
* You will work remotely, but the institutions are physical places near you. Expect to travel locally and present in person when it matters.



  





 What we are looking for:
 



  




* **MBA** 
 , preferably with a marketing or business development specialisation
* 2\+ years in B2B sales, institutional sales, or education sector business development
* Exceptional communication in English, and fluency in your regional language
* The ability to hold a room \- you will present to principals and management committees, often people considerably more senior than you
* Comfort with indifference. Most institutions will not be looking for this when you arrive. You need to create interest where none existed, and stay composed when the first answer is no
* Willingness to work in a startup: unstructured, fast\-moving, and without the support systems of a large organisation
* Based anywhere in India, with the right to work here



  





  





 What we offer:
 



  




* Basic pay plus
 **incentives on every partnership you close** 
 . The incentive is uncapped \- your earnings are decided by your results, not by a band. Compensation is discussed in detail at interview
* Remote working, anywhere in India
* Direct access to the founding team, and real influence over how this is built
* A product you can defend honestly. We do not promise jobs, we do not oversell, and we fund free education for students who cannot pay



  





**Please note: travel expenses are not separately reimbursed. We have deliberately put that money into the incentive structure instead, so the people who close more partnerships earn more rather than the people who travel more.** 




  





  





 One honest note
 



 This is an early\-stage company. You will build the sales process rather than inherit one. If you want a defined territory, a warm pipeline and a manager who has done this before you \- this is not that role yet. If you want to be the person who built it, it is.
 



  





  





 To apply
 



 Send your CV to
 **office@skillgrimoire.com** 
 with the subject line
 **"Marketing Executive \- \[Your City]"** 
 .
 



 In your email, answer one question in three or four lines: tell us about a time you convinced someone who was not interested.
 



 We read every application.

title: Director, Technical Consulting— Marketing Cloud Next
description:
**Description**
****ROLE OVERVIEW****
 Salesforce is currently seeking a Director,Technical Consulting (Marketing Cloud Next) to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. We are looking for an experienced professional services leader who has experience in scaling professional services delivery centers across the world. In addition The Director — Marketing Cloud Next is an execution\-focused technical leader responsible for architecting and delivering end\-to\-end migrations from legacy marketing platforms (Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, legacy SFMC) to Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next. As a foundational member of the Strategic Migration CoE and Migration Factory, you will act as primary technical authority for the Marketing Cloud Next track — owning the solution design, data architecture, subscriber migration strategy, journey migration blueprint, and Data Cloud unified profile design. You will combine deep Marketing Cloud Next platform expertise with advanced data migration methodologies to ensure that subscriber data, consent records, journeys, content and preference data are migrated with full integrity, compliance and zero business disruption.
   

  

 This role is 50% billable and in addition to people leadership, you will work with our customers and partners as a senior technical architect/program architect/CTO to solve critically important business challenges using Salesforce’s Cloud.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead a team of up to 8 direct reports, comprising Architects and potentially Managers, providing technical direction, mentorship, and performance leadership.
* Serve as a Senior/Principal Technical Architect for Marketing Cloud migration projects, contributing hands\-on technical expertise and architectural leadership at approximately 50% utilization.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture that drive increased business value.
* Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the Industries Architects’ consulting practice; serving as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise, specifically driving the evolution of an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology within the practice.
* Design the subscriber and audience data migration strategy, including data extension schema, subscriber key mapping, suppression list migration, consent record preservation (GDPR/CAN\-SPAM/CASL) and historical send data handling.
* Architect the Salesforce Data Cloud implementation for unified customer profile design, identity resolution rules, data stream ingestion from source systems, and audience segmentation activation to Marketing Cloud Next.
* Own the journey migration blueprint — mapping legacy automation workflows, drip campaigns and triggered sends from source platforms to Marketing Cloud Next Journey Builder, including decision splits, wait steps and exit criteria.
* Define end\-to\-end data lineage including data profiling, cleansing logic, transformation mapping and reconciliation strategies for all subscriber objects, data extensions and consent tables.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.
* Lead a project team of developers focused on driving optimized solutions for our clients leveraging Salesforce clouds.
* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third\-party stakeholders
* Establish trust with the customer’s leadership, promoting and/or implementing best practices with Salesforce
* Highlight and manage risk areas in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion


**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**
* Marketing Cloud Next Platform Depth: Advanced expertise in Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Mobile Studio, Advertising Studio and Contact Builder / Audience Builder.
* Data Cloud / CDP: Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Data Cloud — data stream configuration, identity resolution, unified profile modelling, segmentation and activation to MC Next.
* Subscriber Data Architecture: Deep understanding of subscriber data model, data extensions, sendable vs non\-sendable objects, contact counts, suppression logic and list management at scale.
* Consent \& Compliance Architecture: Expert knowledge of GDPR, CAN\-SPAM, CASL, POPI — consent record migration, preference centre design, suppression list management and compliance\-aligned data handling.
* Email Deliverability: Strong understanding of sender reputation, IP warm\-up strategy, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and deliverability validation post\-migration.
* Data Migration Methodology: Proven expertise in executing high\-volume subscriber migrations — data profiling, ETL pipeline design, transformation mapping and reconciliation for marketing data objects.
* Integration Architecture: Understanding of Marketing Cloud Connect (CRM sync), REST/SOAP Marketing Cloud APIs, API\-triggered sends and event\-driven messaging patterns.
* AMPscript / SSJS: Proficiency in dynamic content scripting for migrated email templates — ensuring legacy personalisation logic is recreated accurately in MC Next.


**Minimum Requirements**
* 18\+ years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects and handling individual contributors.
* 8\+ years of people management experience
* Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills
* Demonstrated experience migrating high\-volume subscriber databases (10M\+ records) with zero consent data loss
* Experience migrating from Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot or legacy SFMC Classic to Marketing Cloud Next
* Hands\-on experience with ETL tools — Informatica Cloud, Talend, MuleSoft, Azure Data Factory — for large\-scale subscriber data extraction and transformation
* Strong interpersonal skills \- nurture effective working relationships with others
* Proficiency in English. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience


**Preferred Skills — Good To Have**
* CTA
* Experience migrating from Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot or legacy SFMC Classic to Marketing Cloud Next
* Hands\-on experience with ETL tools — Informatica Cloud, Talend, MuleSoft, Azure Data Factory — for large\-scale subscriber data extraction and transformation
* Knowledge of Salesforce Interaction Studio / Personalisation for 1\-to\-1 journey personalisation post\-migration
* Experience with WhatsApp, LINE, Push and SMS channel migration in addition to email
* Familiarity with marketing data warehouse patterns (Snowflake, Databricks) as upstream Data Cloud data sources
* Understanding of Salesforce Loyalty Cloud or Commerce Cloud as upstream journey trigger sources
* Thorough individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies, including hands\-on delivery patterns for generative AI and agentic frameworks.
* A great listener with the ability to communicate with people in diverse roles
* Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration
* Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems
* Adept at navigating/mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue
* Exceptional analytical skills \- experience overseeing and managing business metrics, productivity, AI evaluation frameworks, and outcomes.

title: Digital Marketing and E-Commerce Manager
description:
**Digital Marketing and E\-Commerce Manager** 




  





**Location:** 
 Gurugram, Haryana, India
 



**Experience:** 
 7\-10 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 bioQuad Life Sciences is a biotechnology company that manufactures patented, clinically tested supplements built on Bio\-Replenishments®, bioactive molecules the body naturally produces to maintain homeostasis. Published clinical trials support the company’s claims, which is uncommon in this industry. We operate two brands: bioQuad® for people and Boneo Canine® for pets. Both brands sell in the US, Europe and the UAE through Amazon, direct\-to\-consumer Shopify stores, and professional and retail distribution channels. Our products are based on original scientific research and are designed to support the body’s natural systems of regulation, repair, renewal and balance. The company has a growing international presence across the US, Europe, the Middle East and India. We combine scientific rigour, product quality and commercial execution to develop next\-generation solutions for metabolic and broader systemic health. This role reports directly to the Founder and CEO and will help build the paid acquisition function that supports the next stage of growth.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This role takes charge of our paid advertising and makes it profitable. Amazon US is the priority. Both brands sell well there on their own, but the advertising has been left unmanaged by an outside agency. You will audit the accounts, present a rebuild plan, and then run the campaigns yourself. After Amazon US, you will launch Meta and Google, then paid traffic to our Shopify stores, and then assess Amazon UAE. None of these channels is currently running at full capability. You will work directly in the ad accounts, report to the Founder and CEO, and take responsibility for the numbers. The first ninety days are clear: audit the accounts, relaunch Amazon advertising on an approved structure, restore return on ad spend, and present a plan for the next channels. As the function grows, you will help set creative priorities, review agencies and take part in hiring additional digital team members.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Audit the existing Amazon US campaigns for both brands and present a written, costed rebuild plan before making changes.
* Create the campaign structure across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Display, with sound bidding, match types and negative keyword management.
* Restore return on ad spend to a profitable level and hold it, while ensuring budgets pace evenly through the day and remain within approved limits.
* Maintain account health and respond to policy notifications and listing suppressions within 24 hours. Improve titles, keywords, images and A\+ content before publication.
* Track inventory levels, restock timing and the causes of order cancellations so advertising does not create demand for products that cannot be supplied.
* Develop Meta and Google from dormant accounts into working campaigns across prospecting, retargeting, Search, Shopping and Performance Max, with tracking verified through GA4, Tag Manager and platform pixels.
* Strengthen the path from advertisement to completed Shopify checkout, identify conversion bottlenecks, and create and test campaign landing pages with the creative team.
* Submit a performance report every Monday, covering spend, revenue and return across all channels. Set creative and agency deliverables, verify reported figures, and escalate risks promptly.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Advertising and Brand Registry, including Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Display, bidding, match types, negative keywords and account health.
* Meta Ads Manager and Business Manager, Google Ads, Google Search, Shopping and Performance Max, with the ability to launch and manage campaigns yourself.
* Google Analytics 4, Tag Manager, Search Console and platform pixels, including the ability to verify tracking and diagnose gaps in reported performance.
* Shopify administration and analytics, with practical experience improving product pages, landing pages, checkout conversion and the wider e\-commerce funnel.
* Strong command of return on ad spend, ACOS, TACOS, cost per acquisition, conversion rate, budget pacing, revenue forecasting and quarterly spend planning.
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, with experience preparing weekly performance reports, forecasts, variance analysis and channel\-level decisions.
* Daily use of AI tools for research, ad copy, creative briefs, keyword analysis and reporting, alongside practical use of Helium 10, Jungle Scout or similar tools.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Background in supplements, nutraceuticals, health or pet products, where product claims, customer education and compliance require care.
* Experience with Amazon UAE or European marketplaces, including the differences in demand, creative, timing and marketplace operations.
* Experience reviewing an external marketing agency, leading a small digital team, or managing advertising budgets substantially larger than the current spend.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* Seven to ten years in performance marketing or e\-commerce growth, still working hands\-on in the advertising accounts.
* A revenue target you carried for a channel and met, with the ability to talk through the numbers and explain what drove the result.
* A channel you launched from nothing and made profitable, including the starting position, the actions taken and the timeline to profitability.
* Hands\-on command of Amazon Advertising and Seller Central. You must be able to diagnose and repair an underperforming account yourself.
* A track record of running Meta or Google advertising profitably for a direct\-to\-consumer brand, preferably in a Western market.
* The ability to prepare a quarterly spend and revenue forecast, not only optimize week to week.
* Fluency in return on ad spend, ACOS, TACOS, cost per acquisition and conversion rate, with the judgment to act when they move.
* Strong written and spoken English, sufficient for clear reporting to senior management. You use AI tools daily and are comfortable working directly with the Founder and CEO.
* You are commercially accountable, organized and willing to build the function rather than wait for a finished team, established process or fully managed account.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* You turn a channel around rather than maintain one. The result of your work is visible and attributable in revenue, return on ad spend and budget performance.
* You report directly to the Founder and CEO, with no layers between you and the decision. Strategy, budget and channel priorities are close to the person accountable for the business.
* The scope grows in a defined order: Amazon US first, then Meta and Google, then Shopify, then Amazon UAE. You will build the system as each channel comes online.
* You help shape and hire the digital team that follows you. This is an opportunity to establish how paid acquisition, creative testing, reporting and agency management are done.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A hands\-on role with direct responsibility for paid advertising across two international health and pet\-care brands.
* Direct reporting to the Founder and CEO, with clear ownership of channel performance, budget control, reporting and the ninety\-day delivery plan.
* A defined path to broaden the role from Amazon US into Meta, Google, Shopify, Amazon UAE and digital team building.
* Full\-time, in\-office work at HQ27, Sector 27, Gurugram, a Grade A building near IFFCO Chowk metro, with a food court and parking.

title: Product Marketing Intern
description:
Back to Careers
   

  

 Product Marketing Intern
   

  

 Bengaluru, India
   

  

* Paid
* 6 Months
* Fresher or 1\+ year experience


 "Cybersecurity is drowning in noise. We don't need someone to generate content. We need someone to make the industry stop scrolling."
   

  

**About Trench**
 The legacy SIEM is dead. Bloated toolchains, alert storms, SOC playbooks written for a world that no longer exists. Trench is an AI\-native cybersecurity platform built on one conviction: security teams deserve decisions, not more data. We are not improving the status quo. We are replacing it.
   

  

 THE ROLE
   

  

 You will own Trench's voice and product messaging across every channel the bridge between what we build and why the world should care. LinkedIn posts that make a CISO stop scrolling. One\-pagers that reframe how buyers think. Videos that make agentic SecOps feel obvious.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Social: Strategy, cadence, and platform voice across LinkedIn, X, and short\-form video.
* Product Messaging: Positioning and persona\-specific narratives for CISOs, SOC analysts, and buyers.
* Collateral: One\-pagers, battle cards, and event materials that turn product depth into buyer clarity.
* Video \+ Events: Short\-form storytelling and Trench's end\-to\-end presence at industry events.


 MINDSET
   

  

* Features don't sell. Problems do. Product messaging is the job, not a byproduct of it.
* Cybersecurity is complex. Making it simple without dumbing it down is rare \-\- and exactly what we need.
* Volume is not the goal. Impact is. You know the difference between content that exists and content that matters.
* You ship before you ask for feedback. Ambiguity is the environment, not the exception.


**Skills**
* Tech background with genuine curiosity toward cybersecurity domain interest is non\-negotiable.
* Strong writing with a distinct voice across formats taglines, messaging docs, social posts.
* Ability to read dense technical content and extract the story buried inside it.
* Comfortable with design and video tools, or hungry to learn fast.


**What We're Not Looking For**
* Someone who uses AI to generate content and calls it done.
* Someone with no real interest in technology or cybersecurity.
* Someone who measures success by volume posts, assets, impressions.
* Someone who treats messaging as separate from the product.


**What You Get**
* Build a career as a next\-generation storyteller in the AI\-native marketing world before most people know that's the career to build.
* Real ownership over Trench's voice and messaging at the stage when both are still being defined.
* Direct access to the founding team across product, sales, and strategy.
* A portfolio that proves you can make one of the most complex domains feel urgent and human.


**How To Apply**
 Ready to make the industry stop scrolling? Write to us not about yourself but why do you think you have fitment \-career@trenchsecurity.ai.

title: SEO Executive

**Job Overview:**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct deep keyword research to find low\-competition, easy\-to\-rank keywords with good traffic and business potential
* Suggest niche opportunities and content clusters that can rank faster
* Analyze competitors and identify keyword/content gaps
* Improve SEO performance of existing websites through on\-page, technical, and content optimization
* Create SEO strategies to increase organic traffic, keyword rankings, and domain authority
* Optimize title tags, meta descriptions, headers, internal linking, URL structure, and page content
* Audit websites for technical SEO issues such as crawl errors, indexing issues, duplicate content, page speed, mobile usability, and broken links
* Recommend content ideas based on search intent, keyword opportunities, and topical authority
* Build or guide white\-hat backlink strategies to improve authority and rankings
* Track rankings, traffic, impressions, CTR, backlinks, and overall SEO performance
* Work with writers, developers, and marketers to implement SEO improvements
* Regularly provide reports with insights, progress, and next\-step recommendations

**Required Skills \& Experience:**

* Proven experience in SEO for multiple websites or niches
* Strong knowledge of keyword research tools and SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Screaming Frog, or similar
* Good understanding of on\-page SEO, technical SEO, off\-page SEO, and content SEO
* Ability to identify easy\-to\-rank keywords and realistic ranking opportunities
* Experience improving existing websites and recovering underperforming pages
* Knowledge of topical authority, internal linking, and SEO content strategy
* Understanding of backlink quality, link\-building outreach, and domain authority growth
* Ability to perform competitor analysis and convert findings into actionable strategies
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Clear communication and reporting skills

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working in competitive niches
* Experience scaling organic traffic for new and aged domains
* Understanding of local SEO, programmatic SEO, or affiliate SEO is a plus
* Basic understanding of HTML, WordPress, and website structure
* Experience handling SEO for multiple projects at once

**What We Expect From the Candidate:**

* Ability to find niches and keyword opportunities that are easier to rank
* Ability to improve SEO of existing websites, not just new content planning
* Ability to suggest practical strategies to increase domain authority safely
* Focus on long\-term, white\-hat SEO methods
* Strong execution, not just theory

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

* Growth in organic traffic
* Improvement in keyword rankings
* Increase in impressions and CTR
* Growth in referring domains / quality backlinks
* Improvement in technical SEO health
* Increase in ranking pages and indexed pages
* Better authority and visibility of the website over time

**Application Requirements:**  
Please share:

* Past SEO projects or case studies
* Websites you have worked on and results achieved
* Tools you use for keyword research and SEO audits
* Examples of low\-competition keywords or niches you identified successfully
* Your approach for improving domain authority and SEO performance of existing websites

**Optional Screening Task:**

* Review one of our websites and share:
* easy keyword opportunities
* niche/content suggestions
* major SEO issues
* quick wins for traffic growth
* strategy to improve authority

description:
**Marketing Head – Khubani** 




**Location:** 
 New Delhi
 



**About Khubani** 




 Khubani is an award\-winning luxury dining and high\-energy hospitality destination that seamlessly blends global culinary excellence with immersive entertainment and timeless elegance. Inspired by the richness of Persian heritage and contemporary luxury, Khubani offers an experience where every detail—from its breathtaking interiors and handcrafted décor to its vibrant nightlife and exceptional hospitality—is designed to leave a lasting impression.
 



 Created by the visionary founders behind the iconic Imperfecto brand, Khubani is a celebration of art, culture, gastronomy, and unforgettable experiences. The venue is distinguished by its magnificent chandeliers sourced from around the world, bespoke handcrafted interiors, Persian\-inspired aesthetics, curated artworks, intricate Rajasthani craftsmanship, and an atmosphere that transforms every visit into a journey of indulgence and celebration.
 



 Beyond its remarkable design, Khubani is renowned for its thoughtfully curated menu featuring the finest Indian and global cuisines, signature cocktails, world\-class entertainment, live performances, and exceptional guest experiences. Every corner of the venue has been personally envisioned and curated by the founders, reflecting their passion for design, storytelling, and luxury hospitality.
 



 More than just a restaurant, Khubani is a destination where fine dining meets experiential nightlife, creating moments that are both extraordinary and unforgettable. With a commitment to innovation, impeccable service, and creating memorable guest experiences, Khubani continues to set new benchmarks in India's luxury hospitality landscape.
 



**Position Summary** 




 The Marketing Head will be responsible for leading the overall marketing strategy, brand communication, digital presence, guest acquisition, customer engagement, and revenue\-driven marketing initiatives for Khubani. This leadership role requires an individual who combines strategic thinking with creativity and possesses a deep understanding of luxury hospitality, high\-energy restro bars, nightlife, entertainment, and consumer behaviour.
 



 The ideal candidate will have a proven ability to build brands, execute integrated marketing campaigns, develop strategic partnerships, create memorable guest experiences, and deliver measurable business growth. Working closely with the Founder and senior leadership, the Marketing Head will ensure that every marketing initiative contributes to increasing revenue, enhancing guest loyalty, and strengthening Khubani's position as one of India's leading hospitality brands.
 



**Experience \& Qualifications** 



* Minimum
 **10\+ years of overall experience** 
 in Marketing, Brand Management, or Business Development.
* Minimum
 **4–5 years of leadership experience** 
 in Luxury Hospitality, High\-Energy Restro Bars, Fine Dining Restaurants, Luxury Hotels, Nightlife, Entertainment, or Lifestyle Brands.
* MBA in Marketing, Business Administration, or equivalent qualification preferred.
* Proven track record of driving revenue growth through strategic marketing initiatives.
* Strong understanding of luxury consumer behaviour, digital marketing, brand communication, and experiential marketing



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 




 The Marketing Head will be entrusted with complete ownership of Khubani's marketing function and will be responsible for developing and executing annual marketing strategies that align with the company's business objectives.
 



 The role demands a leader who can successfully build brand equity while consistently driving guest footfall, reservations, customer engagement, and revenue growth through innovative marketing initiatives.
 



 The incumbent will lead all aspects of brand communication, digital marketing, social media, public relations, influencer collaborations, creative campaigns, experiential marketing, and strategic partnerships, ensuring that every guest interaction reflects Khubani's premium positioning.
 



 The Marketing Head will conceptualize and execute high\-impact campaigns for festive occasions, seasonal promotions, menu launches, live entertainment, cocktail festivals, luxury brunches, celebrity evenings, and signature experiences that reinforce Khubani's unique identity.
 



 The role will require close collaboration with Operations, Culinary, Events, Business Development, and Finance teams to ensure seamless execution of campaigns while maximizing commercial outcomes.
 



 The successful candidate will also oversee the complete digital marketing ecosystem, including social media strategy, Meta and Google advertising, CRM, email marketing, WhatsApp marketing, influencer campaigns, website performance, and online reputation management.
 



 Additionally, the Marketing Head will be responsible for establishing strong relationships with luxury brands, corporate organizations, media houses, influencers, celebrities, event agencies, and strategic partners to create meaningful collaborations that enhance business opportunities and brand visibility.
 



 The position requires ownership of the annual marketing budget, ensuring optimum allocation of resources while continuously evaluating campaign performance, return on investment, and overall marketing effectiveness through data\-driven insights.
 



 The Marketing Head will also lead, mentor, and inspire a high\-performing marketing team, fostering a culture of creativity, accountability, collaboration, innovation, and excellence.

* Luxury Hospitality Marketing

* Influencer \& Celebrity Marketing
* Strategic Partnerships
* CRM \& Customer Retention

* Use Claude and other AI tools extensively to improve productivity and automate repetitive SEO/marketing tasks.
  
* Manage tracking, A/B testing and email automation.
  
* Build WhatsApp agents and web agents.
  
* Drive YouTube content promotion as an essential part of the role.
  


  


  




**Requirements** 
  

  
* 5\+ years of experience in content marketing and SEO content strategy.
  
* 5\+ years of experience driving Google Search and organic ranking growth.
  
* 5\+ years of experience with Google Analytics/GA4 and Google Tag Manager (GTM).
  
* 5\+ years of experience in keyword research and competitor analysis.
  
* 4\+ years of experience with React and Next.js.
  
* 5\+ years of overall experience, at Senior level.
  
* YouTube content promotion experience is essential.
  
* Ability to work in a balanced independent and collaborative manner.
  
* Ability to balance big\-picture thinking with attention to detail.
  
* A strongly flexible and adaptive working style.

* Data\-driven decision\-making and proficiency in Excel/Analytics tools.
* Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
