title: Senior Global Brand Manager
description:
**🚀 About Joveo** 




 Joveo builds AI\-powered recruiting technology. We are looking for someone who can help make Joveo a company people turn to for a clear, informed view on AI and the future of hiring.
 



 You will help bring the ideas, expertise and work inside the company into the conversations that matter to our business.
 



  





**🌟 About the role** 




 We are hiring a communications professional with an editor’s instinct for a story and the initiative to make it happen. You can spot an angle in a customer conversation, draw a compelling point of view out of a founder, and earn attention for work that deserves it.
 



 Reporting directly to the
 **Chief of Strategic Initiatives \& Global Supply Officer** 
 , you will lead strategic PR and leadership visibility. You will work closely with senior stakeholders to shape Joveo’s corporate narrative and advise on where we should speak, what we can credibly say and which opportunities deserve our attention.
 



  





**Strategic PR is the primary mandate.** 
 Creative brand campaigns are an important extension of it. We want someone who brings original ideas, understands how different channels work and can turn a strong story into a campaign people remember.
 



  





**🧠 What you’ll do** 



* Develop Joveo’s corporate narrative. Get close to our leaders, customers and subject experts. Find the evidence behind the story and turn it into compelling pitches, commentary, contributed articles and briefing material.
* Build a sustained earned\-media program across relevant business, technology, startup and industry publications. Develop relationships with journalists, editors, newsletters and podcasts by understanding their audiences and bringing them useful ideas.
* Strengthen leadership visibility. Develop distinctive points of view, prepare executives for interviews and identify relevant speaking opportunities. Make the message sharper while preserving the person’s voice.
* Lead communications around approved company milestones, product developments and funding announcements when relevant. Prepare FAQs, manage media enquiries and advise leadership when an issue requires a careful response.
* Originate creative campaigns that support our PR priorities. Turn customer insights, company expertise or a timely point of view into an editorial series, collaboration, event or other relevant format. Own the brief and channel choices, coordinating specialists where needed.
* Use paid PR selectively and make the budget work harder. Assess sponsored content, distribution, events and agencies against a clear audience, objective and cost. Find resourceful ways to build visibility through earned and owned channels.
* Measure whether the work is making a difference. Track coverage relevance, message accuracy, audience engagement and attributable inbound interest. Keep paid exposure distinct from earned coverage and use the results to improve the next campaign.



  





**🎯 What we’re looking for** 



* You have personally earned relevant coverage for a technology business, startup or agency client. You can explain how you found the story, pitched it and adapted when the first approach did not work.
* You know India’s business and technology media and have relevant working relationships.
* You write and edit exceptionally well. You can understand a complex product and explain why it matters in language people want to read.
* You are comfortable advising senior leaders, questioning a weak angle and recommending a stronger one.
* You have originated a campaign, collaboration or channel idea that made an impact. You can show your contribution and explain the audience insight behind it.
* You are resourceful with a focused budget and can take an idea through execution. Experience in AI, enterprise technology, corporate milestone communications or international media is useful.



  





**✨ Why join Joveo** 




 You will help shape the story while it is being formed, with direct access to senior leadership and responsibility for how it reaches the public.
 



 There is room to bring your own editorial judgment and pursue original ideas. Your work will influence how customers, prospective hires and the wider business community understand Joveo, with PR at the centre and creative thinking throughout.

description:
**Job title** 
 :
 *Global Scientific Content Manager \- HEVA and PDMD*
* Hiring Manager: Head/Group Lead/Team Lead – Scientific Writing

* Job type: Permanent and Full time


**About The Job**
**Our Team:**
*Sanofi Business Operations (SBO) is an internal Sanofi resource organization setup to centralize processes and activities to support Specialty Care, Vaccines, General Medicines, CHC, CMO, and R\&D, Data \& Digital functions. SBO strives to be a strategic and functional partner for tactical deliveries to Medical, HEVA (including Patient\-Driven Medicines Development \[PDMD]), and Commercial organizations in Sanofi, Globally.*
**Main Responsibilities**
*The overall purpose and main responsibilities are listed below:*
* Scientific Engagement
+ Support the development of the integrated strategy for scientific expert engagement; scientific congress, scientific events and medical education; scientific dissemination; and multichannel engagement (in collaboration with global and local colleagues covering this area) for the assigned therapeutic area/products.
+ Ensure timely execution of the scientific dissemination, scientific expert engagement, and medical multichannel engagement plans for global and countries.
+ Support the development of engagement plans by identifying new multi\-channel customer facing/engagement initiatives that will enhance the customer experience for scientific and medical learning and improvement of patient care, incorporating patient\-centric perspectives and patient\-reported outcomes (PROs).
+ Closely track emerging and evolving digital technologies across industries, with a focus on healthcare \& pharmaceutical industries, leveraging proof of concept to test ideas and channels.
+ Support the development and expansion of a network of experts in the disease areas of responsibility through expert/KOL mapping activities that includes identification, profiling, and segmentation of international experts including emerging leaders and rising stars. Work closely with geographic segments/regions and countries to harmonize expert mapping activities and engagement plans.
+ Establish and maintain professional and collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders, KOLs, scientific and academic societies, patient association and advocacy groups, medical communication and strategy companies involved.
+ Attend the medical meetings, advisory boards, outreach meetings at key institutions, and interact with key experts, academic societies, and advocacy groups.
+ Support the management and oversight of Scientific Congresses / Events, Donations and Other Contributions, advisory board planning \& organization, compliance \& transparency requirements.


* Scientific Publications and Medical Communications
+ Support the development and oversight of strategic scientific publication plans and execution of operational and tactical activities within the overall medical communication platforms for assigned products/disease areas of responsibility (including HEVA and PDMD research outputs such as patient\-reported outcomes, qualitative patient studies, and real\-world evidence).
+ Support the planning and proposal of content deliverables aligned with the strategic imperatives supporting the assigned products/disease areas. This includes reviewing and identifying relevant clinical findings, disease burden, unmet needs, patient\-reported outcomes, and then proposing the development of corresponding compelling content.
+ Serve as a key scientific reviewer, performing thorough quality control, scientific/clinical accuracy checks, and peer review of all draft manuscripts, abstracts, posters, slide decks, and value communication documents prior to stakeholder/author circulation.
+ Ensuring timely delivery of high\-quality, fair\-balanced, scientifically/clinically accurate medical communications resources (including but not limited to proactive/reactive manuscript and poster/oral presentation slide decks, scientific platforms, lexicons, FAQs/trainings, symposia materials, medical booth materials, webinars, congress related microsites), scientific publication projects (including but not limited to manuscripts, abstracts, posters, and oral presentations, and enhanced content such as video, infographic, PLS, and podcast), internal communication and education resources (including but not limited to publication alerts, yammer communication of publications and congress events, pre\-congress training slide deck, congress newsletters and reports), and integration of digital enhancements in medical publications in accordance with established timelines, compliance guidelines/policies, and budgets, in collaboration with the scientific writers and occasionally external agencies.
+ Providing oversight, quality control, scientific review, and project management, for scientific publication and medical communication projects, ensuring accuracy, quality, and adherence to project timelines.
+ Providing direction, constructive editorial review, and guidance to internal and external scientific writers, stakeholders, and regional partners regarding assigned projects, to ensure high\-quality alignment with medical/scientific objectives, content development and dissemination processes, and adherence to Standard Operating Procedures.
+ Maintain knowledge of international requirements and guidance associated with scientific publications/medical communications and their associated tools (iEnvision, PromoMats etc.).
+ Ensure global and local teams are informed about the availability and relevance of developed content assets.
+ Analyse regularly content usage data to evolve medical content development.


* Additional
+ Maintain a keen understanding of the key stakeholder and patient community needs.
+ Incorporate customer\-specific insights, gaps, patient burden/lived experience insights, and needs in crafting strategies supporting overall medical/business priorities.
+ Support the adoption of innovative content formats and processes, staying current with internal content evolution and industry trends.
+ Ensure designated activities are appropriately executed, adherent to corporate SOPs and policies, and consistent with relevant external scientific, legal, and regulatory standards.
+ Collaborate closely with colleagues as well as cross\-functionally within a matrix organization (including HEVA, Global Medical Affairs, and Clinical teams) to ensure that information and knowledge transfer is conducted with internal and external stakeholders.
+ Maintain transparency with peers and colleagues across the organization, to produce aligned strategy and tactics, while promoting synergy and avoiding duplication of effort.
+ People: (1\) Maintain effective relationship with the stakeholders (medical affairs, HEVA/PDMD, marketing, communications, regulatory affairs, medical scientific community etc.) within the allocated Global Business Unit and product – with an end objective to disseminate education and communication content as per requirement; (2\) Interact effectively with internal teams and health care professionals on developed content; and (3\) Constantly guide mentor, and peer\-review the work of scientific writers in developing content and sharing expertise
+ Performance: (1\) Oversee the development, scientific review, quality assurance, and ensure delivery of publication/medical education material (slide deck, abstract, poster, manuscript, patient\-centric materials, etc.) aligned with medical strategy as per agreed timelines and quality; (2\) Provide strategic inputs with individuals and institutions, which may serve as resources for publications and medical communications purpose; (3\) Ensure the successful achievement of goals, operating within all policies, procedures, and guidance to ensure compliance with SOPs, including transparency reporting
+ Process: (1\) Support in driving publication/medical communication processes and document review workflows; (2\) Act as an expert in the assigned therapeutic area(s) and patient\-driven methodology; (3\) Assist the medical team in conducting comprehensive publication\-need analysis; (4\) Assist in driving the publication/medical communications plan and associated activities for the year identified for the region; (5\) Work with selected vendors within the region to deliver the required deliverables as per defined process, providing critical scientific review of vendor outputs; (6\) Leverage advanced training delivery tools and techniques thereby enhancing the effectiveness of training delivery; and (7\) Support in designing an overall plan of action based on end\-user feedback and improve course content and delivery
+ Stakeholder: (1\) Work closely with medical and HEVA/PDMD teams globally and in regions/areas to identify publication needs and assist in developing assigned deliverables and (2\) Liaise with medical department (global and local teams) to prepare relevant and customized deliverables


**About You**
* Experience: \>8 years of experience in the pharmaceutical or related healthcare industry, with 2\-3 years of understanding in all aspects of scientific publication and medical communications strategy, planning, and execution during all phases of drug development and post\-launch/marketed products. Hands\-on experience in peer reviewing scientific manuscripts, qualitative patient research, or HEVA/PDMD deliverables is highly desirable.
* Soft skills: Strong cross\-functional collaboration, teamwork, and stakeholder management; outstanding interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills with exceptional time management skills; demonstrated peer\-review and critical evaluation skills; ability to work independently and effectively in an internal and external environment; track record of managing multiple conflicting priorities in a rapidly evolving environment with successful outcomes; ability/willingness to maintain professional relationship with KOLs, scientific organizations/societies, advocacy groups, HCP authors, journals and publishers; strategic/critical thinking and problem\-solving attitude; leadership, planning, organizing and negotiation skills; innovative mindset to help evolve current approaches to scientific engagement and communication/publications
* Technical skills: Therapeutic area/domain knowledge exposure; publication and medical communication processes; and/or project management; understanding of clinical trial, patient\-reported outcomes (PROs), qualitative research methods, and real\-world evidence study design and execution, statistical methods, and reporting requirements; ability to critically review scientific literature, data, and written content for accuracy, tone, and logical flow; knowledge of industry guidelines pertaining to stakeholder engagement and interactions with healthcare providers; understanding of good publication practices and guidance (GPP4, ICJME), Sunshine Act, Pharma Code of Conduct, and other guidance related to data communication; familiarity with publication and medical communication management tools (iEnvision, PromoMats, CRM); scientific expertise in assigned disease area and experience with digital/innovative technology is highly preferred
* Education: Advanced degree in life sciences/pharmacy/similar discipline or medical degree
* Languages: Excellent knowledge of English language (spoken and written)

 Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.

title: Head of E-Commerce & Quick Commerce
description:
**Location:** 
 Mumbai (in\-office)
 



**Function:** 
 E\-Commerce \& Quick Commerce
 



**Reports to:** 
 Founders
 



  





 Earthful is a plant\-based nutrition brand for women's health, backed by Fireside Ventures and V3 Ventures. Marketplaces and quick commerce are two of our largest growth channels — this role owns both end to end: the revenue, the profitability, the operational health, and the team that runs them day to day.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 This role owns Earthful's marketplace (Amazon, Flipkart, and similar) and quick\-commerce (Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, and similar) channels end to end — revenue growth, channel profitability (CM2\), and operational health metrics like fill rate and on\-shelf availability. You'll build and lead a team of Key Account Managers, with all KAMs reporting into this role, and you'll be the one who decides where to invest, where to pull back, and how the team is structured to hit both channels' targets without sacrificing margin. You'll report directly to the founders on revenue, profitability, and ops performance.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




**Marketplace \& Quick Commerce Revenue Growth** 




 • Own and grow marketplace revenue to ₹3–6 Cr/month across platforms (Amazon, Flipkart, and similar)
 



 • Own and grow quick commerce revenue to ₹2–5 Cr/month across platforms (Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, and similar)
 



 • Set and track platform\-wise revenue targets, adjusting strategy as performance data comes in
 



  





**Channel Profitability** 




 • Keep every channel CM2\-positive, tracking contribution margin by platform on a monthly basis
 



 • Own retail media and ad spend on marketplace and quick\-commerce platforms (Amazon Ads, Flipkart Ads, Blinkit/Zepto sponsored placements), with ROAS targets that protect CM2 while hitting revenue goals
 



 • Monitor competitive pricing and promotional activity on each platform, adjusting pricing and promotion strategy to protect margin and market share
 



  





**Operational Health Metrics** 




 • Track and sustain RIS%, PO fill rates, and on\-shelf availability — with particular focus on quick commerce OSA given its real\-time nature
 



 • Coordinate with Supply Chain and Warehouse on demand forecasting and inventory allocation, so fill rate and OSA targets are actually achievable rather than just tracked after the fact
 



  





**Team Building \& Leadership** 




 • Recruit, onboard, and manage a team of Key Account Managers (KAMs), with all KAMs reporting into this role
 



 • Allocate platforms and accounts across the team, and set individual targets that ladder up to overall channel goals
 



 • Build the team's capability so KAMs can independently manage platform relationships and day\-to\-day account operations
 



  





**Platform \& Cross\-Functional Relationship Management (Suggested Additions)** 




 • Own strategic relationships with marketplace and quick\-commerce platform category/account teams — unlocking better placements, programs, and support
 



 • Coordinate new SKU listings and launches across all marketplace and quick\-commerce platforms
 



 • Coordinate with the Regulatory \& Compliance team on marketplace listing compliance (claims, mandatory declarations) before SKUs go live
 



  





**Reporting (Suggested Addition)** 




 • Report revenue, CM2, and operational metrics to leadership on a regular cadence, with a clear read on what's driving hits or misses
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 • 6–10\+ years of experience in marketplace, e\-commerce, or quick\-commerce roles, including at least 2–3 years directly managing a team
 



 • Proven experience owning contribution margin (CM1/CM2\) or channel profitability for an e\-commerce or marketplace channel, not just topline revenue
 



 • Direct, hands\-on experience managing retail media and ad spend on marketplace platforms (Amazon Ads, Flipkart Ads) and/or quick\-commerce sponsored placements
 



 • A track record of scaling marketplace or quick\-commerce revenue at a D2C or e\-commerce brand — real numbers, not just “grew revenue” claims
 



 • Experience building or managing a team of Key Account Managers or similar account\-owning roles
 



 • Comfortable with operational metrics (fill rate, on\-shelf availability, return rate) and coordinating with Supply Chain/Warehouse to hit them
 



 • Strong analytical and Excel/dashboard skills

description:

--------------------------



The Category Leader, Health \& Nutrition (H\&N) serves as the face of the sub\-regional, customer\-facing Research \& Development team and works closely with the Category Strategy \& Business Development teams to build and deliver a customer\-centric innovation pipeline within the Health \& Nutrition segment.  

In this role, you will act as the central technical and innovation contact for customers, providing deep category expertise and translating customer needs into differentiated ingredients and application solutions. You will lead customer insight generation and product development activities in close partnership with Key Account Managers, ensuring alignment between customer requirements, market trends, and business growth objectives.  

You will be responsible for driving the execution of category strategies, growth plans, and innovation priorities from an R\&D perspective. Working collaboratively with Category Leadership and Strategy teams, you will identify unmet customer and market needs, generate actionable insights, and convert them into innovation opportunities and commercially viable solutions.  

Additionally, you will bring the voice of the customer into the organization, providing regular updates on customer trends, project portfolios, innovation pipelines, and business outcomes. You will support strategic workforce planning by identifying capability gaps, recommending talent development initiatives, and contributing to training programs that strengthen the organization's Health \& Nutrition expertise.**Key Accountabilities**
------------------------


* Partner with Category Strategy, Business Development, and Commercial teams to develop and execute the Health \& Nutrition innovation pipeline.
* Serve as the primary R\&D interface for strategic customers, providing technical leadership and category expertise.
* Translate customer insights, market trends, and emerging consumer needs into innovative ingredient and application solutions.
* Lead customer\-focused product development projects from concept through commercialization.
* Collaborate closely with Key Account Managers to identify growth opportunities and address customer challenges.
* Drive the implementation of category growth strategies and innovation priorities from an R\&D perspective.
* Identify unmet needs and emerging trends within the Health \& Nutrition space and convert them into actionable innovation programs.
* Communicate project progress, portfolio health, market insights, and innovation results to key stakeholders.
* Champion the voice of the customer across the organization to ensure customer\-centric decision making.
* Support workforce capability development through strategic resource planning, technical training, and talent development initiatives.
* Foster strong cross\-functional collaboration with Marketing, Regulatory, Commercial, Supply Chain, and Global R\&D teams to deliver successful customer solutions.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Minimum of five years of experience in Health and Nutrition products
* Proven ability to develop customer relationships and trust through technical knowledge and expertise

title: Associate Marketing Recruiter | Tamatar Talent
description:
Our Mission
   

  

**Tamatar Talent** 
 helps mission\-driven, boldly ambitious startups \- the ones trying to solve problems that matter, the ones who should win \- build their internal marketing, brand, and creative teams. We're an early\-stage recruitment marketing firm, and we're building this from zero.
   

  

 We're looking for someone to be that zero\-to\-one partner with us: someone who can recruit for marketing roles with real market fluency, real hustle, and real judgment \- someone who enables founders to build a much stronger brand by finding them the right marketing talent.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Talk to founders and brand leaders directly \- understand not just what they're asking for, but what they actually need, by asking the right questions and reading between the lines.
* Scout and reach out to candidates on LinkedIn, at volume \- this is a manual, high\-touch process, and the more organized you are (and the smarter you use AI to help), the further you'll get.
* Use your own judgment to call whether someone's a real fit \- for the role and for the business behind it. You'll need to put yourself in the founder's shoes.
* Shortlist candidates, manage the pipeline, and keep communication instant \- same\-day replies to clients and candidates, always. No one waits two days to hear back from you.
* Close the gap between what a client wants and what a candidate wants \- get both sides to yes, without overselling either one.
* Schedule and prep everyone for calls, interviews, and conversations \- meticulously.
* Build relationships for the long term, not just the placement \- a candidate who isn't right for one role today might be exactly right for something six months from now.
* Help build the processes and systems for how this team recruits \- from the ground up, alongside us.


 Who we're looking for
   

  

**Marketing hiring experience.** 
 You've done non\-tech hiring before, mostly for brand, marketing, or GTM roles. You know what "good" looks like in a marketing hire, not just what a job description says.
   

  

**Real marketing fluency.** 
 You understand the jargon that comes with the territory, B2B included, and you can tell the difference between what a B2B tech marketer does versus a consumer brand\-side marketer, an agency\-side digital marketer, and an SEO. You keep track of where the marketing landscape is moving, not just where it's been.
   

  

**A consultative seller, not a pusher.** 
 You can convince a brand why a candidate is right, and a candidate why a role is right \- but only because you've actually figured out what they need. Sales, to us, means counseling: asking the right question at the right time, never talking someone into the wrong thing.
   

  

**AI\-fluent.** 
 You already use tools like Claude and Cowork to move faster, and you want to keep getting better at that.
   

  

**A real networker.** 
 You're a people person who doesn't run out of energy after talking to 50 people in a day. You want to build a strong network among marketers and brand builders \- and you genuinely understand what marketing does for a brand, not just how to source for it.
   

  

**Early in your career, but strong and ambitious.** 
 You want to build something real from the ground up, not just execute a job description.
   

  

**Organized, prompt, and meticulous.** 
 You read between the lines in a conversation instead of just replying to it. You keep things in order because you genuinely care about being organized, not because someone's checking.
   

  

**Curious about how businesses are built.** 
 You want to learn how teams, brands, and companies come together, and you see every client relationship as a chance to learn that.
   

  

**A fast learner who solves before you escalate.** 
 In the age of AI, when you're stuck, your first call is to AI and to yourself, not to whoever on the team is closest \- you don't disrupt the whole team's flow before you've tried to figure it out. You'll get plenty of feedback when you get things wrong, and that's fine \- you're not expected to be scared of mistakes. Own them, be able to explain the call you made and why, and use that to grow faster.
   

  

 The practical bits
   

  

* Location: Hybrid, based out of Bangalore.
* Engagement: Full\-time preferred; open to the right person on a contract or freelance basis.
* Timeline: We're in no rush. We're looking for the right person, not the fastest hire.

* Manage day\-to\-day partner and account correspondence, and coordinate follow\-ups across the team.

* **3–7 years of experience**

* **AI\-first working style**

 **B2B tech, SaaS, cybersecurity, or compliance/regulatory** 
 markets.

**Education**

* New Delhi (Hybrid Role)

description:
**Company Description** 
 MSE Technology partners with brands to bring their vision of outstanding digital experiences to life. With strong Data and MarTech expertise, MSE Technology focuses on insight\-driven decision\-making to enhance consumer engagement. **Role Purpose** 
 The Marketing Technologist is a regional specialist combining loyalty, marketing technology and analytics to support markets across promotions, catalogue and Programme performance.The role works closely with regional stakeholders from initial brief through to execution and performance review \- assessing feasibility, helping shape the right customer solution, coordinating delivery across internal and external partners, supporting launch and hypercare, and analysing whether the activity achieved its intended outcome.The role also brings promotion and catalogue expertise into Product discovery and solution reviews, while providing ongoing analysis and recommendations across loyalty and Programme performance.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Promotion \& Catalogue Delivery** 



* Review market briefs and assess technical and operational feasibility
* Help shape the right promotion, reward or catalogue solution based on the business objective and customer experience
* Recommend appropriate mechanics, eligibility, targeting, rewards and supporting content
* Configure promotions, catalogue and content directly where appropriate, or coordinate execution through the Ops COE
* Define clear requirements, business rules and acceptance criteria for delivery teams
* Coordinate with specialist CRM partners where messaging or CRM activity supports the promotion
* Own or facilitate QA, UAT and launch readiness
* Support post\-launch hypercare, monitoring and issue resolution
* Analyse performance and recommend optimisation or next actions



  





**2\. Regional \& Partner Facilitation** 



* Build strong relationships with regional stakeholders and understand their customer and loyalty priorities
* Facilitate activity across Regions, Ops COE, CRM partners, Product, Data and other specialist teams
* Ensure all parties have the context, requirements and information needed to deliver successfully
* Bring together promotion, CRM, Product and customer performance into a joined\-up view
* Provide clear recommendations on what action should be taken and why
* Act as the regional point of continuity from initial brief through to outcome.



  





**3\.Product Discovery \& Solution Review** 



* Participate in Product discovery where new capabilities impact promotions, catalogue, rewards or associated customer journeys
* Represent the market, loyalty and operational perspective in solution discussions
* Review proposed solutions for feasibility, usability and impact on existing promotion and catalogue processes
* Help define business rules, requirements, dependencies and operational considerations
* Participate in solution reviews, testing and UAT where relevant
* Identify potential gaps or unintended impacts before new capabilities are launched
* Ensure appropriate measurement and monitoring is considered as part of the solution



  





**4\. Programme Analytics \& Optimisation** 



* Own regular regional and Programme performance analysis
* Monitor loyalty performance across earn, burn, redemption, expiry, retention, promotions and rewards
* Own liability analysis and identify material changes, risks and opportunities
* Evaluate promotion, catalogue and relevant CRM performance
* Use SQL, behavioural analytics and BI tools to investigate underlying drivers
* Apply segmentation and customer analysis to identify opportunities for optimisation
* Translate analysis into clear recommendations for regional stakeholders
* Measure the impact of implemented activity and feed learnings into future briefs and solutions
* Use AI and automation to improve analysis, monitoring, QA and repeatable execution workflows



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 8\+years' experience across loyalty, marketing technology, promotions, customer analytics or related disciplines
* Strong understanding of loyalty mechanics including promotions, rewards, earn, burn, redemption and liability
* Experience with promotion engines, loyalty platforms, catalogue or content management systems
* Strong analytical capability including SQL and experience with behavioural analytics / BI tools
* Ability to assess a business brief from both a customer value and delivery feasibility perspective
* Comfortable moving between hands\-on configuration, analysis and stakeholder discussions
* Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills
* Experience working across Product, Operations, Data and external partners
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to coordinate activity across multiple teams



  





**Desirable** 



* Experience with Braze or similar CRM platforms
* Experience with Mixpanel, Power BI, Looker or equivalent
* Experience with segmentation, experimentation and customer value analysis
* Experience using AI or automation to improve marketing or analytical workflows
* Experience working across multiple markets or regions



**Measures of Success** 



* Market briefs are translated into appropriate, feasible customer solutions
* Promotions and catalogue activity are delivered accurately and effectively
* Delivery across Regions, Ops COE and CRM partners is well coordinated
* Launches are effectively monitored and issues identified quickly
* Programme and liability risks are surfaced with clear recommended actions
* Product solutions appropriately account for promotion, catalogue and market requirements
* Analysis consistently translates into decisions and optimisation
* AI and automation progressively reduce manual effort and improve speed and consistency

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
TUUTEEZ

JOB DESCRIPTION

Digital Marketing Executive \| AI\-Powered Learning Startup

Location

Bengaluru / Hybrid

Experience

1–3 years

Employment

Full\-time

Reporting to

Marketing / Founding Team

About Tuuteez

Tuuteez is an AI\-powered learning platform built around Lumi — a personal AI tutor who knows the student's textbook, syllabus and learning journey. We are building a brand that goes beyond another EdTech product: helping students understand, learn and become more confident, while giving parents a meaningful learning companion for their children.

The Role

We are looking for a Digital Marketing Executive who wants to build, not just execute. The role sits at the intersection of Content, Social Media, Performance Marketing, Analytics, Audience Understanding and Growth.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable moving from: “What are students struggling with?” → “What content will make them stop scrolling?” → “How do we distribute it?” → “Did it work?” → “What do we change?”

Key Responsibilities

1\. Social Media Management

* Own day\-to\-day execution across Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn and relevant emerging platforms.
* Manage content calendars, publishing, captions, hooks, CTAs, hashtags/keywords and community engagement.
* Monitor comments and DMs; track trends, competitors and weekly performance.
* Understand why content worked or failed — not simply whether it received views.

2\. Content \& Creative Execution

* Develop content ideas based on real student and parent pain points.
* Create strong hooks and Reel concepts around learning struggles, difficult concepts, curiosity, exam pressure, homework and academic confidence.
* Work with writers, designers and video editors to ensure timely, high\-quality execution.
* Ensure all content is aligned with Tuuteez's positioning and Lumi's role as a personal AI tutor.

3\. Performance Marketing

* Support and execute campaigns across Meta, Google, YouTube and other relevant acquisition channels.
* Handle campaign setup, targeting, creative/copy testing, A/B testing, budget monitoring and optimization.
* Track leads, sign\-ups, trials, customer acquisition cost and conversion performance.
* Understand CPM, CPC, CTR, CPL, CAC, conversion rate and ROAS.

4\. Analytics \& Reporting

* Prepare regular reports covering reach, engagement, saves, shares, follower growth, clicks, views, watch time and retention.
* Track paid marketing and funnel metrics from content through sign\-up, trial, activation and paid conversion.
* Answer: What happened? Why did it happen? What should we change next?

5\. Audience \& Competitor Research

* Continuously study student and parent pain points, competitor positioning, content strategies, EdTech trends and search/social behaviour.
* Turn research into actionable content, campaign and growth opportunities.

6\. Website \& Conversion Optimization

* Work with the team to improve the digital funnel from content → landing page → sign\-up → trial → activation → paid conversion.
* Identify drop\-offs and recommend tests for messaging, CTAs, landing pages and campaigns.

7\. Marketing Experiments

* Regularly test hooks, creatives, messaging, audience segments, CTAs, landing pages, ad formats and acquisition channels.
* Structure experiments as Hypothesis → Execution → Measurement → Learning → Next Action.

8\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with founders, marketing, content, design, video, product, sales/customer\-facing teams and external agencies where applicable.
* Brief clearly, follow up on deliverables, maintain deadlines and protect execution quality.

Who We Are Looking For

* Curious: naturally asks “Why?” and investigates performance.
* Data\-driven: connects metrics to decisions rather than reporting vanity numbers.
* Creative: understands hooks, storytelling, formats, trends and audience psychology.
* Proactive: identifies the next marketing opportunity without waiting for daily instructions.
* Fast learner: comfortable learning new platforms, tools and strategies.
* Ownership\-oriented: investigates underperformance instead of blaming the algorithm.
* Execution\-focused: turns ideas into finished work on time.

Required Skills

* 1–3 years of digital marketing experience.
* Strong understanding of Instagram and YouTube.
* Basic\-to\-good understanding of Meta Ads and Google Ads.
* Content marketing, copywriting and social media analytics.
* Familiarity with GA4 and Google Search Console.
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills.
* Basic SEO understanding.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Ability to create and interpret marketing reports.

Good to Have

* EdTech or startup experience.
* Performance marketing and YouTube growth experience.
* Influencer marketing and landing\-page optimization.
* CRM/funnel understanding.
* Experience with AI tools, Canva or basic video editing.

Tools

Meta Business Suite / Ads Manager • Google Ads • GA4 • Google Search Console • YouTube Studio • Google Sheets / Excel • Canva • Social scheduling tools • AI\-powered marketing/content tools

What This Role Is NOT

* Not a role for someone who only schedules posts.
* Not a role for someone who copies competitors without understanding the audience.
* Not a role where followers and views are treated as the only definition of success.
* Not a role for someone who needs to be told what to do every day.
* Not a role for someone uncomfortable with numbers, testing or accountability.
* Not a role where poor performance is explained away as “the algorithm.”

First 90 Days — Expectations

First 30 Days — Understand

* Understand Tuuteez, Lumi, target audiences, competitors, existing content and marketing funnel.
* Audit digital channels and establish baseline KPIs.
* Identify immediate content and growth opportunities.
* Deliverable: Digital Marketing Audit \+ 30\-Day Action Plan.

Days 31–60 — Execute

* Execute the content calendar, launch/test campaigns, establish reporting and begin creative testing.
* Identify winning content formats and audience engagement opportunities.
* Deliverable: Performance Dashboard \+ Experiment Tracker.

Days 61–90 — Optimize \& Own

* Identify winning content pillars and audiences; optimize paid campaigns and acquisition efficiency.
* Build repeatable processes and recommend budget allocation and growth opportunities.
* Deliverable: 90\-Day Growth Review \+ Next\-Quarter Growth Plan.

Key Performance Indicators

* Brand: relevant reach, engagement quality, audience growth and brand awareness.
* Content: views, watch time, retention, saves, shares and engagement rate.
* Acquisition: website traffic, sign\-ups, trial users, CAC and conversion rate.
* Paid Marketing: CTR, CPC, CPL, CAC and ROAS.
* Overall: quality of learning, speed of execution and measurable improvement.

We do not expect every campaign to succeed. We expect the candidate to learn quickly when one doesn't.

Ideal Candidate

Experience: 1–3 years. A Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Media or a related field is preferred, but demonstrable skills and results matter more than the degree. Candidates with startup projects, successful content pages, YouTube growth or hands\-on campaign experience should be considered.

Interview Process

* Round 1 — Screening: experience, communication and digital marketing fundamentals.
* Round 2 — Practical Assignment: audience understanding, content thinking, creative ability, marketing logic and data interpretation.
* Round 3 — Founder/Marketing Interview: ownership, creativity, strategic thinking, startup mindset and ability to execute independently.
* Round 4 — Final Evaluation: culture fit, role expectations and compensation.

Mandatory Practical Assessment

Give shortlisted candidates a real Tuuteez problem. Ask them to create 5 Reel concepts targeting 13–18\-year\-old students and their parents, including the hook, target audience, CTA and success metrics.

Then ask: “One Reel gets 100,000 views but almost no sign\-ups. Another gets 12,000 views but generates significantly more trials. Which one is more successful and why?”

This test helps distinguish someone who understands marketing and growth from someone who only understands social media.

The Person We Want

We are looking for someone who can grow from Digital Marketing Executive → Digital Marketing Owner → Growth Marketer.

The right candidate will not only ask, “What should I post today?” They will ask: “What does our audience need to hear, why will they care, how do we reach them, and how do we prove it worked?”

Pay: ₹10,239\.35 \- ₹25,095\.95 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bengaluru, Karnataka 560034

title: Product & Growth Marketing Lead
description:
Inc42 is India's largest media and intelligence platform for the startup economy. Most people know us for the journalism and IRL communities. Fewer know that underneath it sits a set of products – a data intelligence platform covering 75,000\+ companies, a newly launched mobile app, newsletters, and a subscription business – that thousands of founders, investors and operators use to make decisions.
 



  





 Those products are good. Their adoption, activation and retention are not yet where they should be – and that is the job.
 



  





 This is not a campaign marketing role. It is the person who owns whether someone who signs up ever comes back, whether a trial becomes a habit, and whether an audience that reads us becomes an audience that uses us.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



* The product marketing function – positioning, launch, adoption and lifecycle across our data platform, our app, and the unified product experience we're building across them
* Activation and retention – onboarding, lifecycle journeys, cohort retention, the trial\-to\-paid funnel, and the reasons people churn
* The audience\-to\-user conversion – Inc42 has a large, engaged audience. Turning readers into registered, returning, eventually paying users is the central growth problem
* Performance marketing – paid channels, attribution and efficiency, as a growth lever rather than a standalone function
* Lifecycle and CRM as a system – segments, automation, deliverability, and the martech stack that everything runs on
* A small team – you'll lead marketers already working on distribution, lifecycle and paid, and grow the function as it scales



  





**What success looks like** 



* Registered users become activated, returning users at a materially better rate than today
* The subscription funnel stops leaking in month two
* The app finds its retention curve and its habit loop
* We can answer "what does a good user look like, and how do we make more of them" with data rather than instinct
* Product marketing exists as a discipline here, rather than as three people's side\-project



  





**Who you are** 



* 6–9 years in product marketing, growth marketing or lifecycle marketing – in a subscription product, an app, a marketplace, or a PLG business
* You have owned an activation or retention number, not just contributed to one
* You are fluent in the mechanics: cohorts, funnels, lifecycle journeys, onboarding design, churn diagnosis, pricing and packaging
* You are comfortable with data – you can specify what you need instrumented and interrogate what comes back
* AI\-fluent in practice, not in theory: you use it daily in your own workflow
* You've worked closely with product and engineering, and you know where product marketing ends and product management begins
* Not primarily a brand or campaign marketer. That lane is covered, and this seat is the complement to it



  





**What's on offer** 



* A product surface with real audience demand already attached – you are not creating demand from zero, you are converting it
* A genuine 0\-to\-1: product marketing does not currently exist as a function here
* Direct work with the founders, the product team and the data team
* Competitive compensation \+ meaningful ESOPs
* Delhi, in\-person – five days in office, six\-day working week

title: Senior Manager - Network B2B Product Marketing
description:

* Manage end\-to\-end execution of product marketing deliverables for the Network business, including workflow coordination, timelines, reviews, quality assurance, and final delivery. Partner with Legal, Compliance, Product, Strategy, and client\-facing teams to ensure timely execution
* Develop, update, and maintain sales enablement and client retention materials, including pitch decks, sell sheets, one\-pagers, product guides, toolkits, and messaging documents
* Own and maintain the product marketing asset repository and intake process, ensuring marketing content remains current, conducting periodic audits, and identifying downstream updates resulting from product changes
* Customize and tailor marketing materials for specific client opportunities, target audiences, and market segments by adapting messaging, value propositions, proof points, and supporting content
* Collaborate closely with Network business stakeholders to understand market needs, product capabilities, and customer challenges, ensuring marketing collateral clearly communicates the value proposition

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field
* 10\+ years of marketing experience, preferably within B2B, product marketing, healthcare, or related industries
* 3\+ years of project management experience in a matrixed organization, with the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and workstreams
* Demonstrated experience driving projects from initiation through execution while ensuring alignment across cross\-functional teams
* Demonstrated solid organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously
* Demonstrated solid communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills
* Demonstrated excellent planning, organization, and problem\-solving capabilities
* Proven ability to manage, prioritize, and deliver multiple projects and deliverables in a fast\-paced environment

title: Marketing Task Author (AI Training)
description:
**About The Role**
 Alignerr is building a dataset of expert tasks that train and evaluate advanced AI agents on real enterprise marketing work. As a Marketing Task Author based in Bangalore, you will design and calibrate demand and content tasks grounded in real data — drafting on\-brand announcements, building competitive comparisons, and tracing campaign attribution — that require factual accuracy, brand judgment, and data\-backed conclusions.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role open to experienced marketing professionals who want to contribute their expertise to cutting\-edge AI projects from Bangalore's thriving tech hub.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: Flexible, task\-based


**Key Responsibilities**
* Author realistic marketing task prompts: on\-brand announcement drafts, competitive comparison documents, and campaign attribution analysis.
* Write scoring rubrics that specify factual accuracy standards, brand fit criteria, and the data logic required to confirm a conclusion is supported.
* Set up task environments with the campaign data, brand guidelines, competitive intelligence, and analytics outputs needed to replicate a real marketing work scenario.
* Solve each task yourself to confirm the scenario is realistic, the correct output is clear, and the rubric reflects genuine marketing judgment.
* Calibrate task difficulty — adjust data complexity, brand guideline specificity, or attribution ambiguity until the task reliably challenges the model to the intended degree.
* Review and correct AI\-drafted task prompts or rubrics when provided.


**Qualifications**
* Hands\-on experience in a marketing role — demand generation, content marketing, product marketing, or a closely related function.
* Ability to verify factual accuracy in marketing claims and confirm that stated conclusions follow from the underlying data.
* Strong brand judgment: can assess whether a draft is on\-brand and articulate why with specific, checkable criteria.
* Comfortable working with campaign performance data, attribution reports, and competitive positioning documents.
* Ability to define precise correctness criteria for marketing outputs — not just "good writing" but verifiable accuracy, brand alignment, and data support.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience in B2B, SaaS, or enterprise marketing within the Indian technology sector.
* Familiarity with marketing analytics platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Marketo, Google Analytics, Looker).
* Background working with global tech brands or India\-based product companies.


**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting\-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs.
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you.
* Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, task\-based work.
* Contribute to AI development that directly shapes how technology handles real enterprise marketing challenges.
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch.

 This European manufacturer is setting up a shared\-services centre in India and has partnered with Flexiple to build a trade marketing function inside it, one that supports the company's dealer and distributor network across several markets, not just India.  The dealer network has grown faster than the marketing support behind it, and requests for point\-of\-sale material, trade promotions, and dealer collateral currently get handled ad hoc by whoever has time. * Plan and run trade promotions and dealer incentive campaigns
* Manage the production and distribution of point\-of\-sale and dealer collateral

* Build the tools and playbooks the dealer network uses to sell
* Coordinate with regional sales teams to prioritise what gets built next

**Who Fits This Role** 



* 4 to 9 years in trade, channel, or distributor marketing
* Experience supporting a dealer or distributor network, ideally in manufacturing or industrial goods
* Strong coordination skills across sales, production, and marketing
* Clear written and spoken English



**Extra Credit** 



* Experience working with a shared\-services or multi\-market marketing setup

**What You Get** 



* A founding trade marketing seat inside a newly built shared\-services centre
* Exposure to a dealer network spanning multiple markets, not just India
* An on\-site role in Pune or Chennai with a genuinely global scope



**The Hiring Steps** 




 HR Screening → Assignment → Panel Round → Culture Fit
 



 Flexiple keeps a single application on file for this opening and any future match, so there is no need to apply again elsewhere.

title: SEO Specialist
description:
**About the Role** 




 Scale.jobs is a hybrid AI \+ human job application platform. Real humans, backed by automation, apply to jobs on behalf of job seekers so they can spend their time interviewing instead of filling out forms. We're a Techstars '24 company, profitable, serving job seekers across the US, Canada, UK, Germany, and Australia. Millions of applications processed so far.
 



  





 You'd be our SEO person. Not one of several \- the one. You own organic growth end to end: strategy, execution, and the number we look at every month.
 



  





 Here's why the timing is interesting. A growing share of our customers now find us through ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews instead of ten blue links. The classic playbook still matters, but the ground underneath it is moving. We want someone who's paying attention to that.
 



 You'll get direct CMS access. You're expected to ship on\-page changes yourself, not queue everything behind a developer. Code\-level work goes to engineering with a clear spec you wrote.
 



  





**What you'll actually be doing** 



1. **On\-page.** 
 Keyword research, mapping, and intent analysis across blogs, landing pages, and programmatic pages. Primary and secondary keywords assigned per URL so two pages never fight each other. Titles and metas written for clicks, not just relevance. Heading structure, internal linking, topic clusters, killing orphan pages. Schema (Article, FAQ, JobPosting, Breadcrumb, Organization) plus OG and Twitter cards.
2. **AI search (GEO/AEO).** 
 Structure content so AI engines can extract and cite it \- clean Q\&A blocks, tight definitions, claims backed by schema. Track our citation share across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews. Watch where competitors are getting surfaced and close the gap.
3. **Technical.** 
 Semrush audits triaged by revenue impact, not error count. Robots.txt, sitemaps, canonicals, crawl budget, index coverage. Core Web Vitals. Site architecture, breadcrumbs, pagination, mobile rendering, redirects, duplicate content. When you can't ship it yourself, you write the spec \- repro steps, affected URLs, expected outcome.
4. **Content.** 
 Blogs and newsletters that actually bring traffic and leads. Revamping old underperforming posts, which is often better ROI than net\-new. Editing and formatting pages in basic HTML.
5. **Off\-page.** 
 Outreach, guest posts, resource\-page placements. Converting unlinked brand mentions into links. Competitor backlink gap analysis. Reddit and niche job\-seeker communities \- real participation, not spam. Backlink health monitoring. And digital PR around launches, which is completely greenfield here, so you'd be building it from zero.
6. **Reporting.** 
 Own the dashboard across GSC, GA4, and Semrush. Monthly report that ties organic performance to signups and revenue. Recommendations, not a metrics dump.



  





**We'll vibe if you…** 



* Have 4 years of hands\-on SEO. Actual execution, not agency oversight.
* Can plan and run on\-page and off\-page strategy without someone handing you a brief
* Do keyword research, mapping, and intent analysis in your sleep
* Are comfortable editing and formatting pages in basic HTML
* Write titles and metas that earn the click
* Write genuinely good long\-form content \- blogs, newsletters \- without needing a second editor
* Know your way around Semrush audits
* Can look at Semrush \+ GSC \+ GA4, find the real problem, and either fix it or spec it clearly
* Actually get GEO/AEO \- how content gets written, structured, and surfaced in AI answers
* Optimize blogs and pages as per the competitor analysis and market trends.
* Report performance with recommendations attached, not just charts
* Are opinionated about prioritization and can defend why one fix beats twenty others
* Find the AI search shift interesting rather than annoying



  





**Bonus points:** 
 SaaS or marketplace SEO. Multi\-region work (hreflang, geo\-targeting \- we serve five markets). Programmatic SEO at scale. Basic SQL or spreadsheet modeling. Familiarity with Next.js and how rendering affects crawlability. Digital PR or founder\-led distribution.
 



**Tools:** 
 GSC, GA4, Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Sheets, and whichever AI visibility tracker we land on.
 



  





**What's in it for you** 



* **Full ownership.** 
 You're not executing someone else's SEO strategy. It's yours.
* **You ship.** 
 Direct CMS access, no waiting three sprints for a title tag change.
* **Profitable company.** 
 We're not burning the runway. That means a real budget for tools and links, and no pressure to chase vanity numbers for a deck.
* **A genuinely new problem.** 
 AI search optimization has not settled the playbook yet. Whatever you figure out here is yours to take anywhere.



  





 To fast\-track your application, email
 **hr@scale.jobs** 
 with the subject line
 **"SEO Specialist Application"** 
 . Include your portfolio and your current and expected compensation.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Own and run Practice by Numbers' paid advertising engine; build campaigns, manage spend, and optimize performance.
   

  

**Team Location Type**
 Marketing Gurugram, India Full\-time
   

  

**Summary**
 You'll be the hands\-on owner of Practice by Numbers' paid advertising. You'll build and manage campaigns, control day\-to\-day spend, monitor performance, test new opportunities, optimize toward a qualified pipeline, and continuously improve the efficiency of our paid acquisition programs.
   

  

 This is not a role where you'll hand campaigns off to an agency or an execution team.
 **You will be in the platforms every day.** 
 You'll research opportunities, build campaigns, write targeting and keyword structures, set bids and budgets, manage audiences, launch ads and landing\-page tests, troubleshoot tracking, and make ongoing optimization decisions.
   

  

 You'll manage paid acquisition across channels such as Google, Meta, LinkedIn, retargeting, and other channels that make sense for PbN. You'll own the performance data behind these channels and use it to recommend where we should invest, scale, reduce, or test.
   

  

 You'll also own the paid media budget proposal, forecasting, CRO strategy, and performance reporting.
   

  

****The Role****
 This role sits at the intersection of
 **demand generation, experimentation, and growth.**
 Your job is simple to say, but hard to do:
   

  

**Create more qualified opportunities for the sales team.**
* You'll own a broad set of acquisition programs across paid marketing, email, social intelligence, digital PR, and other emerging channels. Some will be established programs that need to be scaled. Others will start as an idea, a signal, or a promising audience that you've discovered and want to test.
* You might find a high\-intent audience hiding in an unexpected place. You might uncover a new way to reach practice owners through an industry community. You might identify a publication or industry list where PbN needs to be present. You might see an opportunity to turn an existing audience into a new acquisition channel.
* Your job is to spot the opportunity, build the test, measure the result, and scale what works.
* This is a hands\-on marketing role. You'll own execution, but you're not here simply to execute someone else's checklist. We want someone who can look at a growth target and figure out where the opportunities are and how we can capture them.
* You'll report to the Marketing Director and work closely with marketing leadership on growth priorities and direction.
* Run paid marketing. Plan, launch, manage, and optimize paid campaigns. Own targeting, audiences, budgets, bidding, conversion goals, retargeting, testing, and ongoing performance.
* Own paid media planning. Build budget proposals and forecasts, evaluate channel opportunities, and recommend where to scale, reduce, or reallocate investment.
* Drive email acquisition. Build and execute prospecting, nurture, re\-engagement, and lead\-generation campaigns. Segment audiences, test campaigns, and optimize for qualified responses.
* Turn social into a growth channel. Monitor relevant communities, conversations, content, and industry activity to identify prospects, buying signals, and new audience opportunities.
* Build digital PR and third\-party presence. Identify relevant publications, listicles, directories, comparison sites, podcasts, newsletters, communities, and other opportunities where PbN can build visibility, authority, traffic, or prospects. Manage outreach and evaluate organic and paid placement opportunities.
* Find new lead sources. Research where our ICP spends time and identify new ways to reach them. Turn promising ideas into structured experiments and scale the ones that generate qualified leads.
* Optimize conversion. Identify opportunities across campaigns, landing pages, forms, and acquisition journeys. Develop tests and work with relevant teams to improve conversion.
* Measure what matters. Track acquisition through qualified lead and, where measurable, demo, opportunity, and pipeline. Use data to understand what is working and where we should invest next.
* Use AI to accelerate growth. Apply AI and automation to research, prospect discovery, campaign analysis, reporting, optimization, and repetitive marketing workflows.


****What You'll Need****
**4–7 years of experience in growth marketing, performance marketing, demand generation, or digital acquisition, ideally with 3\+ years in B2B SaaS.**
* Hands\-on experience running and optimizing paid acquisition programs.
* Experience with email\-based lead generation and nurture.
* Strong understanding of B2B demand generation and lead funnels.
* Experience with audience research, prospect identification, list building, or new lead\-source development.
* Exposure to digital PR, outreach, communities, social listening, listings, or similar acquisition channels.
* Strong analytical and experimentation skills.
* Experience working with CRM and marketing analytics data.
* Understanding of conversion tracking, attribution, and funnel performance.
* Strong AI fluency and experience using AI to improve marketing execution and analysis.
* Comfortable working independently across multiple acquisition programs.


****Bonus Points****
* B2B SaaS experience with a sales\-led or hybrid sales model.
* Dental, healthcare, or practice\-management software experience.
* Experience building an acquisition channel from scratch.
* Experience with digital PR, publications, podcasts, newsletters, communities, directories, or listicles.
* Experience managing paid placements or marketing partnerships.
* Experience building automated prospecting or marketing workflows.


****The KPIs You'll Own****
* Qualified Lead Generation: Qualified leads generated across growth programs.
* Lead Quality: Quality and relevance of leads passed to the SDR team.
* Acquisition Efficiency: Cost per qualified lead and efficiency of acquisition programs.
* Pipeline Contribution: Demos, opportunities, and pipeline generated where measurable.
* Channel \& Experiment Performance: Performance of existing channels and outcomes from new acquisition experiments.

title: Growth & Marketing Lead
description:
**Homeie is building the consumer company for where you live.** 




  





 The first product is the smartest way to rent a home in India. You tell Homeie what matters once, and our AI understands your taste, searches and coordinates across a fragmented offline market, helps you see only the homes actually worth considering, and gets the transaction done, including ₹0 security deposit upfront. What takes weeks today should eventually feel like one really good afternoon.
 



  





 But renting is only where we enter the relationship. Where you live shapes a huge part of your life: how you commute, where you spend, the neighbourhood you become part of, how much you pay every month, and eventually where you choose to buy a home.
 



  





 Zomato made restaurants feel like consumer tech. Blinkit made grocery delivery feel culturally relevant. Snabbit is doing something similar with household help.
 **Renting is just as boring today. We think it can feel completely different.** 




  






 We’ve raised 
 
**$750k** 

  from a stealth fund, whose backers include Abstract Ventures, Bain Capital and Long Journey. We are still a very small team, which means the people joining now will have an absurd amount of influence over what Homeie becomes.
 




  





**What you’ll own:** 



* **Creative growth.** 
 Come up with ideas people actually want to talk about. Online, offline, weird, cheap, expensive, scrappy, beautiful. We care much more about whether it works than what category it falls into.
* **Performance marketing.** 
 Own Meta, Google and whatever else becomes useful. Understand CAC properly, build landing pages, test creatives aggressively and know exactly where money is being wasted.
* **GTM experiments.** 
 Reddit, offices, partnerships, societies, referrals, creator collaborations, companies relocating employees, offline distribution. Run lots of experiments and kill most of them quickly.
* **Content.** 
 Figure out how Homeie earns attention even when someone isn’t looking for a house this week.
* **Launches.** 
 When we release the app, a new feature, a new city, Homeie Concierge, or something we haven’t invented yet, make the launch feel much bigger than a feature announcement.
* **The numbers.** 
 Brand is not an excuse to avoid measurement. You should know CAC, conversion, channel economics, referral rates and what every meaningful experiment actually did.



  





**Who we're looking for:**

 Apartment lifts, cafés, moving boxes, creator partnerships, performance ads, unique referral loops, physical installations.

 Retail media is CommerceIQ's biggest and fastest\-growing product line, and it sits inside one of the fastest\-growing categories in all of advertising.  Our model is services as software: an agent plus a managed services team working together, owning the outcome for the customer rather than just handing them a dashboard. This is one of the most ambitious mandates in the company: build and run the commercial engine that takes InSEA from its current scale to many times that size over the next three years.
   

  

 InSEA is a strategic hub for RZR, not just a sales region. Global function leaders in Analytics, Machine Learning, Product, and more are based here, and this role operates as a true peer to them — combining commercial execution with the hub's technical and analytical firepower to drive growth for the region and the company.
   

  

 You will lead the InSEA commercial organization, including the Director of Sales and the Growth/CS team, reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer. You will partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Operations to drive tight go\-to\-market execution, and you will represent RZR at the most senior levels in the GCR market.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Revenue Growth \& Regional Scale
   

  

* Grow the InSEA business aggressively over the next three years through a balanced mix of net\-new acquisition, baseline protection, and share\-of\-wallet expansion.
* Own regional revenue targets with predictable pacing and disciplined execution throughout the year.


 New Business Acquisition
   

  

* Direct the Director of Sales, InSEA on pipeline generation, forecasting accuracy, and go\-to\-market execution across gaming and non\-gaming advertisers.
* Grow non\-gaming revenue as a share of the regional mix through focused vertical expansion.
* Build a repeatable sales engine that reduces dependency on individual hero performance.


 Existing Business Growth \& Retention
   

  

* Drive systematic share\-of\-wallet expansion across the existing InSEA customer base.
* Drive fast, repeatable upsell into new products based on demonstrated performance.
* Protect baseline revenue through consistent delivery against customer goals and early identification of churn risk.


 Product Penetration \& New Product Rollout
   

  

* Significantly increase iOS product penetration across the existing InSEA customer base.
* Launch and scale new growth products — including CTV and Influencer — in the region, securing early lighthouse customers.
* Establish clear feedback loops from InSEA customers to Product on channels, measurement, and creative formats.


 Strategic Hub Leadership \& Cross\-Functional Partnership
   

  

* Operate as a peer to RZR's global function leaders based in InSEA, aligning regional revenue execution with global priorities.
* Combine commercial execution with the hub's analytics, ML, and product capabilities to deliver growth outcomes for both the region and the company.
* Represent RZR at senior levels across the InSEA market — with top customers, at industry events, and with strategic partners.


 Customer Advocacy \& Market Influence
   

  

* Build a customer advocacy flywheel — onboard, grow, amplify, repeat — with a steady cadence of case studies, executive references, and event participation across the InSEA ecosystem.


 Marketing Partnership \& Demand Generation
   

  

* Partner with the CMO on a InSEA marketing plan localized to regional channels and events, with a clear return\-on\-investment bar.


 Team Growth, Hiring \& Leadership Development
   

  

* Grow and develop the InSEA commercial organization, maintaining a high bar on commercial judgment, technical credibility, and execution rigor.
* Build leadership depth across the team, including the Director of Sales, InSEA and Growth/CS management.


 Operating Discipline \& Scalability
   

  

* Establish a strong operating cadence across forecasting, pipeline inspection, account planning, and execution.
* Build scalable processes across Sales and CS that support rapid growth, and strengthen cross\-functional execution with Product, ML, Analytics, and RevOps across time zones.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* 10\+ years of senior leadership experience across Sales, Customer Success, or General Management in high\-growth environments, with 5\+ years leading teams in the Indian market.
* Proven ownership of large revenue targets with direct accountability for growth, retention, and expansion, and a track record of aggressive, multi\-year scaling.
* Demonstrated ability to manage both Sales and Customer Success/Growth teams under one leader and run them as a single revenue system.
* Prior experience operating within or alongside a performance marketing DSP, mobile advertising platform, or closely adjacent ecosystem.
* Deep understanding of the Greater China mobile advertising ecosystem — channels, measurement norms, and how GCR advertisers buy growth.
* An existing network of senior customers and industry leaders in the GCR mobile/gaming ecosystem.
* Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and grow Sales and CS teams, including managers and future leaders.
* Strong cross\-functional operating skills, with the ability to partner as a peer with global function leaders in Analytics, ML, and Product based in the region.
* Deep comfort with revenue operations — forecasting accuracy, pipeline inspection, pacing, and KPI\-driven execution.
* Native Mandarin and business\-fluent English, with experience operating alongside a global executive team.


 Why Join RZR in India ?
   

  

* Own an entire region end\-to\-end — Sales and CS, acquisition through expansion — as RZR's senior revenue leader in India (Bangalore), with a mandate to grow the business roughly tenfold over three years.
* Operate from a strategic hub: work alongside RZR's global leaders in Analytics, ML, and Product based in the region, with the full weight of those functions behind your growth plan.
* Build the organization yourself — hire, develop, and grow the team, including the Director of Sales, GCR, with real autonomy over your operating model and cadence.
* Partner directly with the CRO, CEO, and COO to shape both regional and company strategy.
* Join RZR at the moment it is building a full\-funnel, cross\-channel platform spanning mobile, CTV, and influencer — with Greater China central to that story and a clear path to broader global leadership upon success.


 RZR Behaviors
   

  

 RZR operates by eight core behaviors: Extreme Ownership
   

  

* Move Fast
* Drive for Excellence
* Proactive Communication
* Courage
* Curiosity
* Deliver Results
* Manage Ambiguity

Our mission is to empower fashion professionals to make smarter, faster sourcing decisions. Founded on the principles of transparency and responsibility, we bridge fashion businesses with the suppliers they need, helping them design and produce with both people and the planet in mind.

**Collaboration \& Communication**

**Problem Solving \& Continuous Improvement**

**Compliance \& Innovation**

**Additional Responsibilities**
