title: SOUTH INDIAN R&D CHEF / MANAGER
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONPosition

**South Indian R\&D Chef / Manager – Culinary Innovation \& Product Development**

Qualification \& Experience

* Diploma/Degree in Hotel Management or Food Production from **IHM or a reputed Hotel Management Institute** – mandatory.
* **5–10 years** of overall culinary experience.
* Minimum **3 years of hands\-on experience** in Culinary R\&D, Product Development, Menu Development, or Culinary Innovation.
* Experience in a **Restaurant, QSR, Central Kitchen, Food Manufacturing, FMCG Food Company, or Hospitality industry** is preferred.

Key Responsibilities1\. Culinary R\&D \& Product Development

* Lead South Indian cuisine R\&D and new product development from concept through commercial launch.
* Develop authentic, innovative, market\-relevant South Indian recipes suitable for modern restaurant and QSR formats.
* Conduct kitchen trials, product prototyping, benchmarking, recipe refinement, and validation.
* Convert traditional recipes into commercially viable, scalable, consistent, and operationally feasible products.
* Demonstrate strong hands\-on culinary skills and actively participate in kitchen trials.

2\. Regional South Indian Cuisine Expertise

Possess strong knowledge of regional and sub\-regional cuisines across:

* Tamil Nadu
* Kerala
* Karnataka
* Andhra Pradesh
* Telangana

Strong understanding of sub\-regional cuisines, including:

* Chettinad
* Kongunadu
* Malabar
* Thalassery
* Mangalorean
* Udupi
* Coorg
* Rayalaseema
* Telangana

Understand regional spice profiles, masalas, ingredients, cooking techniques, traditional preparation methods, and their adaptation to modern commercial formats.

3\. Recipe Standardisation \& Commercialisation

* Develop and maintain **Standard Recipe Cards (SRCs), SOPs, and process specifications**.
* Define recipe grammage, yield, portion size, cooking time, temperature, and process parameters.
* Conduct small\-batch, bulk, and scale\-up trials for commercial production.
* Ensure consistency, authenticity, taste, texture, appearance, and operational feasibility.
* Optimise recipes for commercial scalability and multi\-unit operations.
* Develop products based on available equipment, production processes, and operational capabilities.

4\. Sensory Evaluation \& Benchmarking

* Conduct sensory evaluations and product benchmarking.
* Perform competitive product analysis and market benchmarking.
* Evaluate products on:
* Taste
* Texture
* Aroma
* Appearance
* Authenticity
* Consistency
* Commercial feasibility
* Refine products based on sensory feedback and consumer/market requirements.

5\. Costing, Yield \& Portion Control

* Calculate and optimise food cost, recipe cost, yield, portion size, and wastage.
* Ensure recipes meet defined commercial cost targets without compromising quality and authenticity.
* Monitor yield and process efficiency during trials and scale\-up.

6\. Vendor \& Ingredient Development

* Identify and evaluate regional ingredients, spices, masalas, and potential vendors.
* Conduct vendor trials and support ingredient/product standardisation.
* Work closely with Procurement and SCM teams for sourcing and product development.
* Provide technical inputs for ingredient specifications and commercial trials.

7\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with:

* SCM \& Procurement
* Quality Assurance
* Operations
* Marketing
* Vendors
* Central Kitchen
* Manufacturing Teams
* Culinary Teams

Provide technical and culinary inputs for centralised production, manufacturing, and outlet\-level implementation.

8\. Product Implementation \& Training

* Support product implementation during pilot and post\-launch stages.
* Troubleshoot product and process issues after launch.
* Conduct product training and knowledge transfer for Operations and Culinary teams.
* Conduct outlet visits to ensure adherence to approved recipes, specifications, and processes.

9\. Market \& Culinary Research

* Research regional food trends and emerging South Indian culinary opportunities.
* Identify new dishes, ingredients, formats, and consumer trends.
* Undertake market visits and regional food research for benchmarking and innovation.
* Explore opportunities to adapt traditional South Indian cuisine to contemporary restaurant, QSR, central kitchen, RTE, frozen, and other commercial formats.

10\. Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain complete documentation of:
* Product trials
* Recipes
* SRCs
* SOPs
* Ingredient specifications
* Costing
* Yield
* Sensory evaluations
* Benchmarking
* Trial feedback
* Final approvals
* Maintain accurate records throughout the product development and commercialisation cycle.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should have:

* Strong passion and deep expertise in **South Indian cuisine**.
* Excellent understanding of the culinary diversity of South India rather than expertise limited to one regional cuisine.
* Proven **Culinary R\&D / Product Development** experience.
* Strong R\&D mindset with the ability to **research, create, test, refine, standardise, and commercialise** products.
* Strong understanding of recipe standardisation and commercial scalability.
* Good knowledge of food costing, yield management, portion control, and wastage optimisation.
* Strong sensory evaluation and palate development skills.
* Experience in new product launches and menu development.
* Good understanding of restaurant/QSR operational requirements.
* Strong communication, presentation, documentation, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Creative, analytical, detail\-oriented, and commercially focused.
* Willingness to travel for regional research, market visits, benchmarking, vendor trials, and product development.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in the following environments will be preferred:

* Reputed QSR or Restaurant Chains
* Central Kitchens
* Food Manufacturing Companies
* FMCG Food Companies
* Hospitality Groups
* Multi\-unit restaurant operations
* RTE/Frozen food product development
* Vendor development and commercial trials
* Manufacturing scale\-up and productionisation

Key Screening Criteria

Candidates will be evaluated primarily on the following:

* **IHM / Reputed Hotel Management Background**
* **Strong South Indian Regional Cuisine Knowledge**
* **Proven Culinary R\&D / Product Development Experience**
* **Hands\-on Trial \& Recipe Development Capability**
* **Commercialisation \& Scale\-up Experience**
* **Recipe Standardisation \& SRC/SOP Development**
* **Food Costing, Yield \& Portion Control**
* **Sensory Evaluation \& Product Benchmarking**
* **QSR / Restaurant / Central Kitchen Experience**
* **Vendor Trials \& Ingredient Standardisation**
* **New Product Launch Experience**
* **Ability to Work Cross\-Functionally with Operations, QA, SCM, Procurement and Marketing**

Core Competencies

**South Indian Cuisine \| Culinary R\&D \| Product Development \| Recipe Innovation \| Commercialisation \| Recipe Standardisation \| SRC \& SOP Development \| Food Costing \| Yield Management \| Sensory Evaluation \| Benchmarking \| Scale\-up Trials \| Vendor Development \| QSR Operations \| Central Kitchen \| Market Research \| Product Launch \| Culinary Training**

 help businesses simplify operations, strengthen financial control, and drive sustainable

 distributors, retailers, and trading businesses.
 



  





 Over the years, ProfitNX has built a strong reputation across Gujarat and has become a

 particularly within the ceramic and tile industry—one of India's most dynamic
 



 manufacturing ecosystems. The platform has consistently helped businesses improve
 



 financial management, inventory control, operational efficiency, and business visibility.
 



  





 Building on its strong ERP expertise, Dsoft successfully expanded into specialized industry
 



 solutions with ORNATE ERP, now trusted by 5,000\+ jewellery businesses across 23 states,
 



 along with innovative platforms such as SUVARNA SETU and ORNATE CRM.

 ERP solution for SMEs across India. With a mature product, an experienced technology
 



 team, and a clear national growth vision, ProfitNX is entering its most exciting phase of
 



 expansion.
 



  





 To lead this journey, we are looking for an accomplished business leader who can transform
 



 a proven regional success into a nationally recognized ERP brand.

 Unlike many leadership positions focused on managing mature businesses, this opportunity
 



 allows you to scale an established ERP platform with a proven market foundation.

  A mature and market\-tested Accounting ERP solution.

 national business.

 implementation partners.

 finance leaders, and strategic customers.
 



  Building a predictable sales engine through structured pipeline management, CRM
 



 adoption, and sales governance.
 



  Working closely with Product development, Marketing, and Customer Success teams
 



 to strengthen ProfitNX's market leadership.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Business Growth \& Strategy:** 




  Define and execute the long\-term business growth strategy.
 



  Identify new industries, customer segments, and geographical opportunities.
 



  Develop scalable go\-to\-market models for national expansion.
 



  





**Revenue Leadership:** 




  Own revenue, profitability, and business performance.
 



  Deliver sustainable quarter\-on\-quarter and year\-on\-year growth.
 



  Build a healthy sales pipeline and improve conversion performance.
 



  





**Market Expansion:** 




  Develop and execute state\-wise expansion strategies.
 



  Build ProfitNX's presence across emerging and high\-potential business markets.
 



  Establish strong regional sales capabilities.
 



  





**Channel Development:** 




  Build a nationwide partner ecosystem comprising resellers, implementation
 



 partners, consultants, and referral partners.
 



  Enable partner\-led business growth through structured engagement programs.
 



 Sales Leadership
 



  Recruit, mentor, and inspire high\-performing business development leaders.
 



  Build a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous
 



 improvement.
 



  





**Strategic Customer Engagement** 




  Build trusted relationships with enterprise customers and key decision\-makers.
 



  Position ProfitNX as a strategic business solution through consultative selling.
 



  





**Who You Are** 




 You are an entrepreneurial business leader who enjoys building organizations, creating
 



 markets, and delivering sustainable business growth.
 



  





 You think strategically, execute decisively, and lead by example.
 



  





 You believe in developing people, creating customer value, and building businesses that
 



 stand the test of time.
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  12–15 years of experience in ERP, SaaS, or Enterprise Software sales.
 



  Minimum 5 years in a senior business leadership role.
 



  Proven track record of building business across multiple Indian states.
 



  Demonstrated ownership of revenue, profitability, and commercial growth.
 



  Strong experience in enterprise sales and consultative solution selling.
 



  Success in developing channel partner and distribution ecosystems.
 



  Experience building and leading high\-performing sales organizations.
 



  Strong executive presence with the ability to engage CXOs and business owners.
 



  





**Why Join ProfitNX** 




 Joining ProfitNX means more than taking on a leadership role—it means shaping the future
 



 of a proven ERP platform.
 



  





 You will have the opportunity to:
 



  





  Lead the national expansion of a mature Accounting ERP solution.

  Work directly with promoters who value ownership, agility, and innovation.
 



  Influence business strategy and product direction.
 



  Build high\-performing teams and create a lasting market impact.
 



  Be rewarded for creating sustainable business growth and long\-term value.
 



  





**Shape the Future with ProfitNX** 




  





**Great businesses are built by leaders who see opportunity where others see limitations.**

 measurable business impact, we invite you to lead the next chapter of ProfitNX's journey.
 



  





**Build Business. Build Markets. Build a Legacy**

A creative mindset, strong communication, and willingness to learn are more important. Who Were Looking For You may be a good fit if you: Naturally spend time understanding social media trends and content. Notice why some posts perform better than others. We are looking for someone who wants to learn how social media works as a business function not just someone who likes using Instagram. What Youll Learn During the 6-month internship, you will gain practical experience in: Social media management Content planning and content calendars Social media copywriting Graphic and carousel creation Short-form video and reel creation Organic social media growth Competitor and market research Social media analytics and reporting Community management Client communication Marketing operations Using AI tools for marketing and content workflows Managing social media for multiple business brands What You Can Expect Hands-on experience managing social media for real businesses. title: Founder’s Office - Associate (AI Marketing)
description:
**ABOUT CLARO ENERGY** 





 Claro Energy is a leading clean energy company in India with 15\+ years of experience in building decentralized renewable energy solutions. We have delivered 1,00,000\+ solar projects across solar irrigation pumps, rooftop solar, and large\-scale clean energy programs, working closely with farmers, households, institutions, and government initiatives across multiple Indian states.
 




  






 As we scale further, we are building an AI\-first data and intelligence foundation to power automation, forecasting, and faster decision\-making across operations, growth, inventory, and finance. This role sits in the Founder's Office and will help extend that vision to the marketing front.
 




  





**THE MISSION** 





 We are not building a traditional marketing department. We are building an autonomous growth engine. We're looking for a technically curious, high\-energy fresh graduate — someone hungry to learn and eager to get hands\-on — to help build and run our AI\-native marketing pod. You'll work alongside a small team armed with an outsized AI tech stack, punching above your weight to execute with the volume and precision of a 20\-person enterprise team.
 




  





**WHAT YOU WILL DO** 



* Learn the Stack: Get hands\-on with workflows linking our CRM, website, and outbound channels using automation tools (n8n, Make) and AI agents
* Run the Content Factory: Shift from "writing" to "prompting and editing" — help build the templates and system prompts that let AI generate high\-quality SEO, social, and ad copy at scale, using gen\-AI content tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Runway, Higgsfield, HeyGen, and ElevenLabs
* Build Reusable Playbooks: Create and maintain AI skills and templates (e.g., on Claude) that encode our brand guidelines, tone, and design language — so every new campaign, post, or asset stays consistent and on\-brand without starting from scratch each time
* Support the Pod: Work closely with marketing interns and the wider team — help sharpen daily workflows, focusing on data quality, AI output auditing, and community engagement
* Execute Agile Campaigns: Help deploy intent\-based outbound campaigns, set up dynamic website personalizations, and test ad variants using AI\-driven platforms
* Protect the Brand Soul: Support quality control — help ensure our output never sounds like a generic robot, and stays true to our voice and strategic edge across every marketing touchpoint



  





**WHO YOU ARE** 



* Experience: 0–2 years — fresh graduates welcome; what matters most is curiosity, hustle, and a genuine appetite to learn.
* AI\-Native: You use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Perplexity daily, and are comfortable writing detailed, context\-rich prompts — you're curious about agentic workflows
* Gen\-AI Content Curiosity: You're excited about tools like Midjourney, Runway, Higgsfield, HeyGen, and ElevenLabs — you don't need hands\-on experience with these specific tools, just the interest and aptitude to pick them up fast
* Technical Chops: You don't need to be a software developer, but you're not afraid of webhooks, APIs, CRM data structures, or vibe\-coding tools like Lovable, Bolt.new, or Replit Agent
* Antifragile: You thrive in iterative environments — when a platform algorithm changes or an AI model updates, you're excited to adapt rather than wait for a new playbook



  





**WHY THIS ROLE?** 





 You'll skip the traditional corporate marketing ladder from day one. Instead of managing spreadsheets of manual tasks, you'll be learning to build and command the systems that do the work — with direct exposure to company revenue and a seat close to the founder's office.
 




  





**HOW TO APPLY** 





 Click Apply Now to be redirected to the Claro Energy recruitment portal, where you'll submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a few basic details. Alternatively, you can email your resume directly to hr@claroenergy.in with the subject line "Application – Associate, AI Marketing (Founder's Office)".

description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 Salesforce is currently seeking a Director,Technical Consulting (Marketing Cloud Next) to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. We are looking for an experienced professional services leader who has experience in scaling professional services delivery centers across the world. In addition The Director — Marketing Cloud Next is an execution\-focused technical leader responsible for architecting and delivering end\-to\-end migrations from legacy marketing platforms (Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, legacy SFMC) to Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next. As a foundational member of the Strategic Migration CoE and Migration Factory, you will act as primary technical authority for the Marketing Cloud Next track — owning the solution design, data architecture, subscriber migration strategy, journey migration blueprint, and Data Cloud unified profile design. You will combine deep Marketing Cloud Next platform expertise with advanced data migration methodologies to ensure that subscriber data, consent records, journeys, content and preference data are migrated with full integrity, compliance and zero business disruption.
   

  

 This role is 50% billable and in addition to people leadership, you will work with our customers and partners as a senior technical architect/program architect/CTO to solve critically important business challenges using Salesforce’s Cloud.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead a team of up to 8 direct reports, comprising Architects and potentially Managers, providing technical direction, mentorship, and performance leadership.
* Serve as a Senior/Principal Technical Architect for Marketing Cloud migration projects, contributing hands\-on technical expertise and architectural leadership at approximately 50% utilization.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture that drive increased business value.
* Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the Industries Architects’ consulting practice; serving as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise, specifically driving the evolution of an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology within the practice.
* Design the subscriber and audience data migration strategy, including data extension schema, subscriber key mapping, suppression list migration, consent record preservation (GDPR/CAN\-SPAM/CASL) and historical send data handling.
* Architect the Salesforce Data Cloud implementation for unified customer profile design, identity resolution rules, data stream ingestion from source systems, and audience segmentation activation to Marketing Cloud Next.
* Own the journey migration blueprint — mapping legacy automation workflows, drip campaigns and triggered sends from source platforms to Marketing Cloud Next Journey Builder, including decision splits, wait steps and exit criteria.
* Define end\-to\-end data lineage including data profiling, cleansing logic, transformation mapping and reconciliation strategies for all subscriber objects, data extensions and consent tables.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.
* Lead a project team of developers focused on driving optimized solutions for our clients leveraging Salesforce clouds.
* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third\-party stakeholders
* Establish trust with the customer’s leadership, promoting and/or implementing best practices with Salesforce
* Highlight and manage risk areas in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion


**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**
* Marketing Cloud Next Platform Depth: Advanced expertise in Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Mobile Studio, Advertising Studio and Contact Builder / Audience Builder.
* Data Cloud / CDP: Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Data Cloud — data stream configuration, identity resolution, unified profile modelling, segmentation and activation to MC Next.
* Subscriber Data Architecture: Deep understanding of subscriber data model, data extensions, sendable vs non\-sendable objects, contact counts, suppression logic and list management at scale.
* Consent \& Compliance Architecture: Expert knowledge of GDPR, CAN\-SPAM, CASL, POPI — consent record migration, preference centre design, suppression list management and compliance\-aligned data handling.
* Email Deliverability: Strong understanding of sender reputation, IP warm\-up strategy, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and deliverability validation post\-migration.
* Data Migration Methodology: Proven expertise in executing high\-volume subscriber migrations — data profiling, ETL pipeline design, transformation mapping and reconciliation for marketing data objects.
* Integration Architecture: Understanding of Marketing Cloud Connect (CRM sync), REST/SOAP Marketing Cloud APIs, API\-triggered sends and event\-driven messaging patterns.
* AMPscript / SSJS: Proficiency in dynamic content scripting for migrated email templates — ensuring legacy personalisation logic is recreated accurately in MC Next.


**Minimum Requirements**
* 18\+ years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects and handling individual contributors.
* 8\+ years of people management experience
* Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills
* Demonstrated experience migrating high\-volume subscriber databases (10M\+ records) with zero consent data loss
* Experience migrating from Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot or legacy SFMC Classic to Marketing Cloud Next
* Hands\-on experience with ETL tools — Informatica Cloud, Talend, MuleSoft, Azure Data Factory — for large\-scale subscriber data extraction and transformation
* Strong interpersonal skills \- nurture effective working relationships with others
* Proficiency in English. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience


**Preferred Skills — Good To Have**
* CTA
* Experience migrating from Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot or legacy SFMC Classic to Marketing Cloud Next
* Hands\-on experience with ETL tools — Informatica Cloud, Talend, MuleSoft, Azure Data Factory — for large\-scale subscriber data extraction and transformation
* Knowledge of Salesforce Interaction Studio / Personalisation for 1\-to\-1 journey personalisation post\-migration
* Experience with WhatsApp, LINE, Push and SMS channel migration in addition to email
* Familiarity with marketing data warehouse patterns (Snowflake, Databricks) as upstream Data Cloud data sources
* Understanding of Salesforce Loyalty Cloud or Commerce Cloud as upstream journey trigger sources
* Thorough individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies, including hands\-on delivery patterns for generative AI and agentic frameworks.
* A great listener with the ability to communicate with people in diverse roles
* Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration
* Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems
* Adept at navigating/mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue

title: Marketing Lead
description:
**Job Description** 




  





**Marketing Lead — Digital, KOL \& Medical Marketing** 





 Own and build the Dōtō Health brand across digital, clinician (KOL) and medical marketing
 




**Role:** 

 Marketing Lead — Digital, KOL \& Medical Marketing
 




**Reports to:** 

 Founder \& CEO (close partnership with Sales \& Product)
 




**Location:** 

 Pune, Maharashtra (on\-site; frequent travel)
 




**Employment:** 

 Full\-time
 




**Experience:** 

 6–10 years, including team management
 




**Function:** 

 Marketing · Brand · Digital · KOL \& Medical Affairs
 




  





**About Dōtō Health (CareMother):** 





 Dōtō Health Private Limited, operating as CareMother, is a Pune\-based, Made\-in\-India femtech and medical\-device company on a mission to create equal opportunities of care for women. We build a full\-stack, AI\-enabled maternal\-care platform — spanning conception to post\-partum — that combines smart monitoring devices, AI\-powered decision support and protocol\-driven workflows for fetal, labour, birthing and post\-partum care.
 





 CareMother is deployed across 28 states and 2,500\+ facilities in India and seven LMICs, covering 700,000\+ pregnancies and 2 million\+ tests, and is a licensed CDSCO medical device backed by clinical research partnerships with IIT Bombay, University of Oxford, multiple AIIMs and key medical institutions in India.
 




  





**About the Role:** 





 We're looking for a Marketing Lead to own and grow the Dōtō Health / CareMother brand and lead marketing across three connected fronts: digital marketing, KOL (Key Opinion Leader) engagement and medical / scientific marketing.
 





 In healthtech, trust is everything — built with clinicians through credible science and with mothers through a warm, clear brand.
 





 You will set marketing strategy, build and lead the team, deepen relationships with leading obstetricians and medical societies, and translate our clinical impact into demand across hospitals, clinics and homes.
 





 This is a hands\-on, build\-from\-the\-front role for someone with a strong desire to build a category\-defining maternal\-health brand.
 




  





**What You'll Do** 




  





**1\.BRAND \& MARKETING STRATEGY:** 





 – Own the brand — positioning, narrative and identity for Dōtō Health and its products (AnandiMaa, FetoMax, Nurtura) across B2B (hospitals and clinics) and B2C (mothers and home care).
 





 – Set and run the marketing plan — annual strategy, calendar, budget and channel mix aligned to sales and product goals, with clear ownership of pipeline and brand metrics.
 




  





**2\.DIGITAL MARKETING** 





 – Lead performance and organic marketing across website, SEO/SEM, social, content, email and paid campaigns, backed by analytics and a healthy marketing funnel.
 





 – Drive demand generation — generate and nurture qualified leads for the sales team and grow the home\-care product funnel; manage marketing automation and CRM hygiene.
 





 – Own content and creative — website, decks, videos, case studies and campaign assets; manage external agencies, freelancers and vendors to a high bar.
 




  





**3\.KOL \& MEDICAL MARKETING** 





 – Build and nurture KOL relationships with leading obstetricians, gynaecologists, maternal\-fetal\-medicine experts and medical societies (e.g. FOGSI and state chapters), turning them into advocates and advisers.
 





 – Lead medical and scientific marketing — advisory boards, CMEs, symposia, webinars and clinical\-evidence dissemination that communicate our impact accurately and credibly.
 





 – Produce compliant medical content — clinically accurate collateral developed with medical and regulatory teams, respecting medical\-advertising norms and PC\-PNDT sensitivities.
   






**4\.EVENTS, CONFERENCES \& FIELD PRESENCE** 





 – Represent Dōtō Health at medical conferences, exhibitions and society meetings, and lead product launches and on\-ground activations — this role involves frequent travel across India.
 









**5\.TEAM LEADERSHIP** 





 – Build and lead the marketing team — We have members managing each function above. We need someone who can navigate them, coach them and lead by example.
 




  





**Who You Are** 





 – 5\+ years in marketing, with a strong track record spanning digital and KOL/medical marketing, ideally in healthcare, medtech, pharma or femtech.
 





 – Proven team management and leadership — you've built, led and mentored marketing teams and managed agencies to results.
 





 – Deep digital marketing experience — performance marketing, SEO/SEM, social and content, marketing automation, and comfort with analytics tools (GA4, Meta/Google Ads, CRM).
 





 – A relationship\-builder — able to earn the trust of senior clinicians and KOLs and manage those relationships with credibility and care.
 





 – A strong desire to build a brand — an owner's mindset, high energy and the ambition to make Dōtō a household and clinician\-trusted name.
 





 – Willing and able to travel frequently for conferences, KOL engagements and field activations.
 





 – An excellent communicator and storyteller, data\-driven and organised, with a Bachelor's degree; an MBA in marketing is a plus.
 




  





**Bonus Points** 





 – Healthcare / medtech / pharma marketing background with an understanding of medical marketing, HCP engagement and regulatory sensitivities in India.
 





 – An existing network within the OB\-GYN / maternal\-health clinical community.
 





 – Experience marketing to both clinicians (B2B) and consumers (B2C), and a good design and content sensibility.
 




  





**What We Offer** 





 – Full ownership of the brand and the mandate to build a category\-defining maternal\-health name from the front.
 





 – A mission that matters — your work helps make pregnancy and childbirth safer for mothers and newborns across India and LMICs.
 





 – Direct access to leadership, a fast\-moving environment and real influence over strategy and growth.
 





 – Competitive compensation and a collaborative, high\-calibre team at our Pune headquarters.
 




  





**﻿
 
 How to Apply** 





 Send your CV, a short note on a brand you helped build, and any campaign work you're proud of to hr@dotohealth.com with the subject line “Marketing Lead — Digital, KOL \& Medical Marketing”.
 





 Dōtō Health Private Limited (CareMother) · Pune, Maharashtra ·
 
 www.caremother.in
 
 \| Dōtō Health is an equal\-opportunity employer and strongly encourages women to apply.

title: Performance Marketing Head
description:
We're hiring a Head of Performance Marketing at Oniisaab.
 



  





 Remote, anywhere in India. Full\-time. 5\+ years. Reports to the founders.
 



  





 Context: we're an anime\-inspired streetwear brand out of Jaipur. Twelve drops in two years, 12,000\+ orders, most sold out, built almost entirely on Meta and a loud Instagram community.
 



  





 We're profitable, founder\-led, and currently plateaued. One campaign carries most of our spend, our attribution has a COD\-shaped hole in it, and we've hit the ceiling of what two founders can push part\-time.
 



  





 So we're handing the whole thing to one person.
 



  





 THE ROLE
 



  





 You own paid acquisition end\-to\-end: strategy, spend, structure, creative direction, measurement, and the number at the bottom.
 



  





 Today that's a Meta\-dominant account at 6\-7x blended ROAS, with one Advantage\+ campaign doing most of the heavy lifting. A good problem and a fragile one. We need someone who can scale it without destabilising the learning phase, diversify beyond it, and build a testing system that doesn't need a founder in Ads Manager daily.
 



  





 You'll be in the ad account. You'll also be the person who decides what we stop doing.
 



  





 WHAT YOU'LL OWN
 



  





 \- Meta across two ad accounts: campaign architecture, budget allocation, scaling cadence
 



 \- Fixing structural drag: fragmentation, cannibalisation, spend\-limit issues
 



 \- New channels: Google/PMax, YouTube, creator\-led paid
 



 \- The creative engine: UGC, statics, product video, hooks and CTAs, briefed by you
 



 \- A real testing framework: hook rate, hold rate, cost\-per\-purchase by concept
 



 \- Tracking that tells the truth: CAPI health, match quality, UTM hygiene
 



 \- The weekly number founders and investors read: MER, CAC, contribution margin
 



  





 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
 



  





 \- 5\+ years in performance, at least 3 owning D2C e\-commerce. Not lead\-gen, not B2B, not agency\-of\-record reporting
 



 \- Real ownership of meaningful monthly spend in India
 



 \- Deep Meta expertise: Advantage\+ behaviour, CBO vs ABO, learning\-phase mechanics, and what actually happens when you push budget 40% in a day
 



 \- Real creative instincts. You can brief an ad, judge a hook, explain why one static beat another. This is a creative\-led category and media buying alone will not save you
 



 \- Comfort with COD\-heavy Indian commerce and its attribution mess
 



  





 Bonus: apparel, PMax, creator\-led paid, or a real feel for anime and streetwear.
 



  





 NOT FOR YOU IF
 



  





 You've only ever worked inside an agency reporting template. You need a creative team, a data team, and a brief handed to you. Your scaling plan is "increase budget and wait."
 



  





 THE OFFER
 



  





 Remote\-first, one weekly founder sync, no layer between you and the decision. Compensation benchmarked to senior in\-house performance leadership in India, upside tied to contribution margin.
 



  





 TO APPLY
 



  





 Email oniisaab@gmail.com, subject "Performance Lead". Tell us about the best account you've ever run and what broke while you scaled it. No cover letters, we read every reply.

 Teceze is an IT services company supporting clients across Digital Workplace Services, Cloud and Infrastructure, Cyber Security, Staff Augmentation and Global Procurement Services. This role contributes to client Salesforce consulting and delivery, working with business stakeholders and technical teams to implement, improve and support enterprise applications.

* Document assets, data flows and operating procedures; support campaign incidents, train users and coordinate release changes with client teams.



**Required skills and experience** 



* Hands\-on Marketing Cloud Engagement experience with Journey Builder, Automation Studio, data extensions and campaign deployment.
* Strong SQL and AMPscript skills, plus HTML and CSS for responsive email development and debugging.
* Understanding of subscriber identity, data relationships, segmentation, consent handling and the risks of incorrect audience selection.
* Experience with APIs or Marketing Cloud Connect and reconciliation of data exchanged with CRM or other platforms.
* Ability to test complex journeys and personalisation scenarios and troubleshoot data, automation and sending failures.
* Ability to translate campaign objectives into maintainable technical implementations and explain performance results to marketing stakeholders.



  





**Education:** 
 Degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent practical experience. Evidence of successful delivery is more important than certification alone.
 



**Key deliverables** 




 Journey designs, audience queries, automation workflows, tested email assets, campaign QA evidence, reporting definitions and operational runbooks.
 



**Measures of success** 



* Campaign audiences, exclusions and personalisation match approved specifications, with consent and suppression controls consistently applied.
* Journeys and automations run reliably, and campaign defects are detected before activation or resolved through clear incident procedures.
* Engagement and conversion outcomes are measured against agreed objectives with transparent definitions and responsible interpretation.

title: Digital Marketing executive
description:
What this role actually is

Lending is a trust business. Nobody borrows money from a brand they do not believe in. That belief is not built by

posting offers. It is built by showing real people, real shops, and real moments where credit changed something, and

telling those stories well enough that a stranger stops scrolling.

So this is a video and storytelling role first, wrapped in a social media job. You will find the story, script it, shoot it, cut

it, and put it out. You will also plan the calendar, write the copy, design the statics, and read the numbers, because

the function is yours end to end.

How we work

Quality over quantity, and we mean it. We would rather publish six pieces a month that people send to a friend

than thirty that fill a grid. You will never be measured on post count. Nobody here will ask you why you did not post

on Tuesday.

High agency is the whole job. This is a small team. Nobody will hand you a brief, a shot list, or a queue of tasks.

You will decide what is worth making, find the shop owner willing to talk on camera, get yourself to their store, and

come back with something. When you hit a wall, we expect you to route around it and tell us afterwards, not wait for

permission. If you need someone to tell you what to do next, this will be a frustrating place to work.

You get real tools. Design, editing, scheduling, analytics, and paid AI subscriptions. Camera and audio gear if you

can make the case for it. What we are looking for is the judgment to use them well.

What you will own

Video, end to end

Find the stories worth telling: borrower journeys, shop floors, the team, the neighbourhoods we lend in

Script and storyboard before you shoot, so the edit is not a rescue operation

Shoot on location: phone or camera, framing, lighting, and clean audio (audio is where most amateur video dies)

Edit short form vertical for reels and shorts, plus the occasional longer cut for YouTube and sales use

Subtitles, sound design, pacing, hooks. Own the craft, not just the software.

Storytelling and copy

Find the human angle in a product that is fundamentally a spreadsheet

Write hooks, scripts, and captions in Tamil and English that sound like a person and not a press release

Build a narrative that holds together across months rather than a series of unrelated posts

Content planning

Build and maintain a monthly calendar across Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, and WhatsApp channels

Tie content to what the business needs that month: a product push, a branch opening, a festive lending season, a

hiring driveDesign creative for the posts that are not video, and keep the visual identity consistent

Community

Reply to comments and DMs, route genuine loan enquiries to the right internal team, keep the tone consistent

Track what people keep asking us and turn that back into content

AI leverage

Use AI across ideation, scripting, first draft copy, image generation, editing, subtitling, and repurposing

Build workflows so one shoot day yields a month of material

Know where AI output is not good enough and fix it by hand

Measurement

Report weekly on reach, retention, saves, shares, follower growth, and enquiries generated

Watch retention curves on video and change how you cut the next one because of what you saw

What we are looking for

Video you have made. A reel, a short film, a college documentary, a wedding edit, a YouTube channel, a meme

page you edit yourself. This is the single most important thing in your application. Send it before you send anything

else.

A storytelling instinct: you notice the detail that makes a story land, and you know what to cut

Comfort with editing and design tools (CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci, Canva, Figma, or whatever you already use well)

Fluent Tamil and English, written and spoken, and the confidence to put a nervous shop owner at ease on camera

Genuine daily use of AI tools, with opinions about which are good and why

High agency: a track record of starting things nobody asked you to start

Willingness to learn how lending works. You cannot tell the story of a credit product you do not understand.

Care about accuracy. We operate in a regulated space, so claims about rates, eligibility, and approvals have to be

exactly right.

Nice to have

Experience with a fintech, bank, NBFC, or any regulated brand

Basic understanding of RBI's fair practices expectations for lender communication

On camera presence, or photography

Experience running paid campaigns, even at a small budget

What you get

Full ownership of a function from day one, with your work in front of the founders every week

A paid stack of the best tools available rather than a request form and a wait

Direct exposure to how an NBFC is actually built, financed, and scaled

Room to grow into leading the marketing function as the team expands

How to apply

Send us the best video you have made, plus links to any other work you want us to see. Shortlisted candidates will

receive a short practical assignment. We watch the video first.

Pay: ₹10,239\.35 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

Kore.ai is a globally recognised leader in the conversational and generative AI space, helping enterprises deliver extraordinary experiences for their customers, employees, and contact centre agents. Our goal is to empower businesses with effective, simple and responsible AI solutions that create engaging interactions across sectors, serving over 100M consumers and 500,000\+ employees worldwide. Kore.ai is one of the fastest\-growing AI companies globally, recognised as a leader by leading technology and industry analysts like Gartner, Forrester, IDC, ISG, and Everest. Founded in 2014 by serial successful entrepreneur Raj Koneru, Kore.ai supports customers globally across offices in Orlando, Hyderabad, New York, London, Germany, Dubai, Frankfurt, Tokyo and Seoul.

**Position Overview**
---------------------


We are seeking a strategic, results\-driven, and highly collaborative **Associate Director, Global Partner Marketing – Hyperscaler** to lead the development and execution of joint go\-to\-market strategies with Amazon Web Services (AWS).


This role is critical to accelerating Kore.ai’s growth through the AWS ecosystem by building joint marketing plans, driving co\-sell and co\-marketing motions, strengthening executive and field alignment, and delivering measurable pipeline and revenue impact. The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in enterprise technology partner marketing, hyperscaler ecosystems, integrated campaign execution, executive stakeholder management, and global program leadership.


This role requires a balance of strategic thinking and hands\-on execution. The candidate should be comfortable defining GTM priorities, managing complex cross\-functional initiatives, engaging senior stakeholders, and driving programs from planning through execution, measurement, and optimisation.

**Location:** India, with Hyderabad or Bangalore preferred

**Role Description**
--------------------


Are you passionate about building high\-impact partner marketing programs that drive business outcomes? In this role, you will be responsible for leading Kore.ai’s AWS partner marketing strategy and execution globally, with a focus on building awareness, generating demand, accelerating the pipeline, and strengthening Kore.ai’s presence within the AWS ecosystem.


You will work closely with AWS partner marketing, alliances, sales, field marketing, product marketing, solution consulting, and revenue teams to create integrated GTM programs that support joint business priorities. This includes campaign planning, content development, digital demand generation, executive engagement, events, agency management, budget oversight, and performance reporting.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Partner Marketing Strategy and GTM Leadership**

* Develop and lead the global AWS partner marketing strategy aligned to Kore.ai’s business priorities, AWS partnership goals, and regional pipeline objectives.
* Build quarterly and annual joint marketing plans with AWS, including campaign priorities, target accounts, event strategy, content themes, budget allocation, and success metrics.

### **Integrated Campaign Execution**

* Lead the planning and execution of integrated partner marketing campaigns across digital, field, event, content, and partner channels.
* Manage campaign timelines, budgets, deliverables, dependencies, and cross\-functional execution to drive awareness, demand generation, and pipeline acceleration.

### **Content Development and Messaging**

* Develop compelling joint value propositions, campaign narratives, messaging frameworks, and solution positioning for AWS\-focused initiatives.
* Lead the creation of co\-branded assets, including solution briefs, case studies, whitepapers, blogs, landing pages, webinar content, executive presentations, and sales enablement materials.

### **Digital Marketing and Demand Generation**

* Drive digital marketing programs through Kore.ai and AWS channels to generate qualified demand and accelerate pipeline.
* Leverage AWS Partner Central, AWS Marketplace, co\-sell programs, MDF opportunities, and partner digital platforms to support joint opportunity creation.

### **Events and Executive Engagement**

* Develop and execute event strategies aligned to AWS priorities, including AWS re, AWS Summits, partner events, executive briefings, webinars, roundtables, and workshops.
* Coordinate sponsorships, speaking opportunities, executive participation, customer sessions, attendee acquisition, logistics, and post\-event follow\-up to drive measurable outcomes.

### **Cross\-Functional Leadership**

* Act as the central marketing lead for AWS\-related partner marketing initiatives, ensuring alignment across sales, alliances, product marketing, field marketing, marketing operations, and AWS stakeholders.
* Build strong relationships with AWS partner marketing, field, alliance, and program teams to identify opportunities for deeper collaboration and joint GTM impact.

### **Budget, Agency, and Vendor Management**

* Manage AWS partner marketing budgets, MDF programs, agency relationships, vendor execution, and program performance.
* Ensure all campaigns and events are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned to business objectives, pipeline goals, and ROI expectations.

### **Measurement, Reporting, and Optimization**

* Define and track success metrics across awareness, engagement, MQLs, meetings, pipeline influence, sourced pipeline, and revenue impact.
* Build executive\-ready reporting that communicates program outcomes, key learnings, pipeline impact, and recommendations for optimization.

**Qualifications \& Skills Required**
-------------------------------------

### **Must\-Have Skills**

* 10\+ years of B2B marketing experience, with strong experience in partner marketing, alliance marketing, ecosystem marketing, or enterprise technology marketing.
* Proven ability to develop and execute partner marketing strategies and integrated GTM plans that drive awareness, demand generation, pipeline creation, and revenue impact.
* Strong understanding of hyperscaler ecosystems, preferably AWS, Microsoft, or Google Cloud, including co\-sell, marketplace, MDF, and joint campaign motions.

* Strong cross\-functional collaboration and executive engagement skills, with the ability to work across sales, alliances, product, technical, field marketing, marketing operations, and partner stakeholders.

Join the Kore.ai team and help companies of all sizes simplify the adoption of advanced AI solutions responsibly. Work alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry to pioneer safe, reliable solutions. We're reshaping the way companies harness the power of AI, simplifying and enhancing accessibility.

title: SEO Specialist
description:
**Role Overview**

  

Cambridge Technology is seeking an experienced SEO, AEO \& GEO Specialist to lead the organic search strategy across all Cambridge brands and digital properties. The role will strengthen visibility across traditional search engines, answer engines, and AI\-powered discovery platforms, translating business priorities into measurable organic growth.


This strategic and hands\-on position encompasses technical, on\-page, off\-page, local, and international SEO, along with performance analytics and search governance. The specialist will collaborate with internal marketing, content, design, product, and development teams to establish priorities, guide implementation, and improve search visibility, qualified website traffic, and lead generation.


The specialist will also be responsible for managing Google Analytics dashboards, monitoring website performance, and presenting week\-on\-week analytical reports and actionable insights to relevant internal stakeholders.

 **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Develop and maintain an integrated SEO, AEO, and GEO strategy across all company brands, websites, products, and target markets.
* Conduct keyword research, search\-intent analysis, competitor research, and content\-gap analysis to identify organic growth opportunities.
* Lead technical SEO audits covering crawlability, indexation, website architecture, redirects, structured data, page speed, mobile usability, and Core Web Vitals.
* Define on\-page optimization recommendations for page structure, metadata, headings, internal linking, schema markup, and content coverage.
* Create prioritized SEO roadmaps and provide clear implementation requirements to internal marketing, content, design, product, and development teams.
* Develop off\-page SEO strategies covering backlink quality, link acquisition, brand mentions, digital PR opportunities, and topical authority.
* Plan and guide local and international SEO initiatives, including business profiles, citations, localized pages, geographic targeting, localization, and hreflang.
* Improve visibility across answer engines and generative AI platforms—including Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Bing Copilot, and Perplexity—through structured, authoritative, and machine\-readable content recommendations.
* Monitor organic rankings, qualified traffic, leads, conversions, technical health, backlinks, and AI\-search visibility across brands and markets.
* Provide monthly performance reports and quarterly strategic recommendations based on search trends, platform changes, competitive movement, and business priorities.
* Own the creation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of Google Analytics 4 dashboards covering website traffic, acquisition channels, user engagement, landing\-page performance, events, conversions, and lead\-generation activity.
* Analyze and present website performance on a week\-on\-week basis, highlighting key movements, traffic trends, conversion changes, potential issues, and recommended actions. Ensure that Google Analytics events, conversions, UTM parameters, and reporting configurations are accurately implemented and maintained.

**Required Qualifications**

  

* Min. 6 years of hands\-on experience in SEO, including ownership of multi\-site or multi\-brand organic search programs.
* Strong command of technical SEO, on\-page SEO, off\-page SEO, local SEO, and international SEO.
* Demonstrated ability to create and execute data\-led organic search strategies tied to traffic, lead generation, and business outcomes.
* Practical knowledge of AEO and GEO, including optimization for AI\-generated answers, conversational search, entity signals, structured data, and source citation.
* Strong understanding of search intent, information architecture, content ecosystems, link authority, crawling, indexation, and ranking systems.
* Ability to audit websites, diagnose performance issues, write clear recommendations, and validate technical implementations.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Google Analytics 4, including dashboard creation, event and conversion tracking, traffic\-source analysis, audience segmentation, UTM tracking, attribution, and website\-performance reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to interpret analytics data, identify meaningful trends and anomalies, and present clear week\-on\-week findings and recommendations to business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, presentation, prioritization, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Tools and Platforms**

  

The successful candidate should have hands\-on proficiency with major SEO and analytics platforms, including most of the following:

* Search and analytics: Google Search Console, advanced proficiency in Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Bing Webmaster Tools, and Looker Studio, including the ability to build, maintain, and present comprehensive website\-performance dashboards.
* Research and competitive intelligence: Semrush, Ahrefs, Moz, Google Trends, Keyword Planner, and equivalent enterprise SEO platforms.
* Technical auditing: Screaming Frog SEO Spider, Sitebulb, PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse, Chrome DevTools, and log\-file analysis tools.
* Structured data and validation: Schema.org, Google Rich Results Test, Schema Markup Validator, and related testing utilities.
* Content and publishing ecosystems: Working familiarity with Webflow, WordPress or comparable CMS platforms, and CRM/marketing platforms such as HubSpot.
* AI\-search visibility: Familiarity with emerging AI visibility, citation\-monitoring, and generative\-search tracking platforms.

  

Experience: 5–8 years  

Location: Hyderabad, India

title: Director, Technical Consulting— Marketing Cloud Next
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 Salesforce is currently seeking a Director,Technical Consulting (Marketing Cloud Next) to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. We are looking for an experienced professional services leader who has experience in scaling professional services delivery centers across the world. In addition The Director — Marketing Cloud Next is an execution\-focused technical leader responsible for architecting and delivering end\-to\-end migrations from legacy marketing platforms (Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, legacy SFMC) to Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next. As a foundational member of the Strategic Migration CoE and Migration Factory, you will act as primary technical authority for the Marketing Cloud Next track — owning the solution design, data architecture, subscriber migration strategy, journey migration blueprint, and Data Cloud unified profile design. You will combine deep Marketing Cloud Next platform expertise with advanced data migration methodologies to ensure that subscriber data, consent records, journeys, content and preference data are migrated with full integrity, compliance and zero business disruption.
   

  

 This role is 50% billable and in addition to people leadership, you will work with our customers and partners as a senior technical architect/program architect/CTO to solve critically important business challenges using Salesforce’s Cloud.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead a team of up to 8 direct reports, comprising Architects and potentially Managers, providing technical direction, mentorship, and performance leadership.
* Serve as a Senior/Principal Technical Architect for Marketing Cloud migration projects, contributing hands\-on technical expertise and architectural leadership at approximately 50% utilization.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture that drive increased business value.
* Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the Industries Architects’ consulting practice; serving as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise, specifically driving the evolution of an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology within the practice.
* Design the subscriber and audience data migration strategy, including data extension schema, subscriber key mapping, suppression list migration, consent record preservation (GDPR/CAN\-SPAM/CASL) and historical send data handling.
* Architect the Salesforce Data Cloud implementation for unified customer profile design, identity resolution rules, data stream ingestion from source systems, and audience segmentation activation to Marketing Cloud Next.
* Own the journey migration blueprint — mapping legacy automation workflows, drip campaigns and triggered sends from source platforms to Marketing Cloud Next Journey Builder, including decision splits, wait steps and exit criteria.
* Define end\-to\-end data lineage including data profiling, cleansing logic, transformation mapping and reconciliation strategies for all subscriber objects, data extensions and consent tables.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.
* Lead a project team of developers focused on driving optimized solutions for our clients leveraging Salesforce clouds.
* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third\-party stakeholders
* Establish trust with the customer’s leadership, promoting and/or implementing best practices with Salesforce
* Highlight and manage risk areas in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion


**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**
* Marketing Cloud Next Platform Depth: Advanced expertise in Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Mobile Studio, Advertising Studio and Contact Builder / Audience Builder.
* Data Cloud / CDP: Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Data Cloud — data stream configuration, identity resolution, unified profile modelling, segmentation and activation to MC Next.
* Subscriber Data Architecture: Deep understanding of subscriber data model, data extensions, sendable vs non\-sendable objects, contact counts, suppression logic and list management at scale.
* Consent \& Compliance Architecture: Expert knowledge of GDPR, CAN\-SPAM, CASL, POPI — consent record migration, preference centre design, suppression list management and compliance\-aligned data handling.
* Email Deliverability: Strong understanding of sender reputation, IP warm\-up strategy, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and deliverability validation post\-migration.
* Data Migration Methodology: Proven expertise in executing high\-volume subscriber migrations — data profiling, ETL pipeline design, transformation mapping and reconciliation for marketing data objects.
* Integration Architecture: Understanding of Marketing Cloud Connect (CRM sync), REST/SOAP Marketing Cloud APIs, API\-triggered sends and event\-driven messaging patterns.
* AMPscript / SSJS: Proficiency in dynamic content scripting for migrated email templates — ensuring legacy personalisation logic is recreated accurately in MC Next.


**Minimum Requirements**
* 18\+ years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects and handling individual contributors.
* 8\+ years of people management experience
* Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills
* Demonstrated experience migrating high\-volume subscriber databases (10M\+ records) with zero consent data loss
* Experience migrating from Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot or legacy SFMC Classic to Marketing Cloud Next
* Hands\-on experience with ETL tools — Informatica Cloud, Talend, MuleSoft, Azure Data Factory — for large\-scale subscriber data extraction and transformation
* Strong interpersonal skills \- nurture effective working relationships with others
* Proficiency in English. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience


**Preferred Skills — Good To Have**
* CTA
* Experience migrating from Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot or legacy SFMC Classic to Marketing Cloud Next
* Hands\-on experience with ETL tools — Informatica Cloud, Talend, MuleSoft, Azure Data Factory — for large\-scale subscriber data extraction and transformation
* Knowledge of Salesforce Interaction Studio / Personalisation for 1\-to\-1 journey personalisation post\-migration
* Experience with WhatsApp, LINE, Push and SMS channel migration in addition to email
* Familiarity with marketing data warehouse patterns (Snowflake, Databricks) as upstream Data Cloud data sources
* Understanding of Salesforce Loyalty Cloud or Commerce Cloud as upstream journey trigger sources
* Thorough individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies, including hands\-on delivery patterns for generative AI and agentic frameworks.
* A great listener with the ability to communicate with people in diverse roles
* Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration
* Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems
* Adept at navigating/mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue
* Exceptional analytical skills \- experience overseeing and managing business metrics, productivity, AI evaluation frameworks, and outcomes.


 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
   

  

 Accommodations
   

  

 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

**Job Title:** Project Coordinator \- PDS
  
**Location:** \- Gurugram. Hybrid WFO model
  
Shift Timings \- EMEA / UK Shift (1:00 PM \- 10:00 PM)
  
  

**Job Description:**  

We are seeking a highly motivated and meticulous Project coordinator. The ideal candidate will have a background in project management / construction management and be familiar with industry best practices. This role will support management in reviewing various construction projects from initiation to completion.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
Plan, coordinate, and review various projects.
  
Comprehend quality assurance systems and SOP/Operations manual requirements.
  
Utilize project management software and tools to review projects.
  
Check project process compliance and adherence to the SOP.
  
Verify contract compliance and scope of work adherence
  
Review project reports, including status updates and risk assessments.
  
Check project progress and performance against approved baselines (Schedule, Budget etc.,); Identify and report on project variances, risks, and potential issues
  
  

Evaluate quality assurance and management systems implemented in projects
  
Verify drawings (Ex. GFC / shop drawings / as built drawings etc.,), specifications and BOQ and approvals.
  
Examine invoicing, measurements against relevant codes and standards, material inward and outward tracking, budget / cost sheets and approval
  
Review procurement and change management process compliance, including required approvals and documentation for change orders / variation orders.
  
Review closeout documentation.
  
Check adherence to process control procedures and availability of all necessary approvals from internal approvers and client.
  
  

Analyse project data and identify the gaps in documentation records and status updates
  
Identify non\-compliances; prepare regular status reports; highlight project compliance status and impacts.
  
Follow up on gaps and non\-compliance closures with project teams / respective stakeholders and escalate issues when necessary.
  
Track project review progress and completion of follow up actions.
  
Prepare and manage periodic management reports and presentations for leadership.
  
  

**Qualifications:**  

1\-3 years of Experience in Construction field \- Project management / Construction management professional or related role.
  
A relevant education background \- Degree in Architecture; Post\-graduation in Construction management / Project management or equivalent, will be preferred.
  
Sound knowledge and understanding of audit, construction contracts and local statutory regulations \& laws, quantity surveying, cost management.
  
Familiarity with construction best practices; quality assurance and quality control procedures
  
Proficiency in project management software and other related tools (Ex. Primavera; Microsoft Project, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Smart Sheet; BI; BIM software; AutoCAD, etc.,)
  
Strong organizational and time management skills
  
Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities
  
Ability to read and interpret construction drawings and specifications.
  
Knowledge of building codes (Ex.NBC etc.,), standards, and regulations.
  
Knowledge of relevant IS codes for MEP systems, including measurement.
  
Knowledge about HSE
  
Knowledge about sustainability
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

**Location:** Bangalore, Novo Nordisk Global Business Services (GBS), India
  
  

Shape the future of device commercialisation across global and international markets – from strategy to launch and beyond.
  
  

Your new role
  
In this role, you will develop and execute commercial device strategy and priorities across both International Operations (IO) and Global, with your time split equally between the two. You will independently drive projects related to device marketing, branding, product launch excellence and lifecycle management activities – bringing commercial guidance to device development across therapy areas and working with stakeholders at every level of the organisation.
  
  

**Your key responsibilities will include:**  

Driving strategic and tactical execution of device strategy from a Global/IO perspective, ensuring alignment with global, regional and affiliate launch priorities
  
Leading device\-related lifecycle management activities by coordinating with regions, affiliates and cross\-functional stakeholders to support timely and effective execution
  
Serving as the primary Global/IO point of contact for launch\-related queries, actions and issue resolution for in\-market and upcoming devices
  
Independently driving commercial deliverables as part of the claims process, including identifying target claims, conducting cross\-functional processes and providing input across therapy areas
  
Leading developmental projects including business case development and evaluations with multiple stakeholders
  
Supporting governance, readiness tracking and stakeholder alignment for device launches by identifying risks, enabling decision\-making and driving completion of key launch deliverables
  
Contributing to the development of new promotional and training materials as needed
  
International travel of 5–10 days per year is expected.
