title: Sales And Marketing Intern
description:
Sales \& Marketing Intern
   

 Company: Indux Technology
   

 Duration: 6 Months
   

 Stipend (Months 1–6\): Unpaid / No Stipend
   

 Continuation (From Month 7\): Performance\-based continuation; selected candidates may receive ₹1,000–₹15,000/month based on performance
   

 Internship Type: Remote
   

 About Indux Technology
   

 Indux Technology is a technology\-focused company delivering digital solutions and real\-world technology projects. The internship program is designed to give students and freshers practical exposure, professional work habits, team collaboration, and role\-specific experience while contributing to company initiatives.
   

 About the Internship
   

 We are looking for motivated candidates for the Sales \& Marketing Intern position. This 6\-month internship is intended for candidates who want to build practical skills through real\-world work, guided learning, feedback, and consistent contribution. Support customer acquisition through prospect research, lead generation, outreach, follow\-ups, digital marketing, campaign execution, and sales support.
   

 Role Description
   

 As a Sales \& Marketing Intern, you will work with the relevant team to support assigned projects and operational activities. You will be expected to learn quickly, follow professional processes, complete assigned responsibilities, and progressively take greater ownership of your work.
   

 Key Responsibilities
   

 Identify target customers, industries, companies, and business opportunities.
   

 Generate leads through LinkedIn, email, social media, online research, and other channels.
   

 Assist with cold calling, cold emailing, LinkedIn outreach, and follow\-ups.
   

 Promote Indux Technology services and understand prospect business requirements.
   

 Qualify leads and maintain accurate lead status and communication history.
   

 Schedule meetings and support the sales team with prospect coordination.
   

 Assist with sales presentations, proposals, quotations, and marketing materials.
   

 Support social media and digital marketing activities that contribute to lead generation.
   

 Research competitors, customer needs, market trends, and new opportunities.
   

 Maintain CRM records and track outreach, follow\-ups, meetings, and outcomes.
   

 Collaborate with sales, marketing, content, design, and technical teams.
   

 Monitor campaign/outreach performance and suggest practical improvements.
   

 Maintain professional communication and represent the company appropriately.
   

 Skills \& Requirements
   

 Good communication and interpersonal skills.
   

 Interest in sales, marketing, business development, and technology.
   

 Basic knowledge of lead generation, customer acquisition, and digital platforms.
   

 Familiarity with LinkedIn, email, CRM, and social media is preferred.
   

 Good research, follow\-up, organization, and relationship\-building skills.
   

 Confidence to communicate with prospects professionally.
   

 Target\-oriented, proactive, and willing to learn.
   

 Students and freshers are welcome.
   

 Performance Expectations
   

 Consistent completion of assigned tasks with acceptable quality.
   

 Ability to learn from feedback and demonstrate measurable improvement.
   

 Professional communication and timely response to team members.
   

 Reliability, discipline, ownership, and adherence to deadlines.
   

 Positive contribution to team goals and willingness to take initiative.
   

 Role\-specific performance and contribution during the internship.
   

 What You Can Gain
   

 Practical exposure to real\-world projects and professional workflows.
   

 Hands\-on experience relevant to the selected role.
   

 Opportunity to build projects, work samples, and a professional portfolio where applicable.
   

 Guidance, feedback, collaboration, and exposure to cross\-functional teams.
   

 Internship Completion Certificate, subject to successful completion and company policy.
   

 Letter of Recommendation (LOR), where applicable and based on performance/conduct.
   

 Opportunity to be considered for performance\-based continuation from Month 7\.
   

 If selected for continuation, an opportunity for a stipend of ₹1,000–₹15,000/month based on performance.
   

 Important Internship Terms
   

 The first six months are strictly unpaid; no stipend is payable during Months 1–6\.
   

 The internship does not guarantee a job, paid employment, stipend, or continuation after six months.
   

 Continuation from Month 7 is selective and depends on performance, business requirements, availability, and management approval.
   

 A stipend, if offered from Month 7, will be decided individually within the ₹1,000–₹15,000/month range.
   

 Interns must maintain confidentiality and must not share company/client information, source code, credentials, documents, or internal data without authorization.
   

 Interns are expected to follow company policies, assigned working schedules, deadlines, meeting requirements, and reasonable instructions from managers/mentors.
   

 How to Apply
   

 Interested candidates can share their Resume at:
   

 hr@induxtechnology.com
   

 Apply now and begin your practical career journey in Sales \& Marketing with Indux Technology.

title: Growth & Social Media Intern
description:
We are hiring at
 **Gravity for AI.**

 **Full\-Time Intern** 




  





 We build autonomous

 platforms for healthcare clinics, real estate firms, and North American digital agencies.
 



  





 Our organic content pipeline is scaling fast, and we need someone sharp to take ownership of two critical functions:
 



 1\. Managing our Instagram media engine
 **(@gravityforai).** 




 2\. Managing inbound lead conversations from initial comment to scheduled discovery call.
 



  





 This is NOT a generic "post 3 Canva graphics a week" social media job.
 



 This is a front\-line revenue operations role.
 



  





 What you will actually be doing:

 **Instagram Account Management** 
 (@
 **gravityforai** 
 )
 



 • Scheduling 4–5 high\-retention Reels weekly across Instagram and LinkedIn.
 



 • Publishing daily behind\-the\-scenes Stories (polls, product tests, live client demos).
 



 • Writing structured, 3\-tier captions optimized for search indexing and dwell time.
 



 • Executing our 15\-minute daily outbound seeding protocol on target B2B accounts.
 



  





 2\.
 **Inbound Lead Triage \& Social Selling** 




 • Monitoring post comments and triggering our automated ManyChat DM funnels.
 



 • Engaging directly with inbound DMs in real time (qualifying clinic owners, real estate brokers, and agency founders).
 



 • Delivering personalized resources (audits, staging demo lines, architecture whitepapers).
 



 • Booking qualified prospects directly onto our founder's calendar for 15\-minute diagnostic calls.
 



  





 Who this is for:
 



 • You understand short\-form video pacing, retention hooks, and modern Instagram/LinkedIn algorithms.
 



 • You have exceptional written communication in English (fast, polite, articulate, professional).

 • You are organized: zero dropped conversations, fast response times during business hours, and disciplined calendar management.
 



  





 What we offer:
 



  





 • Competitive compensation (Base \+ Performance incentives per qualified call booked).
 



 • Direct mentorship working alongside technical AI engineers and growth strategists.
 



 • Zero corporate bureaucracy high autonomy, fast execution, and real responsibility from Day 1\.
 



  





 HOW TO APPLY (The Filter):
 



 Please do NOT send a generic resume or click "Easy Apply."
 



  





 Instead, send a short DM to this page (or an email to contact@gravityforai.com) with the subject: "Growth Operator \- \[Your Name]" including:
 



  





 1\. A 2\-sentence breakdown of what you would improve on our Instagram page (@gravityforai) today.
 



 2\. One example of an account, campaign, or inbound lead funnel you have managed or contributed to.
 



 3\. Your current availability.

title: Experiential Marketing Manager
description:
Company Description Nudge Asia is a 360° strategy, creative, experience, and execution agency for brands that aim to actively shape culture. The team works across strategy, digital and social, technology, content, events, activations, retail, fabrication, production, and merchandise, bringing both thinking and making under one roof. With production houses in Delhi, Mumbai, and Bengaluru, Nudge Asia not only develops ideas but also builds and delivers them end\-to\-end. The agency’s dedicated Alcobev platform, The Cocktail Story, reflects its deep experience in the drinks industry. Nudge Asia is driven by the belief in “Ideas That Move Culture” and collaborates with brands to create meaningful, impactful experiences.
 



  





**Nudge Asia \| Ideas That Move Culture** 




  





 We’re looking for an Experiential Marketing Manager who can take a client opportunity from the first conversation to the final experience. This is a client\-facing, business\-oriented role for someone who understands experiential marketing, can build strong presentations and proposals, develop new business, and manage accounts confidently.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Business Development \& Growth** 




  





 Identify and pursue new business opportunities across brands and categories.
 



 Reach out to prospective clients, build relationships and generate leads.
 



 Attend new\-business meetings, understand briefs and convert opportunities into projects.
 



 Support pitches, proposals, commercial discussions and account growth.
 



 Actively identify opportunities to upsell and expand existing client relationships.
 



  





**Presentations, Pitches \& Strategy** 




  





 Create strong PowerPoint presentations, pitch decks, proposals and concept notes.
 



 Translate client briefs into clear experiential strategies and creative directions.
 



 Work closely with design, creative and operations teams to develop compelling ideas.
 



 Present concepts and proposals confidently to clients.
 



 Own pitch timelines and ensure decks are sharp, persuasive and commercially relevant.
 



  





**Client Servicing \& Account Management** 




  





 Act as a key point of contact for assigned clients.
 



 Lead client meetings, briefings, presentations and regular follow\-ups.
 



 Understand client expectations and translate them into clear internal briefs.
 



 Manage feedback, approvals, timelines and deliverables across projects.
 



 Build long\-term client relationships rather than simply servicing individual projects.
 



  





**Experiential Marketing \& Project Ownership** 




  





 Develop and manage brand experiences, activations, launches, events, retail experiences and on\-ground campaigns.
 



 Coordinate closely with design, production, operations and vendor teams.
 



 Maintain quality and brand consistency from ideation through execution.
 



 Be present on\-ground when required and take ownership of the overall client experience.
 



 Conduct post\-project reviews and identify opportunities for future business.
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




  





 3–6 years of experience in experiential marketing, events, activations, advertising or a similar agency environment.
 



 Strong business development and client\-servicing skills.
 



 Excellent command over PowerPoint / pitch\-deck creation and storytelling.
 



 Confident in presenting and conducting client meetings independently.
 



 Strong communication, negotiation and relationship\-management skills.
 



 Commercially aware and comfortable working with budgets, estimates and proposals.
 



 Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast\-paced agency environment.
 



 Someone who is proactive, resourceful and comfortable taking ownership.
 



  





**The Nudge Mindset** 




  





 We’re looking for someone who can think like a strategist, present like a storyteller, service like a partner and sell like an entrepreneur.
 



  





 At Nudge, this role isn’t limited to managing briefs. You’ll be expected to build relationships, create opportunities, win business and turn ideas into experiences that move culture.

title: Senior Associate, Global Marketing Campaigns and Content, GESS - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Associate to join our Global Marketing Promotional Capabilities team at our Global Capability Centre in Gurgaon. The Promotional Capabilities team comprises two functions: campaigns and content. This role supports both — coordinating and executing global marketing campaigns and reviewing thought leadership and promotional content to ensure it meets our editorial and content compliance guidelines. On the campaigns side, the Senior Associate will help plan and launch digital and social content, advertising activities, thought leadership campaigns, and more. On the content side, they will review thought leadership, newsletters, and promotional materials against A\&M’s editorial standards and compliance requirements, helping ensure A\&M has a clear and consistent voice across our digital channels while also protecting and maintaining the A\&M brand. The ideal candidate is a strategic and creative thinker who thrives in a fast\-paced, global environment, managing multiple projects at once, upholding A\&M’s compliance standards, and collaborating across teams to deliver excellence in campaign execution
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
 As a member of the A\&M Global Marketing team, you will:

title: Social Media Manager
description:
**Role Overview:** 




 As Social Media Manager, you will own the strategy, content calendar, and day\-to\-day execution of company's social presence. You will manage a small internal team, direct outside agency partners, and use data to decide what gets published rather than just report on what already did. This role requires someone who has built organic growth from scratch in a regulated industry and knows the difference between a vanity metric and a real one.
 



  





 Shifts: 11:30 am\- 8:30 pm
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Social Strategy \& Campaign Management: Plan and execute social campaigns end to end, from concept through publishing through post\-mortem, for a finance and lending audience.
 



 • Organic Growth: Grow Biz2Credit's channels without leaning on paid spend as the primary lever.
 



 • Content Calendar Ownership: Build and maintain a content calendar balancing brand storytelling, product education, timely finance news, and proprietary data such as the Small Business Lending Index.
 



 • Data \& Reporting: Track performance using Google Analytics and platform\-native tools and translate findings into changes to what gets published next.
 



 • Team Management: Manage and coach a small social team, setting the standard for planning and execution.

 • Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product and content teams to turn loan products, company milestones, and market data into accurate, shareable content.
 



 • Reputation Monitoring: Track brand mentions and industry conversation, and flag anything that needs a fast response.
 



  





 Key Competencies
 



 • 7\-10 years managing social media campaigns, preferably with a finance or banking background.
 



 • Proven experience growing organic reach for a US\-based audience.
 



 • Fluency in Google Analytics and social\-native analytics and scheduling tools.
 



 • Hands\-on experience building and running a content calendar across multiple platforms.

title: Marketing Leader
description:
**Marketing Leader — Lenskart** 




**Gurugram, India · On\-site · Full\-time** 




  





**Mission Brief: Build the Brand That Puts Eyewear on Every Face in the World** 




 Lenskart is not a traditional eyewear company. We are a technology\-first, vertically integrated retail machine operating 2,000\+ stores across India, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East — and we are accelerating. This is your mandate: own the complete marketing engine that will take Lenskart from a dominant Indian brand to a globally recognised name, while deploying AI as a core operating tool across every dimension of how we build, grow, and communicate.
 



 You will be the architect of brand love, customer acquisition, and cultural relevance at scale. You will run performance and brand marketing as a single, unified growth system — driven by data, powered by AI, and executed with creative boldness. This is one of the highest\-impact marketing leadership roles in Indian consumer tech, and it is wide open for someone ready to build something generational.
 



  





**🔑 Core Mandate** 




**1\. Brand Strategy \& AI\-Powered Growth** 



* Own the full brand vision for Lenskart — positioning, narrative, and long\-term equity — across all markets and channels
* Use AI\-powered consumer intelligence tools to track brand perception, identify cultural opportunities, and stress\-test creative strategy in real time
* Build and run a systematic brand experimentation framework, using AI to rapidly test messaging, visual identity, and campaign concepts before committing budget at scale
* Lead large\-scale ATL campaigns (TV, OOH, Print, Digital Video) with rigour — using AI tools for media mix modelling, audience targeting, and post\-campaign attribution



**2\. Performance Marketing \& Revenue Ownership** 



* Drive customer acquisition and revenue growth across Google, Meta, programmatic, and emerging channels — treating every rupee of budget as a precision instrument
* Deploy AI and ML tools for dynamic bidding, predictive audience segmentation, creative fatigue detection, and real\-time campaign optimisation
* Own shared P\&L accountability for marketing\-driven revenue, with full transparency into CAC, LTV, ROAS, and payback periods across all cohorts
* Build a test\-learn\-scale culture where AI accelerates the feedback loop from hypothesis to decision



**3\. AI\-First Content \& Creative Operations** 



* Redefine how Lenskart creates content — integrating AI tools (generative creative, copy optimisation, personalisation engines) into the day\-to\-day workflow of the marketing and creative team
* Scale content output without scaling headcount, by building AI\-augmented production pipelines for social, performance, and brand content
* Ensure all content decisions are grounded in performance data, while never losing the creative spark that makes a brand memorable



**4\. Social, Influencer \& Community** 



* Lead Lenskart's social strategy across all platforms — owning the intersection of cultural relevance, community building, and commercial conversion
* Build an influencer ecosystem that goes beyond paid reach — identifying authentic brand advocates and structuring long\-term partnerships that drive trust at scale
* Use AI\-powered social listening and trend intelligence tools to move at the speed of culture, not the speed of a content calendar



**5\. Team Leadership \& Marketing Culture** 



* Build, lead, and inspire a high\-performing marketing organisation — setting the standard for analytical rigour, creative ambition, and AI fluency
* Establish AI literacy as a baseline expectation across the marketing team — running upskilling initiatives, piloting new tools, and creating a culture where experimentation is celebrated
* Act as a strong cross\-functional partner to Product, Retail, and Tech — ensuring marketing is an engine that the whole business relies on, not a support function



  





**The Essentials** 




**Experience:** 
 8–12 years in marketing, with at least 5 years in a leadership role at a high\-growth D2C, consumer tech, or omnichannel brand. You've built and scaled brands, not just maintained them.
 



**AI \& Tech Fluency:** 
 You are not waiting to learn AI — you are already using it. You have hands\-on experience with AI tools in marketing (creative, performance, analytics, or automation), and you have strong opinions on where the technology is heading and how it changes the CMO role.
 



**Performance \+ Brand Duality:** 
 You are equally at home reading a media attribution model and approving a brand film. You understand that performance and brand are not opposites — they are multipliers of each other.
 



**Proven Revenue Impact:** 
 You have directly influenced topline growth through marketing, with measurable outcomes across CAC, LTV, conversion rates, and brand health metrics.
 



**Education:** 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
 



  





**The Mindset** 




**AI\-Native, Not AI\-Curious.** 
 You believe AI is not a feature of marketing — it is the new operating system. You actively seek out new tools, pilot them with your team, and build institutional capability rather than individual expertise.
 



**Bias for Scale.** 
 You think in systems. When something works, your first instinct is: "How do we do this ten times bigger?" You build processes, playbooks, and platforms — not just campaigns.
 



**Creative \+ Commercial.** 
 You hold the tension between emotional brand\-building and hard business outcomes without flinching. You know that the best marketing does both at the same time.
 



**Intellectually Restless.** 
 You are genuinely excited by the pace of change in marketing technology, consumer behaviour, and media. You bring new thinking into the room and push your team to be ahead of the curve, not behind it.
 



**Transformational, Not Transactional.** 
 You lead with vision, earn trust through clarity, and drive change by bringing people with you — not by issuing mandates.
 



  





**Why Lenskart, Why Now** 




 Lenskart is at an inflection point. We have the brand, the distribution, the technology infrastructure, and the global ambition — what we need is the marketing leader who can tie it all together and take us to the next level. You will have:
 


* **Unmatched scope** 
 — a $1B\+ revenue business, 2,000\+ stores, tens of millions of customers, and marketing budgets at a scale very few leaders in India get to operate at
* **AI infrastructure that's already being built** 
 — you will be joining as we transform core business systems with AI, and marketing will be a key frontier of that transformation
* **Creative freedom with commercial accountability** 
 — you will set the direction, build the team, and own the outcomes
* **A seat at the table** 
 — this is a leadership role with direct influence on business strategy, not just marketing execution
* **A mission worth showing up for** 
 — we believe clear vision changes lives. Helping the world see better is a purpose you can build a career around



  





*If you are a marketing leader who is excited by AI, energised by scale, and ready to build something that lasts — we want to hear from you.*

title: Senior Regional Marketing Manager, India
description:
**Overview**
 Atlassian is at an inflection point. We built one of the most successful product led growth engines in enterprise software with millions of teams now adopting our tools bottoms up, without a single sales call. Now, we're in the middle of a deliberate, high stakes evolution: taking that massive installed base and building an enterprise go to market motion on top of it. AI is accelerating everything. Our products (Jira, Confluence, Loom, Rovo) are becoming an AI powered platform and the connective tissue for how the world's best teams plan, build, and deliver.
   

  

 This role exists to bring that story to life in market and turn it into pipeline for sales.
   

  

 We're looking for a
 **Senior** 
**Regional Marketing Manager** 
 to own the marketing strategy and pipeline outcomes for India. Our job is simple: generate pipeline for sales. Everything we do, every event, campaign, partner activation, and regional program, is measured by whether it creates and accelerates opportunities for our sales teams.
   

  

 You'll work alongside sales, PMM, demand gen, events, and partner marketing, but you are the one accountable for understanding why the region is or isn't hitting its number, and for driving the response. We're looking for someone who thinks like a business owner, not a program operator.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**In this role you will:**
* Own a regional pipeline target and be directly accountable for generating and accelerating pipeline for the sales team in India
* Build and execute the regional marketing strategy in close partnership with sales leadership
* Partner with regional sales leaders to align on target accounts, segment priorities, and go to market motions
* Diagnose performance gaps i.e. when the region is behind, and own figuring out why and recommending the change in approach
* Translate regional market intelligence into recommendations that inform global campaign strategy, content priorities, and investment decisions
* Bring Atlassian's AI and platform transformation story to life in\-market, translating global narratives into locally resonant proof points, customer stories, and campaign themes
* Leverage AI tools (Rovo, Atlassian Intelligence, third\-party platforms) to inform strategy, personalize at scale, and accelerate campaign development and performance analysis
* Influence and shape priorities across central teams (demand gen, PMM, brand, events) based on what your region needs
* Be the voice of India inside the marketing organization and ensure regional priorities are represented in planning
* Coordinate across ABM, demand gen, events, and partner marketing to deliver a cohesive, locally relevant marketing mix
* Work with partner marketing and channel partners to drive co\-marketing initiatives that amplify regional reach
* Manage the regional activity calendar and ensure all motions ladder up to the pipeline plan
* Measure, analyze, and report on regional performance to marketing and sales leadership
* Oversee adaptation of global content and campaigns to ensure relevance and flag when global programs won't land inmarket


**Compensation**
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**On the first day we'll expect you to have:**
* 12\+ years in B2B marketing with a regional or market level focus (field marketing, demand gen, or regional marketing)
* Experience generating pipeline for a sales organization. You've owned a number, built programs to hit it, and can speak to how your work directly created revenue opportunities
* Strong AI fluency. You actively use AI tools in your marketing workflow (content generation, audience insights, campaign optimization, analytics) and can articulate how AI changes the marketing playbook
* Genuine curiosity about how AI is transforming enterprise software and the ability to translate that into compelling marketing narratives
* Strong strategic thinking: you can diagnose a performance gap, build a hypothesis, and recommend a course of action
* Track record of influencing cross functional teams, not just coordinating with them
* Self starting tendencies with an ability to drive projects forward without waiting for permission
* Deep understanding of B2B buying cycles (ideally in tech) and how marketing motions map to pipeline stages
* Comfort with data: you use pipeline and campaign performance data to make decisions, not just report on them
* Experience with marketing automation and CRM (Salesforce \& Marketo a plus)


**It's a Plus If You Have**
* Experience marketing platform or enterprise transformation products to C\-suite buyers
* Familiarity with both product led growth (PLG) and sales led enterprise go to market motions — and an understanding of how they complement each other
* Familiarity with Atlassian's product suite and the "system of work" value proposition
* Background in a high growth B2B SaaS company navigating a major product or positioning shift


**Benefits \& Perks**
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits** 
**.**
**About Our Team**
 We are
 **Regional and Partner Marketing** 
 , a global team of business owners, not program operators. We're building a new kind of regional marketing function where every marketer is a strategist, an advocate for their market, and accountable for pipeline. If you want to be part of shaping how one of the world's most iconic software companies tells its next chapter, market by market, customer by customer this is the team.
   

  

**About Atlassian**
 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
   

  

 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
   

  

 To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/crh** 
**.**
 In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
**About the role** 




 We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to turn compelling narratives and hypotheses into measurable go\-to\-market activities: attracting technical professionals and buyers, and driving adoption of Computer across self\-serve and enterprise audiences.
 



 You'll define how a product area is positioned and brought to market, own the go\-to\-market strategy, and execute it across segments. We expect you to build the engine while staying deeply in the work, writing the messaging, running the launch, and reading the results yourself.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




  




* Lead go\-to\-market strategy and execution for launches and feature releases, owning the launch plan, ICP, value drivers, and coordination with product, design, sales, and demand gen.
* Define positioning, messaging, and differentiation across segments, from solo sign\-ups to enterprise buyers.
* Build a measurement framework that gives clear visibility into expected outcomes and lets you track traction continuously: pipeline, sign\-ups, activation, adoption, win rate.
* Own the competitive narrative for your area (against horizontal AI, legacy CX/EX tools, and build\-it\-yourself alternatives), translated into battlecards and objection handling the field can use.
* Partner with product and engineering to shape roadmap priorities through customer and competitive insight, and close the loop by feeding named asks from win/loss and customer calls back to leadership.
* Support sales enablement with pitch narratives, competitive messaging, demos with objection handling, and case studies.
* A clear, sharp writer. You can explain a complex feature in a subject line and hold a room with the strategy behind it.
* Strong at positioning: you look at a segment and a product moment and know which story will land, and you bring a point of view, not just execution against a brief.
* An experimenter. You develop and test hypotheses on channels, messaging, and value propositions, treat every launch as a test with a clear outcome you can read, and iterate fast.
* Someone who dives deep on the numbers. You track the KPIs that matter, understand what's moving and why, and turn the insight into the next action, not a deck that sits in a drive.
* Biased toward shipping and iterating quickly over long planning cycles.
* Able to build cross\-functional trust and manage senior stakeholders without formal authority.
* You get energy from building from scratch, and have a hacker mentality.



  





**What you'll bring** 




  




* 5\+ years in product marketing, growth, or developer marketing for a technical or enterprise audience.
* A track record of customer\-facing content, campaigns, or messaging you can speak to in detail and tie to measurable outcomes.
* Experience owning end\-to\-end product launches and marketing campaigns.
* Comfort with analytics, CRM, and marketing automation tools (e.g., HubSpot) to drive decisions.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration, prioritization, and program management.
* Background in, or strong interest in, AI\-powered products.



  





**What sets you apart** 




  




* You use gen AI tools daily and ship content with them. You're in every new model the week it drops.
* Experience with A/B testing and customer research methodologies.
* A track record of leading successful product launches across multiple markets or segments.
* Experience working in matrixed, cross\-functional organizations.
* Familiarity with product analytics, CRM, and marketing automation platforms.

We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.
   

  

 We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing\-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.
   

  

**Meet the team**
 Join a dynamic marketing group that drives the identity of Dexcom. This team brings our products to life through smart strategy, strong partnerships, and meaningful storytelling. You’ll be part of a collaborative, creative space where ideas move fast, teams support each other, and your work directly shapes how customers connect with our brand.
   

  

**Where You Come In**
* Join our team to lead impactful, multi\-channel campaigns that drive adoption and access to Dexcom Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) Systems.
* Shape strategic engagement with healthcare professionals, payors and key stakeholders \- empowering commercial, clinical and market access teams with the right tools and messaging.
* Develop and execute integrated campaigns based on customer journey insights and care pathways.
* Craft compelling, compliant messaging and multi\-format assets tailored to local market needs.
* Activate campaigns across digital, field, event and partnership channels \- optimizing reach and engagement.
* Measure performance and use insights to refine strategy and improve ROI.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally and manage agency relationships to deliver high\-quality, on\-brand materials.


**What Makes You Successful**
* You have deep experience in brand strategy and know how to build compelling, insight\-driven plans.
* You excel at working cross\-functionally and influencing teams at all levels.
* You bring strong judgment and can navigate complex or sensitive situations with confidence.
* You are skilled at managing multiple projects, guiding teams, and driving results in fast\-paced environments.
* Your communication and collaboration skills make you a trusted partner across the business.


**Experience And Education**
* Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree with 8–12 years of industry experience.
* 2–5 years of previous management or lead experience.
* Experience working on regional strategy or partnership initiatives is strongly preferred.
* A graduate degree (MBA or equivalent) is an advantage.
* Nice to have: Experience in medical devices, healthcare, or other highly regulated industries; familiarity with global brand frameworks; people leadership experience.


*To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies: Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Dexcom. Only authorized staffing and recruiting agencies may use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes on specific requisitions. Dexcom does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to the Talent Acquisition team, Dexcom employees or any other company location. Dexcom is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications.*
**AI in Hiring Notice:** 
 We may use AI supported tools to help make our hiring process more efficient, consistent, and accessible for candidates around the world. All hiring decisions are made by people.
   

  

 At Dexcom, we are committed to providing a fair and inclusive recruitment process, and welcome candidates of all genders and gender identities to apply. If any wording in this description appears unintentionally gendered or exclusionary, please be assured this is not intentional.
   

  

 Should a reasonable accommodation be necessary to aid a disability, requests should be sent to Dexcom Talent Acquisition at talentacquisition@dexcom.com.

title: Senior Brand Manager
description:
**Brand Manager — Nutraceuticals (Early\-Stage D2C Launch)** 




 📍 Bangalore \| Full\-time \| In\-person
 



**About EYRA** 




 EYRA is a new nutraceutical brand launching in India, built on a simple premise: most quality claims in this category are marketing, and ours are testable. Every batch we ship is independently tested — heavy metals, potency, purity — and every raw material is verified before it goes near a formulation. We're starting with Magnesium \+ Glycine (Sleep \& Recovery), with Vitamin D3 \+ K2 and Omega\-3 Fish Oil next in the pipeline.
 



**The Role** 




 This isn't a role to manage an existing brand — it's a role to build one. We need someone who has done this before and can own the ground\-level work of taking EYRA from a formulation and a manufacturing spec to a real product on shelves and screens, with minimal hand\-holding.
 



**What you'll own** 



* Brand positioning, voice, and messaging across web, social, and packaging — translating our sourcing and testing standards into language people actually care about, not just spec\-sheet claims
* End\-to\-end D2C launch: website build\-out, product content, and go\-live
* Marketplace setup and management (Amazon, Flipkart seller onboarding and listings)
* Packaging and label execution, working directly with design and our regulatory consultant to keep everything FSSAI\-compliant
* Launch marketing: founding\-customer seeding, micro\-influencer outreach, early paid social — building initial demand before and at launch
* Our social presence from zero — Instagram and LinkedIn, building both from scratch
* Pricing and launch offer strategy
* Tracking what's actually working post\-launch — CAC, reviews, repeat purchase — and adjusting in real time



**What we're looking for** 



* 4\-6\+ years in brand or marketing roles, ideally in D2C, wellness, FMCG, or health/nutraceutical categories
* Real experience taking a product from pre\-launch to market — not just running an existing playbook
* Comfortable being a generalist early hire: you'll be doing the work yourself as often as directing others
* Strong writing instincts — able to turn technical or scientific claims into clear, honest consumer messaging without dumbing them down or overselling them
* Working knowledge of Shopify and marketplace seller platforms



**Strong plus, not required** 



* Experience in a regulated consumer category (health, food, pharma, supplements) and comfort working within compliance constraints rather than around them
* Startup or 0\-to\-1 experience specifically
* Genuine interest in the wellness/supplements space

title: Senior Marketing Manager
description:
**Experience: 7\+ Years** 




**Reporting To: Chief Revenue Officer (CRO)** 




  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a
 **Senior Marketing Manager** 
 to work closely with our CRO and Sales Leadership team and take ownership of key marketing initiatives at Techademy.
 



 This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role for someone who understands B2B marketing, brand building, demand generation, content, events, social media, and customer marketing.
 



 The person will work closely with the CRO to identify and execute marketing initiatives that strengthen Techademy's brand, support sales, improve market visibility, and create opportunities for customer acquisition.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who can think strategically but is equally comfortable getting things done — whether that means identifying the right industry event, managing our LinkedIn presence, developing a customer case study, working with Sales on a campaign, or coordinating with external partners and agencies.
 



  





 Apply Link \- https://forms.gle/NVfkg9VTycwW9iyf7
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




 1\.
 **Brand \& Market Presence** 



* Help strengthen and grow Techademy's brand presence across relevant B2B, technology, HR, L\&D and enterprise communities.
* Develop and execute initiatives that increase brand awareness and visibility among our target customers.
* Identify relevant industry conversations, trends, platforms, communities and opportunities where Techademy should have a presence.
* Ensure consistent messaging and positioning across marketing channels and customer\-facing materials.
* Conduct market and competitor research to identify new opportunities for brand and market positioning.
* Help build Techademy's voice and presence across relevant digital and industry platforms.



  





 2\.
 **Events \& Industry Presence** 



* Identify and evaluate industry conferences, events, roundtables, webinars, forums and sponsorship opportunities that Techademy should participate in.
* Build an annual/quarterly event calendar based on target industries, customers and business priorities.
* Work with the CRO and Sales team to decide which events are worth investing in.
* Manage event participation end\-to\-end, including planning, messaging, collateral, speakers, customer participation and post\-event follow\-up.
* Look for opportunities for Techademy leaders to speak, participate in panels, moderate discussions or build thought leadership at relevant industry events.
* Track the effectiveness of events and recommend where we should increase, reduce or change our investment.



  





 3\.
 **Social Media \& Content** 



* Own and manage Techademy's key social media channels, particularly LinkedIn.
* Develop and maintain a content calendar aligned with business priorities, industry trends and company initiatives.
* Work with internal teams to create content around customers, leadership, industry insights, products, events and company updates.
* Coordinate with designers, content creators and external agencies where required.
* Monitor engagement and performance and continuously improve our content strategy.
* Build a stronger executive and leadership presence on social platforms where relevant.



  





 4\.
 **Customer Marketing \& Sales Support** 



* Work closely with Sales to identify opportunities to showcase our customers and success stories.
* Own the development of customer testimonials, case studies, success stories, customer videos and other advocacy content.
* Work with Sales teams to identify strong customer stories and turn them into compelling marketing assets.
* Develop sales collateral, presentations, brochures, one\-pagers and other materials that help Sales communicate Techademy's value proposition.
* Support Sales with marketing campaigns and initiatives focused on target accounts and customer acquisition.
* Understand what Sales teams need from Marketing and ensure the right content and support are available.



  





 5\.
 **Demand Generation \& Campaigns** 



* Plan and execute marketing campaigns that support brand awareness, lead generation and customer acquisition.
* Work with the CRO and Sales team to identify priority industries, accounts, personas and markets.
* Support targeted campaigns around specific industries, solutions, customer segments or business priorities.
* Work with relevant partners and agencies to execute digital campaigns, email campaigns, webinars and other demand\-generation initiatives.
* Track campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve engagement and lead generation.
* Help build a more structured and measurable marketing engine over time.



  





 6\.
 **CRO \& Leadership Projects** 



* Work closely with the CRO on strategic marketing and business initiatives.
* Take ownership of special projects that require research, market understanding, content, campaigns or external engagement.
* Prepare marketing plans, presentations and recommendations for leadership.
* Research new markets, industries, customer segments, partnerships and marketing opportunities.
* Help translate business priorities from the CRO and Sales leadership into practical marketing initiatives.
* Be comfortable taking an idea from "we should do this" to planning, execution and measurement.



  





 7\.
 **Global Marketing Exposure** 



* Support marketing initiatives across India and international/global markets as Techademy expands its presence.
* Understand the differences in messaging, channels, events, content and customer engagement across different markets.
* Bring global B2B marketing best practices into Techademy's marketing initiatives.
* Adapt campaigns and content for different geographies and audiences where required.
* Experience working with global teams, customers or markets will be strongly preferred.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* **7\+ years of experience** 
 in B2B Marketing, Brand Marketing, Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Content Marketing or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of B2B marketing and enterprise customer audiences.
* Experience working closely with Sales and senior business leaders.
* Strong experience in managing LinkedIn and other social media channels for a B2B organization.
* Experience planning and executing events, conferences, webinars, roundtables or industry initiatives.
* Strong content and communication skills with the ability to create or manage high\-quality marketing content.
* Experience developing case studies, customer testimonials and sales collateral.
* Good understanding of demand generation and marketing campaigns.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects from start to finish.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and presentation skills.
* Commercial mindset — understands that Marketing should ultimately support brand, customer engagement and revenue growth.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* **Experience in B2B SaaS, EdTech, HRTech, Learning \& Development, Technology, Consulting or Professional Services.**
* Experience working with global markets or international marketing teams.
* Experience marketing to enterprise customers and senior decisionmakers.
* Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, designers or content partners.
* Experience with marketing automation, CRM and analytics tools.
* Exposure to account\-based marketing (ABM) or targeted account campaigns.
* Experience with thought leadership and executive branding.
* Experience managing marketing budgets and evaluating ROI from events and campaigns.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* Techademy has a stronger and more consistent presence across the markets and communities that matter to us.
* We have a clear and effective presence across LinkedIn and other relevant channels.
* We participate in the right industry events and get meaningful value from them.
* Sales teams have strong customer stories, case studies, content and collateral to support their conversations.
* Marketing initiatives contribute to brand awareness, customer engagement and new business opportunities.
* The CRO and Sales Leadership team have a strong marketing partner who can take initiatives from idea to execution.
* Techademy's marketing becomes more structured, consistent, measurable and scalable.

title: Senior Regional Marketing Manager, India
description:
**Overview**
 Atlassian is at an inflection point. We built one of the most successful product led growth engines in enterprise software with millions of teams now adopting our tools bottoms up, without a single sales call. Now, we're in the middle of a deliberate, high stakes evolution: taking that massive installed base and building an enterprise go to market motion on top of it. AI is accelerating everything. Our products (Jira, Confluence, Loom, Rovo) are becoming an AI powered platform and the connective tissue for how the world's best teams plan, build, and deliver.
   

  

 This role exists to bring that story to life in market and turn it into pipeline for sales.
   

  

 We're looking for a
 **Senior** 
**Regional Marketing Manager** 
 to own the marketing strategy and pipeline outcomes for India. Our job is simple: generate pipeline for sales. Everything we do, every event, campaign, partner activation, and regional program, is measured by whether it creates and accelerates opportunities for our sales teams.
   

  

 You'll work alongside sales, PMM, demand gen, events, and partner marketing, but you are the one accountable for understanding why the region is or isn't hitting its number, and for driving the response. We're looking for someone who thinks like a business owner, not a program operator.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**In this role you will:**
* Own a regional pipeline target and be directly accountable for generating and accelerating pipeline for the sales team in India
* Build and execute the regional marketing strategy in close partnership with sales leadership
* Partner with regional sales leaders to align on target accounts, segment priorities, and go to market motions
* Diagnose performance gaps i.e. when the region is behind, and own figuring out why and recommending the change in approach
* Translate regional market intelligence into recommendations that inform global campaign strategy, content priorities, and investment decisions
* Bring Atlassian's AI and platform transformation story to life in\-market, translating global narratives into locally resonant proof points, customer stories, and campaign themes
* Leverage AI tools (Rovo, Atlassian Intelligence, third\-party platforms) to inform strategy, personalize at scale, and accelerate campaign development and performance analysis
* Influence and shape priorities across central teams (demand gen, PMM, brand, events) based on what your region needs
* Be the voice of India inside the marketing organization and ensure regional priorities are represented in planning
* Coordinate across ABM, demand gen, events, and partner marketing to deliver a cohesive, locally relevant marketing mix
* Work with partner marketing and channel partners to drive co\-marketing initiatives that amplify regional reach
* Manage the regional activity calendar and ensure all motions ladder up to the pipeline plan
* Measure, analyze, and report on regional performance to marketing and sales leadership
* Oversee adaptation of global content and campaigns to ensure relevance and flag when global programs won't land inmarket


**Compensation**
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**On the first day we'll expect you to have:**
* 12\+ years in B2B marketing with a regional or market level focus (field marketing, demand gen, or regional marketing)
* Experience generating pipeline for a sales organization. You've owned a number, built programs to hit it, and can speak to how your work directly created revenue opportunities
* Strong AI fluency. You actively use AI tools in your marketing workflow (content generation, audience insights, campaign optimization, analytics) and can articulate how AI changes the marketing playbook
* Genuine curiosity about how AI is transforming enterprise software and the ability to translate that into compelling marketing narratives
* Strong strategic thinking: you can diagnose a performance gap, build a hypothesis, and recommend a course of action
* Track record of influencing cross functional teams, not just coordinating with them
* Self starting tendencies with an ability to drive projects forward without waiting for permission
* Deep understanding of B2B buying cycles (ideally in tech) and how marketing motions map to pipeline stages
* Comfort with data: you use pipeline and campaign performance data to make decisions, not just report on them
* Experience with marketing automation and CRM (Salesforce \& Marketo a plus)


**It's a Plus If You Have**
* Experience marketing platform or enterprise transformation products to C\-suite buyers
* Familiarity with both product led growth (PLG) and sales led enterprise go to market motions — and an understanding of how they complement each other
* Familiarity with Atlassian's product suite and the "system of work" value proposition
* Background in a high growth B2B SaaS company navigating a major product or positioning shift


**Benefits \& Perks**
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits** 
**.**
**About Our Team**
 We are
 **Regional and Partner Marketing** 
 , a global team of business owners, not program operators. We're building a new kind of regional marketing function where every marketer is a strategist, an advocate for their market, and accountable for pipeline. If you want to be part of shaping how one of the world's most iconic software companies tells its next chapter, market by market, customer by customer this is the team.
   

  

**About Atlassian**
 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
   

  

 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
   

  

 To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/crh** 
**.**
 In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

title: Brand Manager (Marketing)
description:
**About KisanKraft** 





 KisanKraft Limited is a leading Bengaluru\-headquartered agricultural equipment and power tools company, dedicated to empowering farmers across India with modern, affordable farm mechanization solutions. With a 46\-acre manufacturing facility in Nellore, 14 branch offices, a dealer network of 5,000\+ partners across the country, and exports to 19\+ countries, KisanKraft is committed to driving productivity and innovation in the agricultural sector.
 




  





**About the Role** 





 We're looking for an energetic, versatile, and strategic Brand Manager to drive the company's brand presence across ATL, BTL, Digital Marketing, and PR. The role calls for a strong blend of creative thinking, strategic planning, and hands\-on execution to build brand visibility, positioning, and engagement across farmer, dealer, and institutional audiences.
 




  






 The ideal candidate has a genuine interest in the agricultural sector and rural economy and is willing to travel to calibrate branding efforts on the ground. You should be a self\-motivated leader, comfortable managing your own team, collaborating across divisions, and working with external agencies on PR and branding.
 




  






 You will lead all digital marketing activities for the brand — SEO, performance marketing, social media, influencer and affiliate marketing, and content creation — with an in\-house team of graphic designers and videographers, external support for performance marketing, and backing from our sales, service, CRM, and management teams.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Brand Strategy \& Creative Direction** 



* Own creative and strategic decisions that align with company goals, objectives, and budget.
* Lead idea development to create compelling, motivating campaigns that drive audience response.
* Develop branding collateral for digital platforms (graphics, videos, articles) and traditional formats (catalogues, brochures, diaries, calendars, wall paintings, signboards, flex banners, posters).
* Conceptualize campaigns for in\-store and exclusive\-store branding, including product branding, logo placement, colour schemes, packaging, and user manuals.
* Ensure consistent branding across online and offline channels.



  





**2\. Digital Marketing, E\-commerce \& Performance** 



* **Performance Marketing \& SEO:** 

 Execute and scale paid ad campaigns across Google and Meta; use keyword research and Google Search Console to monitor and improve search visibility.
* **E\-commerce \& Web Optimization:** 

 Manage website aesthetics and user experience — page layouts, imagery, and copywriting — to improve conversion rates.
* **Social Media \& Brand Growth:** 

 Plan and execute a consistent social media calendar to expand community reach and organic engagement.



  





**3\. Offline Retail \& BTL Execution** 



* Manage setup operations for new retail outlet openings.
* Participate in branding activities such as online campaigns, mobile showroom (display truck) tours, field demonstrations, exhibitions, TV/radio ads, and other promotional activities.
* Coordinate end\-to\-end design and nationwide fulfilment of physical print materials for regional teams.
* Support company events — season kick\-offs, annual dealer meetings, technician and farmer meetings, press meetings, etc.
* Visit dealers regularly to strengthen in\-store and neighbourhood branding.



  





**4\. Team Leadership** 



* Manage the in\-house creative pod — two graphic designers and one video editor — directing day\-to\-day operations and workflows.
* Work with external agencies on ATL, BTL, digital, and PR activities to strengthen KisanKraft's image among farmers, dealers, and government stakeholders.
* Build the team: recruit, train, and continuously raise the bar.



  





**5\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Market Intelligence** 



* Align the organization around a consistent marketing direction and product line strategy.
* Analyze brand positioning through market research, dealer and exhibition visits, consumer insights, and competitor tracking to identify opportunities and issues.
* Partner closely with the sales team to map branding activities to crops and seasons, ensuring strategy stays in sync with crop data across regions.



  





**6\. Performance Tracking \& Reporting** 



* Track and report on the performance of all marketing campaigns and branding activities, including progress of your team and external agencies, to management.
* Stay flexible to take on new assignments as business priorities shift.



  





**Travel** 





 Occasional travel is required to visit exhibitions, customers, and farmer events.

title: Category Manager (D2C)
description:
**About
 
 AppsForBharat**




 AppsForBharat, a series C\-funded faith\-tech startup, is backed by India’s best venture capital investors including Fundamentum, Susquehanna Asia VC, Peak XV partners (prev. Sequoia Capital), Elevation Capital, \& BEENEXT. Our highly ambitious and audacious team comprises alumni from prestigious institutions like IITs \& IIMs, with extensive experience in scaling high\-growth startups. We're dedicated to developing mobile and web apps catering to the devotional and spiritual needs of 100s of millions of users across the globe.
 



 Our flagship product, Sri Mandir, launched in November 2020, is the world’s largest app for Hindu devotees. It serves as a digital sanctuary for millions of devotees worldwide. Our mission is to enrich individuals' spiritual lives through innovative technology, offering seamless access to sacred pilgrims \& rituals, divine teachings, and a vibrant community. The overwhelming user love motivates us as we aim to serve 100s of millions more in the coming years.
 



 The devotion market is a $44B opportunity in India (growing at 10% CAGR), which is primarily offline and unorganised. Of the $44B, the temples drive GMV of \~$27B in temple offerings, services, and commerce. There are 2M\+ temples in India \- about 10k of these temples have a strong historical and cultural significance. Tourism to these religious places is a $10B opportunity. The Sri Mandir app is the world’s largest app for Hindu devotees and growing 20\-25% month\-on\-month.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 You own
 **growth and category** 
 for Srimandir's own
 
 D2C channel
 
 end\-to\-end. It's a full\-loop role: you
 **generate the demand** 
 , decide the
 **assortment** 
 (how deep within a category, how wide across categories), set the
 **price and promotion** 
 , and orchestrate all of it against India's
 **devotional calendar** 
 , the rhythm that drives this business. You run the store like a P\&L and grow it.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



* **1 · Category — vertical \& horizontal thinking.** 
 Build the assortment on two axes:
* **Vertical (go deep):** 
 depth and premium ladders within winning categories, drive the NPD pipeline (new SKUs, variants, price tiers).
* **Horizontal (go wide):** 
 expand into new categories, cross\-sell and basket expansion — decide what to add, what to scale, and what to cut.
* **2 · Pricing \& promotion.** 
 Set the pricing and margin architecture per category; design the discounting, offers and bundling that grow volume without eroding margin.
* **3 · Calendar planning.** 
 Build and run the festive / muhurat / seasonal calendar (Sawan, Navratri, Diwali and the rest) as the operating rhythm — plan launches, campaigns, inventory and promotions against each peak, well ahead of time.
* **4 · Demand generation (Marketing).** 
 Own the funnel end\-to\-end \- traffic (performance marketing across Meta / Google), on\-site / in\-app conversion, and repeat (CRM, notifications, WhatsApp). Partner with performance and creative teams; own the growth number, CAC and ROAS.



  





**What success looks like (first 6–12 months)** 



* D2C revenue and growth at or above plan; category contribution up.
* AOV and repeat\-purchase rate rising, with healthy CAC / ROAS.
* Margin held while scaling volume, pricing and promo discipline.
* Calendar\-led launches shipped on time, with demand captured at each festival peak.



  





**What you bring** 



* 4–6 years in category management, growth, or D2C e\-commerce \-
 **ideally a mix of category ownership and demand generation.**
* Performance\-marketing fluency \- run or closely partnered on Meta / Google plus CRM / retention.
* Pricing and P\&L comfort; a sharp assortment / NPD instinct (vertical depth \+ horizontal expansion).
* Data\-driven \- strong analytics; makes decisions from funnel and category data.

**About The Role**
 InMobi's APAC marketing team builds demand and brand preference among advertisers, agencies and app publishers across India, Southeast Asia, Australia – New Zealand, Japan, China and South Korea. We are looking for an Integrated Marketing Lead to own India and Korea’s end\-to\-end marketing program: the campaigns that generate pipeline, the events and partnerships that build relationships, and the calendar and budget that hold it all together. This is a hands\-on lead role for someone equally comfortable building a quarterly plan with sales leadership, briefing a paid media agency, and working a booth on day three of an industry conference.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the integrated marketing plan. Build and run a quarterly and annual plan across demand generation, events, content and partnerships, aligned to regional revenue targets and priority segments.
* Drive B2B demand generation. Design and execute multi\-channel campaigns (events, PR and comms, paid media, email, LinkedIn, webinars, ABM) targeting brands, agencies and publishers; own MQL and pipeline\-contribution targets.
* Run the regional event portfolio. Lead InMobi's presence at industry events and owned formats — from sponsorship selection and booth experience to executive roundtables, customer dinners and post\-event follow\-up.
* Build partner and co\-marketing programs. Work with agency groups, platform partners and industry bodies on joint campaigns, research, awards and speaking opportunities that extend reach.
* Own the calendar and the budget. Maintain a single source of truth for India and Korea’s marketing calendar; allocate and track spend across markets and channels, forecast quarterly, and reallocate based on performance.
* Partner with sales. Act as the marketing counterpart for regional sales leaders — align on target accounts, build campaign\-to\-pipeline visibility, and enable teams with the right assets and follow\-up motions.
* Measure and report. Define KPIs, localize global product messaging for APAC markets, and report monthly on spend efficiency, pipeline influence and program ROI to regional and global leadership.


**What We're Looking For**
* 4\-6 years of B2B marketing experience, with at least 3 years running integrated or demand\-generation programs across multiple APAC markets.
* A track record of owning pipeline or MQL targets and reporting on marketing's contribution to revenue.
* Hands\-on experience delivering large industry events and field marketing programs end to end, including sponsorship negotiation and on\-site execution.
* Demonstrated ownership of a marketing budget — planning, allocation, tracking and in\-quarter reprioritisation.
* Fluency with the modern marketing stack (e.g. Marketo, HubSpot or Pardot, Salesforce, LinkedIn Campaign Manager) and comfort working in dashboards and spreadsheets.
* Strong written and verbal communication in English, and the judgement to tailor a message across very different APAC markets.
* Ad tech, martech, SaaS or digital media experience preferred, with familiarity with the advertiser–agency ecosystem and willingness to travel across APAC roughly 20–25% of the time.


*Since 2007, InMobi has built the extraordinary. Beyond just technology. It has built a way of working.*
*Across 16 offices globally, through every pivot and breakthrough, one thing has remained constant: we are Builders, Dreamers, Doers. We are fluid enough to move fast, grounded enough to own outcomes, and human enough to care deeply about the work and about one another.*
*Culture is at the core of that ethos. It has been co\-created by the people who built this company and by those continuing to shape it every day. It lives in how we work, how decisions are made, how teams show up for one another, and how seriously we take the responsibility to build the best.*
*This is a place where ambition and belonging occupy the same space. Where the bar is high and the support is real. Where freedom comes with trust, and trust comes with accountability. Where you are valued not only for what you do, but for the perspective, judgment, and humanity you bring to the work. Where you will be challenged by the work and supported by the communities, passions and experiences that shape who you are beyond your role.*
*When people show up fully, we do more than build meaningful work. We build something extraordinary together.*
*If this sounds like the place you have been looking for, join us.*
*Find out more here:* 
*InMobi Culture*
**The InMobi Culture**
 At InMobi, culture isn’t a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.
   

  

 We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.
   

  

 We believe in nurturing and investing in your development through continuous learning and career progression with our InMobi Live Your Potential program.
   

  

 InMobi is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace.
   

  

 Visit https://www.inmobi.com/company/careers to better understand our benefits, values, and more!
