title: Director, Product Management
description:
**Director, Product Management — Ecosystem \& Optimisation** 




  






 Shell Recharge Solutions
 
 is a leader in delivering the new electric mobility future through innovative software, infrastructure, and professional services that empower utilities, cities, fleets, transit agencies, and automakers to deploy EV charging infrastructure at scale. Our technology is connecting EV infrastructure solutions with public and private charging needs in a safer, cleaner, and smarter way. Headquartered in India, the company’s global footprint spans across three continents with deployments in 13 different countries. With a team of up to 200 professionals in India, we serve as the operational backbone for one of the world’s most advanced EV charging networks — driving decarbonization, digitalization, and mobility at scale.
 



  





 Shell and its portfolio company, Shell Recharge Solutions, operate over 70,000 charge points globally. We are committed to building and operating a cutting\-edge, end\-to\-end E\-Mobility technology platform, encompassing critical CPO and MSP digital capabilities. Our business goals include a 4x increase in EV margins by 2030, improved ROACE, and industry\-leading efficiency and resilience. The software platforms led by the CPO will be central to achieving these ambitions.
 



 At Shell Recharge Solutions, we are looking for candidates who want to be a part of something bigger than themselves — passionate, purpose\-driven individuals who believe having a career means making a meaningful impact on our business and the world. We believe in creating and ‘doing the right thing’ through responsible and sustainable EV deployment. We are looking for the innovative, driven to find a solution in a complex and dynamically evolving marketplace and look at “no” as just a challenge to find the next “yes”.
 



  





**Why this role matters** 




 Shell Recharge’s ability to expand network reach, integrate partners and improve charging economics depends on an interoperable ecosystem and intelligent optimisation capabilities. The
 **Ecosystem and Optimization Product Portfolio** 
 brings these outcomes together: Ecosystem Access \& Roaming, and Energy, Data \& Decision Optimisation. The squad enables usable partner\-network growth while lowering energy cost and creating reusable, governed decision intelligence.
 



 The Product Director — Ecosystem \& Optimisation is the player\-coach accountable for the squad’sstrategy, outcomes and roadmap. The role leads senior product talent and directly owns one product domain, connecting commercial priorities, partner needs and engineering execution across roaming, Auto\-OEM and API integrations, licence\-market enablement, smart charging, site load management, EMS integration, analytics products and decision services.
 



 This is a high\-visibility leadership role with end\-to\-end accountability for measurable business and operational outcomes, clear decision authority and disciplined management of cross\-squad dependencies.
 



**Role Overview** 




 You will lead the Ecosystem \& Optimisation squad and its two outcome pods. Ecosystem Access \& Roaming owns partner mediation, interoperability and ecosystem expansion through OCPI/OICP, partner onboarding, Auto\-OEM integrations, APIs and licence\-market enablement. Energy, Data \& Decision Optimisation owns smart charging, site load management, EMS integration, governed analytics and reporting products, and reusable model and decision services.
 



 Success means growing usable accessible charge points and reducing partner activation time, while delivering measurable energy benefit, safe automation and adoption of data and decision products. You will ensure partner exchange is normalised without compromising the authoritative session, tariff and financial records owned by other domains.
 



 The role reports to the Head of Product, SRS.
 



**What You’ll Do** 




 • Build scalable partner and integration products rather than one\-off solutions; make explicit trade\-offs between strategic differentiation, reuse, speed and cost\-to\-serve.
 



 • Lead discovery, prioritisation, validation, delivery, launch and in\-life optimisation with Engineering, Architecture, Design, Data Science, Operations, Commercial and market teams.
 



 • Define governance, guardrails, evaluation criteria and human escalation paths for AI\-enabled decision use cases; ensure outcome pods retain accountability for their AI use cases.
 



 • Represent the squad with senior executives, markets and external partners, creating decision\-ready narratives on value, risk, sequencing, dependencies and performance.
 



 • Set the product strategy, outcome roadmap and investment priorities for your squad, balancing ecosystem growth, interoperability, energy economics and reusable decision intelligence.
 



 • Lead as a player\-coach: manage and develop product leaders while directly owning one of the squad’s product domains.
 



 • Own measurable outcomes and KPI movement, including usable accessible points, partner activation time, energy benefit, safe automation and product adoption.
 



 • Drive the ecosystem roadmap across roaming mediation, OCPI/OICP adapters, partner management, protocol credentials, Auto\-OEM integrations, APIs, capital\-light propositions and licence\-market enablement.
 



 • Drive the optimisation roadmap across smart charging, site load management, EMS integration, demand response, analytics and reporting products, and model or decision services.
 



 • Establish clear contracts with adjacent product domains: Session remains the source of session truth, Tariff owns price truth, CDR owns financial truth, and Smart Charging requests profiles through Session/OCPP.
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




**Must\-haves** 




 •
 **EV industry experience:** 
 15\+ years in product management, including significant leadership experience in EV charging, e\-mobility, CPO/MSP platforms, charging networks, energy management or closely related EV products.
 



 • Demonstrated ownership of multi\-domain product strategy and measurable business or operational KPIs at Director, Head of Product or equivalent scope.
 



 • Strong knowledge of EV charging ecosystems, including roaming, interoperability, CPO/MSP operating models, Auto\-OEM or partner integrations, charging protocols and cross\-market deployment.
 



 • Experience leading product managers and cross\-functional teams as a player\-coach, with clear accountability for prioritisation, stakeholder alignment and delivery outcomes.
 



 • Proven ability to shape scalable platform products and APIs, manage domain boundaries and dependencies, and resist fragmentation caused by bespoke market or partner demand.
 



 • Commercial and financial acumen to connect product choices to network growth, energy benefit, cost\-to\-serve, adoption and value realisation.
 



 • Executive\-level communication and stakeholder leadership across global markets, enterprise partners and matrixed organisations.
 



 • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, business or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
 



**Good to have** 




 • Technical fluency across OCPI/OICP, OCPP, APIs, smart charging, EMS integration, data products, analytics and automated decision services; able to engage credibly with Engineering and Architecture.
 



 •
 **AI\-native product build experience:** 
 hands\-on use of AI tools to create functional prototypes, prompts, agents, workflows or lightweight product logic, with experience defining evaluation sets, quality thresholds, guardrails, human review, fallback behaviour and staged rollout.
 



 • Direct product ownership in roaming platforms, Auto\-OEM charging integrations, licence\-market enablement, smart charging, site load management, demand response or energy\-management systems.
 



 • Experience building governed analytics, reporting, data or decision products used in live operational environments.
 



 • Experience operating a global, API\-first platform across Europe, North America and APAC.
 



 • MBA or advanced technical, data or business degree.
 



**What sets this role apart** 




 This role sits at the intersection of ecosystem scale and network economics. It shapes how Shell Recharge connects with roaming partners, Auto\-OEMs, licence markets and energy systems, while turning data and intelligent decision services into repeatable operational advantage.
 



 The Product Director will have visible accountability for business outcomes, lead senior product talent and influence critical platform decisions across commercial, engineering, operations and market leadership. The mandate combines strategy with hands\-on product ownership—ideal for a leader who can translate complex EV ecosystem dynamics into scalable products and measurable value.
 



  





**What We Offer** 




 • A work environment that allows you to work with and learn from some of the best and brightest in this emerging industry.
 



 • The ability to make a difference in a world that needs our technology to help reduce carbon emissions and enable a more sustainable energy future through the use of electric vehicle charging software, services and infrastructure.
 



 • The freedom to learn, suggest, and implement innovative new ideas applied to our systems, processes, programs and technologies.
 



 • Daily ownership of your role in a challenging, high\-growth environment.
 



 • A casual work environment and culture that supports work\-life ‘fit’, enabling you to fit life into your work and work into your life — flexible scheduling, virtualization options, and a generous holiday package.
 



 • Well\-being programs that enable you to thrive, e.g. investment in ergonomics, healthy snacks in the workplace, and a fully subsidized onsite gym program.
 



 • Competitive pay and benefits programs designed to enable you to thrive inside and outside of work.
 



 • Participation in Shell Recharge Solutions’ performance and rewards bonus program.
 



 • Medical benefits for employees.
 



 • Innovative paid time off program.

title: Head of Strategy and New Businesses
description:
**Purpose of this position / Position summary** 




 The Head – Strategy \& New Businesses will play a pivotal role in shaping the organization’s long\-term direction, driving business transformation, and enabling scalable, data\-driven growth. This leader will partner closely with the executive team to define strategic priorities, evaluate new growth opportunities, and institutionalize excellence in execution. The role requires a blend of strategic foresight, analytical depth, and operational discipline — ideal for a fast\-growing, high\-performing organization. The incumbent should be on a hands\-on strategic leader who has successfully navigated the early scale build and scale up journey of building and scaling businesses, and who brings a deep, end\-to\-end understanding of how product, commercial, customer, operations, and financial levers come together to drive sustainable growth.
 



  





**Primary duties and responsibilities** 




**1\.Strategic Direction:** 




 a. Define and drive long\-term business strategy aligned with organizational goals and the growth vision.
 



 b. Shape long\-term business direction and identify scalable growth opportunities.
 



 c. Translate strategic priorities into actionable plans with clear financial, operational, and customer outcomes.
 



**2\.Market \& Competitive Intelligence:** 




 a. Continuously assess market dynamics, emerging trends, and competitive movements to guide strategic positioning.
 



 b. Analyze trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscapes to inform business strategy.
 



 c. Use data to frame strategic questions, validate hypotheses, and guide decisions at leadership and board levels.
 



**3\.Cross\-Functional Alignment:** 




 a. Partner with business and functional heads to ensure alignment and execution of strategic priorities.
 



 b. Collaborative approach to align teams and drive organization\-wide clarity and focus.
 



**4\.New Growth Opportunities:** 




 a. Evaluate and model new business ventures, partnerships, and expansion areas to diversify revenue streams.
 



 b. Drive the early\-stage creation and scaled execution of new business lines—from concept, feasibility, piloting, GTM, customer validation, to operational rollout.
 



 c. Establish success metrics, experimentation frameworks, and feedback loops to ensure rapid learning and iteration.
 



 d. Build playbooks for scaling—processes, systems, capabilities, and governance required for sustainable growth.
 



**5\.Data\-Driven Decision Support:** 




 a. Build analytical frameworks and dashboards that inform decision\-making and measure strategic impact.
 



 b. Experienced in evaluating business models, investment opportunities, and partnerships with a structured, analytical approach.
 



**6\.Financial and Commercial Acumen:** 




 a. Build and own business cases, revenue models, P\&L projections, investment requirements, and risk assessments for new initiatives.
 



 b. Drive portfolio decisions—prioritization, resource allocation, and scenario planning.
 



  





**Education requirements / Experience / Job Specifications** 




 o MBA or advanced degree in Business, Strategy, or related field from Premier B\-School
 



 o 12\-15 years of experience in strategy, business excellence, or transformation roles within high\-growth or multinational organizations.
 



 o Proven track record of building or scaling businesses from 0–1—startup, new ventures, new markets, or large enterprise incubations.
 



 o Entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership.
 



 o Strong people leader with experience of mentorship and setting up high performing teams.
 



 o Strong exposure to P\&L thinking, operational models, product/market dynamics, and customer\-centric business design.
 



 o Experience working with senior leadership and board\-level stakeholders.
 



 o Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and storytelling skills, strong bias for action.
 



 o Ability to work in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments and drive clarity.

 AIMLEAP is a global AI and technology consulting company specializing in end\-to\-end full\-stack development across AI, data engineering, and software solutions. Certified at CMMI Level 3 and ISO 9001:2015 / ISO/IEC 27001:2013, AIMLEAP focuses on delivering secure, scalable, and high\-performance AI\-powered products. Recognized as a Great Place to Work®, AIMLEAP operates global delivery centers in the USA, Canada, India, and Australia. 
 
  
 





  
 




  





**About the Role** 

  
 




  





 AIMLEAP is looking for a
 **Head of SEO \& Organic Growth** 
 — a senior, P\&L\-minded leader who will
 **own organic visibility and growth across AIMLEAP's entire product and brand portfolio** 
 (including RADAR, APISCRAPY, PRICE\-LEAP, and future products), as well as set the SEO/GEO/AEO standard applied across client engagements.
 
  
 




  





 This is not a delivery\-execution role. This is an

 — the person in this seat is answerable for organic traffic, qualified pipeline, AI\-search visibility, and topical authority across every property in the portfolio, and for building the team, systems, and strategy that get us there. They will operate as a strategic partner to Product, Engineering, Content, and Business leadership, not just a functional head of SEO. 
 
  
 




  






  
 




  





**What You'll Be Accountable For** 

  
 




  




* **Portfolio\-level ownership** 
 : End\-to\-end accountability for organic search and AI\-search performance (traffic, qualified leads, sign\-ups, share of voice) across all AIMLEAP products and brands — not a single site or campaign.
* **Strategy \& roadmap** 
 : Defining and owning the multi\-quarter SEO/AEO/GEO roadmap across the portfolio, prioritized against business impact, and defending it to leadership.
* **Team \& function building** 
 : Building, mentoring, and scaling the SEO organization (Technical SEO, Content SEO, AEO/GEO specialists) — including hiring, structuring, and performance\-managing the team.
* **AI search leadership** 
 : Positioning AIMLEAP's products for visibility inside ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, and Copilot — treating GEO/AEO as a first\-class growth channel, not an add\-on to classic SEO.

 : Owning the technical SEO health of the portfolio — architecture, crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, structured data/schema, JS SEO, and crawl budget — across multiple product properties simultaneously.
* **Cross\-functional influence** 
 : Operating as the SEO voice inside Product and Engineering roadmap conversations, so SEO is designed in, not bolted on.

 : Presenting portfolio\-wide performance, risk, and opportunity directly to leadership on a recurring cadence, with a clear POV — not just a metrics dump.
* **Competitive \& market intelligence** 
 : Continuously scanning competitor and category movement (including AI search behavior shifts) and translating it into action for the portfolio.




  
 




  





**What We're Looking For** 

  
 




  




* **6–12 years** 
 of hands\-on and leadership experience in Technical SEO, SaaS Product SEO, and Organic Growth, with a track record of
 **owning outcomes across multiple products/brands** 
 , not a single site.
* Demonstrated experience being
 **held accountable for a portfolio, P\&L\-adjacent metric, or multi\-brand growth number** 
 — this is the key differentiator versus a standard Lead SEO hire.
* Deep expertise in
 **Technical SEO**

title: Commercial Director, India
description:

 Insider One is the

 that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and
 **become unstoppable.**
 Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry\-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered

 **Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst**

 Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only
 **woman\-founded, women\-led B2B SaaS unicorns** 
 in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts,
 **we are the only vendor recognized as the \#1 leader** 
 in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself. We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, and the results speak for themselves.
   

  

 From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world\-class product company, but also to create one of the
 **most socially progressive technology communities** 
 in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like
 *100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables* 
 , our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30\+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.
   

  

 Behind all these achievements is
 **an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers** 
 that moves fast and agile, creating cutting\-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.
   

  

 As our growth story accelerates, we’re looking to bring a Commercial Director to continue to build and develop our Sales organisation. This is a high\-impact leadership role for someone who has successfully scaled sales teams in fast\-growing SaaS environments and thrives in ambiguity, rapid growth, and change.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Build, develop, and retain best\-in\-class sales talent that exceeds performance goals
* Translate growth objectives into clear operating plans, priorities, and execution rhythms
* Coach and develop your team, setting a high bar for growth and accountability
* Develop deep product knowledge and industry expertise and embed this within your team
* Set and uphold rigorous standards for forecast accuracy, deal quality, inspection, and execution
* Interact with clients at all the stages of the sales cycle, from prospecting to negotiating and closing, supporting teams in navigating complex, multi\-stakeholder deals with confidence and credibility
* Lead cross\-functionally to ensure that your extended team is aligned, motivated and engaged through creating clarity, building trusted relationships and efficiency
* Champion a customer\-first mindset, ensuring strategies and execution improve the end\-to\-end customer journey
* Build executive relationships in key clients and partners, and drive thought leadership across the region


**What You Will Need**
* 10\+ years of proven experience within SaaS selling to Enterprise customers, with at least 5 years of experience in MarTech selling to similar ICPs as ours
* 3\+ years of experience leading and developing a team of Account Executives, with a strong track record of exceeding revenue targets
* Strong coaching philosophy grounded in growth, accountability, and development
* Strategic thinker who can zoom out to define direction — and zoom in to drive execution
* Demonstrates high technical acumen and stays ahead of industry trends in AI and digital innovation
* Comfortable operating in fast\-paced, high\-growth, and evolving environments
* Clear, confident communicator with strong executive presence
* Familiarity with MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or similar enterprise sales methodologies
* Experience selling to DTC companies highly preferred
* Strong network across E\-commerce, Retail, Internet companies, and BFSI is an important criterion


**What We Offer**
* Be part of a diverse team that’s as global as it gets — where every voice is heard and 50\+ nationalities build together
* Level up with internal trainings covering AI fundamentals, coding, foreign languages, and a wide range of personal development skills
* Feed your curiosity with access to Spotify, LinkedIn Learning, Blinkist, MasterClass, and CloudGuru
* Become a Shareowner through our eligibility\-based “ESOP” and own a piece of what you build
* Help build the team you want to work with and enjoy rewarding referral bonuses
* Opportunities to give back to your community through volunteering and purpose\-driven social impact projects
* From global retreats to team\-building activities, expect year\-round events that turn into lifelong memories


 We aren't just hiring for a position; we are hiring for a mission — a mission to build a lasting legacy that will set the benchmark for the most progressive tech companies out there.
   

  

 To do this, we are looking for exceptional talent to join a community of good\-hearted individuals who take high ownership and are relentlessly driven to go the extra mile.
   

  

 If this sounds like who you are and where you aspire to be, we are excited to meet you.
   

  

 We provide equal opportunity in a zero\-discrimination workplace and not just welcome but also embrace everyone without regard to sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status.
   

  

 Please follow Insider One on LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook and Medium!

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Territory Manager
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.


**A Day in the Life**
=====================

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.


* Promotes and sells Medtronic's products and services within an assigned geographic area and /or specific customer accounts to meet or exceed sales targets.
* Responsible for developing, building, and strengthening long\-term relationships with stakeholders including distributors and healthcare professionals.
* Responsible for pursuing leads, assessing needs and providing product services to maximize the benefits derived from Medtronic's products and/or services.
* Promotes and establishes education of the company's products and/or services.
* Conducts market research including customers and competitors activities.
* Implements market development plans/strategies and changes as needed.
* Communicates customer feedback on new products and/or modifications to existing products or applications to internal stakeholders including R\&D, Operations and Marketing.

**SALES PROFESSIONAL CAREER STREAM:** Typically sales professional individual contributors with direct sales responsibilities. May direct the work of other lower level sales professionals or manage sales processes and / or accounts involving multiple team members. The majority of time is spent establishing and maintaining customer relationships, developing new customer relationships, implementing sales strategies and closing sales.


**DIFFERENTIATING FACTORS**

**Autonomy:** Established and productive sales professional managing multiple small to mid\-size accounts. Sells products and/or services to a group of clients and identifies new and potential customers. Works independently with general supervision. Builds relationships.


**Organizational Impact:** Works to achieve individual sales targets within product area and/or account by selling products/ services, developing new accounts and/or expanding existing accounts. Has a direct impact on achieving department’s sales results. May help to set objectives or goals for individual or team accounts. Works on larger, moderately complex accounts or have a small or medium\-sized quota/territory. Understands market landscape, marketing and pricing structure, more influence on pricing structures. Works with sales, marketing and finance to structure complex contracts.


**Innovation and Complexity:** Makes adjustments or recommends enhancements in sales processes to solve problems or improve effectiveness of job area. Recommends changes in account tactics to achieve sales goals. Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action.


**Communication and Influence:** May influence parties within own job function at an operational level. Obtains or provides information requiring some explanation or interpretation. Communicates with external customers and / or vendors, involving negotiation and / or presentations in order to manage relationships and close sales.


**Leadership and Talent Management:** Normally receives general instructions on routine work, detailed instructions on new projects or assignments. May provide guidance and assistance to entry level sales professionals and / or support employees.


**Required Knowledge and Experience:** • High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 6\+ years experience\* • OR Associate’s Degree AND 4\+ years experience\* • OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 2\+ years experience\* \*Relevant sales, clinical, or related experience in medical devices, medtech, healthcare, or life sciences.  



**Physical Job Requirements**  

  

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.
‌


**Recruitment Fraud Alert**

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:  



  

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.  



  

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.  



  

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments.  



  

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com .
‌  



**Benefits \& Compensation**
============================

**Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package**  

A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

 **market expansion, customer acquisition, product portfolio, technology, operations, manufacturing, quality, supply chain and people**

**Business Strategy \& 3X Growth**

**P\&L Ownership \& Financial Performance** 



* Own the complete
 **P\&L of the Mechatronics business**

 **product mix, pricing, localization, cost engineering, productivity and operational excellence** 
 .

* Drive improvement in
 **ROCE and overall capital efficiency**

**Customer \& Market Development**

 .

* Identify opportunities for
 **new product introductions, platform nominations and long\-term customer partnerships** 
 .
* Build strong relationships with CXO\-level stakeholders across customers and ecosystem partners.



  





**Product \& Technology Strategy** 



* Develop the future product and technology roadmap in line with evolving automotive and industrial requirements.
* Strengthen capabilities in
 **mechatronics, electronics, embedded systems, sensors, actuators, control systems and software\-driven products** 
 , as relevant to the business.

 **technology partnerships, strategic alliances, acquisitions or in\-house capability development** 
 .
* Ensure the product portfolio evolves from conventional products towards higher\-value, technology\-driven solutions.

**New Business \& Revenue Expansion** 



* Drive new business development across
 **existing and new customers** 
 .
* Identify adjacent markets and applications where the company's mechatronics capabilities can be leveraged.

* Build a healthy balance between
 **core business growth and new\-growth businesses** 
 .

**Manufacturing \& Operational Excellence** 



* Ensure manufacturing capacity and capabilities are aligned with the planned 3X growth.
* Develop a scalable manufacturing strategy covering
 **capacity expansion, automation, productivity, technology and infrastructure** 
 .
* Drive operational excellence through continuous improvement, lean manufacturing and digitalization.
* Improve
 **OEE, productivity, yield, cycle time and overall asset utilization** 
 .
* Ensure manufacturing scalability without compromising quality, delivery or cost competitiveness.



  





**Supply Chain \& Localization** 



* Build a robust and scalable supply chain capable of supporting 3X business growth.
* Drive localization of critical components and technologies to improve competitiveness and reduce supply\-chain risks.
* Develop strategic supplier partnerships and ensure adequate capacity for future growth.
* Improve procurement effectiveness through
 **cost engineering, VA/VE, localization and strategic sourcing** 
 .
* Build resilience against supply disruptions and commodity/FX volatility.



  





**Quality \& Customer Excellence** 



* Establish a strong culture of
 **quality ownership and customer satisfaction** 
 across the organization.
* Drive improvements in PPM, warranty, customer complaints and field quality.

* Develop preventive quality mechanisms as the business scales.

**Organization \& Leadership Development**

 **Sales, Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance and HR** 
 .

* Build a culture of
 **ownership, speed, innovation, customer focus and execution excellence** 
 .

**Transformation \& Digitalization**

 .

title: Online Production Manager
description:
**E\-Commerce Coordinator**

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a highly organised, detail\-oriented and proactive **Production Manager** to take complete ownership of the planning, coordination, execution and post\-production follow\-up for our monthly website and content shoots. The role will be the key coordination point between the internal team, creative/marketing agency, photographer, videographer, models, influencers and other production partners, ensuring every shoot and content requirement is planned properly, executed smoothly and delivered on time and to the required standard.

**1\. PRE\-PRODUCTION – PLANNING \& PREPARATION**

* Understand the shoot concept, creative direction, products and required deliverables before every shoot.
* Ensure all shoot requirements are identified and planned well in advance.
* Prepare and maintain a Pre\-Production SOP/checklist for every shoot.
* Coordinate and confirm concept and scenes; products/sarees; props and accessories; models; photographer/videographer; makeup artist/stylist/other crew; location/studio; shoot date and schedule; equipment and production requirements; budget and expenses.
* Ensure all products, props, accessories and other materials are available, organised and ready before the shoot.
* Follow up with all stakeholders and ensure there are no last\-minute gaps.
* Prepare shoot schedules, requirement lists, briefs and coordination emails.
* Ensure the production is good to go before the shoot date through proper checks and confirmations.

**2\. SHOOT\-DAY MANAGEMENT**

* Be present during the shoot and take ownership of production coordination and execution.
* Ensure the shoot follows the approved concept, scenes, schedule and requirements.
* Coordinate between the photographer, videographer, models, stylist, internal team and agency.
* Ensure the correct products, accessories and props are used for each scene.
* Track the progress of planned scenes and deliverables.
* Ensure all required photographs and video content are captured.
* Resolve production\-related issues and coordinate solutions when required.
* Ensure the shoot stays within the approved scope, timeline and budget.
* Maintain a high level of attention to detail throughout the shoot.

**3\. POST\-PRODUCTION**

* Prepare and maintain a Post\-Production SOP/checklist for every shoot.
* Coordinate with the agency, photographer, videographer, editor and internal team for all post\-production requirements.
* Track the editing and delivery of product photographs, website photographs, reels/videos and other agreed content deliverables.
* Review edited photographs and videos against the approved concept and requirements.
* Check for product accuracy, framing and composition, styling, continuity, image/video quality, brand alignment and overall visual standards.
* Consolidate feedback from the internal team and communicate revisions clearly to the agency/editor.
* Follow up until all final deliverables are completed, reviewed and approved.
* Ensure final files are properly organised and delivered to the relevant teams.

**4\. SOP \& DOCUMENTATION**

* Create and maintain clear Pre\-Production and Post\-Production SOPs for every monthly shoot.
* Ensure the relevant SOP/checklist is reviewed and signed off by the responsible parties before proceeding.
* Maintain records of shoot requirements, concepts and scenes, budgets, approvals, schedules, vendor/team details, deliverables, feedback and final approvals.
* Ensure every shoot follows a consistent and repeatable production process.
* Continuously improve the SOP based on learnings from previous shoots.

**5\. AGENCY \& INTERNAL TEAM COORDINATION**

* Act as the primary coordination point between the internal team and external agency/production partners.
* Coordinate with the agency on all monthly shoot requirements and deliverables.
* Ensure the agency has all required information, products, concepts and approvals on time.
* Coordinate with internal teams to collect requirements, feedback and approvals.
* Ensure communication between all parties is clear and timely.
* Strongly follow up with all stakeholders to ensure deadlines are met.
* Identify potential delays or gaps in advance and proactively resolve them.
* Draft professional shoot\-related emails, briefs, confirmations, follow\-ups and feedback.
* Escalate delays, budget issues or production challenges when required.

**6\. INSTAGRAM INFLUENCER COORDINATION**

* Coordinate monthly with the agency for Instagram influencer collaborations.
* Review and understand the proposed influencer, story and content concept.
* Ensure the story, concept, styling and overall content direction align with the brand identity.
* Ensure influencer content reflects the brand's positioning, tone and visual standards.
* Coordinate with the agency and influencer to communicate brand requirements clearly.
* Follow up on timelines, content submission and publishing schedules.
* Review proposed influencer content before publishing and coordinate any required changes or approvals with the internal team.
* Ensure the final influencer content is aligned with the approved concept and brand expectations.

REQUIRED SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE

* Prior experience in production management, content production, photography/video production or a similar role.
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Excellent organisational and time\-management skills.
* Strong email drafting and professional communication skills.
* Basic understanding of photography and video production standards and workflows.
* Ability to understand creative concepts and translate them into clear production requirements.
* High attention to detail.
* Strong ownership and accountability from pre\-production through final delivery.
* Ability to coordinate multiple people, vendors, agencies and deliverables simultaneously.
* Ability to identify potential issues before they become problems.
* Comfortable working with agencies, photographers, videographers, creatives, influencers and internal teams.
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines and ensure consistent follow\-through.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE**

A highly organised **doer and owner** who can independently take a shoot and related content requirements from:

**CONCEPT → PRE\-PRODUCTION → COORDINATION → SHOOT → POST\-PRODUCTION → REVIEW → APPROVAL → FINAL DELIVERY**

The ideal candidate should not simply coordinate tasks but should **own the complete production process**, ensure every detail is covered, follow up consistently, identify gaps proactively and make sure the final output is delivered to the expected quality, brand standard, timeline and budget.

**Work you’ll do**
 The USI AI\-Led Work Transformation (AIWT) Manager owns core AIWT workstreams across GTM activation, AI\-enabled asset development, and integration — translating program strategy into results in coordination with Deloitte’s four businesses (T\&T, SR\&T, T\&L, A\&A) and Member Firms. The Manager drives workstreams end to end and oversees the work of other AIWT team members in delivering them.
   

  

**Activities:**
* Own components of the AIWT GTM activation campaign strategy, driving sector\-organized market activation that brings AIWT capabilities to clients across priority geographies.
* Own development of AI\-enabled GTM assets and capabilities, building tools and enablement materials that help Member Firms activate and deliver AIWT in market.
* Oversee AIWT sales and pipeline reporting and analytics, ensuring data integrity and translating insights into recommendations for program strategy and leadership decisions.
* Support workplan integration across T\&T, SR\&T, T\&L, and A\&A, ensuring AIWT is embedded in each business’s storefront rather than run as a parallel workstream.
* Drive alignment across Member Firms and geographies to ensure consistent, high\-velocity execution of AIWT strategy, including lighthouse pursuit visibility and eminence cascade.
* Identify and champion creative, non\-traditional approaches that help Member Firms deliver AIWT beyond conventional consulting delivery models.
* Shape and drive AIWT leadership moments (strategy workshops, MF market activation) that reinforce program strategy and Member Firm buy\-in.
* Oversee the work of the other AIWT team members across GTM activation, asset development, and pipeline reporting, ensuring quality, consistency, and alignment with program strategy.
* Partner with AIWT leadership to implement the program's operating cadence and governance model across priority geographies.
* Coordinate across key internal stakeholders to align priorities, resourcing, timelines, and delivery support across AIWT workstreams.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Build and steward relationships across T\&T, SR\&T, T\&L, and A\&A leadership to keep AIWT integrated across all four businesses.
* Partner with the broader AIWT team, internal stakeholder groups, and CBG peers (Finance, Cost Transformation, Operate, Climate \& Infrastructure, E2E M\&A) to keep AIWT aligned with broader portfolio priorities and supported through effective delivery coordination.
* Facilitate knowledge sharing and eminence — packaging client examples, case studies, and POVs for cross\-network use.
* Coordinate USI resources in support of priority AIWT pursuits and lighthouse clients.
* Activate markets, drive MDM/AIO behaviours, and address our clients’ Heart of the Business issues through the AIWT lens.
* Build strong working relationships across internal stakeholder groups to coordinate execution, resolve delivery dependencies, and maintain alignment across shared workstreams.


 Requisite core skills
   

  

* High performance at a Manager\-level equivalent
* Growing network and working relationships across GCS pillars (T\&T, SR\&T), DTTL, and Member Firm stakeholders
* Experience owning GTM campaign execution, AI\-enabled asset development, or sales/pipeline reporting and analytics in a professional services or B2B environment
* Experience overseeing or coaching junior team members, with accountability for the quality and consistency of team output
* Exposure and/or experience with or multi\-offering programs in a matrixed environment, including environments where success depends on influence rather than direct authority
* Familiarity with Human Capital transformation, Organization \& Work Transformation (OWT), or workforce strategy concepts
* Understanding of the CBG MDM/AIO narrative, strategic priorities, and Heart of the Business issues, with a track record of advancing the narrative across diverse stakeholder groups
* Working knowledge of how AI is reshaping work and the operating\-model implications (no hands\-on development required)
* Strategic thinker with the ability to translate concepts into practical, executable plans, including creative, non\-traditional delivery approaches
* Strong understanding of Deloitte USI and Member Firm clients, industries, and programs
* Works well under pressure in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to coordinate across many constituents
* Ability to interact and interface with all levels, especially with leadership
* Strong project management skills with attention to detail
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical abilities
* Strong relationship building and relationship management skills
* Strong executive communication skills (written and oral)

description:

**LOCATION: NAVI MUMBAI, INDIA** 




  





**OUR STORY:** 




  





 JioSaavn is India’s leading audio streaming service to access, discover, and listen to favourite songs \& Podcasts across languages and genres. We blend digital technology, data analysis (which we have affectionately coined Music Science), and a strong, fearless business acumen to reach all corners of the globe. Our default mode is that of perpetual innovation. Together, we form a concerted rhythm that goes beyond borders. We don't just go with the flow, we create it.

We encourage everyone to be open to experiences and perspectives beyond their normal; divergent thinkers create differentiated products, and even better music.
 



 If our vibe matches with yours, we'd love to hear from you.

 We are looking for an
 **Sr. Manager – Product Marketing** 
 to build and lead a world\-class Product Marketing function at JioSaavn. This is a high\-impact leadership role responsible for turning products into categories users understand, value, and love. You will own product positioning, go\-to\-market strategy, user insight systems, feature adoption, and growth narratives across key products and experiences. You will work closely with Product, Growth, Analytics, Design, Business, and Leadership teams to ensure our products are not only built well, but launched, adopted, and scaled exceptionally well.

**1\. Product Positioning \& Strategy** 



* Define differentiated positioning, messaging, and narratives for core and emerging products.
* Translate market signals, user behaviour, and competitive insights into strategic product recommendations.
* Influence product roadmaps through market\-back thinking and customer insight.



**2\. Go\-To\-Market Leadership** 



* Own end\-to\-end GTM strategy for product launches, major feature releases, and strategic initiatives.
* Build scalable launch playbooks covering segmentation, targeting, messaging, channels, and measurement.
* Ensure launches deliver measurable business outcomes—not just awareness.



**3\. User Insight \& Market Intelligence** 



* Build strong voice\-of\-customer systems using qualitative and quantitative inputs.
* Identify friction points across acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention funnels.
* Monitor competitive moves and identify whitespace opportunities for category leadership.



**4\. Growth \& Adoption** 



* Drive feature adoption, engagement, and retention in partnership with Product and Growth teams.
* Design interventions that improve habit formation and lifecycle conversion.
* Own core metrics such as activation rate, feature penetration, repeat usage, and retention uplift.



**5\. Cross\-Functional Leadership** 



* Act as the strategic bridge between Product, Marketing, Growth, Data, and Business teams.
* Drive alignment across stakeholders on priorities, narratives, and success metrics.
* Build Product Marketing as a strategic capability within the organization.



  





**REQUIREMENTS:**



* 8–10 years of experience across Product Marketing, Product Management, Growth, or consumer\-tech strategy roles.
* Proven track record of driving product adoption and growth at scale.
* Strong understanding of consumer behavior, lifecycle funnels, and GTM strategy.
* Excellent analytical capability with comfort using data to drive decisions.
* Strong storytelling and communication skills with executive presence.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and operate cross\-functionally.
* Experience in consumer internet, OTT, telecom, subscription, or digital products preferred.



  





**BENEFITS AND PERKS:**




 At JioSaavn, we blur work and play, and you get all the perks of a global company. You will get to work with a dynamic group of entrepreneurs, who are delivering results and working zealously to make a difference in the way the world experiences music.

 We are seeking a strategic and entrepreneurial marketing leader to drive the growth and market development of Sybrava, a strategic cardiovascular brand with significant potential to transform treatment paradigms and patient outcomes. title: Entrepreneur in Residence
description:
Pepper (
 
 https://www.pepper.inc/
 
 ) is an AI\-native marketing services company redefining how enterprise brands scale organic growth through a unified blend of strategy, creative talent, technology, and automation. We are building an AI\-powered marketing services engine that seamlessly combines top global creative talent with proprietary workflows and automation to deliver measurable, scalable outcomes for modern CMOs.
 



 Our platform and services bring together content, data, talent, and AI to help brands plan, create, manage, distribute, and measure high\-impact marketing programs and all on one intelligent system designed for enterprise growth and efficiency.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We're hiring an Entrepreneur in Residence (EIR) into the Founder's Office at Pepper Content.
 



 This is not a strategy seat. It's an operating seat.
 



 We're looking for someone who has already carried the weight of a business. A founder who built and ran something, or an operator who has owned Ops, Strategy, or Customer Success end\-to\-end and been accountable for the number at the bottom. You'll work alongside the Founder/CEO and the central Centre of Excellence (COE) team, and you'll be handed the problems that matter most and are least defined: a business line that needs to be rebuilt, a function that needs an owner, a market that needs to be cracked, a manual process that needs to become an AI\-first one.
 



 You won't be given a playbook. You'll be expected to write one, run it, prove it works, and then hand it to someone else so you can go take the next thing.
 



 Base location: Mumbai (in\-office)
 



 Shift: 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM IST
 



  





**What You'll Own** 



* Take a business problem from zero to working. You'll be handed ambiguous, high\-stakes mandates, a new revenue line, a broken unit economic, an underperforming segment, a market entry and own them outright. Diagnosis, plan, build, launch, iterate, results.
* **Run functions that don't have an owner yet.** 
 Where something is founder\-led, ad\-hoc, or held together by heroics, you step in as interim owner: build the team, the process, and the metrics, stabilise it, then hand it over.
* **Rebuild how work gets done with AI.** 
 Identify the highest\-leverage workflows across Ops, CS, Delivery and GTM, and rebuild them AI\-first. Partner with product and engineering to ship, then hold yourself to measurable impact on cost, speed, margin, and quality.
* **Own customer outcomes where it counts.** 
 Get into live accounts — especially US enterprise — understand why customers stay or churn, fix retention and expansion mechanics at the root, and turn what you learn into product and process.
* **Build the operating layer.** 
 Definitions, dashboards, reviews, and cadences that make performance legible. If the Founder can't see what's working within 24 hours of asking, that's your problem to fix.
* **Be a genuine second pair of hands for the Founder.** 
 Diligence, fundraising material, pricing experiments, partnership evaluation, board prep, escalations — whatever the quarter demands.
* **Build the bench.** 
 Hire, coach, and hand off. Success in this role is measured partly by how many things you've made someone else's job.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* **6–10 years of experience, with at least one of the following as your core story:**
* **You founded and ran a company.** 
 You raised or bootstrapped, hired, sold, shipped, and made payroll. Whether it exited, scaled, or shut down matters less than what you carried and what you learned.
* **You've owned Ops, Strategy, or Customer Success at a high\-growth company.** 
 A real function with a team, a budget, and a number you were held to. Not a supporting role in one
* Full\-stack operating range. You can build the model, write the deck, sit in the QBR, debug the process, and get on the phone with an unhappy customer all in the same day. No task is beneath you and no problem is above you.
* Comfort with ambiguity that would paralyse most people. You're handed a sentence, not a brief. You come back with a plan.
* Commercial instinct. You think in margin, CAC, retention, and payback and not just activity and output.
* A real point of view on AI. You use LLMs, agents, and automation platforms daily, and you have an argument about how they change the shape of a services and marketplace business. Bonus if you've actually deployed AI into production workflows and can talk about what broke.
* Bias for shipping. A working v1 beats a perfect plan. You'd rather be corrected by the market than by a meeting.
* Sharp, structured communication. You can write a one\-pager the board reads without questions, and a brief a frontline team can execute without a follow\-up call.
* High ownership, low ego. You chase the hundredth detail without losing the plot, and you don't need credit to do the work.
* Prior exposure to US customers or teams is a strong plus.

 .
 



  





  





 From studio design and hygiene standards to storytelling, education, and community, we’ve consistently raised the bar for what tattooing can mean in modern India.
 



  





  





 Aliens operates 16 studios today and is scaling to 100 over the next three years. We also run
 



 one of India’s largest tattoo schools with up to 1,000 students annually. This role will lead marketing across studios, Tattoo school, and franchise verticals. We are looking for a strong growth\-oriented marketing leader who understands multi\-location retail, digital performance, and brand building. The role covers acquisition, CRM, content, PR, and city\-level launches. Clear ownership of revenue\-aligned KPIs is essential. You should have experience scaling brands across multiple cities, managing integrated teams, and delivering measurable impactacross footfall, admissions, and marketing ROI. This is a leadership role with real business ownership, not just
 



 campaign execution. If you have built structured marketing engines for growing brands and enjoy operating in fast expansion environments, we would like to connect.
 



  





  





**Executive summary**

The Head of Marketing leads an integrated, multi\-channel marketing function across studios, schools, and franchise verticals.

title: Manager - HW Dietary Supplement
description:
ADM is seeking a Business Development Manager, Health \& Wellness(H\&W), South Asia(SA) to build and lead our H\&W business, starting in India, with an initial focus on the Dietary Supplement (DS), Pharma \& Nutra/Functional foods segments. Success calls for strategic agility, commercial acumen, and the leadership to grow both a business and a team.
  

  

**Your Responsibilities**

* Drive cross\-sell across ADM's active health ingredients (Probiotics, Prebiotics, Postbiotics, Vitamins, Sterols, Isoflavones, Botanicals) and enabling ingredients (Flavors, Colors, Proteins).
* Business Development
* Identify and develop new business across the region, building partnerships with CMOs, brand owners, and key clients as core routes to market.
* Own the full deal cycle from prospecting to close, backed by a strong, well\-managed pipeline.
* Product, Market \& Stakeholder Development
* Work with technology, platform, and marketing teams to adapt ADM's DS and Pharma \& Nutra offerings for India and localize go\-to\-market.
* Build strong relationships with customers, distributors, academia, and regulatory authorities, and represent ADM at industry and trade forums.
* Leadership \& Governance
* Build a high\-performing team and a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability, partnering with HR on talent.
* Ensure compliance with local regulation and ADM policy, and manage business risk for sustainable operations.

**Your Profile**
  

  

Education \& Experience
* A science or pharmacy foundation (B.Pharm/M.Pharm, or M.Sc/B.Sc in Microbiology, Biotechnology, Food Science, or Nutrition, or a Food Tech/Biotech engineering degree), postgraduate level preferred. An MBA is strongly preferred; a PhD in life sciences or a medical qualification (MBBS) is an added advantage, especially for the pharma and clinical channels.
* 10\+ years in business development or commercial roles across Nutrition, Food Ingredients, or Health \& Wellness, or in a CMO/CDMO environment.
* Proven track record of regional coverage and closing deals, with a strong network across the nutrition, supplements, and contract manufacturing ecosystem.
* Solid grasp of the region's regulatory and market dynamics.

Skills \& Attributes
* Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, and communication, with the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders.
* Sharp feel for consumer and market trends.
* Comfortable in a fast\-paced, cross\-cultural environment.
* Entrepreneurial, with an owner's mindset and an influencing leadership style.
**\#IncludingYou**
  

  

Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging are cornerstones of ADM’s efforts to continue innovating, driving growth, and delivering outstanding performance. We are committed to attracting and retaining a diverse workforce and create welcoming, truly inclusive work environments — environments that enable every ADM colleague to feel comfortable on the job, make meaningful contributions to our success, and grow their career. We respect and value the unique backgrounds and experiences that each person can bring to ADM because we know that diversity of perspectives makes us better, together.

At ADM, we unlock the power of nature to provide access to nutrition worldwide. With industry\-advancing innovations, a complete portfolio of ingredients and solutions to meet any taste, and a commitment to sustainability, we give customers an edge in solving the nutritional challenges of today and tomorrow. We’re a global leader in human and animal nutrition and the world’s premier agricultural origination and processing company. Our breadth, depth, insights, facilities and logistical expertise give us unparalleled capabilities to meet needs for food, beverages, health and wellness, and more. From the seed of the idea to the outcome of the solution, we enrich the quality of life the world over. Learn more at www.adm.com.

### **Manager Supply Chain\- Supply Hub (India \& SEA)**

### **A strong supply chain strategy is built on effective planning, coordination, and execution across India and Southeast Asia, ensuring seamless product availability, optimized inventory management, and efficient movement of goods throughout the supply chain.**

### **In the role of** **Manager – Supply Chain (India \& SEA)****, you will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end supply chain operations, ensuring effective planning, procurement, inventory control, logistics, order management and customer service to deliver reliable product availability and operational excellence across the region.**

### **Make a difference as a Manager\- Supply Chain (India \& SEA)**
**As a Manager \- Supply Chain (India \& SEA),** **you will play a key role in developing and executing regional supply chain strategies to ensure seamless product availability and operational efficiency across India and Southeast Asia.**

### **You will work closely with Sales \& Marketing, Product Development, Production, Procurement, R\&D and Operations teams to align demand and supply plans, seed movements in line with regulatory compliance, optimize inventory levels, manage logistics and distribution activities, and support data\-driven decision\-making to achieve business objectives and customer service targets.**

### **In this role, your work will include to:**

* ### **Lead, coach, and develop the Supply Chain team to drive high performance and collaboration.**
* ### **Manage end\-to\-end supply planning to ensure product availability, optimal inventory levels, and customer service excellence across India and SEA.**
* ### **Oversee inbound and outbound logistics, import/export operations, and regulatory compliance to ensure timely and efficient product movement.**
* ### **Drive capacity planning, processing, testing, and scheduling activities while proactively identifying and resolving operational bottlenecks.**
* ### **Ensure compliance with quality standards, testing protocols, and supply chain processes to deliver high\-quality products to the market.**
* ### **Champion continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service, quality, efficiency, inventory management, and cross\-functional collaboration.**
* ### **Lead supply chain discussions in cross\-functional business reviews and contribute to strategic decision\-making and operational excellence.**
* ### **Ensure engagement and alignment with the Global supply planning processes and Centre of expertise.**
* ### **Working / application of ERP in day\-to\-day supply operations.**

### **What You Bring as Our Future Colleague**

### **As a** **Supply Chain Manager****, you bring strong capabilities in demand and supply planning, inventory optimization, logistics coordination, regulatory compliances and stakeholder management. You are skilled at balancing customer demand with operational capacity, driving cross\-functional collaboration, and using data\-driven insights to ensure efficient supply chain operations, high service levels, and continuous business improvement.**

### **In addition, you possess the following:**

* ### **Education in M.Sc Agriculture and additional certification/ course in Supply chain management with 9\-12 years of relevant experience.**
* ### **Training in leadership and coaching**
* ### **Knowledge of and experience in digitalization / automation of supply chain processes or related.**
* ### **Knowledge of International flows of supply routes, markets and interdependencies, and documentation.**
* ### **Proficient in the English language, both written and verbal.**
* ### **Readiness to work at Pune location**
* ### **Proficient in ERP, MS office Suite.**

### **Enza Zaden as your employer**
**Enza Zaden is an international family\-owned company that has been developing innovative vegetable varieties since 1938\. Together with more than 3,300 colleagues worldwide, we work on vegetable seeds with better flavor, higher yield and strong resistances. We do this from our mission: “Breeding to feed the world.” Every day, more than 480 million people eat vegetables grown from our seeds, and that is something we are very proud of.**

### **We’re passionate about our work and care about one another. Good ideas are given room to grow and together we keep moving forward. This is how we continue to grow and innovate, both as a company and as colleagues.**

### **What you can expect from us**
**We believe it is important that you can grow in your work and feel good about what you do. That is why we invest in your development, well\-being, and job satisfaction. Through our Great to Grow development program, our focus on vitality, and activities that bring colleagues together, we create a work environment where you can keep learning and contribute with energy and enjoyment.**

### **You can also count on:**

* ### **A role for 45 to 48 hours per week;**
* ### **Attractive compensation aligned with industry benchmarks**
* ### **An attractive bonus plan ;**
* ### **A laptop from Enza Zaden;**
* ### **Room to develop yourself through our Great to Grow development program, training courses and e\-learning platform;**

### **Let’s connect**
**Looking for a career that grows with you? Apply using the application button by 30th November 2026\. You will receive an automatic confirmation within a few minutes. We will let you know the next step within 10 business days.**

### **An assessment is part of the application process. This role cannot be filled on an interim basis. A security screening is also part of our recruitment process.**

### **Do you have questions about the role or the application process? Please feel free to contact Pranita Aghamkar, HR Specialist, at P.aghamkar@enzazaden.co.in.**

### **Enza Zaden is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on background, identity, or personal characteristics.**

### **Want to learn more about Enza Zaden? Visit our** **website****.**

title: General Manager Marketing
description:
Marketing Manager
 
**Location:** 
 Delhi
 



**Experience:** 
 5–8 Years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Department :** 
 Marketing
 



  




**About the Role :\-** 

 We are looking for a highly versatile and hands\-on
 **Marketing Manager** 
 who can take ownership of the
 **complete marketing function** 
 across our FMCG, Entertainment, Events, Sports, and Lifestyle businesses.
 



 This is an
 **all\-round marketing role** 
 for someone who can think strategically, execute independently, manage multiple stakeholders, and drive marketing from
 **idea to execution to measurable results** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should have exposure to both
 **online and offline marketing** 
 and should be comfortable handling everything from brand strategy and digital campaigns to events, partnerships, PR, activations, content, customer acquisition, and agency management.
 



  




**Key Responsibilities :\-** 
 1\. Overall Marketing Strategy
 * Develop and execute the overall marketing strategy across different brands and business verticals.
* Create annual, quarterly, and campaign\-wise marketing plans.
* Identify target audiences, market opportunities, and growth areas.
* Build brand awareness, customer acquisition, engagement, and retention strategies.
* Ensure marketing initiatives are aligned with business and revenue objectives.


 2\. Brand \& Communication
 * Own brand positioning, brand identity, messaging, and communication.
* Develop marketing concepts and campaigns that strengthen brand visibility.
* Ensure consistency of brand communication across digital, offline, events, PR, and other touchpoints.
* Work with creative teams to develop impactful campaigns, creatives, videos, presentations, and marketing collateral.


 3\. Digital \& Social Media
 * Oversee the complete digital marketing function, including social media, paid advertising, SEO/SEM, content, email/WhatsApp marketing, and lead generation.
* Develop social media strategy and content calendars.
* Monitor digital campaigns and optimise them for reach, engagement, leads, and conversions.
* Explore new digital platforms and marketing opportunities.
* Manage influencer and creator collaborations.


 4\. FMCG \& Consumer Marketing
 * Develop and execute marketing initiatives for FMCG products and consumer brands.
* Support product launches, promotions, sampling, retail activations, and seasonal campaigns.
* Work with sales/distribution teams to improve product visibility and market penetration.
* Understand consumer behaviour and use insights to develop effective campaigns.


 5\. Events \& Experiential Marketing
 * Develop and execute marketing strategies for events, tournaments, entertainment properties, activations, and experiences.
* Drive registrations, bookings, ticket sales, footfall, and audience engagement.
* Plan pre\-event, event\-day, and post\-event marketing campaigns.
* Manage on\-ground activations, promotional activities, and brand experiences.


 6\. Partnerships, Sponsorships \& Collaborations
 * Identify and build partnerships with brands, corporates, influencers, media houses, communities, schools, and other organisations.
* Develop sponsorship and co\-branding opportunities.
* Negotiate and manage strategic marketing collaborations.
* Explore cross\-promotional opportunities to increase brand reach and business.


 7\. PR \& Media
 * Develop PR and media strategies to increase brand visibility.
* Coordinate with PR agencies, journalists, media partners, and publications.
* Identify opportunities for press coverage, interviews, brand stories, and media partnerships.
* Manage brand communication during major launches and events.


 8\. Offline \& On\-Ground Marketing
 * Plan and execute outdoor advertising, print, retail marketing, activations, sampling, hoardings, merchandise, and other offline initiatives.
* Identify innovative ways to reach target consumers.
* Coordinate with vendors and agencies for on\-ground execution.


 9\. Campaign Management
 * Conceptualise, plan, execute, and evaluate end\-to\-end marketing campaigns.
* Prepare campaign briefs, timelines, budgets, and deliverables.
* Coordinate with creative, content, sales, operations, event, and external agency teams.
* Ensure campaigns are delivered on time and within budget.


 10\. Budget, Analytics \& ROI
 * Plan and manage marketing budgets across different activities.
* Track campaign performance, leads, conversions, reach, engagement, customer acquisition, and ROI.
* Prepare regular marketing reports and present insights to management.
* Identify what is working and continuously optimise marketing investments.


 11\. Agency \& Vendor Management
 * Manage relationships with advertising, digital, creative, PR, influencer, production, media, and event agencies.
* Brief agencies, evaluate proposals, negotiate commercials, and monitor deliverables.
* Build and manage a reliable network of marketing vendors and partners.


 12\. Team \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration
 * Work closely with Sales, Business Development, Events, Operations, Creative, Content, and Leadership teams.
* Lead and coordinate internal and external marketing resources.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously and ensure timely execution.
* Take complete ownership of marketing deliverables from concept to execution.



  




**What We’re Looking For :\-** 
* **5–8 years of experience** 
 in marketing, preferably across multiple sectors such as
 **FMCG, Entertainment, Events, Sports, Media, Hospitality, Lifestyle, or Consumer Brands** 
 .
* Strong understanding of
 **360° marketing** 
 across digital and offline channels.
* Proven experience in brand building and campaign management.
* Experience in events, activations, partnerships, sponsorships, PR, and influencer marketing.
* Strong commercial understanding and ability to connect marketing activities with business results.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Strong project\-management and execution capabilities.
* Creative, analytical, proactive, and highly hands\-on.
* Ability to independently manage multiple marketing functions rather than being limited to one area.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.

**Job Description:**
**ROLE PURPOSE:**
 As Market Access Manager, you will be responsible for enabling access across the company’s portfolio by developing and implementing market access strategies that address pricing, reimbursement, funding pathways, policy shaping, and stakeholder engagement. The role will support portfolio\-wide access objectives across relevant therapeutic areas, with a specific focus on public accounts, national and sub\-national health authorities, public procurement bodies, and public health programs. Your work will help ensure timely, sustainable, and equitable access to medicines and vaccines by aligning evidence, value communication, and partnership strategies with public\-sector priorities and patient needs.
   

  

**ACCOUNTABILITIES:**
**Portfolio Market Access Strategy:** 
 Develop and execute integrated market access strategies across the portfolio, ensuring each product has a clear access pathway that reflects its value proposition, patient need, public health relevance, affordability considerations, and local healthcare system dynamics.
 **Evidence Generation and Value Demonstration:** 
 Collaborate with medical, HEOR, policy, and cross\-functional teams to generate and translate evidence that demonstrates clinical, economic, budgetary, and public health value across the portfolio, supporting access discussions with public stakeholders and payers.
 **Pricing, Reimbursement, and Funding Pathways:** 
 Support pricing and reimbursement strategies by analyzing market dynamics, public funding mechanisms, procurement models, affordability barriers, and competitor benchmarks, while ensuring alignment with portfolio value, patient access objectives, and compliance requirements.
 **Public Account Engagement:** 
 Build and maintain strategic relationships with public accounts, including government health authorities, public payers, national and sub\-national institutions, procurement agencies, public hospitals, and public health program stakeholders, to understand priorities and shape sustainable access solutions.
 **Value Communication:** 
 Communicate product and portfolio value propositions to policymakers, public payers, procurement stakeholders, healthcare providers, and internal teams, clearly articulating clinical value, public health impact, economic considerations, and relevance to public\-sector priorities.
 **Public Market Intelligence:** 
 Monitor healthcare policy, public funding priorities, reimbursement trends, procurement processes, tender opportunities, competitor activity, and stakeholder dynamics to identify access opportunities, risks, and implications for the portfolio.
 **Access Planning and Execution:** 
 Partner with cross\-functional teams to integrate market access considerations into brand planning, launch planning, lifecycle management, reimbursement planning, public account plans, and private\-channel access initiatives, ensuring timely execution of activities that support access across the portfolio.
 **Compliance:** 
**and Governance:** 
**:** 
 Ensure all market access and public account activities comply with applicable laws, regulations, internal policies, and ethical standards, maintaining transparency and integrity in all interactions with external stakeholders.
   

  

**Critical leadership capabilities:**
 As a Market Access Manager responsible for portfolio\-wide access with a focus on public accounts, strong leadership capabilities are essential to navigate complex healthcare systems, align internal and external stakeholders, and deliver sustainable access outcomes. The following capabilities are critical for success in this role
   

  

**Strategic Vision:** 
 A Market Access Manager should have a clear and compelling strategic vision for market access initiatives. They must be able to align with the organization's overall goals and craft a well\-defined roadmap to achieve market access objectives.

 Building and maintaining trusted relationships with public\-sector stakeholders, including government officials, public payers, procurement bodies, health authorities, HTA bodies, and healthcare institutions, is crucial to advancing access priorities across the portfolio.
 **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 
 Market access initiatives require close collaboration with commercial, medical, regulatory, policy, legal, compliance, supply, and finance teams. The Market Access Manager should foster alignment across functions to support portfolio planning, public account execution, and sustainable access outcomes.
   

  

**Adaptability:** 
 The healthcare landscape and regulatory environment can be dynamic and unpredictable. Effective leaders in market access must be adaptable to changes, able to navigate challenges, and pivot strategies as needed to achieve objectives.
   

  

**Data\-Driven Decision Making:** 
 A successful Market Access Manager relies on data\-driven insights to support their decisions. This includes analyzing health economic data, market trends, competitor analysis, and real\-world evidence to shape pricing and access strategies.
   

  

**Ethical and Compliance Orientation:** 
 Market access involves engaging with public health stakeholders, and ethical conduct is critical. A Market Access Manager should uphold high ethical standards and ensure compliance with relevant laws and regulations throughout all interactions.
   

  

**Resilience:** 
 Achieving market access for a new vaccine can be a complex and demanding process, often requiring persistence and resilience. A strong leader in this role remains focused, positive, and determined in overcoming obstacles and achieving objectives.
   

  

**Innovative:** 
**Access:** 
**Thinking:** 
 Public\-sector access may require innovative approaches to address affordability, funding, procurement, and implementation barriers. A capable leader should identify practical solutions and partnership models that improve access while supporting long\-term portfolio sustainability.
   

  

**Results\-Oriented:** 
 Setting clear goals and objectives is essential, and a Market Access Manager should be results\-oriented, ensuring the team remains focused on achieving measurable outcomes in terms of pricing, reimbursement, and access.

* Proven experience in market access, pricing, reimbursement, public policy, public account management, or health economics within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, vaccine, or healthcare industry, with the ability to support access across a broad portfolio.
