description:
The client is India's leading Voice AI platform for consumer sales. Their AI agents run 50 lakh\+ calls a day for 60\+ leading brands including Kotak Mahindra Bank, AngelOne, PhonePe, IndiaMART, TATA Digital, Amazon, Swiggy and Eureka Forbes, giving every lead the best pitch, in their language, on their preferred channel, at the right time. Our customers see up to 90% lead connectivity, 40% more conversions and 2\-3x lower CAC. We own the stack we run on. Arth, our speech\-to\-text model, is trained on 600M\+ minutes of real Indian sales conversations and, on our own benchmark of noisy Hinglish telephony audio, comes out ahead of every other model. Maya, the world's first Sales LLM, is trained on 400M\+ real sales interactions and their outcomes, so it learns what actually closes, not just what sounds fluent. We process over a trillion tokens a month at under 0\.8 second median latency, and every conversation makes the next one better. Driven by 200\+ builders and backed by Blume Ventures, Chiratae Ventures and Bertelsmann India Investments, we believe how we build matters as much as what we build. Ownership is real, trust is the default, and there is room for deep work. Careers here are not one\-size\-fits\-all. Growth can be linear or non\-linear, leadership can be quiet or bold, and people build, lead and challenge without being pushed into a single mould. If you're excited by AI, driven by purpose, and want your work to truly matter, there is space for you here.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




  





  





 We are looking for an Associate Director, Marketing to shape how the client shows up in the market as we build the category for AI Voice Agents in consumer sales. This is not a “manage campaigns from a distance” role. We are looking for someone who can think sharply, write clearly, build narratives from first principles, and turn marketing into a real growth engine. You will own the positioning, messaging, launches, content engine, website, PR, events and the overall brand quality across touchpoints. You will work closely with the founders, product, sales and customer teams to define how we tell our story to enterprise buyers, how we launch new capabilities, how we create demand, and how we build trust in a fast\-emerging AI category. The role needs someone who is strategic enough to define the narrative, operating cadence and budget, but still hands\-on enough to write, edit, brief, review, ship and improve the work personally. A big part of the mandate is also to build a genuinely AI\-native marketing operating system. Not just using AI to draft copy, but rethinking how research, content, launch prep, reporting, website work and creative workflows can run faster and better with AI, while still maintaining strong human judgment and brand quality. This is a high\-ownership role for someone who wants to build the marketing function for a serious B2B AI company at an important stage of scale.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* Positioning and product marketing
* Define the narrative and messaging architecture, including the category story for AI voice agents in consumer sales.
* Run every launch end to end: messaging, enablement, assets, post\-launch measurement.
* Brand, content and website
* Build the content engine and keep the brand coherent across blog, thought leadership, case studies and socials.
* Own the website as a growth asset: structure, conversion, and visibility across search and AI answer engines.
* Lead the design team and raise the quality bar on everything we ship.
* PR and events
* Own PR end to end: agency, media relationships, announcements, executive bylines, analyst relationships.
* Own the event calendar, and be accountable for its pipeline contribution rather than just its execution.
* The team’s AI operating model
* Decide which workflows run agentically, which need human review, and how brand voice holds up at scale.
* Rebuild content, research, launch prep and reporting as AI\-assisted pipelines with quality gates.
* Team
* Lead and grow the team across content, product marketing and design.
* Own the budget across agencies, tools, events and PR.



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





  




* 7\+ years in marketing, at least 3 in B2B SaaS or AI sold to enterprise buyers.
* 2\+ years managing people, including a designer or creative.
* You have written positioning and messaging yourself, and run launches end to end where you can say what moved as a result.
* You have run an editorial calendar across SEO\-led pieces, case studies and executive posts, with traffic or pipeline numbers attached to it.
* You have shipped and iterated website pages yourself, and you know how organic visibility works: site structure, technical SEO, schema, and how AI answer engines choose their sources.
* You have directed PR in\-house or through an agency, as long as you drove the output rather than approved it.
* You have owned events, sponsorships, roundtables or webinars, and you know what pipeline came out of them.
* Still hands\-on. If your last few months contain nothing you personally wrote, designed or built, this is not the right fit.
* Genuinely AI\-native. You have restructured a real workflow around AI rather than using it to draft copy, you have built prompt libraries or agents that other people use, and you have an opinion on where AI output is unacceptable.
* Strong written English. This role writes, edits and raises the standard of everything written.



  





  





  





**Why should you consider us seriously?** 




  





  





 We believe that long\-term, people over product and profits, prioritize culture over everything else. We are a well\-balanced team of experienced entrepreneurs and are backed by top investors across India and Silicon Valley (Chiratae Ventures, Blume Ventures, Abstract Ventures, Emergent Ventures; Senior execs at Google, Square, Genpact \& Flipkart; Co\-founders of Infosys, Snapdeal, Slideshare, Zomato, etc.)

title: Deputy General Manager Marketing
description:
**Job Summary:** 




 Lead and drive the overall marketing strategy for AEG, with accountability for brand growth, demand generation, student acquisition, marketing ROI and revenue contribution. Lead an integrated, data\-driven marketing ecosystem across brand, digital, performance, content, product marketing, partnerships and admissions.
 



  





**1\. Strategic Planning, Business Growth \& Leadership** 



* Develop and execute AEG’s comprehensive marketing strategy aligned with institutional goals, admissions and revenue objectives.
* Provide strategic direction to ensure marketing contributes to student acquisition, revenue growth, brand visibility and market expansion.
* Define annual, quarterly and monthly marketing priorities and forecasts for leads, applications, admissions, revenue and spend.
* Identify new geographies, audience segments, courses and demand\-generation opportunities.
* Lead, mentor and coach a high\-performing marketing team with clear objectives, accountability and continuous upskilling.



**2\. Brand Management, Reputation \& Communication** 



* Strengthen AEG’s brand identity and ensure consistent messaging across online and offline channels.
* Drive PR, corporate communication, reputation management and institutional storytelling.
* Oversee brand campaigns, creative direction and visual identity guidelines.
* Manage creative agencies, PR partners and media houses for quality, timelines and brand alignment.
* Monitor brand perception, market sentiment, reviews and competitor positioning.



**3\. Digital Marketing \& Marketing Technology** 



* Oversee SEO, SEM, website experience, landing pages, social media, email marketing and online community engagement.
* Develop platform\-specific strategies for Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook and emerging channels.
* Optimise website and landing pages for user experience, lead generation and conversion.
* Drive adoption of relevant AI, automation, analytics and MarTech solutions to improve productivity and efficiency.



**4\. Performance Marketing, Attribution \& ROI** 



* Plan, execute and optimise paid campaigns across Google, Meta, YouTube, affiliate and relevant platforms.
* Drive full\-funnel performance focused on qualified leads, CPL, CAC and conversion.
* Measure campaign performance and ROI; test new channels, creatives, landing pages, audiences and targeting.
* Establish end\-to\-end attribution: Campaign → Lead → Qualified Lead → Application → Admission → Revenue.
* Optimise budget towards the highest\-performing channels, campaigns, courses and geographies.



**5\. Lead Generation, Demand Creation \& Funnel Management** 



* Drive integrated campaigns to generate high\-quality leads and support student acquisition.
* Achieve performance and organic lead\-generation targets within approved budgets.
* Build multi\-channel funnels through digital campaigns, events, partnerships, outreach and collaborations.
* Implement lead nurturing through automation, retargeting, segmentation and personalised communication.
* Monitor lead quality and improve lead\-to\-application and application\-to\-admission conversion.
* Work closely with Sales/CRC to identify funnel leakage, improve follow\-up and increase conversion.



**6\. Marketing–Sales Alignment \& Revenue Contribution** 



* Establish regular Marketing–Sales/CRC reviews covering lead quality, funnel performance, conversion and revenue.
* Develop shared KPIs between Marketing and Sales/Admissions.
* Analyse rejection, non\-contact, drop\-off and non\-conversion reasons and implement corrective actions.
* Provide Sales/CRC with campaign insights, audience intelligence, product messaging and sales enablement.
* Track marketing\-sourced and marketing\-influenced admissions and revenue.



**7\. Product Marketing \& Go\-to\-Market** 



* Collaborate with Product, Academic, Sales and Business teams on value propositions and GTM strategies.
* Develop course\-wise positioning, target audience, messaging and campaign strategies.
* Lead marketing launches for new courses, programmes, campuses and major initiatives.
* Ensure priority/new programmes have structured GTM plans before launch.
* Benchmark competitor courses, pricing, positioning and promotional strategies.



**8\. Content, Social Media \& Community** 



* Lead content across blogs, newsletters, videos, brochures, landing pages, case studies and academic materials.
* Ensure content supports SEO, brand positioning, engagement and lead generation.
* Maintain a content calendar aligned with campaigns, events and admission cycles.
* Develop creator/influencer, alumni, referral and community\-led demand\-generation initiatives.
* Measure content by reach, engagement, traffic, leads and conversion.



**9\. Partnerships \& Alternate Demand Generation** 



* Develop strategic marketing partnerships with schools, colleges, corporates, institutions, communities, platforms and industry partners.
* Explore demand\-generation channels beyond paid digital advertising.
* Evaluate partnerships based on reach, qualified leads, admissions and business impact.



**10\. Student / Customer Insights \& Lifecycle Marketing** 



* Understand prospective\-student needs, preferences, motivations and barriers to enrolment.
* Analyse conversion and non\-conversion reasons and translate insights into marketing actions.
* Develop lifecycle communication across Enquiry → Application → Admission → Joining.
* Coordinate with Sales/Admissions for a consistent prospective\-student experience.



**11\. Events \& Experiential Marketing** 



* Align student\-related events with brand and marketing goals.
* Manage event creatives, promotion, timelines and post\-event reporting.
* Measure events through attendance, engagement, leads, applications, admissions and brand impact.
* Convert institutional events and experiences into ongoing content and demand\-generation assets.



**12\. Marketing Analytics, MIS \& Governance** 



* Establish a reliable dashboard covering spend, leads, qualified leads, CPL, CAC, applications, admissions, revenue, conversion, ROI/ROAS and channel/course performance.
* Ensure accurate campaign tracking, attribution and data governance.
* Present monthly and quarterly dashboards with actionable recommendations.
* Establish clear data ownership and reporting standards across Marketing and agencies.



**13\. Budget, Vendor \& ROI Management** 



* Prepare and manage the annual marketing budget across digital, performance, brand, events, partnerships and outreach.
* Monitor budget utilisation, variance and ROI.
* Establish agency/vendor scorecards and SLAs and conduct regular performance reviews.
* Reallocate budgets towards channels and initiatives delivering stronger business outcomes.



**14\. Team Leadership \& Capability Development** 



* Build a high\-performing marketing organisation with clear roles, accountability and measurable KRAs.
* Develop capability across performance, digital, content, brand, analytics, product marketing and emerging technologies.
* Establish performance reviews, coaching, development plans and succession planning.
* Foster ownership, innovation, experimentation and data\-driven decision\-making.



**Key Success Measures** 



* Marketing contribution to admissions and revenue
* Qualified lead generation and lead quality
* Lead\-to\-application and application\-to\-admission conversion
* Cost per qualified lead and cost per admission
* Marketing ROI / ROAS
* Brand visibility, reputation and engagement
* Organic traffic and digital growth
* Course\-wise campaign and GTM performance
* Marketing budget efficiency
* Agency/vendor performance
* Team productivity and capability development



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* MBA/PGDM in Marketing, Communications, Business Management or related discipline.
* Equivalent relevant qualifications and experience may be considered.
* Certification in Digital Marketing, Performance Marketing or Analytics is an advantage.



  





**Required Experience** 



* 8–12 years of overall Marketing experience.
* Preferably 3–5\+ years in a managerial/leadership role with responsibility for teams, budgets and business outcomes.
* Experience across brand, digital, performance, content and lead generation.
* Experience managing agencies, vendors and strategic partners.
* Experience working with Sales/Admissions/Business teams to drive conversion and revenue.
* Preferred background: Education, Higher Education, EdTech, Consumer Internet, Media/Entertainment, Lifestyle or other consumer\-facing businesses.



  





**Required Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strategic marketing planning, business and revenue orientation, market research and GTM.
* Team leadership, coaching, mentoring, delegation and performance management.
* Stakeholder management, influencing, collaboration and cross\-functional leadership.
* Agency/vendor management, negotiation and commercial management.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, funnel\-analysis, attribution and ROI skills.
* Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills.
* Creative thinking, brand storytelling and value\-proposition development.
* Data\-driven decision\-making and ability to translate insights into action.

* Ability to manage ambiguity, with excellent problem\-solving skills and strategic mindset to translate problems into project opportunities aligned with evolving business priorities.
* Excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels, with experience building win\-win relationships with cross\-functional teams.


**About The Job**
 As a Strategic Partner Development Manager, you'll open doors with potential partners, lead exploratory discussions and evaluate/develop business opportunities. You will lead cross\-functional teams, provide thought leadership and serve as a mentor to managers and associates. You are comfortable escalating and presenting business development strategies and key issues to senior management. You'll work closely with Google Product, Engineering, Legal and Sales teams on new product initiatives and key strategic relationships that support our online advertising business.
   

  

 This Strategic Partnerships Development Manager for Knowledge, and Information (K\&I) Partnerships will drive high\-impact initiatives across DeepMind, Google Research, and Tech and Society. Bridging the gap between cutting\-edge AI research and real\-world societal impact, you will lead critical ecosystem engagements to improve foundational models and public data infrastructure for billions of users. From scaling Indic language capabilities and AI accessibility programs to establishing factual public data infrastructure via Data Commons, this role is critical to ensuring our frontier AI models are highly capable, and localized for the APAC region. You will have the ability to design and manage scaled partnership ecosystems and advance research strategies across complex organizations (Deep Mind (DM), Research, Tech and Society). You will have experience engaging with a set of partners, including the academic institutes (e.g., IISc, AI4Bharat), government ministries, and NGOs. You will have passion for AI accessibility and societal impact, operating comfortably in ambiguity to drive "first\-of\-its\-kind" partnerships in frontier language data collection and model bench marking . You will also have exceptional cross\-functional collaboration and operational excellence, managing multiple complex funding streams, data licensing extensions, and Go\-To\-Market strategies simultaneously.
   

  

 The Global Partnerships organization is responsible for exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Google’s Global Partnerships team works with a wide range of partners to bring the best of Google to power their business. The Global Partnerships team supports Google’s own Product teams with essential partnerships to help Google’s user experiences in advertising, Search, Assistant, Maps, Travel, Shopping, Payments and more. Teams create product\-enabling partnerships, go\-to\-market strategies and incubate business growth for a variety of products.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Support languages data and partnerships for Google Research to improve multi\-linguality affecting \~1\.5B users. Drive critical programs such as Vaani phase 3 for Indic data generation with IISc, manage DM agreement extensions for data acquisition, and support strategic Go\-To\-Market partnerships like the 1800\-Gemini rollout.
* Lead the expansion of Data Commons (DC) in APAC, with a primary focus on India. Work closely with government and institutional partners to build example state\-level implementations and influence standard data formats. Explore DC Model Context Protocol (MCP) server usage with market players like Sarvam to ground external LLMs on factual Data Commons data.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Investment Specialist
description:
**About the Opportunity**
=========================


Job Type: Permanent
Application Deadline: 20 September 2026**Purpose of your role**


The individual will act as an agent for growth of the Systematic Investment business (primarily focussing on Systematic Fixed Income), remain focused on efficiency and profitability and ensure excellence of client service. As a key member of a growing team, the successful candidate will be able to influence how the Systematic proposition evolves to meet client needs. Accordingly, having an entrepreneurial approach which is open to changing how we do things to better support our clients is key to success in this role.

* The individual will join Systematic Investment Group, supporting client\-facing and product activity for Fidelity’s global distribution business. The individual will work closely with the Systematic Investment Group Investment Directors and Investment Specialists liaise with the Portfolio Managers and the global sales force.
* Responsibilities include the production of a wide range of written material to support client engagement. This includes pitch books and product presentations, reporting materials, marketing and training collateral, editorial content and thought leadership, RFP/RFI submissions, competitor analysis and responses to client queries.
* Collaboration with Investment Directors to design, create and enhance collateral to articulate Fidelity’s capabilities \- both on existing investment strategies as well as evolving disciplines.


The individual’s specific responsibilities will include:

* Production of presentation materials, including pitch books and client updates and working with teams globally for onboarding new clients and mandates.
* Working with Fidelity’s internal distribution teams to support their knowledge and promotion of Fidelity Systematic Investment portfolios and broader investment capabilities.
* RFP/RFI support, articulating Fidelity Systematic Investment Group’s investment process and disciplines (both broadly and for specific portfolios.)
* Query resolution, specifically ensuring that ad hoc fund and strategy queries from clients/sales force are answered quickly and accurately, to be done in concert with global team.
* Working with the India\-based Investment Fund Analysts to support regular standard fund reporting requirements.
* As required, cover regular reporting, working with others in the team to analyse performance, attribution and positioning data and articulate investment messages to clients and distribution teams.
* Liaising with colleagues globally to share information and best practice and to help provide information to clients in a range of formats, including written material, internal briefing or training, and participating in client calls or meetings as appropriate.

**Experience and Qualifications Required**

* A client and service focused mindset.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, preferably with experience of working in a large team, and engagement with stakeholders.
* Graduate or higher qualification with significant experience finance industry experience in Systematic fixed income. Some Systematic Equity/Quant experience would be an added advantage.
* Experience in investment writing and content production (in a variety of formats.)
* Broad knowledge of wholesale and institutional client types.
* Excellent capability with Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
* Familiarity with financial data \- using Thomson Reuters Datastream, Bloomberg, Eikon and or other third party systems.
* Strong data and analytical skills.

**Desired experience and qualifications**


The core skillsets required for this role are strong commendation skills, an entrepreneurial approach and going the extra mile for clients. However, the following experience and qualifications are also desirable:

* Post graduate qualification in finance or related field.
* Experience range between 5 to 10 years
* Context, understanding of the systematic and quantitative analysis and investment process and its drivers, coupled with a knack and knowledge of various quantitative investment models.
* Knowledge of key institutional client types and their requirements (e.g. insurance, banking and pensions.)
* A grounding in portfolio theory and investment concepts.


While not a pre\-requisite for the role, any additional technical expertise which could assist in the automation of regular tasks is a plus. This could include:

* Basic knowledge of VBA, Python or other programming language.

**Feel rewarded**


For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

Professional in documentation

As Category Manager, Motorola India, you will own the end\-to\-end success of the smartphone portfolio across strategy, P\&L, product lifecycle and market execution. Reporting to the Managing Director, Motorola India, you will serve as the single point of accountability for franchise growth, acting as the bridge between Global Product Portfolio, Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, Finance, Supply Chain and channel partners to maximize revenue, profitability and market share.

**Strategy \& P\&L Ownership**

* Own franchise\-level P\&L, revenue, margin, market share and business performance.
* Define category strategy, growth priorities and investment choices aligned to Motorola India's long\-term ambitions.
* Define the right product at the right price point for India – work closely with the Global Product team to define the same and ensure the same is coming to India at the right time to market
* Drive short\-term and long\-term business planning to deliver volume, profitability and premiumization goals.
* Build and lead a high\-performing category organization with clear franchise ownership and accountability.

* Own the complete product lifecycle from portfolio planning and launch to in\-market management, transition and end\-of\-life.
* Partner with Global Product Portfolio teams to shape India product strategy, close portfolio gaps and localize market requirements.
* Drive portfolio optimization, lifecycle decisions and transition planning to maximize sell\-through and profitability.

**Demand Planning \& Launch Excellence**

* Lead demand planning and forecast alignment with Sales, Partners, Supply Chain, Sales Operations \& Planning, Finance and Global teams.
* Own commercial readiness for all launches, including pricing, channel strategy, inventory, affordability programs and go\-to\-market execution.
* Drive launch governance, post\-launch reviews and rapid course correction to ensure business targets are achieved.
* Ensure disciplined investment deployment while maximizing sell\-in, sell\-out and return on investment.

**Consumer \& Market Leadership**

* Own category insights across consumers, competitors, channels and market trends.
* Translate market intelligence into portfolio, pricing, positioning and go\-to\-market decisions.
* Anticipate competitive moves and lead response strategies to protect and grow market share.
* Partner with Marketing to deliver differentiated consumer propositions and consistent brand experience across channels.

**Cross\-Functional Leadership**

* Act as the business owner and decision integrator across Product, Marketing, Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Service and external partners.
* Drive alignment and execution across stakeholders, balancing growth, profitability, inventory and customer experience.
* Influence regional and global stakeholders to secure resources, products and strategic support for India.
* Build strong partner relationships to enhance category performance, distribution effectiveness and launch quality.

**Performance Management**

* Define and track key business metrics including revenue, market share, margin, inventory health, sell\-in, sell\-out and launch success.
* Lead regular business reviews and drive corrective actions against performance gaps.
* Leverage analytics and scenario planning to improve forecast accuracy, portfolio productivity and investment effectiveness.

title: Chief Executive Officer
description:
**The Group**
 Generac is a total energy solutions company that empowers people to use energy on their own terms. Founded in 1959, Generac is a leading global designer, manufacturer, and provider of a wide range of energy technology solutions. The Company provides power generation equipment (i.e. diesel and gas generator), energy storage systems, energy management devices and solutions, and other power products serving the residential, light commercial, data \& telecom, and industrial markets.
   

  

 Generac is a global company with approximately USD 4\.4 billion in annual revenues and direct subsidiaries in more than 18 countries worldwide. The Company continues to expand its energy technology offerings in pursuit of its mission to Power a Smarter World and to lead the evolution toward more resilient, efficient, and sustainable energy solutions.
   

  

 In India, Generac entered the market in 2019 through the acquisition of Captiva Energy Solutions, a bespoke generator manufacturer. Since then, significant investments have been made to scale operations and fully integrate the business into Generac’s global platform. The local headquarters and manufacturing facility are based in Kolkata, supported by regional and remote offices across India. Generac has ambitious growth plans for India, positioning the country as a strategic market within its global footprint.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 This is a high\-impact, commercially driven leadership role reporting to the Board of Directors. The selected candidate will have full responsibility for defining and executing Generac’s strategy in India and for driving business development, managing sales operations, overseeing manufacturing, project and service operations, and delivering the overall financial performance of the legal entity.
   

  

 The role requires strong commercial leadership, operational excellence, and the ability to build a scalable and sustainable organization aligned with Generac’s global standards and values. A key objective will be to elevate the manufacturing operation to full global quality standards, enabling the factory to support exports to other Generac subsidiaries worldwide.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define and execute the commercial and growth strategy for India, with a strong focus on market expansion, customer acquisition, and long\-term value creation.
* Lead the local sales organization and channel network, including key partnerships with distributors, strategic customers, and industry influencers.
* Provide leadership oversight of manufacturing, project execution, and service operations, ensuring alignment between market demand, production planning, and delivery performance.
* Manage full P\&L responsibility across sales, service, and production operations, including budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and cash management.
* Work cross\-functionally with R\&D, supply chain, quality, and engineering teams to align production capabilities, product offerings, and innovation with market demand and sales objectives.
* Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence across all aspects of the business, with a focus on efficiency, quality, safety, and scalability.
* Build, lead, and develop high\-performing teams, fostering a strong performance culture aligned with Generac’s values and long\-term objectives.
* Act as the primary interface with the Board of Directors and Generac global leadership, providing clear visibility on performance, risks, opportunities, and strategic initiatives.


**Qualifications \& Requirements**
* Proven experience in business development, sales management, and operational leadership within an industrial or manufacturing environment.
* Experience in technology\-driven capital equipment businesses (such as diesel generators, HVAC, or commercial and industrial pumps); strong knowledge of the power generation industry is a plus.
* Solid understanding of manufacturing processes, quality systems, regulatory compliance, and operational best practices.
* Demonstrated success in managing full P\&L responsibility and building high\-performing, cross\-functional teams.
* Strategic vision combined with an entrepreneurial mindset and strong interpersonal and communication skills.
* Degree in Engineering, Industrial Management, or a related field; an advanced degree is a plus.
* Ability to operate effectively in a high\-pace, dynamic environment.

Position: On Ground Operations and Marketing manager
   

  

 Location: Bengaluru

 Experience Required: 2\-5 years
   

  

 On Ground Operations \& Marketing Manager
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 Our client is looking for an On Ground Operations \& Marketing Manager to own how they shows up in the real world.
   

  

 You’ll sit at the intersection of on\-ground marketing and operations, figuring out how the activations can stand out while ensuring they are executed smoothly, efficiently and at scale.
   

  

 You’ll own the process end to end, from developing the activation approach and identifying the right partners to coordinating the on\-ground workforce, agencies and vendors, managing execution and measuring outcomes.
   

  

 You won’t necessarily be on ground for every activation. Your job is to build the plan, get the right people in place, manage execution and make sure it gets done well.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Plan and execute BTL, on\-ground and consumer\-facing activations
* Develop ideas and formats that make our client’s on\-ground presence stand out
* Build execution plans, briefs, timelines, budgets and SOPs
* Coordinate and manage the student workforce executing activities on ground
* Manage vendors, agencies, promoters and external execution partners
* Identify the right locations, formats and partners for different activations
* Own activations end to end, from planning and coordination to execution and post\-campaign analysis
* Track reach, costs, leads, conversions and other relevant metrics
* Build processes that make on\-ground execution repeatable and scalable across locations
* Work with Category, Product and Marketing teams to take new consumer categories into the market
* Review what worked, what didn’t and continuously improve future activations
* Work closely with founders to test new ideas and build the consumer side of our client


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

* 2\-5 years of experience in On\-Ground Marketing, BTL, Field Marketing, Activations, Marketing Operations or a similar role
* Strong experience planning and executing on\-ground campaigns and activations
* Experience managing vendors, agencies, promoters or distributed on\-ground teams
* Strong project and stakeholder management skills
* Good understanding of BTL marketing, activations and local marketing
* Ability to take an idea and turn it into a practical execution plan
* Strong organisational and problem\-solving skills
* Comfortable managing multiple activations, partners and timelines
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving, ambiguous environment


 This Role Is For You If
   

  

 You enjoy turning ideas into things that actually happen while caring about both sides of the job: how an activation looks and feels, and whether it was executed properly.
   

  

 You can manage a vendor, coordinate a workforce, fix an execution issue and still think about how the next activation can be better.
   

  

 You’re resourceful, organised and comfortable building processes where there isn’t a playbook yet.
   

  

 Most importantly, you take ownership from start to end.
   

  

 Ready to make an impact?

title: Sr. Growth Marketing Manager
description:
**Role\- Head of Field Operations** 




**Location\- Based in Hyderabad; multi\-state travel across all nine states** 




**Reporting To\- Senior Leadership (Founders / CEO / COO)** 




**Experience\- 10\+ years overall; 2\+ years running a multi\-state, multi\-tier field org (150\+ people)** 




**Language\-No single language required; multi\-language comfort important (South India \+ Hindi belt)** 




**Notice Period\- 30\-60 days** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 Own the field organization end to end, raise productivity per head as it grows, and build the systems that let it scale without losing quality or integrity. This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's — you will still be in the field, personally.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities** 




**The Number** 
 — Convert marketing demand into admissions against a seasonal curve; own the field's contribution to the 9\-state admissions target.
 



**Coverage \& Capacity** 
 — Territory design, headcount allocation, beat/visit planning; own the capacity model showing whether the team can mathematically hit target.
 



**Productivity Per Head** 
 — Raise admissions per SRO as the team grows, not just by adding headcount — the outcome that matters most.
 



**People at Scale** 
 — Hiring engine, ramp\-to\-productivity, performance management across four tiers, the SRO → ABH promotion ladder, and hard calls on the bottom decile.
 



**Rhythm \& Systems** 
 — Daily huddles, weekly/monthly reviews, counselling\-season war rooms; visit SOPs, follow\-up cadence, lead routing, SLAs, and the performance dictionary.
 



**Cost Management** 
 — Field cost per admission, travel/expense governance, incentive design that drives the right behaviour.
 



**Data \& Integrity** 
 — CRM/app adoption, data hygiene, visit audits; zero tolerance for fabricated data or over\-promising to families.
 



  





**Key Outcomes Expected** 




 Hit the field's share of the 9\-state admissions target on a seasonal curve, not a year\-end scramble.
 



 Show a rising admissions\-per\-SRO trend as the team scales, not headcount\-driven growth alone.
 



 Stand up a working capacity model and a functioning SRO → ABH hiring/ramp/promotion pipeline.
 



 Establish the full review rhythm and SOPs, and get CRM/data hygiene to a standard where audits catch issues early.
 



  





**Must\-Have Candidate Profile** 




 Screened on what you've run, not on years:
 



 Owned 150\+ field people across multiple states and languages (not a single\-city team).
 



 Managed at least two layers of leadership below you (manager of managers), across a four\-tier structure.
 



 Run a consultative, high\-consideration sale — insurance, education, lending, healthcare, real estate — not a fast transactional product.
 



 Planned capacity for a compressed peak season (March/exam/harvest\-type) and managed the trough after.
 



 Fluent in field economics — cost per visit, productivity per head, cost per acquisition — without prompting.
 



 Built a hiring engine: 50\+ field hires in a year, with a view on ramp time and early attrition.
 



 Caught data fabrication or mis\-selling in your own team and acted on it.
 



 Still in the field — leads from the ground, not the dashboard.
 



 10\+ years overall, incl. 2\+ years running a multi\-state, multi\-tier field org of this scale.
 



 Strong pluses: exposure across South India and the Hindi belt; experience making a CRM/field\-app rollout stick against field resistance; a track record of building or rebuilding a field system rather than inheriting one.
 



  





**Preferred Industry Background** 




 Edtech experience not required. Strong candidates are just as likely to come from insurance agency channels, gold\-loan/microfinance branch networks, coaching chains, or BFSI direct sales.
 



  





**What We Offer**

description:
Are you a passionate and enthusiastic quality assurance professional looking to build your career in Salesforce testing and enterprise cloud solutions?
 



 Join LevelShift as a Test Engineer – Salesforce Projects, where you'll ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of Salesforce implementations that drive business transformation. description:
**Role summary** 




 You will take independent, end\-to\-end ownership of an assigned portfolio of Amber Group brand websites, planning and executing their SEO strategies, running technical SEO, driving content and link\-building programs, optimizing for AI answer engines, and reporting results per brand. You will work under the SEO Lead's group strategy, coordinate with developers and designers, and support website migrations. This role owns projects, it does not just support them.
 



**Key responsibilities** 



* Own end\-to\-end monthly SEO for an assigned portfolio of brand websites; develop and execute each site's SEO strategy independently.
* Keyword research, content calendars and content briefs.

* Technical SEO: full site audits (Screaming Frog / Semrush), Search Console error resolution, indexation, redirects, canonical structure and Core Web Vitals monitoring, coordinating fixes with the development team.
* SEO ownership of website migrations and new launches: crawl baselines, redirect mapping, metadata parity and post\-launch monitoring.
* AI\-search optimization (GEO/AEO/AIO): answer\-first content structure, FAQ and schema strategy, AI\-crawler access (robots.txt, llms.txt), and AI\-visibility tracking across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews.
* Off\-page strategy: quality link prospecting, outreach and guest\-post placements.
* Monthly per\-brand reporting: rankings, organic traffic, indexation health, competitor benchmarking and a concrete action plan.



**Required skills \& experience** 



* 1–5 years of hands\-on SEO with demonstrable ranking/traffic results.
* Strong, provable daily use of Google Search Console, GA4 and Semrush; Screaming Frog proficiency.
* Technical SEO depth: redirects, canonicals, indexation control, Core Web Vitals, structured data.
* Experience supporting at least one website migration or major relaunch (preferred).
* Working knowledge of AI\-search optimization: AI crawlers, GEO/AEO concepts, and practical use of AI tools in SEO workflows.
* Proven quality link\-building experience, able to distinguish links that help from links that harm.
* Ability to manage multiple website projects independently and communicate clearly with developers, designers.



**Nice to have** 



* HTML/CSS basics; exposure to modern frameworks (Next.js).
* Local SEO / Google Business Profile experience.



**What you get** 




 Genuine ownership of a multi\-brand portfolio, direct involvement in Next.js migrations and AI\-search programs, and visibility of your results at management level every month.

MongoDB is rapidly expanding its Strategic Account Marketing efforts to drive significant business growth with our highest\-value Global accounts. We are seeking an innovative and collaborative Sr Marketing Manager to execute key programs in India for select strategic accounts, coordinating across Global account plans with peers in EMEA and AMER



In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for developing and executing 1:1 and 1:few Strategic Account Marketing plans to accelerate growth in our most important accounts that have a large developer and technical team presence in India. You will be a highly strategic, results\-driven professional with a passion for marketing and a direct impact on our developer mindshare, upmarket initiatives, and revenue goals.



This position will report to the Head of India Marketing, although will work very closely with with EMEA and AMER Strategic Account Marketing leaders, and the larger APJ marketing team.



We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.


### **Primary Responsibilities:**


* Develop and execute strategic marketing programs for select Global accounts with developer arms in India. Work closely with account teams to uncover account\-specific challenges, understand decision\-making processes, and identify key personas, to drive the creation and execution of tailored marketing strategies and messaging that address the unique needs and interests of each account, unlock senior leadership and buying team engagement, and lead to growth opportunities. You'll work closely with the strategic account marketing leads, developer advocacy teams, sales teams and customers to ensure delivery of a holistic DevRel Marketing program within each account.
* Bring the marketing expertise: Act as a strategic marketing consultant to sales teams and clients, recommending tailored programs and tactics that align with both sales objectives and client needs.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams: Work closely with cross\-functional teams like field marketing, partner marketing, customer marketing, demand generation and developer advocacy teams to ensure delivery of a holistic marketing strategy within each account that incorporates cross functional programs into 1:1 Strategic Account Marketing plans.
* GTM alignment: Work closely with the sales team to align marketing efforts with sales goals, provide sales enablement resources, ensure smooth handoff of qualified leads, and communicate and educate the sales team regarding new and planned marketing activities including global, regional, and account specific programs.
* Measure impact \& optimize: Track performance metrics and ROI, ensuring processes are in place to evaluate the effectiveness of your programs, and apply insights to refine and optimize ABM campaigns for maximum impact.

### **We're looking for someone with:**


* Educational and Professional Background:
* + Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience.
	+ 12\+ years of account marketing, field marketing, industry marketing or sales experience in the Tech area.
	+ Experience working with large and complex Global enterprise accounts across multiple verticals including: FSI, Manufacturing, Automotive Retail, and others, with a proven success record in planning and executing effective marketing programs
* Skills and Expertise:
* + Experience with strategic 1:1 or 1:few account\-based marketing, leveraging multi\-channel tactics across digital and F2F.
	+ Experience working with cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), ISV, AI, and other tech partners.
	+ Incredible written and oral communication skills, including experience presenting to sales and marketing leadership, as well as customers.
	+ Impeccable event and project management skills, ensuring seamless planning, coordination, and delivery of initiatives with an ability to problem\-solve quickly.
	+ Results\-oriented and analytically skilled, capable of interpreting data, making informed data\-driven decisions, and reporting insights to the business.
	+ AI\-savvy with strong desire to understand and learn how AI tools and processes can be used in daily work.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration:
* + Experience working cross\-functionally with enterprise or corporate sales, customer success teams, and account development teams, obsessing over addressable market and specific account goals.
	+ Capable of establishing credibility with sales partners to effectively convey marketing value propositions and key messages.
* Technical Proficiency:
* + Proficiency with Google Workspace and Salesforce, and marketing technology tools like 6sense, Eloqua, Pathfactory, Sigma, Tableau.
* Attributes and Work Style:
* + Must be a highly self\-motivated, entrepreneurial professional who can excel in an autonomous work environment and proactively drive initiatives.
	+ Ability to leverage data to inform decisions and strategic plans.
	+ Bring a strategic and creative mindset to the team, collaborating effectively to generate new ideas.
	+ Growth mindset and results\-oriented
	+ Team ethos is made up of good humor, a positive can\-do attitude, yet high standards and focused on impact.
	+ Time management, prioritization, and organizational skills are key.
* Additional Requirements:
* + Proven experience working with Global teams and key APAC markets, including India, Vietnam, Thailand, and China.
	+ Travel as required.

#### **Success Measures:**



The Strategic Accounts Marketing Programs Manager will be successful in this role when they can execute the following strategic tasks/responsibilities:


* In 3 months you'll have fostered a relationship with your Sales Account teams (ex: sales, solution architects, field partner leads, customer success) to understand their account priorities, begin planning marketing programs, and ramp on current account status and MongoDB product knowledge.
* In 6 months you'll have a clear understanding of your key objectives, have executed marketing activities with pipeline influence, and have started to become a trusted partner to your account stakeholders.
* In 12 months you'll have cemented yourself as a key account partner, be fully ramped and actioning against all account objectives.

  


### **About MongoDB**



MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. **Job Type:** Full\-time, In\-office  
**Experience:** 0\-2 years

About SkillUpExchange

SkillUpExchange is building a new technology publishing and learning company. We work with experienced technology professionals and developers to create high\-quality technical books, courses, audiobooks, and other learning products.

We are an early\-stage company, so you will not simply execute an existing marketing plan. You will help us build our community, distribution channels, partnerships, and marketing processes from the ground up.

About the Role

We are looking for a **Marketing \& Community Associate** who enjoys researching people, starting conversations, building relationships, and learning about technology.

A significant part of this role involves identifying relevant developers and technology professionals on LinkedIn, researching their backgrounds and interests, reaching out to them with personalized messages, and developing those relationships over time.

You will also support our authors with social media content, build partnerships with technology newsletters and creators, and maintain our growing community database.

You do not need to be a software developer. You do need to be curious about technology, comfortable communicating with professionals, and willing to learn.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Technology Community Outreach**

* Identify relevant developers, engineers, technology professionals, technical leaders, and technology enthusiasts on LinkedIn.
* Research prospects and understand their interests before reaching out.
* Conduct personalized outreach and appropriate follow\-ups.
* Build genuine, long\-term relationships rather than treating outreach as one\-time communication.
* Invite relevant professionals to become early readers, community members, or participants in our learning programs.
* Build relationships with approximately 40 relevant professionals per working day.

**2\. Community \& CRM Management**

* Maintain our relationship database in Zoho Bigin.
* Track contacts, roles, companies, technology interests, conversations, responses, follow\-ups, and opportunities.
* Track early\-reader participation, learning interests, partnership opportunities, and potential future authors or instructors.
* Keep the database organized and ensure follow\-ups happen consistently.

**3\. Author \& Social Media Support**

* Work with authors to create LinkedIn content ideas and posts.
* Prepare approximately 2 posts per week for each active author.
* Coordinate content calendars and publishing schedules.
* Help authors turn their technical expertise, books, and ideas into useful social content.
* Support content creation for SkillUpExchange, AuthPlat, and the founder's LinkedIn presence.

**4\. Partnerships**

* Research technology newsletters, YouTubers, podcasts, bloggers, developer communities, educators, and online publications.
* Build prospect lists and initiate conversations with potential partners.
* Track partnerships from initial contact through to collaboration or publication.

**5\. Measure, Learn \& Improve**

* Track the journey from people identified → contacted → connected → responded → interested → engaged → community members → customers/participants.
* Analyze what outreach and distribution approaches are working.
* Help improve our processes based on results and feedback.

What We're Looking For

* Strong written and spoken English.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Curious about technology and willing to learn technical concepts.
* Comfortable researching people and understanding what they do.
* Comfortable using LinkedIn and online communities.
* Strong organization and follow\-up skills.
* Persistent without being pushy.
* Comfortable working with targets and measurable goals.
* Comfortable learning AI tools, CRM software, and other new technologies.
* Self\-motivated and willing to take ownership in an early\-stage environment.

Who Can Apply?

This role can be a strong fit for:

* Fresh graduates and candidates with up to 2 years of experience.
* Candidates from engineering, computer science, technology, marketing, communications, or related backgrounds.
* People active in technology communities, college tech clubs, or online communities.
* Candidates interested in marketing, community building, developer relations, technology publishing, or technology businesses.
* People who genuinely enjoy meeting new people and starting conversations.

**You do NOT need:**

* Prior publishing experience.
* A marketing degree.
* Previous Developer Relations experience.
* To be a software developer.
* An MBA.
* Experience at a large technology company.

We care more about your curiosity, communication skills, initiative, and ability to build relationships than your degree or previous job title.

What Success Looks Like

In your first few months, you will help build a growing network of relevant technology professionals and contribute to:

* Developer and technology professional community growth.
* Early\-reader participation for our books.
* Genuine reader reviews and feedback.
* Author and company LinkedIn visibility.
* Newsletter, creator, and community partnerships.
* Growth and quality of our CRM database.
* A repeatable process for finding and engaging the right audience for our books and learning products.

Compensation

**₹25,000/month fixed salary \+ performance bonus of up to ₹35,000 per quarter.**

Performance will be based on agreed distribution and community\-building objectives, including both results and quality of execution. Spam, irrelevant outreach, misleading communication, or attempts to manipulate reviews will not qualify as successful performance.

Work Schedule

* Monday\-Friday: Office
* 1st, 3rd and 5th Saturday: Working
* 2nd and 4th Saturday: Off
* Up to 2 WFH days per month

Why Join SkillUpExchange?

You will join at an early stage and have the opportunity to help build our technology community and distribution engine from scratch.

You will gain exposure to:

* Technology marketing
* Community building
* Developer relations
* LinkedIn and social media
* Partnerships
* CRM and relationship management
* AI\-assisted research and marketing
* Technology publishing
* Distribution and growth

As the company grows, this role can develop into broader responsibilities across Developer Relations, Community, Developer Programs, Technology Publishing, and Author/Content Acquisition.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume along with a short note explaining why you think you would be good at building relationships with technology professionals.

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a practical exercise involving finding relevant technology professionals for a technical book, explaining why they are relevant, writing an introductory LinkedIn message, and explaining how they would build a relationship with someone who responds.

We care more about how you think and communicate than having the perfect resume.

Pay: ₹300,000\.00 \- ₹440,000\.00 per year

We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented **Business Development Manager** with 5–8 years of experience in the **tour and travel industry**. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing new business opportunities, building strong client relationships, generating revenue, and expanding the company’s customer base.

The candidate should have strong knowledge of the travel industry, excellent communication and negotiation skills, and a proven track record in business development and sales.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and develop new business opportunities in the travel and tourism sector.
* Generate leads through networking, referrals, cold calling, online channels, industry connections, and other business development activities.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with corporate clients, travel agents, B2B partners, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Understand client travel requirements and coordinate with the operations/team to provide suitable travel solutions.
* Prepare and present travel proposals, packages, quotations, and commercial terms to clients.
* Negotiate pricing and close deals while maintaining healthy margins for the company.
* Achieve monthly and annual sales/revenue targets.
* Develop new B2B and B2C business channels as required.
* Explore opportunities for corporate travel, group tours, leisure travel, domestic/international packages, MICE, and other travel segments.
* Maintain regular follow\-ups with prospective and existing clients.
* Track leads, sales pipeline, conversions, and revenue through CRM/MIS.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, customer preferences, and emerging travel opportunities.
* Work closely with Sales, Operations, Reservations, Finance, and other internal teams to ensure smooth execution of bookings.
* Handle client escalations and ensure a high level of customer satisfaction.
* Attend industry events, travel exhibitions, networking events, and client meetings for business development.
* Develop and implement strategies to increase repeat business and referrals.
* Prepare regular business development and sales performance reports for management.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Tourism, Travel Management, Marketing, or a related field.
* **5–8 years of relevant experience in the tour \& travel industry.**
* Proven experience in business development, sales, or corporate/B2B travel sales.
* Strong existing network within the travel industry will be an added advantage.
* Good understanding of travel products, tour packages, destinations, hotels, and travel services.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-management skills.
* Target\-oriented with strong business acumen.
* Ability to generate leads independently and convert them into business.
* Strong follow\-up and client\-handling skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office and CRM/sales tracking tools.
* Willingness to travel for client meetings, business development, and industry events when required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* New business generated
* Monthly/annual revenue achieved
* Lead\-to\-client conversion rate
* Number of new corporate/B2B accounts
* Client retention and repeat business
* Gross margin/profitability
* Sales pipeline value
* Collection/payment follow\-up
* Business partnerships developed

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate should be **well\-connected within the travel industry, commercially driven, confident in client interactions, and capable of independently generating and closing business opportunities.** Experience in B2B travel sales, corporate travel, group tours, or travel partnerships would be highly valuable.

Pay: ₹700,000\.00 \- ₹1,000,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Developer Marketing Manager, Developer Marketing
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Marketing Manager to join the Developer Marketing Team. Our innovative and dynamic organization is responsible for helping to grow our brand presence within the developer community. In this role, you will lead the planning, execution, and optimization of paid media and marketing campaigns.  

  

A successful candidate has a strong background in paid media, campaign management, and performance marketing. As a marketing manager on the Developer team, you have a passion for building communities, driving engagement, and amplifying brand voice. You will play a pivotal role in developing and executing strategies that connect with developer audiences, foster loyalty, and deliver measurable results.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Develop and implement overall marketing strategies aligned with business objectives
* Plan, manage, and optimize marketing campaigns
* Analyze and monitor campaign performance and adjust strategies as needed
* Ensure consistent messaging across all assets

  

About the team  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7\+ years of developing and managing acquisition marketing or channel programs experience
* Experience communicating results to stakeholders
* Experience developing and executing campaigns across a multitude of timezones and languages
* Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
* Experience executing scaled marketing campaigns through email or social media

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross\-functional teams and agency partners
* Experience designing and executing joint marketing plans with strategic alliance partners with global footprint

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Assistant - Digital Project Management, Digital Marketing
description:
**Introduction**  


Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.
  

**Overview**  

The Assistant Digital Project Manager is an integral part of The Marketing Studio, Gallagher’s in\-house agency. responsible for managing the intake, resourcing, routing, and prioritization of requests across our marketing divisions. This position partners closely with Account Management, Project Management, divisional stakeholders, and internal team members to ensure work is properly scoped, resourced, and tracked from submission through completion.  

With a strong background in traffic management and project coordination, this role supports the efficient flow of work through the Web team by reviewing incoming requests, validating readiness criteria and required information to begin work, aligning expectations with Project Managers, and directing tasks to the appropriate resources. This position is essential to maintain organized workflows, supporting SLA and quality delivery adherence, and ensuring work progresses smoothly and on time.  


  

**How you'll make an impact** **Responsibilities**:  

* Manages traffic flow of new and in\-flight web, SEO and Google Ads support requests across all divisions supported by the Marketing Org at Gallagher and facilitates subject\-matter expertise to ensure the right people are involved at the right times.
* Reviews incoming Marketing Studio web requests for readiness, validates required information is included and appropriate to complete the request, proactively works with Account Services team to ensure clarity before work is assigned and provides proactive solutions to meet delivery timing and quality expectations.
* Validates web content, documentation, images, graphics and interactive content is provided during intake to ensure adherence to web specs and capabilities, validating project readiness.
* Collaborates with internal Marketing Studio teams to ensure a clear understanding of project requirements, timelines or constraints, resource capacity, and deliverables, while ensuring adherence to established processes, project data standards, and reporting requirements to support the timely delivery of website updates, enhancements, and digital initiatives.
* Prioritizes, resources and routes requests appropriately based on scope, urgency, team capacity, and established delivery schedules.
* Proactively communicates with Account Services team to mitigate project timing risks and reset expectations if needed, as well as managing available resources as required to meet or revise timelines.
* Monitors active requests and task flow to ensure predecessor and successor tasks are properly sequenced, resourced and projects remain on track.
* Identifies opportunities to improve traffic management and resourcing processes and workflow efficiency while continuing to meet or exceed internal SLAs.
* Coordinates across time zones as needed to support timely request handling and project movement.

  


  

**About you** **Qualifications**:  

* Bachelor’s degree required, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 5\+ years of project or traffic management experience, including at least 3 years supporting web functions on marketing projects.
* Experience with Adobe Workfront is required.
* Strong understanding of traffic and project management, intake and resource coordination, and delivery prioritization.
* Solid understanding of integrated campaigns and digital projects.
* Proven ability to work collaboratively across teams and levels of the organization.
* Detail\-oriented, self\-motivated team player with a proactive, solution\-oriented mindset.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and drive results in a fast\-paced environment.
* Fluency in English with strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.

**Preferred Skills:*** Experience working in a deadline\-driven environment with shifting priorities.
* Strong relationship\-building skills with internal stakeholders and divisional partners.

  


  

**Additional Information**  

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well\-being
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
* A collaborative, people\-first culture with accessible leadership
* The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact

**At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.*Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

title: Marketing Ops, PMO
description:
**The Company**


PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.


We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.


We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.


Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.


**Job Summary:**


This job serves as a thought partner, identifying issues and recommending best practices to enhance marketing effectiveness. Responsibilities include leading functional projects, analyzing business trends, and developing marketing plans that support organizational goals. The position requires effective project management to ensure the smooth operation of marketing functions and drive business improvements.
**Job Description:**


**Essential Responsibilities:**

  
* Identify issues and recommend best practices to enhance marketing effectiveness.
  

  
* Lead functional projects and programs that drive business improvements.
  

  
* Collaborate with teams to analyze business trends and inform marketing strategies.
  

  
* Develop and manage marketing plans that support organizational goals.
  

  
* Ensure the efficient operation of marketing functions through effective project management.
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

  

  
* 5\+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
  

  

**Additional Responsibilities \& Preferred Qualifications****:**


* Deep expertise with Adobe marketing technologies, particularly AEP, AJO and Adobe Target.
* Strong experience with owned\-channel operations across email, push, in\-app and onsite communications.
* Experience with CRM operations, omnichannel campaign execution, customer contact strategies and marketing governance.
* Strong knowledge of media and channel operations, including regulatory controls and campaign compliance.
* Experience with web and app instrumentation, customer\-behavior tracking, decisioning frameworks and performance insights.
* Strong operational data\-analysis skills with the ability to identify opportunities to optimize campaigns, channels and platforms.
* Experience training, onboarding and developing marketing\-team capabilities.
* People leadership or team management experience is preferred.
* Experience with PayPal platforms and tools such as OMT, PFS, LEAP, Rewards Point/Incentives, Picasso, RPS, Dropzone, ELMO and Personalization Studio is preferred.
* Familiarity with instrumentation and diagnostic capabilities including FPTI events and CAL logs is preferred.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities.
* Strong end\-to\-end problem\-solving and troubleshooting capabilities across marketing operations, platforms and channels.

**Additional Responsibilities**


* Lead execution of marketing campaigns across product and owned channels, driving timely, accurate and compliant delivery.
* Oversee operational capacity, campaign workflows and tooling to improve efficiency, quality and scalability across Consumer Centralized Communication Operations.
* Partner with Risk \& Compliance to manage controls and governance for incentive and rewards programs.
* Serve as a subject matter expert and escalation point for PayPal’s incentives and rewards systems and associated compliance processes.
* Lead the global operational rollout and scaling of loyalty and rewards initiatives.
* Champion omnichannel delivery strategy and campaign governance across email, push, in\-app and onsite experiences.
* Monitor campaign and operational performance, translating insights into actions that improve execution, platform effectiveness and customer experiences.
* Provide subject matter expertise across Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) and Adobe Target.

**Subsidiary:**


PayPal
**Travel Percent:**


0
PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one\-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact\-us.


For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in\-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.


**Our Benefits:**


At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset\-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice\-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health.


**Who We Are:**

  


**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**

PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com.


**Belonging at PayPal:**


Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal.


Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community.


We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.
