title: Executive - SEO/ASO
description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance**
 At CoinDCX, our mission is clear – to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance. As India's first crypto unicorn valued at $2\.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale. We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what's next. If you're driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you'll feel right at home here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This isn't a typical
 **Executive \- SEO/ASO** 
 role.
   

  

 Crypto moves in hours, not quarters – and the people who win are the ones who can explain it clearly, fast, and at scale. As an SEO Executive, you'll be at the front line of how millions of Indians learn about crypto, blockchain, and Web3 through CoinDCX. You'll turn market moves, price action, and complex concepts into sharp, search\-optimised content that ranks, educates, and builds trust.
   

  

 This role exists because content is one of our most powerful engines for organic discovery and user education. You'll write daily, ship at pace, and learn how great content compounds into real traffic and real growth – while building deep expertise in one of the fastest\-evolving industries in the world.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Create and validate SEO\-optimised content – write blog content on the crypto industry covering trending updates, price predictions, and in\-depth educational articles.
* Deliver 3–4 articles daily , each 1,600–2,000\+ words, using a functional understanding of technical analysis of price charts to sharpen quality and relevance.
* Ideate and research – generate fresh content ideas and build unique content IPs, staying ahead of the latest in crypto, blockchain, and Web3, and tracking global market trends and price movements to shape content strategy.
* Execute core SEO tasks – build cohesive interlinking across articles, craft engaging meta titles and descriptions, and track performance in Google Search Console and Google Analytics to generate actionable reports and insights.
* Expand into new verticals – develop and manage content for new verticals across multiple products in the CoinDCX portfolio.
* Fuel community \& social content – create brief, price\-centric posts and content IPs for the community and social media platforms.
* Own publishing on CMS – upload, format, and SEO\-optimise blog content end\-to\-end in a Content Management System


**You'll Excel in This Role If You**
* Have 2–3 years of experience creating crypto\-related or fintech content.
* Write clearly and fast, and can handle a high\-volume content schedule without dropping quality.
* Have a foundational understanding of blockchain, crypto, and Web3 trends.
* Are familiar with global crypto market dynamics and trading tools, and can read price charts at a functional level.
* Know the SEO basics – interlinking, meta tags, GSC, and GA – and are hungry to go deeper.
* Are comfortable publishing and optimising content in Content Management System
* Are curious, self\-driven, and stay plugged into crypto news as it breaks.
* Know the basics of App Store Optimisation


**You'll Know You're Winning When**
* You’re consistently shipping 3–4 high\-quality, well\-optimised articles a day.
* Your articles are ranking and pulling in growing organic traffic month over month.
* Your content IPs are being read, shared, and reused across community and social channels.
* Interlinking, meta, and on\-page basics are clean and consistent across everything you publish.
* Your GSC and GA reports are turning into insights the team actually acts on.


**Why This Role Matters \& What's In It For You**
 This is a role where you learn fast and see your impact quickly. You'll build real SEO and content craft, develop deep crypto and Web3 knowledge, and watch your work turn into measurable organic growth. You'll work alongside a sharp growth team and grow into a specialist in one of the world's fastest\-moving industries.
   

  

**Hiring Process**
 Here's what your journey with us looks like:
   

  

* Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent.
* Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better.
* Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem\-solving.
* Assignment / Simulation Round – A take\-home task or live problem\-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios.
* Culture \& Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best.
* Founder Conversation (Optional) – For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long\-term fit.


**Where We Work**
 We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space. With this belief, we operate as a work\-from\-office organisation. This role is based out of our Bangalore office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.
   

  

**Perks That Empower You**
 We believe great people deserve great experiences.
   

  

* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle.
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need.
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources.
* Learning Sessions: Bi\-weekly learning and growth opportunities.


**Ready to Build What's Next?**
 If you're looking for a role that gives you direct access to high\-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it. Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

* Work with the CRM team on lead\-source tracking, nurturing and segmentation, ensuring lead volume matches admissions capacity
* Prepare and monitor marketing budgets, campaign\-wise spend and ROI; recommend reallocations and avoid non\-performing expenditure
* Supervise Digital Marketing, Social Media, Content, Creative, Events and Coordinator roles – KPIs, reviews, training and evaluations

**Qualification \& Experience**
* Essential: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Mass Communication, Advertising, Digital Marketing or a related discipline
* Preferred: MBA/PGDM or Master's in Marketing/Communications/Digital Marketing; certifications in Google Ads, Meta, Google Analytics or SEO

* Digital \& Analytical: Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, Google Analytics, CRM, funnel and ROI analysis, budget optimisation

* Attributes: strategic, creative, analytical, highly organised, commercially aware, target\-oriented, proactive and strong in execution – a doer, not only a planner


**REPORTING STRUCTURE \& ROLE BOUNDARY**
 Reports to the Head – Admissions \& Marketing, and supervises Digital Marketing, Social Media, Content, Creative, Events/Activation and Marketing Coordinator functions. Provides daily operational updates, a weekly performance report, a monthly marketing dashboard and a quarterly marketing review.
   

  

**FINAL ROLE STATEMENT**
 The Marketing Manager is responsible for building AIMS's brand, creating market demand, generating high\-quality student enquiries and executing measurable marketing campaigns across digital and offline channels – combining brand management, performance marketing, content, social media, events, market intelligence, agency management and analytics to convert marketing investment into sustainable student enrolment growth, working closely with the Admissions Team.

* **RetainIQ**

 If you've been doing marketing for a few years and find yourself more interested in the strategy and craft of customer retention than another Meta ads dashboard, read on.
   





**About us** 


 RetainIQ is a tech\-first retention marketing company based in Bangalore. We've built our own personalization platform that powers email and SMS programs for D2C brands across the US; candle companies, supplement brands, apparel labels, outdoor gear, pet products. Our SaaS tooling sits at the core of how we deliver retention outcomes that our clients can measure directly in revenue.
 





 We're hiring across the marketing team this year as we grow. This is one of the most important roles in the company; the person in this seat is the brain behind every brand's marketing program.
   





**What you'll actually do** 


 You'll own marketing strategy for 5\-6 D2C brand accounts. The work spans:
 



* Build the quarterly retention strategy for each brand you own. Where the revenue is coming from, where the gaps are, what to fix next.
* Translate strategy into monthly campaign calendars. Promotional sends, lifecycle flows, A/B tests, segmentation experiments.
* Write campaign briefs that designers and copywriters execute against. Some weeks you'll write copy yourself.
* Run weekly client calls. Read their data, present what's working and what's not, recommend the next move. These are senior\-level conversations with founders and marketing leads.
* Audit existing email and SMS programs. Find what's broken or missing and build a plan to fix it.
* Use our internal personalization platform, Klaviyo, Hiro Analytics, and a deep AI tooling stack to move 3\-5x faster than a traditional marketer.
* Work alongside a Designer, a Pod Lead, and a Customer Success Associate. Strong collaboration is the default mode.


**What we're looking for** 
* 1\-2 years in marketing of any flavor. Performance marketing, content marketing, brand marketing, lifecycle marketing, growth marketing, all relevant. Email marketing experience specifically is a plus but not a requirement.
* Comfortable with data. You should be able to look at a campaign report or a funnel chart, form a hypothesis about why the numbers look the way they do, and recommend a next step.
* Strong written communication. Briefs, copy, client emails, internal docs. Writing is most of the job. Strong writing is non\-negotiable.
* The ability to think in systems. Lifecycle marketing isn't a sequence of campaigns; it's an interconnected engine. We need someone who can see the engine.
* Comfortable on calls with US\-based clients. Confident, warm, articulate. You should be able to hold your own with founders and marketing leads.
* Klaviyo, HubSpot, Mailchimp, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, MoEngage, or any modern ESP experience is a plus, not a requirement. We'll teach you our stack.
* Service mindset paired with a strong point of view. You like clients and want them to win, but you also push back when they're wrong.


**What we're not looking for** 
* Pure media buyers who haven't done strategic or lifecycle work.
* Marketers who define themselves by which platform they ran ads on. We care how you think, not what platforms you've touched.
* People who think marketing is about creativity alone, with no patience for spreadsheets, performance data, or process. The role is 60% rigor, 40% craft.
* Candidates who view agency work as a stepping stone they want to leave in 12 months. The best growth here comes from staying long enough to own a real book of business.


**What you get** 
* ₹8\-10 LPA based on experience. The Specialist vs Strategist title is decided at offer based on level.
* Real ownership from week one. You'll be the named lead on 4\-5 brand accounts, not a junior on someone else's account.
* Exposure to 50\+ US D2C brands across categories. Few marketing roles in India offer this.
* AI\-augmented workflow. We invest heavily in tooling, including our own platform, and you'll come out of this knowing how to leverage AI for marketing better than 99% of marketers.
* Growth path: Senior Strategist, Pod Lead are the real next steps for the right person.
* Hybrid working out of our Bangalore office.



  





**How to Apply:** 




  





 Please fill this form \-\>
 **https://forms.gle/CS2AU27C6Wwmvy6K8** 




  





**Selection Process:** 



1. Apply via form
2. Assignment
3. L1 interview with a senior marketing strategist
4. L2 interview with marketing head

 You will work on hard, meaningful problems that help generations build wealth. We move fast, think clearly, and give you complete ownership to build products that transform lives for millions of global investors.
 



  





**Why this role?**

 .

 **better research in capital markets** 
 . You will be responsible for creating content that does more than inform \- it helps users understand markets, ask better questions, and make more informed decisions.
 



  





**What we expect?** 




  




* Build and own original content IPs



 Develop and own original, recognisable content IPs that
 **scream “Research”** 
 across social media and other relevant channels.
 



  




1. Understand our target audience, identify what they want to learn, and build repeatable content franchises that drive engagement, learning, and strong brand recall \- while owning the performance metrics behind them.

1. Track capital\-market developments in real time and identify opportunities to turn market\-moving events, earnings, economic announcements, sector developments, and emerging trends into high\-impact content.

* Turn research into content



  




1. Drive high\-quality
 **research reports, articles, blogs, video scripts, newsletters, social content, and other finance\-first formats** 
 for StockGro’s owned and digital channels.

* Make market data accessible



  




1. Analyse market data, company earnings, economic events, financial trends, and other relevant information to create content that helps users understand

* Build with cross\-functional teams



  




1. Collaborate closely with
 **Design, Video, Product, Growth, and Community**

* Own the numbers



  




1. Measure content performance through relevant engagement, consumption, retention, and brand metrics.
2. Use audience behaviour, platform trends, and performance insights to continuously improve content formats, distribution, and the overall content strategy.



  





**Who are you?** 




  




* You have a relevant degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience working in financial markets or financial content.

 If Capital Markets excite you, come build with us!!
 



 Help us build the brand people associate with
 **doing better research.**

 You will set up and run digital demand generation for a project launch from close to zero: paid search and social aimed at homebuyers researching a new city, a landing page and lead\-capture flow, and a retargeting sequence for people who visit a show apartment but do not book on the spot.  Two to seven years in digital or performance marketing, ideally with some real\-estate, high\-ticket, or long\-cycle\-purchase experience. You should be comfortable owning a paid budget directly, reading a CRM to understand what is actually converting to bookings rather than just leads, and working closely with an on\-ground sales team rather than at arm's length from them.
 


* Hands\-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads, including landing\-page and retargeting setup
* Comfort with a CRM and basic funnel reporting



**What you'd get out of it** 




 You would be the first owner of a real digital budget at this company, not inheriting someone else's dashboards, with direct visibility into what converts to actual bookings and a straight line to the head of sales and marketing.

 A short case exercise on the launch, one round with the head of sales and marketing, and a decision within two weeks.

DigitalSME is BrandCrest's newest vertical, currently commercializing its invoicing and payroll/HR software, so this is a high\-ownership, hands\-on role for someone who has done this before in an early\-stage B2B SaaS environment — someone who can build a growth engine from the ground up, not just run campaigns inside an existing one. You will report directly to the founding team.
 



 You'll work closely with the founding team, product, and sales to turn DigitalSME's product suite into a predictable pipeline of qualified SME/professional\-services customers, across both live products and upcoming launches. In the first few months, the priority is building repeatable acquisition and activation for the live products, before scaling across the full portfolio.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Own the growth strategy and roadmap across acquisition, activation, retention, and expansion for DigitalSME's SaaS products.
* Build and manage multi\-channel demand generation — SEO, paid (search/social), content, email/lifecycle, partnerships, and outbound — with a clear eye on CAC and payback period.
* Define and instrument the growth funnel (awareness → demo → trial/signup → activation → paid → expansion), and own the metrics that matter: MQL/SQL conversion, CAC, LTV, activation rate, churn.
* Run structured, high\-velocity experimentation (A/B tests, landing pages, messaging, pricing/packaging) to find and scale what works.
* Partner with Product to improve onboarding and activation flows, using product\-led growth tactics where relevant.
* Work with Sales to ensure smooth handoff of qualified leads and tighten the marketing\-to\-sales loop.
* Build positioning and messaging for DigitalSME's live product lines (Invoice, Payroll \& HR), tailored to their specific buyer personas, and extend this to new lines (Advertising ERP, CA/Accounting ERP, Fraud Detection) as they launch.
* Set up and own growth reporting/dashboards; report results and learnings to leadership regularly.
* Manage growth budget and any external agencies/freelancers/tools.



  





**Specification:** 



* 2–3 years in a growth, performance marketing, or demand generation role, with a significant portion spent at a B2B SaaS company (early\-to\-growth stage strongly preferred).
* Proven track record of owning a growth funnel end\-to\-end and moving core metrics — CAC, activation, conversion, retention — with numbers to show for it.
* Strong hands\-on experience with paid acquisition, SEO, lifecycle/email marketing, and marketing/growth analytics tools (e.g., GA4, HubSpot/Zoho, Mixpanel/Amplitude, Meta/Google Ads).
* Comfortable with both strategy and execution — you're equally happy building a quarterly growth plan and personally shipping a landing page or campaign.
* Data\-driven and experiment\-led: you form hypotheses, test fast, and kill what doesn't work.
* Understanding of SME and professional\-services buyer behavior is a strong plus (agencies, accounting firms, consultancies).
* Excellent written communication — you'll be shaping positioning and messaging directly.
* Startup mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and building processes rather than inheriting them.



  





**Qualification:** 



* Experience growing a product from early stage to a defined GTM motion.
* Exposure to product\-led growth (PLG) models alongside sales\-assisted motions.
* Familiarity with vertical SaaS or workflow/operations software for SMEs.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under tight deadlines.



  





**Perks \& Benefits:** 



* Glass Door Work Culture
* Mentorship
* Flexible Hours
* Casual Wear
* Refreshment
* Parking
* Compensatory Offs
* Travel \& Expense Reimbursement
* Accidental Insurance
* Health Insurance
* Company Retreats

title: Brand Manager (Marketing)
description:
**About KisanKraft** 





 KisanKraft Limited is a leading Bengaluru\-headquartered agricultural equipment and power tools company, dedicated to empowering farmers across India with modern, affordable farm mechanization solutions. With a 46\-acre manufacturing facility in Nellore, 14 branch offices, a dealer network of 5,000\+ partners across the country, and exports to 19\+ countries, KisanKraft is committed to driving productivity and innovation in the agricultural sector.
 




  





**About the Role** 





 We're looking for an energetic, versatile, and strategic Brand Manager to drive the company's brand presence across ATL, BTL, Digital Marketing, and PR. The role calls for a strong blend of creative thinking, strategic planning, and hands\-on execution to build brand visibility, positioning, and engagement across farmer, dealer, and institutional audiences.
 




  






 The ideal candidate has a genuine interest in the agricultural sector and rural economy and is willing to travel to calibrate branding efforts on the ground. You should be a self\-motivated leader, comfortable managing your own team, collaborating across divisions, and working with external agencies on PR and branding.
 




  






 You will lead all digital marketing activities for the brand — SEO, performance marketing, social media, influencer and affiliate marketing, and content creation — with an in\-house team of graphic designers and videographers, external support for performance marketing, and backing from our sales, service, CRM, and management teams.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Brand Strategy \& Creative Direction** 



* Own creative and strategic decisions that align with company goals, objectives, and budget.
* Lead idea development to create compelling, motivating campaigns that drive audience response.
* Develop branding collateral for digital platforms (graphics, videos, articles) and traditional formats (catalogues, brochures, diaries, calendars, wall paintings, signboards, flex banners, posters).
* Conceptualize campaigns for in\-store and exclusive\-store branding, including product branding, logo placement, colour schemes, packaging, and user manuals.
* Ensure consistent branding across online and offline channels.



  





**2\. Digital Marketing, E\-commerce \& Performance** 



* **Performance Marketing \& SEO:** 

 Execute and scale paid ad campaigns across Google and Meta; use keyword research and Google Search Console to monitor and improve search visibility.
* **E\-commerce \& Web Optimization:** 

 Manage website aesthetics and user experience — page layouts, imagery, and copywriting — to improve conversion rates.
* **Social Media \& Brand Growth:** 

 Plan and execute a consistent social media calendar to expand community reach and organic engagement.



  





**3\. Offline Retail \& BTL Execution** 



* Manage setup operations for new retail outlet openings.
* Participate in branding activities such as online campaigns, mobile showroom (display truck) tours, field demonstrations, exhibitions, TV/radio ads, and other promotional activities.
* Coordinate end\-to\-end design and nationwide fulfilment of physical print materials for regional teams.
* Support company events — season kick\-offs, annual dealer meetings, technician and farmer meetings, press meetings, etc.
* Visit dealers regularly to strengthen in\-store and neighbourhood branding.



  





**4\. Team Leadership** 



* Manage the in\-house creative pod — two graphic designers and one video editor — directing day\-to\-day operations and workflows.
* Work with external agencies on ATL, BTL, digital, and PR activities to strengthen KisanKraft's image among farmers, dealers, and government stakeholders.
* Build the team: recruit, train, and continuously raise the bar.



  





**5\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Market Intelligence** 



* Align the organization around a consistent marketing direction and product line strategy.
* Analyze brand positioning through market research, dealer and exhibition visits, consumer insights, and competitor tracking to identify opportunities and issues.
* Partner closely with the sales team to map branding activities to crops and seasons, ensuring strategy stays in sync with crop data across regions.



  





**6\. Performance Tracking \& Reporting** 



* Track and report on the performance of all marketing campaigns and branding activities, including progress of your team and external agencies, to management.
* Stay flexible to take on new assignments as business priorities shift.



  





**Travel** 





 Occasional travel is required to visit exhibitions, customers, and farmer events.

title: Demand Generation and Growth Manager
description:
Enterprise Bot is the leading provider of GenAI, Conversational AI and automation software, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland.
 


  


 Our intelligent virtual assistants and automation tools help companies increase efficiency, reduce costs, and deliver exceptional customer experiences in industries such as banking, insurance, and logistics. Our mission is to become the world's leading provider of AI\-powered automation software within the next five years.
 


  


 We work with leading companies such as SIX Group (Swiss Stock Exchange), SWICA, Generali and others to improve customer interactions and automate business processes using our state\-of\-the\-art Conversational AI technology.
 


  


 Our global team comprises more than 70 highly qualified professionals from diverse backgrounds.
 


  


 We foster an open, progressive company culture with state\-of\-the\-art technology and flat hierarchies. At Enterprise Bot, you'll experience a unique blend of passion, ambition, challenge, and fun.
 


  

 Tasks
   


 Enterprise Bot builds agentic AI for voice, chat, email and messaging, and sells it to large enterprises in deals with long cycles, multiple stakeholders, procurement scrutiny and real compliance requirements.
 


  


 Our growth constraint is not awareness. It is qualified, sales\-ready pipeline in the accounts we actually want. This role owns that pipeline. You will design, run and optimise the programmes that generate and convert demand across Europe, and you will be measured on pipeline and revenue contribution rather than on lead volume.
 


  


**What you'll own:** 



  


**Pipeline generation** 



  

  
* Own the demand generation strategy and quarterly pipeline targets by region and segment
  
* Design and run integrated campaigns across paid search, paid social, content syndication, SEO, email and webinars
  
* Build and run account\-based marketing programmes against a defined target account list, in tight coordination with sales
  
* Develop the outbound support layer: sequences, content and intent\-based targeting that make SDR and AE outreach land
  


  


**Funnel ownership and conversion** 



  

  
* Own the funnel end to end, from traffic and conversion through MQL, SQL, opportunity and closed\-won, and diagnose where it leaks
  
* Build and maintain lead scoring, routing and nurture flows so that sales receives genuinely qualified handoffs
  
* Run structured experimentation on landing pages, offers, messaging and channel mix
  
* Improve conversion rates on existing traffic before spending to increase it
  


  


**Marketing operations and measurement** 



  

  
* Own the marketing automation and CRM stack (HubSpot), including workflows, lifecycle stages, data hygiene and attribution
  
* Build reporting that connects spend to pipeline to revenue, and report it honestly to leadership
  
* Manage the demand generation budget with clear accountability for cost per opportunity and pipeline ROI
  


  


**Website ownership** 



  

  
* You own the website as a platform and as a conversion asset. Product Marketing owns the messaging on
  
* core product and solution pages, and Content owns localisation into market languages.
  
* Own the website platform and CMS, including the publishing workflow, page templates, governance and release process
  
* Own technical SEO and site performance, including site structure, page speed, indexation, structured data and Core Web Vitals
  
* Own site analytics and tracking, including tag management, event tracking, consent management and the attribution model
  
* Build and optimise landing pages and campaign pages, and run continuous conversion rate optimisation across the site
  
* Implement the information architecture and site narrative proposed by Product Marketing, and challenge it where it conflicts with conversion or search performance
  
* Coordinate with Content on the rollout and technical implementation of localised pages, including hreflang and market\-level site structure
  
* Manage external web development or agency resource where required
  


  


**Programmes and partners** 



  

  
* Run the webinar and event programme, including field and industry events across Europe and India
  
* Build co\-marketing programmes with integrators, BPOs and technology partners
  
* Work with Product Marketing so that campaign messaging reflects current positioning rather than drifting from it
  
* Support product and platform launches with the demand side of the launch plan
  


  

 Requirements
   

  
* 5\+ years in demand generation, growth or performance marketing within B2B technology, SaaS or enterprise software
  
* Track record generating pipeline for enterprise deals with long, complex sales cycles, rather than SMB or self\-serve motions
  
* Hands\-on expertise with marketing automation and CRM, ideally HubSpot. You build the workflows yourself
  
* Hands\-on website ownership experience, including working directly in a CMS, and practical technical SEO capability rather than oversight of someone else doing it
  
* Working knowledge of web analytics and tag management implementation, including event tracking and consent requirements under GDPR
  
* Strong analytical capability across funnel diagnostics, attribution, and cohort and channel analysis
  
* Demonstrated ABM experience against named enterprise accounts
  
* Paid media management experience with real budget accountability
  
* Strong written English
  
* Comfort operating with European working hours for part of the day
  


  


**Strongly preferred** 



  

  
* Experience marketing to European enterprise buyers, particularly in financial services or insurance
  
* Background in conversational AI, CCaaS, contact centre or enterprise automation categories
  
* Experience running multilingual campaigns across European markets, and managing a multilingual website structure
  
* SQL or advanced analytics capability
  
* Experience in a company scaling from founder\-led sales toward a repeatable marketing engine
  


  


**How we’ll know you are the right fit** 



  

  
* You talk in pipeline and revenue, not impressions and MQLs
  
* You can point to specific programmes you built and the pipeline they produced
  
* You have killed a channel that was not working, and can explain how you knew
  


  


**First 90 days** 



  

  
* **Days 1 to 30:** 
 Full funnel audit complete. Baseline metrics established by channel and region. Website technical SEO and tracking audit complete, with gaps identified.
  
* **Days 31 to 60:** 
 Target account list agreed with sales. First ABM programme live. The two or three highest\-potential channels prioritised and resourced.
  
* **Days 61 to 90:** 
 Repeatable campaign cadence running. Pipeline reporting live and trusted by sales leadership. A clear view of cost per opportunity by channel.
  


  

 Benefits
   

  
* **Shape a function from the ground up** 
 – Build Enterprise Bot's first Product Marketing function and have a direct impact on product strategy, positioning and go\-to\-market.
  
* **Work with cutting\-edge AI** 
 – Help define the market narrative for an enterprise\-grade agentic AI platform used by leading financial services, insurance and public sector organisations across Europe.
  
* **Global exposure** 
 – Collaborate daily with Product, Engineering and commercial teams across Switzerland, Spain, Poland, the UK and other European markets.
  
* **High ownership, low bureaucracy** 
 – Take ownership of launches, competitive strategy and messaging, with the autonomy to influence business decisions and work directly with senior leadership.
  
* **Competitive salary and performance\-based incentives** 
 – We offer a competitive compensation package aligned to experience and impact.
  


  


 This is a unique opportunity to build a Growth Marketing function from the ground up and influence how Enterprise Bot competes and grows across Europe. If that excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Content Marketing Manager

 building an AI\-native Marketing, Support \& Sales suite for
 **e\-commerce brands.**

 At BiteSpeed, marketing isn't about being the loudest voice in the room. It's about saying something worth listening to. We've built a product customers genuinely love, and now we're looking for someone who can tell that story in a way that educates, earns trust and makes people want to be a part of what we're building.
   

  

 As our
 **Content Marketer** 
 , you'll own our content engine end to end. From founder\-led thought leadership and product storytelling to SEO, customer stories and campaign content, you'll shape how thousands of marketers discover, learn about and remember BiteSpeed. If you're the kind of person who obsesses over a headline as much as a growth chart, you'll fit right in.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own BiteSpeed's content strategy across channels, ensuring everything we publish contributes to awareness, pipeline or customer education.
* Write and edit high\-quality content including blogs, case studies, product launches, newsletters, website copy, sales enablement content and thought leadership pieces.
* Partner closely with founders and subject matter experts to turn their ideas into content people actually want to read and share.

* Develop customer stories, playbooks and educational content that showcase the value our customers create using BiteSpeed.

**What Makes You a Good Fit**
* You believe great content teaches first and sells second.
* You're an exceptional writer who can simplify complex ideas without making them simplistic.
* You have 3\+ years of experience in content marketing, editorial or B2B SaaS marketing.
* You have experience building content strategies that have driven measurable business outcomes, whether that's organic traffic, pipeline, customer engagement or brand awareness.
* You enjoy talking to customers, understanding their problems and turning those conversations into compelling stories.
* You're highly opinionated about quality, but pragmatic enough to ship, learn and iterate instead of chasing perfection.
* You have a strong sense of ownership and don't wait for someone else to tell you what needs to be done.


**Salary and Location**
**Location:** 
 Bangalore
   

  

**Expected CTC:** 
 We pay top of market for the right folks and also offer generous equity (ESOP) to everyone in the team
   

  

**Our Purpose**
 At BiteSpeed, work is personal. You could blame this on us being existential, but most of us are spending the best years of our lives doing this and we want to be purposeful about the kind of workplace we’re trying to create.
   

  

**Our purpose is about why we’re here and what we care about:\-**
* Personal Transformation
* Wealth Creation
* Winning Together


**Our Values**
 Our values are about how we do what we do. Values define the right thing to do. We hire, reward and sometimes have to let go based on our values.
   

  

**We have 5 core values:\-**
* Go Above And Beyond
* Making Things Happen
* Say It Like It Is
* Progress Over Perfection
* Don’t Take Yourself Seriously, Take Your Work Seriously


**Perks \& Benefits**
 Small things we’ve done to ensure we take care of our wellness, learning \& keep things fun:\-
   

  

* Health Insurance \- Health insurance cover and accident coverage for extra cushion and mental peace when rainy days hit us.
* Quarterly Off\-sites \- Quarterly off\-sites are a core part of the BiteSpeed culture. Our off\-sites range from intense quarter planning sessions to crazy mafia nights and competitive cricket matches (with a lot of trash talking).
* Cult Fitness Membership \- All work and no play makes jack a dull boy. Cult Fit and Cult Play passes to make sure we hit the gym more often.
* Personal Development \- We sponsor courses, conference tickets, books on a case to case basis to ensure we’re constantly growing.
* Salary In Advance \- Trust first, by default. We pay out salaries in the first week of the month.

 Bizom

 Algorithmic Jugaad
 
 .

 If you are not scared of roadblocks, failures, and seemingly unachievable goals then you should read on.
 



  





 Growth Marketer at Bizom is kind of a solopreneurship journey but with a major twist. You will have a stack of mature products and an existing user base of over 700 CPG brands to talk about.  You will develop business acumen and learn ways to deliver the maximum value to maximum prospects at minimum cost and in minimum time. As a cohort owner you will be working closely with the sales team, in collaboration with other customer\-facing teams to create specific marketing plans. Your cohort will be your market, and all the required marketing will be your responsibility

* Building GTM for your cohort

* Chasing the customer’s voice
* Setting up ICPs and user journey maps

* You will be working with a set of experts who will support your growth
* Drive Bizom’s GTM through its strategies
* Learning everything SaaS and selling to enterprises
* Building the world’s best: Account based Marketing team
* A chance to dabble with every aspect of marketing and push it as you see fit.
* Your coworkers will be operating from a high\-risk, high\-reward perspective



  





**Why Bizom?** 



* We are happy Souls, working together and having each other’s back! People, Product and Profit is our motto.
* Fly beyond your imagination as we believe in giving wings to your passion.
* No Kinder\-garden, We fall, We learn and we stick together like a chewing\-gum.
* We trust in our association and allow free rein to our employees. To act and explore themselves while delivering the best and sustainable results.
* We celebrate success hard and failures harder, It's always a collective success or collective failure. We enjoy our learnings more with a sip of our poison;)
* Have Buddies, Mentors But be your own boss. It goes hand in hand.
* Know your people, Talk, Chat, learn and Share \- have access anytime to reach anyone in the family.
* Stay Quiet \- Stay Foolish. We are courageous people who speak and do right things keeping in heart to serve best to our clients and our company.
* We believe in rolling our sleeves up, getting our hands dirty, dreaming and achieving together.



  





**What Will you get while working with Bizom?** 



* Work is Fun \- We believe work is fun\-and we go the extra mile to make sure you



 enjoy what you do every single day.
 


* Design Your Own Role \- You don’t just fit into a job\-we let you shape it. Take up



 what excites you, and we’ll back you with trust and responsibility.
 


* Freedom to Own Your Work \- Less rules, more trust. You get the freedom to figure things out your way\-with the right support when needed.
* Take Full Ownership \- It’s your ship. You steer it. You own it. You make things happen.

* People Come First \- Always. We back our people through thick and thin. That’s our culture.
* Stay Fit \& Feel Good \- We care about your health\-with fitness activities, sports, and regular wellness sessions to keep you balanced.
* Happy Tummy, Happy You \- Enjoy fresh, tasty meals every day at our very own in\- house cafeteria. We take food seriously!

title: Chief of Staff, Marketing & Growth
description:
**About This Role**
 We're looking for a Chief of Staff to the Marketing \& Growth function who can bring structure, pace, and clarity to how the team operates and executes. This role sits at the center of the function — connecting strategy to execution, keeping cross\-functional workstreams on track, and ensuring leadership has the visibility and context needed to make good decisions fast.
   

  

 You'll work closely with marketing, sales, and revenue stakeholders to drive alignment across priorities, remove execution friction, and help the function scale with discipline.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

**Strategic Operations \& Execution**
* Translate leadership priorities into structured execution plans with clear owners, timelines, and milestones
* Track progress across key marketing and growth initiatives and surface blockers early
* Prepare leadership for key reviews, business meetings, and cross\-functional planning cycles


**Cross\-Functional Alignment**
* Act as a coordination layer between marketing, sales, revenue, and product teams
* Facilitate alignment on shared goals, pipeline targets, and GTM priorities across functions
* Represent the marketing and growth leadership in operational forums when needed


**Planning \& Rhythm of Business**
* Own the operating cadence for the function — quarterly planning, team reviews, and business reporting cycles
* Build and maintain dashboards and reporting structures that give leadership clear visibility into function health and performance
* Drive the annual and quarterly planning process in close partnership with marketing leads


**Special Projects \& Leadership Support**
* Own discrete high\-priority projects that fall outside standard team structures
* Identify process gaps and build frameworks that improve how the team works and scales
* Support leadership on org\-level decisions, communication, and change management


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 4–8 years of experience in marketing operations, strategy, consulting, or a Chief of Staff function
* Strong understanding of B2B marketing and growth motions — demand generation, GTM planning, pipeline contribution
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex cross\-functional workstreams with multiple stakeholders
* Comfortable working with funnel data, marketing analytics, and performance reporting
* Excellent written and verbal communication — able to synthesize complexity and communicate clearly upward and across teams
* Proven ability to operate with minimal direction and hold multiple priorities simultaneously


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience in a SaaS or technology\-led B2B environment
* Exposure to international GTM planning across APAC, EMEA, or Americas
* Prior experience in a marketing\-adjacent Chief of Staff or strategy role


 What Makes You a Strong Fit
   

  

* You're a strong systems thinker who can see both the detail and the bigger picture without losing either
* You operate with calm and structure in fast\-moving, ambiguous environments
* You earn trust quickly with peers and leadership by following through consistently
* You communicate with precision — in writing, in meetings, and in how you frame trade\-offs
* You treat execution as a discipline and bring the same rigor to operations that a marketer brings to campaigns


 Why This Role Matters
   

  

 Marketing and growth functions move fast and span many workstreams — demand generation, GTM expansion, analytics, operations, and more. Without strong operational leadership at the center, execution becomes fragmented and leadership context gets lost. This role directly improves the function's ability to prioritize well, move fast, and scale with clarity.
   

  

 Why Join Us
   

  

* Work at the center of a marketing and growth function with real international scope and business impact
* Collaborate directly with senior leadership across marketing, sales, and revenue
* Operate with meaningful ownership over how the function runs and scales
* Join a team that values data, pace, and clear thinking over hierarchy and process
* Grow in a role with high visibility and direct influence on how the business evolves

title: Partnerships Manager
description:
**Senior Associate (Partnerships Manager) — Global Partnership Management** 




 You don't just "manage" partners. You build the supply engine that powers a global AI platform.
 



 Joveo's recruitment advertising platform runs on machine learning, real\-time bidding, and predictive optimization — delivering millions of job ads to the right candidates at the right moment. But none of that works without world\-class supply partnerships fueling the machine.
 



 That's where you come in.
 



  





**The Role — In Plain English** 




 You'll own relationships that directly impact revenue, reach, and platform performance across global markets.
 



 This isn't account management with a fancier title. You're the person who spots an untapped supply channel in Southeast Asia on Tuesday, negotiates the commercial terms by Thursday, and has it live and delivering candidates the following week.
 



 Your week might look like this:
 


* **Monday:** 
 Analyze partner performance data. One channel is underpacing — you diagnose why and fix it before anyone escalates.
* **Tuesday:** 
 Jump on a call with a new publisher. Pitch the partnership. Negotiate terms that work for both sides.
* **Wednesday:** 
 Sit with Product and Tech to unblock an integration that's been stalling a high\-value partner launch.
* **Thursday:** 
 Build an automation workflow that eliminates 4 hours of manual reporting your team does every week.
* **Friday:** 
 Present your partner growth roadmap to the CXO. Get buy\-in. Start executing.



 You'll talk to partners in the morning, negotiate contracts before lunch, dig into performance dashboards after, and pitch process improvements to leadership by end of day — all in the same role.
 



  





**What Makes This Different** 




 Most partnership roles at this level put you in a box — either "relationship manager" or "operations associate." This one refuses to separate the two.
 



 You'll own the full lifecycle: find the partner, close the deal, launch the integration, track the numbers, optimize the outcome. End to end. No handoffs to five other teams.
 



 Direct access to CXOs and senior leadership. Real commercial ownership from day one. And you're building systems that scale — not just doing the work, but redesigning how the work gets done.
 



  





**You Might Be Right For This If...** 



* You have 2\+ years in partnerships, supply ops, business operations, or client\-facing roles — ideally in SaaS, Ad Tech, HR Tech, or recruitment advertising
* You've actually negotiated a deal, not just "supported" one. You know what it feels like to own a number.
* You're the person who looks at a messy spreadsheet and sees a pattern everyone else missed
* You can context\-switch between a partner call, a data pull, and a strategy doc without losing momentum
* Process inefficiency physically bothers you. You automate things before anyone asks you to.
* You're comfortable in ambiguity — startup speed doesn't stress you, it sharpens you



  





**What You'll Get** 



* **Real ownership:** 
 Commercial decisions, partner relationships, and operational outcomes — yours from day one
* **Leadership exposure:** 
 Work directly with CXOs and cross\-functional leads across Product, Tech, Sales, and Client Success
* **Growth trajectory:** 
 Previous hires in this function have built entirely new capabilities within Joveo's supply ecosystem
* **Compensation:** 
 Among the most competitive in India, including stock options
* **Global scope:** 
 Partners and markets that span continents — not a single\-geography desk job



  





**If you'd rather build the partnership playbook than follow one — we should talk.** 




 Joveo. Where AI meets the future of work.

title: Founder's Office - Sales & Marketing Associate
description:
**The Mission** 




 We're not building a traditional sales team. We're building an AI\-native, on\-ground growth engine from scratch — and you'll be one of its first builders. We need a sharp, fast\-moving individual who can walk into any room, in any language, and turn a conversation into a relationship — and a relationship into revenue. AI will be your default tool, not your last resort. You'll move at the speed of someone with years of experience, because you'll have the right tools, the freedom to build, direct access to the founder, and a real stake in where this goes.
 



  





**What You Will Do (The Grow Loop)** 




 ● Find the Opportunity: Work closely with teams across the function to spot warm leads, untapped markets, and brand\-building opportunities across the region.
 



 ● Represent the Brand: Use tools like Claude to prep every pitch, tailor every message, and walk into every meeting positioned as the face of the brand, not just another rep.
 



 ● Run the Marketing Engine: Own outbound and lifecycle messaging using tools like Gupshup — build automations, sequences, and campaigns that keep leads warm and customers engaged without manual follow\-up.
 



 ● Close and Compound: Handle conversations end\-to\-end — first call to final confirmation — in English, Hindi, or Telugu, and turn every closed deal into a stronger, wider network.
 



 ● Sit at the Table: Be part of stakeholder discussions and work closely with the founder — your read on the ground shapes decisions, not just executes them.
 



 ● Grow, Track, Improve: Log every interaction, learn what's working, and keep sharpening your approach. Treat every relationship like a long\-term asset, because it is one.
 



 ● Keep Things Organized: Maintain trackers, CRM notes, and follow\-up schedules so nothing — and no one — falls through the cracks.
 



  





**Who You Are** 




 ● Experience: 1–2 years. You've built something before — a client base, a network, a brand presence — and you know what it takes to grow it.
 



 ● Multilingual \& Ready: Fluent in English, Hindi, and Telugu — you can build trust with anyone who picks up the phone or walks through the door.
 



 ● AI\-Native: You already use Claude (or similar tools) every day — not just to get answers, but to move faster and think sharper.
 



 ● Marketing\-Comfortable: You've worked with or are quick to pick up automation tools like Gupshup — you think in sequences and campaigns, not just one\-off messages.
 



 ● Curious, Not Just Persuasive: You don't need a sales degree, but you're quick to learn a product, a market, or a new angle.
 



 ● Adaptable: If a pitch doesn't land or a market shifts, you adjust and try again — you don't wait around for direction.
 



 ● Ships Fast: You'd rather make ten calls today than perfect a script for a week.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 ● Real impact, not vanity metrics — your work directly drives brand presence and revenue, not just reports.
 



 ● Own the region end\-to\-end — rare for this level of experience; you won't just execute a playbook, you'll help build it.
 



 ● A seat in the room — be part of stakeholder discussions and work directly with the founder, not three levels removed from decisions.
 



 ● Ground floor of a new initiative — this function doesn't exist yet in its final form, and you'll shape what it becomes.
 



 ● Small team, high trust — flat structure, direct access to leadership, fast decision\-making.
 



 ● Strong growth trajectory — this is a launch pad role, built for someone who wants to grow into ownership, not stay an intern.
 



 ● Competitive stipend with a clear path to a full\-time, higher\-title role as the initiative scales.
 



 ● Mission\-driven company — a decade\-plus track record solving one of India's toughest operational problems.
 



  





**Why This Role?** 




 Most entry\-level sales or brand roles start with a fixed script and a fixed ceiling. This one's different. You're joining at the start of a new initiative, sitting in on decisions with the founder, and running the marketing engine yourself — which means your growth isn't capped by a job description, it's shaped by how far you take it. You get real ownership, real impact, and an early shot at shaping what brand growth looks like at a real company, in three languages, from day one.
 



  





**How to Apply** 





 Click Apply Now to be redirected to the Claro Energy recruitment portal, where you'll submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a few basic details. Alternatively, you can email your resume directly to hr@claroenergy.in with the subject line "Application – Associate, Sales \& Marketing (Founder's Office)".

 \* Act as the main point of contact for assigned clients.

 \* Prepare weekly and monthly digital marketing reports.

 \* Identify areas for improvement and recommend next steps.

**Preferred Qualifications**

 \* Previous experience working in a digital marketing, advertising, branding, or creative agency is preferred.
 



 \* Experience handling healthcare, education, real estate, hospitality, retail, or service\-based clients will be an advantage.
 



 \* Experience coordinating with designers, video editors, content writers, and web developers is preferred.
 



  





**Tools and Platforms** 




  





 Candidates should have working knowledge of some of the following:

 \* Google Search Console
 



 \* Google Business Profile
 



 \* Canva
 



 \* Social media scheduling tools

**Key Performance Indicators**

 \* Growth in social media reach, engagement, and followers.
 



 \* Number and quality of leads generated.

They should be capable of understanding client requirements, suggesting suitable digital marketing solutions, coordinating with the internal team, and ensuring that the work is delivered on time.

title: Performance Marketing Manager (PPC)
description:
**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
 



**Work Mode:** 
 5 days WFO (Work from office)
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



  





 We are hiring a Performance Marketing Manager – PPC to own performance marketing end to end for one or more consumer brands. You will research customer demand, identify winning ad angles, brief the in\-house creative team, and use performance data to decide what to scale, test, or stop. You will work closely with creative, operations, and finance teams to drive profitable growth.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Research keywords and customer problems using tools such as Helium10, and use search intent and demand signals to decide which product angles are worth building campaigns around.
* Source winning creative concepts from competitors and organic content using tools such as Foreplay, along with manual scouting on platforms like TikTok and Instagram, and identify why a given hook or format is working.
* Generate ad scripts using our in\-house AI tools, refining them so that the final script is genuinely high quality rather than a rough first pass.
* Brief our video editors and graphic designers clearly, including the reference creative, the hook, and the intended angle, and review and approve their work before it goes live.
* Launch, manage, and optimize paid campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.
* Monitor performance daily against clear benchmarks, including CPM under thirty dollars, CPC under one dollar fifty, CTR above three percent, CAC in the range of forty to fifty dollars, and cost per add to cart under fifteen dollars, along with hook rate, hold rate, and click rate.
* Make clear scale or kill decisions based on return on ad spend. Scale an ad when Meta ROAS is above one. Hold with no action when it is between zero point seven and one. Kill an ad when Meta ROAS stays below zero point seven for two to three consecutive days.
* Understand and work within a subscription\-driven revenue model, where a Meta ROAS below one can still be a healthy result once repeat and subscription revenue is accounted for, and track blended Shopify ROAS against a breakeven target of one point four.
* Own the revenue target and budget allocation for your assigned brand or product line.
* Work closely with channel managers and performance marketing executives to keep paid social, marketplaces, and organic efforts aligned rather than working against each other.
* Provide regular, structured reporting on campaign performance, budget pacing, and revenue against target.



  





**Required Qualifications and Experience** 




  




* At least three years of experience in performance marketing, with a proven track record of scaling paid campaigns and delivering measurable return on investment.
* Hands\-on experience running and optimizing campaigns in Meta Ads Manager, along with familiarity with TikTok Ads or similar platforms.
* A strong grasp of direct response marketing metrics and unit economics, including CAC, ROAS, and lifetime value, and how they connect to actual profitability.
* Experience briefing and iterating with a creative team, since this role is as much about creative direction as it is about media buying.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-testing, high\-volume creative environment where campaigns and creative are refreshed constantly rather than left to run untouched.
* Working knowledge of analytics and attribution tools such as Google Analytics and Meta Ads Manager reporting.
* A master’s degree is preferred but not required.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  




* Experience in health, wellness, supplements, or adjacent consumer categories.
* Experience at a growth\-stage direct\-to\-consumer company, for example at businesses such as Bellavita, BetterAlt India, or Mosaic Wellness.
* Experience with subscription or retention\-driven revenue models, rather than only one\-time purchase businesses.
* Experience owning a channel or product line's P\&L, not just its ad spend.



  





**Where We Expect to Find This Person** 




  





 Strong candidates are likely to come from:
 



  




* A performance or performance marketer at a direct\-to\-consumer or e\-commerce brand, ideally one with a subscription or repeat\-purchase revenue model.
* A media buyer at a performance marketing agency who has grown into owning strategy and creative direction, not just ad account management.
* A performance marketer at a company in health, wellness, or a related consumer category who is ready to own a full brand or product line rather than a single channel.



  





**Key Competencies** 




  




* You are genuinely data\-driven, and can look at CPM, CTR, ROAS, and CAC together and know what story they are telling you, rather than optimizing for one metric in isolation.
* You are creative\-literate, and can brief an editor or designer clearly enough that what comes back actually matches what you had in mind.
* You are comfortable owning a number, and treat your product line's revenue and profitability as your own responsibility rather than something to report on.
* You are decisive under ambiguity, and can make a scale or kill call on a campaign without waiting for someone else to tell you it is safe to do so.
* You work well cross\-functionally, particularly with creative, operations, and finance, since a good campaign idea is worthless if we cannot fulfill it profitably.



  





**Compensation and Benefits** 




  




* Pay is based on experience, in line with market standards.



  





**Success Metrics for the First Three to Six Months** 




  




* Revenue and ROAS targets for your assigned brand or product line are consistently met or exceeded.
* CAC is held within target range as spend scales, rather than rising uncontrolled with volume.
* A clear testing cadence is in place, with new creative angles and hooks tested on a regular schedule rather than ad hoc.
* Scale and kill decisions are made promptly and correctly, without campaigns being left to run well past the point they should have been cut.



  





 Strong working relationship established with the creative team, reflected in fewer revision rounds and faster turnaround from brief to finished ad.

title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
**Introduction To Demandbase**
 Demandbase is the only pipeline AI platform that empowers GTM teams to automate growth at scale. With a unified view of data, insights, actions, and outcomes, B2B enterprises can seamlessly align and execute their account\-based GTM strategies with confidence. Thousands of businesses trust Demandbase to maximize revenue, minimize waste, and consolidate their data and tech stacks – all in one platform.
   

  

 As a company, we’re as committed to growing careers as we are to building world\-class technology. We invest heavily in people, our culture, and the community around us. We have also continuously been recognized as One of The Best Places To Work in the San Francisco Bay Area by Fortune, and One of The 60 Best Companies To Sell For by Selling Power. Our offices are located in San Francisco, New York, Austin, Seattle, India, and the United Kingdom.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Demandbase is looking for an enthusiastic marketer with an extensive background in marketing operations and a passion for technology coupled with meticulous attention to detail.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of driving growth and engagement through effective program and workflow management. We are looking for someone with strong Marketo proficiency, combined with AI know\-how, to streamline operations and automate workflows to improve both efficiency and productivity.
   

  

 If you’re excited about digital marketing and metrics, have a passion for working with a variety of teams and marketing projects, and enjoy seeing all your hard work come to life in a growth stage environment, then this opportunity is for you!
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Campaign Execution \& Quality Assurance**
* Approach every problem as a GTM Engineer, with the goal of streamlining processes for ease of use and self service for our customers across the company
* Own our intake and project management framework to ensure nothing is lost, SLAs are met and projects are delivered in a timely manner and in working order
* Understand and take advantage of the full breadth of our marketing techstack to solve ever changing GTM challenges
* Operate with an AI and Automation first mindset by Identifying opportunities to improve on marketing automation and efficiency
* Be not just an order taker, but a strategic and operational partner to our marketing team by leveraging your expertise to optimize programs, tactics and processes
* Construct, QA, and execute multi\-channel campaigns including email, nurture programs, forms, landing pages, and event workflows
* Build and maintain customer journeys, advanced nurture paths, and email campaigns across the customer lifecycle
* Conduct A/B testing on subject lines, email copy, layouts, and CTAs to continuously boost conversions
* Monitor email performance metrics and manage sender scores, deliverability rates, unsubscribes, and subscription preferences
* Perform pre\-launch QA: review segmentation logic, suppression lists, UTM parameters, form configurations, tracking, and routing rules
* Adhere to UTM standards including naming conventions, required parameters, and channel attribution rules
* Track post\-launch performance, monitor deliverability metrics, validate conversion tracking, and identify issues requiring troubleshooting
* Ensure adherence to relevant regulations including CAN\-SPAM, GDPR, and other industry\-specific compliance requirements
* Enforce naming conventions, folder structures, documentation requirements, and operational best practices


**Marketing Automation \& Platform Administration**
* Dive into our new internal automation platform, Mojo, and lead by example on the cutting edge of marketing technology by uncovering and solving for new use cases in the platform
* Support and coordinate defined cross\-platform initiatives that span multiple platforms (Marketo, SFDC, Bigquery, etc), teams and stakeholders to unify disparate datasets
* Become an internal power user of Demandbase to help steer internal usage of the platform and lend expertise to product development direction via our Demandbase on Demandbase initiative
* Configure programs, create smart campaigns, manage templates, and troubleshoot automation workflows to maintain platform health
* Monitor and troubleshoot integrations between Marketo, Salesforce, and other MarTech tools (e.g., Brightcove, ON24, Seventh Sense, Demandbase)
* Evaluate and implement marketing technologies to improve operational efficiency and campaign effectiveness; ensure integration and alignment with CRM and other systems
* Configure, test, and deploy new features, automations, and workflows to support evolving go\-to\-market needs
* Provide training and support to marketing team members on Marketo and other marketing technologies
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of platform configurations, processes, and best practices
* Stay updated on industry trends, implement best practices, and continuously optimize campaigns


**Qualifications**
* 4–6 years of relevant experience of hands\-on marketing operations or marketing automation experience in a B2B environment; SaaS experience is a plus
* Proficiency in Artificial Intelligence platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini
* Strong hands\-on Marketo (or equivalent MAP) experience required: proven experience producing campaigns, managing automation workflows, and administering Marketo instances in a production environment
* Salesforce proficiency: strong understanding of Salesforce objects (Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Campaigns, Opportunities), SFDC\-Marketo sync, and CRM data management
* Technical aptitude: comfortable with HTML/CSS basics, API concepts, data imports/exports, and troubleshooting technical issues
* Experience leveraging UTMs to track web visits and campaign engagement (building, applying, and QA)
* Strong QA discipline and extreme attention to detail: ability to catch errors, validate logic, and ensure accuracy in campaign launches
* Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills; ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional environment
* Excellent communication skills: ability to translate complex data into actionable insights, train teams on best practices, document work, and flag risks early
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and process\-driven with a proactive, agile, can\-do attitude
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field; or equivalent industry experience


**Preferred**
* Experience with additional MarTech tools: Asana, Workato, Qualified, ON24, Brightcove, Stensul, Seventh Sense, Demandbase, or similar platforms
* Marketo Certified Expert (MCE) or equivalent certification strongly preferred
* Familiarity with ABM (Account\-Based Marketing) strategies and execution
* Understanding of attribution models, funnel metrics, and marketing analytics; predictive pipeline analytics experience is a plus
* Background in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology marketing
* SQL or data manipulation skills
* Familiarity with advanced segmentation strategies, lifecycle marketing, and personalization frameworks
* Experience supporting AI\-driven marketing automation, personalization, or optimization initiatives
* Experience supporting A/B testing or experimentation frameworks
* Exposure to compliance requirements: GDPR, CCPA, CAN\-SPAM


**Core Competencies**
* Attention to Detail \& QA Discipline
* AI first mindset
* Problem\-Solving \& Troubleshooting
* Collaboration \& Cross\-Functional Partnership
* Adaptability \& Agility in Fast\-Paced Environments
* Ownership, Accountability \& Follow\-Through
* Curiosity \& Continuous Improvement
* Process Discipline \& Documentation
* Data\-Driven Decision Making


**Benefits**
 Our benefits include Group Medical, Personal Accident, and Term Life Insurance for comprehensive protection. Preventive healthcare covers dental, vision, and OPD needs, complemented by strong mental health support. We also provide a fitness benefit, car lease policy, and gratuity for long\-term financial well\-being.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Demandbase**
 At Demandbase, we believe in creating a workplace culture that values and celebrates diversity in all its forms. We recognize that everyone brings unique experiences, perspectives, and identities to the table, and we are committed to building a community where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported. Discrimination of any kind is not tolerated, and we strive to ensure that every individual has an equal opportunity to succeed and grow, regardless of their gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, race, ethnicity, background, marital status, genetic information, education level, veteran status, national origin, or any other protected status. We do not automatically disqualify applicants with criminal records and will consider each applicant on a case\-by\-case basis.
   

  

 We recognize that not all candidates will have every skill or qualification listed in this job description. If you feel you have the level of experience to be successful in the role, we encourage you to apply!
   

  

 We acknowledge that true diversity and inclusion requires ongoing effort, and we are committed to doing the work required to make our workplace a safe and equitable space for all. Join us in building a community where we can learn from each other, celebrate our differences, and work together.
   

  

**Unsolicited Submissions**
 At Demandbase, we value thoughtful partnerships and direct connections with candidates. We’re not accepting unsolicited resumes or outreach from third\-party recruiting agencies. Any unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed, and no fees will be paid.

description:
**About This Role** 




**Digital Marketing Manager / Pod Manager – Client Growth \| Pod P\&L \| Escalation Leadership** 




**Full\-Time \| Work From Office \| Banjara Hills, Hyderabad \| Reports to: Founder / CEO** 




  





**Company Description** 




 Digital Mojo is a results\-driven digital marketing agency based in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. Since 2016, we have been helping brands scale through performance\-focused digital strategies, storytelling, lead generation, branding, and high\-impact marketing campaigns.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 We are looking for a highly ownership\-driven
 **Digital Marketing Manager / Pod Manager** 
 with 4\-7 years of agency experience to lead a pod of clients end\-to\-end.
 



 The Pod Manager is not a delivery coordinator. They are the business head of their pod. They own the P\&L of their accounts, drive client growth strategy, lead the pod team, and are the last point of escalation before it reaches the CEO. Every commercial decision, every retention risk, every growth opportunity within the pod runs through them.
 



 If something goes wrong in the pod, the Pod Manager owns it. If something goes right, the Pod Manager drove it.
 



  





**What This Role Is Not** 




 Not a senior Account Manager with a fancier title
 



 Not someone who only reviews reports and attends calls
 



 Not someone who escalates client problems to the CEO without first attempting resolution
 



 Not a task manager or execution coordinator
 



 Not someone who waits for strategy to come from above
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Pod P\&L Ownership** 




 Own the revenue, profitability, and commercial health of all accounts within the pod
 



 Track pod\-level billing, scope utilization, and team bandwidth against revenue
 



 Identify accounts where the agency is over\-servicing and course\-correct scope or pricing
 



 Protect agency margins by managing team allocation and delivery efficiency
 



 Flag accounts at commercial risk to the Founder with a clear plan, not just a problem
 



 Identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities and close them in coordination with the Founder
 



 Own monthly pod revenue targets and report against them with clarity
 



**2\. Client Growth Strategy** 




 Go beyond delivery. Actively think about what is next for each client's business
 



 Develop quarterly growth plans for key accounts covering new campaigns, channels, and opportunities
 



 Proactively bring ideas to clients before they ask. Be the strategic voice in every client relationship
 



 Identify gaps in a client's current marketing mix and recommend solutions backed by data
 



 Lead strategic review meetings with clients, not just performance catch\-up calls
 



 Connect client business goals to marketing strategy and keep both aligned as the business evolves
 



 Be the person a client calls when they want a fresh perspective, not just a status update
 



**3\. Escalation Leadership** 




 Serve as the final internal escalation point before the CEO for all pod\-level issues
 



 Handle client escalations, conflicts, and difficult conversations directly and with confidence
 



 Resolve delivery failures, team gaps, and quality issues at the pod level without pushing them upward
 



 Make judgment calls on scope disputes, pricing conversations, and client dissatisfaction independently
 



 Know when to involve the Founder and walk in with context, options, and a recommendation
 



 Protect the Founder's bandwidth by resolving 90% of pod issues at the pod level
 



**4\. Team Leadership and Pod Management** 




 Lead and manage Account Managers, Social Media Managers, Performance Marketers, and SEO Specialists within the pod
 



 Set clear expectations, review output quality, and hold team members accountable
 



 Run pod reviews, identify underperformance early, and address it directly
 



 Build a culture of ownership, speed, and quality within the pod
 



 Identify training or skill gaps in the team and flag them to the Founder
 



 Ensure Account Managers are handling day\-to\-day client communication so the Pod Manager can focus on strategy and commercial outcomes
 



**5\. Delivery and Quality Oversight** 




 Own the quality of everything that leaves the pod, from reports to creatives to campaign performance
 



 Ensure all client deliverables across social media, SEO, and performance marketing are on time and to standard
 



 Review monthly performance reports before they reach the client
 



 Maintain SLA adherence across the pod and flag risks before they impact delivery
 



 Coordinate with centralized teams including design, SEO, website, and automation for seamless execution
 



**6\. Performance and Campaign Strategy** 




 Understand performance marketing fundamentals including CPL, ROAS, CTR, lead quality, and funnel structure
 



 Review campaign performance across accounts and push for optimization when results are not meeting targets
 



 Work with Performance Marketers on budget planning, channel strategy, and campaign direction
 



 Ensure SEO, social, and paid strategies are aligned and working toward the same client business outcome
 



**7\. Commercial Responsibility and Client Retention** 




 Own client retention across all pod accounts
 



 Conduct regular health checks on every account and know the status of each relationship at all times
 



 Identify at\-risk clients early and create a recovery plan before it becomes a churn situation
 



 Manage contract renewals, scope expansions, and pricing conversations
 



 Track client satisfaction and act on early signals before they escalate
 



  





**Key KPIs** 




 Pod Revenue vs Target
 



 Pod Gross Margin and Profitability
 



 Client Retention Rate
 



 Upsell and Cross\-sell Revenue Generated
 



 Client Satisfaction Score
 



 Escalations Reaching CEO (target: minimal)
 



 On\-Time Delivery Percentage
 



 Team Utilization and Bandwidth Efficiency
 



 Strategic Growth Plans Delivered per Quarter
 



  





**Required Skills and Qualifications** 




 4\-7 years of experience in a digital marketing agency
 



 Proven experience managing multiple client accounts and cross\-functional teams
 



 Strong understanding of agency P\&L, billing, scope management, and margin control
 



 Deep knowledge of performance marketing, social media, SEO, and content marketing
 



 Experience handling client escalations and difficult commercial conversations independently
 



 Strong strategic thinking with the ability to build and present growth plans for clients
 



 Excellent English communication skills, written and verbal
 



 Confident in senior client\-facing discussions and presentations
 



 Experience with project management and reporting tools
 



 Ability to lead, motivate, and hold a team accountable in a fast\-paced environment
 



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile** 




  





**Agency experience is mandatory** 




 Has managed a revenue\-bearing portfolio of clients, not just a team of people
 



 Has had commercial conversations with clients around scope, pricing, and renewals
 



 Thinks in terms of client business growth, not just campaign delivery
 



 Is a problem\-solver who finds solutions before escalating
 



 Can lead a room whether it is a team standup or a senior client strategy session
 



  





**Reporting Structure** 




**Reports To:** 
 Founder / CEO
 



 Manages: Account Managers, Social Media Managers, Performance Marketers, SEO Specialists
 



**Coordinates With:** 
 Creative Team, SEO Team, Website Team, Automation Team
 



**Escalation Authority:** 
 Final internal point before the CEO
 



**Career Growth** 




 Senior Pod Manager → Group Account Manager → Delivery Head → Business Head
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full\-Time, Work From Office, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad
 



 Benefits: Health Insurance \| Provident Fund \| Leave Encashment

title: Associate Director - Global Partner Marketing – Hyperscaler
