title: Assistant General Manager - Marketing
description:
**About the job** 




  





**Get to know us better** 




 We are Gera Developments Private Limited (GDPL), a brand known by our five\-decade history as one of the pioneers in the Real Estate business in Pune. Innovation, transparency, and enhanced customer experience is how we have created award\-winning, premium residential and commercial projects in Pune, Goa, Bengaluru, and California. We live and work by “Let’s Outdo”, a philosophy that defines everything we do to raise the standards of Real Estate in the country.
 



 There are many ‘firsts’ that stand to our credit. Way back in 2004, we introduced India’s first 5\-year Warranty on Real Estate, that RERA mandated only in 2017\. We then introduced India’s first and only 7\-year warranty in Real Estate. In 2014, we designed and launched the award\-winning ChildCentric® Homes, which revolutionised the Real Estate sector for both, the developer, and the home buyer. IntelliplexesTM, SkyVillasTM, and The Imperium series are our other highly successful product lines. In our 50th Year, we launched yet another first\-of\-its\-kind industry initiative—Gera’s Home Equity Power—a means to provide financial flexibility to customers to meet financial emergencies.
 



  





**How the world sees us** 




 It has been an honour to be recognised as an innovative business leader, and an employer to build a career with by some of the best talent in the country.
 



 We’re the only Real Estate company to be recognised in the top 10 mid\-size organisations six times in a row by the Great Places to Work® Institute, and we continue to feature amongst the Top 50 Great Mid\-Size WorkplacesTM 2024 in India. In 2024, we have also been proudly recognised as one of India’s Best WorkplacesTM in Real Estate, and India’s Best WorkplacesTM in Building a Culture of Innovation for All. As we raise the bar on service orientation, product innovation, real estate marketing, and brand building, we are consciously creating a workplace where our employees achieve new heights in their areas of expertise.
 



  





**Our people\-forward culture** 




 How did we achieve this? By cheering for our outdoers. We care about our people, and invest in their success. We cultivate a culture of innovation, inclusiveness, high growth and rewards, inspiring our employees to challenge themselves, and besting their own past performance to achieve their professional goals and their self\-development objectives.
 



  





**Position Overview:** 




 We are seeking an experienced marketing leader with 10\+ years of experience at Gera Developments. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in brand strategy, customer lifecycle management, digital marketing, tech\-enabled customer journeys, and team leadership. As a key driver of business growth, you will be responsible for driving demand generation, enhancing customer experience, and strengthening the Gera brand across domestic and international markets.
 








**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Strategic Marketing \& Business Growth** 



* Lead development and execution of integrated marketing strategies aligned with company’s growth vision and brand objectives.
* Drive 30%\+ YoY business growth through performance marketing, direct, D2H channels, and referral/loyalty programs.
* Devising GTM strategies for project launches (₹3000\+ Cr portfolio), ensuring positioning, pricing, and promotion excellence.








**Customer Lifecycle \& Experience Management** 



* Own the customer journey from acquisition to handover, improve advocacy and reduce acquisition cost.
* Integrate digital platforms (Salesforce, SAP, Razorpay) to streamline experience and operations across customer touchpoints.
* Champion CX innovations.








**Budget \& Performance Management** 



* Manage and optimize ₹40\+ Cr marketing budgets with data\-backed ROI accountability across media, digital, and offline platforms.
* Analyze marketing KPIs, campaign performance, and consumer insights to refine strategy and improve efficiency.








**Team Leadership \& Stakeholder Collaboration** 



* Lead and mentor a high\-performing team; drive talent development, internal growth, and organizational alignment.
* Collaborate with leadership, sales, product, and tech teams to ensure strategic coherence and execution excellence.








**Marketing Ancillaries** 



* Lead marketing strategy for allied business verticals like The Gera School
* Represent Gera at industry forums, exhibitions, award platforms, and partner meets, enhancing corporate reputation.








**Ideal Candidate must possess:** 



* 10\+ years of progressive experience in marketing, brand strategy, digital growth, and customer experience.
* Proven success in driving large\-scale marketing programs, preferably in real estate, lifestyle, or service\-led sectors.
* Strong analytical and decision\-making skills with a data\-driven mindset.
* Expertise in CRM systems, marketing automation, and digital ecosystems (Salesforce, SAP, HubSpot, etc.).
* Excellent leadership, interpersonal, and communication skills.
* MBA in Marketing or equivalent from a reputed institution

title: Senior Marketplaces Advertising Strategist..
description:
This is not a reporting seat or an execution\-only role. You will own the advertising performance of your accounts end\-to\-end — strategy, targets, partner relationship, and outcomes — and act as the eyes and ears of the ads function on the ground. That means proactively surfacing risks, opportunities, and optimisation calls before partners or leadership have to ask, and translating what the data is telling us into decisions and action.
   

  

**You will work side\-by\-side with the Marketplaces Advertising Lead, supporting them to deliver against team\-level commercial targets while running your own book of accounts with autonomy. You will be hands\-on across Amazon Ads, Amazon DSP, and Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC), and equally comfortable leading a partner conversation about commercial strategy as you are inside a bid management interface.**
 ₹0 \- ₹0 a year
   

  

**Account Ownership \& Strategy Leadership**
* Own a portfolio of strategic brand accounts end\-to\-end — you are the senior strategist accountable for advertising performance against agreed commercial targets (revenue, ROAS, TACoS, new\-to\-brand, share of voice)
* Define quarterly and monthly advertising strategies for each account, aligned to partner commercial goals — growth, profitability, launches, defence, and category share
* Lead the advertising conversation in partner meetings, monthly performance reviews, and quarterly business reviews — own the narrative on what happened, why, what we are doing next, and what to expect
* Be the eyes and ears of the ads function — proactively flag what is working, what is at risk, and what to do about it, ahead of partners or leadership asking
* Partner with the Marketplaces Advertising Lead to hit portfolio\-level targets; raise pacing, performance, and budget risks early and bring the recommended call, not just the problem


**Campaign Strategy \& Optimisation**
* Plan, execute, and monitor paid advertising campaigns on Amazon (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display) and Amazon DSP for your strategic accounts
* Lead optimisation across the portfolio — campaign structure, keyword strategy, negatives, bid strategy, audience targeting, creative direction, and budget pacing
* Test, scale, and retire — design structured tests (bid, placement, creative, audience), interpret results with rigour, and roll winners into the playbook
* Plan and manage weekly and monthly advertising budgets across your accounts; keep spend on pace and on strategy
* Continuously improve the tracking of brand\-level ad spend and return on ad spend, and the way we report performance to partners


**Amazon Marketing Cloud, DSP \& Advanced Advertising**
* Use Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) as a core part of how you build strategy — path\-to\-conversion, audience overlap, incrementality, new\-to\-brand analysis
* Run and interpret Amazon DSP campaigns and analytics — quantify how upper\-funnel activity contributes to lower\-funnel conversions and feed that back into the plan
* Stay ahead of the Amazon advertising roadmap — beta features, new ad types, AMC releases — and bring the relevant ones into how we operate


**Partner \& Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Communicate with partners via email, calls, and face\-to\-face meetings — bring insight, not just updates
* Define compelling advertising strategies that meet partner commercial goals and articulate them clearly to non\-specialist audiences
* Work closely with Brand Management, Merchandising, and SEO/Content to drive an aligned commercial agenda for your accounts — advertising is one lever, not the whole story


**Team \& Function**
* Train, develop, and coach more junior strategists and the offshore execution team — quality\-check work, raise the bar on standards, and build playbooks others can reuse
* Support the Lead on partner escalations, portfolio reviews, and strategic initiatives across the team
* Adopt internal tools and feed requirements back to the tech team to make the team faster and sharper


**Must\-Have**
* 5\+ years of total experience, with 3\+ years in a hands\-on digital advertising role on Amazon — agency, accelerator, or in\-house at a meaningful scale
* Demonstrable track record of owning accounts and carrying performance targets — you have held a number and hit it, not just reported on one
* Deep working knowledge of the Amazon advertising ecosystem — Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and DSP
* Hands\-on experience with Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) — or strong fluency in clean\-room / advanced advertising analytics and willingness to certify within the first 90 days
* Line management or senior mentoring experience — you have raised the performance of people around you
* Strategic thinker with a strong commercial bias — you can connect a bid adjustment to a P\&L outcome and explain it to a non\-specialist
* Excellent verbal and written communication — you can lead a partner conversation and write a sharp performance narrative
* Excellent analytical skills, including budget management and attention to detail
* Proactive and self\-directed — comfortable operating with autonomy across a portfolio and raising your hand before being asked


**Nice to Have**
* Experience working with retail / ecommerce brands across multiple categories
* Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) certification
* Working knowledge of SQL for advertising data analysis
* Experience with BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Quicksight)
* Experience working with offshore execution teams or across geographies

title: VP, Investment Allocations
description:
Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1\.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Further information is available at www.blackstone.com. Follow @blackstone on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Instagram.

**Job Summary and Business Unit Overview**


Blackstone Credit \& Insurance (BXCI) was created in September 2023 by combining Blackstone's Credit and Insurance businesses. BXCI offers a broad range of solutions across corporate and asset\-based credit, including investment\-grade and non\-investment\-grade private credit. BXCI invests across the credit markets and manages strategies focused on sectors with strong fundamentals.


We are seeking a highly motivated Vice President to lead the Investment Allocations team within BXCI. The role will oversee the Bengaluru Center of Excellence (CoE) team and partner closely with global Investment Allocations stakeholders. The Vice President will be responsible for allocation governance, operational execution, controls, data quality, team leadership, and strategic transformation. The role requires sound judgment, strong execution discipline, and the ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders across Investments, Capital Formation, Insurance, Finance, Operations, Technology, Legal and Compliance, and Data teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the Bengaluru Investment Allocations CoE and establish clear objectives, service standards, capacity plans, and accountability across the team.
* Partner with global colleagues to run hypothetical allocation scenarios (hypos), evaluate allocation outcomes, and support the timely and accurate finalization of allocations across asset classes, funds, and client mandates.
* Oversee the end\-to\-end allocation process, including data intake, eligibility validation, constraint monitoring, exception management, approvals, booking support, and post\-allocation review.
* Ensure allocations are executed in accordance with approved policies, investment guidelines, client and fund restrictions, conflicts protocols, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Establish and maintain robust governance, including maker\-checker controls, documented approvals, audit trails, escalation protocols, and periodic control attestations.
* Define, monitor, and report key risk indicators (KRIs), key performance indicators (KPIs), service\-level metrics, and operational trends; drive timely remediation of identified issues.
* Perform and oversee periodic allocation surveillance, portfolio reviews, and management reporting for relevant business and client stakeholders.
* Drive consistent data quality and reconcile allocation inputs and outputs across source systems, models, and downstream records; ensure exceptions are investigated and resolved promptly.
* Act as the senior point of contact across business, Technology, Finance, Operations, Data, Legal and Compliance, Capital Formation, and Insurance teams globally.
* Lead strategic initiatives focused on modernization, workflow digitization, automation, standardization, and operational scalability.
* Assess change impacts, define business requirements, coordinate user acceptance testing, and ensure effective implementation and post\-go\-live stabilization of new processes and systems.
* Create effective handover and follow\-the\-sun operating models between regional teams, supported by clear procedures, business continuity plans, and cross\-training.
* Build, coach, and retain a high\-performing team through structured development plans, timely feedback, succession planning, and an inclusive culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
* Prepare concise, executive\-level updates on performance, capacity, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and strategic outcomes.
* Respond to ad hoc requests from Investment, Capital Formation, Insurance, and other stakeholders, providing accurate and timely analysis.
* Support internal and external audits, regulatory inquiries, and risk or compliance reviews by maintaining complete and readily retrievable evidence.


Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong knowledge of investment allocation processes, portfolio management operations, private credit, fund structures, and investment guideline monitoring.
* Demonstrated people leadership experience, including managing managers or senior individual contributors in a global or CoE operating model.
* Strong control mindset with experience in operational risk, governance, issue management, root\-cause analysis, and remediation.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data, identify patterns, and make sound decisions under time pressure.
* Ability to understand the broader business context while maintaining close attention to detail and accuracy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence senior stakeholders and communicate complex matters succinctly.
* Proven ability to manage competing priorities, multiple projects, and demanding deadlines with limited guidance.
* Strong relationship\-building skills and the ability to work seamlessly across functions and geographical locations.
* Experience driving process optimization, automation, technology implementation, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* High standards of integrity, accountability, professional judgment, and commitment to excellence.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly advanced Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with data visualization, workflow, or analytics tools is preferred.


Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business, or a related discipline. A Chartered Accountant qualification, CFA, CPA, or MBA in Finance is preferred.
* 10 \+ years of relevant experience in investment management, private credit, asset management operations, a Big Four firm, or a global financial services organization.
* Prior experience in investment allocations, portfolio operations, guideline monitoring, or a related investment control function is strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of direct lending, private credit, insurance mandates, and multi\-fund allocation frameworks is advantageous.
* Experience leading a distributed team and partnering with stakeholders in North America or other global locations is preferred.

title: Event Production Event Manager
description:
Event Production Executive / Manager

**Industry:** Event Management \& MICE  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** Bengaluru  
**Company:** MOE India LLP

Role Overview

We are looking for a dynamic and experienced **Event Production Executive / Manager** to manage the end\-to\-end production and on\-ground execution of corporate events, conferences, MICE programs, exhibitions, product launches, annual days and other large\-format events.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of **event fabrication, technical production, vendor management and site execution**, with the ability to convert approved concepts and designs into high\-quality event setups.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle complete **event production from planning to dismantling**.
* Study event briefs, layouts and 3D designs and translate them into executable production plans.
* Coordinate fabrication of stages, backdrops, entrance arches, registration areas, photo booths, exhibition stalls, branding and décor.
* Manage **LED screens, AV, lighting, sound, trussing, rigging, power and other technical requirements**.
* Conduct venue recce and take accurate site measurements.
* Prepare production schedules, technical requirements and material lists.
* Source, negotiate and coordinate with fabricators, AV vendors, printers, rental agencies and other production partners.
* Obtain quotations, compare costs and maintain production budgets.
* Supervise fabrication workshops and ensure production matches approved designs and specifications.
* Manage event setup and dismantling teams at the venue.
* Coordinate with creative, client servicing, operations and venue teams.
* Ensure branding, dimensions, finishes and technical installations are executed correctly.
* Troubleshoot last\-minute production and technical challenges during setup and live events.
* Maintain quality standards while meeting strict event timelines.
* Ensure safety procedures are followed during fabrication, rigging, electrical work and event installation.
* Manage multiple events and vendors simultaneously when required.

Candidate Requirements

**Experience:** 3–7 years in event production, preferably with an **event management, MICE, exhibition or experiential marketing agency**.

Candidate should have:

* Strong knowledge of event fabrication and production materials.
* Practical understanding of stages, LED, AV, sound, lighting, trussing and electrical requirements.
* Ability to understand **2D layouts, technical drawings and 3D event designs**.
* Strong vendor network and negotiation skills.
* Good knowledge of event venues and production vendors in Bengaluru.
* Strong budgeting and cost\-control skills.
* Excellent coordination and problem\-solving ability.
* Ability to work under tight timelines and manage overnight/event\-day setups.
* Willingness to travel for events and projects.
* Strong ownership of projects from production planning through final execution.

Preferred Background

Candidates currently working as **Event Production Executive, Production Manager, Event Operations Manager, Technical Production Executive or Event Production Coordinator** with an event/exhibition agency will be preferred.

What We’re Looking For

A hands\-on production professional who understands that a great event is not just about the concept—it is about **accurate execution, quality finishing, timely delivery and smooth on\-ground management**.

title: Senior Revenue Operations & AI Adoption Executive
description:
### **Job Information**

### **Job Description**


Who We Are:

  

Increff is the most preferred retail SaaS partner, solving complex inventory management and supply chain challenges for retailers seeking to revolutionize their supply chains both technologically and operationally.

  

What We Offer:

  

Our core focus is on providing innovative retail tech solutions, including merchandising and omni channel inventory management. These solutions are meticulously designed to cater to the specific needs of brands and retailers, empowering them to thrive in the dynamic marketplace Innovative technology, comprehensive support, and a dynamic environment for career growth.

  

Our Vision:

  

To be the most admired retail technology company.

  

Job Summary:

  

As a Senior Revenue Operations \& AI Adoption Executive, you'll own the systems, data, and automation that connect Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. This is a senior individual\-contributor role with architectural ownership: you will design the CRM data model, lead revenue analytics and forecasting, build the automation and AI infrastructure the GTM org runs on, and set the operating standards other RevOps executives and GTM teams follow.

  

This is also a builder role, ideal for someone who enjoys owning systems end\-to\-end, designing scalable processes, and working directly with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and leadership to translate ambiguous business problems into scalable systems.

  

Responsibilities:

  

1\. Revenue Operations Strategy \& GTM Analytics

* Own end\-to\-end revenue reporting: pipeline, MRR, expected MRR, conversion, stage movement, forecasting, and revenue performance
* Build and continuously evolve management dashboards and recurring weekly/monthly revenue reporting for leadership
* Maintain pipeline and revenue snapshots to enable historical trend analysis and forecasting accuracy
* Lead ad\-hoc analysis and data\-driven input for business reviews, board decks, and leadership decision\-making
* Set the reporting and metrics framework (definitions, cadences, ownership) that the entire S\&M team follows

  

2\. CRM Architecture, Data Governance \& Salesforce Administration

* Own Salesforce configuration end\-to\-end: custom objects, fields, Flows, validation rules, sharing model, and Experience Cloud access
* Define and enforce data governance standards across Leads, Accounts, Contacts, and Opportunities
* Design multi\-track lead qualification frameworks (e.g. product\-line\-specific tracks), BANT structures, and auto\-population logic
* Diagnose and resolve complex production issues (record\-locking flows, trigger bugs, sharing/ownership conflicts) with root\-cause investigation
* Author CRM SOPs and process documentation that scale as the GTM org grows

  

3\. Revenue Automation \& AI\-Driven Systems

* Architect the revenue automation stack — intent/visitor data, contact enrichment, email sequencing, and workflow orchestration (e.g. Factors.ai, Apollo/Seamless, Salesforce, n8n, Make)
* Build integrations across CRM, communication, productivity, and GTM systems to create connected, end\-to\-end workflows
* Design AI\-assisted processes that convert unstructured inputs (emails, meeting notes, internal chat) into structured CRM and revenue data
* Evaluate and maintain the entire S\&M tech stack, building custom MCP/API connectors where needed to enable AI\-assisted workflows
* Build lightweight internal tools or agents where off\-the\-shelf software doesn't solve the problem

  

4\. Pipeline \& Forecast Ownership

* Own monthly pipeline and revenue forecast accuracy, including coverage\-vs\-target analysis
* Build and maintain deal/pipeline health scoring (risk flags, weighted scoring, stage\-based alerts) for rep\- and manager\-level visibility
* Identify forecast risk early and communicate gaps to Sales leadership with supporting data
* Run pipeline hygiene audits — stale\-deal and stale\-lead identification using activity\-based (not just date\-based) criteria
* Support Monthly/Quarterly Business Reviews with accurate, defensible revenue and pipeline narratives

  

5\. Cross\-Functional Leadership \& GTM Intelligence

* Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Customer Success to design cross\-functional workflows (deal approvals, commercial reviews, customer hand\-offs)
* Build structured intake/ticketing processes for revenue\-related requests with clear SLAs and ownership
* Own competitive intelligence and account/GTM research frameworks that drive outbound and demand\-gen prioritization
* Mentor and set standards for other RevOps Executives, reviewing their CRM builds, reports, and automations
* Continuously identify and prioritize process redesigns that scale with GTM headcount growth

### **Requirements**


Who Should Apply:

  

This role is ideal for candidates with 2\-3 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Analytics, with demonstrated ownership of a CRM instance end\-to\-end.

  

Required Skills:

* 2\-3 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Analytics, with demonstrated ownership of a CRM instance end\-to\-end
* Deep, hands\-on Salesforce administration expertise: Flows, validation rules, sharing/security model, custom objects, Experience Cloud
* Proven experience designing and operating automation/integration workflows (n8n, Make, or equivalent) or AI tools (Claude, OpenAI etc) across multiple systems
* Strong quantitative fluency in revenue/SaaS metrics (MRR, pipeline coverage, conversion, forecasting) and advanced spreadsheet modeling
* Excellent written communication for leadership reporting, SOPs, and cross\-functional alignment, with a track record of translating ambiguous business problems into scalable systems

  

Nice to Have:

* Experience with AI/LLM\-assisted workflow design (agentic automation, structured data extraction from unstructured text)
* Background in B2B SaaS, supply chain, or retail\-tech GTM
* Experience building GTM strategy for new market segments or regulatory\-driven opportunities
* Familiarity with MCP/API connector setup for AI\-assisted tooling

title: Account Marketing Manager
description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. **Strategy:** Person in this position will play a pivotal role in Thales growth trajectory in India . **Marketing:** Person in this position will collaborate with business leaders to understand and analyze the market, to ensure that Thales’ products \& services correspond to customer needs and expectations. The person in this role will also implement elements of the Corporate Marketing Plan for the Region.

**Outcomes: Strategy / Business Development:**

* Actively supports the annual rolling 5\-year regional/country strategic plans for alignment with GBUs, MoD strategic account plans, and country strategic plan, with clear understanding of the economic and industrial trends of the market (including customer needs and competitor offerings), Thales addressable market, and strategy to win keeping in mind Make in India obligations \- in order to secure Thales’ position and growth in the market.

 Bring original ideas for Instagram reels—trend\-spotting, format experimentation, and scripting, not just execution of a brief.
 




 ✅
 
 Grow and manage community—increase followers, drive engagement, and build a loyal, active audience across channels.
 




 ✅
 
 Manage Reddit for Houzeo Corp—identify and participate in relevant subreddits (e.g., r/RealEstate, r/FirstTimeHomeBuyer, r/FSBO), share genuinely helpful, non\-promotional content, and manage brand\-safe community discussions.
 




 ✅
 
 Monitor community conversations and trending topics to surface real user pain points, FAQs, and content ideas for the broader marketing team.
 




 ✅
 
 Build relationships with brokers, real estate builders, agencies, community moderators, and micro\-influencers for co\-marketing, content features, and partnerships.
 




 ✅
 
 Track and report on performance—KPIs, engagement, referral traffic, and sentiment—weekly/monthly, and adjust strategy based on data.
 




 ✅
 
 Stay on top of platform algorithm changes, community guidelines, and emerging real estate communities to keep Houzeo's presence current and compliant.

 ▸
 
 3–4 years of experience in social media marketing/strategy, ideally within proptech, fintech, or D2C brands.

 Proven track record of managing a social media channel (Instagram, in particular) with demonstrable follower growth—be ready to share handles and numbers.

 Experience with, or strong interest in, founder\-led / personal branding content.

 Strong reels ideation and scripting skills—you understand what makes content stop the scroll, not just what's trending.

 Comfortable managing multiple campaigns at once without dropping quality or deadlines.

 Active Reddit user, or genuinely excited to become one fast—you understand (or can quickly learn) platform culture, etiquette, and what gets engagement vs. what gets downvoted.

 Experience or willingness to build relationships with external stakeholders (brokers, builders, agencies, moderators, micro\-influencers).

 Strong communication and coordination skills — you'll work closely and directly with the founder, and brief a video editor and content writer regularly.
 




 ▸ Strong
 
 writing skills with the ability to switch between professional, conversational, and community\-native tones.

 A Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, journalism, or a related field.

 Prior experience in real estate, proptech, or fintech marketing.

 Experience running boosted/paid posts for reach and awareness.

 Familiarity with social listening tools (Brandwatch, Sprout Social) or even disciplined manual subreddit tracking.

 ownership—you shape the founder's public voice and the brand's community presence, with a video editor and content writer to execute alongside you.

title: Brand Manager
description:
**About Nua** 




 Nua is a digital\-ﬁrst, omnichannel brand reimagining women’s wellness with the full attention it has always deserved – instead of the superficial solutions it has typically received. We serve nearly 20 lakh women and girls each month with Zero Irritation period care, maternity care, skincare, everyday intimate care, and digital tools like our Period Tracker App and SecretKeeper chat.
 



 With a thriving D2C business, we are also the second\-largest women’s wellness brand on most Indian e\-commerce and quick commerce platforms.
 



 We have innovated around the neglected, overlooked frictions women and girls face in their wellness journeys – the irritations they’ve learned to manage quietly, the problems that others dismiss as ‘just part of being a woman.’ Our guiding philosophy is “Thought Around You,” to ensure we develop wellness products that truly ease your cycle, body, feelings, and life.
 



 Founded in 2017, Nua is fast\-growing and profitable, powered by a hardworking, supportive, and diverse team that always puts customers first. If you enjoy a fast\-paced environment, if creative and collaborative problem\-solving excites you, and if you’re looking for an opportunity to own true impact, Nua might be the place for you!
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a highly motivated and analytical Category Manager to support the development and execution of category strategies that drive growth, profitability, and market share. The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, data\-driven, and passionate about consumer insights, product performance, and brand building.
 



 You’ll work closely with the Marketing, Supply Chain, and Sales teams to ensure seamless planning, performance tracking, and innovation across the product portfolio.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 1\. End\-to\-End P\&L Ownership
 



 ● Own category\-level P\&L including revenue, gross margins, contribution margins, and bottom\-line delivery.
 



 ● Drive cost efficiency, pricing strategy, demand forecasting, and inventory planning in partnership with sales, supply chain and finance teams.
 



 ● Monitor performance through dashboards and use data\-driven insights to steer business decisions.
 



  





 2\. Category \& Business Strategy
 



 ● Define and execute long\-term category strategy aligned with consumer needs, brand positioning, and business goals.
 



 ● Chalk out the communication and media strategy for the portfolio to deliver on annual business and brand objectives.
 



 ● Identify whitespace opportunities and develop the product roadmap for new launches and innovations.
 



 ● Build annual operating plans (AOPs) with clear volume, value, and channel targets.
 



  





 3\. 4Ps Ownership (Product, Price, Place, Promotion)
 



 ● Lead product strategy including concept creation, packaging decisions, claims, and consumer value propositions.
 



 ● Develop pricing models that balance competitiveness and profitability.
 



 ● Identify the right distribution mix across D2C, marketplaces, and offline retail.
 



 ● Craft and oversee integrated marketing campaigns to drive awareness, acquisition, and loyalty.
 



  





 4\. Consumer \& Market Understanding
 



 ● Deeply understand the female wellness landscape, category trends, and consumer motivations.
 



 ● Lead consumer research, competition benchmarking, and opportunity mapping.
 



 ● Drive a consumer\-first culture across the team and product pipeline.
 



  





 5\. Commercial \& Business Acumen
 



 ● Bring strong strategic thinking with the ability to translate insights into actionable business decisions.
 



 ● Evaluate business performance through KPIs such as mind share, SoV, CAC, repeat rates, retention metrics, RoAS and category margins.
 



 ● Continuously optimize the category’s financial health through levers such as portfolio mix, pricing, promotions, and operational efficiencies.
 



  





 6\. Leadership \& Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Management
 



 ● Influence and collaborate with senior leaders across NPD, Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain and Finance.
 



 ● Align leadership teams on category priorities, resource allocation, and growth initiatives.
 



 ● Manage and mentor high\-performing direct and cross\-functional teams to drive execution.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 




 Education \& Experience
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, or a related field.
* MBA preferred.
* 5\-7 years of experience in category management preferably in the skin care or cosmetics space (Beauty, Ecommerce or D2C experience preferred).
* Experience in conceptualising and building a product/portfolio from 0 to 1 and scaling it from 1 to 10\.



 Skills \& Competencies
 


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; proficiency in Excel and data visualization tools.
* Strong understanding of P\&L management, pricing, and consumer behavior.
* High ownership, execution intensity, and comfort operating in a fast\-growing environment.
* An entrepreneurial mindset and enthusiasm for building brands and products consumers love.
* Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Detail\-oriented with the ability to multitask and manage timelines.

 Own paid acquisition across key channels.

* Develop acquisition and retargeting strategies
* Build creative testing frameworks
* Brief, evaluate and iterate on performance creatives
* Monitor CAC, ROAS, MER and contribution margin

 Turn data into decisions.

 Build a brand customers want to return to.

 , Neo is building a modern financial institution from India, with global aspirations.

The role will own the end\-to\-end digital growth funnel—from demand generation and lead acquisition to conversion optimization and customer journeys—for one of India's most differentiated alternative investment platforms.

title: Director of Product
description:
**Director of Product** 




 AI Cloud and Orchestration, Velocis Platform
 



**Reports to** 
 Chief Product Officer
 



**Location** 
 Mumbai
 



**Function** 
 Product Leadership, AI Infrastructure (Velocis)
 



  





**Why this role, why now?** 




 Neysa is building the AI cloud for the era where AI runs in production rather than in pilots. The promise we are claiming to deliver is operational confidence, the ability for an enterprise to run AI predictably, affordably and accountably. Infrastructure choices now decide which AI programmes are viable at all, and for us sovereignty means strategic control rather than a compliance checkbox.
 



 Velocis is how we deliver that, across GPU as a service and our AI platform as a service. We are scaling from strong early proof into a platform that serves sovereign enterprise buyers in India and large offtake capacity globally. This role exists to help set product direction and to make it real.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are hiring a Senior Director of Product to sit alongside the Chief Product Officer as a balanced strategist and operator, and to co\-own the Velocis product ecosystem. You will help shape the two\-year product strategy and you will own the roadmap, prioritisation and specification sign\-off that turn it into shipped platform. Engineering, infrastructure operations, design and go\-to\-market are your delivery partners, and product holds the pen on what gets built and in what order.
 



 You will move between whiteboarding high\-density cluster architecture with an executive buyer in one hour and running a deep specification review with a product manager in the next. Both are the job.
 



  





**What you will own?Product strategy and roadmap** 




 • Co\-own the 12 and 24 month strategy for Velocis across GPU as a service and the AI platform, and hold the roadmap, prioritisation and specification sign\-off end to end.
 



 • Ship the Velocis AI platform stack and move straight into post\-launch feature velocity, reliability, and the Day\-0 and Day\-1 user journey.
 



 • Keep a live read on the global AI infrastructure landscape, across orchestration layers, sovereign cloud, inference economics and power and density, so Velocis holds its edge.
 



  





**Team and craft** 




 • Lead, mentor and hold accountable a team of four or more product managers across the core Velocis modules.
 



 • Build a product culture of extreme ownership, technical precision and fast feedback, and raise the hiring bar as the team grows.
 



 • Coach high\-potential talent and step in where a track needs lift.
 



**Enterprise commercials and offtake** 




 • Partner with the CPO and CEO on offtake opportunities from 1,000 to 8,000 GPUs, shaping orchestration specs, tenant isolation and SLA commitments.
 



 • Act as executive product sponsor for key Indian enterprise accounts.
 



 • Turn bespoke offtake and enterprise requirements into platform capabilities the wider base can use, without fragmenting the core codebase. This is one of the hardest and most important parts of the role.
 



**Platform economics** 




 • Own core product economics with the CPO, across GPU utilisation efficiency, gross margin, tenant density and feature monetisation.
 



 • Treat onboarding time to value and expansion as first\-order outcomes, since Velocis revenue behaves as consumption rather than subscription and expansion is the dominant growth lever.
 



  





**What you bring?** 




 • Ten or more years in product management, with four or more leading product teams. Hands\-on experience in GPU computing, AI or ML orchestration or HPC is ideal, and strong candidates from adjacent large\-scale cloud or general\-purpose cloud infrastructure, with the ability to ramp fast, will be considered.
 



 • A track record of shipping complex B2B infrastructure products from concept to meaningful revenue scale.
 



 • Fluency across GPU infrastructure on NVIDIA and AMD, container and workload orchestration such as Kubernetes, Slurm and Ray, VPC and network topologies, object storage and dedicated inference pipelines.
 



 • Working command of multi\-tenancy and tenant isolation, observability and cost attribution, sovereign deployment patterns such as air\-gapped clusters and customer\-managed keys, and inference economics measured as cost per token and P99 latency.
 



 • Commercial fluency, so that you connect product decisions to gross margin, resource efficiency and customer return.
 



  





**How you work?** 




 • You zoom out to market positioning and a two\-year horizon, and zoom in to specifications, telemetry and the granular detail, without losing either.
 



 • You have a default to action and high standards, and you pair them with the judgment to say no and to sequence well.
 



 • You are a low\-ego and articulate communicator who earns credibility quickly with engineers, enterprise CTOs and executive leadership.
 



 • You are comfortable building in a category that is still being created.
 



  





**Your first 90 days** 




 • Take full ownership of the roadmap and prioritisation across the PM tracks, with clear ownership lines in place.
 



 • Land the near\-term Velocis milestones with clean telemetry on adoption and stability.
 



 • Establish a working rhythm with engineering, operations and go\-to\-market that delivers predictably.
 



  





**Success in the first 6 to 12 months** 




 • Roadmap predictability and release velocity, with the Velocis milestones shipped and instrumented for adoption and reliability.
 



 • Movement on the economics you own, across GPU utilisation efficiency, gross margin and tenant density.
 



 • Time to production for offtake customers and time to value in onboarding, both trending down.
 



 • Expansion on named enterprise and offtake accounts.
 



 • A high\-functioning product team with clear ownership and a rising bar.

title: Manager - Ecommerce transformation
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Consulting \- Manager \- Ecommerce Transformation**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Manager \- Ecommerce Transformation will drive ecommerce transformation initiatives within the Customer practice, combining digital commerce strategy, customer experience improvement, operating model design, and delivery excellence. The role will support clients in improving online growth, commerce operations, product discovery, conversion, order experience, and omnichannel effectiveness. You will work with business and technology stakeholders to shape commerce roadmaps, design scalable operating models, and implement transformation initiatives that improve revenue realization, digital adoption, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Business Development \& Market Leadership
+ Support ecommerce transformation pipeline development across advisory, implementation, and managed transformation opportunities.
+ Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, business cases, demos, and executive presentations focused on digital commerce growth and operational improvement.
+ Support GTM strategies for ecommerce transformation offerings across B2B, B2C, and marketplace\-led business models.
+ Design and refine commerce transformation offerings aligned with client priorities, including digital channel growth, product data improvement, checkout optimization, and omnichannel enablement.
+ Contribute to thought leadership, client workshops, and points of view on ecommerce trends, digital buying behaviour, platform modernization, and commerce operating model evolution.


* Client Engagement \& Delivery
+ Lead ecommerce transformation workstreams from current\-state assessment through strategy, roadmap design, implementation planning, and execution support.
+ Assess commerce journeys, digital storefronts, product information flows, merchandising processes, search and navigation, order management touchpoints, and performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
+ Design ecommerce operating models, governance structures, product data processes, merchandising workflows, channel strategies, and performance management frameworks.
+ Support initiatives across product discovery, catalog readiness, personalization, pricing and promotions, cart and checkout, order visibility, returns experience, and customer support integration.
+ Partner with product, technology, data, marketing, sales, and operations teams to translate commerce priorities into structured requirements, process flows, user stories, and delivery roadmaps.
+ Develop business cases and benefits models to quantify conversion improvement, revenue uplift, digital adoption, cost\-to\-serve reduction, and operational productivity gains.
+ Ensure delivery excellence across assigned workstreams, including scope, timeline, budget, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder alignment.
+ Support change management, adoption, and governance activities to embed sustainable commerce capabilities across business teams.


* Technology \& Innovation
+ Enable teams to leverage ecommerce platforms, product information management systems, order management systems, CRM, analytics, personalization tools, automation, and AI\-enabled insights.
+ Stay ahead of technology trends shaping ecommerce transformation, including composable commerce, headless architecture, AI\-enabled product discovery, personalization, digital shelf analytics, and omnichannel orchestration.
+ Identify opportunities to develop reusable accelerators for commerce journey assessment, product data maturity, conversion diagnostics, and benefits tracking.


* Leadership \& People Development
+ Manage project teams or workstreams and ensure high\-quality delivery across ecommerce transformation engagements.
+ Mentor consultants and analysts on ecommerce strategy, requirements structuring, delivery governance, and cross\-functional stakeholder management.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Demonstrate knowledge of digital commerce capabilities, including B2B and B2C commerce, marketplace models, dealer and distributor portals, and subscription commerce.
* Have exposure to leading commerce platforms and ecosystems, including Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, Shopify, SAP Commerce Cloud, commerce tools, BigCommerce, Akeneo, Salsify, and similar technologies.


**What We Look For**
* 8\+ years of experience in ecommerce transformation, digital commerce, omnichannel strategy, customer experience, product data transformation, or commerce operations.
* Consulting experience is desired.
* Proven experience supporting or leading ecommerce transformation programs, digital channel improvement initiatives, or commerce operating model redesign.
* Strong understanding of ecommerce journeys, digital merchandising, product information management, order experience, conversion optimization, and commerce performance metrics.
* Hands\-on experience with ecommerce platforms, analytics tools, PIM, OMS, CRM, or related digital commerce technologies.
* Strong business development support, stakeholder management, communication, and project delivery skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

 Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Editor to manage end\-to\-end post\-production for a wide variety of video projects.

The Video Editor will be responsible for assembling raw footage into polished, engaging, and visually compelling content by combining storytelling, editing techniques, sound design, motion graphics, colour grading, and visual effects. The ideal candidate should possess a strong understanding of narrative flow, pacing, audience engagement, and platform\-specific content optimization.

This role requires close collaboration with Video Producers, Motion Graphic Designers, Creative Teams, Account Managers, and Clients to ensure every video meets creative expectations, business objectives, and quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Video Editing \& Storytelling**

 Edit raw footage into compelling and engaging videos while maintaining the intended

narrative and creative vision.

 Understand project objectives, target audience, brand guidelines, and client

expectations before editing.

 Structure content to maximize viewer engagement and storytelling effectiveness.

 Create edits for:

o Corporate Films

o Brand Videos

o Social Media Content

o Advertisements

o Product Videos

o Explainer Videos

o Training \& E\-learning Videos

o Event Videos

o Interviews

o Testimonials

o Promotional Videos

o Podcasts \& Webinars

o Reels, Shorts \& YouTube Videos

o Rough Cut

o Final Cut

o Colour Correction

o Colour Grading

o Audio Cleanup

o Sound Mixing

o Background Music Integration

o Noise Reduction

o Subtitle Integration

o Captioning

o Video Compression

 Balance dialogue, background music, and sound effects.

 Remove unwanted background noise.

 Ensure professional audio quality across all deliverables.

title: Account Marketing Manager
description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

**Missions And Responsibilities Of The Role**
**Strategy:** 
 Person in this position will play a pivotal role in Thales growth trajectory in India . The person will be responsible for providing inputs and project managing the building of the growth strategies for the India region, closely working with key internal stakeholders and external partners.
   

  

**Marketing:** 
 Person in this position will collaborate with business leaders to understand and analyze the market, to ensure that Thales’ products \& services correspond to customer needs and expectations. The person in this role will also implement elements of the Corporate Marketing Plan for the Region.
   

  

**Outcomes: Strategy / Business Development:**
* Actively supports the annual rolling 5\-year regional/country strategic plans for alignment with GBUs, MoD strategic account plans, and country strategic plan, with clear understanding of the economic and industrial trends of the market (including customer needs and competitor offerings), Thales addressable market, and strategy to win keeping in mind Make in India obligations \- in order to secure Thales’ position and growth in the market.
* Execute continuous monitoring of the global trends, competitor activities, regulatory changes and emerging technologies. Address key questions to inform the Group on how India can play a role as a market, a supplier and an innovation engine
* Identify growth opportunities, organic and inorganic, and prepare report/ recommendations for management review/ action.
* Lead/Co\-lead critical special projects as needed in partnership with internal stakeholders. This would also include contributing to must\-win sales / pre\-sales engagements, including capture plans / GTM strategy, partner selection, competitive offense / defense strategies.
* Key responsibility to identify and nurture white spaces, to the point where it can be handed over to sales, in line with Group’s Gate review processes


**Outcomes: Marketing:**
* Generates a Marketing Plan aligned with the Country Strategic Plan (CSP) and coordinate corresponding actions
* Supports Key Account Managers/ Sales \& Business development teams in promoting Thales’ solutions during the upstream opportunity phase
* Understands/ analyses the customer’s mission, operational environment and priorities.
* Drives marketing efforts and defines the best solution (product/system/service) addressing customers’ needs during the upstream opportunity phase
* Analyze the accessible and non\-accessible market, customer needs and developments, budgeted investment programme, competition (strategy, products), and contribute to medium\-term order intake forecasts with the sales forces
* Deploys adapted tools to support strategic business intelligence and keep abreast of trends and competitor’s marketing movements.


**Candidate Qualifications/Requirements for the role:**
* Engineer OR MBA from premier business school.
* At least 8\+ years of experience in relevant industry preferably from Aerospace \& Defense and / or in management consulting .
* Experience working in a multi\-national organization. Ability to navigate a highly matrixed organization.
* International exposure (education, work experience) preferred.
* Adaptability in a fast\-evolving technological and geo\-political landscape.
* Excellent influencing and relationship\-building skills
* Results\-oriented, team player, excellent written and verbal communication skills, good attention to detail, strong project management skills and ability to work under pressure.


 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Senior Manager, Marketing Operations
description:
Daxko builds the software that powers fitness, wellness, and community organizations—everything from member management and payments to digital engagement and analytics. From small studios to the largest associations, we help thousands of fitness businesses streamline operations, enhance member experiences, and drive sustainable revenue growth.
   

  

 This role sits at the center of how Daxko's go\-to\-market engine runs. As
 **Senior Manager, Marketing Operations** 
 , you own the quality, completeness, and activation\-readiness of our customer and prospect data — the foundation everything else is built on. You'll design the architecture, lead a team of specialists, and make sure the data flowing into our campaigns, segments, and ABM programs is accurate, enriched, and ready to act on.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own data enrichment end\-to\-end: tool selection, provider management, AI\-assisted workflows, and the roadmap for maintaining best\-in\-class data completeness across the database
* Engineer multi\-source enrichment pipelines through Snowflake and Databricks into CDP activation layers, translating pipeline goals into clear data requirements and audience intelligence at scale
* Design and enforce governance standards across field ownership, enrichment source hierarchy, freshness SLAs, and tagging conventions; maintain data dictionaries that serve as the team's source of truth
* Own identity resolution logic, including merge rules, deduplication standards, and record governance, and define the field\-level segmentation and trigger criteria that make HubSpot and CDP data immediately activation\-ready
* Lead structured experimentation across enrichment sources, segmentation logic, and trigger criteria to improve downstream conversion; evaluate and sunset tools that no longer serve the stack
* Partner with demand gen, martech, and ops stakeholders to align data strategy with pipeline goals, ensuring the stack operates as a connected, high\-performing system
* Lead and develop a team of individual contributors: set clear goals, run regular 1:1s, support growth, and hold a high execution standard on QA, documentation, and data accuracy


**What You'll Bring**
* 5\+ years in marketing operations in a B2B SaaS environment
* Expert\-level HubSpot experience with direct ownership of database quality, enrichment programs, and MAP data architecture
* Deep, hands\-on experience with B2B enrichment platforms and data providers, including multi\-source layering and field\-level enrichment decisions
* Proven ability to design segmentation and trigger logic from the ground up, translating ICP and campaign criteria into scalable rules in HubSpot
* Experience building AI\-assisted enrichment workflows, with sound judgment on output quality, failure modes, and when human review is required
* Working knowledge of how data moves through a B2B MarTech stack, from enrichment provider into CRM through to campaign activation
* Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or equivalent relevant experience


**Nice to have**
* Working knowledge of SQL for data validation and enrichment logic review
* Experience with CDP concepts and how enriched data connects to triggered campaign infrastructure
* Familiarity with ABM platforms, intent data tools, or AI\-powered marketing automation
* HubSpot, Salesforce, or Google Analytics certifications


 Daxko is dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce. We are committed to diversity in the broadest sense, including thought and perspective, age, ability, nationality, ethnicity, orientation, and gender. The skills, perspectives, ideas, and experiences of all of our team members contribute to the vitality and success of our purpose and values.
   

  

 We truly care for our team members, and this is reflected through our offices, and benefits, and great perks. These perks are only for our full\-time team members.
   

  

**Some Of Our Favorites Include**
 🏢 🏡 Hybrid work model
   

  

 📆 Leave entitlements

 🍼 Paid parental leaves (Maternity, Paternity, \& Adoption)

title: Lead Growth Marketing - Faces
description:
Mandate 1 — Build a Profitable D2C Growth Model for Faces
   

  

 Canada
   

  

* Own the D2C P\&L — revenue, contribution margin, and forecast accuracy — against


 targets set and build a model to grow the D2C platform profitably
   

  

* Reconstruct the D2C P\&L from first principles: AOV, blended and paid CAC, discount


 rate, COGS, shipping, payment gateway cost, RTO cost, and contribution margin at
   

  

 order level and cohort level.
   

  

* Benchmark our unit economics against comparable Indian beauty D2C businesses and


 be clear about which of their models are structurally unavailable to us.
   

  

* Design and test the specific levers that can move contribution margin from negative or


 marginal to genuinely positive — assortment and bundle architecture, AOV thresholds,
   

  

 price and promotion architecture relative to marketplace, low\-CAC and zero\-CAC traffic
   

  

 sources, prepaid mix and RTO reduction, and repeat\-order economics.
   

  

* Run this as a series of structured, time\-boxed, instrumented experiments with a kill


 criterion for each. Come back within two quarters with either a validated, scalable model
   

  

 or a clear, evidenced recommendation on what D2C should be instead.
   

  

* Own the site experience and conversion funnel end to end, and the D2C tech stack


 decisions — storefront, checkout, CRM, analytics, shipping and OMS.
   

  

* Build lifecycle automation across WhatsApp, email, SMS and push: welcome,


 abandonment, replenishment triggers timed to actual product usage cycles and also
   

  

 cross category selling / upgrades
   

  

 Mandate 2 — Own Performance marketing overall for the Brand
   

  

 to enable demand generation and capture effectively and
   

  

 efficiently
   

  

 You own the media engine that creates and converts demand for the whole brand, not just for
   

  

 one channel.
   

  

 Demand generation and Capture \- mid to low funnel
   

  

* Plan and run the digital demand\-creation / Capture layer: Meta reach and video,


 YouTube, connected TV, programmatic and display, and paid amplification of creator
   

  

 assets in coordination with our influencer media model.
   

  

* Evaluate the impact of the performance marketing campaigns on direct sales growth on


 various Ecom platforms and accordingly scale/kill/optimize campaigns
   

  

* Run targeted CPAS campaigns on ecom platforms
* Build product\- and category\-level demand for priority launches and hero SKUs, not


 undifferentiated brand impressions.
   

  

* Own the creative testing engine. Beauty performance is won on hooks, shade


 demonstration and social proof — you will run high\-volume, disciplined creative testing
   

  

 and scale winners fast.
   

  

 Mandate 3 — Team, Partners and Measurement Infrastructure
   

  

* Lead a team of 2\-3 across performance, D2C operations and creative.
* Manage agencies on a scorecard and on outcomes. Set briefs, audit accounts, replace


 non\-performers.
   

  

* Build the measurement layer: a self\-serve daily and weekly dashboard in Looker Studio


 or Power BI that leadership can read without a translator, covering owned and
   

  

 marketplace media, D2C P\&L and cohort health.
   

  

* Present regular business reviews.


 What We Are Looking For
   

  

 \- 6–9 years in growth or digital marketing. Beauty, personal care or a comparable high\-
   

  

 frequency, high\-consideration FMCG category would be preferred
   

  

* Evidence of having built or fixed an economic model — turned a channel from


 unprofitable to profitable, or grown one while improving contribution margin. Growth
   

  

 achieved by spending more is not what we are hiring for.
   

  

* Fluency in unit economics as a working language: CM1, CM2, paid and blended CAC,


 cohort LTV, RTO cost, contribution per order.
   

  

* Hands\-on, account\-level command of Meta and Google — able to open an account and


 diagnose it in twenty minutes.
   

  

* Working idea of: Amazon Ads, Nykaa NMP, Flipkart Ads, Myntra M\-Ads.
* Managed a team of at least 2\-3 including hiring and performance management.
* GA4, plus the ability to build in Looker Studio or Power BI without waiting for an analyst.

description:
Company Description
 
  





 Digital Divide Data (DDD) delivers AI Data Solutions with human\-in\-the\-loop for LLMs and Physical AI, specializing in AI/ML model training and annotation services. Trusted by Fortune 500 companies and leading organizations in robotics, autonomous driving, government, defense tech, technology, AgTech, and cultural heritage, DDD helps ensure the safety, performance, and reliability of AI applications. DDD also offers Generative AI solutions such as NLP dataset creation, prompt engineering, model output evaluation, red teaming, reinforcement learning, fine\-tuning, and rigorous quality control. 
 



 Digital Divide Data is a mission driven social enterprise with the goal of using technology and digital skills to bridge the divide between economically and socially marginalized youth and employment opportunities that lead to a sustainable and viable future. Our headquarters are in New York, and we have over 2,500 employees across delivery centers in Kenya, Cambodia, Laos, Philippines, and India. 
 



 www.digitaldividedata.com
 



  




 About the Role
 
  






 In preparation for DDD’s next phase of growth, we're looking for a hands\-on
 
**Marketing and Revenue Operations Specialist** 

 to own the systems, data, and processes connecting marketing and sales in a fast\-moving organization. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining the integrity and performance of our HubSpot and Salesforce environments, transforming complex data into reliable dashboards that inform executive decision\-making, and establishing the operational infrastructure that aligns Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success into a cohesive revenue motion.
 





 This is a hands\-on position suited to a professional who is equally effective architecting Salesforce workflows, ensuring the accuracy and cleanliness of contact data, and presenting pipeline insights to senior leadership. The ideal candidate brings a disciplined approach to data governance and a proactive mindset toward reporting, delivering dashboards that anticipate the questions stakeholders need answered.
   






 Key Responsibilities
 

  





***Marketing Operations***



* Administer, configure, and optimize both HubSpot and Salesforce, including objects, fields, workflows, automation, permissions, and integrations between the two platforms and with Linkedin Sales Navigator, Apollo, Google Ads and other marketing stack.
* Own list segmentation, lead scoring, and database hygiene (deduping, enrichment, opt\-in compliance).
* Track campaign performance and report on cost\-per\-lead, conversion rates, and channel ROI.



***Revenue / Sales Operations***



* Administer the CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot), design, build, and maintain dashboards and reports across the full funnel\- lead\-to\-close, pipeline health, forecast accuracy, conversion rates, and revenue attribution for reps, managers, and executives.
* Own lead routing and the MQL\-to\-SQL handoff process between marketing and sales.
* Support basic forecasting, pipeline reviews, and deal tracking for the sales team.



***Reporting \& Analytics***



* Build and maintain dashboards covering funnel metrics, pipeline health, and marketing\-sourced revenue.
* Deliver weekly/monthly reporting to leadership on marketing and sales performance.



***Process \& Tools***



* Document processes and playbooks as the team scales.
* Evaluate and recommend new tools as budgets allow, keeping the stack lean and cost\-effective.
* Coordinate cross\-functionally with sales, marketing, and solutions team on shared definitions and SLAs.



 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 

  




* 8\-10 years of experience spanning marketing operations and/or sales/revenue operations, ideally in a B2B SaaS, IT services, or startup environment.
* Deep, hands\-on expertise in both
 
**HubSpot and Salesforce** 

 \- not just using them, but configuring, administering, and connecting them. Salesforce Administrator
* Proven track record of building dashboards and reports that drive decisions, including comfort with Salesforce reports/dashboards, HubSpot reporting, and ideally a BI tool (Looker Studio)
* Strong data management skills: you know how to model data cleanly, keep it clean, and diagnose why a number looks wrong.
* Solid grasp of the revenue funnel and GTM motions, how leads become pipeline and pipeline becomes revenue.
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to translate raw data into clear, actionable narratives for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Good communication skills to work directly with founders/leadership in a smaller, less hierarchical setup.
* Master's degree in marketing, business, or a related field.

title: Area Business Manager
description:
Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
   

  

 Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
   

  

 Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Position Summary You will lead commercial and team activities across a defined area in India to deliver measurable business results. You will build trusted relationships with healthcare professionals, hospital teams and internal partners to ensure high\-quality engagement. We value clarity, teamwork and practical problem solving. This role offers visible impact, career growth and the chance to help GSK unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following: \- Develop and deliver an area business plan that meets local objectives and patient needs. \- Build and maintain trusted relationships with clinicians, hospital teams and healthcare decision makers. \- Lead, coach and support field teams to achieve targets and grow professionally. \- Coordinate with medical, market access and marketing colleagues to align local activities. \- Use market and customer insights to refine plans and improve local decisions. \- Monitor area performance, manage budgets and ensure accurate, timely reporting. Why You? Basic Qualification We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals \- Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, nursing, business or related field. \- Minimum 3 years’ experience in pharmaceutical field roles, territory management or sales. \- Experience managing teams or leading field activities. \- Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills. \- Comfortable using CRM systems, Microsoft Office and digital tools. \- Valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel across the assigned area. Preferred Qualification If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus \- Experience working with hospitals, specialty or tertiary care providers. \- Background in specialty or complex therapeutic areas. \- Experience collaborating with medical affairs, access or procurement teams. \- Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into practical actions. \- Prior coaching, mentoring or line management experience. \- Familiarity with virtual customer engagement and omnichannel approaches. Working arrangement This role is on\-site with regular travel across the assigned area. Hybrid working options may be discussed based on business needs and local policy. What we value in you We value clear communicators who listen and learn. We look for people who work well with others and put patients first. You should be curious, adaptable and comfortable making decisions with incomplete information. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply. How to apply If this role motivates you and you want to grow while making a real difference to patients, please submit your CV and a short note explaining your interest. We look forward to hearing how you can contribute to our work to get ahead of disease together.
   

  

**Skills**
 Customer Centric Selling, Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Omnichannel, Sales Territory Management, Scientific Literacy
   

  

**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
 GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2\.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
   

  

 People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
   

  

**Inclusion at GSK:**
 As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
   

  

 Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment\-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
   

  

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
 GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.
