title: Digital Shelf Manager
description:
**About the Role:**
 The Digital Shelf Manager is responsible for maximizing product visibility, discoverability, content quality and conversion across marketplaces, quick commerce and eB2B platforms. The role will own digital shelf excellence by ensuring accurate and compelling product content, high availability, strong search performance, pricing compliance and competitive visibility. This position will work closely with internal cross\-functional teams, platform partners and external agencies to drive best\-in\-class online shopper experiences and support sustainable e\-commerce growth.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities:**
 Digital Shelf Management
   

  

* Own and manage digital shelf health across marketplaces, quick commerce and eB2B platforms.
* Ensure complete and accurate product content across all online channels, maintaining high standards of digital shelf excellence.
* Drive continuous improvements in product page quality, visibility and shopper experience.


**Product Content \& Catalog Management**
* Manage end\-to\-end product listings, including titles, descriptions, images, videos, A\+ content, keywords, attributes and product page optimization.
* Ensure all product content aligns with brand guidelines and platform requirements.
* Identify and address gaps in hero images, pack shots, product claims, benefit communication and conversion\-driving content.


**Search \& Discoverability Optimization**
* Improve organic search rankings and product discoverability across platforms.
* Optimize keyword strategies and content to increase share of shelf for priority SKUs.
* Monitor and enhance product visibility through ongoing search performance analysis.


**Availability, Pricing \& Compliance Monitoring**
* Track product availability, out\-of\-stock levels and assortment performance across platforms.
* Ensure pricing hygiene and compliance with platform\-specific pricing policies.
* Monitor content compliance, ratings, reviews and platform standards to maintain brand consistency.


**Competitive Intelligence**
* Monitor competitor listings, content quality, pricing, assortment, promotions, ratings, reviews and search visibility.
* Identify marketplace trends, emerging opportunities and competitive threats.
* Translate competitive insights into actionable recommendations for business growth.


**New Product Launch Support**
* Support new product introductions through timely listing creation, content readiness, keyword mapping and platform asset deployment.
* Ensure seamless execution of launch plans across digital commerce platforms.
* Track launch performance and provide recommendations to improve visibility and sales outcomes.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Partner closely with Brand, Category, E\-Commerce, Media, Supply Chain and Agency teams to execute digital shelf initiatives.
* Work with platform teams and account managers to resolve catalog, content, listing and visibility issues.
* Coordinate stakeholder alignment to ensure timely implementation of content and visibility enhancements.


**Review \& Consumer Insights Management**
* Monitor consumer ratings and reviews across platforms.
* Identify recurring product, content and service\-related improvement opportunities based on shopper feedback.
* Collaborate with relevant teams to address consumer concerns and improve overall customer experience.


**Performance Tracking \& Reporting**
* Develop and maintain digital shelf scorecards covering content quality, search performance, availability, pricing, ratings and competitive benchmarks.
* Analyze digital shelf performance metrics and identify areas for improvement.
* Prepare weekly, monthly and quarterly business reports with insights, action plans and accountability tracking.


**About You:**
* 5\-8 years of experience in E\-Commerce, Digital Commerce, Digital Shelf Management, Category Management or Online Marketplace Operations
* Experience working with major marketplaces, quick commerce platforms and eB2B channels
* Strong understanding of digital shelf analytics, marketplace algorithms and content optimization practices

In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for developing and executing 1:1 and 1:few Strategic Account Marketing plans to accelerate growth in our most important accounts that have a large developer and technical team presence in India. You will be a highly strategic, results\-driven professional with a passion for marketing and a direct impact on our developer mindshare, upmarket initiatives, and revenue goals.



This position will report to the Head of India Marketing, although will work very closely with with EMEA and AMER Strategic Account Marketing leaders, and the larger APJ marketing team.



We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.


### **Primary Responsibilities:**


* Develop and execute strategic marketing programs for select Global accounts with developer arms in India. Work closely with account teams to uncover account\-specific challenges, understand decision\-making processes, and identify key personas, to drive the creation and execution of tailored marketing strategies and messaging that address the unique needs and interests of each account, unlock senior leadership and buying team engagement, and lead to growth opportunities. You'll work closely with the strategic account marketing leads, developer advocacy teams, sales teams and customers to ensure delivery of a holistic DevRel Marketing program within each account.
* Bring the marketing expertise: Act as a strategic marketing consultant to sales teams and clients, recommending tailored programs and tactics that align with both sales objectives and client needs.

* GTM alignment: Work closely with the sales team to align marketing efforts with sales goals, provide sales enablement resources, ensure smooth handoff of qualified leads, and communicate and educate the sales team regarding new and planned marketing activities including global, regional, and account specific programs.
* Measure impact \& optimize: Track performance metrics and ROI, ensuring processes are in place to evaluate the effectiveness of your programs, and apply insights to refine and optimize ABM campaigns for maximum impact.

### **We're looking for someone with:**


* Educational and Professional Background:
* + Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience.
	+ 12\+ years of account marketing, field marketing, industry marketing or sales experience in the Tech area.
	+ Experience working with large and complex Global enterprise accounts across multiple verticals including: FSI, Manufacturing, Automotive Retail, and others, with a proven success record in planning and executing effective marketing programs
* Skills and Expertise:
* + Experience with strategic 1:1 or 1:few account\-based marketing, leveraging multi\-channel tactics across digital and F2F.
	+ Experience working with cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), ISV, AI, and other tech partners.
	+ Incredible written and oral communication skills, including experience presenting to sales and marketing leadership, as well as customers.
	+ Impeccable event and project management skills, ensuring seamless planning, coordination, and delivery of initiatives with an ability to problem\-solve quickly.
	+ Results\-oriented and analytically skilled, capable of interpreting data, making informed data\-driven decisions, and reporting insights to the business.
	+ AI\-savvy with strong desire to understand and learn how AI tools and processes can be used in daily work.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration:
* + Experience working cross\-functionally with enterprise or corporate sales, customer success teams, and account development teams, obsessing over addressable market and specific account goals.
	+ Capable of establishing credibility with sales partners to effectively convey marketing value propositions and key messages.
* Technical Proficiency:
* + Proficiency with Google Workspace and Salesforce, and marketing technology tools like 6sense, Eloqua, Pathfactory, Sigma, Tableau.
* Attributes and Work Style:
* + Must be a highly self\-motivated, entrepreneurial professional who can excel in an autonomous work environment and proactively drive initiatives.
	+ Ability to leverage data to inform decisions and strategic plans.
	+ Bring a strategic and creative mindset to the team, collaborating effectively to generate new ideas.
	+ Growth mindset and results\-oriented
	+ Team ethos is made up of good humor, a positive can\-do attitude, yet high standards and focused on impact.
	+ Time management, prioritization, and organizational skills are key.
* Additional Requirements:
* + Proven experience working with Global teams and key APAC markets, including India, Vietnam, Thailand, and China.
	+ Travel as required.

#### **Success Measures:**



The Strategic Accounts Marketing Programs Manager will be successful in this role when they can execute the following strategic tasks/responsibilities:


* In 3 months you'll have fostered a relationship with your Sales Account teams (ex: sales, solution architects, field partner leads, customer success) to understand their account priorities, begin planning marketing programs, and ramp on current account status and MongoDB product knowledge.
* In 6 months you'll have a clear understanding of your key objectives, have executed marketing activities with pipeline influence, and have started to become a trusted partner to your account stakeholders.
* In 12 months you'll have cemented yourself as a key account partner, be fully ramped and actioning against all account objectives.

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing & Community Associate SkillUpExchange 
 25,000/month + performance bonus up to 35,000/quarter Full-time | In-office | Mumbai 
 Build relationships with technology professionals and help us build the distribution engine for a new technology publishing and learning company. 
 About SkillUpExchange 
 SkillUpExchange is building a new kind of technology publishing and learning company. 
 We work with experienced technology professionals and developers to create high-quality technical books, courses, audiobooks, and other learning products. 
 Our technology platform, AuthPlat , helps experts turn their knowledge into professionally produced technical content. SkillUpExchange is the consumer platform where these books and learning products are published, distributed, and connected with a broader technology learning community. 
 We are an early-stage company, which means you will not simply be executing an established marketing plan. You will help us build the plan and the processes themselves. 
 Our immediate focus is to build relationships with developers and technology professionals who can become readers, early learners, community members, advocates, course participants, and eventually even authors and instructors. 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for a Marketing & Community Associate to help us build our technology community and distribution function. 
 This is a people + research + communication + execution role. A significant part of your day will involve identifying relevant technology professionals, researching their backgrounds and interests, reaching out to them through LinkedIn, starting conversations, introducing them to relevant books and learning products, and developing those relationships over time. 
 You will also work with our authors to build awareness for their books, support social media activity, develop partnerships with newsletters and technology creators, and maintain our growing community database. The role is particularly suited to someone who genuinely enjoys talking to people, is curious about technology, and likes building things from scratch. 
 You do not need to be a software developer. You do need to be comfortable learning about technology and communicating with people who work in technology. 
 What You Will Do 1. Technology Community Outreach Identify relevant developers, engineers, technology professionals, technical leaders and technology enthusiasts on LinkedIn. Build relationships with approximately 40 relevant professionals per working day . Use the founder's LinkedIn network as well as your own professional network for outreach. Research people before contacting them and understand why a particular person may be relevant to a particular book or learning product. Send personalized introductory messages and follow up appropriately. Maintain conversations rather than treating outreach as a one-time activity. Invite relevant professionals to participate as early readers, community members, or learning participants. Build long-term relationships that can be useful across multiple books and products. 
 2. Community & Relationship Management You will maintain our relationship database in Zoho Bigin . You will record useful information such as: Who we have contacted Their role and company Technology interests Which books they may be interested in Conversations and responses Early-reader participation Course or learning interests Partnership opportunities Potential future author/instructor opportunities Follow-up dates and next actions The objective is not simply to generate contacts. Every relationship we create should make future distribution easier. 
 3. Author Support & Social Media Work with our authors to help them build awareness for their books. This will include: Preparing LinkedIn content ideas for authors. Creating approximately 2 posts per week for each active author . Giving authors content options they can review and approve. Coordinating publishing schedules. Reminding authors about scheduled posts. Helping authors turn their expertise, book launches and ideas into useful social content. Preparing content for SkillUpExchange, AuthPlat and the founder's LinkedIn presence. 
 4. Partnerships Research and develop relationships with people and organizations that already have audiences interested in technology. Potential partners include: Technology newsletters Technical bloggers YouTubers Podcasts Developer communities Technology educators Community organizers Relevant online publications You will build prospect lists, initiate conversations, and track partnerships from first contact through to publication or collaboration. 
 5. Measure, Learn & Improve Because we are an early-stage company, part of your job is to help us understand what actually works . You will track the journey from: People identified contacted connected responded interested read engaged became community members purchased/participated 
 You will review the results and help us improve our approach. We care about quality of relationships, not just the number of messages sent. 
 What We Are Looking For 
 You could be a great fit if you are: Curious about technology and enjoy learning new things. Naturally comfortable talking to people. Confident communicating with professionals and senior people. Strong in written and spoken English. Good at researching people and understanding what they do. Persistent without being pushy. Organized and consistent. Comfortable working with targets and measurable goals. Interested in LinkedIn and online communities. Comfortable using AI tools and learning new software. Ambitious and interested in taking ownership. Someone who enjoys building something from scratch. 
 You do NOT need: Prior publishing experience. A traditional marketing degree. Previous Developer Relations experience. To be a software developer. An MBA. Experience at a large technology company. 
 We are more interested in your curiosity, communication skills, initiative, and ability to build relationships than your degree or previous job title. 
 Who Would Be Especially Suitable? This role could be a particularly good fit for: Recent graduates in engineering, computer science or related fields. Students or graduates who are active in technology communities. People who enjoy LinkedIn and online networking. Candidates with strong communication skills who want to work in technology. Early-career candidates interested in marketing, community building, developer relations, technology publishing or technology business. Candidates who have organized college technology events, communities or clubs. People who enjoy meeting new people and starting conversations. 
 What Success Looks Like In your first few months, success will mean building a real and growing network of relevant technology professionals . You will be expected to contribute to: Growth of our developer and technology professional network. Early-reader participation for our books. Genuine Amazon reviews and reader feedback. LinkedIn visibility and author-generated content. Newsletter, creator and community partnerships. Growth of our CRM/community database. Better understanding of which outreach and distribution channels work. 
 The most important thing is that you help us move from: We have published a book. to “We know how to consistently find the right people to read it.” 
 Compensation & Benefits Salary 25,000 per month 
 Performance Bonus The role has a quarterly performance bonus of up to 35,000 , based on achievement against agreed distribution and community-building objectives. 
 Quarterly AchievementBonus Below 30%030–39%040–49%5,00050–59%10,00060–69%15,00070–79%20,00080–89%25,00090–99%30,000100%+ 35,000 
 Performance will consider both results and quality of execution . Spam, irrelevant outreach, misleading communication, or attempts to manipulate reviews will not qualify as successful performance. 
 Work Location & Schedule Location: Mumbai This is primarily an in-office role because you will work closely with the founder and the rest of the team while we build the distribution function. 
 Monday–Friday: Office 1st, 3rd and 5th Saturday: Working 2nd and 4th Saturday: Off Up to 2 WFH days per month 
 Why Join Us? This is an opportunity to join a company at a very early stage and help build an important function from the ground up. You will not be joining an established marketing department with a predefined process. 
 You will help us build: 
 technology publishing community distribution learning The role will give you exposure to: Technology marketing Community building Developer relations LinkedIn and social media Partnerships CRM and relationship management AI-assisted research and marketing Technology publishing Building distribution for a product from the ground up 
 As the company grows, this role can develop into broader responsibilities across Developer Relations, Community, Developer Programs, Technology Publishing and Author/Content Acquisition. If you are ambitious, curious about technology and enjoy building relationships with people, this is an opportunity to have a much larger impact than you would typically have in an entry-level role at a large company. 
 How to Apply 
 Please send your resume along with a short note explaining why you think you would be good at building relationships with technology professionals. 
 Candidates may also be asked to complete a short practical exercise involving: Finding relevant technology professionals for a technical book. Explaining why those people are relevant. Writing an introductory LinkedIn message. Thinking through how they would build a relationship with someone who responds. 
 We care more about how you think and communicate than about having the perfect resume.

title: Digital Marketing Assistant
description:
Digital Marketing Account Manager Performance Marketing & Social Media Company: SK Consulting Marketing
 Location: Central Delhi
 Work Mode: In-Office
 Employment Type: Full-Time 
 About SK Consulting Marketing 
 SK Consulting Marketing is a strategic digital marketing agency helping Luxury, Lifestyle, Healthcare, EdTech and Personal Brands drive measurable business growth through the combination of experienced marketing professionals and AI-powered marketing systems. We work across Brand Marketing, Content Marketing, Social Media, Performance Marketing, SEO, CRM, Funnels and AI-led marketing operations. We are looking for a Digital Marketing Account Manager who can independently manage the day-to-day digital marketing operations of multiple clients and take ownership of performance, execution and client communication. 
 The Role This is not a pure social media or client servicing role. The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable with: Managing client accounts Planning and executing digital marketing strategies Running and optimizing Meta Ads & Google Ads Managing social media operations Analysing campaign performance Communicating with clients Coordinating with creative/content teams Using AI to improve everyday marketing operations Identifying opportunities to improve client results and agency processes 
 You will be expected to think, execute, analyse and proactively solve problems rather than simply follow instructions. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Performance Marketing Plan, launch, manage and optimize Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns. Manage campaigns across Lead Generation, Sales, Traffic, Remarketing and Conversion objectives. Conduct audience, keyword, competitor and campaign research. Monitor CPL, CPA, ROAS, CTR, CPC, CVR and other relevant performance metrics. Analyse campaign performance and identify opportunities for optimization. Manage campaign budgets and allocation across platforms. Develop hypotheses, test creatives/audiences/campaign structures and implement learnings. Understand conversion tracking, pixels, events and basic GA4/GTM concepts. Prepare performance reports with clear business insights and recommendations. 
 2. Social Media Operations Develop and execute social media strategies for multiple client accounts. Manage monthly content calendars and ensure timely execution. Coordinate with graphic designers, video editors, copywriters and other team members. Review content before client submission/publishing. Track content performance and recommend improvements. Stay updated with Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube trends and platform developments. 
 3. Account Management Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients. Conduct regular client calls and communicate campaign progress, challenges and opportunities. Understand client business objectives and translate them into marketing actions. Manage timelines, deliverables and internal teams. Proactively identify problems before they become client escalations. Build strong, professional client relationships. 
 4. AI & Marketing Innovation This is an important part of the role. We are looking for someone who is AI-friendly and curious about how AI can fundamentally improve the way a marketing agency operates. You should be comfortable using AI tools for: Campaign analysis Research Content ideation Copywriting Reporting Competitor analysis Client communication SOP creation Data analysis Workflow automation Marketing strategy Productivity and operational efficiency More importantly, you should be able to identify new ways of using AI to make the agency faster, smarter and more scalable. What We're Looking For 
 Mandatory 2-4 years of relevant digital marketing experience Strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads Experience managing multiple client accounts Good understanding of social media marketing Strong analytical and problem-solving ability Excellent written and spoken English Strong client communication skills Ability to independently manage deadlines and priorities Comfortable working in a fast-paced agency environment Strong interest in AI and emerging marketing technologies 
 Preferred Prior experience in a digital marketing/advertising agency Experience with both lead-generation and e-commerce campaigns Google Analytics / GA4 Google Tag Manager Looker Studio CRM / marketing automation WhatsApp marketing SEO fundamentals Shopify / e-commerce ecosystem Experience using AI tools beyond basic content generation 
 The Kind of Person We Want 
 We are looking for someone who is: 
 Proactive Doesn't wait to be told every next step. Analytical Looks at numbers and understands what they mean for the business. Client-oriented – Can communicate confidently and professionally with business owners and senior stakeholders. AI-native – Uses AI to improve how they work rather than treating it as just a content-writing tool. Accountable – Takes ownership of outcomes, deadlines and client requirements. Curious – Constantly learns, experiments and brings new ideas to the table. Execution-focused – Can turn strategy into actual campaigns, content and measurable outcomes. 
 Why Join SK Consulting Marketing? Work directly with multiple Luxury, Lifestyle, Healthcare, EdTech and Personal Brands Opportunity to work across both strategy and execution Exposure to Meta Ads, Google Ads, social media, funnels, CRM and AI High ownership and autonomy Opportunity to build AI-powered marketing processes within a growing agency Work closely with the Founder/Strategic Head Hybrid working environment in Central Delhi Opportunity to grow into a senior account/strategy role 
 Candidates with exceptional hands-on expertise may be considered outside this range. How to Apply Please apply with: Updated CV Brief summary of your experience managing Meta Ads + Google Ads Examples of campaigns/accounts you have personally managed, wherever possible A short note describing how you currently use AI in your daily marketing workflow 
 Only candidates with strong hands-on experience in both Meta Ads and Google Ads will be considered.

Basic understanding of SEO and keyword research is an advantage. Basic knowledge of digital marketing tools and analytics platforms is preferred. Good research, analytical, and organizational skills. Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines. Willingness to learn and adapt to new tools and marketing trends. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor s degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, English, Business, or a related field. 6 months to 1 year of experience in digital marketing, content marketing, social media, or a related role. **Company Description** 
 Unit 9 Technologies is a trusted supplier of advanced battery solutions for industrial applications, partnering with leading manufacturers of lithium, VRLA, and nickel\-cadmium batteries. The company specializes in understanding complex industrial power requirements and matching them with reliable, high\-performance battery technologies. Solutions are tailored for use cases such as backup power, operational continuity, and specialized energy storage, with a strong emphasis on quality and consistency. Unit 9 Technologies is committed to delivering long\-term value through performance, reliability, and ongoing support that industrial customers can depend on.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Sales Marketing Engineer role based in Chennai. The role involves identifying and qualifying industrial customers, presenting battery solutions aligned with their power requirements, and managing the full sales cycle from lead generation to closing. Daily tasks include conducting market research, preparing technical and commercial proposals, engaging in customer meetings and product demonstrations, and coordinating with internal engineering and operations teams to ensure accurate solution design and delivery. The Sales Marketing Engineer will also support marketing campaigns, maintain sales documentation and CRM records, provide post\-sale support, and contribute feedback to improve product positioning and customer experience.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and Market Research abilities for understanding industrial power requirements and identifying opportunities.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills for customer interaction, presentations, and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Candidates should possess solid Sales skills for lead generation, negotiations, and closing deals in technical or industrial markets.
* Candidates should possess Marketing skills for supporting campaigns, creating collateral, and positioning battery solutions effectively.
* Relevant engineering background (electrical, electronics, or related field) and familiarity with industrial battery technologies are highly beneficial.
* Experience in B2B or industrial sales, proficiency with CRM tools, and strong organizational skills are preferred.
* Ability to work on\-site in Chennai, travel to customer locations as needed, and collaborate within a diverse, inclusive team environment.

title: Sales Marketing Manager
description:
**Role Purpose
 



  





 The Regional Manager \- HVAC \& Ventilation Systems will be responsible for developing KOHMER as a preferred air\-movement and ventilation solutions brand within the assigned territory.
 



 The position combines technical HVAC knowledge, specification selling, consultant engagement, OEM development and project\-based business development. The candidate will understand customer requirements involving airflow, static pressure, efficiency, acoustics, motor/control technology and application conditions, and work with KOHMER's engineering team to propose technically and commercially appropriate fan and ventilation solutions.
 



 The role supports KOHMER's portfolio across EC/AC fans, centrifugal and plenum solutions, industrial axial fans, cabinet plug fans, fan wheels and related air\-movement applications for HVAC, AHUs, data centres, industrial ventilation, cooling and process applications.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Regional Business Development
 



 • Develop and execute the regional business plan for KOHMER ventilation products.
 



 • Identify HVAC and industrial projects at concept, design, tender and execution stages and build a healthy opportunity pipeline.
 



 • Take ownership of lead generation, technical\-commercial proposals, negotiations, order conversion and account development.
 



 2\. Consultant \& Specification Development
 



 • Build strong relationships with MEP consultants, HVAC consultants, architects, PMC/EPC organizations and design engineers.
 



 • Conduct technical presentations, product demonstrations and design discussions to establish KOHMER products in consultant specifications, approved vendor lists and project schedules.
 



 • Track projects from initial specification through tendering, contractor selection and final order conversion.
 



 3\. HVAC OEM \& AHU Business
 



 • Develop strategic relationships with AHU manufacturers and OEMs, HVAC equipment manufacturers, system integrators, ventilation contractors, MEP contractors, data\-centre solution providers and industrial equipment manufacturers.
 



 • Identify opportunities for product standardization and recurring/OEM business rather than relying only on individual project sales.
 



 4\. Technical Solution Selling
 



 • Interpret project requirements including airflow, static pressure, fan efficiency, acoustic requirements, operating temperature, space limitations, motor/control requirements and installation configuration.
 



 • Coordinate with KOHMER engineering/application teams for fan selection, technical submittals, drawings and performance data.
 



 • Support commercial HVAC and industrial ventilation applications involving EC fans, plenum/plug fans, centrifugal/backward\-curved fans and industrial axial fans.
 



 5\. Project \& Application Development
 



 • Develop opportunities across commercial buildings, factories, warehouses, data centres, pharmaceutical facilities, food processing, hospitals, cleanrooms, industrial plants, cooling systems, railway/mobility applications and process ventilation.
 



 • Explore broader industrial applications including chemical, mining, textile, paper \& pulp, tunnel ventilation and air\-pollution\-control systems where relevant.
 



 6\. Key Account Management
 



 • Identify and develop strategic accounts with long\-term business potential.
 



 • Establish account plans for consultants, OEMs, contractors and major end users.
 



 • Maintain disciplined follow\-up from enquiry through technical approval, quotation, negotiation, purchase order, delivery and post\-sales coordination.
 



 7\. Commercial \& Revenue Responsibility
 



 • Own the assigned region's Order Intake, Revenue, Gross Margin, Collections and Pipeline.
 



 • Prepare monthly forecasts and maintain CRM\-based opportunity tracking.
 



 • Monitor pricing, competition and market trends while maintaining commercial discipline.
 



 8\. Market \& Competition Intelligence
 



 • Monitor competing fan and ventilation technologies, pricing, consultant preferences and emerging HVAC requirements.
 



 • Provide structured feedback to management regarding product gaps, new\-product opportunities, regional pricing and application trends.
 



 9\. Technical Marketing \& Brand Development
 



 • Represent KOHMER at ISHRAE/ASHRAE programs, HVAC conferences, exhibitions, technical seminars, consultant meets and industry forums.
 



 • Conduct technical sessions for consultants and customers on fan selection, EC/PM technology, energy\-efficient ventilation, acoustics and system optimization.
 



 10\. Site \& Project Coordination
 



 • Conduct project/site visits to understand installation conditions and coordinate technical requirements between customers, contractors and the factory/application engineering team.
 



 • Support troubleshooting and ensure effective technical\-commercial closure of project issues.
 



 Candidate Profile
 



 Education: BE/B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering preferred. Diploma Mechanical candidates with strong relevant HVAC/fan experience may also be considered. MBA/PGDM in Marketing or Sales will be an advantage.
 



 Experience: Ideally 5\-10 years in HVAC, ventilation, fans, AHUs, air movement, industrial ventilation or related engineered products.
 



 Market Exposure: Preference for candidates with demonstrated relationships among HVAC/MEP consultants, AHU manufacturers, contractors, OEMs and industrial customers.
 



 Essential Technical Knowledge
 



 Airflow (CMH/CFM) \| Static/Total Pressure \| Fan Curves \| Fan Selection \| Fan Efficiency \| System Resistance \| RPM \| Motor Power \| EC/PM/AC Motors \| VFD Controls \| Axial Fans \| Centrifugal/Backward\-Curved Fans \| Plenum/Plug Fans \| Acoustics/Noise \| AHU Applications \| Supply/Exhaust Ventilation
 



 Exposure to AMCA 210 / ISO 5801 fan\-performance concepts and testing practices will be particularly valuable.
 



 Key Competencies
 



 • Technical credibility combined with strong commercial drive.
 



 • Ability to discuss fan performance and system requirements confidently with HVAC consultants and design engineers.
 



 • Strong B2B project\-sales, negotiation, presentation and networking capability.
 



 • Disciplined project tracking, CRM usage, forecasting and reporting.
 



 • Independent working style with strong internal collaboration and ownership.
 



 • Willingness to travel frequently for consultant, customer, OEM and project/site meetings.**

description:
Founding Marketing Member
 
  





**HSR Layout · On\-site · Full\-time · Reports to the founders** 

 ·
 
**₹5–6 LPA \+ life changing equity** 




**Track to Head of Marketing** 




  





 Consumer business, home services. We sell to parents in Bangalore. Just raised. Right now marketing is the founders doing it between everything else, and that stops working next month. You're the first marketing hire.
   




 The job
 
 You own all things marketing. Paid, organic, content, community, partnerships, brand. If it brings a parent or a caregiver to us, it's yours.
 



  





 You run it with your own hands. Google Ads and Meta Ads are yours from day one. You set up the campaigns, write the copy, make the creatives, manage the budget, read the numbers every morning, and kill what isn't working before it eats the month.
 



  





 Around that: landing pages, WhatsApp funnels, referrals, apartment and parent communities, content, partnerships. We sell to parents and we also recruit caregivers, so you'll run acquisition on both sides of the business.
 



  





 You'll have the freedom to bring in interns and freelancers when the work needs more hands, and you'll decide who and when.
 



  





 What you'll be measured on is simple. Cost per lead, cost per customer, and how many of those customers stay.
 



  





 High ownership, high agency. The wins are yours and so are the misses. As the team grows, this role is built to become Head of Marketing.
 



  




 You'll do well here if
 
  




* Your English writing is in the top 1%. Every ad, landing page, and WhatsApp message you write will be read by parents deciding who looks after their child. Sloppy copy costs us trust.
* You communicate clearly and briefly, in writing and in person.

**Job Description**
**About Datahash**
 Datahash is a privacy\-centric first\-party data platform. Our core product, Datahash Signals, gives marketers low\-code, no\-code integrations between web, app, e\-commerce, CRM, marketing automation and data warehouses on one side and the major ad channels on the other: Meta, Google, TikTok, Snap, Amazon and more. We are one of a handful of badged integration partners across these channels and work with them directly on first\-party data adoption programmes, where advertisers are moving to server\-side integrations, conversions APIs and privacy\-safe measurement. We are bootstrapped, profitable, and run across Dubai, Bangalore, Mumbai and London with clients in EMEA, India, Africa, APAC and the US.
   

  

**The role**
 Marketing at Datahash runs agent\-first: a marketing head agent plans, content and page agents produce, an inbound agent qualifies, and named humans approve. This seat is for the person who directs that machine: an operator who owns the voice, the partner\-marketing relationships with Meta, Google, Snap and TikTok, and the demand numbers, and who directs the agents rather than replacing them. You will not be asked to build the machine; it exists. You will be asked to make it produce leads and to make Datahash sound like one company.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own the number. Marketing\-qualified leads from 25 to 100 a month across eight engines, with the segment, journey and content calendar the agents run reviewed by you weekly.
* Own the voice. Every external asset sounds like Datahash: you set the standard, the agents produce to it, and you are the final human read on anything public.
* Own the partner marketing. Co\-marketing programmes and MDF with the channel partners, from claim to campaign, in partnership with the Growth Manager (Channel Partnerships).
* Direct the agents. Brief them, correct them, measure them: acceptance rate, cost per accepted output and the override log are your management tools.
* Launch. Run the SYNAPSE launch communications and the design\-partner programme to the existing base.


**What Success Looks Like**
* MQL ramp on plan with source and quality tracked.
* Case studies shipping monthly with consent, in the three registers we use.
* Partner co\-marketing live with at least one channel per quarter.
* Agent acceptance rates rising quarter on quarter under your direction.


**How We Hire**
 We move fast and we are transparent about how we decide. Every decision about a person is made by a person.
   

  

 Step 1: a short structured screen within two working days of applying. Step 2: a 50\-minute conversation with the hiring manager. Step 3: a small case exercise close to the real work, which you present to two or three of us. Step 4: fit and terms with our VP Delivery or Head of Sales and Partnerships, and for senior roles the founder. We aim to give you a decision within five working days of the final conversation.
   

  

 We evaluate evidence rather than claims, the quality of your questions, how you handle ambiguity, and how naturally you already use AI in your own work.
   

  

**Requirements**
**What we need from you**
* Five to eight years in B2B marketing for SaaS, adtech or martech with demand and content ownership.
* You have worked with platform partner marketing teams (Google, Meta or similar) and know how co\-marketing funds actually get spent.
* A strong editorial eye and a plain writing style; you can tell AI cadence from a human sentence and fix it.
* Daily, expert use of AI tools; you have already directed AI\-produced content at volume.
* Comfort with analytics: GA4, CRM reporting, attribution.


**Nice to have**
* Experience launching a product to an installed base.
* Experience in a company below 100 people where you were the whole marketing function.


**Probably not a fit if**
* You want a team of humans to manage; the team is mostly agents.
* You would rather write everything yourself than direct production.


**Benefits**
* A startup environment backed by a stable, bootstrapped, profitable business.
* Competitive compensation and one of the most employee\-friendly ESOP programmes in the industry.
* Work from anywhere, on your hours; coworking access when you want a change from home.
* Health cover for you and your family.
* Real international exposure: clients and partners across the Gulf, Europe, Africa, India, APAC and the US.
* A yearly offsite that we take seriously, and a culture that does not.


 Datahash is an equal\-opportunity employer. We hire on evidence and fit for the work and do not ask for salary history. Compensation is discussed at the fit\-and\-terms stage.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**About RenewCO2**




 RenewCO2 makes carbon\-negative chemicals and fuels. Our electrocatalytic CO2 utilization technology runs on electricity, water, and waste CO2, and the product drops straight into existing industrial supply chains. Because the process is energy\-efficient, our cost structure competes with fossil\-derived incumbents rather than relying on a green premium.
 



  





 We are venture\-backed with grant funding from the U.S. Department of Energy, NSF, DARPA, the New Jersey Commission on Science, Innovation and Technology, and Breakthrough Energy. The technology is demonstrated at pilot scale with customers, and we are now building toward commercial scale. R\&D is based in the United States; product development and manufacturing happen in India. Our customers are chemical, fuel, and materials producers across Asia, Europe, and North and Latin America.
 



  





 This role is based in Chikkaballapur, Karnataka, at Ohmium International, which builds green hydrogen electrolyzers at a gigafactory there. RenewCO2 has a joint development agreement with Ohmium: working beside a partner that already makes electrochemical stacks at volume shortens our path to manufacturing at scale.
 



  





**The role**




 You will be our first marketing hire in India, owning marketing execution: what we say, where we say it, and whether the market takes us seriously. This is a build job — no playbook, no large budget, no agency doing the thinking.
 



  





 Our buyers are chemical producers, fuel producers, industrial gas companies, EPC contractors, and licensors. They make eight\-figure decisions slowly, with a technical committee in the room. Your job is to make RenewCO2 legible to that audience and make a small team read as the serious technology company it is. You will work with a Brand \& Marketing Designer, hiring in parallel, and directly with technical and commercial leadership in the U.S.
 



  





**What you will do**




*Positioning and messaging* 



* Own the messaging architecture: what RenewCO2 is, what each product line solves, why our approach wins on cost and energy efficiency, and what we can and cannot claim today.
* Turn technical and techno\-economic material into arguments that hold up in front of a process engineer and a CFO in the same meeting.
* Track adjacent CO2 conversion, power\-to\-X, and low\-carbon chemical players, and feed that back into positioning and commercial strategy.



  





*Content* 



* Run the content calendar: technical posts, bylined articles, case notes, explainers, LinkedIn, newsletters.
* Write and place bylines and interviews in the trade press our buyers actually read — chemicals, energy, hydrogen, aviation fuel, and polymers.
* Write and submit award applications; handle analyst and industry\-database relationships.



  





*Website and digital* 



* Run the website as a commercial asset: information architecture, copy, publishing cadence, on\-page SEO, conversion paths. You publish in the CMS directly with the designer.
* Run LinkedIn as our main organic and paid channel, plus targeted email.
* Set up the measurement layer: GA4, CRM hygiene, UTM discipline. Report on what produces qualified conversations.



  





*Events and conferences* 



* Own the conference program: which events, abstract and speaking submissions, booth briefs, pre\-show outreach, meeting scheduling, follow\-up, and cost reporting.
* Prepare spokespeople with slides, talk tracks, likely questions, and clear boundaries on what is public.



  





*Commercial and investor support* 



* Build what the commercial team needs: capability decks, one\-pagers, technical FAQs, objection handling, customer\-specific pitch versions.
* Support fundraising and partner diligence with investor\-grade material, working with the CEO and CTO.
* Coordinate joint communications with partners, including anything tied to the Ohmium joint development agreement, with written approval on both sides.



  





*Team, vendors, and budget* 



* Manage and art\-direct the Brand \& Marketing Designer. Brief and manage outside vendors: PR support, translators, printers, exhibit builders, videographers.
* Own the marketing budget and report on spend and return each quarter.



  





**Required qualifications**



* Five to seven years in B2B marketing, at least three marketing something technical: process technology, capital equipment, specialty chemicals, energy, or industrial hardware.
* You work straight from technical source material — hand you a conference abstract, a techno\-economic analysis, or a process flow diagram and you produce accurate copy without an engineer rewriting it. Bring an example.
* Comfortable with the units our buyers live in: tonnes of CO2 per year, cost per tonne, kWh per kilogram, capacity factor, carbon intensity, life cycle assessment, technology readiness level. You do not need to be an electrochemist. You do need to never publish a wrong number.
* Experience marketing to industrial buyers — procurement, sustainability, corporate development, process engineering — through a sales cycle measured in years.
* You have run a B2B conference program: abstracts and speaking submissions against hard deadlines, booth planning, pre\-show meeting generation, and post\-show reporting. Familiarity with the chemicals, hydrogen, carbon management, sustainable aviation fuel, or polyester and packaging circuits helps.
* Hands\-on with LinkedIn organic and paid, a CRM or marketing automation platform (HubSpot, Salesforce, or Marketo), GA4, and a CMS you can publish in yourself.
* Publication\-quality written English. Your press releases, bylines, and website copy have to convince a chemical engineer and a journalist at once.
* Judgment about claims and confidentiality. Performance data does not go out before a patent is filed. Overstated environmental claims create real legal exposure — we treat this as non\-negotiable.
* Willingness to hold a standing evening overlap with our U.S. team in Eastern Time. Bachelor's degree; chemistry, chemical engineering, materials, or environmental engineering counts for a lot.



  





**Strongly preferred**



* Time at a hard\-tech or climate\-tech company between pilot and first plant — you know the difference between marketing a product that exists and marketing a credible plan to build one.
* Experience on fundraising or diligence material: investor decks, data rooms.
* Exposure to government\-funded program communications: DOE, MNRE and the National Green Hydrogen Mission, DST, or state clean energy programs.
* Working knowledge of what drives our customers' purchasing: ISCC PLUS and mass balance chemistry, CORSIA, RED III, EU ETS and CBAM, 45Q and 45V.
* Experience hiring or art\-directing a designer and holding vendors to a budget.
* Kannada or Hindi alongside English, for local partner, vendor, and press work.



  





**What success looks like in six months**



* One agreed messaging framework in use across the website, decks, and commercial conversations, with claim boundaries written down and respected.
* A rebuilt website our commercial team sends to prospects without being asked, updatable in hours.
* A published event and speaking calendar four quarters out, submissions in, booths budgeted.
* A working content cadence and measurement baseline that shows which activity produces qualified conversations.



  





**This role is probably not for you if...** 



* You need an established brand, a real budget, or a team underneath you to be effective.
* You would rather hand technical content to someone else than get inside it.
* Saying "we do not have that data yet" to a colleague, a journalist, or a prospect makes you uncomfortable.



  





**Location, working pattern, and compensation**




 Hybrid: two days a week on site in Chikkaballapur, the rest wherever you work best. A company shuttle runs from Bengaluru.
 



 Compensation: ₹17–20 lakh fixed CTC, plus equity and benefits. A standing overlap with Eastern Time usually costs part of your evening rather than a full shift.
 



  





**What to submit**




 We read work samples closely and CV formatting barely at all. Send three to five pieces, each with a line or two of context and a clear statement of what you did versus what a team or agency did.
 


* Something technical you wrote from primary source material: a byline, white paper, application note, or technical post.
* A positioning document, one\-pager, or deck narrative you authored. We are reading the argument, not the design.
* One campaign or conference program you ran — objective, what you did, the result. Include one that underperformed and what you changed.
* A website or landing page you owned, with a live link and a note on what you changed and why.
* Optional: a press release, award submission, or placement you landed.



  





 Do not send anything under NDA. Redact figures, customer names, and unpublished data, or just describe the work — we will take your description at face value and ask about it in the interview.
 



  





**How to apply**




 Apply at https://www.renewco2\.com/careers?bzid\=6764731291dc.
 



  





*RenewCO2 is an equal opportunity employer. We judge candidates on what they have done and what they can do, and we welcome applicants of every background. If you need an accommodation at any stage, tell us and we will arrange it.*

 🎥 Video Shooting \& Cinematic Content
   

  

 \* Shoot high\-quality videos and reels at puja ceremonies, homes, temples, events and other locations.
   

 \* Capture cinematic shots of rituals, pandits, decorations, samagri and important moments.
   

 \* Plan shots, angles, sequences and storytelling before and during shoots.
   

 \* Create short\-form content for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and other social platforms.
   

 \* Travel to different puja locations, customer homes, temples and events for content creation.
   

  

 ✂️ Video Editing
   

  

 \* Independently edit engaging short\-form videos and reels.
   

 \* Add music, transitions, subtitles, voiceovers, sound effects and storytelling elements.
   

 \* Create content that feels authentic, premium and culturally appropriate.
   

 \* Repurpose long\-form footage into multiple social media assets.
   

 \* Maintain consistent visual quality and brand identity.
   

  

 💡 Content \& Brainstorming
   

  

 \* Generate new and creative content ideas around:
   

  

 \* Hindu rituals \& traditions
   

 \* Pujas and festivals
   

 \* Hindu mythology
   

 \* Pandit stories and experiences
   

 \* Behind\-the\-scenes content
   

 \* Customer experiences
   

 \* Temple and cultural content
   

 \* Educational/religious content
   

 \* Research trending formats, sounds and content styles and adapt them appropriately.
   

 \* Participate actively in weekly content brainstorming sessions.
   

 \* Develop concepts from idea → shoot → edit → publish.
   

 🎨 Designing \& Social Media
   

  

 \* Create basic social media creatives, thumbnails, posters and stories.
   

 \* Design content using tools such as Canva, Photoshop or similar software.
   

 \* Assist with maintaining BookMyPooja's social media calendar.
   

 \* Write basic captions, hooks and content copy.
   

 \* Monitor content performance and use insights to improve future content.
   

  

  

 🛕 Cultural \& Religious Understanding
   

  

 The candidate should have a genuine interest in Hindu rituals, traditions and Indian culture.
   

  

 You should be comfortable understanding and correctly representing:
   

  

 \* Different Hindu pujas and rituals
   

 \* Festival traditions
   

 \* Basic Sanskrit/Hindu terminology
   

 \* Regional variations in rituals and customs
   

 \* Temple etiquette and cultural sensitivities
   

  

 Prior experience in religious/cultural content is an advantage.
   

  

  

 🚗 Travel \& On\-Site Work
   

  

 This is not a desk\-only social media role.
   

  

 You will regularly travel to:
   

  

 \* Customer homes
   

 \* Puja locations
   

 \* Temples
   

 \* Apartment societies
   

 \* Religious events
   

 \* Festivals
   

 \* BookMyPooja events
   

  

 You should enjoy being on the ground, meeting people, carrying out shoots and finding interesting stories.
   

  

 Local travel for shoots will be part of the role.
   

  

 Required Skills
   

  

 Must Have
   

  

 \* Strong video shooting skills
   

 \* Strong video editing skills
   

 \* Good understanding of Instagram Reels \& YouTube Shorts
   

 \* Creative thinking and brainstorming ability
   

 \* Good sense of framing, composition and storytelling
   

 \* Basic graphic designing skills
   

 \* Ability to shoot using a smartphone/camera
   

 \* Understanding of social media trends
   

 \* Willingness to travel for shoots
   

 \* Interest in Hindu culture and rituals
   

 \* Ability to work independently from concept to final content
   

  

 Software / Tools
   

  

 Experience with one or more of:
   

  

 \* Adobe Premiere Pro
   

 \* After Effects
   

 \* DaVinci Resolve
   

 \* CapCut
   

 \* Canva
   

 \* Photoshop
   

 \* Lightroom
   

  

 Strong editing and shooting ability is more important than knowing every software tool
   

  

 Who We Are Looking For
   

  

 We are looking for someone who:
   

  

 \* Thinks like a content creator, not just a social media manager.
   

 \* Can take an ordinary puja and turn it into an engaging story.
   

 \* Is comfortable approaching people and shooting real moments.
   

 \* Has a strong eye for cinematic visuals.
   

 \* Can come up with ideas independently.
   

 \* Is comfortable travelling for shoots.
   

 \* Understands that religious content requires respect, accuracy and sensitivity.
   

 \* Takes ownership of the complete content process.
   

 \* Is energetic, curious and willing to experiment.
   

  

 Performance \& KPIs
   

  

 The role will include performance\-based incentives linked to measurable KPIs such as:
   

  

 \* Quality and consistency of content produced
   

 \* Number of reels/videos delivered
   

 \* Content engagement and reach
   

 \* Growth in social media followers
   

 \* Video views and watch time
   

 \* Creative campaign performance
   

 \* Timely execution of the content calendar
   

 \* Lead/enquiry contribution from social media
   

 \* Successful execution of on\-ground shoots and campaigns
   

  

 Salary: ₹3,00,000 per annum
   

 Additional:Performance\-based incentives linked to agreed KPIs.
   

  

  

 Experience
   

  

 Experience:1–3 years preferred.
   

  

 Freshers with an exceptional portfolio in video editing, cinematic shooting, content creation or social media may also be considered.
   

  

 Portfolio Required
   

  

 Candidates should share examples of:
   

  

 \* Reels/videos edited by them
   

 \* Videos they have personally shot
   

 \* Cinematic/creative work
   

 \* Social media campaigns or pages handled
   

 \* Graphic designs, if available
   

  

 Portfolio quality will be given significant importance.
   

  

 Why Join BookMyPooja?
   

  

 \* Work at the intersection of technology, culture and spirituality

 \* Travel to different locations for content
   

 \* Build a strong portfolio in a unique content category

title: SEO / AEO Specialist
description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**Job Summary**
*Role Purpose*
 Candescent is seeking an analytical, detail\-oriented SEO / AEO Specialist to grow our organic search visibility and traffic from one of our India office locations. You will own hands\-on execution across keyword research, on\-page and technical optimisation, and content collaboration, while tracking performance and translating data into clear recommendations.
   

  

 This is an execution\-focused role. The Web Strategy Manager sets overall search direction and priorities; you own the day\-to\-day work that delivers against them. You will work closely with content, web development, and demand generation teams to ensure our site is discoverable, fast, and well\-structured for both traditional search engines and emerging AI\-driven answer experiences.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Deliverables**
*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*
**Technical \& On\-Page SEO**
* Perform technical SEO audits covering site speed, crawlability, indexation, site architecture, structured data, and mobile usability, and partner with the web development team to resolve issues.
* Optimise existing pages and new content for on\-page best practices including titles, meta descriptions, headers, internal linking, and schema markup.
* Partner with the web team to ensure site changes and new page launches follow SEO best practices before they go live.


**Research, Content \& AEO**
* Conduct keyword research and competitive analysis to identify growth opportunities and content gaps.
* Collaborate with content and marketing teams to plan and brief search\-friendly content that aligns with search intent.
* Apply emerging Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) practices to improve visibility in AI\-driven search surfaces such as Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity.
* Support backlink and digital PR efforts that build domain authority.


**Measurement \& Reporting**
* Monitor and report on organic performance using Google Analytics (GA4\), Google Search Console, and SEO tooling.
* Track rankings, traffic, and conversion trends, and translate data into actionable recommendations.
* Present regular performance reporting and insight to stakeholders.


**Collaboration \& Ways of Working**
* Work to the direction and priorities set by the Web Strategy Manager, flagging trade\-offs and opportunities as they arise.
* Partner with web development, design, content, and demand generation teams to get recommendations implemented.
* Stay current on search engine algorithm updates and evolving discoverability practices.
* Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and handoffs.


**Experience**
*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*
* 6–9 years of experience in SEO, digital marketing, or a related role.
* Strong understanding of technical SEO, on\-page optimisation, and content strategy.
* Hands\-on experience with Google Analytics (GA4\) and Google Search Console.
* Proficiency with SEO tooling such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, or Screaming Frog.
* Familiarity with emerging AEO concepts and how AI\-driven search surfaces are changing discoverability.
* Basic understanding of HTML and CSS and how site structure impacts search performance.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Excellent written communication skills, and comfort briefing content teams and writing optimised copy.
* Detail\-oriented and organised, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.


**Qualifications \& Preferred Distinctions**
*Additional accomplishments*
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
* Experience with Webflow or other content management platforms is preferred.
* Experience with structured data and schema markup implementation is preferred.
* Familiarity with A/B testing and conversion rate optimisation is a plus.
* Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred.
* Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Consistent quarter\-over\-quarter growth in organic traffic and keyword rankings.
* Improved site health scores and a reducing backlog of technical SEO issues.
* Content that ranks well and genuinely satisfies search intent.
* Growing visibility in AI\-driven answer experiences.
* Clear, data\-backed reporting that informs content and web strategy decisions.


**What Will Make You Successful**
* Persistence in chasing fixes through to implementation rather than stopping at the recommendation.
* Curiosity about how search is changing, and willingness to test new approaches.
* Strong attention to detail and a high standard of craft and quality.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities without losing momentum.
* Clear, proactive communication with stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* A collaborative, low\-ego working style and a genuine willingness to give and receive feedback.
* Strong organisation, follow\-through, and accountability in a global, fast\-paced environment.


**Statement to Third Party Agencies**
 To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

* Repurpose content into multiple assets for various channels to maximize reach
* Take complete ownership for a project or task and collaborate with multiple teams such as sales, client services/solutions, design, digital, and product marketing

  


**This Role is Perfect for You If**


* You are a great listener, and you have a knack for asking the right questions to frame the right story.

* You are good at prioritizing, planning, and taking ownership of tasks.

* You love storytelling, words are how you frame your thoughts, and you are obsessed with punctuation and grammar.

* You have had experience in social media and social media advocacy programs

**The InMobi Culture**



At InMobi, culture isn't a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.



We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.

InMobi is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace.



Visit https://www.inmobi.com/company/careers to better understand our benefits, values, and more!

title: Social Media Strategist
description:
Arré is a media\-tech platform where stories, ideas, and conversations come alive across formats, screens, and perspectives. From web series and documentaries to podcasts and social experiments, Arré creates thought\-provoking, digital\-first content.
   

  

 Arré Voice is its dynamic conversation platform where creators share opinions, stories, trending takes, and snackable voice content. We are building communities through conversations and giving creators new ways to express themselves.
   

  

 Role: Social Media Strategist \& Content Creator
   

  

 Location: Chennai
   

 Work Mode: Hybrid
   

 Employment: Full\-time
   

 Apply Here : https://forms.gle/ZARBnujUcDznMbQJA
   

  

 We are looking for a content creator or aspiring content creator who understands social media, digital culture, trends, and what makes content perform.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of the Indian and Tamil creator ecosystem, including content creators, influencers, podcasters, artists, and digital personalities, and ideally have an existing network of creators they can collaborate with.
   

  

 The role involves developing and executing social media strategies, creating original content, managing content calendars, identifying trends, building creator collaborations, monitoring analytics, and driving audience growth for Arré Voice and other Arré properties.
   

  

 This is a target\-driven role. The candidate will be expected to achieve specific targets set by management, which may include content output, creator onboarding and collaborations, reach, engagement, audience growth, campaign performance, and other business or growth metrics.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 \- Develop and execute platform\-specific social media strategies across Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, and other relevant platforms.
   

 \- Create, write, shoot, edit, or coordinate original, social\-first content aligned with Arré's brand and objectives.
   

 \- Build and manage content calendars, ensuring consistent and timely content across platforms.
   

 \- Identify emerging trends, memes, formats, conversations, and cultural moments and convert them into relevant content opportunities.
   

 \- Build and maintain relationships with content creators, influencers, podcasters, artists, and digital communities.
   

 \- Identify, approach, onboard, and collaborate with relevant creators for Arré Voice campaigns and initiatives.
   

 \- Develop creator\-led content and campaigns designed to increase reach, engagement, downloads, community participation, and brand visibility.
   

 \- Monitor social media conversations and actively participate in relevant online communities to identify opportunities for organic growth.
   

 \- Track and analyze reach, engagement, watch time, follower growth, conversions, and campaign performance.
   

 \- Use analytics and insights to continuously refine content, formats, hooks, distribution strategies, and campaigns.
   

 \- Experiment with new content formats and platform strategies to improve performance and discover scalable growth opportunities.
   

 \- Work closely with content, editorial, design, community, growth, and marketing teams to execute campaigns and initiatives.
   

 \- Support launches, contests, partnerships, influencer campaigns, and other marketing initiatives.
   

 \- Maintain a consistent brand voice and visual/content identity across platforms.
   

 \- Stay deeply connected to Indian and Tamil digital culture, creators, trends, communities, and audience behaviour.
   

 \- Take ownership of assigned social media and creator\-growth targets and consistently work towards KPIs defined by management.
   

 \- Adapt strategies quickly based on changing platform algorithms, audience behaviour, trends, and business priorities.
   

  

 Qualifications
   

  

 \- Must be a content creator or aspiring content creator with a genuine interest in creating digital content.
   

 \- Strong understanding of Social Media Marketing, Social Media Optimization (SMO), and platform\-specific content strategy.
   

 \- Strong knowledge of Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, and other relevant social platforms.
   

 \- Strong familiarity with the Indian and Tamil content creator ecosystem.
   

 \- Ability to identify, approach, build relationships with, and collaborate with creators.
   

 \- An existing creator network or demonstrated experience working with creators is a strong advantage.
   

 \- Excellent communication, writing, storytelling, and content ideation skills.

title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
**About SuperOps** 




 SuperOps is building the AI\-native platform for modern IT management unifying PSA and RMM into a single, agent\-first system that enables IT teams and MSPs to run and scale their operations with dramatically less manual effort. We are backed by Addition Partners, March Capital, Matrix Partners India, Elevation Capital, and Tanglin Venture Partners
 



  





 SuperOps is looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to own the full marketing infrastructure \- from the systems and automation that power our campaigns to the data and attribution layer that tells us what's working. This is a high\-ownership role that sits at the intersection of strategy, execution, and technology.
 



 You will own everything: HubSpot infrastructure, lead lifecycle and scoring, multi\-touch attribution, AI\-native workflows, campaign operations, SDR enablement, and the reporting systems that keep the revenue team aligned. You won't just manage tools \- you'll build systems that diagnose problems, surface insights, and keep the pipeline moving.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




**Marketing Operations Strategy and Operating Model** 



* Build and own the Marketing Operations roadmap, operating model and quarterly priorities.
* Create a clear intake and prioritisation process so the function focuses on work with measurable pipeline or efficiency impact.
* Establish documentation, change\-management and continuity standards for critical systems and workflows.
* Partner with Marketing, RevOps, SDR leadership and Finance on shared definitions, processes and service\-level agreements.



**Marketing Systems and Lifecycle** 



* Own and continuously improve HubSpot's marketing architecture, including properties, workflows, segmentation, campaign structures, lifecycle automation and integrations.
* Define and maintain lifecycle stages, qualification criteria, lead and account scoring, nurture paths, routing and SDR handoffs in partnership with RevOps.
* Improve data quality through reliable enrichment, deduplication, field standards, governance and exception monitoring across contact and company records.
* Create documentation, change\-control practices and service\-level agreements that make critical processes reliable and easy to operate.
* Monitor routing performance and SLA adherence, using SDR feedback to improve lead and account quality over time.



**GTM Intelligence and Market Research** 



* Build and maintain the target\-account universe for IT and mid\-market segments, with clear ICP tiers, verticals, regions, use cases and buying groups.
* Run the Marketing Research Engine (MRE) as a repeatable intelligence process that produces campaign\-ready and SDR\-ready audiences not one\-off lists.
* Combine fit, engagement, intent and timing sign signals to prioritise accounts and recommend the appropriate nurture, campaign or SDR action.
* Use campaign outcomes and SDR feedback to improve data sources, segments, scoring models and targeting decisions over time.
* Evaluate enrichment and intelligence tools based on coverage, accuracy, cost and measurable impact on pipeline generation.



**Measurement, Attribution and Planning** 



* Own Marketing's metrics layer and data dictionary, including lifecycle definitions, sourcing, influence and pipeline contribution.
* Build practical attribution and reporting across inbound, outbound, paid, events, partners and account\-based programs.
* Translate funnel, campaign, channel and account performance into recommendations on audience, investment and next\-best action.
* Partner with Growth, RevOps and Finance on trusted dashboards, budget\-versus\-actual reporting, forecasting and data\-quality controls.



**Campaign Operations and Enablement** 



* Turn audience and campaign strategy into scalable, measurable programs with Growth, Segment Marketing and Demand Generation.
* Standardise campaign setup, taxonomy, UTMs, lists, forms, nurture, routing, QA and post\-campaign reporting.
* Build reusable playbooks for webinars, events, content, paid, partner and targeted\-account programs.
* Support Web and Growth teams with form architecture, conversion tracking and experiment instrumentation.
* Equip SDR teams with prioritised audiences, campaign context, timely alerts and feedback loops while keeping sales execution with SDR leadership.



**AI\-Enabled Automation** 



* Identify, pilot and scale AI\-enabled workflows for research, enrichment, qualification, routing, campaign QA, reporting and operational insight.
* Build practical automations in HubSpot, n8n and related tools; partner with technical teams when a solution requires custom APIs or data infrastructure.
* Apply appropriate human review, monitoring, fallback paths and documentation so automation remains accurate, safe and maintainable.
* Measure adoption, accuracy, hours saved, workflow reliability and business impact rather than tool usage alone.



**What Success Looks Like in the First Six Months** 



* Publish a prioritised Marketing Operations roadmap with clear ownership, service levels and dependencies.
* Standardise lifecycle stages, qualification, routing and SDR handoffs, with visible exception and SLA reporting.
* Establish an account\-level mid\-market data model with ICP tiers, scoring signals and buying\-group coverage.
* Launch a trusted full\-funnel reporting view that connects campaign and channel investment to pipeline outcomes.
* Put two or more AI\-enabled or automated workflows into regular use with measurable gains in speed, quality or decision\-making.



  





**What You Bring** 




**Must\-Have** 



* 6\+ years of B2B marketing operations, revenue operations or GTM operations experience, ideally in SaaS.
* Deep hands\-on HubSpot expertise across workflows, lifecycle management, segmentation, scoring, reporting and integrations.
* Experience designing lead\-to\-revenue processes in a sales\-led or hybrid motion involving Marketing, SDRs and Account Executives.
* Strong command of funnel metrics, attribution, campaign taxonomy, UTM governance and pipeline reporting.
* Hands\-on automation experience with tools such as n8n, Zapier, Make or Workato, and working knowledge of APIs and webhooks.
* Strong data fluency, including advanced spreadsheets and experience with BI tools, SQL or equivalent analysis methods.
* A track record of turning ambiguous business needs into adopted systems, workflows, metrics and documentation.
* Clear cross\-functional communication and the judgment to align Marketing, Sales, RevOps and Finance stakeholders.



**Strong Advantage** 



* Experience supporting an SMB\-to\-mid\-market transition, account\-based programs or complex B2B buying journeys.
* Experience with account scoring, intent signals, buying\-group analysis or enrichment platforms such as ZoomInfo, Clay, Apollo or Clearbit.
* Experience building AI\-assisted workflows with Claude, ChatGPT or comparable models, including human\-review controls.
* Familiarity with sales\-engagement tools, operational databases or data warehouses.
* Exposure to Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, GA4 and Looker Studio from a measurement perspective.



**You Will Thrive Here If** 



* You combine strategic thinking with hands\-on execution and are comfortable building the first version yourself.
* You treat Marketing Operations as a revenue system, not a campaign helpdesk.
* You care about clean definitions, reliable data and clear ownership before adding more tools.
* You build repeatable systems, use AI with sound judgment and document work so others can operate it.
