You will work closely with leadership and cross\-functional teams to establish a market\-leading platform for investing in global equities.
 



 This role is ideal for someone who has built and scaled digital businesses, products, or investment platforms and thrives in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 









**Business Ownership \& Strategy** 



* Own the end\-to\-end P\&L and growth of the US Stocks business.

* Identify new growth opportunities, revenue streams, and business models to accelerate scale.

* Develop and execute the go\-to\-market (GTM) strategy for customer acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention.

* Own the product vision and roadmap for the US Stocks business.

* Partner with Product, Technology, Design, Operations, Compliance, and Risk teams to deliver seamless customer experiences.



  





**Commercial Strategy** 



* Define pricing, brokerage, subscription, and monetization strategies that enhance customer value while improving business profitability.
* Evaluate commercial levers, promotional campaigns, and pricing experiments using data and market insights.



  





**Business Analytics \& Performance** 



* Own business performance metrics and establish a robust operating cadence.
* Lead funnel analysis across acquisition, onboarding, activation, funding, trading, and retention to improve conversion and customer lifetime value.
* Leverage customer cohort analysis and behavioral insights to identify opportunities for growth and optimization.
* Present business performance, strategic recommendations, and investment priorities to senior leadership.



  





**Market Intelligence \& Competitive Positioning** 



* Continuously benchmark the US Stocks offering against domestic and global competitors.
* Track industry trends, customer behavior, regulatory developments, and emerging investment products.
* Recommend strategic initiatives to strengthen competitive positioning and create differentiated customer value.



  





**Leadership \& Cross\-functional Collaboration** 



* Lead cross\-functional teams to execute strategic priorities with speed and excellence.
* Partner with Marketing, Product, Technology, Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Customer Support to successfully launch and scale initiatives.
* Build a high\-performance culture focused on customer obsession, innovation, accountability, and execution.



  





**Who you are:** 



* 3\-5 years of experience in business leadership, general management, strategy, product management, category management, or P\&L ownership within fintech, wealth management, capital markets, broking, asset management, or digital financial services.
* Proven track record of building, launching, and scaling high\-growth businesses, digital platforms, or investment products.

title: Financial Controller - Analyst
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

As an Analyst within the Global Technology Controllers in Corporate Sector Controllers, you will be responsible for providing controllership support to the technology function, including accounting for technology in accordance with US GAAP and JPMC standards.


Global Technology Controller provide controllership support to technology function in to Hardware, Software, Professional services and other direct expense lines. Team is also responsible for capitalization of tangible or intangible assets.




Job Responsibilities:


* Determine expense versus capitalization treatment, ensure timely disposal recognition, and post close entries with appropriate support and approvals.
* Partner with Technology, P\&A, Business Management, and Procurement to align on project scope, in\-service dates, and cutover timing, and maintain SOX\-compliant controls and audit\-ready evidence.
* Perform ongoing review of work\-in\-process ledger balances, including aging analysis, root\-cause identification, and timely clearing to fixed assets or expense when criteria are met.
* Reconcile WIP balances to upstream project and procurement systems and validate against purchase orders, capitalization requests, and approvals.
* Capitalize qualifying assets by evaluating projects against thresholds and criteria and determining start/stop capitalization dates, place\-in\-service dates, useful lives, and residual values.
* Validate operational impacts and future benefit assumptions with Technology and business stakeholders and record entries accurately and timely in the general ledger.
* Ensure balance sheet positions are appropriately supported to maintain a strong fortress balance sheet.
* Document analytics through estimates, walk\-forwards, controller financial reviews, and flash reports.
* Analyze, communicate, and resolve material variances between the general ledger and upstream systems, as defined by the line of business.

Required qualifications, skills, and capabilities

* 3 years of related experience
* General Ledger experience
* Experience with financial reporting and month end close responsibilities
* Comfortable liaising with business and risk managers
* Able to build and maintain partnerships within the various product aligned businesses and across other corporate financial, treasury, and accounting groups
* Able to understand business drivers and requirements and influence middle and front office partners to deliver solutions to business issues and problems
* Strong analytical skills: Ability to quickly understand workings of a complex processing system and general ledger systems across the infrastructure and their interrelationships and dependencies
* Excellent desktop/spreadsheet/database skills
* Excellent organizational and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Able to multi\-task in a constantly changing environment

Able to critically challenge with the goal of identifying control issues  
* 

Preferred qualifications, skills, and capabilities

* Existing relationships and networks within the firm's IB community an advantage
* Shift Timing: Mid\-day shift 1pm to 10pm


**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.  

  

Global Finance \& Business Management works to strategically manage capital, drive growth and efficiencies, maintain financial reporting and proactively manage risk. By providing information, analysis and recommendations to improve results and drive decisions, teams ensure the company can navigate all types of market conditions while protecting our fortress balance sheet.

title: Senior Manager, Community, Advocacy and Partnerships
description:
Circa:


Salary is competitive.


The Royal Society of Chemistry is a not\-for\-profit organisation whose mission is to advance chemical sciences. As a not\-for\-profit publisher, we reinvest surplus funds back into the global scientific community, supporting our purpose to help the chemical science community to create a future that is more open and more equal. We work closely with public authorities, universities and schools.


We are looking for an experienced Leader in publishing to join us as a **Senior Manager, Community, Advocacy and Strategic Partnerships** . In this role you will be a Growth Accelerator in identifying new opportunities and partnerships with our key external stakeholders. You will continue building and developing strong relationships with government and policy bodies, ONOS, Inflibnet, private and public universities across the region to strengthen our existing position in the market.


In this role you will be the one who will develop and deliver unified community engagement and partnership strategy across India and South Asia, helping to expand the reach, visibility and impact of the Royal Society of Chemistry's activities.


As the strategic lead for community outreach, advocacy and institutional partnerships, you will bring together engagement activities into a coordinated, year\-round programme focused on delivering measurable outcomes and long\-term impact. You will work closely with colleagues across Editorial, Memberships, Sales and Marketing to align engagement initiatives with organisational priorities and increase awareness and use of RSC content and services, while maximising opportunities through national initiatives such as ONOS.


This is a very exciting opportunity for an experienced leader with a strong understanding of scientific publishing, research and higher education landscape across India and South Asia, including open science, open access, research funding and science policy.


**Key Responsibilities:**

* Set and own the India and South Asia community, advocacy and strategic partnerships strategy, defining regional priorities, maintaining a forward roadmap and aligning activity, resource and investment to RSC’s global purpose and long\-term goals.
* Strengthen RSC’s position in ONOS, INFLIBNET, open access and APC revenue opportunities by building priority partnerships, supporting platform and journal adoption, and working with Head of Sales on pilots, lighthouse wins and monetised partnerships.
* Oversee the planning and delivery of major events and engagement activity, including setting agendas with partners and briefing or involving RSC Senior Leadership for priority activity such as sustainability and CRSI\-related events.
* Create a collaborative team environment that encourages open communication, knowledge sharing and joined\-up delivery across internal and external partners.
* Translate global and regional priorities for open science, open access, sustainable chemistry, inclusion, research culture and scientific impact into clear plans, flagship activity and workstreams with defined owners, timelines and governance.
* Own senior engagement with research communities through structured stakeholder mapping, targeted programmes and relationship management across PhD students, postdoctoral researchers, early career researchers, authors, reviewers, academics, institutions and senior scientific leaders.
* Set the regional policy and sector insight agenda by monitoring developments across science, research, higher education, publishing and the funder ecosystem, assessing implications for RSC and producing clear recommendations, briefings and internal updates.
* Build and steward strategic relationships with government, funders, academic institutions, research networks, innovation clusters, startups, incubators, sector bodies and other priority partners through clear engagement plans and partnership objectives.
* Set the strategic engagement approach for librarians, consortia, academic influencers and state and central universities, strengthening awareness, adoption and effective use of RSC platforms, products, journals and books across priority institutions.
* Communicate priorities, expectations and decisions clearly, ensuring direct reports and stakeholders understand responsibilities, objectives and how their work contributes to the wider strategy.
* Work with relevant internal stakeholders to deliver major outreach, advocacy, partnership and market development programmes, including sustainability, DEI, women in chemistry, open science and open access activity.
* Ensure programmes are well governed and properly resourced through clear budgets, risk controls, supplier oversight, decision governance, delivery reviews, operational delivery standards and post\-programme evaluation.
* Act as the regional point of influence for community, advocacy and partnership insight, helping Editorial, Sales, Membership, Marketing and relevant Global Impact Group teams align priorities and delivery.

**Requirements:**

* Degree or Master’s level education in science, or equivalent practical experience, with significant senior\-level experience in community engagement, advocacy, policy, partnerships or scientific outreach.
* Strong understanding of the Indian and South Asian research, higher education, science policy, funder, publishing, open access, open science or chemistry community landscape.
* Proven ability to set direction, shape strategy and lead complex regional engagement, advocacy or partnership plans.
* Experience building senior relationships with academic leaders, policymakers, funders, government bodies, librarians, research institutions and sector partners.
* Strong policy judgement, communication, advocacy and influencing skills, including clear recommendations for senior audiences.
* Experience leading major programmes, including budgets, governance, procurement, supplier oversight, risk management, evaluation, impact reporting and ROI.
* Commercial awareness, including business case development, value for money, revenue growth opportunities, cost recovery, sponsorship or co\-funding where relevant.

At the Royal Society of Chemistry, we support flexibility and offer hybrid working, which means our teams come together when they need to collaborate.
 

Although this role is contractually based at our Delhi office, and therefore you will have the opportunity to work mostly from any other location in India, as agreed with your line manager. Applicants should be aware that there is an expectation that employees will attend our Delhi office once a month. Please be aware that in this role you are expected to travel across India for events or meetings with our external partners.


This role will close on 27th September at 23\.59 (local time). The interviews will be held via Teams on the **1st and 2nd October** . If you are interested in this role, please apply before the end of the closing date. When applying, you will need to provide an up\-to\-date CV and a supporting statement (no more than 500 words) indicating how your skills/ expertise match the competencies outlined in the Job Description.


Visit our **Work For Us** website to learn more about us, our benefits, equal opportunities statement and inclusive culture pledge.


At the RSC, we recognise the benefits of a diverse workforce and welcome applicants from a range of backgrounds to apply. We particularly encourage applications from disabled and ethnic minority candidates.


As a part of the Disability Confident Scheme, we endeavour, where possible, to offer an interview to candidates meeting the essential criteria of the role, who has a substantial physical/mental impairment which impacts their ability to carry out day\-to\-day tasks.


We are committed to making our recruitment processes accessible to all and as part of this, we are flexible in the ways we give and receive information. If you would like to apply using a different format, please contact the Recruitment Team at jobs@rsc.org or on \+44 (0\) 1223 432229 and we will do our best to put any reasonable adjustments in place.


If you have any questions, please contact us at jobs@rsc.org

title: Brand Manager - Ostocalcium
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  

  

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.


**JOB PURPOSE:**

The Brand Manager – Ostocalcium role will deliver sustainable business growth by shaping brand strategy, identifying consumer and category opportunities, leading innovation and communication plans, and ensuring effective commercialization across channels and markets


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 

* Deliver topline, P\&L and full year plans for the brand.
* Strategize and execute to deliver aligned brand objectives – to accelerate brand penetration gains.
* Develop and implement comprehensive marketing strategies and activations to drive brand growth and market share gains.
* Create and execute innovative, consumer\-centric marketing campaigns across multiple channels (digital, traditional, in\-store, Dcomm etc).
* Drive product positioning, ensuring alignment with consumer needs, market trends, and company objectives.
* Performance management \& Budgeting\- Plan, execute, and optimize marketing campaigns, ensuring alignment with budget and objectives. Track campaign performance, analyze results, and adjust strategies for optimal ROI.
* Influence senior cross\-functional stakeholders to align commercial, category, sales, and marketing priorities.
* Provide strategic direction to agencies and internal teams to ensure consistent brand positioning.
* Cross functional collaboration and Agency Management.

**Why you?**

**Basic Qualifications:**

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:


* MBA/masters from an institute of repute.
* Minimum 4 years of total experience, with 2\+ years in brand management.
* Strong stakeholder management and leadership skills.
* Proven experience in developing and executing brand strategies and integrated marketing campaigns.
* Strong understanding of consumer insights, market research, brand equity, and portfolio management.
* Experience managing cross\-functional stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Insights, and R\&D.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:


* Experience in FMCG or consumer healthcare sector.
* Demonstrated track record of driving business growth, market share gains, or successful innovation launches.
* Experience leading agencies and mentoring junior brand marketers.

Strong strategic thinking, influencing skills, and ability to operate in a fast\-paced, matrix organization.  

* 

**Job Posting End Date**

2026\-10\-17  

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  

  

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  

  

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.  



**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
----------------------------------------

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.  



**Note to candidates**
----------------------

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Manager, Hotel Partner Solutions
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.


### **Introduction to the Team**

Travel Partnerships and Advertising helps partners, including hotels, airlines, destination marketing organizations, and more, deliver excellent traveler and B2B experiences. We create growth for our partners and the Expedia Group marketplace through competitive supply, travel media, and affiliate solutions.


As Manager—Hotel Partner Solutions, you will lead a team of analysts and technical professionals who deliver solutions supporting hotel partners and business priorities. You will connect technology decisions to partner needs, guide multi\-quarter projects, and create an environment that supports collaboration, development, and meaningful outcomes.


### **Key Responsibilities**

**In this role, you will:**

* Provide direction, coaching, feedback, and technical guidance to a team of analysts and individual contributors.
* Establish team goals, clarify roles and accountabilities, and connect daily work to business priorities.
* Lead delivery across multiple well\-defined, multi\-quarter projects.
* Serve as a technical lead for a defined domain and select appropriate technologies for business and partner needs.
* Partner with Product teams to develop and deliver roadmaps.
* Oversee operational support activities, service performance, response trends, and adherence to established procedures.
* Identify opportunities to improve technology, processes, efficiency, and productivity.
* Plan team capacity and allocate financial, material, and technical resources responsibly.
* Build trusted relationships with hotel partners and internal stakeholders by understanding needs and communicating practical solutions.
* Hire, onboard, recognize, and develop team members while supporting professional growth.
* Monitor key performance indicators, communicate team status, and surface risks, dependencies, and opportunities for simplification.
* Contribute to product reviews, communities of practice, and the product development lifecycle from idea through launch and ongoing improvement.

### **Experience and Qualifications**

Required


* 5\+ years of related experience with a bachelor’s degree, or 3\+ years of related experience with a master’s degree.
* 1–3 years of people leadership experience, including coaching, feedback, performance support, and workload planning.
* Experience leading at least three multi\-quarter projects as a technical lead or equivalent individual contributor.
* Experience with multiple technology implementations and selecting technologies for specific business or partner needs.
* Bachelor’s degree, master’s degree, or equivalent related professional experience; technical degree preferred, including Information Technology, Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, or a related technical field.
* Proficient communication skills and the ability to connect technical concepts with business priorities.

Preferred


* Experience supporting hotel, hospitality, travel, or partner\-facing technology solutions.
* Experience partnering with Product teams on roadmaps and product development.
* Experience supporting technology operations or service management.
Experience identifying process improvements and using metrics to evaluate outcomes.  
* 

  

  

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation .  



  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.  



  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .  



  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: Sales Marketing Manager
description:
**Role Purpose
 



  





 The Regional Manager \- HVAC \& Ventilation Systems will be responsible for developing KOHMER as a preferred air\-movement and ventilation solutions brand within the assigned territory.
 



 The position combines technical HVAC knowledge, specification selling, consultant engagement, OEM development and project\-based business development. The candidate will understand customer requirements involving airflow, static pressure, efficiency, acoustics, motor/control technology and application conditions, and work with KOHMER's engineering team to propose technically and commercially appropriate fan and ventilation solutions.
 



 The role supports KOHMER's portfolio across EC/AC fans, centrifugal and plenum solutions, industrial axial fans, cabinet plug fans, fan wheels and related air\-movement applications for HVAC, AHUs, data centres, industrial ventilation, cooling and process applications.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Regional Business Development
 



 • Develop and execute the regional business plan for KOHMER ventilation products.
 



 • Identify HVAC and industrial projects at concept, design, tender and execution stages and build a healthy opportunity pipeline.
 



 • Take ownership of lead generation, technical\-commercial proposals, negotiations, order conversion and account development.
 



 2\. Consultant \& Specification Development
 



 • Build strong relationships with MEP consultants, HVAC consultants, architects, PMC/EPC organizations and design engineers.
 



 • Conduct technical presentations, product demonstrations and design discussions to establish KOHMER products in consultant specifications, approved vendor lists and project schedules.
 



 • Track projects from initial specification through tendering, contractor selection and final order conversion.
 



 3\. HVAC OEM \& AHU Business
 



 • Develop strategic relationships with AHU manufacturers and OEMs, HVAC equipment manufacturers, system integrators, ventilation contractors, MEP contractors, data\-centre solution providers and industrial equipment manufacturers.
 



 • Identify opportunities for product standardization and recurring/OEM business rather than relying only on individual project sales.
 



 4\. Technical Solution Selling
 



 • Interpret project requirements including airflow, static pressure, fan efficiency, acoustic requirements, operating temperature, space limitations, motor/control requirements and installation configuration.
 



 • Coordinate with KOHMER engineering/application teams for fan selection, technical submittals, drawings and performance data.
 



 • Support commercial HVAC and industrial ventilation applications involving EC fans, plenum/plug fans, centrifugal/backward\-curved fans and industrial axial fans.
 



 5\. Project \& Application Development
 



 • Develop opportunities across commercial buildings, factories, warehouses, data centres, pharmaceutical facilities, food processing, hospitals, cleanrooms, industrial plants, cooling systems, railway/mobility applications and process ventilation.
 



 • Explore broader industrial applications including chemical, mining, textile, paper \& pulp, tunnel ventilation and air\-pollution\-control systems where relevant.
 



 6\. Key Account Management
 



 • Identify and develop strategic accounts with long\-term business potential.
 



 • Establish account plans for consultants, OEMs, contractors and major end users.
 



 • Maintain disciplined follow\-up from enquiry through technical approval, quotation, negotiation, purchase order, delivery and post\-sales coordination.
 



 7\. Commercial \& Revenue Responsibility
 



 • Own the assigned region's Order Intake, Revenue, Gross Margin, Collections and Pipeline.
 



 • Prepare monthly forecasts and maintain CRM\-based opportunity tracking.
 



 • Monitor pricing, competition and market trends while maintaining commercial discipline.
 



 8\. Market \& Competition Intelligence
 



 • Monitor competing fan and ventilation technologies, pricing, consultant preferences and emerging HVAC requirements.
 



 • Provide structured feedback to management regarding product gaps, new\-product opportunities, regional pricing and application trends.
 



 9\. Technical Marketing \& Brand Development
 



 • Represent KOHMER at ISHRAE/ASHRAE programs, HVAC conferences, exhibitions, technical seminars, consultant meets and industry forums.
 



 • Conduct technical sessions for consultants and customers on fan selection, EC/PM technology, energy\-efficient ventilation, acoustics and system optimization.
 



 10\. Site \& Project Coordination
 



 • Conduct project/site visits to understand installation conditions and coordinate technical requirements between customers, contractors and the factory/application engineering team.
 



 • Support troubleshooting and ensure effective technical\-commercial closure of project issues.
 



 Candidate Profile
 



 Education: BE/B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering preferred. Diploma Mechanical candidates with strong relevant HVAC/fan experience may also be considered. MBA/PGDM in Marketing or Sales will be an advantage.
 



 Experience: Ideally 5\-10 years in HVAC, ventilation, fans, AHUs, air movement, industrial ventilation or related engineered products.
 



 Market Exposure: Preference for candidates with demonstrated relationships among HVAC/MEP consultants, AHU manufacturers, contractors, OEMs and industrial customers.
 



 Essential Technical Knowledge
 



 Airflow (CMH/CFM) \| Static/Total Pressure \| Fan Curves \| Fan Selection \| Fan Efficiency \| System Resistance \| RPM \| Motor Power \| EC/PM/AC Motors \| VFD Controls \| Axial Fans \| Centrifugal/Backward\-Curved Fans \| Plenum/Plug Fans \| Acoustics/Noise \| AHU Applications \| Supply/Exhaust Ventilation
 



 Exposure to AMCA 210 / ISO 5801 fan\-performance concepts and testing practices will be particularly valuable.
 



 Key Competencies
 



 • Technical credibility combined with strong commercial drive.
 



 • Ability to discuss fan performance and system requirements confidently with HVAC consultants and design engineers.
 



 • Strong B2B project\-sales, negotiation, presentation and networking capability.
 



 • Disciplined project tracking, CRM usage, forecasting and reporting.
 



 • Independent working style with strong internal collaboration and ownership.
 



 • Willingness to travel frequently for consultant, customer, OEM and project/site meetings.**

description:
Founding Marketing Member
 
  





**HSR Layout · On\-site · Full\-time · Reports to the founders** 

 ·
 
**₹5–6 LPA \+ life changing equity** 




**Track to Head of Marketing** 




  





 Consumer business, home services. We sell to parents in Bangalore. Just raised. Right now marketing is the founders doing it between everything else, and that stops working next month. You're the first marketing hire.
   




 The job
 
 You own all things marketing. Paid, organic, content, community, partnerships, brand. If it brings a parent or a caregiver to us, it's yours.
 



  





 You run it with your own hands. Google Ads and Meta Ads are yours from day one. You set up the campaigns, write the copy, make the creatives, manage the budget, read the numbers every morning, and kill what isn't working before it eats the month.
 



  





 Around that: landing pages, WhatsApp funnels, referrals, apartment and parent communities, content, partnerships. We sell to parents and we also recruit caregivers, so you'll run acquisition on both sides of the business.
 



  





 You'll have the freedom to bring in interns and freelancers when the work needs more hands, and you'll decide who and when.
 



  





 What you'll be measured on is simple. Cost per lead, cost per customer, and how many of those customers stay.
 



  





 High ownership, high agency. The wins are yours and so are the misses. As the team grows, this role is built to become Head of Marketing.
 



  




 You'll do well here if
 
  




* Your English writing is in the top 1%. Every ad, landing page, and WhatsApp message you write will be read by parents deciding who looks after their child. Sloppy copy costs us trust.
* You communicate clearly and briefly, in writing and in person.
* You've spent real money in Google Ads Manager and Meta Ads Manager yourself, and can tell us what your CPL was and what you did to move it.
* 1 to 4 years in. Performance marketing at a startup, a D2C brand, an agency where you actually ran the accounts, or your own side project.
* You can ship a decent creative in Canva or CapCut by lunch without waiting on a designer.
* You're comfortable in a spreadsheet and can build a funnel report on your own.
* Hindi or Kannada alongside English is a plus.

description:

 If you've grown a D2C brand on Meta and Google and can explain exactly what moved the numbers, read on.
 



 Tailoraedge is a men's essentials brand built in Bharat. Shirts, trousers, denims, cargos, shorts, jackets. Two fits, Tailored and Relaxed, in one chosen palette, so almost everything goes with almost everything. We sell online through our own store and are opening our first retail store in Bengaluru.
 



 We're looking for someone to own end\-to\-end marketing for the brand, as an operator, not a reporter. Meta ads are the primary channel. Google ads, including YouTube, are the second. You're comfortable being honest when something isn't working, including about our own ideas.
 



 Two ways this works. Either you join us full\-time and work from our office on Mysore Road, Bengaluru, five days a week, so you need to be in Bengaluru or willing to move.  How to reach us: connect with me here on LinkedIn and send a short pitch in the note or a DM, or email your resume to yash@tailoraedge.com or socialsandweb@tailoraedge.com. Three things are enough. **Job Description**
**About Datahash**
 Datahash is a privacy\-centric first\-party data platform. Our core product, Datahash Signals, gives marketers low\-code, no\-code integrations between web, app, e\-commerce, CRM, marketing automation and data warehouses on one side and the major ad channels on the other: Meta, Google, TikTok, Snap, Amazon and more. We are one of a handful of badged integration partners across these channels and work with them directly on first\-party data adoption programmes, where advertisers are moving to server\-side integrations, conversions APIs and privacy\-safe measurement. We are bootstrapped, profitable, and run across Dubai, Bangalore, Mumbai and London with clients in EMEA, India, Africa, APAC and the US.
   

  

**The role**
 Marketing at Datahash runs agent\-first: a marketing head agent plans, content and page agents produce, an inbound agent qualifies, and named humans approve. This seat is for the person who directs that machine: an operator who owns the voice, the partner\-marketing relationships with Meta, Google, Snap and TikTok, and the demand numbers, and who directs the agents rather than replacing them. You will not be asked to build the machine; it exists. You will be asked to make it produce leads and to make Datahash sound like one company.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own the number. Marketing\-qualified leads from 25 to 100 a month across eight engines, with the segment, journey and content calendar the agents run reviewed by you weekly.
* Own the voice. Every external asset sounds like Datahash: you set the standard, the agents produce to it, and you are the final human read on anything public.
* Own the partner marketing. Co\-marketing programmes and MDF with the channel partners, from claim to campaign, in partnership with the Growth Manager (Channel Partnerships).
* Direct the agents. Brief them, correct them, measure them: acceptance rate, cost per accepted output and the override log are your management tools.
* Launch. Run the SYNAPSE launch communications and the design\-partner programme to the existing base.


**What Success Looks Like**
* MQL ramp on plan with source and quality tracked.
* Case studies shipping monthly with consent, in the three registers we use.
* Partner co\-marketing live with at least one channel per quarter.
* Agent acceptance rates rising quarter on quarter under your direction.


**How We Hire**
 We move fast and we are transparent about how we decide. Every decision about a person is made by a person.
   

  

 Step 1: a short structured screen within two working days of applying. Step 2: a 50\-minute conversation with the hiring manager. Step 3: a small case exercise close to the real work, which you present to two or three of us. Step 4: fit and terms with our VP Delivery or Head of Sales and Partnerships, and for senior roles the founder. We aim to give you a decision within five working days of the final conversation.
   

  

 We evaluate evidence rather than claims, the quality of your questions, how you handle ambiguity, and how naturally you already use AI in your own work.
   

  

**Requirements**
**What we need from you**
* Five to eight years in B2B marketing for SaaS, adtech or martech with demand and content ownership.
* You have worked with platform partner marketing teams (Google, Meta or similar) and know how co\-marketing funds actually get spent.
* A strong editorial eye and a plain writing style; you can tell AI cadence from a human sentence and fix it.
* Daily, expert use of AI tools; you have already directed AI\-produced content at volume.
* Comfort with analytics: GA4, CRM reporting, attribution.


**Nice to have**
* Experience launching a product to an installed base.
* Experience in a company below 100 people where you were the whole marketing function.


**Probably not a fit if**
* You want a team of humans to manage; the team is mostly agents.
* You would rather write everything yourself than direct production.


**Benefits**
* A startup environment backed by a stable, bootstrapped, profitable business.
* Competitive compensation and one of the most employee\-friendly ESOP programmes in the industry.
* Work from anywhere, on your hours; coworking access when you want a change from home.
* Health cover for you and your family.
* Real international exposure: clients and partners across the Gulf, Europe, Africa, India, APAC and the US.
* A yearly offsite that we take seriously, and a culture that does not.


 Datahash is an equal\-opportunity employer. We hire on evidence and fit for the work and do not ask for salary history. Compensation is discussed at the fit\-and\-terms stage.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**About RenewCO2**




 RenewCO2 makes carbon\-negative chemicals and fuels. Our electrocatalytic CO2 utilization technology runs on electricity, water, and waste CO2, and the product drops straight into existing industrial supply chains. Because the process is energy\-efficient, our cost structure competes with fossil\-derived incumbents rather than relying on a green premium.
 



  





 We are venture\-backed with grant funding from the U.S. Department of Energy, NSF, DARPA, the New Jersey Commission on Science, Innovation and Technology, and Breakthrough Energy. The technology is demonstrated at pilot scale with customers, and we are now building toward commercial scale. R\&D is based in the United States; product development and manufacturing happen in India. Our customers are chemical, fuel, and materials producers across Asia, Europe, and North and Latin America.
 



  





 This role is based in Chikkaballapur, Karnataka, at Ohmium International, which builds green hydrogen electrolyzers at a gigafactory there. RenewCO2 has a joint development agreement with Ohmium: working beside a partner that already makes electrochemical stacks at volume shortens our path to manufacturing at scale.
 



  





**The role**




 You will be our first marketing hire in India, owning marketing execution: what we say, where we say it, and whether the market takes us seriously. This is a build job — no playbook, no large budget, no agency doing the thinking.
 



  





 Our buyers are chemical producers, fuel producers, industrial gas companies, EPC contractors, and licensors. They make eight\-figure decisions slowly, with a technical committee in the room. Your job is to make RenewCO2 legible to that audience and make a small team read as the serious technology company it is. You will work with a Brand \& Marketing Designer, hiring in parallel, and directly with technical and commercial leadership in the U.S.
 



  





**What you will do**




*Positioning and messaging* 



* Own the messaging architecture: what RenewCO2 is, what each product line solves, why our approach wins on cost and energy efficiency, and what we can and cannot claim today.
* Turn technical and techno\-economic material into arguments that hold up in front of a process engineer and a CFO in the same meeting.
* Track adjacent CO2 conversion, power\-to\-X, and low\-carbon chemical players, and feed that back into positioning and commercial strategy.



  





*Content* 



* Run the content calendar: technical posts, bylined articles, case notes, explainers, LinkedIn, newsletters.
* Write and place bylines and interviews in the trade press our buyers actually read — chemicals, energy, hydrogen, aviation fuel, and polymers.
* Write and submit award applications; handle analyst and industry\-database relationships.



  





*Website and digital* 



* Run the website as a commercial asset: information architecture, copy, publishing cadence, on\-page SEO, conversion paths. You publish in the CMS directly with the designer.
* Run LinkedIn as our main organic and paid channel, plus targeted email.
* Set up the measurement layer: GA4, CRM hygiene, UTM discipline. Report on what produces qualified conversations.



  





*Events and conferences* 



* Own the conference program: which events, abstract and speaking submissions, booth briefs, pre\-show outreach, meeting scheduling, follow\-up, and cost reporting.
* Prepare spokespeople with slides, talk tracks, likely questions, and clear boundaries on what is public.



  





*Commercial and investor support* 



* Build what the commercial team needs: capability decks, one\-pagers, technical FAQs, objection handling, customer\-specific pitch versions.
* Support fundraising and partner diligence with investor\-grade material, working with the CEO and CTO.
* Coordinate joint communications with partners, including anything tied to the Ohmium joint development agreement, with written approval on both sides.



  





*Team, vendors, and budget* 



* Manage and art\-direct the Brand \& Marketing Designer. Brief and manage outside vendors: PR support, translators, printers, exhibit builders, videographers.
* Own the marketing budget and report on spend and return each quarter.



  





**Required qualifications**



* Five to seven years in B2B marketing, at least three marketing something technical: process technology, capital equipment, specialty chemicals, energy, or industrial hardware.
* You work straight from technical source material — hand you a conference abstract, a techno\-economic analysis, or a process flow diagram and you produce accurate copy without an engineer rewriting it. Bring an example.
* Comfortable with the units our buyers live in: tonnes of CO2 per year, cost per tonne, kWh per kilogram, capacity factor, carbon intensity, life cycle assessment, technology readiness level. You do not need to be an electrochemist. You do need to never publish a wrong number.
* Experience marketing to industrial buyers — procurement, sustainability, corporate development, process engineering — through a sales cycle measured in years.
* You have run a B2B conference program: abstracts and speaking submissions against hard deadlines, booth planning, pre\-show meeting generation, and post\-show reporting. Familiarity with the chemicals, hydrogen, carbon management, sustainable aviation fuel, or polyester and packaging circuits helps.
* Hands\-on with LinkedIn organic and paid, a CRM or marketing automation platform (HubSpot, Salesforce, or Marketo), GA4, and a CMS you can publish in yourself.
* Publication\-quality written English. Your press releases, bylines, and website copy have to convince a chemical engineer and a journalist at once.
* Judgment about claims and confidentiality. Performance data does not go out before a patent is filed. Overstated environmental claims create real legal exposure — we treat this as non\-negotiable.
* Willingness to hold a standing evening overlap with our U.S. team in Eastern Time. Bachelor's degree; chemistry, chemical engineering, materials, or environmental engineering counts for a lot.



  





**Strongly preferred**



* Time at a hard\-tech or climate\-tech company between pilot and first plant — you know the difference between marketing a product that exists and marketing a credible plan to build one.
* Experience on fundraising or diligence material: investor decks, data rooms.
* Exposure to government\-funded program communications: DOE, MNRE and the National Green Hydrogen Mission, DST, or state clean energy programs.
* Working knowledge of what drives our customers' purchasing: ISCC PLUS and mass balance chemistry, CORSIA, RED III, EU ETS and CBAM, 45Q and 45V.
* Experience hiring or art\-directing a designer and holding vendors to a budget.
* Kannada or Hindi alongside English, for local partner, vendor, and press work.



  





**What success looks like in six months**



* One agreed messaging framework in use across the website, decks, and commercial conversations, with claim boundaries written down and respected.
* A rebuilt website our commercial team sends to prospects without being asked, updatable in hours.
* A published event and speaking calendar four quarters out, submissions in, booths budgeted.
* A working content cadence and measurement baseline that shows which activity produces qualified conversations.



  





**This role is probably not for you if...** 



* You need an established brand, a real budget, or a team underneath you to be effective.
* You would rather hand technical content to someone else than get inside it.
* Saying "we do not have that data yet" to a colleague, a journalist, or a prospect makes you uncomfortable.



  





**Location, working pattern, and compensation**




 Hybrid: two days a week on site in Chikkaballapur, the rest wherever you work best. A company shuttle runs from Bengaluru.
 



 Compensation: ₹17–20 lakh fixed CTC, plus equity and benefits. A standing overlap with Eastern Time usually costs part of your evening rather than a full shift.
 



  





**What to submit**




 We read work samples closely and CV formatting barely at all. Send three to five pieces, each with a line or two of context and a clear statement of what you did versus what a team or agency did.
 


* Something technical you wrote from primary source material: a byline, white paper, application note, or technical post.
* A positioning document, one\-pager, or deck narrative you authored. We are reading the argument, not the design.
* One campaign or conference program you ran — objective, what you did, the result. Include one that underperformed and what you changed.
* A website or landing page you owned, with a live link and a note on what you changed and why.
* Optional: a press release, award submission, or placement you landed.



  





 Do not send anything under NDA. Redact figures, customer names, and unpublished data, or just describe the work — we will take your description at face value and ask about it in the interview.
 



  





**How to apply**




 Apply at https://www.renewco2\.com/careers?bzid\=6764731291dc.
 



  





*RenewCO2 is an equal opportunity employer. We judge candidates on what they have done and what they can do, and we welcome applicants of every background. If you need an accommodation at any stage, tell us and we will arrange it.*

title: SEO / AEO Specialist
description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**Job Summary**
*Role Purpose*
 Candescent is seeking an analytical, detail\-oriented SEO / AEO Specialist to grow our organic search visibility and traffic from one of our India office locations. You will own hands\-on execution across keyword research, on\-page and technical optimisation, and content collaboration, while tracking performance and translating data into clear recommendations.
   

  

 This is an execution\-focused role. The Web Strategy Manager sets overall search direction and priorities; you own the day\-to\-day work that delivers against them. You will work closely with content, web development, and demand generation teams to ensure our site is discoverable, fast, and well\-structured for both traditional search engines and emerging AI\-driven answer experiences.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Deliverables**
*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*
**Technical \& On\-Page SEO**
* Perform technical SEO audits covering site speed, crawlability, indexation, site architecture, structured data, and mobile usability, and partner with the web development team to resolve issues.
* Optimise existing pages and new content for on\-page best practices including titles, meta descriptions, headers, internal linking, and schema markup.
* Partner with the web team to ensure site changes and new page launches follow SEO best practices before they go live.


**Research, Content \& AEO**
* Conduct keyword research and competitive analysis to identify growth opportunities and content gaps.
* Collaborate with content and marketing teams to plan and brief search\-friendly content that aligns with search intent.
* Apply emerging Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) practices to improve visibility in AI\-driven search surfaces such as Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity.
* Support backlink and digital PR efforts that build domain authority.


**Measurement \& Reporting**
* Monitor and report on organic performance using Google Analytics (GA4\), Google Search Console, and SEO tooling.
* Track rankings, traffic, and conversion trends, and translate data into actionable recommendations.
* Present regular performance reporting and insight to stakeholders.


**Collaboration \& Ways of Working**
* Work to the direction and priorities set by the Web Strategy Manager, flagging trade\-offs and opportunities as they arise.
* Partner with web development, design, content, and demand generation teams to get recommendations implemented.
* Stay current on search engine algorithm updates and evolving discoverability practices.
* Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and handoffs.


**Experience**
*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*
* 6–9 years of experience in SEO, digital marketing, or a related role.
* Strong understanding of technical SEO, on\-page optimisation, and content strategy.
* Hands\-on experience with Google Analytics (GA4\) and Google Search Console.
* Proficiency with SEO tooling such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, or Screaming Frog.
* Familiarity with emerging AEO concepts and how AI\-driven search surfaces are changing discoverability.
* Basic understanding of HTML and CSS and how site structure impacts search performance.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Excellent written communication skills, and comfort briefing content teams and writing optimised copy.
* Detail\-oriented and organised, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.


**Qualifications \& Preferred Distinctions**
*Additional accomplishments*
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
* Experience with Webflow or other content management platforms is preferred.
* Experience with structured data and schema markup implementation is preferred.
* Familiarity with A/B testing and conversion rate optimisation is a plus.
* Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred.
* Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Consistent quarter\-over\-quarter growth in organic traffic and keyword rankings.
* Improved site health scores and a reducing backlog of technical SEO issues.
* Content that ranks well and genuinely satisfies search intent.
* Growing visibility in AI\-driven answer experiences.
* Clear, data\-backed reporting that informs content and web strategy decisions.


**What Will Make You Successful**
* Persistence in chasing fixes through to implementation rather than stopping at the recommendation.
* Curiosity about how search is changing, and willingness to test new approaches.
* Strong attention to detail and a high standard of craft and quality.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities without losing momentum.
* Clear, proactive communication with stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* A collaborative, low\-ego working style and a genuine willingness to give and receive feedback.
* Strong organisation, follow\-through, and accountability in a global, fast\-paced environment.


**Statement to Third Party Agencies**
 To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

 SuperOps is looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to own the full marketing infrastructure \- from the systems and automation that power our campaigns to the data and attribution layer that tells us what's working. This is a high\-ownership role that sits at the intersection of strategy, execution, and technology.
 



 You will own everything: HubSpot infrastructure, lead lifecycle and scoring, multi\-touch attribution, AI\-native workflows, campaign operations, SDR enablement, and the reporting systems that keep the revenue team aligned. You won't just manage tools \- you'll build systems that diagnose problems, surface insights, and keep the pipeline moving.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




**Marketing Operations Strategy and Operating Model** 



* Build and own the Marketing Operations roadmap, operating model and quarterly priorities.
* Create a clear intake and prioritisation process so the function focuses on work with measurable pipeline or efficiency impact.
* Establish documentation, change\-management and continuity standards for critical systems and workflows.
* Partner with Marketing, RevOps, SDR leadership and Finance on shared definitions, processes and service\-level agreements.



**Marketing Systems and Lifecycle** 



* Own and continuously improve HubSpot's marketing architecture, including properties, workflows, segmentation, campaign structures, lifecycle automation and integrations.
* Define and maintain lifecycle stages, qualification criteria, lead and account scoring, nurture paths, routing and SDR handoffs in partnership with RevOps.
* Improve data quality through reliable enrichment, deduplication, field standards, governance and exception monitoring across contact and company records.
* Create documentation, change\-control practices and service\-level agreements that make critical processes reliable and easy to operate.
* Monitor routing performance and SLA adherence, using SDR feedback to improve lead and account quality over time.



**GTM Intelligence and Market Research** 



* Build and maintain the target\-account universe for IT and mid\-market segments, with clear ICP tiers, verticals, regions, use cases and buying groups.
* Run the Marketing Research Engine (MRE) as a repeatable intelligence process that produces campaign\-ready and SDR\-ready audiences not one\-off lists.
* Combine fit, engagement, intent and timing sign signals to prioritise accounts and recommend the appropriate nurture, campaign or SDR action.
* Use campaign outcomes and SDR feedback to improve data sources, segments, scoring models and targeting decisions over time.
* Evaluate enrichment and intelligence tools based on coverage, accuracy, cost and measurable impact on pipeline generation.



**Measurement, Attribution and Planning** 



* Own Marketing's metrics layer and data dictionary, including lifecycle definitions, sourcing, influence and pipeline contribution.
* Build practical attribution and reporting across inbound, outbound, paid, events, partners and account\-based programs.
* Translate funnel, campaign, channel and account performance into recommendations on audience, investment and next\-best action.
* Partner with Growth, RevOps and Finance on trusted dashboards, budget\-versus\-actual reporting, forecasting and data\-quality controls.



**Campaign Operations and Enablement** 



* Turn audience and campaign strategy into scalable, measurable programs with Growth, Segment Marketing and Demand Generation.
* Standardise campaign setup, taxonomy, UTMs, lists, forms, nurture, routing, QA and post\-campaign reporting.
* Build reusable playbooks for webinars, events, content, paid, partner and targeted\-account programs.
* Support Web and Growth teams with form architecture, conversion tracking and experiment instrumentation.
* Equip SDR teams with prioritised audiences, campaign context, timely alerts and feedback loops while keeping sales execution with SDR leadership.



**AI\-Enabled Automation** 



* Identify, pilot and scale AI\-enabled workflows for research, enrichment, qualification, routing, campaign QA, reporting and operational insight.
* Build practical automations in HubSpot, n8n and related tools; partner with technical teams when a solution requires custom APIs or data infrastructure.
* Apply appropriate human review, monitoring, fallback paths and documentation so automation remains accurate, safe and maintainable.
* Measure adoption, accuracy, hours saved, workflow reliability and business impact rather than tool usage alone.



**What Success Looks Like in the First Six Months** 



* Publish a prioritised Marketing Operations roadmap with clear ownership, service levels and dependencies.
* Standardise lifecycle stages, qualification, routing and SDR handoffs, with visible exception and SLA reporting.
* Establish an account\-level mid\-market data model with ICP tiers, scoring signals and buying\-group coverage.
* Launch a trusted full\-funnel reporting view that connects campaign and channel investment to pipeline outcomes.
* Put two or more AI\-enabled or automated workflows into regular use with measurable gains in speed, quality or decision\-making.



  





**What You Bring** 




**Must\-Have** 



* 6\+ years of B2B marketing operations, revenue operations or GTM operations experience, ideally in SaaS.
* Deep hands\-on HubSpot expertise across workflows, lifecycle management, segmentation, scoring, reporting and integrations.
* Experience designing lead\-to\-revenue processes in a sales\-led or hybrid motion involving Marketing, SDRs and Account Executives.
* Strong command of funnel metrics, attribution, campaign taxonomy, UTM governance and pipeline reporting.
* Hands\-on automation experience with tools such as n8n, Zapier, Make or Workato, and working knowledge of APIs and webhooks.
* Strong data fluency, including advanced spreadsheets and experience with BI tools, SQL or equivalent analysis methods.
* A track record of turning ambiguous business needs into adopted systems, workflows, metrics and documentation.
* Clear cross\-functional communication and the judgment to align Marketing, Sales, RevOps and Finance stakeholders.



**Strong Advantage** 



* Experience supporting an SMB\-to\-mid\-market transition, account\-based programs or complex B2B buying journeys.
* Experience with account scoring, intent signals, buying\-group analysis or enrichment platforms such as ZoomInfo, Clay, Apollo or Clearbit.
* Experience building AI\-assisted workflows with Claude, ChatGPT or comparable models, including human\-review controls.
* Familiarity with sales\-engagement tools, operational databases or data warehouses.
* Exposure to Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, GA4 and Looker Studio from a measurement perspective.



**You Will Thrive Here If** 



* You combine strategic thinking with hands\-on execution and are comfortable building the first version yourself.
* You treat Marketing Operations as a revenue system, not a campaign helpdesk.
* You care about clean definitions, reliable data and clear ownership before adding more tools.
* You build repeatable systems, use AI with sound judgment and document work so others can operate it.

Uless brings valuable savings together in one convenient platform, making it easier for consumers to discover trusted offers without searching across multiple websites. Verified students can unlock additional student\-exclusive discounts and benefits, giving them even more opportunities to save. Uless also helps brands reach and acquire new customers through digital marketing, affiliate partnerships, and targeted promotional campaigns. The company is building a trusted global savings ecosystem where consumers can discover better deals and make smarter spending decisions every day.

 The Digital Marketing \& Social Media Growth Manager is a

 . This role is responsible for developing and executing digital marketing and social media growth strategies that increase brand awareness, website traffic, user acquisition, engagement, conversions, and revenue for Uless. * Excellent communication, copywriting, and storytelling skills, with the ability to create clear, compelling, and brand\-aligned content for both general consumers and student audiences.
* Experience developing and executing digital marketing and growth strategies focused on increasing website traffic, user acquisition, engagement, conversions, and revenue.
* Experience with content strategy, including planning content calendars, defining content themes, creating campaigns, and aligning content with marketing and business objectives.
* Familiarity with digital marketing tools and analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Meta Business Suite, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, SEO tools, email marketing platforms, and social media analytics.
* Understanding of SEO, paid advertising, performance marketing, conversion optimization, affiliate marketing, influencer marketing, and customer acquisition strategies.

title: Senior Marketing Executive
description:
**About the Company** 




 About Keplin Global Services India Pvt. Ltd.Keplin Group is a fast\-growing, multi\-brand consumer goods and e\-commerce business, operating across Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, and D2C channels. We hold licensed brand partnerships including Disney and Bluey, and our operations span the UK (Uxbridge HQ and Stratford\-upon\-Avon warehouse) and India. This role sits within Keplin Global Services, our Navi Mumbai\-based entity, which provides critical back\-office and operational support to the wider Keplin Group. Joining Keplin Global Services means being part of a dynamic, international team driving the growth of some of the most loved brands in the consumer goods space.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 About the roleOwn the delivery of Keplin's marketing across e\-commerce, content and campaigns, working to Marketing manager. You will plan and run campaigns, write the copy that carries them, take new products to market, keep our marketplace and web presence sharp, and report on what worked. Broad and hands\-on: writing, planning and numbers in the same week.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* What you will do Campaign management. Plan and execute marketing campaigns across e\-commerce channels, social media, email and digital ads, from brief through to calendar, assets, scheduling and sign\-off
* Product launches. Coordinate go\-to\-market for new Keplin products, writing launch assets, ad copy and product positioning
* Content strategy. Write engaging copy for web pages, product descriptions, email newsletters and promotional ads, and shape what we say where
* Page structure. Plan module hierarchy on web pages: what modules a page needs, in what order, what each is there to do, and the headlines and content within them
* Marketplace optimisation. Assist with promotional assets and messaging for online marketplaces
* SEO alignment. Work alongside our SEO specialist as the link into marketing, making sure blogs, web copy and page structure align with the SEO plan. You need to understand the discipline well enough to brief it, question it and act on it, not to deliver it yourself
* Performance tracking. Monitor campaign performance, tracking ROI, conversion rates and traffic metrics, and use the data to shape what we do next
* Competitor research. Ongoing market research on e\-commerce trends, pricing strategies and competitor product offerings
* Commercial checks. Pull and interpret Shopify reporting on stock position and product\-level sales, flagging problems before a campaign goes live so we are not driving traffic to lines that are low or out of stock
* AI tooling. Use tools such as Claude as a normal part of your workflow, for drafting copy, structuring pages and speeding up research



  





**Qualifications** 



* What you need Four to six years in marketing, ideally consumer goods or e\-commerce



  





**Required Skills** 



* Genuinely strong copywriting in English. Much of this role is words, and we will ask for samples
* Track record taking products to market: launch planning, positioning and the assets that carry it
* A working understanding of SEO: how search works, what a specialist will ask of you, and why it shapes how a page is written and structured. You will not be doing the technical work
* A feel for content structure — why a page is ordered the way it is and what each section is meant to achieve
* Comfortable planning campaigns and reporting on them with real numbers rather than activity summaries
* Confident in a CMS, with enough HTML to fix your own problems
* Shopify experience: navigating admin, running reports, and reading stock and sales data with a commercial eye
* Active user of AI tooling, and able to show us how you use it
* Organised, accurate and reliable to a deadline



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Nice to have Klaviyo experience, particularly building email content and templates
* Marketplace experience — Amazon Seller Central or similar
* Exposure to paid social or Google Ads
* GA4 or similar analytics



  





**How to Apply** 



* Send your updated resume to: rohinigujar@keplin\-group.com

 Lead Kytes digital marketing strategy and execution to generate qualified demand, improve pipeline contribution, and strengthen brand visibility.  Drive HubSpot or equivalent CRM and marketing automation: segmentation, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, nurture workflows, routing, attribution, reporting, and database hygiene.

 Build dashboards for traffic, leads, MQLs, SQLs, opportunities, pipeline, campaign attribution, CAC, and ROI; turn findings into clear corrective actions.

 Lead, coach, and develop the digital marketing team; set weekly and monthly priorities and performance goals.
 



**•** 
 Create SOPs, templates, dashboards, prompts, and repeatable AI\-assisted workflows that increase quality and productivity.
 



**•** 
 Review campaign quality before and after launch; encourage disciplined experimentation while protecting brand consistency.

 8\-10 years in digital marketing, ideally B2B SaaS, enterprise software, IT services, technology, or professional services; proven experience managing teams.

 Marketing\-sourced and influenced pipeline; qualified leads and opportunities; MQL\-to\-SQL conversion; cost per qualified lead; paid ROI; organic qualified conversions; email and website conversion; automation effectiveness; team productivity; and adoption of AI\-enabled workflows.

 A strategic yet hands\-on leader who can discuss growth priorities with leadership, review pipeline with sales, diagnose a campaign dashboard, improve an ad or landing page, and help the team use AI to achieve better business outcomes.

 • Location and audience targeting.

 for each campaign.

 **brand awareness, engagement, enquiries, footfall and sales.**

 3\. Content Ideation

 **clear purpose and connection to the brand or marketing objective.**

 **photo and video content** 
 for social media.

 **premium, aesthetic and consistent visual language.**

* Ensure consistency in the visual language, tone and positioning of each brand.
* Develop content that communicates the premium nature of Guzaarish and Bon Heur.
* Constantly identify opportunities to make the brands more distinctive and memorable.
* Contribute ideas beyond social media that can strengthen overall brand awareness and customer engagement.


 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 
 We are
 **not looking for a traditional social media executive whose primary responsibility is posting content.** 




**We are looking for someone who can think like a marketer, creator and brand builder.** 




**The ideal candidate should be able to:** 




**Understand the business → Build the strategy → Develop the campaign → Create the content → Execute it → Analyse the results → Improve it.**

 **marketing, content creation and social media management** 
 .

* Demonstrated experience in developing and executing marketing campaigns.
* Excellent understanding of Instagram and digital content.
* Strong aesthetic sense.
* Excellent photography and videography skills.
* Strong video editing skills.
* Ability to independently ideate and execute content.
* Understanding of social media analytics and performance metrics.
* Strong communication and organisational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines.

* Photography and composition

* Colour and visual consistency
* Reels and short\-form storytelling
* Premium brand communication

**as you are with:**

*why*

About Cvent:
 



 Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500\+ employees and \~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.
 



  





 Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4\.6B in 2023\.
 



  





 Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
 



*Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection.* 




  





**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future** 




 Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
 



  





 Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
 



  





***Recruitment Scam Notice:***
*Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “
 
 name@cvent.com
 
 ” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.* 









*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at
 
 recruitingindia@cvent.com
 
 .* 









*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.
 
 https://www.cvent.com/en/notice\-recruitment\-fraud
 
 .* 




  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




  





 The Head of Data Strategy \& Operations is a senior leadership role responsible for building and leading the unified data function across Cvent's primary clouds: Enterprise Corporates (EC) and Hospitality (HC). This is a strategic and operational role — you will set the vision for how Cvent acquires, enriches, governs, and activates its marketing database, while managing a team of \~40 across three distinct functions.
 



  





 This is a newly created role designed to consolidate previously fragmented data functions into a single, accountable team with unified strategy, cloud\-specific ownership, and a modern AI\-native operating model. You will report into the VP, Global Demand Center and partner closely with IT, Sales, Product Marketing, and Analytics.
 



  





**What you will Be doing:** 




  





**Strategic Leadership** 



* Own the end\-to\-end data strategy for Cvent's marketing database — acquisition, enrichment, governance, and activation — across EC and HC
* Define and maintain ICP, TAM/SAM, and persona frameworks in partnership with Product Marketing and Sales
* Build and drive cloud\-specific scorecards that create clear accountability for EC and HC data quality, coverage, and campaign readiness
* Serve as the single accountable leader for the ADI function; act as the primary liaison to the VP of GDC, CMO, and cross\-functional partners



  





**Team \& Org Leadership** 



* Lead three functional sub\-teams — Audience Strategy \& Intelligence, Data Acquisition \& Activation, and Data Infrastructure \& Governance
* Develop and retain strong team leads; build career paths and capability plans within each function
* Drive a unified operating model that eliminates duplication across previously siloed teams and enables scale without proportional headcount growth



  





**Data Operations \& Quality** 



* Ensure the marketing database meets and exceeds quality thresholds: Account accuracy ≥80%, Contact accuracy ≥85%, SAM coverage \>80%
* Oversee database normalization, deduplication, governance, and data validation across both clouds
