title: Affiliate Manager
description:
Role Overview
 



 As the Full\-Time Affiliate Marketing Specialist/Manager, you will be responsible for building, optimizing, and scaling Jebelz’s affiliate program across the UAE and the broader GCC region. You will identify, recruit, and manage strategic partnerships with affiliate networks, publishers, coupon/deal portals, cashback websites, media houses, and content creators to drive traffic, acquire new customers, and maximize e\-commerce revenue.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 1\. Program Strategy \& Execution
 


* Design, build, and execute Jebelz’s end\-to\-end affiliate marketing strategy aligned with business revenue targets.
* Define competitive commission structures, incentive tiers, and payout models (CPA, CPL, CPS) for different partner segments.



 2\. Partner Recruitment \& Relationship Management
 


* Actively recruit, onboard, and retain top\-tier affiliates, publishers, influencer networks, price\-comparison engines, and deal/cashback platforms across the MENA region.
* Maintain strong, long\-term relationships with key affiliates through proactive communication, weekly newsletters, and tailored promotional offers.



 3\. Campaign \& Promotions Management
 


* Plan and run exclusive affiliate campaigns tied to key shopping seasons (e.g., White/Yellow Friday, Ramadan, Eid, UAE National Day, Back\-to\-School).
* Provide affiliates with optimized creative assets, tracking links, banners, product feeds, and exclusive promo codes.



 4\. Network \& Platform Optimization
 


* Manage affiliate platforms and tracking networks (e.g., Impact, Admitad, ArabyAds, CJ Affiliate, or custom software solutions).
* Ensure seamless tracking, attribution accuracy, fraud prevention, and timely partner payouts.



 5\. Performance Analysis \& Reporting
 


* Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly performance KPIs, including sales volume, Conversion Rate (CR), Average Order Value (AOV), Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), and Cost Per Acquisition (CPA).
* Analyze affiliate channel profitability and optimize underperforming partnerships.
* Prepare clear performance dashboards and reports for leadership.



  





 Requirements \& Qualifications
 



  




* **Experience:** 
 3–5 years of dedicated full\-time experience managing e\-commerce affiliate programs in the UAE or GCC region.
* **Network Knowledge:** 
 Established relationships with key MENA publishers, deal/cashback platforms, content sites, and affiliate networks (e.g., Admitad, ArabyAds, Impact, ArabClicks).
* **Technical Skills:** 
 Hands\-on experience with affiliate tracking software, deep linking, product feed management (XML/CSV), and web analytics tools (Google Analytics 4\).
* **Analytical Mindset:** 
 Strong data analysis skills to evaluate campaign performance, ROI, and partner attribution.
* **Commercial Acumen:** 
 Outstanding negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills.

title: Business Head – School Partnerships
description:
HEAD – SALES
   

  

**Department:** 
 Sales \& Business Development
   

  

**Location:** 
 Delhi NCR / Pan India
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 CEO / Business Leadership
   

  

**About EdTerra**
 EdTerra Edventures is a leading experiential learning and educational travel company that designs and delivers immersive learning journeys for school students across India and international destinations.
   

  

 We partner with schools to create meaningful experiences that combine travel, learning, culture, adventure and real\-world exposure.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Head – Sales** 
 to lead EdTerra's sales function and drive the next phase of revenue growth.
   

  

 This is a
 **business leadership role** 
 with end\-to\-end ownership of the sales engine—from market strategy and school acquisition to key account growth, sales\-team performance, forecasting and revenue delivery.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be a commercially strong, data\-driven and inspiring sales leader who can build scalable sales systems while personally driving strategic relationships with large schools and institutional partners.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities1\. Revenue \& Business Growth
   

  

* Own the overall sales revenue, growth and commercial performance for the business.
* Develop and execute the annual and quarterly sales strategy in line with organizational objectives.
* Translate business targets into territory, segment, product and team\-level targets.
* Identify new revenue opportunities across geographies, school segments and products.
* Drive both new business acquisition and growth of existing accounts.
* Develop strategies to increase customer lifetime value, repeat business and wallet share.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with school management, principals, trustees, coordinators and other key decision\-makers.

* Lead and mentor the complete sales organization across regions/functions.
* Define team structures, roles, territories, targets and performance expectations.
* Recruit, coach and develop high\-performing sales managers and sales professionals.
* Establish a strong culture of ownership, accountability and performance.
* Conduct structured weekly, monthly and quarterly business reviews.
* Identify capability gaps and implement targeted coaching and development plans.
* Build a strong succession pipeline for critical sales positions.
* Sales Process \& Performance Management
* Build a predictable and scalable sales process from lead generation → qualification → meetings → proposals → negotiation → closure → repeat business.
* Establish clear sales KPIs and performance dashboards.
* Monitor conversion ratios at every stage of the funnel.
* Improve sales productivity and reduce sales\-cycle time.
* Ensure disciplined CRM usage and accurate pipeline management.
* Establish mechanisms for identifying and resolving pipeline bottlenecks.
* Forecasting \& Business Intelligence
* Own the monthly and quarterly sales forecast.
* Maintain strong visibility on pipeline value, probability and expected closures.
* Develop accurate revenue projections based on historical performance and current pipeline.
* Use sales data to identify trends, risks and opportunities.
* Present actionable sales insights and recommendations to the leadership team.
* Develop territory\-wise and account\-wise performance dashboards.
* Market Expansion
* Identify and evaluate new cities, regions and school segments for expansion.
* Analyse competitor positioning, pricing, offerings and market trends.
* Develop go\-to\-market strategies for new products and markets.
* Identify emerging opportunities within the education and experiential\-learning ecosystem.
* Work with the leadership team to evaluate strategic partnerships and new business channels.
* Key Account Growth \& Retention
* Build a structured Key Account Management framework.
* Develop annual growth plans for strategic schools.
* Drive repeat journeys, renewals and increased engagement with existing schools.
* Monitor account health, satisfaction and revenue potential.
* Ensure high\-value clients receive proactive relationship management.
* Work with Operations and Customer Experience teams to resolve critical client concerns.
* Commercial \& Margin Ownership
* Balance revenue growth with profitability and contribution margins.
* Participate in pricing and commercial strategy.
* Establish appropriate discounting and negotiation frameworks.
* Monitor deal economics and commercial effectiveness.
* Work closely with Finance to improve collection efficiency and reduce outstanding receivables.
* Ensure sales commitments remain commercially and operationally viable.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration


**Work Closely With**
* Marketing – lead generation, campaigns and brand positioning
* Product – product development, pricing and market fit
* Operations – delivery feasibility and execution
* Finance – pricing, margins, collections and commercial controls
* HR – manpower planning, hiring and capability development
* Customer Experience – client satisfaction and retention


 Ensure seamless alignment between
 **what is sold, what is promised and what is delivered** 
 .
   

  

 Success in the First 12 Months
   

  

**The Successful Candidate Will Be Expected To**
* Deliver agreed annual revenue and growth targets.
* Build a predictable and healthy sales pipeline.
* Improve sales conversion and sales productivity.
* Strengthen the key\-school account portfolio.
* Increase repeat business and customer retention.
* Build a high\-performing and accountable sales leadership team.
* Improve forecast accuracy.
* Establish standardized sales processes and performance dashboards.
* Identify and successfully penetrate new markets.
* Improve revenue quality and contribution margins.


 Key Performance Indicators
   

  

**Business**
* Revenue Achievement %
* YoY Revenue Growth
* Gross Contribution / Margin
* New Revenue


**Acquisition**
* New Schools Acquired
* New Revenue from New Accounts
* Conversion Rate
* Average Deal Value


**Retention \& Growth**

* School Retention
* Key Account Growth
* Revenue per Strategic Account


**Sales Productivity**
* Pipeline Coverage
* Sales Cycle
* Lead\-to\-Meeting Conversion
* Meeting\-to\-Closure Conversion
* Individual \& Team Productivity


**Forecasting**
* Forecast Accuracy
* Pipeline Health
* Closure Predictability


**People**
* Team Target Achievement
* Sales Attrition
* Manager Productivity
* Internal Talent Development


 Candidate ProfileExperience
   

  

* 10–15\+ years of progressive experience in B2B / institutional / consultative sales.
* 4\+ years in a senior sales leadership role managing sizeable sales teams.
* Proven experience owning significant revenue targets.
* Experience managing multi\-city or multi\-region sales operations preferred.
* Strong experience in relationship\-led businesses such as education, EdTech, travel, hospitality, SaaS, media or other B2B services will be advantageous.


 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in any relevant discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Sales, Marketing, Business Management or a related field preferred.


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Strategic Sales Leadership
* Revenue \& P\&L Orientation
* B2B / Institutional Sales
* Enterprise/Key Account Management
* Negotiation \& Commercial Acumen
* Sales Forecasting
* CRM \& Sales Analytics
* Market Expansion
* Team Building \& Leadership
* Coaching \& Performance Management
* Cross\-functional Collaboration
* Executive Communication


 Leadership Traits We Value
   

  

**We Are Looking For Someone Who**
* Thinks like a business owner, not just a salesperson.
* Is highly accountable for outcomes.
* Can operate strategically while remaining close to the ground.
* Uses data to make decisions.
* Builds strong, long\-term relationships.
* Can challenge existing processes and create better systems.
* Develops people rather than simply managing them.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented environment.
* Has the energy and maturity to represent EdTerra with senior school stakeholders.


 Why Join EdTerra?
   

  

 At EdTerra, sales is not simply about selling a product.
   

  

 It is about building long\-term partnerships with schools and helping create experiences that can have a lasting impact on students.
   

  

 As Head – Sales, you will have the opportunity to

* Experience working cross\-functionally with product, engineering, developer relations, research, analytics, and digital marketing

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, marketing, business, analytics, or a related discipline

 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience with developer\-led or product\-led growth, and measuring developer funnel signals (downloads, API calls, repository activity, retention)

* Professional fluency in one or more regional languages (e.g., Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, Bahasa Indonesia, Vietnamese, or Hindi) is a plus because the role requires direct engagement with developers, partners, and customers in local APAC markets where business is conducted in the local language


 About Meta:
   

  

 Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect.  Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. title: Regional Vice President
description:
**SRMB STEEL \| JOB DESCRIPTION** 




  





**Regional Vice President – TMT Sales, North India** 




  





**Position** 
 Regional Vice President – TMT Sales, North India
 



**Region** 
 North India
 



**Function** 
 TMT Sales, under one national market framework
 



**Grade / Level** 
 Vice President
 



**Reports to** 
 President and Chief Sales \& Marketing Officer
 



**Directly leads** 
 3–4 Zonal Heads and a regional team of 60 or more.
 



  





**Location** 




 Regional headquarters in North India, with extensive district and counter\-level travel.
 



  





**Experience** 




 15–20 years in TMT sales, from Tier 1 or Tier 2 brands only.
 



  





**1\. Why this role exists** 




 SRMB is scaling TMT towards a ₹5,000 crore business, and that scale has to be built region by region by leaders who own their market like a profit center.
 



 The Regional Vice President – North India runs the region’s TMT sales business end to end: the P\&L, the Zonal Heads, and the district and counter execution that turns strategy into market share.
 



 The region operates under one national market framework, ensuring comparable performance, disciplined execution and profitable growth.
 



  





**2\. The national market framework — one scope** 




**Every region operates on the same three pillars:** 



* **Contribution margin:** 
 Growth is measured by contribution alongside tonnage. The region is run to protect and grow margin.
* **Fixed\-cost and team productivity:** 
 Output per member and return on fixed cost are managed as measurable business outcomes, ensuring efficient scaling.
* **Counter share:** 
 Share of counter sales, won district by district, is a core measure of market strength.



  





**3\. Regional scope** 



* Region Indicative states / territories Special mandate
* **North India**
* Delhi NCR, Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Punjab, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh and Jammu \& Kashmir
* Build profitable scale across the northern demand belt through channel expansion, stronger counter share and disciplined market execution



  





**4\. Key responsibilities** 



* **Own the regional P\&L:** 
 Deliver volume, contribution margin and counter share for North India under the national framework.
* **Lead the Zonal Heads:** 
 Set targets for 3–4 Zonal Heads, run structured performance reviews, and build a regional team of 60 or more that consistently performs.
* **Drive district and counter execution:** 
 Increase counter share through disciplined district plans, wider reach, product availability and stronger channel relationships.
* **Manage cost and productivity:** 
 Hold fixed costs and team productivity to plan so the region grows profitably as it scales.
* **Lead the North India growth mandate:** 
 Strengthen existing markets, identify underserved districts, and expand distributor and dealer coverage to build sustainable regional scale.
* **Develop the market and the team:** 
 Grow the channel, increase productive counters, and develop the next line of leaders across the region.



  





**5\. Who we are looking for** 



* **15–20 years in TMT sales, from Tier 1 or Tier 2 brands only.**
* Must have led a
 **team of at least 60** 
 , with
 **3–4 direct reports at Zonal Head level** 
 .
* Proven regional P\&L ownership, with demonstrated contribution margin improvement alongside sales growth.
* Deep command of district and counter\-level execution and counter\-share growth.
* Strong track record in
 **North India’s TMT markets** 
 , with experience managing sales across multiple states and developing distributor and dealer networks.
* A leader who builds teams and the next line of leaders, uses data effectively and maintains a clear performance review cadence.
* Willingness to undertake extensive district and counter\-level travel across North India.
* **MBA preferred.**



  





**7\. What good looks like in year one** 




 North India runs as a profit center under the national framework. Growth delivers stronger contribution margins, counter share increases in priority districts, and the Zonal Heads and regional team of 60 or more perform to plan.
 



 Fixed costs and productivity remain under control as the region scales. Stronger distributor and dealer coverage, rising active billing counters and consistent district\-level execution establish a sustainable foundation for further growth.

description:
**SRMB STEEL \| JOB DESCRIPTION.** 




**Regional Vice President.**

 SRMB STEEL.

 President and Chief Sales \& Marketing Officer.

 SRMB Group is one of India’s respected steel and construction\-materials companies, with a turnover of over ₹2,500 crore, 3,000\+ employees and a strong manufacturing base.
 



 We are looking for an experienced
 **Regional Vice President.** 




  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Own the regional P\&L. Deliver volume, contribution margin and counter share for the region under the national framework.
* Lead the Zonal Head. Set targets for 3 to 4 Zonal Heads, run the review cadence, and build a 60\-plus team that performs.
* Drive district and counter execution. Take share at the counter through disciplined district plans, reach and range, not through price wars.
* Manage cost and productivity. Hold fixed cost and team productivity to plan, so the region grows profitably as it scales.
* Lead the West Bengal model (East \& NE). For East \& NE, drive the 2X West Bengal play through the two Bengal Zonal Heads and make it the template other regions follow.
* Develop the market and the team. Grow the channel, the counters and the next line of leaders across the region.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* **15 to 20 years** 
 from
 **Tier 1 or Tier 2 brands only** 
 .
* MBA preferred across all regions.



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Must have led a team of at least 60, with 3 to 4 direct reports at Zonal Head level.
* Proven regional P\&L ownership, with growth delivered on contribution margin, not tonnage alone.
* Deep command of district and counter\-level execution and counter\-share gain.
* A leader who builds teams and the next line of leaders, and runs on data and a clear review cadence.
* For East \& NE, a strong track record in the eastern market and the ability to drive the West Bengal 2X model.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Experience operating under a unified national market framework.
* Experience in managing multiple regions or diverse state markets.



  





**Pay range and compensation package** 




  





 As per the Industry.
 



  





**Additional Role Context** 




  





*Why this role exists* 



* The Regional VP runs a region of steel sales end to end: the P\&L, the Zonal Heads, and the district and counter execution that turns strategy into share.
* All four regions run under one national market framework, so growth is comparable, disciplined and margin\-led rather than a set of local styles.



  





*The national market framework (one scope)* 



* Every region operates on the same three pillars, under one scope.
* Contribution margin. Growth is measured by contribution, not tonnage alone. The region is run to protect and grow margin.
* Fixed\-cost and team productivity. Output per member and return on fixed cost are managed as hard numbers, so the region scales efficiently.
* Counter share. Share of the counter, won district by district, is the true measure of market strength.
* East \& NE leads the model. West Bengal must lead the framework, targeting 2X sales growth and competitive dominance through rigorous district and counter\-level execution, with two dedicated Zonal Heads for North Bengal and South Bengal.



  





*Regional scope* 




  




* Region / Indicative states / Special mandate.
* East \& NE: West Bengal, Odisha, Bihar, Jharkhand, Assam and the North East, Sikkim – Lead the model: West Bengal 2X, two ZHs for North and South Bengal.



  





*Measurable indices and scale of growth* 




  




* Targets are indicative and to be locked per region with the CSMO..
* Index / What it measures / Target .
* Volume growth – Regional steel tonnage – \+25 to 35% YoY (WB: 2X).
* Contribution margin – Region contribution and margin – Grow margin YoY under one framework.
* Counter share – Share of counter throughput – Top 2 or 3 in priority districts.
* Reach – Active billing counters – Rising quarter on quarter.
* Team productivity – Tonnage and contribution per member – Improve YoY, fixed cost held.
* Collections – DSO and overdue share – Within norm, overdue under 5%.

title: Product Management- (IDfy Labs)
description:
**About IDfy Labs**
 IDfy Labs is an entrepreneurial team within IDfy that is going to be working on fundamentally futuristic products in the Trust space. Our endeavor here is to work on products that will change the way our customers look at Fraud. This role is highly collaborative and you will work closely on not just the latest technologies, the focus will be on solving problems together with CEO (Ashok Hariharan), this will be a small team of 4\-5 people across functions. This will be a crash course on building a product fast, taking it to market, and driving this 0\-1 journey for the next generation of IDfy products.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 You must be deeply customer\-obsessed, naturally curious, and thrive in ambiguity. You will be responsible for identifying emerging opportunities, validating new ideas, and building entirely new products and businesses from the ground up.
   

  

 This role exists to discover the next growth opportunities for IDfy by turning unstructured problems into scalable products—not by improving what already exists, but by creating what doesn't.
   

  

**Here’s What Your Day Will Look Like…**
* Identify white\-space opportunities through customer insights, market research, and emerging technology trends.
* Validate new product ideas through customer discovery, hypothesis testing, rapid experimentation, and proof\-of\-concepts.
* Define product vision, strategy, and business cases for new ventures, taking ideas from concept to Product\-Market Fit.
* Build and iterate MVPs in collaboration with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and Business teams, using customer feedback and data to guide decisions.
* Design and execute experiments to validate desirability, feasibility, viability, and scalability before investing in full\-scale development.
* Own the end\-to\-end innovation lifecycle—from ideation and prototyping to pilot launches, early customer adoption, and successful handover for scale.
* Stay ahead of market trends, competitive landscape, regulatory changes, and advancements in AI to identify the next opportunities for IDfy.


**We are the Perfect match if you have...**
* MBA from tier 1 Institute with 3–9 years of experience in Product Management, Innovation, Venture Building, Strategy Consulting, Product Strategy, Founder’s Office, or 0→1 product development within B2B SaaS, fintech, AI, or platform businesses.
* Exceptional problem\-solving and first\-principles thinking—you enjoy solving problems that have no predefined answers.
* Proven experience building products or launching new initiatives from scratch, taking ideas from concept to execution.
* Strong customer discovery and product validation skills, with experience conducting interviews, testing hypotheses, and iterating rapidly.
* High analytical ability with a data\-driven approach to experimentation and decision\-making.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity, changing priorities, and fast\-moving environments where the path is rarely defined.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence Engineering, Business, Design, and Leadership teams.
* Entrepreneurial mindset—you take ownership, move quickly, challenge assumptions, and bias towards action.
* Obsessed with identifying opportunities before others do and passionate about building products that create entirely new value for customers.

description:
**Job Title:** Associate Territory Manager**Function:** Commercial**Reports to:** Area Manager**Location:** Kolkata**Travel Required**:**25%****50%****þ****75%****About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**  


The Senior Business Development Executive/Associate Territory Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth within the assigned Area by effectively managing the sales process for all products, including Domestic Priority (DP), International, Retail, Cargo, and E\-Retail. The role will also focus on revenue enhancement through channel partners such as Regional Service Providers (RSPs), Consolidators, Franchise Collection Centres (FCCs), and One\-Stop Centres (OSCs). The incumbent will play a crucial role in customer acquisition, relationship management, and adherence to company sales policies.

**Job Purpose:**  


This role will focus on managing the end\-to\-end sales cycle, ensuring customer satisfaction, and driving sustained business development. It requires a highly motivated and target\-driven individual with a strong understanding of the logistics and courier industry.

 **Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**  

**Sales \& Revenue Growth**

* Monitor and drive Area revenue performance to achieve targeted sales growth and profitability.
* Evaluate the profitability of key accounts and take corrective measures to achieve profit targets.
* Track product\-wise yields regularly and develop action plans to meet set targets.
* Manage the end\-to\-end sales process for the Area, ensuring revenue growth for all products.

**Channel Partner \& Customer Management**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing customers, ensuring revenue retention.
* Identify and drive new business opportunities through channel partners.
* Monitor and enhance channel partner performance in terms of revenue, sales, and profitability.
* Support sales capability\-building initiatives for sales teams and channel partners.

**Sales Operations \& Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) among sales teams and channel partners.
* Implement sales and marketing strategies to enhance market share and profitability.
* Follow up and ensure closure of product\-specific sales leads received from telemarketing or other departments.
* Negotiate rates and service offerings with customers within set approval limits.
* Maintain and update prospect details in the Saffire system on a daily basis.
* Address and resolve customer service issues in coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
* Provide insights to the Branch Sales Head regarding modifications to existing product offerings to enhance revenue and profitability.

**Collection \& Remittance**

* Ensure achievement of collection targets within the set remittance cycle and Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) benchmarks.

**People Management**

* Guide and support the sales team to ensure high performance and goal alignment.
* Ensure optimal staffing levels within the Area sales team.

**Qualifications \& Experience:**  

**Education**:* Essential: Graduate degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
* Preferred: An MBA or Postgraduate degree in Sales \& Marketing.

**Experience**:

* 1\-3 years of experience in sales, business development, or key account management in the logistics, courier, supply chain, or e\-commerce industry.
* Experience in B2B sales, managing channel partners, and driving revenue growth is an added advantage

**Skills \& Capabilities:**  

**Technical Skills:*** Strong understanding of sales processes, revenue management, and market expansion strategies.
* Experience in logistics, courier services, or supply chain management.
* Proficiency in using sales tracking tools like Saffire and Avature.
* Knowledge of data analytics and business intelligence tools for tracking sales trends and performance.

**Key Competencies:*** Result\-Oriented: Strong drive to achieve sales targets and revenue growth.
* Customer\-Centric: Ability to develop and maintain strong customer relationships.
* Analytical Thinking: Proactive approach to market analysis and business development.
* Negotiation \& Influence: Strong persuasion skills to drive sales and revenue enhancement.

**Key Performance Indicators:**  

**KRAs**

 **KPIs**

  

Growth in Area Revenues

  

% achievement of product\-wise and channel\-wise revenue targets


Achievement of yield targets (Yield per piece) for all products

  

Drive Market Growth

  

% increase in revenues from key industry segments (e.g., Automotive, Life Sciences, etc.) and key accounts

  

Enhance Revenues via Channel Partners

  

Revenue targets achieved through RSPs and other channel partners

  

Ensure Timely Collections

  

Achievement of Logic Remittance targets


Reduction in outstanding receivables (e.g., 60\-day, 90\-day, 150\-day buckets)

  

Drive Sales Capability, Productivity, and Process Adherence

  

Achievement of Sales KPIs and compliance with SOPs

  

New Product Development

  

Successful implementation of new products in the Area

  

Foster a Performance\-Driven Culture

  

Timely adherence to Performance Management System guidelines

  

Drive Employee Morale and Engagement

  

Employee retention and engagement metrics

  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**  


When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths**across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

* Experience articulating complex market access topics clearly and persuasively to key decision\-makers.
* Commercial, business or medical experience at a managerial level, with the ability to work effectively within cross\-functional teams.
  

**Useful, but not essential:**

  

* Exposure to areas beyond your direct experience listed above.

  

**What you'll do**

  

* Shape therapy access strategies for new and existing launches by identifying market opportunities, planning account\-based approaches and ensuring budget allocation for Novo Nordisk therapy areas.
* Manage national key accounts — including ESI, Railway, CGHS and Army — driving aligned actions across commercial functions to strengthen product presence and formulary inclusion.
* Coordinate with Sales Managers and Key Account Managers on state tenders, tracking product cycles across institutional accounts and providing regular updates on tender and account status.
* Train and support Key Account Managers on account management practices, collaborating with Sales, Marketing and People \& Organisation to build capability.
* Serve as the single point of contact for therapy access knowledge, connecting global materials and up\-to\-date product information with local teams and institutional partners.
* Support the institution team in filing tenders by providing accurate, current documentation and product information.
  

**Who you'll work with**

  

You will join a market access team within Rare Disease \& Public Care, working at the intersection of commercial strategy and payer engagement. Your closest partners will be colleagues across Marketing, CMR, Sales, Key Account Management and medical functions within the affiliate.

  

Externally, you will build and maintain a broad network of stakeholders with influence on market access outcomes — including government bodies, payers, policy makers and key opinion leaders. You will also connect with regional and global market access colleagues to share learning and align on priorities.

  

The role is cross\-functional by nature. You will bring different perspectives together, create clarity around account priorities and help teams move from insight to action across therapy areas.

  

**What you can expect here**

  

You will work in an environment where your expertise in payer engagement and account strategy directly shapes commercial outcomes. The role offers the opportunity to deepen your market access skills, collaborate across functions and contribute to work that expands treatment access for people living with serious chronic diseases.

  

You will be trusted to take ownership of your accounts and priorities, supported to develop new capabilities and encouraged to share your perspective. Cross\-functional collaboration, honest feedback and a focus on results define how the team works together.

  

**Start now**

  

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to strengthen therapy access and help more people benefit from Novo Nordisk's portfolio, apply for the Market Access Manager role by 24 September 2026\. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

  

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

**NATIONAL BUSINESS HEAD – MEDICAL DEVICES \& HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY** 




**Company:** 

 EL\&EL Industries Pvt. Ltd.

 Ahmedabad, Gujarat \| Extensive travel across India
 




**Reporting to:** 

 Managing Director / Founders
 




**Function:** 

 National Sales, Marketing, Distribution \& Institutional Business
 



**ABOUT EL\&EL** 


 EL\&EL Industries Pvt. Ltd. is an emerging Indian medical technology company focused on advanced surgical devices, medical equipment, minimally invasive surgery solutions, sterilization and infection\-control systems, and allied healthcare technologies.
 




 With a strong and growing business in Gujarat, EL\&EL is now entering its next phase: building a structured, scalable pan\-India presence.
 



 We are looking for a
 **National Business Head** 
 to lead this expansion and build the commercial organization required for EL\&EL’s next stage of growth.
 



 This is a hands\-on business\-building role. The person will be expected to build markets, recruit teams, appoint distributors, develop hospital and institutional relationships, establish systems and deliver measurable revenue growth.
 


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 

**1\. PAN\-INDIA EXPANSION \& SALES** 




 • Develop the national expansion strategy and state\-wise roadmap.
 



 • Prioritize markets based on potential, competition, customer opportunity and channel availability.
 



 • Set revenue targets, manpower requirements, distributor plans and timelines.
 



 • Design the national sales structure and recruit regional, zonal, state and territory teams.
 



 • Define KRAs, territories, targets and accountability systems.
 



 • Conduct field visits, joint customer calls and performance reviews.
 




 • Build a strong second line of leadership.
 




**2\. DISTRIBUTOR \& CHANNEL DEVELOPMENT** 




 • Identify, evaluate, appoint and develop distributors across priority markets.
 



 • Negotiate commercial terms, territory rights, targets, payment terms and stock commitments.
 



 • Evaluate partners on market reach, financial strength, hospital relationships, sales/service capability and compliance.
 



 • Track distributor productivity, secondary sales, inventory, customer activation and collections.
 



 • Manage channel conflict, discounting and inactive partners.
 



**3\. HOSPITAL \& INSTITUTIONAL BUSINESS** 




 • Develop business with corporate hospitals, hospital chains, medical colleges, surgical centres and other healthcare institutions.
 




 • Build relationships with surgeons, clinicians, biomedical teams, purchase departments and hospital management.
 




 • Drive the sales cycle from demonstrations and clinical evaluations through quotations, purchase orders, installation, training and repeat business.
 



 • Develop key hospital accounts and clinical opinion\-leader relationships.
 



 • Coordinate with application, service, regulatory, operations and manufacturing teams.
 



**4\. GOVERNMENT \& TENDER BUSINESS** 




 • Build EL\&EL’s government and institutional business across India.
 




 • Develop opportunities with Central and State Government institutions, government medical colleges, public hospitals, defence healthcare institutions, ESIC and other eligible buyers.
 




 • Drive business through government tenders, GeM, e\-procurement, rate contracts and procurement bodies.
 



 • Establish tender intelligence and opportunity tracking.
 



 • Coordinate bids with regulatory, finance, legal, service and operations teams.
 



 • Monitor profitability, payment cycles, execution obligations and receivables.
 



 • Ensure all government business is conducted ethically and in compliance with applicable laws.
 



**5\. COMMERCIAL SYSTEMS, MARKETING \& GROWTH** 




 • Implement a standardized sales pipeline and disciplined CRM usage.
 



 • Establish regular business reviews and improve forecast accuracy.
 



 • Build dashboards for revenue, margins, collections, pipeline and channel productivity.
 




 • Own national sales targets and contribute to the commercial P\&L.
 




 • Maintain pricing, margin and collection discipline.
 




 • Coordinate demand forecasting with manufacturing, procurement and inventory teams.
 




 • Develop recurring revenue through consumables, accessories, service contracts and repeat business.
 



 • Develop marketing programs including product launches, clinical workshops, training, conferences, exhibitions and digital initiatives.
 



 • Ensure marketing generates measurable opportunities.
 



**6\. LEADERSHIP \& CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL MANAGEMENT** 





 • Build a culture based on ownership, integrity, accountability, teamwork and execution.
 





 • Set clear expectations and measurable KRAs.
 





 • Encourage realistic forecasting and transparent reporting.
 





 • Develop future managers and leaders.
 




 • Work closely with Founders and cross\-functional teams.
 



 • Ensure customer commitments are commercially and operationally deliverable.
 


**KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS** 

 The role will be measured through:
 




 • National revenue and YoY growth
 





 • Gross/contribution margins
 




 • New customer acquisition, repeat and consumable revenue
 



 • Collections and receivable ageing
 




 • Priority states activated
 





 • Active and productive distributors
 




 • Sales\-team recruitment and productivity
 




 • Pipeline quality and forecast accuracy
 





 • Demonstration\-to\-order and quotation\-to\-order conversion
 




 • Government and tender business
 




 • Key hospital accounts and clinical relationships
 




 • Marketing and market\-development ROI
 


**IDEAL CANDIDATE** 


 •
 
**10–20 years** 

 of relevant experience in medical devices, surgical equipment, hospital equipment, healthcare technology, capital equipment or related healthcare businesses.
 




 • At least
 **5 years in a senior regional, zonal or national sales leadership role.** 





 • Proven experience expanding business across multiple Indian states.
 




 • Experience building and managing geographically distributed sales teams.
 




 • Strong distributor and channel\-management experience.
 





 • Experience selling to hospitals, surgeons, purchase departments and biomedical teams.
 





 • Meaningful exposure to government tenders, institutional business and public\-sector procurement.
 




 Experience in
 **surgical devices, minimally invasive surgery, operating\-room equipment, sterilization/infection control, medical capital equipment, surgical consumables or aesthetic medical devices** 
 is an advantage.
 



**Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field. MBA/postgraduate qualification in Sales, Marketing or Business Management is preferred but not mandatory. Strong business performance and execution will carry greater weight than qualifications alone.
 


**THE LEADER WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 

 We are looking for a hands\-on leader who spends meaningful time in the market, converts discussions into actions and orders, provides realistic forecasts, takes ownership of problems and builds systems that can scale beyond individual relationships.
 


**FIRST\-YEAR MANDATE** 


 Within the first 12 months, the National Business Head will be expected to:
 



1. Review EL\&EL’s current Gujarat business, product portfolio, pricing, channels and sales capabilities.
2. Develop a pan\-India expansion plan covering priority states, revenue, manpower, distributors and timelines.
3. Establish sales leadership and market coverage across priority regions.
4. Build and activate a high\-quality distributor network.
5. Implement national CRM, sales\-review and forecasting systems.
6. Build a structured government and institutional\-business pipeline.
7. Develop relationships with major hospital groups, government institutions, surgeons and clinical opinion leaders.
8. Deliver agreed revenue, margin and collection targets.
9. Build a disciplined and ethical sales culture.
10. Create a scalable commercial organization for EL\&EL’s national growth.


**WORKING CONDITIONS** 


 • Full\-time leadership position based in/around Ahmedabad.
 





 • Extensive travel across India is an essential part of the role.
 





 • Regular customer, hospital, distributor, government and field\-team engagement is expected.
 





 • Performance will be reviewed against defined quarterly and annual objectives.
 




**If you are a hands\-on healthcare sales leader who has built markets, teams and channels and are ready to build a national business from the ground up, we would like to hear from you.**

 Category \& Business Ownership
 


* Own the
 **Baby \& Kids Wear category** 
 and its overall business performance.
* Develop annual, seasonal and category growth plans.
* Own category\-level revenue, margin, profitability and inventory outcomes.
* Analyse sales, margins, sell\-through, stock cover, ageing and SKU\-level performance.
* Identify category gaps and opportunities across price points, age groups, styles and product segments.
* Build a balanced portfolio of core, seasonal and new products.
* Drive sustainable category growth while maintaining healthy inventory and margins.



 Design \& Collection Development
 


* Lead the development of seasonal and core collections from concept to launch.
* Define collection themes, colour palettes, prints, fabrics, silhouettes and product direction.
* Translate consumer insights, market trends and competitive intelligence into commercially viable products.
* Build and manage collection calendars and launch timelines.
* Ensure collections have the right balance of
 **fashion, functionality, comfort, safety and commercial viability** 
 .
* Evaluate product performance and use consumer and sales data to inform future collections.



 Product Development \& Apparel Expertise
 


* Own product development from initial concept through sampling, approvals and production.
* Have strong knowledge of
 **knitted and woven fabrics** 
 and their application in baby and kids apparel.
* Understand GSM, shrinkage, pilling, colourfastness, fabric performance and garment durability.
* Have strong understanding of fit, patterns, stitching, trims, construction and garment finishing.
* Ensure apparel meets appropriate standards for
 **comfort, quality, durability and safety** 
 for babies and children.
* Work closely with technical and quality teams to resolve product and manufacturing issues.



 Sourcing \& Vendor Management
 


* Build and manage a reliable network of
 **mills, garment manufacturers, factories and trim suppliers** 
 .
* Drive product development and sourcing from concept to commercial production.
* Evaluate and develop vendors based on quality, capability, capacity, cost and delivery performance.
* Own product costing, BOMs, target pricing and manufacturing feasibility.
* Negotiate with suppliers to achieve competitive cost structures without compromising quality.
* Monitor vendor performance and drive improvements in quality, lead time and OTIF.
* Develop alternate sourcing options for critical products and materials.



 Merchandising \& Range Management
 


* Lead merchandising strategy across the Baby \& Kids Wear portfolio.
* Build assortment plans based on consumer demand, seasonality, price points and channel requirements.
* Define SKU architecture and collection depth.
* Monitor product\-level performance and make timely decisions on replenishment, markdowns, continuation and discontinuation.
* Ensure new collections are launched with the right inventory and channel readiness.



 Forecasting \& Inventory Planning
 


* Own demand forecasting and seasonal merchandise planning.
* Work closely with sales and ecommerce teams to translate demand signals into inventory requirements.
* Establish SKU\-level inventory plans and replenishment mechanisms.
* Maintain healthy stock cover and inventory turns.
* Minimise stock\-outs, excess inventory and ageing stock.
* Use sales and inventory data to continuously improve forecast accuracy and buying decisions.



 Team Leadership
 


* Lead and develop teams across
 **design, merchandising and product development** 
 .
* Set clear KRAs, KPIs, SOPs and review mechanisms.
* Build a strong product and category culture focused on ownership and commercial outcomes.
* Mentor team members and build leadership capability within the function.
* Ensure clear accountability across the product lifecycle.



 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
 



 Work closely with:
 


* Supply Chain
* Procurement
* Quality
* Ecommerce
* Retail / Sales
* Marketing
* Finance
* Operations



 to ensure seamless execution from
 **product concept → development → sourcing → production → launch → sell\-through** 
 .
 



  





**Key Performance Indicators** 




 Success in this role will be measured through:
 


* Category Revenue \& Growth
* Gross Margin \& Profitability
* Collection Launch Adherence
* Product Success Rate
* Sell\-through %
* Inventory Turns
* Stock Cover
* Forecast Accuracy
* Stock\-out \& Ageing Inventory
* Vendor OTIF
* Product Quality \& Returns
* New Product Contribution
* Team Performance



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* **10\+ years of experience** 
 in apparel, fashion, merchandising, category management or product leadership.
* Strong experience in
 **Baby Wear / Kids Wear / Children's Apparel** 
 is highly preferred.
* Experience owning or significantly contributing to a complete apparel category or business.
* Strong understanding of the
 **end\-to\-end apparel value chain** 
 — design, product development, fabrics, sourcing, manufacturing, merchandising and inventory.
* Strong fabric and garment knowledge, particularly across knitted and woven products.
* Proven experience in vendor development, product costing and manufacturing management.
* Strong understanding of demand forecasting, assortment planning and inventory management.
* Commercial orientation with the ability to connect product decisions to
 **revenue, margin and profitability** 
 .
* Experience working with retail, D2C, ecommerce or consumer brands.
* Strong team leadership and cross\-functional stakeholder management skills.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-moving environment with high ownership and accountability.



  





**Qualification** 




 Graduate / Postgraduate in
 **Fashion Design, Textile Technology, Apparel Manufacturing, Fashion Management** 
 or a related discipline.
 



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile** 




 We are looking for candidates currently working in senior roles such as
 **Apparel Head, Category Head, Business Head, Product Head, Design \& Merchandising Head or similar leadership positions** 
 within Baby Wear, Kids Wear, Fashion, Apparel, Retail, D2C or consumer brands.
 



 The ideal candidate should have demonstrated ownership across multiple stages of the apparel value chain and be able to combine
 **strong product understanding with commercial and category thinking** 
 .
 



  





 Why Join?
 


* Lead and build a high\-potential
 **Baby \& Kids Wear category** 
 .
* Own the category across product, sourcing, merchandising and commercial performance.
* Work closely with leadership on category strategy and growth.
* Build collections that directly reach a large base of parents and young consumers.
* Opportunity to build a category and team with significant scope for growth.

title: Director - Aftermarket
description:

 This role is intended to create a single accountability center for aftermarket growth and is expected to unlock Whitespace revenue across the installed base by establishing structured coverage, pricing discipline, and cross\-functional execution rigor.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
**P\&L Ownership \& Revenue Growth**
* Own the complete national aftermarket P\&L – spares revenue, M\-Powered, retrofits, service billings and new AM product lines
* Set and deliver annual revenue targets in partnership with Head of Sales \& Marketing and Regional leadership
* Protect margin guardrails across pricing, channel economics and service billing models
* Lead monthly AM reviews with Regional Aftermarket Heads; drive corrective action on revenue and coverage gaps


**Strategy \& Growth Roadmap**
* Own the AM growth roadmap, including identified growth initiatives, installed\-base monetization, M\-Powered conversion, retrofit pipeline

* Data\-driven performance management with strong revenue forecasting capability
* Strategic roadmap development and governance planning

**Leadership**
* Cross\-functional leadership – ability to align Sales, Spares, Service and Supply Chain

**Experience**
* 15\+ years of total experience, with at least 5–7 years in aftermarket, service or B2B industrial sales leadership roles
* Demonstrated P\&L ownership in capital goods, industrial equipment or allied sectors (e.g., compressors, machine tools, auto components, material handling)
* Proven track record of building and scaling aftermarket revenue including spares and service revenue streams
* Experience managing large, geographically distributed field teams (service engineers, sales managers)
* Exposure to channel/dealer networks and distributor management is a strong plus
* MBA or equivalent preferred; engineering background (Mechanical / Production) is advantageous

 \&

title: Category Manager - Orthopedic Power Systems
description:
Category Manager \- Orthopedic Power Systems
   

 Location: Pune, Maharashtra
   

 Employment Type: Full\-time
   

 Travel: Extensive domestic travel; occasional international travel
   

  

 1\. Role Purpose
   

  

 The Category Manager – Orthopedic Power Systems will be responsible for building, managing, and growing Manman’s Orthopedic Power Systems business as an independent strategic category.
   

  

 The role will own the complete category lifecycle — from market intelligence, product strategy and portfolio planning to pricing, sales enablement, channel development, marketing, product launches, inventory planning and profitability.
   

  

 The individual will act as the central interface between R\&D, Engineering, Production, Quality \& Regulatory, Sales, Service, Marketing, Finance and Supply Chain, ensuring that the Orthopedic Power Systems portfolio remains clinically relevant, commercially competitive and financially successful.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should combine strong orthopedic product knowledge with commercial and business\-development capability.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 2\. Key Responsibilities
   

  

 A. Category Strategy \& Business Ownership
   

  

 \- Develop and execute the annual and long\-term strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 \- Own category revenue, gross margin, market share and growth objectives.
   

 \- Develop annual business plans covering:
   

 \- Revenue
   

 \- Unit volumes
   

 \- ASP
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- Channel mix
   

 \- Geographic expansion
   

 \- Identify new market opportunities, customer segments and applications for orthopedic power systems.
   

 \- Develop category growth strategies for India and selected international markets.
   

 \- Track competitors, pricing, technology, product launches and market positioning.
   

 \- Identify gaps in Manman’s portfolio and recommend new products or product variants.
   

  

 B. Product Portfolio Management
   

  

 Own the complete Orthopedic Power Systems portfolio, including relevant:
   

  

 \- High\-speed drill systems
   

 \- Large\-bone systems
   

 \- Small\-bone systems
   

 \- Saw systems
   

 \- Oscillating/sagittal saws
   

 \- Reciprocating saws
   

 \- Shaver systems
   

 \- Endoscopic burr systems
   

 \- Attachments
   

 \- Handpieces
   

 \- Accessories
   

 \- Consumables
   

 \- Batteries and chargers
   

 \- Related service and AMC offerings
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Define product positioning and target customer for each product.
   

 \- Maintain the product portfolio and product lifecycle.
   

 \- Identify products requiring upgrades, replacement or discontinuation.
   

 \- Develop product roadmaps in coordination with R\&D and Engineering.
   

 \- Define product specifications based on market and clinical requirements.
   

 \- Gather voice\-of\-customer and surgeon feedback.
   

 \- Convert clinical requirements into clear product requirements for Engineering/R\&D.
   

  

 C. Product Development \& New Product Introduction
   

  

 \- Prepare Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for new products.
   

 \- Work with Engineering/R\&D on product development priorities.
   

 \- Coordinate prototype evaluation with surgeons and key opinion leaders.
   

 \- Organize clinical/user evaluations and product trials.
   

 \- Coordinate with Quality \& Regulatory for required documentation and approvals.
   

 \- Develop launch plans for new products.
   

 \- Establish product readiness gates before commercial launch.
   

 \- Coordinate first production, field trials and commercial release.
   

  

 D. Pricing \& Commercial Management
   

  

 \- Develop product pricing strategy based on:
   

 \- Manufacturing cost
   

 \- Landed cost
   

 \- Competitor pricing
   

 \- Clinical value
   

 \- Channel margins
   

 \- Customer segment
   

 \- Market positioning
   

 \- Recommend MRP, distributor/dealer pricing and institutional pricing.
   

 \- Monitor discounting and price realization.
   

 \- Develop tender and institutional pricing frameworks.
   

 \- Identify opportunities to improve category gross margin.
   

 \- Monitor profitability by product, customer segment and channel.
   

  

 E. Sales Enablement
   

  

 Work closely with the Sales team to increase conversion and category penetration.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop sales presentations and product literature.
   

 \- Create product comparison sheets.
   

 \- Develop competitive battle cards.
   

 \- Conduct regular product training for sales teams and distributors.
   

 \- Train sales personnel on clinical applications and product positioning.
   

 \- Support major customer meetings, product demonstrations and evaluations.
   

 \- Participate in important tenders and institutional negotiations.
   

 \- Support the sales team in converting strategic accounts.
   

  

 F. Surgeon \& Key Opinion Leader Engagement
   

  

 Build strong relationships with orthopedic surgeons, hospitals and clinical experts.
   

  

 \- Identify and develop Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).
   

 \- Conduct surgeon feedback programs.
   

 \- Organize product demonstrations and workshops.
   

 \- Coordinate product evaluations at hospitals.
   

 \- Gather structured feedback on product performance and clinical usability.
   

 \- Identify emerging surgical techniques and applications.
   

 \- Develop surgeon advisory panels where appropriate.
   

 \- Convert clinical feedback into product\-development priorities.
   

  

 G. Channel \& Market Development
   

  

 \- Develop strategies for direct, dealer and distributor channels.
   

 \- Identify and onboard suitable channel partners.
   

 \- Define territory\-wise category opportunities.
   

 \- Develop distributor sales targets and business plans.
   

 \- Monitor distributor inventory and secondary sales.
   

 \- Identify underpenetrated states and territories.
   

 \- Support international expansion of the category where required.
   

 \- Develop market\-entry plans for new countries.
   

  

 H. Marketing \& Category Communication
   

  

 Work with the Marketing team to build the Orthopedic Power Systems brand and category.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop category positioning and messaging.
   

 \- Plan product launches and campaigns.
   

 \- Create clinical and technical marketing content.
   

 \- Develop brochures, catalogues, videos and digital content.
   

 \- Support exhibitions, conferences and workshops.
   

 \- Plan surgeon engagement activities.
   

 \- Develop product demonstrations and educational material.
   

 \- Measure marketing effectiveness and lead conversion.
   

  

 I. Demand Planning \& Inventory
   

  

 Work closely with Sales, Production and Supply Chain to ensure the right product availability.
   

  

 \- Prepare monthly and annual demand forecasts.
   

 \- Translate sales plans into SKU\-level forecasts.
   

 \- Monitor inventory levels and ageing.
   

 \- Identify slow\-moving and obsolete inventory.
   

 \- Coordinate production planning based on demand.
   

 \- Ensure availability of critical handpieces, attachments, batteries and consumables.
   

 \- Monitor forecast accuracy.
   

 \- Work towards improving inventory turns and working capital efficiency.
   

  

 J. Service \& Product Lifecycle Management
   

  

 Work closely with the Service team to improve customer experience and product lifecycle economics.
   

  

 \- Analyse field failures and service complaints.
   

 \- Identify recurring product issues.
   

 \- Coordinate corrective actions with Engineering and Quality.
   

 \- Monitor warranty claims.
   

 \- Develop AMC/service opportunities.
   

 \- Identify opportunities for refurbishment, upgrades and replacement sales.
   

 \- Track installed base and replacement cycles.
   

 \- Develop strategies for consumable and accessory attachment.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

 The Category Manager will be evaluated on measurable business outcomes including:
   

  

 Commercial
   

  

 \- Category revenue growth
   

 \- Unit sales growth
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Average selling price
   

 \- Price realization
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- New customer acquisition
   

  

 Market
   

  

 \- Market share growth
   

 \- Number of active hospitals
   

 \- Number of active surgeons/users
   

 \- Geographic penetration
   

 \- Dealer/distributor productivity
   

  

 Product
   

  

 \- New product launches
   

 \- Launch success
   

 \- Product adoption
   

 \- Product lifecycle management
   

 \- Customer satisfaction
   

 \- Product quality feedback
   

  

 Channel
   

  

 \- Active distributors/dealers
   

 \- Distributor sales
   

 \- Secondary sales
   

 \- Dealer productivity
   

 \- Channel inventory
   

  

 Operational
   

  

 \- Forecast accuracy
   

 \- Inventory turns
   

 \- Slow\-moving inventory
   

 \- Product availability
   

 \- Warranty/service performance
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 4\. Cross\-Functional Responsibilities
   

  

 The Category Manager will work closely with:
   

  

 Function\| Primary Interaction
   

 Sales\| Revenue, pipeline, product conversion
   

 Marketing\| Category positioning and campaigns
   

 R\&D / Engineering\| Product development and roadmap
   

 Production\| Costing, capacity and product availability
   

 Quality \& Regulatory\| Compliance and product approvals
   

 Service\| Installed base, failures and lifecycle
   

 Supply Chain\| Forecasting and inventory
   

 Finance\| Pricing, margins and profitability
   

 Management\| Category strategy and business reviews
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 5\. Candidate Profile
   

  

 Education
   

  

 Preferred:
   

  

 \- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or a related discipline.
   

 \- MBA in Marketing, Product Management or Business Management will be an advantage.
   

  

 Experience
   

  

 5–10 years of relevant experience, preferably in:
   

  

 \- Orthopedic medical devices
   

 \- Surgical instruments
   

 \- Orthopedic power tools
   

 \- Neurosurgical power tools
   

 \- Surgical equipment
   

 \- Medical device product management
   

 \- Medical device sales/business development
   

  

 Candidates with strong experience in orthopedic power tools, surgical drills, saws, shavers or related capital equipment will be preferred.
   

  

 Required Skills
   

  

 \- Strong understanding of orthopedic surgical procedures and applications.
   

 \- Product management experience.
   

 \- Commercial and business\-development orientation.
   

 \- Strong analytical and market\-research capabilities.
   

 \- Understanding of medical\-device distribution.
   

 \- Pricing and margin management.
   

 \- Excellent presentation and communication skills.
   

 \- Ability to interact confidently with orthopedic surgeons.
   

 \- Ability to work with engineering and technical teams.
   

 \- Strong negotiation skills.
   

 \- Willingness to travel extensively.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 6\. Desired Personal Attributes
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be:
   

  

 \- Commercially aggressive but analytically driven
   

 \- Customer and surgeon focused
   

 \- Strong in ownership and execution
   

 \- Comfortable working with ambiguity
   

 \- Data driven
   

 \- Curious about technology
   

 \- Strong at cross\-functional coordination
   

 \- Able to understand both clinical and commercial requirements
   

 \- Comfortable presenting to senior management
   

 \- Willing to spend significant time in the field
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 7\. What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Within the first 12 months, the Category Manager should be able to:
   

  

 1\. Establish a clear strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 2\. Build a comprehensive competitor and market map.
   

 3\. Define the product portfolio and product roadmap.
   

 4\. Establish SKU\-level sales and demand forecasts.
   

 5\. Improve sales\-team product capability.
   

 6\. Build a structured surgeon/KOL engagement program.
   

 7\. Improve product conversion and market penetration.
   

 8\. Identify new product and portfolio opportunities.
   

 9\. Improve category gross margins and price realization.
   

 10\. Establish a measurable category review system with monthly business dashboards.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 8\. Role Philosophy
   

  

 This is not a conventional Product Manager role.
   

  

 The Category Manager is expected to operate as the business owner of Orthopedic Power Systems, with responsibility extending beyond product specifications into revenue, profitability, market development, customer adoption and portfolio growth.
   

  

 The role requires an individual who can move seamlessly between a surgeon discussion in the morning, a product\-development meeting in the afternoon and a commercial/business review with management in the evening.

title: Business Head - India

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Business \& P\&L Leadership
   

  

* Lead the India business with full P\&L accountability
* Drive sustainable revenue growth and profitability
* Manage business planning, budgeting, forecasting, and pricing strategy
* Oversee commercial performance, inventory, working capital, and operational effectiveness
* Report business performance and strategic initiatives to the Board

* Lead, coach, and develop the sales organization
* Set sales targets, monitor performance, and drive accountability

 Business Development

title: Senior Manager 2-Auto Loan : Fintech
description:

 Flipkart is looking for a high\-impact leader to spearhead the growth of our Auto Loan Marketplace. As the
 



 Senior Manager of Business Development, you will be the primary architect of our 2\-Wheeler (2W) and
 



 4\-Wheeler (4W) financing ecosystem. You aren't just managing a product; you are building a scalable
 



 business from the ground up within the Flipkart app, ensuring that millions of customers have seamless
 



 access to vehicle credit.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 ● Lender Onboarding: Identify, negotiate, and integrate with leading Banks, NBFCs, and Captive
 



 Finance companies to build a diverse lending panel.
 



 ● OEM \& Dealer Relations: Build strategic alliances with major 2W/4W manufacturers (OEMs) and
 



 large dealer networks to integrate financing at the point of intent.
 



 ● Product Ecosystem: Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to build a frictionless
 



 "Apply\-to\-Disburse" journey for users.
 



 ● Stakeholder Management: Ability to influence internal product teams and external C\-suite
 



 executives at banking institutions.
 



 ● Revenue Growth: Take full accountability for the Auto Loan P\&L, focusing on Top\-line
 



 (Disbursement volumes) and Bottom\-line (Commission/Fee income).
 



 ● Market Penetration: Design and execute go\-to\-market (GTM) strategies to scale the business
 



 across Pan India digitally.
 



 ● Incentive Design: Manage subvention programs and promotional budgets to drive conversion
 



 without eroding margins.
 



 ● Entrepreneurial Mindset: You are comfortable with ambiguity and have the grit to build a vertical
 



 in a fast\-paced environment.
 



 ● Funnel Optimization: Deep\-dive into the conversion funnel—from lead generation to loan
 



 sanction—to identify and fix drop\-offs.
 



 ● Risk \& Quality: Work closely with the partners Risk team to ensure the lead quality meets lender
 



 appetite while maintaining a healthy "Approval Rate."
 



 ● Analytical Rigor: You are a "Power User" of Excel. You don't just report numbers; you find the
 



 story within them to drive strategy.
 



 What We Are Looking For
 



 ● Experience: 6–10 years of experience, ideally in a FinTech, Digital Lending, or a high\-growth
 



 E\-commerce environment. Direct experience in Auto Finance is a huge plus.
 



 Qualifications:
 



 Education: MBA in Finance, Banking or a related field.
 



 Experience: 6 to 10 years of experience in lending operations, with at least 5 years in the Two\-Wheeler
 



 finance sector.
 



  





 Why Join Flipkart Fintech?
 



  





 You will be at the forefront of the "Credit Revolution" in India. With Flipkart's massive user base, you have
 



 the unique opportunity to solve for credit under\-penetration in the automobile sector using data and
 



 technology at a scale very few companies globally can offer.
 



 Note: This role requires a balance of "feet\-on\-street" partnership hustle and "office\-at\-desk" analytical
 



 depth.
 



 To succeed in this role – you should have the following: \*
 



 ● Strong understanding of the Indian two\-wheeler market and lending landscape.
 



 ● Proficiency in financial modeling, budgeting, and forecasting.
 



 ● Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
 



 ● Ability to drive digital transformation and process automation in lending operations.
 



 Mandatory Skills
 



 Understanding of Two Wheeler \& Four Wheeler Financing business, Ability to analyze data, Stakeholder
 



 Management, Strong Problem Solving Skills, Strong Excel Skills
 



  





 1\. Strategic Partnerships \& Marketplace Building

title: Strategic Insights Manager
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3\.7 billion in revenue, its first billion\-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27\. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology \- hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.
   

  

 This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.
   

  

**SHOULD YOU ACCEPT THIS CHALLENGE...**
 We are seeking a strategic, analytically rigorous individual to fill the role of a
 **Strategic Insights Manager** 
 within the Commercial Strategy \& Transformation team. This role will serve as a critical partner in driving a 360° view of business performance, supporting the Line of Business (LoB) Rhythm of the Business (RtB), and advancing high\-impact commercial transformation initiatives.
   

  

 This individual will combine structured problem solving, data\-driven insight generation, and cross\-functional influence to accelerate growth, improve operational efficiency, and ensure accountability to transformational OKRs.
   

  

* Support the Rhythm of the Business (RtB) operating model (e.g., QBR preparation, earnings support, dashboard development) while advancing carved\-out workstreams and transformation\-focused analyses
* Lead efforts to gather, analyze, and interpret commercial performance data, customer insights, and market trends to identify actionable insights and synthesize at an executive level
* Develop detailed fact bases and standardized assessment approach to formulate initial data\-driven hypotheses to guide strategic discussions and decision\-making
* Create robust business cases and financial models to assess the feasibility, impact, and ROI of proposed transformation initiatives working closely with cross\-functional stakeholders to validate assumptions, conduct sensitivity analysis, and present recommendations
* Collaborate with Commercial Strategy \& Transformation HQ resources on specific artifacts, playbooks, and frameworks to support activation plans and ensure consistency in execution
* Support program management of transformation initiatives tied to commercial transformation projects, ensuring alignment, stakeholder engagement, and successful adoption
* Develop and maintain dashboards and KPI tracking mechanisms to monitor performance, proactively surface tactical insights, and recommend optimization actions


**What You’ll Need To Bring To This Role…**
* 3\-5\+ years of relevant work experience with at least 2 years in management consulting, private equity or top\-tier tech strategy or ‘biz ops’ functions
* Robust analytical skill set mixed with intellectual curiosity and open\-mindedness to accelerate change
* GTM experience with strategic business transformation and commercial excellence topics such as operating model design, process efficiency, sales effectiveness, productivity improvement, revenue acceleration, etc.
* Experience in partnering with cross functional teams to program manage and execute large\-scale transformations
* Strong influencing skills and the ability to inspire teams and stakeholders at all levels of the organization
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas to Executive audiences
* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, or related field. MBA or advanced degree preferred or “direct promote” in Consulting
* Experience in the B2B technology industry is a must, knowledge of the data storage industry is a plus


 We are primarily an in\-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Pure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

* Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!

 And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company\-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.
   

  

**Accommodations And Accessibility**
 Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA\-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.
   

  

**Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team**
 We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.
   

  

 Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.
