title: Head of Startups - India and South Asia
description:
NVIDIA Inception is our free global programme for start\-ups building with AI, data science and accelerated computing — now more than 40,000 companies worldwide, with over 2,000 of them based in India alone. South Asia is one of the fastest\-moving corners of that network: a market whose density sits in applied and vertical AI — medical imaging, drug discovery, edge vision, agentic and sovereign AI, robotics, agri\-tech, AI governance — rather than in frontier model labs.
   

  

 We are looking for an Inception Regional Lead to own that motion end to end. This is a builder’s role with a commercial edge. You will set the regional strategy, lead a team of Inception Partner and Community managers across India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and neighbouring markets, and be personally accountable for how much NVIDIA hardware, software and cloud the region’s start\-ups design in and consume. You will spend real time on the ground in founders’ offices, because that is where stalled accounts turn into concrete asks. And you will act as the connective tissue between start\-ups and the rest of NVIDIA — worldwide field operations, solution architects, developer marketing, the reseller and cloud partner ecosystem, and NVentures.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Own the South Asia Inception strategy and number. Set regional priorities, coverage model and account tiering across strategic, member, community and prospect accounts; forecast and report on pipeline, design wins and consumption to programme and field leadership.
* Lead and grow the team. Manage, coach and develop a team of Inception Partner and community programme managers. Set territory and vertical coverage, run the operating cadence, and raise the bar on technical fluency and commercial rigour across the team.
* Drive commercial outcomes with start\-ups. Move accounts from awareness to technical discovery to a named workload — running workload, benchmark and target\-metric discovery, qualifying architecture and annual cloud spend, and landing hardware and cloud asks through the Inception Benefits Catalog, rebate programmes, DGX Cloud credits and preferred pricing.
* Build the partner and reseller motion. Work with OEMs, resellers, cloud and NVIDIA Cloud Partners and system integrators so that start\-up demand converts cleanly into fulfilled orders and deployed capacity.
* Deepen the ecosystem. Build durable relationships with the region’s VCs and accelerators through the Inception VC Alliance, and with research parks, IITs and university incubators, government innovation bodies and industry associations, to generate high\-quality inbound and give members a route to capital and customers.
* Land the technical value. Partner with solution architects and developer relations to get members productive on the NVIDIA stack — NIM, NeMo, Nemotron, Riva, Isaac Sim, Omniverse, Morpheus, Clara, Jetson, DGX and AI Enterprise — and drive Deep Learning Institute training, hackathons, workshops and bring\-your\-own\-project days at scale.
* Tell the region’s story. Work with developer and Inception marketing on co\-marketing plans, technical blogs, member showcases, testimonials and video, and represent Inception at GTC, AI Summits, and regional start\-up and investor events.
* Run the programme cleanly. Own member onboarding, tier qualification, data hygiene and reporting in NVIDIA’s programme and CRM systems, so that regional performance is measurable and auditable.
* Bring the market back to NVIDIA. Feed structured intelligence on regional workloads, competitive pressure, sovereign AI initiatives and funding trends to product, field and executive stakeholders.


**What We Need To See**
* 12\+ years of experience across start\-up ecosystem development, developer or partner programmes, technology alliances, business development or technical sales — with at least 5 years leading and developing a team.
* BS/BTech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. MBA or advanced degree welcome.
* Demonstrated ownership of a commercial target in a technology business, with a track record of turning early\-stage relationships into revenue, design wins or measurable platform adoption.
* Working technical fluency in AI and accelerated computing: you can hold a credible conversation with a founder or CTO about model training and inference, GPU selection and sizing, on\-premises versus cloud trade\-offs, and where NVIDIA’s software stack fits.
* Deep, current knowledge of the South Asian start\-up ecosystem — founders, investors, accelerators, incubators, research institutions and the policy environment — and the network to open doors quickly.
* Proven success operating in a large, matrixed organization, influencing sales, marketing, engineering and executive stakeholders without formal authority.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication; comfort presenting to founders, investors and NVIDIA executives with equal ease.
* Willingness to travel frequently across the region.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Direct experience at a start\-up, VC firm, accelerator or incubator — you know how founders actually make decisions and where programmes create or destroy value for them.
* Hands\-on background with GPU infrastructure, cluster deployment or MLOps, or prior experience as a solution architect or developer advocate.
* Experience building go\-to\-market motions with cloud providers, OEMs, resellers or system integrators in India.
* A public track record in the AI community — speaking, writing, or convening founders and investors.
* Experience with sovereign AI, regulated\-industry AI (healthcare, financial services, public sector) or edge and robotics deployments in emerging markets.

**Job Description**
**About Datahash**
 Datahash is a privacy\-centric first\-party data platform. Our core product, Datahash Signals, gives marketers low\-code, no\-code integrations between web, app, e\-commerce, CRM, marketing automation and data warehouses on one side and the major ad channels on the other: Meta, Google, TikTok, Snap, Amazon and more. We are one of a handful of badged integration partners across these channels and work with them directly on first\-party data adoption programmes, where advertisers are moving to server\-side integrations, conversions APIs and privacy\-safe measurement. We are bootstrapped, profitable, and run across Dubai, Bangalore, Mumbai and London with clients in EMEA, India, Africa, APAC and the US.
   

  

**The role**
 You own the day\-to\-day relationship with one or more of our badged ad\-channel partners (Meta, Snapchat, TikTok, Google, Reddit, Pinterest and others) and turn those relationships into advertiser leads, joint go\-to\-market programmes and revenue, working with Sales, Delivery and Marketing to convert partner momentum into pipeline. This is hands\-on: you run the cadence with partner reps, keep the relationship map current, and make sure every programme has an owner, a number and a next step. A partnerships agent keeps the commitments ledger, the pre\-meeting packs and the MDF tracker current; you hold the relationships.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Partner relationship management. Own the point\-of\-contact map across your partner orgs (account managers, partner managers, leadership) and keep it current in CRM with hierarchy and relationship depth. Run a regular cadence including quarterly reviews and be the first port of call for anything Datahash needs from the partner.
* Pipeline and revenue. Drive advertiser referrals from partner reps and carry a quarterly referred\-pipeline target; track lead\-to\-activation through the funnel and unblock deals that need partner support.
* Joint go\-to\-market. Build and run co\-marketing programmes with partners (webinars, case studies, events, MDF\-funded activity) with Marketing on assets and messaging; represent Datahash in partner enablement sessions.
* Programme operations and reporting. Keep partner tools and trackers current, send partner updates and dashboards, report programme health to leadership, and ensure invoice\-readiness criteria (tags, PO, naming) are met before implementations reach finance.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Quarterly referred\-pipeline and activated\-account targets met.
* CRM and partner tracker accurate and current, over 95 percent coverage on active partner accounts.
* At least two joint go\-to\-market initiatives shipped a quarter with measurable reach.
* Strong qualitative feedback from partner counterparts and from Sales and Delivery.


**How We Hire**
 We move fast and we are transparent about how we decide. Every decision about a person is made by a person.
   

  

 Step 1: a short structured screen within two working days of applying. Step 2: a 50\-minute conversation with the hiring manager. Step 3: a small case exercise close to the real work, which you present to two or three of us. Step 4: fit and terms with our VP Delivery or Head of Sales and Partnerships, and for senior roles the founder. We aim to give you a decision within five working days of the final conversation.
   

  

 We evaluate evidence rather than claims, the quality of your questions, how you handle ambiguity, and how naturally you already use AI in your own work.
   

  

**Requirements**
**What we need from you**
* Five to eight years in partnerships, channel or alliance management, or business development, preferably in SaaS, adtech or martech.
* Working knowledge of the digital marketing ecosystem: pixels, conversions APIs, first\-party data and the major ad channels.
* A record of owning a partner or client relationship end to end and converting it into pipeline.
* Comfort with CRM discipline and data\-driven reporting; daily use of AI tools.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management across internal teams and partner organisations.


**Nice to have**
* Direct experience with Meta, Google or TikTok partner programmes, or with MDF and co\-marketing funds.
* Exposure to CAPI, server\-side tracking or customer data platforms.
* Experience running co\-marketing programmes end to end.


**Probably not a fit if**
* You prefer a pure marketing or a pure sales role; this sits between them and owns the partner.
* You are uncomfortable carrying a pipeline number.


**Benefits**
* A startup environment backed by a stable, bootstrapped, profitable business.
* Competitive compensation and one of the most employee\-friendly ESOP programmes in the industry.
* Work from anywhere, on your hours; coworking access when you want a change from home.
* Health cover for you and your family.
* Real international exposure: clients and partners across the Gulf, Europe, Africa, India, APAC and the US.
* A yearly offsite that we take seriously, and a culture that does not.


 Datahash is an equal\-opportunity employer. We hire on evidence and fit for the work and do not ask for salary history. Compensation is discussed at the fit\-and\-terms stage.

description:

To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
   

  

 Our SI partners play a key role in bringing our customers' data\-backed ambitions to life by implementing and harnessing the power of the Snowflake AI Data Cloud for cutting edge workloads and use cases. Through our partnerships, we enable companies to empower their employees with the data they need when and how they need it to better engage their customers, optimize their operations, and transform their products.
   

  

 The Partner Development Senior Manager role involves driving and nurturing relationships with our System Integrator (SI) partners. Your primary objective is to strengthen and expand the collaboration between Snowflake and these partners to drive growth.
   

  

 In this role you will be responsible for growing the relationship with IBM in the Americas. The success of these partnerships is demonstrated by driving growth with our joint customers, delivering key Go\-To\-Market (GTM) programs, establishing critical executive relationships, enabling partners to grow their Snowflake competency, and delivering customer success.
   

  

 Your success depends on your ability to drive compelling business strategies, GTM motions and relationships with IBM. Strong communication, experienced strategic alliance leadership, and problem\-solving skills are vital to excel in this role.
   

  

 HERE ARE SOME KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND TASKS ASSOCIATED WITH:
   

  

* Strategic Go\-to\-Market: Work closely with IBM to build comprehensive joint business plans. Collaborate on joint GTM strategies including strategic objectives and target markets/industries. Define joint industry solutions and offerings with that demonstrates capability while differentiating the partner. Achieve partnership goals including sales quota and marketing activities; this is a quota carrying position.
* Practice Development: Inspire IBM \& Young to grow their practices with Snowflake. Evaluate their expertise, capabilities, and delivery quality and activate the GTM programs accordingly. Define certification growth plans and support enablement of the partner. Cultivate strong and lasting relationships with key Sr executives and decision\-makers at the partner.
* Results\-oriented Partner Management: Effective and proven Partner Management skills will be necessary to manage the alliance development lifecycle. This will require the ability to be a self\-starter focused on building and owning the 360\-degree relationship.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with other departments, such as product development, sales, sales engineering, professional services, legal and marketing, to ensure a seamless partner \& customer experience. Share partner \& customer feedback and insights with relevant teams to drive continuous improvement. This candidate will collaborate with a team of technical experts to drive solution building with our partners.
* Co\-Marketing Initiatives: Coordinate and execute co\-marketing activities, including events, webinars, and content creation, to increase brand visibility and generate leads.
* Deal Support: Assist IBM in navigating Snowflake’s partner program \& sales process, including deal registration, proposal support, reporting and alignment with Sales Leadership. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure a smooth and efficient sales cycle.
* Deliver on Performance: Monitor the performance and success of IBM related to specific metrics. It is important to have the ability to shift priorities, take risks and think outside of the box to deliver on key criteria.


 DESIRED EXPERIENCE \<!\[CDATA\[Senior Partner Solution Engineer
   

  

 At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise.  Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential — and people too. With a culture that’s all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology — and careers — to the next level.

 Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

title: Senior Global Brand Manager
description:
**🚀 About Joveo** 




 Joveo builds AI\-powered recruiting technology. We are looking for someone who can help make Joveo a company people turn to for a clear, informed view on AI and the future of hiring.
 



 You will help bring the ideas, expertise and work inside the company into the conversations that matter to our business.
 



  





**🌟 About the role** 




 We are hiring a communications professional with an editor’s instinct for a story and the initiative to make it happen. You can spot an angle in a customer conversation, draw a compelling point of view out of a founder, and earn attention for work that deserves it.
 



 Reporting directly to the
 **Chief of Strategic Initiatives \& Global Supply Officer** 
 , you will lead strategic PR and leadership visibility. You will work closely with senior stakeholders to shape Joveo’s corporate narrative and advise on where we should speak, what we can credibly say and which opportunities deserve our attention.
 



  





**Strategic PR is the primary mandate.** 
 Creative brand campaigns are an important extension of it. We want someone who brings original ideas, understands how different channels work and can turn a strong story into a campaign people remember.
 



  





**🧠 What you’ll do** 



* Develop Joveo’s corporate narrative. Get close to our leaders, customers and subject experts. Find the evidence behind the story and turn it into compelling pitches, commentary, contributed articles and briefing material.
* Build a sustained earned\-media program across relevant business, technology, startup and industry publications. Develop relationships with journalists, editors, newsletters and podcasts by understanding their audiences and bringing them useful ideas.
* Strengthen leadership visibility. Develop distinctive points of view, prepare executives for interviews and identify relevant speaking opportunities. Make the message sharper while preserving the person’s voice.
* Lead communications around approved company milestones, product developments and funding announcements when relevant. Prepare FAQs, manage media enquiries and advise leadership when an issue requires a careful response.
* Originate creative campaigns that support our PR priorities. Turn customer insights, company expertise or a timely point of view into an editorial series, collaboration, event or other relevant format. Own the brief and channel choices, coordinating specialists where needed.
* Use paid PR selectively and make the budget work harder. Assess sponsored content, distribution, events and agencies against a clear audience, objective and cost. Find resourceful ways to build visibility through earned and owned channels.
* Measure whether the work is making a difference. Track coverage relevance, message accuracy, audience engagement and attributable inbound interest. Keep paid exposure distinct from earned coverage and use the results to improve the next campaign.



  





**🎯 What we’re looking for** 



* You have personally earned relevant coverage for a technology business, startup or agency client. You can explain how you found the story, pitched it and adapted when the first approach did not work.
* You know India’s business and technology media and have relevant working relationships.
* You write and edit exceptionally well. You can understand a complex product and explain why it matters in language people want to read.
* You are comfortable advising senior leaders, questioning a weak angle and recommending a stronger one.
* You have originated a campaign, collaboration or channel idea that made an impact. You can show your contribution and explain the audience insight behind it.
* You are resourceful with a focused budget and can take an idea through execution. Experience in AI, enterprise technology, corporate milestone communications or international media is useful.



  





**✨ Why join Joveo** 




 You will help shape the story while it is being formed, with direct access to senior leadership and responsibility for how it reaches the public.
 



 There is room to bring your own editorial judgment and pursue original ideas. Your work will influence how customers, prospective hires and the wider business community understand Joveo, with PR at the centre and creative thinking throughout.

title: Business Head – Expansion
description:
**Job Description: Business Head – Expansion** 




  





 Location: Bangalore
 



 Department: Business / Expansion
 



 Experience: 5–8 Years
 



 Qualification: MBA from a Top\-Tier Business School
 



  





**About the Company** 




 We are one of India’s leading K–12 school networks with a large and rapidly growing presence across the country. As part of our next phase of growth, we are expanding aggressively across existing and new cities through new school launches, takeovers and other expansion formats.
 



  





 We are looking for a high\-calibre
 **Business Head – Expansion** 
 who can take complete business ownership of new schools from the pre\-launch stage through launch, admissions ramp\-up and operational stabilization.
 



  





 This is a high\-impact role requiring a combination of
 **sales orientation, operational excellence, analytical ability and strong execution skills.** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 The Business Head – Expansion will be responsible for successfully launching and scaling new schools across India.
 



  





 The individual will work cross\-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Operations, Academics, HR, Projects, Finance and other central teams to ensure that every new school is launched on time and achieves its business objectives.
 



  





 The role requires someone who can move comfortably between strategy and ground\-level execution, analysing a market and building a business plan on one day, while solving sales, staffing or operational bottlenecks at a school on another.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. New School Launches** 



* Take end\-to\-end business ownership of new school launches.
* Develop detailed launch plans covering admissions, marketing, manpower, operations and academic readiness.
* Establish clear timelines and milestones for each new school.
* Coordinate with multiple central and regional teams to ensure that schools are operationally ready before launch.
* Identify potential launch bottlenecks early and drive rapid resolution.
* Ensure smooth transition from project/construction stage to fully operational school.



  





**2\. Admissions \& Sales** 



* Own student admission targets for new schools.
* Develop the sales strategy for each new location based on catchment, competition, pricing and market potential.
* Build and manage the initial admissions/sales teams for new campuses.
* Establish lead management, counselling, follow\-up and conversion processes.
* Monitor the complete admissions funnel; leads, appointments, walk\-ins, applications and admissions.
* Review sales performance frequently and intervene wherever conversion or productivity is below expectations.
* Drive a strong target\-oriented sales culture across expansion schools.



  





**3\. Market \& Catchment Analysis** 



* Evaluate the business potential of new school locations.
* Understand catchment demographics, competing schools, fee structures, parent profiles and market positioning.
* Work with internal teams to determine appropriate pricing, positioning and launch strategy for each school.
* Conduct competitive benchmarking and identify opportunities for differentiation.
* Translate market insights into actionable sales and operating plans.



  





**4\. Business Planning \& P\&L** 



* Prepare business plans for new schools covering student ramp\-up, revenue, manpower, operating expenses and profitability.
* Own key financial and operating metrics during the initial years of a school.
* Monitor revenue, admissions, costs and profitability against approved business plans.
* Identify deviations early and develop corrective action plans.
* Work with Finance to review budgets, forecasts and unit economics.
* Drive each school towards targeted enrolment, operational efficiency and profitability.



  





**5\. School Operations** 



* Ensure new schools are operationally ready across all critical areas before opening.
* Establish processes for front office, parent communication, transport, security, housekeeping, facilities and other school operations.
* Ensure high standards of parent and student experience from the first day of operations.
* Monitor operational issues during the stabilization period and drive rapid resolution.
* Ensure company SOPs and operating standards are implemented consistently.



  





**6\. Cross\-Functional Leadership** 




 The Business Head – Expansion will act as the central owner for each new school and coordinate extensively with:
 


* Sales \& Admissions
* Marketing
* Academics
* Recruitment \& HR
* Projects \& Construction
* Procurement
* IT
* Transport
* Finance
* Legal
* School Operations



  





 The individual will be expected to drive these teams towards common launch timelines and business objectives even where the teams do not directly report to them.
 



  





**7\. Team Building \& Leadership** 



* Help identify and build leadership teams for new schools.
* Recruit, mentor and manage sales and operational teams where required.
* Establish clear KPIs and accountability for teams.
* Conduct structured performance reviews and intervene quickly when targets are not being achieved.
* Build a culture of ownership, urgency and execution excellence.



  





**8\. Stabilisation \& Handover** 



* Remain closely involved with new schools through the initial ramp\-up period.
* Establish stable operating processes and management rhythms.
* Ensure admissions, parent experience, academics and operations reach defined performance standards.
* Transition stabilized schools to the appropriate regional/zonal operating leadership based on agreed milestones.
* Capture learnings from each launch and continuously improve the expansion playbook.



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 We are looking for a high\-energy business leader with a strong combination of
 **sales, operations and general management capability.** 




  





 The ideal candidate should:
 


* Have
 **5–8 years of post\-MBA professional experience.**
* Hold an
 **MBA/PGDM from a top\-tier business school** 
 .
* Have substantial experience in
 **Sales and Operations** 
 .
* Have managed meaningful revenue, business targets or P\&L responsibilities.
* Have experience leading sizeable teams and working across multiple functions.
* Be highly analytical and comfortable working with numbers, dashboards and business metrics.
* Have demonstrated ability to operate in fast\-paced and ambiguous environments.
* Be willing to travel extensively across India as required.



  





**Preferred Background** 




 Candidates from high\-growth, multi\-location consumer businesses would be particularly relevant, including:
 



  




* Education / EdTech
* Retail
* Consumer Services
* Hospitality
* Healthcare
* Fitness
* QSR
* Multi\-location businesses
* Start\-ups with strong offline operations



  





 Prior experience in K–12 education is not mandatory, provided the candidate has strong sales and operations experience.
 



  





**Key Competencies** 



* Strong sales orientation
* Business and commercial acumen
* P\&L understanding
* Operational excellence
* Structured problem\-solving
* Data\-driven decision\-making
* Team leadership
* Stakeholder management
* Project management
* High ownership and accountability
* Ability to execute under aggressive timelines
* Strong communication and influencing skills



  





**Why This Role?** 




 This is an opportunity to play a central role in building one of India's largest K–12 school networks.
 



  





 Rather than managing one function, the individual will have exposure to the complete lifecycle of building a new business unit; market assessment, business planning, marketing, sales, hiring, operations, academics, P\&L and scale\-up.
 



  





 The role provides significant ownership and visibility with senior leadership and is particularly suited to someone who wants to develop into a
 **business leader/general manager with end\-to\-end P\&L responsibility.**

title: Underwriting Enablement Manager
description:
**About The Team**
 The Senior Specialist, Frontline Support, Enablement empowers Zillow’s sales teams by designing and delivering enablement programs, training, and resources that drive seller effectiveness and business results. This role leads cross\-functional initiatives to streamline onboarding, continuous learning, and sales playbooks, ensuring sellers have the tools and knowledge needed to excel. Operating with high autonomy, the Senior Specialist partners across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations to identify gaps, optimize processes, and enhance the adoption and impact of enablement strategies.
   

  

**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission\-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** 
 Our work spans cross\-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high\-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
   

  

**About The Role**
* Lead the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of sales enablement programs—including playbooks, tools, and resources—to support effective prospecting, pipeline management, and deal execution. \- Develop and maintain sales training content (live, virtual, and asynchronous), ensuring materials are accurate, scalable, and aligned to product updates and go\-to\-market priorities. \- Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product, Operations, and Analytics to identify seller needs, friction points, and translate insights into enablement strategies and assets that improve productivity and conversion. \- Analyze enablement program effectiveness using data, feedback, and performance metrics; diagnose capability gaps and recommend enhancements to content, processes, and delivery channels. \- Act as a subject matter expert on enablement tools and systems, supporting configuration, usage best practices, and change management to ensure easy access and adoption by sales teams. \- Coordinate and facilitate cross\-functional efforts for major sales initiatives (e.g., new product launches, campaign rollouts, sales kickoffs), ensuring timely, cohesive messaging, training, and supporting collateral. \- Mentor and coach less experienced enablement and sales support team members on best practices in content design, training facilitation, and data\-informed decision\-making. \- Document and refine standard operating procedures for enablement programs, including governance for content updates, intake and prioritization of requests, and communication plans to the sales organization.


 This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
   

  

 In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation subject to applicable laws and relevant Zillow policies. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Education, or a related field. \- 8\+ years of experience in sales enablement, sales operations, revenue programs, or a closely related sales support function, including experience designing and delivering sales training and content for quota\-carrying teams. \- Proven experience using data and sales performance metrics to evaluate enablement impact and inform program improvements. \- Experience working cross\-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations teams to support go\-to\-market initiatives and drive seller adoption of tools and processes. \- Or an equivalent combination of education and experience.


 Get to know us
   

  

 At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.
   

  

 Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
   

  

 No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.
   

  

*Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment.*
*If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly.*
*Qualified applicants will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law.*

title: Head of Operations – International Markets
description:
𝗛𝗲𝗮𝗱 𝗼𝗳 𝗢𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 – 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗸𝗲𝘁𝘀
 



 𝗥𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝗢𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄
 



 You will be responsible for leading and scaling Rubick's international operations function, with end\-to\-end ownership of operational strategy, business performance, client delivery, revenue growth, profitability, quality, and team performance across international markets.
 



 This role focuses on building scalable operating systems, strengthening client relationships, improving operational efficiency, and ensuring high\-quality delivery across Rubick's global customer base.
 



 You will work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Technology, Finance, and Leadership teams to drive international business growth and build a world\-class operations organization. You will be reporting to the VP of operations.
 



  





 The role involves three areas: 𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁 𝟭: 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗙𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗮𝗹𝘀 \| 𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁 𝟮: 𝗔𝗜\-𝗗𝗿𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗻 𝗢𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝗘𝘅𝗰𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲 \| 𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁 𝟯: 𝗜𝗻𝗻𝗼𝘃𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 \& 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗮𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻
 



  





 𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁 𝟭: 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗙𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗮𝗹𝘀
 



 𝗢𝘄𝗻 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗢𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀: Lead the overall strategy, execution, and performance of Rubick’s international operations across clients, markets, teams, and service lines.
 



 𝗗𝗿𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗕𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝗣𝗲𝗿𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲: Own key metrics including revenue, profitability, productivity, utilization, quality, turnaround time, client satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
 



 𝗕𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱 𝗦𝗰𝗮𝗹𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗢𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀: Develop standardized, scalable products, processes, and operating mechanisms that support international growth while accommodating market\-specific requirements.
 



 𝗘𝗻𝘀𝘂𝗿𝗲 𝗗𝗲𝗹𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘆 𝗘𝘅𝗰𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲: Drive consistent, high\-quality delivery across international accounts, proactively identifying bottlenecks, operational risks, and areas for improvement.
 



 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗱 𝗧𝗲𝗮𝗺𝘀 \& 𝗖𝗮𝗽𝗮𝗰𝗶𝘁𝘆: Build and manage high\-performing operations teams with clear goals and accountability, while overseeing workforce planning, capacity, and resource allocation.
 



 𝗦𝘁𝗿𝗲𝗻𝗴𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗻 𝗚𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲: Establish dashboards, MIS, performance reviews, and governance mechanisms that provide visibility and drive timely corrective action.
 



 𝗗𝗿𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗖𝗹𝗶𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗦𝘂𝗰𝗰𝗲𝘀𝘀: Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, clients, and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless onboarding, implementation, delivery, escalation management, client satisfaction, and account growth.
 



 Build strong relationships with key international clients and act as a senior escalation point when required.
 



  





 𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁 𝟮: 𝗔𝗜\-𝗗𝗿𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗻 𝗢𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝗘𝘅𝗰𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲
 



 𝗗𝗿𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗔𝗜\-𝗟𝗲𝗱 𝗢𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀: Leverage AI, automation, and technology to improve productivity, quality, scalability, margins, and decision\-making across international operations.
 



 𝗔𝘂𝘁𝗼𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗳𝗹𝗼𝘄𝘀: Identify and automate repetitive, manual, and high\-effort operational processes to reduce intervention, errors, and cost.
 



 𝗕𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗶𝗴𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗢𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗦𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺𝘀: Develop AI\-enabled mechanisms for quality monitoring, productivity tracking, forecasting, reporting, workflow management, and process optimization.
 



 𝗘𝗻𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮\-𝗗𝗿𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗻 𝗗𝗲𝗰𝗶𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀: Use data and analytics to identify trends, uncover performance gaps, forecast capacity requirements, and improve business outcomes.
 



 𝗦𝘁𝗿𝗲𝗻𝗴𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗻 𝗣𝗲𝗿𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗠𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁: Establish data\-driven dashboards, KPIs, and performance management systems that create transparency and accountability across teams.
 



 𝗗𝗿𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗔𝗜 𝗔𝗱𝗼𝗽𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: Embed AI\-assisted tools into day\-to\-day operations, including client reporting, planning, quality assurance, and delivery management.
 



 𝗖𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝘁𝗶𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗔𝗱𝘃𝗮𝗻𝘁𝗮𝗴𝗲: Partner with leadership and technology teams to identify and implement new AI and automation use cases that improve efficiency, differentiation, and scalability in international markets.
 



  





 𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁 𝟯: 𝗜𝗻𝗻𝗼𝘃𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 \& 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗮𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻
 



 𝗦𝗰𝗮𝗹𝗲 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗢𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀: Develop and execute strategies to expand Rubick’s operations across existing and new international markets.
 



 𝗕𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱 𝗥𝗲𝗽𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗢𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗠𝗼𝗱𝗲𝗹𝘀: Create scalable models and best practices that can be replicated across markets while adapting to local customer and business requirements.
 



 𝗘𝗻𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗕𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝗚𝗿𝗼𝘄𝘁𝗵: Identify new service opportunities, capabilities, and operational improvements that support revenue growth, margins, and client retention.
 



 𝗦𝗵𝗮𝗽𝗲 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗦𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗴𝘆: Partner with leadership and cross\-functional teams to identify market opportunities, emerging trends, and strategic priorities that contribute to Rubick’s long\-term international growth.
 



  





 𝗧𝗼 𝗛𝗮𝘃𝗲
 



 10\+ years of experience in Operations, Business Operations, International Operations, Customer Success, Delivery, or similar leadership roles.
 



 Proven experience managing large\-scale operations with end\-to\-end ownership of business performance.
 



 Strong experience managing international clients, global teams, or operations across multiple geographies.
 



 Demonstrated experience in managing revenue, profitability, productivity, quality, and operational KPIs.
 



 Strong understanding of client management, account growth, escalations, and service delivery.
 



 Experience building and scaling operational teams and processes in a high\-growth organization.
 



 Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to make data\-driven business decisions.
 



 Experience working cross\-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Technology, Finance, and Leadership teams.
 



 Strong understanding of process optimization, workforce planning, capacity planning, and performance management.
 



 Experience implementing automation, AI, analytics, or technology\-led operational improvements is strongly preferred.
 



 Experience in eCommerce, Retail, SaaS, Marketplace Operations, Catalog Operations is preferred.
 



 Strong communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and leadership skills.
 



 Ability to operate with high ownership, manage ambiguity, and build scalable systems from the ground up.
 



 Strong business acumen with the ability to balance customer experience, operational excellence, revenue growth, and profitability.
 



  





 𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗥𝘂𝗯𝗶𝗰𝗸
 



 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗻𝘆 𝗢𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄
 



 Rubick OS is a leading platform for brands and marketplaces, enabling seamless management of catalog and seller management automation, pricing and competitive intelligence, compliance systems, and assortment intelligence.
 



 Our solutions are used across five countries by major brands and marketplaces, including Amazon, Myntra, Reliance Group, Nykaa, Flipkart, Rare Rabbit, Decathlon, Celio, The Bay, Kiabi, Myer, Jumbo, and many more.
 



  





 𝗟𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻
 



 Bangalore (Jayanagar 1st Block, Near Ashoka Pillar)
 



  





 𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸 𝗠𝗼𝗱𝗲𝗹
 



 Work from Office – Monday to Friday
 



  





 𝗧𝗲𝗮𝗺 𝗦𝗶𝘇𝗲
 



 250\+ Employees
 



  





 𝗜𝗻𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀
 



 Invested by Innospark US, Betatron Hong Kong, MJV India, 1Crowd India, and other investors.
 



 Rubick.ai is a place to work if you want to build something foundational rather than incremental. We are the AI operating layer for retail ecommerce, solving complex, real\-world problems across the spectrum.
 



 You get high ownership, direct impact, and exposure to various parts of the business, making you an entrepreneur in\-house. Rubick operates in the AI segment, which means you will be at the forefront of the technological revolution.

title: Digital Buildings Offer Success, Process owner and Performance leader, Connected Services Hub
description:
A key member of the Connected Services Excellence team responsible for accelerating the integration, adoption and growth of Digital Buildings Connected Services within the CSH ecosystem, locally and globally. The role ensure that Buildings Services are embedded within the CSH operating model and drives global performance, scalability and business outcomes.
   

  

 Lead the CSH readiness and transformation roadmap for Digital services offers such a Ecostruxure Foresight, embedding Buildings Connected Services in a scalable, multi\-module service model across Buildings, Power and Energy.

 Offer Success \& Performance

 Design the technical support model and knowledge management to cover all offers in the scope.

 Successful integration of Buildings Connected Services into CSH; adoption and growth across countries; achievement of business performance targets; customer satisfaction improvements; productivity gains; and adoption of standard operating practices globally.

 Influence without authority, align global and local stakeholders, represent the voice of Buildings within CSH Excellence, and deliver measurable business outcomes through collaboration and execution excellence.

title: Senior Integrated Marketing Program Manager
description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**Job Summary**
*Role Purpose*
 Candescent is seeking a Senior Integrated Marketing Program Manager to lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of our most important marketing programs from one of our India office locations. This role leads integrated campaigns and go\-to\-market initiatives that build brand visibility, generate pipeline, and support product and segment growth.
   

  

 You will be marketing leadership’s trusted planning partner — turning priorities into operating cadences, decision\-ready materials, and clear owners, milestones, and outcomes.
   

  

 You will co\-own execution alongside functional leads across brand, product marketing, web, demand generation, events, and marketing operations, bringing the programmatic rigor that keeps complex work on track. Beyond individual programs, you will help define how marketing operates together, establishing the operating model, cadences, and ways of working that scale as the team grows.
   

  

 This is a senior role with direct exposure to the marketing senior leadership team. You will also serve as a senior leader within the India marketing operations team, partnering closely with the US\-based Marketing Operations lead and the US\-based process and program management counterpart.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Deliverables**
*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*
**Program Planning \& Delivery**
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of complex, cross\-functional marketing programs, from intake and planning through launch, measurement, and optimization.
* Translate business and marketing priorities into integrated roadmaps, milestone plans, dependency maps, and risk registers.
* Co\-own execution alongside functional leads, partnering with product marketing on launches, brand on creative delivery, and demand generation on campaign activation.
* Ensure campaign briefs, objectives, audience definitions, content requirements, channel plans, measurement plans, and launch criteria are agreed before work enters execution.
* Manage portfolio\-level visibility across concurrent programs, including prioritization, capacity trade\-offs, escalation, and delivery risk mitigation.
* Own the integrated marketing calendar as the shared view of what marketing is delivering and when, using it to drive sequencing, prioritization, and capacity conversations.


**Operating Cadence \& Governance**
* Build and run the operating cadences that keep priorities, risks, dependencies, and next steps visible, including status reviews, planning cycles, and launch readiness forums.
* Help define how marketing operates together — establishing the operating model, rituals, and ways of working that scale as the team and its remit grow.
* Improve intake, prioritization, approval, and launch governance processes, and build the templates, checklists, and standards that make delivery repeatable.
* Facilitate senior stakeholder alignment, ensuring decisions, scope changes, approvals, and dependencies are documented, communicated, and resolved.
* Keep planning tools and the marketing calendar current and trusted, so conflicts, gaps, and over\-commitment surface before they affect delivery.


**Executive Engagement \& Reporting**
* Partner directly with the marketing senior leadership team on planning, prioritization, and trade\-off decisions, and bring forward the information they need to decide.
* Synthesize inputs from marketing, sales, product, and agency stakeholders into decision\-ready briefings and reporting for leadership.
* Provide executive\-ready visibility into program health, launch readiness, risks, blockers, trade\-offs, and decisions required.
* Partner with marketing operations and analytics to ensure tracking, measurement plans, and success metrics are defined and operational before launch.
* Communicate clearly and concisely with senior leaders, simplifying complex workstreams and presenting trade\-offs rather than escalating problems without options.


**Team Leadership \& Capability Building**
* Serve as a senior leader within the India marketing operations team, providing direction, review, and coaching to other team members and raising the standard of delivery across the group.
* Be accountable for the quality, timeliness, and consistency of the programs the India team delivers.
* Coordinate closely with the US\-based Marketing Operations lead on priorities, intake, status, escalations, and stakeholder communication.
* Partner with the US\-based process and program management counterpart to keep standards, templates, and ways of working consistent across regions.
* Build capability that outlasts any one individual — success is measured not only by what you deliver, but by how well the team can deliver without you.
* Apply AI tools practically to accelerate briefs, status reporting, documentation, and synthesis, and help the team adopt them in day\-to\-day ways of working.
* Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and decision\-making.


**Experience**
*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*
* 10\+ years of experience in marketing program or project management, integrated campaign delivery, or marketing operations, including significant time at a senior level.
* Proven track record managing complex, multi\-channel marketing programs in a fast\-paced B2B environment.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional teams, influence senior stakeholders, and drive accountability across functions.
* Experience running an integrated marketing calendar or equivalent planning system across multiple teams and channels.
* Experience working directly with senior marketing leadership on planning, prioritization, and trade\-off decisions.
* Strong working knowledge of how marketing moves from brief to content creation, channel activation, launch, and performance reporting.
* Practical fluency across core marketing channels, including email, web, webinars, events, paid media, organic social, and ABM programs.
* Experience overseeing delivery of marketing content such as emails, landing pages, ads, case studies, videos, event assets, and sales enablement materials.
* Excellent executive communication skills, with the ability to simplify complexity, present trade\-offs, and escalate risks with recommendations.
* Experience establishing or improving marketing execution processes, intake models, and governance cadences.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.


**Qualifications \& Preferred Distinctions**
*Additional accomplishments*
* PMP, agile, or equivalent program management certification is preferred.
* Experience in technology, financial services, SaaS, or other complex enterprise go\-to\-market environments is preferred.
* Experience with marketing automation, CRM, and work management platforms such as Marketo, Salesforce, Smartsheet, Jira, Asana, or Workfront.
* Experience leading ABM or account\-focused programs, including target account prioritization, sales alignment, and account\-level performance tracking.
* Experience managing external agencies, media partners, freelancers, or offshore and shared\-services delivery teams.
* Working knowledge of campaign measurement, including engagement and conversion metrics, pipeline influence, attribution, and funnel movement.
* Experience building a new team, function, or delivery model from the ground up is a strong plus.
* Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.


**How Success Will Be Measured**
*The measures this role will be held to*
**Measure**
**What Good Looks Like**
**On\-time delivery**
 High\-priority marketing programs and campaign launches delivered on schedule and within agreed scope.
   

  

**Program cycle time**
 Time from intake to launch reduces as intake, briefing, and approval processes mature.
   

  

**Launch readiness \& quality**
 Deliverables meet quality expectations with reduced rework and fewer late\-stage surprises.
   

  

**Stakeholder satisfaction**
 Marketing leadership and functional partners rate planning and program support as reliable and valuable.
   

  

**Executive visibility**
 Leaders consistently have clear, current insight into the marketing calendar, program health, risks, and decisions required.
   

  

**Operating model maturity**
 Execution processes become more scalable, documented, and repeatable, with less dependency on any one person.
   

  

**Business impact**
 Program delivery supports measurable improvement in audience engagement, pipeline contribution, and campaign velocity.
   

  

**What Will Make You Successful**
* Comfort leading through influence and shared ownership rather than relying on positional authority.
* The instinct to bring structure to ambiguity without adding bureaucracy for its own sake.
* Confidence and composure in front of senior leaders, including when the news is difficult.
* Judgment about what genuinely needs escalating, and what you should simply resolve.
* Credibility with specialists — enough marketing depth to ask the right questions and challenge constructively.
* Clear, proactive communication with stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* A collaborative, low\-ego working style and a genuine willingness to give and receive feedback.
* Strong organization, follow\-through, and accountability in a global, fast\-paced environment.


**Statement to Third Party Agencies**
 To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

title: Director of Engineering
description:
Director of Engineering  



This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.**Who We Are:**


Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

  



***Job Family Definition:***


The job family spans across multiple engineering disciplines. Work consists of designing, developing, analyzing, troubleshooting and debugging systems, software and solutions for research and/or research development of product, services, and solutions for HPE’s portfolio. Requires a broad knowledge and application of engineering disciplines, methodologies and tools.


Job Family Definition for Executive Levels only: Directs and manages a diverse team of engineering professionals performing research, development, design and/or implementation of products, services, solutions for the company’s portfolio. Responsible for creating and communicating technical strategy within the organization and/or across the function.

***Management Level Definition:***


Leads a large or broad function/department within a multifaceted organization. Responsible for operational success, strategic alignment and integration of activities with other major organizational functions. Responsible for one or more recognized professional disciplines. Fully accountable for the success of the designated function or department. Influences strategy and sets policy and direction. Owns a significant number of measurable functional, operational and strategic goals or priorities. Assumes responsibility for the successful implementation of business plans in a defined area of responsibility. Contributes to the overall strategic definition of a function with strong business acumen. Acts as a key advisor to executive management in influencing the strategic direction of the business. Typically reports to VP.

***Responsibilities:***

* Provides direct and ongoing strategic leadership for a department or functional organization of multiple subordinate managers and high\-level individual contributors designing and developing engineering solutions utilizing multiple engineering disciplines for products, systems, software, and solutions.
* Creates strategic and tactical operations and resource plans, goals, and priorities for assigned organization based on business and technology roadmap and functional objectives.
* Manages headcount, deliverables, schedules, and costs for the organization, ensuring that resources are appropriately allocated and that goals, objectives, timelines, and budgets are met in accordance with organizational metrics and business plans.
* Engages with program managers, marketing, supply chain, technical leaders and executives to communicate program status, escalate issues, and guide and influence strategic decision\-making
* Manages senior relationships and escalated issues with outsourced partners and suppliers, including setting expectations regarding deliverables, product quality, schedules, and costs; ensures that organization is effectively leveraging outsourced resources.
* Identifies opportunities for and drives organizational initiatives and programs to support business process improvements and cost reductions.
* Provides overall people\-care management for direct reports, including hiring, setting and monitoring of annual performance plans, coaching, and career development; drives and fosters organization\-wide performance standards, expectations, and practices to support ongoing team member and process development.

***Education and Experience Required:***

* First level university degree or equivalent experience required. May have advanced university degree.
* Typically 15 or more years of related work experience, including 10 years of people management experience.

***Knowledge and Skills:***

* Strong leadership skills, including coaching, team\-building, and conflict resolution.
* Organizational and strategic management skills, including budget and business planning and forecasting.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
* Ability to manage human capital across multiple geographies and organizations to drive workforce development and achieve desired results.
* Advanced communication skills catered to a wide variety of audiences. (e.g. written, verbal, presentation); mastery in English and local language.
* Extensive business acumen, technical knowledge, and industry experience encompassing one or more engineering, technology, and product domains.
* Advanced multi\-tasking and prioritization skills.
* Advanced relationship management skills, including partnering and consulting with senior management and executive roles for internal and external partners.
* Good understanding of the company's policies and processes.

***Impact/Scope:***

* Collaborates across functions to deliver multidisciplinary engineering solutions.
* Typically interacts with high\-level Individual Contributors, Managers, Directors, and VPs and SVPs for internal and external suppliers, partners, and customers.

title: Manager, RA Publishing & Submissions
description:
**About Astellas**

Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com.


Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?


We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.


**Purpose and Scope** :


Responsibilities include managing the planning, preparation, submission and tracking of correspondence, applications and other structured data to regulatory agencies; identifying and ensuring adherence to relevant submission standards; and interacting with key personnel within the global RAPV organization to resolve procedural and operational complexities.


The position also involves execution\-focused interactions with regional health authorities and other Astellas functions such as Marketing Operations, Data Science, Supply Chain, Manufacturing and other areas within Research \& Development.


**Responsibilities and Accountabilities** :


Understands how industry specifications/initiatives impact our processes and deliverables


Trains other staff members on systems and processes


Provides interpretive analyses of complex regulatory guidance documents, regulations, or directives that impact products and operations; advises personnel within RAPV regarding their applicability and impact


Conducts trainings for new users in relevant systems and creates job ides and other documentation on our systems and processes


May assist with certain business system support tasks for key systems including user and functional requirement definition, end user testing and technical infrastructure requirements


May supervise external staff in the conduct of their duties


Manages the planning, preparation, delivery and archiving of published submissions to regulatory agencies around the globe, commonly focusing on specific geographies


Ensures adherence to relevant submission standards, regulatory pathways and regulatory strategies to facilitate efficiency of agency review


Supports submission activities for affiliates and business partners around the globe, commonly focusing on specific geographies


Executes processes to promote electronic document and submission quality control  



Maintains strong working relationships with RAPV, members of Project Management and publishing vendors to set submission timelines and content plans


Manages timely internal communication regarding regulatory filing status and other operational information related to assigned products


May represent RAPV Operations on various project teams / task forces as a subject matter expert in the field of electronic document management, submissions management and dossier publishing


May represent the Astellas Publishing \& Submission function in meetings with regulatory authorities, usually in conjunction with other RA staff


  
**Required Qualifications:**

Bachelor’s degree (science or technology is preferred)


At least three years’ experience in the pharma industry with some experience in a regulatory operations role


Demonstrated accomplishments and/or education will be evaluated and substituted for extent of experience, as needed


Ability to work independently with minimal direction and within project teams, committees, etc. to attain group goal


Proven ability to prioritize and multi\-task with minimal supervision based on interactions with project team members


If managing staff the incumbent should have experience managing people and/or teams or otherwise demonstrate the ability to do so


Strong ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally in English


Ability to multi\-task across multiple projects and deliverables


High integrity to maintain confidential and proprietary information


Ability to keep calm under pressure  



**Preferred Qualifications:**

Advanced degree (e.g., Masters, PhD, etc,)


Experience with managing IT systems or providing business operational support


Experience using document management, submission publishing, registration management, labeling and/or change control systems


Basic understanding of information taxonomies, master data management or other structured data concepts


Basic understanding of data warehousing, data lakes and reporting/analytics platforms or concepts


Proficiency in other language(s) – most common/useful are Dutch, Japanese, Spanish, Portuguese, French, Russian, Chinese


**What awaits you at Astellas?**

Global collaboration: Become part of a connected global business of like\-minded life science leaders, all dedicated to improving patients' lives worldwide.


Real\-world patient impact: Contribute to transformative therapies that reach patients around the world, knowing your work makes a difference every day.


Relentless Innovation: Join a company at the forefront of scientific breakthroughs, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare.


A Culture of Growth: Chart your own course within a supportive environment that values your contributions, champions your development, and empowers you to pursue your passions.


**Our Organizational Values and Behaviors**

Values: Innovation, Integrity and Impact sit at the heart of what we do.


Behaviors: We come together as ‘One Astellas’, working with courage and a sense of urgency. We are outcome focused and consistently take accountability for our personal contribution.

title: Head of Strategic Business Enablement, NTAM India
description:

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Role/ Department:**


Drive operating model assessment and its evolution across NTAM India to deliver the business’ strategic growth and scale objectives. Play an active role in communicating and influencing the change agenda, including leading the successful implementation and adoption of AI across NTAM India. Provide strategic local leadership across capabilities, including Investment, Product, Risk, Marketing, Research, and Wealth. Ensure strong visibility and presence of NTAM India in the local market and NT. Responsible for attracting and growing talent across NTAM India.


The individual will serve as a senior leader, representing the function in governance forums and key decision\-making bodies, while influencing strategic outcomes and fostering alignment across stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Operating Model Evolution**

* Assess operating models, technology, process, and organizational opportunities and translate insights into actionable roadmaps.
* Lead select initiatives, including current\-state assessment, and design future\-state processes that are standardized, scalable, auditable, and technology\-enabled
* Lead value discovery and business value mapping initiatives to ensure transformation investments are aligned to strategic objectives and measurable business outcomes.
* Develop business cases, define success metrics, and track value realization to ensure transformation investments deliver measurable business and client outcomes.

**Communication and Stakeholder Management**

* Build trusted, proactive relationships with global senior leaders by maintaining clear communication rhythms, surfacing insights early, and translating offshore execution perspectives into strategic recommendations.
* Influence across a global matrix by framing operating model assessments in terms of business value, risk, scalability, and growth, ensuring recommendations are practical, well\-socialized, and aligned with senior stakeholder priorities.
* Communicate a compelling AI and technology\-enabled change agenda, helping senior leaders understand the “what, so what, and now what” of opportunities to improve productivity, strengthen capabilities, and support business growth.

**Change Leadership**

* Influence enterprise\-wide change agendas by providing expertise on business process transformation, platform modernization, digital adoption, and organizational effectiveness.

**Learning and Adoption**

* Provide local thought leadership for NTAM India on AI, data, and digital learning agenda by curating relevant trends, use cases, and best practices that can be translated into practical business adoption opportunities.
* Partner with global teams to shape and oversee targeted training programs for India partners, aligning content, timing, and audience segmentation to build digital fluency, accelerate AI adoption, and strengthen future\-ready capabilities.

**Thought Leadership**

* Serve as a senior subject matter expert on Digital Products, Data Platforms, Artificial Intelligence and Asset Management technology, partnering with business, technology and platform leaders to shape future\-state capabilities.

**Change Leadership**

* Influence enterprise\-wide change agendas by providing expertise on business process transformation, platform modernization, digital adoption, and organizational effectiveness.

**Regional Leadership:**

* Act as the senior regional leader for NTAM's capabilities in India, providing oversight, connectivity and governance across Product, Investment Risk, Marketing, Quantitative Research, OCIO, Wealth and other investment\-support functions.
* Serve as the primary India\-based partner to global functional leaders, helping shape workforce strategy, operating model decisions, location strategy, organizational design and capability expansion across Non\-COO teams.

**Capability Expansion:**

* Partner with global stakeholders to identify, incubate and scale new capabilities in India, ensuring alignment to NTAM's growth strategy, future\-state operating model and evolving business priorities.

**Talent Leadership:**

* Build and sustain a high\-performing talent ecosystem across NTAM India by strengthening leadership pipelines, succession plans, capability development, coaching, and employee engagement to support current and future business needs. Promote an inclusive, collaborative, and growth\-oriented culture that supports innovation, engagement, and career development across diverse teams.

**Skills/ Experience Required:**

* Solid track record Asset Management or Asset Servicing, with broad experience gained ideally within a global asset manager or outsourcing provider.
* Highly adaptable leader with the ability to operate across a global matrixed organization and diverse business, investment, risk and enabling functions.
* Proven track record of leading transformational change initiatives and driving adoption across global, matrixed organizations.
* Proven ability as a proactive hands\-on leader and people manager to effectively drive and execute to high standards across a diverse and increasingly complex book of business.
* Ability to build authentic and high\-performing teams while fostering accountability, collaboration, and strong partner engagement.
* Strong track record of assessing risk, identifying opportunities, communicating solutions, and driving meaningful change.
* Highly organized, detail oriented and results focused individual with a strong track record in managing teams and self to deliver on multiple initiatives both locally and globally.
* Foster an environment which encourages ownership, excellence, employee engagement, teamwork, and communication.

**Technical \& Communication Skills**

* Exceptional communication and executive presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex operational, technology, risk, and investment concepts into clear business outcomes for diverse stakeholder groups.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders, build trusted partnerships, challenge constructively, and drive alignment across complex global organizations.
* Strong understanding of asset management operating models, investment lifecycle processes, operational risk frameworks, data governance, and control environments.
* Strong understanding of AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, digital workflow technologies, and data analytics, with the ability to identify and scale practical business use cases.
* Demonstrated ability to assess emerging industry trends, technologies, and best practices and translate them into practical business opportunities and operating model improvements.
* Ability to leverage data, metrics, and insights to evaluate performance, prioritize investments, measure outcomes, and support strategic decision\-making.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively, articulate a compelling vision, and drive adoption across geographically dispersed teams.
* Strong facilitation, negotiation, and conflict\-resolution skills, with the ability to navigate competing priorities and achieve alignment across stakeholders.
* Excellent written communication skills, including the preparation of executive\-level presentations, strategy papers, governance materials, and board\-ready updates.
* High degree of commercial acumen and strategic thinking, with the ability to connect industry trends, emerging technologies, and organizational priorities to business outcomes.

**Experience \& Education**

* Strong preference for candidates with senior\-level experience at a large global asset management firm or a leading consulting organization supporting the asset management industry.
* 20\+ years of overall experience \& minimum 10 years of relevant Asset Management experience mandatory.
* Strong asset management domain knowledge; process transformation and operating model design; AI, automation, and data literacy; business analysis and product thinking; stakeholder leadership; change management; governance and control mindset; ability to translate strategy into executable delivery.
* Strong commercial sense with demonstrated ability to take industry trends, innovative behaviors, data analytics, and automation to drive growth, scale and risk management.
* Well\-developed project management skills organized and disciplined with attention to detail and ability to execute.
* University degree in any discipline (Engineering/Finance/Investments preferred) with a post graduate MBA degree/CFA from a premier institute.

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  



  

  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

  

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub \- Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

Coordinate go\-to\-market strategies with third\-party retail and national distributor partners (e.g., Flipkart, Croma) to ensure healthy channel harmony and brand positioning.

title: Manager - Regional Product development
description:
**Job Details** 




 To introduce the right regional products by generating an in\-depth understanding of cultural, ritualistic and community specific requirements for jewelry and by undertaking extensive indexing of relevant competition. On this basis to work closely with the Cluster management and the regional teams for determining the appropriate sales plan and the supporting assortment plans. This role will also be responsible for identifying regionally relevant products or categories that can be imbued with Tanishq’s signature and promoted as such. As a part of the WiMI programme, this role will also work closely with the regional DEC and the Cluster management teams on the development of regionally relevant, marketed collections aligned to regional marketing calendar
 



  





**Merchandising: Planning for Regional Products** 




 1\. Mapping the current universe of regional products
 



 2\. Range\-planning for regional products: Identifying the gaps in the current universe, based on customer, community understanding as well as competitive indexing. Accordingly, planning for product introduction for ensuring that these product gaps are filled
 



 3\. Collaborating with the regional vendors to ensure the development of products to fill the product gap happens on a regular \& timely basis.
 



 4\. Wherever required, work closely with the Responsible Sourcing teams for the timely onboarding on relevant and capable vendor partners
 



 5\. Review of product performance and decision making on product continuation 6\. Engaging closely with the Retail stores for driving decisions on range expansion/discontinuation

 1\. Evaluating the current vendor ecosystem for regional products both in terms of expertise \& cost 2\. Periodic visits to the vendors to understand their capability as well to get inputs from vendors on regional products.
 



 3\. Conduct existing vendor performance evaluations based on product performance and evaluate new vendors based on the skill set planning.
 



 4\. On boarding the right new vendors in terms of expertise \& cost as per the gap observed in the current regional vendor eco\-system
 



  





**Periodic Competition Indexing** 




 1\. Monthly visits to regional competition to benchmark the regional products offered, weight bands, making charge ...etc.
 



 2\. Synthesis of actionable insights and incorporation into the Range plan

 1\. Manage the entire product lifecycle from inception to product retiral for regional products.

 3\. Provide inputs on the model stock recommendations for assortment planning.

 5\. Coordinate with the NPD \& NPIM team to ensure that the first set of proto are received as per the design approved – if not ensuring that the feedback is given for correction.

 7\. Conduct periodic canvassing with L3s for indent enhancement, seasonal up stocking etc. to improve new product penetration.
 



 8\. Collaborate with marketing for ad\-variant planning

 Education \- Graduate Relevant Experience 10 \-15 years with experience in Sourcing or Product development or Design or Merchandising functions with National or Regional jewelry brands.
 



 Prior work in the jewelry sector and a thorough understanding of regional nuances is a must Behavioural Skills

 • Business acumen
