title: GTM Architect
description:
**ABOUT JMAN:** 




 JMAN Group is a fast\-growing data engineering \& data science consultancy. We work primarily with Private Equity Funds and their Portfolio Companies to create commercial value using Data \& Artificial Intelligence. In addition, we also work with growth businesses, large corporates, multinationals, and charities.
 



  





 We are headquartered in London with Offices in New York, London and Chennai. Our team of over 450 people is a unique blend of individuals with skills across commercial consulting, data science and software engineering.
 



  





 We were founded by cousins Anush Newman (Co\-founder \& CEO) and Leo Valan (Co\-founder \& CTO) and have grown rapidly since 2019\. In May 2023 we took a minority investment from Baird Capital and in January 2024 we opened an office in New York with the ambition of growing our US business to be as large as, if not bigger than, our European business by 2027\.
 



  





**Why work at JMAN:** 




 Our vision is to ensure JMAN Group is the passport to our team’s future. We want our team to go on a fast\-paced, high\-growth journey with us – when our people want to do something else, the skills, training, exposure, and values that JMAN has instilled in them should open doors all over the world.
 



 Current Benefits:
 



 − Competitive annual bonus
 



 − Market\-leading private health insurance
 



 − Regular company socials
 



 − Annual company away days
 



 − Extensive training opportunities
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The GTM Architect will be the strategic bridge between JMAN product and delivery capabilities and our global client client partners (US/UK), driving sales enablement, value creation, and delivery alignment for the Private Equity and portfolio client ecosystem.
 



  





 While the primary focus is on sales enablement and value creation, this role will also oversee delivery management for active accounts to ensure solution promises translate into client outcomes.
 



  





 This position is ideal for senior professionals with technology presales experience with a MBA from a reputed Indian B\-School who can combine commercial acumen, solution storytelling, and operational discipline to scale our go\-to\-market efforts.
 



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* 5–10 years in technology presales, GTM, or solution consulting roles in tech services, consulting, or SaaS/product firms.
* MBA from a reputed Indian B\-School (like, IIM, ISB, XLRI, SPJIMR, Great Lakes etc.) with strong exposure to GTM, consulting, or tech solutioning.
* Good understanding of Private Equity ecosystem and portfolio value creation levers (preferred).
* Proven ability to design value propositions linking solutions to business outcomes.
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills. Ability to articulate impactful solution presentations.
* Experience in managing or overseeing delivery teams to ensure alignment with GTM objectives.
* Exposure to data, analytics, cloud, or AI\-led solutions is a plus.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Sales Enablement \& Solution Readiness
 *(Core Focus)***



* Develop solution playbooks, value propositions, and proposal templates tailored for PE and portfolio clients.
* Partner with US/UK Client Partners to craft impactful client pitches, proposal response and data \& AI solution narratives.
* Lead solutioning workshops with Delivery, Labs, and CoEs for cross\-functional GTM alignment.
* Maintain a centralized repository of sales assets, proof points, and case studies.



**Value Creation Strategy
 *(Core Focus)***



* Map JMAN’s data \& AI solution offerings to portfolio business value drivers (e.g. top\-line growth, margin improvement, operational efficiency, etc).
* Quantify and articulate ROI outcomes for client proposals.
* Contribute to strategic account plans and market expansion strategies.



**Delivery Management
 *(Supporting Focus)***



* Work with Tech Delivery Leads and PMO to monitor project progress for strategic accounts.
* Ensure delivery outputs align with agreed solution value propositions, and business outcomes.
* Identify opportunities to expand accounts through insights from delivery engagements.



**Global GTM Collaboration \& Governance** 



* Serve as the India\-based GTM anchor for global pursuits, ensuring quick turnaround and time zone coverage.
* Align with Marketing to drive campaigns and thought leadership tied to target accounts.
* Support PMO with pipeline tracking, conversion analytics, and win\-loss reviews.
* Run bi\-weekly GTM huddles with US/UK partners to review opportunity pipeline.

title: Marketing Practice Head

Metayb focuses on delivering seamless customer experiences, improving operational efficiency, and enabling data\-driven decision\-making. By leveraging emerging technologies, we aim to be the preferred partner for global enterprises in achieving their strategic goals within a digital\-first ecosystem.Our core expertise spans Digital Transformation, Data Science, SAP Implementation, Workflow Automation, Dashboarding \& Visualization, Finance, and Supply Chain services. We are continuously expanding into next\-generation areas such as IoT, AI/ML, and Virtual Reality, with a vision to be best\-in\-class across digital solutions, infrastructure, and product engineering.

This leadership role is responsible for strengthening the Metayb brand, driving demand generation, enabling sales growth, and developing market\-leading marketing services for our clients.

The individual should possess a strong blend of strategic thinking, execution excellence, client engagement, and practice management capabilities.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

title: Director, Platform Engineering (Product Management)
description:
Here at Appian, our values of
 **Intensity** 
 and
 **Excellence** 
 define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.
 



  
 



**This role is open to people who are currently in a product leadership role or someone in an engineering leadership role that is interested to make the switch into product.** 




 This role combines experienced product management leadership with the pivotal responsibilities of a Group Product Lead, offering an opportunity to shape the product strategy and the missions of several teams. You will oversee the product management execution working closely with the product managers for several cross\-functional software engineering teams around the world. This position reports to the Head of Product for the Platform Engineering Strategic Business Unit, which is responsible for Appian Cloud offering.
 



 An excellent candidate will come with a wide range of experience in a product leadership role in the cloud infrastructure domain at a software\-as\-a\-service firm. The product portfolio owned by this position will cover a wide range of cloud native infrastructure and services – from the highly available, resilient, scalable, and efficient infrastructure components on which all Appian Cloud services operate to the the scalable, enterprise\-grade managed services that power the backend data persistence and event streams for customer sites in Appian Cloud. You will provide product management leadership for initiatives that deliver efficient and scalable infrastructure, core compute capacity, and managed data planes as multi\-tenant services to accelerate the innovations of Engineering teams throughout the department. Your portfolio will include aspects that intersect with AWS account and VPC topology, Kubernetes clusters, network mesh, and edge web layer, as well as efforts to transform existing systems and software components into cloud\-native, Kubernetes\-based and multi\-tenant managed services while achieving incremental value for our customers from intermediate milestones.  
 



 You'll form strong relationships with counterparts within the Engineering department as well as stakeholders in other departments. You will oversee the creation of an impactful vision and ensure alignment between the product managers in your group and the roadmaps of the feature teams that rely on the services and frameworks provided by your organization. You will be accountable for the business impact of the features your group delivers. This includes owning the product strategy and feature backlog and ensuring effectiveness and adherence to standard product management processes. 
 



 This position is based at our office in Chennai, India. Appian was built on a culture of in\-person collaboration, which we believe is a key driver of our mission to be the best. This role will be 5 days office based from 11th Floor, Tower B, Brigade World Trade Center, Chennai.
 



**What you'll do:** 



* Oversee the initiation, planning, execution, and rollout for strategic initiatives.
* Lead the creation and ongoing maintenance of a multi\-team, short\-term and long\-term feature backlogs strongly aligned to product and corporate vision.
* Initiate and facilitate conversations across business units and departments to reach alignment on strategy, roadmap, key investments and messaging.
* Build relationships with key business stakeholders, keeping them apprised of important features, critical scope changes, planned investments.
* Help identify and cultivate the next generation of product management leaders.
* Provide constructive feedback on feature specifications to ensure new feature delivery provides optimal impact.
* Coach product managers on balancing functional and non\-functional enhancements and 
   

 system improvements.
* Continuously enhance and improve the product management processes and techniques at Appian.



**About you:** 



* **Strong technical background, likely as a former software architect or developer.**
* Proven people management skills in guiding product managers to success.
* **Passion for the backend and infrastructure technologies that power cloud\-based enterprise software systems, including proprietary, open\-source, and industry\-standard**
**components, especially those in the Cloud Native Computing Foundation landscape.**
* Experience with cloud native technologies and Kubernetes. An especially strong candidate will have previous exposure to the infrastructure behind Software\-as\-a\-Service 
   

 cloud product offerings.
* Understanding of networking and cross\-VPC connectivity and the security and compliance requirements that apply to such systems with respect to enterprise 
   

 customers. Previous experience with zero trust connectivity implementations would be a strong asset.
* Understanding of data persistence, object storage services, event streaming platforms, multi\-tenant shared services, and the security and compliance requirements that apply 
   

 to such systems with respect to enterprise customers.
* **Experience delivering cloud infrastructure features built using AWS services such as EKS, ECR, transit gateways, WAFs, and Global Accelerator (or similar offering from**
**other cloud providers).**
* Strong interest in the scalability, performance, security, observability, and reliability of distributed systems.
* Excellent communication skills, comfortable talking high\-level strategy with CxOs in the morning and feature details with developers in the afternoon.



  
 




**Tools and Resources** 




* Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department\-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First\-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires.
* Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.
* Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee\-led affinity groups. title: Shopify CRO Manager
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and commercially minded Shopify CRO Manager to own our end\-to\-end conversion rate optimisation programme.
 



 The role is responsible for the complete process from insight and hypothesis through experiment design, tracking QA, launch, statistical evaluation, winner rollout and measurable CVR/revenue impact.
 



 This position is not limited to marketplace listing optimisation, paid advertising or campaign execution. The successful candidate will improve the Shopify customer journey by working closely with dedicated Data Analyst, UI/UX, development, content and merchandising teams.
 


 Key responsibilities
 * Own the Shopify CRO roadmap across product pages, category/collection pages, search, navigation, cart and checkout.
* Analyse customer behaviour, funnel performance, device performance, engagement data and commercial results to identify conversion opportunities.
* Create structured hypotheses supported by evidence and prioritise experiments based on expected impact, confidence and effort.
* Define primary KPIs, secondary metrics, guardrail metrics, target audience, test duration and success criteria before each experiment.
* Partner with the Data Analyst to ensure accurate event tracking, dashboards, data quality and reliable post\-test analysis.
* Brief UI/UX, content and development teams with clear experiment requirements and expected customer/business outcomes.
* Conduct pre\-launch QA including tracking validation, mobile/desktop review, browser testing, localisation, merchandising checks and rollback readiness.
* Launch and monitor A/B tests and other controlled experiments without disrupting customer experience or trading performance.
* Evaluate test outcomes using appropriate statistical methods; distinguish meaningful uplift from inconclusive or false\-positive results.
* Roll out confirmed winners, document learning, and ensure results are incorporated into future product and page templates.
* Maintain an experiment backlog, prioritisation framework, testing calendar, QA checklist and executive reporting.
* Present clear recommendations and revenue/CVR impact to senior stakeholders.


 Required qualifications and experience
 * 4\+ years of experience in conversion rate optimisation, e\-commerce growth, digital analytics, product experimentation or a related role.
* Proven experience personally owning website experiments from hypothesis to successful rollout.
* Hands\-on experience with Shopify and a strong understanding of D2C e\-commerce journeys.
* Strong knowledge of A/B testing, control/variant design, sample size, statistical significance, confidence levels and incremental impact.
* Experience using GA4, Google Tag Manager, Shopify Analytics and reporting tools such as Looker Studio, Power BI or Tableau.
* Ability to work effectively with Data, UI/UX, developers, content, merchandising and commercial stakeholders.
* Strong analytical thinking, structured communication and project\-management skills.
* Ability to prioritise high\-impact initiatives in a fast\-moving e\-commerce environment.


 Preferred qualifications
 * Experience with experimentation platforms such as VWO, Optimizely, Convert, AB Tasty or similar.
* SQL knowledge and experience working with product, customer or web\-behaviour datasets.
* Experience with heatmaps/session\-replay tools such as Hotjar, Contentsquare, Microsoft Clarity or similar.
* Experience improving international e\-commerce stores, localised content or multi\-market Shopify storefronts.
* Experience in fitness, consumer goods, retail or high\-consideration D2C products.


 How success will be measured
 * Conversion\-rate uplift across key Shopify journeys.
* Incremental revenue and profitability generated through experiments.
* Quality and speed of the hypothesis\-to\-launch process.
* Accuracy of tracking, QA and statistical evaluation.
* Number and impact of winning experiments successfully rolled out.
* Clear documentation and adoption of learnings across teams.


 Application requirement
 
 Candidates should share 2\-3 examples of experiments they personally owned, including:
 


* The hypothesis and business problem
* Primary KPI and test setup
* Test duration/sample size approach
* Result and statistical conclusion
* Final rollout decision and measurable business impact

 Manage the overall health of the partner relationship, moving beyond simple transactions to strategic alignment.

 Strong understanding of how large technology vendors (Hyperscalers, ERP, CRM) operate their partner programs.

 Familiarity with complex enterprise sales cycles and the ability to influence sales teams without direct authority.

 Experience managing MDF budgets, partner portals, and pipeline reporting (Salesforce/HubSpot).

title: Business Lead
description:
**Founding Business Development Lead**
 Build the Commercial Engine for an Indigenous Deep\-Tech Cooling Company
   

  

**About Us**
 Zerocubit is an indigenous sustainable ultra\-low temperature refrigeration company founded by IISc alumni bringing hands\-on R\&D and product engineering experience from Atlas Copco and IIT Madras Research Park \- grounding the company in deep technical rigor across mechanical design, thermal systems, and industrial product development, with a track record of taking engineering\-heavy products from concept to deployment \- building patentable, high\-performance cooling technology for pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, semiconductor manufacturing, defence, lyophilization, and advanced industrial cooling that matches global systems on engineering capability, reliability, sustainability, and performance; solving India's near\-total dependence on imported ULT equipment (steep distributor markups, long lead times, thin local service support) and the absence of any independent multi\-brand service network, through systems designed around low\-GWP refrigerants that cut environmental impact and help customers lower their own carbon footprint, on a phased roadmap from −40°C to −60°C in Pilot 1, extending to −100°C in Pilot 2 and −150°C in Pilot 3, toward becoming a single\-point stop for cryogenic products; currently pre\-launch and founder\-led.
   

 Now, we are looking for the person who will help build the business \& commercial side of the company from the ground up.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are hiring our first Business Development Lead \- a builder, strategist, relationship creator, and commercial leader who wants to create a business function rather than inherit one.
   

 You will work directly with the founders to identify markets, open strategic doors, build customer relationships, develop partnerships, shape our go\-to\-market strategy, and convert early opportunities into long\-term business. This is not a traditional business development role where you inherit a CRM, sales scripts, established territories, and predefined targets.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad, India (base), with frequent travel across India.
   

  

**You will help create the playbook.**
 From identifying our highest\-potential customer segments to building the sales pipeline, refining pricing, developing partnerships, representing the company at major industry events, and eventually building your own team \- you will play a central role in defining how the company grows.
   

  

 We think of this role through a "
 **Cheetah \+ Elephant** 
 " mindset:
   

 Move like a cheetah when speed, experimentation, and decisive action matter.
   

 Think like an elephant when relationships, credibility, partnerships, and long\-term strategic positioning require patience and consistency. Some opportunities may convert in days. Others may take months. You should know the difference and know how to build both.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Build and grow opportunities across pharma API manufacturing, biotech, lyophilization, semiconductors, defence, and industrial cooling.
* Own the full commercial cycle – from lead generation and customer discussions to proposals, negotiations, and contract conversion.
* Build strong relationships with plant leaders, engineering teams, procurement, business heads, and government stakeholders.
* Work closely with the founders and engineering team to translate customer needs into commercial and technical proposals.
* Gather market and competitor intelligence to support pricing, positioning, and product decisions.
* Create the sales pipeline through outbound outreach, partnerships, industry events, and strategic relationships.
* Represent the company at trade shows, conferences, industry forums, and relevant media opportunities.
* Help define the company's go\-to\-market strategy, sales process, pricing structure, collateral, and future business team.


**What We're Looking For**
* 3–5 years of experience in B2B, industrial, technical, deep\-tech, capital equipment, pharma, semiconductor, defence, refrigeration, or related markets.
* Can build relationships and opportunities from scratch.
* Is comfortable with complex, consultative sales cycles.
* Can understand technical products and communicate their business value.
* Works well in a fast\-moving, high\-ambiguity startup environment.
* Thinks strategically but is equally comfortable executing on the ground.
* Can manage both short\-term opportunities and long\-term customer relationships.
* Direct experience in ultra\-low\-temperature refrigeration is valuable, but not required.


 A builder's mindset, commercial judgment, and ability to create business matter more.
   

  

**Compensation**
 Competitive base salary (commensurate with experience) plus revenue\-linked incentives and meaningful equity.
   

  

**What You Get**
* A chance to build the commercial function from zero alongside the founders.
* High ownership and direct influence on company strategy and growth.
* Career progression based on results and impact, not tenure.
* The opportunity to commercialize cutting\-edge, sustainable Made\-in\-India deep\-tech technology.
* Direct exposure to customers, engineering, product strategy, and key company decisions.


**Culture**

title: POD Manager
company: Digital Mojo - Branding and Digital Marketing Agency in Hyderabad
description:
**Company Description** 





 Digital Mojo is a results\-driven digital marketing agency based in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. Since 2016, we have been helping brands scale through performance\-focused digital strategies, storytelling, lead generation, branding, and high\-impact marketing campaigns.
 




  





**Role Description** 




**We are looking for a highly ownership\-driven Pod Manager with 5\-7 years of agency experience to lead a pod of clients end\-to\-end.** 





 The Pod Manager is not a delivery coordinator. They are the business head of their pod. They own the P\&L of their accounts, drive client growth strategy, lead the pod team, and are the last point of escalation before it reaches the CEO. Every commercial decision, every retention risk, every growth opportunity within the pod runs through them.
 





 If something goes wrong in the pod, the Pod Manager owns it. If something goes right, the Pod Manager drove it.
 




**What This Role Is Not** 



* Not a senior Account Manager with a fancier title
* Not someone who only reviews reports and attends calls
* Not someone who escalates client problems to the CEO without first attempting resolution
* Not a task manager or execution coordinator
* Not someone who waits for strategy to come from above



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Pod P\&L Ownership** 



* Own the revenue, profitability, and commercial health of all accounts within the pod
* Track pod\-level billing, scope utilization, and team bandwidth against revenue
* Identify accounts where the agency is over\-servicing and course\-correct scope or pricing
* Protect agency margins by managing team allocation and delivery efficiency
* Flag accounts at commercial risk to the Founder with a clear plan, not just a problem
* Identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities and close them in coordination with the Founder
* Own monthly pod revenue targets and report against them with clarity



**2\. Client Growth Strategy** 



* Go beyond delivery. Actively think about what is next for each client's business
* Develop quarterly growth plans for key accounts covering new campaigns, channels, and opportunities
* Proactively bring ideas to clients before they ask. Be the strategic voice in every client relationship
* Identify gaps in a client's current marketing mix and recommend solutions backed by data
* Lead strategic review meetings with clients, not just performance catch\-up calls
* Connect client business goals to marketing strategy and keep both aligned as the business evolves
* Be the person a client calls when they want a fresh perspective, not just a status update



**3\. Escalation Leadership** 



* Serve as the final internal escalation point before the CEO for all pod\-level issues
* Handle client escalations, conflicts, and difficult conversations directly and with confidence
* Resolve delivery failures, team gaps, and quality issues at the pod level without pushing them upward
* Make judgment calls on scope disputes, pricing conversations, and client dissatisfaction independently
* Know when to involve the Founder and walk in with context, options, and a recommendation
* Protect the Founder's bandwidth by resolving 90% of pod issues at the pod level



**4\. Team Leadership and Pod Management** 



* Lead and manage Account Managers, Social Media Managers, Performance Marketers, and SEO Specialists within the pod
* Set clear expectations, review output quality, and hold team members accountable
* Run pod reviews, identify underperformance early, and address it directly
* Build a culture of ownership, speed, and quality within the pod
* Identify training or skill gaps in the team and flag them to the Founder
* Ensure Account Managers are handling day\-to\-day client communication so the Pod Manager can focus on strategy and commercial outcomes



**5\. Delivery and Quality Oversight** 



* Own the quality of everything that leaves the pod, from reports to creatives to campaign performance
* Ensure all client deliverables across social media, SEO, and performance marketing are on time and to standard
* Review monthly performance reports before they reach the client
* Maintain SLA adherence across the pod and flag risks before they impact delivery
* Coordinate with centralized teams including design, SEO, website, and automation for seamless execution



**6\. Performance and Campaign Strategy** 



* Understand performance marketing fundamentals including CPL, ROAS, CTR, lead quality, and funnel structure
* Review campaign performance across accounts and push for optimization when results are not meeting targets
* Work with Performance Marketers on budget planning, channel strategy, and campaign direction
* Ensure SEO, social, and paid strategies are aligned and working toward the same client business outcome
* The character in sitcom is Ross



**7\. Commercial Responsibility and Client Retention** 



* Own client retention across all pod accounts
* Conduct regular health checks on every account and know the status of each relationship at all times
* Identify at\-risk clients early and create a recovery plan before it becomes a churn situation
* Manage contract renewals, scope expansions, and pricing conversations
* Track client satisfaction and act on early signals before they escalate



  





**Key KPIs** 



* Pod Revenue vs Target
* Pod Gross Margin and Profitability
* Client Retention Rate
* Upsell and Cross\-sell Revenue Generated
* Client Satisfaction Score
* Escalations Reaching CEO (target: minimal)
* On\-Time Delivery Percentage
* Team Utilization and Bandwidth Efficiency
* Strategic Growth Plans Delivered per Quarter



  





**Required Skills and Qualifications** 



* 4\-7 years of experience in a digital marketing agency
* Proven experience managing multiple client accounts and cross\-functional teams
* Strong understanding of agency P\&L, billing, scope management, and margin control
* Deep knowledge of performance marketing, social media, SEO, and content marketing
* Experience handling client escalations and difficult commercial conversations independently
* Strong strategic thinking with the ability to build and present growth plans for clients
* Excellent English communication skills, written and verbal
* Confident in senior client\-facing discussions and presentations
* Experience with project management and reporting tools
* Ability to lead, motivate, and hold a team accountable in a fast\-paced environment



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile** 



* **Agency experience is mandatory.**
* Has managed a revenue\-bearing portfolio of clients, not just a team of people
* Has had commercial conversations with clients around scope, pricing, and renewals
* Thinks in terms of client business growth, not just campaign delivery
* Is a problem\-solver who finds solutions before escalating
* Can lead a room whether it is a team standup or a senior client strategy session



  





**Reporting Structure** 



* Reports To: Founder / CEO
* Manages: Account Managers, Social Media Managers, Performance Marketers, SEO Specialists
* Coordinates With: Creative Team, SEO Team, Website Team, Automation Team
* Escalation Authority: Final internal point before the CEO

title: Senior Manager - RGM
description:

ICC is a growing function within PepsiCo that leverages one strategy and common approach to introduce new, technology\-driven capabilities and elevate service quality while meeting current and future business needs. PEP RGM is a key priority function where transformation, technology, strategy and capabilities enablement are aimed to be the best in class, and to be standardized and deployed globally. The vision is to develop playbook to develop analytic packs with insights across Brand Ladders, Channel PPA, In\-Market Pack Price realization, Trade Investment Strategy, Promo ROI and Mix Management. This work will accelerate growth through efficient positioning across price tiers, optimized channel\-based package types, right pricing, well directed commercial strategy and increase promotional ROI driven by enhanced and standardized insights.




This position will be part of the ICC \- Revenue growth Management organization. This position contributes to the success of the company and contribute to growth through strategy development, and implementation of RGM frameworks. The incumbement will work for different markets across the globe and work with different stakeholders to develop RGM playbooks and ensure analytics execution

  


Responsibilities:

Key Activities


* Perform granular level analysis to identify growth opportunities
* Prepare data for the analyses to be performed (Data Pre\-processing Tools – Alteryx/KNIME exp preferred)
* Understand the nuances of the product category and market to tailor the output according to business needs
* Run the analyses and create visualizations (Power BI and Tableau experience preferred); prepare drill down analyses to derive insights
* Create a storyline out of various analyses output for the business to comprehend the output
* Meet the service level agreements and perform QC of the end\-to\-end analysis
* Expand playbook analytic pack scope to include additional analyses upon alignment with market

  


Qualifications:  

* \+7 years of experience in Retail Analytics/Category Management/Revenue Management
* 2\-3 years of relevant professional experience working with large data sets and experience in CPG /Consulting / ICC Organizations
* Experience in any of the RGM lever practices\- Pricing, Promo, Assortment, Trade Investment
* Strong analytics skills with expertise in data analytics and data visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI
* Strong Advanced Analytics acumen, Agile ways of working, managing high end data science

title: Global Campaign Manager
description:
Overview:
**About JAGGAER**  

JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source\-to\-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries.  

Our 1,200\+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products \- ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses.  

For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com **Role Summary:**  

The Global Nurture Campaigns Manager will own the execution, optimization, and governance of JAGGAER's marketing automation programs across Salesforce and Pardot (Marketing Cloud Account Engagement). This role will be responsible for building scalable campaign infrastructure, managing automated journeys, maintaining data quality, and ensuring marketing programs move prospects and customers through the funnel effectively.  

This role will partner closely with Demand Generation, Lifecycle Marketing, Marketing Operations, Sales Operations, Content, Digital, and regional marketing teams to translate campaign strategy into technically sound, measurable programs. The position will manage campaign setup, segmentation, lead routing, scoring, nurture programs, email execution, testing, reporting, and ongoing platform optimization.  

The ideal candidate combines strong hands\-on Pardot and Salesforce expertise with campaign operations discipline, lifecycle marketing knowledge, analytical thinking, and the ability to improve processes at scale.
Principal Responsibilities:
**Marketing Automation Platform Ownership:*** Serve as a primary owner and power user of Pardot (Marketing Cloud Account Engagement), ensuring the platform is configured, maintained, and used according to established marketing operations standards.
* Manage automation rules, engagement programs, dynamic lists, completion actions, scoring, grading, segmentation logic, suppression rules, and other core Pardot functionality.
* Maintain strong alignment between Pardot and Salesforce, including field mappings, campaign synchronization, lead and contact records, campaign membership, and activity visibility.
* Monitor platform health, sync errors, automation conflicts, data issues, and operational risks, resolving issues directly or coordinating with Sales Operations, IT, and external partners.

 **Campaign Management \& Execution*** Own the technical setup and execution of integrated marketing campaigns across email, webinars, events, paid media, content programs, and other demand generation channels.
* Build and manage Salesforce Campaigns and Pardot campaign assets, including emails, forms, landing pages, lists, automation rules, tracking links, and campaign member statuses.
* Establish repeatable campaign templates, naming conventions, QA checklists, and launch processes that improve speed, consistency, and reporting accuracy.
* Partner with campaign owners to translate campaign briefs into executable workflows, audience segments, routing logic, follow\-up actions, and measurement plans.
* Conduct pre\-launch and post\-launch QA for links, forms, personalization, segmentation, tracking, routing, suppression, rendering, and CRM synchronization.

 **Lifecycle Marketing \& Nurture Programs*** Support the lifecycle marketing strategy by building automated nurture journeys for prospects, leads, customers, and other key audiences.
* Develop and optimize Pardot Engagement Studio programs based on lifecycle stage, persona, product interest, engagement, buying signals, geography, and account characteristics.
* Partner with Demand Generation and Content teams to map content and messaging to stages of the buyer journey and create scalable always\-on nurture programs.
* Build re\-engagement, lead recycling, stalled\-opportunity, post\-event, customer engagement, and other lifecycle programs that improve progression and conversion.
* Continuously test cadence, subject lines, messaging, calls to action, segmentation, and journey logic to improve engagement and downstream pipeline impact.

 **Lead Management, Scoring \& Routing*** Manage and optimize lead scoring, grading, qualification, lifecycle stage progression, and handoff processes between Marketing and Sales.
* Support lead routing and assignment logic to ensure qualified prospects are delivered to the correct sales teams quickly and accurately.
* Monitor funnel movement and identify operational breakdowns between inquiry, qualification, nurture, MQL, sales acceptance, and opportunity stages.
* Partner with Sales Operations and Marketing Operations to improve lead status governance, campaign member statuses, attribution inputs, and CRM data consistency.

 **Data, Segmentation \& Personalization*** Build accurate audience segments using Salesforce and Pardot data, including demographic, firmographic, behavioral, campaign, account, and lifecycle attributes.
* Maintain suppression logic, consent requirements, subscription preferences, and data hygiene processes to improve deliverability and campaign quality.
* Use dynamic content, personalization, and segmentation to create more relevant experiences across lifecycle and demand generation programs.
* Identify duplicate, incomplete, stale, or inconsistent records and work with operations partners to improve
  

database quality and governance.

 **Reporting, Measurement \& Optimization*** Track campaign and lifecycle performance including delivery, engagement, conversion, MQL creation, funnel progression, pipeline influence, and other agreed KPIs.
* Build and maintain campaign reporting within Salesforce and Pardot, and partner with Analytics teams on dashboards and attribution reporting.
* Analyze program performance to identify bottlenecks, underperforming segments, nurture opportunities, and areas for campaign optimization.
* Provide actionable recommendations to campaign owners and marketing leadership based on performance data and funnel behavior.

 **Marketing Operations \& Governance*** Maintain documentation for campaign processes, automation logic, naming conventions, field usage, scoring models, routing, and lifecycle workflows.
* Support user access, platform governance, testing, release management, and change control across Salesforce and Pardot marketing workflows.
* Partner with Marketing Operations, Sales Operations, IT, and vendors on integrations, troubleshooting, platform enhancements, and process improvements.
* Stay current on Salesforce and Pardot capabilities and recommend improvements that increase automation, efficiency, scalability, and data quality.


Position Requirements:
* 5\+ years of experience in marketing automation, marketing operations, lifecycle marketing, campaign operations, or a related B2B marketing role.
* Hands\-on experience administering and executing campaigns in Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement.
* Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, including Campaigns, Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Opportunities, campaign member statuses, and reporting.
* Experience building automated nurture programs, segmentation, lead scoring, grading, routing, email campaigns, forms, and landing pages.
* Strong understanding of B2B demand generation funnels, lifecycle stages, lead management, and Marketing to\-Sales handoff processes.
* Experience with campaign QA, data hygiene, consent and suppression logic, email deliverability, and marketing database management.
* Ability to troubleshoot automation, sync, routing, segmentation, tracking, and campaign execution issues independently.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign and funnel performance and turn findings into operational improvements.
* Excellent project management and communication skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to documentation, governance, and quality assurance.

 **Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Experience supporting marketing automation within a B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, procurement, or complex global organization.
* Salesforce or Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement certifications.
* Experience with advanced Salesforce reporting, campaign attribution, dashboards, and funnel analytics.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, webinar platforms, paid media integrations, ABM platforms, and other marketing technology tools.
* Experience with HTML/CSS for email and landing page troubleshooting or customization.
* Experience supporting global campaigns, multiple regions, languages, business units, or complex routing structures.
 **Success Measures:*** Campaigns launch accurately, on time, and with consistent tracking, routing, and Salesforce campaign structure.
* Lifecycle and nurture programs increase engagement, qualification, funnel progression, and pipeline contribution.
* Lead scoring, routing, and Marketing\-to\-Sales handoffs operate reliably with fewer errors and faster follow\-up.
* Salesforce and Pardot data remains clean, synchronized, well governed, and usable for segmentation and reporting.
* Marketing teams gain scalable processes, templates, documentation, and automation that reduce manual campaign work and improve execution speed.
 **What We Offer:**  

At JAGGAER, we are committed to supporting you and your family's well\-being. Your health is a priority, and we offer a

At JAGGAER, our business is about people. Our products are built on intellectual property, but the real differentiator is the

set of expectations for how we work together across products, cultures, and geographies.* **Transparency** \- Openness Builds Trust: Candor strengthens relationships, speeds decision\-making, and ensures  

problems are solved together \- with customers, teammates, and partners.

cornerstone of both organizational and personal growth.
* **Accountability \-** Thumbs In, Not Fingers Out: We take responsibility ourselves before pointing elsewhere.

quickly, and ensure we're delivering real impact.

You will work closely with leadership and cross\-functional teams to establish a market\-leading platform for investing in global equities.
 



 This role is ideal for someone who has built and scaled digital businesses, products, or investment platforms and thrives in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 









**Business Ownership \& Strategy** 



* Own the end\-to\-end P\&L and growth of the US Stocks business.
* Define the long\-term business vision, strategic roadmap, and annual operating plan.
* Identify new growth opportunities, revenue streams, and business models to accelerate scale.
* Drive sustainable growth while balancing customer experience, profitability, and regulatory requirements.



  





**Go\-to\-Market \& Business Growth** 



* Develop and execute the go\-to\-market (GTM) strategy for customer acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention.
* Identify target customer cohorts and define tailored acquisition, engagement, and cross\-sell strategies.
* Build scalable growth engines across digital channels, partnerships, referrals, and ecosystem integrations.
* Drive adoption of the US Stocks offering through data\-driven experimentation and continuous optimization.



  





**Product \& Customer Experience** 



* Own the product vision and roadmap for the US Stocks business.
* Identify customer pain points and market opportunities to launch differentiated products and features.
* Prioritize initiatives that improve onboarding, trading experience, customer engagement, and long\-term retention.
* Partner with Product, Technology, Design, Operations, Compliance, and Risk teams to deliver seamless customer experiences.



  





**Commercial Strategy** 



* Define pricing, brokerage, subscription, and monetization strategies that enhance customer value while improving business profitability.
* Evaluate commercial levers, promotional campaigns, and pricing experiments using data and market insights.



  





**Business Analytics \& Performance** 



* Own business performance metrics and establish a robust operating cadence.
* Lead funnel analysis across acquisition, onboarding, activation, funding, trading, and retention to improve conversion and customer lifetime value.
* Leverage customer cohort analysis and behavioral insights to identify opportunities for growth and optimization.
* Present business performance, strategic recommendations, and investment priorities to senior leadership.



  





**Market Intelligence \& Competitive Positioning** 



* Continuously benchmark the US Stocks offering against domestic and global competitors.
* Track industry trends, customer behavior, regulatory developments, and emerging investment products.
* Recommend strategic initiatives to strengthen competitive positioning and create differentiated customer value.



  





**Leadership \& Cross\-functional Collaboration** 



* Lead cross\-functional teams to execute strategic priorities with speed and excellence.
* Partner with Marketing, Product, Technology, Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Customer Support to successfully launch and scale initiatives.
* Build a high\-performance culture focused on customer obsession, innovation, accountability, and execution.



  





**Who you are:** 



* 3\-5 years of experience in business leadership, general management, strategy, product management, category management, or P\&L ownership within fintech, wealth management, capital markets, broking, asset management, or digital financial services.
* Proven track record of building, launching, and scaling high\-growth businesses, digital platforms, or investment products.
* Demonstrated experience owning business strategy, GTM execution, customer growth, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong understanding of investment products, capital markets, and customer behavior in wealth management.
* Experience driving pricing strategy, business analytics, funnel optimization, customer segmentation, and profitability initiatives.
* Exceptional analytical and strategic thinking with the ability to translate insights into business outcomes.
* Strong executive stakeholder management and the ability to influence across senior leadership teams.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias for action, ownership, and delivering measurable business impact.



  





**At Angel One, our thriving culture is rooted in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI).** 









*As an Equal opportunity employer, we wholeheartedly welcome people from all backgrounds irrespective of caste, religion, gender, marital status, sexuality, disability, class or age to be part of our team.* 




*We believe that everyone's unique experiences and viewpoints make us stronger together.* 




*Come and be a part of \#OneSpace\*, where your individuality is celebrated and embraced.*

Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

**The Role**
 This is a senior role within International Wealth and Personal Banking (IWPB) reporting to the Head of IWPB India with accountability for the Overseas Indian (OI) channel strategy. You’ll shape and deliver a strategy that grows deposits, wealth and remittances across key international corridors while strengthening customer experience and long\-term client relationships. The role brings a strong cross\-border focus and involves close partnership with overseas Group offices and International Banking Centres. Success means building sustainable revenue and market share, improving customer outcomes and ensuring the business operates within HSBC’s risk appetite and regulatory requirements. You’ll also set direction for teams and operating model changes that increase frontline capacity and improve productivity and cost discipline.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Formulate and implement the OI strategy to build on the current market share
* Oversee International Banking Centres and develop the International Booking Centre concept across key corridors
* Build deposits and wealth management growth across OI segments alongside remittance and FEX (foreign exchange) flows
* Establish new external partnerships and expand existing relationships to strengthen the OI proposition
* Strengthen customer experience and customer voice across the organisation to support retention and relationship expansion
* Coordinate cross\-border collaboration with overseas Group offices to build referral models and corridor growth plans
* Embed risk management and regulatory compliance across the OI business including cross\-border, AML and sanctions requirements
* Develop training and accreditation roadmaps across overseas markets to build capability across sales and support teams


**What We're Looking For**
* Bring substantial experience managing Offshore and NRI (Non Resident Indian) client segments in a senior, multi\-geography role
* Demonstrate a proven record of building and growing an Overseas Indian business across different countries
* Show strong understanding of IWPB products across assets, wealth and liabilities and what drives performance and profitability
* Apply established capability in customer segmentation, proposition development and go\-to\-market execution
* Communicate effectively with senior stakeholders and customer groups including C\-suite and Treasurers
* Influence across business lines and geographies to deliver coordinated outcomes in a matrix environment
* Interpret local and cross\-border regulations and compliance guidelines to support franchise growth within risk appetite
* Complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment as required


**Building growth across key corridors**
 If you want to shape a cross\-border strategy with clear commercial impact this role offers the scope to make it happen. You’ll work across HSBC’s network to build corridor\-based business models that grow deposits, wealth and remittances while improving the end\-to\-end customer experience. The work is high visibility and closely connected to how IWPB delivers growth in a regulated environment. Apply to help build sustainable outcomes for customers and the wider Group.
   

  

 You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
   

  

 www.hsbc.com/careers

* Identify, develop, and convert new business opportunities while expanding existing customer partnerships.
* Partner with application specialists and cross\-functional teams to support customer education, clinical adoption, and commercial execution.
* Monitor market dynamics, competitive activity, and customer needs to inform business planning and territory strategy.

title: Financial Controller - Analyst
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

As an Analyst within the Global Technology Controllers in Corporate Sector Controllers, you will be responsible for providing controllership support to the technology function, including accounting for technology in accordance with US GAAP and JPMC standards.


Global Technology Controller provide controllership support to technology function in to Hardware, Software, Professional services and other direct expense lines. Team is also responsible for capitalization of tangible or intangible assets.




Job Responsibilities:


* Determine expense versus capitalization treatment, ensure timely disposal recognition, and post close entries with appropriate support and approvals.
* Partner with Technology, P\&A, Business Management, and Procurement to align on project scope, in\-service dates, and cutover timing, and maintain SOX\-compliant controls and audit\-ready evidence.
* Perform ongoing review of work\-in\-process ledger balances, including aging analysis, root\-cause identification, and timely clearing to fixed assets or expense when criteria are met.
* Reconcile WIP balances to upstream project and procurement systems and validate against purchase orders, capitalization requests, and approvals.
* Capitalize qualifying assets by evaluating projects against thresholds and criteria and determining start/stop capitalization dates, place\-in\-service dates, useful lives, and residual values.
* Validate operational impacts and future benefit assumptions with Technology and business stakeholders and record entries accurately and timely in the general ledger.
* Ensure balance sheet positions are appropriately supported to maintain a strong fortress balance sheet.
* Document analytics through estimates, walk\-forwards, controller financial reviews, and flash reports.
* Analyze, communicate, and resolve material variances between the general ledger and upstream systems, as defined by the line of business.

Required qualifications, skills, and capabilities

* 3 years of related experience
* General Ledger experience
* Experience with financial reporting and month end close responsibilities
* Comfortable liaising with business and risk managers
* Able to build and maintain partnerships within the various product aligned businesses and across other corporate financial, treasury, and accounting groups
* Able to understand business drivers and requirements and influence middle and front office partners to deliver solutions to business issues and problems
* Strong analytical skills: Ability to quickly understand workings of a complex processing system and general ledger systems across the infrastructure and their interrelationships and dependencies
* Excellent desktop/spreadsheet/database skills
* Excellent organizational and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Able to multi\-task in a constantly changing environment

Able to critically challenge with the goal of identifying control issues  
* 

Preferred qualifications, skills, and capabilities

* Existing relationships and networks within the firm's IB community an advantage
* Shift Timing: Mid\-day shift 1pm to 10pm

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.  

  

Global Finance \& Business Management works to strategically manage capital, drive growth and efficiencies, maintain financial reporting and proactively manage risk. By providing information, analysis and recommendations to improve results and drive decisions, teams ensure the company can navigate all types of market conditions while protecting our fortress balance sheet.

title: Senior Manager, Community, Advocacy and Partnerships
description:
Circa:


Salary is competitive.


The Royal Society of Chemistry is a not\-for\-profit organisation whose mission is to advance chemical sciences. As a not\-for\-profit publisher, we reinvest surplus funds back into the global scientific community, supporting our purpose to help the chemical science community to create a future that is more open and more equal. We work closely with public authorities, universities and schools.


We are looking for an experienced Leader in publishing to join us as a **Senior Manager, Community, Advocacy and Strategic Partnerships** . In this role you will be a Growth Accelerator in identifying new opportunities and partnerships with our key external stakeholders. You will continue building and developing strong relationships with government and policy bodies, ONOS, Inflibnet, private and public universities across the region to strengthen our existing position in the market.


In this role you will be the one who will develop and deliver unified community engagement and partnership strategy across India and South Asia, helping to expand the reach, visibility and impact of the Royal Society of Chemistry's activities.


As the strategic lead for community outreach, advocacy and institutional partnerships, you will bring together engagement activities into a coordinated, year\-round programme focused on delivering measurable outcomes and long\-term impact. You will work closely with colleagues across Editorial, Memberships, Sales and Marketing to align engagement initiatives with organisational priorities and increase awareness and use of RSC content and services, while maximising opportunities through national initiatives such as ONOS.


This is a very exciting opportunity for an experienced leader with a strong understanding of scientific publishing, research and higher education landscape across India and South Asia, including open science, open access, research funding and science policy.


**Key Responsibilities:**

* Set and own the India and South Asia community, advocacy and strategic partnerships strategy, defining regional priorities, maintaining a forward roadmap and aligning activity, resource and investment to RSC’s global purpose and long\-term goals.
* Strengthen RSC’s position in ONOS, INFLIBNET, open access and APC revenue opportunities by building priority partnerships, supporting platform and journal adoption, and working with Head of Sales on pilots, lighthouse wins and monetised partnerships.
* Oversee the planning and delivery of major events and engagement activity, including setting agendas with partners and briefing or involving RSC Senior Leadership for priority activity such as sustainability and CRSI\-related events.
* Create a collaborative team environment that encourages open communication, knowledge sharing and joined\-up delivery across internal and external partners.
* Translate global and regional priorities for open science, open access, sustainable chemistry, inclusion, research culture and scientific impact into clear plans, flagship activity and workstreams with defined owners, timelines and governance.
* Own senior engagement with research communities through structured stakeholder mapping, targeted programmes and relationship management across PhD students, postdoctoral researchers, early career researchers, authors, reviewers, academics, institutions and senior scientific leaders.
* Set the regional policy and sector insight agenda by monitoring developments across science, research, higher education, publishing and the funder ecosystem, assessing implications for RSC and producing clear recommendations, briefings and internal updates.
* Build and steward strategic relationships with government, funders, academic institutions, research networks, innovation clusters, startups, incubators, sector bodies and other priority partners through clear engagement plans and partnership objectives.
* Set the strategic engagement approach for librarians, consortia, academic influencers and state and central universities, strengthening awareness, adoption and effective use of RSC platforms, products, journals and books across priority institutions.
* Communicate priorities, expectations and decisions clearly, ensuring direct reports and stakeholders understand responsibilities, objectives and how their work contributes to the wider strategy.
* Work with relevant internal stakeholders to deliver major outreach, advocacy, partnership and market development programmes, including sustainability, DEI, women in chemistry, open science and open access activity.
* Ensure programmes are well governed and properly resourced through clear budgets, risk controls, supplier oversight, decision governance, delivery reviews, operational delivery standards and post\-programme evaluation.
* Act as the regional point of influence for community, advocacy and partnership insight, helping Editorial, Sales, Membership, Marketing and relevant Global Impact Group teams align priorities and delivery.

**Requirements:**

* Degree or Master’s level education in science, or equivalent practical experience, with significant senior\-level experience in community engagement, advocacy, policy, partnerships or scientific outreach.
* Strong understanding of the Indian and South Asian research, higher education, science policy, funder, publishing, open access, open science or chemistry community landscape.
* Proven ability to set direction, shape strategy and lead complex regional engagement, advocacy or partnership plans.
* Experience building senior relationships with academic leaders, policymakers, funders, government bodies, librarians, research institutions and sector partners.
* Strong policy judgement, communication, advocacy and influencing skills, including clear recommendations for senior audiences.
* Experience leading major programmes, including budgets, governance, procurement, supplier oversight, risk management, evaluation, impact reporting and ROI.
* Commercial awareness, including business case development, value for money, revenue growth opportunities, cost recovery, sponsorship or co\-funding where relevant.

At the Royal Society of Chemistry, we support flexibility and offer hybrid working, which means our teams come together when they need to collaborate.
 

Although this role is contractually based at our Delhi office, and therefore you will have the opportunity to work mostly from any other location in India, as agreed with your line manager. Applicants should be aware that there is an expectation that employees will attend our Delhi office once a month. Please be aware that in this role you are expected to travel across India for events or meetings with our external partners.


This role will close on 27th September at 23\.59 (local time). The interviews will be held via Teams on the **1st and 2nd October** . If you are interested in this role, please apply before the end of the closing date. When applying, you will need to provide an up\-to\-date CV and a supporting statement (no more than 500 words) indicating how your skills/ expertise match the competencies outlined in the Job Description.


Visit our **Work For Us** website to learn more about us, our benefits, equal opportunities statement and inclusive culture pledge.


At the RSC, we recognise the benefits of a diverse workforce and welcome applicants from a range of backgrounds to apply. We particularly encourage applications from disabled and ethnic minority candidates.


As a part of the Disability Confident Scheme, we endeavour, where possible, to offer an interview to candidates meeting the essential criteria of the role, who has a substantial physical/mental impairment which impacts their ability to carry out day\-to\-day tasks.


We are committed to making our recruitment processes accessible to all and as part of this, we are flexible in the ways we give and receive information. If you would like to apply using a different format, please contact the Recruitment Team at jobs@rsc.org or on \+44 (0\) 1223 432229 and we will do our best to put any reasonable adjustments in place.


If you have any questions, please contact us at jobs@rsc.org

title: Brand Manager - Ostocalcium
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  

  

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.


**JOB PURPOSE:**

The Brand Manager – Ostocalcium role will deliver sustainable business growth by shaping brand strategy, identifying consumer and category opportunities, leading innovation and communication plans, and ensuring effective commercialization across channels and markets


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 

* Deliver topline, P\&L and full year plans for the brand.
* Strategize and execute to deliver aligned brand objectives – to accelerate brand penetration gains.
* Develop and implement comprehensive marketing strategies and activations to drive brand growth and market share gains.
* Create and execute innovative, consumer\-centric marketing campaigns across multiple channels (digital, traditional, in\-store, Dcomm etc).
* Drive product positioning, ensuring alignment with consumer needs, market trends, and company objectives.
* Performance management \& Budgeting\- Plan, execute, and optimize marketing campaigns, ensuring alignment with budget and objectives. Track campaign performance, analyze results, and adjust strategies for optimal ROI.
* Influence senior cross\-functional stakeholders to align commercial, category, sales, and marketing priorities.
* Provide strategic direction to agencies and internal teams to ensure consistent brand positioning.
* Cross functional collaboration and Agency Management.

**Why you?**

**Basic Qualifications:**

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:


* MBA/masters from an institute of repute.
* Minimum 4 years of total experience, with 2\+ years in brand management.
* Strong stakeholder management and leadership skills.
* Proven experience in developing and executing brand strategies and integrated marketing campaigns.
* Strong understanding of consumer insights, market research, brand equity, and portfolio management.
* Experience managing cross\-functional stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Insights, and R\&D.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:


* Experience in FMCG or consumer healthcare sector.
* Demonstrated track record of driving business growth, market share gains, or successful innovation launches.
* Experience leading agencies and mentoring junior brand marketers.

Strong strategic thinking, influencing skills, and ability to operate in a fast\-paced, matrix organization.  

* 

**Job Posting End Date**

2026\-10\-17  

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  

  

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  

  

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.  



**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
----------------------------------------

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.  



**Note to candidates**
----------------------

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Manager, Hotel Partner Solutions
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.


### **Introduction to the Team**

Travel Partnerships and Advertising helps partners, including hotels, airlines, destination marketing organizations, and more, deliver excellent traveler and B2B experiences. We create growth for our partners and the Expedia Group marketplace through competitive supply, travel media, and affiliate solutions.


As Manager—Hotel Partner Solutions, you will lead a team of analysts and technical professionals who deliver solutions supporting hotel partners and business priorities. You will connect technology decisions to partner needs, guide multi\-quarter projects, and create an environment that supports collaboration, development, and meaningful outcomes.


### **Key Responsibilities**

**In this role, you will:**

* Provide direction, coaching, feedback, and technical guidance to a team of analysts and individual contributors.
* Establish team goals, clarify roles and accountabilities, and connect daily work to business priorities.
* Lead delivery across multiple well\-defined, multi\-quarter projects.
* Serve as a technical lead for a defined domain and select appropriate technologies for business and partner needs.
* Partner with Product teams to develop and deliver roadmaps.
* Oversee operational support activities, service performance, response trends, and adherence to established procedures.
* Identify opportunities to improve technology, processes, efficiency, and productivity.
* Plan team capacity and allocate financial, material, and technical resources responsibly.
* Build trusted relationships with hotel partners and internal stakeholders by understanding needs and communicating practical solutions.
* Hire, onboard, recognize, and develop team members while supporting professional growth.
* Monitor key performance indicators, communicate team status, and surface risks, dependencies, and opportunities for simplification.
* Contribute to product reviews, communities of practice, and the product development lifecycle from idea through launch and ongoing improvement.

### **Experience and Qualifications**

Required


* 5\+ years of related experience with a bachelor’s degree, or 3\+ years of related experience with a master’s degree.
* 1–3 years of people leadership experience, including coaching, feedback, performance support, and workload planning.
* Experience leading at least three multi\-quarter projects as a technical lead or equivalent individual contributor.
* Experience with multiple technology implementations and selecting technologies for specific business or partner needs.
* Bachelor’s degree, master’s degree, or equivalent related professional experience; technical degree preferred, including Information Technology, Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, or a related technical field.
* Proficient communication skills and the ability to connect technical concepts with business priorities.

Preferred


* Experience supporting hotel, hospitality, travel, or partner\-facing technology solutions.
* Experience partnering with Product teams on roadmaps and product development.
* Experience supporting technology operations or service management.
Experience identifying process improvements and using metrics to evaluate outcomes.  
* 

  

  

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation .  



  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.  



  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .  



  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
**About SmartWinnr** 

  
 




 SmartWinnr is an enterprise\-grade sales enablement platform that helps organizations build sales readiness through AI sales roleplay, coaching, and certification at scale. The platform serves Fortune 500 clients including Boston Scientific, Johnson \& Johnson, and AstraZeneca, along with other major companies such as Abbott, Medtronic, HDFC Life, SBI Life, ICICI Prudential, and Aditya Birla to boost sales productivity. SmartWinnr has earned recognition from G2 as one of the top 50 sales products for two consecutive years, based on authentic customer reviews and feedback.
 



  





  





**Job Role:** 

 Product Marketing Manager
 




   
 



**Job Location:** 
 Hyderabad (On\-site)
 



  





  





**About the role:** 





 SmartWinnr is a revenue enablement platform for life sciences, serving pharmaceutical and medical device companies. Our customers include some of the largest life sciences organisations in the world, and most of our revenue comes from the United States.
 




  






 We are looking for our first product marketing hire. That means building from nothing: limited existing messaging, no competitive library, no case studies. It also means the person who takes this on defines how we talk about the product for the next several years.
 




  






 If you want to join a function that already runs, this is the wrong role. If you want to build one, it is a good one.
 




  





  





**What you will own:** 



* **Messaging and positioning.** 

 How we describe the product to each segment we sell to, from enterprise pharmaceutical companies to specialty biotech to medical device manufacturers. These audiences buy differently, and the messaging has to reflect that.
* **Competitive intelligence.** 

 Who we compete with and what they claim, and how our marketing and sales team should respond. Ongoing work rather than a one\-off deck.
* **Customer proof.** 

 Interviewing customers, building case studies, and maintaining a proof library that maps to the accounts we target. This is the single biggest gap we have today.
* **Sales enablement.** 

 The material our US sales team uses in live deals: battlecards, objection handling, one\-pagers, deal support.
* **Launch support.** 

 Bringing new capabilities to market internally and externally, working with Product.



  





  





  





**What the first 90 days look like:** 




  





**We will judge the role on output, not activity. By the end of the first quarter, we would expect:** 



* A messaging framework covering enterprise pharmaceutical and enterprise medical device buyers.
* A battlecard for our primary competitors, built from win and loss evidence rather than their website.
* Three customer stories published from US life sciences accounts.
* A proof point library mapped to the accounts our outbound program is targeting.



  





  





**What we are looking for:** 



* Five or more years in B2B SaaS product marketing.
* You have built messaging from scratch rather than maintained someone else's. We will ask you to walk us through one.
* Experience marketing to United States buyers, whether from India or elsewhere.
* Comfortable talking to customers directly. A good part of this role is interviewing people and finding the story inside what they tell you.
* Able to write clearly and with a point of view.



  





**Useful but not required:** 





 Experience in life sciences, healthcare or another regulated industry. Familiarity with sales enablement, learning technology. We can teach the industry to someone who is good at crafts.
 




  





**What this role is not:** 





 It is not a content marketing role. We have people writing for the blog and for searching. It is not a demand generation role. And it is not a people management role, at least initially. You will be doing the work yourself.
 




  





**Practical details:** 





 You will be based in India and working on a market that is nine and a half hours behind. Some overlap with US hours is part of the job, particularly for customer interviews.
