title: Digital Marketing Delivery Manager
description:
**Digital Marketing Delivery Manager** 





 For Digital Marketing Agency located in Kochi
 




  




**Purpose of the Role** 

 Ensemble delivers digital marketing and AI services to a growing base of clinical and healthcare clients.
 



 The
 **Digital Marketing Delivery Manager** 
 owns end\-to\-end scope, strategy, delivery execution, resource efficiency, and client SLAs across all accounts. This role combines deep technical domain knowledge with operational discipline \- ensuring campaigns ship on\-time and on\-scope, while remaining hands\-on to troubleshoot setups, audit strategy, quality, review analytics and optimize internal team throughput.
 



 This role streamlines prioritized workflow, inspires the team do its best work without friction, ensures stakeholder trust and growth prospects.
 


**Reporting** 

**Reports to:** 
 COO / Managing Director
 



**Works with:** 
 Account leads, the offshore (India) delivery team, and across SEO, Paid Ads, Creative, Video, Web Development, Content, and AI.
 


**Core Responsibilities** 

**1 Proven experience in Digital Marketing industry standard scope delivery** 




  





 ·    End to end knowledge of holistic digital marketing industry standard scope of work execution successfully.
 



 ·    Ability to take ownership, translate strategies, align with expectations and ensure effective execution, take proactive, corrective and preventive measures throughout workflow process with
 
 ROI focus.
 



 ·    Be hands\-on and actively perform technical audits on paid campaigns and content strategies prior to launch, step in directly to fix technicalities, tracking, campaign structure, or workflow blockers, do overall reviews and provide inputs to SEO, setups, to creatives, for development team etc.
 



 ·    Proficiency in market research, competitor analysis and reporting and familiar with tools like Semrush, MS Clarity, Looker Studio
 **,** 
 popular tools, CRM platforms etc.
 



 ·    Knowledge of AI tools and its leverage to expedite productivity and faster turn arounds.
 



 ·    Strong analytical skills – ability to translate data into clear strategy.
 


**2 Own on\-time delivery across all accounts** 

 •   Hold end\-to\-end accountability for every client deliverable shipping on time and to standard.
 



 •   Own scope and maintain one live view of all work in flight — status, owner, due date, and risk — so nothing stays invisible until it is already late.
 



 •   Be hands on and streamline productivity and strive for efficiency – individuals and team.
 


**3\. Plan capacity, resource, control workflow, priorities and scope** 

 •   Forecast team capacity against committed work and flag over\-allocation
 **before** 
 it causes slippage.
 



 •   Balance workload across the offshore team and specialists; reassign to clear bottlenecks.
 



 •   Translate client commitments into realistic timelines the team can actually hit — push back when they can’t.
 



 •   Run a disciplined workflow process — no work starts without a clear scope, owner, and deadline.
 



 •   Implement operational frameworks (Agile/Kanban) to maximize team output per hour. Monitor billable vs. non\-billable time and eliminate operational drag across the offshore team.
 



 •   Set and communicate priorities across accounts; resolve conflicts between competing client demands Catch scope creep early and escalate the trade\-off rather than silently absorbing it into the timeline.
 


**5\. Run the delivery cadence** 

 •   Lead a recurring delivery rhythm (daily standup \+ weekly account review) that surfaces risk early.
 



 •   Coordinate across time zones so the offshore team stays unblocked and handoffs don’t stall overnight.
 



 •   Track dependencies and escalations and drive them to resolution.
 


**6\. Enforce quality** 

 •   Review deliverables before they reach the client — nothing ships below standard.
 



 •   For healthcare and clinical clients, ensure work meets compliance expectations (HIPAA\-aware handling, compliant tracking and reporting).
 



 •   Reduce rework by catching issues internally, not at the client.
 


**7\. Report to clients and leadership** 

 •   Give clients clear, consistent status updates — progress, what’s next, and any risks to the timeline.
 



 •   Give leadership an honest, data\-backed view of delivery health and where it is at risk.
 



 •   Standardize daily use of tools (Portal, CRM etc) to maintain 100% visibility into account velocity and resource capacity.
 


**8\. Build the delivery system** 

 •   Develop and maintain SOPs, checklists, and workflows so delivery is predictable, not heroic.
 



 •   Continuously remove recurring blockers and improve throughput without simply adding headcount.
 



 •   Mentor coordinators and the offshore team toward accountability and ownership.
 



  




**What Success Looks Like (KPIs)** 

 Scope Delivery health is measured, reviewed biweekly / monthly, and owned by this role:
 



**Metric** 




**Target** 




 On\-time delivery rate ≥ 95% of deliverables shipped by the committed date
 



 Rework rate \< 10% of deliverables needing rework after internal review
 



 Client\-reported quality issues Trending down quarter over quarter
 



 Team utilization 80–90% (productive, not overloaded or idle)
 



 Scope Deliverables/SLA / turnaround compliance ≥ 95% of requests handled within agreed timeframes
 



 Delivery visibility and Reporting 100% of scope and active work tracked in one live source of truth
 




 with daily, weekly reporting.
 




 Escalation handling Risks flagged and resolved before the deadline, not after.
 


**Qualifications** 

 •   Minimum Graduate with 5 years in digital marketing \& delivery management, ideally in a digital or creative agency.
 



 •   Proven track record of aligning with client requirements, add value by improving quality and scaling on\-time delivery across multiple concurrent accounts.
 



 •   Strong knowledge of Google ads, social media ads, creatives, blogs, email marketing, content, analytics and working knowledge of SEO ,video production, web development \- to get hands on and to judge productivity, quality and timelines.
 



 •   Experience coordinating distributed or offshore teams across time zones.
 



 •   Be updated with latest trends and developments in the digital marketing domain.
 



 •   Familiarity with healthcare or clinical client requirements (HIPAA awareness) is a strong plus.
 



 •   Organized and Strong on digital marketing workflow design, prioritization, communication, and stakeholder management.
 



 •   Effective English communication skills (spoken and written).
 



 •   Ability to work independently and as part of team, effectively manage priorities and productivity
 



  




**Ideal Candidate** 

 The one who makes digital marketing scope delivery boringly predictable as per stakeholder expectations. Organized, calm under competing deadlines, and relentless about removing blockers and building the systems that let good work ship on time \- every account, every time.
 



 CTC: 6 Lacs Per Annum
 



 Location: Kochi office full\-time role

title: Brand Marketing- Digital Product Engineering & AI
description:
**Brand Marketing\- Digital Product Engineering \& AI** 




  





**BOMBAYDC \| Mumbai, Andheri West (onsite)** 




  





**About BOMBAYDC** 




 BOMBAYDC is a digital product engineering company that helps enterprises grow revenue, improve customer adoption and reduce the cost of doing business through digital products, platforms, engineering and AI.
 



 We work differently from traditional technology and design companies.
 



 Rather than starting only with a business or technology problem, we start with the customer: what they are trying to accomplish, where the experience is failing them, and what is preventing them from taking the desired action. We work backwards from these customer needs into business strategy, experience, intelligence and engineering.
 



 Our work spans digital banking, commerce, enterprise platforms and consumer products for some of India's leading organisations.
 



 As technology and AI reshape the digital services industry, we are now looking for a sharp marketer who can help us build the next chapter of the BOMBAYDC brand.
 



  





**The Role:** 



* We are looking for a Marketing Lead who can position BOMBAYDC as a leading digital product engineering company and build sustained visibility for the firm among enterprise decision\-makers.
* This is not a social media management role.
* We need someone who understands technology, digital products, engineering and AI well enough to turn our capabilities, work and thinking into a compelling market narrative.
* You will own how BOMBAYDC presents itself to the outside world, across our website, content, social media, search, PR, events and thought leadership.
* The mandate is simple: Make the right people understand what BOMBAYDC does, why we are different, and why they should consider us for important digital product and engineering mandates.



  





**What You Will Own:** 




**1\. Positioning \& Brand Narrative** 



* Own and continuously sharpen BOMBAYDC's positioning as a digital product engineering company, moving market perception beyond UI/UX or design.
* Translate our capabilities across customer strategy, AI, experience and engineering into a clear and differentiated proposition.
* Build strong narratives around our core practices, including BFSI, Commerce and Enterprise/Consumer Products.
* Ensure that everything we communicate reinforces one consistent market position.



**2\. Website \& Digital Presence** 



* Own the BOMBAYDC website as our most important marketing asset.
* Continuously improve its structure, messaging, practice pages, case studies and content to reflect where the company is headed.
* Ensure that new work, client wins, launches, capabilities, leadership perspectives and company news are always current.
* Work with our internal design and engineering teams to continuously improve the website rather than treating it as a one\-time project.



**3\. Content \& Thought Leadership** 



* Build and run a strong content engine for BOMBAYDC.
* Identify topics where we should have a point of view across AI, digital products, banking, commerce, customer experience and engineering.



 Turn internal knowledge and client work into:
 



 ● Case studies
 



 ● Articles and POVs
 



 ● White papers and reports
 



 ● LinkedIn content
 



 ● Leadership content
 



 ● Client conversations and interviews
 



 ● Videos and other relevant formats You will not be expected to personally write everything. You will, however, be expected to know what we should be talking about, why it matters, and ensure it gets produced well.
 



**4\. Social \& Leadership Presence** 



* Build a consistent and high\-quality presence for BOMBAYDC and its leadership, particularly on LinkedIn.
* Move beyond routine company posts and create formats that demonstrate our thinking and expertise.
* This could include conversations with CXOs, client roundtables, industry perspectives, project stories, engineering insights, AI experiments and leadership viewpoints.



**5\. PR \& Industry Visibility** 



* Build relationships with relevant technology, business, marketing and industry publications. Identify stories worth taking to the media: major launches, client work, new capabilities, AI initiatives, research and leadership perspectives.
* Drive a steady rhythm of meaningful media visibility rather than occasional press releases.



**6\. Search, SEO \& AI Discoverability** 



* Own BOMBAYDC's organic discoverability.
* Improve our visibility for the areas in which we want to build business, across traditional search as well as AI\-driven discovery/GEO.
* Work towards BOMBAYDC appearing when enterprise decision\-makers research digital product engineering partners, AI\-led digital transformation, banking platforms, commerce transformation and related capabilities.
* Track what is driving qualified traffic and continuously improve it.



**7\. Events \& Market Engagement** 



* Identify the right conferences, industry forums, awards, roundtables and networking opportunities for BOMBAYDC.
* Evaluate where we should attend, speak, participate, partner or host. Create our own opportunities to bring together clients and industry leaders through roundtables, conversations and focused events.



  





**Who We Are Looking For:** 




 Someone with approximately 6–10 years of B2B marketing experience, ideally within:
 



 Digital product engineering, technology services, digital transformation, IT services, product consulting, enterprise SaaS or a similar business.
 



  





**You should:** 




 ● Understand how technology services companies sell to enterprises.
 



 ● Be comfortable discussing digital products, engineering, AI and customer experience.
 



 ● Be able to simplify complex capabilities into sharp market propositions.
 



 ● Have strong writing and storytelling judgment.
 



 ● Understand content marketing, LinkedIn, SEO and digital distribution.
 



 ● Have exposure to PR, events and thought leadership.
 



 ● Be comfortable working directly with founders, business leaders, designers and engineers.
 



 ● Be extremely hands\-on. This is not a role for someone who only manages agencies and reviews presentations.
 



 ● Have strong ownership and execution discipline.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like:** 




 Within the first 12 months, we should see:
 



**A clearer market position** 



* People increasingly understand BOMBAYDC as a digital product engineering company rather than primarily a UI/UX or design firm.



**A stronger digital footprint** 



* Our website becomes current, deeper and more representative of our capabilities and practices.



**A consistent content engine** 



* High\-quality case studies, perspectives, articles and leadership content go out consistently.



**Greater discoverability** 



* Improved visibility across Google and AI\-led discovery for strategically important topics.



**Stronger industry visibility** 



* More relevant media coverage, speaking opportunities, roundtables and industry participation.



**Commercial impact** 




 Marketing increasingly contributes to conversations, opportunities and inbound enquiries from the kind of enterprise clients BOMBAYDC wants to work with.
 



  





**Most Important:** 




 We are not looking for someone to simply run our social media calendar.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who can understand the business deeply, identify what makes BOMBAYDC relevant in a rapidly changing technology market, turn that into a sharp narrative, and then make sure that narrative reaches the people who matter.
 



  





 If you enjoy figuring out what a company should stand for and then building the machinery that makes the market notice it, we would like to speak with you.

 ● Adaptable: If a pitch doesn't land or a market shifts, you adjust and try again — you don't wait around for direction.
 



 ● Ships Fast: You'd rather make ten calls today than perfect a script for a week.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 ● Real impact, not vanity metrics — your work directly drives brand presence and revenue, not just reports.
 



 ● Own the region end\-to\-end — rare for this level of experience; you won't just execute a playbook, you'll help build it.
 



 ● A seat in the room — be part of stakeholder discussions and work directly with the founder, not three levels removed from decisions.
 



 ● Ground floor of a new initiative — this function doesn't exist yet in its final form, and you'll shape what it becomes.

 ● Strong growth trajectory — this is a launch pad role, built for someone who wants to grow into ownership, not stay an intern.
 



 ● Competitive stipend with a clear path to a full\-time, higher\-title role as the initiative scales.

You're joining at the start of a new initiative, sitting in on decisions with the founder, and running the marketing engine yourself — which means your growth isn't capped by a job description, it's shaped by how far you take it. title: Performance Marketing Manager — Digital Ads & Revenue Growth
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Performance Marketing Manager — Digital Ads \& Revenue Growth
 



**Company:** 
 AJ\&VG Media Private Limited
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



  





**Reporting To:** 
 Founder \& CEO
 



  





**About AJ\&VG Media** 




  





 AJ\&VG Media Private Limited is a Bengaluru\-based marketing consulting and technology firm serving B2B technology clients across India, the Middle East, Europe, the UK, the USA, and South East Asia. We operate at the intersection of marketing strategy, AI\-native product development, and enterprise technology. Our portfolio spans fractional CMO engagements, B2B SaaS products, AI\-powered marketing platforms, and professional education programs including online courses and workshops for senior marketing and technology professionals.
 



 This is not a brand awareness role. This is a revenue role.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We are looking for a 100% performance\-oriented digital marketer who lives and breathes paid media results. You will own the full paid media function across
 **Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Google (Search, Display, YouTube, PMax), and LinkedIn** 
 — planning, executing, optimising, and scaling campaigns that generate measurable pipeline and revenue.
 



  





 You will be responsible for selling two distinct but related categories:
 


1. **Online courses, workshops, and professional learning programs** 
 targeting senior marketing and technology professionals
2. **B2B SaaS products and enterprise Martech solutions** 
 targeting decision\-makers across India, the Middle East, the US, and APAC markets



 You are not here to run experiments for months with no accountability. You are here to drive outcomes. If you are someone who tracks ROAS before you check your email in the morning, read on.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Paid Media Execution \& Ownership** 




  




* Plan, launch, manage, and optimise paid campaigns across
 **Meta Ads (Facebook \& Instagram), Google Ads (Search, Display, Shopping, YouTube, Performance Max),** 
 and
 **LinkedIn Campaign Manager**
* Own campaign architecture — account structure, campaign types, ad sets, audience segmentation, bidding strategies, and budget allocation across platforms
* Write or brief compelling ad copy and creatives; work closely with design/content to produce high\-converting assets
* Run rigorous
 **A/B and multivariate tests** 
 on creatives, copy, landing pages, audiences, and bidding strategies
* Manage and optimise
 **retargeting and remarketing** 
 funnels across all platforms
* Set up and maintain
 **conversion tracking, UTM frameworks, pixel implementation,** 
 and attribution models across all platforms



  





**Online Course \& Workshop Sales** 




  




* Drive registrations and revenue for online courses, masterclasses, webinars, and workshops through paid channels
* Build and manage full\-funnel campaigns — awareness to conversion — specifically designed for professional education products
* Understand the buying psychology of senior professionals and craft campaigns that address their aspirations and pain points
* Manage launch campaigns, evergreen funnels, and flash\-sale/cohort\-based promotions
* Work with email marketing and CRM systems to build nurture sequences that complement paid efforts



  





**B2B SaaS \& Enterprise Martech Sales** 




  




* Generate qualified pipeline for B2B SaaS products and enterprise Martech solutions targeting
 **CXOs, CMOs, CTOs, VPs of Marketing and Technology**
* Understand long B2B sales cycles and build paid media strategies that support pipeline at every stage — not just top\-of\-funnel
* Run
 **LinkedIn lead generation campaigns** 
 targeting specific company sizes, industries, seniority levels, and job functions
* Execute
 **Account\-Based Marketing (ABM)** 
 style campaigns on LinkedIn and display networks targeting named accounts or lookalike segments
* Coordinate with sales/BD teams to align on ICP, messaging, and lead quality feedback loops



  





**Multi\-Market Campaign Management** 




  




* Run and localise campaigns across
 **India, Middle East (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar), US,** 
 and
 **APAC** 
 markets simultaneously
* Understand cultural, linguistic, and platform nuances across markets — what works in India does not always work in the UAE or the US
* Manage multi\-currency budgets and optimise CAC by market and product line
* Adapt creative and messaging for different market maturities and buyer sophistication levels



  





**Analytics, Reporting \& Optimisation** 




  




* Own a clear
 **performance dashboard** 
 tracking spend, impressions, CTR, CPL, CPA, ROAS, MQL volume, and revenue contribution by campaign, platform, and market
* Deliver weekly and monthly performance reports with clear insights, not just numbers
* Identify underperforming campaigns quickly and make data\-backed decisions to pause, pivot, or scale
* Maintain a structured
 **testing calendar** 
 and document learnings systematically
* Work with tools like
 **Google Analytics 4, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Tag Manager,** 
 and CRM/CDP platforms



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 




  




* **5–8 years** 
 of hands\-on performance marketing experience with a strong, provable track record
* Expert\-level proficiency in
 **Meta Ads Manager** 
 — campaign structure, custom audiences, lookalikes, retargeting, Advantage\+ campaigns, CAPI setup
* Expert\-level proficiency in
 **Google Ads** 
 — Search, Display, YouTube, and Performance Max; strong understanding of Smart Bidding, Quality Score, and auction dynamics
* Strong proficiency in
 **LinkedIn Campaign Manager** 
 — Sponsored Content, Message Ads, Lead Gen Forms, Matched Audiences, and ABM targeting
* Demonstrated experience
 **selling online courses, workshops, or professional education products** 
 through paid channels — not just awareness campaigns, actual conversions and revenue
* Demonstrated experience generating
 **B2B SaaS or enterprise software leads and pipeline** 
 through paid media — especially for products with ACV above ₹5L or $10K
* Experience running campaigns across
 **at least two of the four markets** 
 — India, Middle East, US, APAC
* Strong working knowledge of
 **conversion tracking, pixel setup, GA4, GTM,** 
 and attribution methodologies (first\-touch, last\-touch, data\-driven)
* Ability to brief or write ad copy independently — you should not be 100% dependent on a copywriter to get campaigns live
* Experience managing
 **monthly ad budgets of ₹5L and above** 
 (or equivalent in USD/AED) with full accountability for results



  





**Good to Have** 




  




* Experience with
 **programmatic advertising** 
 platforms (DV360, The Trade Desk, or similar)
* Familiarity with
 **CRM and marketing automation platforms** 
 (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, or similar) and how paid media integrates with them
* Experience with
 **landing page builders and CRO tools** 
 (Unbounce, Webflow, VWO, Hotjar)
* Knowledge of
 **email marketing and paid social integration** 
 for full\-funnel campaign design
* Exposure to
 **AI\-powered ad optimisation tools** 
 and prompt\-based creative generation for ad variants
* Prior experience at a
 **marketing agency or consulting firm** 
 managing multiple client accounts simultaneously
* Familiarity with
 **Martech, SaaS, or enterprise technology** 
 as a product category — understanding the buyer, the jargon, and the sales cycle



  





**KPIs You Will Be Measured On** 




  





 This role has no vanity metrics. You will be measured on:
 



  




* **Revenue and pipeline generated** 
 from paid campaigns — by product and market
* **Cost per Qualified Lead (CPQL)** 
 by platform and market
* **Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)** 
 by campaign type and product category
* **Course/workshop registration conversion rate** 
 from paid traffic
* **Lead\-to\-MQL conversion rate** 
 for B2B SaaS and Martech campaigns
* **Month\-on\-month improvement** 
 in CAC, ROAS, and qualified lead volume
* **Campaign uptime and execution quality** 
 — no missed launches, no broken tracking



  





**Who You Are** 




  




* You are obsessed with outcomes, not activity — you measure your worth by pipeline and revenue, not impressions and clicks
* You are equally comfortable in a spreadsheet and inside an ads dashboard
* You can manage multiple campaigns across multiple platforms and markets simultaneously without dropping the ball
* You do not make excuses when campaigns underperform — you diagnose, iterate, and fix
* You understand that B2B buying is not the same as B2C and you have adapted your approach accordingly
* You stay ahead of platform algorithm changes, policy updates, and new ad formats — you are not the last person to know when Meta changes something important
* You communicate results clearly to non\-technical stakeholders — the Founder does not want a 40\-slide deck, they want a clean summary and a clear next step
* You are comfortable working in a lean team where you will not have a 10\-person support structure around you



  





**What We Offer** 




  




* Full ownership of the paid media function — this is not an execution role inside a large team, this is a leadership role
* Work on a diverse portfolio — AI\-native SaaS, enterprise Martech, and professional education — across global markets
* Direct exposure to and collaboration with a Founder\-CEO with 22\+ years of B2B enterprise marketing experience
* Performance\-linked compensation structure — we reward results generously
* Competitive base compensation \+ performance incentives commensurate with demonstrated results
* Hybrid\-friendly culture with a high\-trust, low\-bureaucracy environment



  





**To Apply** 




  





 Send the following to
 **\[marketing** 
**@ajnvg.com** 
**]** 
 :
 


* Your CV
* A
 **one\-page performance summary** 
 — campaigns you ran, budgets you managed, and results you delivered (numbers, not adjectives)
* Links to
 **at least one course/workshop campaign** 
 and
 **one B2B SaaS campaign** 
 you managed — describe the objective, approach, and outcome
* Your expected CTC and notice period
* **Applications without a performance summary will not be reviewed.**

* Drive technical SEO at scale — crawlability, indexation, site architecture, internal linking, Core Web Vitals, structured data and the specific challenges of programmatic, high\-churn event and restaurant inventory.
* Build and own the programmatic SEO engine — templated page systems across city, cuisine, restaurant, artist and event dimensions, with quality controls to avoid thin and duplicate pages.
* Own App Store and Play Store optimization as part of the organic discovery surface, alongside local and map\-based discovery for dining.
* Bring a strong martech and measurement orientation, with hands\-on experience across Search Console, GA4, and crawl and rank\-tracking tools, applied within a super\-app ecosystem where multiple businesses share a single domain and app.
* Own measurable KPIs — organic sessions, non\-brand traffic, indexed page health, keyword and SERP\-feature share, AI citation share, and organic conversions — with clear accountability across both verticals.
* Run structured experiments across page templates, titles, content formats and internal linking to identify what scales, and build a repeatable testing calendar rather than one\-off tests.
* Work closely with content, product and engineering to get SEO requirements shipped, and report performance with trends, projections and clear next steps.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 3\+ years of experience in SEO, with deep, hands\-on expertise across technical, content and programmatic SEO.
* Demonstrated ownership of organic growth independently, at scale — this is an SEO mandate, not a general content marketing one.
* Working knowledge of AEO and GEO, and a point of view on how AI search changes discovery, retrieval and citation.
* Experience solving 0\-1 martech problems, with a strong grasp of the organic funnel and the ability to work through dynamic, open\-ended problem statements.
* Comfort with data — able to work with large keyword and crawl datasets, and with the tooling to analyze them.
* Strong analytical, stakeholder management and communication skills; self\-driven with a strong bias for action.
* Comfortable operating across two verticals with different rhythms and different internal owners.

title: Marketing Lead
description:
**Company Description** 
 iTCart is a technology company focused on transforming how modern enterprises operate by embedding intelligence, accountability, and operational discipline into core business execution. Its flagship platform, AiXHub™, is an AI\-native operating system that delivers governed autonomy, real\-time SLA enforcement, and clear explainability for high\-stakes organizational workflows. AiXHub™ is built to work across Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, AWS, and hybrid environments, helping enterprises manage complexity, scale, and compliance. iTCart is led by experienced technologists and industry leaders across sectors such as IT, manufacturing, insurance, healthcare administration, financial services, and public\-sector shared services. The company serves mid\-sized and large organizations that require precision, traceability, and strong governance in their day\-to\-day operations.
 



  





  





**Marketing Lead** 




  





 Role title Marketing Lead, AiXMarketing
 



 Team AiXMarketing, iTCart (IT Cart Private Limited)
 



 Reports to \[Insert \- Founder / CEO / CMO]
 



 Direct reports Content Writer \& Strategist, Social Media Executive, AEO/SEO/GEO Executive, design and apprentice roles
 



  





 Experience : 3 \- 4 years in B2B marketing, including at least 2 leading a team
 



 Employment type : Full\-time
 



 Location: Bengaluru
 



 Markets served India and United States (Northwest Ohio focus)
 



  





 THE ROLE :
 



 We are looking for someone who can hold the whole picture: seven product lines, two geographies, several brand ecosystems and a small team, and then make hard decisions about where to concentrate rather than spreading everything thin.
 



  





 The first job is diagnosis. Before anything gets planned, we want someone who will audit what exists, sit with sales, talk to buyers, look honestly at where our marketing is absent versus where our buyers actually are, and tell us plainly what is broken. The plan comes after that, not before.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on leadership role in a company where marketing is expected to contribute to pipeline, not just to awareness. You will build the strategy and you will still write, edit and review real work.
 



  





 What you will do :
 



  





 Strategy and prioritisation
 



 • Own the annual and quarterly marketing plan across product lines and both geographies.
 



 • Build the positioning and messaging architecture \- what each product claims, for whom, and how it is different from what else the buyer is looking at.
 



 • Decide where we concentrate and, just as importantly, what we stop doing. A plan that covers everything covers nothing.
 



 • Set the budget and defend how it is allocated.
 



  





 Market research and gap analysis
 



 • Run structured category and competitor research \- how rivals position, price, message and where they are weak.
 



 • Define and keep sharpening the ideal customer profile and the buying committee for each product line.
 



 • Conduct gap analysis: where buyers are looking versus where we appear, which questions we do not answer, which formats and channels we are absent from, and which segments are under\-served.
 



 • Feed win and loss reasons back into positioning, working directly with sales rather than from a dashboard.
 



 • Track category shifts \- including how AI\-driven search and answer engines are changing where buyers discover vendors \- and adjust before it costs us visibility.
 



  





 Demand generation and pipeline
 



 • Design and run campaigns that produce qualified pipeline, not just traffic.
 



 • Agree funnel definitions and handoff rules with sales, and hold both sides to them.
 



 • Run account\-based work for named enterprise targets, including our Northwest Ohio focus accounts.
 



 • Own webinars, events and partner activity where they earn their cost.
 



  





 Brand, content and channels
 



 • Set the editorial direction and hold the quality bar on everything published.
 



 • Maintain brand consistency across iTCart and associated brand ecosystems.
 



 • Build the leadership team into visible voices in the category \- founder and executive thought leadership is often the highest\-return channel in B2B.
 



 • Oversee SEO, AEO and GEO, website, LinkedIn, email and paid where it is justified.
 



 • Enforce claim discipline, particularly for healthcare and BFSI audiences where a published claim is read as a commitment.
 



  





 Team and operations
 



 • Hire, coach and retain a small, high\-output team across content, social, search and design.
 



 • Set KPIs and KRAs, run review cadences, and give feedback that people can act on.
 



 • Manage agencies, freelancers and vendors, including negotiation and performance review.
 



 • Build the reporting rhythm \- monthly to leadership, with honest accounting of what failed and what changed as a result.
 



  





 What success looks like
 



  





 Horizon : What we expect
 



 First 30 days : A completed audit of current marketing across channels, products and both markets. Time spent with sales and with at least a few customers. A baseline set of numbers. A written diagnosis of the three biggest gaps, presented to leadership.
 



  





 First 90 days : A prioritised plan with an explicit list of what we are not doing this quarter. Team KPIs and review cadence in place. Positioning and messaging tightened for at least the two highest\-priority product lines. Monthly reporting running.
 



  





 Six months : Measurable marketing contribution to pipeline, with an agreed definition of what that means. A team producing quality work without daily direction. Sales pulling marketing assets rather than asking for them. A clear point of view in the market that did not exist before.
 



  





 What we are looking for :
 



  





 Essential
 



 • 3 \- 6 years in B2B marketing, with at least two years leading people.
 



 • You have owned a full marketing plan, not just a channel. You can walk us through one you built, what you cut from it, and what happened.
 



 • Real research capability. Competitive analysis, category research and gap analysis that produced a decision, not a slide deck.
 



 • Fluency with enterprise sales cycles and genuine working alignment with a sales team \- including the difficult conversations about lead quality.
 



 • Data literacy. GA4, CRM, LinkedIn and campaign data at a level where you can interrogate the numbers yourself rather than waiting for a report.
 



 • Experience marketing to both Indian and international buyers, and an understanding that the difference is proof and procurement, not spelling.
 



 • Strong writing, and the editorial judgement to improve someone else’s draft without rewriting it into your own voice.
 



 • Current on AI\-era discovery \- AEO and GEO, how answer engines cite sources \- and on AI tooling in a marketing workflow.
 



  





 Nice to have
 



 • Enterprise AI, SaaS or IT services background.
 



 • Marketing into regulated sectors \- healthcare, banking and financial services, or the public sector.
 



 • Account\-based marketing experience against named enterprise targets.
 



 • US mid\-market experience, particularly outside the coastal metros.
 



 • Agency\-side experience, or having built a marketing function from a standing start.
 



 • Experience managing multiple brands or sub\-brands simultaneously.
 



  





 Who this role is not for
 



  





 We would rather be honest now than lose you a few months in.
 



 • If you want to run brand and communications without being accountable for pipeline, this is not that role.
 



 • If you need a large budget and a big team to be effective, you will struggle here. The resourcing is real but modest, and prioritisation is the core skill.
 



 • If you no longer want to write or edit, this will not suit you. It is a hands\-on lead role.
 



 • If you prefer to keep a plan intact rather than change it when the data disagrees, we will find that difficult.
 



  





 How we hire
 



  





 Stage : Format : What we are looking at
 



 1 : Application \- review Track record, scope of what you have owned, the note you send with your CV
 



  





 2 : Screening call (30 minutes) \- Scope, team size, motivation, compensation expectations
 



 3 : Panel interview (75–90 minutes) \- Strategy, research and gap analysis, sales alignment, team leadership
 



 4 : Second Round Interview \- Final round of interview with Head of the Department. Evaluating Technical proficiency \& Team fit.
 



 5 : Leadership conversation and references \- Fit with founders, expectations, offer
 



  





 To apply
 



 Send your CV and a short note answering one question: what is the single biggest gap you see in how iTCart markets itself today, and what would you do about it first?
 



 One well\-argued page will get further with us than a full audit. We are interested in how you think, and specifically in whether you can identify what matters before you have all the information.
 



  





 Applications to aixstaffing@itcart.ai

title: SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER
description:
StrongHer by The Quad
   

  

* Reports to the Marketing Manager


 Every post is a chance to get one more woman to believe she can get strong.
   

  

 StrongHer is a brand under The Quad, built with one mission: get 10,000 women strength training. Not "fit" in the vague, generic sense — strong.
   

  

 We built StrongHer around the real constraints women face — cost, time, location — which is why the programme is entirely virtual, designed to fit into a woman's life instead of asking her to rearrange it around fitness.
   

  

 We need someone who can carry that mission online.
   

  

**What This Role Is About**
 This is end\-to\-end ownership of StrongHer's social media — the content, the calendar, the voice, and the conversations that happen in the comments and DMs.
   

  

 You'll design, edit and write content that makes women stop scrolling and start believing StrongHer is for them. You'll sit with our students, hear where they started and what changed, and turn that into something honest.
   

  

 You don't need years behind you. You need range, taste, and opinions you're willing to say out loud.
   

  

 What you'll be doing
   

  

* Owning the content calendar — planning what goes out, when, and why, so content is consistent and intentional, not last\-minute
* Designing posts, carousels and social creatives that are clean, aesthetic and instantly easy to consume — Canva or equivalent should be second nature
* Editing organic videos and reels that hook fast, hold attention and tell a story. Use whatever software you like, as long as the result is on brand and has a clear narrative
* Writing scripts, captions and story content that sound like a real woman talking to another woman — not brand copy
* Staying on top of Instagram — new formats, algorithm shifts, what's trending and what's dying — and bringing that into the content rather than reacting to it after the fact
* Meeting StrongHer students to learn their real stories — their starting point, their struggles, their wins — and bringing those to life as testimonials, transformation stories and behind\-the\-scenes content
* Responding to DMs, comments and community engagement. You're often the first, and the most human, touchpoint someone has with StrongHer
* Tracking performance — keeping the social media dashboard updated, and reading the numbers to shape what gets made next, not just to report on what already happened
* Supporting shoots for paid ad content. Our performance agency owns paid strategy and creative; you'll help bring their scripts to life on the ground


 What we're looking for
   

  

 Must\-haves
   

  

* A portfolio showing both design and video work. Range matters more than years of experience — if you're just starting out, show us what you can do
* Strong writing samples — captions, scripts or story content that show you can connect, not just construct sentences
* A real understanding of Instagram — what makes someone stop, watch and follow
* Comfortable working with data — reading numbers and translating them into content decisions


 Good to have
   

  

* Prior content experience in fitness, wellness or a mission\-driven brand
* Familiarity with AI tools for design or video editing


 The kind of person we're looking for
   

  

* Sees value in the mission
* Into fitness, or curious to get into it. You don't need to be training already, but you should want to understand why strength training changes lives
* Has opinions and says them — "here's what I'd do and why", not just "sent for approval" Empathetic enough to sit with a student, hear her story, and turn it into something honest rather than polished into blandness
* Takes ownership without needing to be chased


 What you get
   

  

* A balanced, respectful work culture that respects your life outside work
* Free membership at The Quad
* Health insurance, annual health checkups and wellness support
* Industry\-standard salaries and a generous leave policy
* Work that visibly changes how women see themselves. You'll see it in the DMs


 How to apply
   

  

 Use the form below, and send us your portfolio — design work and video, both. If you've written captions or scripts you're proud of, include those too. We read every application, and you'll hear from us either way. The Quad is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title:** 
 Digital Marketing Specialist
   

  

**About Finnovate:** 
 Finnovate is a holistic financial planning and wealth advisory platform. We are passionate about transforming the way Indians get personal finance advice. Our team is dedicated to providing comprehensive financial solutions that cater to the unique needs of our clients.
   

  

**The Role:** 
 This is a performance\-driven digital marketing role. You will own paid advertising, lead nurturing, email marketing, lead management, and brand campaigns, working closely with the content and design teams to execute with consistency and intent.
   

  

 You are not here to just run ads. You are here to build a digital growth engine: one that generates quality leads, nurtures them across channels until they are ready to engage, and hands them to the right advisor at the right time. Over time, you will build and lead a small marketing team.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Andheri, Mumbai (Primary) and Wadala, Mumbai (Occasionally)
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Paid Advertising and Retargeting
* Plan, execute, and optimise paid campaigns on Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google Ads (Search and Display), and LinkedIn.
* Build and manage retargeting audiences including website visitors, video viewers, and email lists across Meta and Google to move prospects through the funnel.
* Own ad spend allocation. Every rupee must be tracked against a measurable outcome.
* Analyse campaign performance weekly and present data\-backed recommendations to the AVP.
* Lead Nurturing
* Build and manage multi\-channel nurture journeys for all digital leads across email, WhatsApp, and paid retargeting.
* Map nurture flows to the lead's stage of awareness: cold leads receive education\-first content; warm leads receive proof and process content.
* Use retargeting ads to reinforce messaging for leads who have engaged but not yet converted.
* Set up WhatsApp touchpoints for timely, relevant follow\-up without being intrusive.
* Monitor nurture performance and refine sequences based on open rates, click throughs, and lead progression in Zoho CRM.
* The goal is simple: no digital lead should go cold due to lack of follow\-up.
* Email Marketing
* Own end\-to\-end email marketing: list management, segmentation, campaign creation, A/B testing, and reporting.
* Build automated drip journeys for new leads, client onboarding, and re\-engagement.
* Work on Zoho Marketing, Getresponse, or Mailerlite depending on campaign requirements.
* Lead Management and CRM
* Review incoming leads for quality by connecting with the lead owner to understand context and intent.
* Assign leads to the appropriate advisor or caller based on profile, product fit, and capacity.
* Track and report on lead conversion at two stages: lead to meeting, and meeting to conversion.
* Maintain lead data hygiene in Zoho CRM and flag drop\-offs and patterns that need attention.
* Work closely with the sales team to close the feedback loop between marketing input and sales output.
* Brand Awareness Campaigns
* Lead digital brand awareness initiatives: define the audience, select the channels, set the message, and measure reach and recall.
* Coordinate cross\-channel campaigns where paid, email, nurture, and content work together toward a unified objective.
* Competitor Analysis and Weekly Reporting
* Monitor competitor digital activity including ad creatives, messaging, channel mix, and positioning on an ongoing basis.
* Bring specific, actionable recommendations from competitor analysis to the weekly review.
* Prepare and present a structured weekly performance report covering paid campaigns, email, lead nurturing, lead funnel, and brand metrics.
* Own the marketing dashboard as the single source of truth for digital performance.
* Design Collaboration and Content Mix
* Brief the design team on visual requirements for all campaigns: ads, landing pages, emailers, and nurture creatives.
* Provide clear, specific feedback on design outputs to ensure alignment with campaign goals and brand standards.
* Recommend the content format mix (video, static, or carousel) for each campaign based on platform behaviour and audience stage. Recommendations go to the AVP for approval.
* Participate in creative discussions with the content team on ad copy, hooks, and messaging angles.
* Content Team Coordination
* Work with the content team to align ad creatives and campaign messaging with the broader content calendar.
* Coordinate briefing, review, and sign\-off of all ad\-related content before launch.
* Ensure all paid and branded content meets Finnovate's tone, positioning, and compliance standards.


**Must\-Have Skills**
**What We Are Looking For**
* 3 to 5 years of hands\-on digital marketing experience, ideally in fintech or financial services.
* Proven track record running Meta and Google Ads campaigns with measurable outcomes.
* Solid working knowledge of retargeting: pixels, custom audiences, lookalikes, and funnel sequencing.
* Experience building multi\-channel lead nurture journeys across email, WhatsApp, and paid channels.
* Experience with email marketing platforms and marketing automation workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with Zoho CRM or a comparable CRM tool.
* Proficiency in Google Analytics 4 and the ability to build clear, actionable reports from data.
* Excellent written and spoken English. You will review content that goes out under the Finnovate brand.
* Strong organisational skills. You will manage campaigns, a lead pipeline, nurture sequences, and a weekly reporting cycle simultaneously.


**Good to Have**
* Familiarity with financial services content compliance (SEBI guidelines, AMFI standards).
* Experience with LinkedIn Ads targeting senior professionals or niche audiences.
* Understanding of landing page principles and conversion rate optimisation.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.


**Life at Finnovate**
* Health Insurance: coverage including options for dependents.
* Paid Time Off: vacation days and public holidays with full pay.
* Parental Leave: paid leave for maternity, paternity, and adoption.
* Professional Development: training, workshops, and conference access.
* Performance\-Based Incentives: variable pay tied to outcomes, not just activity.
* Employee Referral Programme: bonuses for bringing in great people.
* Team Events: regular outings and team\-building activities.
* Sunday Comp Off: employees working Sundays are eligible for a compensatory day off.


**Working Days:** 
 Monday to Saturday (Alternate Saturdays off)
   

  

**Working Hours:** 
 9:30 am to 6:30 pm

description:
**Company:** 
 Procedure
   

  

**Website:** 
 Visit Website
   

  

**LinkedIn:** 
 Visit LinkedIn
   

  

**Business Type:** 
 Small/Medium Business

 Product \& Service

 B2B

 Bootstrapped

**Salary Range:** 
 ₹ 6\-13 Lacs PA
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for a sharp, hands\-on
 **digital marketer** 
 to join our
 **Marketing team** 
 at Procedure. We're an engineering services company built with AI at our core since day one, not bolted on later. Before we dive into the job description, allow us to introduce ourselves.
   

  

 Our team is a mixed bag. Of the smart and the hard workers. Of the organised and slightly chaotic. Of the early risers and the burners of the midnight oil. We appreciate diversity and truly like having differing perspectives in the room.
   

  

 We pride ourselves on being early adopters of the latest tools, libraries and frameworks while delivering business value all the time. People who work with us fall in love with their craft. We have changed the definition of "work" for them.
   

  

**Here Are Some Of Our Beliefs About Work**
* Work is only 1 part of your life and not your entire life. We treat it as such.
* Weekends are sacred and not to be messed around with. You won't be asked to work on one.
* Commuting is a waste of time. Working from home saves you additional time. Go crazy with it.
* Asynchronous by\-default. Synchronous communication is expensive, so we default to writing docs and literature to enable async communication.


**Apart from work, we continually invest in growing you as a professional and a human.**
* Book club — broaden your horizons by picking up a book every month and have fun doing so
* P1, The Half Yearly Tech Conference — here's where we explore futuristic themes to keep you informed about what's happening in the tech space outside our office.
* Mumbai Meets AI (MMAI) — our quarterly community meetup where engineers and AI practitioners come together. You'll help shape how we take this to market.


**Growth requires mentorship**
 We believe choosing a mentor is more important than choosing a company. You'll work directly with our marketing lead, who'll mentor you on building a marketing engine from first principles — not from a playbook someone else wrote.
   

  

**What's It Like Here**
 We love debating over tools and strategies. Ahrefs or Semrush? Long\-form or programmatic? DR or traffic first? If you have opinions about why most B2B content is forgettable and how to fix it, you'll fit right in. Continuous improvement is at the heart of everything we do at work and outside.
   

  

**This sounds good. But what exactly will you work on?**
**Role**
 This isn't a "post on social media and send the weekly report" role. You'll own the systems that drive organic visibility and inbound leads for a B2B engineering consultancy targeting decision\-makers in the US and India. Here's what that looks like:
   

  

**Content SEO and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)**
 You'll own the organic pipeline end\-to\-end. That means keyword research, SERP gap analysis, on\-page optimization, and making sure our content gets cited by LLMs like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude, not just ranked on Google. We care deeply about being the answer, not just being on page one.
   

  

 You'll work with our content and engineering teams to ensure every blog, service page, and technology page is structured for both human readers and AI retrieval. Think: FAQ schema, AEO short\-answer blocks, clean heading hierarchy, internal link architecture.
   

  

**Backlink Outreach and DR Growth**
 You'll run outreach campaigns to grow our Domain Rating. That means identifying high\-DR targets, managing outreach sequences, building relationships with editors and publishers, and finding creative ways to earn editorial backlinks that actually move the needle.
   

  

 You should be comfortable reading a referring domains report in Ahrefs and knowing exactly what to do next.
   

  

**GA4, GTM, and Dashboards**
 You'll own our measurement stack. GA4 property setup, GTM container management, custom event tracking, conversion goals, and reporting. We use Looker Studio for dashboards. You'll build and maintain dashboards that the team actually uses to make decisions: traffic by channel, AI referral tracking, content performance, lead attribution.
   

  

 If you've set up custom channel groups in GA4 (like tracking AI assistant referral traffic separately), we'll get along well.
   

  

**What You Won't Be Doing**
* You won't be writing blog posts. We have a content writer and a structured editorial pipeline for that.
* You won't be designing carousels or editing videos. We have a designer for that.
* You won't be posting on LinkedIn and X. We have someone handling social execution.
* Your job is the engine underneath all of it: the data, the visibility, the systems, and the growth.


**Here's What We Expect From You**
* 3\-4 years of hands\-on digital marketing experience, preferably in a B2B or tech services context. You've done this before, not just read about it.
* SEO is second nature to you. You understand keyword difficulty, search intent, content gaps, internal linking strategy, and technical SEO basics (crawlability, canonical tags, structured data). You've moved the needle on organic traffic for a real website.
* You've done AEO and GEO, not just read about them. Answer Engine Optimization and Generative Engine Optimization are not buzzwords to you. You've structured content that got cited by LLMs, tracked that traffic, and tied it back to pipeline. You've had targets around AI\-driven MQLs and you've hit them. We want someone who's proven this works, not someone who's still tinkering.
* You've set up GA4 properties from scratch, configured GTM containers, created custom events, and built dashboards in Looker Studio (or similar). You can trace a lead from first touch to form submission.
* You've done backlink outreach. You know the difference between a directory listing and an editorial backlink. You've used Ahrefs (or Semrush/Moz) to analyze competitor backlink profiles and find opportunities.
* You can build dashboards people actually look at. Looker Studio, Google Sheets with data connectors, or similar. You know that a dashboard nobody checks is worse than no dashboard at all.
* You've worked on websites and landing pages. You've been involved in building, optimizing, or managing website pages and landing pages that convert. You understand what makes a high\-intent page work: structure, copy, CTAs, page speed, and how it all ties back to the funnel.
* You use AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT as thinking partners. For research, for ideation, for breaking down complex problems. Not for copy\-pasting AI\-generated fluff. You know the difference, and it shows in your work.
* You write clearly. Not blog posts, but briefs, reports, Slack messages, outreach emails. Clear thinking shows up in clear writing.


**Tools you'll work with**
* SEO/AEO: Ahrefs, Google Search Console, Screaming Frog
* Analytics: GA4, GTM, Looker Studio
* AI: Claude Pro, ChatGPT Plus (premium licenses provided)
* Ops: Notion, Slack
* Outreach: Email (your preferred tool), LinkedIn


**The fine print**
* Experience: 3\-4 years
* Location: Mumbai (Bhandup West, Hybrid)
* Reports to: Marketing Head
* Team: You'll collaborate daily with our content writer, social media manager, designer, and engineering team.


 If you've read this far and thought "this is exactly the kind of marketing I want to do," we should talk. Apply now.

 “This concept needs to be tested today.”
 



 …and then actually making a usable first version yourself rather than waiting two days for a designer.
 



  





**4\. Google Ads** 




 You will also manage / work closely on:
 


* Google Search
* Performance Max
* Shopping
* Brand vs non\-brand
* Keyword research
* Search intent
* Negative keywords
* Conversion tracking
* Budget allocation
* ROAS / CAC optimisation
* Landing\-page optimisation



 Meta will be your
 **specialisation** 
 ; Google should be a strong secondary capability.
 



  





**5\. Amazon Ads** 




 Hands\-on experience with Amazon advertising is required.
 



 You should understand:
 


* Sponsored Products
* Sponsored Brands
* Sponsored Display
* Keyword strategy
* Search term analysis
* Product targeting
* Competitor targeting
* Amazon ROAS / TACoS
* Organic \+ paid interaction
* Product detail page optimisation



  





**6\. Quick Commerce** 




 Experience with platforms such as:
 


* Blinkit
* Zepto
* Swiggy Instamart
* Amazon Fresh / other relevant platforms



 You should understand how paid visibility, search placement, product availability, pricing, promotions and conversion interact on quick\-commerce platforms.
 



  





**7\. Competitor \& Market Intelligence** 




 This is another area I would make a
 **core responsibility** 
 , because it differentiates this role.
 



 You should constantly be researching:
 



**Competitor Ads** 



* What are competitors advertising?
* Which creatives are they repeatedly running?
* What hooks are they using?
* What offers are they pushing?
* Which products are they promoting?
* How are they positioning themselves?



**Competitor Products** 



* Pricing
* Bundles
* Offers
* Reviews
* Ratings
* Product positioning
* Claims
* Landing pages
* Amazon listings



**Audience Intelligence** 



* Who are competitors speaking to?
* What problems are they addressing?
* What objections are consumers raising?
* What language are customers using?



**Tools** 




 You should be comfortable using relevant tools such as:
 


* Meta Ads Library
* Similarweb
* SEMrush / Ahrefs
* Google Trends
* Amazon research tools
* Social listening tools
* Ad intelligence platforms
* Competitor tracking tools
* AI research tools



**You don't need to know every tool. You need to know how to find the answer.** 




  





**8\. Data \& Analytics** 




 You should live inside numbers.
 



 Track and analyse:
 



**CTR** 




**CPC** 




**CPM** 




**Hook Rate** 




**Hold Rate** 




**CVR** 




**CAC** 




**CPA** 




**AOV** 




**ROAS** 




**MER** 




**LTV** 




**Contribution Margin** 




**Frequency** 




**iROAS** 




 And importantly:
 



**Understand the relationship between them.** 




 For example:
 



 CPM ↑ → CTR ↓ → CPC ↑ → CVR ↓ → CAC ↑
 



 You should be able to identify
 **where the actual problem is** 
 instead of simply saying:
 



 “Meta performance has gone down.”
 



  





**9\. Scaling** 




 We are specifically looking for someone who has
 **actually scaled campaigns** 
 , not someone who has only managed ₹2–5 lakh/month budgets.
 



 You should have experience with:
 


* Scaling winning campaigns
* Increasing spend without destroying efficiency
* Creative fatigue
* Audience saturation
* Budget reallocation
* Geographic expansion
* New product launches
* New customer acquisition
* Retention / remarketing
* Scaling from ₹X/day → ₹X lakh/day



 We want someone who can demonstrate:
 



**“This was the starting point.** 




**This was the budget.** 




**This was the CAC/ROAS.** 




**This is what I changed.** 




**This is where we reached.”** 




  





**10\. Build the Performance Marketing Dashboard** 




 You will own weekly performance reporting.
 



 Not vanity reports.
 



 Every week you should be able to tell the founders:
 



**WHAT HAPPENED?** 




**WHY DID IT HAPPEN?** 




**WHAT DID WE LEARN?** 




**WHAT ARE WE TESTING NEXT?** 




**WHERE SHOULD WE PUT MORE MONEY?** 




**WHERE SHOULD WE STOP SPENDING?** 




  





**The Person We Are Looking For** 




**You might be the right person if:** 



* You genuinely enjoy Meta Ads.
* You spend time inside Ads Manager even when nobody asks you to.
* You understand creative performance.
* You obsess over CAC and ROAS.
* You have personally scaled campaigns.
* You know how to structure experiments.
* You understand audiences deeply.
* You are comfortable with large budgets.
* You can work with founders directly.
* You can create a quick ad yourself.
* You use AI to accelerate your workflow.
* You are constantly researching competitors.
* You are uncomfortable making decisions without data.



**You are probably NOT the right person if:** 



* Your primary skill is simply campaign setup.
* You outsource every creative decision.
* You only know boosted posts.
* You cannot explain why an ad won.
* You have never personally scaled spend.
* You report impressions and reach but don't understand unit economics.
* You need someone else to tell you what to test.



  





**Mandatory Experience** 




 I'd make these requirements quite specific:
 



**Required:** 



* 3–7 years performance marketing experience
* Strong hands\-on Meta Ads experience
* Experience with either a
 **D2C brand or performance marketing agency**
* Demonstrated experience managing substantial advertising budgets
* Experience contributing to
 **$1M\+ in attributable revenue / GMV**
* Strong understanding of CAC, ROAS, LTV and contribution margin
* Google Ads experience
* Amazon Ads experience
* Quick\-commerce advertising experience
* Canva \+ AI creative tools
* Strong analytical skills
* Competitor research / ad intelligence experience



**Preferred:** 



* Food / FMCG / nutrition / wellness / beauty / D2C experience
* Experience scaling a consumer brand

**Digital Content Specialist**

**Role** 




  





 The Digital Content Specialist owns how TDV shows up online — across social, search, and web — turning the story of a design\-led institution into content that captivates prospective students, parents, and the broader design community. This is a hands\-on role combining creative storytelling with the discipline of SEO and performance tracking, working closely with admissions, academic, and design teams to keep every touchpoint consistent and on\-brand.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Content \& Storytelling** 




 \- Write compelling, audience\-focused copy for web, email, blog, and ad campaigns
 



 \- Regularly edit and update website content for accuracy, clarity, and brand\-tone alignment
 



 \- Translate academic and admissions milestones into stories that resonate with prospective students and parents
 



  





**Social \& Community** 




 \- Manage and grow TDV's social media presence across Instagram, LinkedIn, Reddit, and emerging platforms
 



 \- Build and maintain a content calendar aligned with admissions cycles, events, and campaigns
 



 \- Monitor and respond to community engagement, maintaining TDV's voice and responsiveness online
 



  





**SEO \& Organic Growth** 




 \- Own and execute a comprehensive SEO strategy to grow visibility and organic traffic
 



 \- Conduct keyword research and on\-page optimization across web and blog content
 



 \- Stay current on search algorithm changes and adjust strategy accordingly
 



  





**Monitoring Paid Marketing Performance** 




 \- Track paid campaign performance across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), and LinkedIn Ads, alongside the Digital/Performance Marketing function
 



 \- Monitor key metrics (CPL, CTR, conversion rate, spend efficiency) to spot underperformance or creative fatigue early
 



 \- Ensure paid and organic messaging stay consistent — same narrative and tone across every paid and owned channel
 



 \- Feed paid\-campaign learnings back into organic content strategy, and vice versa
 



  





**Cross\-functional Collaboration** 




 \- Partner with design, admissions, and academic teams to ensure content supports enrollment and outreach goals
 



 \- Coordinate with the Digital/Performance Marketing function on paid\-organic content alignment
 



 \- Support Nantes and Italy campus teams with localized content needs as TDV's European footprint grows
 



  





**Analytics \& Optimization** 




 \- Track performance across channels using Google Analytics and platform\-native insights
 



 \- Translate data into actionable recommendations — what to double down on, what to retire
 



 \- Report content, SEO, and paid\-performance summaries on a regular cadence to the Head, Communications 
 



  





**Profile** 




 \- 3\+ years of experience in digital content, marketing, or communications — ideally in education, design, or a creative\-industry\-adjacent space
 



 \- Strong command of SEO principles and digital publishing best practices
 



 \- Working knowledge of paid platforms (Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager) — hands\-on execution not required, but comfortable reading and interpreting performance data
 



 \- Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with an eye for visual\-first platforms
 



 \- Experience with CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress), social media management tools, and basic HTML
 



 \- Comfortable with Google Analytics, keyword tools, and content performance metrics
 



  





**Traits** 




 \- Creative instincts paired with analytical discipline
 



 \- Self\-starter who can manage a content calendar independently
 



 \- Collaborative — comfortable working across design, admissions, marketing, and academic stakeholders
 



 \- Genuine interest in design, education, and digital culture
 



 \- Adaptable to a fast\-moving, growing institution with multiple campuses
