title: Senior Manager, Product Management
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 We are looking for a Senior Manager, Product Management to join our team within our Clinicals division. In this role you will be responsible for one or more product areas within the overarching product’s portfolio; understanding the market and customers, contributing to the product vision, developing business cases and ensuring a set of product features meet business requirements. You will help define how AI is responsibly integrated into clinical workflows, ensuring solutions are safe, trustworthy, and deliver measurable value to healthcare providers and patients.
   

  

 You will work closely with scrum teams defining and writing user stories, prioritizing product backlogs, and making trade\-off decisions between scope and schedule. Your work will span both strengthening our current solutions and delivering innovative, AI\-driven features that improve user experience and clinical decision\-making. Success in this role will be measured by improvements in provider efficiency, mobile adoption, workflow completion, user satisfaction, product quality, and safe adoption of AI\-enabled capabilities.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Mobile team brings together Product Management, Engineering, User Experience, Product Analytics, Data Science, and Patient Safety partners to improve the efficiency and experience of healthcare providers. The team works across product strategy, execution, and measurement to deliver both core product capabilities and AI\-enabled solutions where they add value. The team collaborates closely to ensure products are usable, reliable, and aligned with clinical and business needs. This role will support that mission by helping shape product decisions and delivery for an assigned area.
   

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
* Drive product vision incorporating AI/ML capabilities, predictive insights, and automation opportunities
* Lead early\-stage discovery for features including: Identifying high\-value use cases for AI, Validating concepts with users and stakeholders, and Defining data requirements and feasibility
* Partner with UX, Analytics and Data Science teams to define measurement strategies for AI feature performance (e.g., validity, bias, data quality, adoption, impact)
* Translate product strategy into outcome\-based roadmaps that connect customer problems, business goals, delivery priorities, and measurable success criteria.
* Define product success metrics for each major initiative, including adoption, engagement, workflow efficiency, customer satisfaction, safety, and business impact.
* Own go\-to\-market strategies for products, including its AI\-enabled features
* Monitor post\-release performance and use product analytics, customer feedback, and operational data to guide iteration and prioritization.
* Work directly with scrum teams to prioritize work and ensure delivery of both core and AI\-enabled product capabilities
* Own ongoing maintenance of core products, including triaging production issues and managing enhancements
* Collaborate with data science and engineering teams to translate AI models into scalable product features
* Understand the market opportunity via user needs, market forces, applicable business models, emerging AI trends and competitive AI capabilities
* Drive the analysis of Product Area(s) of ownership including AI/ML\-driven products
* Define epics and user stories that clearly articulate: Functional requirements, User experience considerations, Data and model requirements, AI behavior expectations (e.g., explainability, confidence levels)
* Partner with UX and Engineering to design mobile experiences that are intuitive, accessible, performant, and reliable in fast\-moving clinical environments.
* Partner with Data Science and Engineering to manage the full AI/ML lifecycle, including model evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement


**Expected Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s Degree required: Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business, or related field preferred
* 6\+ years of product management experience
* Understanding of US healthcare / health IT environment is strongly preferred
* Experience working in an Agile environment is strongly preferred
* Experience building or scaling mobile products, preferably iOS and Android applications in SaaS, healthcare, or enterprise environments.
* Understanding of mobile UX patterns, performance considerations, accessibility, release management, and app adoption strategies.
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts and productization of AI features
* Familiarity with: Model lifecycle (training, validation, deployment, monitoring), Data pipelines and data quality considerations, Experimentation frameworks
* Understanding of Responsible AI principles, model bias, and explainability
* Experience working on AI\-driven or data\-intensive products preferred
* Experience bringing products to market is needed
* Technical understanding (mobile, SaaS, data, APIs) – ability to check technical feasibility and timelines and remove technical development barriers
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to translate complex concepts into clear business value


**Additional Information**
* Some travel to the US may be required for customer site visits, internal collaborations, and industry events (5%)

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Brand Manager – Industrial \& Marketing** 
 to strengthen our corporate brand, enhance market visibility and lead integrated marketing initiatives across digital, content, industrial marketing, events and sales enablement.
 


 Key Responsibilities / KRAs1\. Brand Strategy \& Positioning
 * Develop and execute the overall brand and marketing strategy for Steelbuild.

* Build consistent messaging around engineering expertise, manufacturing capabilities, quality, reliability and project execution.

 * Develop targeted B2B marketing strategies for industrial customers and decision\-makers.

* Support account\-based marketing initiatives for high\-value prospects.
* Develop marketing assets for customer meetings, proposals and business\-development activities.
* Track marketing\-generated leads and coordinate with Sales for follow\-up.

* Identify opportunities for leadership and technical teams to contribute to industry publications and forums.

* Negotiate vendor commercials while maintaining quality standards.
* Monitor campaign timelines, deliverables and expenditure.
* Ensure activities are completed within approved budgets and timelines.

* Support Sales with effective customer\-facing materials.
* Coordinate with HR on employer branding and corporate communication when required.
* Maintain effective coordination between internal teams and external partners.

* Improvement in brand visibility within target industrial sectors.
* Website traffic, SEO visibility and conversion performance.
* Digital campaign effectiveness and cost efficiency.
* Social media reach, engagement and audience quality.
* Quality and frequency of project case studies and marketing assets.
* Effectiveness of sales\-enablement campaigns and collateral.
* Event and exhibition lead generation.
* Brand consistency across digital and offline channels.
* Marketing campaign execution and budget utilization.

 Preferred Skills
 * Brand Management \& Brand Strategy
* Industrial \& B2B Marketing
* Corporate Branding \& Communication
* Digital Marketing
* Content Strategy \& Corporate Storytelling
* SEO \& Google Ads
* LinkedIn \& Social Media Marketing
* Lead Generation
* Website Marketing \& Optimization

* Campaign Management
* Market Research \& Competitor Analysis
* Sales Enablement

title: Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager - Brand & Engagement
description:
**💻 Position: Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager \- Brand \& Engagement** 




**📍Location: Delhi** 




**🗓️ Working Days: Monday to Friday** 




**📌 Experience Required: 4–7 years** 




  





**About the Role** 




 Own the
 **end\-to\-end implementation and growth of FMCG brand campaigns post\-sale** 
 — getting them live, setting up tooling/dashboards, handling SQL, legal/ops, and building solutions when standard processes don’t fit.
 



  





**The Role** 



* You own what happens after a brand signs — and part of what happens just before.
* You take a signed (or near\-signed) enterprise brand and stand up a working, measurable campaign: configuring internal tooling, building the demo/sandbox the brand evaluates, wiring up their analytics dashboards, and clearing the legal and operational steps between contract and go\-live.
* When the standard path doesn't fit a brand's ask, you design one. And you feed every recurring gap back to Product, so the next deployment is faster.
* This is a builder's seat, not a relationship\-management seat. You'll be measured on getting brands live, instrumented and expanding — not on meeting cadence.



  





**What You'll Do** 



* **Demos \& sandboxes:** 
 Build the demo environments and proof\-of\-concept setups brands evaluate, in coordination with the founding team.
* **Solutioning:** 
 Translate a brand's objective into a concrete campaign configuration. Invent workarounds when our defaults don't fit.
* **Customer setup:** 
 Configure and launch new enterprise customers in our internal tools. Own time\-to\-first\-live\-campaign.
* **Analytics:** 
 Stand up and maintain customer\-facing dashboards so every brand can see purchase intent and campaign outcomes without having to ask.
* **Cross\-functional coordination:** 
 Drive legal (MSAs, DPAs, brand \& procurement reviews) and operations (fulfilment, sampling logistics) to unblock go\-live.
* **Account outcomes:** 
 Own the ongoing result — accounts that stay live and grow because they're properly instrumented. Catch risk in the data before it surfaces at renewal, not after.
* **Product partnership:** 
 Surface recurring friction, scope it with Product, and help shape the tooling built specifically for this function.



  





**Requirements** 



* 4–7 years in solutions engineering, implementation / onboarding, technical account management, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS, martech or adtech company.
* Hands\-on data fluency. You build dashboards from raw data, not just read them — hands\-on SQL, plus a BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Power BI, Tableau).
* Ownership in ambiguity. You've run an implementation or a complex onboarding end\-to\-end, not just managed a relationship around one.
* Enterprise stakeholder management. You've sat across from brand / marketing, procurement and legal — ideally in or around FMCG / CPG brand teams or their agencies (WPP, Publicis, Mindshare, Dentsu).
* Communication. Sharp written and verbal; you can run a room of senior client stakeholders.

title: Country Manager – (HVAC, Ventilation, IAQ, ERV/HRV, Heating-cooling system)
description:
**Country Manager – (HVAC, Ventilation, IAQ, ERV/HRV, Heating\-cooling system)** 




**Zehnder Group \| Represented in India by T\&A Consulting** 




**Location: Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru** 




  





**About Zehnder Group** 




 Zehnder Group is a Swiss headquartered provider of world\-leading solutions for a comfortable, energy\-efficient and healthy indoor climate. The products and services of the Group include heating, cooling, indoor ventilation and air cleaning. The Group develops and manufactures its products at its own factories in Europe, China, and North America.
 



 As part of its international growth strategy, Zehnder is now entering the Indian market and is looking to appoint Country Manager – India.
 



**More about Zehnder Group on www.zehndergroup.com** 




 Zehnder has partnered with
 **T\&A Consulting** 
 to support its India market entry and leadership hiring.
 



  





**About T\&A Consulting** 




 T\&A Consulting is a global advisory firm, with extensive experience of working with government, economic development agencies, businesses and academic institutions across Europe, Asia, and the Americas towards their expansion in the international markets.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Country Manager – India who will be responsible for building Zehnder’s business in India from the ground up.
 



 This is not a conventional sales role. It is a
 **market\-entry, business development and category\-building role** 
 for a senior commercial professional who can create demand for premium indoor climate solutions in India.
 



 The role requires someone who can position Zehnder as a premium ventilation, fresh\-air and indoor air quality brand in India, build specification\-led demand, develop a strong project pipeline, create the right partner ecosystem, and secure early reference projects.
 



 The ideal candidate should be comfortable operating in a lean, entrepreneurial setup where brand awareness, channels, installer capability and market acceptance need to be built from scratch.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. India Market Entry \& Business Build\-Up** 



* Establish Zehnder’s presence in India.
* Develop and execute a practical go\-to\-market plan for India.
* Identify priority customer segments, geographies and project types.
* Build Zehnder’s visibility among architects, consultants, developers, contractors and premium project decision\-makers.
* Generate qualified project pipeline and secure early reference projects.
* Provide regular market intelligence, competitor insights and customer feedback to Zehnder’s global leadership team.



  





**2\. Ventilation, Fresh\-Air \& Indoor Climate Business Development** 



* Lead market development for Zehnder’s balanced energy recovery ventilation systems
 **(ERV/ HRV, fresh air)** 
 with focus on the residential market.
* Build demand around the need for healthy indoor air, controlled ventilation, humidity management, energy efficiency and premium indoor comfort.
* Educate the market on the difference between air purification, air\-conditioning and engineered balanced energy recovery ventilation systems.
* Position Zehnder as a premium, technically superior and performance\-led indoor climate solution provider.



  





**3\. Premium / Luxury Project Sales** 



* Identify and develop opportunities in premium and luxury building projects.
* Target relevant segments such as luxury residential developments, branded residences, HNI villas, premium apartments, wellness spaces, high\-end hospitality, international schools, healthcare and select green building projects.
* Build relationships with premium developers, architects, interior designers, consultants, villa owners, project owners and HNI\-focused ecosystem partners.
* Sell on value, performance, comfort, health, acoustics, energy efficiency and lifecycle benefit, not on price alone.



  





**4\. Specification \& Project Sales** 



* Drive specification\-led selling by engaging architects, MEP consultants, HVAC consultants, green building consultants, PMCs, developers and contractors.
* Influence projects at the design and specification stage, before tendering and commercial negotiation.
* Develop technical presentations, concept notes and project\-specific value propositions.
* Support the creation of BOQ inputs, specification language, product comparisons, technical submittals and project proposals.
* Ensure that Zehnder is positioned as a system solution, not merely a product or equipment supplier.



  





**5\. Partner Ecosystem Development** 



* Identify, evaluate and develop suitable channel partners, system partners, installers, integrators and commissioning partners.
* Build a limited but high\-quality partner network capable of selling, installing and servicing premium ventilation systems.
* Train partners on Zehnder’s product value proposition, installation standards, commissioning discipline and customer experience expectations.
* Ensure that partners have the capability to support premium projects and maintain Zehnder’s brand standards.
* Develop a partner model that protects pricing, service quality, installation quality and long\-term customer satisfaction.



  





**6\. Technical Selling \& Customer Education** 



* Explain Zehnder’s solutions convincingly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Communicate the benefits of balanced ventilation, fresh\-air supply, energy recovery, humidity control, filtration, low\-noise operation and indoor air quality.
* Conduct presentations, seminars, consultant meetings, architect discussions, CPD\-style sessions and industry engagements.
* Build awareness among the market that premium indoor climate is about air quality, comfort, health and performance \- not only cooling.



  





**7\. Brand Representation \& Executive Presence** 



* Act as the face of Zehnder in India.
* Represent the company in senior client meetings, industry forums, trade events, consultant interactions and partner discussions.
* Build credibility with Indian stakeholders while maintaining alignment with Zehnder’s European quality, brand and business standards.
* Communicate clearly with Zehnder’s global leadership team on India market realities, opportunities, challenges and progress.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




  





**Experience** 



* 10–15 years of experience in HVAC, ventilation, building technology, indoor air quality, air filtration, fresh\-air systems, ERV/HRV, heat recovery, energy recovery, related technical building solutions.
* Experience in premium or specification\-led project sales is strongly preferred.
* Prior exposure to international companies, European brands, premium technical products or MNC environments will be an advantage.
* Experience in building a new business vertical, product category, region, partner network or market from an early stage will be highly valued.



  





**Product / Sector Exposure** 




 The ideal candidate should have exposure to one or more of the following:
 


* **Balanced energy recovery ventilation systems (ERV/ HRV, fresh air)**
* **Residential ventilation systems**
* Heat recovery / energy recovery
* Indoor air quality solutions
* Air filtration / clean\-air solutions
* Premium HVAC systems
* Green building / energy\-efficient building solutions



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 We are looking for a commercially strong, self\-driven professional with a builder mindset. The right candidate will be someone who has the maturity of working with international companies, but also the agility, ownership, and entrepreneurial drive required to build a business in a new market.
 



  





**Key Competencies** 




 ▪ Strong business development and pipeline creation capability
 



 ▪ Ability to build markets, channels, and partnerships from the ground up
 



 ▪ Commercially sharp and opportunity\-driven
 



 ▪ Strong network in HVAC / ventilation / building technology ecosystem
 



 ▪ Good understanding of specification\-led and project\-led sales
 



 ▪ Ability to work independently with limited local infrastructure
 



 ▪ High ownership, initiative, and accountability
 



 ▪ Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
 



 ▪ Comfortable working with international leadership teams
 



 ▪ Strategic thinking with hands\-on execution capability
 



  





**Why This Role Is Exciting** 




 ▪ Opportunity to lead the India market entry for a respected European brand
 



 ▪ First commercial leadership role for Zehnder in India
 



 ▪ High ownership and visibility with global leadership
 



 ▪ Opportunity to shape market strategy, channel structure, and early business growth
 



 ▪ Ideal role for a professional who enjoys building, not just managing.

title: International Policy & Communications Lead, India (Director)
description:
**Role Description**
* Develop and manage strategic policy initiatives to support Pfizer's business in India.
* Develop and implement innovative policy strategic platforms to support Pfizer’s business, including but not limited to creation of broader industry coalitions and platforms to advance Pfizer’s objectives.
* Serve as thought partner to the Head of IPC EM and the India Country President in anticipating and assessing the impact of the external policy environment on business strategy.
* Develops and leads Policy, Communications and Patient Advocacy strategies across India to support key Pfizer and business unit priorities, including access, pricing, intellectual property, localization, life\-course immunization, and stakeholder engagement.
* Executive support for the Country President and local country\-level external communications programs, with the support of the local IPC team, that drive business objectives and strengthen Pfizer’s reputation in India.


**ROLE RESPONSIBILTIES**
**Strategic planning and implementation**
* Proactively assesses trends, policies and identifies key opportunities and threats.
* Prepares informational materials for management, highlighting opportunities and potential threats and works in partnership with the Head of IPC EM to develop responsive strategies where such developments could impact business operations.
* Utilizes Pfizer corporate policy positions to develop targeted political strategies and action plans.
* Develops and implements a macro\-level strategic policy plan that effectively shapes the environment to create a favorable operating environment for Pfizer.
* Leverages insights and knowledge to create a vision for the future and position Pfizer as a preferred partner.
* Prioritizes and drives both long\-term and short\-term opportunities.
* Works in partnership with the Head of IPC EM, Country President and local functional teams to develop innovative policy strategies that proactively shape the environment for launch of new assets.
* Adapt and implement TA\-level policy strategies and tactics to support access to Pfizer products address the patient affordability challenge.


**External Relations**
* Participates in advocacy functions at trade and business associations at a local level, as required.
* Establishes, maintains and consistently leverages relationships with policy makers, think tanks, patient advocacy groups and other organizations to advance Pfizer’s strategic priorities and ensure Pfizer’s position is reflected in advocacy materials.
* Supports the development of briefing materials for external engagements.
* Appropriately and effectively tailors Pfizer International policy positions to local market dynamics.
* Maintains strict compliance with all applicable policies and laws, especially those related to interactions with government officials.


**Patient Advocacy**
* Develop and lead the implementation of country strategic, pro\-active agenda with internal and external stakeholders
* Provide leadership and direction for all cross functional engagement with targeted key stakeholders, including current and future patients, and serve as a key relationship manager, leading and/or guiding relationships with patient and professional advocacy organizations as appropriate.
* Communicates on key topics such as IP, health reform, access to medicines, pricing, trade agreements, etc. through the development of briefing notes, position papers, talking points, as well as relevant correspondence, proposals and presentations.
* Provide strategic counsel and tactical communications support to the Country President, as well as country marketing teams and other functions in order to develop external communications country plans aligned with the business vision, mission and key priorities.
* Work collaboratively across functions in the business to manage proactive and reactive external communications.
* Partner with commercial teams in India, ensuring alignment with global messaging and priorities and that local teams have the external communications support needed to execute local business strategies.
* Provide strategic communications counsel and messaging support for country leadership with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment and consistency with Pfizer corporate narratives and international policy messaging.


**Leadership**
* Serves as key thought partner to the Country President and Commercial Leads in assessing the impact of the external policy environment on business strategy. Provide strategic counsel in business planning decisions including but not limited to operating plan discussions and business reviews.
* Coordinates and prepares the LT for external engagements.
* Ensures that the local management team understand the impact of Policy \& Comms activities and role in supporting the BU commercial goals.


**ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**
* Internal: H\&V, Legal, Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, IPC regional and global team.
* External: Academics, trade associations, policy makers, government officials, patient advocacy groups, consultants, media and key influencers.


**Qualification And Experience**
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in public policy, strategy or consulting related to policy, government relations, and/or corporate affairs.
* Bachelor degree required. Advanced Degree in health/public policy, international affairs, political science, and/or law preferred
* Deep knowledge of healthcare policy and pharmaceutical pricing and reimbursement issues. Excellent knowledge of the local healthcare system and its major players and decision\-makers.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute effective, innovative and practical policy/public affairs and policy solutions and comprehensive plans that deliver results.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and deploy appropriate "public affairs and policy" tools (advocacy, lobbying, stakeholder engagement plans).
* Strong understanding of business strategy and key drivers of commercial success
* Highly skilled at anticipating, identifying, and addressing emerging issues and related risks that could impact Pfizer's business
* Strong ability to develop relationships with key stakeholders. Skilled at advocacy influence within internal/external matrix organizations. Skilled at navigating complex environments through range of internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong executive presence and interpersonal acumen, highly substantive and collaborative. Demonstrated ability to succinctly convey relevant information at the right time and with the proper context and seek input as needed.
* Excellent oral and written communications skills.
* Excellent command of English language. Fluency in English required; fluency in Hindi or another relevant Indian language preferred.


**RESOURCES MANAGED**
* Financial Accountability – Responsible for managing local Policy \& Communications budgets.
* Supervision – Local team (2 colleagues), local agency resources in India, as applicable.


 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.

 Evolve Energy Group is a premium provider of end\-to\-end solar power solutions, focused on accelerating India’s transition to clean, reliable, and sustainable energy. The company views solar energy as a long\-term investment that demands careful planning, advanced technology, and high\-quality components to ensure consistent performance over a 25\-year project life. The Business Head will support investor and lender relationships, monitor portfolio performance, and ensure compliance with regulatory and contractual requirements. * Prior experience in IPP or utility\-scale renewable energy in India is highly desirable, including exposure to New Delhi/NCR markets.

title: Independent Director
description:
**Why a marketing\-led Independent Director** 




  





 The company provides integrated marketing services spanning creative development, media, analytics and research. Its Board seeks an experienced marketing and agency\-business leader to challenge the strategy for entering and expanding in EU markets. The appointment must bring independent judgment about where the company's capabilities create a defensible proposition, how local credibility will be earned and what organisational and financial commitments expansion requires.
 



  





 The Director is not being appointed to act as a commissioned salesperson, introduce clients for fees or manage a European business unit. Expansion advice will be exercised through the statutory Board role. Executive management retains responsibility for sales, negotiations, hiring and delivery.
 



  





**The EU expansion decision** 




  





 The Director will help the Board distinguish a coherent market thesis from an ambition to establish a presence. Evaluate demand by service line, customer need, buying behaviour, procurement expectations, language, cultural adaptation, delivery model and margin. Creative reputation in one market does not automatically transfer into local insight or a credible integrated offering in another.
 



  





 Market selection should consider the company's actual right\-to\-win, available leadership, referenceable work, partner capability, client concentration and full cost of entry. The Board should approve specific commitments rather than a broad mandate to pursue Europe. Every entry case needs a staged investment, accountable executive, downside funding, review point and exit option.
 



  





**Integration is a promise to the client** 




  





 Challenge whether creative, media, analytics and research operate as one proposition or four services joined in a pitch. Review client leadership, planning, pricing, shared briefs, scope ownership, data access, delivery assurance and escalation. Cross\-selling should create demonstrable client value rather than increase internal referrals without improving outcomes.
 



  





 The Director will examine which work can be delivered from existing operations, which requires local teams and which should remain with specialist partners. Offshore efficiency must be evaluated alongside time zones, language, research validity, creative relevance, client access and responsible supervision. Non\-standard commitments should carry explicit commercial and delivery approval.
 



  





**Money, measurement and market trust** 




  





 Oversee client and service\-line profitability after talent, freelance and production cost, media commitments, research procurement, analytics infrastructure, travel, rework, working capital and local management. Media billings, pass\-throughs and agency income must be clearly distinguished. The Board needs to understand who holds customer money, who commits spend and how balances are reconciled.
 



 Review rebates, principal\-agent relationships, connected suppliers, incentives, subcontractors and commercial transparency. Performance and audience claims should identify observed facts, modelled estimates, attribution assumptions and limitations. Research quality requires suitable samples, methods, consent, participant protection and honest treatment of uncertainty.
 



  





 AI\-generated creative, synthetic content, analytical tools and automated research introduce questions of intellectual property, authenticity, confidentiality and evidence. The Director should ensure that product and client claims do not outrun the company's ability to substantiate them.
 



  





**Local accountability before launch** 




  





 Require qualified legal and tax advice on proposed entities, employment, contracting, advertising, consumer conduct, privacy, research, IP and data transfer arrangements. The Director will challenge the completeness of this advice and its translation into operating controls, without substituting personal opinion for specialist conclusions.
 



  





 Client contracts should specify deliverables, scope change, data and IP rights, subcontracting, media authority, liability, acceptance, payment and termination. Customer information and campaign data must not be repurposed across clients or used to train external models without appropriate authority and safeguards.
 



  





 For acquisitions or partnerships, assess cultural compatibility, key\-person retention, client conflicts, ownership of work and data, hidden media or production commitments, deferred obligations, claims and the cost of integration. A local relationship network is not an adequate valuation thesis if it depends on one individual who may leave.
 



  





**Leadership and independent governance** 




  





 Help the Board appoint and evaluate international leadership, define delegation and build succession across client service, creative, media, analytics, research and finance. Incentives should reward retained clients, collected contribution, delivery quality and conduct rather than bookings or expansion announcements alone.

title: CSP - Value Stream Owner, Service Excellence & Retention
description:
**About The Opportunity**
 Job Type: Permanent
   

  

 Application Deadline: 31 October 2026
   

  

**Title** 
**CSP \- Value Stream Owner, Service Excellence \& Retention**
**Department** 
**Client Servicing Platforms**
**Location** 
**Gurgaon**
**Reports To** 
**Head of Client Servicing Platforms**
**Level** 
**8**
 We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our Client Servicing Platform team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
   

  

**About Your Team**
 As a business, we are constantly evolving how we work to stay ahead of what our clients need and to deliver on our Forward 8 ambitions. FIL Platforms represents the next step in that journey \- bringing together Asset Management Delivery, Enterprise Technology Services, and delivery and change teams from across the business into a single integrated structure, designed for clarity, speed, and impact.
   

  

 That structure is organised around Platforms, each a focused unit of capability with a single accountable owner and within each Platform, a set of Value Streams that translate strategic priorities into funded, sequenced delivery.
   

  

 Your value stream sits at the heart of that model. It exists to connect our talent and expertise directly to the priorities that matter most, delivering value for our clients with less duplication and fewer competing backlogs
   

  

 Client Servicing Platform is accountable for delivering on Fidelity’s client commitments after engagement, ensuring servicing outcomes are reliable, consistent and scalable across regions. The team owns the end\-to\-end client servicing journey, focusing on standardisation, transparency and repeatable delivery.
   

  

 The Service \& Retain value stream owns the platform capabilities that strengthen service performance and deepen long\-term client relationships. It brings together live service stability, continuous improvement, client insight and relationship\-focused outcomes so that service delivery is transparent, repeatable and aligned to client needs across regions.
   

  

**About Your Role**
 A value stream is FIL's core delivery construct \- the unit through which strategy becomes execution. Each value stream is underpinned by a clear roadmap, supported by the right people and capabilities required to deliver it. It sits below the Platform and above the Agile Release Train (ARTs) and Squads that do the work, and it is the layer where sequencing is decided, scope is defined and refined, and outcomes are owned.
   

  

 As a Value Stream Owner you represent the voice of the customer \- translating their strategic needs into delivery, as well as the Platform priorities.
   

  

 You will lead across both run (e.g. live service performance and stability) and change (e.g. delivery and continuous improvement). You’ll enable your teams to focus on the work that makes the biggest difference to FIL and its clients.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of Client Servicing Platforms, you will lead the Service \& Retain value stream, ensuring Fidelity’s client servicing outcomes are reliable, consistent, scalable and continually improving across the end\-to\-end client journey.
   

  

 Key outcomes
   

  

* Reliable, consistent and scalable servicing outcomes across the end\-to\-end client servicing journey.
* A coherent roadmap across the Strengthen Service and Deepen Relationships ARTs, linked to platform OKRs and client value.
* Clear ownership of service stability, operational risk, client insight and continuous optimisation.
* Transparent performance tracking focused on service quality, client retention, engagement, cost\-to\-serve and platform effectiveness.


 Day to day, this means:
   

  

* Setting and defining the value stream vision (Objective \& Key Results) and roadmap, keeping it aligned to platform OKRs and FIL's Forward 8 priorities as both evolve with a focus on continuously delivering incremental value at all times.
* Acting as Value Stream Owner within the LPM process, accepting agreed demand into the backlog and leading delivery through the quarterly planning and execution cycle.
* Owning the Initiative backlog, and development of the Lean Business Case and making sequencing decisions.
* Managing the value stream budget and headcount within allocated funding levels, and making the case for investment where it is needed.
* Tracking and reporting on outcomes, not just delivery progress \- knowing what has actually moved and being honest when it has not.
* Leading Quarterly Planning Cycles and ensuring the ARTs are co\-ordinating a coherent, well\-sequenced plan.
* Managing operational risk and service stability within the value stream alongside the change agenda.
* Building and developing the leadership team within the value stream, and holding them accountable to outcomes.
* Accountable for role modelling and championing the correct behaviours and change culture.
* Championing and driving the value stream at the relevant governance forums and with senior stakeholders.
* Transiting the value stream to the North Star view over time (reducing dependencies and additional coordination horizontal layers).


**About You**
 This role will suit if you’ve run, changed and owned a large, complex global product (including service, platform, proposition or product) at scale, including: the viability, the operational, the technical, and value dimensions.
   

  

**Specifically, we are looking for:**
* Commercial acumen to own a business outcome and make the value case for a value stream's priorities.
* A genuine track record of building high\-performing, engaged teams to move the dial on performance metrics via the value delivered.
* An individual who has led both run and change, and are comfortable being fully accountable for live performance, delivery outcomes, operational effectiveness and the long\-term health of a value stream.
* An individual who can engage senior stakeholders with integrity, using sound judgement and negotiation skills to influence outcomes, manage competing interests and ensuring the right initiatives are being delivered in the right way.
* Strong familiarity with Agile operating models at scale; experience with SAFe or a comparable framework is an advantage.
* Financial management experience \- owning a budget, making trade\-offs, and being accountable for spend against outcomes.
* The technical fluency to engage meaningfully with engineering leads on architecture, debt, and delivery risk.
* Sound judgement in complex, regulated environments, balancing experience, delivery feasibility, risk, control and operational practicality without losing momentum.
* The ability to define the longer\-term direction for a value stream while staying close enough to execution, risk, delivery and operational detail to ensure results are actually achieved.
* An excellent communicator who can motivate and align large teams (including matrixed roles), create shared understanding across complex stakeholder groups and maintain momentum through clarity, consistency and presence.
* Enterprise\-first individual, supporting the creation of common, reusable patterns and repeatable solutions that improve consistency, speed and simplicity across the platforms.


 Behavioural expectations
   

  

**Brave**
* Prioritise learning and momentum over defending legacy commitments.
* Remove blockers and reset priorities when outcomes are at risk.
* Role model stopping or reshaping work that no longer delivers value.


**Bold**
* Set clear, outcome led direction and make decisive tradeoffs at valuestream level.
* Simplify governance, roles and interfaces to reduce duplication and escalation.
* Delegate real decision authority and protect teams’ ability to move at pace.


**Curious**
* Drive continuous prioritisation based on flow, outcomes and data.
* Expect evidence led conversations (not status updates) in the appropriate governance forums.
* Use delivery data to inform funding, sequencing and capacity decisions.


**Compassionate**
* Act as a visible advocate for client outcomes across the value stream.
* Build psychological safety so issues are raised early rather than escalated late.
* Balance pace with sustainability and colleague wellbeing.


 Feel rewarded
   

  

 For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

title: TALENT ACQUISITION– SOCIAL MEDIA & CREATIVE HIRING
description:
Department: Human Resources
 





 Location: Cocoma Digital HQ – Andheri West, Mumbai
 





 Employment Type: Full\-Time \| On\-site
 





 Experience Required: 3\+ Years
 





 Reporting To: Head of HR
 




  





**ABOUT COCOMA DIGITAL \& STUDIOS** 




**Cocoma Digital \& Studios** 
 is a growing creative and marketing company managing multiple brands and businesses. Our
 **Digital division** 
 focuses on YouTube, social media, content, creator collaborations, and digital brand building, while our
 **Studios division** 
 provides end\-to\-end post\-production for films, TV, OTT, web series, and social content. We create content that
 **informs, entertains, engages, and builds communities** 
 , while delivering measurable digital growth.
 



  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




 We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist – Social Media \& Creative Hiring to manage end\-to\-end recruitment at Cocoma Digital \& Studios. The role focuses on hiring across Social Media, Creative, YouTube, Content, and Digital profiles, with strong emphasis on active sourcing and headhunting.
 



 You’ll manage sourcing, screening, interviews, trials, pipelines, stakeholder coordination, and position closures, while working to improve hiring quality and reduce TAT.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong recruitment skills, communication, follow\-up discipline, and experience hiring for social media and creative roles.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 





 1\. End\-to\-End Recruitment
 



* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from requirement understanding to candidate onboarding.
* Understand manpower requirements and convert them into clear hiring briefs and JDs.
* Source, headhunt, screen, shortlist, interview\-coordinate, and follow up with candidates.
* Ensure candidates move efficiently through every stage of the hiring process.
* Maintain active pipelines for current and upcoming requirements.
* Take ownership of assigned positions until successful closure and joining.




 2\. Talent Sourcing \& Headhunting
 



* Actively source and headhunt candidates through LinkedIn, job portals, employee referrals, social media, institutes, creative communities, databases, and other relevant channels.
* Identify and approach passive candidates who may not be actively looking for opportunities.
* Build targeted talent maps for Social Media, Creative, YouTube, Content, Marketing, and related Digital roles.
* Develop and maintain talent pools for frequently hired and critical positions.
* Identify new and effective sourcing channels based on role requirements.
* Proactively map relevant talent from Social Media Agencies, Digital Marketing Agencies, Creative Agencies, Media Companies, and other relevant organisations.
* Build relationships with creative and social media talent communities to support ongoing hiring.




 3\. Social Media \& Creative Hiring
 



* Understand the talent requirements of a social\-focused, YouTube\-first creative business.
* Hire across social media and creative functions including:
* Social Media Managers / Executives
* YouTube Managers / Executives
* Video Editors
* Motion Graphic Designers
* Graphic Designers
* Visualisers
* Content Writers / Script Writers
* Content Creators
* Performance Marketers
* Account Managers
* Campaign Managers
* Creative Leads and other related profiles
* Understand the difference between evaluating creative talent and conventional corporate profiles.
* Review portfolios, showreels, campaign work, YouTube channels, social profiles, case studies, assignments, and relevant work samples wherever applicable.
* Identify candidates based on both skill and suitability for Cocoma’s fast\-paced creative environment.




 4\. Candidate Screening \& Evaluation
 



* Conduct initial telephonic/video screening of candidates.
* Evaluate candidates against experience, skills, communication, salary expectations, availability, portfolio/work quality, and role suitability.
* Review portfolios, resumes, work samples, trials, and assessments wherever applicable.
* Conduct structured screening based on the requirements of each role.
* Ensure only relevant and qualified candidates are forwarded to hiring managers.
* Maintain consistent screening standards across roles.




 5\. Interview, Trial \& Stakeholder Management
 



* Coordinate interviews across multiple rounds with hiring managers and business stakeholders.
* Coordinate candidate trials, assignments, assessments, and portfolio reviews wherever required.
* Ensure interview and assessment feedback is collected within defined timelines.
* Follow up with hiring managers for pending feedback and decisions.
* Maintain clear communication between candidates, HR, and hiring teams.
* Escalate delays or bottlenecks that may impact hiring timelines.
* Keep candidates engaged throughout the recruitment process.




 6\. Recruitment Operations \& Tracking
 



* Maintain accurate recruitment trackers, candidate databases, interview schedules, and hiring reports.
* Track applications, sourcing, screening, shortlisting, interviews, trials/assessments, selections, offers, and joining status.
* Monitor position\-wise hiring progress and identify pipeline gaps.
* Maintain accurate recruitment MIS and daily/weekly hiring updates.
* Ensure recruitment data is updated in the designated HR systems and tools.
* Maintain proper documentation and version control across recruitment activities.

* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work in a fast\-paced, on\-site team environment are advantageous.

title: Regional Launch Director SIR
description:
**Job Description Summary**
* Job Description


 As Regional Launch Director, you'll be accountable for maximizing the value of the
   

  

 launch, leading development and execution of E2E plan through cross functional
   

  

 collaboration. Contributes to the development and execution of the strategic regional
   

  

 launch plan, tactical program development and implementation including marketing
   

  

 mix and operational plans that optimize sales, market share and revenue growth in the
   

  

 short and long term. Commercial launch readiness is achieved through close
   

  

 collaboration with Commercial teams in market, and with close collaboration and
   

  

 support from Platforms, Development, BD, Regulatory, IP/Legal, STO and ESO.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Position Purpose:**
 As Regional Launch Director, you'll be accountable for maximizing the value of the launch, leading development and execution of E2E plan through cross functional collaboration. Contributes to the development and execution of the strategic regional launch plan, tactical program development and implementation including marketing mix and operational plans that optimize sales, market share and revenue growth in the short and long term. Commercial launch readiness is achieved through close collaboration with Commercial teams in market, and with close collaboration and support from Platforms, Development, BD, Regulatory, IP/Legal, STO and ESO.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:
   

  

* Proactively lead the development and implementation of strategic regional launch readiness.
* Monitor the launch performance, competitive environment to quickly identify plan changes.
* Manage ROI assessments of tactical programs \& through collaboration with Commercial Leadership, develop and execute action plans to address competitive threats and/ or exogenous market events, maximizing pipeline value.
* Engage with other functional teams to ensure operational launch readiness of Region SIR launches and ensure E2E coordination to maximize commercial opportunities.
* Collaborate with Platforms on critical issues related to market commercialization, aligning as appropriate to their global product launch strategy.
* Together with Supply Chain and Platforms, drive decisions for regional product allocations if needed, at\-risk manufacturing and API purchases to optimize upsides and mitigate risk.
* Provide leadership to the market team and extended functional launch team members including coaching, advising, and developing team members
* Ensure compliance with Sandoz policies and procedures and full integration into the Sandoz culture and support resources
* Perform other duties as required by the Region from time to time.


**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**
* A minimum of 5 years of pharmaceutical industry experience in the GLP\-1 or Biosimilar field
* Sales/commercial leadership and mindset
* Sound Project Management experience (min 5 years)
* Hands\-on approach combined with business acumen, strategic thinking, and pragmatism
* Experience in managing/leading cross\-functional matrix teams
* Excellent communication and relationship management skills
* Stakeholder engagement with respect for different cultures and diverse groups.


**Why Sandoz?**
 Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world’s medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100\+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more, so that everyone can achieve the basic human rightof access to good healthcare.
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

 Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster.
   

  

**Commitment To Diversity \& Inclusion**
 We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.
   

  

**Skills Desired**
 Agility, Brand Awareness, Cross\-Functional Collaboration, Customer Engagement, Customer Experience, Customer Insights, Data Strategy, Digital Marketing, Go\-To\-Market Strategy, Influencing Skills, Inspirational Leadership, Marketing Strategy, Media Campaigns, People Management, Product Marketing, Product Roadmap, Return on Investment (ROI), Stakeholder Engagement, Stakeholder Management, Strategic Marketing

title: Event Management & Marketing Executive
company: Blue Data Consulting And It Services
description:
About the Organisation Blue Data Consulting is a technology consulting, capability-building and professional education company specialising in Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Analytics, Automation and emerging technologies. Through Blue Data Consulting, we work with enterprises, professionals, students, universities and technology communities to deliver corporate training programs, workshops, webinars, technology events and career-focused learning initiatives. 
 Role Overview We are looking for a hands-on and ownership-driven Event Management & Marketing Executive to manage webinars, podcasts, workshops, training programs, exhibitions, expos and community events. The person will take responsibility for the complete event lifecycle from planning and promotion to execution, participant engagement, lead capture and post-event reporting. This is an execution-focused role for someone who enjoys running events, coordinating multiple stakeholders and creating marketing campaigns that generate registrations, engagement, visibility and business opportunities. The successful candidate should be comfortable working independently, following up with speakers and vendors, managing event-day operations and ensuring that every event is delivered successfully. Key Responsibilities 1. Event Planning and Execution Develop and maintain a calendar of webinars, podcasts, workshops, training events, exhibitions and community programs. Convert event ideas into structured execution plans with objectives, timelines, budgets and responsibilities. Identify suitable dates, venues, speakers, trainers, partners and vendors. Prepare event checklists and monitor readiness across all workstreams. Coordinate internal teams, speakers, designers, vendors and external partners. Take ownership of event-day operations and resolve last-minute issues. Ensure that events are delivered on schedule, within budget and according to expected quality standards. Conduct post-event reviews and document recommendations for improvement. 2. Webinars and Virtual Events Identify relevant webinar topics related to AI, technology, analytics, automation, careers and professional education. Coordinate with speakers, moderators and subject-matter experts. Set up and manage webinars using Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet or similar platforms. Create registration forms and coordinate landing pages where required. Manage invitations, confirmations, reminders and participant communication. Conduct technical rehearsals and speaker briefings. Manage live sessions, including participant admission, moderation, polls, Q&A and recordings. Coordinate post-event communication, feedback collection and resource sharing. Track registrations, attendance, engagement, enquiries and qualified leads. 3. Podcasts and Video Interviews Identify suitable podcast guests from the technology, business, education and startup ecosystem. Reach out to potential guests and coordinate recording schedules. Research speakers and prepare discussion themes and interview questions. Coordinate studio, venue, audio, video, lighting and technical requirements. Manage both physical and virtual podcast recordings. Coordinate video editing, branding, thumbnails, captions and publishing. Repurpose podcast content into short videos, social-media posts, quotations and articles. Maintain a consistent podcast and video publishing calendar. Track views, engagement, watch time and enquiries generated. 4. Offline Workshops and Training Events Organise public workshops, corporate training programs, masterclasses and technology meetups. Coordinate venues, trainers, participants, event materials, certificates and refreshments. Manage registration desks and participant support during events. Coordinate audio-visual equipment, seating, signage, photography and videography. Ensure that trainers and speakers receive complete event information and support. Collect participant feedback and coordinate certificates and post-event resources. Support follow-up with prospective students, professionals and corporate participants. 5. Exhibitions, Expos and Conferences Identify relevant exhibitions, conferences and technology expos in Surat and other priority locations. Evaluate exhibitor, sponsorship and participation opportunities. Coordinate stall booking and communication with event organisers. Manage stall branding, banners, brochures, demonstrations and promotional materials. Coordinate staff schedules, travel, logistics and on-site operations. Develop pre-event, live-event and post-event promotional campaigns. Capture visitor information and categorise potential leads. Prepare post-event reports covering footfall, leads, expenditure and business opportunities. 6. Event Marketing and Campaign Management Develop a promotional plan for every event. Define the target audience, event message, channels and campaign timeline. Run campaigns through LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp and relevant online communities. Coordinate Instagram and Facebook promotions when relevant. Develop speaker-led and partner-led promotional campaigns. Coordinate outreach to colleges, companies, professional groups and local communities. Prepare clear content and design briefs for the support team. Review campaign creatives and ensure their timely publication. Monitor registrations and adjust campaigns where participation is below target. Support paid campaigns when approved. 7. Social-Media and Content Coordination Maintain an event-focused social-media content calendar. Prepare post concepts, captions, campaign messages and basic content drafts. Coordinate with graphic designers, video editors and the content team. Schedule or publish approved content across relevant platforms. Promote upcoming events, speakers, training programs, success stories and participant outcomes. Repurpose event recordings into social-media content. Monitor reach, impressions, engagement, clicks, registrations and enquiries. Recommend improvements based on campaign performance. 8. Partnerships and Community Outreach Build working relationships with colleges, universities, coworking spaces and professional communities. Engage with startup networks, technology communities, HR groups and L&D professionals. Develop relationships with local media, event organisers, speakers and influencers. Identify opportunities for joint events, community promotions and speaker exchanges. Coordinate with college training and placement departments. Support venue partnerships and audience-sharing arrangements. Maintain an updated database of potential partners, communities and speakers. 9. Lead Capture and Follow-Up Coordination Ensure that participant and visitor information is collected accurately. Categorise leads into students, professionals, corporate buyers, partners and speakers. Update the CRM or approved lead-tracking system. Share qualified leads with the relevant sales, admissions or counselling team. Coordinate post-event follow-up communication. Track enquiries and conversions generated through events. Ensure that participant information is handled responsibly and according to applicable privacy requirements. 10. Budget and Vendor Management Prepare event-level budget estimates. Obtain and compare quotations from venues and vendors. Coordinate with printers, photographers, videographers, caterers and production teams. Negotiate commercially reasonable rates and payment terms. Obtain internal approvals before confirming expenditure. Monitor planned versus actual event costs. Verify vendor deliverables before processing invoices. Maintain a reliable database of local venues and event-service providers. 
 Internal Support Available The selected candidate may receive support from internal or remote teams for: Graphic design Video editing Content development Landing-page development Technical subject-matter inputs Administrative coordination However, the candidate will remain responsible for preparing clear briefs, following up with support teams, maintaining timelines and ensuring successful final delivery. 
 Required Skills and Experience 36 years of relevant experience in event management, marketing, community management, education marketing or a related field. Demonstrated experience managing physical and virtual events. Working knowledge of digital marketing and social-media campaigns. Experience coordinating speakers, vendors, venues, partners and participants. Strong planning, organisation and follow-up capabilities. Ability to manage multiple events and deadlines simultaneously. Good written and verbal communication skills. Comfortable using LinkedIn, Canva, Google Workspace, WhatsApp Business, Zoom and similar tools. Basic understanding of campaign metrics, lead tracking and post-event reporting. Ability to work independently with limited supervision. Willingness to travel locally and occasionally to nearby cities. Willingness to support events during evenings or weekends when required. Fluency in English and Hindi; Gujarati proficiency would be an advantage. 
 Preferred Qualifications Experience in technology, Artificial Intelligence, EdTech, professional education or corporate training. Existing relationships with colleges, universities, professional communities or event partners in Surat. Experience managing webinars, podcasts or video-based content. Familiarity with CRM, email-marketing or marketing-automation platforms. Experience participating in exhibitions, expos or conferences. Basic copywriting, content-creation or Canva skills. 
 Desired Attributes We are looking for someone who is: Ownership-driven and dependable Highly organised and detail-oriented Energetic and comfortable interacting with people Proactive in following up with stakeholders Calm under pressure Resourceful when dealing with last-minute problems Comfortable with hands-on execution Focused on measurable outcomes Interested in AI, technology and professional education 
 Key Performance Indicators Performance may be assessed through: Number of successfully delivered events Timely and within-budget event execution Event registrations and attendance Registration-to-attendance conversion rate Cost per registration and qualified lead Participant feedback and satisfaction Qualified leads generated through events Event-generated enquiries and conversions Number of active community and institutional relationships Social-media reach and engagement Consistency of webinar, podcast and content publication Quality and timeliness of post-event reports Vendor performance and cost management 
 Important Role Expectations This is a hands-on role. The selected candidate must be comfortable: Taking end-to-end responsibility for events. Personally following up with speakers, vendors and internal teams. Conducting promotional outreach and campaign activities. Working from event venues when required. Handling last-minute operational issues. Working occasionally during evenings or weekends. Travelling locally and occasionally outside Surat. Being measured on registrations, attendance, engagement, leads and event outcomes. 
 Why Join Us? Work in the fast-growing AI, technology and professional education ecosystem. Lead diverse webinars, podcasts, training programs and offline events. Build relationships with industry leaders, universities, communities and technology professionals. Receive support from experienced design, content and technical teams. Gain significant ownership and an opportunity to grow into an events, community or marketing leadership role.

title: Community Builder and Social Media Specialist
description:
**Community Builder and Social Media specialist – LUHO** 




 Bengaluru \| Full\-time \| On\-ground across LUHO homes
 



  





**About LUHO** 




 LUHO runs nine serviced homes across Bengaluru, each with a live\-in butler, home\-cooked meals and hotel\-level care. Most of our guests are corporate travellers who stay with us for days or weeks. We want every one of them to feel looked after, and we want the world to hear about it from them.
 



  





**The role** 




 You'll be the face and voice of LUHO. You'll meet guests, host events, bring in influencers, and turn everyday life at LUHO into content people want to follow. You'll be employed full\-time by LUHO and work with Talking Ants Media, our content and brand partner, who will guide the creative direction, content plan and quality bar.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Post on LUHO's social media every day: reels, stories, photos and short updates from our homes
* Meet guests across properties, check in on their stay and build rapport
* Collect testimonials on video, in writing and as reviews, and make it easy for happy guests to share their experience
* Spot moments worth sharing, like a birthday surprise, a long\-stay guest's routine, or a butler going the extra mile
* Plan and host events at LUHO homes, such as guest dinners, networking evenings, workshops, festive get\-togethers and pop\-ups, from idea to guest list to the night itself
* Promote events online and offline, and fill them with the right mix of guests, corporate contacts and local community
* Find and bring in influencers and creators whose audience fits LUHO, then invite them for stays or events and manage the collaboration end to end
* Grow a community around LUHO: repeat guests, corporate contacts, creators and online followers
* Pass guest feedback to the LUHO team so issues get fixed quickly
* Follow the content calendar and brand guidelines from Talking Ants, and share weekly updates on what's working



  





**Working hours** 




 Your day follows our guests. Mornings start early, when guests are heading out, and evenings are when they're back, relaxed, and when most events happen. The middle of the day is yours to plan: edit content, reach out to creators, schedule posts, or take a break. We care about output, not desk time.
 



  





**Who we're looking for** 



* Confident, presentable and at ease starting a conversation with anyone, from a CXO to a first\-time traveller
* Strong spoken communication in English; Kannada or Hindi is a must
* A natural people person who is warm, observant and genuinely curious about others
* Comfortable on camera and good at getting others comfortable on camera
* Good at organising: can plan an event, manage vendors and invites, and make sure it runs smoothly on the day
* Comfortable reaching out to influencers and creators, or already connected to Bengaluru's creator scene
* Handy with a phone for shooting and basic editing (CapCut, InShot, Instagram tools)
* Self\-driven and responsible with flexible hours
* 1–3 years in social media, hospitality, events, community management or guest relations preferred; freshers with a strong personal profile are welcome
* Own two\-wheeler preferred for moving between properties



  





**What you get** 



* Hands\-on creative mentorship from a professional video and brand studio
* Freedom to shape how LUHO shows up online and offline
* A front\-row seat in a growing hospitality brand

**About Nudge.new** 


 Nudge.new builds AI\-native marketing products for small and growing businesses across the US and Canada. We run our clients' entire marketing engine — acquisition (SEO, AEO, Website, paid ads) and retention (email, WhatsApp, SMS) — delivered as a fully managed, Done\-For\-You service, powered by our AI\-native platform, Nudge, and backed by human experts. 
 





 We give SMBs agency\-quality marketing at a fraction of the price, across verticals from DTC and hospitality to professional services and coaching.
 





 Nudge is founded by ex\-founders and leaders of startups like MySmartPrice, Livspace and Brightchamps, and is backed by Accel and some of the biggest angels in India. We're a fast\-moving, AI\-first team where client success comes first — and we're scaling quickly.
   





**The Role** 


 You own paid social as a channel across our client portfolio. Not as a reviewer of reports — as the person in the ad account, in Events Manager fixing what's broken and deciding what runs next.
 





 We don't charge clients a percentage of ad spend. We think like their in\-house team:
 
**Our objective is their business outcome, not a billable ad spend.** 

 That changes how you'll make decisions, and it should be the single biggest motivating factor before you apply.
 





 We're looking for a channel operator
 
*and* 

 a solution builder: someone who can execute, debug, use AI intelligently, and systematise it.
   





**What you'll do** 
* Own end\-to\-end Meta delivery (and TikTok where it's relevant) — for a portfolio of US and Canadian SMBs
* Personally build, configure, troubleshoot and optimise: campaigns, tracking, audiences, feeds, tags. Not delegate it and review decks / dashboards.
* Own channel measurement end to end — pixel, CAPI, GA4, GTM, UTM architecture, offline conversions, integrations. We have great engineers when we need them but you would be the person who explains (if)why platform numbers and GA4 disagree, and which one to act on.
* Run the creative engine: hooks, angles, UGC and creator content, static vs video, testing frameworks, and iteration velocity high enough to beat fatigue.
* Diagnose performance drops to a root cause — creative, audience, tracking, landing page, offer. Test, Iterate and Improve rather than reflexively changing bids.
* Report on what moves the business (ROAS, CAC, LTV, conversion rate, incrementality), and be willing to say some metrics like reach doesn't matter as much.
* Turn everything you learn into SOPs, checklists, QA processes and playbooks — and push as much of it as possible onto the Nudge platform with the product/AI team.


**What we're looking for** 
* 4–6 years in paid social with
 
**exceptional Meta work** 

 (ideally for SMBs in US or international markets) — you've built a deep understanding of how the channel actually works, not just run campaigns on it.
* **Strong fundamentals:** 

 you can look at what a client sells, work out what appeals to their buyer, and form a point of view on how to win on the channel.
* **Meta, hands\-on:** 

 Ads Manager, Business Portfolio, Pixel, Conversions API, Events Manager, custom conversions, audiences and lookalikes, catalogs/commerce, Advantage\+, dynamic creative, retargeting, attribution.
* **Creative judgment:** 

 creative fatigue, hooks and angles, UGC and creator content, testing frameworks, audience × creative interactions, landing page and message match.
* Genuine curiosity about what AI brings to paid ads — and evidence you've built AI into real marketing workflows, not just used ChatGPT to write copy.
* **Comfort with the plumbing:** 

 tracking, pixels and tags, analytics, APIs, product feeds, integrations. Real grasp of measurement and attribution.
* Degree from a reputed college with a strong academic record(Masters is an advantage).
* Excellent written and spoken English — you'll be client\-facing.
* Willing to work the split shift and relocate to Bangalore; able to join within \~1 month
* **A strong advantage:** 

 hands\-on TikTok Ads experience.


**Why you'll love it here** 
* A direct line to the Founders and real influence over how client delivery works
* Build on an AI\-native platform that's genuinely ahead of the curve
* Outsized ownership in a fast\-growing, Accel\-backed startup
* Meaningful ESOPs — share in the upside you help create


**Compensation \& logistics**

* Medical insurance \+ lunch \+ snacks
* Reports to: Delivery Manager

title: Cofounder (Growth & Marketing)
description:
**About Tingu Tales** 
 Tingu Tales is an AI\-powered personalized storytelling platform that creates beautiful, meaningful storybooks for children in 9 Indian languages. We turn a child into the hero of their own story — personalized with their name, interests, experiences, language, and character.
 



  





 Beyond personalized creation, Tingu Tales also features a rapidly growing, curated
 **Digital \& Print Library** 
 of pre\-made, high\-quality, culturally relevant children's books. Our users can seamlessly access this library through single\-book purchases or our all\-access monthly subscriptions, with printed copies delivered directly to families at home.
 



  





 What started as a hackathon project has evolved into a real product with paying customers, hundreds of stories generated during our early beta, and a massive opportunity in the personalized children's books and digital storytelling space. We are now looking for a Growth Cofounder to join us at this pivotal stage and help scale the business.
 



  





**About the Role** 
 This is not a traditional employee role. As a Cofounder, you will be a core pillar of the company, working side\-by\-side with the founding team to take Tingu Tales from early traction to widespread adoption.
 



 You will own the entire growth engine—figuring out who our best customers are, how to reach them, how to convert them, and how to build repeatable, scalable acquisition channels around both our personalized story engine and our curated library.
 



 You will lead efforts across:
 


* **Direct\-to\-parent sales and customer acquisition** 
 (driving both one\-off book purchases and recurring monthly subscriptions)
* **Monetizing the Library:** 
 Crafting campaigns to upsell library credits and promote our pre\-made library as a standalone value proposition
* **Partnerships** 
 with schools, bookstores, parenting communities, and children's brands
* **Influencer and creator partnerships**
* **Social media and content\-led growth**
* **Community building** 
 around early childhood reading and storytelling
* **Offline events, exhibitions, and demos**
* **B2B and institutional sales opportunities** 
 (e.g., school library integrations)
* **Performance marketing and growth experiments**
* **Product positioning, pricing strategy, and messaging**
* **Tracking conversion, CAC, recurring revenue (MRR), and unit economics**



 You'll have significant ownership, equity, and the freedom to experiment aggressively to build a category\-defining brand.
 



  





**Who We're Looking For** 
 We're looking for someone who is:
 


* Extremely entrepreneurial, resilient, and comfortable with the ambiguity of an early\-stage startup
* A natural hustler who is excited to roll up their sleeves and own sales, marketing, and growth
* A strong communicator and relationship builder
* Comfortable talking to parents, schools, educators, businesses, and partners
* Willing to pick up the phone, send messages, run experiments, and close deals
* Data\-driven but also highly creative
* Able to take an idea from
 *"let's try this"* 
 → execution → measurable results
* Deeply excited about AI, children's literature, education, storytelling, or consumer technology
* Prior experience in growth, marketing, EdTech, consumer products, D2C, or SaaS is a strong plus — but an entrepreneurial mindset and undeniable execution ability matter more than credentials.


- 


**Why Join Us?** 
 If you are looking for a conventional 9\-to\-5 job, this is not the right opportunity. If you want to build a company from the ground up, own a massive chunk of the growth trajectory, and create products that bring genuine joy to children and families, we’d love to talk.
 



  





**Interested?** 
 Send us a message with:
 


1. A brief introduction about yourself
2. Your growth/startup/marketing experience
3. Why building Tingu Tales excites you
4. One idea you would try to get our first 100/1,000 active subscribers



  





 Please send the Founder linkedin.com/in/achints a LinkedIn message or email.
 



  





 Let's build the future of personalized children's storytelling together.
 



**\#Hiring \#Cofounder \#CMO \#GrowthLead \#StartupJobs \#Bengaluru \#AI \#GenerativeAI \#EdTech \#D2C \#TinguTales**
