title: Director of Product, Platform
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
**QAD** 
 is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose\-built for manufacturing industries — automotive, life sciences, food \& beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence.
   

  

 Enterprise software is entering a third era. The first gave manufacturers a System of Record — ERP that answered 'what do we have and what did we commit to?' The second gave them Data Infrastructure — the ability to move, analyse, and query that data at scale. The third era is domain\-specific intelligence: AI agents that can act autonomously on manufacturing data, but only if that data has been given the context, relationships, and governed rules that allow an agent to reason correctly.
   

  

**ERA — QAD's Enterprise Resource Allocation platform —** 
 is the domain intelligence layer that sits between any ERP and any AI agent. It encodes what manufacturing data means, governs what agents are permitted to do, and makes every autonomous decision traceable and accountable.
   

  

**Job Description**
 This role owns a key pillar of ERA — the Manufacturing Data Fabric \& Intelligence layer. This is the foundational intelligence core: the semantic layer that encodes what manufacturing data means, the metric registry that governs how business outcomes are measured, and the AI Insights and conversational analytics capabilities that surface intelligence to users and agents alike. Without this layer, the rest of ERA cannot function. It is the prerequisite for every downstream agent action, every governed decision, and every autonomous workflow ERA enables.
   

  

 As Director of Product for Data, AI, Reporting \& Analytics, you will report directly to the Head of Platform Product and lead a team of Product Managers and Technical Product Owners. Your scope is the intelligence core — not the integration layer, not the governance engine, not the developer API. You will partner closely with the Directors leading those pillars, but your mandate is singular: make manufacturing data meaningful, queryable, and AI\-ready at enterprise scale.
   

  

 This is a high\-visibility, high\-leverage role. The semantic layer is ERA's primary moat — the hardest layer to build and the one no horizontal AI platform will invest in replicating. Your roadmap decisions will compound over years and directly determine QAD's competitive positioning in the era of autonomous manufacturing.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Foundation Exists — The Mandate Now Is To Build ERA's Intelligence Core Into The Definitive Manufacturing Ontology Platform. You Will Have The Scope To
   

  

* Define and own the manufacturing semantic layer — encoding supplier criticality, lead time patterns, quality thresholds, and operational constraints in a form AI agents can reason from
* Build the contextual intelligence layer that passes metric definitions, data distributions, and business rules to LLMs for accurate, anomaly\-aware narrative generation
* Drive QAD's conversational analytics strategy — enabling non\-technical manufacturing users to query operations in natural language without SQL or BI expertise
* Establish the AI evaluation framework that governs quality, accuracy, and latency of every AI\-generated insight shipped to enterprise customers
* Evolve the platform from reactive reporting to proactive, agentic intelligence — where the system surfaces recommended actions, not just data


**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Strategy \& Roadmap**
* Own the multi\-year product roadmap for ERA's Manufacturing Data Fabric \& Intelligence layer — from raw data pipeline to user\-facing AI insights
* Define the manufacturing semantic layer: encoding metric definitions, operational constraints, supplier relationships, and business rules into a governed ontology that AI agents can reason from
* Translate QAD's ERA vision into concrete, sequenced product bets for the intelligence core — partnering with Directors leading the Integration, Governance, and API pillars to ensure the full platform coheres
* Lead the evolution of AI Insights capabilities: contextual anomaly detection, plain\-language narrative generation, and agentic root cause analysis


**AI \& Conversational Analytics**
* Drive the conversational analytics product — ontology design, knowledge graph, context graph, and intent detection for natural language querying
* Establish and own the AI evaluation framework: latency, accuracy, relevancy gates, LLM\-as\-judge, and human\-in\-the\-loop oversight
* Architect the contextual layer that passes metadata, data distributions, and business rules to LLMs for accurate, enterprise\-grade output
* Define QAD's approach to agentic AI — moving from reactive Q\&A to proactive, action\-triggering intelligence within ERP workflows


**Enterprise Self\-Service Reporting**
* Own the product strategy for self\-service report building — enabling business users across manufacturing, finance, supply chain, and operations to create, customise, and share reports without engineering dependency
* Define the RBAC model for reporting: row\-level and column\-level access controls, report sharing permissions, data scoping by plant, region, and business unit — ensuring enterprise customers can safely deploy self\-service capabilities across large, complex org structures
* Lead the go\-to\-market and rollout strategy for self\-service reporting across B2B industry verticals — working with Customer Success and Solutions Engineering to drive adoption, define onboarding playbooks, and reduce time\-to\-value for enterprise deployments
* Set the product bar for enterprise\-grade report authoring: scheduling, export, embedding, white\-labelling, and audit trails that meet the compliance and operational needs of regulated industries
* Establish feedback loops with enterprise customers to continuously refine the self\-service experience — tracking adoption metrics, identifying capability gaps, and prioritising the roadmap against real user workflows


**Data Infrastructure \& Intelligence**
* Partner with Engineering to define the data lake, pipeline, and event architecture that underpins ERA's intelligence layer — optimising for AI\-readiness, scale, and cost efficiency
* Own the metric registry and semantic data model — ensuring consistent, governed definitions of manufacturing KPIs across all ERA consumers
* Collaborate with the Governance \& Compliance pillar to ensure intelligence outputs meet enterprise compliance requirements; own the data quality and freshness standards within your layer
* Define monetization strategy for intelligence platform capabilities including governed data exports, delta sharing, and partner integrations


**GTM, Sales \& Market Enablement**
* Act as the product authority for Sales and Marketing on ERA's Data, AI, and Analytics capabilities — providing positioning, messaging, and competitive differentiation across the full intelligence layer, not just reporting
* Partner with GTM teams to develop selling motions for AI Insights, conversational analytics, and self\-service reporting — translating platform capabilities into clear business value narratives for manufacturing buyers
* Build and maintain sales enablement assets: demo environments, capability decks, objection\-handling guides, and ROI frameworks that equip field teams to position the intelligence layer confidently
* Engage with Marketing on thought leadership, analyst relations, and campaign strategy — ensuring QAD's AI and analytics narrative reflects the depth and differentiation of what the platform can actually deliver
* Work with Solutions Engineering and Pre\-Sales on complex enterprise deals — providing product depth in discovery, RFP responses, and proof\-of\-concept engagements where the intelligence layer is a key differentiator


**Customer Discovery \& UX Partnership**
* Maintain a structured and continuous customer discovery programme — conducting regular interviews, site visits, and advisory sessions with manufacturing customers across segments and geographies
* Translate customer discovery into sharp problem definitions and validated hypotheses before committing roadmap resources — ensuring the team builds what the market needs, not what it assumes
* Serve as a named executive contact for key enterprise customers and design partners; build relationships that provide early access to real workflows, pain points, and adoption barriers
* Partner closely with UX and Design from problem framing through to launch — ensuring the intelligence layer is not just technically capable but genuinely usable by non\-technical manufacturing users
* Champion the user in internal prioritisation debates; bring customer evidence — not opinion — to roadmap and trade\-off discussions


**Leadership \& Stakeholder Management**
* Lead and grow a team of PMs and TPOs; create a high\-performance, execution\-focused product culture with strong discovery and delivery discipline
* Drive alignment across Product, Engineering, UX, Customer Success, Sales, and Executive leadership on platform priorities and sequencing
* Represent the Data, AI \& Analytics platform in senior leadership forums, including roadmap reviews with the President's office


**Qualifications**
**Experience**
* 15\+ years in product management, with significant time in data platforms, analytics, or AI/ML products in enterprise SaaS environments
* Proven track record owning 0\-to\-1 and scale\-up AI Insights or analytics platforms — from early access through enterprise GA
* Experience in ERP, CRM, or broader B2B enterprise software; deep familiarity with the data needs of complex enterprise operations
* Demonstrated ability to drive measurable outcomes: user growth, CSAT improvement, cost optimization, and revenue expansion through platform capabilities
* Prior experience working directly with Sales, Pre\-Sales, and Marketing to build GTM motions and enablement for platform or data products — not just handing off a roadmap but actively participating in market positioning and deals
* History of structured customer discovery practice — conducting interviews, running advisory boards, or embedding with customers to build evidence\-based roadmaps


**Technical Depth**
* Hands\-on fluency with: LLM evaluation frameworks, semantic layer design, knowledge graphs, RAG architectures, conversational analytics, and agentic AI
* Strong command of data platform architecture: Snowflake, Databricks, delta sharing, ETL/ELT, event\-driven pipelines, federated search
* Ability to engage deeply with engineering on infrastructure trade\-offs — pipeline cost, performance at scale, and AI feature architecture
* Working knowledge of SQL, data modelling, and API design sufficient to hold authoritative technical conversations


**Leadership \& Communication**
* Director\-level leadership maturity: translates business strategy into functional plans, reconciles multi\-stakeholder views, and drives execution across matrixed organizations
* Comfortable operating on complex, ambiguous problems where established frameworks don't apply — defines the approach, not just follows one
* Makes decisions with long\-horizon awareness; understands that platform architecture choices compound over years and plans accordingly
* Proven experience building and scaling product teams; consistent track record of developing strong PMs and fostering a culture of ownership
* Excellent executive communication — makes complex platform decisions accessible to non\-technical senior leaders and enterprise customers alike
* Actively engages with major customers and cross\-functional leaders; able to negotiate priorities and build consensus across competing stakeholder views
* Strong collaborator with UX and Design — understands that intelligence platform adoption lives or dies on usability, not just capability


**Preferred Background**
* Prior experience at enterprise SaaS companies scaling AI/analytics platforms to multi\-thousand customer deployments
* Familiarity with manufacturing ERP data models, production operations, or supply chain analytics is a strong plus
* Experience defining and owning monetization strategy for data or AI platform features
* Patents, publications, or open\-source contributions in AI, data infrastructure, or analytics are valued


**Why This Role at QAD**
* Direct impact: Your roadmap decisions will shape AI capabilities used by thousands of manufacturers worldwide
* Strategic mandate: This is not a maintenance role — it is a build mandate at the intersection of AI, data, and enterprise ERP
* Executive visibility: You will operate at the centre of QAD's platform transformation, with direct access to the President's office and cross\-functional leadership
* Pune platform hub: QAD is actively expanding its platform engineering and product capabilities in India — you will be a founding voice in that growth


**Additional Information**
* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work\-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard\-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea\-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set


**About QAD**
 QAD \| Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD \| Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.
   

  

 QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.
   

  

 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

title: Social Media Strategist
description:
Role Overview
 
 As a
 **Social Media Strategist** 
 , you will be responsible for developing social media strategies and content directions for brands and campaigns.
 



 You will work closely with the Strategy, Creative, Influencer Marketing, Planning, and Revenue teams to develop ideas that are
 **platform\-native, culturally relevant, creator\-friendly, and aligned with brand objectives** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate is someone who spends a lot of time understanding social media, follows emerging trends closely, knows why certain content works, and can translate those observations into actionable strategies.
 



 This role requires a combination of
 **strategic thinking, cultural understanding, content expertise, platform knowledge, and strong execution skills** 
 .
 



  





  




 Key Responsibilities1\. Social Media Strategy
 * Develop comprehensive social media strategies based on brand objectives, target audiences, category dynamics, and platform behaviour.
* Translate business and communication objectives into clear social media strategies.
* Define the role of different social platforms within a campaign or brand ecosystem.
* Develop content pillars, themes, formats, and communication territories.
* Build social strategies for launches, campaigns, always\-on communication, and influencer\-led initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to make brand communication more relevant to current social conversations and cultural moments.
* Develop platform\-specific approaches rather than applying the same content strategy across all platforms.



  





  




 2\. Content Strategy \& Ideation
 * Develop content ideas that are relevant, engaging, and aligned with the brand's positioning.
* Create content frameworks and creative territories for social platforms.
* Develop campaign concepts that can be translated into creator\-led and social\-first content.
* Work closely with creative teams to convert strategic thinking into strong content ideas.
* Develop hooks, content angles, storytelling approaches, and formats for different platforms.
* Identify opportunities for short\-form video, reels, carousels, stories, memes, creator content, and other emerging formats.
* Ensure ideas are both strategically relevant and realistically executable.



  





  




 3\. Social \& Cultural Trends
 * Stay highly updated on Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.
* Track emerging formats, memes, trends, creators, communities, conversations, and cultural moments.
* Identify trends that can be meaningfully connected to brands.
* Distinguish between short\-lived trends and trends with genuine strategic relevance.
* Build regular trend reports or trend\-led recommendations for internal and client teams.
* Identify opportunities for brands to participate in relevant conversations without appearing forced or disconnected.
* Maintain a strong understanding of changing social\-media behaviour and audience preferences.



  





  




 4\. Influencer \& Creator Strategy
 * Develop influencer strategies aligned with the overall social media and communication strategy.
* Recommend creator profiles based on audience, content style, credibility, relevance, and campaign objectives.
* Define the role creators should play within a campaign.
* Develop creator content directions, storytelling frameworks, and content territories.
* Identify opportunities for creators to create content that feels native to their communities rather than overly branded.
* Collaborate with Planning and Talent Management teams to identify relevant creators.
* Provide clear strategic direction to creators while allowing sufficient creative freedom.
* Evaluate creator content from a strategic and brand perspective.



  





  




 5\. Campaign Strategy
 * Develop strategic frameworks for influencer and social media campaigns.
* Understand the campaign brief and identify the core communication challenge.
* Define the campaign thought, communication territory, audience insight, and content approach.
* Develop campaign narratives that can be executed across multiple creators and platforms.
* Build campaign journeys from awareness to engagement and action where relevant.
* Develop strategic presentations and campaign proposals for internal and client\-facing discussions.
* Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute strategic and creative thinking.
* Ensure campaign ideas are differentiated, relevant, and aligned with the brand.



  





  




 6\. Social Listening \& Audience Insights
 * Monitor social conversations and audience behaviour around relevant categories and brands.
* Identify audience pain points, interests, behaviours, and content preferences.
* Conduct social listening and competitor analysis.
* Identify gaps and opportunities in the brand's current social presence.
* Track competitor campaigns, creator partnerships, content formats, and communication approaches.
* Convert observations into actionable insights and recommendations.
* Use social and audience insights to continuously improve content strategy.

 This role owns the CRM and Marketing Technologies strategy and roadmap for A\&M’s growing India Global Capability Center. The position is accountable for orchestrating projects and initiatives across CRM, marketing automation, analytics, AI and broader MarTech ecosystems. Success requires strong MarTech/CRM expertise, marketing business and technology transformation experience, and proven project, change and stakeholder management. You will connect Marketing, IT, data teams and business units to improve integration, data quality, channel execution and decision\-making. The role combines strategic planning with hands\-on execution, ensuring solutions are fit for purpose, adopted by users and aligned with compliance expectations. You will also act as a trusted subject matter expert, shaping investment choices and recommending innovations that improve marketing effectiveness, operational efficiency and measurable business outcomes.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the CRM and MarTech strategy and roadmap, converting marketing objectives into sequenced initiatives, investment priorities and capabilities that improve campaign effectiveness, operational efficiency and stakeholder outcomes.
* Lead delivery of CRM, marketing automation, analytics, AI and channel technology projects through structured governance, milestones, risk controls and benefits tracking that keep transformation initiatives on schedule.
* Translate business requirements into technical capabilities, solution designs and prioritized backlogs, ensuring platforms and processes support scalable, compliant and measurable multi\-channel marketing execution.
* Partner with data teams to improve infrastructure, data quality and integration across databases and MarTech components, enabling reliable customer insights, segmentation, activation and reporting.
* Establish and improve marketing operating models, processes and organization structures through technology\-enabled transformation, clarifying ownership and increasing consistency across business units and geographies.
* Analyze marketing performance data and convert findings into improvement initiatives, recommendations and executive\-ready insights that strengthen strategy, resource allocation and business decision\-making.
* Manage stakeholder alignment across Marketing, IT, data teams, business units and vendors, resolving dependencies and building credibility through clear communication, negotiation and outcome\-focused governance.
* Monitor MarTech trends, compliance requirements and vendor capabilities, recommending innovations and managing integrations that improve effectiveness while addressing customer\-data obligations such as GDPR and CCPA.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Strong expertise across CRM, marketing automation, MarTech platforms, channels, AI and analytics tools, with the ability to connect business requirements to practical technical functionality and integrated solutions.
* Demonstrated marketing business and technology transformation experience, including operating\-model design, process improvement, product or project delivery and adoption of new capabilities across matrixed organizations.
* Advanced project, change and stakeholder management skills, supported by analytical thinking, vendor negotiation, troubleshooting, executive communication and customer\-data compliance awareness.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* PMP, CPM or comparable project and product management certification is an advantage, particularly where it demonstrates disciplined delivery, governance and benefits realization across complex transformation programs.
* Experience working with global marketing organizations, distributed stakeholders and cross\-regional CRM initiatives is beneficial, especially within consulting, professional services or other matrixed environments.
* Exposure to emerging MarTech, AI, analytics and automation trends is valuable when paired with sound judgment about adoption, integration effort, governance and measurable business impact.



  





**What You'll Bring** 




 You bring 10–12 years of relevant experience managing marketing technology platforms and systems, with total professional experience typically ranging from 10 to 15 years. Your background demonstrates strong MarTech and CRM expertise, combined with marketing business and technology transformation experience. You have led complex projects or products from strategy through implementation, using structured governance, change management and stakeholder alignment to deliver adoption and measurable results. You understand how Marketing organizations operate, how processes and operating models shape performance, and how technical capabilities can solve business priorities. You are comfortable working across CRM, marketing automation, analytics, AI, channels, data infrastructure and platform integrations. You use data to diagnose performance, shape recommendations and guide decisions. You can negotiate with vendors, troubleshoot issues, manage deadlines and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders and delivery teams. You understand customer\-data compliance considerations, including GDPR and CCPA, and can operate effectively in a matrix environment. A bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Technology, Business Administration or a related field is required. You are organized, detail\-oriented, credible, collaborative and accountable for outcomes rather than activity.
 



  





**Why Join Us** 




 At A\&M, you will own technology\-enabled marketing transformation within a rapidly growing Global Capability Center that works directly with global business units and case teams. Your decisions will influence how CRM, MarTech, data and automation capabilities scale across major markets and industries. The role offers the opportunity to shape strategy and roadmap while remaining close to implementation, adoption and measurable business impact. You will work alongside experienced consultants, technologists, data professionals and leaders across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, gaining exposure to complex operating models and diverse client environments. A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture rewards independent thinking, practical problem\-solving and professionals who create visible results. The organization supports continuous learning through formal training, on\-the\-job development and performance conversations that recognize contribution and encourage progression. You will join a center that is expanding its capabilities, strengthening its global delivery model and investing in specialized talent. This is an opportunity to build enduring platforms, improve how marketing operates and grow as a transformation leader in a collaborative, inclusive environment.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* A\&M supports continuous professional development through structured performance conversations, formal training and on\-the\-job learning that help employees build capabilities and progress through a meritocratic environment.
* Employees receive resources and support focused on personal well\-being, enabling sustainable performance while contributing to meaningful work in a collaborative and inclusive culture.
* The role offers exposure to global markets, senior stakeholders, multiple industries and cross\-functional transformation initiatives within a rapidly growing India Global Capability Center.

title: Content Marketing Associate
description:
At Aftershoot, we’re building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post\-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world.
   

  

 From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.
   

  

 We’re a fast\-growing, passionate team backed over 100K\+ active users globally. Double\-digit ARR in less than 4 years, amazing investors and team who truly believe in our mission.
   

  

 Our mission is clear: Become the default companion for every photographer in the world.
   

  

 If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

 Let’s create the future of AI in photography, together.
   

  

 🚀
 **Your Mission:**
 Aftershoot is a leading AI\-powered post\-production software company with over 200,000 users and tens of thousands of customers. We are looking for a Content Writer to join our dynamic marketing team. As a Content Marketing Manager, you'll be responsible for executing the company's content strategy and driving engagement through various channels. We're seeking a creative individual with strong writing skills and the ability to produce content that resonates with our audience of professional photographers.
   

  

 🎯
 **What You Will Do:**
* Execute content strategies that drive measurable business outcomes, including user acquisition and conversions.
* Grow the Aftershoot blog into a valuable resource for photographers while optimising content for SEO and AI platforms
* Create diverse content assets (guides, ebooks, templates) that help us to build trust and generate results
* Identify, prioritise, and implement new content opportunities to drive organic growth
* Manage content production schedules, working with freelancers and agencies to scale output and optimise ROI
* Collaborate across teams (marketing, design, product, SEO) to ensure content aligns with brand messaging and performance goals
* Build and nurture relationships with partners and industry influencers to extend content reach
* Monitor content performance metrics and provide regular reports with insights for improvement
* Contribute to content planning for newsletters, social media, and video channels to ensure cohesive messaging
* Maintain consistent brand voice while adapting to different platforms and audience needs


 💪
 **What We're Looking For:**
* 2\-4 years of experience in content marketing, writing, editing, or a related field
* Strong storytelling abilities and writing skills, with a portfolio of published work
* Basic understanding of SEO principles and content optimisation techniques
* Experience using analytics tools to track content performance
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail
* Experience in B2B content marketing preferred
* Familiarity with the photography industry a plus but not required


**What happens after you apply?**
* Step 1: If your profile aligns with our vibe and requirements for the role, our people team will reach out to you for a brief phone call.
* Step 2: If everything aligns, your next chat will be with one of your future team members to better understand the role and your experience.
* Step 3: You will then be given a task \- this helps us evaluate your thought process and help you showcase your expertise.
* Step 4: If everything goes well, you will meet the leadership for a quick bar\-raiser round.
* Step 5: If you do manage to clear all rounds, this is the point we make an offer, shake hands, and welcome you to the team.


**You will work with:**
* Captain: Vrushti
* Team Members: Sriyanka, Vasundhara and the rest of the Aftershoot team.

title: Retention Marketing Executive
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Retention Marketing Executive to drive customer engagement, repeat purchases, and retention for a growing healthcare and wellness brand.
 



 This role focuses on the complete customer lifecycle — lead → purchase → product experience → repeat purchase. You will be responsible for converting interested leads, reducing customer drop\-offs, and increasing repeat revenue through WhatsApp, email, CRM, and marketing automation.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Plan and execute segmented WhatsApp and email campaigns for different customer lifecycle stages.
* Build lead nurture journeys for quiz\-takers, enquiries, checkout abandoners and other prospects.
* Create post\-purchase journeys covering onboarding, reminders, product experience, repeat purchase and win\-back.
* Develop and manage CRM and marketing automation workflows using triggers, timing and customer behaviour.
* Segment customers based on lifecycle stage, purchase history, engagement, recency/frequency, and other relevant data.
* Write clear, persuasive and customer\-focused WhatsApp and email communication.
* Analyse retention, repeat purchase, cohort and funnel data to identify customer drop\-offs and opportunities.
* Track campaign performance and continuously test messaging, timing, segmentation and CTAs.
* Monitor WhatsApp and email health, including opt\-outs, engagement, deliverability and compliance.
* Work closely with marketing, sales, and customer experience teams to improve the overall customer journey.
* Ensure all healthcare\-related communication follows responsible marketing and communication practices.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 1–3 years of experience in Retention Marketing, CRM, Lifecycle Marketing, Email Marketing, WhatsApp Marketing, or Growth Marketing.
* Hands\-on experience managing WhatsApp and email campaigns.
* Experience with CRM/marketing automation tools and customer journey creation.
* Strong understanding of segmentation, customer lifecycle, retention, and repeat purchase marketing.
* Ability to analyse campaign and customer data and turn insights into actionable campaigns.
* Good copywriting skills with a strong understanding of customer psychology.
* Familiarity with cohort analysis, RFM, funnel metrics and retention KPIs is an advantage.
* Strong execution, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience in healthcare, wellness, D2C or consumer brands is preferred but not mandatory.



  





**Success in This Role** 




 Your primary goal will be to convert more existing leads, reduce customer drop\-offs, increase repeat purchases, and grow retention revenue.
 



 We are looking for someone who can move beyond simply sending campaigns and understand who should receive what message, at what stage, through which channel, and why.

title: Social Media & Content Creation Lead | 2-4 years | Faridabad (WFO)| upto 10LPA
description:
**Social Media \& Content Creation Lead \|** 




**Full\-time \|** 




**Reporting to: Brand Manager \|** 




**Location: Faridabad (in\-office)** 




  





**TARGET CANDIDATE PROFILE 2–4 years in social media or content creation • Strong short\-form portfolio • Comfortable on camera • Beauty, lifestyle or D2C experience preferred** 




**About the opportunity** 




**fast\-growing beauty and personal\-care company with in\-house manufacturing and R\&D, and multiple consumer brands.** 




**We are building organic social as a repeatable content engine, not a posting calendar. Working under the Brand Manager, you will personally take ideas from hook to script to camera to edit to publish, then use the numbers to decide what deserves another iteration. This is a hands\-on creator role with real ownership, not an agency\-coordination position.** 




**The essentials** 



1. **Experience: 2–4 years in social media management, content creation, brand content or a closely related role.**
2. **Location: Faridabad, Haryana. In office, five days a week, with on\-site shoots when required.**
3. **On\-camera work: Mandatory. You should be confident presenting products, tutorials, demonstrations and brand stories on video.**
4. **Production: You must be able to script, shoot and edit Reels, Shorts and other platform\-native short\-form content yourself.**
5. **Role type: Strong individual contributor. You may coordinate designers or photographers when needed, but you remain personally accountable for output and quality.**
6. **Terms: Full time. Six\-month probation. No bond and no lock\-in. Statutory PF and gratuity apply.**
7. **Reporting: Brand Manager; working closely with Creative and Performance Marketing.**
8. **Start date: Immediate joining preferred.**
9. 



**What you will actually build** 




**The mandate is to create a durable organic\-content capability across our beauty brands:** 



1. **A platform\-first content system: clear content pillars, recurring series, formats and channel roles for each brand.**
2. **A reliable short\-form engine: a fast weekly rhythm from insight and hook to script, shoot, edit, caption and publish.**
3. **A recognisable on\-camera presence: credible demonstrations, tutorials, problem\-solution stories and product education that feel native to the platform.**
4. **A disciplined social operating rhythm: calendars, approvals, publishing, community responses and an organised content library.**
5. **A measurable learning loop: weekly reviews that identify winning hooks and formats, then turn them into repeatable series and stronger briefs.**



**What the job involves** 



1. **Turning the Brand Manager’s priorities into monthly calendars and weekly production plans with clear objectives for every piece.**
2. **Researching audience problems, product truths, trends, and cultural moments, then converting them into original content ideas.**
3. **Writing hooks, scripts, captions, calls to action and thumbnail text in a clear, distinctive brand voice.**
4. **Appearing on camera and directing your own performance until the delivery feels natural, credible and platform\-native.**
5. **Shooting clean footage with strong framing, lighting and audio, then editing for pace, retention, subtitles and mobile viewing.**
6. **Publishing consistently across Instagram and YouTube Shorts, and adapting content for other relevant channels when required.**
7. **Managing comments and community conversations, and feeding recurring questions or objections back to the Brand Manager.**
8. **Reviewing watch time, completion, shares, saves, profile visits and organic traffic; testing new hooks instead of defending weak content.**
9. **Handing proven organic assets to Performance Marketing for amplification. You will not own media buying or paid\-campaign optimisation.**



**What we are looking for** 



1. **A portfolio that proves personal contribution. We want to see content you conceived, scripted, presented, shot or edited, not only work produced by an agency.**
2. **Strong short\-form craft: hooks, structure, pacing, framing, lighting, audio, subtitles and a clear reason to keep watching.**
3. **Comfort with at least one practical editing workflow, such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro or an equivalent tool.**
4. **Good writing and visual judgment. You can recognise a weak hook, cluttered frame or generic caption before it goes live.**
5. **Speed with standards. You can publish at a steady cadence without letting brand voice, accuracy or finish collapse.**
6. **Analytical discipline. You understand that reach and followers are signals, while retention, shares, saves, profile visits and traffic reveal whether content worked.**
7. **High ownership and openness to direct feedback. You can reshoot, recut and improve without treating every revision as a creative disagreement.**

title: Meller India Head
description:
**Mission Brief: Build and Scale Meller as a Business in India** 




  





 Meller, Lenskart's Barcelona\-born, D2C\-first sunglasses brand is entering its next chapter in India. Known for bold silhouettes, expressive colourways, and a design language rooted in Barcelona's street culture, Meller has a cult following of 700K\+ on Instagram and a strong Gen Z and Millennial fan base across Europe and the U.S.
 



  





 This role owns Meller as a business in India end\-to\-end P\&L, growth strategy, and operational execution across retail, e\-commerce, and marketing. Sitting at Lenskart's India HQ, you will effectively run Meller India as a founder would: setting the strategy, building the team, and making the commercial, brand, and operational calls that turn Meller to a category\-leading sunglasses brand in India.
 



  





 This is a builder's role at the intersection of business leadership, brand, and retail. You'll work closely with the global Meller team in Barcelona, Lenskart's leadership, and internal functions spanning category, retail, e\-commerce, supply chain, and finance while building a lean India team to execute the mission.
 



  





**🔑 Core Mandate: Business Ownership \& P\&L Leadership** 




  





**1\. Business Strategy \& P\&L Ownership (The Founder Focus)** 




**P\&L Ownership:** 
 Own Meller India's P\&L end\-to\-end — revenue, margin, and profitability — making the trade\-offs needed to build a healthy, scaling business.
 



**Business Strategy:** 
 Define and drive Meller's India growth strategy — market entry sequencing, channel mix, pricing, and expansion roadmap across retail and online.
 



**Brand Architecture Fit:** 
 Position Meller within Lenskart's house\-of\-brands portfolio (alongside John Jacobs, Owndays, and Le Petit Lunetier), with clear differentiation in price, design, and audience.
 



**Investment \& Resource Allocation:** 
 Decide where to invest — stores, marketing, people, technology — to maximise growth and return, and build the business case for future investment.
 



  





**2\. Retail, Category \& Channel Execution (The Growth Focus)** 




**Retail Rollout \& Performance:** 
 Own store performance and expansion across the \~500 launch stores and beyond — driving sell\-through, productivity, and the store economics that justify further rollout.
 



**Category \& Assortment Strategy:** 
 Partner with category and buying teams to shape the assortment strategy, ensuring product\-market fit for Indian consumers while staying true to Meller's global design DNA.
 



**E\-commerce \& D2C Growth:** 
 Drive Meller's presence and growth across Lenskart's app, website, and D2C channels, balancing brand experience with commercial performance.
 



**Channel \& Partnership Development:** 
 Identify and build new channels and partnerships — marketplaces, collaborations, wholesale, or others — that extend Meller's reach in India.
 



  





**3\. Brand, Marketing \& Consumer Experience** 




**Brand Custodianship:** 
 Ensure Meller's brand voice, positioning, and consumer experience in India stay true to its bold, design\-led, youth\-first DNA within global brand guidelines.
 



**Marketing Strategy Oversight:** 
 Set the direction for Meller's marketing engine in India — brand campaigns, influencer and community building, and performance marketing — and hold the team accountable for outcomes.
 



**Consumer Insight:** 
 Build a strong read on the Indian Gen Z and Millennial consumer — fashion trends, buying behaviour, and sentiment — to keep Meller's proposition sharp.
 



  





**4\. Global Coordination, Team \& Stakeholder Leadership** 




**Global Coordination:** 
 Serve as the primary interface between the Barcelona\-based Meller team and Lenskart's India leadership — aligning on strategy, brand consistency, and market learnings.
 



**Cross\-Functional Leadership:** 
 Work closely with Retail, E\-commerce, Category, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure the business runs as one integrated system.
 



**Team Building:** 
 Build, mentor, and lead a lean, high\-performing India team capable of running Meller as an independent, founder\-led business within Lenskart.
 



**Leadership Reporting:** 
 Own business reviews and reporting cadences with Lenskart and Meller global leadership — covering performance, strategy, and course corrections.
 



  





**The Essentials** 




  




* **Experience:** 
 Proven experience in business leadership, general management, or P\&L ownership roles, with meaningful experience building or scaling a D2C brand; exposure to fashion/lifestyle, retail, or consumer brands is a strong plus, as is an entrepreneurial bent of mind.
* **P\&L \& Commercial Acumen:** 
 Proven ability to own and grow a P\&L — balancing revenue growth, margin, and working capital while making sound commercial trade\-offs.
* **Brand \& Retail Understanding:** 
 Strong grounding in brand building, retail operations, and consumer behaviour, particularly within fashion, lifestyle, or eyewear categories.
* **Entrepreneurial Track Record:** 
 Experience building or scaling a business, brand, or new market with founder\-like ownership, ideally in a fast\-growing or category\-disrupting environment.
* **Cross\-Border Collaboration:** 
 Experience or strong aptitude for working with global teams, balancing brand consistency with local market relevance.
* **Stakeholder \& Team Leadership:** 
 Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams and influence senior leaders across commercial, retail, marketing, and finance functions.
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor's or Master's in Business, Marketing, Economics, or a related discipline. MBA preferred.



  





**🧠 The Mindset** 




  




* **Founder's Mentality:** 
 You think and act like you own the business — chasing outcomes, not just tasks, and taking full accountability for Meller's success in India.
* **Brand Storyteller:** 
 You understand how to turn a brand's design DNA into stories and experiences that resonate with a new generation of consumers.
* **Globally Minded, Locally Grounded:** 
 You carry a brand's global identity faithfully while adapting it with nuance for Indian consumers and platforms.
* **Commercially Grounded:** 
 You balance brand ambition with the discipline of running a healthy, profitable business.
* **Entrepreneurial Bent of Mind:** 
 You're comfortable with ambiguity, quick to take ownership, resourceful with limited support, and driven to make things happen rather than wait for a playbook.
* **Collaborative Operator** 
 : You move easily between strategic, creative, and commercial conversations, working across category, retail, and global brand teams to get things done.
* **Execution\-Focused:** 
 You don't just set strategy — you see it through, chase details, and hold the bar high at every touchpoint.

title: Manager - Content Strategy
description:
**Role Overview:** 




 We are looking for a Content Strategist to lead content planning and execution across its international markets. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution — owning the content roadmap while also shaping creator briefs, performance creative, and e\-commerce storytelling across different markets.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**International Content Strategy** 



* Develop and own the annual and quarterly content strategy for Fast\&Up’s international markets.
* Build market\-specific content pillars based on consumer behaviour, cultural nuances, sporting calendars and business priorities.
* Identify content opportunities around sports, fitness, wellness, hydration, lifestyle and cultural moments.



**Social Media Content** 



* Own content strategy for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and other relevant platforms.
* Develop concepts for Reels, TikToks, static content, carousels, stories and other social formats.
* Identify trends, formats, sounds, conversations and cultural moments relevant to each market.
* Ensure content is optimized for engagement, reach and discovery.



**Creator \& Influencer Content** 



* Work closely with the creator/influencer team to develop briefs and content directions.
* Develop creative briefs for different creator cohorts and use cases.
* Identify opportunities to convert creator content into paid media assets.



**Performance Content** 



* Develop strategy for content specifically for Meta, TikTok and other paid platforms.
* Develop creative testing frameworks across hooks, formats, messaging, CTAs and audiences.
* Analyse performance data and feed learnings back into content strategy.



**E\-commerce Content** 



* Work with e\-commerce teams to ensure strong product storytelling and consistency across all platforms.
* Help Develop enhanced product content, A\+ content, banners, videos and platform\-specific assets.
* Ensure brand consistency across D2C and marketplace environments.



**Team \& Agency Management** 



* Manage internal content resources, copywriters, editors and external agencies/creators.
* Build efficient content workflows and approval processes across international markets.
* Brief creative teams and ensure timely delivery of assets.
* Maintain high standards of quality and brand consistency.



**Market \& Competitor Intelligence** 



* Track competitors and emerging brands across international markets.
* Monitor social and cultural trends in the Europe, GCC, South East Asia and other markets.



  





**Work Exp:** 




 5–8 years of experience in content strategy, brand marketing, or social media, ideally with exposure to international/global markets.
 



  





**Skills:** 



* Strong understanding of social platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube) — their formats, algorithms, and what drives engagement in each.
* Proven experience briefing and directing creators/influencers, with an eye for what makes content authentic vs. branded.
* Familiarity with performance marketing content — understands how creative testing (hooks, formats, CTAs) ties back to paid media results.
* Cultural fluency or working experience across different international markets.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to write and evaluate briefs with clarity.
* Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, or a small internal content team.
* Comfortable working with data — can read performance dashboards and translate numbers into content decisions.

title: DIGITAL MARKETING & LEAD GENERATION EXECUTIVE
description:
**Company Description** 
 Journey Partner, founded in November 2021, is a travel solutions provider serving clients across India and internationally for tours, travel, and MICE requirements. The company has organized domestic travel across diverse regions of India, including Jammu \& Kashmir, Rajasthan, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Andaman \& Nicobar Islands, Eastern and North Eastern states, and Gujarat. Internationally, Journey Partner has supported travel to destinations in South East Asia, the Middle East, Europe, the USA, and Africa. Countries frequently served include Japan, Singapore, Vietnam, Malaysia, Thailand, Cambodia, Sri Lanka, Maldives, Bhutan, UAE, Türkiye, Russia, Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Greece, France, the UK, USA, Italy, and Kenya. The organization focuses on delivering reliable, tailored travel experiences for a wide range of customer needs.
   

  

**Role Objective**
 To drive Journey Partner’s digital growth by improving online visibility, generating qualified business leads and strengthening engagement across search engines, social media, website and other digital channels.
   

  

 The role will have end\-to\-end responsibility for digital marketing activities, with a strong emphasis on measurable lead generation and conversion
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 \*\*1\. Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)\*\*
   

  

 \* Develop and execute on\-page, off\-page and technical SEO initiatives.
   

 \* Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis and search trend analysis.
   

 \* Improve organic ranking for relevant travel, holiday, corporate travel and MICE\-related searches.
   

 \* Optimise website pages, blogs, destination content and landing pages.
   

 \* Monitor performance through Google Search Console, GA4 and appropriate SEO tools.
   

  

 \*\*2\. Lead Generation \& Performance Marketing\*\*
   

  

 \* Plan and execute digital campaigns for generating qualified enquiries.
   

 \* Generate leads for domestic and international holidays, corporate travel, MICE and other Journey Partner services.
   

 \* Design campaign funnels and landing pages to improve conversion.
   

 \* Track leads from source through enquiry and conversion.
   

 \* Continuously improve cost per lead and quality of leads.
   

  

 \*\*3\. Google Ads\*\*
   

  

 \* Independently plan and manage Google Search, Display, remarketing and other relevant campaigns.
   

 \* Undertake keyword planning, audience targeting, bidding and budget optimisation.
   

 \* Monitor CPC, CTR, conversion rate, CPL and ROI.
   

 \* Optimise campaigns based on actual business results.
   

  

 \*\*4\. Social Media \& Meta Marketing\*\*
   

  

 \* Manage Journey Partner’s presence across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube and other relevant platforms.
   

 \* Plan and execute Meta advertising campaigns.
   

 \* Develop monthly social media and campaign calendars.
   

 \* Increase meaningful reach, engagement, enquiries and conversions.
   

  

 \*\*5\. Digital Content Creation\*\*
   

  

 \* Create engaging destination content, promotional posts, reels, short videos, campaign creatives and advertisements.
   

 \* Develop digital content around customer experiences, destinations, offers, festivals and travel trends.
   

 \* Prepare SEO\-friendly website and blog content.
   

 \* Coordinate photography/video/content requirements wherever necessary.
   

  

 \*\*6\. Website \& Digital Presence\*\*
   

  

 \* Regularly review and update website content, packages, offers and landing pages.
   

 \* Improve website user journey and calls\-to\-action.
   

 \* Work towards increasing organic traffic, enquiries and conversion.
   

 \* Coordinate with website/technical service providers where specialist intervention is required.
   

  

 \*\*7\. Analytics \& Performance Reporting\*\*
   

  

 \* Monitor GA4, Google Search Console, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager and social\-media analytics.
   

 \* Prepare monthly digital performance dashboards.
   

 \* Analyse source\-wise leads and conversions.
   

 \* Recommend corrective actions based on data and campaign performance.
   

  

 \#\#\# Key Performance Indicators
   

  

 Performance will primarily be evaluated through:
   

  

 \* Qualified leads generated
   

 \* Cost per qualified lead
   

 \* Lead\-to\-conversion ratio
   

 \* Revenue generated from digital leads
   

 \* Return on advertising spend
   

 \* Organic search growth and keyword rankings
   

 \* Website traffic and enquiry conversion
   

 \* Social\-media reach and engagement
   

 \* Growth in direct and organic enquiries
   

  

 \#\#\# Candidate Profile
   

  

 The candidate should have:
   

  

 \* 2–4 years of hands\-on digital marketing experience.
   

 \* Demonstrable experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads.
   

 \* Practical knowledge of SEO and Google Search Console.
   

 \* Experience in lead\-generation campaigns.
   

 \* Working knowledge of GA4 and conversion tracking.
   

 \* Ability to independently create digital content and campaign concepts.
   

 \* Working knowledge of Canva or similar design tools.
   

 \* Basic reel/video editing capability.
   

 \* Strong analytical and communication skills.
   

  

 Experience in travel, tourism, hospitality or another B2C/B2B service industry will be preferred.
   

  

 Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate actual campaigns handled and measurable results achieved during the selection process.
   

  

  

 The candidate should be capable of independently planning and executing campaigns—not merely coordinating with external agencies.
   

  

 What Success Will Look Like
   

  

 The role will be measured not simply by followers, likes or website traffic, but by:
   

  

 Organic Search Growth \| Qualified Leads \| Cost per Lead \| Lead\-to\-Conversion Ratio \| Website Enquiries \| Campaign ROI \| Digital Revenue Contribution

description:
**Social Media Strategist** 




 📍
 **Hyderabad \| Full\-time** 




  





**About SkinBae** 




*SkinBae is one of India’s leading platforms for curated Korean skincare. We work closely with global Korean brands and focus on thoughtful storytelling, strong visuals, and education\-led marketing.* 




*As we grow our team in Hyderabad, we’re looking for people who care about quality, can think independently, and take ownership of their work. If you enjoy building things properly, not just quickly, and want to be part of a hands\-on, fast\-growing brand, you’ll feel at home here.* 




  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a
 **Social Media Strategist** 
 who can think creatively, execute consistently, and take ownership of SkinBae’s social media presence end\-to\-end. This role is equal parts
 **strategy, content execution, publishing, and performance tracking** 
 .
 



 You will be responsible not just for ideas, but for
 **seeing content through from concept to upload to performance analysis** 
 .
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Social Media Strategy \& Execution** 



* Develop and manage the Instagram content calendar, ensuring consistency, relevance, and engagement
* Plan, strategize, and execute organic social media campaigns aligned with SkinBae’s overall marketing objectives
* Monitor social media trends, algorithm updates, audience behaviour, and industry best practices to keep content fresh, competitive, and platform\-relevant
* Ensure content aligns with SkinBae’s premium brand positioning and brand tone at all times
* Identify opportunities to improve content strategy, engagement, reach, and overall social media growth



  





**2\. Video Content Ideation, Scripting \& Execution** 



* Lead the end\-to\-end video content creation process for:
* Instagram Reels
* YouTube Shorts
* Other short\-form and long\-form video formats as required
* Ideate and script engaging video concepts based on brand objectives, audience interests, and platform trends
* Direct and oversee video execution, working closely with internal creators and relevant teams
* Plan, schedule, and oversee content shoots, ensuring timelines, quality, and brand consistency
* Review video content before publishing and provide clear, constructive feedback to improve quality, hooks, storytelling, retention, and overall performance



  





**3\. Content Publishing \& Platform Management** 



* Upload, schedule, and publish content across:
* Instagram posts
* Instagram Reels
* Instagram Stories
* YouTube
* Other relevant social media platforms as required
* Manage captions, hashtags, tags, thumbnails, descriptions, links, CTAs, and other publishing requirements
* Ensure all content is accurate, timely, and aligned with SkinBae’s brand guidelines
* Maintain consistency across all social media platforms
* Take ownership of the final content that goes live across SkinBae’s social media channels



  





**4\. Content \& Design Collaboration** 



* Work closely with graphic designers to develop:
* Instagram posts
* Carousels
* Video creatives
* Campaign assets
* Other social media creatives
* Provide clear creative direction for visually compelling and engaging social media content
* Ensure all creative assets align with SkinBae’s premium brand aesthetic and visual identity
* Coordinate with content writers and designers to ensure smooth execution and timely delivery
* Review creative assets and provide feedback before publishing



  





**5\. Influencer \& Affiliate Marketing** 



* Identify, shortlist, and coordinate with relevant influencers and creators aligned with SkinBae’s brand
* Manage influencer collaborations end\-to\-end, including outreach, briefing, coordination, follow\-ups, content delivery, and execution
* Ensure influencer content aligns with campaign objectives and SkinBae’s brand guidelines
* Support affiliate marketing initiatives and coordinate with relevant partners
* Track influencer and affiliate collaboration performance and identify opportunities for improvement



  





**6\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 Work closely with Marketing, Content, Design, Performance Marketing, E\-commerce, and Leadership teams
 


* Coordinate with content writers and designers to develop social media posts, campaigns, videos, and other creative assets
* Provide inputs for:
* Emailers
* Ad copies
* Website content
* Campaign messaging



 Collaborate with external agencies and partners where required for:
 


* Paid campaigns
* Influencer collaborations
* Email marketing support
* Other marketing initiatives
* Ensure organic social media efforts are aligned with paid marketing campaigns and broader brand communication



  





**7\. Customer Engagement \& Community Management** 



* Manage Instagram comments, DMs, and other social media interactions while maintaining SkinBae’s brand tone
* Respond to customer and community queries appropriately and escalate issues when required
* Support customer communication through email and WhatsApp for social\-media\-related queries where required
* Build meaningful audience engagement and strengthen SkinBae’s online community
* Monitor audience feedback and identify insights relevant to content and brand communication



  





**8\. Performance Tracking \& Analytics** 



* Monitor social media performance using platform analytics and other relevant tools
* Track key metrics including:
* Reach
* Engagement
* Follower growth
* Views
* Engagement rate
* Content\-level performance
* Analyse content and platform\-level data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement
* Prepare regular performance updates and share data\-backed recommendations
* Identify high\-performing and underperforming content and use insights to improve future content
* Continuously optimise social media strategy based on performance insights



  





**9\. Team Leadership \& Growth** 



* Support and guide junior content creators, coordinators, or team members where required
* Provide feedback on content ideation, execution quality, and brand storytelling
* Help improve social media workflows, content planning processes, and publishing systems
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and scalability of social media operations
* Stay updated with emerging social media formats, trends, tools, and platform changes



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* **3–6 years** 
 of hands\-on social media experience with a brand or agency
* Proven experience managing Instagram
 **end\-to\-end** 
 , including planning, publishing, engagement, and performance tracking
* Strong understanding of short\-form video formats such as Reels and Shorts
* Experience ideating, scripting, and overseeing video content
* Strong understanding of hooks, storytelling, retention, and content performance
* Experience working with influencers and creators
* Ability to think strategically while executing consistently
* Strong communication and coordination skills across content, design, influencer, and marketing teams
* Ability to understand premium brand positioning and maintain consistent brand communication
* Strong ownership and attention to detail
* Someone who can work independently and take responsibility for getting things done



  





**This Role Is Not for You If** 



* You only enjoy ideating but don’t want to execute
* You rely heavily on trends without understanding brand context
* You need constant direction or frequent validation before making decisions
* You avoid accountability when content underperforms
* You see social media as just posting, not positioning
* You are not comfortable taking ownership of what goes live



  





**Final Note** 




 If you enjoy creating content, taking ownership, and building a strong social media presence consistently over time, we would love to hear from you.
 



  





**Office Address:** 




 8\-2\-277/24, Plot No. 24, Road No. 3, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad, Telangana \- 500034, India

title: Head - Brand Marketing
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Head – Brand Marketing to lead and redefine how India books and
 



 experiences bus travel through AbhiBus. In this role, you will blend data\-driven performance
 



 with emotive storytelling to scale the AbhiBus brand, strengthen market leadership in the online
 



 bus ticketing space, and own the end\-to\-end marketing journey for the modern bus traveler.
 



 You will be the brand custodian for AbhiBus—ensuring it is not just a transactional booking
 



 platform but a trusted companion for every bus journey across India.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Brand Stewardship \& Narrative** 




 • Architect AbhiBus’s brand positioning, visual identity, and voice to resonate across
 



 diverse traveler segments and regional markets.
 



 • Ensure AbhiBus is perceived not as a commoditized booking tool, but as a premium,
 



 reliable, and traveler\-first brand throughout the booking and travel journey.
 



**2\. Integrated Multi\-Channel Growth** 




 • Orchestrate high\-impact, 360\-degree marketing campaigns spanning Performance,
 



 Social, PR, and Influencer channels tailored to the bus travel audience.
 



 • Move beyond transactional marketing to build a cohesive brand ecosystem that drives
 



 top\-of\-funnel awareness and converts high\-intent travelers into confirmed bus bookings.
 



**3\. Data\-Driven Performance \& LTV Optimisation** 




 • Own the marketing tech stack and analytical framework to measure real\-time ROI across
 



 all brand and performance channels.
 



 • Optimise the balance between Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and Customer Lifetime
 



 Value (CLV), leveraging first\-party data and CRM tools to predict travel patterns and
 



 drive repeat bookings in a highly competitive, low\-loyalty category.
 



**4\. GTM \& Product Innovation Strategy** 




 • Partner with Product and Engineering to lead Go\-To\-Market (GTM) strategies for new
 



 features such as booking technology enhancements, fintech integrations, ancillary
 



 services, and route\-level innovations.
 



 • Translate technical product updates into compelling consumer benefits that improve the
 



 user experience and drive app adoption for AbhiBus.
 



**5\. Strategic Partnerships \& Ecosystem Growth** 




 • Identify and negotiate high\-leverage partnerships with bus operators, state transport
 



 corporations, payment platforms, travel aggregators, and regional influencers.
 



 • Build alliances that act as force multipliers for the AbhiBus brand—expanding reach into
 



 new demographics, routes, and markets, and creating exclusive value for our customers.
 



**6\. Competitive Intelligence \& Trend Forecasting** 




 • Serve as the internal expert on the online bus ticketing and broader surface\-transport
 



 landscape, including competitive OTA platforms and emerging mobility players.
 



 • Synthesise market research and competitor moves to proactively pivot
 



 strategies—anticipating trends such as tier\-2/3 city demand, sustainable bus travel,
 



 route\-specific dynamic pricing, and AI\-driven trip planning.
 



**7\. Commercial Leadership \& P\&L Accountability** 




 • Lead, mentor, and scale a high\-performing brand marketing team for the Bus business
 



 unit.
 



 • Maintain P\&L accountability, aligning the marketing budget with AbhiBus’s broader
 



 commercial goals and ensuring every rupee spent is an investment in scalable,
 



 sustainable growth.
 



  





  





**Requirements** 




 • 10\+ years of marketing experience with 4\+ years in a senior leadership role (Senior
 



 Manager / Head level) within high\-growth B2C travel, consumer tech, or e\-commerce
 



 companies.
 



 • Proven track record in FMCG, D2C, travel, hospitality, OTAs, or online marketplaces,
 



 with deep understanding of seasonal demand cycles and regional market dynamics in
 



 India.
 



 • Expert\-level command of CAC/LTV modelling, multi\-touch attribution, and modern
 



 MarTech stacks (CDPs, CRMs, GA4, and equivalent tools).
 



 • Demonstrated ability to marry high\-velocity performance marketing with emotive,
 



 world\-class brand storytelling.
 



 • Experience recruiting, mentoring, and leading high\-performance, cross\-functional
 



 marketing teams.
 



 • Strong P\&L management skills with the ability to align marketing output with broader
 



 commercial and leadership\-level goals.
 



 • Understanding of the Indian bus travel market, regional language nuances, and tier\-2/3
 



 city consumer behaviour is a strong plus.
 



  





**Nice\-to\-Have** 




 • Experience working in or with online travel aggregators (OTAs) focused on bus or
 



 surface transport.
 



 • Familiarity with vernacular and regional marketing strategies for Indian audiences.
 



 • Prior exposure to fintech\-integrated or super\-app ecosystems within travel.
 



  





**Why AbhiBus?** 




 • Lead the brand for one of India’s leading online bus ticketing platforms with a massive,
 



 growing user base.
 



 • Shape how millions of Indians discover, book, and experience bus travel.
 



 • Work at the intersection of technology, data, and consumer storytelling in one of the
 



 country’s most exciting travel categories.
 



 • Be part of a high\-growth organisation with the ambition to redefine surface transport in
 



 India.
 



  





  





  





**Additional information:** 
 Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures

 Loyalty \& Community
 



  





 \-Build and manage loyalty and rewards initiatives.
 



 \-Develop referral programs to turn existing customers into acquisition channels.
 



 \-Drive customer reviews, UGC, testimonials and referrals.
 



 \-Create campaigns that build engagement and brand affinity beyond discount\-led marketing.
 



  





 Data \& Experimentation
 



  





 \-Track Repeat Purchase Rate, LTV, Churn, Purchase Frequency, CRM Revenue, AOV and Reactivation Rate.
 



 \-Build customer segments based on purchase behaviour, recency, frequency, product purchased and customer value.
 



 \-Analyse campaign performance and identify growth opportunities.
 



 \-Run A/B tests and continuously optimise the customer lifecycle.

 \-2\-5 years of experience in Retention Marketing, CRM, Lifecycle Marketing, D2C or E\-commerce.

 \-Hands\-on experience with WhatsApp, Email, SMS and CRM/marketing automation platforms.

 \-Experience in beauty, personal care, wellness or consumer brands is preferred.
 



 \-Strong communication and copywriting skills.
 



 \-Someone who enjoys experimenting and finding out what actually makes customers come back.
 



 \-A hands\-on, ownership\-driven startup mindset.
 



  





 What Success Looks Like
 



  





 Your core goal: Turn first\-time customers into repeat customers and repeat customers into loyal Xtovia advocates.
 



  





 You will be responsible for improving: Repeat Purchase Rate \| Customer LTV \| Purchase Frequency \| CRM Revenue \| Reactivation \| Customer Engagement \| Referrals

 At StudyIn, we believe that the right guidance has the power to change lives. As the world’s most trusted higher education specialist, we’ve helped over 1\.3 million students access study opportunities since 2006, placing them at top universities across the UK, USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Ireland, and Dubai. Our global team of 500\+ professionals spans 40\+ countries worldwide, offering expert counselling, admissions support, visa guidance, and university partnerships.
 



  





**Main Duties \& Scope of the role** 




 The Strategic Alliance Manager is responsible for driving hyperlocal brand visibility, institutional engagement, and student lead generation for StudyIn within their assigned territory. This role acts as a vital link between central marketing and local on\-ground execution, ensuring campaigns translate effectively into branch\-level growth and conversions.
 



 The ideal candidate is a high\-energy, execution\-focused professional who excels at building relationships with schools, colleges, and coaching centers, whilst seamlessly managing community events and B2B partner engagement to boost student walk\-ins and applications.

**1\. Institutional Partnerships \& Relationship Management**

 Identify and build long\-term relationships with schools, colleges, coaching institutes, and language academies within target catchment areas to strengthen regional presence.
* **Partnership Activation:** 
 Activate and nurture key institutional accounts through well\-defined engagement plans and continuous follow\-through.
* **Account Planning:** 
 Maintain a structured pipeline of institutional partners, mapping their academic calendars to ensure timely and relevant engagement activities.



**2\. Local Demand \& Lead Generation** 



* **Outreach Initiatives:** 
 Plan, coordinate, and execute a range of student outreach initiatives, including seminars, workshops, and webinars within partner institutions.
* **Event Management:** 
 Organise and drive student participation for branch\-level events, in\-house education fairs, and university delegate visits.
* **Activity Calendar:** 
 Calendarize the local city\-level activities and monthly outreach schedules to ensure consistent market presence and efficient resource deployment.



**3\. Hyperlocal Marketing Execution** 



* **Identify Local Branding Opportunities:** 
 Identify local branding opportunities including standees, posters, kiosks and outdoor branding.
* **Offline Visibility Campaigns:** 
 Coordinate branch\-level offline visibility campaigns near coaching hubs and educational clusters.
* **Tactical Activations:** 
 Support local promotions and tactical activations to increase walk\-ins (e.g., experiential pop\-ups and student networking sessions).
* **Social Amplification:** 
 Act as the social media champion for the local branch, capturing high\-quality content and student testimonials during events for digital amplification.



**4\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Reporting** 



* **Sales Alignment:** 
 Work collaboratively with the Branch Manager Sales and counselling teams to ensure seamless lead handovers, timely follow\-ups, and a cohesive student conversion journey.
* **Budget \& ROI Tracking:** 
 Manage the assigned outreach budget efficiently, tracking the return on investment (ROI) and effectiveness of all local marketing activities.
* **Data \& CRM Hygiene:** 
 Ensure all event records, partner contacts, and performance metrics (lead volume, event participation) are accurately maintained within the CRM system.



  





**About the Candidate (including required competencies)** 



* **Relationship Management:** 
 Proven capability to network with senior stakeholders, institutional heads, and academic partners.
* **Execution \& Autonomy:** 
 Strong event coordination skills, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple engagements in a fast\-paced environment.
* **Public Speaking:** 
 Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to deliver engaging seminars to large student audiences.
* **Commercial Acumen:** 
 Result\-oriented mindset with a clear focus on data, performance reporting, and pipeline metrics.



  





**Requirements \& Qualification** 



* **Education:** 
 University degree required; a Master’s degree or equivalent professional qualification is preferred.
* **Experience:** 
 3–8 years of experience in field marketing, institutional sales, educational partnerships, or business development.
 *(Experience within the international education, study abroad, or EdTech sectors is highly desirable)* 
 .
* **Mobility \& Local Expertise:** 
 Must be highly mobile, well\-versed with the geography of the local city, and fluent in the local language. Willingness to travel frequently within the designated territory is essential.
