title: Senior Manager Project Pursuits
description:
**Job Description**
**Position Summary:**
 If you are a Project Pursuit professional Iooking for an opportunity to grow your career, Emerson has an exciting opportunity for you! Based in Delhi, Bengaluru, Mumbai, or Chennai, India, you will play a pivotal role in shaping early\-stage project success by engaging with Global Engineering Centers (GECs) and Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) organizations. This role focuses on building strong, trusted relationships and positioning Emerson’s Measurement Solutions portfolio within engineering standards, specifications, and project requirements before procurement begins. You will contribute directly to business growth by influencing project design decisions, strengthening customer partnerships, and enabling innovative, value\-driven solutions across industries.
   

  

**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**
* Build and sustain strategic relationships with Global Engineering Centers and EPC stakeholders to position Emerson as a preferred partner.
* Drive early engagement in project lifecycles to embed Measurement Solutions products into specifications, standards, and material requisitions.
* Develop and execute structured account plans, including stakeholder mapping, project pipeline tracking, and qualification strategies.
* Collaborate across global teams, including sales, marketing, product, and strategic account teams, to align pursuit strategies and deliver customer value.
* Lead technical discussions, workshops, and training sessions to build customer capability and strengthen product adoption.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date project and account information in CRM tools to support data\-driven decision\-making and forecasting.
* Provide insights on market trends, competitive positioning, and customer needs to inform strategy and innovation.
* Monitor and improve key performance indicators, including specification success rate, pipeline growth, and customer engagement outcomes.
* Develop and execute training plans for assigned Global Engineering Center, delivering awareness, application, and advanced technical training tailored to client seniority and discipline mix. Leverage Emerson’s training organization, Application Specialists, and Product Marketing. Position training as a strategic specification and preference tool. Track execution and measure outcomes including specification activity, stakeholder coverage, and client feedback.
* Partner with Global Strategic Account teams to align pursuit strategies, commercial positioning, and stakeholder messaging for shared accounts. Regularly share account and project pipeline updates and support the execution of global approved vendor list qualification, Global Frame Agreement utilization, and licensor engagement activities at the local Global Engineering Center level.


**Who You Are:**
 You consistently deliver on commitments by following through on plans with accuracy and attention to detail while maintaining a strong focus on measurable outcomes. You build partnerships and work collaboratively across teams and functions, sharing knowledge and aligning efforts to achieve shared goals. You develop a deep understanding of customer needs and use that insight to create meaningful solutions that drive long\-term value. You adapt your approach to identify new opportunities, think creatively, and respond effectively to evolving business and customer requirements.
   

  

**For This Role, You Will Need:**
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering or a relevant technical field (such as instrumentation, electrical, mechanical, or chemical engineering).
* A minimum of 8 years of related experience required; 10\+ years preferred.
* Experience in industrial automation, process measurement, or related industries, with exposure to EPC or owner\-operator environments.
* Understanding of the project lifecycle, including engineering design, specification development, and procurement processes.
* Experience engaging with engineering teams on technical specifications, vendor qualification, or project pursuit activities.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and deliver engaging presentations or training sessions.
* Familiarity with CRM systems and a data\-driven approach to managing pipelines and customer interactions.
* Willingness and ability to travel as part of the role.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and deliver technical training or product capability sessions to engineering audiences, including drafting structured, multi\-level training plans.
* Experience engaging or coordinating with strategic or major account management teams on shared accounts including aligning pursuit strategies and sharing structured account intelligence.


**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**
* Experience working with or within EPC organizations or Global Engineering Centers.
* Knowledge of Measurement Solutions technologies (flow, pressure, temperature, level, analytical, or systems) or similar product portfolios.
* Exposure to industries such as oil and gas, petrochemicals, power generation, or industrial manufacturing.
* Experience with engineering tools or platforms used for specification and design (e.g., SmartPlant, AVEVA).
* Demonstrated ability to work across global teams and influence without direct authority.
* Experience supporting global approved vendor list qualification efforts, Global Frame Agreement utilization, or licensor engagement programs at a local or regional level.


**Our Culture and Commitment To You:**
 At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

 Here’s a wonderful opportunity to join the Leading Cybersecurity \& Networking organisation – Fortinet, who truly converge Network \& Security. Fortinet’s Mission \& Vision is “to secure People, Devices and Data everywhere”. Fortinet’s Integrated, AI\-driven Security platform is a Unified, Integrated cybersecurity platform that spans Network, Core, Endpoints, Applications, Cloud, etc.
   

  

 Fortinet portfolio of over 50\+ enterprise\-grade products is the largest integrated offering available, delivering proven cybersecurity everywhere you need it. More than 890,000 customers trust Fortinet solutions, which are among the most deployed, most patented, and most validated in the industry.
   

  

 Fortinet is included in the Fortune 500 list, has made numerous appearances on Fortune Magazine’s listing of 100 Fastest Growing Companies, and has been nominated to Fortune Magazine's Most Admired Companies List.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 The “Regional Account Manager (RAM) – Emerging Business” is responsible for driving business thro’ Whitespace customer accounts, driving cybersecurity solution adoption, and working closely with channel partners to grow revenue. The role requires a strong understanding of cybersecurity products, partner ecosystems, and enterprise customer needs. The candidate will serve as the primary point of contact for customers and collaborate with channel partners to develop opportunities, close deals, and expand market presence.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Account Management
* Drive business thro’ Whitespace mid\-market Accounts \& ensure high satisfaction and retention.
* Responsible for bringing new logos
* Cross\-sell/ Up\-sell multi\-solution stack, with both existing \& new Accounts
* Leverage Tech\-Days/ Fast track training sessions, to ensure customers have a complete solution understanding of various Fortinet solution to meet their use\-cases
* Leverage partners extensively to cross\-sell to existing Accounts \& penetrate into net new Accounts
* Understand customer security needs, pain points, and ongoing threats; position the right cybersecurity solutions.
* Conduct regular account reviews, QBRs, and roadmap discussions with customers.
* Collaborate with pre\-sales/SE teams to deliver demos, POCs, and solution designs.
* Channel Collaboration
* Work closely with resellers, distributors, MSSPs, and system integrators to drive partner\-led sales.
* Support partners with deal strategy, pricing, proposals, and competitive positioning.
* Ensure channel partners are aligned with the company’s product roadmap, promotions, and incentive programs.
* Resolve channel conflicts and ensure smooth deal registration.
* Sales \& Revenue Growth
* Own the full sales cycle from prospecting to closure for accounts handled through partners.
* Achieve quarterly and annual sales targets (revenue, pipeline, partner activity).
* Identify upsell/cross\-sell opportunities across the cybersecurity \& Networking portfolio (endpoint, network, cloud, identity, SOC, etc.).
* Build and maintain a healthy pipeline using CRM tools.
* Partner \& Customer Enablement
* Conduct product trainings, workshops, and joint account planning with partners.
* Support marketing teams with regional partner events, webinars, and campaigns.
* Ensure customers and partners are aware of threat updates, product enhancements, and new features.
* Market Intelligence \& Reporting
* Track competitor activities, pricing trends, and partner ecosystem performance.
* Provide monthly/quarterly sales forecasts, pipeline reports, and business insights.
* Share customer and partner feedback with product and engineering teams.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, IT, or related field (MBA preferred).
* 10\-12 years of sales/account management experience in Cybersecurity, Networking or IT security.
* Hands\-on experience working with channel partners (distributors, VARs, MSSPs, integrators).
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity domains: Endpoint protection, firewalls, SASE/ ZTNA, SIEM/SOAR, IAM, cloud security, XDR, etc.
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship\-building abilities.
* Knowledge of CRM tools (Salesforce/HubSpot) and sales forecasting.


**Preferred Attributes**
* Existing relationships with local cybersecurity partners and distributors.
* Experience selling Enterprise security or Networking solutions
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment.
* Strong analytical and presentation skills.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
About Godrej Industries Group (GIG)
 



 At the Godrej Industries Group, we are privileged to serve over 1\.1 billion consumers globally through our businesses with market leadership positions in the consumer products, real estate, agriculture, financial services and chemicals industries
 



 To know more, visit www.godrejindustries.com.
 



  





 About Godrej Properties Limited (GPL)
 



 Godrej Properties brings the Godrej Group philosophy of innovation, sustainability, and excellence to the real estate industry. Each Godrej Properties development combines the over 125\-year legacy of excellence and trust with a commitment to cutting\-edge design, technology, and sustainability.
 



 To know more, visit www.godrejproperties.com.
 



  





**About the role** 




 The role is responsible for driving incremental bookings and improving inventory absorption for the North / South / West n East Zones sustenance portfolio through digital, data\-led, and partnership\-driven initiatives. You will go beyond pure lead generation to focus on conversion, database monetization, organic demand, and project reputation in close partnership with sales and CRM/CDP teams.
 



**Roles \& Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Affiliate \& Walk\-in Programs** 



* Onboard and manage affiliate partners and third\-party presales teams to generate qualified walk\-ins for sustenance projects.
* Coordinate with site sales to keep offers, narratives, and talk tracks updated and conversion\-focused.
* Track partner performance (walk\-ins, bookings, RoI) and recommend optimization actions.



  





**2\. CRM / CDP\-led Activation** 



* Work with CRM/CDP teams to identify high\-intent, warm, and dormant leads from historical databases.
* Build basic audience cohorts and launch reactivation journeys (email, WhatsApp, calling prompts, remarketing).
* Support planning and promotion of curated events, invite\-only previews, and portfolio/project\-specific engagement initiatives to drive site visits and bookings.



  





**3\. Organic Demand (SEO \& GEO)** 



* Execute SEO and local GEO strategies to increase non\-paid traffic and inquiries for sustenance projects.
* Coordinate creation and publishing of project\-specific content (landing pages, blogs, FAQs, videos, micro\-site updates) to improve discoverability.
* Monitor organic performance (traffic, leads, rankings) and share insights for continuous improvement.



  





**4\. Conversion \& Funnel Optimization** 



* Monitor the funnel from lead → walk\-in → booking and highlight drop\-offs by project.
* Work with sales, call centre, and agencies to refine scripts, journeys, landing pages, and creatives to improve conversion metrics.
* Support inventory\-specific conversion programs (limited period offers, nudges, journeys) to accelerate movement of priority units.



  





**5\. Reputation \& Brand Saliency** 



* Track ratings, reviews, and social chatter for key projects across platforms.
* Execute initiatives to improve review scores, response rates, and perception in key micro\-markets.
* Coordinate with social/media teams to amplify positive stories and customer testimonials.



  





**6\. Competitive \& Market Intelligence** 



* Maintain a live view of competing projects: pricing, offers, creative hooks, and digital activity.
* Share structured inputs for counter\-offers, creatives, and positioning in weekly reviews.



  





**7\. Cross\-functional Coordination (War Room Support)** 



* Act as the digital and data point\-person in weekly “inventory monetization” / “war room” reviews.
* Coordinate with media agency, creative agency, CRM/CDP, IT and sales to ensure timely execution of agreed digital initiatives.



  





**Key Metrics of Success** 



* Incremental booking value influenced from sustenance projects (through non\-paid and digital initiatives).
* Percentage of bookings/revenue generated from CRM/CDP and database activation.
* Non\-paid lead contribution and qualified walk\-ins from affiliates and organic channels.
* Improvement in lead\-to\-visit and visit\-to\-booking conversion ratios by project.
* Reputation indicators: review scores, response rates, and sentiment in key micro\-markets.



  





**Key Requirements** 




  





**Who We Are Looking for:** 




**Qualification:**



* 5\-6 years of performance/growth marketing experience in Real Estate, BFSI, Automobile, or Insurance sectors.
* Prior people\-management experience, having led a team of 3\-4\+ members.
* Working experience in Agentic AI or implementing digital marketing workflows using LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, etc.).
* Strong orientation across Performance/Growth Marketing and AI/Tech/MarTech, not purely a marketing\-only background.



  





**Tools Knowledge** 



* Hands\-on experience with Meta Ads Manager / Meta Business Suite, Google Ads Manager, and LinkedIn Ads Manager.
* Working knowledge of Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, SEMrush (good to have).
* Familiarity with CRM platforms like Salesforce and LeadSquared (preferred).



  





**Core Skills** 



* Strong hands\-on performance marketing / growth marketing experience. Campaign execution tied to funnel and revenue outcomes, not just spend management.
* Experience on Agentic AI and implementing digital marketing workflows using LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, etc.).
* Practical experience with SEO, local SEO, content coordination, and analytics.
* Comfort working with agencies and internal stakeholders across sales, marketing, and tech.



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Working knowledge of CRM tools, basic CDP concepts, and lifecycle / remarketing journeys.
* Ability to read attribution and funnel dashboards (multi\-touch or last touch), interpret performance, and translate into action plans.



  





**Behaviours** 



* High ownership, execution bias, and comfort with weekly target reviews.
* Data\-driven, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills to work cross\-functionally.

title: Social media manager
description:
**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a creative, strategic, and result\-oriented
 **Social Media Manager** 
 to manage the company’s social media presence and digital communication. The candidate will be responsible for developing social media strategies, planning and publishing content, managing campaigns, coordinating with creative teams, monitoring performance, and building strong online brand visibility.

 Candidate Requirements
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Communications, Mass Communication, or a related field.

* Strong understanding of social media marketing, content strategy, and audience engagement.
* Good knowledge of Instagram Reels, Stories, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Meta Business Suite.
* Experience with social media analytics and reporting.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Creative mindset with strong understanding of current social media trends.

 Key Skills
   

  

* Social Media Strategy
* Content Planning \& Management
* Instagram \& Facebook Marketing
* LinkedIn Marketing
* Reels \& Short\-Form Video
* Copywriting \& Caption Writing
* Influencer Marketing
* Paid Social Media Campaigns
* Social Media Analytics

* Creative Thinking

Position Overview:

This role involves overseeing the sales team, implementing strategic sales and marketing plans, and enhancing revenue through channel partners.  Sales Strategy \& Planning
   

  

  

* Develop and implement short\-term and long\-term sales strategies aligned with organizational revenue and profitability goals.

* Collaborate with the Regional Sales Head – Product to identify opportunities for new offerings or product modifications to drive revenue.

* Monitor branch sales performance against targets, analyse deviations, and implement corrective measures to ensure consistent growth.
* Oversee the sales process to ensure compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and best practices.
* Drive revenue growth through effective channel partner management, including performance tracking and support initiatives.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, decision\-makers, and business partners to enhance customer satisfaction and retention.
* Negotiate rates, service terms, and offers in consultation with the Branch Head, ensuring adherence to pricing and profitability guidelines.


 Financial Management
   

  

  

* Ensure timely collections and manage account receivables to meet financial targets and maintain healthy cash flow.
* Support the Branch Head in achieving overall profitability through effective cost control and revenue optimization.


 Team Leadership \& Capability Building
   

  

  

* Provide direction, coaching, and support to the sales team to drive performance and productivity.
* Ensure adequate staffing levels and foster a high\-performance, target\-oriented culture.
* Support capability\-building initiatives, including sales training, skill enhancement, and performance evaluation programs.


 Qualifications \& Experience:

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Marketing, Sales, or a related field; a Master’s degree (MBA) is preferred.
* Relevant certifications in sales management or marketing are advantageous.


 Experience:
   

  

  

* 3\-5 years of experience in sales, marketing, or business development roles.
* Proven track record of driving revenue growth and managing branch operations within the logistics or express delivery industry.
* Strong experience in developing and executing strategic sales plans, monitoring performance metrics, and achieving financial targets.


 Skills \& Capabilities:
   

  

 Technical Skills:
   

  

  

* Proficiency in sales management techniques and strategies.
* Strong understanding of market analysis and competitive landscape.
* Experience with data analysis and reporting tools to monitor sales performance.
* Knowledge of logistics and express delivery industry practices.
* Ability to develop and implement effective marketing plans.


 Key Competencies:
   

  

  

* Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop a high\-performing sales team.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for building customer relationships.
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving abilities to drive sales performance.
* Adaptability and resilience in responding to changing market conditions.
* Customer\-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering high\-quality service and solutions.


 Key Performance Indicators:

* % adherence to operational cost targets (OCPK and OCPM)

* Employee engagement scores within the sales team
* % of team members participating in training and development programs


 Market Expansion
   

  

  

* Number of new clients acquired in targeted segments
* % increase in market share for assigned product categories


 Compliance and Reporting
   

  

  

* Timeliness of sales reporting to senior management
* % adherence to compliance standards and internal policies


 Performance Management
   

  

  

* Adherence to performance management system timelines for sales staff

title: Business Manager
description:

 :

The Business Manager collaborates closely with internal stakeholders and external customers to drive growth, execute strategic plans, and ensure compliance with, LEGAL, regulatory and quality standards. description:
**Company Description** 
 MedEazy is positioned as one of the fastest online pharmacies in India, focusing on rapid, reliable delivery of prescription and over\-the\-counter medications. The company aims to simplify healthcare access by offering a user\-friendly digital platform for ordering medicines and health products. MedEazy emphasizes customer convenience, speed, and trust, working to streamline the experience of buying medicines online. As the organization grows, it seeks collaborators who are interested in shaping the future of digital healthcare and expanding its reach across diverse communities.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time remote role for a Co\-Founder with capital contribution at MedEazy. The Co\-Founder will be involved in defining the strategic direction of the company, overseeing day\-to\-day operations, and driving growth in online pharmacy services. Responsibilities include developing and executing sales and marketing initiatives, analyzing business performance, conducting market and competitive research, and building partnerships with key stakeholders. The role also involves shaping product offerings, contributing to financial planning, collaborating closely with other founders and core team members, and ensuring compliance with relevant regulations. The individual will actively participate in major decision\-making and invest capital to support the company’s expansion.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong analytical skills to interpret data, evaluate business performance, and support strategic decision\-making.
* Excellent communication skills to collaborate with stakeholders, lead teams, and represent the organization externally.
* Sales and marketing skills to drive customer acquisition, retention, and brand growth in a competitive online pharmacy market.
* Research skills to understand customer needs, market trends, competition, and regulatory environments.
* Prior experience in startups, e\-commerce, healthcare, or pharmaceuticals is highly beneficial.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently in a remote setting and take ownership of outcomes.
* Financial acumen and willingness to contribute capital, with an understanding of investment risk and reward.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare, pharmacy, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.

title: Manager/ Sr. Manager – Product Innovation & Fabric Expert
description:
**About Company:** 




 Group Bayport is a rapidly growing global e\-Commerce, B2B2C, B2B and B2C organization and an industry leader in print technology, operates in the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, UK, and India through its family of brands – Banner Buzz, Covers \& All, Vivyx Printing, Circle One, Giant Media, Neon Earth, Optamark and North cape. From full suites of trade show and small business marketing solutions to sophisticated outdoor living covers, signages and shades to eclectic personal accents and home decor, we help our customers, clients, and partners to make a personalized statement through ,customization.
 



 While our advanced technology and customer focus are certainly our salient attributes, our true strength comes from our team of 1800\+ people. We are seeking exceptional talent across the board to join us in our exciting growth journey.
 



 For more about Group Bayport, please visit
 



**Website:** 
 https://groupbayport.com/about\-us/
 



**LinkedIn:** 
 https://www.linkedin.com/company/groupbayport/mycompany/
 



  





**Designation: Manager/ Sr. Manager\- Product Innovation \& Fabric Expert** 




**Location: Gandhinagar** 




  





  





**About the Role** 




 To lead product innovation and fabric development initiatives for the Covers category by improving product aesthetics, functionality, durability, and customer experience through advanced fabric research, innovative stitching techniques, accessories development, and product engineering. The role will be responsible for repositioning the entire Covers portfolio by identifying best\-in\-class fabrics, optimizing product construction, and introducing innovative design features that enhance perceived value while maintaining cost competitiveness.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 1\. Product Design \& Aesthetic Enhancement
 



  




* Review existing Covers portfolio and benchmark against global competitors.
* Develop innovative stitching patterns and construction methods to improve product appearance.
* Improve product fit, shape retention, and premium look.
* Introduce design elements that enhance customer perception and usability.
* Standardize product finishing specifications across categories.
* Improve packaging and presentation of finished products.



  





 2\. Accessories \& Trim Innovation
 



 • Develop and evaluate accessories such as:
 



 o Buckles
 



 o Straps
 



 o Drawcords
 



 o Elastic systems
 



 o Velcro closures
 



 o Air vents
 



 o Handles
 



 o Reinforcement patches
 



 o Branding elements
 



  





 • Identify opportunities to improve functionality and aesthetics through trims and hardware.
 



  





 3\. Fabric Research \& Development
 


* Lead fabric innovation programs for all cover categories.
* Evaluate lighter\-weight fabrics without compromising durability.
* Develop category\-wise fabric strategy based on:



  





 o Weather resistance
 



 o UV resistance
 



 o Water repellency
 



 o Breathability
 



 o Strength
 



 o Cost
 



 o Customer expectations
 



  





 • Benchmark global fabric suppliers and technologies.
 



 • Develop alternative fabric sourcing strategies to reduce cost and improve performance.
 



 • Work with suppliers on new coating and finishing technologies.
 



  





 4\. Product Engineering \& Testing
 



  





 • Define performance standards for each category.
 



 • Conduct testing for:
 



 o UV resistance
 



 o Waterproofness
 



 o Tear strength
 



 o Abrasion resistance
 



 o Color fastness
 



 o Weathering performance
 



  





 • Establish product validation protocols before commercialization.
 



 • Create technical specifications and BOM standards.
 



  





 5\. Competitive Benchmarking
 



  





 • Benchmark leading brands in:
 



 o Outdoor covers
 



 o Furniture covers
 



 o Grill covers
 



 o Equipment covers
 



 o Automotive covers
 



  




* Identify innovation trends and customer pain points.
* Recommend product upgrades based on market intelligence.



  





 6\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration
 



 • Work closely with:
 



 o Design Team
 



 o Sourcing Team
 



 o Manufacturing Team
 



 o Quality Team
 



 o Product Management Team
 


* Support pilot runs and commercialization of new products.
* Drive innovation projects from concept to production launch.



  





**Key Deliverables (First 12 Months)** 




  





**Product Enhancement** 



* Complete review of entire Covers portfolio.
* Develop category\-wise premium product positioning strategy.
* Launch improved construction standards for all key categories.



  





**Fabric Development** 




  





 Identify and validate lighter\-weight fabric alternatives.
 



 Develop fabric matrix for each cover category.
 



 Deliver minimum 3–5 new fabric innovations.
 



  





**Innovation Pipeline** 




  





 Launch minimum 10 product improvement initiatives.
 



 Reduce product weight while maintaining performance standards.
 



 Improve customer satisfaction related to fit, appearance, and functionality.
 



  





**Cost \& Value Improvement** 




  





 Improve value perception without increasing product cost significantly.
 



 Develop premium and value\-engineered product tiers.
 



  





  





**Key Requirements:** 




**Education** 




 • B.Tech / B.E. Textile Technology
 



 • Technical Textiles
 



 • Apparel Technology
 



 • Product Engineering
 



  





**Experience** 



* 10–15\+ years experience in:



  




* Technical textiles
* Outdoor products
* Protective covers
* Furniture covers
* Automotive covers
* Home furnishing products
* Product development



  





**Technical Skills** 



* Fabric development and sourcing
* Sewing engineering
* Pattern development
* Technical textiles
* Product testing
* Product innovation
* Vendor development
* Cost engineering



  





**Desired Industry Background** 




 Preferred from:
 



 • Outdoor furniture cover manufacturers
 



 • Automotive cover manufacturers
 



 • Technical textile companies
 



 • Home furnishing manufacturers
 



 • Global brands specializing in outdoor protection products

title: Event Management & Marketing Executive
company: Blue Data Consulting And It Services
description:
About the Organisation Blue Data Consulting is a technology consulting, capability-building and professional education company specialising in Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Analytics, Automation and emerging technologies. Through Blue Data Consulting, we work with enterprises, professionals, students, universities and technology communities to deliver corporate training programs, workshops, webinars, technology events and career-focused learning initiatives. 
 Role Overview We are looking for a hands-on and ownership-driven Event Management & Marketing Executive to manage webinars, podcasts, workshops, training programs, exhibitions, expos and community events. The person will take responsibility for the complete event lifecycle from planning and promotion to execution, participant engagement, lead capture and post-event reporting. This is an execution-focused role for someone who enjoys running events, coordinating multiple stakeholders and creating marketing campaigns that generate registrations, engagement, visibility and business opportunities. The successful candidate should be comfortable working independently, following up with speakers and vendors, managing event-day operations and ensuring that every event is delivered successfully. Key Responsibilities 1. Event Planning and Execution Develop and maintain a calendar of webinars, podcasts, workshops, training events, exhibitions and community programs. Convert event ideas into structured execution plans with objectives, timelines, budgets and responsibilities. Identify suitable dates, venues, speakers, trainers, partners and vendors. Prepare event checklists and monitor readiness across all workstreams. Coordinate internal teams, speakers, designers, vendors and external partners. Take ownership of event-day operations and resolve last-minute issues. Ensure that events are delivered on schedule, within budget and according to expected quality standards. Conduct post-event reviews and document recommendations for improvement. 2. Webinars and Virtual Events Identify relevant webinar topics related to AI, technology, analytics, automation, careers and professional education. Coordinate with speakers, moderators and subject-matter experts. Set up and manage webinars using Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet or similar platforms. Create registration forms and coordinate landing pages where required. Manage invitations, confirmations, reminders and participant communication. Conduct technical rehearsals and speaker briefings. Manage live sessions, including participant admission, moderation, polls, Q&A and recordings. Coordinate post-event communication, feedback collection and resource sharing. Track registrations, attendance, engagement, enquiries and qualified leads. 3. Podcasts and Video Interviews Identify suitable podcast guests from the technology, business, education and startup ecosystem. Reach out to potential guests and coordinate recording schedules. Research speakers and prepare discussion themes and interview questions. Coordinate studio, venue, audio, video, lighting and technical requirements. Manage both physical and virtual podcast recordings. Coordinate video editing, branding, thumbnails, captions and publishing. Repurpose podcast content into short videos, social-media posts, quotations and articles. Maintain a consistent podcast and video publishing calendar. Track views, engagement, watch time and enquiries generated. 4. Offline Workshops and Training Events Organise public workshops, corporate training programs, masterclasses and technology meetups. Coordinate venues, trainers, participants, event materials, certificates and refreshments. Manage registration desks and participant support during events. Coordinate audio-visual equipment, seating, signage, photography and videography. Ensure that trainers and speakers receive complete event information and support. Collect participant feedback and coordinate certificates and post-event resources. Support follow-up with prospective students, professionals and corporate participants. 5. Exhibitions, Expos and Conferences Identify relevant exhibitions, conferences and technology expos in Surat and other priority locations. Evaluate exhibitor, sponsorship and participation opportunities. Coordinate stall booking and communication with event organisers. Manage stall branding, banners, brochures, demonstrations and promotional materials. Coordinate staff schedules, travel, logistics and on-site operations. Develop pre-event, live-event and post-event promotional campaigns. Capture visitor information and categorise potential leads. Prepare post-event reports covering footfall, leads, expenditure and business opportunities. 6. Event Marketing and Campaign Management Develop a promotional plan for every event. Define the target audience, event message, channels and campaign timeline. Run campaigns through LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp and relevant online communities. Coordinate Instagram and Facebook promotions when relevant. Develop speaker-led and partner-led promotional campaigns. Coordinate outreach to colleges, companies, professional groups and local communities. Prepare clear content and design briefs for the support team. Review campaign creatives and ensure their timely publication. Monitor registrations and adjust campaigns where participation is below target. Support paid campaigns when approved. 7. Social-Media and Content Coordination Maintain an event-focused social-media content calendar. Prepare post concepts, captions, campaign messages and basic content drafts. Coordinate with graphic designers, video editors and the content team. Schedule or publish approved content across relevant platforms. Promote upcoming events, speakers, training programs, success stories and participant outcomes. Repurpose event recordings into social-media content. Monitor reach, impressions, engagement, clicks, registrations and enquiries. Recommend improvements based on campaign performance. 8. Partnerships and Community Outreach Build working relationships with colleges, universities, coworking spaces and professional communities. Engage with startup networks, technology communities, HR groups and L&D professionals. Develop relationships with local media, event organisers, speakers and influencers. Identify opportunities for joint events, community promotions and speaker exchanges. Coordinate with college training and placement departments. Support venue partnerships and audience-sharing arrangements. Maintain an updated database of potential partners, communities and speakers. 9. Lead Capture and Follow-Up Coordination Ensure that participant and visitor information is collected accurately. Categorise leads into students, professionals, corporate buyers, partners and speakers. Update the CRM or approved lead-tracking system. Share qualified leads with the relevant sales, admissions or counselling team. Coordinate post-event follow-up communication. Track enquiries and conversions generated through events. Ensure that participant information is handled responsibly and according to applicable privacy requirements. 10. Budget and Vendor Management Prepare event-level budget estimates. Obtain and compare quotations from venues and vendors. Coordinate with printers, photographers, videographers, caterers and production teams. Negotiate commercially reasonable rates and payment terms. Obtain internal approvals before confirming expenditure. Monitor planned versus actual event costs. Verify vendor deliverables before processing invoices. Maintain a reliable database of local venues and event-service providers. 
 Internal Support Available The selected candidate may receive support from internal or remote teams for: Graphic design Video editing Content development Landing-page development Technical subject-matter inputs Administrative coordination However, the candidate will remain responsible for preparing clear briefs, following up with support teams, maintaining timelines and ensuring successful final delivery. 
 Required Skills and Experience 36 years of relevant experience in event management, marketing, community management, education marketing or a related field. Demonstrated experience managing physical and virtual events. Working knowledge of digital marketing and social-media campaigns. Experience coordinating speakers, vendors, venues, partners and participants. Strong planning, organisation and follow-up capabilities. Ability to manage multiple events and deadlines simultaneously. Good written and verbal communication skills. Comfortable using LinkedIn, Canva, Google Workspace, WhatsApp Business, Zoom and similar tools. Basic understanding of campaign metrics, lead tracking and post-event reporting. Ability to work independently with limited supervision. Willingness to travel locally and occasionally to nearby cities. Willingness to support events during evenings or weekends when required. Fluency in English and Hindi; Gujarati proficiency would be an advantage. 
 Preferred Qualifications Experience in technology, Artificial Intelligence, EdTech, professional education or corporate training. Existing relationships with colleges, universities, professional communities or event partners in Surat. Experience managing webinars, podcasts or video-based content. Familiarity with CRM, email-marketing or marketing-automation platforms. Experience participating in exhibitions, expos or conferences. Basic copywriting, content-creation or Canva skills. 
 Desired Attributes We are looking for someone who is: Ownership-driven and dependable Highly organised and detail-oriented Energetic and comfortable interacting with people Proactive in following up with stakeholders Calm under pressure Resourceful when dealing with last-minute problems Comfortable with hands-on execution Focused on measurable outcomes Interested in AI, technology and professional education 
 Key Performance Indicators Performance may be assessed through: Number of successfully delivered events Timely and within-budget event execution Event registrations and attendance Registration-to-attendance conversion rate Cost per registration and qualified lead Participant feedback and satisfaction Qualified leads generated through events Event-generated enquiries and conversions Number of active community and institutional relationships Social-media reach and engagement Consistency of webinar, podcast and content publication Quality and timeliness of post-event reports Vendor performance and cost management 
 Important Role Expectations This is a hands-on role. The selected candidate must be comfortable: Taking end-to-end responsibility for events. Personally following up with speakers, vendors and internal teams. Conducting promotional outreach and campaign activities. Working from event venues when required. Handling last-minute operational issues. Working occasionally during evenings or weekends. Travelling locally and occasionally outside Surat. Being measured on registrations, attendance, engagement, leads and event outcomes. 
 Why Join Us? Work in the fast-growing AI, technology and professional education ecosystem. Lead diverse webinars, podcasts, training programs and offline events. Build relationships with industry leaders, universities, communities and technology professionals. Receive support from experienced design, content and technical teams. Gain significant ownership and an opportunity to grow into an events, community or marketing leadership role.

title: Community Builder and Social Media Specialist
description:
**Community Builder and Social Media specialist – LUHO** 




 Bengaluru \| Full\-time \| On\-ground across LUHO homes
 



  





**About LUHO** 




 LUHO runs nine serviced homes across Bengaluru, each with a live\-in butler, home\-cooked meals and hotel\-level care. Most of our guests are corporate travellers who stay with us for days or weeks. We want every one of them to feel looked after, and we want the world to hear about it from them.
 



  





**The role** 




 You'll be the face and voice of LUHO. You'll meet guests, host events, bring in influencers, and turn everyday life at LUHO into content people want to follow. You'll be employed full\-time by LUHO and work with Talking Ants Media, our content and brand partner, who will guide the creative direction, content plan and quality bar.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Post on LUHO's social media every day: reels, stories, photos and short updates from our homes
* Meet guests across properties, check in on their stay and build rapport
* Collect testimonials on video, in writing and as reviews, and make it easy for happy guests to share their experience
* Spot moments worth sharing, like a birthday surprise, a long\-stay guest's routine, or a butler going the extra mile
* Plan and host events at LUHO homes, such as guest dinners, networking evenings, workshops, festive get\-togethers and pop\-ups, from idea to guest list to the night itself
* Promote events online and offline, and fill them with the right mix of guests, corporate contacts and local community
* Find and bring in influencers and creators whose audience fits LUHO, then invite them for stays or events and manage the collaboration end to end
* Grow a community around LUHO: repeat guests, corporate contacts, creators and online followers
* Pass guest feedback to the LUHO team so issues get fixed quickly
* Follow the content calendar and brand guidelines from Talking Ants, and share weekly updates on what's working



  





**Working hours** 




 Your day follows our guests. Mornings start early, when guests are heading out, and evenings are when they're back, relaxed, and when most events happen. The middle of the day is yours to plan: edit content, reach out to creators, schedule posts, or take a break. We care about output, not desk time.
 



  





**Who we're looking for** 



* Confident, presentable and at ease starting a conversation with anyone, from a CXO to a first\-time traveller
* Strong spoken communication in English; Kannada or Hindi is a must
* A natural people person who is warm, observant and genuinely curious about others
* Comfortable on camera and good at getting others comfortable on camera
* Good at organising: can plan an event, manage vendors and invites, and make sure it runs smoothly on the day
* Comfortable reaching out to influencers and creators, or already connected to Bengaluru's creator scene
* Handy with a phone for shooting and basic editing (CapCut, InShot, Instagram tools)
* Self\-driven and responsible with flexible hours
* 1–3 years in social media, hospitality, events, community management or guest relations preferred; freshers with a strong personal profile are welcome
* Own two\-wheeler preferred for moving between properties



  





**What you get** 



* Hands\-on creative mentorship from a professional video and brand studio
* Freedom to shape how LUHO shows up online and offline
* A front\-row seat in a growing hospitality brand

**About Nudge.new** 


 Nudge.new builds AI\-native marketing products for small and growing businesses across the US and Canada. We run our clients' entire marketing engine — acquisition (SEO, AEO, Website, paid ads) and retention (email, WhatsApp, SMS) — delivered as a fully managed, Done\-For\-You service, powered by our AI\-native platform, Nudge, and backed by human experts. 
 





 We give SMBs agency\-quality marketing at a fraction of the price, across verticals from DTC and hospitality to professional services and coaching.
 





 Nudge is founded by ex\-founders and leaders of startups like MySmartPrice, Livspace and Brightchamps, and is backed by Accel and some of the biggest angels in India. We're a fast\-moving, AI\-first team where client success comes first — and we're scaling quickly.
   





**The Role** 


 You own paid social as a channel across our client portfolio. Not as a reviewer of reports — as the person in the ad account, in Events Manager fixing what's broken and deciding what runs next.
 





 We don't charge clients a percentage of ad spend. We think like their in\-house team:
 
**Our objective is their business outcome, not a billable ad spend.** 

 That changes how you'll make decisions, and it should be the single biggest motivating factor before you apply.
 





 We're looking for a channel operator
 
*and* 

 a solution builder: someone who can execute, debug, use AI intelligently, and systematise it.
   





**What you'll do** 
* Own end\-to\-end Meta delivery (and TikTok where it's relevant) — for a portfolio of US and Canadian SMBs
* Personally build, configure, troubleshoot and optimise: campaigns, tracking, audiences, feeds, tags. Not delegate it and review decks / dashboards.
* Own channel measurement end to end — pixel, CAPI, GA4, GTM, UTM architecture, offline conversions, integrations. We have great engineers when we need them but you would be the person who explains (if)why platform numbers and GA4 disagree, and which one to act on.
* Run the creative engine: hooks, angles, UGC and creator content, static vs video, testing frameworks, and iteration velocity high enough to beat fatigue.
* Diagnose performance drops to a root cause — creative, audience, tracking, landing page, offer. Test, Iterate and Improve rather than reflexively changing bids.
* Report on what moves the business (ROAS, CAC, LTV, conversion rate, incrementality), and be willing to say some metrics like reach doesn't matter as much.
* Turn everything you learn into SOPs, checklists, QA processes and playbooks — and push as much of it as possible onto the Nudge platform with the product/AI team.


**What we're looking for** 
* 4–6 years in paid social with
 
**exceptional Meta work** 

 (ideally for SMBs in US or international markets) — you've built a deep understanding of how the channel actually works, not just run campaigns on it.
* **Strong fundamentals:** 

 you can look at what a client sells, work out what appeals to their buyer, and form a point of view on how to win on the channel.
* **Meta, hands\-on:** 

 Ads Manager, Business Portfolio, Pixel, Conversions API, Events Manager, custom conversions, audiences and lookalikes, catalogs/commerce, Advantage\+, dynamic creative, retargeting, attribution.
* **Creative judgment:** 

 creative fatigue, hooks and angles, UGC and creator content, testing frameworks, audience × creative interactions, landing page and message match.
* Genuine curiosity about what AI brings to paid ads — and evidence you've built AI into real marketing workflows, not just used ChatGPT to write copy.
* **Comfort with the plumbing:** 

 tracking, pixels and tags, analytics, APIs, product feeds, integrations. Real grasp of measurement and attribution.
* Degree from a reputed college with a strong academic record(Masters is an advantage).
* Excellent written and spoken English — you'll be client\-facing.
* Willing to work the split shift and relocate to Bangalore; able to join within \~1 month
* **A strong advantage:** 

 hands\-on TikTok Ads experience.


**Why you'll love it here** 
* A direct line to the Founders and real influence over how client delivery works
* Build on an AI\-native platform that's genuinely ahead of the curve
* Outsized ownership in a fast\-growing, Accel\-backed startup
* Meaningful ESOPs — share in the upside you help create


**Compensation \& logistics** 
* Competitive fixed CTC \+ performance\-linked variable \+ ESOPs
* Medical insurance \+ lunch \+ snacks
* Reports to: Delivery Manager
* Location: ORR, Bangalore (relocation required)
* Shift: In\-office 2:00 PM–6:00 PM, then WFH 8:00 PM–12:00 AM


**How to apply** 


 Also fill this application form(mandatory):
 
 https://forms.gle/paUbgNoQCVRx59Gk7
 



  





**Our process:** 





* Direct application (CV \+ note \+ form)
* Intro call with the Team \+ assignment
* In\-person deep dive (case / working session)
* Team \& values conversation with founders
* Offer

title: Cofounder (Growth & Marketing)
description:
**About Tingu Tales** 
 Tingu Tales is an AI\-powered personalized storytelling platform that creates beautiful, meaningful storybooks for children in 9 Indian languages. We turn a child into the hero of their own story — personalized with their name, interests, experiences, language, and character.
 



  





 Beyond personalized creation, Tingu Tales also features a rapidly growing, curated
 **Digital \& Print Library** 
 of pre\-made, high\-quality, culturally relevant children's books. Our users can seamlessly access this library through single\-book purchases or our all\-access monthly subscriptions, with printed copies delivered directly to families at home.
 



  





 What started as a hackathon project has evolved into a real product with paying customers, hundreds of stories generated during our early beta, and a massive opportunity in the personalized children's books and digital storytelling space. We are now looking for a Growth Cofounder to join us at this pivotal stage and help scale the business.
 



  





**About the Role** 
 This is not a traditional employee role. As a Cofounder, you will be a core pillar of the company, working side\-by\-side with the founding team to take Tingu Tales from early traction to widespread adoption.
 



 You will own the entire growth engine—figuring out who our best customers are, how to reach them, how to convert them, and how to build repeatable, scalable acquisition channels around both our personalized story engine and our curated library.
 



 You will lead efforts across:
 


* **Direct\-to\-parent sales and customer acquisition** 
 (driving both one\-off book purchases and recurring monthly subscriptions)
* **Monetizing the Library:** 
 Crafting campaigns to upsell library credits and promote our pre\-made library as a standalone value proposition
* **Partnerships** 
 with schools, bookstores, parenting communities, and children's brands
* **Influencer and creator partnerships**
* **Social media and content\-led growth**
* **Community building** 
 around early childhood reading and storytelling
* **Offline events, exhibitions, and demos**
* **B2B and institutional sales opportunities** 
 (e.g., school library integrations)
* **Performance marketing and growth experiments**
* **Product positioning, pricing strategy, and messaging**
* **Tracking conversion, CAC, recurring revenue (MRR), and unit economics**



 You'll have significant ownership, equity, and the freedom to experiment aggressively to build a category\-defining brand.
 



  





**Who We're Looking For** 
 We're looking for someone who is:
 


* Extremely entrepreneurial, resilient, and comfortable with the ambiguity of an early\-stage startup
* A natural hustler who is excited to roll up their sleeves and own sales, marketing, and growth
* A strong communicator and relationship builder
* Comfortable talking to parents, schools, educators, businesses, and partners
* Willing to pick up the phone, send messages, run experiments, and close deals
* Data\-driven but also highly creative
* Able to take an idea from
 *"let's try this"* 
 → execution → measurable results
* Deeply excited about AI, children's literature, education, storytelling, or consumer technology
* Prior experience in growth, marketing, EdTech, consumer products, D2C, or SaaS is a strong plus — but an entrepreneurial mindset and undeniable execution ability matter more than credentials.


-

 If you are looking for a conventional 9\-to\-5 job, this is not the right opportunity. If you want to build a company from the ground up, own a massive chunk of the growth trajectory, and create products that bring genuine joy to children and families, we’d love to talk.
 



  





**Interested?** 
 Send us a message with:
 


1. A brief introduction about yourself
2. Your growth/startup/marketing experience
3. Why building Tingu Tales excites you
4. One idea you would try to get our first 100/1,000 active subscribers



  





 Please send the Founder linkedin.com/in/achints a LinkedIn message or email.
 



  





 Let's build the future of personalized children's storytelling together.

title: Growth Marketing Lead- D2C
description:
**About the Company** 




 We run growth for a portfolio of fast\-growing D2C brands — skincare, beauty, apparel, lifestyle, wellness, food. Multiple Growth Leads, each owning several brands.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The problem we're hiring for is a structural leak in how learning and innovation spread across our portfolio. You are not another Growth Lead. You take the highest\-value growth thinking emerging from the Founder, from individual Growth Leads, and from individual accounts — and you inject it across the organisation so that the Founder's best thinking stops depending on the Founder being personally present in every account.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




*The mandate:* 



* You are not another Growth Lead. You take the highest\-value growth thinking emerging from the Founder, from individual Growth Leads, and from individual accounts — and you inject it across the organisation.



  





*Two responsibilities:* 




**1\) Transfer learning across the portfolio** 



* When something works, you establish what worked, why, whether it's replicable, which brands it applies to, how it needs adapting, who implements it, whether they actually did, and what it produced.
* When something breaks in one account, you find out whether it's forming elsewhere.
* Individual problem → repeated pattern → systemic solution.



  





**2\) Operationalise the Founder's innovation** 



* The Founder develops new frameworks by applying them to a specific brand.
* You learn that thinking deeply enough to take it beyond that brand — extract the principle, convert it into a repeatable system, document it, train Growth Leads on it, drive adoption, measure impact.
* Founder insight → framework → playbook → training → implementation → measurement.



  





*What you'll own* 



* The growth operating system — frameworks, audit processes, diagnosis methods, experimentation structures, prioritisation systems, playbooks, SOPs
* Cross\-portfolio knowledge transfer — winning strategies worth replicating, failed experiments worth not repeating, bottlenecks showing up in more than one place
* Growth Lead enablement — making the people executing significantly better at diagnosing, prioritising and thinking strategically
* The question you'll ask constantly: if we solved this once, why is anyone solving it from scratch again?



  





*AI is core to this role* 



* Not a productivity tool — part of the operating system.
* We expect aggressive, sophisticated use of AI for pattern\-finding across accounts, summarising learnings, building playbooks, generating hypotheses, analysing performance data, and building internal tools and workflows.
* We want someone who actively experiments with new tooling and finds leverage the rest of the team hasn't.



  





*How you'll be measured* 



* Speed of transfer of successful strategies.
* Reduction in duplicated mistakes.
* Number of Founder\-led innovations actually operationalised and adopted.
* Adoption and quality of growth frameworks.
* AI workflows shipped and the manual work they removed.
* Systemic problems identified and solved.
* Not the growth of one portfolio — the growth capability of the company.



  





**Qualifications** 



* 5\+ years in D2C growth, performance marketing, or growth consulting
* Experience across multiple brands, not one



  





**Required Skills** 



* Working fluency across the D2C stack: Meta, Google, influencer, email, WhatsApp, CRO, retention, funnel analytics, AOV/LTV, CAC/ROAS/MER, unit economics, forecasting, P\&L fundamentals
* Systems thinking — you see one event and ask whether it's a pattern
* Exceptional at learning something complex and teaching it simply
* Able to challenge people constructively and drive adoption without hierarchy
* You should be able to move between a client account, a spreadsheet, a strategy session with the Founder, an AI workflow, and a company\-wide operating framework.



  





**Pay range and compensation package** 



* Compensation ₹15–25 LPA \+ bonus.



  





**How to Apply** 



* Send your resume plus a short note answering:
* "Tell us about something you figured out that other people then started doing. What was the decision, and how did you get it adopted?"
* Email: tamanna.d@porcellia.com, talent@porcellia.com, riteshdritelin@porcellia.com,
* Applications without the note won't be considered



  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




 We welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Applications will be evaluated solely on merit and role fit.

title: Marketing Lead
description:
**About Origin**
 Origin (previously 10xConstruction) is building general\-purpose autonomous robots for US construction to tackle rising costs, safety risks, and labour shortages. Our modular, multi\-trade platform combines purpose\-built hardware with real\-time site intelligence to navigate complex environments and execute tasks with precision. Trained in high\-fidelity simulation and already deployed on live sites, our robots deliver 5x faster execution, 250%\+ margin expansion, and significant cost savings. Join India's most talent\-dense robotics team consisting of individuals from IITs, Stanford, UCLA, etc.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Marketing Lead, you will own how Origin is understood by contractors, developers, partners, press, and investors, and build the marketing function that turns that understanding into demand for OG1\.
   

  

 Construction robotics is an understood category. Origin's position inside it is not: one general\-purpose robot that performs every interior\-finishing trade starting with compound application, sanding, priming, and painting and adding other interior workflows, in a market conditioned to expect a separate machine for each task. Making that idea land is patient, repeated work, and it is the core of this role.
   

  

 You will define the positioning, build the awareness engine behind it, stand up always\-on demand generation that produces qualified conversations, find and win the stages where a working robot deserves to be seen, and hold every internal department and external agencies and partners to one visual and verbal system.
   

  

 Because Origin sells across India, the United States, Europe, and Asia Pacific, you will also build a marketing plan for each region rather than one global plan that fits none of them. You will have a Creative Content Producer working to your plan, alongside creative, content, and PR agencies and freelancers, and you will be the person who keeps all of them pointed at the same narrative and coordinated around the same release calendar. For the first year you are the marketing team: you will set the strategy and you will also fix the product page, write the brief, and staff the booth.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Positioning and Category Awareness
* Define Origin's category position, the proof behind it, what it displaces, and what it is routinely confused with
* Build audience\-specific message tracks for general contractors, interior and drywall subcontractors, developers and owners, partners, press, and investors
* Run a sustained awareness plan of explainers, demonstrations, comparisons, briefings, and formats that move audiences from "a robot that plasters and paints" to "a platform that does all interior works."
* Write and maintain objection handling for the questions that decide deals, including why a general\-purpose platform beats single\-task machines and manual crews
* Test messaging in real sales calls, pilots, partner meetings, and investor conversations, and change it on evidence rather than opinion
* Keep one approved boilerplate, product description, and narrative live across the website, decks, brochures, outbound, job postings, and investor material
* Build named, repeatable formats Origin owns outright, a series people subscribe to rather than stumble across, instead of campaigns that end and leave nothing behind
* Hold the line that renders explain and footage proves: claims about OG1 are backed by real site evidence, because the buyer has been sold construction robotics before and it did not work
* Demand Generation
* Build always\-on channels with playbooks, owners, budgets, and locked measurement, so pipeline does not depend on the event calendar
* Run a monthly campaign rhythm with documented experiments covering hypothesis, result, learning, and decision
* Own the website and product pages as working sales surfaces, not brochures
* Make Origin the source AI answer engines quote: canonical explainers targeting what a contractor actually asks, structured for search and for generative answers rather than written as keyword filler
* Own tracking, source capture, UTM discipline, and attribution hygiene end to end
* Report qualified conversations and cost per qualified conversation by channel and by region
* Route inbound enquiries to Sales quickly, with source, segment, and region recorded
* Events, Showcases, and Industry Presence
* Own the showcase portfolio across trade shows, pavilions, speaking slots, panels, awards, innovation programme, demo days, customer and partner site demonstrations, industry bodies, press and analyst briefings, and investor events
* Actively hunt for opportunities Origin is not already tracking, and qualify each on audience fit, buyer density, cost, and effort before committing
* Work every membership and sponsorship Origin already pays for until it delivers the visibility it promised
* Write and submit speaking abstracts, panel proposals, and award nominations against a tracked deadline calendar
* Run each committed appearance to a written brief agreed with the internal team and the event coordinator, covering objective, demo plan, staffing, collateral, lead capture, and follow\-up ownership
* Score every paid appearance against cost within thirty days, and make the renewal recommendation from that number
* Brand, Design, and Messaging Consistency
* Publish and maintain Origin's brand and messaging system, covering logo and colour usage, typography, imagery and robot photography standards, diagram conventions, templates, product naming, and approved terminology
* Roll the system out to Sales, Engineering, Hardware, Deployment, People, and leadership with the templates each team actually needs
* Review externally published technical material for terminology and message consistency without dulling its technical accuracy
* Make the compliant path the easy one through templates and a fast request route, rather than policing after the fact
* Keep design, messaging, and product naming consistent across web, decks, documents, event collateral, site signage, and technical documentation
* Product Marketing, Launches, and Campaign Coordination
* Build the launch playbook and run it on OG1 milestones, from positioning and proof through assets, channels, internal readiness, and post\-launch review
* Own the release calendar and coordinate every party against it — the Creative Content Producer, creative and content agencies, PR support, Sales, Deployment, and Engineering — so product milestones, content, events, and announcements land together rather than separately
* Write the single narrative brief that the content team, agencies, and freelancers all work from, so one campaign does not arrive in three different voices
* Run the approval and review flow for campaigns and releases, with clear owners, deadlines, and a final sign\-off that does not sit with the founders by default
* Equip Sales with the enterprise kit before they ask: pitch narrative, RaaS economics and ROI material, pilot evidence, case studies, compliance one\-pagers, and the objection library
* Maintain competitive positioning and comparison material against other construction robotics players and manual alternatives
* Support fundraising and partnership conversations with accurate, current narrative material
* Regional Marketing
* Write and run a marketing plan for each active market, covering the local buyer, the labor\-cost and ROI argument, the competitive set, regulatory message constraints, localization, channel mix, local events, and partner support
* Localize messaging rather than translating it, and validate it in\-market before scaling
* Report each region against its own baseline and recommend where budget should move
* Founder Voice and Employee\-Generated Content
* Run the founder\-voice programme: three co\-founders with genuinely distinct public voices and distinct territory — company thesis, autonomy and physical AI, hardware reality — supported to publish on a cadence without being flattened into one house tone
* Build and run an employee\-generated content programme across deployment, operations and engineering, with voice guides, prompt packs, capture kits, and an approval flow simple enough that nobody has to be a writer
* Keep the trust hierarchy straight: a post from a deployment lead on a live site does something a company page structurally cannot, and the programme should be designed around that
* Working With the Content Team, Agencies, and Partners
* Direct the Creative Content Producer against a quarterly plan tied to the awareness, launch, and demand priorities, and make sure they walk into a running system rather than a blank calendar
* Select, brief, review, and manage creative, content, video, PR, and design agencies and freelancers against a defined standard, a budget, and an agreed set of deliverables
* Coordinate in\-house and external creative on the same campaign without duplicated work or conflicting narratives, including where an agency owns production and Origin owns the message
* Hold external partners to measurable outcomes, review performance on a set cadence, and make the renew, renegotiate, or end call on evidence
* Work daily with founders, engineers, deployment, and sales to find the strongest stories and get them out quickly, and support each founder's public voice without flattening it into one house tone


****Must\-Haves****
* Five or more years in B2B marketing, including time owning the function, its number, and its budget rather than a single channel within someone else's plan
* Demonstrated product marketing experience: you have taken a product to market, not only run campaigns for one
* A track record of positioning work that outlasted you — messaging other people adopted and repeated
* Proven ownership of demand generation against a pipeline number, with the ability to state your cost per qualified conversation without a week's preparation
* Experience marketing to enterprise buyers with committee decisions and multi\-month sales cycles
* Ability to work hands\-on and strategically at the same time, in a company where there is no one else to hand the work to
* Strong writing: you can produce a positioning document, a launch plan, a one\-pager, and a conference abstract yourself
* Comfort with analytics, tracking, attribution, CRM, and marketing automation, and the discipline to keep the data clean
* Ability to hold your own with engineers, get a technical claim right, and make a complex physical product clear without flattening it
* The discipline to market on evidence rather than claims, to a buyer who has been promised this before: you reach for proof from real sites ahead of a better\-looking render, and you can tell the difference between marketing that argues with doubt and marketing that removes the reason for it
* Comfort enabling other people's voices — founders, engineers, operators — rather than putting everything through a single corporate channel
* Experience running events or field marketing as a pipeline channel, not as logistics
* Experience directing creative people and external agencies against a defined standard, and coordinating in\-house and outsourced creative on the same release without the work colliding
* Experience running a release or campaign calendar across several teams and holding it, including the unglamorous coordination that makes a launch land on one day rather than over three weeks
* Comfort working around engineers, hardware, robots, workshops, labs, testing areas, and live construction sites
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally, including to customer sites and trade shows
* Genuine interest in robotics, construction, startups, and physical products


****Good\-to\-Haves****
* Experience marketing a physical product in robotics, hardware, manufacturing, automotive, construction technology, industrial automation, or aerospace
* Experience selling into construction, real estate, infrastructure, or field\-service buyers
* Experience marketing a subscription, leasing, or as\-a\-service commercial model
* Experience building a brand and design system that technical teams actually adopted
* Experience running marketing across more than one country or region, including localization
* Experience with account\-based marketing against a named target list
* Experience building a category or evangelizing an unfamiliar product class
* Experience supporting fundraising with narrative and investor\-facing material
* Experience working with press, analysts, or industry associations
* Experience on the client side of an agency relationship — scoping, briefing, and getting real output from a narrative, content, or PR partner
* Experience with AI\-assisted marketing tooling used for real leverage rather than novelty
* Familiarity with construction workflows, jobsites, and industrial environments


****Application Requirement****
 Applicants must share examples of their own work: a positioning or messaging document, a launch plan, a campaign with its results, or a piece of enablement material you wrote.
   

  

 We are especially interested in work involving technical or physical products, unfamiliar product categories, enterprise buyers, and results you can attribute to your own decisions.
   

  

 Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short practical assignment on positioning and launching OG1\.
   

  

**What You'll Gain**
* The opportunity to define the category position of an early\-stage robotics company, rather than inherit one
* Ownership of an entire marketing function, its budget, and its first hires
* Direct work with founders, engineers, robots, customer demonstrations, and field deployments
* Experience marketing a physical, AI\-driven product into one of the world's largest and least digitized industries
* Exposure across sales, fundraising, partnerships, and product as marketing touches all of them
* International scope from day one, across India, the United States, Europe, and Asia Pacific
