title: Manager - CRM & Marketing Technology
description:
**Manager, CRM \& Marketing Technology** 




  





**Location:** 
 Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



**Experience:** 
 10–12 years of relevant experience preferred
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm known for entrepreneurial, action\-oriented and results\-focused professionals. The firm takes a hands\-on approach to solving client problems and helping organizations reach their potential. Its culture values independent thinkers and doers who create meaningful client and industry impact. A\&M operates with a commitment to Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward and Inclusive Diversity. In 2023, A\&M established a Global Capability Center in India to expand specialized talent, accelerate delivery, maintain competitive pricing and enable automation through digital and analytics capabilities. The Gurgaon\-based center partners with global business units and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC. Unlike traditional back\-office models, it contributes to end\-to\-end case delivery and thought leadership across industries including Consumer \& Retail, Healthcare, Software \& Technology, Automotive \& Industrials, Hospitality \& Leisure, Energy \& Natural Resources and Financial Services. The GCC is growing rapidly and already has more than 1,000 members.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This role owns the CRM and Marketing Technologies strategy and roadmap for A\&M’s growing India Global Capability Center. Reporting to the CRM and Marketing Technologies Director, you will translate marketing priorities into scalable technology capabilities, operating models and delivery plans. The position is accountable for orchestrating projects and initiatives across CRM, marketing automation, analytics, AI and broader MarTech ecosystems. Success requires strong MarTech/CRM expertise, marketing business and technology transformation experience, and proven project, change and stakeholder management. You will connect Marketing, IT, data teams and business units to improve integration, data quality, channel execution and decision\-making. The role combines strategic planning with hands\-on execution, ensuring solutions are fit for purpose, adopted by users and aligned with compliance expectations. You will also act as a trusted subject matter expert, shaping investment choices and recommending innovations that improve marketing effectiveness, operational efficiency and measurable business outcomes.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the CRM and MarTech strategy and roadmap, converting marketing objectives into sequenced initiatives, investment priorities and capabilities that improve campaign effectiveness, operational efficiency and stakeholder outcomes.
* Lead delivery of CRM, marketing automation, analytics, AI and channel technology projects through structured governance, milestones, risk controls and benefits tracking that keep transformation initiatives on schedule.
* Translate business requirements into technical capabilities, solution designs and prioritized backlogs, ensuring platforms and processes support scalable, compliant and measurable multi\-channel marketing execution.
* Partner with data teams to improve infrastructure, data quality and integration across databases and MarTech components, enabling reliable customer insights, segmentation, activation and reporting.
* Establish and improve marketing operating models, processes and organization structures through technology\-enabled transformation, clarifying ownership and increasing consistency across business units and geographies.
* Analyze marketing performance data and convert findings into improvement initiatives, recommendations and executive\-ready insights that strengthen strategy, resource allocation and business decision\-making.
* Manage stakeholder alignment across Marketing, IT, data teams, business units and vendors, resolving dependencies and building credibility through clear communication, negotiation and outcome\-focused governance.
* Monitor MarTech trends, compliance requirements and vendor capabilities, recommending innovations and managing integrations that improve effectiveness while addressing customer\-data obligations such as GDPR and CCPA.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Strong expertise across CRM, marketing automation, MarTech platforms, channels, AI and analytics tools, with the ability to connect business requirements to practical technical functionality and integrated solutions.
* Demonstrated marketing business and technology transformation experience, including operating\-model design, process improvement, product or project delivery and adoption of new capabilities across matrixed organizations.
* Advanced project, change and stakeholder management skills, supported by analytical thinking, vendor negotiation, troubleshooting, executive communication and customer\-data compliance awareness.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* PMP, CPM or comparable project and product management certification is an advantage, particularly where it demonstrates disciplined delivery, governance and benefits realization across complex transformation programs.
* Experience working with global marketing organizations, distributed stakeholders and cross\-regional CRM initiatives is beneficial, especially within consulting, professional services or other matrixed environments.
* Exposure to emerging MarTech, AI, analytics and automation trends is valuable when paired with sound judgment about adoption, integration effort, governance and measurable business impact.



  





**What You'll Bring** 




 You bring 10–12 years of relevant experience managing marketing technology platforms and systems, with total professional experience typically ranging from 10 to 15 years. Your background demonstrates strong MarTech and CRM expertise, combined with marketing business and technology transformation experience. You have led complex projects or products from strategy through implementation, using structured governance, change management and stakeholder alignment to deliver adoption and measurable results. You understand how Marketing organizations operate, how processes and operating models shape performance, and how technical capabilities can solve business priorities. You are comfortable working across CRM, marketing automation, analytics, AI, channels, data infrastructure and platform integrations. You use data to diagnose performance, shape recommendations and guide decisions. You can negotiate with vendors, troubleshoot issues, manage deadlines and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders and delivery teams. You understand customer\-data compliance considerations, including GDPR and CCPA, and can operate effectively in a matrix environment. A bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Technology, Business Administration or a related field is required. You are organized, detail\-oriented, credible, collaborative and accountable for outcomes rather than activity.
 



  





**Why Join Us** 




 At A\&M, you will own technology\-enabled marketing transformation within a rapidly growing Global Capability Center that works directly with global business units and case teams. Your decisions will influence how CRM, MarTech, data and automation capabilities scale across major markets and industries. The role offers the opportunity to shape strategy and roadmap while remaining close to implementation, adoption and measurable business impact. You will work alongside experienced consultants, technologists, data professionals and leaders across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, gaining exposure to complex operating models and diverse client environments. A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture rewards independent thinking, practical problem\-solving and professionals who create visible results. The organization supports continuous learning through formal training, on\-the\-job development and performance conversations that recognize contribution and encourage progression. You will join a center that is expanding its capabilities, strengthening its global delivery model and investing in specialized talent. This is an opportunity to build enduring platforms, improve how marketing operates and grow as a transformation leader in a collaborative, inclusive environment.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* A\&M supports continuous professional development through structured performance conversations, formal training and on\-the\-job learning that help employees build capabilities and progress through a meritocratic environment.
* Employees receive resources and support focused on personal well\-being, enabling sustainable performance while contributing to meaningful work in a collaborative and inclusive culture.
* The role offers exposure to global markets, senior stakeholders, multiple industries and cross\-functional transformation initiatives within a rapidly growing India Global Capability Center.

title: Content Marketing Associate
description:
At Aftershoot, we’re building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post\-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world.
   

  

 From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.
   

  

 We’re a fast\-growing, passionate team backed over 100K\+ active users globally. Double\-digit ARR in less than 4 years, amazing investors and team who truly believe in our mission.
   

  

 Our mission is clear: Become the default companion for every photographer in the world.
   

  

 If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

 Let’s create the future of AI in photography, together.
   

  

 🚀
 **Your Mission:**
 Aftershoot is a leading AI\-powered post\-production software company with over 200,000 users and tens of thousands of customers. We are looking for a Content Writer to join our dynamic marketing team. As a Content Marketing Manager, you'll be responsible for executing the company's content strategy and driving engagement through various channels. We're seeking a creative individual with strong writing skills and the ability to produce content that resonates with our audience of professional photographers.
   

  

 🎯

title: Retention Marketing Executive
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Retention Marketing Executive to drive customer engagement, repeat purchases, and retention for a growing healthcare and wellness brand.
 



 This role focuses on the complete customer lifecycle — lead → purchase → product experience → repeat purchase. You will be responsible for converting interested leads, reducing customer drop\-offs, and increasing repeat revenue through WhatsApp, email, CRM, and marketing automation.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Plan and execute segmented WhatsApp and email campaigns for different customer lifecycle stages.
* Build lead nurture journeys for quiz\-takers, enquiries, checkout abandoners and other prospects.
* Create post\-purchase journeys covering onboarding, reminders, product experience, repeat purchase and win\-back.
* Develop and manage CRM and marketing automation workflows using triggers, timing and customer behaviour.
* Segment customers based on lifecycle stage, purchase history, engagement, recency/frequency, and other relevant data.
* Write clear, persuasive and customer\-focused WhatsApp and email communication.
* Analyse retention, repeat purchase, cohort and funnel data to identify customer drop\-offs and opportunities.
* Track campaign performance and continuously test messaging, timing, segmentation and CTAs.
* Monitor WhatsApp and email health, including opt\-outs, engagement, deliverability and compliance.
* Work closely with marketing, sales, and customer experience teams to improve the overall customer journey.
* Ensure all healthcare\-related communication follows responsible marketing and communication practices.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 1–3 years of experience in Retention Marketing, CRM, Lifecycle Marketing, Email Marketing, WhatsApp Marketing, or Growth Marketing.
* Hands\-on experience managing WhatsApp and email campaigns.
* Experience with CRM/marketing automation tools and customer journey creation.
* Strong understanding of segmentation, customer lifecycle, retention, and repeat purchase marketing.
* Ability to analyse campaign and customer data and turn insights into actionable campaigns.
* Good copywriting skills with a strong understanding of customer psychology.
* Familiarity with cohort analysis, RFM, funnel metrics and retention KPIs is an advantage.
* Strong execution, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience in healthcare, wellness, D2C or consumer brands is preferred but not mandatory.



  





**Success in This Role** 




 Your primary goal will be to convert more existing leads, reduce customer drop\-offs, increase repeat purchases, and grow retention revenue.
 



 We are looking for someone who can move beyond simply sending campaigns and understand who should receive what message, at what stage, through which channel, and why.

title: Social Media & Content Creation Lead | 2-4 years | Faridabad (WFO)| upto 10LPA
description:
**Social Media \& Content Creation Lead \|** 




**Full\-time \|** 




**Reporting to: Brand Manager \|** 




**Location: Faridabad (in\-office)** 




  





**TARGET CANDIDATE PROFILE 2–4 years in social media or content creation • Strong short\-form portfolio • Comfortable on camera • Beauty, lifestyle or D2C experience preferred** 




**About the opportunity** 




**fast\-growing beauty and personal\-care company with in\-house manufacturing and R\&D, and multiple consumer brands.** 




**We are building organic social as a repeatable content engine, not a posting calendar. Working under the Brand Manager, you will personally take ideas from hook to script to camera to edit to publish, then use the numbers to decide what deserves another iteration. This is a hands\-on creator role with real ownership, not an agency\-coordination position.** 




**The essentials** 



1. **Experience: 2–4 years in social media management, content creation, brand content or a closely related role.**
2. **Location: Faridabad, Haryana. In office, five days a week, with on\-site shoots when required.**
3. **On\-camera work: Mandatory. You should be confident presenting products, tutorials, demonstrations and brand stories on video.**
4. **Production: You must be able to script, shoot and edit Reels, Shorts and other platform\-native short\-form content yourself.**
5. **Role type: Strong individual contributor. You may coordinate designers or photographers when needed, but you remain personally accountable for output and quality.**
6. **Terms: Full time. Six\-month probation. No bond and no lock\-in. Statutory PF and gratuity apply.**
7. **Reporting: Brand Manager; working closely with Creative and Performance Marketing.**
8. **Start date: Immediate joining preferred.**
9. 



**What you will actually build** 




**The mandate is to create a durable organic\-content capability across our beauty brands:** 



1. **A platform\-first content system: clear content pillars, recurring series, formats and channel roles for each brand.**
2. **A reliable short\-form engine: a fast weekly rhythm from insight and hook to script, shoot, edit, caption and publish.**
3. **A recognisable on\-camera presence: credible demonstrations, tutorials, problem\-solution stories and product education that feel native to the platform.**
4. **A disciplined social operating rhythm: calendars, approvals, publishing, community responses and an organised content library.**
5. **A measurable learning loop: weekly reviews that identify winning hooks and formats, then turn them into repeatable series and stronger briefs.**



**What the job involves** 



1. **Turning the Brand Manager’s priorities into monthly calendars and weekly production plans with clear objectives for every piece.**
2. **Researching audience problems, product truths, trends, and cultural moments, then converting them into original content ideas.**
3. **Writing hooks, scripts, captions, calls to action and thumbnail text in a clear, distinctive brand voice.**
4. **Appearing on camera and directing your own performance until the delivery feels natural, credible and platform\-native.**
5. **Shooting clean footage with strong framing, lighting and audio, then editing for pace, retention, subtitles and mobile viewing.**
6. **Publishing consistently across Instagram and YouTube Shorts, and adapting content for other relevant channels when required.**
7. **Managing comments and community conversations, and feeding recurring questions or objections back to the Brand Manager.**
8. **Reviewing watch time, completion, shares, saves, profile visits and organic traffic; testing new hooks instead of defending weak content.**
9. **Handing proven organic assets to Performance Marketing for amplification. You will not own media buying or paid\-campaign optimisation.**



**What we are looking for** 



1. **A portfolio that proves personal contribution. We want to see content you conceived, scripted, presented, shot or edited, not only work produced by an agency.**
2. **Strong short\-form craft: hooks, structure, pacing, framing, lighting, audio, subtitles and a clear reason to keep watching.**
3. **Comfort with at least one practical editing workflow, such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro or an equivalent tool.**
4. **Good writing and visual judgment. You can recognise a weak hook, cluttered frame or generic caption before it goes live.**
5. **Speed with standards. You can publish at a steady cadence without letting brand voice, accuracy or finish collapse.**
6. **Analytical discipline. You understand that reach and followers are signals, while retention, shares, saves, profile visits and traffic reveal whether content worked.**
7. **High ownership and openness to direct feedback. You can reshoot, recut and improve without treating every revision as a creative disagreement.**

 The role requires a combination of
 **creator relationship management, business development, commercial negotiation, campaign execution, and stakeholder management** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should understand the influencer ecosystem, be comfortable communicating with creators and their teams, have strong negotiation skills, and be capable of managing multiple campaigns simultaneously.
 



 This is a high\-ownership role where the individual will be expected to act as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of creators and ensure that their interests, commercial opportunities, and campaign commitments are managed effectively.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities1\. Creator / Talent Relationship Management
 * Manage and build strong, long\-term relationships with a portfolio of influencers and content creators.

title: Meller India Head
description:
**Mission Brief: Build and Scale Meller as a Business in India** 




  





 Meller, Lenskart's Barcelona\-born, D2C\-first sunglasses brand is entering its next chapter in India. Known for bold silhouettes, expressive colourways, and a design language rooted in Barcelona's street culture, Meller has a cult following of 700K\+ on Instagram and a strong Gen Z and Millennial fan base across Europe and the U.S.
 



  





 This role owns Meller as a business in India end\-to\-end P\&L, growth strategy, and operational execution across retail, e\-commerce, and marketing. Sitting at Lenskart's India HQ, you will effectively run Meller India as a founder would: setting the strategy, building the team, and making the commercial, brand, and operational calls that turn Meller to a category\-leading sunglasses brand in India.
 



  





 This is a builder's role at the intersection of business leadership, brand, and retail. You'll work closely with the global Meller team in Barcelona, Lenskart's leadership, and internal functions spanning category, retail, e\-commerce, supply chain, and finance while building a lean India team to execute the mission.
 



  





**🔑 Core Mandate: Business Ownership \& P\&L Leadership** 




  





**1\. Business Strategy \& P\&L Ownership (The Founder Focus)** 




**P\&L Ownership:** 
 Own Meller India's P\&L end\-to\-end — revenue, margin, and profitability — making the trade\-offs needed to build a healthy, scaling business.
 



**Business Strategy:** 
 Define and drive Meller's India growth strategy — market entry sequencing, channel mix, pricing, and expansion roadmap across retail and online.
 



**Brand Architecture Fit:** 
 Position Meller within Lenskart's house\-of\-brands portfolio (alongside John Jacobs, Owndays, and Le Petit Lunetier), with clear differentiation in price, design, and audience.
 



**Investment \& Resource Allocation:** 
 Decide where to invest — stores, marketing, people, technology — to maximise growth and return, and build the business case for future investment.
 



  





**2\. Retail, Category \& Channel Execution (The Growth Focus)** 




**Retail Rollout \& Performance:** 
 Own store performance and expansion across the \~500 launch stores and beyond — driving sell\-through, productivity, and the store economics that justify further rollout.
 



**Category \& Assortment Strategy:** 
 Partner with category and buying teams to shape the assortment strategy, ensuring product\-market fit for Indian consumers while staying true to Meller's global design DNA.
 



**E\-commerce \& D2C Growth:** 
 Drive Meller's presence and growth across Lenskart's app, website, and D2C channels, balancing brand experience with commercial performance.
 



**Channel \& Partnership Development:** 
 Identify and build new channels and partnerships — marketplaces, collaborations, wholesale, or others — that extend Meller's reach in India.
 



  





**3\. Brand, Marketing \& Consumer Experience** 




**Brand Custodianship:** 
 Ensure Meller's brand voice, positioning, and consumer experience in India stay true to its bold, design\-led, youth\-first DNA within global brand guidelines.
 



**Marketing Strategy Oversight:** 
 Set the direction for Meller's marketing engine in India — brand campaigns, influencer and community building, and performance marketing — and hold the team accountable for outcomes.
 



**Consumer Insight:** 
 Build a strong read on the Indian Gen Z and Millennial consumer — fashion trends, buying behaviour, and sentiment — to keep Meller's proposition sharp.
 



  





**4\. Global Coordination, Team \& Stakeholder Leadership** 




**Global Coordination:** 
 Serve as the primary interface between the Barcelona\-based Meller team and Lenskart's India leadership — aligning on strategy, brand consistency, and market learnings.
 



**Cross\-Functional Leadership:** 
 Work closely with Retail, E\-commerce, Category, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure the business runs as one integrated system.
 



**Team Building:** 
 Build, mentor, and lead a lean, high\-performing India team capable of running Meller as an independent, founder\-led business within Lenskart.
 



**Leadership Reporting:** 
 Own business reviews and reporting cadences with Lenskart and Meller global leadership — covering performance, strategy, and course corrections.
 



  





**The Essentials** 




  




* **Experience:** 
 Proven experience in business leadership, general management, or P\&L ownership roles, with meaningful experience building or scaling a D2C brand; exposure to fashion/lifestyle, retail, or consumer brands is a strong plus, as is an entrepreneurial bent of mind.
* **P\&L \& Commercial Acumen:** 
 Proven ability to own and grow a P\&L — balancing revenue growth, margin, and working capital while making sound commercial trade\-offs.
* **Brand \& Retail Understanding:** 
 Strong grounding in brand building, retail operations, and consumer behaviour, particularly within fashion, lifestyle, or eyewear categories.
* **Entrepreneurial Track Record:** 
 Experience building or scaling a business, brand, or new market with founder\-like ownership, ideally in a fast\-growing or category\-disrupting environment.
* **Cross\-Border Collaboration:** 
 Experience or strong aptitude for working with global teams, balancing brand consistency with local market relevance.
* **Stakeholder \& Team Leadership:** 
 Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams and influence senior leaders across commercial, retail, marketing, and finance functions.
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor's or Master's in Business, Marketing, Economics, or a related discipline. MBA preferred.



  





**🧠 The Mindset** 




  




* **Founder's Mentality:** 
 You think and act like you own the business — chasing outcomes, not just tasks, and taking full accountability for Meller's success in India.
* **Brand Storyteller:** 
 You understand how to turn a brand's design DNA into stories and experiences that resonate with a new generation of consumers.
* **Globally Minded, Locally Grounded:** 
 You carry a brand's global identity faithfully while adapting it with nuance for Indian consumers and platforms.
* **Commercially Grounded:** 
 You balance brand ambition with the discipline of running a healthy, profitable business.
* **Entrepreneurial Bent of Mind:** 
 You're comfortable with ambiguity, quick to take ownership, resourceful with limited support, and driven to make things happen rather than wait for a playbook.
* **Collaborative Operator** 
 : You move easily between strategic, creative, and commercial conversations, working across category, retail, and global brand teams to get things done.
* **Execution\-Focused:** 
 You don't just set strategy — you see it through, chase details, and hold the bar high at every touchpoint.

title: Field Partnerships Manager, Delhi NCR
description:
**Company Description** 
 Me100 is redefining where health begins in India by focusing on early signals of disease long before symptoms appear. The company offers advanced testing beyond standard full body checkups, using over 100 biomarkers across more than 13 body systems. Me100 combines family history, medical context, and lifestyle data into a single connected picture, reviewed by biomedical experts, with two in\-depth readings each year to track changes in the body. Individuals receive insights on biological age versus calendar age, along with a personalized action plan after each reading. At\-home sample collection is enabled through leading NABL\-accredited labs across 200\+ cities, supporting people to think long\-term about their health and well\-being.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Field Partnerships Manager, Delhi NCR is a full\-time, on\-site role based in New Delhi. This role is responsible for identifying, onboarding, and nurturing partnerships with clinics, wellness centers, corporates, and other health ecosystem stakeholders in the Delhi NCR region. The manager will conduct regular field visits, present Me100’s offerings, negotiate terms, and ensure smooth execution of partnership agreements. Day\-to\-day activities include managing partner relationships, tracking performance metrics, coordinating with internal teams for operations and marketing support, and resolving partner issues promptly. The role also involves gathering market insights, contributing to local go\-to\-market strategies, and representing Me100 at events and meetings to strengthen brand presence.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong Partnerships and Strategic Partnerships skills to identify, build, and grow high\-impact relationships.
* Account Management and Communication skills to maintain partner satisfaction and manage ongoing collaboration.
* Analytical Skills to interpret data, assess partnership performance, and inform decisions.
* Experience in field sales, business development, or ecosystem partnerships, ideally in health, wellness, or related sectors.
* Ability to work on\-site across the Delhi NCR region, with flexibility to travel for meetings and events.
* Comfort using CRM tools and basic productivity software to track activities and outcomes.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Healthcare Management, or a related field; relevant experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.
* Self\-driven, organized, and able to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced environment.

description:
**Company Description** 
 Journey Partner, founded in November 2021, is a travel solutions provider serving clients across India and internationally for tours, travel, and MICE requirements. The company has organized domestic travel across diverse regions of India, including Jammu \& Kashmir, Rajasthan, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Andaman \& Nicobar Islands, Eastern and North Eastern states, and Gujarat. Internationally, Journey Partner has supported travel to destinations in South East Asia, the Middle East, Europe, the USA, and Africa. Countries frequently served include Japan, Singapore, Vietnam, Malaysia, Thailand, Cambodia, Sri Lanka, Maldives, Bhutan, UAE, Türkiye, Russia, Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Greece, France, the UK, USA, Italy, and Kenya. The organization focuses on delivering reliable, tailored travel experiences for a wide range of customer needs.
   

  

**Role Objective**
 To drive Journey Partner’s digital growth by improving online visibility, generating qualified business leads and strengthening engagement across search engines, social media, website and other digital channels.
   

  

 The role will have end\-to\-end responsibility for digital marketing activities, with a strong emphasis on measurable lead generation and conversion
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 \*\*1\. Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)\*\*
   

  

 \* Develop and execute on\-page, off\-page and technical SEO initiatives.
   

 \* Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis and search trend analysis.
   

 \* Improve organic ranking for relevant travel, holiday, corporate travel and MICE\-related searches.
   

 \* Optimise website pages, blogs, destination content and landing pages.
   

 \* Monitor performance through Google Search Console, GA4 and appropriate SEO tools.
   

  

 \*\*2\. Lead Generation \& Performance Marketing\*\*
   

  

 \* Plan and execute digital campaigns for generating qualified enquiries.
   

 \* Generate leads for domestic and international holidays, corporate travel, MICE and other Journey Partner services.
   

 \* Design campaign funnels and landing pages to improve conversion.
   

 \* Track leads from source through enquiry and conversion.
   

 \* Continuously improve cost per lead and quality of leads.
   

  

 \*\*3\. Google Ads\*\*
   

  

 \* Independently plan and manage Google Search, Display, remarketing and other relevant campaigns.
   

 \* Undertake keyword planning, audience targeting, bidding and budget optimisation.
   

 \* Monitor CPC, CTR, conversion rate, CPL and ROI.
   

 \* Optimise campaigns based on actual business results.
   

  

 \*\*4\. Social Media \& Meta Marketing\*\*
   

  

 \* Manage Journey Partner’s presence across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube and other relevant platforms.
   

 \* Plan and execute Meta advertising campaigns.
   

 \* Develop monthly social media and campaign calendars.
   

 \* Increase meaningful reach, engagement, enquiries and conversions.
   

  

 \*\*5\. Digital Content Creation\*\*
   

  

 \* Create engaging destination content, promotional posts, reels, short videos, campaign creatives and advertisements.
   

 \* Develop digital content around customer experiences, destinations, offers, festivals and travel trends.
   

 \* Prepare SEO\-friendly website and blog content.
   

 \* Coordinate photography/video/content requirements wherever necessary.
   

  

 \*\*6\. Website \& Digital Presence\*\*
   

  

 \* Regularly review and update website content, packages, offers and landing pages.
   

 \* Improve website user journey and calls\-to\-action.
   

 \* Work towards increasing organic traffic, enquiries and conversion.
   

 \* Coordinate with website/technical service providers where specialist intervention is required.
   

  

 \*\*7\. Analytics \& Performance Reporting\*\*
   

  

 \* Monitor GA4, Google Search Console, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager and social\-media analytics.
   

 \* Prepare monthly digital performance dashboards.
   

 \* Analyse source\-wise leads and conversions.
   

 \* Recommend corrective actions based on data and campaign performance.
   

  

 \#\#\# Key Performance Indicators
   

  

 Performance will primarily be evaluated through:
   

  

 \* Qualified leads generated
   

 \* Cost per qualified lead
   

 \* Lead\-to\-conversion ratio
   

 \* Revenue generated from digital leads
   

 \* Return on advertising spend
   

 \* Organic search growth and keyword rankings
   

 \* Website traffic and enquiry conversion
   

 \* Social\-media reach and engagement
   

 \* Growth in direct and organic enquiries
   

  

 \#\#\# Candidate Profile
   

  

 The candidate should have:
   

  

 \* 2–4 years of hands\-on digital marketing experience.
   

 \* Demonstrable experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads.
   

 \* Practical knowledge of SEO and Google Search Console.
   

 \* Experience in lead\-generation campaigns.
   

 \* Working knowledge of GA4 and conversion tracking.
   

 \* Ability to independently create digital content and campaign concepts.
   

 \* Working knowledge of Canva or similar design tools.
   

 \* Basic reel/video editing capability.
   

 \* Strong analytical and communication skills.
   

  

 Experience in travel, tourism, hospitality or another B2C/B2B service industry will be preferred.
   

  

 Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate actual campaigns handled and measurable results achieved during the selection process.
   

  

  

 The candidate should be capable of independently planning and executing campaigns—not merely coordinating with external agencies.
   

  

 What Success Will Look Like
   

  

 The role will be measured not simply by followers, likes or website traffic, but by:
   

  

 Organic Search Growth \| Qualified Leads \| Cost per Lead \| Lead\-to\-Conversion Ratio \| Website Enquiries \| Campaign ROI \| Digital Revenue Contribution

 .

 .

* Paid campaigns

**1\. Brand Stewardship \& Narrative**

 reliable, and traveler\-first brand throughout the booking and travel journey.
 



**2\. Integrated Multi\-Channel Growth**

 Social, PR, and Influencer channels tailored to the bus travel audience.

**3\. Data\-Driven Performance \& LTV Optimisation** 




 • Own the marketing tech stack and analytical framework to measure real\-time ROI across

**4\. GTM \& Product Innovation Strategy** 




 • Partner with Product and Engineering to lead Go\-To\-Market (GTM) strategies for new

**5\. Strategic Partnerships \& Ecosystem Growth** 




 • Identify and negotiate high\-leverage partnerships with bus operators, state transport
 



 corporations, payment platforms, travel aggregators, and regional influencers.
 



 • Build alliances that act as force multipliers for the AbhiBus brand—expanding reach into
 



 new demographics, routes, and markets, and creating exclusive value for our customers.
 



**6\. Competitive Intelligence \& Trend Forecasting**

 landscape, including competitive OTA platforms and emerging mobility players.

 route\-specific dynamic pricing, and AI\-driven trip planning.

 unit.

 commercial goals and ensuring every rupee spent is an investment in scalable,
 



 sustainable growth.
 



  





  





**Requirements** 




 • 10\+ years of marketing experience with 4\+ years in a senior leadership role (Senior
 



 Manager / Head level) within high\-growth B2C travel, consumer tech, or e\-commerce
 



 companies.
 



 • Proven track record in FMCG, D2C, travel, hospitality, OTAs, or online marketplaces,
 



 with deep understanding of seasonal demand cycles and regional market dynamics in
 



 India.
 



 • Expert\-level command of CAC/LTV modelling, multi\-touch attribution, and modern
 



 MarTech stacks (CDPs, CRMs, GA4, and equivalent tools).
 



 • Demonstrated ability to marry high\-velocity performance marketing with emotive,
 



 world\-class brand storytelling.
 



 • Experience recruiting, mentoring, and leading high\-performance, cross\-functional
 



 marketing teams.
 



 • Strong P\&L management skills with the ability to align marketing output with broader
 



 commercial and leadership\-level goals.
 



 • Understanding of the Indian bus travel market, regional language nuances, and tier\-2/3
 



 city consumer behaviour is a strong plus.
 



  





**Nice\-to\-Have** 




 • Experience working in or with online travel aggregators (OTAs) focused on bus or
 



 surface transport.
 



 • Familiarity with vernacular and regional marketing strategies for Indian audiences.
 



 • Prior exposure to fintech\-integrated or super\-app ecosystems within travel.
 



  





**Why AbhiBus?** 




 • Lead the brand for one of India’s leading online bus ticketing platforms with a massive,

 country’s most exciting travel categories.

 India.

 Ensure all event records, partner contacts, and performance metrics (lead volume, event participation) are accurately maintained within the CRM system.

 Proven capability to network with senior stakeholders, institutional heads, and academic partners.

 Strong event coordination skills, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple engagements in a fast\-paced environment.

 Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to deliver engaging seminars to large student audiences.

 Result\-oriented mindset with a clear focus on data, performance reporting, and pipeline metrics.

Fortinet’s Integrated, AI\-driven Security platform is a Unified, Integrated cybersecurity platform that spans Network, Core, Endpoints, Applications, Cloud, etc.
   

  

 Fortinet portfolio of over 50\+ enterprise\-grade products is the largest integrated offering available, delivering proven cybersecurity everywhere you need it. More than 890,000 customers trust Fortinet solutions, which are among the most deployed, most patented, and most validated in the industry.

**Position Overview**
 The “Regional Account Manager (RAM) – Emerging Business” is responsible for driving business thro’ Whitespace customer accounts, driving cybersecurity solution adoption, and working closely with channel partners to grow revenue. The candidate will serve as the primary point of contact for customers and collaborate with channel partners to develop opportunities, close deals, and expand market presence.

* Account Management

* Support partners with deal strategy, pricing, proposals, and competitive positioning.
* Ensure channel partners are aligned with the company’s product roadmap, promotions, and incentive programs.
* Resolve channel conflicts and ensure smooth deal registration.
* Sales \& Revenue Growth
* Own the full sales cycle from prospecting to closure for accounts handled through partners.
* Achieve quarterly and annual sales targets (revenue, pipeline, partner activity).
* Identify upsell/cross\-sell opportunities across the cybersecurity \& Networking portfolio (endpoint, network, cloud, identity, SOC, etc.).

* Partner \& Customer Enablement
* Conduct product trainings, workshops, and joint account planning with partners.
* Support marketing teams with regional partner events, webinars, and campaigns.

 To know more, visit www.godrejindustries.com.

 Godrej Properties brings the Godrej Group philosophy of innovation, sustainability, and excellence to the real estate industry. Each Godrej Properties development combines the over 125\-year legacy of excellence and trust with a commitment to cutting\-edge design, technology, and sustainability.
 



 To know more, visit www.godrejproperties.com.
 



  





**About the role** 




 The role is responsible for driving incremental bookings and improving inventory absorption for the North / South / West n East Zones sustenance portfolio through digital, data\-led, and partnership\-driven initiatives. You will go beyond pure lead generation to focus on conversion, database monetization, organic demand, and project reputation in close partnership with sales and CRM/CDP teams.
 



**Roles \& Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Affiliate \& Walk\-in Programs** 



* Onboard and manage affiliate partners and third\-party presales teams to generate qualified walk\-ins for sustenance projects.
* Coordinate with site sales to keep offers, narratives, and talk tracks updated and conversion\-focused.
* Track partner performance (walk\-ins, bookings, RoI) and recommend optimization actions.



  





**2\. CRM / CDP\-led Activation** 



* Work with CRM/CDP teams to identify high\-intent, warm, and dormant leads from historical databases.
* Build basic audience cohorts and launch reactivation journeys (email, WhatsApp, calling prompts, remarketing).
* Support planning and promotion of curated events, invite\-only previews, and portfolio/project\-specific engagement initiatives to drive site visits and bookings.



  





**3\. Organic Demand (SEO \& GEO)** 



* Execute SEO and local GEO strategies to increase non\-paid traffic and inquiries for sustenance projects.
* Coordinate creation and publishing of project\-specific content (landing pages, blogs, FAQs, videos, micro\-site updates) to improve discoverability.
* Monitor organic performance (traffic, leads, rankings) and share insights for continuous improvement.



  





**4\. Conversion \& Funnel Optimization** 



* Monitor the funnel from lead → walk\-in → booking and highlight drop\-offs by project.
* Work with sales, call centre, and agencies to refine scripts, journeys, landing pages, and creatives to improve conversion metrics.
* Support inventory\-specific conversion programs (limited period offers, nudges, journeys) to accelerate movement of priority units.



  





**5\. Reputation \& Brand Saliency** 



* Track ratings, reviews, and social chatter for key projects across platforms.
* Execute initiatives to improve review scores, response rates, and perception in key micro\-markets.
* Coordinate with social/media teams to amplify positive stories and customer testimonials.



  





**6\. Competitive \& Market Intelligence** 



* Maintain a live view of competing projects: pricing, offers, creative hooks, and digital activity.
* Share structured inputs for counter\-offers, creatives, and positioning in weekly reviews.



  





**7\. Cross\-functional Coordination (War Room Support)** 



* Act as the digital and data point\-person in weekly “inventory monetization” / “war room” reviews.
* Coordinate with media agency, creative agency, CRM/CDP, IT and sales to ensure timely execution of agreed digital initiatives.



  





**Key Metrics of Success** 



* Incremental booking value influenced from sustenance projects (through non\-paid and digital initiatives).
* Percentage of bookings/revenue generated from CRM/CDP and database activation.
* Non\-paid lead contribution and qualified walk\-ins from affiliates and organic channels.
* Improvement in lead\-to\-visit and visit\-to\-booking conversion ratios by project.
* Reputation indicators: review scores, response rates, and sentiment in key micro\-markets.



  





**Key Requirements** 




  





**Who We Are Looking for:** 




**Qualification:**



* 5\-6 years of performance/growth marketing experience in Real Estate, BFSI, Automobile, or Insurance sectors.
* Prior people\-management experience, having led a team of 3\-4\+ members.
* Working experience in Agentic AI or implementing digital marketing workflows using LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, etc.).
* Strong orientation across Performance/Growth Marketing and AI/Tech/MarTech, not purely a marketing\-only background.



  





**Tools Knowledge** 



* Hands\-on experience with Meta Ads Manager / Meta Business Suite, Google Ads Manager, and LinkedIn Ads Manager.
* Working knowledge of Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, SEMrush (good to have).
* Familiarity with CRM platforms like Salesforce and LeadSquared (preferred).



  





**Core Skills** 



* Strong hands\-on performance marketing / growth marketing experience. Campaign execution tied to funnel and revenue outcomes, not just spend management.
* Experience on Agentic AI and implementing digital marketing workflows using LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, etc.).
* Practical experience with SEO, local SEO, content coordination, and analytics.
* Comfort working with agencies and internal stakeholders across sales, marketing, and tech.



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Working knowledge of CRM tools, basic CDP concepts, and lifecycle / remarketing journeys.
* Ability to read attribution and funnel dashboards (multi\-touch or last touch), interpret performance, and translate into action plans.



  





**Behaviours** 



* High ownership, execution bias, and comfort with weekly target reviews.
* Data\-driven, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills to work cross\-functionally.

 Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.

 If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition. Position Overview:
   

  

 The Manager – Business Development / Territory Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth through effective sales process management across all product categories, including DP, International, Retail, Cargo, and E\-Retail. This role involves overseeing the sales team, implementing strategic sales and marketing plans, and enhancing revenue through channel partners. Additionally, the Manager – Business Development monitors performance metrics and fosters strong relationships with key clients to ensure operational excellence and profitability. Job Purpose:
   

  

 To drive the revenue growth by managing the sales process for all product categories within the branch. This role focuses on implementing strategic sales initiatives, optimizing channel partner performance, and ensuring operational excellence. Key Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

 Sales Strategy \& Planning
   

  

  

* Develop and implement short\-term and long\-term sales strategies aligned with organizational revenue and profitability goals.
* Forecast sales trends, set performance targets, and devise action plans to achieve growth objectives across all product categories.
* Collaborate with the Regional Sales Head – Product to identify opportunities for new offerings or product modifications to drive revenue.


 Sales Operations \& Performance Management
   

  

  

* Monitor branch sales performance against targets, analyse deviations, and implement corrective measures to ensure consistent growth.
* Oversee the sales process to ensure compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and best practices.
* Drive revenue growth through effective channel partner management, including performance tracking and support initiatives.


 Client Relationship Management
   

  

  

* Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, decision\-makers, and business partners to enhance customer satisfaction and retention.
* Negotiate rates, service terms, and offers in consultation with the Branch Head, ensuring adherence to pricing and profitability guidelines.


 Financial Management
   

  

  

* Ensure timely collections and manage account receivables to meet financial targets and maintain healthy cash flow.
* Support the Branch Head in achieving overall profitability through effective cost control and revenue optimization.


 Team Leadership \& Capability Building
   

  

  

* Provide direction, coaching, and support to the sales team to drive performance and productivity.

 Experience:
   

  

  

* 3\-5 years of experience in sales, marketing, or business development roles.
* Proven track record of driving revenue growth and managing branch operations within the logistics or express delivery industry.
* Strong experience in developing and executing strategic sales plans, monitoring performance metrics, and achieving financial targets.


 Skills \& Capabilities:
   

  

 Technical Skills:
   

  

  

* Proficiency in sales management techniques and strategies.
* Strong understanding of market analysis and competitive landscape.
* Experience with data analysis and reporting tools to monitor sales performance.
* Knowledge of logistics and express delivery industry practices.
* Ability to develop and implement effective marketing plans.


 Key Competencies:
   

  

  

* Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop a high\-performing sales team.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for building customer relationships.
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving abilities to drive sales performance.
* Adaptability and resilience in responding to changing market conditions.

 Key Performance Indicators:

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Anna Simona Kids is a premium D2C baby and kids essentials brand, sold online, across retail partners and in shop-in-shops. Our sister brand, Anna Simona Home, brings the same design sensibility to premium bedding and home. We're already at a solid scale and are now building our growth engine in-house.

**Why this role exists**

We've worked with agencies. Now we want someone who lives inside our brand, knows our customers and numbers intimately, and owns growth end to end. You won't be splitting attention across ten clients. It's just us, and you'll have the room and backing to build properly.

**What you'll own**

* Meta and Google Ads end to end, including strategy, account structure, creative testing, budgets and scaling
* WhatsApp marketing and CRM, covering campaigns, automations, flows and segmentation
* Retention and repeat purchase through email, WhatsApp, loyalty and win-back
* Full-funnel performance, meaning CAC, ROAS, contribution margin, LTV and conversion rate, not just platform metrics
* Creative direction for ads, with clear briefs to design and content teams on what to make and why
* Tracking and attribution (pixel, CAPI, GA4, UTMs), so we trust our data
* Growth across two brands with different audiences and price points

**What we're looking for**

* 4+ years in performance marketing, with most of it in D2C e-commerce, ideally in fashion, baby, lifestyle or home
* A track record of profitably scaling spend, with results you can walk us through
* Deep hands-on skill in Meta and Google Ads. You run the accounts yourself.
* Experience with WhatsApp marketing tools and retention platforms
* Strong command of Shopify and D2C unit economics
* A sharp creative eye and an instinct for what makes a premium brand convert
* An owner's mindset: proactive, accountable and comfortable working closely with the founder

**Why join**

* Full ownership of growth for two premium brands
* Direct access to the founder and quick decisions
* Room to build systems your way, without agency layers
* Competitive pay for the right experience

title: Performance Marketing Executive
description:
Job Description – Performance Marketing Manager

Position: Performance Marketing Manager

Department: Digital Marketing

Experience: 2–5 years

Job Type: Full Time

Work Mode: Remote

### About the Role

We are looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to plan, execute, monitor, and optimize paid marketing campaigns across digital platforms. The ideal candidate should have strong analytical skills and hands-on experience in driving leads, conversions, and measurable business growth through paid advertising.

 Key Responsibilities

\* Develop and execute performance marketing strategies aligned with business goals.

\* Plan and manage campaigns across Meta Ads, Google Ads, and other relevant platforms

\* Manage campaign budgets and ensure efficient utilization of ad spend.

\* Conduct audience, competitor, and market research to identify growth opportunities.

\* Set up and optimize campaigns, audiences, placements, bidding, and budgets.

\* Monitor key performance metrics such as CPL, CPA, CPC, CTR, CPM, ROAS, and conversions

\* Continuously test and optimize ad creatives, copies, audiences, landing pages, and campaign strategies.

\* Analyze campaign data and identify opportunities to improve performance and ROI.

\* Work closely with the Creative, Social Media, Content, and Sales teams to improve campaign outcomes.

\* Track leads and conversions and coordinate with the sales team to monitor lead quality.

\* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights.

\* Identify underperforming campaigns and take timely corrective actions.

\* Stay updated with the latest digital advertising trends, platform updates, and performance marketing practices.

 Requirements

\* 2–5 years of experience in performance marketing or paid media.

\* Strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads

\* Good understanding of lead generation, conversion campaigns, retargeting, and funnel optimization.

\* Strong analytical and data interpretation skills.

\* Experience managing and optimizing advertising budgets.

\* Ability to make data-driven decisions and improve campaign performance.

\* Good communication, reporting, and team coordination skills.

\* Experience with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking will be an advantage.

 Key Performance Areas

\* Lead generation and conversion performance

\* Cost per lead/acquisition

\* ROAS and overall campaign ROI

\* Budget utilization

\* Lead quality

\* Campaign optimization and growth

\* Reporting and data-driven decision-making

title: Co-Founder, Chief Marketing & Transformation Officer(CMTO) with Investment
description:
**Company: Yuvrus Botanicals Pvt. Ltd.**

**Industry: Child Nutrition | Natural FMCG | Wellness**

**Location: Mumbai / Hybrid**

**Role: Full-Time | Co-Founder | Leadership & Investment Role**

**About Yuvrus Botanicals:**

Yuvrus Botanicals is building a new generation of trusted child nutrition and wellness products, combining the wisdom of nature with modern paediatric science. Better Nutrition. Better Choices. Better Futures. Beginning with our flagship child nutrition product Choco Genius, we are building a broader portfolio of natural nutrition and care products for children.Our ambition is bigger than building another FMCG brand: We aspire to build one of India's most trusted child nutrition brands — a brand mothers know, trust, choose, recommend and pass on.

**The Opportunity:**

We are looking for a Co-Founder & Chief Marketing & Transformation Officer (CMTO) to own and build the complete Brand, Marketing, Growth, Consumer and Transformation engine of Yuvrus Botanicals.

This is not a traditional CMO role.We are looking for a hands-on builder and growth operator who can take Yuvrus from:0 → 1 → 10 → 100

You will personally drive early-stage campaigns, identify what works, build repeatable growth systems, create a powerful consumer brand and eventually transform marketing into a data-driven, technology-enabled and increasingly automated growth engine.Brand → Attention → Trust → Acquisition → Conversion → Retention → Advocacy → ScaleThe goal is not simply to run campaigns.The goal is to build the machine that continuously creates demand, customers, revenue and brand equity.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Build the Yuvrus BrandOwn the evolution of Yuvrus from an early-stage startup into a nationally trusted child nutrition brand.

* Brand positioning and differentiation
* Consumer proposition and storytelling
* Brand voice and creative strategy
* Packaging and communication
* Founder and mother-led storytelling
* Consumer trust strategy
* Brand consistency and guidelines

When a mother thinks about child nutrition, Yuvrus should be one of the first brands that comes to mind.

2. Own Performance Marketing & Revenue GrowthYou must be exceptionally strong in performance marketing and comfortable owning revenue numbers.Lead and scale:

* Meta Ads
* Google Ads
* YouTube
* Marketplace advertising
* D2C acquisition
* Retargeting & remarketing
* Affiliate and social commerce

Own and optimise:CAC | ROAS | MER | CPA | CTR | CVR | AOV | LTV | LTV:CAC | Contribution MarginYou should be able to answer:“If we invest ₹1 crore in marketing, how much profitable revenue can we generate?”Marketing success will be measured by profitable growth, not vanity metrics.

3. Build the 0 → ₹100 Cr Growth EngineOwn the journey:₹0 → ₹1 Cr → ₹10 Cr → ₹50 Cr → ₹100 Cr+Identify winning channels, audiences, creatives, campaigns and offers, then build systems to scale them.You should be comfortable moving from:Doing → Building → Scaling → Systemising → AutomatingInitially, you may personally launch and optimise campaigns. As Yuvrus scales, build the team, technology, dashboards, SOPs, automation and AI systems required to make growth increasingly predictable and founder-independent.

4. Content Marketing & Consumer StorytellingBuild Yuvrus into a content-led child nutrition brand.Own content across:

* Instagram, YouTube and social platforms
* Reels and short-form video
* UGC and creator content
* Founder and expert-led content
* Educational and parent-focused content
* SEO and blogs
* Influencer partnerships
* Community content

Turn:Consumer Insight → Idea → Content → Distribution → Engagement → ConversionYou should be able to identify why content works and turn winning concepts into scalable creative systems.

5. Creative + PerformanceUnderstand that in modern D2C:Creative is the new targeting.Build and test:

* High-converting ad creatives
* UGC scripts
* Hooks and storyboards
* Testimonials
* Product demonstrations
* Educational/problem-solution creatives
* Social proof
* Founder/expert stories

Continuously test:Hook × Creative × Audience × Offer × Landing Page × CTAand scale combinations that produce sustainable economics.

6. Build the Trust EngineChild nutrition is fundamentally a trust category.Build consumer confidence through:

* Scientific communication
* Paediatric credibility
* Ingredient education
* Product transparency
* Parent education
* Expert collaborations
* Reviews and testimonials
* UGC and community
* Quality communication
* Mother-led storytelling

“Yuvrus is a brand I can trust with my child.”That should become the consumer reaction we earn.

7. Consumer Intelligence, CRM & RetentionBuild systems to understand:

* Why parents buy or don't buy
* What creates trust and hesitation
* Consumer and competitor trends
* Pricing and product opportunities
* Content and channel opportunities

Build:First Purchase → Second Purchase → Habit → Loyalty → AdvocacyOwn CRM, WhatsApp, email, loyalty, referrals, segmentation, personalisation and lifecycle marketing.

8. AI, Technology & Marketing TransformationYuvrus intends to become an AI-first FMCG company.Identify and implement:

* AI-assisted content creation
* Marketing automation
* CRM and segmentation
* Predictive analytics
* Personalisation
* Automated campaign optimisation
* Attribution and dashboards
* Automated reporting
* Creative testing
* Consumer intelligence
* AI-powered decision support

Build a marketing organisation where technology and AI multiply human capability and reduce operational dependency.

9. Build the Marketing Organisation & Operating SystemInitially be a hands-on builder and progressively build a high-performance team across:Brand | Performance | Growth | Content | Creative | Social | Influencers | CRM | E-commerce | AnalyticsEstablish:

* Annual and quarterly growth plans
* Campaign calendars
* Weekly growth reviews
* CAC/ROAS/LTV dashboards
* Cohort and conversion tracking
* Attribution
* Creative testing
* Marketing SOPs
* Campaign post-mortems

Every marketing rupee should answer:Where did it go? What did it generate? What did we learn? Should we scale, optimise or stop?

**Who You Are?**

We are looking for a builder, not a caretaker.

You should be:

* A proven marketing and growth leader
* Exceptional in performance marketing
* Excellent in content marketing
* Highly analytical and commercially minded
* Obsessed with ROAS and profitable growth
* Strong in CAC/LTV economics
* Experienced in D2C and e-commerce
* Strong in brand building and storytelling
* Experienced in influencer/creator marketing
* Comfortable with A/B testing and experimentation
* Strong in marketing analytics and consumer research
* Comfortable building teams and agencies
* Comfortable with ambiguity and limited resources
* Entrepreneurial and comfortable owning revenue outcomes
* Excited to build from scratch

You should want to build something you can call your own.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA / PGDM from IIM / ISB / IIT / equivalent reputed global institution preferred
* 10+ years in marketing, growth, FMCG, D2C, food, nutrition, wellness, baby care or consumer brands
* Proven experience scaling a consumer business from early stage
* Hands-on expertise in Performance Marketing
* Strong expertise in Meta, Google, YouTube and digital acquisition
* Strong understanding of ROAS, MER, CAC, LTV, contribution margin and retention
* Strong Content Marketing experience
* Experience with D2C, marketplaces, influencers and creators
* Experience implementing CRM and marketing automation
* Experience building high-performance teams
* Excellent communication, storytelling and leadership skills

**Preferred Industry:**
Child Nutrition | Baby Care | FMCG | Food | Nutraceuticals | Wellness | Ayurveda | Parenting | Healthcare

**What Success Looks Like**

You will be measured on business outcomes, not vanity metrics.Brand: Awareness | Consideration | Search | Trust | Share of VoiceGrowth: Revenue | CAC | ROAS | MER | LTV | LTV:CAC | Conversion | Repeat Purchase | Retention | Contribution MarginContent: Organic Growth | Engagement | UGC | Creator Performance | Content-to-Commerce ConversionTransformation: Automation | AI Adoption | Team Productivity | SOPs | Reporting | Reduced Founder Dependency

Ultimate KPI: Can Yuvrus continue growing even when the founder is not personally driving every campaign?

**What You Get**

* Co-Founder & Chief Marketing & Transformation Officer title
* Meaningful equity ownership with investment participation
* Direct ownership of Brand, Growth, Marketing & Transformation
* Salary post-fundraise, aligned with market standards and role scope
* Significant strategic decision-making authority
* Opportunity to build a high-performance marketing organisation
* Opportunity to build a national D2C + FMCG brand
* Long-term ownership in a high-growth natural wellness company
* Opportunity to work directly with the founding team

**The Co-Founder Mindset**

This is not for someone looking for a conventional CMO job.It is for someone who wants to build.Someone who doesn't ask:“What is my marketing budget?”but asks:“What is the fastest responsible way to build consumer trust and create ₹100 Cr of sustainable demand?”Someone who doesn't say:“My agency will handle it.”but says:“I own the outcome.”You don't want to simply manage an established brand. You want to build one.

**Our Mission:**
Every child deserves better nutrition. Every mother deserves better choices.

**If you are ready to put your experience, network, leadership, entrepreneurial energy and capital behind building a brand that millions of mothers can trust:We should talk.**

**Build the Brand. Build the Growth Engine. Build the Future of Child Nutrition.**

**Apply to become Co-Founder & Chief Marketing & Transformation Officer at Yuvrus Botanicals..**

title: Performance Marketing Expert
description:
Performance Marketing Expert (Meta & Google Ads) — Better Opinions (YC W22)

Location: Bangalore [Remote]

Experience: [3–6] years in performance marketing

Type: Full-time

About Us

Better Opinions is a Y Combinator-backed (W22) consumer tech company building products for India’s sports fans. Our products include SpottoTV, a subscription sports video app, and Crick AI, an AI-powered cricket companion app.

The Role

We’re looking for a hands-on Performance Marketing Expert who can own paid acquisition on Meta and Google end to end, with minimum supervision. You’ll be responsible for driving installs and paid subscriptions at efficient CAC, and you’ll have real budget, real ownership, and a direct line to the founders. This is not a role where you wait for briefs. You’ll set the plan, run the experiments, read the data, and scale what’s working.

What You’ll Do

* Plan, launch and scale campaigns across Meta (Facebook, Instagram) and Google (UAC/App campaigns, Search, YouTube) for SpottoTV and Crick AI
* Own key metrics: CPI, cost per trial, cost per subscriber, ROAS and payback period
* Build and run a structured testing roadmap across audiences, creatives, bidding strategies and landing flows
* Work with the design and content team to brief, iterate and refresh ad creatives, and identify winning hooks quickly
* Plan spends around the cricket calendar (IPL, India series, World Cups) and capitalise on live-match moments
* Set up and maintain tracking with MMPs, Firebase and GA4; make sure attribution is clean
* Analyse funnel and cohort data to optimise not just for installs, but for revenue
  retention
* Manage budgets independently and report weekly on performance, learnings and next steps
* Stay on top of platform changes, policy updates and new ad formats

What We’re Looking For

* 3–5 years of hands-on experience running Meta and Google app campaigns, ideally for consumer subscription, OTT apps
* Proven track record of scaling spends profitably (please share numbers in your application)
* Strong understanding of app install and app event optimisation and MMP setup
* Data-driven: comfortable with spreadsheets, dashboards and ideally basic SQL
* Sharp creative instinct: you know what makes a scroll-stopping ad for Indian audiences
* Self-starter who can work independently and make decisions without close supervision
* Bonus: experience marketing to Tier 2/3 India, regional language campaigns, or a genuine love for cricket

Why Join Us

* Full ownership of a core growth channel with meaningful budgets
* Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy, and room to experiment
* Competitive compensation

How to Apply

Send your CV to soumyajit@betteropinions.in with the subject “Performance Marketing application – [Your Name]”. Include one campaign you scaled, the spend, and the results. Applications with real numbers get priority.

title: Social Media Executive
description:
Role: Social Media Executive

Experience: 0–2 Years

Mode: Remote / In-person (Noida)

Compensation: ₹2.40 LPA (Fixed) + Growth incentives based on output

**About the job**

We are hiring an original thinker who sees patterns in things most miss and in parallel has equivalent passion to build a name for themselves in the social media industry.

We work with Meta, Google, Netflix, Microsoft, Nvidia, Indian Navy, Adobe, World Bank and brands you have definitely heard of.

Here is the thing: if you strongly think you match the above description and can outwork anyone when it comes to grunt work while keeping a big tech CTO and a fresher developer engaged behind a social media admin guise, we would love to hear from you.

**You're a good fit if**

* You think about how content is consumed, remembered, and shared.
* You live online and instinctively know why certain content pops off while corporate posts get scrolled past.
* You understand platform psychology: how a visual narrative on Instagram differs from an update on LinkedIn, a quick take on X, or a conversation on Reddit.
* You write like an actual person, sharp, conversational, and direct.
* You understand clear thinking precedes clear writing. If you cannot explain an idea simply in one sentence, you do not understand it well enough. The internet rewards compression, not fluff.
* You get that distribution is a product. Your job is not just to schedule posts. It is to understand internet distribution loops, human psychology, and how ideas spread.
* You get why taste matters. Bad design, sloppy formatting, and generic corporate tone dilute brand equity immediately. You should have high standards.
* You are exceptionally fast and have high agency. You run experiments rather than waiting for permission.
* You care about real outcomes: inbound interest, registrations, and genuine community engagement.
* You treat content like it’s real estate. Every word you write has a clear value proposition and an obvious call to action.

Take a look at Reskilll’s digital presence. If you're looking for a serious long-term engagement rather than just another stint, make up your mind and apply below. If you are able to hit the spot, an assignment awaits you to prove your mettle.

Time to socialize, online 👩🏻‍💻

Apply now and join the team!

title: Performance Marketing Account Executive
description:
Company:       The Ad Hive

Location:          Udyog Vihar, Gurugram, Haryana

Work-Model:  Hybrid - 4 days in office (mandatory) + 1 day work from home

Type:                Full-time

Experience:    2–4 years, hands-on

Joining:            Immediate joiners preferred (notice period up to 15 days)

**About us**

The Ad Hive is a boutique performance marketing agency. We run Meta and Google Ads for D2C fashion and lifestyle brands in India and the US.

We keep our client list small on purpose, so every account gets real attention. Our founder brings 20+ years in e-commerce and paid media.

**The Role**

You will run the day-to-day work on our client meta, google and other paid media ad accounts and handle routine client communication. The founder owns strategy, automation and final sign-off.

Your job is to make sure the plan gets done: on time, without errors, and with clients kept informed.

**What you'll do**

**Campaign execution**

* Build, launch and update Meta and Google campaigns (PMax, Shopping, Search, Demand Gen, Advantage+) as per the agreed plan.
* Run daily account checks: spend pacing, errors, disapprovals, creative fatigue, budget changes.
* Fix product feed issues in Google Merchant Center and the Meta catalogue.
* Brief and produce ad creative variations using AI tools (Higgsfield).

**Client communication**

* Be the first point of contact for routine client requests on WhatsApp and email: creative swaps, offer updates, small fixes, status updates.
* Reply to clients the same working day.
* Escalate anything about strategy, budgets, results or complaints to the founder the same day.

**Reporting and process**

* Prepare weekly and monthly report data. Match ad-platform sales against Shopify.
* Log every task and campaign change in ClickUp.
* Use Claude and our in-house AI workflows daily to speed up audits, reports and builds.

**Must-have**

* 2–4 years of hands-on work in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads. You did the work yourself, not just the reporting.
* Experience with D2C or e-commerce brands. Fashion or apparel is a strong plus.
* Working knowledge of Shopify and Google Merchant Center.
* You can explain why a campaign won or failed, using numbers (ROAS, CPA, CTR, conversion rate).
* Clear, polite written English. Hindi helps for Indian clients.
* Strong in Excel or Google Sheets.
* Comfortable with AI tools, and quick to learn new ones.

**Good to have**

* Festive or sale-season campaign experience (Diwali, Black Friday).
* Exposure to US-market campaigns.
* Basic GA4, Google Tag Manager, or Meta pixel and Conversions API knowledge.

**This role is not for you if**

* Your experience is mostly boosting posts, or lead-gen only.
* You prefer making strategy decks over hands-on execution.
* You need step-by-step instructions for routine work.
* You can't commit to 4 days a week in the office.

**What we offer**

* Competitive salary plus a performance bonus, based on experience.
* Hybrid work: 4 days in office, 1 day from home.
* Mon–Fri working week.
* Direct learning from a founder with 20+ years in e-commerce and paid media.
* Exposure to Indian and international D2C brands.
* A modern, AI-first workflow with less manual grunt work.
* Paid certifications and learning support.
