title: Growth Marketing Manager (User Acquisition & Lifecycle)
description:
**Growth Marketing Manager (User Acquisition & Lifecycle)**

**Spiceworks | Cloud Help Desk & Inventory Online**

**The Opportunity**

Spiceworks has been an industry pillar for more than 15 years, cultivating a community of millions of IT

professionals. Its flagship IT Helpdesk product, now Cloud Help Desk (CHD), has evolved from a completely free,

ad-supported solution to a freemium, subscription-based model designed to provide users with an ad-free

experience and additional premium features.

We are looking for a hands-on Growth Marketing Manager to own user acquisition and lifecycle execution across

Cloud Help Desk and Inventory Online. This is a high-drive individual contributor role for someone who enjoys

building, launching, testing, and optimizing growth programs directly. You will be responsible for increasing user

acquisition, reactivating lapsed users, engaging active free users, and helping convert qualified users into premium

subscribers.

You will work closely with Product Management, Community, and internal product experts. While product experts

will support deep technical demonstrations and product knowledge, you will own the growth engine—from audience

segmentation and campaign execution through engagement, conversion, and performance measurement.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Database Reactivation & Win-Back Funnels: Build, write, launch, and optimize targeted reactivation email

campaigns for historical and lapsed users. Develop messaging that communicates the value of the modernized,

ad-free product experience, ease of setup, workflow efficiency, and minimal operational disruption.

* Product-Led Growth (PLG) & Lifecycle Marketing: Build and manage automated lifecycle campaigns triggered by

user behavior and product-usage milestones. Own the user journey from free sign-up or trial through

engagement, activation, and premium conversion.

* Campaign Development & Optimization: Create segmented, targeted, and multi-channel campaigns using

lifecycle marketing platforms such as HubSpot, Intercom, Marketo, or similar tools. Test messaging, audiences,

timing, and conversion paths to improve acquisition and subscription outcomes.

* Field Marketing, Local Meetups & Roadshows: Plan, coordinate, and host localized user meetups, workshops,

and roadshows designed to re-engage free and lapsed users. Work with existing Spiceworks community

chapters to build local participation and create meaningful user interactions.

* Event-Led Acquisition: Partner with internal product experts to deliver engaging user sessions, ensuring

technical product demonstrations are complemented by clear value messaging and a defined digital conversion

journey.

* Community & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with the Community Manager to understand forum

sentiment, identify opportunities within the community, and turn relevant discussions and engagement into

acquisition opportunities.

* Performance & Insights: Track acquisition velocity, engagement, reactivation, free-to-paid conversion, and

campaign performance. Use data and event feedback to identify opportunities, improve campaigns, and provide

actionable insights to Product Management.

* End-to-End Ownership: Take personal ownership of growth initiatives from audience selection and campaign

creation through launch, measurement, optimization, and reporting.

**Job Qualifications**

**Required Knowledge, Skills and Attributes:**

* 2–5 years of hands-on experience in B2B SaaS growth marketing, user acquisition, lifecycle marketing, product-

led growth, or a closely related discipline.

* Demonstrated experience building and executing automated lifecycle campaigns using tools such as HubSpot,

Intercom, Marketo, or similar marketing automation platforms.

* Hands-on experience with user segmentation, behavioral targeting, email journeys, conversion funnels, and

campaign optimization.

* Experience organizing and executing community events, user meetups, workshops, roadshows, or other field

marketing initiatives.

* Strong growth-oriented copywriting skills, with the ability to translate product capabilities and updates into clear,

compelling user benefits.

* Strong analytical mindset with comfort working with user data, acquisition metrics, conversion rates, campaign

performance, and growth targets.

* Ability to work independently, move quickly, experiment, learn from results, and take ownership of execution.
* Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly when partnering with Product,

Community, and technical subject-matter experts.

Required Education and/or Experience:

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior experience in a SaaS, technology, IT, developer, workflow, or digital product environment is preferred.
* Experience working with a freemium or product-led growth model is strongly preferred.

**About Spiceworks:**

Spiceworks is a technology-focused community and software business serving IT professionals. Its community

brings together IT professionals and technology decision-makers, while its software products help businesses

manage essential IT workflows. The Cloud Help Desk and Inventory Online products are designed to support IT

teams with practical tools for managing their day-to-day technology operations.

As part of Ziff Davis, Spiceworks operates within a portfolio of leading brands across technology, shopping,

entertainment, health and wellness, cybersecurity, and marketing technology. This role offers the opportunity to

work at the intersection of SaaS growth, community, product marketing, and user acquisition.

**About Ziff Davis:**

Ziff Davis (NASDAQ: ZD) is a vertically focused digital media and internet company whose portfolio includes leading

brands in technology, shopping, gaming and entertainment, health, cybersecurity, and martech. Today, Ziff Davis is

focused on six key verticals – Technology, Shopping, Entertainment, Health & Wellness, Cybersecurity and

Marketing Technology. Its brands include IGN, Mashable, RetailMeNot, PCMag, Humble Bundle, Spiceworks,

Everyday Health, BabyCenter, Moz, iContact and Vipre Security.

**Our Benefits:**

Ziff Davis offers competitive salaries in addition to robust, health and wellness-focused benefits. We are committed

to work-life balance with paid time off when you need it.

At Ziff Davis, we remain dedicated to creating an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and

empowered to succeed. We offer Employee Resource Groups, company-sponsored events, and regular

opportunities for professional growth through educational support, mentorship programs, and career development

resources. Our employees are recognized and celebrated through employee engagement programs and recognition

awards.

If you are seeking a dynamic and collaborative work environment where you can see the direct impact of your

performance and thrive both personally and professionally, then Ziff Davis is the place for you.

Compensation Range:

Compensation details will be provided based on the applicable location and employment market. Individual

compensation may be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, geographic location,

education and training, and business and company performance.

Ziff Davis is an Equal Opportunity Employer. At Ziff Davis, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) has always been

about fairness, equal opportunity, and belonging. DEI enables us to attract and retain the best talent, regardless of

background or circumstances, while enabling our thousands of employees worldwide to thrive. If you have a

disability or learning difficulty that requires accommodation, please let us know through the appropriate

Recruiting/HR contact.

title: Growth Marketing Manager (User Acquisition & Lifecycle)
description:
**Growth Marketing Manager (User Acquisition & Lifecycle)**

**Spiceworks | Cloud Help Desk & Inventory Online**

**The Opportunity**

Spiceworks has been an industry pillar for more than 15 years, cultivating a community of millions of IT

professionals. Its flagship IT Helpdesk product, now Cloud Help Desk (CHD), has evolved from a completely free,

ad-supported solution to a freemium, subscription-based model designed to provide users with an ad-free

experience and additional premium features.

We are looking for a hands-on Growth Marketing Manager to own user acquisition and lifecycle execution across

Cloud Help Desk and Inventory Online. This is a high-drive individual contributor role for someone who enjoys

building, launching, testing, and optimizing growth programs directly. You will be responsible for increasing user

acquisition, reactivating lapsed users, engaging active free users, and helping convert qualified users into premium

subscribers.

You will work closely with Product Management, Community, and internal product experts. While product experts

will support deep technical demonstrations and product knowledge, you will own the growth engine—from audience

segmentation and campaign execution through engagement, conversion, and performance measurement.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Database Reactivation & Win-Back Funnels: Build, write, launch, and optimize targeted reactivation email

campaigns for historical and lapsed users. Develop messaging that communicates the value of the modernized,

ad-free product experience, ease of setup, workflow efficiency, and minimal operational disruption.

* Product-Led Growth (PLG) & Lifecycle Marketing: Build and manage automated lifecycle campaigns triggered by

user behavior and product-usage milestones. Own the user journey from free sign-up or trial through

engagement, activation, and premium conversion.

* Campaign Development & Optimization: Create segmented, targeted, and multi-channel campaigns using

lifecycle marketing platforms such as HubSpot, Intercom, Marketo, or similar tools. Test messaging, audiences,

timing, and conversion paths to improve acquisition and subscription outcomes.

* Field Marketing, Local Meetups & Roadshows: Plan, coordinate, and host localized user meetups, workshops,

and roadshows designed to re-engage free and lapsed users. Work with existing Spiceworks community

chapters to build local participation and create meaningful user interactions.

* Event-Led Acquisition: Partner with internal product experts to deliver engaging user sessions, ensuring

technical product demonstrations are complemented by clear value messaging and a defined digital conversion

journey.

* Community & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with the Community Manager to understand forum

sentiment, identify opportunities within the community, and turn relevant discussions and engagement into

acquisition opportunities.

* Performance & Insights: Track acquisition velocity, engagement, reactivation, free-to-paid conversion, and

campaign performance. Use data and event feedback to identify opportunities, improve campaigns, and provide

actionable insights to Product Management.

* End-to-End Ownership: Take personal ownership of growth initiatives from audience selection and campaign

creation through launch, measurement, optimization, and reporting.

**Job Qualifications**

**Required Knowledge, Skills and Attributes:**

* 2–5 years of hands-on experience in B2B SaaS growth marketing, user acquisition, lifecycle marketing, product-

led growth, or a closely related discipline.

* Demonstrated experience building and executing automated lifecycle campaigns using tools such as HubSpot,

Intercom, Marketo, or similar marketing automation platforms.

* Hands-on experience with user segmentation, behavioral targeting, email journeys, conversion funnels, and

campaign optimization.

* Experience organizing and executing community events, user meetups, workshops, roadshows, or other field

marketing initiatives.

* Strong growth-oriented copywriting skills, with the ability to translate product capabilities and updates into clear,

compelling user benefits.

* Strong analytical mindset with comfort working with user data, acquisition metrics, conversion rates, campaign

performance, and growth targets.

* Ability to work independently, move quickly, experiment, learn from results, and take ownership of execution.
* Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly when partnering with Product,

Community, and technical subject-matter experts.

Required Education and/or Experience:

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior experience in a SaaS, technology, IT, developer, workflow, or digital product environment is preferred.
* Experience working with a freemium or product-led growth model is strongly preferred.

**About Spiceworks:**

Spiceworks is a technology-focused community and software business serving IT professionals. Its community

brings together IT professionals and technology decision-makers, while its software products help businesses

manage essential IT workflows. The Cloud Help Desk and Inventory Online products are designed to support IT

teams with practical tools for managing their day-to-day technology operations.

As part of Ziff Davis, Spiceworks operates within a portfolio of leading brands across technology, shopping,

entertainment, health and wellness, cybersecurity, and marketing technology. This role offers the opportunity to

work at the intersection of SaaS growth, community, product marketing, and user acquisition.

**About Ziff Davis:**

Ziff Davis (NASDAQ: ZD) is a vertically focused digital media and internet company whose portfolio includes leading

brands in technology, shopping, gaming and entertainment, health, cybersecurity, and martech. Today, Ziff Davis is

focused on six key verticals – Technology, Shopping, Entertainment, Health & Wellness, Cybersecurity and

Marketing Technology. Its brands include IGN, Mashable, RetailMeNot, PCMag, Humble Bundle, Spiceworks,

Everyday Health, BabyCenter, Moz, iContact and Vipre Security.

**Our Benefits:**

Ziff Davis offers competitive salaries in addition to robust, health and wellness-focused benefits. We are committed

to work-life balance with paid time off when you need it.

At Ziff Davis, we remain dedicated to creating an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and

empowered to succeed. We offer Employee Resource Groups, company-sponsored events, and regular

opportunities for professional growth through educational support, mentorship programs, and career development

resources. Our employees are recognized and celebrated through employee engagement programs and recognition

awards.

If you are seeking a dynamic and collaborative work environment where you can see the direct impact of your

performance and thrive both personally and professionally, then Ziff Davis is the place for you.

About House of Ardour

House of Ardour is an Ahmedabad-based home fragrance brand creating thoughtfully crafted luxury soy candles and reed diffusers. We combine beautiful design, elevated fragrances, and everyday indulgence to create products for personal use, gifting, and corporate occasions.

* Identify and reach out to potential corporate gifting clients, gifting agencies, retailers, event planners, and other B2B customers.

**2. WhatsApp & Customer Marketing**

* Plan and execute WhatsApp marketing and customer outreach campaigns for product launches, festive gifting, offers, and repeat purchases.
* Maintain customer and prospect databases and ensure timely follow-ups.
* Assist with email outreach, promotional campaigns, and other customer engagement initiatives.

**3. Sales Operations & Organization**

* Maintain Excel sheets and trackers for leads, orders, follow-ups, sales performance, and client databases.
* Keep sales records, quotations, and customer information accurate and up to date.
* Track pending enquiries, upcoming follow-ups, order status, and other important tasks independently.
* Help improve existing processes and bring more structure to day-to-day operations.

**4. Marketing & Brand Support**

* Assist with basic Canva designs for catalogs, presentations, product promotions, and sales collateral.
* Coordinate product catalogs, gifting proposals, and marketing material for B2B clients.
* Support product launches, festive campaigns, collaborations, and other marketing initiatives.
* Contribute ideas to improve brand visibility, customer engagement, and sales conversion.

**5. General Business Support**

* Be willing to take ownership of additional tasks and projects as the business grows.
* Coordinate with internal teams, vendors, and clients to ensure smooth execution of orders and campaigns.
* Take initiative, identify gaps, and proactively suggest solutions rather than waiting for instructions for every task.

What We’re Looking For

* Experience in sales, business development, customer relationship management, or sales and marketing operations.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including data organization, filters, sorting, and basic formulas.
* Confidence and willingness to make cold calls and follow up with prospective clients.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly over WhatsApp, email, and phone.
* Good organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and follow-ups.
* Basic Canva skills and an eye for presentation and visual consistency.
* A proactive, resourceful, and ownership-driven attitude.
* Comfort working in a small, growing business where responsibilities may extend beyond a fixed job description.

**Most importantly, we value initiative, consistency, and the ability to get things done.**
We are looking for someone who can work independently, stay organized, and contribute to both sales growth and the smooth functioning of the business.

Ahmedabad

Full-time, on-site

**Department:**
Sales & Marketing

Marketing Strategy & Planning

* Develop and execute the company’s overall marketing strategy for target markets in the USA, UK, Europe, and Australia.

* Create annual and quarterly marketing plans with clear budgets, timelines, KPIs, and expected pipeline contribution.

SEO & Website Marketing

* Own the company’s SEO strategy, including keyword research, on-page SEO, technical SEO coordination, link-building, and local/international SEO.

Outbound Lead Generation

Content & Blog Management

About Sapiogen AI

Sapiogen AI is an AI-first software engineering company that helps businesses build intelligent software products, scalable digital platforms, and AI-powered business solutions. We combine AI capabilities with human engineering expertise to help startups, scale-ups, and enterprises accelerate product development, modernize technology, and drive business growth.

Our services include AI-powered product development, AI strategy and consulting, AI development and systems, AI automation, conversational and voice AI, AI integration, cloud infrastructure engineering, data systems engineering, and legacy modernization.

We are building a strong international presence, targeting clients across the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, and the UAE.

At Sapiogen AI, SEO is not just about rankings and traffic. It is about building organic visibility, establishing authority in AI and software engineering, attracting decision-makers, and generating qualified business opportunities.

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive and analytical SEO Executive to strengthen Sapiogen AI's organic search presence and contribute to our inbound marketing strategy.

The ideal candidate should understand technical SEO, on-page optimization, keyword research, content optimization, link building, and performance analysis. You will work closely with the marketing team and content writers to improve our website's search visibility, attract relevant international audiences, and generate organic leads.

You should also be interested in the evolving search landscape, including AI-powered search experiences, answer engines, and generative search platforms.

Key Responsibilities1. Keyword Research & Search Strategy

* Conduct keyword research to identify high-intent commercial, transactional, and informational keywords relevant to AI services and software engineering.
* Identify keyword opportunities around AI development, AI consulting, custom software development, AI automation, and enterprise technology solutions.
* Analyze keyword difficulty, search volume, search intent, competition, and business relevance.
* Map primary and secondary keywords to existing website pages and new content opportunities.
* Identify long-tail keywords and service-specific search opportunities targeting international markets.
* Conduct competitor SEO analysis to identify content gaps, backlink opportunities, and ranking strategies.

2. On-Page SEO

* Optimize website pages, service pages, landing pages, blogs, and industry-specific pages.
* Improve title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, image alt text, internal links, and content structure.
* Ensure pages align with search intent and relevant commercial keywords.
* Optimize landing pages for both organic visibility and conversion potential.
* Maintain keyword mapping and prevent keyword cannibalization across website pages.
* Collaborate with content writers to ensure SEO-friendly, readable, authoritative, and user-focused content.

3. Technical SEO

* Conduct regular technical SEO audits and identify website issues affecting crawling, indexing, and rankings.
* Monitor XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical tags, redirects, broken links, and indexability.
* Identify duplicate content, crawl errors, orphan pages, and internal linking issues.
* Monitor Core Web Vitals, mobile usability, page speed, and overall website performance.
* Implement or coordinate structured data and relevant schema markup.
* Work with developers to resolve technical SEO issues and improve website architecture.
* Verify that important pages are accessible to search engines and render correctly.
* Support SEO requirements during website updates, migrations, and new landing page launches.

4. Content SEO & Topical Authority

* Develop keyword-driven content briefs for blogs, landing pages, service pages, and supporting resources.
* Identify content clusters and topic opportunities that establish Sapiogen AI's authority in AI-first software engineering.
* Optimize existing content to improve rankings, relevance, engagement, and organic conversions.
* Coordinate with content writers to maintain consistent publishing schedules.
* Identify outdated or underperforming content and recommend updates.
* Ensure content demonstrates expertise, provides genuine value, and avoids keyword stuffing or low-quality AI-generated material.
* Support the development of industry pages, use-case pages, comparison pages, and solution-focused content.

5. Off-Page SEO & Link Building

* Identify relevant, authoritative websites for backlink acquisition.
* Execute ethical link-building activities through outreach, guest contributions, digital PR opportunities, and relevant industry partnerships.
* Monitor backlink profiles, referring domains, anchor text, and competitor link-building strategies.
* Identify potentially harmful backlinks and recommend appropriate action where necessary.
* Focus on relevant, quality backlinks rather than spammy link volume.

6. International SEO

* Support organic growth across the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, and the UAE.
* Research regional keyword variations, search intent, and competitor positioning.
* Optimize service and industry pages for relevant international audiences.
* Identify opportunities to improve geographic relevance without creating unnecessary duplicate pages.
* Monitor organic traffic, rankings, and conversions by country.

7. AI Search, AEO & GEO

* Understand and support emerging SEO practices for AI-powered search experiences.
* Help optimize content for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
* Structure content to answer relevant customer questions clearly and accurately.
* Improve topical authority, entity consistency, structured data, and content credibility.
* Monitor brand visibility and mentions across AI search platforms where reliable measurement methods are available.
* Explore opportunities to improve Sapiogen AI's discoverability across platforms such as Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT search, and Perplexity.
* Track changes in organic search and AI-driven discovery without treating unverified AI visibility metrics as guaranteed rankings.

8. Analytics & Reporting

* Monitor website performance using Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and SEO tools.
* Track keyword rankings, organic clicks, impressions, click-through rates, landing page performance, and conversions.
* Prepare weekly progress updates and monthly SEO performance reports.
* Identify traffic drops, ranking changes, indexing issues, and opportunities for improvement.
* Evaluate SEO performance based on qualified traffic and business outcomes, not just keyword positions.
* Recommend data-driven actions to improve organic visibility and lead generation.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 3+ years of hands-on SEO experience.
* Strong understanding of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and keyword research.
* Practical experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4.
* Familiarity with tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or equivalent SEO platforms.
* Understanding of website architecture, internal linking, indexing, crawling, canonicalization, and redirects.
* Experience optimizing content for search intent, topical relevance, and conversions.
* Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, website performance, and structured data.
* Strong analytical, research, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to collaborate with developers, content writers, and marketing professionals.
* Understanding of B2B SEO and international SEO will be an advantage.
* Familiarity with AI search optimization, AEO, GEO, and AI-assisted SEO workflows is desirable.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated against agreed targets, baseline website performance, and business priorities.

* Improvement in organic clicks, impressions, and qualified organic traffic.
* Growth in rankings for relevant commercial and service-related keywords.
* Improvement in organic click-through rates and landing page performance.
* Technical SEO issue identification and resolution.
* Growth in relevant referring domains and high-quality backlinks.
* Consistent execution of the approved SEO and content optimization roadmap.
* Improvement in organic conversions, enquiries, and marketing-qualified leads.
* Improved visibility for priority services and target international markets.
* Contribution to brand discoverability across traditional and AI-powered search experiences.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to build and scale SEO for an AI-first software engineering company.
* Hands-on exposure to international B2B marketing and technology markets.
* Opportunities to work across technical SEO, content strategy, and AI search optimization.
* Direct collaboration with the marketing, content, and engineering teams.
* A performance-oriented environment with opportunities for professional growth.
* The opportunity to contribute to a growing technology brand from an early stage.

Who Should Apply?

We are looking for someone who takes ownership, thinks analytically, and understands that effective SEO combines technical excellence, valuable content, authority building, and business relevance.

If you enjoy solving SEO challenges, experimenting with emerging search strategies, and turning organic visibility into meaningful business opportunities, we would like to hear from you.

**Apply now to join Sapiogen AI and help build our organic growth engine.**

The candidate will be responsible for developing new business opportunities, building strong relationships with OEMs, industrial customers, dealers, distributors, system integrators, and consultants, and achieving assigned sales and marketing targets.

The ideal candidate must have a strong understanding of industrial products, technical sales, market trends, and customer requirements, with the ability to convert inquiries into profitable business.

Key Responsibilities1. Business Development & Market Expansion

* Develop new territories and strengthen the company's presence in existing markets.
* Conduct regular customer visits to generate leads, understand technical requirements, and develop long-term business relationships.

title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

**The Role**

JoVE is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Senior Marketing Operations Specialist. This role combines email marketing, marketing automation, CRM/database management, and marketing analytics to ensure our campaigns are delivered efficiently, reach the right audiences, and generate measurable business results.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, and Google Analytics and can translate marketing objectives into reliable segmentation, automated journeys, and actionable reporting. They independently identify root causes, recommend practical solutions, and implement improvements that deliver measurable results.

**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain automated lifecycle journeys, including entry and exit criteria, behavioral triggers, sales handoffs and return-to-nurture rules. Support campaign execution through reusable workflows and templates.
* Perform quality assurance (QA) to ensure campaigns are error-free and delivered successfully.
* Diagnose and improve email delivery, inbox placement and engagement. Monitor sender reputation, bounces, complaints and audience health, coordinating technical fixes with RevOps.
* Design and evaluate campaign A/B tests using clear hypotheses and success metrics, including downstream conversion.
* Maintain and improve the marketing database through enrichment, validation, duplicate controls and documented data-quality checks.
* Own marketing data-quality monitoring and audience usability. Partner with RevOps, Sales, and Product on shared CRM definitions, field mappings, and data integrity.
* Build and maintain dashboards across Salesforce, HubSpot, and Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
* Track marketing KPIs, campaign performance, lead generation, funnel conversion, pipeline contribution, and ROI.
* Analyze marketing performance and provide actionable insights to optimize campaigns and support strategic decision-making.
* Develop and validate lead and account scoring using profile and behavioral signals. Agree handoff thresholds with Sales and refine scoring based on progression and feedback.
* Evaluate and introduce tools, including AI, that expand marketing capabilities, and enable the team to use them effectively through enablement and practical guidance.

 **Requirements**  

* 5+ years of relevant experience, including independent ownership of Marketing Operations improvements beyond campaign execution.

* Advanced HubSpot experience in workflows, dynamic segmentation and data management.
* Ability to evaluate behavioral signals, explain performance and deliver measurable improvements.
* Knowledge of email deliverability best practices and marketing automation.
* Experience with marketing attribution and funnel analysis.
* Experience with Salesforce reporting, CRM management and Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
* Experience managing marketing databases, segmentation, and data hygiene.
* Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets.

**Success Measures**

* Accurate and timely execution of global email campaigns, with reduced turnaround time and manual effort.
* A reliable marketing database with effective audience segmentation and fewer recurring data errors.
* Reliable dashboards and reporting that support business decisions.
* Improved lead qualification, funnel progression and Sales handoff quality.
* Adoption of reusable processes, automation and tools that improve team productivity and reduce workflow errors.
Measurable improvements in campaign performance and contribution to pipeline generation.  

  
  
**Benefits**  

* A competitive compensation package

* You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
* Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
* Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Marketing AI and Personalization SME
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

The Marketing AI and Personalization SME will define and drive AI-enabled marketing transformation. The role will identify, prioritize, and shape AI, generative AI, decisioning, and agentic AI use cases that improve marketing effectiveness, customer experience, and operational productivity.

The candidate should combine strong marketing knowledge with practical knowledge of AI capabilities. This is not an AI engineering role. The primary focus is on business use cases, solution shaping, operating models, adoption, responsible AI, and value realization.

**Key Responsibilities –**

**Marketing AI Strategy**

* Define the AI-enabled or AI-native marketing vision and transformation roadmap.
* Assess current marketing processes to identify opportunities for AI augmentation or automation.
* Prioritize AI use cases based on business value, feasibility, risk, data readiness, and adoption requirements.
* Define the role of AI across marketing planning, content, audiences, journeys, decisioning, operations, and measurement.
* Develop executive business cases and investment recommendations.

**Generative AI for Marketing**

* Define use cases for content ideation, generation, variation, summarization, review, and localization.
* Develop requirements for marketing copilots and knowledge assistants.
* Design human-in-the-loop processes for content generation, approval, and compliance review.
* Identify opportunities to reduce campaign development and content production cycle times.
* Define integration requirements between generative AI capabilities and content, campaign, and workflow platforms.

**Agentic Marketing**

* Identify marketing processes suitable for agent-based orchestration or automation.
* Define use cases for campaign planning, audience analysis, journey monitoring, content operations, marketing analytics, and performance optimization agents.
* Design human oversight, escalation, audit, and approval requirements.
* Collaborate with AI architects to define multi-agent workflows and platform requirements.
* Establish boundaries for autonomous and human-approved actions.

**AI-Driven Personalization and Decisioning**

* Define AI-enabled segmentation and propensity-based targeting strategies.
* Develop next-best-action, next-best-offer, and recommendation use cases.
* Define decisioning requirements, including eligibility, prioritization, suppression, arbitration, and contact policies.
* Help connect customer signals, predictive insights, contextual information, and business rules.
* Partner with analytics teams to define model use cases and measurement approaches.

**Job Description cont'd**
--------------------------

**Responsible AI and Governance**

* Define responsible AI controls for marketing use cases.
* Establish transparency, explainability, fairness, privacy, human oversight, and audit requirements.
* Identify risks related to hallucination, bias, intellectual property, inappropriate content, customer discrimination, and regulatory compliance.
* Collaborate with legal, privacy, compliance, model risk, security, and brand teams.
* Define monitoring requirements for AI-generated content and AI-driven customer decisions.

**AI Operating Model and Adoption**

* Define how marketing roles and processes will change through AI adoption.
* Develop the future-state interaction model between marketers, agencies, platforms, copilots, and AI agents.
* Identify new roles, skills, governance forums, and ways of working.
* Support change management, training, adoption, and workforce enablement.
* Create reusable Marketing AI playbooks and maturity models.

**Consulting and Pre-Sales**

* Lead Marketing AI ideation and prioritization workshops.
* Develop AI transformation proposals, proofs of concept, and executive presentations.
* Shape Marketing AI opportunities with business, technology, data, and AI stakeholders.
* Create Marketing AI points of view, demonstrations, accelerators, and reusable solutions.

**Primary skills**
------------------

* 10+ years of experience across marketing, personalization, customer analytics, marketing technology, AI consulting, or digital transformation.

title: Principal TPM: DGX
description:
**Overview**
------------

Intuit's Data, Growth, & Experiences (DGX) organization is building the system of intelligence that powers every AI-driven customer experience across TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma, and Mailchimp. As a Principal TPM on this team, you will sit at the intersection of enterprise data infrastructure and marketing technology — orchestrating the programs that enable 100M+ customers to experience Intuit as one seamlessly intelligent platform.  
This is a strategic leadership position for a technical operator who understands data platforms and MarTech ecosystems deeply, moves with urgency, and earns the trust of both engineers and executives. You will drive programs that define how Intuit collects, manages, and activates data to deliver personalised, agentic, done-for-you financial experiences at scale.

**Responsibilities**

Lead Platform Programs at Enterprise Scale

* Own end-to-end delivery of a portfolio of strategic programs spanning data infrastructure (lakehouse, streaming, IDX), MarTech platforms (CDP, campaign orchestration, personalization), and AI-powered experimentation
* Drive program strategy, architecture alignment, milestone tracking, risk mitigation, and stakeholder communication from initiation through business outcome realization
* Maintain unwavering focus on outcomes — not just delivery milestones — translating engineering execution into measurable business impact

Operate at VP Level with Executive Authority

* Partner directly with VP and Director-level leaders across DGX to shape investment priorities, resolve organizational dependencies, and hold delivery commitments at scale
* Serve as the connective tissue between engineering, product management, data science, marketing, and business stakeholders — enabling decisions that would otherwise stall in silos
* Drive regular executive readouts, program reviews, and async communication that give senior leadership real-time visibility into portfolio health and emerging risks

Build the DGX Program Operating Model

* Define and continuously evolve the TPM frameworks, program health metrics, operating cadences, and delivery standards for the DGX organization
* Establish portfolio visibility practices — dependency maps, risk registers, milestone dashboards — that enable a high say-do ratio across all DGX programs
* Champion Agile and adaptive delivery methodologies, calibrating process rigor to program complexity without adding unnecessary overhead

Champion AI-Native Program Management

* Bring AI tools and agentic workflows into your program management practice — accelerating planning, risk synthesis, stakeholder communication, and decision support
* Collaborate with engineering leads on AI platform programs (e.g., GenOS, agentic pipelines) as a technically fluent partner who can evaluate architectural trade-offs and drive delivery
* Model what it means to be an AI-first builder: demonstrate and teach how LLMs, automation, and intelligent tooling can make the entire team faster and sharper

Develop the TPM Community

* Coach and mentor program managers across DGX, raising the technical and strategic capabilities of the team
* Define best practices, playbooks, and frameworks that scale the TPM discipline and elevate program management standards across the broader Intuit TPM community
* Act as a trusted advisor to product and engineering leaders — someone who is brought in early on hard problems because of the clarity, rigor, and influence you bring

**Qualifications**

Experience & Track Record

* 12+ years of Technical Program Management experience in large-scale, matrixed technology organizations
* Demonstrated history of delivering enterprise data platform programs — data warehouses, lakehouses, event streaming pipelines, data mesh architectures, or large-scale API platforms
* Direct experience with MarTech ecosystems — CDPs (e.g., Segment, Salesforce, Adobe), campaign orchestration platforms, personalisation engines, A/B experimentation infrastructure, or growth technology
* Proven ability to influence VP- and Director-level stakeholders on strategic investment decisions and organizational priorities

Technical Depth

* Strong conceptual and applied understanding of modern cloud data architectures: data lakehouses (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery), event streaming (Kafka, Flink), data mesh or data fabric patterns, and API design
* Fluent in the MarTech stack: understands how CDPs, DMPs, campaign tools, measurement frameworks, and personalization engines interconnect to create unified customer data activation
* Comfortable leading architectural design reviews, evaluating technical trade-offs, and representing engineering complexity in executive narratives
* Conversant in AI/ML concepts as applied to customer data: feature pipelines, model serving, real-time inference, experimentation, and responsible AI practices

Strategic & Analytical Mindset

* Uses data as a first-class tool for program management: monitors leading and lagging indicators, constructs health dashboards, and makes evidence-based course corrections
* Anticipates risks before they materialize; designs mitigation strategies that address root cause, not just symptoms
* Sees across organizational boundaries — identifies systemic dependencies, cross-team sequencing risks, and alignment gaps that others miss

Communication & Influence

* Exceptional written and verbal communicator; able to distill highly technical and complex program status into clear, executive-ready narrative
* Skilled navigator of ambiguity, competing priorities, and organizational tension — influences outcomes without relying on authority
* Builds trust rapidly across engineering, product, data, design, and business functions through credibility, follow-through, and genuine intellectual curiosity

Education

* BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline — or equivalent practical experience
* PMP, SAFe, or Agile/Scrum certifications are a plus; demonstrated equivalent mastery is equally valued

NICE TO HAVE

* Prior experience at a company with significant MarTech or data platform infrastructure at consumer scale (e.g., Google, Meta, Adobe, Salesforce, Uber, Airbnb, Netflix, Amazon, Intuit)
* Background in financial technology, SaaS, or consumer platforms with 50M+ active users
* Hands-on experience with GenAI application development, LLM platform programs, or agentic AI system delivery
* Familiarity with privacy-by-design frameworks, consent management platforms, or data governance programs at enterprise scale

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit. Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.

**Job Summary**

This job is responsible for steering software development strategies that support the organization's goals. It involves setting coding standards, leading teams in the creation of innovative software, and managing ongoing support for existing platforms. Key duties include overseeing software releases, collaborating with managers on project delivery, and handling large-scale budgets. It also focuses on integrating new technologies to improve development practices and partnering cross-functionally to align with broader organizational objectives

**Job Description**

**Responsibilities**

* **Own end-to-end engineering delivery for Martech platforms**, including Digital Asset Management (DAM), Content Management System (CMS), Customer Data Platform (CDP), Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), ensuring scalability, performance, and resilience.
* **Drive integration across Adobe ecosystem and in-house platforms**, enabling unified customer profiles, real-time data activation, and omnichannel personalization.
* **Lead architecture and execution for omnichannel communications platforms**, including Email, SMS, Push Notifications, and RCS, ensuring consistent messaging experiences across channels.
* **Enable 1:1 personalized marketing and communications journeys** by leveraging CDP/AEP data pipelines and AJO orchestration capabilities.
* **Establish reusable services and APIs** to support content delivery, campaign orchestration, and cross-channel engagement.
* **Drive operational excellence for campaign execution platforms**, ensuring high availability, throughput, and compliance with privacy, PCI, and regulatory standards.
* **Partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Analytics teams** to translate business use cases into scalable platform capabilities and measurable outcomes.
* **Champion governance, data quality, and platform standards** across Martech and Communications systems to ensure consistency and long-term maintainability.
* **Lead modernization initiatives**, including migration to cloud-native architectures and adoption of AI/agentic capabilities to optimize customer engagement and campaign performance.
* Leading the development and execution of software strategies to align with organizational goals, **including Martech (DAM, CMS, CDP, AEP, AJO) and omnichannel communications platforms (Email, SMS, Push, RCS)**.
* Defining coding standards, architectural patterns, and reusable frameworks for application development across digital, Martech, and communications ecosystems.
* Directing a large team in creating innovative software and web applications, **including content platforms, customer data platforms, and engagement systems**, while ensuring ongoing support for existing solutions.
* Managing the rollout of software releases and updates across Martech and communications platforms, ensuring seamless implementation and minimal disruption to customer-facing experiences.
* Collaborating with managers and cross-functional partners (Marketing, Product, Analytics) to meet project deadlines, specifications, and budgetary constraints, while developing performance metrics tied to **customer engagement and platform adoption**.
* Reporting on project progress and managing large-scale budgets to meet financial targets, including investments across Martech and communications capabilities.
* Researching, evaluating, and integrating new technologies such as **Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), and emerging AI/agentic capabilities** to enhance development efficiency and personalization at scale.
* Driving integration across **Adobe ecosystem and in-house platforms** to enable unified customer profiles, real-time data activation, and 1:1 personalized experiences.
* Leading the architecture and execution of **omnichannel communication capabilities**, ensuring consistent, scalable delivery across Email, SMS, Push, and RCS channels.
* Establishing reusable services, APIs, and data pipelines to support **content delivery, campaign orchestration, and cross-channel engagement**.
* Driving operational excellence for campaign execution platforms, ensuring high availability, throughput, and compliance with **privacy, PCI, and regulatory standards**.
* Championing governance, data quality, and platform standards across Martech and communications systems to ensure scalability, consistency, and long-term maintainability.
* Partnering with other engineering teams to adopt practices and architectures that support broader organizational and platform transformation objectives.
* Leading modernization initiatives, including migration to **cloud-native architectures** and enabling **AI-driven customer engagement and personalization**.
* Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) as necessary.
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Employees at all levels are expected to:**

* Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
* Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.
* Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
* Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
* Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
* Drive results and growth.
* Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead.
* Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities.

Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Comcast provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Additionally, Comcast provides best-in-class Benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality - to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. Please visit the compensation and benefits summary on our careers site for more details.

Bachelor's Degree

description:

financial decisions.

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Senior Associate, YouTube Marketing, to own and scale our YouTube and Instagram presence from the ground up. The role requires strong content instincts, SEO and analytics skills, and the ability to coordinate with editors and designers, so that every piece of content is high quality, discoverable and built to grow our audience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the YouTube and Instagram strategy, including positioning, content pillars, formats and a 3-6 month growth roadmap
* Build both channels from scratch and set up the content engine, publishing cadence and processes
* Plan and run long-form shows, Shorts and Reels, from guest and topic research to scripting and episode planning
* Lead editors, designers and videographers on edits, thumbnails, hooks and post-production quality
* Review cuts and share clear edit notes, and identify highlights and timestamps for clips
* Drive YouTube SEO and Instagram discovery through titles, thumbnails, keywords, captions, hashtags and retention
* Track performance weekly (CTR, watch time, retention, reach, saves, follower growth) and turn insights into experiments
* Create supporting carousels and social content, and repurpose across YouTube, Instagram.
* Source and coordinate guests, collaborators and creators
* Set and report on growth goals for subscribers, followers, views and engagement

**Skills**

* Proven experience building and scaling a YouTube channel and an Instagram page, ideally from scratch, with growth numbers you can share.
* Familiarity with AI video and content tools to speed up workflows and improve the quality of editing, scripting, thumbnails and repurposing.
* Deep understanding of YouTube SEO, the algorithm, thumbnails, retention and Instagram Reels and carousel mechanics
* Strong storytelling, scripting and editorial instincts, with a sharp eye for hooks and what makes content perform
* Hands-on experience managing editors, designers and freelancers
* Comfort with analytics tools such as YouTube Studio and Instagram Insights, and a data-driven approach to testing
* Strong communication and project management skills, and the ability to juggle multiple content pieces and deadlines
* Self-starter mindset with high ownership and minimal hand-holding

We are a start-up organization focused on fast growth with quality products; hence, the ability to work in a fast-paced environment goes without saying!
  
  
**Our People & Culture**
People and culture are the most important aspects of our business.
  
  
We Are Looking For Team Members Just Like Us, In Simple Words - Good People To Work With And Demonstrate Following Personality Traits
  
  

* Be super obsessed about ensuring customer satisfaction.

(We are here because of our customers, and will be here only if we serve our customers)
  
  

* We have a single opportunity to serve.

(Our customers will give us one opportunity to serve - we can’t let them down. Be it product,
  
  
uptimes, customer service or any interaction we have to deliver a wow experience.)
  
  

* Respect your work, your team, your co-workers and our customers.

(The only way to get respect is to give it first)
  
  

* Speed is all that matters. Ship right and ship faster.

(You either help the team move ahead fast, or you slow it down. We prefer the first.)
  
  

* Humility & politeness over arrogance & over-confidence.

(If you are the smartest one in the room, bring up others to speed. We are here to serve our
  
  
customers, not to prove a point.)
  
  

* Quality over quantity.

(It is fine if you pick up a few things to do, but do them exceedingly well.)
  
  

* Make your hands dirty irrespective of who you are.

(Our CEO responds to customers every day. Our CTO codes every day. This is us.)
  
  

* Talent and Competency over Credentials.
* Entrepreneurial, ownership driven and disciplined.

(We trust you to help us gain and retain the trust of our customers and our stakeholders)
  
  

* Less words, more action.

(Believe in something? show it by doing things. Not just by talking about it)
  
  

* Flat hierarchy with open culture & conversations.

(You are among all of us, and we all are with you)
  
  

* Passionate about the business you are a part of.

(Do it because you are passionate about it, not because it’s your job.)
  
  

* Raise is an equal opportunity employer.

(We celebrate diversity and inclusion.)
  
  
**Why Join Raise?**
We’ve been recognised as a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years, reflecting the culture we’ve built and the way we work together. At Raise, you’ll experience a flat hierarchy, open conversations, high ownership and a strong bias for action. We value people who bring passion,
  
  
humility and curiosity to their work, and who care deeply about building great products and creating meaningful customer impact.
  
  
We believe in growth with ownership, speed with thoughtfulness and ambition with humility. We celebrate wins, learn from challenges and give people the ownership and responsibility to build and make an impact. If you enjoy building from the ground up, working with passionate people, and
  
  
being part of a high-growth fintech ecosystem, Raise offers an environment where you can do meaningful work and grow with the business.
  
  
**About Raise Financial Services**
Raise Financial Services is building technology-led financial products and infrastructure for India’s financially aware and digitally savvy consumers.
  
  
Our ecosystem spans multiple aspects of financial services, with Dhan as our flagship investment and trading platform. Alongside Dhan, we are building and scaling businesses across the financial ecosystem, including Millions, Upsurge, Filter Coffee, Stratzy, Pluto Insurance, Fuzz and several other emerging products and platforms. Our ambition is to build a trusted ecosystem of financial products and experiences that make investing, trading, wealth creation and other financial services simpler, smarter and more accessible
  
  
**Our Philosophy Is Simple**

* Build great products.
* Deliver awesome experiences.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**Suspire Marketing Manager - Brand, Growth & Product Marketing**

**Location:**
 Vile Parle (West), Mumbai | 
**Type:**
 Full-time, On-site | 
**Joining:**
 Immediate

**Experience:**
 2-3 years | 
**Reports to**
: Founder and the CMO

**About Suspire**

Suspire makes better living easier, through wellness-first, thoughtfully curated choices you can

trust. We are a 4-year-old startup building an ecosystem of 400+ sustainable brands, 500,000+

conscious community members, and 100,000+ delivered eco-friendly gifts. Our mission: help

people live healthier, stronger and calmer lives by building a high-trust wellness ecosystem.

We are a tight, high-ownership team at a critical growth stage. Every hire shapes our future.

**The Team You'll Lead: Marketing**

Suspire's full-stack marketing team isn't just about promotions; it owns our end-to-end digital

presence, brand voice, customer journeys, content, data analysis and revenue-generating

initiatives. We also build products and in-house technology. Suspire sits at an exciting

intersection of brand, customers and B2B clients, so marketing here touches almost every part

of the business. You'll lead a dynamic department that drives real business and proactively

accelerates Suspire’s growth journey.

**The Role**

Own marketing at Suspire as our Marketing Manager at a pivotal moment. The role sits between

a brand manager and a growth marketer, with a product mindset: you will set how the brand

shows up, own growth and the best use of budgets, and help shape the features and products

that serve our customers, our partner brands and our B2B clients.You will be a driving force behind our new branding and repositioning, and behind taking Suspire to its next level. This is not a one-dimensional role: the right person sees how every decision lands on sales, customers, finances and brand reputation, and decides accordingly.

**Your core responsibilities:**

●
**Strategy and brand:**
 Build and own the marketing strategy and plan, and own Suspire's

positioning, brand voice and consistency across channels as the new brand rolls out.

●
**Growth and budgets:**
 Own the marketing budget. Plan, allocate and optimize it across

paid, organic and retention, track returns, costs and contribution, and make fast

scale-or-stop calls.

●
**Channels and campaigns:**
 Direct end-to-end digital marketing funnels and customer

lifecycle management across Meta, Google, Instagram and social, website, SEO, PR,

email and WhatsApp, with content that can double as performance creative.

●
**Product thinking**
: Partner with tech and product teams to shape customer experience

and features, and to package offerings that can be sold to our partner brands and B2B

clients.

●
**Launches:**
 Plan and run launches from narrative and assets through rollout sequencing

based on audience and objective, followed by post-launch review.

●
**Agencies and cross-functional work:**
 Brief, manage and review external agencies,

and coordinate across ops, sales, design and tech so teams move in the same direction.

●
**Reporting and leadership communication:**
 Track and analyse performance, and

translate it into clear updates, trade-offs and recommendations for the founder and the

CMO.

●
**AI-led ways of working:**
 Use AI to sharpen strategy, speed up execution, stress-test

ideas and improve creative work, and turn what works into repeatable processes.

●
**People and systems:**
 Lead, coach and set priorities for the in-house team, raise the

quality bar, and build simple systems and SOPs so the team runs well without you in

every decision.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You won't just hand work to agencies, and you won't just

execute tasks yourself. You set the direction, hold the quality bar, make the call and keep things

moving.

**Primary KPIs**

Marketing-driven Revenue and Contribution | Channel-wise Performance | Budget Efficiency |

End-to-End Customer Experience | Average Order Value | Lifecycle & Retention Metrics |

Organic Growth | Experiment Velocity (test, learn, scale or kill) | Products Build & Launch

delivery | Team and agency output quality | Effort-Result Ratio

**Who You Are**

**Must-haves:**

● 2-3 years of marketing experience with a strong grasp of marketing, brand and customer

behaviour fundamentals.

● Ownership at manager level: you take responsibility for outcomes, make decisions even

with incomplete information, and own the results.

● Big-picture judgement: you can see the impact of decisions on sales, customers,

finances and brand reputation, and balance them.

● Taste and judgement: you can review creative, content and campaigns, give sharp,

constructive feedback and decide what ships.

●nSpeed: you enjoy building, measuring and fixing quickly, you keep what works, and you

kill ideas fast when they don't.

● A real pulse on teams: you understand what ops, sales, design and tech need and plan

your work so it lands well across functions and with leadership.

● Team leadership: you have led, mentored or coordinated people, interns or agencies,

and you enable others instead of doing everything yourself.

● Working familiarity with Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity, Google Ads, Meta Ads, CRM

platforms and Excel or Sheets. You don't need to be a hands-on technical expert, but

you should know enough to brief, audit and challenge.

● Fluent English and Hindi (spoken) with strong written English.

**AI is part of how we work:**

● You use AI regularly (ChatGPT, Claude, Lovable, etc.) for strategy, execution,

stress-testing ideas and creative work, and you know how to prompt clearly and iterate.

● You have the taste to judge AI-generated output and decide what is good enough to

ship.

● You are curious about building agentic and AI-assisted workflows that cut manual effort.

**Good-to-haves:**

● Experience in e-commerce or D2C brands (a big plus), including familiarity with Shopify.

● Exposure to a range of digital marketing formats, from paid and social to SEO, email,

WhatsApp and content.

● Digital marketing certifications, for example in Google Ads, Google Analytics or Meta

**Education:**
 A Bachelor's or Master's in Marketing, Business or a related field is strongly

preferred.

**Why Join Suspire**

● Join at a pivotal moment: a new brand and positioning, with you helping to shape it.

● Report directly to the founder and the CMO, and work closely with leadership on most

decisions.

● Work at the intersection of brand, customers and B2B clients, and see how marketing

connects to product and revenue.

● Take real ownership of strategy, budgets, experiments and a team, and see the impact of

your work quickly.

Suspire appreciates energetic ideas, coupled with even better execution. We welcome trial and

error and give you complete room to grow, explore and build, just like Suspire itself does.

**How to Apply**

Share your 
**CV + a short note**
 at 
swayam.doshi@suspire.in
 on the following:

● Why you'd like to work with Suspire.

● One marketing decision you made, such as scaling or killing a campaign or idea quickly,

and what made you decide.

Feel free to reach out to us on Instagram (@suspire.in) / LinkedIn if you'd like to chat, ask

questions or simply get a feel of the brand. Meanwhile, explore our website and socials to

understand our community, brands and philosophy.

**Thank you for your interest in being part of Suspire's journey. We would be happy to**

**connect and explore whether this role and our team are the right fit for you.**

**ABOUT BAROMETER**

Barometer Technologies is a Mumbai company that helps food and beverage businesses control their inventory and costs. We are a software company that goes beyond software: every client gets our products and a dedicated operations expert.

Our two products are MATS, for kitchen, store and outlet inventory, and Bar, for bar, pub and club inventory. They cover purchase, recipe costing, stock counts, wastage, pour cost and reports. They connect with tools that our clients already use, for example Petpooja, UrbanPiper, Tally and Zoho Books.

Our team also does the hands-on work: data audits, onboarding, monthly expert reviews, SOPs and custom reports. More than 300 outlets use Barometer. They include restaurants, bars, cafés, bakeries, QSRs, cloud kitchens and fine-dine groups such as The Bombay Canteen and Khar Gymkhana.

Our buyers are restaurant owners, chefs and bar managers. So our content is about food, drink, and the money behind both.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

You own Barometer's social media, from the strategy to the last post. You decide what we post, where, and why. Then you make it happen: you plan the calendar, make the creatives, post on time, and measure the results.

You work closely with the sales team, so our content brings in real enquiries from restaurant owners. The strategy, the execution and the results are all yours.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Own the strategy

• Set the social media strategy for Barometer: the goals, the platforms, the content themes, the formats and how often we post.

• Agree targets for reach, engagement, follower growth and leads with the Head of Sales.

• Turn the strategy into a monthly content plan, and present it before the month starts.

• Track what competitors and F&B brands post. Bring new ideas to the team.

• Review the results every month. Keep what works, drop what does not, and change the plan.

2. Run the accounts

• Own the content calendar for Instagram, LinkedIn and the other platforms where we are active. Plan one week ahead and keep it full.

• Schedule and publish posts, reels, stories and carousels.

• If a post waits for an approval, chase that approval. Do not let the slot pass.

• Reply to comments and DMs. Send every real sales enquiry to the sales team on the same day.

• Keep a simple sheet of what went out, when, and how it did. Keep it current.

3. Make the creatives

• Build static posts, carousels and light reels in Canva, or in a tool that you are fast in. Use our templates and brand guidelines.

• Write captions and hooks in plain English. Our readers are restaurant owners and F&B managers, not marketers.

• Reuse what we already have. Case studies, product screenshots, blog posts and webinar clips can all become social content.

• Edit short videos for reels and shorts. CapCut or Premiere Rush is fine.

4. Report results

• Prepare a short monthly report against the targets: reach, engagement, follower growth, profile clicks and leads.

• Tell us plainly what works and what does not. If a format fails three times, tell us then. Do not let us find out two months later.

5. Support sales and campaigns

• Make creatives for email and WhatsApp campaigns.

• Make collateral for events and trade shows.

• Do small content updates on our website.

• Talk to the sales team often, so that our posts match the questions that clients actually ask.

REQUIREMENTS

Must have

• You can plan a social media strategy and explain the reasons behind it. You know which formats work, on which platform, and how often to post.

• You post on Instagram and LinkedIn yourself. You do not only scroll.

• Real Canva skill. Send us your work, not certificates.

• Clear written English. Our clients read your captions.

• Dependability. In this job, posts that go out on time and work that you finish count for more than raw talent.

• You accept feedback. You can redo a creative two or three times without a problem.

• A degree in any stream. Marketing or mass communication helps, but it is not compulsory. Freshers with strong work samples can apply.

Good to have

• Short video edits for reels.

• Time spent in restaurants, bars or hotels. A part-time job at a café also counts.

• Some use of Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn page analytics, or a scheduling tool.

• Good phone photography.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

• Salary: ₹20,000 to ₹25,000 a month in hand.

• Internet allowance: ₹500 a month.

• Time off: paid leave, and all national holidays off.

• Hybrid work: part of the week in our Mumbai office, part from home.

• A seat next to sales: you report to the Head of Sales, so you hear how restaurants are actually sold to. Most marketing jobs never get near those conversations.

• Live accounts: you run our real accounts. Your work goes out under the Barometer name from week one.

• Real F&B knowledge: you learn how food businesses run: food cost, inventory and margins. This knowledge is useful in hospitality and in SaaS marketing.

• Room to grow: as we grow, the role grows with you. Good results lead to more responsibility in our marketing.

**HOW TO APPLY**

• Apply through this job post.

• Add a link to 3 to 5 samples of your work: Canva posts, carousels, reels, or a page that you run.

• Add a short note, maximum 150 words: how will you grow Barometer on Instagram or LinkedIn in your first three months?

• Tell us your earliest start date.

We shortlist only applications that include work samples.

title: Field Marketing Manager
description:
**Are you ready to unlock intelligence?**
If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.
  
  
**Build Kong’s India marketing engine from the ground up.**
The opportunity
  
  
Kong is the AI connectivity company. We help engineering teams manage, secure, and scale the APIs and AI traffic that power modern businesses.
  
  
India represents a significant growth opportunity for Kong. We’re looking for a Field Marketing Manager to build our marketing presence in the market from the ground up—turning strategic priorities into programs that create demand, accelerate pipeline, and establish Kong as a leader in API and AI connectivity.
  
  
This is a builder’s role. There’s no established playbook, inherited marketing engine, or existing team to lean on. You’ll have the ownership to define the strategy, make the bets, build the programs, and prove what works.
  
  
You’ll partner closely with Sales, global marketing, and channel partners to bring Kong’s story to India’s enterprise technology leaders. You’ll be expected to think strategically, execute hands-on, and connect every marketing investment to measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**Your mission: build a repeatable, scalable marketing engine that drives growth for Kong in India.**
What you’ll do
  
  
Own the India marketing strategy
  
  

* Define the regional marketing strategy, priorities, and investment plan in alignment with India Sales and global marketing.
* Identify the industries, enterprise accounts, and buyer segments with the greatest growth potential.
* Turn market insights into focused programs that generate pipeline and accelerate revenue.
* Make deliberate choices about where to invest—and where not to.

Build and execute account-based marketing
  
  

* Partner with Sales to develop and prioritize target account lists, buying groups, and account-specific growth strategies.
* Design and execute ABM programs that engage decision-makers, build buying-group awareness, and create opportunities within strategic accounts.
* Coordinate campaigns, executive engagement, content, and field activities around account priorities.
* Measure account engagement, opportunity creation, pipeline influence, and progression through the sales cycle.

Create demand that converts
  
  

* Build integrated demand generation programs across digital, content, email, events, and partner channels.
* Translate Kong’s global messaging into locally relevant campaigns that resonate with India’s enterprise technology buyers.
* Work with Sales to define lead qualification, routing, follow-up SLAs, and conversion targets.
* Continuously optimize programs based on pipeline contribution, conversion rates, and cost efficiency.

Build the India events engine
  
  

* Develop an events strategy spanning executive roundtables, technical workshops, webinars, industry conferences, and flagship experiences.
* Create programs that bring together engineering leaders, enterprise decision-makers, developers, and strategic customers.
* Own event planning, audience acquisition, execution, follow-up, and performance measurement.
* Build a repeatable events model that prioritizes meaningful engagement and commercial outcomes over attendance numbers alone.

Turn partnerships into growth
  
  

* Work with channel and technology partners to develop joint demand generation and co-marketing programs.
* Equip partners with localized content, campaigns, event resources, and sales enablement.
* Identify opportunities to extend Kong’s reach through strategic ecosystems and industry relationships.

Establish Kong’s presence in India
  
  

* Adapt global brand campaigns and content for local market needs while maintaining consistency with Kong’s positioning.
* Build relationships with relevant industry communities, technology leaders, and enterprise decision-makers.
* Develop programs that strengthen awareness, credibility, and consideration among Kong’s target audiences.

Own the budget and prove impact
  
  

* Manage the India field marketing budget, allocating investment against clear business priorities.
* Establish dashboards and reporting that connect marketing activity to qualified pipeline, opportunity progression, and revenue outcomes.
* Share performance transparently, including what worked, what didn’t, and what should change.
* Build a continuous improvement culture grounded in data, experimentation, and accountability.

What you’ll bring
  
  

* A builder’s mindset. You’ve built a marketing function, regional program, or demand engine from scratch—not just operated an established one.
* B2B technology marketing experience. You understand how to market complex technology solutions to enterprise buyers and translate technical value into business impact.
* Strong ABM and demand generation expertise. You know how to prioritize accounts, engage buying groups, generate demand, and build programs that contribute to pipeline.
* A track record in high-growth environments. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities, limited resources, and the need to move quickly.
* Cross-functional leadership. You can align Sales, global marketing, partners, and regional stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
* Events that deliver results. You know how to design experiences that build relationships, create opportunities, and justify the investment.
* Commercial and analytical rigor. You understand pipeline metrics, conversion rates, campaign performance, and marketing efficiency—and know how to act on the data.
* Deep knowledge of India’s enterprise technology landscape. You understand the accounts, industries, buying dynamics, and ecosystems that matter.
* Clear, adaptable communication. You can build credibility with engineers, executives, sales teams, and marketing leaders alike.

What will set you apart
  
  

* Experience marketing APIs, cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, cybersecurity, or AI technologies.
* Experience building channel marketing or partner-led demand generation programs.
* Established relationships across India’s enterprise technology, financial services, or global capability center (GCC) ecosystem.
* Experience working in a global, matrixed organization while building programs tailored to a regional market.

**About Kong**
Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com.

title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager
description:

* Analyze marketing performance and provide actionable insights to optimize campaigns and support strategic decision-making.
