* Evaluate and introduce tools, including AI, that expand marketing capabilities, and enable the team to use them effectively through enablement and practical guidance.

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of relevant experience, including independent ownership of Marketing Operations improvements beyond campaign execution.

* Advanced HubSpot experience in workflows, dynamic segmentation and data management.
* Ability to evaluate behavioral signals, explain performance and deliver measurable improvements.
* Knowledge of email deliverability best practices and marketing automation.
* Experience with marketing attribution and funnel analysis.
* Experience with Salesforce reporting, CRM management and Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
* Experience managing marketing databases, segmentation, and data hygiene.
* Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets.

**Success Measures**

* Accurate and timely execution of global email campaigns, with reduced turnaround time and manual effort.
* A reliable marketing database with effective audience segmentation and fewer recurring data errors.
* Reliable dashboards and reporting that support business decisions.
* Improved lead qualification, funnel progression and Sales handoff quality.
* Adoption of reusable processes, automation and tools that improve team productivity and reduce workflow errors.
* Measurable improvements in campaign performance and contribution to pipeline generation.

**Benefits**

* A competitive compensation package

* You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
* Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
* Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Key Account Manager (E-Commerce)
description:

title: Head of India Theatrical Distribution, Theatrical Distribution, Italy, Amazon MGM Studios
description:
**Description**
Amazon MGM Studios is seeking a Head of India Theatrical Distribution to lead sales, exhibitor marketing, and distribution strategy for all theatrical releases in India. The role includes strategic planning, stakeholder engagement, exhibitor negotiations, release scheduling, performance forecasting, and business intelligence reporting. The Head of Theatrical Distribution will provide leadership across sales and operational functions to drive accessibility, box office performance, and profitability, while aligning local market strategy with global studio objectives. This position reports to the Head of International Theatrical Distribution.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Sales Strategy & Execution
  
  

* Develop and implement sales strategies across local theatrical releases, ensuring alignment with commercial objectives.
* Lead negotiations with exhibitors to secure optimal screen allocations, revenue share, and access to premium formats (IMAX, PLFs, 3D).
* Oversee holdovers, dispute resolutions, and in-theater activation to optimize box office performance.

Release Planning & Circuit Development
  
  

* Identify and secure optimal release dates,balancing local conditions with studio objectives.
* Define and refine circuit strategies, considering market segmentation, seasonality, and competitor activity.

Stakeholder Engagement
  
  

* Maintain strong relationships with LA head office, local exhibitors, and key stakeholders.
* Present sales strategies, release plans, and product slates to exhibition clients and internal leadership.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Provide clear leadership, direction, and support to the local Sales & Distribution team.
* Foster a collaborative and high-performance team culture that encourages growth, innovation, and accountability.

Business Intelligence, Reporting & Financial Oversight
  
  

* Lead the collection and analysis of accurate box office and industry data to support strategic decision-making.
* Oversee distribution budgets, ensuring financial discipline and alignment with film budgets.

Technology & Systems
  
  

* Drive innovation in digital exhibition and distribution, ensuring the business remains at the forefront of industry technology.

Trailer & Promotional Asset Management
  
  

* Lead the planning, production, and delivery of trailers and promotional assets.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience leading cross-functional teams to deliver projects on tight deadlines
* Knowledge of internet, software, and media industries and the legal and regulatory environment in which they operate or equivalent
* 7–10 years of experience in theatrical distribution, with demonstrable expertise across both Indian-language and English-language releases in the Indian market.
* Proven ability to build and maintain strong, lasting relationships with exhibitors, circuits, and industry partners, with in-depth knowledge of the Indian exhibition landscape including national chains (PVR INOX, Cinépolis), regional circuits, and single-screen operators and exceptional negotiation skills across diverse market segments.
* Deep understanding of India's theatrical release dynamics, including Bollywood, regional-language cinema, and Hollywood tentpoles; festival and holiday release windows; censorship and certification processes (CBFC); and the competitive landscape of simultaneous multi-language releases.
* High proficiency in business intelligence and data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, Tableau, Power BI, Rentrak), with the ability to translate box office data, audience insights, and market intelligence into actionable distribution strategies for both local and international content.
* Strong financial and analytical expertise, including P&L management for theatrical releases, deal structuring, and budget oversight combined with excellent strategic thinking, communication, and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate fluently in English with global stakeholders, including Amazon MGM Studios' international distribution leadership, while also being proficient in Hindi and ideally one or more additional Indian languages to effectively engage with regional exhibitors and partners.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with film performance forecasting and revenue modeling including the ability to project box office outcomes for both local and Hollywood releases using historical data, advance booking trends, and audience sentiment analysis.
* Problem-solving, can-do attitude; embraces challenges and embraces change. Thrives in ambiguity and can pivot strategy rapidly in response to last-minute release date shifts, competitive clashes, or market disruptions
* Experience managing stakeholders across multiple business functions, including marketing, legal/business affairs, finance, content acquisition, and home entertainment/streaming teams.
* Inspires and drives innovation, takes calculated risks, and challenges the status quo including leveraging emerging exhibition technologies, or reimagining how Hollywood content is positioned for Indian audiences.
* Established network within the Indian film industry, including relationships with producers, co-production partners, talent agencies, and trade bodies of India.
* Experience in managing dubbed/subtitled release strategies for Hollywood content across multiple Indian languages, with an understanding of localization best practices and audience preferences by territory.

title: D2C Growth Head
description:
**Location:**
Mumbai (in-office)

**Function:**
D2C Growth & Performance Marketing

**Reports to:**
Founders

Earthful is a plant-based nutrition brand for women's health, backed by Fireside Ventures and V3 Ventures. This is a leadership role: you'll own the D2C (earthful.me) growth number end to end, and build the team behind it as the channel scales — not just run campaigns, but decide where the channel goes next.

**Role Overview**

This role leads Earthful's D2C growth engine — full ownership of the website's revenue number, driven through performance marketing, conversion optimization, and a high-velocity creative pipeline. You'll be directly accountable for hitting D2C growth targets set in the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), decide how budget is allocated across products, and build the team needed to scale that ownership over time. You'll work closely with the organic/content team, the creative team, and the website team — this starts as a hands-on individual role, but is expected to grow into leading a small team as the channel scales.

**What You'll Own**

**D2C Revenue Growth & Ownership**

• Own the D2C (earthful.me) revenue number end-to-end, driven primarily through performance marketing across Meta, Google, and other paid channels

• Be directly accountable for hitting D2C growth targets set in the AOP

• Coordinate with the organic/content team so paid and organic efforts reinforce each other rather than working at cross purposes

**Creative Pipeline for Performance**

• Direct the creative team's output for performance — a steady flow of new hooks, angles, and formats

• Run structured creative testing across campaigns

• Brief the next round of creative based on what the data shows is actually working

**Budget, ROAS & Site Conversion**

• Decide how budget is allocated across products — what to scale up, what to scale down, and the ROAS target for each

• Own website conversion end-to-end — landing page CVR, checkout drop-off, and AOV — directing the website team's roadmap around what actually moves conversion

• Own the full D2C P&L view — revenue, ad spend, and contribution margin — not just a topline growth number

**Team Building & Leadership**

• Build and lead a small performance marketing/growth team as the D2C channel scales — this starts as a hands-on, individual role but is expected to grow into managing others

• Set the growth roadmap and testing cadence for the function, not just execute your own campaigns

**Cross-Functional (Suggested Additions)**

• Track CAC and LTV alongside channel-level ROAS, so budget decisions aren't driven by vanity metrics that look good in a single channel but don't hold up at the business level

• Coordinate with Supply Chain on demand forecasting tied to growth targets — aggressive scaling only works if inventory can back it up

• Maintain a structured testing roadmap/calendar for creative and channel experiments, rather than running tests ad hoc

**Optional Scope Extensions (decide before posting)**

• Own or co-own retention/CRM levers (email, WhatsApp, repeat purchase) — a natural extension if you want this role to cover full-funnel D2C, not just acquisition and conversion

• Weigh in on on-site pricing and promotions strategy, since these directly affect conversion and AOV

**What We're Looking For**

• Ideally has been part of a D2C/e-commerce brand's growth or marketing team during a scale-up phase — joining when revenue was roughly ₹0–30 Cr and helping scale it to ₹300 Cr or more

• MBA from a top-tier B-school strongly preferred, with 4–6+ years of post-MBA experience in performance marketing or growth

• At least 2+ years of experience owning a full P&L or AOP-style revenue number

• Direct, hands-on experience running and optimizing paid campaigns on Meta and Google Ads

• Prior experience building or leading a team, or clear readiness to do so as the role grows — this is a leadership-track role, not a purely individual-contributor one

• Comfortable making budget allocation calls across multiple products, trading off scale versus ROAS

• Understanding of website conversion levers (CVR, checkout drop-off, AOV) and experience working with a website/CRO team

• Strong analytical and Excel skills — comfortable building and interpreting performance dashboards

Full-Time

5+ Years of Experience

Remote / Hybrid

We are looking for a hands-on General Manager to lead business development, strategic partnerships, and operational coordination for a growing cross-border healthcare business.

The role focuses on connecting patients, referring doctors, hospitals, insurers, and healthcare partners to facilitate access to quality and affordable international medical treatment. The successful candidate will work closely with the CEO and cross-functional teams to expand referral networks, develop hospital partnerships, improve patient coordination, and drive the adoption of a technology-enabled healthcare platform.

* Develop and manage relationships with doctors, hospitals, clinics, insurers, corporates, healthcare facilitators, and other referral partners.

* Support partnership negotiations, agreements, onboarding, and ongoing engagement.

4. Digital Healthcare Platform Adoption

* Work with product and technology teams to improve a digital platform supporting patients, hospitals, doctors, insurers, and healthcare partners.
* Provide operational feedback, participate in platform testing, and follow up on agreed development priorities.
* Onboard pilot partners and encourage active platform usage to increase patient referrals.

* Support initiatives such as surgical camps, telemedicine services, post-treatment care, and insurance-focused healthcare solutions.

* Support the implementation of business growth initiatives across international markets.

* Ensure timely follow-ups, accountability, and a consistent patient experience.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* At least 4 years of relevant experience in healthcare operations, healthcare business development, patient services, or related fields.

* Excellent communication, negotiation, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage strategic responsibilities while contributing directly to operational activities.

title: Director- Programming, Member Experience & Brand
company: The Leela Palaces, Hotels and Resorts
description:
**About The Leela**

The Leela Palaces, Hotels and Resorts is India’s largest institutionally owned and managed pure-play luxury hospitality brand. Backed by Brookfield, The Leela’s portfolio comprises 15 operating award-winning properties spanning owned, operated, and managed hotels and another 10 in the pipeline across leading leisure and business destinations in India and Dubai. Recognized globally for architectural excellence and bespoke services, The Leela was ranked #2 globally among the best Hotel Brand in the World by the Travel + Leisure World's Best Awards 2026 and has been previously ranked as the World’s Best Hotel Brand by Travel + Leisure World’s Best Awards in 2020 and 2021, and among the global top three in 2023, 2024 and 2026. The brand remains committed to delivering timeless Indian hospitality through world-class luxury experiences.

**Why join The Leela?**

* **Award-Winning Brand**
  : Join a brand that has been recognized as one of the World’s Best Hotel Brands for two consecutive years.
* **Commitment to Excellence**
  : Be part of a team that is dedicated to providing the highest standards of service and hospitality.
* **Innovative Environment**
  : Be part of a team that encourages creativity and innovation, ensuring that we stay at the forefront of luxury hospitality.
* **Career Growth**
  : Benefit from our strong pipeline of future projects and opportunities for career advancement within The Leela and our global alliances.
* **Cultural Experiences**
  : Engage with the rich cultural tapestry of India, bringing unique and authentic experiences to our discerning guests.

**Position Overview**

**Reporting to:**
Vice President - Marketing

**Location**
: The Leela Corporate Office, BKC, Mumbai

**Travel**
: Frequent travel across Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Delhi and upcoming ARQ Club locations

The Head of Programming, Member Experience & Brand will serve as the strategic custodian of ARQ Club's desirability, cultural relevance, member engagement and experiential ecosystem.

This role is responsible for curating and delivering world-class experiences that make ARQ one of the most coveted private membership communities in India. The incumbent will create cultural moments, build influential networks, strengthen the member value proposition and foster a sense of exclusivity and belonging that drives both member advocacy and membership demand.

The role requires a unique blend of luxury marketing expertise, cultural intelligence, relationship management, hospitality sensibility, commercial understanding and programming excellence.

The ultimate objective is to ensure ARQ becomes a club that influential individuals aspire to join and existing members feel privileged to belong to.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Programming & Experience Curation**

* Develop and execute a best-in-class annual programming calendar across all ARQ locations.
* Curate highly exclusive experiences spanning gastronomy, luxury lifestyle, arts, culture, literature, music, business, wellness, design, fashion, travel and sports.
* Conceptualize marquee signature events and IPs that become synonymous with ARQ.
* Create experiences that generate anticipation, exclusivity, conversation and strong word-of-mouth amongst members and prospective members.
* Build a programming strategy that creates genuine desirability and "fear of missing out" amongst India's most influential audiences.
* Lead experiential concepts for new club launches and expansion markets.

**Member Experience & Engagement**

* Own the end-to-end member journey and engagement strategy.
* Continuously strengthen the ARQ member value proposition and benefits ecosystem.
* Develop initiatives that improve member participation, satisfaction, loyalty and retention.
* Drive member advocacy through highly personalized experiences and access-led privileges.
* Curate milestone celebrations for members, including birthdays, anniversaries, achievements and other meaningful moments.
* Design memorable gifting and recognition programs that reinforce the premium positioning of ARQ.
* Ensure members consistently discover new reasons to engage with the club.

**Brand Building & Positioning**

* Act as the principal marketing stakeholder for ARQ Club within The Leela ecosystem.
* Partner closely with central marketing, communications, PR and digital teams to strengthen ARQ's positioning.
* Ensure all member-facing communication reflects the understated sophistication and exclusivity of the brand.
* Develop experiential storytelling, bespoke content, invitations, gifting programs and premium collateral.
* Build ARQ's reputation as one of India's most prestigious and culturally relevant membership communities.

**Membership Growth & Selective Acquisition**

* Work closely with Membership Sales teams to support acquisition of highly affluent, influential and culturally relevant members.
* Help shape member acquisition strategy through programming and experiences rather than traditional sales-led approaches.
* Support the identification and cultivation of prospective members who align with the ethos and stature of ARQ.
* Collaborate with club leadership and membership teams to ensure continued elevation of member quality and network value.
* Create experiences and engagement opportunities that actively support referral-led membership growth.

**Launches & Expansion**

* Lead the experiential and member engagement strategy for upcoming ARQ Club launches.
* Develop launch programs that establish desirability and relevance within new markets.
* Create launch experiences that attract influential audiences, tastemakers and prospective founding members.
* Partner with leadership teams to ensure each new club launch delivers a distinctive and elevated ARQ experience.

**Partnerships & Influence Networks**

* Build and maintain strategic relationships with:
* Artists and curators
* Authors and intellectuals
* Celebrities and entertainers
* Business leaders and entrepreneurs
* Diplomats and policymakers
* Influencers and tastemakers
* Luxury brands and maisons
* Sports personalities
* Designers and cultural leaders
* Develop exclusive collaborations that provide members with access unavailable elsewhere.

**Public Relations & Cultural Relevance**

* Collaborate with PR teams to create newsworthy and culturally impactful experiences.
* Drive earned media opportunities and organic advocacy.
* Position ARQ at the center of relevant conversations across luxury, business, culture and lifestyle.
* Build relationships with influential opinion-makers and cultural gatekeepers.

**Commercial Contribution**

* Support membership growth through elevated brand positioning and compelling member experiences.
* Increase engagement and revenue contribution across:
* Restaurants and Bars
* Wellness and Spa
* Rooms and Hospitality Experiences
* Events and Experiences
* Partner with Sales, Operations and Club Leadership to maximize member lifetime value while preserving exclusivity and club standards.

**Ideal Candidate Profile:**

**Experience**

* 12-15+ years of relevant experience.
* Strong background in private members' clubs or luxury hospitality, with experience in experiential marketing for UHNI relationship management or cultural programming is preferred
* Significant experience in luxury automotive, fine jewellery, luxury retail, private banking, art, culture or lifestyle sectors catering to UHNI and HNI audiences via experiential events

**Knowledge & Expertise**

* Deep understanding of luxury consumer behavior and affluent audiences.
* Excellent knowledge of hospitality, food and beverage, culture, arts, literature and luxury lifestyle trends.
* Proven capability in conceptualizing and executing highly curated premium experiences.
* Strong marketing, communication and storytelling skills.
* High commercial acumen with understanding of membership-led businesses.
* Impeccable attention to detail and aesthetic sensibility.

**Network & Relationships**

The ideal candidate will bring an existing network and proven ability to engage with:

* CEOs and CXOs
* Entrepreneurs and industrialists
* Diplomats and policymakers
* Artists and cultural influencers
* Celebrities and entertainers
* Authors and intellectuals
* Luxury brand leaders
* Socialites and tastemakers
* Sports personalities

A demonstrated track record of creating meaningful access and high-value relationships within influential communities will be highly preferred.

**What Success Looks Like**

* ARQ is recognized as one of India's most coveted private members' clubs.
* Membership demand outpaces available capacity.
* Members actively advocate for the club and participate in its experiences.
* ARQ becomes a highly respected cultural and networking platform for influential India.
* Strong member retention, engagement and loyalty metrics.
* A distinctive and differentiated programming calendar that members cannot easily access elsewhere.
* A powerful ecosystem of luxury, cultural and influence partnerships.
* Successful activation and launch of new ARQ locations.

**The Ideal Person**

A natural tastemaker. A connector. A curator. Someone equally comfortable hosting a private dinner for industrialists, facilitating an intimate conversation with a global thought leader, launching a cultural property, collaborating with a luxury maison, or creating a member experience that becomes the talk of the city.

Most importantly, this person understands that ARQ is not in the business of events. It is in the business of creating belonging, influence, access and aspiration for India's most discerning individuals.

As a
**Customer Manager – Consumer & Electronics and Mobility & Transportation**
to be located at Navi Mumbai/Bangalore and Pune, you will be responsible for driving profitable growth across strategic accounts and key market segments. You will work closely with OEMs, Tier suppliers, Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) providers and distribution partners to expand Dow's silicone solutions portfolio within Automotive, Electronics, Consumer Applications, Release Coatings, Elastomers, Railways, and other high-growth industries.

* Proven track record of managing strategic customer relationships and delivering sustainable business growth.
* Strong understanding of commercial sales processes, account planning, opportunity management, and value-based selling.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Willingness to travel extensively across India to support customers and business growth initiatives.

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively

* High emotional intelligence and strong interpersonal skills when collaborating with customers and cross-functional teams

**Additional Notes:**

* Travel within India is required based on business needs.
* Relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not available for this position.

**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
We invest in you.
  
  
Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
  
  
Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
  
  

* Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
* Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
* Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals.

+ Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).

+ Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.

* Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
* Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.
* Workplace culture empowering role-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs.

* Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured.

With broadest technology sets spanning performance materials, industrial intermediates, and plastics Dow India delivers differentiated science-based products and solutions in high-growth segments, such as packaging, infrastructure, automobile, and consumer care.
  
  
A Great Place to Work® Certified company with approximately over 1000 employees, its operations comprise of manufacturing sites, innovation center, established centers of excellence, and commercial office. **What You Will Do**

* Own the Mumbai P&L end-to-end — revenue targets, team performance, and market expansion
* Assess, restructure, and grow the existing 6-person Mumbai ops team; hire senior team members as the business scales
* Collaborate with Bangalore's product and tech teams to adapt the platform for Mumbai-specific consumer behaviour
* Work with performance marketing and content teams to drive top-of-funnel lead generation
* Drive Mumbai from ~1 home/month to a target of ~50 homes/month within the first year
* Build developer relationships and establish Propsoch's advisory presence in the Mumbai market
* Spend ~50% of initial time working with the Bangalore team on product iteration and market experiments for Mumbai

**Must Haves**

* Postgraduate management degree from a Tier 1 institution (IIM, ISB, or equivalent)
* Proven 10X+ growth ownership from a meaningful baseline — personally driven, not assisted or advised; must have owned a real target and can articulate the specific levers they pulled
* Full P&L, city, or category ownership at a B2C/D2C business — accountable for targets, team, and outcomes (not a strategy or analytics contributor)
* Direct team leadership — must have built and managed a team, not just cross-functional influence
* Minimum 50% of career spent at consumer-facing B2C/D2C startups; comfortable with ambiguity, pace, and the absence of structured process

**Good to Have**

* Operations-first career — experience managing field teams, advisors, or customer-facing ops units
* Engineering undergraduate degree
* Consulting background (Big 4, MBB, or boutique strategy firm)
* Experience at a high-signal B2C consumer brand: Swiggy, Zomato, Urban Company, NoBroker, or PropTech companies
* New geography or city launch experience — has taken a brand or category into a new city from scratch
* Cross-functional collaboration with product and engineering teams

* Step 1: Click On Apply! And Register or Login on our portal.
* Step 2: Complete the Screening Form & Upload updated Resume
* Step 3: Increase your chances to get shortlisted & meet the client for the Interview!

Our goal is to make hiring reliable, simple, and fast. Our role will be to help all our talents find and apply for relevant contractual onsite opportunities and progress in their career. We will support any grievances or challenges you may face during the engagement.
  
  
(Note: There are many more opportunities apart from this on the portal. Depending on the assessments you clear, you can apply for them as well).
  
  
So, if you are ready for a new challenge, a great work environment, and an opportunity to take your career to the next level, don't hesitate to apply today. We are waiting for you!

title: Country Director - India
description:
**About TechnoServe:**
At TechnoServe, we believe that everyone deserves the opportunity to build a better life. For over 50 years, we have given smallholder farmers and entrepreneurs the skills, connections, and confidence to lift themselves out of poverty. We leverage the power of markets and the private sector to create sustainable economic growth to benefit people and the planet. Our unique mix of business solutions, deep knowledge of local contexts, and data-driven insights is helping to fight poverty across Africa, Asia, and Latin America.
  
  
TechnoServe staff are local–95% are from the countries in which they work. We put a high premium on collaboration and entrepreneurship. We hold ourselves and each other to the highest standards of integrity and transparency. And we focus on delivering lasting impact for our mission.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
As the Country Director for TechnoServe India, you have the incredible opportunity to lead and shape the strategic direction of sustainable economic development in the country. The Country Director will be at the forefront of driving impactful change, overseeing all aspects of our work from strategic branding to operational excellence. This role isn’t just about managing day-to-day operations; it's about making a lasting difference by ensuring high-quality program implementation, and championing TechnoServe’s mission in India and the Southern Africa and Asia Region. You'll be the face of TechnoServe in India- representing us to stakeholders, developing a robust pipeline of new program opportunities to grow the India platform, and steering our team towards efficient, effective, and impactful outcomes. It’s a dynamic and rewarding position that offers the chance to drive meaningful change and leave a lasting legacy of economic empowerment and development. The Country Director reports to the Regional Director.
  
  
The country platform is comprised of 250 staff in 4 provinces.
  
  
**Primary Functions & Responsibilities:**

* Business Development and Strategic Growth: In collaboration with regional leadership and program development teams, execute a new business strategy aligned with TechnoServe’s global and regional strategies, maintain strong relationships with a wide range of donors, and develop a robust pipeline of new program opportunities to grow the India platform and scale TechnoServe’s impact.
* Stakeholder Engagement & Advocacy: Establish and maintain strong relationships with relevant stakeholders, including government ministries, private sector companies, business associations, and civil society organizations; securing their support as needed; represent TechnoServe at internal and external functions.
* Leadership & Communication: Act as a role model who assumes accountability, communicates transparently, provides thought leadership and escalates issues to home offices in a timely manner, and encourages staff to do the same. Build a working culture that aligns with organizational values and fosters a healthy / productive working environment for in-country staff. Be accessible to staff and hold regular staff meetings to communicate vision, developments, and expectations.
* Program Oversight: Recruit, coach and supervise competent project managers to ensure successful delivery of results; ensure projects are set up and closed down in a timely manner; work with program teams to identify and address technical assistance needs; ensure submission of internal reports, corporate measurement, and high quality donor reports with support of the divisional back-stopping team; support country-level adaptation and use of program management tools; coordinate support from TechnoServe technical practices in India.
* Finance & Administration: Establish and maintain a high functioning financial and administrative team to ensure banking, tax, and financial transactions are conducted in compliance with organizational and donor policies, and budgets align with HQ and donor regulations; review and approval of expenditures, monthly monitoring of budget burn rates, and corrective action where spending deviates from plan; ensure timely financial close and budget realignments, where required; ensure submission of high quality reports to TechnoServe’s HQ; ensure that TechnoServe assets (office space, vehicles, technology equipment, etc.), are utilized responsibly and in accordance with organizational policies.
* Human Resources: Recruit and manage a strong local Senior Management Team, consisting of Program Managers, a Deputy Country Director and leaders of the HR, Finance and Procurement functions who can adequately oversee and support day-to-day operations, follow policy, and manage and motivate their teams; ensure that HR and Recruiting policies and procedures are being followed and ensure timely completion of HR-related activities such as staff performance appraisals; keep abreast of local regulations and proactively addressing performance concerns; ensure pay and performance are in line with local labor laws and organizational policies.
* Legal Compliance: Act as primary signatory on behalf of the organization and represent TechnoServe in all legal matters at the country level, and ensure TechnoServe retains and consults with qualified local legal counsel as needed; ensure that TechnoServe is properly registered in India and complies with all local laws including labor regulations; establish and manage a board of directors if required. Execute agreements with local government, bilateral and multilateral institutions, and client groups.
* Regional Coordination: establish and maintain strong working relationships with divisional, regional and HQ teams; ensure information is shared and flows transparently within the country project team, TechnoServe practices, and to the regional program management team.
* Safety and Security: ensure the country office has a robust, well-communicated security plan and for managing safety and security issues in coordination with HQ and external security advisers.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in economics, international relations business or related field, with a minimum of 15 years of experience; or Master’s degree in economics, international economics, international relations/policy, with a minimum of 10 years of experience.
* 5 years’ implementation and management experience relating to large-scale projects with responsibility for all aspects of operations.
* Experience working in developing countries, with a preference for Asia program management.
* Significant operations experience, including experience in budget development and management; private sector experience; donor and stakeholder management experience.

**Required Languages:**
Excellent oral, written, and interpersonal skills, including fluency in local and English languages.
  
  
**Travel:**
Travel up to 20%
  
  
**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* Entrepreneurial and inspirational, with a demonstrated ability to build and maintain high-performing teams in stressful contexts.
* Ability to build strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**
Supervises department heads including program and operations staff.
  
  
**Job Details:**
Candidates must possess valid, unrestricted work authorization for India. TechnoServe does not offer visa sponsorship for this role. The successful candidate will receive a local employment contract with compensation paid in Indian Rupees (INR). Salary is competitive, aligned with local market rates, and commensurate with qualifications and internal equity.
  
  
We encourage all qualified individuals who share TechnoServe's vision of improving the lives of others through proven business solutions to apply.
  
  
With our commitment to diversity, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and affirmative action employer and do not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, color, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, HIV/AIDS status, protected veteran status, disability and all other protected classes.
  
  
We are also proud of our commitment to protecting staff, partners, and beneficiaries from abuse and exploitation and thoroughly vet all final candidates through rigorous background and reference checks.
  
  
If you have a disability that affects your ability to use our online system to apply for a position at TechnoServe please contact Human Resources at recruitment@tns.org or call +1 202 785 4515.

title: Customer Success Manager - Marketing Cloud
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer's workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and advice to customer organizations.
  
  
The CSM is responsible for identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, aligning them strategically with customer priorities, projects, and problems. The CSM serving Marketing Cloud customers acts as the primary Marketing Cloud Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the technical and operational configuration and needs of the customer.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
Customer Accountability and Value Alignment
  
  

* Single Point of Accountability: Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
* Signature Lifecycle Oversight: Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle.
* Value Delivery: Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
* Prioritization: Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
* Internal Resource Utilization: Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.

**Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management**

* Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer's business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
* Innovation Partnership: Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.
* Customer Engagement: Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
* Collaborative Problem Solving: Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.

**Technical Health, Adoption, and Risk Management**

* AI Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.
* Prompt Engineering Basics: Ability to use natural-language commands to guide AI agents in retrieving accurate customer data and generating first drafts of success plans.
* AI Engagement Monitoring: Using AI-driven sentiment and intent analysis to flag early customer concerns for human intervention.
* Collaborative Learning: Actively seeking out "Agentblazer" training and certifications to stay current on autonomous agent capabilities.
* Learning & Development: Apply product knowledge and expertise to address technical concerns, use this knowledge to ask effective diagnosis questions and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps.
* Proactive Reviews: Proactively monitor and conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
* Incident Management: Act as the primary point of contact for major incidents, ensuring timely communications and resolution of issues.
* Cross-functional Relationships: Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
* Client Engagement Planning: Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision-making.

**You're Our Person If...**

* Experience (Mandatory): Experienced business professional with 9+ years of relevant industry expertise, including a mandatory minimum of 4+ years of direct, hands-on experience working with the Salesforce Marketing Cloud platform (Marketing Cloud Engagement, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement / Pardot, or Marketing Cloud Next) in a customer success, administrator, consultant, or marketing operations capacity. Candidates without demonstrated Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience will not be considered for this role.
* Consulting Skills: Strong consulting skills and demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate discussions, handle objections, and influence C-level conversations.
* Domain Expertise: Possess industry-relevant expertise and begin honing skills in a relevant functional area. Should understand the broad impact of the industry on the customer's business.
* Communication: Excellent communication skills to articulate technical issues to diverse audiences and the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms.
* Learning & Development: Actively seek out relevant learning activities, approach obstacles as growth opportunities, and seek experienced mentors to accelerate personal development.

**Even Better If...**

* Marketing Cloud Engagement Administrator — hands-on experience configuring Marketing Cloud products using industry and product best practices.
* Marketing Cloud Email Specialist — proven knowledge of email marketing best practices, message design, subscriber & data management, and inbox delivery.
* Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Specialist — skills in designing, building, and implementing marketing workflows through the Account Engagement (Pardot) platform.
* Marketing Cloud Engagement Consultant — ability to create multi-channel campaign solutions using the full suite of Marketing Cloud tools.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Performance Marketing Creative Lead
description:
View Application

**Location:** Mumbai (in-office)

**Function:** Marketing / Growth

**Reports to:** Founders

  

Earthful is a clean-label, plant-based nutraceutical and wellness brand built for women's health, backed by Fireside Ventures and V3 Ventures. We sell primarily online, which means performance creative isn't a support function here — it's core to how the business grows. This role sits at the centre of that engine, turning what's working (and what's failing) in our ads into a steady, high-volume stream of creative that moves ROAS in the right direction.

**Role Overview**

The Performance Marketing Creative Lead owns Earthful's entire performance creative output — 200–250 pieces live every month across video, hook variations, and statics — and leads a team of 5–8 people (writers, editors, and coordinators) who produce it. You'll work closely with the Growth Manager to translate platform data (Meta, Google, ROAS by product) into a monthly creative plan, then run that plan through concept development, scripting, and production, whether the work is produced in-house or by an agency. This is fundamentally a copywriting-and-strategy-led role, not a visual design or art direction one — you'll be judged on how well your scripts and hooks convert, not on a portfolio's visual polish. You're accountable for both the ROAS the creative drives and the team and pipeline that produce it.

**What You'll Own**

**Monthly Creative Planning & ROAS Ownership**

* Build the monthly creative plan in discussion with the Growth Manager, drawing on performance data from Meta, Google, and product-level ROAS

* Decide which creator personas, products, and USPs get priority for the month, and roughly how much of the plan runs in-house versus through agencies

* Build the plan backward from the ROAS target for creative output — volume (200–250 pieces/month) is a function of that target, not the goal itself

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and manage a team of 5–8 people — writers, video editors, and creative coordinators — who execute the monthly plan

* Allocate work across the team based on individual strengths and the month's priority products/personas

* Build the team's capability in direct-response scriptwriting and hook development through hands-on review and feedback

**Concept Development & Scriptwriting**

* Personally write and/or closely edit ad scripts and hook variations — this role is hands-on with the writing, not just directing others' output

* Develop concepts that mix winning ideas replicated or iterated from previous months' performance with new ideas built for experimentation

* Ground concepts in competitor insight, current trends, and persona fit, prioritising what performs over what's simply creatively interesting

* Map every concept to the persona × product × USP matrix set in the monthly plan

**In-House Script Execution**

* Brief writers on approved concepts and run scripts through up to two rounds of feedback before they're shoot-ready

* Personally write hook variations for high-priority concepts

**Video & Static Production Oversight**

* Hold a weekly check-in with the senior video editor (or directly with editors where needed) to give feedback and keep output on pace for the monthly target

* Run a monthly plan for static creatives, mapped to product, USP, and persona the same way video is

* Review all static content before it goes live

**Agency-Executed Creatives**

* Discuss concepts and scripts jointly with agency partners, with the agency owning shoot and edit execution

* Review agency output against the same persona × product × USP matrix and ROAS logic used for in-house work

**What We're Looking For**

* 8+ years in performance marketing, with a background rooted in copywriting, content writing, or scriptwriting — this is not a visual design or art direction role, and candidates from a primarily design/art-direction background are not a fit

* Direct, hands-on experience running or closely supporting performance marketing ad campaigns (Meta, Google) — not just producing creative disconnected from the media side

* Experience managing a high-volume creative pipeline (video and/or static), ideally 100+ assets/month, across multiple people or teams

* Proven experience directly managing a team of 5+ people — hiring, developing, and holding them to a quality and output bar

* A portfolio or work sample showing direct-response ad scripts and hooks you personally wrote, not just creative you directed or approved

* Experience working with external creative or production agencies, including holding their output to a defined standard

* Working fluency with AI tools for creative drafting and iteration (scripts, concepts, copy) — Earthful expects AI-assisted drafting across the pipeline, with the judgment to revise AI output before it ships, not use it raw

Be a part of Earthful’s Family!

  

**About Earthful**

Earthful is a VC-funded FMCG brand building India’s most trusted clean-label wellness products. We were recently featured on **Shark Tank India** and have raised a **Pre-Series A round led by V3 Ventures and Fireside Ventures.**

The founders (Sudha Gogineni and Veda Gogineni) are graduates from IIT Kharagpur and ISB with a multitude of experience across multinational companies & startups, such as Uber, Meesho, Deutsche Bank, ITC.

Earthful is a **fast-growing startup**, offering high ownership and the opportunity to work closely with the founders. We are looking for a candidate who is passionate about scaling a startup!

title: Manager Bakery Applications & Technical Services
description:
At Corbion, we exist to champion preservation in all its forms, preserving food and food production, health, and our planet.

**The role**  
As Manager Bakery Applications & Technical Services, you will connect customer needs with practical ingredient solutions that support product innovation and commercial growth across India. Your primary focus will be bakery applications, complemented by opportunities in confectionery, sauces, dressings and condiments, meat, poultry and seafood.

This is a senior, customer-facing technical role rather than a traditional laboratory-based R&D position. You will engage directly with customers and their R&D teams, explore their current and future technical challenges, and translate these insights into viable solutions. Working closely with Corbion’s product management, commercial, regional and global application teams, you will develop, test and implement solutions using Corbion’s portfolio of preservation systems, vinegar-based solutions, cultured ingredients, organic acids, emulsifiers, fermentation-derived ingredients and functional blends.

A unique part of the position is the opportunity to help establish Corbion’s new Application Laboratory in Navi Mumbai. You will contribute your expertise and recommendations during its development and subsequently lead its activities as a regional innovation hub. The laboratory will support bakery, confectionery, sauces, dressings and condiments applications and enable customer solutions to be tested and optimized before implementation at customer locations.  
The position is based fully on-site in Navi Mumbai and involves approximately 30% to 40% travel, primarily within India and, where required, selected South Asian markets. Customer implementation and plant trials may require visits of several consecutive days.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build trusted technical partnerships with customers, distributors and strategic accounts by understanding their product, process, quality and manufacturing challenges.
* Work directly with customer R&D teams to identify current and future application needs and translate these into commercially viable ingredient solutions.
* Develop and optimize applications using Corbion’s portfolio of preservation systems, vinegar-based solutions, cultured ingredients, organic acids, emulsifiers, fermentation-derived ingredients and functional blends.
* Lead formulation and application work across bakery, confectionery, sauces, dressings and condiments, meat, poultry and seafood, with bakery as the primary area of focus.
* Develop solutions addressing shelf-life extension, food safety, clean-label reformulation, texture enhancement, yield improvement, flavour optimization and cost-in-use reduction.
* Take customer development projects from initial needs assessment and laboratory trials through validation, implementation and commercialization.
* Design and conduct application trials, including ingredient selection, dosage optimization and process improvement, to identify solutions customers can efficiently validate and implement.
* Lead customer plant trials, industrial validation and implementation across multiple manufacturing locations where required.
* Troubleshoot formulation, preservation, processing and implementation challenges, and conduct product benchmarking and competitive evaluations.
* Work with regional and global product management and application teams to adapt existing knowledge and solutions to Indian market requirements.
* Contribute expertise and recommendations to establishing Corbion’s new Application Laboratory in Navi Mumbai, and lead it as a center of excellence supporting customer innovation and business growth.
* Define laboratory objectives, budgets, equipment investment plans and capability-development roadmaps; manage resources, maintenance, calibration, utilization and materials inventory.
* Coordinate pilot-scale and customer-simulation trials, introduce new testing methodologies, and maintain protocols, formulation databases, technical reports and project documentation.
* Ensure compliance with Corbion’s safety, quality, food-safety and housekeeping standards and support internal and external laboratory audits.
* Deliver technical presentations, customer workshops, seminars and training programs, and support customer qualification processes and technical audits.
* Partner with Sales and Marketing to identify opportunities, develop the commercial pipeline and convert technical projects into business growth.
* Participate in strategic customer engagements, business reviews, innovation sessions, exhibitions, trade fairs and industry forums.
* Monitor market trends, regulatory developments, competitor activity and emerging technologies, and recommend innovation priorities based on customer and market insights.
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Supply Chain, Manufacturing and regional and global R&D teams.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring timely execution and, as the laboratory develops, help build and coach its technical capabilities.

  

**You bring**  
*Requirements*

  

* A bachelor’s degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Biotechnology or a closely related food-science discipline.
* At least 8 to 10 years of relevant experience in food ingredients, food manufacturing or the specialty ingredients industry.
* Strong experience in customer-facing technical support and the credibility to work directly with experienced customer R&D and manufacturing teams.
* Strong knowledge of food ingredients and their functionality within finished-product applications, with strong technical expertise in bakery applications.
* Experience in at least one additional relevant category, preferably confectionery, sauces, dressings and condiments, meat, poultry or seafood. Deep bakery expertise with some confectionery exposure may also fit.
* The ability to explore customer needs in depth, ask strong technical questions and translate customer challenges into practical application and ingredient solutions.
* Experience with laboratory or application trials, formulation optimization, technical troubleshooting and implementation in customer production environments.
* Understanding of product scale-up and commercialization, including implementation across multiple customer manufacturing locations.
* Knowledge of food preservation, clean-label product development, food safety and microbiology fundamentals.
* Strong project leadership, problem-solving, stakeholder-management, communication, presentation and influencing skills.
* A customer-focused, commercially aware and collaborative approach, with the ability to work across functions and geographies.
* Willingness to work fully on-site in Navi Mumbai and travel approximately 30% to 40%.

  

*Preferred*

* A master’s degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Biotechnology or a related discipline.
* Experience in application or product development. Candidates whose primary strength is customer-facing technical support may also fit when combined with strong ingredient knowledge and solution-development capability.
* Experience leading or contributing to the establishment, management or capability development of an application laboratory.
* Experience within a multinational food-ingredient company.
* Specialized training or experience in bakery, confectionery, meat processing, culinary products, preservation technologies or product development.
* Knowledge of organic acids, cultured ingredients, fermentation-based solutions, functional blends and emulsifiers.
* Knowledge of HACCP, GMP, FSSC 22000 and other relevant food-quality systems.
* Experience with experimental design, laboratory documentation, audits and equipment or budget planning.
* Previous production experience or direct exposure to customer manufacturing environments.
* Experience coaching or developing technical or laboratory colleagues.

  

**What we offer**

* The opportunity to shape and lead Corbion’s new Application Laboratory in Navi Mumbai and contribute your expertise while its capabilities are being established.
* A highly visible role combining customer engagement, technical problem-solving, application development and commercial impact.
* The opportunity to work on strategic innovation priorities, including natural preservation solutions for bakery and new confectionery applications.
* Direct collaboration with customer R&D and manufacturing teams and with Corbion’s Sales, Product Management, Marketing, Regulatory, Quality, Manufacturing and global innovation organizations.
* Access to expertise from Corbion’s regional and global application teams, allowing successful technologies and solutions from other markets to be adapted for India.
* The opportunity to build application capabilities that strengthen Corbion’s position as an innovation partner for preservation, food safety, clean-label and sustainable ingredient solutions.
* Scope to build and develop a technical laboratory team as the Navi Mumbai facility grows.
* Potential to broaden into larger technical-commercial or business-development responsibilities in India and across Asia.
* The opportunity to contribute to measurable customer and business outcomes, including successful product launches, commercialized projects, improved technical solutions and stronger strategic partnerships.

**About Corbion**

Corbion is the global market leader in lactic acid and its derivatives, and a leading supplier of emulsifiers, functional enzyme blends, minerals, vitamins, and algae ingredients. We use our unique expertise in fermentation and other processes to deliver sustainable solutions for the preservation of food and food production, health, and our planet. For over 100 years, we have been uncompromising in our commitment to safety, quality, innovation and performance. Drawing on our deep application and product knowledge, we work side-by-side with customers to make our cutting-edge technologies work for them. Our solutions help differentiate products in markets such as food, home & personal care, animal nutrition, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and bioplastics. In 2025, Corbion generated annual sales of €1,267.4 million and had a workforce of 2,408 FTE. For more information: www.corbion.com

Corbion is an equal opportunity employer and committed to a diverse workplace. All applicants will be considered equally.

***Corbion does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers. All candidates must be submitted by approved Corbion vendors who have been expressly requested to make a submission by our Talent Acquisition team for a specific job opening. No placement fees will be paid to any firm unless such a request has been made by the Corbion Talent Acquisition team and such candidate was submitted to the Corbion Talent Acquisition Team.***

* CAC
* ROAS

* Develop alternate sourcing options to mitigate supply risks and support business growth.

#### **3. Supplier Relationship Management**

* Establish long-term partnerships with key suppliers and manufacturing partners.
* Monitor supplier performance through scorecards covering quality, cost, delivery, flexibility, responsiveness, and production capability.
* Conduct regular supplier reviews and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Resolve supply chain, quality, and operational issues proactively.

#### **4. Commercial Negotiation & Cost Optimization**

* Lead negotiations on pricing, MOQ, payment terms, lead times, and commercial agreements.
* Develop costing models and supplier comparisons to support procurement decisions.
* Identify and implement cost optimization opportunities while maintaining quality standards.
* Drive procurement savings and support budgeting and purchase planning activities.

#### **5. Quality Control & Product Compliance**

* Coordinate with Product Development and Quality teams to ensure products meet brand standards.
* Review and approve development samples before bulk production.
* Monitor key quality parameters including fabric GSM, composition, shrinkage, stitching, colour fastness, print quality, embroidery, and packaging.
* Manage supplier corrective actions and ensure consistency across production batches.

#### **6. Production Planning & Inventory Management**

* Coordinate with Product, Operations, Warehousing, and Logistics teams on procurement and delivery schedules.
* Manage purchase orders, production timelines, and inventory planning.
* Ensure timely deliveries and minimize stock-outs.
* Track orders from sourcing through final delivery.

#### **7. Supplier Audits & Reporting**

* Conduct factory visits and supplier assessments covering manufacturing capability, capacity, quality systems, compliance, and scalability.
* Drive supplier development initiatives.
* Maintain vendor databases, costing sheets, procurement dashboards, and supplier scorecards.
* Generate procurement reports and analytics to support business decisions.

title: Head of Banking Platforms
description:
If you’re looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 58 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Head of Banking Platforms**

**The Opportunity**

The Head of Banking Platforms is responsible for establishing and scaling AI-native engineering capabilities across the organization. This role leads the adoption of modern AI-assisted software engineering practices, leveraging AI platforms, ownership of governance standards, and delivery frameworks to improve software quality, engineering productivity, operational efficiency, and product innovation.

Global Banking Technology is responsible for delivering the technology strategy, platforms, products and engineering capabilities that underpin a number of CIB’s front line value streams. The organisation supports critical client-facing and revenue-generating businesses including Capital Markets & Advisory (CMA), Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Infrastructure Finance & Sustainability (HIF&S), Omnia platform, Marketing and Innovation Banking. It delivers digital capabilities that enable relationship managers, product specialists and clients to originate, manage and grow client relationships, while driving operational efficiency, resiliency and innovation across the CIB and wider franchise.

Working across multiple engineering domains and technology stacks within Global Banking Technology, the role acts as a strategic and engineering/technical leader enabling teams to safely and effectively integrate AI into the software development lifecycle and broader technology estate.

**What you’ll do**

**AI Engineering Strategy**

* Define and execute the enterprise AI engineering roadmap aligned to business and technology strategy.
* Act as the senior technical authority for AI Engineering across Global Banking Technology.
* Establish standards, patterns, and reference architectures for AI-enabled engineering.
* Partner with CTO, Architecture, Security, Data, and Platform teams on enterprise AI capability development.
* Drives a deliberate strategy of when and how to leverage latest tools and models, aids cross-domain understanding of when and how to use tooling in a productivity enhancing and cost effective way.

**Engineering Transformation**

* Works closely with the Head of Engineering to develop org strategy and re-defines and re-imagines resource activities and POD design.
* Drive adoption of AI-assisted development tooling across our engineering teams.
* Evolve SDLC practices to incorporate AI-native workflows, automation, and intelligent testing approaches.
* Define engineering productivity metrics and AI impact measurement frameworks, own accountability of delivery of GCIO and CIO related OKRs.

**AI Platform & Enablement**

* Lead development of shared AI engineering capabilities and reusable services.
* Standardize frameworks for LLM integration, prompt engineering, agent orchestration, evaluation, observability, and governance.
* Establish enablement programs, training, communities of practice, and engineering guidance.
* Build common patterns for re-use across AI platform consumed across GCIO and customised within our tech estate.

**Governance & Risk**

* Implement governance standards for responsible AI usage within engineering.
* Partner with Cyber, Risk and Data teams to ensure compliance and operational safety and automation opportunities across our Risk and Control book of work.
* Understand and define controls for model usage, data protection, auditability, and AI operational resilience.

**Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Influence senior engineering and product leaders across a federated technology organization.
* Build organizational capability in AI engineering practices.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning multiple delivery teams and business domains.
* Grow knowledge of team members and ensure re-use of capabilities as they are built
* Build a successful resource mix and engage market participants to ensure GB tech are at the forefront of AI resource strategy

**Success Measures**

* Increased engineering productivity and delivery velocity
* Reduction in SDLC friction and operational toil
* Adoption of AI engineering standards, patterns and tooling
* Innovation mind set, focused and deliberate in driving growth of capability
* Measurable improvements in quality and developer experience
* Safe and governed use of AI technologies
* Increased reuse of AI platform capabilities across teams

**What you will need to succeed in the role**

  

* Deep software engineering leadership background
* Experience scaling engineering practices across large organizations
* Leads by example through hands-on experimentation, prototyping and adoption of emerging AI engineering capabilities.
* Champions engineering excellence through modern development practices, automation, quality engineering and developer experience improvements.
* Principle Engineer or PE mindset, serve as an internal thought leader, helping shape the future direction of engineering within Global Banking Technology.
* Principle Engineer or PE mindset, create technical strategies and reference implementations that accelerate adoption across multiple domains.
* Assess emerging AI technologies and translate industry innovation into practical engineering outcomes.
* Strong understanding of modern AI/LLM engineering ecosystems
* Familiarity with platform engineering, DevOps, and developer experience practices
* Experience implementing governance and operational controls for AI systems
* Strong influencing and organizational change leadership skills

**You’ll achieve more at HSBC.**

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. description:
**Job Description: Marketing Executive / Marketing Manager**

**Department:** Marketing  
**Experience:** 3–6 years (preferred)  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Location:** Dehu, Pune  
**Reports To:** Marketing Head / Business Head

**Job Overview**

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented marketing professional to plan, execute, and manage integrated marketing initiatives across offline and digital channels. The candidate will be responsible for expanding brand reach, acquiring new customers, managing marketing vendors, coordinating creative deliverables, and optimizing marketing campaign performance.

The ideal candidate should have strong market research skills, vendor management capabilities, knowledge of bulk messaging platforms, and experience in social media marketing and campaign execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Outdoor Advertising & Hoarding Management**

* Conduct market research to identify high-potential locations for outdoor advertising and business hoardings.
* Evaluate locations based on target audience, footfall, visibility, demographics, and advertising costs.
* Coordinate with advertising agencies and vendors for site selection, quotations, bookings, installation, and maintenance.
* Monitor campaign execution and evaluate the effectiveness of hoarding placements.

**2. Marketing Campaigns & Customer Acquisition**

* Plan and execute marketing activities to increase brand awareness, customer engagement, and new customer acquisition.
* Identify new marketing channels, promotional opportunities, and local outreach initiatives.
* Conduct competitor analysis and market research to identify customer trends and business opportunities.
* Develop campaign plans, budgets, timelines, and performance metrics.
* Track campaign results and recommend improvements to maximize reach and return on investment (ROI).

**3. Bulk Messaging, RCS & Voice Campaigns**

* Manage marketing communication campaigns through bulk SMS, RCS (Rich Communication Services), multimedia messaging (MMS), and voice messaging platforms, as applicable.
* Coordinate with bulk messaging vendors for campaign planning, pricing, scheduling, delivery, and troubleshooting.
* Understand messaging formats, multimedia content requirements, delivery reports, and campaign analytics.
* Work with the content and design teams to prepare engaging communication materials.
* Ensure campaigns comply with applicable messaging regulations, consent requirements, and customer communication policies.

**4. Corporate Gifting & Vendor Management**

* Plan and procure promotional gifts, festive gifts, customer appreciation items, and corporate gifting products within approved budgets.
* Research suppliers, identify suitable products, obtain quotations, negotiate pricing, and evaluate vendors.
* Coordinate purchase orders, production, packaging, delivery schedules, and quality checks.
* Maintain inventory records of gifting items and monitor stock levels to ensure availability for planned campaigns.
* Track expenditure against allocated budgets and maintain vendor and procurement documentation.

**5. Content & Design Team Coordination**

* Coordinate with content writers, graphic designers, and external agencies to develop marketing collaterals.
* Brief the creative team on campaign objectives, target audiences, messaging, formats, and delivery timelines.
* Manage the development of hoarding designs, promotional creatives, brochures, banners, digital advertisements, and other marketing materials.
* Review deliverables for accuracy, brand consistency, quality, and timely execution.
* Ensure marketing materials are approved and delivered before campaign launch dates.

**6. Social Media & Performance Marketing**

* Coordinate and manage social media management and digital marketing teams to execute the marketing strategy.
* Plan and oversee social media calendars, promotional campaigns, paid advertisements, and audience engagement activities.
* Work with performance marketing teams on campaign targeting, budget allocation, lead generation, and customer acquisition.
* Monitor key metrics such as reach, impressions, engagement, click-through rate, cost per lead, conversions, and return on ad spend (ROAS).
* Review campaign reports, identify performance gaps, and recommend data-driven improvements.
* Ensure consistent brand communication across social media platforms and digital advertising channels.

**7. Budgeting, Reporting & Coordination**

* Prepare marketing activity plans and budgets in alignment with business objectives.
* Maintain records of campaign expenses, vendor quotations, purchase orders, and marketing deliverables.
* Prepare periodic reports on campaign performance, customer reach, expenditure, and outcomes.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external agencies to ensure smooth execution of marketing activities.
* Manage multiple campaigns simultaneously while meeting deadlines and budget requirements.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
* 3–6 years of experience in marketing, campaign execution, vendor management, or digital marketing.
* Practical understanding of outdoor advertising, local marketing, and customer acquisition initiatives.
* Knowledge of bulk SMS, RCS, multimedia messaging, and voice messaging campaigns.
* Experience in vendor sourcing, quotation comparison, negotiation, procurement, and inventory management.
* Strong coordination skills to manage content, design, social media, and performance marketing teams.
* Familiarity with social media platforms and paid digital advertising campaigns.
* Strong communication, planning, budgeting, and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for budgeting, tracking, and reporting.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, vendors, and deadlines independently.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Increase in brand reach and new customer acquisition.
* Effectiveness and cost efficiency of outdoor advertising placements.
* Campaign execution within approved budgets and timelines.
* Bulk messaging delivery rates, engagement, and campaign outcomes.
* Cost savings and procurement efficiency in gifting activities.
* Timely delivery and quality of marketing creatives.
* Social media growth, engagement, leads, conversions, and ROAS.
* Overall marketing expenditure efficiency and contribution to business growth.

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is hands-on, organized, commercially aware, and comfortable managing both on-ground marketing activities and digital campaigns. They should be able to independently coordinate with vendors and internal teams, manage budgets, identify new marketing opportunities, and ensure that marketing initiatives deliver measurable business results.

description:
**About Growify Digital**

Growify Digital is a results-driven digital marketing agency specializing in scaling luxury fashion brands. We craft data-backed strategies to help businesses grow sustainably and build impactful online experiences.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and creative
**Email Marketing Specialist**
to
**manage and execute**
email marketing campaigns from strategy to delivery. The ideal candidate will be passionate about customer engagement, have a strong grasp of segmentation and automation, and possess the ability to create campaigns that drive measurable results.

**What You'll Do**

**Plan the strategy:**

* Build a monthly retention calendar for each brand covering launches, sales, festive drops and newsletters.
* Segment customers by purchase behaviour, browsing activity, location and lifecycle stage (new, repeat, VIP, lapsed).
* Pick the right channel for each message so customers hear from us at the right time without being over-messaged.

**Build and run campaigns:**

* Set up and maintain automated flows: welcome series, browse and cart abandonment, post-purchase, back-in-stock, win-back and birthday.
* Run promotional, launch and newsletter campaigns end to end, from brief to send.

* A/B test subject lines, content, offers, layouts and send times, then roll the winners into future campaigns.
* Share a monthly performance report for each brand with clear next steps.

**Keep lists healthy and compliant:**

* Clean lists regularly, manage bounces and inactive subscribers, and protect sender reputation and deliverability.
* Follow consent and opt-out rules. These include India's DPDP Act, TRAI DLT registration for SMS, WhatsApp Business policies, and GDPR for international customers.

* 2+ years in email, CRM, retention or lifecycle marketing, ideally for D2C or eCommerce brands.

* Ability to manage multiple brands, campaigns and deadlines without missing details.
