title: Head of Wealth Management
description:
**Job Summary:**

We are looking for an experienced Wealth Management business leader to build and scale a new Wealth Management vertical from the ground up. The role will have end-to-end responsibility for business development, client acquisition, AUM and revenue growth, product strategy, digital engagement, business operations and team building across Retail and HNI/UHNI segments. The candidate will work closely with the Senior Leadership Team to establish the business model, operating framework and growth roadmap. Candidates with prior experience in building or scaling a wealth, digital wealth or investment business in a technology-led environment will be preferred.

**Job Responsibilities:**

**1. Build & Scale the Wealth Business**

* Take end-to-end ownership of the Wealth Management business, including business planning, growth strategy, operations, revenue, AUM and profitability.
* Work closely with Senior Leadership to define the business model, target segments, operating structure, growth roadmap and key business metrics.
* Establish the Wealth business, processes and operating framework from the ground up and create a scalable model for future growth.
* Identify new business opportunities and continuously strengthen the Wealth Management proposition based on market and client requirements.

**2. Client Acquisition & Business Development**

* Develop and execute strategies for new client acquisition, client activation, relationship development, cross-sell and retention across Retail, Affluent, HNI and UHNI segments.
* Build scalable acquisition channels through digital engagement, referrals, partnerships, existing customer ecosystems and relationship-led channels.
* Drive key business metrics including AUM, revenue, client acquisition, activation, product penetration and retention.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key HNI/UHNI clients and strategic business partners.

**3. Wealth Products & Investment Proposition**

* Develop and manage a comprehensive wealth proposition covering Mutual Funds, PMS, AIFs, Insurance, Direct Equity/Stock Portfolios and other relevant investment products.
* Work with Product, Research, Technology, Operations and Compliance teams to create effective product funnels and investment journeys.
* Develop client-centric investment solutions aligned with different customer segments, investment objectives and risk profiles.
* Monitor market trends, competitive offerings and customer needs to continuously improve the wealth proposition.

**4. Digital, Technology & Automation**

* Drive a digital first Wealth Management experience, leveraging technology and automation across the client lifecycle.
* Work closely with Product and Technology teams on digital onboarding, KYC, investment journeys, CRM, portfolio tracking, client engagement, reporting and product discovery.
* Identify and implement opportunities to automate processes, improve productivity and enhance client experience.
* Translate business requirements into technology/product solutions and ensure their effective adoption across the Wealth business.

**5. Team Building & Leadership**

* Build and scale the Wealth Management team in line with business growth, including Wealth/Relationship Managers, Investment/Product specialists and Business Operations resources.
* Define team structures, responsibilities, targets, KPIs and performance frameworks.
* Develop a high-performance, client-centric culture with strong focus on business ownership, service quality and compliance.
* Mentor and develop team members to build a sustainable Wealth Management organization.

**6. Business Operations, Governance & Compliance**

* Establish robust processes covering client onboarding, investment execution, portfolio servicing, reporting, client engagement and issue resolution.
* Work closely with Compliance, Risk, Operations, Technology and other functions to establish a scalable and compliant operating environment.
* Develop business dashboards and MIS covering AUM, revenue, client acquisition, productivity, product penetration, retention and profitability.
* Ensure adherence to applicable regulatory requirements and internal policies.

**Job Requirements:**

* Master’s degree in finance, Business, Economics or a related discipline. CFA or relevant professional certification will be an advantage.
* 8–15 years of relevant experience in Wealth Management, Private Wealth, Digital Wealth, Stock Broking services businesses.
* Strong experience across Retail, Affluent, HNI and/or UHNI client segments.
* Demonstrated experience in building, launching, scaling or transforming a Wealth Management or investment-led business/vertical.
* Strong understanding of Mutual Funds, PMS, AIFs, Insurance, Direct Equity/Stock Portfolios and other investment products.
* Proven track record in client acquisition, business development, AUM growth, revenue generation and relationship management.
* Strong hands-on exposure to digital wealth platforms, technology-enabled investment journeys, CRM, automation and digital client engagement.
* Experience in building teams, establishing processes and creating operating models from scratch will be highly preferred.
* Strong commercial orientation with the ability to translate business strategy into execution and measurable business outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with experience working closely with CXOs/Senior Leadership.
* Good understanding of applicable regulatory and compliance requirements within the wealth management/stock broking ecosystem.

KPIs:

* Establish and scale the Wealth Management vertical from the ground up.
* Build a sustainable pipeline of new Retail, Affluent, HNI and UHNI clients.
* Drive AUM, revenue, profitability and client retention Achieve and exceed individual and team sales targets to drive revenuegrowth.
* Increase client retention and satisfaction by providing high-quality investment advice and personalized service.
* Build a differentiated and scalable multi-product wealth proposition.
* Develop digital first and technology-enabled client journeys.
* Build and scale a high-performing Wealth Management team.
* Establish efficient, data-driven and compliant business operations and processes.
* Create a scalable Wealth business capable of sustained long-term growth.
* Maintain a high level of compliance with relevant regulations and internal policiesto ensure that clients' investments are protected.
* Stay up to date with the latest markettrends and news to identifyinvestment opportunities and risks.

**Why This Role?**

This is a build-and-scale opportunity for a senior Wealth Management professional who wants to create and shape a Wealth business rather than manage only an established client book. The role offers an opportunity to work closely with Senior Leadership and influence the business strategy, digital ecosystem, product proposition, team structure and growth journey of the Wealth Management vertical.

- Execute BTL marketing activities such as corporate activations, exhibitions, roadshows, kiosks, mall activations, residential society campaigns, and local-area promotions.

- Plan marketing activities for new project launches, festive campaigns, inventory promotions, site events, and special sales campaigns.

- Identify strategic locations for outdoor advertising and branding based on target audience, catchment areas, traffic, and project connectivity.

- Coordinate with media agencies, printing agencies, event agencies, fabricators, and other marketing vendors for campaign execution.

title: SPL – EdTech and AI
description:
**About The Job SPL - EdTech And AI**
**Senior Project Lead – EdTech and AI**
**Location:**
Delhi
  
  
Founded in 2012, Central Square Foundation is a non-profit philanthropic foundation working with the vision of ensuring quality school education for all children in India. We believe that effective foundational learning is essential for better learning outcomes for all children in school. Development of foundational literacy and numeracy skills can help children progress to higher levels of learning and is an essential building block in a child's life.
  
  
We are driven by our mission to enable the school education system to adopt solutions that are scalable, sustainable and effective, so that all children get equal access to opportunities needed for leading a better life. CSF has prioritised five critical areas of work: Foundational Literacy & Numeracy (FLN); EdTech and AI; Early Childhood Education (ECE); Schools Governance; and High Potential Students (HPS).
  
  
Read more about our work at the CSF website: https://www.centralsquarefoundation.org.
  
  
**About EdTech And AI At CSF**
CSF's EdTech and AI initiative focuses on leveraging technology to enhance teaching and learning, both in classrooms and at home, through student-focused and teacher-directed interventions. Our goal is to improve foundational learning in primary grades and provide remediation support in middle school using evidence-based, scalable technology solutions.
  
  
**Role**
Since 2012, CSF has played a pivotal role in shaping India's EdTech ecosystem by bridging demand and supply, backed by rigorous research. We drive impact by:
  
  

* Supporting EdTech organisations to build contextually relevant, pedagogically sound products for low-income learners.
* Generating evidence on what works, how it works, and how to scale effective EdTech interventions.
* Partnering with governments to adopt and effectively implement evidence-backed EdTech solutions, strengthen the utilisation of public investments in technology, and influence policy and system priorities.
* Creating public goods to drive innovation and strengthen the broader ecosystem.

In the last five years, CSF has collaborated with 15+ EdTech organisations, 11+ state governments, and leading academic institutions, reaching over 10 million learners across India.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Senior Project Lead – EdTech and AI will lead CSF's government adoption, implementation and policy portfolio across EdTech and emerging AI-enabled opportunities in school education.
  
  
The role will translate CSF's EdTech and AI strategy into government adoption and sustained implementation at scale by:
  
  

* Leading partnerships across 3–4 states, from opportunity identification and programme design through procurement, implementation and institutionalisation.
* Building relationships with senior government stakeholders and supporting states to use technology investments effectively.
* Strengthening implementation systems, including Technical Support Units (TSUs), Programme Management Units (PMUs) and other technical-assistance structures.
* Contributing to CSF's engagement with the Ministry of Education and other central institutions.
* Managing teams, budgets and complex programmes while converting evidence and field insights into policy and system-level action.

The Senior Project Lead will report to the Associate Project Director – EdTech and AI.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Strategy, Portfolio Leadership & Growth
* Translate CSF's EdTech and AI strategy into priorities, workplans and measurable outcomes.
* Lead a portfolio of 3–4 state partnerships, ensuring clear strategies, milestones, ownership, risks and resource plans.
* Identify opportunities for evidence-backed EdTech and AI-enabled interventions and contribute to CSF's thinking on AI in education, digital infrastructure and technology-enabled governance.
* Government Adoption, Implementation & Institutionalisation
* Build demand for evidence-backed EdTech approaches and lead engagements from opportunity identification through scale-up and institutionalisation.
* Support quality-led procurement through programme specifications, technical requirements and implementation frameworks.
* Diagnose implementation bottlenecks using data and field insights, and strengthen government capabilities, ownership, monitoring and sustained usage.
* Government Engagement, Advocacy & Salience Building
* Build trusted relationships with senior state and central government stakeholders.
* Lead engagement with the Ministry of Education and other national institutions on EdTech, AI and digital education.
* Develop government-facing narratives and outputs, including concept notes, policy memos, guidelines, procurement language and implementation frameworks.
* Programme Management, Governance & Technical Assistance
* Lead programme design, partner selection, contracting, implementation planning, risk management, monitoring and course correction.
* Establish effective governance systems, including workplans, reviews, decision logs and deliverable tracking.
* Design or strengthen TSUs, PMUs and other technical-assistance structures, working with Evidence/M&E, Finance, Communications, State Reform and other CSF teams.
* Evidence, Knowledge & Thought Leadership
* Use evidence, implementation data and field learning to guide programme decisions and recommendations.
* Develop case studies, implementation playbooks, policy notes, frameworks and other knowledge outputs.
* Contribute to CSF's thought leadership on evidence-backed EdTech, AI in education, technology for governance and public investment in education technology.
* Team Leadership, Budgeting & Organisational Management
* Lead, coach and performance-manage a high-performing team while building ownership and execution capability.
* Own portfolio planning, budgeting, resource allocation, reporting and decision materials for leadership and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate across CSF teams and contribute to talent reviews, capability building and organisational priorities.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 10+ years of relevant experience, including significant work with Indian state and/or central government systems. Preference will be given to applicants from Education, EdTech, or adjacent social sectors.
* Track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder programmes from design through implementation and institutionalisation.
* Experience managing portfolios, budgets, teams and external partners with strong execution discipline.
* Master's degree in business, public policy, education, engineering, development studies or a related field.
* Demonstrated ability and track record in building senior government relationships and translating evidence and programme insights into policy, strategy and system-level outcomes.

**Desired Qualities**

* Strong commitment to improving learning outcomes and equity through public education systems.
* Systems thinker who connects policy, programmes, implementation, evidence and government incentives while remaining execution-focused.
* Entrepreneurial, self-directed and comfortable creating structure in ambiguous and evolving environments.
* Strong influencing, relationship-building, judgement and prioritisation skills across diverse stakeholders.
* Excellent synthesis and communication skills, with curiosity about emerging technologies and their responsible application to education and government systems.

**Compensation**
Remuneration will be competitive with Indian philanthropy and social-impact sector benchmarks, commensurate with experience.
  
  
**Application Process**
Interested candidates should submit a resume customised to role outlining relevant experience, a brief statement of interest outlining how your past experience and future aspirations connect to the role (max. 500 words) through the CSF Careers Portal by
**20th September 2026**
.
  
  
Candidates should apply only if they can
**commit to at least a three-year journey**
to help materialise CSF's 2025–2028 EdTech and AI strategy.

Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer's workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and advice to customer organizations.
  
  
The CSM is responsible for identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, aligning them strategically with customer priorities, projects, and problems. The CSM serving Marketing Cloud customers acts as the primary Marketing Cloud Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the technical and operational configuration and needs of the customer.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
Customer Accountability and Value Alignment
  
  

* Single Point of Accountability: Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
* Signature Lifecycle Oversight: Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle.
* Value Delivery: Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
* Prioritization: Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
* Internal Resource Utilization: Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.

**Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management**

* Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer's business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
* Innovation Partnership: Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.
* Customer Engagement: Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
* Collaborative Problem Solving: Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.

**Technical Health, Adoption, and Risk Management**

* AI Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.
* Prompt Engineering Basics: Ability to use natural-language commands to guide AI agents in retrieving accurate customer data and generating first drafts of success plans.
* AI Engagement Monitoring: Using AI-driven sentiment and intent analysis to flag early customer concerns for human intervention.
* Collaborative Learning: Actively seeking out "Agentblazer" training and certifications to stay current on autonomous agent capabilities.
* Learning & Development: Apply product knowledge and expertise to address technical concerns, use this knowledge to ask effective diagnosis questions and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps.
* Proactive Reviews: Proactively monitor and conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
* Incident Management: Act as the primary point of contact for major incidents, ensuring timely communications and resolution of issues.
* Cross-functional Relationships: Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
* Client Engagement Planning: Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision-making.

**You're Our Person If...**

* Experience (Mandatory): Experienced business professional with 9+ years of relevant industry expertise, including a mandatory minimum of 4+ years of direct, hands-on experience working with the Salesforce Marketing Cloud platform (Marketing Cloud Engagement, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement / Pardot, or Marketing Cloud Next) in a customer success, administrator, consultant, or marketing operations capacity. Candidates without demonstrated Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience will not be considered for this role.
* Consulting Skills: Strong consulting skills and demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate discussions, handle objections, and influence C-level conversations.
* Domain Expertise: Possess industry-relevant expertise and begin honing skills in a relevant functional area. Should understand the broad impact of the industry on the customer's business.
* Communication: Excellent communication skills to articulate technical issues to diverse audiences and the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms.
* Learning & Development: Actively seek out relevant learning activities, approach obstacles as growth opportunities, and seek experienced mentors to accelerate personal development.

**Even Better If...**

* Marketing Cloud Engagement Administrator — hands-on experience configuring Marketing Cloud products using industry and product best practices.
* Marketing Cloud Email Specialist — proven knowledge of email marketing best practices, message design, subscriber & data management, and inbox delivery.
* Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Specialist — skills in designing, building, and implementing marketing workflows through the Account Engagement (Pardot) platform.
* Marketing Cloud Engagement Consultant — ability to create multi-channel campaign solutions using the full suite of Marketing Cloud tools.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing SEO strategies to improve Google rankings, increase organic traffic, generate qualified patient enquiries, strengthen local search visibility, and improve website performance across all healthcare brands.

**1. SEO Strategy & Execution**

* Improve organic rankings for relevant treatment, doctor, hospital, diagnostic, and location-based keywords.
* Build SEO roadmaps aligned with business objectives and patient acquisition goals.

**2. Technical SEO**

* Conduct regular technical SEO audits and resolve crawlability, indexation, canonicalisation, redirect, sitemap, robots.txt, and structured-data issues.

* Monitor Google Search Console for indexing issues, ranking changes, and search performance.

**3. On-Page SEO & Content Optimisation**

**4. Local SEO & Google Business Profile**

* Manage and optimise Google Business Profiles for multiple hospital and healthcare locations.
* Improve visibility in Google Maps and local search results.
* Manage business categories, services, contact information, photos, posts, and location information.
* Monitor reviews and coordinate appropriate, privacy-conscious responses.
* Track local rankings and Google Business Profile performance.

**5. Off-Page SEO & Authority Building**

* Develop ethical link-building and digital PR strategies.
* Identify relevant healthcare publications, authoritative websites, and legitimate industry opportunities.
* Monitor backlink quality, referring domains, and website authority indicators.
* Avoid spammy link schemes, paid-link manipulation, and other high-risk SEO practices.

**6. Analytics and Reporting**

* Use Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, and SEO tools to measure performance.
* Prepare weekly and monthly SEO reports covering rankings, organic traffic, qualified leads, conversions, and technical improvements.
* Track SEO performance by website, department, location, and landing page.
* Maintain an SEO task tracker, implementation roadmap, and accountability system.

**7. Modern Search & AI Visibility**

* Monitor changes in Google Search, AI Overviews, and AI-assisted search experiences.
* Improve content structure, factual accuracy, entity clarity, and discoverability across relevant search experiences.
* Understand structured data, E-E-A-T principles, and the evolving relationship between traditional SEO and AI search.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, IT, or a related field preferred.
* 5–10 years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably with multi-location businesses, healthcare, hospitals, or service-based brands.
* Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, local SEO, and off-page SEO.
* Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, and Google Business Profile.
* Working knowledge of tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or equivalent platforms.
* Familiarity with WordPress and basic HTML/CSS troubleshooting.
* Understanding of schema markup, Core Web Vitals, keyword mapping, content optimisation, and conversion tracking.
* Strong analytical, communication, project-management, and problem-solving skills.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Growth in qualified organic traffic.
* Improvement in rankings for relevant, high-intent keywords.
* Growth in Google Maps and local organic visibility.
* Increase in qualified organic enquiries and tracked conversions.
* Improvement in indexation, technical SEO health, and Core Web Vitals.
* Growth in relevant, high-quality referring domains.

Candidates with experience in hospital SEO, healthcare marketing, multi-location SEO, local lead generation, WordPress website optimisation, and managing multiple websites will be preferred.

description:

We, at TrackoBit, take our work seriously and that last slice of pizza more seriously. We are a bunch of technogeeks with a knack for creativity. The environment at our office is anything but dull.   We are looking for a Content Lead who can run a content engine, not just write well. You will own the content roadmap across all three products, raise the quality of a team of writers, and produce content that business decision-makers trust and that moves pipeline. You will work closely with the Content Manager, product, sales, design and growth teams.

  This is a 12-month contract-to-hire role. It suits someone who wants real ownership from day one and who is confident that their work will speak for itself. Conversion to a permanent role is based on performance and business fit.

  ### **WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

  * **Content strategy and roadmap:** Build and run the editorial calendar across TrackoBit, TrackoField and TrackoMile, tied to audience, search intent and business goals.
  * **Team leadership:** Guide, mentor and review a team of writers. Set the quality bar for tone, structure, accuracy and depth, and get work approved with fewer revision rounds.
  * **High-impact content:** Create and oversee landing pages, long-form blogs, case studies, whitepapers, email copy and product messaging. Where it matters, write the flagship pieces yourself.
  * **Complex tech to clear messaging:** Turn GPS telematics, field workforce automation and delivery logistics into content that a fleet owner, operations head or CXO finds clear and credible.
  * **SEO and performance:** Use keyword research, search intent and analytics (traffic, CTR, engagement, conversions) to decide what to write, what to fix and what to retire.
  * **Content ROI:** Co-own the measurement of what content delivers in leads, pipeline and revenue influence, and report it clearly.
  * **Brand voice:** Keep messaging consistent across all three products and every channel.
  * **Cross-functional partnership:** Work with product, sales, support, design and growth to keep content accurate, on-brand and campaign-ready. Align with the social media team as needed.
  * **Fresh thinking:** Bring in new formats, ideas and smart use of AI tools to increase output without lowering quality.

  ### **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

  * **First 30 days:** Audit existing content, map keyword and messaging gaps, and understand all three products and their buyers.
  * **First 90 days:** A working editorial calendar, a clear review process for the team, and visible gains in content quality and turnaround time.
  * **By month 6 to 12:** Measurable impact on organic traffic, lead quality and content-attributed pipeline, and a team that can deliver without heavy rewrites.

  ### **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

  * 6+ years of B2B content experience (IT/SaaS preferred), with at least 5 years directly relevant
  * At least 2 years of managing or mentoring writers
  * Excellent writing, editing and storytelling skills, with a strong eye for clarity and accuracy
  * Solid grasp of content strategy, SEO and conversion copywriting
  * Comfort with analytics and the ability to link content to business outcomes
  * Ability to work in a fast-moving environment with multiple stakeholders, including senior leadership
  * A portfolio of published work you can walk us through

  **Bonus:** experience in fleet management, field force or logistics domains; hands-on use of AI tools in content workflows; CRM or product marketing content.

  ### **QUALIFICATIONS**

  Graduate in any discipline (English, Journalism, Communications or Marketing preferred).

  ### **LOGISTICS**

  * **Location:** Noida (WFO). Delhi/NCR-based or ready to relocate
  * **Engagement:** Contract-to-hire, 12 months
  * **Notice period:** Immediate to 30 days
  * **Openings:** 1

  * You own content for products used by industry leaders, and your work is read by real buyers
  * You lead a team and shape how content is run, rather than following a set playbook
  * You are measured on outcomes, and strong performance leads to a permanent seat
  * You work in a fast, ambitious marketing team that values content

A **Public Relations (PR) Officer** acts as the voice and ambassador of an organization. Their primary goal is to build, maintain, and protect a positive public image, cultivate good relationships with media and key stakeholders, and manage communication during key announcements or crises.

Content & Communications Strategy

* **Corporate Content:** Draft speeches for executives, company newsletters, annual reports, corporate blogs, and official statements.
* **Brand Storytelling:** Craft compelling brand narratives to highlight product launches, community engagement, and strategic milestones.
* **Social Media & Digital PR:** Collaborate with social media and marketing teams to ensure brand messaging is consistent across digital channels.

Reputation & Crisis Management

* **Crisis Communication:** Develop and execute crisis management plans to handle negative publicity, scandals, or operational emergencies quickly and effectively.
* **Brand Monitoring:** Track news coverage, industry developments, and social media sentiment to proactively address potential reputation risks.

Internal Communications & Events

* Stakeholder EngagementA **Public Relations (PR) Officer** acts as the voice and brand ambassador of an organization. Their primary responsibility is to build, maintain, and manage a positive public image and reputation for the company, client, or institution they represent.

Here is a comprehensive overview of the typical job description, duties, qualifications, and skills for a PR Officer.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONChief Operating Officer (COO) – Garment Manufacturing

**Company Name:** Lyallpur Emporium Pvt. Ltd.  
**Designation:** Chief Operating Officer (COO)  
**Department:** Operations  
**Reporting To:** Managing Director (MD)  
**Location:** Noida, Uttar Pradesh  
**Industry:** Garment Manufacturing – School Uniforms and Retail Apparel

1. JOB PURPOSE

The Chief Operating Officer (COO) will be responsible for overseeing and optimizing the company's overall operations, including garment manufacturing, production planning, merchandising, procurement, inventory management, quality control, warehousing, supply chain, and retail operations.

The role requires a strategic and result-oriented leader who can improve operational efficiency, control costs, ensure timely order execution, strengthen departmental coordination, and achieve the company's production and business objectives.

2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**A. Production & Manufacturing Management**

* Oversee end-to-end garment manufacturing operations, including cutting, stitching, embroidery, finishing, quality checking, packing, and dispatch.
* Develop and implement production plans based on sales forecasts, order requirements, and delivery schedules.
* Ensure achievement of monthly and annual production targets.
* Monitor production capacity, manpower utilization, machine efficiency, and production output.
* Identify production bottlenecks and implement corrective measures to improve productivity.
* Ensure timely completion of bulk orders and maintain production schedules.
* Monitor in-house and outsourced production activities, including job work and contractor performance.
* Establish productivity benchmarks and accountability for production teams.

**B. Merchandising & Order Management**

* Oversee merchandising activities from order confirmation to final dispatch.
* Ensure proper coordination between sales, merchandising, sampling, purchase, and production teams.
* Monitor sampling, product development, approvals, and production readiness.
* Ensure availability of fabrics, trims, accessories, and other materials before production commencement.
* Track order status, delivery commitments, and pending production requirements.
* Ensure timely execution of school uniform orders and other customer requirements.

**C. Supply Chain & Procurement Management**

* Oversee procurement planning for fabrics, accessories, trims, packaging materials, and other production requirements.
* Ensure timely purchase of materials at competitive prices without compromising quality.
* Establish vendor selection, evaluation, and performance monitoring procedures.
* Monitor purchase orders, material receipts, supplier lead times, and pending deliveries.
* Ensure appropriate approval procedures for purchase orders and vendor payments in coordination with the concerned departments.
* Develop reliable vendor and contractor networks.
* Minimize procurement delays and supply chain disruptions.

**D. Inventory & Warehouse Management**

* Oversee raw materials, work-in-progress (WIP), finished goods, and goods-in-transit (GIT) inventory.
* Ensure accurate inventory records and reconciliation between physical stock and system data.
* Implement regular stock audits and investigate shortages, excess stock, and inventory discrepancies.
* Monitor material issuance, returns, transfers, and consumption.
* Establish controls to minimize fabric wastage, material loss, dead stock, and excess inventory.
* Ensure proper documentation of goods receipts, material movements, job work, and dispatches.
* Maintain optimum inventory levels based on production requirements and sales demand.

**E. Quality Control & Compliance**

* Establish quality standards at every stage of garment manufacturing.
* Ensure quality inspections for incoming materials, in-process production, and finished garments.
* Monitor rejection rates, rework, customer complaints, and product defects.
* Implement corrective and preventive actions to reduce quality issues.
* Ensure products meet approved specifications, size charts, fitting requirements, and customer expectations.
* Monitor compliance with applicable factory, labour, safety, and environmental requirements.
* Coordinate with HR, Admin, and relevant specialists to address statutory and operational compliance matters.

**F. Retail Operations & Sales Coordination**

* Oversee operational performance of company-operated uniform retail stores.
* Monitor store-wise sales, stock availability, replenishment, inventory accuracy, and customer service.
* Coordinate with retail, warehouse, merchandising, and production teams to prevent stockouts.
* Review store performance, slow-moving inventory, and seasonal sales requirements.
* Ensure timely replenishment of school uniforms according to seasonal demand.
* Implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) for store operations, stock handling, and reporting.
* Coordinate with the sales and marketing teams to align production and inventory with business demand.

**G. Cost Control & Financial Efficiency**

* Monitor manufacturing costs, material consumption, labour costs, overtime, job-work charges, and operational expenses.
* Identify opportunities to reduce production costs and improve operating margins.
* Monitor wastage, rework, rejection costs, and avoidable operational expenditure.
* Work with Finance and Accounts to prepare operating budgets and review actual expenses against budgets.
* Track departmental costs and implement cost-control measures.
* Evaluate operational investments and recommend initiatives that improve productivity and profitability.

**H. ERP, MIS & Process Automation**

* Ensure effective utilization of the company's ERP/software systems for production, inventory, procurement, and order tracking.
* Establish accurate and timely operational reporting across departments.
* Monitor system data accuracy and ensure that material movements and production transactions are properly recorded.
* Implement standardized workflows for job cards, purchase orders, goods receipts, material issuance, and dispatches.
* Develop dashboards and MIS reports for management review.
* Identify opportunities for automation, process improvement, and better operational control.

**I. Team Leadership & Departmental Coordination**

* Lead and coordinate Production, Merchandising, Purchase, Inventory, Warehouse, Quality, and other assigned operational functions.
* Define departmental goals, key performance indicators (KPIs), and individual accountability.
* Conduct regular performance reviews with department heads.
* Improve coordination between manufacturing, sales, retail, finance, HR, and administration.
* Identify training requirements and strengthen the capabilities of operational teams.
* Build a culture of ownership, discipline, transparency, and continuous improvement.
* Resolve operational escalations and ensure timely completion of assigned responsibilities.

**J. Strategic Planning & Management Reporting**

* Translate the Managing Director's business objectives into actionable operational plans.
* Prepare annual, quarterly, and monthly operating plans.
* Review production performance, order fulfilment, inventory, costs, quality, and departmental productivity.
* Present periodic operational performance reports to the Managing Director.
* Identify operational risks and develop contingency plans.
* Recommend capacity expansion, process improvements, resource allocation, and business efficiency initiatives.
* Drive continuous improvement across manufacturing and retail operations.

3. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

The COO's performance will be evaluated against mutually agreed business targets, including:

* **Production Achievement:** Actual production against approved monthly targets.
* **On-Time Delivery:** Percentage of customer orders dispatched within committed timelines.
* **Production Efficiency:** Output per employee, line efficiency, and capacity utilization.
* **Manufacturing Cost:** Cost per garment against approved standards.
* **Material Utilization:** Fabric and accessory consumption against approved consumption norms.
* **Quality Performance:** Rejection rate, rework percentage, and customer complaints.
* **Inventory Accuracy:** Accuracy of physical stock against ERP records.
* **Inventory Control:** Reduction in excess stock, shortages, dead stock, and unexplained inventory variances.
* **Procurement Efficiency:** Purchase cost, supplier lead time, and material availability.
* **Order Fulfilment:** Timely completion of orders against confirmed requirements.
* **Retail Performance:** Store-wise sales performance, stock availability, and replenishment efficiency.
* **Cost Control:** Achievement of approved operating budgets and reduction in avoidable expenditure.
* **ERP Compliance:** Accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of operational transactions and MIS reporting.
* **Team Performance:** Achievement of departmental targets and timely closure of operational issues.
* **Process Improvement:** Successful implementation of measurable productivity, quality, and cost-saving initiatives.

4. EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS

* Bachelor's degree in Textile Technology, Garment Manufacturing, Apparel Production, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field.
* MBA in Operations, Supply Chain Management, or Business Administration will be an added advantage.

5. EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

* 12–18 years of relevant experience in garment manufacturing, apparel production, or textile operations.
* At least 5 years in a senior leadership position, such as Head of Operations, General Manager – Operations, Plant Head, or COO.
* Experience managing multiple departments and large operational teams.
* Proven experience in production planning, merchandising coordination, procurement, inventory control, quality management, and cost optimization.
* Experience in school uniforms, institutional apparel, or seasonal garment businesses will be preferred.
* Experience managing both in-house manufacturing and outsourced job work will be an advantage.

6. REQUIRED SKILLS & COMPETENCIES

* Strong leadership and people management skills.
* Excellent knowledge of garment manufacturing processes.
* Strong production planning and execution capabilities.
* Expertise in supply chain, procurement, and inventory management.
* Financial understanding and cost-control capabilities.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Experience with ERP systems and operational MIS.
* Excellent coordination, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple departments and meet strict delivery deadlines.
* Strong focus on operational discipline, process improvement, and business profitability.

7. AUTHORITY & ACCOUNTABILITY

The COO will be accountable for operational performance within the authority delegated by the Managing Director.

The role includes:

* Recommending production plans, manpower requirements, and resource allocation.
* Reviewing and monitoring departmental budgets and operating expenses.
* Evaluating supplier, contractor, and departmental performance.
* Recommending process changes and cost-saving initiatives.
* Ensuring adherence to approved SOPs and internal control procedures.
* Escalating significant financial, operational, compliance, and business risks to the Managing Director.
* Ensuring that operational decisions and expenditure remain within approved budgets and delegated authority.

8. EXPECTED OUTCOMES

The successful candidate is expected to:

* Establish a structured and accountable operational system.
* Improve production planning and delivery performance.
* Reduce manufacturing costs, wastage, and rework.
* Strengthen inventory accuracy and material control.
* Improve coordination between manufacturing, merchandising, procurement, warehouse, and retail teams.
* Enhance ERP adoption and operational reporting.
* Improve departmental productivity and accountability.
* Support sustainable business growth and profitability.

Job Title: FP&A Manager (Financial Planning & Analysis)

**Company:** Earth Store  
**Department:** Finance  
**Reports To:** Founder / CEO  
**Experience:** 6–10 years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

About Earth Store

Earth Store is a growing consumer-focused business committed to building a scalable and financially sustainable organization. We believe in ownership, accountability, operational excellence, and data-driven decision-making.

We are looking for a commercially minded FP&A Manager who can turn financial data into actionable business insights, improve profitability, strengthen financial planning, and support strategic decisions.

Role Overview

The FP&A Manager will lead financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and management reporting at Earth Store. The role will work closely with the Founder/CEO and department heads to monitor business performance, identify financial risks and opportunities, and drive profitable growth.

We are looking for someone who goes beyond preparing reports—someone who understands the business behind the numbers and proactively recommends what needs to change.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Planning & Budgeting

* Develop annual budgets, operating plans, and financial forecasts.
* Work with department heads to prepare and consolidate departmental budgets.
* Translate business goals into financial targets and measurable performance indicators.
* Monitor actual financial performance against budgets and identify variances.
* Update forecasts based on changing business conditions and performance trends.

2. Financial Analysis & Profitability

* Analyse revenue, gross margins, contribution margins, operating expenses, and EBITDA.
* Identify the key drivers of profitability and cost inefficiencies.
* Evaluate product, channel, and business-segment profitability.
* Analyse pricing, discounting, product costs, logistics expenses, and marketing expenditure.
* Recommend initiatives to improve margins, reduce costs, and increase operating efficiency.

3. Management Reporting & MIS

* Prepare accurate and timely monthly management reports and financial dashboards.
* Present financial performance, budget variances, risks, and opportunities to the leadership team.
* Develop relevant KPIs to track business and departmental performance.
* Convert financial data into clear, actionable business recommendations.
* Establish consistent reporting formats and performance review mechanisms.

4. Financial Forecasting & Modelling

* Build financial models for revenue, expenses, profitability, and cash flow.
* Develop best-case, base-case, and worst-case scenarios.
* Forecast financial performance and identify potential gaps against business targets.
* Evaluate new product launches, business expansion, and other growth initiatives.
* Conduct break-even, sensitivity, and return-on-investment analyses.

5. Business Partnering

* Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Procurement, Operations, Warehouse, and HR teams.
* Evaluate departmental spending and financial performance.
* Analyse marketing ROI, sales performance, inventory costs, and operational expenses.
* Challenge assumptions and support department heads in making financially sound decisions.
* Drive accountability for budgets and business performance across functions.

6. Working Capital & Cash Flow Analysis

* Prepare cash flow forecasts and monitor projected cash requirements.
* Analyse inventory turnover, stock ageing, receivables, and payables.
* Identify opportunities to improve working capital efficiency.
* Assess the financial impact of inventory purchases, growth plans, and operating decisions.
* Highlight potential liquidity risks and recommend appropriate actions.

7. Strategic Decision Support

* Support the Founder/CEO in financial and commercial decision-making.
* Evaluate new business opportunities and investment proposals.
* Identify financial risks, growth opportunities, and potential profitability improvements.
* Present recommendations backed by financial data and business analysis.
* Support the development of long-term financial plans and growth strategies.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* CA, CMA, MBA Finance, or an equivalent finance qualification preferred.
* 6–10 years of relevant experience in FP&A, financial planning, business finance, or commercial finance.
* Experience in retail, e-commerce, D2C, FMCG, or consumer businesses is preferred.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, profitability, and financial modelling.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
* Experience with financial dashboards and reporting tools; Power BI or similar tools is an advantage.
* Ability to work with large datasets and translate analysis into business recommendations.
* Strong communication, analytical thinking, and stakeholder management skills.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is commercially aware, analytical, proactive, and comfortable working directly with senior leadership.

They should be able to explain why financial performance is changing, identify risks before they become problems, challenge assumptions constructively, and recommend practical actions that improve business outcomes.

We value ownership, problem-solving, attention to detail, and the ability to connect financial numbers with real business decisions.

Why Join Earth Store?

* Work closely with the Founder/CEO and influence business decisions.
* Build and improve financial planning and analysis processes.
* Take ownership of financial insights that directly impact business growth.
* Collaborate with multiple departments and understand the business end to end.
* Be part of a growing organization where initiative and accountability matter.

title: Performance Marketing Specialist
description:
**Job Title:** Performance Marketing Specialist  
**Department:** Digital Marketing

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly analytical, performance-driven, and results-oriented **Performance Marketing Specialist** with strong hands-on expertise in Google Ads and Meta Ads. The ideal candidate will be responsible for evaluating and optimizing our existing advertising campaigns, identifying growth opportunities, improving campaign efficiency, and driving measurable business results.

This role requires a combination of analytical thinking, strategic campaign management, creative experimentation, and practical knowledge of AI-powered marketing tools. The candidate should be comfortable working with campaign data, identifying performance gaps, and translating insights into actionable strategies that improve lead quality, conversion rates, cost efficiency, and return on advertising spend (ROAS).

We are particularly interested in candidates who can leverage AI tools and automation to enhance marketing performance, streamline workflows, and make data-backed decisions.

Key Responsibilities

* **Campaign Management:** Audit, manage, optimise, and scale existing Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns to achieve business and marketing objectives.
* **Performance Optimisation:** Analyse campaign performance metrics, identify inefficiencies, and implement strategies to reduce cost per lead (CPL), improve conversion rates, and maximise ROAS.
* **Lead Quality & Conversion:** Focus on generating high-quality leads with a strong likelihood of converting into customers, rather than optimising solely for lead volume.
* **Audience Targeting:** Develop and refine audience segments, targeting strategies, remarketing campaigns, and customer acquisition initiatives.
* **Data Analysis & Reporting:** Monitor key performance indicators, including CPC, CTR, CPL, conversion rates, and ROAS. Prepare regular performance reports with actionable insights and recommendations.
* **Conversion Tracking:** Implement, monitor, and troubleshoot conversion tracking using relevant tools such as Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and Conversions API, wherever applicable.
* **A/B Testing:** Plan and execute structured experiments across ad creatives, copy, audiences, landing pages, bidding strategies, and campaign structures.
* **AI-Driven Marketing:** Use relevant AI tools to support campaign analysis, audience insights, creative ideation, performance forecasting, and marketing decision-making.
* **Workflow Automation:** Identify opportunities to automate repetitive marketing tasks, reporting, data analysis, and campaign workflows using suitable AI-powered tools and integrations.
* **Creative Collaboration:** Work closely with content and design teams to develop compelling ad creatives, messaging, and campaign variations based on performance insights.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Stay updated with changes in advertising platforms, campaign optimisation techniques, AI marketing developments, and industry best practices.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Proven hands-on experience in managing and optimising Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.
* Strong understanding of paid search, paid social, campaign structures, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and remarketing.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse campaign data and improve CPL, conversion rates, lead quality, and ROAS.
* Practical knowledge of conversion tracking, attribution, analytics, and campaign measurement.
* Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and related performance measurement tools.
* Working knowledge of AI tools for marketing analysis, creative development, testing, and process automation.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to interpret data, identify root causes of underperforming campaigns, and recommend measurable corrective actions.
* Good communication skills and the ability to present campaign performance and optimisation strategies clearly.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience marketing AI-related products, SaaS solutions, technology services, or other digital-first offerings.
* Familiarity with AI-powered marketing platforms, automated reporting, and data-driven campaign optimisation.
* Experience working with lead-generation funnels, landing page optimisation, CRM integrations, and lead tracking.
* A portfolio of successful campaigns demonstrating improvements in lead quality, acquisition costs, conversions, or revenue.

**What Success Looks Like in This Role**

The successful candidate will take ownership of campaign performance and demonstrate measurable improvements through:

* Better utilisation of advertising budgets and reduced acquisition costs.
* Improved lead quality and conversion rates.
* Increased campaign efficiency and return on advertising spend.
* Effective use of AI tools and automation to improve productivity and decision-making.
* Consistent reporting, experimentation, and data-backed optimisation.

**About Minfy:**

Minfy is an applied AI and technology services company helping enterprises and public-sector organizations move from cloud and data foundations to production-scale AI. Across advisory, engineering, implementation and managed operations, Minfy modernizes technology, builds intelligent and agentic applications, unlocks enterprise data and operates mission-critical systems. Founded in 2016, Minfy serves Fortune Global 500 companies, public-sector organizations and high-growth businesses across North America, India and Asia-Pacific.

Our culture is defined by high velocity, ownership, and a 'Think & Execute Big' mindset. Minfy is at a pivotal inflection point—poised for exponential global scale, future growth, and imminent financial milestones, making this an unparalleled opportunity to shape the financial destiny of a true digital disruptor. Minfy’s ambition is to become the trusted partner for making enterprise AI dependable, scalable and operational.

Building on this foundation, Minfy is advancing its position as an Applied AI and platform company, with an active Data & AI pipeline, mature platforms and growing platform-led opportunities. Frontier-model alignment and Forward Deployed Engineering are central to this next phase.

**The Opportunity**

Minfy is seeking a US Marketing Leader to drive its marketing agenda for the United States from Hyderabad. Reporting to the VP – Global Branding, Marketing & Communication, the leader will work exclusively on the US market, partnering closely with US sales, alliances, practice and field teams to execute go-to-market plans and to build Minfy’s brand presence, analyst standing and market recognition with US enterprise and public-sector buyers.

This is a senior leadership role. It combines US market strategy with hands-on execution across GTM enablement, demand generation, partner co-marketing, analyst relations, communications and events, all within the global strategy, positioning and brand standards. The role offers a path to broader regional or global marketing leadership based on demonstrated business outcomes and leadership readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. US Marketing Strategy & Planning: Translate Minfy’s global marketing strategy, positioning and brand standards into an annual and quarterly US marketing plan. Partner with the VP(Marketing) and US business leaders on priorities, budgets and investment allocation, and review performance against agreed US goals.
2. US GTM Execution & Field Enablement: Work hand-in-hand with US sales, alliances and practice teams to execute GTM plans for priority industries, accounts and offerings. Provide messaging, sales plays, pitch materials, battlecards and campaign support so US teams can engage buyers consistently and at pace.
3. US Brand Presence & Positioning: Build awareness and credibility for Minfy as an Applied AI and platform company among US enterprise and public-sector buyers. Adapt global narratives to US buyer priorities, industry context and the competitive landscape, supported by US customer evidence and business outcomes.
4. Analyst Relations & Market Recognition: Own the US-facing analyst relations programme with research and advisory firms such as Gartner, Forrester, IDC, ISG, Everest Group and HFS Research. Plan briefings, inquiries, evaluation submissions and customer references; measure progress in coverage, evaluations, rankings and awards.
5. Hyperscaler & OEM Partner Marketing: Work with alliances and SCA owners to secure US-relevant partner recognitions, awards and co-marketing opportunities with hyperscaler, frontier-model and OEM partners. Turn partner commitments into joint US campaigns, marketplace propositions and events, and govern MDF and partner campaign deliverables within the marketing remit.
6. Demand Generation & Account-Based Marketing: Build an integrated US demand engine spanning account-based marketing for strategic accounts, digital and paid campaigns, content, webinars and marketing automation. Track engagement through sales-accepted opportunities, pipeline and revenue, and improve conversion.
7. Pipeline Accountability: Own agreed targets for US marketing-sourced and influenced qualified pipeline, applying Minfy’s global definitions for sourcing, sales acceptance and attribution. Support opportunity acceleration with US sales and report performance regularly to the VP( Marketing) and US leadership.
8. Platform, Applied AI & FDE Propositions: Work with product, engineering and practice leaders to adapt platform, Applied AI and Forward Deployed Engineering propositions for US buyers. Develop US lighthouse stories, demonstrations, workshops and outcome-led campaigns.
9. Communications, PR & Thought Leadership: Drive US media relations, executive visibility and thought leadership in coordination with global communications. Build US customer case studies, bylines, speaking opportunities and award submissions that strengthen Minfy’s reputation in the market.

description:

**About Minfy:**

Minfy is an applied AI and technology services company helping enterprises and public-sector organizations move from cloud and data foundations to production-scale AI. Across advisory, engineering, implementation and managed operations, Minfy modernizes technology, builds intelligent and agentic applications, unlocks enterprise data and operates mission-critical systems. Our culture is defined by high velocity, ownership, and a 'Think & Execute Big' mindset. Minfy is at a pivotal inflection point—poised for exponential global scale, future growth, and imminent financial milestones, making this an unparalleled opportunity to shape the financial destiny of a true digital disruptor. Minfy’s ambition is to become the trusted partner for making enterprise AI dependable, scalable and operational.

Building on this foundation, Minfy is advancing its position as an Applied AI and platform company, with an active Data & AI pipeline, mature platforms and growing platform-led opportunities. Frontier-model alignment and Forward Deployed Engineering are central to this next phase.

**The Opportunity**

Minfy is seeking a VP – Global Branding, Marketing & Communication to build and lead the function from Hyderabad. Reporting to the CEO, the leader will serve as custodian of global marketing strategy, positioning and brand. The role owns execution across APJ, with full territory responsibility for India, ANZ and Malaysia, and coordinates with US regional field teams to align local programs with global strategy.

The role combines strategic brand building with hands-on execution across demand generation, platform and solution marketing, OEM partnership GTM, analyst relations, executive positioning and marketing operations. title: Senior Technical Consultant -Migration-Marketing Cloud
description:
**Description**
ROLE OVERVIEW
  
  
The Senior Technical Consultant — Marketing Cloud Next is a hands-on delivery specialist responsible for
  
  
executing the build, configuration, data migration and testing workstreams within Marketing Cloud Next
  
  
migration waves. Working under the direction of the Technical Architect and Solution Architect, the STC owns
  
  
specific delivery workstreams end-to-end — including Email Studio configuration, Journey Builder
  
  
implementation, subscriber data migration, AMPscript and SSJS development, Data Cloud data stream
  
  
configuration and automated migration validation tooling. The STC also mentors Technical Consultants on the
  
  
wave team, reviewing their work and ensuring factory quality standards are upheld across all MCN
  
  
deliverables.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Execute Marketing Cloud Next platform configuration — building Email Studio sending domains, IP

configurations, Content Builder templates, Automation Studio programs, Journey Builder flows and
  
  
subscriber data extension schemas as specified in the Technical Architect's solution design.
  
  

* Execute subscriber data migration — running the full data migration lifecycle: data profiling,

transformation scripting, data extension population, suppression list loading, consent record migration
  
  
and bulk data load execution using ETL tools and Salesforce Bulk API.
  
  

* Develop AMPscript and SSJS personalisation — writing dynamic content personalisation scripts for

migrated email templates, recreating legacy segmentation logic, lookup functions and conditional content
  
  
rules in MCN native scripting.
  
  

* Configure Salesforce Data Cloud data streams — setting up data stream ingestion from source

systems, configuring DLO schemas, mapping fields to DMOs and validating data completeness per the
  
  
Data Cloud Architect's design.
  
  

* Migrate and rebuild Journey Builder flows — translating legacy marketing automation workflows,

drip campaigns and triggered sends into Journey Builder — recreating entry sources, decision splits, wait
  
  
steps, send activities and exit criteria.
  
  

* Build migration validation and reconciliation tooling — developing Apex batch utilities, LWC

dashboards and Salesforce Flow automations for subscriber count reconciliation, data extension record
  
  
validation and consent flag verification.
  
  

* Execute and manage dry run cycles — coordinating migration dry runs against SIT/UAT environments,

capturing reconciliation counts, logging validation failures and iterating until dry run success criteria are
  
  
met.
  
  

* Configure sender authentication and deliverability — implementing SPF, DKIM and DMARC DNS

records, private domain configuration, reply mail management and IP warm-up scheduling as directed by
  
  
the TA.
  
  

* Develop and execute unit and system integration tests — writing test scripts for migrated journeys,

data extensions and automations; executing SIT cycles; logging defects; retesting fixes against factory
  
  
quality thresholds.
  
  

* Support go-live cutover execution — following the cutover runbook: executing final subscriber data

loads, activating journeys, validating data extension record counts and confirming suppression lists are
  
  
active.
  
  

* Prepare technical handover documentation — producing configuration workbooks, data mapping

sheets, AMPscript library documentation and journey flow diagrams for client team handover post go-
  
  
live.
  
  

* Mentor Technical Consultants — reviewing TC deliverables for quality, explaining MCN platform

patterns, unblocking technical issues and providing feedback aligned to factory standards.
  
  

* Contribute to the factory accelerator library — after every wave, updating reusable MCN

configuration templates, AMPscript snippet libraries, data migration scripts and validation toolkits in the
  
  
shared accelerator repository.
  
  
**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**

* Marketing Cloud Next — Hands-On Configuration: Proven ability to configure Email Studio, Journey

Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder and Contact Builder end-to-end, including sending domain
  
  
configuration, journey entry sources, decision splits and triggered sends.
  
  

* AMPscript & SSJS Development: Proficiency in AMPscript and SSJS for dynamic email personalisation

— lookup functions, conditional content, row sets, attribute rendering and legacy personalisation logic
  
  
recreation.
  
  

* Subscriber Data Migration Execution: Hands-on experience executing subscriber data migrations —

data extension population, bulk data loading via Import Wizard and API, suppression list management,
  
  
consent record migration and reconciliation validation at scale.
  
  

* Salesforce Data Cloud — Configuration: Working knowledge of Data Cloud data stream setup,

DLO/DMO schema configuration, field mapping and data ingestion validation.
  
  

* ETL Tools & Data Loading: Experience using at least one ETL tool (Informatica Cloud, Talend, Azure

Data Factory, MuleSoft) or scripted Bulk API / REST API approaches for subscriber data extraction,
  
  
transformation and loading.
  
  

* Apex & Platform Development: Ability to write Batch Apex, Schedulable classes, REST callout handlers

and Apex test classes for migration utility development, including subscriber reconciliation tools and
  
  
consent flag verification.
  
  

* Lightning Web Components & Salesforce Flow: Ability to build LWC migration dashboards, subscriber

count trackers and Salesforce Flow automations as internal factory tooling.
  
  

* CI/CD & Source Control: Comfortable working within Salesforce DX and Git-based workflows —

committing changes, following branching conventions, submitting PRs and using Gearset/Copado for
  
  
environment promotion.
  
  
**Preferred Skills — Good To Have**

* Experience migrating from Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot or legacy SFMC Classic to Marketing Cloud

Next
  
  

* Knowledge of Marketing Cloud Intelligence (Datorama) for cross-channel reporting post-migration
* Experience with WhatsApp, Push, SMS or LINE channel configuration in Marketing Cloud Next
* Familiarity with Marketing Cloud REST and SOAP API for programmatic data operations and triggered

sends
  
  

* Understanding of IP warm-up strategy and email deliverability monitoring tools (250ok, Validity/Return

Path)
  
  

* Exposure to Agentforce journeys triggered from Data Cloud activation segments

**Experience Requirements**

* 5–8 years of Salesforce and marketing technology delivery experience
* 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud / Marketing Cloud Next configuration experience
* Experience executing at least 1 end-to-end Marketing Cloud migration or large implementation project as

a key delivery contributor
  
  

* Demonstrated hands-on experience with subscriber data migration — bulk loading, data extension setup,

consent migration and reconciliation validation
  
  

* Experience mentoring junior Technical Consultants on MCN configuration and data migration tasks

SALESFORCE & PLATFORM CERTIFICATIONS

description:

**Good Health Can’t Wait**
.

As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).

‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency

Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. **Job Description**

**Job Summary**
  
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Brand Franchise Manager to ensure successful brand growth for
**Venusia and the launch of innovative, first time in India market-driven products**
in the category for gathering market insights from Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), developing and executing new product launch plans, conducting effective sales force training, and implementing market research strategies for brand performance enhancement. • You will be responsible for brand performance review by gathering market insights, identifying key issues, and implementing action plans to maintain optimal brand performance, including conducting market research for brand positioning correction.

Science/Pharma/Medical Graduate preferably with MBA in Marketing
  
  
  
  
**Minimum work experience-**
3-6 years of experience in Sales & Marketing

• Understanding of Pharmaceutical industry; ability to interpret market data; gain marketing insights from various resources
  
  
• Basic understanding of anatomy and physiology.
  
  
• Ability to analyze market trends, competitor activities, and customer needs within the generics market.
  
  
• Strong problem-solving skills to address regulatory challenges, market access issues, and product-related obstacles.
  
  
**Behavioral Skills:**
  
• Strong collaborator and excellent communication.
  
  
• Good at building and leveraging relationship.
  
  
• Adaptability and change management skills.
  
  
• Creative and good Analytical thinker.

**Additional Information**

**About the Department
  
  
Global Generics India**
  
Global Generics India business journey began in 1986. In the last three decades, we have grown as a trusted name in the healthcare industry and rank as one of the top 10 Pharma Companies in the Indian Pharma Market (IPM) as per IQVIA MAT (November 2022). Our commitment to Lead Ahead has helped us move ranks from 16th position to 10th position (IPM) in the last four years. We are a fast-growing organisation with double-digit growth and significant market share in domestic markets. Currently, we rank among the top 5 in oncology, anti-allergy and gastrointestinal diseases and the top 10 in a few other therapy areas. Our focus is on leveraging our digital capabilities, collaborations, innovations and inorganic opportunities to become the top 5 companies in the Indian Pharma Market.
  
  
  
  
**Benefits Offered**
  
At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.
  
  
The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.
  
  
  
  
**Our Work Culture**
  
Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.

**https://careers.drreddys.com/#!/**

**Minimum Skills**
