title: Marketing Operations Team Lead
description:
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced and versatile Team Lead for GCC Marketing Operations to own and scale the full spectrum of digital marketing execution for our global ecommerce platform. This is a high-impact leadership role within our rapidly expanding Global Capability Center (GCC) in Pune.
  
  
You will lead a multidisciplinary team responsible for CMS and web publishing, email campaigns, social media operations, and publications and content governance. This is not a siloed role. We need a leader who can orchestrate all four workstreams simultaneously, maintain quality across channels, manage stakeholder expectations from Belgium and global markets, and build a team culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  
  
You will be at the centre of building a world-class marketing operations engine.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**CMS & Web Publishing -**
You will own the end-to-end CMS publishing workflow, from intake and briefing through to QA, go-live, and post-launch review. You will ensure 95%+ on-time delivery and maintain a less than 1% post-launch error rate across all published assets. You will design and enforce standard operating procedures for briefing, template use, checklist enforcement, and publishing gates. You must have hands-on experience with our CMS platform (Drupal), ensure all published content meets on-page SEO standards, and verify layouts and functionality on desktop, tablet, and mobile before every go-live.
  
  
**Email Campaign Management -**
You will plan, build, test, and deploy promotional, transactional, and lifecycle email campaigns at scale. You will manage our email marketing platform with hands-on proficiency, design and execute A/B tests on subject lines, creative, and send times to optimise open rates and click-through rates, and ensure accurate audience segmentation, suppression lists, and GDPR compliance. You will monitor open rates, CTR, conversion rates, bounce rates, and unsubscribe rates, and report insights on a weekly basis. You will build and maintain triggered email automation flows including abandoned cart, browse abandonment, post-purchase, and welcome series, and design, maintain, and update responsive email templates aligned with brand guidelines.
  
  
**Social Media Operations -**
You will maintain a social media content calendar aligned with campaign schedules and market events, and use social media management tools to schedule and publish content across key channels. You will localise and adapt global social content for market-specific nuances, languages, and cultural context, and monitor comments and messages, escalating customer service issues to the relevant team. You will track reach, engagement, follower growth, and content performance, and share monthly insights with stakeholders. You will ensure all published content adheres to brand guidelines, legal requirements, and platform policies.
  
  
**Publications & Content Governance -**
You will oversee all marketing assets including images, videos, copy, and templates in our digital asset management system. You will ensure the correct version of every asset is used across all channels and markets, and manage translation workflows, market-specific adaptations, and cultural review processes. You will enforce brand guidelines across CMS, email, social, and printed publications, coordinate go-live dates across all channels to ensure campaign consistency and timing, and ensure all images, fonts, and content used have proper licensing and legal clearance. You will maintain clean, searchable archives of all published content for compliance and re-use.
  
  
**Must-Have**
**Required Experience & Skills**

* You must have 8+ years in digital marketing operations with hands-on experience across at least three of the following: CMS- Drupal, email marketing, social media operations, or content governance. You must have 4+ years leading a multidisciplinary team of 5 or more in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
* You must have 7+ years of hands-on experience with enterprise CMS platform Drupal You must have + years managing email campaigns and automation at scale, with proficiency in at least one major email service provider. You must have 3+ years using social media management platforms such as Hootsuite, Sprout Social, or Meta Business Suite.
* You must have a deep understanding of ecommerce content, campaigns, and customer journey touchpoints. You must have a proven ability to design standard operating procedures, enforce brand compliance, and manage complex publication workflows. You must have experience working with global stakeholders across time zones, with strong communication and negotiation skills. Prior experience in a Global Capability Center or offshore delivery model is required. Conduct CMS audits. Opportunist attitude to advice and consult on the possible solutions, be critical, and proactive solution identifier and provider Content Data analytics(content marketing points - to be read and identified) - nice to have
* You must be fluent in written and spoken English, and be a confident communicator with global leadership.
* Leading the GCC Mkt operation Pro-actively

**Nice-to-Have**

* Basic proficiency in Google Analytics, email performance dashboards, and social media analytics.
* Familiarity with design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, or Canva for creative handoff and review.
* Experience with marketing automation platforms such as Marketo, HubSpot, or Salesforce.
* Experience using AI tools for content generation, proofreading, or workflow automation.
* Experience with Jira, sprint management, and agile delivery frameworks. Ability to work across multiple language markets - French, Dutch, or German is a strong plus.

**Personal Attributes**

* You are an orchestrator, not a specialist. You can juggle four or more workstreams simultaneously without dropping the ball on any of them.
* You have zero tolerance for sloppy work across any channel - CMS, email, social media, or publications.
* You maintain clarity and composure during campaign launches and tight multi-channel deadlines.
* You are a proactive communicator who flags risks early, updates stakeholders without being chased, and closes every loop. You take complete ownership of outcomes. There is no blame-shifting, no excuses, and no surprises. You are genuinely invested in growing your team members, creating career pathways, not just task lists.
* You understand how each channel contributes to revenue, conversion, and customer experience.
* You thrive in a scaling environment and are comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change.
* You handle difficult conversations with maturity and build psychological safety in your team.

**Position Overview:**

As the Director of Sales & Marketing for Coal Washery Process Equipment at John Finlay India Pvt Ltd, you will assume a critical role in driving business expansion through leading sales initiatives, fostering client relationships, and ensuring the successful delivery of coal washery process equipment and services. This position calls for a strategic leader with an in-depth understanding of the coal washery sector, coupled with proven expertise in sales, marketing, and team leadership.

**Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering from a reputable institution.
* 10 - 15 years of sales experience in industries related to coal washery process equipment, such as Cyclones, Centrifuges, Vibrating Screens, Magnetic Separators, DM Baths, and Dry Washing Equipment, with substantial capital investment.
* Proficiency in strategic planning, negotiation, and goal-oriented thinking.
* Demonstrated capability in managing and leading substantial sales teams.
* Familiarity with analytical tools such as Power BI and CRM platforms like Salesforce.
* Experience in collaborating with global organizations.
* Comprehensive knowledge of parts and materials used in Flow Control, Mining, Steel, and allied industries.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with a customer-centric and sales-oriented approach.

**Personal Attributes**
: Strong interpersonal skills, evident in both written and verbal communication. Possesses a sales-driven mindset and excels in collaborative team environments.
  
Exhibits analytical prowess, effectively handling multiple projects concurrently.

**Note:**

This role may involve up to 65-70% travel.
  
John Finlay India Pvt Ltd is committed to considering reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities.

**Job Responsibilities**

Cultivate and nurture a dynamic network of relationships both within and outside client organizations, fostering enduring advisory partnerships and establishing effective communication channels.
  
Employ commercial acumen to develop, implement, and sustain sales strategies for John Finlay India Pvt Ltd's coal washery process equipment, including Cyclones, Centrifuges, Vibrating Screens, Magnetic Separators, DM Baths, and Dry Washing Equipment. This will drive growth and establish market leadership.

Attain comprehensive insights into customer needs and preferences at diverse levels, positioning John Finlay India Pvt Ltd as the preferred vendor and service provider across all accounts.
  
Devise tailored strategies for pivotal clients and accounts, efficiently addressing queries and grievances to ensure customer satisfaction.

Undertake comprehensive market analysis, examining customer business landscapes, market dynamics, and competition, transforming intelligence into actionable insights for strategic advantage.
  
Exhibit fiscal responsibility by leveraging financial data for informed decision-making, promoting cost-effectiveness, profitability, and revenue growth.

Demonstrate awareness of legal implications within the scope of work, ensuring alignment of customer/supplier contracts with John Finlay India Pvt Ltd's product and service standards.
  
Showcase expertise in John Finlay India Pvt Ltd's coal washery process equipment portfolio, supply chain, and product management processes, elevating customer service quality.
  
Champion a robust commitment to health, safety, and environmental practices, integrating HSE principles into daily operational routines.

Engage and understand potential customers to decipher equipment, supply, and service requirements, providing expert guidance on equipment operation and maintenance.
  
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver product training, applications, and technical services, supporting clients effectively.

Develop and oversee sales and service programs, enhancing the market standing of John Finlay India Pvt Ltd's coal washery process equipment lineup, ensuring swift and efficient customer support.
  
Formulate and negotiate sales contracts, project sales forecasts, and actively participate in marketing initiatives to promote coal washery process equipment offerings.

**Benefits**

Why choose John Finlay for your career? Here are some compelling reasons:

**Global Exposure:**
As a multinational company, John Finlay provides you with the opportunity to work on international projects and collaborate with colleagues from around the world.

**Core Member Advantage:**
Joining us during this expansion phase makes you eligible to become a core member, with the added benefits of ESOPs (Employee Stock Ownership Plans) and the chance for onsite visits to our operations in China and Australia.

**Professional Development:**
We believe in nurturing talent. At John Finlay, you'll have access to ongoing training and development programs to enhance your skills and advance your career.

**Innovation Hub:**
Be part of a culture that encourages innovation and creativity. Your ideas can shape the future of the industry.

**Diverse Workforce:**
We embrace diversity and inclusion. Your unique perspective and background are valued assets in our global team.

**Competitive Compensation:**
We offer competitive salary packages and benefits to reward your hard work and dedication.

**Work-Life Balance:**
We understand the importance of work-life balance and offer flexible work arrangements to support your well-being.

**Career Growth:**
John Finlay is committed to promoting from within. Your career path can be as dynamic as our global presence.

Join us on this exciting journey of growth, innovation, and global impact. Your future begins here at John Finlay.

title: Co-Founder
description:
**About Refactyl**

Refactyl is building a safer way to modernise software codebases.

We help developers migrate legacy code to modern frameworks and languages through deterministic transformation rules, AI-assisted changes, real compiler verification and reviewable diffs.

Our vision is to make code modernisation something developers can run, verify and review rather than a risky, manual rewrite.

Explore the product: https://www.refactyl.com

**Why this opportunity exists**

I'm Yash Sharma, the technical founder of Refactyl.

I've been building the product and working on the engineering behind it.

Now I want to find the right person to help turn Refactyl into a real, growing business.

I'm not looking for someone to execute marketing tasks.

I’m looking for an experienced co-founder who can handle marketing, sales, finding customers and growing the business to turn our product into a successful business with real users and paying customers.

**I want us to build the company together.**

**What you'll be responsible for**

* Finding our first users and paying customers.
* Identifying developers, engineering teams and businesses that need code modernisation.
* Conducting customer discovery and understanding why people would or wouldn't use Refactyl.
* Building an acquisition strategy through direct outreach, developer communities, partnerships, technical content, SEO, and other experiments.
* Turning product demonstrations and trials into active users and customers.
* Developing our positioning, messaging, and sales process.
* Measuring what works, learning from rejection, and continuously improving our approach.
* Helping shape the business strategy and long-term direction of Refactyl.

You'll have meaningful ownership over how we take this product to market.

**Who I want to meet**

**I'm looking for someone with real-world experience who has demonstrated the ability to turn a product or business into something people actually use and pay for.**

**This is not an entry-level marketing opportunity or a role for someone looking to learn sales from scratch.**

**I'm looking for a potential co-founder who can bring meaningful experience, independent thinking, and execution to the business.**

**You could be a strong fit if you have:**

* **Demonstrable growth or sales experience:**
  You've acquired customers, generated revenue, built a sales pipeline, grown a product's user base, or helped an early-stage business gain traction.
* **Startup experience:**
  You've worked at an early-stage startup, built your own business or taken a product from an idea to real customers.
* **B2B or SaaS experience:**
  You understand how to identify potential customers, conduct discovery calls, communicate value, and convert interest into adoption or revenue.
* **A track record of execution:**
  You can explain what you personally accomplished, the strategies you used, and the results you achieved.
* **Independent ownership:**
  You can identify opportunities, formulate a plan, execute it and learn from the results without needing constant direction.

Experience with developer tools, technical products, developer communities or selling to engineering teams would be a significant advantage.

You don't necessarily need experience at a famous company or a particular number of years in the industry. What matters is relevant experience, evidence of results, and the ability to apply that experience to an early-stage product.

**Please don't apply solely because you are interested in startups or want to learn marketing.**

I'm looking for someone who can contribute meaningful expertise from the beginning.

**How to apply**

**Please include the following in your application:**

1. **Your background:**
   A brief overview of your relevant professional experience, previous startups or businesses you've built.
2. **Your results:**
   One or two examples of products or businesses you've helped grow, customers you've acquired, revenue you've generated, or sales outcomes you've achieved. Include numbers and timeframes where possible, and clearly explain your personal contribution.
3. **Your approach:**
   How would you identify and acquire Refactyl's first 10 users and first paying customer?
4. **Your availability:**
   How much time can you realistically commit to building Refactyl?
5. **Your motivation:**
   Why do you want to join Refactyl as a co-founder, and what would you bring to the founding team?

Please include your LinkedIn profile and any relevant portfolio, case studies, startup projects, or other evidence of your work.

Applications that only express enthusiasm without demonstrating relevant experience or execution will not be prioritised.

**What I am offering**

* The opportunity to help shape an early-stage software company from the ground up.
* A technical founder focused on building and improving the product.
* Real ownership over growth and go-to-market decisions.
* An equity-based founding partnership, with the structure negotiated transparently.
* The opportunity to build something ambitious together.

**Important transparency**

Refactyl is currently at an early stage and is pre-revenue.

There is no guaranteed salary or upfront cash compensation at this time.

This is a founding partnership opportunity, not a salaried position.

Equity, vesting, responsibilities, commitment and decision-making will be discussed openly before we agree to work together.

I'm looking for someone who understands the risks and genuinely wants to build a business together, not someone being promised quick money or guaranteed success.

I'm looking for a person with initiative, conviction, and the ability to turn ideas into action.

If you're interested in building Refactyl with me, I'd love to hear from you.

title: Director - Data Management
description:
Marsh is seeking a Data Domain Lead to support the strategy, development, and adoption of enterprise data products within an assigned domain. This role will be accountable to turn domain data into trusted, reusable, and business-ready products that support operational processes, analytics, reporting, and AI use cases.
  
  
The ideal candidate will combine strong business acumen with data experience, partnering across business, technology, architecture, governance, and regional teams to support domain priorities, help maintain authoritative business definitions, and contribute to measurable business value. This is a highly cross-functional role that requires a product mindset, strong stakeholder engagement, and the ability to help translate business needs into scalable, governed data solutions.
  
  
**What can you expect?**

* An opportunity to contribute to enterprise data products that support critical business processes and decisions
* Visibility across business, technology, and regional leadership teams
* A highly collaborative role working across architecture, engineering, governance, and operational stakeholders
* The ability to contribute to how data is trusted, reused, and activated across the organization
* An environment focused on business outcomes, measurable value, and enterprise-scale transformation

**What is in it for you?**

* A key contributor role in advancing Marsh's data strategy
* The opportunity to drive real business impact through data product adoption and value realization
* Collaboration with colleagues and cross-functional teams
* Exposure to enterprise architecture, governance, analytics, and AI initiatives
* A culture that values innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement

**We will count on you to:**

* Own the strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for an assigned data domain
* Define domain scope, boundaries, and authoritative business definitions
* Translate business needs into reusable, governed domain data products
* Partner with business sponsors, architects, engineers, and governance teams to deliver domain capabilities
* Support management of the domain backlog, release priorities, and product acceptance criteria
* Ensure the domain supports end-to-end business processes, not just individual systems or datasets
* Lead tracer testing across real business transactions to validate data quality, handoffs, identifiers, and usability
* Drive adoption across operational applications, reporting, analytics, self-service, and AI capabilities
* Establish quality, governance, privacy, and control requirements within the product lifecycle
* Assist in coordinating delivery across global and regional teams, including dependencies, milestones, and risks
* Contribute to measuring domain success through trust, reuse, adoption, and business value
* Escalate unresolved issues related to ownership, quality, capacity, and priorities

**What you need to have:**

* Experience in data products, enterprise data, business data strategy, or product management
* Strong knowledge of business process design and translation of business needs into data requirements
* Experience contributing to delivering data capabilities into production and supporting adoption with business stakeholders
* Working knowledge of data architecture, data modeling, metadata, quality, governance, and integration
* Strong stakeholder collaboration skills across business, technology, operations, and regional teams
* Ability to contribute to cross-functional initiatives without relying solely on direct authority
* Strong prioritization, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex data topics in clear business language
* Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity while driving measurable outcomes

**What makes you stand out?**

* Experience in insurance, risk, benefits, financial services, or another complex regulated industry
* A product-oriented mindset with a strong focus on adoption, value realization, and business outcomes
* Experience balancing enterprise consistency with regional and business-specific requirements
* Demonstrated success in identifying and resolving data handoff, ownership, and quality issues across end-to-end processes
* Familiarity with data activation across analytics, reporting, operational platforms, and AI use cases

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
  
  
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: Lead AI Engagement Specialist
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
QAD | Redzone is building an enterprise AI platform to support AI-enabled and agentic workflows across the organisation. The AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) is accountable for turning that ambition into deployed, measured, production workflows across priority business functions.
  
  
The CoE is small, senior and high-leverage. It combines architecture and engineering with a set of functional AI Engagement Specialists who own the demand side: what gets built, why it is worth building, whether anyone uses it, and whether it actually works once live.
  
  
**Job Description**
The
**Lead AI Engagement Specialist**
owns a portfolio of AI workflows within one or more business functions, end to end. You will identify where AI genuinely changes how the work is done, redesign that work, write the PRD, drive the build with the architect and engineers, land the adoption, and then manage the performance of the agents in production as a product you are accountable for.
  
  
This is a product and transformation role, not a business analysis role. The distinction matters and we mean it: you will own a roadmap, write specifications precise enough to build from, make scope calls, and be measured on realised value rather than on delivered documentation. If a workflow does not clear its quality bar or nobody uses it, that is your problem to solve, not to report.
  
  
**Where this role sits**
**Reports to:**
Head of the AI Centre of Excellence
  
  
**Alignment:**
Dotted line to the leadership of the business function you cover
  
  
**Works with:**
AI Engagement specialists, Lead AI Architect and Senior AI Engineer daily; external implementation partners; Security, GRC, Legal and Data teams as required
  
  
**Owns:**
The prioritised workflow pipeline, PRDs, roadmap, adoption and live agent performance for one function. Lead & manage other AI Engagement specialists.
  
  
**Accountable for:**
Realised, measured business value — not deployment count
  
  
**What You Will Own**
**Opportunity identification and prioritisation**

* Own the AI workflow pipeline for your function — a ranked, evidence-based view of where AI creates value, refreshed as the business and the technology move.
* Distinguish rigorously between work that AI genuinely changes and work that merely looks automatable in a demo — and be willing to argue that a well-sponsored idea is not worth building.
* Prioritise on value, feasibility, data readiness, risk and time to impact, in partnership with the architect.

**Process discovery and workflow redesign**

* Map the current state properly: volumes, cycle times, cost to serve, exception paths, decision points, systems and data touched, and where the work actually breaks — grounded in observation and data, not in what the process document claims.
* Redesign the work, not just the tool. Decide what the agent does, what the human does, where the handoff sits, what the escalation path is, and what changes in roles, policies, SOPs and controls as a consequence.
* Design the human-in-the-loop model with the architect: where review is mandatory, where an agent may act autonomously, and how a wrong action is caught and reversed.

**Business case and value ownership**

* Build the business case: baseline metrics, benefit hypothesis, quantified target, build and run cost, payback and sensitivity — and the honest version of it, including the case against building.
* Establish the baseline before launch. A benefit that cannot be measured against a pre-existing baseline will not be believed, and should not be.
* Own benefits realisation after go-live — report the real number, including when it is below target, and recommend iterate, rebuild or retire accordingly.

**Product specification and roadmap**

* Write the PRD: problem, users, scope and non-scope, target workflow, acceptance criteria, quality bar, data and system dependencies, non-functional expectations, risks, and success metrics — detailed enough that the architect and engineers can design and build from it without a translation layer.
* Own the roadmap for your function: sequencing, dependencies, release planning, and a defensible view of what comes next and why.
* Partner with delivery daily — make scope calls, resolve ambiguity, unblock, test, and accept. Be available to engineers at the pace they work.

**Agent performance management**

* Define the quality bar in measurable terms with engineering — what a correct output is, what an acceptable error rate is, and what failure mode is unacceptable at any rate.
* Build and curate the evaluation datasets for your workflows, drawing on real cases from your function.
* Review live agent output on an ongoing basis and run the feedback loop back into engineering.
* Monitor production performance — accuracy and quality, containment or deflection, escalation rate, latency, cost per transaction, and user satisfaction — and drive the iteration cycle.
* Treat a live agent as a product under active management, not a project that was completed.

**Adoption and change**

* Own adoption as an outcome you are measured on: enablement, training, communications, champions, policy and SOP updates, and management routines.
* Instrument usage and act on what it shows — including the uncomfortable finding that a well-built workflow is being avoided.
* Engage with resistance seriously. Where people are working around the agent, understand why before attempting to change the behaviour.
* Work with function leadership on role definition, capacity and performance expectations as work is redesigned.

**Governance and CoE contribution**

* Ensure workflows meet responsible AI, data handling, privacy and approval requirements, working with Security, GRC and Legal.
* Feed reusable patterns back into the CoE so that a solved problem in one function does not get re-solved from scratch in another.

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years in product management, business or digital transformation, operations strategy, or top-tier consulting — with a track record of change that shipped and stuck, not recommendations that were accepted.
* Demonstrable ownership of product specifications or PRDs that engineering teams built from. We will ask to discuss one in detail.
* Strong process redesign capability. Lean, Six Sigma, service design or similar training is welcome; evidence of redesigned work in production matters more than certification.
* Business case and value modelling — comfort with baselines, unit economics, cost to serve and payback, and the intellectual honesty to model the downside.
* Data literacy: able to interrogate data, work with BI tooling, and define and track metrics that hold up to scrutiny.
* Working fluency in what current AI systems can and cannot do — retrieval, agents, hallucination and grounding, evaluation, human-in-the-loop, and cost. Enough to scope realistically with engineers and to push back on hype and on pessimism with equal confidence. Coding is not required.
* Change management and adoption experience with real end users, including users who did not ask for the change.
* Strong influence at senior levels without formal authority, and the standing to tell a function leader that their favourite idea is not the right first build.
* Excellent written communication — clear specifications, clear reasoning, clear status.
* Deep functional expertise in the business function this opening covers — the specific requirements are set out under “Functional depth” below.

**Functional depth**
This role requires credibility with practitioners and leaders inside the function from the first week. We are looking for someone who understands how the work is genuinely done — its operating rhythm, its systems, its economics and its performance measures — well enough to challenge how it is done today rather than to describe it.
  
  
**Strongly Preferred**

* Enterprise B2B SaaS experience.
* Manufacturing, supply chain or ERP domain knowledge.
* Having deployed AI or automation into production and lived with the results — including a deployment that underperformed and what you did about it.
* Experience operating across multiple regions and time zones.
* Experience working alongside system integrators or external delivery partners.

**What This Role Is Not**

* Not a process documentation role. Mapping is an input; redesigned, adopted, measured work is the output.
* Not a change communications role. You own the product, not the announcement.
* Not a requirements-gathering role. You will not hand a wish list to engineering and wait; you will specify, decide and stay accountable through production.
* Not a role that ends at go-live. Managing agent performance afterwards is a permanent part of the job.

**What Success Looks Like**
**First 3 months**

* A credible, ranked workflow pipeline for your functions, grounded in real process data and endorsed by function leadership.
* The first one or two PRDs written and accepted into build by the architect and engineering without a translation gap.
* Baselines established for the metrics your first workflows will move.

**First 6 months**

* First workflows live in production, with adoption instrumented and quality actively monitored.
* A functioning feedback loop between live agent performance and the engineering backlog.
* A 12-month roadmap for your function that leadership has signed up to.

**First 12 months**

* Measured, defensible business value delivered against pre-established baselines — reported honestly, including where the result fell short.
* Adoption at a level where the redesigned workflow is the normal way the work is done, not an optional tool.
* At least one reusable pattern contributed to the CoE and adopted by another function.
* A function that is materially more capable of absorbing the next wave than it was when you joined.

**How We Assess**

* Portfolio conversation — a transformation or product initiative you owned end to end, including the value actually realised versus the value forecast.
* Written exercise — a short PRD or workflow redesign on a realistic problem from your function.
* Working session with the AI CoE on scoping and quality definition for a live QAD workflow.
* Stakeholder interview with leadership from the function you would cover.

**Additional Information**

* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

**About QAD**
QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.
  
  
QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.
  
  
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

description:

**Location**

**Job Summary**

The Water Domain Business Lead is responsible for building and growing strategic client relationships across the water and wastewater utilities sector. The role combines domain leadership, consultative business development, account planning, solution shaping, and ecosystem collaboration to create qualified demand and convert opportunities into sustainable revenue. The position acts as a trusted business advisor to clients, connects business priorities with TCS capabilities, and orchestrates cross-functional teams to deliver differentiated, outcome-led propositions.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Achieves Revenue & Pipeline Targets through Demand Creation**

* Identify and develop demand across water and wastewater utilities by connecting client priorities with relevant TCS capabilities, industry solutions, digital engineering, IoT, data, cloud, asset management, operational technology, and transformation services.
* Build and maintain a healthy, qualified opportunity pipeline through executive conversations, account workshops, industry insights, targeted campaigns, partner propositions, and proactive solution concepts.
* Lead opportunity origination and early-stage qualification, establish business value, define the buying context, and shape a clear path from client need to funded initiative.
* Work with sales, accounts, consulting, delivery, solution, and partner teams to improve conversion from lead to qualified opportunity and from opportunity to closure.
* Monitor the pipeline for value, probability, ageing, competitive position, decision milestones, and dependencies, and initiate timely recovery actions where required.

**2 Ownership of Targets**

* Own agreed revenue, order-book, pipeline, and demand-generation targets for the water domain, with clear accountability for performance and forecast accuracy.
* Translate annual business objectives into account-level and solution-level pursuits, measurable milestones, and disciplined execution plans.
* Maintain visibility of target attainment, risks, gaps, and corrective actions, and provide evidence-based updates to leadership.
* Balance short-term pursuit conversion with medium-term pipeline development and long-term strategic account growth.

**3 Positions TCS as Business Advisor**

* Develop a strong understanding of each client’s business strategy, operational challenges, regulatory context, investment priorities, technology landscape, and transformation agenda.
* Engage client executives and business leaders with a point of view on sector trends, operational resilience, customer and environmental outcomes, asset performance, data-led decision-making, and digital transformation.
* Create client-specific value propositions, business cases, roadmaps, maturity assessments, and executive narratives that clearly link TCS capabilities to measurable business outcomes.
* Bring relevant TCS experience, reusable assets, alliances, and cross-industry innovation into client discussions without presenting generic or technology-led propositions.
* Build credibility through domain depth, commercial awareness, structured problem solving, and consistent follow-through.

**4 Alliance Led Growth**

* Define and execute alliance-led growth strategies for the water domain by aligning TCS capabilities with complementary technology, engineering, platform, and industry-partner offerings.
* Identify priority alliance partners and jointly develop differentiated propositions, market plays, account-entry strategies, and repeatable solution patterns for water and wastewater utilities.
* Create joint go-to-market plans covering target clients, demand-generation campaigns, executive engagement, workshops, demonstrations, thought leadership, and industry events.
* Work with alliance, sales, consulting, solution, and delivery teams to originate and qualify partner-influenced opportunities and establish clear ownership across the pursuit lifecycle.
* Develop joint value propositions and business cases that define the client outcome, combined capabilities, delivery responsibilities, commercial model, and competitive differentiation.
* Maintain governance for alliance pursuits, including opportunity tracking, pipeline contribution, partner commitments, solution dependencies, risks, and agreed next actions.
* Strengthen partner relationships through regular business reviews, shared account planning, solution enablement, credential development, and structured knowledge exchange.

**5 Collaboration & Networking**

* Create effective virtual teams across sales, account management, consulting, delivery, engineering, industry units, centers of excellence, alliances, and marketing.
* Build a strong internal network to mobilize the right subject-matter experts, credentials, accelerators, and leadership sponsorship for each opportunity.
* Develop relationships with technology and industry partners to shape complementary propositions and strengthen market access.
* Encourage knowledge sharing across geographies and accounts, including reuse of proven case studies, solution patterns, lessons learned, and proposal content.
* Represent the water domain in relevant client forums, internal communities, industry events, and partner engagements.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in engineering, technology, environmental sciences, business, or a related discipline.

A postgraduate qualification in business, management, utilities, or a related field is desirable.

**Experience**

* 10+ experience in the water and wastewater utilities sector, with a strong understanding of utility business, operational, asset, customer, environmental, and regulatory priorities.
* Proven experience in business development, consulting, client relationship management, account growth, solution shaping, or strategic sales in a complex B2B environment with $20M+ target achievement.
* Demonstrated ability to originate and qualify opportunities, influence senior stakeholders, coordinate multi-disciplinary teams, and support complex pursuits through closure.
* Experience developing client-specific propositions, business cases, account plans, executive presentations, and proposal responses.
* Experience working across geographies and with distributed teams, alliance partners, and delivery organizations is desirable.

**Technical Skills**

* Water and wastewater utility domain knowledge, including core business processes and the operating context of asset-intensive utilities.
* Working knowledge of digital utility capabilities such as operational technology and IT convergence, SCADA and telemetry, IoT, data platforms, analytics and AI, GIS, asset management, digital twins, cloud, and cyber security.
* Ability to translate technical capabilities into business outcomes, value drivers, implementation roadmaps, and differentiated propositions.
* Strong capability in opportunity qualification, pipeline management, forecasting, account planning, commercial awareness, and proposal governance.
* Proficiency in creating executive-ready presentations, structured documents, business cases, and management reports.
* Soft Skills
* Executive presence and the ability to communicate credibly with business, operational, and technology stakeholders.
* Consultative listening, structured problem solving, commercial judgement, and a strong client-outcome orientation.
* Influencing and negotiation skills, with the ability to align stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Collaboration, cultural awareness, adaptability, resilience, and disciplined follow-through.
* High standards of integrity, confidentiality, accountability, and attention to detail.

**Measures of Success**

* Achievement of agreed revenue, order-book, qualified-pipeline, and demand-creation outcomes.
* Quality, coverage, progression, and forecast accuracy of the water-domain opportunity pipeline.
* Growth in strategic client relationships, executive access, and TCS participation in priority transformation initiatives.
* Conversion of differentiated propositions into qualified pursuits and successful outcomes.
* Effectiveness of cross-functional collaboration, governance adherence, and leadership reporting.
* Contribution to reusable water-domain assets, thought leadership, partner propositions, and team capability.

FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
  
  
Our Company
  
  
FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
  
  
Our Philosophy
  
  
The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.
  
  
Our Culture
  
  
Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

title: Sales And Marketing Intern
description:
**About Internship**

We are an early-stage startup building a business from scratch, and we are looking for an intern to work on sales and marketing. This internship is for job seekers who have completed their studies and are ready to work full-time. It is not open to students. Interns who perform well will be offered a full-time role with us.

This is not a desk internship with a fixed routine. You will work directly with the founder, see how a business is built from the ground up, and take on real responsibility from your first week. If you want exposure, learning, and hands-on experience more than anything else, read on.

**What you will do**

**Sales**

• Find and reach out to potential customers by phone, WhatsApp, and in-person visits.

• Follow up on leads, explain our products, and close orders.

• Build and maintain relationships with customers, dealers and partners.

**Marketing**

• Plan and post content on our social media channels.

• Support online campaigns, promotions and local marketing activities.

• Collect customer feedback and market insights from the field.

**Supporting tasks**

• Coordinate orders, deliveries and vendors.

• Keep sales, stock and customer records up to date in Excel or Google Sheets.

• Prepare simple reports and presentations for the founder.

• Take on whatever the business needs that week; in a startup, everyone does a bit of everything.

**Who we are looking for**

**Must have**

• Real passion and enthusiasm for business: you enjoy selling, talking to people and figuring out how things work.

• Fluent in Tamil and English (spoken).

• Basic computer skills: Excel, Word and PowerPoint.

• Your own laptop, mobile phone, and two-wheeler (with a valid driving licence).

• Willing to travel for customer visits, market visits, and events.

**Good to have**

• Hindi.

• Any attempt at entrepreneurship: a small business, freelancing, reselling, or running a social media channel or page. Tell us about it, even if it didn't work out.

• Any sales, marketing or customer-facing experience, from a previous job, a business, or freelance work.

• Living in or near Vandalur, Chennai.

**Internship Details**

* Stipend (during internship): ₹5,000 per month
* Duration: 1 Month
* After the internship: Full-time role for selected interns
* Working days: 4 days a week: 3 weekdays + 1 weekend day
* Work mode: Hybrid; come to the office when required
* Location: Office near Vandalur, Chennai, plus field travel
* You bring: Your own laptop, mobile phone, and two-wheeler

**Please read before applying**

**If your priority is salary and convenience, this internship is not for you, and we request you not to apply.**

We are looking for someone whose first priority is exposure, learning, and experience. You will learn how a business is built from scratch, through sales and marketing, faster than in most jobs. In return, we expect ownership, flexibility, and the drive to make things happen. Interns who show this will continue with us full-time.

About the Role

We are looking for a

**creating and publishing the content independently**
.

The ideal candidate should be someone who can come up with ideas, write the copy, create basic creatives/videos/reels, identify trends and execute content without constantly depending on a designer, content writer or video editor.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and execute social media strategies aligned with business and marketing objectives.

  **Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube and X**
  .

  , including:
* Social media posts
* Carousels
* Reels and short-form videos
* Stories
* Campaign creatives
* Captions and copy
* Hooks and CTAs
* Employer branding content
* **Be capable of creating content independently without depending on a dedicated designer, content writer or video editor for every post.**
* Use tools such as
  **Canva, CapCut and AI-powered content creation tools**
  to create and edit content.
* Research trends, competitors, hashtags, audience behaviour and emerging content formats.

* Build and engage the online community through comments, messages and relevant interactions.
* Track social media performance and analyse reach, engagement, follower growth and conversions.
* Prepare regular social media performance reports and recommend improvements.
* Continuously experiment with new content formats and strategies to improve organic reach and engagement.
* Collaborate with internal teams to gather information and convert business/technical topics into engaging social media content.
* Support employer branding and recruitment marketing initiatives.
* Plan and execute social media campaigns for company events, announcements, product launches and other initiatives.

Candidate Requirements

* **2–3 years of hands-on experience**
  in Social Media Management, Social Media Strategy or Digital Marketing.
* Strong understanding of Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube and other relevant platforms.
* **Strong content creation skills — the candidate must be able to create content independently.**
* Good knowledge of Canva and basic video editing tools such as CapCut or similar.
* Ability to write engaging captions, hooks, headlines and CTAs.
* Strong creative thinking and storytelling ability.
* Good understanding of social media analytics and performance metrics.
* Ability to identify trends and turn them into relevant content quickly.
* Strong communication and copywriting skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of the complete social media function.
* Ability to manage multiple content requirements and meet deadlines.

Must-Have

**This is a hands-on role. Candidates should be comfortable creating content themselves rather than only planning or delegating content creation.**

The candidate should be able to:

**Think → Ideate → Create → Edit → Publish → Analyse → Improve**

Candidates who only have experience in
**content planning/coordination**
and depend entirely on designers or content writers for execution may not be suitable for this role.

Good to Have

* Experience in B2B / IT / Technology / Startup environments.
* Experience managing LinkedIn pages and employer branding.
* Basic understanding of Meta Ads and LinkedIn Ads.
* Experience creating Reels/short-form videos.
* Experience using AI tools for content creation.
* Understanding of SEO and digital marketing.
* Experience creating content around technology, workplace culture or employer branding.

Key Performance Indicators

* Social media reach and engagement
* Organic follower/community growth
* Content quality and consistency
* Reels/video performance
* Lead generation and conversions
* Employer brand visibility
* Campaign performance
* Ability to consistently produce and publish content independently

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is
**not just a Social Media Manager, but a creator + strategist**
.

Someone who can take a requirement like
*“We need to promote this event”*
and independently turn it into:

**Idea → Content Concept → Copy → Creative/Video → Caption → Publishing → Performance Analysis.**

You should be comfortable getting your hands dirty and creating the content yourself —
**not waiting for someone else to create it for you.**

**What you'll do**

* Develop crisp product positioning and value-driven messaging that differentiates Freshworks solutions in the customer service market.
* Frame technical capabilities into clear, compelling narratives tailored to buyer personas, CX leaders, and executives.
* Lead cross-functional product launches in close collaboration with Product Management, Sales, Marketing, and Enablement teams.

* Develop, scale, and maintain actionable competitive enablement assets, including battlecards, competitive matrices, demos, FAQs, displacement pitch decks, and win/loss analysis. Serve as an SME on direct sales calls, executive briefing centers, and competitive deal desks.

* Partner with Product Management to feed real-time competitive gap insights back into the product roadmap.

* Partner with Demand Generation, Lifecycle Marketing teams, and other PMMs to inject product and competitive positioning into field campaigns, web, content, webinars, and any customer-facing collateral and campaigns.
* Integrate modern AI tools into daily marketing workflows to automate content creation, market research, competitive intelligence, and win/loss data analysis, thereby accelerating output and asset development.

title: Senior Vice President - Entertainment PRS, South Regionals
description:
**Job Summary**
The Senior Vice President – Product & Revenue Strategy (PRS), South will be responsible for defining and driving the overall revenue growth and monetisation strategy for the South region. The role will shape the regional commercial strategy by identifying growth opportunities, strengthening pricing and yield realisation, developing new revenue streams, and maximising the monetisation potential of South-led content and marquee properties.
  
  
As a strategic leader you will translate regional market dynamics, advertiser needs, content investments and competitive trends into differentiated commercial strategies that drive sustainable revenue growth. The role will lead the development of innovative advertising products, formats and go-to-market strategies for the South market, while shaping the future monetisation of South properties.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Market Strategy & Revenue Leadership
* Define and drive the overall PRS strategy for the South market across all regional channels, aligned with business priorities and revenue objectives.
* Own the annual revenue and yield strategy, including bottom-up planning, forecasting, pricing and inventory optimisation across channels, time bands and properties.
* Translate market trends, competitive dynamics, content performance and advertiser demand into actionable revenue strategies.
* Identify new growth opportunities across genres, categories, advertisers and emerging content properties to expand monetisation potential.
* Establish performance metrics and review mechanisms to track revenue delivery, identify gaps and drive corrective actions.
* Pricing, Planning & Supply Strategy
* Own pricing decisions for the South linear portfolio, including rate cards, time-band pricing, show-level pricing, sponsorship packages and commercial frameworks.
* Develop pricing and inventory strategies based on demand-supply dynamics, audience delivery, competitive benchmarks and advertiser requirements.
* Drive revenue and yield optimisation across channels, ensuring effective utilisation of available inventory and maximisation of commercial value.
* Provide strategic inputs on pricing and monetisation for high-impact South properties on JioHotstar, with scope to expand into digital monetisation as the business evolves.
* Lead deal strategy for key clients and strategic accounts, providing commercial inputs and approvals for complex or high-value opportunities.
* Ad Product Innovation & Monetisation
* Create and scale innovative linear ad products and formats that address evolving advertiser needs and unlock incremental revenue streams.
* Partner with Sales and Programming to develop differentiated commercial solutions around content, audience engagement and marquee properties.
* Drive monetisation strategies for high-impact shows, tentpole events and regional content franchises through sponsorships, integrations and customised advertiser solutions.
* Identify opportunities to build new properties and monetisation models that strengthen the South portfolio and improve revenue potential.
* Evaluate the commercial viability and performance of new ad products and formats, refining offerings based on market response and revenue outcomes.
* Go-to-Market Strategy & Media Consulting
* Lead the go-to-market strategy and rollout of new South properties, ad products and commercial initiatives.
* Equip Sales teams with pricing frameworks, client propositions, market insights and customised pitches to accelerate adoption and revenue delivery.
* Drive media consulting by translating audience, content and category insights into effective advertising solutions for clients and agencies.
* Build advertiser and category-level strategies using market intelligence, competitive analysis and buying patterns to identify opportunities for increased share of wallet.
* Lead business reviews and market-facing initiatives to communicate the value proposition of South channels and properties to advertisers.
* Programming & Sales Partnership
* Act as the key interface between Programming and Sales, ensuring alignment between content strategy, commercial priorities and market demand.
* Partner with Programming teams on the content calendar, FPC, upcoming shows and new properties to identify monetisation opportunities early.
* Provide market and advertiser feedback to influence property packaging, programming decisions and commercial planning.
* Work closely with Sales leadership to align revenue priorities, develop client-specific solutions and support negotiations for strategic deals.
* Collaborate with Ad Operations and other relevant teams to ensure seamless delivery of commercial commitments and optimal inventory utilisation.
* Market Intelligence & Competitive Benchmarking
* Build a strong understanding of South market dynamics, including regional advertiser behaviour, category trends, competitive pricing and content consumption patterns.
* Leverage BARC data, industry reports, client buying patterns and competitive intelligence to inform pricing and monetisation decisions.
* Monitor changes in demand, supply and audience performance to proactively adjust commercial strategies.
* Develop insights on advertiser investment across genres, channels, properties and competing media platforms to identify growth opportunities.
* Lead periodic business reviews and present actionable recommendations to senior business stakeholders.
* Stakeholder Management & Leadership
* Build strong partnerships with Sales, Programming, Finance, Ad Operations and other cross-functional teams to drive shared business outcomes.
* Influence senior stakeholders through data-backed recommendations, commercial insights and clear articulation of revenue opportunities and risks.
* Lead and develop the PRS team for the South market, establishing clear priorities, accountability and a culture of data-led decision-making.
* Drive alignment on pricing policies, monetisation priorities and go-to-market execution across the South portfolio.
* Ensure effective governance of pricing decisions, revenue forecasts, inventory planning and commercial performance.
* Financial Accountability / Commercial Impact
* Own revenue and yield performance for the South region in partnership with Sales leadership.
* Drive achievement of annual, quarterly and monthly revenue plans through effective pricing, planning, supply and monetisation strategies.
* Maximise revenue from channels, time bands, shows, sponsorships and high-impact properties.
* Deliver incremental revenue through new ad products, innovative formats, differentiated packages and improved inventory utilisation.
* Identify revenue risks and opportunities early, driving timely course correction and ensuring commercial plans remain aligned with business objectives.

**Key Skills & Experience**

* Masters in Business Management or related field from a reputed institute with at least 18 years of experience in media, broadcasting, entertainment, advertising with strong understanding of the South Indian media and advertising ecosystem.
* Demonstrated expertise in pricing, revenue strategy, inventory planning, yield optimisation and monetisation across linear television.
* Strong understanding of advertising products, sponsorships, branded integrations, innovative ad formats and property-led monetisation.
* Experience partnering with Sales and Programming teams to translate content and market opportunities into commercial outcomes.
* Proven ability to lead go-to-market initiatives, develop new revenue opportunities and influence senior stakeholders.
* Strong commercial acumen, analytical capability, market orientation and data-led problem-solving skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, negotiation and leadership capabilities.
* Strong people management experience, with a track record of building and leading high-performing teams.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities and drive outcomes across a complex, cross-functional environment.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and operational rigour.

title: I&P-GN - SONG-MT-DSMS-Customer Lifecycle Campaign- Retail-Manager
description:
**Job Summary:**

The I&P Global Network Song practice works with clients across their marketing, sales and services functions, providing transformation services driven by key offerings like Living Marketing, Connected Commerce and Next-Generation Customer Care. You will own customer lifecycle engagement and campaign transformation workstreams for clients across Retail, Financial Services, Software & Platforms, and Life Sciences. This is a workstream ownership role: you carry the client relationship for your track, lead a team of consultants, and are accountable for the commercial outcomes of the campaigns and journeys you design. You translate growth, retention and loyalty ambitions into segmented, decisioning-driven lifecycle interventions and prove the value they create.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* **Customer Lifecycle Strategy:**
* Own the end-to-end customer lifecycle framework - acquisition, onboarding, activation, engagement, cross-sell, upsell, retention, loyalty, renewal and win-back.
* Define customer segmentation and treatment strategies across lifecycle stage, value tier, behavioural profile, propensity, risk and engagement level.
* Own the campaign calendar and prioritisation across a complex, multi-channel environment, balancing commercial objectives, customer relevance, contact policy and regulatory requirements.
* **Next Best Action & Personalisation:**
* Translate business objectives into Next Best Action and Next Best Offer strategies - eligibility, suitability, applicability and prioritisation logic.
* Work with decisioning, data and martech teams to define engagement policies, arbitration rules, contact policy and suppression frameworks.
* Drive the shift from batch campaign execution to trigger-based, event-driven, real-time and always-on engagement.
* **Industry-Specific Growth & Retention Programmes:**
* Retail: Design lifecycle programmes that drive repeat purchase, purchase frequency, basket growth, loyalty participation, category expansion, omnichannel conversion and customer retention.
* Financial Services: Design onboarding, activation, product adoption, cross-sell, wallet-share, servicing, retention and lifetime-value programmes while accounting for consent, suitability and regulatory controls.
* Software & Platforms: Drive onboarding completion, feature adoption, free-to-paid conversion, usage expansion, subscription renewal, churn prevention and reactivation across user and account lifecycles.
* Life Sciences: Shape compliant HCP and patient engagement journeys, including HCP education, patient support programme enrolment, adherence, persistence and omnichannel engagement, in partnership with medical, legal and regulatory stakeholders.
* **Journey & Channel Orchestration:**
* Design omnichannel journeys across email, SMS, mobile app, push notifications, web, ecommerce, digital media, contact centre, sales and assisted channels.
* Translate customer behaviours, transactions and business events into automated lifecycle journeys and timely interventions.
* Optimise channel mix, cadence, content relevance and customer experience across touchpoints.

Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection*.*

At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.* *If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at* *recruitingindia@cvent.com**.* *For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.* *https://www.cvent.com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud**.*

title: Senior Manager/ Associate Director - Revenue | Kolkata
description:
As a Senior Manager/Associate Director - Revenue within our autonomous, geography-focused business unit, you will serve as a primary engine of execution and revenue generation. We do not look for traditional executors; we seek
**Growth Architects**
—professionals who view regional business, platform operations, and marketing through the lens of data, engineering, and first-principles thinking.
  
  
Operating within a fast-paced, high-velocity pod, you will collaborate cross-functionally to manage localized funnels, scale performance metrics, and optimize platform health to hit aggressive top-line and bottom-line targets.
  
  
**Purpose of the Role**
To deliver robust top-line growth and bottom-line margins through disciplined platform execution, targeted audience engagement, data-driven optimization, and tight cross-functional coordination. You will treat your functional domain as a system to be architected, tested, and scaled.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* First-Principles Growth & Execution
* Deconstruct complex performance funnels into measurable variables, managing full-funnel activation from new user acquisition to repeat engagement.
* Plan, execute, and scale on-app propositions, digital marketing campaigns, and sale event constructs end-to-end with absolute precision.
* Optimize live performance daily, utilizing conversion, traffic, and margin signals to make real-time programmatic adjustments.
* Commercial, Pricing & P&L Alignment
* Monitor performance metrics and financial margins across various categories to ensure regional growth is both competitive and accretive to the P&L.
* Liaise with central product, brand, and buying teams to negotiate optimal commercial terms, funding constructs, and localized SKU assortments.
* Strategically promote high-margin initiatives or products to systematically elevate the overall geography contribution profile.
* Data Modeling, Analytics & Platform Health
* Own end-to-end tracking of critical performance trends, identifying user cohort trends and operational gaps.
* Translate localized consumer and market analytics into actionable assortment, campaign targeting, and activation decisions.
* Maintain a strict focus on system stability, aggressively flagging and fixing operational gaps, pricing mismatches, or delivery supply risks.
* Experimentation & Supply Operations
* Design and execute high-velocity A/B tests or activation changes with statistical rigor, ensuring every modification is heavily data-backed.
* Coordinate meticulously with supply chain and internal teams to establish complete sync between live demand triggers and asset availability.
* Manage a structured activation and marketing calendar that flows seamlessly alongside macro events and business priorities.

**What We Are Looking For**
**Academic Pedigree**

* B.Tech / B.E. from IIT or other Tier-1 engineering institutes, or an equivalent heavily quantitative/analytical background.

**Experience & Competencies**

* Experience:4–8 years of professional experience in high-growth environments like e-commerce, quick commerce, consumer-tech, or data/business analytics.
* The Engineer Mindset:Intensely logical and structured. You possess a natural curiosity to understand the "under-the-hood" mechanics of any platform, funnel, or user cohort.
* Technical Savvy:Highly proficient in Excel/Google Sheets with exposure to SQL, BI data visualization tools (Tableau/Looker), or automation workflows.
* Cross-Functional Fluency:Demonstrated comfort and maturity in driving cross-functional alignments with brand, supply chain, and central product environments.
* Ownership & Grit:You have the zeal to build robust processes from absolute zero and the execution resilience required to thrive in a high-velocity, concurrent work environment.

**Good to Have**

* Prior regional, hyperlocal, or category management experience within quick commerce, marketplace, or hyper-growth consumer apps.
* Familiarity with app CMS platforms, digital promotion engines, or inventory optimization systems.

**The Perks**

* Direct Impact:You aren’t just running campaigns or updating a dashboard; you are actively engineering the growth engine of an autonomous business unit.
* Intellectual Autonomy:We foster a high-trust, fast-paced environment where hierarchy takes a backseat—data and logical arguments always win.

**About Company**
Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
  
  
Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.
  
  
What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.
  
  
In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.
  
  
With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.
