**About the Role**

Vanmoh is expanding its financial services portfolio with a focus on providing customers with accessible and structured
**credit and lending solutions**
.

We are looking for an experienced
**Manager – Credit Solutions**
to manage and grow the credit solutions function, covering customer acquisition, loan processing, credit assessment coordination, documentation, disbursement and portfolio follow-up.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of lending processes, credit operations and customer relationship management, with the ability to balance
**business growth with credit quality and risk discipline**
.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Credit Business Development**

* Drive growth of Vanmoh’s credit solutions business.
* Identify and develop new customer acquisition channels.
* Build relationships with customers, channel partners, DSAs, agents and other business partners.
* Achieve monthly and quarterly business targets.
* Develop strategies to increase loan enquiries, applications and disbursements.

**2. Loan & Credit Processing**

* Manage the complete credit processing cycle from application to disbursement.
* Verify customer applications and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate collection and verification of KYC, income and other required documents.
* Ensure applications are processed accurately and within defined turnaround times.
* Coordinate with credit, operations, legal and documentation teams.

**3. Credit Assessment Coordination**

* Conduct preliminary assessment of customer applications.
* Review customer financial information, repayment capacity and credit history.
* Identify potential credit risks and escalate cases requiring detailed assessment.
* Coordinate with the credit/risk team for final underwriting and approval.
* Ensure lending decisions are supported by complete and accurate documentation.

**4. Customer & Partner Management**

* Maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers.
* Understand customer financial requirements and recommend appropriate credit solutions.
* Manage channel partners and referral sources.
* Ensure transparent communication regarding eligibility, documentation, pricing, repayment and other terms.
* Handle customer queries and coordinate resolution of service issues.

**5. Disbursement & Operations**

* Coordinate approved cases through documentation and disbursement.
* Ensure all pre-disbursement requirements are completed.
* Track applications at every stage and minimise processing delays.
* Maintain accurate records of applications, approvals, rejections and disbursements.

**6. Portfolio Monitoring & Collections Coordination**

* Monitor the performance of the credit portfolio.
* Track repayment status and overdue accounts.
* Coordinate with the collections team on delinquent accounts.
* Identify early warning indicators and escalate potential portfolio risks.
* Support initiatives to improve repayment performance and reduce delinquency.

**7. MIS & Reporting**

* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly credit business reports.
* Track:
* Applications received
* Applications processed
* Approvals
* Rejections
* Disbursements
* Disbursement value
* Turnaround time
* Overdue accounts
* Portfolio performance
* Provide management with regular updates and insights.

**8. Process & Compliance**

* Ensure all credit activities follow Vanmoh’s internal policies and approval processes.
* Maintain proper KYC and documentation standards.
* Ensure customer data and financial information are handled confidentially.
* Follow applicable regulatory and compliance requirements.
* Identify gaps in the credit process and recommend improvements.

**9. Team Management**

* Manage and mentor credit/operations executives where applicable.
* Allocate applications and responsibilities across the team.
* Set team-level targets and KPIs.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and provide training.
* Build a disciplined, customer-focused credit operations team.

**Key KRAs / KPIs**

Monthly loan/credit disbursement value

Number of new customers acquired

Application-to-disbursement conversion

Processing turnaround time

Portfolio quality

Delinquency / overdue levels

Customer retention

Channel partner productivity

Documentation accuracy

Compliance adherence

Team productivity

**Required Qualifications**

Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Finance, Business Administration or a related field.

MBA / PGDM in Finance will be an advantage.

4–8 years of relevant experience in credit, lending or financial services.

**Preferred Industry Experience**

Candidates with experience in:

NBFCs

Banks

Chit funds

Consumer finance

Business loans

Personal loans

Secured / unsecured lending

Fintech

Credit distribution

Loan processing

will be preferred.

Experience handling
**branch-based lending or credit operations**
will be an added advantage.

**Skills Required**

Credit & lending process knowledge

Financial analysis

Customer relationship management

Loan documentation

Risk awareness

Business development

Negotiation skills

Team management

MIS & reporting

MS Excel

CRM / loan management systems

Strong communication skills

**Ideal Candidate**

We are looking for someone who can balance
**business growth and credit discipline**
.

The ideal candidate should be:

Commercially driven but risk conscious.

Strong in customer and partner relationships.

Comfortable working with targets.

Good at analysing customer financial information.

Highly organised with documentation.

Capable of independently managing credit operations.

Proactive in identifying risks and operational issues.

Comfortable working with senior management and cross-functional teams.

**Compensation:**

Applicable based on agreed business and portfolio targets.

Full-Time

Immediate

title: Marketing Associate/Senior Associate
description:
**About Vimaan and the Role**

Vimaan is a Silicon Valley-based B2B deep-tech/SaaS startup, backed by Amazon and recognized by Gartner. We’re building Inventory Intelligence for warehouses and distribution centers, selling to operations and supply chain leaders at large enterprises across the world. We’re building a new category, so marketing here is market building, not just doing activities.

As a Marketing Associate, you will work closely with the Head of Growth & Marketing, helping plan and run the programs that build Vimaan's brand and generate demand.

**Location:**
Bengaluru, In-office

**Reports to:**
Head of Growth & Marketing (Raushan Barnwal)

**Type:**
Full-time

**What You Will Do**

Your work will span the areas below, with real ownership of each:

1. **Campaign Management:**
   Run our CRM (HubSpot) setup - contact lists, segmentation, forms, email builds and sends, and database hygiene. Execute the recurring email program and LinkedIn outbound sequences, drive paid campaigns, and manage the quarterly marketing calendar.
2. **SEO and AEO:**
   Drive our visibility in search and AI engines like Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini; track performance, build a weekly view of what’s working vs not, publish content and pages with the right on-page setup, and act on what the data shows.
3. **Website:**
   Coordinate with external web developers on the changes the website needs, from briefing to testing to going live, and publish and maintain pages day to day.
4. **Creatives:**
   Work closely with graphic designers, video makers and editors; share clear creative briefs, track production, review against the brief, and get assets produced on time.
5. **Content:**
   Take briefs from ideas to publishing - maintain the editorial calendar, coordinate with writers and freelancers, check drafts against our style and accuracy rules, publish, and distribute across channels. You don’t necessarily need to write the content, but you run everything around it.
6. **Events and Webinars:**
   Help with tradeshow logistics and lead follow-up, and running webinars: registration, reminders, hosting support, post-event nurture and reporting.
7. **Reporting:**
   Track deliverables and spend, and give leadership a clear monthly summary of results and learnings.
8. **AI for Marketing**
   : Across all of the above, you will also look for repeatable work to automate, using AI tools and lightweight workflows to maximize productivity.

**What We Are Looking For**

We care more about how fast you learn and how reliably you deliver than just about years of experience.

* Passionate about B2B technology products, and curious about how a deep-tech product works and why enterprises buy it.
* A degree from a top-tier institution and 1-3 years of experience in marketing and/or growth at a fast-paced tech startup; strong internships count as well.
* Comfortable with startup life: you want ownership and impact rather than a 9-to-5 job, and you enjoy building things that do not exist yet.
* Flexible and adaptable: priorities shift quickly, and you are happy to pick up whatever the work needs.
* Ownership: a record of owning something end to end, however small, and following it through without being chased.
* Proficient in or genuinely eager to learn AI tools, and keen to use them for everything they can do well. We expect you to automate repeatable work and find faster ways to get things done.
* Comfort with data: you read a spreadsheet or a dashboard and say what it means and what to do next.
* Clear communication: You will write emails, briefs, reports and status updates; and talk with different stakeholders regularly.
* Attention to detail: In our category, a wrong number or an overstated claim costs credibility, so accuracy matters.
* Based in Bengaluru already and able to work from our office as the work needs close daily collaboration.

**Good to have**

* Hands-on experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM and marketing automation tool.
* Exposure to B2B marketing, especially for technical or industrial products, or supply chain and logistics.
* Experience with web analytics, Google Search Console or SEO tools.
* Basic scripting or no-code automation skills.

Digital Marketing Manager, Growth (Paid & Organic)

Location: Bangalore, Gurgaon or Mumbai (India), Singapore, or Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia). Flexible for the right candidate.

Reports to: Marketing Director, working closely with our Enterprise Sales leadership

ABOUT BIPO

BIPO is a global HR and payroll technology company with 15+ years of experience, over 5,600 clients and 700,000+ users. One integrated platform covers HRMS, Global Payroll Outsourcing (90+ countries) and Employer of Record services (170+ countries). We run our own payroll engine in 26 countries, have 51 offices worldwide and are a Workday Platinum Partner. Having raised over USD 50 million, BIPO is now scaling its enterprise business globally.

THE ROLE

You will build and run BIPO's digital demand engine across paid, organic and data-driven outbound channels. Your job is not clicks or impressions. It is a steady flow of qualified meetings and pipeline for our sales teams from HR, Finance and IT leaders at multi-country companies.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will run Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads yourself, build target-account lists and automated workflows in Clay and Apollo, grow organic and AI-search visibility, and turn data into decisions every week. Coverage is APAC first (Singapore, Malaysia, India, Greater China, Southeast Asia), with support for global campaigns.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Paid acquisition

- Plan, build and optimise Google Ads campaigns (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube) for high-intent keywords such as global payroll, EOR and HRMS, by country and language

- Run account-based and persona-based LinkedIn Ads campaigns aimed at CHROs, CFOs, HR and payroll leaders

- Own the paid budget, pacing and bidding, and manage cost per lead, cost per meeting, cost per opportunity and ROAS

- Run a structured test plan for copy, offers, formats and landing pages

Organic growth

- Own keyword strategy, technical SEO, on-page optimisation and link building across BIPO's website and country pages

- Improve BIPO's visibility in AI search results such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews

- Identify content opportunities based on search demand and campaign performance, and brief the Marketing team on digital requirements

Outbound, ABM and data

- Build ideal-customer-profile and target-account lists with Clay, Apollo and LinkedIn Sales Navigator, enriched with firmographic, technographic and intent data

- Turn buying signals (expansion into new countries, HR leadership changes, hiring surges) into targeted campaigns and audience segments

- Work with Sales and SDRs on target audiences, lead definitions and handover criteria, and use performance data to improve lead quality

- Support digital ABM campaigns for priority enterprise accounts

Website, MarTech and analytics

- Own landing pages and website conversion, including A/B tests on forms and demo-request flows

- Set up and maintain GA4, Google Tag Manager, LinkedIn Insight Tag, offline conversion imports and UTM standards

- Build, test and optimise automated campaigns, nurture workflows and lead scoring

- Build dashboards showing spend, leads, meetings, pipeline and revenue by channel, country and campaign

- Use AI and automation tools (Clay, n8n, Make, Zapier) to make demand generation faster and more efficient

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- First 90 days: paid, SEO, tracking and CRM audit completed; clean attribution in place; Google Ads rebuilt or optimised; first Clay/Apollo outbound plays live with SDRs

- First 12 months: clear rise in marketing-sourced pipeline and meetings, lower cost per opportunity, growth in organic traffic and AI-search mentions, and a repeatable ABM programme for top accounts

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must have

- 5+ years in digital, performance or growth marketing, with at least 3 years in B2B SaaS or tech selling to business buyers

- Hands-on Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads experience: you have built, run and scaled campaigns yourself, with results you can show

- Strong working knowledge of Clay, Apollo and LinkedIn Sales Navigator (or ZoomInfo, Lusha, Cognism)

- Solid SEO knowledge (technical, on-page, content) and an understanding of AI-search visibility

- A pipeline mindset: you measure success by meetings, opportunities and revenue, not vanity metrics

- Strong with data, spreadsheets and dashboards

- Experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, Ahrefs, Semrush, UTMs and conversion tracking

- Hands-on experience managing websites in WordPress or a similar CMS

- Excellent written English with clear, punchy copywriting. Fluency in another Asian language is ideal for supporting local-language campaigns across APAC

Nice to have

- Experience in HR tech, payroll, EOR, fintech or other compliance-heavy B2B products

- Multi-country campaigns across APAC markets and languages

- ABM and intent platforms such as 6sense, Demandbase, Bombora or G2 Buyer Intent

- Automation and technical skills: n8n, Make or Zapier; basic SQL, Python or spreadsheet scripting

- Google Ads, LinkedIn Marketing Labs, HubSpot or Salesforce certifications

**Job Description: Web2/Web3 Marketing & Growth Whiz**

**Company:**

**About Basil Health**

Basil Health is building at the intersection of
**AI, cognitive wellness, EEG technology, and Web3**
. Through our CalmSync platform, we aim to make cognitive wellness more personalised and accessible using brain-signal insights, AI-powered coaching, and tailored wellness experiences. We are also exploring Web3-powered rewards and community engagement. We’re an ambitious, early-stage team looking for creative, driven people who want to help build something meaningful.

**The Role: We Need a Self-Starter, Not Just a Poster!**

We want a
**social-media-native, growth-minded marketer**
who:

* **Understands Eastern Gen Z and Millennials.**
  You understand how young people across India and other Eastern markets think, communicate, discover brands, respond to humour, follow trends, and decide whether something is worth their attention. You can create content that feels culturally relevant and authentic—not forced, generic, or copied from Western marketing playbooks.
* **Is a self-starter.**
  You don't wait for a detailed brief for every post or campaign. You identify opportunities, propose ideas, test them, learn, and execute.
* **Thinks beyond vanity metrics.**
  Likes and followers are not the end goal. You care about reach, engagement quality, profile visits, website traffic, sign-ups, community growth, retention, and ultimately product adoption.
* **Can make complex ideas interesting.**
  AI, EEG, cognitive wellness, brain data, and Web3 can sound intimidating. You know how to turn them into simple, relatable, memorable stories.
* **Understands both Web2 and Web3.**
  You are comfortable with mainstream social media and digital growth, and you understand the culture of online communities, crypto-native audiences, tokens, rewards, and decentralised ecosystems—or are eager to demonstrate that you can learn quickly.
* **Has a point of view.**
  You bring original ideas, challenge weak approaches, and can explain why you believe a campaign will work.
* **Can execute independently.**
  You can plan, write, create, publish, analyse, and improve content without needing constant supervision.

**What You’ll Do**

 

* **Build visibility:**

**Highly Preferred**

title: Founding Marketing Lead (Strategy & Content)
description:
---------
**WHAT WE DO**

---------

Slidely AI is a PowerPoint AI assistant built for professionals. In the last 30 days, users created more than 50,000 slides with Slidely, and 82.5% of them made it into real presentations.

Professionals at Deloitte, Airtel, Axis Bank and ABM Industries use Slidely, and our customers include teams at Fortune 500 companies. We’ve done this with a team of fewer than 10 people.

Now we’re hiring our founding marketing lead to shape how the world hears about Slidely. Your job will be to decide what Slidely says and where it says it, and then write it.

---------
**WHY SLIDELY EXISTS ---------**

ChatGPT and Claude have made presentations easier for casual users. For professionals, a big gap remains.

**Making PowerPoints is nobody’s job but everybody’s problem**

Decks take up 30 to 50% of a consultant’s time, but nobody is paid to make them faster, and the best AI model changes every month. Keeping up is our job, so it doesn’t have to be theirs.

**AI has no judgement, and no one has time to teach it**

It doesn’t know which slides a sell-side private equity deck needs, or when a slide is too dense to read. We build what good looks like in each industry into every workflow: 95% best practice, 5% you.

**A bad first draft just pushes the work to later**

Without that judgement, ChatGPT and Claude ignore your template and put your speaker notes on the slide. Our plugin starts from your template, your industry’s best practices and your past work, and our PowerPoint add-in handles the iteration.

**AI guesses what you want instead of checking with you**

It asks a few generic questions, then disappears on a long job. Slidely confirms the storyline, data and layouts before building your deck, and shows you three options when you redesign a slide.

**A sloppy deck comes off as sloppy work**

A deck can decide whether you get the funding, the investment or the approval, and the audience judges the work by the slides. Set up one design kit, and every slide anyone in your company creates follows it.

**Making a great deck is hard freaking work, so nobody wants to do it again (and again)**

A great deck takes days, sometimes weeks, so people keep reusing their best old slides. Slidely does that for the whole company, and every deck makes the next one better.

---------
**ABOUT THE TEAM & COMPANY**

---------

We're backed by Y Combinator and supported by prominent founders, operators and executives.

Despite being a team of fewer than 10, we serve demanding enterprise customers and operate at a much larger company's pace.

Our founders, Apoorve and Nikhil, are computer science graduates from IIT Kharagpur with deep backgrounds in AI.

This is an in-person role from our office in HSR Layout, Bengaluru. We work six days a week, typically 9-10 hours a day, together.

---------
**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

---------

You’ll own what Slidely says and how it reaches the people who need it. Working closely with our CEO, you’ll set our content, SEO and AEO strategy, then write the words that carry it. Once a process works, you’ll work with our GTM engineer to automate it, so you spend your time on the work only you can do.

1. **Set the SEO and AEO strategy.**
   Decide which topics, keywords and pages we should win, and which questions Slidely should come up for in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini. Then build the plan to get there.
2. **Own what’s working.**
   Read our performance across traffic, rankings, AI search, sign-ups and engagement, decide what to double down on and what to kill, and adjust our content and strategy accordingly.
3. **Write blog posts and key pages**
   (comparison, industry and feature pages) that rank, get cited by AI search, and that people actually want to read.
4. **Run case studies.**
   Decide how we get customer stories (like offering power users credits for an interview), write the outreach, interview customers and turn their wins into stories that sell.
5. **Write social content**
   for our channels: LinkedIn, X, Reddit.
6. **Write email copy**
   for onboarding, re-engagement and outreach that gets opened and acted on.
7. **Write homepage copy**
   that explains what Slidely does in seconds.
8. **Run creator partnerships.**
   Find, brief and manage creators for paid UGC and influencer marketing.
9. **Turn what works into a process.**
   Once a format proves itself, define what good looks like and work with our GTM engineer to automate it.

---------
**YOU'LL DO WELL HERE IF YOU**

---------

1. **Write clearly and sharply.**
   You can explain complex ideas simply, and you cut more than you keep. You know how to write a hook that stops the scroll and a CTA that gets the click. You also know where AI falls short, and you edit until nothing reads like AI slop.
2. **Know SEO deeply.**
   You understand the fundamentals, you’ve published blog posts with traffic to show for it, and you can turn that experience into an SEO strategy for Slidely.
3. **Get social media.**
   You’ve built a following on at least one platform, and you have good instincts for what an audience will engage with, like knowing when a short clip beats a YouTube link.
4. **Understand your audience.**
   You can explain Slidely’s benefits in terms a consultant, PE associate or strategy lead actually cares about.
5. **Are AI-native.**
   You use AI to research, draft and repurpose content at a pace a one-person team couldn’t manage otherwise, and you build your own prompts, skills and workflows to do it.
6. **Let data guide you.**
   You track what’s working in traffic, rankings, sign-ups and engagement, and you double down or kill things based on the numbers, not on what you like.

---------
**BENEFITS**

---------

* Total CTC: ₹12-18 LPA + ESOPs
* One-time joining bonus of ₹50k
* Access to leading AI and marketing tools
* Workstation setup and upgrades
* Additional software required to do your best work

**About the Team**

The Growth Marketing team at Navi is responsible for activation, engagement, and retention of users who are on the Navi App. The CLM team owns the end-to-end lifecycle of the user, through every message that reaches our customers after they install our app. We operate at high volume, with a strong focus on precision, compliance, and continuous improvement. Our mission is to make every customer communication relevant, useful, timely, and effortlessly clear - so that the customer feels Navi understands them.

**About the Role**

● Execute marketing campaigns end-to-end on a daily basis - setting up, scheduling, and dispatching across SMS, WhatsApp, email, and push channels with accuracy and speed.

● Maintain detailed, structured records of every campaign run - including audience segments, message variants, send times, and outcomes, so that nothing is lost or ambiguous in the audit trail.

● Work closely with the content and design team to give campaign briefs, refine them, test with real users, and finally test and execute them with high accuracy.

● Analyse the result of each campaign, get learnings, and report them, with clear insights and next steps.

● Maintain the marketing calendar, ensuring that marketing campaigns get created accurately and executed on time.

● Identify recurring friction points in the execution workflow and propose or help implement process improvements, checklists, or alerts to reduce manual error.

**What We Expect From You**

● A methodical, process-first approach — you follow steps precisely, document everything, and treat shortcuts as a risk .

● Strong attention to detail — you catch discrepancies in audience lists, message content, or scheduling parameters before they go out, not after.

● A collaborative instinct — you ask the right questions when a brief is unclear rather than making assumptions, and you loop in stakeholders early when something looks off.

● A structured mindset around error prevention — you naturally think in terms of checklists, version control, and confirmation steps.

**Must Haves**

● Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets - for managing audience lists, tracking campaign logs, and maintaining execution records.

● Demonstrated experience in a high-volume, process-driven operations or execution role.

● Excellent record-keeping habits - can maintain a clean, auditable log of all work done with zero ambiguity.

● Ability to follow detailed SOPs precisely and raise a flag when something deviates from the defined process.

● Good written communication skills in English - for coordination with internal teams and documenting execution notes.

**Good to have**

Familiarity with any marketing tool like Clevertap, Moengage, Hubspot or Raven is preferred.

**About Navi**

We are shaping the future of financial services for a billion Indians through products that are simple, accessible, and affordable. From Personal & Home Loans to UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds, and Gold — we’re building tech-first solutions that work at scale, with a strong customer-first approach.

Founded by Sachin Bansal & Ankit Agarwal in 2018, we are one of India’s fastest-growing financial services organisations. But we’re just getting started!

**Our Culture**

At Navi, we’re a place where ambition meets opportunity and ideas turn into impact quickly. We empower people with high ownership from the start, encouraging them to solve meaningful problems and build with excellence. Teams here work in an environment that values speed, collaboration and craftsmanship, while celebrating learning, growth and shared wins along the way. Whether you’re shaping the future of fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life at Navi means being part of a high-energy, talent-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a difference.

We’re guided by our own operating system - The Navi OS - a set of principles that shape how we work and win together. You can explore them at navi.com/our-values to see what drives us every day.

If this feels like you, Navi is the place to grow, thrive, and make a real impact.

title: Marketing Operations Lead (GTM - RevOps): 371
description:
Amagi is an AI-enabled industry cloud platform built for the new video economy, helping media companies modernize operations, unify streaming and broadcast workflows, and drive advanced monetization. From live remote production and real-time ad decisioning to automated playout and global content syndication. We operate a dynamic content and advertising marketplace and offer fully managed broadcast services that ensure 24/7 reliability and compliance. Trusted by 56% of the Top 50 media companies globally, Amagi powers over 7,000 channel deliveries across 300+ content distributors, processing 500K+ hours of content and generating 26 billion+ monetized ad impressions. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, with a 1000+ member global team across Americas, EMEA and APAC, Amagi is redefining how media is created, distributed, and monetized—intelligently and globally.

**Our identity and mission:**
Amagi, epitomizing the essence of freedom, embarks on an extraordinary mission to establish the world's foremost media technology business rooted in a foundation of goodness. Our commitment to autonomy is paralleled by our shared connection through a compelling purpose, with the Amagi Way serving as our guiding light. In our pursuit, we strive to create a harmonious blend of individual freedom and collective purpose, shaping a unique and transformative journey that sets us apart in the realm of media technology.

Work Mode                  : In Office

Location                       : Bengaluru (Bannerghatta Road)

**Job Profile:**

Amagi is hiring a Marketing Operations Lead to own the systems, data, and automation that power our GTM engine. This is not a traditional MOps seat - it sits at the intersection of marketing operations and GTM engineering. You’ll run the full marketing-ops backbone (campaign ops, lead lifecycle, attribution, database hygiene) while building AI-native automations that eliminate manual work across Sales, Marketing, and RevOps. If you instinctively reach for a Claude + Clay workflow before a spreadsheet, this is your playground - and you’ll own the reporting layer leadership runs on, accountable for turning dashboards into decisions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Marketing Operations Ownership**

Own the marketing-ops backbone: campaign operations, lead lifecycle, scoring/routing, attribution, and database hygiene across the funnel.

Administer HubSpot and Salesforce hands-on — objects, workflows, fields, and integration — keeping Salesforce as the single source of truth.

Drive SLA adherence and clean handoffs between Marketing, BDR/SDR, and Sales.

**AI-Native Automation & GTM Engineering**

Build end-to-end automations using a Claude + Clay combination plus n8n / Make to enrich, research, and act on data with minimal human overhead.

Stand up advanced enrichment and account-intelligence pipelines (ICP matching, contact/title enrichment, ABM, outreach automation).

Proactively identify automation opportunities; ensure workflows are scalable, fail-safe, and maintainable.

**Reporting That Drives Outcomes**

Own reporting and dashboards across HubSpot, Salesforce, and the GTM stack for stakeholders up to leadership.

Translate pipeline, campaign, and funnel data into actionable recommendations — and own the follow-through.

Use SQL (and Python where useful) to extract, transform, and analyze data across systems; run a 30-60-90 reporting cadence.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

Partner with Sales, SalesOps, BDRs, PMM, and Leadership to turn business needs into scalable systems.

Document workflows and data flows, train the team, and support rapid deploy-measure-iterate experiments.

**Skills and Expertise Required:**

AI-native operator: fluent in applying LLMs (Claude in particular) to design and ship real workflows — not just prompt occasionally.

Hands-on, advanced proficiency with HubSpot, Salesforce, and Clay (all must-have).

Proven ability to build automations with Claude + Clay and orchestration tools (n8n / Make); SQL for querying GTM data.

Reporting and dashboarding, with the judgment to turn data into action.

Strong grasp of GTM workflows: lead routing, scoring, ICP matching, ABM automation, attribution, and pipeline hygiene.

**Competencies**

Funnel & lifecycle ownership: govern lead lifecycle and stage definitions (Inquiry → MQL → SQL → Opportunity), scoring models, and routing rules.

Attribution & measurement: stand up and defend a campaign measurement and multi-touch attribution methodology tying activity to pipeline and revenue.

Campaign ops & data governance: own campaign setup, UTM/taxonomy, segmentation, QA, and database health (dedupe, normalization, enrichment, compliance).

Martech stack ownership: administer, evaluate, and rationalize the stack; manage vendors, renewals, integrations, and license/credit utilization.

Planning & stakeholder leadership: partner on target-setting and multi-BU campaign governance; drive cross-functional alignment on process, SLAs, and a single source of truth.

**Good-to-Have**

Python; warehouse / BI exposure (Databricks, Looker / LookML basics).

B2B SaaS GTM experience (post-IPO / high-growth); familiarity with Gong Engage, Outreach, or Swoogo.

**Who You Are**

AI-first by default: you reach for a Claude-powered workflow before a manual process and treat LLMs as core to how you operate.

Hands-on operator: equally at home building enrichment in Clay, configuring Salesforce and HubSpot, and reviewing pipeline with leadership.

A systems thinker with a bias for automation, strong ownership, and a builder’s instinct in high-growth environments.

You flag data-quality issues honestly rather than shipping polished-but-wrong output.

“Amagi is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against applicants based on their gender, marital status, race, religion, color, age, capacity to work, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran.”

**Job Description**
**SEO/AEO Analyst (Bangalore)**
**About The Role**
As the SEO and AEO Analyst, you’ll own and execute a high-impact organic growth strategy that drives qualified traffic, product sign-ups, and revenue. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines SEO expertise, analytical thinking, experimentation, and strong execution, and is excited about the evolving world of AI-powered search and answer engines.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own end-to-end SEO and AEO strategy for the company website, with a focus on organic visibility, qualified traffic, sign-ups, and revenue
* Identify and capture high-intent searches by our customers and community
* Conduct keyword, search-intent, SERP, competitor, and content-gap research to identify scalable growth opportunities
* Build content strategies, topic clusters, and search-focused roadmaps aligned with business goals, product priorities, and customer journeys
* Optimize landing pages, product pages, blogs, and solution pages for rankings, CTR, conversions, featured snippets, and AI-powered search visibility
* Apply AEO/GEO best practices to improve content discoverability, structure, entity understanding, and visibility across emerging answer-engine experiences
* Lead technical SEO initiatives like crawlability, indexation, site architecture, internal linking, Core Web Vitals, JavaScript SEO, canonicalization, sitemaps, robots.txt, and structured data
* Run SEO/AEO experiments and use data to improve rankings, organic CTR, qualified traffic, engagement, and conversions
* Analyze competitors, search trends, SERP features, and AI search experiences to identify content, technical, and visibility opportunities
* Collaborate with paid marketing teams to improve funnel performance

**What We’re Looking For**

* 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably in B2B SaaS, technology, or product-led businesses
* Proven ability to grow organic traffic, qualified leads, product sign-ups, pipeline, or revenue
* Strong understanding of technical SEO, on-page optimization, keyword research, search intent, content strategy, and competitor analysis
* Working knowledge of AEO/GEO and AI-powered search, including structured content, entity optimization, Schema.org, and direct-answer experiences
* Experience with Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs/SEMrush, and SEO/AEO reporting/analytics tools
* Experience working with CMS platforms; WordPress experience is a plus
* International exposure, international SEO, multilingual content, or knowledge of multiple languages is a plus

**Benefits**

* Salary comparable to that of Tech MNCs and commensurate with experience
* Annual bonus based on individual and company performance
* Employee and family health insurance cover of Rs. 5 lakhs per year
* Exposure to international markets
* Excellent work culture (supportive, collaborative, autonomy, mentorship, fun, team, learning environment for professional development)

**Growth Path**
This role is a great gateway to a leadership role in marketing and gives you 360-degree exposure to all aspects of marketing in a small team. You can expect to work on fast-paced and innovative projects with a world-class team. The office is a modern co-working space in Bangalore. This is also a good opportunity for someone who wants to move into a product management role. As a creative team, we work closely together in the office, and work-from-office all days of the week is required.

title: OFF page SEO & GEO Specialist
description:
**Job Description: Off-Page SEO & GEO Specialist**

**Job Title**

**Off-Page SEO & GEO Specialist**

**Experience**

**2–5 years**
in Off-Page SEO, Digital PR, Link Building, Content Outreach, Reputation Management, or GEO/AEO

**Employment Type**

Full-Time/ Part time

**About the Role**

We are looking for an
**Off-Page SEO & GEO Specialist**
who will be responsible for building the company's external authority, online reputation, brand visibility, and presence across search engines, AI search platforms, communities, media publications, and industry websites.

The person will manage the complete off-page function, including
**Digital PR, backlinks, brand mentions, Reddit, Quora, reviews, ratings, community engagement, outreach, citations, guest contributions, influencer/podcast opportunities, and AI/GEO visibility**
.

This role is suitable for someone who understands that modern off-page SEO is not only about generating backlinks. The focus is on building
**credible brand mentions, authoritative references, relevant citations, relationships, and external signals**
that can support both traditional search visibility and AI-generated answers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Digital PR & Media Outreach**

* Identify relevant media publications, journalists, editors and industry websites.
* Develop and execute digital PR campaigns.
* Pitch relevant company stories, announcements, research and expert opinions.
* Secure relevant editorial coverage and brand mentions.
* Identify opportunities for founder/executive interviews.
* Identify journalist request platforms and relevant media opportunities.
* Coordinate with internal teams to prepare expert comments and responses.
* Track media coverage and resulting mentions/links.
* Build long-term relationships with journalists and publishers.

**2. Off-Page SEO & Link Building**

* Develop and execute ethical, relevance-focused link-building strategies.
* Identify high-quality, industry-relevant websites for outreach.
* Conduct competitor backlink analysis.
* Identify backlink gaps and link opportunities.
* Conduct guest article and expert contribution outreach.
* Identify resource pages and relevant editorial opportunities.
* Find broken-link opportunities where appropriate.
* Identify unlinked brand mentions and pursue relevant attribution.
* Monitor new and lost backlinks.
* Evaluate backlink relevance and quality.
* Avoid spammy, automated or low-quality link-building practices.

**3. Reddit Management**

* Identify relevant Reddit communities and discussions.
* Monitor questions and discussions related to the industry.
* Provide genuinely useful and non-promotional responses.
* Identify opportunities for relevant brand/product references.
* Build a credible participation history.
* Monitor brand mentions and discussions.
* Identify discussions that may influence search or AI-generated answers.
* Maintain a natural community-first approach rather than promotional posting.

**4. Quora & Q&A Platforms**

* Identify relevant questions related to the company's products, services and industry.
* Create useful, factual and comprehensive answers.
* Identify opportunities to establish the company as a credible source.
* Monitor existing questions and answers for brand mentions.
* Identify outdated or inaccurate information where appropriate.
* Track visibility of company-related questions and answers.

**5. Reviews & Ratings**

* Identify relevant review platforms for the business.
* Develop a process for generating genuine customer reviews.
* Monitor ratings and review trends.
* Track positive and negative customer feedback.
* Coordinate with customer/support teams where responses are required.
* Respond to reviews professionally and appropriately.
* Identify recurring customer concerns and report them internally.
* Monitor competitor ratings and review presence.

**Important:**
Reviews must be genuine. The role should not involve buying, fabricating or manipulating reviews.

**6. Brand Mention & Reputation Management**

* Monitor brand mentions across the web.
* Identify unlinked brand mentions.
* Identify incorrect company information.
* Identify outdated information that requires correction.
* Track product/service mentions.
* Monitor founder and leadership mentions where relevant.
* Identify opportunities to convert relevant mentions into citations/links.
* Maintain a monthly brand mention report.

**7. Industry Communities & Forums**

* Identify relevant industry communities.
* Participate in professional discussions.
* Answer industry questions.
* Build relationships with relevant community members.
* Identify opportunities for expert contributions.
* Monitor conversations involving the company, products and competitors.

**8. Guest Contributions & Expert Outreach**

* Identify authoritative websites accepting expert contributions.
* Pitch relevant article topics.
* Coordinate with internal SMEs for expert content.
* Manage outreach from prospecting to publication.
* Maintain a database of publishers and contacts.
* Ensure published content is relevant and genuinely useful.
* Track published articles, mentions and links.

**10. Industry Directories & Citations**

* Identify relevant industry directories.
* Maintain accurate business information.
* Identify authoritative local and industry citations.
* Find duplicate or inaccurate listings.
* Maintain consistent company information across important platforms.
* Avoid mass submission to low-quality directories.

**GEO / AI Search Responsibilities**

A major part of this role will be
**Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**
.

The candidate will help improve the likelihood that the company's brand, products, services and expertise are discovered, mentioned and cited by AI/search systems.

**Competitor Research**

The candidate will regularly analyse competitors for:

* Backlinks
* Referring domains
* Digital PR coverage
* Brand mentions
* Media coverage
* Reddit discussions
* Quora visibility
* Review presence
* Industry directory presence
* Expert contributions
* Podcast appearances
* Social mentions
* AI citations
* AI brand mentions
* External sources frequently cited by AI platforms

The objective is to identify
**new, legitimate opportunities**
, not simply copy competitor link-building tactics.

**Outreach Responsibilities**

The candidate should be comfortable with:

* Email outreach
* Journalist outreach
* Publisher outreach
* Blogger outreach
* Expert outreach
* Podcast outreach
* Partnership outreach
* Community outreach
* Review platform outreach

They should maintain an organized outreach database containing:

**Website | Contact | Email | Industry | Opportunity | Status | Follow-up Date | Result | Link/Mention | Notes**

**Reporting & Measurement**

The candidate will prepare regular reports covering:

**Off-Page SEO**

* New referring domains
* New backlinks
* Lost backlinks
* Relevant editorial links
* Brand mentions
* Unlinked mentions
* Digital PR coverage

**Reputation**

* Review count
* Average rating
* New reviews
* Review sentiment
* Major customer issues

**Community**

* Reddit mentions
* Quora visibility
* Forum/community mentions
* Relevant discussions

**GEO**

* AI brand mention rate
* AI citation rate
* AI visibility
* Number of cited external sources
* Competitor citation presence
* Brand/entity consistency
* Relevant external sources appearing in AI answers

**Outreach**

* Prospects identified
* Outreach sent
* Responses
* Opportunities secured
* Articles published
* Media coverage obtained
* Podcasts/webinars secured
* Links/mentions acquired

**Required Skills**

**Must Have**

* Strong understanding of Off-Page SEO
* Link-building experience
* Digital PR experience
* Outreach experience
* Competitor backlink analysis
* Brand mention monitoring
* Reddit knowledge
* Quora knowledge
* Review/reputation management
* Basic understanding of GEO/AEO
* Strong research skills
* Strong written English
* Good communication skills
* Spreadsheet/Google Sheets proficiency
* Ability to conduct structured outreach

**Good to Have**

* Experience with digital PR platforms
* Journalist outreach experience
* Podcast outreach experience
* Experience with AI search/GEO
* Experience monitoring ChatGPT/Gemini/Perplexity visibility
* Experience with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Moz or similar
* Experience with Google Search Console
* Experience with reputation-management platforms
* Experience working with SaaS, technology, automotive, travel, finance or other competitive industries

**What This Role Is NOT**

This is
**not a bulk backlink submission role**
.

The person will not be expected to:

* Buy large quantities of backlinks.
* Spam forums.
* Create automated Reddit/Quora accounts.
* Generate fake reviews.
* Submit websites to hundreds of low-quality directories.
* Use private blog networks.
* Generate irrelevant guest posts purely for links.
* Spam communities with promotional content.

The focus is on
**credible external authority, relevant mentions, editorial coverage, community presence, reputation and AI/search visibility**
.

title: Marketing Manager

Senior Marketing Manager

We’re looking for a highly organized, execution-driven Senior Marketing Manager to lead

end-to-end planning and delivery of webinars, virtual events, and in-person experiences.

This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy and project management ideal for

someone who thrives on timelines, cross-functional coordination, and delivering high-impact

campaigns with measurable outcomes.

You will own the entire lifecycle of events, from ideation and planning to execution, promotion,

and post-event analysis, while ensuring seamless collaboration across marketing, sales, design,

and external partners.

Key Responsibilities

1. Webinar, Podcasts & Event Strategy

● Own and execute the end-to-end lifecycle of all initiatives across webinars, events,

podcasts, and customer-led content (testimonials, success stories)

● Plan and execute a calendar of webinars, workshops, podcasts and events aligned with

business goals

● Identify themes, formats, and speakers that drive engagement and pipeline

● Own audience targeting, positioning, and messaging for each event

● Be responsible for reporting, analytics and growth

2. End-to-End Project Management

● Build detailed project plans, timelines, and workflows for each campaign

● Coordinate across internal teams (content, design, sales, ops) and external stakeholders

assets

stories

demos)

6. Performance & Analytics

● Track key metrics: registrations, attendance, engagement, pipeline, ROI

● Measure impact of customer content on conversion and pipeline

● Analyze performance and generate actionable insights

● Share structured post-event and content reports with stakeholders

● Continuously refine playbooks for scalable growth

Key Requirements

● 2+ years of experience in marketing with a strong focus on events, webinars, or

customer-led content

● Proven ability to own and execute projects end-to-end independently

● Strong project management and organizational skills

● Experience with marketing automation and CRM tools

● Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, vendors, and deadlines simultaneously

● Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

● Data-driven mindset with strong analytical capabilities

● Strong eye for design quality and marketing collateral review

Nice to Have

● Experience in B2B SaaS or childcare space

● Experience running international or multi-region events

● Familiarity with paid acquisition channels for event promotion

title: Growth Marketing Intern (AI and MarTech)
description:
**About Martechture
﻿**

Martechture is a marketing-first martech consulting firm headquartered in New Jersey, with our delivery team based in Bengaluru. We help marketing leaders get more out of the platforms and data they already own, and put AI to work inside them.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a marketing intern who is curious about where growth strategy meets technical execution. You will learn to apply core growth and communication principles while using AI tools, automation, and a working understanding of code, APIs, and CMS platforms as part of your everyday toolkit. You will contribute to real work from your first week, with mentorship and room to take on more as you grow.

If you have taken the time to understand how campaigns run, enjoy experimenting with AI tools, and are comfortable exploring an API or a CMS on your own, we would like to hear from you.

**What You Will Do**

* **Content and social operations:**
  Support day-to-day content creation and distribution across LinkedIn and other social channels, using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity to research and draft content and to repurpose it across formats.

* **Campaign execution:**
  Help plan and launch campaigns, building them inside marketing automation platforms, social schedulers, and ad platforms, and take part in post-campaign reviews.

* **MarTech operations:**
  Learn our stack hands-on, including marketing automation, CMS, social media management, and SEO and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) tools, and help resolve operational issues as they come up.

* **Technical marketing:**
  Take on tasks like landing page updates, tag and pixel deployment, and minor CMS changes, building independence as you go.

* **AI tool evaluation:**
  Research and test emerging AI tools, AI agents, and data enrichment utilities, and share practical views on which ones are worth adopting.

* **Workflow improvement:**
  Look at our marketing funnels and internal workflows with fresh eyes, and suggest improvements where you see gaps or inefficiencies.

* **Documentation:**
  Capture workflows, tool evaluations, prompts, and campaign learnings so they become shared knowledge for the team.

**Eligibility**

* Currently pursuing an MBA, with an undergraduate degree in engineering or a technical discipline (B.Tech, B.E., BCA, or B.Sc. in Computer Science or IT).

* Basic familiarity with HTML/CSS/JavaScript, Python, or SQL, and a conceptual understanding of how APIs and webhooks work.

* Permanently based in Bengaluru and available to work full-time from our office.

* Able to join within 30 days and commit to a continuous six-month internship.

**What We Are Looking For**

* **MarTech awareness:**
  A solid understanding of how core marketing platforms work, such as marketing automation (HubSpot, Marketo, Brevo), CMS (WordPress, Webflow), or SEO tools (Ahrefs, Semrush). Exposure through coursework, free trials, certifications like HubSpot Academy, or personal projects all count.

* **AI curiosity:**
  Genuine interest in using AI tools for marketing work, whether that means writing structured prompts, trying Zapier or Make automations, or building a custom GPT for something you care about.

* **Strong written English:**
  Clear, well-structured writing that adapts to short social posts, long-form articles, and documentation.

* **Ownership mindset:**
  Willingness to take responsibility for your work, ask good questions, and grow into larger tasks as trust builds.

**What You Will Gain**

title: Product-led Growth Manager
description:
**About Hevo**

Hevo is a simple, no-code data pipeline platform that helps companies unify and prepare their data for analytics and AI. Hevo enables 2,500+ data-driven companies, including DoorDash, Shopify, Postman, and Groww, to get their data AI-ready by automating complex integration and transformation tasks across hundreds of sources.

By removing engineering bottlenecks, Hevo allows teams to focus on what actually matters: generating insights, building intelligent products, and making faster decisions.

**What You Will Own**

You own how prospects find Hevo and what happens once they arrive. That spans the organic growth engine, the editorial voice, and AEO strategy that brings technical buyers to the site, plus the trial experience that turns a signup into a paying customer. The two halves are connected: the content you publish sets the intent of the person who signs up, and the trial experience decides whether that intent converts.

This role sits roughly 60% on inbound and organic growth, 40% on trial lifecycle and PLG conversion. You are not a reporter of traffic or a reporter of conversion rate. You are the person who defines what good looks like on both sides of the funnel, instruments it, and ships the work that moves it.

**Core Responsibilities**

**1. Inbound, Editorial, and AEO (Primary)**

* Own Hevo's organic growth strategy and editorial voice across inbound, AEO, and content: find opportunities, plan, publish, track results, and improve performance
* Manage the editorial calendar. Plan and prioritize website pages, blogs, guides, ebooks, and FAQs based on business goals
* Set the quality standard for content and make sure everything published follows Hevo's messaging and tone
* Work with writers, subject matter experts, freelancers, and agencies to get content created, edited, and published
* Repurpose content across blogs, AI search engines, sales materials, and social media to extract more value from every piece
* Optimize content to rank on Google and appear in AI search results. Own inbound and AEO, including schema, website structure, and making content accessible to search engines and AI crawlers
* Build and maintain a backlink and digital PR strategy to strengthen domain authority
* Run experiments on content performance, headlines, CTAs, and formats, and iterate based on conversion data rather than traffic alone
* Set up and maintain dashboards (Looker Studio, GA4, GSC) that give a single view of content performance across the full funnel

**2. Trial Lifecycle and Activation**

* Define what trial success looks like: set activation milestones, instrument the funnel, and report on conversion performance weekly
* Map the trial journey from signup through first pipeline to the aha moment and conversion, and identify where intent drops
* Design and run lifecycle communications: onboarding email sequences, in-app nudges, and re-engagement flows tied to behavioral triggers
* Act as the internal voice of the trial user in product, GTM, and leadership conversations

**3. Conversion Rate Optimization**

* Synthesize behavioral data (session recordings, funnel drop-off, in-app events) into structured conversion hypotheses with clear success metrics
* Design and execute CRO across onboarding flows, high-intent landing pages, and trial touchpoints, with documented methodology and learnings
* Partner with Design on landing page variants for use-case pages, competitor comparison pages, and ICP-segment pages. You define the hypothesis and copy, Design executes
* Maintain a rigorous experiment log: hypothesis, variant rationale, statistical methodology, results, and learnings

**4. Product and GTM Partnership**

* Surface structured, prioritized insights from organic visitors and trial users into the roadmap process weekly
* Build technically credible collateral: setup walkthroughs, migration guides, and competitive comparison assets written for data practitioners, not buyers
* Create and maintain a weekly product-to-GTM feedback brief synthesizing signals from content performance, trials, support tickets, and deal reviews
* Support competitive displacement motions with content and push customers toward a switch decision

**What You Need to Bring**

**Non-Negotiable**

* 5–8 years across Inbound, or PLG at a B2B SaaS company, preferably selling to technical buyers, with direct ownership of organic performance or a self-serve conversion program and measurable outcomes
* Strong writing and editing skills. Comfortable across thought leadership, technical content, and competitor comparison pages
* Hands-on data background, or close enough experience alongside a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, or Data Scientist to write for that audience without translation
* Working understanding of PLG mechanics: activation frameworks, aha-moment design, in-product lifecycle marketing, and trial funnel instrumentation
* Behavioral analytics skills: Amplitude, Mixpanel, or PostHog for funnel and activation tracking, plus Hotjar or FullStory for session analysis
* Experimentation discipline across both content and product surfaces: A/B tests run with proper statistical methodology, not just a headline swap
* Experience building dashboards or reports that connect content, SEO, and lifecycle metrics to pipeline and business outcomes

**Strong Advantage**

* Experience improving visibility across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Copilot, and Gemini
* Familiarity with ELT, data pipelines, or other technical products in a fast-growing startup environment
* Familiarity with PLG tools: in-app messaging (Appcues, Pendo, or equivalent), lifecycle email (Customer.io, Braze), and interactive demos (Arcade, Navattic, Storylane)
* Experience with competitive displacement content at the trial stage
* Basic HTML/CSS comfort to push copy or CTA edits without filing a ticket

**What Good Looks Like at 6 Months**

**Milestone**

**30 Days**

* Organic content audit and trial funnel audit both complete. Activation milestones defined. Editorial calendar live. First lifecycle experiment shipped.

**90 Days**

* Organic traffic and AI visibility trending up against baseline. 5+ CRO or lifecycle experiments shipped with documented outcomes. Onboarding email sequence live and instrumented.

**180 Days**

* Measurable improvement in organic pipeline contribution and trial-to-paid conversion.
* Competitive trial-stage and comparison content covering top displacement scenarios.
* Lifecycle and content experimentation embedded in sprint cycles.

**This Role Is Not for You If**

* You have only done content marketing or demand gen and have never owned a self-serve conversion funnel with measurable outcomes
* You need a separate analyst to tell you where the funnel is breaking before you can act
* You have never written for a technical audience and are relying on learning it on the job
* You treat content and lifecycle marketing as calendars to fill rather than systems that respond to data

title: General Manager / Category Lead_Bambinos.live
description:
We’re Hiring: General Manager / Category Lead | Bambinos.live

**Build a $10M Business. Own a Category. Think Like a Founder.**

At
**Bambinos.live**
, we’re looking for high-ownership, AI-first leaders to build and scale our business verticals into category-leading, profitable businesses.

This isn’t a traditional management role. You’ll own an entire business vertical end to end — from P&L and growth to product, customer experience, sales and educator operations — with a bold mission:
**scale your vertical to $10 million ARR within 24 months.**

If you’re a builder who loves solving problems, working with data, moving fast and using AI to multiply your impact, this could be your next big opportunity.

**About Bambinos.live**

Bambinos.live is a Shark Tank India Season 4-backed live learning platform for children 4–15.

We serve 8,000+ students across India, the Middle East, and the US, with approximately 40% of our buyers being NRI families.

Our vision is to become the
**“Disney of Education”**
by building story-driven, gamified and immersive learning experiences delivered live by expert educators.

The Opportunity

**Role:**
General Manager / Category Lead

**Openings:**
4 — one for each business vertical

**Location:**
Bengaluru, HSR Layout | Work from Office

**Experience:**
2–5 years

**Education:**
B.Tech/B.E. from IIT or BITS, or MBA from IIM Ahmedabad, Bangalore or Calcutta, or ISB

**Reporting to:**
Founder & CEO

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Compensation:**
Competitive salary + ESOPs

Choose Your Vertical

We’re hiring one business owner for each of the following categories:

* **Languages:**
  Unbox English, Unbox Kannada, Hindi for NRI Kids
* **Spirituality:**
  Little Yogi, Bhagavad Geeta
* **Academics:**
  Unbox Math, Unbox Science, Olympiad Preparation
* **Extra-curricular:**
  Unbox Chess, AI for Kids

Each Category Lead will own the roadmap, economics and growth of their vertical, including launching new programs that address evolving customer needs.

What You’ll Own

**1. Business Strategy & P&L**

* Own revenue, gross margin and contribution margin for your vertical.
* Build annual and quarterly business plans covering targets, budgets, pricing and program mix.
* Track unit economics, including CAC, LTV, payback periods and educator cost per class.
* Make data-backed decisions on where to scale, optimise or discontinue initiatives.

**2. Growth & Revenue**

* Drive enrolments across India, the Middle East, the US and other international markets.
* Own the complete funnel: leads → demos → conversions → renewals.
* Partner with marketing on campaigns, content, channels and strategic partnerships.
* Build new revenue streams through schools, B2B partnerships, camps, workshops and program bundles.

**3. Product & Curriculum**

* Own the product roadmap across your vertical's programs.
* Translate parent and child insights into better learning experiences, formats and pricing.
* Take new programs from concept to launch, targeting the first 100 paying students.
* Partner with curriculum and product teams to improve learning outcomes and make progress measurable.

**4. Customer Experience & Retention**

* Own the complete parent and child journey, from demo and onboarding to learning progress and renewal.
* Improve parent NPS, attendance, completion and renewal rates.
* Identify churn drivers and close the loop on escalations, refunds and customer feedback.

**5. Sales & Conversion**

* Work closely with inside sales to sharpen pitches, scripts, objection handling and pricing.
* Establish and review conversion targets for your vertical.
* Equip counsellors with strong program knowledge and effective sales enablement.

**6. Educator Operations & Team Building**

* Build a high-quality educator pipeline ahead of business demand.
* Own educator onboarding, training, quality standards and performance management.
* Optimise capacity, scheduling and utilisation to ensure a consistent learning experience.
* Build and lead a lean, high-performing core team as the vertical scales.

AI-First Is How We Work

At Bambinos.live, AI is not an add-on. It is our default operating system.

We expect our Category Leads to build lean, efficient businesses where AI handles repetitive work and people focus on judgement, creativity and execution.

You will be expected to:

* Use ChatGPT, Claude and other AI tools daily for research, analysis, planning and decision-making.
* Build AI-powered workflows for curriculum drafts, assessments, presentations and content quality checks.
* Automate reporting and dashboards, using tools such as Metabase, SQL and BI platforms.
* Apply AI to sales enablement, lead scoring, parent communication and churn prediction.
* Use AI to improve educator screening, training, feedback and quality assurance at scale.
* Partner with product and technology teams to introduce AI learning experiences.

**Our default question: “Can AI do 80% of this?”**

We’re looking for people who demonstrate AI leverage through their work, not just those who list AI tools on their resumes.

How Success Will Be Measured

Your performance will be reviewed monthly, with quarterly goals aligned directly with the Founder & CEO.

Key measures include:

* **Business:**
  Progress towards $10M ARR, contribution margin and path to profitability.
* **Growth:**
  New enrolments, conversion rates and customer acquisition cost.
* **Retention:**
  Renewal rates, customer lifetime value and churn.
* **Customer experience:**
  Parent NPS, attendance and program completion.
* **Product:**
  New program launches and measurable learning outcomes.
* **Educator operations:**
  Quality, retention and utilisation.
* **AI leverage:**
  Revenue per team member, productivity and meaningful automation.

Your First 90 Days

In your first three months, you will:

* Develop a deep understanding of your vertical's customers, business metrics and unit economics.
* Present a clear 24-month roadmap towards $10M ARR.
* Deliver two measurable quick wins in conversion, retention or operational efficiency.
* Establish an AI-driven weekly business review and performance dashboard.

Who Should Apply?

**Must-have qualifications:**

* 2–5 years of experience in a high-ownership role, such as a founder's office, category or business management, growth, strategy or consulting.
* B.Tech/B.E. from IIT or BITS, or an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad, Bangalore or Calcutta, or ISB.
* Demonstrated ownership of business outcomes such as revenue, growth, conversion or margins.
* Strong analytical skills, including Excel/Google Sheets modelling, funnel analysis and familiarity with SQL or BI tools.
* Practical, demonstrable experience using AI tools to improve productivity and business outcomes.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work across customers, educators and cross-functional teams.
* A strong bias for action and comfort with ambiguity, accountability and fast-paced execution.

**Good to have:**

* Experience in consumer internet, EdTech, D2C or subscription businesses.
* Exposure to international customers, particularly NRI markets.
* Personal interest or expertise in languages, spirituality, mathematics, chess or related learning categories.
* Experience managing freelancers, educators or other distributed workforces.

What You’ll Get

* **Real business ownership:**
  Take responsibility for a complete business vertical early in your career.
* **Founder access:**
  Work directly with the Founder & CEO on strategy and execution.
* **Meaningful upside:**
  Competitive compensation with ESOPs.
* **Career acceleration:**
  A potential pathway to Business Head or CXO roles as your vertical grows.
* **AI-first environment:**
  Access to AI tools and the opportunity to build AI-powered business operations.
* **A meaningful mission:**
  Help shape how children learn, grow and discover their potential.

Our Hiring Process

1. Application review — CV and a short note on your preferred vertical.
2. Introductory conversation with the CEO's office.
3. Take-home case — develop a 90-day plan for one vertical using AI.
4. Case presentation and deep dive with the Founder & CEO.
5. Culture and reference conversations.
6. Offer.

Ready to Build Something Big?

If you want to move beyond managing tasks and start owning business outcomes, we’d love to hear from you.

It's a governed graph that lets any agent or platform, including Trail agents, make the right call on your most complex business processes. Agents today fail not because models are weak, but because they're never given the judgment a business builds up over years. We're fixing that.

Visit our Website and Youtube to learn more!

**The role**

This is a builder's role. You'll work closely with the leadership and sales teams to identify high-potential opportunities, run GTM experiments and unlock new channels for growth. From testing a new customer segment to experimenting with account-based marketing or exploring an untapped channel, you'll own initiatives end-to-end and turn what works into repeatable growth engines.

We're looking for someone smart, driven, and entrepreneurial — someone who takes initiative, moves fast, and is comfortable figuring things out without a playbook. Founder experience is a strong plus.

**What you'll do**

**1. Run GTM experiments**

* Identify promising customer segments, use cases, and GTM approaches for Trail and its products.
* Design and execute experiments to test new messaging, ICPs, outreach strategies, and conversion levers.
* Analyse results, identify what works, and rapidly iterate to improve qualified pipeline generation.

**2. Build and scale outbound motions**

* Develop targeted outbound strategies for enterprise accounts across relevant industries.
* Experiment with prospecting approaches, account prioritisation, messaging, and outreach tools.
* Work closely with AEs to turn insights from customer conversations into more effective prospecting and pipeline generation.

**3. Create new GTM channels**

* Identify and test new ways to reach enterprise buyers through conferences, events, account-based marketing, partnerships, communities, content-led acquisition, and emerging GTM tools.
* Take new initiatives from idea to execution, measure outcomes, and scale the channels that demonstrate traction.
* Explore unconventional approaches to reaching decision-makers and generating qualified opportunities.

**4. Own outcomes end-to-end**

* Track funnel performance, identify bottlenecks, and use data to make decisions.
* Build lightweight processes and repeatable playbooks around successful experiments.
* Work directly with leadership, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and taking ownership from strategy through execution.

**Who we're looking for**

* 5+ years with an undergraduate degree from a Tier 1 institute
* Founder or early-stage startup experience is strongly preferred. You've built something, taken an idea to market, or worked in an environment where you had to create your own playbook.
* You can break down ambiguous problems, identify the highest-impact opportunities, and turn ideas into action.
* You don't wait for instructions or perfect information. You take initiative, experiment quickly, and follow through.
* You understand how businesses buy, what drives customer decisions, and how to translate a product's value into demand.

title: Category Manager
description:
**About the company**

Treebo Hospitality Ventures (THV) is a hotel group operating with a mission of "democratising

the joy of travel". We focus on the affordable segments of the market — economy to

mid-market — to cater to the next 100 million travellers who will experience the joy of travel

over the next 10 years. We offer these guests a high-quality experience at an affordable price

point, with a portfolio of 800+ hotels across 120+ cities.

We operate through multiple brands catering to different sub-segments:

● Itsy (₹1000–1500)

● Treebo and Treebo Premium (₹1500–3000)

● Medalio, our newly launched affordable luxury brand (₹3000–6000 per night)

We are the most loved hotel chain in the affordable segment, with an average rating of 7.8/10

across independent review platforms — and we are just getting started

**About the Role**

The Category Commercial Manager – Hills is the category's chief strategist: the person who

figures out what actually makes a hill-station hotel perform, codifies it into a playbook, and

builds the knowledge base that lets the rest of the organization act on it consistently. This role is

less about running any single lever day-to-day and more about answering the "why" behind

performance — which factors separate a top-performing hill hotel from a struggling one — and

turning that answer into a repeatable, scalable set of actions.

Pricing execution sits with the central Revenue Management pricing team. Everything else that

drives hill-hotel performance — demand patterns, inventory strategy, positioning, marketing,

and policy — is this role's to understand, document, and turn into playbook guidance, working

closely with the teams who execute against it.

This is a high-visibility, senior individual-contributor role reporting into commercial leadership,

with regular exposure to QBR and senior management reviews.

**Key Responsibilities**

Strategy & Playbook Creation (core mandate)

● Diagnose what drives performance in the hills category — pull apart top-performing vs.

underperforming hotels within each cluster (Chikmagalur, Coorg, Ooty, Shimla, Manali,

etc.) and identify the specific, repeatable factors behind the gap

● Translate those findings into a living Hills Category Playbook: a structured, prioritized set

of "what to do" actions — by cluster, by season, by hotel maturity — covering everything

from listing content to demand planning to promotions

● Continuously test and refine the playbook: treat each intervention (a pricing change, a

new cancellation policy, a promotion) as an experiment, and feed results back into the

playbook rather than treating it as one-off

● Own the category's knowledge base — a single source of truth documenting what

works, what doesn't, and why, so that the logic doesn't live only in one person's head

and can be handed off, audited, and built on

● Build decision frameworks (e.g., "when a hotel's occupancy drops below X in season Y, do

Z") that let revenue management, marketing, and ops teams act on the playbook

without needing this role in every conversation

● Benchmark the hills category against comp sets and against Treebo's other categories

(city, business) to pressure-test which "hills-specific" factors are truly unique to the

category

Revenue Management (beyond pricing) — as playbook inputs

● Study demand seasonality by destination (long weekends, festival calendars, school

holidays, wedding/honeymoon seasons) and turn it into a demand-planning framework

the category can reuse year over year

● Define the category's point of view on inventory and availability strategy —

length-of-stay controls, minimum-stay/blackout dates, stop-sells, and overbooking

approach at high-demand properties — and document it in the playbook

● Define the category's channel mix and distribution strategy, and the market/segment

strategy (corporate vs. leisure vs. drive-in) by cluster and season

● Partner with the central pricing team on rate-uplift opportunities (e.g., properties priced

below comp set despite equal or better review scores), feeding them the category insight

behind each opportunity

● Investigate root causes behind Critical No-Show % and other NBV-leakage patterns at

sold-out properties, and codify the intervention playbook (ACQ or otherwise)

Marketing — as playbook inputs

● Determine what marketing actually moves the needle for hill destinations — content

quality, listing photography, promotions, campaigns — and document what works by

cluster and season

● Build the playbook for OTA visibility and content marketing (listing standards,

ranking/boost programs) in coordination with the Listing Intelligence workstream

● Design and run promotion/campaign experiments tied to seasonality, and record which

formats and offers actually lift occupancy and RevPAR

● Track marketing-driven demand signals (e.g., hotel detail view traffic by platform) to

figure out where marketing effort pays off, and build that into the knowledge base

Policy — as playbook inputs

● Determine the right cancellation, refund, and no-show policy stance for the category,

and document the reasoning and trade-offs (guest flexibility vs. NBV protection)

● Define the category's position on rate parity, minimum-stay, blackout, and

booking-window policy for peak-season dates

● Ensure category-level policy recommendations account for OTA platform requirements

and Treebo's broader commercial policy framework

Competitive & Market Intelligence

● Track ARI (Average Rate Index) and Review Index against comp sets for each cluster

● Turn competitive patterns into playbook guidance — e.g., what a competitor is doing

that consistently correlates with better performance, and whether it's worth adopting

Portfolio & P&L Management

● Own the regional P&L narrative for the hills category — revenue, cost-to-serve, and NBV

— and present waterfall/variance analysis in QBRs, tying performance back to playbook

adoption

● Prioritize which playbook interventions to push into which hotels, based on

impact-to-effort

● Partner with acquisition/onboarding teams to apply category learnings to new hotel

signings in high-potential hill destinations

Cross-functional Execution

● Work closely with central Pricing, Distribution, Marketing, OTA/Listing, Operations, and

Category teams — both to gather the inputs the playbook needs and to get playbook

guidance actually adopted

● Represent the hills category in AMJ/quarterly business reviews — own the narrative,

data, and playbook evolution

● Maintain the knowledge base and playbook as living documents, versioned and updated

as new evidence comes in

**What We're Looking For**

● 4–8 years of experience in revenue management, commercial strategy, or program

management in hospitality/ travel, or a marketplace/platform business preferred

● Strong analytical instincts: comfortable moving from raw performance data to "here's

the underlying reason" rather than stopping at the dashboard

● Demonstrated experience building frameworks, playbooks, or SOPs that other teams

adopted and used — not just one-off analyses

● Strong quantitative fluency: comfortable working with RevPAR, ARR, NBV, occupancy,

and P&L waterfalls without hand-holding

● Working knowledge of revenue management levers beyond pricing, OTA distribution

dynamics, and hospitality marketing/policy — enough to know what questions to ask,

even without owning execution of each

● Demonstrated ability to translate data into a clear commercial narrative for senior

stakeholders

● Advanced Excel/Sheets skills; comfort with dashboards (Mixpanel or similar) is a plus

● Willingness to travel periodically to hill-station clusters to validate playbook assumptions

on the ground

● Curious and rigorous by disposition — treats every intervention as something to be

tested and documented, not just executed

**What Success Looks Like (First 2 Quarters)**

● A first version of the Hills Category Playbook live and shared with commercial

leadership, covering demand planning, inventory strategy, marketing, and policy by

cluster

● A knowledge base documenting the specific factors that separate top- and

bottom-performing Hill hotels, with evidence behind each claim

● At least 2–3 playbook recommendations piloted with a measurable before/after read

(e.g., a promotion format, a policy change, a listing fix)

● A repeatable, cluster-level QBR reporting structure adopted by commercial leadership,

framed around playbook adoption and impact

description:
