title: Marketing Lead
description:
**About Origin**
 Origin (previously 10xConstruction) is building general\-purpose autonomous robots for US construction to tackle rising costs, safety risks, and labour shortages. Our modular, multi\-trade platform combines purpose\-built hardware with real\-time site intelligence to navigate complex environments and execute tasks with precision. Trained in high\-fidelity simulation and already deployed on live sites, our robots deliver 5x faster execution, 250%\+ margin expansion, and significant cost savings. Join India's most talent\-dense robotics team consisting of individuals from IITs, Stanford, UCLA, etc.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Marketing Lead, you will own how Origin is understood by contractors, developers, partners, press, and investors, and build the marketing function that turns that understanding into demand for OG1\.
   

  

 Construction robotics is an understood category. Origin's position inside it is not: one general\-purpose robot that performs every interior\-finishing trade starting with compound application, sanding, priming, and painting and adding other interior workflows, in a market conditioned to expect a separate machine for each task. Making that idea land is patient, repeated work, and it is the core of this role.
   

  

 You will define the positioning, build the awareness engine behind it, stand up always\-on demand generation that produces qualified conversations, find and win the stages where a working robot deserves to be seen, and hold every internal department and external agencies and partners to one visual and verbal system.
   

  

 Because Origin sells across India, the United States, Europe, and Asia Pacific, you will also build a marketing plan for each region rather than one global plan that fits none of them. You will have a Creative Content Producer working to your plan, alongside creative, content, and PR agencies and freelancers, and you will be the person who keeps all of them pointed at the same narrative and coordinated around the same release calendar. For the first year you are the marketing team: you will set the strategy and you will also fix the product page, write the brief, and staff the booth.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Positioning and Category Awareness
* Define Origin's category position, the proof behind it, what it displaces, and what it is routinely confused with
* Build audience\-specific message tracks for general contractors, interior and drywall subcontractors, developers and owners, partners, press, and investors
* Run a sustained awareness plan of explainers, demonstrations, comparisons, briefings, and formats that move audiences from "a robot that plasters and paints" to "a platform that does all interior works."
* Write and maintain objection handling for the questions that decide deals, including why a general\-purpose platform beats single\-task machines and manual crews
* Test messaging in real sales calls, pilots, partner meetings, and investor conversations, and change it on evidence rather than opinion
* Keep one approved boilerplate, product description, and narrative live across the website, decks, brochures, outbound, job postings, and investor material
* Build named, repeatable formats Origin owns outright, a series people subscribe to rather than stumble across, instead of campaigns that end and leave nothing behind
* Hold the line that renders explain and footage proves: claims about OG1 are backed by real site evidence, because the buyer has been sold construction robotics before and it did not work
* Demand Generation
* Build always\-on channels with playbooks, owners, budgets, and locked measurement, so pipeline does not depend on the event calendar
* Run a monthly campaign rhythm with documented experiments covering hypothesis, result, learning, and decision
* Own the website and product pages as working sales surfaces, not brochures
* Make Origin the source AI answer engines quote: canonical explainers targeting what a contractor actually asks, structured for search and for generative answers rather than written as keyword filler
* Own tracking, source capture, UTM discipline, and attribution hygiene end to end
* Report qualified conversations and cost per qualified conversation by channel and by region
* Route inbound enquiries to Sales quickly, with source, segment, and region recorded
* Events, Showcases, and Industry Presence
* Own the showcase portfolio across trade shows, pavilions, speaking slots, panels, awards, innovation programme, demo days, customer and partner site demonstrations, industry bodies, press and analyst briefings, and investor events
* Actively hunt for opportunities Origin is not already tracking, and qualify each on audience fit, buyer density, cost, and effort before committing
* Work every membership and sponsorship Origin already pays for until it delivers the visibility it promised
* Write and submit speaking abstracts, panel proposals, and award nominations against a tracked deadline calendar
* Run each committed appearance to a written brief agreed with the internal team and the event coordinator, covering objective, demo plan, staffing, collateral, lead capture, and follow\-up ownership
* Score every paid appearance against cost within thirty days, and make the renewal recommendation from that number
* Brand, Design, and Messaging Consistency
* Publish and maintain Origin's brand and messaging system, covering logo and colour usage, typography, imagery and robot photography standards, diagram conventions, templates, product naming, and approved terminology
* Roll the system out to Sales, Engineering, Hardware, Deployment, People, and leadership with the templates each team actually needs
* Review externally published technical material for terminology and message consistency without dulling its technical accuracy
* Make the compliant path the easy one through templates and a fast request route, rather than policing after the fact
* Keep design, messaging, and product naming consistent across web, decks, documents, event collateral, site signage, and technical documentation
* Product Marketing, Launches, and Campaign Coordination
* Build the launch playbook and run it on OG1 milestones, from positioning and proof through assets, channels, internal readiness, and post\-launch review
* Own the release calendar and coordinate every party against it — the Creative Content Producer, creative and content agencies, PR support, Sales, Deployment, and Engineering — so product milestones, content, events, and announcements land together rather than separately
* Write the single narrative brief that the content team, agencies, and freelancers all work from, so one campaign does not arrive in three different voices
* Run the approval and review flow for campaigns and releases, with clear owners, deadlines, and a final sign\-off that does not sit with the founders by default
* Equip Sales with the enterprise kit before they ask: pitch narrative, RaaS economics and ROI material, pilot evidence, case studies, compliance one\-pagers, and the objection library
* Maintain competitive positioning and comparison material against other construction robotics players and manual alternatives
* Support fundraising and partnership conversations with accurate, current narrative material
* Regional Marketing
* Write and run a marketing plan for each active market, covering the local buyer, the labor\-cost and ROI argument, the competitive set, regulatory message constraints, localization, channel mix, local events, and partner support
* Localize messaging rather than translating it, and validate it in\-market before scaling
* Report each region against its own baseline and recommend where budget should move
* Founder Voice and Employee\-Generated Content
* Run the founder\-voice programme: three co\-founders with genuinely distinct public voices and distinct territory — company thesis, autonomy and physical AI, hardware reality — supported to publish on a cadence without being flattened into one house tone
* Build and run an employee\-generated content programme across deployment, operations and engineering, with voice guides, prompt packs, capture kits, and an approval flow simple enough that nobody has to be a writer
* Keep the trust hierarchy straight: a post from a deployment lead on a live site does something a company page structurally cannot, and the programme should be designed around that
* Working With the Content Team, Agencies, and Partners
* Direct the Creative Content Producer against a quarterly plan tied to the awareness, launch, and demand priorities, and make sure they walk into a running system rather than a blank calendar
* Select, brief, review, and manage creative, content, video, PR, and design agencies and freelancers against a defined standard, a budget, and an agreed set of deliverables
* Coordinate in\-house and external creative on the same campaign without duplicated work or conflicting narratives, including where an agency owns production and Origin owns the message
* Hold external partners to measurable outcomes, review performance on a set cadence, and make the renew, renegotiate, or end call on evidence
* Work daily with founders, engineers, deployment, and sales to find the strongest stories and get them out quickly, and support each founder's public voice without flattening it into one house tone


****Must\-Haves****
* Five or more years in B2B marketing, including time owning the function, its number, and its budget rather than a single channel within someone else's plan
* Demonstrated product marketing experience: you have taken a product to market, not only run campaigns for one
* A track record of positioning work that outlasted you — messaging other people adopted and repeated
* Proven ownership of demand generation against a pipeline number, with the ability to state your cost per qualified conversation without a week's preparation
* Experience marketing to enterprise buyers with committee decisions and multi\-month sales cycles
* Ability to work hands\-on and strategically at the same time, in a company where there is no one else to hand the work to
* Strong writing: you can produce a positioning document, a launch plan, a one\-pager, and a conference abstract yourself
* Comfort with analytics, tracking, attribution, CRM, and marketing automation, and the discipline to keep the data clean
* Ability to hold your own with engineers, get a technical claim right, and make a complex physical product clear without flattening it
* The discipline to market on evidence rather than claims, to a buyer who has been promised this before: you reach for proof from real sites ahead of a better\-looking render, and you can tell the difference between marketing that argues with doubt and marketing that removes the reason for it
* Comfort enabling other people's voices — founders, engineers, operators — rather than putting everything through a single corporate channel
* Experience running events or field marketing as a pipeline channel, not as logistics
* Experience directing creative people and external agencies against a defined standard, and coordinating in\-house and outsourced creative on the same release without the work colliding
* Experience running a release or campaign calendar across several teams and holding it, including the unglamorous coordination that makes a launch land on one day rather than over three weeks
* Comfort working around engineers, hardware, robots, workshops, labs, testing areas, and live construction sites
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally, including to customer sites and trade shows
* Genuine interest in robotics, construction, startups, and physical products


****Good\-to\-Haves****
* Experience marketing a physical product in robotics, hardware, manufacturing, automotive, construction technology, industrial automation, or aerospace
* Experience selling into construction, real estate, infrastructure, or field\-service buyers
* Experience marketing a subscription, leasing, or as\-a\-service commercial model
* Experience building a brand and design system that technical teams actually adopted
* Experience running marketing across more than one country or region, including localization
* Experience with account\-based marketing against a named target list
* Experience building a category or evangelizing an unfamiliar product class
* Experience supporting fundraising with narrative and investor\-facing material
* Experience working with press, analysts, or industry associations
* Experience on the client side of an agency relationship — scoping, briefing, and getting real output from a narrative, content, or PR partner
* Experience with AI\-assisted marketing tooling used for real leverage rather than novelty
* Familiarity with construction workflows, jobsites, and industrial environments


****Application Requirement****
 Applicants must share examples of their own work: a positioning or messaging document, a launch plan, a campaign with its results, or a piece of enablement material you wrote.
   

  

 We are especially interested in work involving technical or physical products, unfamiliar product categories, enterprise buyers, and results you can attribute to your own decisions.
   

  

 Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short practical assignment on positioning and launching OG1\.
   

  

**What You'll Gain**
* The opportunity to define the category position of an early\-stage robotics company, rather than inherit one
* Ownership of an entire marketing function, its budget, and its first hires
* Direct work with founders, engineers, robots, customer demonstrations, and field deployments
* Experience marketing a physical, AI\-driven product into one of the world's largest and least digitized industries
* Exposure across sales, fundraising, partnerships, and product as marketing touches all of them
* International scope from day one, across India, the United States, Europe, and Asia Pacific

title: Strategic Partnerships
description:
**About Astra:** 




 Astra Security is a leader in the penetration testing space, recognized by G2 in the Pentest category. With headquarters in the US \& India, Astra is the trusted security partner for leading brands including Muthoot Finance, Loom, CompTIA, NIIT, Goldcast, HackerRank, Sprinto, ITC \& more. Its one\-of\-a\-kind continuous pentest platform is trusted by 1,200\+ companies across 100\+ countries, from fast\-growing startups to Fortune 100 giants.
 



 Astra's autonomous pentest platform pairs AI agents with certified human pentesters to continuously pentest applications and infrastructure at scale. Vulnerabilities are discovered, validated, and chained the way a real attacker would. Beyond pentesting, Astra's suite includes a DAST Scanner, Cloud Vulnerability Scanner, and API Security Platform, giving teams continuous coverage across web apps, cloud environments, and APIs from a single dashboard. With over 18,000 vulnerabilities detected daily, Astra helps customers prevent millions in potential losses while saving thousands of developer hours. Last year alone, Astra uncovered more than 6\.8 million vulnerabilities for its customers.
 



 Astra's research team actively contributes to the OWASP community, including helping shape the OWASP Autonomous Penetration Testing Standard (APTS) and contributing to the OWASP Top 10 for LLM and Generative AI Security Risks. Astra is CREST\-accredited, CERT\-IN empaneled, and a PCI ASV, reflecting its commitment to the highest standards of security testing.
 



 We've been awarded by the President of France Mr. François Hollande at the La French Tech program and Prime Minister of India Shri Narendra Modi at the Global Conference on Cyber Security. Loom, MamaEarth, Muthoot Finance, Canara Robeco, ScripBox etc. are a few of Astra’s customers
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 At Astra Security, we are building the future of cybersecurity with Autonomous Pentesting — helping teams continuously discover, validate, and fix vulnerabilities across their applications and infrastructure.
 



 We are looking for a Product Partnerships leader to build and scale Astra's ecosystem of technology partners across cybersecurity, SaaS, cloud, developer tools, compliance, and adjacent platforms.
 



 This is a high\-impact, commercially focused role where you will identify the right technology partners, unlock product integrations and marketplace opportunities, and build joint go\-to\-market motions that translate into measurable pipeline and revenue.
 



 You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to take partnerships from identification and negotiation through integration, launch, co\-selling, and revenue generation.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




**Build Astra's Product Partner Ecosystem** 



* Identify and establish partnerships with complementary SaaS, cybersecurity, cloud, developer, compliance, and technology platforms across key geographies.
* Build relationships with Product, Partnerships, Alliances, and GTM leaders within partner organizations.
* Develop a structured partner pipeline based on customer overlap, product fit, integration potential, and commercial opportunity.
* Own the end\-to\-end partnership lifecycle from prospecting and business case development to negotiation, launch, and ongoing growth.
* Build a scalable product partnership strategy across different geographies and partner segments.



**Drive Product Integrations \& Marketplace Partnerships** 



* Identify high\-value integration opportunities that strengthen Astra's product offering and increase customer adoption.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering to define integration requirements, priorities, and launch plans.
* Build partnerships that enable Astra to participate in technology marketplaces and partner platforms.
* Drive marketplace and platform\-sourced business by creating repeatable partner\-led acquisition motions.
* Track adoption, pipeline, and revenue generated through product integrations and technology partnerships.



**Build Joint GTM \& Co\-Sell Motions** 



* Develop joint value propositions, solution positioning, sales plays, and enablement with strategic partners.
* Work with Sales teams to identify and activate joint customer opportunities.
* Build co\-selling and co\-marketing motions that generate measurable partner\-influenced pipeline.
* Coordinate joint launches, webinars, campaigns, events, and other GTM initiatives where relevant.
* Establish processes to track partner\-sourced and partner\-influenced pipeline through the sales funnel.



**Drive Commercial Outcomes** 



* Directly own business outcomes from product partnerships, including partner\-sourced ARR and partner\-influenced pipeline.
* Identify opportunities to expand successful partnerships across additional products, customer segments, and geographies.
* Establish clear business cases and success metrics for each strategic partnership.
* Regularly measure partnership performance and double down on partnerships demonstrating strong customer and commercial impact.



**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Act as the internal owner and champion for strategic product partnerships.
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure partner initiatives move from concept to execution.
* Bring partner and customer feedback into Astra's product and ecosystem roadmap.
* Create repeatable processes for evaluating, launching, and scaling partnerships.



  





**Key KPIs** 




 Success in this role will be measured through tangible commercial and ecosystem outcomes, including:
 


* Marketplace / Platform\-Sourced ARR
* Co\-Sell / Co\-GTM Pipeline Generated
* Number of Product Partnerships Unlocked in Each Target Geography
* Product integrations launched and activated
* Partner\-sourced / partner\-influenced revenue
* Partner activation and adoption
* Expansion of successful partnerships across products and geographies



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Experience in Product Partnerships, Technology Partnerships, Strategic Partnerships, Ecosystem Partnerships, or Platform Partnerships.
* Strong experience in B2B SaaS, preferably cybersecurity or an adjacent technology category.
* Demonstrated experience building partnerships with technology products and SaaS platforms, rather than primarily reseller or channel relationships.
* Experience taking partnerships from identification → integration → marketplace / platform launch → joint GTM → revenue generation.
* Strong understanding of product integrations, APIs, marketplaces, technology ecosystems, and joint solution development.
* Demonstrated ability to build co\-sell and co\-GTM motions with sales teams.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience tying partnerships to measurable pipeline, ARR, adoption, or revenue outcomes.
* Experience working with US or global SaaS companies is highly preferred.
* Strong executive communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Builder mindset with the ability to operate in a zero\-to\-one environment, create processes from scratch, and independently drive initiatives to completion.

You develop a deep understanding of customer needs and use that insight to create meaningful solutions that drive long\-term value. You adapt your approach to identify new opportunities, think creatively, and respond effectively to evolving business and customer requirements.

* Demonstrated ability to work across global teams and influence without direct authority.
* Experience supporting global approved vendor list qualification efforts, Global Frame Agreement utilization, or licensor engagement programs at a local or regional level.

title: Head of Product - JustCall
description:
**Why this role exists** 




  





 Most product orgs optimize for what's already working. We're building JustCall's product function to define what comes next \- as AI reshapes how revenue teams communicate, the product decisions we make in the next 18 months will determine whether JustCall leads that shift or chases it.
 



  





 We are looking for a Head of Product who can sit across the table from an engineer, a sales leader, or a customer \- and walk out with a sharper problem statement, a bolder roadmap, and a team that ships with conviction. Someone who sets the vision, makes the hard calls, and raises the bar across every product surface they touch.
 



  





**What you'll actually do** 




  




* Own all product areas across JustCall \- setting strategy, driving execution, and scaling impact, reporting to the SVP of Product, Design and AI.
* Define product vision and align Engineering, Design, Marketing, and Sales around sharp priorities that translate into business outcomes and customer value.
* Ship high\-impact solutions at pace \- balancing long\-term platform thinking with the velocity to keep JustCall competitive.
* Build and grow a high\-performing PM team \- developing craft, accountability, and the next layer of product leadership.
* Translate customer needs into product decisions that move retention, engagement, and revenue \- not just ship features.
* Drive AI product direction across JustCall \- integrating AI capabilities into existing workflows in ways that feel inevitable, not bolted on.
* Define what great looks like for AI\-powered experiences in communication and revenue tooling \- and hold that bar across the org.
* Feed every insight back into strategy \- every customer conversation, every deal lost, every support ticket should sharpen the roadmap.



  





**What we're looking for** 




  




* 10\+ years of product leadership in SaaS, AI/ML, or platform products \- with 5\+ years managing PMs.
* Proven track record building complex, multi\-surface products across diverse stakeholders.
* Experience shipping AI\-powered products at scale \- with hands\-on familiarity with agentic or multi\-turn AI experiences.
* Strong understanding of AI systems and how to integrate them meaningfully into existing product portfolios.
* Deep customer empathy and the ability to turn user needs into sharp, high\-leverage product decisions.
* Operational rigor \- you deliver measurable improvements in quality, retention, and efficiency.
* Excellent judgment \- you know when to go deep, when to delegate, and when to push back.
* A genuine commitment to growing people and raising the craft bar across the team.



  





**Edges that help** 




  




* You've worked in CCaaS, CPaaS, CRM, or sales engagement environments \- you understand how reps, managers, and ops teams actually work.
* You have a strong background in voice and telephony products, or have shipped communication\-heavy workflows before.
* You've navigated a platform transition \- legacy to AI\-native \- and know what it actually takes to drive that transformation without breaking what works.
* You've influenced pricing, packaging, or GTM strategy alongside product decisions \- you think commercially, not just functionally.
* You've built in a multi\-product company and know how to create coherence across a portfolio without slowing teams down.



  





**How we work** 




  




* Outcomes over output. We measure product impact by retention curves, revenue influence, and customer trust \- not features shipped.
* High ownership from day one \- you'll shape the product org, not inherit a finished one.
* Fast cycles, real ambiguity, and the expectation that you bring a sharp point of view and move quickly on it.
* Competitive pay tied to the product vision you set and the impact you drive.



  





**The bigger picture** 




  





 JustCall is SaaS Labs' flagship product \- used by 6,000\+ businesses across 70\+ countries to run their customer conversations. We're backed by Peak XV and Base10 Partners, have crossed $40M ARR, and are building toward $100M with the team, the product, and the infrastructure to get there.
 



  





 If this is the role you've been waiting to find \- let's talk.
 



  





 SaaS Labs takes pride in being an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products, which is why we're committed to making hiring or any employment decision regardless of race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic.

 This role is not just about running ads.
 



  





 You will be responsible for Meta performance, marketing budgets, lead generation, analytics, reporting, CRM, WhatsApp automation, integrations and building systems that help us convert more leads into residents.
 



  





 If you enjoy looking at numbers, figuring out what is working, fixing what isn't, and building systems that make marketing more efficient this role is for you.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 



* Plan, execute and optimise Meta Ads campaigns across Facebook and Instagram with a strong focus on lead generation and conversions.
* Own monthly marketing budgets, campaign allocation and spend optimisation to maximise ROI.
* Track and analyse key performance metrics including CPL, CAC, lead quality, conversion rates, ROAS and occupancy impact.
* Build and maintain weekly and monthly performance reports and dashboards for management.
* Analyse the complete funnel from ad → lead → CRM → follow\-up → site visit → booking and identify areas for improvement.
* Work closely with the sales and operations teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
* Manage and optimise CRM systems and ensure accurate lead capture, routing, tagging, tracking and follow\-ups.
* Set up and manage WATI / WhatsApp automation for lead communication, follow\-ups, reminders and customer journeys.
* Work on CRM, WhatsApp, website and marketing platform integrations to ensure seamless movement of data across systems.
* Build automated workflows to reduce manual intervention and improve lead response and follow\-up.
* Set up tracking, pixels, events, UTM structures and other marketing measurement systems.
* Work with content and design teams to develop and test high\-converting creatives and messaging.
* Continuously run A/B tests across audiences, creatives, campaigns and landing pages.
* Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to improve campaign performance, reporting and marketing workflows.
* Build scalable marketing processes and systems as Union Living continues to expand.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 2–5 years of hands\-on experience in performance marketing, paid media, growth marketing or a similar role.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Meta Ads Manager — this is a must.
* Experience managing marketing budgets and taking ownership of campaign performance.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign and funnel data and make decisions based on it.
* Experience creating performance reports, dashboards and management\-level MIS.
* Strong understanding of lead\-generation funnels and conversion optimisation.
* Hands\-on experience with CRM platforms such as LeadSquared, HubSpot, Zoho or similar.
* Experience with WATI / WhatsApp Business API and automation is strongly preferred.
* Understanding of API/integrations and connecting CRM, WhatsApp, website and marketing systems.
* Good understanding of Google Analytics/GA4, pixels, tracking and UTM parameters.
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets and data.
* Strong coordination skills across marketing, sales, design and technology teams.
* Ability to independently identify a problem, figure out a solution and implement it.



  





**The Kind of Person We're Looking For** 




**You should be someone who doesn't just say:** 




**“The CPL has increased.”** 




  





**You should be asking:** 




 “Why has the CPL increased, where is the funnel dropping, what can we change, and how do we fix it?”
 


* We want someone who is analytical, curious, hands\-on and extremely execution\-oriented.
* Someone who can run a Meta campaign in the morning, analyse the numbers in the afternoon, fix a CRM workflow in the evening and come back the next day with a better system.



  





**Why This Role?** 



* You'll have direct ownership of a critical part of Union Living's growth engine.
* You'll work across Performance Marketing \+ CRM \+ WhatsApp \+ Analytics \+ Automation \+ Growth, with the opportunity to build systems from the ground up as we scale.



  





 If you like numbers, marketing, systems and making things work, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Growth Manager
description:
**Position:  Growth Manager** 




**Function: Growth / D2C / Marketing (Retention\+ CRM\+ P\&L)** 




**Industry Preference: D2C, FMCG, Nutrition, Wellness, Beauty, Personal Care, Lifestyle** 




**Location: Mumbai** 




**Experience: 7–10 years** 




**Reporting To: Director** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a commercially driven Growth \& Retention leader who can own the complete D2C growth charter with a strong focus on revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, retention, repeat purchases and P\&L management.
 



 The role will be responsible for building and scaling the D2C business by combining performance marketing, CRM, lifecycle marketing, customer segmentation, loyalty, CRO, analytics and commercial decision\-making.
 



 The ideal candidate should have experience working with a consumer\-facing brand, preferably within D2C, FMCG, nutrition, wellness, beauty, personal care or lifestyle, and should be comfortable operating at the intersection of growth, marketing, technology, analytics and business P\&L.
 



  





**1\. D2C Growth \& P\&L Ownership** 




 ·       Own the overall D2C revenue and P\&L, including revenue growth, gross margins, contribution margins, CAC, LTV and profitability.
 



 ·       Develop and execute annual and quarterly D2C growth strategy aligned with business objectives.
 



 ·       Identify opportunities to improve revenue, profitability, customer value and channel efficiency.
 



 ·       Own monthly growth targets and develop actionable plans to achieve them.
 



 ·       Monitor Revenue, AOV, CAC, LTV, ROAS, repeat rate, retention and contribution margin.
 



 ·       Drive data\-led decisions on marketing investments, product mix, promotions and customer segments.
 



  





**2\. Customer Acquisition \& Performance Marketing** 




 ·       Lead performance marketing across Meta, Google and other relevant acquisition channels.
 



 ·       Scale acquisition while maintaining a healthy CAC\-to\-LTV ratio.
 



 ·       Work with performance marketing teams/agencies to optimise campaign performance.
 



 ·       Develop strategies for customer acquisition and efficient media spends.
 



 ·       Diversify acquisition through organic, partnerships, SEO/AEO/GEO, referral and other growth channels.
 



 ·       Establish clear attribution and measurement frameworks.
 



  





**3\. Retention \& CRM** 




 ·       Own the complete customer retention and lifecycle marketing charter.
 



 ·       Increase repeat purchases, customer frequency, retention and LTV.
 



 ·       Develop lifecycle journeys for new, repeat, dormant, high\-value and churn\-risk customers.
 



 ·       Drive CRM through Email, WhatsApp, SMS, push and other relevant channels.
 



 ·       Build journeys covering onboarding, first\-to\-second purchase, replenishment, cross\-sell/upsell, win\-back, loyalty and VIP customers.
 



 ·       Use RFM, cohort and behavioural segmentation to personalise communication.
 



 ·       Track cohort\-level retention and identify opportunities to improve LTV.
 



  





**4\. Loyalty \& Monetisation** 




 ·       Build and scale loyalty, rewards, referral and membership programs.
 



 ·       Increase customer frequency and basket size.
 



 ·       Develop monetisation strategies that improve customer value without negatively impacting contribution margins.
 



 ·       Analyse loyalty adoption, repeat behaviour and profitability.
 



  





**5\. Growth Analytics \& Optimisation** 




 ·       Establish a growth dashboard covering the customer funnel.
 



 ·       Analyse cohorts, acquisition sources, retention curves and LTV.
 



 ·       Conduct A/B testing and CRO across website, landing pages, product pages, checkout and customer journeys.
 



 ·       Identify funnel drop\-offs and work with Product/Tech to improve conversion.
 



 ·       Build forecasting models for revenue, acquisition, retention and marketing spends.
 



 ·       Translate data into business recommendations for leadership.
 



  





**6\. Cross\-Functional Leadership** 




 ·       Work closely with Brand, Product, Creative, Technology, Analytics, Supply Chain, Finance and Operations.
 



 ·       Align growth initiatives with inventory, launches, pricing and promotional calendars.
 



 ·       Partner with Finance to track P\&L, contribution margins and marketing ROI.
 



 ·       Work with Product and Tech to improve D2C customer experience and conversion.
 



 ·       Lead internal teams and external agencies/vendors across growth, CRM, performance and partnerships.
 



  





**7\. Organic \& Emerging Growth Channels** 




 ·       Explore emerging acquisition channels beyond traditional paid media.
 



 ·       Develop SEO, AEO and GEO strategies to increase organic discovery and reduce dependence on paid acquisition.
 



 ·       Track traffic, conversion and revenue from organic and emerging search surfaces.
 



 ·       Identify new digital platforms, partnerships and consumer touchpoints contributing to D2C growth.
 



  





**Key KPIs** 




 ·       D2C Revenue Growth
 



 ·       P\&L / Contribution Margin
 



 ·       Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
 



 ·       Customer Lifetime Value (LTV)
 



 ·       LTV:CAC
 



 ·       Repeat Purchase Rate
 



 ·       Customer Retention
 



 ·       Revenue from Existing Customers
 



 ·       New Customer Acquisition
 



 ·       AOV
 



 ·       Purchase Frequency
 



 ·       ROAS / Marketing Efficiency
 



 ·       CRM Revenue Contribution
 



 ·       Conversion Rate
 



 ·       Cohort Retention
 



 ·       Loyalty Program Adoption \& Revenue
 



 ·       Organic Revenue Contribution
 



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 ·       7–10 years of experience in Growth, D2C, CRM, Retention, Performance Marketing or related consumer businesses.
 



 ·       Owned or significantly contributed to a D2C P\&L.
 



 ·       Hands\-on experience in customer retention and lifecycle marketing.
 



 ·       Experience managing performance marketing budgets and understanding CAC and ROAS optimisation.
 



 ·       Strong understanding of LTV, cohorts, RFM, retention and customer segmentation.
 



 ·       Experience building CRM automation and lifecycle journeys.
 



 ·       Strong commercial mindset and understanding of growth, revenue and profitability.
 



 ·       Comfortable working with data and making decisions based on analytics.
 



 ·       Experience managing cross\-functional teams and external agencies.
 



 ·       Able to operate in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment with high ownership.
 



  





**Preferred Industry Background** 




 D2C \| FMCG \| Nutrition \| Health \& Wellness \| Beauty \| Personal Care \| Food \& Beverage \| Lifestyle \| Consumer Internet \| E\-commerce
 



 Experience with a high\-frequency or repeat\-purchase consumer category would be an added advantage.
 



  





**Preferred Tools / Platforms** 




 Shopify \| CleverTap \| MoEngage \| WhatsApp Business API \| Meta Ads \| Google Ads \| GA4 \| Unicommerce \| Marketing Automation \& CRM Platforms
 



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 The person in this role will be expected to build a profitable and scalable D2C growth engine, where acquisition and retention work together—driving new customer growth while continuously increasing repeat revenue, LTV and contribution margins.
 



 This role is not a pure Performance Marketing or CRM role; it requires someone who can connect Growth \+ Retention \+ Analytics \+ Commercial/P\&L ownership into one business charter.
 



  





 Interested candidate can share their CV at
 **hr@aceblend.com**

title: National Head - Activations & BTL Marketing
description:
Position \-
 **National Head – Activations \& BTL Marketing** 




 Business \-
 **Consumer \& Commercial Bank** 




 Role Level \-
 **Vice President / Senior Vice President** 




 Experience \-
 **12\+ Years** 




 Function \-
 **Marketing – Activations \& BTL** 




  





 WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS
 



 Kotak's next phase of growth will be won market by market, community by community and customer by customer. This role will shape how the bank shows up in those moments, translating strategy into experiences that create trust, engagement and growth at scale.
 



  





**Role Purpose** 




 Kotak is seeking a seasoned marketing leader to build and lead the bank's national activation and engagement ecosystem.
 



 As the National Head – Activations \& BTL Marketing, the incumbent will be responsible for bringing Kotak's brands, propositions and customer experiences alive across markets through branch\-led marketing, customer engagement platforms, experiential activations, events, community outreach and hyperlocal marketing initiatives.
 



 The role sits at the intersection of marketing and business growth, transforming national strategy into market\-level impact. It will lead activation programmes that drive customer acquisition, deepen engagement, strengthen brand affinity and create sustained visibility across Consumer and Commercial Banking.
 



 Beyond programme delivery, the mandate is to build a scalable activation engine that empowers business teams and branches across the country to win in their local markets.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Build Kotak's National Activation Ecosystem
 


* Define the long\-term vision and strategy for BTL marketing, customer engagement and on\-ground activations across Consumer and Commercial Banking.
* Create scalable activation frameworks that can be deployed nationally while remaining relevant to local market opportunities.
* Establish activation marketing as a key driver of business growth, customer acquisition and proposition adoption.
* Build a differentiated market presence for Kotak through innovative customer engagement platforms and experiences.



 Lead Branch \& Regional Marketing Excellence
 


* Develop and institutionalise a national branch marketing framework across Kotak's network.
* Enable branch and regional business teams with scalable programmes that generate awareness, engagement and qualified leads within local markets.
* Drive hyperlocal marketing interventions tailored to regional opportunities, customer segments and business priorities.
* Partner with business and sales leaders to convert market opportunities into impactful activation plans.



 Drive Customer Acquisition \& Demand Generation
 


* Create activation programmes that support acquisition goals across Retail, Affluent, NRI, SME and Commercial Banking segments.
* Build market\-facing engagement programmes that generate qualified leads and improve conversion outcomes.
* Develop segment\-specific activation strategies to support key propositions and business priorities.
* Create clear and measurable linkages between marketing investment and business outcomes.



 Build Signature Customer Engagement Platforms
 


* Conceptualise and lead Kotak's portfolio of customer events, business forums, thought\-leadership platforms, community initiatives and experiential programmes.
* Develop proprietary properties and engagement platforms that strengthen customer relationships and improve brand salience.
* Create memorable experiences that reinforce Kotak's positioning and customer\-centric philosophy.
* Drive innovation across physical, digital and phygital engagement formats.



 Lead Execution at National Scale
 


* Oversee end\-to\-end implementation of activation programmes across multiple geographies and business segments.
* Build best\-in\-class execution capabilities through agencies, vendors and regional partners.
* Establish governance, operating rhythms and performance standards that ensure consistent delivery across markets.
* Drive operational excellence, process compliance, budget discipline and brand consistency.



 Measure Impact \& Build Capability
 


* Establish robust measurement frameworks to track activation effectiveness, lead quality and return on investment.
* Build a data\-led activation culture focused on learning, optimisation and continuous improvement.
* Identify emerging trends in experiential marketing, customer engagement and local market activation.
* Develop internal capabilities, playbooks and best practices that strengthen Kotak's activation ecosystem.



  





**Role Boundaries \& Collaboration** 




 This role owns the strategy and delivery of BTL marketing, experiential engagement, branch\-led marketing and national activation programmes. It will collaborate with the Alliances function where an existing alliance or partner requires activation support, while ownership of alliance strategy, partner identification, commercial negotiation and relationship management remains outside this role's mandate.
 



  





**Key Leadership Competencies** 




 Strategic Growth Orientation
 



 Translates business priorities into scalable market\-facing programmes that drive acquisition, engagement and revenue growth. Focuses on outcomes rather than activity volumes.
 



 Customer \& Market Centricity
 



 Brings a deep understanding of customer behaviour, market dynamics and regional nuances to create relevant and differentiated experiences.
 



 Enterprise Leadership \& Influence
 



 Builds alignment across business heads, regional leadership, sales, distribution, marketing and support functions. Influences successfully without direct authority.
 



 Commercial Acumen
 



 Understands business economics, channel dynamics and growth drivers. Makes investment choices with a clear view of customer value, ROI and commercial impact.
 



 Execution Excellence at Scale
 



 Leads complex, nationally distributed programmes while balancing speed, quality, consistency and governance.
 



 Innovation \& Continuous Improvement
 



 Challenges conventional approaches and creates new ways to engage customers, improve effectiveness and build competitive advantage.
 



 Data\-Led Decision Making
 



 Uses insights, analytics and performance measures to optimise programmes, allocate investment and improve outcomes.
 



 Building High\-Performance Teams
 



 Creates accountability, ownership and continuous learning. Develops talent and builds strong internal, agency and vendor partnerships.
 



 Stakeholder Management \& Executive Presence
 



 Communicates with clarity and confidence, engages senior leadership effectively and represents marketing priorities in strategic business discussions.
 



 Entrepreneurial Mindset
 



 Acts with ownership and agility, identifies opportunities and proactively builds new capabilities to support growth ambitions.
 



  





**Experience \& Qualifications** 



* 12\+ years of experience in BTL marketing, experiential marketing, trade marketing, branch marketing, customer engagement or demand generation.
* Proven experience leading nationally distributed activation programmes across multiple regions and customer segments.
* Strong experience partnering with large sales, branch and distribution organisations.
* Experience in banking, financial services, telecom, consumer goods, retail, hospitality or other large\-scale services organisations preferred.
* Demonstrated track record of driving customer acquisition, market development and measurable business impact through on\-ground marketing.
* Experience managing significant budgets, agencies, vendors and complex cross\-functional stakeholder networks.
* Postgraduate qualification in Marketing, Business Management or a related discipline preferred.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* A nationally scaled activation engine that strengthens Kotak's presence and local relevance across priority markets.
* Best\-in\-class branch and regional marketing capabilities across the network.
* Meaningful contribution to customer acquisition, lead generation and proposition adoption.
* Signature customer engagement platforms that differentiate Kotak in priority segments.
* Consistent, measurable return on activation investments.
* A culture in which activation marketing is recognised as a strategic growth partner to the business.



  





**The Leadership Profile We Are Looking For** 



* A growth\-oriented marketing leader, not simply a campaign or events manager.
* Equally comfortable discussing business strategy, customer acquisition and market development, and reviewing market\-level execution.
* Passionate about building Kotak's presence in local markets and creating customer experiences that drive measurable impact.
* Skilled at operating in a matrixed environment and mobilising large stakeholder groups towards a shared objective.
* Capable of building a nationally scaled activation engine that becomes a competitive advantage for the bank.



  





 BUILD THE ENGINE THAT TURNS KOTAK'S STRATEGY INTO MARKET IMPACT.
 



  





**Location:** 
 Mumbai

title: Marketing Manager
description:
***ABOUT THE COMPANY***




  





 Messe Berlin India is a subsidiary of Messe Berlin GmbH, one of the world’s leading trade fair and conference organisers. As part of Messe Berlin’s international network, Messe Berlin India is focused on developing and expanding the company’s presence in the Indian market through a growing portfolio of B2B exhibitions and conferences across key industry sectors.
 



  





***RESPONSIBILITIES***




  





 We are looking for a creative, organised, and detail\-oriented Marketing Manager to join our team in India. The role will be responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies across Messe Berlin India’s growing portfolio of B2B exhibitions and conferences.
 



  





 The ideal candidate is a strong communicator with excellent project management skills, a keen eye for detail, and the ability to manage multiple campaigns across different industry sectors in a fast\-paced, international environment.
 



  





 Experience in the travel and tourism and/or fresh produce sectors would be an added advantage.
 



  





 Key responsibilities include:
 


* Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns to drive event awareness, exhibitor engagement, visitor registrations, and audience growth.
* Develop compelling marketing copy and content for websites, EDMs, advertisements, social media, brochures, and other campaign materials.
* Plan, execute, and optimise targeted email and digital marketing campaigns across different audience segments.
* Work closely with Sales, Conference, Partnerships, and Project teams to develop clear and effective messaging aligned with each event's commercial and audience objectives.
* Oversee creative direction and content development to ensure consistency with event and corporate brand guidelines.
* Manage event websites and digital content, ensuring information remains accurate, engaging, and aligned with campaign objectives.
* Monitor campaign performance using Google Analytics and other reporting tools, providing insights and recommendations to improve marketing effectiveness.
* Coordinate marketing timelines, budgets, deliverables, and campaign activities across assigned events.
* Manage external agencies and vendors, including PR agencies, designers, photographers, videographers, printers, and digital partners, ensuring timely and high\-quality delivery.
* Support industry partnerships, media collaborations, roadshows, and other promotional activities to strengthen event visibility and market reach.



  





***QUALIFICATIONS***



* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in B2B marketing, exhibitions, event marketing, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing, content marketing, email marketing, and social media.
* Experience with EDM platforms such as Mailchimp and other digital marketing tools.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics, campaign reporting, and performance analysis.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail.
* Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.
* Creative mindset with the ability to develop engaging and commercially effective marketing campaigns.
* Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator; knowledge of Adobe InDesign and Photoshop would be an advantage.
* Experience working within an international or multicultural business environment would be an advantage.



  





***WHY JOIN US?***




  





 At Messe Berlin India, you will be part of a growing international exhibition business with the opportunity to work across established event brands as well as new launches in the Indian market. You will collaborate with colleagues and partners across Messe Berlin’s international network and contribute to the development and growth of our exhibition portfolio in India.
 



  





 If you are ready to take the next step in your career in the exhibitions and events industry, we would be pleased to hear from you. Send your application to hr@messe\-berlin.in
 **.** 




  





*\*\*Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. We thank all applicants for their interest in joining Messe Berlin India.*

 The Jr. Social Media Manager will support the planning, creation, execution, and management of MultiFit's social media content. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of Instagram and short\-form video content, be comfortable coordinating shoots, and have the creativity to turn fitness, trainers, events, campaigns, and brand stories into engaging digital content.

 Key Responsibilities1\. Content Creation \& Shooting

* Identify interesting moments, trends, and stories that can be converted into social media content.
* Work with trainers and internal teams to capture authentic, engaging fitness content.
* Assist in planning shoot requirements, locations, props, talent, and content flow.


 2\. Reels \& Video Execution
 * Create and execute Instagram Reels and other short\-form video content.
* Develop strong hooks and content ideas suited to current social media trends.
* Coordinate the complete reel execution process—from ideation and scripting to shooting, editing coordination, and publishing.
* Understand basic video editing requirements and work with editors wherever required.
* Repurpose existing video content into multiple social media formats.
* Keep track of trending audio, formats, transitions, challenges, and content styles relevant to the fitness and lifestyle industry.


 3\. Social Media Calendar \& Posting
 * Create and maintain weekly/monthly social media content calendars.
* Plan content around brand priorities, campaigns, events, festivals, launches, offers, and important fitness\-related dates.
* Ensure timely posting of reels, posts, carousels, stories, and other content.
* Coordinate with designers, video editors, trainers, and other stakeholders for timely content delivery.
* Maintain consistency in brand tone, visual communication, messaging, and posting frequency.


 4\. Content Writing \& Basic Scripting
 * Write engaging captions, social media copy, hooks, headlines, CTAs, and basic video scripts.
* Develop simple and engaging scripts for reels, trainer videos, educational content, interviews, and campaigns.
* Adapt content according to different social media platforms.
* Proofread content and ensure accuracy before publishing.
* Develop creative content ideas that communicate fitness and wellness concepts in an easy\-to\-understand manner.


 5\. Day\-to\-Day Social Media Management
 * Manage the daily execution of MultiFit's social media handles.
* Schedule and publish approved content.
* Monitor comments, messages, mentions, tags, and audience interactions.
* Coordinate with relevant teams for responses to customer queries or social media interactions.
* Track trending topics and identify opportunities for real\-time content.
* Monitor competitor and industry activity to identify relevant content opportunities.
* Ensure all published content follows MultiFit's brand guidelines.


 6\. YouTube Content Execution
 * Assist in planning and executing YouTube content.
* Coordinate shooting and publishing of YouTube videos, Shorts, trainer content, interviews, workout videos, and event\-related content.
* Write basic titles, descriptions, captions, and content copy for YouTube.
* Repurpose long\-form videos into Shorts and other social media formats.
* Maintain a consistent YouTube content pipeline.


 7\. Events \& Campaign Content
 * Support social media execution for events, fitness challenges, workshops, launches, collaborations, and campaigns.
* Capture real\-time content during events, including stories, reels, interviews, and behind\-the\-scenes footage.
* Coordinate pre\-event, live\-event, and post\-event content.
* Work with the marketing and event teams to ensure campaign communication is executed on time.
* Generate quick\-turnaround content during events and important brand activities.


 8\. Social Media Trends \& Performance
 * Stay updated with Instagram, YouTube, and other relevant platform trends.
* Regularly research trending formats, content styles, sounds, hashtags, creators, and competitors.
* Monitor basic performance metrics such as reach, views, engagement, shares, saves, and follower growth.
* Identify high\-performing content and suggest ideas for improving future content.
* Assist in preparing basic social media performance reports.


 Required Skills
 * Strong understanding of Instagram, Reels, Stories, YouTube, and other major social media platforms.
* Good content ideation and creative thinking skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Basic copywriting and scripting ability.
* Good understanding of short\-form video content.
* Ability to identify and adapt social media trends quickly.
* Basic knowledge of video editing tools such as
 **CapCut, VN, Premiere Pro, Canva** 
 , or similar tools is preferred.
* Basic photography/videography skills will be an advantage.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and manage multiple content requirements simultaneously.
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.

 What We Are Looking For

 in social media, content creation, digital marketing, media, or a related field.

title: Brand Strategy & Social Media Intern
description:
Punekar Group is now expanding into the cosmetics and beauty sector through a new consumer venture, The Beautè Project.
 



 The venture is focused on building an affordable premium beauty brand for the next generation of Indian consumers, combining contemporary brand thinking with Indian beauty and wellness knowledge.
 



 At this stage, we are building the fundamentals of the venture, including consumer research, category strategy, brand positioning, communication, social media and go\-to\-market planning.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The Brand Strategy \& Social Media Intern will work closely with the Founder’s Office on the development of The Beautè Project’s brand strategy, digital presence and marketing initiatives.
 



 The role combines strategic research, consumer insights, content development, social media and execution. The intern will be expected to contribute to how the brand is positioned, communicated and presented to its target audience, while also supporting the execution of day\-to\-day marketing initiatives.
 



 This is a hands\-on role suited to someone who wants exposure to both the strategic and creative sides of brand building, with the opportunity to work across research, campaigns, content, social media and brand development.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* **Brand Strategy \& Market Intelligence:** 
  Conduct structured research across beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness and Ayurveda categories; analyse competitors, consumers, emerging trends and market dynamics to identify insights relevant to brand positioning and growth.
* **Brand \& Content Development:** 
  Translate consumer and market insights into brand narratives, content concepts, social media ideas, communication themes and content calendars across relevant digital platforms.
* **Campaign \& Brand Activation:** 
  Support the development and execution of campaigns, product launches, influencer initiatives, photoshoots and other brand\-building activities in coordination with creative teams and external partners.
* **Social Media \& Digital Strategy:** 
  Track relevant social trends, creators, formats and platform developments; contribute to the development of a consistent and differentiated digital presence.
* **Performance \& Business Insights:** 
  Monitor content and campaign performance, identify key learnings and contribute to internal reports, presentations and recommendations for future initiatives.
* **Project \& Stakeholder Coordination:** 
  Work with designers, creators, influencers, vendors and other stakeholders to drive timely execution, manage follow\-ups and maintain quality across multiple projects.



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 We are looking for individuals who demonstrate structured thinking, commercial awareness, creative judgment and a strong bias towards execution.
 


* **Academic Background:** 
  Master’s degree in 
 **Marketing, Management, Business Administration, Communications or a related discipline from a Tier\-1 business school or leading institution** 
 .
* **Strategic \& Analytical Thinking:** 
  Ability to understand a business or marketing problem, conduct structured research and translate observations into clear, actionable insights.
* **Creative \& Consumer Orientation:** 
  Strong interest in brands, consumer behaviour, cosmetics, lifestyle and digital culture, with an ability to identify what makes communication relevant, distinctive and engaging.
* **Communication \& Collaboration:** 
  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate ideas clearly and work effectively with creative and business stakeholders.
* **Ownership \& Execution:** 
  Takes initiative, manages responsibilities independently, demonstrates strong attention to detail and follows through from idea to execution.
* **Learning Agility:** 
  Curious, commercially aware and comfortable working in a fast\-paced entrepreneurial environment where priorities evolve and new challenges require quick learning.



  





 Familiarity with Canva, CapCut, Instagram, LinkedIn, Meta Business Suite or other content and marketing toolsis an advantage.
 



  





 If you are someone who notices why certain brands stand out, thinks about why consumers respond to particular communication, follows the evolution of beauty and digital culture, and wants to understand brand building beyond textbooks, this role could be a strong fit.
 



  





 Interested candidates may share their CV along with relevant proof of work, portfolio, social media pages or previous projects at: office@punekargroup.com

title: Head of Marketing
description:
**Overview:** 
 Sellability is on an aggressive, market\-redefining growth trajectory, with development mandates spanning residential, commercial and mixed\-use projects. We're a merit\-driven, entrepreneurial team — the kind of place where ambitious, hard\-working people get real ownership early, not after they've proven themselves for years. At Sellability, you don't just build a job, you build a legacy: fast\-tracked career growth, structured mentorship, exposure to marquee developers, and a direct hand in redefining how real estate is sold and marketed in India.
 



  





 Our projects demand year\-round market activation and sustained brand salience. As we serve an AOP of INR 5000 Cr\+ and growing, Marketing carries a real mandate: project branding, launch and sustenance support, and constant innovation. This role will own consumer and media understanding, inventory\-linked activations, MARTECH adoption, campaign management, SOP creation, AOP strategy, ATL/BTL/Digital coordination, PR and brand communication, and a roadmap across our live markets. About the role: You will be responsible for every brand in our portfolio, across Pune, Mumbai, overseas, and NRI markets. You will plan activations around inventory, run loyalty initiatives timed to project delivery milestones, and build word\-of\-mouth that actually works. You will conceptualize and execute a full communication and activation plan and build the growth strategy that drives demand and new customer acquisition across every channel, from mass and brand campaigns to search, digital, PR, outbound and affiliate marketing. You will fire up every distribution and support vertical needed to move sales across our products and markets.
 



  





 What you will own:
 



  





 Brand Marketing
 



 • Be the custodian of the brand. What Sellability stands for rests on your shoulders, and that's a responsibility we take seriously.
 



 • Keep the brand alive and charismatic. Build campaigns that reinforce what we stand for and bring genuine creativity to how we talk to our customers.
 



 • Drive performance marketing: ideas and initiatives across offline and online campaigns that convert into new registrations, working closely with the performance marketing team. Agency \& Partner Management
 



 • Lead agency relationships with the confidence of someone who has run a top marketing team before. You know how to brief an agency and pull real creative output from them.
 



 • Manage digital influencers and turn them into creative, viral campaigns across social platforms. • Partner with content developers to build strong content across media platforms.
 



 • Handle offline media relationships, both content and advertising. Entrepreneurial Drive
 



 • Bring an entrepreneurial mindset to new initiatives and MARTECH. We've already launched community platforms and educational content platforms for our customers, and there's more to build.
 



 • Lead a team of designers, content writers and external freelancers to deliver stories that do justice to the brand.
 



 • Work cross\-functionally with business and functional teams, translating requirements into crisp, actionable briefs for your team and agencies.
 **Business Ownership** 




 • Build and run the SOPs for your department.
 



 • Own the annual marketing budget and its effective utilisation, including short and long\-term scheduling, media split and resourcing.
 



 • Conceptualise and execute campaigns end to end.
 



 • Plan, execute and monitor all ATL/BTL promotions, marketing database, digital, email, social and display advertising across the portfolio.
 



 • Build growth frameworks for long\-term planning and scalable solutions, while enabling rapid daily experimentation and micro\-optimisation.
 



 • Build team capability across our marketing tech stack, including experimentation, data and CRM platforms.
 



 • Design and run comprehensive test and measurement plans that improve the effectiveness of growth initiatives.
 



 • Build the planning function for growth, defining success metrics and tracking goals at a granular level.
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 • 12\-18 years of relevant experience in a dynamic, growing organisation, with strong proficiency across brand marketing, PR, content management, digital and performance marketing.
 



 • Tech savvy, with a strong grip on brand planning, consumer insights, market intelligence, business models and budget management across geographies.
 



 • A strategic mindset that sees the big picture and reads how environmental and organisational change affects the business. • Strong business acumen paired with high EQ.
 



 • Sound judgement, with integrity, compliance and confidentiality as non\-negotiables.
 



 • A self\-starter who can operate independently, set priorities and drive results with minimal supervision.
 



 • Excellent time management and the ability to multi\-task and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
 



 • Meticulous attention to detail while managing multiple stakeholders seamlessly.
 



 • Strong decision\-making with a genuine ownership mindset.
 



 • Someone who leads with process and data but adapts when the situation calls for it. You take initiative, collaborate freely, and care about growing the team and the culture around you as much as the numbers.
 



  





**Why Sellability** 




 • Growth without limits — Real leadership scope from day one: shape the brand strategy for a portfolio scaling toward INR 5000 Cr\+, with direct exposure to marquee developers and large\-scale launches.
 



 • Performance with rewards — A merit\-driven culture where your strategy, your calls and your outcomes are visible at the top, not buried in a hierarchy.
 



 • Collaborative culture — Work directly with founder\-level leadership, in a transparent, "one team" environment built for people who want to build, not just execute.
 



 • Purpose \& impact — Own the brand for one of the most ambitious portfolios in the market, with the mandate to redefine how real estate is sold and marketed in India.

**Ciklum**

 We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
 



**About The Role** 




 We are seeking a seasoned, high\-impact an Associate Director Domain Consulting to anchor and scale our Retail \& Consumer Goods (RCG) vertical. With 12–15 years of industry expertise, you will act as the core consultative bridge between our global clients business challenges and our advanced IT and Digital Engineering services. In this role, your primary responsibility will be up\-front business consulting, proactive discovery, and strategic advisory. You will lead high\-value presales engagements, shape proactive transformational pitches, and author industry\-specific solutions across Digital Experience, Merchandising, and E\-commerce ecosystems. You will partner closely with Regional Sales Leaders and Technical Solution Architects to accelerate pipeline conversion and position our firm as an elite digital transformation partner.
 



**Responsibilities** 



1. **Domain Consulting \& Advisory (50%)**


* Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the global designated authority on modern RCG workflows, driving the foundational business strategy across:



 Digital Experience: Personalization engines, loyalty frameworks, omnichannel customer journeys, and next\-generation smart\-store tech
 



 Merchandising: Inventory optimization, automated assortment planning, dynamic pricing strategies, and end\-to\-end supply chain visibility
 



 E\-commerce Ecosystems: Modern headless/composable commerce architecture, global marketplace integrations, and frictionless checkout optimization
 


* Discovery Workshops: Architect and lead consultative discovery sessions with enterprise\-tier prospective clients to unearth hidden operational pain points and map out actionable digital transformation roadmaps
* Strategic Client Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to prospective client executives, bridging the gap between their business pain points and our technical delivery capabilities long before an RFP is issued



**Presales, Bid Advisory \& Solutioning (35%)** 



* Own the Domain Story: Author end\-to\-end functional and business solutions for complex RFPs, RFIs, and high\-value proactive pitches within the RCG space
* Value Proposition Engineering: Translate traditional retail business challenges into cutting\-edge Digital Engineering, Cloud, Data, and AI solutions
* Deal Governance: Partner closely with Regional Bid Managers and Technical Architects to ensure final engineering designs map perfectly back to the client’s expected business value outcomes
* Defense \& Presentation: Lead orals and solution defense sessions with global prospect stakeholders (C\-level, VPs, Directors) to instill absolute confidence in our vertical capability



**Collateral \& Capability Building (15%)** 



* IP Development: Author forward\-looking white papers, case studies, point\-of\-view (POV) documents, and reusable retail\-specific capability frameworks
* Market Intelligence: Collaborate with the Enablement/Research team to analyze global retail trends, tech disruptions, and competitive landscapes to continuously optimize our market messaging
* Sample KRAs: Deal Win Ratio \& Conversion, Revenue Generation \& Pipeline Influence, Consulting Billability \& Utilization, Thought Leadership \& IP Creation, Solution Quality \& Stakeholder CSAT



**Requirements** 



* Overall Experience: 12–15 years of professional IT/Digital Services experience, with a minimum of 10\+ years dedicated strictly to Domain Consulting, Pre\-sales, \& Solutioning within the RCG domain
* Services Portfolio: Proven track record of winning large\-scale deals in Digital Engineering, Custom Application Development, Cloud Migrations, and Data/Analytics environments
* Domain Track Record: Demonstrable portfolio of shaping solutions across E\-commerce platforms (e.g., Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe/Magento, Commercetools, or custom MACH setups), Unified Merchandising systems, and Digital CX platforms
* Core Competencies:
* Consultative Selling: Ability to pivot fluidly from a high\-level business strategy conversation with a retail Chief Marketing/Operating Officer to a technical alignment discussion with a Chief Architect
* Communication \& Presence: Exceptional verbal, written, and narrative storytelling skills. Ability to write clear, compelling proposal responses that avoid technical jargon where appropriate
* Collaborative Mindset: Experience working in a global matrixed environment, seamlessly orchestrating inputs from localized sales reps, technical leads, and shared enablement utilities
* Education:
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
* An MBA or equivalent post\-graduate management degree from a tier\-1 institute is highly preferred



**What’s in it for you?** 



* Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open\-door environment
* Growth focus: Take on large\-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
* Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company\-paid certifications
* Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands\-on experience with cutting\-edge technologies
* Care: We’ve got you covered with company\-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial \& legal consultations



**About Us** 




 At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting\-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
 



 India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game\-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.
 



**Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!** 




 Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.
